Utilize Tricky's expressive, free-form moveset to explore the various worlds of the Astral Plane, all inspired by the library of a certain ill-fated 6th gen console.

title: My Time at Evershine
description: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

title: Children of Saturn
description:
A found footage coming-of-age story about a group of teenagers growing up under an orange sky.

CHILDREN OF SATURN blends first person adventure gameplay with real video recordings to tell an authentic slice of life story.

title: Love in Space
description: It is the year 2009. A short time after "the incident". Mankind has fled the scorched crusts of planet earth for a better life in space. Those unlucky few who still reside on earth are forced to live beneath the sea in leaky metal domes. This includes you... 50% Visual Novel - 50% Karaoke-Musical.

title: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
description: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

title: The Standard Model
description: The Standard Model is a narrative walking simulator/slice-of-life game set in different worlds throughout the multiverse. The player takes on the role of an undergraduate student that gets to explore and experience 5 different worlds on a quantum adventure.

title: Ties: Soul Link
description:
TIES: Soul Link is an Emotional and Brutal 2D Metroidvania, combining Action RPG elements with Adventure Platformer.
An exciting story of resilience and overcoming fears. Explore incredible cities in a world in decline, set in the year 2097, full of secrets and with brutal and bloody gameplay.

title: LavaLoop
description: LavaLoop is a music-driven shoot'em up, in a hand-drawn Steampunk universe. Face a mad queen and destroy the planet killing machine. Play as three musician fighters and jump from surprise to surprise in this unique fantasy universe.

title: Alchemic Beasts
description: Alchemic Beasts is a monster taming RPG adventure where you breed and transmute creatures using alchemy to forge powerful monsters. Join Zeig, a thrill seeking daredevil, as he harnesses his alchemic beasts to defeat the creature known as the legendary Demon King.

title: Drift Boom Boom
description: Drift Your way around 40+ Race Courses, BOOM Fire missiles, shotguns, and more, Boom Blow up your friends in Split-Screen. Just watch out behind you on the final lap!

title: Machina of the Farthest
description: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

title: The Joy of Creation
description:
The classic Five Nights at Freddy’s fan-game returns, rebuilt from the ground up to offer a modern and immersive horror experience with real-time graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5.

The Joy of Creation puts you in the shoes of The Creator, a game developer forced to confront the manifestations of his own mind throughout five unique levels, each with a unique blend of free-roaming and classic sit-and-survive gameplay mechanics.

This game is officially backed by Scott Cawthon as part of the Fazbear Fanverse Initiative.

title: Code Exit
description: Enter Pantheon, a futuristic city swallowed by darkness and ruled by a rogue AI. Team up with up to 4 players and survive an adaptive pursuer that learns from every mistake. Complete the mission, uncover Minerva’s secrets, and find a way out before the city consumes you.

title: Angel
description: Angel is a rhythm-racing adventure in which digital climate change threatens the eCho network with extinction. Players can propel through digital landscapes, crafting new break beats to infuse a stagnating network with the spark of renewal. Angel imbues the flow state of racing with the complexity of breakbeat music, redefining arcade and combo-based gameplay and enhancing it with a soundtrack from MyraTV and many other breakbeat enthusiasts.

title: OCRPG
description: An Arcade Styled RPG with surprises, laughs and horrors at every turn.

title: Hexplorando
description: Discover the landscape and cultural heritage of Spain in this cozy 3D puzzle game where each region is a puzzle that brings art, territory, and history to life. Unlock heritage elements you can use in a limitless creative sandbox mode, with procedural quests to help you unleash your creativity.

title: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure
description: Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve problems as the dungeon’s janitor. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon.

title: Vignettes: The Dream City
description: Vignettes: The Dream City is a first-person surreal dream-crawler game featuring turn-based combat, knowledge-based gameplay, non-linear exploration, and souls-like progression. Your dreams are haunted by a strange city, and you feel supernaturally drawn to explore it. What will you find within?

title: Dark Lessons
description: Can you survive your teacher in this psychological horror game? With only candles for light and trapped in her home, you have to uncover her family's dark secrets. Solve puzzles, connect the dots and escape. But beware: There is someone else playing games with you, and someone who needs your help.

title: Tidebound
description: Tidebound is a fishing and inventory management game with a relaxing, casual atmosphere. Catch, sell, upgrade your boat, and sail further to catch more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour
description:
It's time for crazy driving, crazy adventure, and crazy money! Crazy Taxi is back and going global!

In this new high-octane adventure, follow Axel as he chases down the mysterious masked villains who stole his beloved taxi. Tackle extreme missions around the world all while earning some CRAZY money!

title: Kemuri
description: Kemuri summons you into a realm where the unpredictable meets the extraordinary in an urban jungle where mysterious creatures - Yokai- hide amongst the population. Become a Yokai Hunter and use your Fox Window to unravel the mysteries of the city and bring balance to the world. Dive into a thrilling adventure alone or with friends, hunt yokai in style, collect their powers and face even greater challenges.

title: Vivarium
description: You wake up and find yourself in an enormous terrarium. Explore, meet characters, and grow your escape - and along the way, uncover the mysteries of the terrarium as well. Vivarium is an adventure game about finding where you belong while surviving in a familiar yet alien environment.

title: Forgery Craft
description: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.

title: Kidbash: Super Legend
description: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

title: Mimic
description: A multiplayer survival horror game where players must choose their allies carefully to survive imminent danger. In this social-deduction game players won't know who to trust with their lives.

title: World of Warcraft: The Last Titan
description: The third of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

title: Last Hour of an Epic to the Moon RPG
description: You like RPGs, but don't have time to play it all. . . We like RPGs, but don't have time to make it all. . . So here's (only) the last hour of an Epic RPG !!

title: Herosbine: The Unknown Island
description: A story-driven open world, action-adventure RPG set on a mysterious island where the player takes on the role of Tim. Tim is living a normal life as a geeky, introverted boy. He is struggling with his identity and the loss of his best friends, and feels out of place.

title: Clown Meat
description: Clown Meat is a Precision Platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and replayability. Tumble through a butchered world where humanity is barely a memory on your naïve journey to cheer up the monolithic clown that came from the Depths of Jupiter.

title: Inferius
description: Descend into the underworld of "INFERIUS," a first-person, card-based game inspired by The Divine Comedy. Solve puzzles, battle creatures, and reclaim your soul in an ever-draining health race. Unleash strategic card combat and descend through 9 haunting levels on a journey of redemption.

title: October Nightmares
description: Explore a Montréal neighborhood in the 70s, investigate a supernatural phenomenon that inflicts nightmares on its residents, and delve into the depths of the world of dreams to save their lives. October Nightmares is a point & click cosmic horror game where exploration mixes with puzzle solving.

title: Hyper Tanks
description: Choose your tank and fight in neon-lit arenas where shots ricochet off walls! Beat challenging campaigns solo or in co-op, or battle your friends and bots in classic multiplayer modes. Use powerups, special weapons and tank abilities to survive the mayhem of Hyper Tanks!

title: Mononoke no Kuni
description: Through free village building and boat trips, this 3D open-world action game adds the fun of discovering and exploring unknown islands, as well as the tension and strategy of roguelite dungeon crawling!

title: Beaten Path
description: Beaten Path is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a world ruled by fallen gods and ancient machines. Take command of Panna and her companions as they unravel the secrets of time, confronting lost memories, mythic powers, and a looping fate.

title: Undefeated: Genesis
description: The ultimate superhero experience. Fly freely and unleash your awesome powers as you battle violent mutants to save an alien planet.

title: The God Slayer
description: The God Slayer is an open-world action RPG featuring a highly immersive gameplay system and story experience, allowing players to enhance their abilities through battles and world exploration with the ultimate goal of defeating enemies and saving the world.

title: Blackout: Zero Point
description: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

title: Just in Crime
description: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

title: Zehlar
description: Explore a world full of secrets and magic, inhabited by creatures with unique elemental abilities. Ally with them to embark on your adventure, and train alongside your creature companions to become stronger and conquer the challenges of the world.

title: Clockwork Revolution
description: Clockwork Revolution is a time-bending steampunk first-person RPG. After stumbling across an incredible invention that allows you to travel into the past, you discover the city you call home—the vibrant steam-powered metropolis of Avalon—has been carefully crafted through the alteration of historical events. By traveling back to key moments, your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world and characters of Avalon, causing them to change and react in unprecedented ways.

title: Neko's Rage
description: 2D pixelart action game with many roguelite mechanics and power up. The gameplay is speed and hardcore but very addictive. You play as Nikki a female cyborg in an apocalyptic world rules by mechanicals creatures.

title: Dolos: Your Best Future
description: A sci-fi political thriller. Live the life of an operator of DOLOS, a social regulation system predicting everyone's future. Analyze applicants' profiles and decide about their lifetime career. Apply DOLOS' logic or find how to counter it ... but don't get fired!

title: Beyond the Plastic Wall
description: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.

title: Forgotten House
description: Try to escape from the old grandfather from his decrepit house by solving riddles. The game is inspired by Gnarled hag

title: Entity: Unknown
description: Choose your side in the confrontation between the nightmare spawns and the SSA organization in an asymmetric multiplayer horror game. Spread the miasma of fear, become a real font of horror and plunge the Hunters into a madness, or plunge into an atmosphere of intense horror together with friends.

title: WTF: Waifu Tactical Force
description: WTF is an anime movement shooter where every PvP win fuels your long-term progression towards the ultimate mercenary army. Victories earn XP and currency to upgrade your waifu-run Mother Base, unlocking perks & rare waifus you bring back into combat. Assign non-playable waifus to buildings for resources, deploy them on missions, and expand your tactical options. Each system feeds the next: shoot to build, build to upgrade, upgrade to dominate. Wrapped in a visual novel framework, it’s a genre hybrid where management, skill, and waifus drive everything.

title: Forge of the Fae
description: Explore a story-rich, mysterious world inspired by Celtic folklore, use crystals to channel powerful magic, and make impactful choices that change the story's outcome. A unique Crystal System and battles with dangerous Fae await in this charming, pixel-style, retro modern RPG.

title: Hanoi Puzzles: Spin Match
description: Inspired by the classic Tower of Hanoi, Assemble towers by spinning pieces to get the right pattern on a hexagonal board with a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere.

title: DecaPolice
description: DecaPolice is a crime-suspense RPG from Level-5, developers of the Layton series. The main character, a rookie detective named Harvard, hunts down criminals in a huge open-world crime-ridden city, traveling back and forth between physical and virtual reality.

title: Gilded Destiny
description: Gilded Destiny is a grand strategy game depicting the transformative era of the Industrial Revolution. You will take the helm of the country of your choice and transform it from a backward agrarian society to an industrial powerhouse.

title: Situation Normal
description: A single-player shoot-'em-up precision platformer.

title: Endless Samurai
description: "Endless Samurai" is a roguelite that overcomes death and becomes stronger. You can experience a new battle system aiming at "fusion of turn-based and speedy action".

title: Dig Dig Boom
description: Dig Dig Boom is a mining roguelike where time only moves when you do. Each expedition, the player explores a new cave in hunt for gold, using a variety of tools and their wit.

title: Holstin
description: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

title: WorldShards
description: WorldShards is a Sandbox-RPG with a levelless progress system. Explore the mysterious fantasy world of Murrlandia, solve its mysteries, and help its tiny inhabitants to rebuild their home!

title: Play Rough
description: Play Rough is a roleplaying game set in the surreal, post-apocalyptic wasteland of what was once California. It's a place where humans live side-by-side with living cartoons, twisted abominations of ink and flesh, and... Clowns...?

title: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea
description: After traveling far to the southern end of Lair Land, seven knights have reached Chainch Bay. Settled in a small tropical fishing village surrounded by ruins, they will spend the next few years building a new life here while facing the most challenging quest they will ever meet.

title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
description: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

title: My Wife is a Princess
description: A traitor appeared in the kingdom, and the seal of the demon king was lifted. In order to save the kingdom~the beautiful queen sent a rescue request to the brave...The price was to become the wife of the brave!

title: Long Gone
description: Decades after the outbreak, you play as a survivor stranded in an old-world suburban neighborhood. Explore the lives of people Long Gone through their forgotten belongings and uncover secrets as you search for supplies in this 2.5D pixel puzzle platformer inspired by adventure games of old.

title: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra
description:
This narrative-driven ensemble game stars Captain America Steve Rogers, Black Panther Azzuri (T'Challa's grandfather), U.S. soldier and member of the Howling Commandos Gabriel Jones, and leader of the fledgling Wakandan Spy Network, Nanali.

All four characters will be playable at different parts of the story. According to Skydance, players can look forward to "intuitive controls and exhilarating second-to-second gameplay that captures the action and excitement of Marvel, inspired by landmark comics, television, and films, as they navigate this all-new glob-trotting adventure."

title: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds
description: A complete remake of the classic Flash game trilogy, Alice is Dead. Hearts and Diamonds includes all new art, added puzzles, expanded lore, and plenty of secrets for old and new fans alike.

title: The Backworld
description: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

title: Taste of Heaven
description: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

title: Kingdom Hearts IV
description: Kingdom Hearts IV follows protagonist Sora and some familiar characters as they journey through the mysterious city of Quadratum. Sora will once again journey to various worlds, where new figures cross his path and new powers awaken in this next chapter.

title: Rooted
description: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

title: The Lost Wild
description: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

title: Constellations: Beyond the Edges
description: After an accident at a space station, you lose all communication with the earth and are no longer able to locate yourself in space, your best chance of returning is to use the space monitoring system to identify known constellations and configure the route back home.

title: Tremen
description: Fight the hordes of mutants that enslaved humanity through a concrete brutalist hell in this FPS with modern graphics and old school gameplay.

title: A Wake Inn: Rebooked
description:
They say bad things happen in Silver Inn Hotel. Strange noises. Mysterious flashing lights in the night. Weird figures slithering in the dark.

They say something is about to awake soon. Will you dare to witness it?

A Wake Inn comes for PC in Rebooked version - redesigned, adding new content, additional endings and fully animated models of enemies.

title: Ink Shapes: Book One
description: Rotate stamps to create beautiful watercolor paintings in this relaxing hand-drawn puzzle.

title: Hanoi Puzzles: Magnetrix
description: Assemble magnetic towers by stacking pieces from opposite poles, to enlighten a electrifying hexagonal board.

title: Espiocracy
description: Espiocracy is grand strategy game with unique take on the Cold War. Play as an intelligence service (CIA, KGB, Stasi, Mossad, and many more): launch proxy wars, stage coups, steal war plans, assassinate enemies, and tilt world history in your favor.

title: They Speak From the Abyss
description:
Venture into the Abyss and face strange and horrifying monsters in this bone chilling RPG.

With the spirit Sophia at your side, you must venture into the nightmare-ish world of the Abyss in order to escape. Monsters will block your path, will you be strong enough to conquer them, or will you perish and join the other lost souls who roam the depths.

title: Clock Overwhelmed
description: Organize tasks within your routine, but be careful not to overlap activities and get overwhelmed!

title: Shadow Seeker
description:
Amorita Town, a sleepy location filled with peaceful residents and gloomy scenery.

You are Carlos Ramirez, a seasoned Detective who has experience in many different kinds of cases and investigations. On a fated day, you come face to face with a case you have never witnessed before. A very mysterious and tragic murder of a family that lived in the outskirts of the town. Something about it is not right, it makes you feel extremely uneasy, and almost, unsure.

As your mission deepens, the mystery appears to be shrouded in an evil like never before. What awaits you will tear you down and shake you to your core, an ancient darkness arises from the shadows. Enter the Shadow Seeker.

title: Being & Becoming
description: Being & Becoming is a dark, atmospheric metroidvania set in a kingdom consumed by a Collective Dream. Play as a Lucid Dreamer, able to possess the corrupted, absorb their spirits, and wield them as weapons to break the world free from its endless slumber.

title: Ill
description: Unleash your survival instincts. Step into the sinister town, face a growing horror and uncover the unsettling truth behind the town's descent into madness. Are you ready to confront your deepest fears?

title: Militsioner
description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

title: Anima: Song from the Abyss
description: Song from the Abyss is the new Action RPG set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters and explore a world full of mysteries. Experience a fluid combat system and a deep story with unforgettable characters.

title: State of Decay 3
description: Unite to survive: push back the blood plague to reclaim the land's resources and carve out a life in the zombie apocalypse.

title: Nonuple Nine: Asymptote
description: "NONUPLE NINE: Asymptote" is a side-scrolling, narrative Sci-fi adventure game. Control the subject girl and solve the mystery of the building where the same floor loops. With vast scientific insights, can you find the answer for the "meaning of humanity" during this deadly journey?

title: Mike & Tyler
description: Mike & Tyler is a point & click adventure game, full of puzzles, mystery and dangerous characters.

title: Shironeko Project Infinity
description: Shironeko New Project is a co-op action RPG based on the mobile game Shironeko Project but will have a new story with new characters.

title: Mirror Land
description: This is an optical illusion space puzzle game with an original core mechanism. It uses MAGIC MIRROR to GRAB and RELEASE characters and cooperate with moving the MAGIC MIRROR to complete incredible space puzzles.

title: The Wolf Among Us 2
description: The Wolf Among Us 2 is an episodic graphic adventure game. It is a sequel to The Wolf Among Us and takes place six months following the events of the first game. Follow Bigby Wolf in a new story filled with not-so-colorful characters from famous fairy tales.

title: Everguest: The Veiled Inn
description: Everguest: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy roguelite strategy RPG with turn-based tactical combat, active dodge timing, and powerful relic and mod builds. Choose your path, manage Mana and Overflow, and survive the cursed inn’s deadly loop.

title: Kyklos
description: In this turn based RPG You must seek out the first gate lost to time. While many myths relate to its existence, only yours will lead to eternal enlightenment. Go out and explore towns, cities, temples, and caves which depths seem to grow stranger the deeper you go.

title: Oathwood Realms
description: Oathwood Realms is a dark fantasy strategy card game focused on careful planning, tactical decisions, and calculated risk. Luck plays a role, but victory favors players who read the board and commit to their choices.

title: Runic Prophecy
description: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.

title: The Shackles Holder #735
description: The Shackles Holder #735 is a female-oriented text-based game set in a steampunk world. On November 30, 1875, Police Chief Temis, known for his 100% case clearance rate, was transferred to the crime-ridden city of Nineveh.

title: Unsound
description: Unsound is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling environments, solve puzzles, and uncover a dark mystery. Things are not always as they seem, and the deeper you go, the stranger things become. Pay attention to your surroundings and piece together the clues.

title: Canyons
description: Canyons is a third-person extraction shooter set in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Fight for your existence in 4 player co-op or solo, control massive Crawlers, build a settlement for survivors, and conquer this savage world!

title: Graytail
description: Graytail is a Zelda-like action-adventure game with interactive puzzles and combat set on a small island in the Pacific. Find the missing best female pilot and uncover the secrets hidden on the island.

title: Beyblade x Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol. 2
Maid Envy
description: Your final year was supposed to be an easy time, studying and preparing for the end of year finals. But when your best friend involves you in a crazy experiment your life is turned upside down, unexpected consequences ensue leading to a chaotic final year.

title: Badass Brad
description: They killed your wife. They killed your dog. Now it's your turn to kill them in this fast paced roguelike!

title: Famine
description: Play as the new candidate chosen to participate in a deadly game. If you succeed, humanity will survive a few more days. If you lose, you die.

title: Bad Heroes
description: Save the world and romance misfit heroes in the first-ever dating sim and beat-em-up! When a crime wave grips Gloom City, you and your ragtag band of heroes-for-hire uncover shocking truths about the A-list supers at the top. Fight crime, punch mimes, and kiss six superheroes with supernatural abs!

title: Eager For Den
description: Metroidvania Survival Co-op Game in which you have to explore to survive, earn abilities to survive, play well-design characters to survive, cooperate with your firends to survive and survive to survive.

title: Love is a Roguelite
description: A turn-based tactical deck-building roguelite where heartbreak makes you stronger. Craft absurd card synergies, outsmart procedural dungeons, and romance your partner across a fracturing timeloop to restore their lost memories—one run at a time.

title: Accursed
description: Bear your vows in Accursed, a 2D narrative-driven soulslike, hand-drawn in worn fantasy and shades of burning autumn. Bequeathed upon a fading world as a herald of Death, may you find your peace within what remains.

title: The Forgotten Ones
description: Leidy dreamed of the city, she never imagined violence would force her there. In this 90s narrative adventure, explore streets and interiors, inspect traces people left behind, hear conflicting family memories, and reconstruct meaningful objects by hand while restoring what violence left unfinished.

title: The Main Menu
description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

title: Cursebreakers
description: Cursebreakers is an exclusively co-op first-person dungeon crawler. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend's Pass and master sword & sorcery together. Explore a lost castle and delve into a rich dark fantasy world full of monsters, traps and magic. Defeat the fallen queen and break the curse!

title: Hey, Don't Look at Me
description: Hey, Don't Look at Me is a psychological first-person horror game where you'll observe ghosts through binoculars, investigate the circumstances of their deaths, and try to survive inside your own apartment. Just don't forget: sometimes, they're watching you too.

title: Dark Island: Faded Memories
description: Ride dragons across forgotten islands. Explore the ruins of a world that fell long ago. Battle monsters and fallen soldiers lurking in the dark. Play solo, or team up with friends in co-op. Nostalgic graphics and style that bring back the magic of childhood.

title: Relicfall
description: Forge your own class in this Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Combine 3 professions to shape a unique skill tree, hunt for powerful loot, and socket relics to create game-breaking synergies. Slay endless hordes and push your build to its limits.

title: Go! Super Awesome Monkey!
description: Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer! Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in 100+ levels. Play at your own pace: casually explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!

title: Survive the Shift
description: workplace survival card decision game. Starting as an intern, you must balance boss trust, team popularity, business output, and personal savings. Slacking rules, dinner culture, and bizarre blame-shifting communications turn into choice cards. Swipe once a day to see how many days you can survive.

title: Tickets, Please!
description: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxing cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair faults, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on the rails in a laid-back yet hectic single-player adventure.

title: Sleepover
description: Sleepover is a cosmic horror visual-novel about the last two humans alive. After the entire population of Earth mysteriously vanishes, the sole survivor, Yuna, struggles to find meaning in an empty world. After a mysterious girl appears at her front door, the two begin their final night together.

title: Tsumamigui 3
description:
A censored port of Tsumamigui 3.
That bittersweet memory in his heart, never fading away— Akihito Natsuki, forced by company circumstances to take a long leave, decides to return to his hometown.

title: Reoxia
description: The story of an astronaut who returns to Earth in the midst of an apocalypse caused by an unknown disease. He mustn't take off the spacesuit to avoid breathing the contaminated air. The devastated world is inhabited by the bloodthirsty infected and mutants, and unknown armed men are hunting him.

title: Rule the Dungeon
description: Your Report, Your Reality. A pixel-art CRPG where a Dungeon Bureau inspector files otherworldly cases into submission. Evidence shapes success. Keywords forge skills. The clock decides everything.

title: Orms
description: Orms follows Sam, a boy lost in a surreal world shaped by his fears. Guided by Kira, he must restore a lighthouse to reconnect with his parents. The game is inspired by Machinarium, but crafted in 3D with expanded locations. It blends emotional storytelling with atmospheric exploration.

title: Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish
description:
Vampires, Werewolves, Witches. What if I told you that the things that go bump in the night are real? What if I told you that you could see them?

Awaken to the truth you’re now a Hunter. Build your character, select skills, and work with a team of allies to investigate the monsters hidden in plain sight, to find their lairs, and to eradicate them. All the while, investigating a story that drags up memories from your past, ones that could change how you see the future.

Welcome to the World of Darkness.

title: Azur
description: Azur is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS set on the French island of Belmas. Every time you respawn, complete missions, explore, and survive as long as possible to secure the best gear, with the risk of losing everything.

title: Chronoscript: The Endless End
description: Chronoscript: The Endless End is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its endacross 2D pages and a 3D manor.

title: Threaded Dungeons
description:
A world threaded in death. Can you cultivate a party of four that defies all odds? Make every action count in tactical turn-based combat. Choose your allegiances carefully. Scour dungeons in search of loot and secrets. Resist or acquiesce to tempting whispers in the darkness.

Threaded Dungeons is a turn-based, party-based dungeon crawling RPG.

title: Purgatory: Blue
description:
A new visual novel led, written and composed by cittan*.

Akito meets his childhood friend, but for some reason, he is the only one who can see and recognize her.

title: Crescent County
description: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

title: Catechesis
description: Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in this Horror RPG. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes.

title: Drill Keeper
description: Drill Keeper combines roguelite deckbuilding and tower defense into a strategic battle for survival. Dig through completely destructible worlds to strip them of their riches and build an impenetrable fortress of mining.

title: Spine
description: Experience Gun Fu like never before with SPINE, an immersive and highly cinematic action game set in a cyberpunk world. Explore the realistic vision of a near-future with a rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant, Spine, as they challenge a totalitarian AI regime in search of Redline’s captured brother. Participate in epic gunfights against charismatic opponents, while performing spectacular choreography with firearms!

title: My Hero Academia: All's Justice - DLC Character 5
My Hero Academia: All's Justice - DLC Character 4
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - DLC Character Pack 3
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - DLC Character Pack 2
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - DLC Character Pack 1
Coraland: The Worst Rescuer
description: Coraland is a puzzle adventure game where we follow Joris, a good for nothing rescuer on her first adventure to save Pon-Pon island from imminent danger. The controls are simple and the puzzles have been designed to be accessible for all ages, without outside knowledge to solve them.

title: Sanctuary: Shattered Sun
description: Sanctuary is a Traditional Real Time Strategy game featuring Strategic Zoom, Streaming Economy, Simulated Projectiles and Grand Scale. Take control of armies of hundreds upon hundreds of units and crush your enemies!

title: Rangingstrike
description: Master the three weapons that change according to the humanoid robot form and fighter form, destroy the scattered enemy attack targets, and finally defeat the boss standing in your way!

title: Dragon Riders
description: A SFW BL/Bara Gacha (without microtransactions), Visual Novel, and Card Battler game. Customizable Love Interests can be Bara Style or BL Style. The main character escapes a dystopian wasteland by bonding with a sentient dragon and becoming a soldier. He must navigate life in his corrupt nation while forming a relationship with another dragon rider. The gacha unlocks 21 different dragons and riders and over 100 cards to add to the battle deck. Gacha credits are earned organically by playing the visual novel and card battler. There is no real-money gambling possible.

title: Shadow Rush
description: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. Can you beat the speed of darkness?

title: Age of Legacy
description: Age of Legacy is an unforgiving roguelike RPG with intense turn-based 1v1 combat. Step into a world where survival is earned, not given. With no allies to assist you, every battle is a high-stakes duel, testing your build optimization and tactical foresight to the limit.

title: Ball and Stick
description: Roll, swing, launch and cause chaos in a physics-driven sci-fi adventure with unique controls, wild attachments and character customization. Explore bizarre alien worlds alone or with friends, and unleash multiplayer mayhem!

title: Outwith
description: Outwith is a first-person, single-player open-world RPG set in a hand-crafted medieval fantasy world. Meet its inhabitants, face lurking dangers, uncover ancient secrets and shape a world that responds to your actions. Let your curiosity guide you as you wander this dark and mysterious land.

title: Evolution Survival
description: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Who knows when Natural Selection is at the wheel!

title: Historiker
description: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

title: Rustown
description: Five years after the idiot virus pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

title: The Arcane Open
description: Golf, but every swing is a card. Build a deck of enchanted shots, bend the odds to find the fairway, and play your way through a fantasy golf tournament where anything can happen.

title: SubDuctis
description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again

title: My Penguin Friend
description: Washed up thousands of miles from home, Dindim, a little penguin on a big journey must puzzle across an unfamiliar, tropical coastline, and forge an unlikely friendship to find more than just his way home.

title: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
description: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

title: HandFoot
description: Inspired by 80s and 90s trash horror, HandFoot is a chaotic 3rd person action game where every gun is also a melee weapon. Shoot, smash, throw, climb, and sneak through gore-soaked battles with bullet-time, stealth gameplay, and puzzle-solving along the way.

title: Fishy Bar
description: Catch fish by day, run a shady lakeside bar by night. Hook 40+ species, cook them into questionable specials, keep the regulars fed and tipsy, dodge taxes and scammers, and upgrade your boat, your bar and your dog. First-person sim. Fresh fish, fishy business.

title: Cozy Cookmaster
description: Cozy Cookmaster is an incremental restaurant management and automation game about turning a tiny food counter into a busy, fully automated restaurant. Start by cooking fries by hand, serving customers and cleaning tables, then unlock new recipes like burgers, hot dogs, donuts and more. Hire chefs, waiters and cleaners to automate the work, use the skill tree to shape your restaurant, and renovate between days by adding tables, kitchen stations and machines. Start with a small counter, build the system and automate the chaos.

title: Lazare's Sacrifice
description: The guillotine awaits. Your only escape? A deck of cards. Play for your life against legends of the French Revolution in this gripping narrative deckbuilder. Solve puzzles in the depths of prison to uncover the truth of your captivity. Cards, health, sanity... What will you sacrifice to survive?

title: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia
description: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia is a comedy adventure RPG featuring a washed-up hero who's turning 30, with talking dogs and hamburger monsters! Solve puzzles in the overworld to collect items, engage in turn-based battles with fighting-game button inputs, and even learn 150+ cooking recipes!

title: Roselle Hunt
description: Step into the shoes of a bounty hunter in a PvPvE backpack auto-battler. Combine and upgrade gear, obliterate your foes, and... Find Roselle.

title: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator
description: You and your friends run a dog daycare. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

title: Loopfang
description: A snake roguelite where your body is your arsenal. Collect weapon segments, fuse matching neighbors into higher tiers, and reorder them until they react with each other. Then close a loop with your own tail: everything trapped inside dies.

title: Hellkick
description: One kick, one survivor. Hellkick is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

title: Bloodbrand
description: Bloodbrand is a story-rich adventure game where every decision carries a weight. Navigate yourself through perilous situations with persuasion, deception, seduction. Explore the cold winter nights of the medieval realm of Norn and sate your vampiric hunger for murder, or resist it at a great cost.

title: Kirby and the World Beyond
description: Get ready to freely explore the World Beyond using Copy Abilities in Kirby and the World Beyond, the latest 3D Kirby adventure, coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2027!

title: Lost Museum: Echoes of the Chromageists
description: Forgotten masterpieces with stories still left to be told... Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists- is an adventure game that tells the story of Chromageists, beings with strange faces born of paintings. Through their memories, unravel the meaning each piece of art holds.

title: Ichorian Tales
description: Inspired by the traditional Zelda formula, Ichorian Tales is focused on that old-school dungeon crawling experience! Explore, fight enemies, solve puzzles and obtain new abilities to crack open the dungeon and fight massive bosses!

title: Momentigrade
description: A fast-paced 3D metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

title: Medieval Dynasty: The Backwood
description: Unleash your imagination with our new free DLC introducing The Backwood! This whole new map will be available in Creative Mode, giving you complete freedom to build, design, and misbehave. Immerse yourself in peaceful serenity or let loose and cause

title: Limes 235
description: A historically grounded single-player point-and-click adventure that blends narrative-driven exploration, role-based perspective shifts, and puzzle solving into an emotional rollercoaster of contrasting storylines and moral choice.

title: Burning Bridges
description: You discover a suspicious box on your parents attic. Uncover a long hidden family secret by rummaging through old homevideo and letters.

title: Ground Drone Operator: Ground Robotic System Simulator
description: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

title: Waifu Bubble
description: Dive into a charming underwater puzzle adventure! Play solo or with a friend, control adorable crabs, and guide a trapped waifu through clever two-layer levels. Solve puzzles, work together, and help her reach the surface!

title: Hotel Is Hungry
description: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, and feed the hotel before it decides to feed itself. One wrong room, someone dies. A body horror hotel management game.

title: Strect
description:
Control your ship and destroy all the enemies and bases that have appeared through teleportation!
< STRECT > is a score-attack vertical shooter for 1 or 2 players.
Enjoy simple shoot-and-dodge gameplay, rich destruction effects, and tons of hidden features.

title: Skies of Valoria
description: "Skies of Valoria" is a fantasy action Roguelite with dynamic builds and fast combat. Soar the clouds on "Aethelwhale", team up with 4 Valkyries across Valoria, and strike the Demon King's Castle! Harness War Souls for endless combos and summon monsters to sweep away all foes.

title: Camping Keeper
description: Build your campground from the ground up: tent sites, cabins, showers, pools, and the pipes and power lines behind them. Watch autonomous campers live, complain... and review you. Set prices, hire staff, and climb from a muddy one-star field to a five-star resort.

title: Spyro: A Realm Beyond
description: Take flight in a brand-new journey through a strange and wondrous realm. When Spyro finds himself stranded, his journey to discover a way home is interrupted by the arrival of a vicious invading force known as the Scavs.

title: Mr. Records
description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

title: Tempus Vitae
description: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons in this sci-fi metroidvania FPS: Tempus Vitae.

title: Super Tacky Astro Ranger: S.T.A.R.
description: Play as the tackiest hero in the galaxy in this fast-paced 3D action roguelite. Battle through chaotic arenas, master various weapons, defeat the Morg Leader, and escape in style. Be bold, be reckless. Be a true S.T.A.R.

title: Headcutter
description: HEADCUTTER is a Sci-fi Spaghetti Western FPS with BRUTAL combat, DESTRUCTIBLE environments, and LOTS O'GORE. You're a space bounty hunter, track targets, explore destroyable maps with multiple routes with CRUNCHY gunplay and cut their heads to get your money. Come on now, go out and GET SOME HEADS!

title: Gravity Circuit 2
description: A new Ark has risen. Switch between the Gravity and Power Circuit in this action-packed 2D platformer inspired by console classics. Gravity Circuit 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed Gravity Circuit

title: Take That Mainstage!
description: It's 1992 in Emerald City. The world screams for change. You made the leap, now fulfill your destiny and change the world. Build your band, write real music you perform, manage relationships, and reach the top of the charts. In this hybrid life sim, be the one to Take That Mainstage!

title: Michikusa Wanderer
description: The Demon Lord and the Hero are gone. With no mission to fulfill, no world to save, you hunt as you please, eat as you please, and travel as you please. It’s an RPG where you are free to do anything.

title: Life and Lemon
description: Life & Lemon is a cozy fruit farming card game! Grow your orchard business, discover countless combination through card fusing, and make new friends. Learn how to run a successful orchard business and help build a thriving community across a lush, vibrant world!

title: Totopia
description: Totopia is calling! Drip in your style and crush 100+ chaotic maps, or smash the Bitrot crisis with Atomon skills! Need a recharge? Visit Pulse Avenue to build, plant, or run a cozy cafe. Cast your fishline, chill, and vibe with quirky Atomons. Your world, your way—join the squad and catch that W!

title: Kitaria Fables 2
description: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend!

title: Intravenous 3
description: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the roles of Steve and Sean, outnumbered and forced to survive a relentless manhunt.

title: Edge on Truth
description:
A story-driven adventure with a mystery atmosphere.
Explore the settlement, gather clues, interact with its inhabitants, and uncover a conspiracy. Your actions shape your relationships with the locals—will they help you, or deceive you? Your choices will determine whether the protagonist can escape, or if his tragic fate will repeat itself again and again.

title: Crackheads
description: Build junky vehicles, battle your friends with physics-based weapons, and survive absurd co-op challenges in this chaotic multiplayer sandbox.

title: Alien Deathstorm
description: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in Alien Deathstorm, the new sci-fi action horror FPS from Rebellion.

title: Diviner
description: Diviner, a turn-based tactical dungeon crawler developed by Born of Three. Players will explore dungeons and castles alike after being tasked by the Diviner to gather the scattered organs of a dead lord to raise him from the dead. Make custom builds, acquire gear, and engage in intense turn-based combat in Diviner.

title: Final Flavor
description: Hone your skills with knives and fire to taste sweet victory... Let them cook! Final Flavor is an old-school dungeon crawler where a diverse party of outcasts slay, bake, and sauté their way to survive. Find the perfect ingredients, following the footsteps of the legendary chef.

title: Mercy Incore
description: Solo indie hack-and-slash. You are a medieval knight with jet booster and transforming sword. Fight your way through a techno-void. Leech enemies’ lives to survive. Escape — or become a techno-vampire.

title: Day Trader Tycoon
description: Play as a day trader gambling on people's pension money and try to beat the stock market. Engage in a comedic story with multiple endings. Meet different characters and get insider info to use for your own advantage. Gamble on cryptocurrency and quickly react to market events.

title: The Second Reproduction: Reunion
description: A remake/alternative version of the otome visual novel "The Second Reproduction."

title: Mega Man: Dual Override
description: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

title: Black Sailors
description: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.

title: Fourleaf Fields
description: Welcome to the tiny world of Fourleaf Fields, a cozy farming life sim where you're no bigger than a carrot. Grow towering crops, care for tiny farm bugs, and uncover a web of secrets fueled by gossip - solo or online with friends!

title: Alone: Mnemophobia
description: Immerse yourself in a world of nightmares with Alone. A psychological horror game that blends first and third-person perspectives. It will become a part of your mind, just as your mind will become a part of it with every decision you make.

title: Contact Protocol
description:
Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator taking place in a gritty, cassette-future. Humanity has spread throughout the solar system and started extracting its natural resources.

You play as the security officer aboard PALE HORSE - a Galileo Corporation vessel carrying miners set for Ganymede, Jupiter's biggest moon. It’s your job to assess the intentions of approaching ships, decide their fate, and keep your crew alive. The company is watching.

title: Blast Bebop
description: Blast Bebop is an easy-to-pick-up action-incremental game, combining dodging, shooting, collecting, and upgrades, set to retro pixel visuals and psychedelic music for a short, relaxing combat experience.

title: Wetter
description: Step into the paws of Luna and explore a rain-soaked archipelago. Uncover pieces of your forgotten past and decide which memories will shape who you become.

title: Deep Siren
description: Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

title: Daybreak Slam
description: Colorful characters clash in this beginner friendly 2D Fighter. Family friendly themes and aesthetics with simple combat mechanics make Daybreak Slam a welcoming experience for new players to the genre, and allow each character to stand out in their own unique ways that veterans will appreciate.

title: FrogSpin
description: A wind-up frogventure bursting with colorful platforming and roguelike surprises. Spin the slots, master precision jumps, and rack up points. Ready to leap into action?

title: Son of Thanjai
description: Son of Thanjai is a cinematic action-adventure epic set in the culturally rich 11th-century South India. As a Chola king burdened by legacy, you must embark on a personal journey that blurs the line between duty and destiny. Will you rise as a legend–or be forgotten?

title: Rhythm Rat Rampage
description: Rhythm meets bullet heaven in a genre-smashing fusion. Strik-9 challenges you to dodge to the beat and shred your enemies in a music-driven gauntlet of chaos, speed, and style.

title: HellHeart Breaker
description: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

title: Postal 2 Redux
description: A ground‑up overhaul of 2003’s infamous open‑world shooter. Part modernization, part love‑letter, POSTAL 2 Redux will hoist every original asset out of the creaking Unreal 1.5 engine and slam it into today’s Unity—delivering the same familiar week in the POSTAL Dude’s life with a merciless glow‑up and a bucket of new toys.

title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

title: Teeko
description: Platformer meets tower defense in this story-rich game inspired by the Costa Rican Día de Las Mascaradas festival. One day, grandma Tita's kids get possessed by the spirits of the gigantes and begin to wreak havoc upon the land. It's now up to her pet sloth, Teeko, to save their town.

title: Take Them Down
description: Combine weapons and abilities in this fast-paced, violent action game to take down necromancers, demons, and betrayers while avoiding being cleaved and crushed by blades, traps, and mines sprawled across nightmarish, macabre levels. Not a roguelike, game features handcrafted levels.

title: Sacrata
description: A dark-themed Roguelike survivor game where you must withstand relentless waves of enemies, craft powerful skill builds, unlock new survivors, and take on dark bosses. Claim sacred artifacts and experience an unparalleled thrill of intense combat and ultimate destruction!

title: Postal 2 VR
description: POSTAL 2 VR lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for VR. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona—buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of absurd weapons and unpredictable NPCs. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

title: Turok: Origins
description: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

title: Everbloom
description: Everbloom is a cute and cozy farming social sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

title: Battle Vision
description: Battle your way to fame and glory in this cosmic tactical puzzle-battle roguelike! Recruit your ultimate team, equip them with powerful abilities and take them on a season-long run of domination in the universe’s most-watched battle-sport!

title: Aokaki
description: Aokaki is a fast-paced 2D platformer where you play as an isopod ronin. Explore fun and challenging levels while battling against the forces of the evil Shogun in this bug inhabited pixelart world.

title: Piggy One Super Spark
description: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

title: Zerra's Adventure
description: Zerra's Adventure is a classic turn-based RPG with no random encounters. Explore diverse areas, collect items and treasures to improve your team and defeat the strangest enemies. Level up, learn new attacks, and meet quirky characters on your adventure!

title: Jest Messter
description:
A comedy-mystery otome visual novel.

Oh no! You're stuck with a pun-curse "gifted" by the mysterious Jester, a mythical entity known to bring happiness in exchange for your memories.

Armed with the worst dad jokes known to mankind, you transferred to the prestigious Marney High in hopes to uncover the Jester's identity... and hopefully make new friends along the way!

Luckily, your new classmates are just as weird as you are: a stuck-up scholar, a brainrot-loving memelord, a two-faced actor, a weapon-wielding roommate, and a secretive senior with a dangerous secret...

So be careful who you trust! As sinister plots start to unravel around you and your classmates, you find yourself tangled in their web of secrets and schemes.

And maybe... your pun-curse is the key to solve them all?

Commercial remaster of "The Punniest Pun Messter".

title: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
description: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

title: Project Mix
description: Project Mix is a VR anime cyberpunk bartending visual novel. What will you do when you've lost everything you once had?

title: Daba: Land of Water Scar
description: Daba: Land of Water Scar is a new title from Dark Star. It tells the story of a humanoid clay puppet. When the world is on the verge of collapse, the puppet traces the whereabouts of the water fragments within the ancient city, and throughout their journey of defeating enemies and seeking answers, unravels the story of the world and oneself. The game features various landscapes including abandoned ruins, a magnificent ancient city, gloomy prison, vast rift valley, expansive snowfield, deadly forest, and a floating city. Non-linear levels are interconnected, distinct, and intricate.

title: Football, Tactics & Glory 2
description: XCOM meets Football Manager. Embark on the career of an unknown coach: tactically outsmart opponents in turn-based matches, earn money and experience, search for talented players, manage a club, build your reputation to get invited to lead the national team, and win the World Championship!

title: Touchstarved
description: You were born cursed, with hands that twist the mind of any human you touch. Desperation leads you to the shadowy city of Eridia, where your fate intertwines with 5 monstrous strangers. Each can offer you salvation or damnation. Find a cure for your curse in Touchstarved, a gothic horror romance visual novel.

title: Psycasso
description:
Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood! Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians.

In this pixel art adventure you'll play as Psycasso, a struggling gallery artist living in an open world city. By day you'll work a day job to earn money and level up skills, seamlessly blending into society. By night you'll be on the lookout to harvest 'red paint' from one of the 'walking meat-bags' to help you create original 2D art. Sell your artwork to art galleries for huge profits! Become rich from your unique artwork while avoiding capture from the ever growing police presence using stealth techniques and unique traps. Buy property, upgrades, furniture, weapons, discover a bustling city and play a host of mini games in this controversial indie title like nothing before.

title: Witches Craft
description: Witches Craft is an adult adventure & crafting game following Selene; A fully trained Hedge Witch and Aspiring Alchemist.

title: Squadron 42
description: Take the role of a rookie UEE Navy combat pilot in a cinematic single-player epic adventure set in the Star Citizen universe. Battle in the stars and face-to-face as you seamlessly transition between dogfighting and ground combat. Serve aboard a massive Navy capital ship as your custom character interacts and builds relationships with a living, breathing crew. Cutting-edge performance capture brings unprecedented emotion and life to some of your favorite actors. Powered by StarEngine, Squadron 42 pushes gaming graphics and fidelity to the next level.

title: No Way Back: Dark Horizon
description: A first-person survival game with horror elements. You wake up on an island with your young son and no memory of how you got there. He gets hungry, he gets scared, you can tell him to wait or follow, and if he dies the game is over. By day you explore, gather, hunt, cook and build shelter; when night falls the island stops being safe.

title: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of New Zealand
Space Evolver
description: Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy game elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, and guide the evolution of species.

title: Unyverse
description: Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse delivers an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience for single and co-op players enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.

title: Paid in Blood
description: Bet your blood in a twisted baccarat game to pay off your mob debt.

title: Make The Dead Dead Again
description: Lux is a DNA-enhanced heroine purging a paranormal outbreak, one loot drop at a time. But loot doesn't just mean bigger guns - it means clothes, makeup, and more. Clear the streets, then spend your spoils making her look drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

title: Indie Hoverboard Racing
description: An advenure racing game featuring colourful open worlds and racing on hoverboards. Single player and for all ages.

title: Pipe Dream
description: A life and crime sandbox set in 2008 Brooklyn, where the taxes are real, the cops aim like people, the radio has 20 stations, and every dollar comes from something you probably shouldn't be doing. You owe Tony $1,500 by Sunday. Bring up to 15 friends.

title: Air Raid 1: ReOvercharge
description:
Join Jacob and his Watermelon Cannon on an adventure against robots to save his home and uncover the secrets of a mysterious energy called "Overcharge."

Play multi-round PvE battles, choosing your skills and upgrades that will progress through the story. Spend time with your allies in a visual novel format and strengthen your relationships to unlock PvE combat improvements.

title: Fcorvus
description: Solve puzzles, uncover riddles, and hunt crows and ravens through layered scenes of mystery. Assemble, search, and compete to reveal the hidden truth in a world where every shadow tells a story. Play solo, with or versus a friend. Learn about the fabulous corvus.

title: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
description: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

title: Mariachi Legends
description: Mariachi Legends is an action-packed mystery Metroidvania game. In Mariachi Legends, Join fantastical festivities at the Day of the Dead carnival alongside Detective Pablo Cruz, currently masquerading as a mariachi player to investigate an evil curse looming over the serene town of Santa Mascota.

title: Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina
description: Melty Blood: Type Lumina is back and better than ever! Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray! A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream.

title: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of Canada
The Edge of the Backrooms
description: After discovering a strange anomaly on Jupiter's moon, Europa, you find yourself in the outer reaches of a dangerous, uncanny complex.

title: Bossfall
description:
Bossfall is a fast paced Sci-Fi Action RPG Boss Rush. Fight a gauntlet of the universe's most lethal warriors and monsters to rise as the arena's ultimate champion.

Master tight controls to shoot and dash your way through dynamic combat. Every victory rewards you with legendary loot, allowing you to endlessly customize your playstyle and adapt to new challenges.

Key Features:
Action-Packed Arena Combat: Face off against a diverse roster of powerful monsters and formidable adversaries.
Dedicated Boss Rush: Test both your mechanical skills and your build crafting strategy in an exciting mode against back to back boss fights.
Deep Customization: Mix and match legendary weapons, spells, and gear to create game breaking builds.
Tight Mechanics: Master responsive dash and shoot gameplay to effortlessly outmaneuver incoming attacks.
High Replayability: Experiment with different loadouts to conquer higher difficulties for even better rewards.
Will you rise to the challenge and conquer the competition to become the ultimate champion?

title: Vapor Strange
description: Explore bizarre procedural generated psychedelic worlds, encounter surreal creatures, experience shifting rulesets, retro aesthetics, and altered music for a wild and truly strange experience.

title: DiscPods
description: Fly your DiscPod robot and compete by being the ultimate and only winner of the arena! PvP your way to the championship!

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Accessory - Risk Taker's Choker
description: A choker that restores HP when using a limit break attack.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Armor - Nymphwing Bracelet
description: A bracelet that slightly restores MP after battle.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Summoning Materia - Polydroid Alexander
description: A summoning materia that summons Polydroid Alexander in the game.

title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Series Trilogy Edition
description: The Trilogy Edition of the Final Fantasy VII Remake Series.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Accessory - Reclaimant Choker & Survival Set
description: An item set for Final Fantasy VII Revelation.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
description:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins.
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Premium Plus Edition
description: The Premium Plus Edition of Final Fantasy VII Revelation. This product includes the main game, the Story Expansion Pass, and Early Access, which allows you to play the game 24 hours before its release.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Premium Edition
description: This product includes the main game, the Story Expansion Pass, and Early Access, which allows you to play the game 24 hours before its release.

title: Exodus
description: Step forward into Exodus — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

title: Mr. Panas
description: Mr. Panas is an asymmetric multiplayer game for 3 to 5 players, where one player is a grumpy old man and the rest are invisible Whispers turning his house upside down. They have until morning to finish their chores. He can only use sounds, shadows and their trail of mess to catch them.

title: UniversiaTCG
description: UniversiaTCG is a strategy game, based around a digital trading card game with solo campaigns, and casual or ranked 1v1, 2v2, and 4 player free-for-all game modes.

title: Ninja JajaMaru Yokai Night Parade
description: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

title: Sokogeek
description: Sokogeek is a block-pushing logic game with electrifying mechanics. Help Flux, a robot vacuum cleaner, escape each level by building the energy circuit that powers the exit. The complexity of the puzzles will test your spatial awareness, abstract thinking, and analytical skills to their limits.

title: Scales
description: Scales is a story-driven action-adventure RPG about a human-reptile hybrid. Players devour reptiles to absorb their DNA, and evolve through a corrupt world, where player choices ultimately determine the outcome of the story, blending combat with a darkly comedic narrative.

title: Matchward
description: Tower defense empowered by match 3 puzzle strategy. Level up and unlock potentially game-breaking upgrades. Design your own levels and share them.

title: Below Lethe
description: The River Lethe holds memories of the dead. Use its memories to uncover what happened and prove a soul's guilt in the Underworld. His guilt seemed clear—until truth shook the verdict. Knowing all the truth, can you still call him guilty? A story-driven psychological horror about memory and judgment.

title: A Game About Shooting Targets
description: Complete challenging missions across diverse shooting ranges, build your custom arsenal with unique weapons and attachments and defeat all blacklist members in order to take your place in the most prestigious squad of the army in this Game About Shooting Targets!

title: Applied Shamanism
description: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

title: Brain Bomb
description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

title: Too Slow Again
description: Too Slow Again is a first-person shooter in which every level is a race against the clock. On each track the player has to eliminate every target, complete its objectives and reach the finish line as fast as possible: every hit taken adds two seconds, dying ends the run and restarts are instant, with nothing left to chance. Over 100 tracks are split into weapon circuits for the assault rifle, pistol, shotgun and sniper rifle, set in a bright, flooded white city where glass, screens, steam pipes and gas cans break and explode. Movement includes sprinting, sliding, vaulting, climbing, leaning, ziplines and rappelling. Bronze, silver and gold medals and a leaderboard on every track measure each run, weapons level up from 1 to 50 to unlock attachments, and the Duo and Squad circuits are built for online co-op with two and four players.

title: Spectral Divide
description: Enter haunted locations alone or with friends, gather evidence, and identify the entity before it hunts you. Uncover memory fragments to piece together its past, discover its motive, and choose how to resolve the haunting.

title: Island Sort
description: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

title: Just One More Season
description: A roguelike esports management sim: take charge of a team and climb from Iron league to Diamond. Recruit and train players, manage finances and fans across seasons that play out differently every run. Lost the final? Just one more season.

title: Falafel King
description: Take orders, fry falafel and fill pitas, solo or with up to three friends, at a quiet stand in Tel Aviv’s Carmel market, back in the early 2000s. Do it well and word gets around: more customers, more dishes, and a lunch rush you’ll need every hand for.

title: Particle Collectotron
description: Click and collect energy in this short, active incremental. Upgrade your reactor, tune injector payload and trajectories, unlock exotic matter, and push the experiment past its limits.

title: My Cozy BookShop
description:
My Cozy Bookshop is a charming blend of shop management sim and light RPG, set in a colorful fantasy world full of magical readers, curious wanderers, and plenty of books to discover & find!

When your grandma decides to retire to a tropical island to finally finish writing her book, she hands the family bookshop over to you with no room for negotiation. The only thing you do get a say in? Renaming the place and making it your own.

title: Sayara's Path
description: Join Sayara on a journey through the snow-covered Vad-Hidek to find a way to bring her brother back to the world of the living. Here everyone’s fate depends on the will of the Spirits, and the path to resurrection becomes a trial the result of which is unknown.

title: Unwanted Guest
description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

title: Watch Out: Shark!
description: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

title: Forgotten Towns
description: Build a flourishing settlement above a dangerous cave system. Explore unique biomes, manage happiness and grief, invite traders, defend against invasions, train soldiers, recruit heroes, defeat world bosses, and prepare to dig into the depths below.

title: Police Stories 2
description:
Police Stories 2 is a cooperative tactical top-down police shooter.

The sequel to the iconic Police Stories will feature new challenges, new mechanics, and a brand-new story. Take command of a rundown precinct in the most crime-ridden part of the city. With limited resources, dangerous choices, and enemies on every side, the line between justice and compromise starts to blur.
Serve the law. Protect the innocent. Survive the system.

title: Warstead
