description: Build your base, secure vital resources, and lead your troops into battle. Warstead combines base building with tactical real-time combat. Will you invest in your economy, strengthen your defenses—or launch an attack?

title: Laylines
description: Laylines is a sailing management game set in the world of the oldest trophy in sailing. The player runs a challenger syndicate competing against five rivals for the right to face the defender. Off the water, the game covers crew scouting and contracts, training, sailor careers and retirement, boat research and development with component reliability and sea trials, design philosophy and target wind, sponsors, TV rights, merchandising and headquarters upgrades. On the water, match race duels play out in real time, boat against boat, under real racing rules: right of way, penalties, laylines, wind zones and shifts. Each Cup is made up of round robin groups, a Semi-final, a Challenger Final and the Cup Final, followed by a new season with a rule change, in an open-ended campaign.

title: Massively Singleplayer
description: A predatorily monetized MMO turned singleplayer action roguelite. Choose your class and face six biomes filled with hordes of monsters. You have 20 minutes before the servers shut down, survive the onslaught or get banned. Gamble your way to glory and pay some guy in a bush to bless you.

title: Project: Null Hypothesis
description: You will play as Elias found recordings, exploring the anomalous space with him. Uncover the sinister secrets of the Backrooms as you wander through endless corridors and frighteningly familiar rooms.

title: Hit the Anvil
description: Strike the anvil, forge rare gear, and build your legacy in a pixel-art incremental crafting game.

title: We Don't Exist
description: Lasers, spikes, gas, scalding steam: every room has its own way of killing you. Survive, room after room, under the gaze of someone who records everything. But the worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Here, survival has a price. You choose which one.

title: Dungeons of Destiny
description: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Loot! Dungeons of Destiny is an action-packed anime 3D dungeon crawler. Explore perilous dungeons, defeat formidable fantasy creatures, master powerful skills, and gather valuable loot to strengthen your character.

title: Taskbar Chickens
description: Taskbar Chickens is a cozy desktop companion game where a tiny chicken farm lives on top of your Windows taskbar while you work or play other games. Pet your chickens, toss them around and let them wander across your desktop. Breed them to hatch new chickens with unique looks and outfits, grow crops to keep them fed, clean up after them, and sell eggs to unlock new tools, structures and skills. Grow your collection and turn a small taskbar farm into a thriving chicken empire at your own pace.

title: Tiny Patisserie
description: Run your own cozy pastry shop. Spot what customers are craving, combine and box up sweet treats, and jump into hands-on minigames for every order. Unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and grow your tiny shop into a thriving neighborhood favorite.

title: Freshly Caught
description: Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

title: Synapse
description: A cyberpunk point-and-click thriller where your emotional score determines everything. Explore a city under constant surveillance, hack its systems, build dangerous connections, and make choices that decide your access - and whether you survive the night.

title: Frostmason
description: Hunt monsters for their body parts. Assemble them into a full specimen as part of a Cold War project

title: Dave the Diver: Subnautica 2
description: Dave the Diver dives into the mysterious world of Subnautica 2 in an all-new crossover adventure. New waters, strange creatures, and unexpected discoveries await beyond the portal.

title: Gamble Hunters
description: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

title: Dronefall
description: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

title: Wonder Air: Lunara's Adventure
description: Wonder Air: Lunaras Adventure is a fantasy flying action game where players can freely soar through a beautifully rendered 3D world.

title: Lemony Fresh
description: You are a tiny lemon who cleans filthy spaces. Explore and restore a home with a warm, beating heart.

title: Rondo's Romp
description: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

title: Jubaku
description: A first-person psychological horror with branching choices and multiple endings. Investigate a haunted house, document paranormal events, uncover hidden recordings, and decide whether to confront or escape the horrors lurking within.

title: The Facility
description: You look different today. Yesterday, you looked different too. Which one is really you? A psychological horror game about paranoia, identity, and the fear of trusting the wrong person.

title: Curse of Cards
description: Battle through a shifting cosmic library in this roguelike card-crawler. Combine satisfying card strategy with first-person exploration. Unleash ancient creatures of British folklore, gather relics, collect powerful cards, and fight to shape your own story escaping the cursed library’s grasp.

title: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager
description: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

title: Mise en War
description: A multiplayer cooking brawl for 2 to 8 players. Race to finish your recipe by chopping, frying, and baking while slapping rivals, stealing their prepared food, and deploying hilarious sabotage traps in a shared, chaotic kitchen arena!

title: Martial Art's History
description: Martial Art’s History: Early Republican China kung fu fighter inspired by classic kung fu films. Play varied warriors with unique authentic martial arts. Retro flat art depicts old dojos and arenas, with single-player story and local 2P duels & solid fluid melee combat.

title: Contract Terminated
description: Lead your band of mercenaries and figure out a way to survive on a hostile planet in this oldschool 1980s-style party-based RPG with pixel graphics. Features a mix of grid-based movement, turn-based tactical combat, and first-person dungeon crawling just like the classics.

title: Photoncytosis
description: Photoncytosis is an idle desktop life simulation in which a tiny organism feeds on the light of the screen and grows while the player works. Each cell stores energy, and absorbed colors influence the organism's development. Players can inspect cells under a microscope, research mutations, move creatures toward light, and confine them to an application window. Specialized cells support harvesting, perception, movement, energy storage, and repair. Organisms can split, regroup, and compete for resources in a changing desktop ecosystem.

title: Sova
description: Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.

title: Game About Botting in an MMORPG
description: Idle Incremental MMORPG Simulator where you start grinding manually, then gradually unlock Bot Modules until the game plays itself. Setup combat behavior and farming routes to find the most optimal configuration.

title: Theoria: A God Simulator
description: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

title: The Final Lane
description: Realistic bowling meets deckbuilding roguelike where the balls are the cards! Draft a synergistic deck of bowling balls, hone your skills, and battle the fellow damned as you climb through Hell for the ultimate prize: a shot at Satan and a chance at redemption.

title: The Wrong Ones
description: The Wrong Ones is a dialogue-driven social deduction game where players must unmask Skinwalkers hiding in plain sight among innocent townspeople. Stripping away action and visual giveaways, the experience challenges players to rely entirely on logic, active observation, and critical reasoning to catch the monsters through what they say—and what they leave out.

title: Cards after Midnight
description: A dark roguelike card adventure where a deadly curse controls the clock. Become a savage werewolf at midnight and a weapon-wielding survivor by day while escaping the villagers hunting you down.

title: Night at the Fun Park
description: A horror game set in an abandoned amusement park. Players search for exit keys while avoiding a giant spider, using noise to distract it and freeing captured teammates from cocoons.

title: Shiki Tea House
description: Shiki Tea House is a single-player cozy life-sim game. Open a little cozy tea shop and take part in farming, running tea business, exploring the town and more.

title: Cursed Gas Station
description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

title: Bloom Control
description: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

title: Too Many Clankers
description: Incremental tower defense game about one simple problem: too many clankers. Build an absurd amount of firepower and reduce the clankers to scrap.

title: No Truce With The Groceries
description: No Truce With The Groceries is a Disco-lite narrative point-and-click adventure set in the decaying hinterland of a declining America.

title: Graveheart
description: A retro FPS where William Wallace is back from the dead, Scotland is invading England, and your cursed weapons keep switching themselves at the worst possible moment.

title: Toxic Frontier
description: Unlock powerful cards and build a safe haven for your people within a world in ruins. In this roguelike city-builder, deploy cards across a hex grid to expand your colony and purify the land, buying another day of survival in the noxious wastes.

title: Really Illegal Golf
description: Golf, but make it illegal. Defy your membership ban and wreak havoc with friends in co-op, or tee off for a high score. Evade security, defend yourself with a customizable arsenal and take your games to the most outrageous places. Who said a tower crane wasn't the perfect place for a hole-in-one?

title: Infant God
description: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

title: Astrocraft
description: Open your own shop on a space station: stock the shelves, serve space travelers, and grow from a lone miner into a space tycoon. Mine asteroids for goods, hire a crew of robots, found outposts, and take to the stars in your own ship, solo or with up to four friends.

title: RingOut
description: Grab a weapon and blast your rivals out of the arena. RingOut is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter with 23 fighters, 13 weapons and 29 arenas. Play solo against bots or battle online — team up or go free-for-all across 6 explosive modes.

title: Still Breathing
description: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

title: Fox Stamps
description: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!

title: Open Land
description: Transform barren land into a thriving ecosystem in this relaxing building game. Recycle trash, grow plants, and reintroduce wildlife to create a self-sustaining world.

title: Deck Breaker
description: Deck Breaker is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder in which players choose a hero, build a deck during branching quests, combine spells, characters, and artifacts, and preserve selected foil cards across runs.

title: Family Time
description: Build a family with thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

title: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator
description: Build and manage your own pet shop in a first-person simulation experience. Sell pets, place stands, decorate your store, satisfy customers, grow your business, and create the ultimate pet shop.

title: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen
description: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen is a short incremental game about running your own kitchen to become the most powerful being on the planet.

title: Unexpected Tasks
description: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

title: Team Hero Coder
description: Assemble your team of heroes. Program their strategy with PseudoC or C#. Watch them battle, learn from what happens, and improve your code. Are you game to code?

title: RoboSquare: Recharged
description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

title: Hollow Crew
description: Hollow Crew is a survival horror set in the confines of an isolated space station. Its loyal androids have suddenly been turned against you - survive their relentless hunt and contain the emergency, or die trying.

title: Dino Cleanup
description:
Dino Cleanup is a wholesome cleaning 3D platformer where you play as a cute dinosaur with a vacuum cleaner saving a world that has been covered in toxic goop.

So many dinosaur friends are waiting for you to save them from a world covered in icky goop! Scale giant dinosaurs, discover ancient mysteries, and stop the corruption at its source. Suck up the goop and unlock unique vacuum abilities!

title: Fleshgrinder
description:
Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic action-rpg where every decision has weight.
Set in 2053, six months after the Fleshgrinder virus outbreak transformed 70% of augmented humanity into a hive-minded techno-organic collective.

Features three distinct characters with their own skill trees, optional friendly fire, hardcore permadeath mode, dismemberment physics, randomized mission areas, 30+ unique weapons, 100+armors, augmentations, consumables, ammo types with deep penetration mechanics and tons of loot with highly randomized attributes. NPCs with lots of side-quests and a faction reputation system which determines trade prices, dialogue choices and overall behaviour. Battle 11 unique enemy types through seamless mission areas in a huge persistent world where everything stays as you left it - all to stop the evolution of the Fleshgrinder and save humanity from extinction.

title: The 7th Shift
description: A psychological horror game about working overnight shifts alone in a grocery store. Stock shelves. Clean. Do your job. But you soon realize something sinister is watching. Survive seven shifts to discover why you were really hired and face a choice that will seal your fate.

title: Blight Doctors
description: Discover, diagnose, exorcise. You are a plague doctor paranormal investigator living in a rotten, gothic city at the end of an apocalypse. Banish ghosts, cure plagues, treat with monsters... all in co-op and proximity chat!

title: Find The Needle
description: Your a pleasant farmer that dropped a bag of needles into a haystack, now your goal is to find the needle. Incremental game where you build multiple Satisfactory style structures and create real production lines to construct the biggest hay processing and needle finding factory possible.

title: Silent Mainland
description: Silent Mainland is a roguelike deckbuilder based on movement and grid mechanics. Players engage in tactical battles on a vast 5x12 battlefield. Facing waves of oncoming monsters, use card-driven movement and positional control to defeat foes in dynamic formations.

title: Diss Diss Discussion
description: When student council president Sakurai fights to make uniforms optional, Hiyama pushes back against her (because Sakurai-senpai looks too good in them!) with nonsensical wit. Hasumi can barely look at what her crush gets himself into... A visual novel about the dumb things we say to get things done.

title: Vital Decisions
description: Take charge of a chaotic emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

title: Kayak Photography Sim
description: A meditative kayaking and photography sim. Open water, a slow boat, and nowhere you have to be. Paddle until you feel like stopping, photograph whatever catches your eye, dive underwater to explore what's down there. Nothing chases you. Nothing is timed. You're just chilling and exploring.

title: The Necessary Evil
description: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

title: HopScout
description: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

title: Armed-Mageddon
description: Grab some guns, mow down endless enemies and grow insanely powerful! Equip outrageous weapons, level up with game-changing upgrades, and create devastating synergies as you blast your way through the end of the world!

title: No Clean, No Exit
description: A 1-6 player co-op horror comedy about cleaning. Mop the filth out of a procedurally generated house while roaches, bedbugs, and ceiling-crawling spiders try to drag you off. The truck doesn't leave until the place is spotless.

title: The Ignition Protocol
description: The Ignition Protocol is an incremental, top-down mining game set in space. Mine and haul asteroids in zero-g, build and automate your base, and ignite a new star - the last light in a fading universe.

title: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon
description: Build a nuclear power plant and manage reactors, generators, and turbines, producing energy to keep the city lit and prevent reactor explosions. Earn resources, research nuclear technologies, build larger and more modern reactors, refine uranium, and create a nuclear energy empire.

title: Party's Over: Backyard Cleanup Simulator
description: A satisfying first-person cleanup sim. Collect trash, cash it in, unlock upgrades and new areas, and piece together what really happened last night.

title: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
description: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

title: Just Another Guild Day
description: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

title: Steel Core
description: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

title: Me and You
description: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

title: Capitol Diktatoria
description: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

title: I Want to Play the Villain!
description: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

title: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
description: This is the most chaotic farm in the universe. Combine 150+ crazy items to theorycraft game-breaking builds. Trigger massive, automated chain reactions to skyrocket your yields, poop to win!

title: Dance of the Butterflies
description: Your twin sister is missing. Under her name, you uncover a deadly system where 50 people compete for a Wish powerful enough to change anything. The price of entry is a piece of yourself, signed away in a contract. Survive. Find her. And try not to lose yourself to the people you meet along the way.

title: Conatus: Forgotten Depths
description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every weapon defines a unique playstyle. Explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, craft powerful potions and unravel the mysteries of a world built from everything humanity chose to forget.

title: Seasons of Books and Keys
description: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

title: Billionaire Life Simulator
description: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

title: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
description: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

title: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
description: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

title: Protocol Bound
description: Bound is a psychological thriller where you search through private conversations, hidden files, and recordings on devices that aren't your own. Manipulate others, uncover dark secrets, and shape the outcome through the choices you make.

title: Deepward
description: Choose 3 heroes from a roster of six, each with distinct weapons, abilities, and playstyles. Build the right squad, switch between heroes on the fly, and fight relentless horrors in this fast-paced horror FPS roguelite set in the 1920s. Descend beneath a god-forsaken place where death is permanent.

title: Gods Play Dice
description: A dice themed roguelike where every roll matters, and your journey will be lead by faith.. Luck isn't on your side, it is the game. Throw dice. Adapt. Survive, and most importantly believe in your dices.

title: Most Scuffed Golf
description: Build the course, then break it. Most Scuffed Golf is mini-golf for 1–4 couch players: each one places a tile in the hole layout, then everyone shoots through the chaos you all built together. Ramps, curves, bridges — and a hole that's always somehow still reachable.

title: Incyanspace
description: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

title: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime
description: An action roguelike deckbuilder with a twist: build your deck out of coins! Fight your way through this hellish train to the driver’s cabin, all while the eyes of a snarky demon are observing you. Although it is thrilled to decide your fate by mere coin flips, you were the one to take its job offer.

title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

title: Jawed
description: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

title: Elysium
description:
Elysium is a next-generation third-person mmorpg featuring a seamless open world, multiplayer gameplay, survival mechanics, crafting systems, AI companions, and player-driven progression; created by Mercenary Games, Elysium combines the best elements of mmorpgs, rpgs, open-world adventures, strategy games, and social multiplayer experiences into a living universe shaped by both players and artificial intelligence.
Explore vast lands, discover hidden secrets, build your legacy, participate in large-scale events, develop professions, engage in trade, battle powerful enemies, and influence the evolving world around you.

title: Rebel Roar
description: Rebel Roar is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in an animal cyberpunk universe. Lead a group of rebel animals, in a revolution against an evil Sapien Corporation. Combine decks to create your perfect warrior: from ninja cat to hacker possum.

title: Kwad
description: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

title: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
description: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games like Star Control, Solar Winds, and Lightspeed. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat; build out modular, upgradable ships; and explore a galaxy torn by war.

title: Ignitement
description: As a fire shaman, descend into a meditative battle against your inner demons. Wield explosive fire magic in a rogue-lite inferno. Burn through hordes, gather coins, unlock upgrades, and master the flame.

title: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore, hide, and evade entities with unique behaviors while using your real phone to detect and exorcise nearby threats, as you uncover what happened to your missing sister.

title: Cyberwars
description: Cyberwars is a turn-based tactics roguelike. You move infantry, vehicles, helicopters, naval units, and aircraft across hand-built maps, capture cities and factories for production, hold airports and ports to control the air and sea, and use terrain and fog of war to break the enemy line.

title: Between the Shelves
description: A cozy bookshop management game where customers step out of classic literature. Curate your shelves, recommend the perfect book, and unlock new items and mechanics as your shop grows into a living collection of stories.

title: Cages: Hidden Worlds
description: A first-person puzzle escape game set in a mansion that holds the remains of a freak show carnival. Meet the former stars of the show, now locked inside intricate contraptions. Venture into surreal worlds lurking between the cracks of reality and solve the workings of complex original machinery.

title: Starship Bloopers
description: Starship Bloopers is a chaotic co-op space survival game where one wrong move can doom the mission. Play with 2 to 6 crewmates as you traverse space, gather resources, survive disasters, battle aliens and each other's incompetence before the sun goes supernova. Can you keep your SHIP together?

title: Haparoot
description: Step into a dream world. Become the sole source of light in the darkness and Explore an authentic handcrafted landscape in third-person. Solve layered environmental puzzles, discuss some familiar issues and uncover secrets shaping the journey toward balance.

title: AmaTisMo
description: A visual novel about depression and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind players.

title: They Stop for Gas at Night
description: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

title: Moonlight Pale
description: Juliette follows the ghost of her dead cat into a nightmare where she has to fight and solve puzzles through eerily familiar corridors as she tries to survive and help the rest of the girls trapped inside. Discover the sins buried under St. Birgitta's Female Seminary.

title: Foxfire
description: A top-down sci-fi survivors-like with space physics and a devastating arsenal of evolving weaponry. Customize your ship and tear through alien swarms as routine recon missions descend into bullet hellscapes.

title: Dead Rose
description: Dead Rose is a 2D top-down action-adventure in pixel art, blending the exploration of a metroidvania with the epic adventure of a Zelda-like, in a world that is both gloomy and magical.

title: Come To My Party!
description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

title: Astral Dive
description: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

title: Clutch
description: Clutch is a cinematic, open-world, action-driving game from the team at Maverick Games - lead by former Forza Horizon Creative Director, Mike Brown, and other senior leads on the franchise.

title: Haunted Cleaner
description: Haunted Cleaner is a relaxing, light puzzle and narrative game about tidying up and decorating the homes of the deceased. Play as a psychic cleaner, uncover the stories left behind and help lingering ghosts find peace. Remember, every place tells a story, you just need to listen.

title: Pair at Sea
description: Manage your own pirate crew and sail across the sea. Take care of the ship morale, drag your sailors from one room to another and raid other ships as you navigate the seas.

title: Inherited Shadows
description: Inspired by the classics of the genre, Inherited Shadows weaves a gripping tale about Amanda, a young adult struggling to lead a normal life while haunted by the trauma of her mother's absence, but on an ordinary morning in 1999, everything will change for her forever.

title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering
description: Incremental suffering. Experience the 2-bit terror of the sole SSC KOPERNICUS survivor. Expand your base, construct weapons and face nightmares while trying to EXTRACT forgotten memories. There is no escape from THE THINGS you love.

title: Hyve
description:
The First and Only 2v2 Digital Card Game
Combine cards with your teammate in real-time to create powerful synergies and defeat your opponents in fast-paced 2v2 matches.

title: Ariadne's Tale
description: Ariadne's Tale is a 3D first-person puzzle adventure. Play as Ariadne, use a magical thread, navigate ancient traps and unravel the secrets of the Labyrinth to rescue Theseus. Myth, cunning and biting humor around every corner.

title: Hotel Paraíso
description: Explore a surreal hotel overrun by ghosts in this mellow yet haunting 2.5D RPG. Battles play like tactical puzzles: match colors, chain combos and stop the ghosts before they cross the board. Meet its animal guests and uncover what tore the worlds apart.

title: Bug Bounce
description: A co-op action roguelike where you evolve insect heroes, build absurdly powerful loadouts, crush swarms of enemies, and fling your friends through chaotic physics-based combat.

title: Spreadsheets & Dungeons
description: A grid-based turn-based roguelike where you manage a party across a dungeon which is a spreadsheet. Explore each dungeon, level up your heroes, build synergies, scale absurd stats, and survive escalating dungeon pressure through tactical positioning and resource management.

title: Caravana 2000
description: Choose your almost-famous costume and face the dangers of Brazilian chaotic nights. In this action roguelike, survive hordes, farm aura, wield sinister gadgets, and create insane combinations while dancing in the face of danger.

title: Dungeonery
description: Crawl your way through the dungeon in this roguelike autobattler. Equip your heroes with epic loot and test their might in battle! Your team might uncover game-breaking synergies and conquer the dungeon… or get wiped out. Probably will, actually. No biggie, there’s always more where they came from.

title: Kerogen
description: Dredge up corpses from an oil-drenched nightmare. Lost at sea, the small crew of the Atlas calls for aid. Elmsfire dances in the clouds above while black beasts stir in the waves beneath. Take your meds. Hold your breath. The black sea won't let go.

title: Bravo, Gaspar!
description: "Survive my sadistic show. An action roguelike where your performance with collectible creatures serves only to feed me. On my stage, the rule is simple: entertain or die!"

title: Fear Tall Grass
description: Dark creature-collecting roguelite where humanity enslaves their old gods. Command evolving monsters on the board of Humanity’s final crusade.

title: Fuman Ghoul
description: A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters. Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

title: Manafinder II
description: Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek a new purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

title: Czar Ry
description: Physically interactive adventure where you must escape a strange abyssal structure inside a batholith by learning its secrets. Use fully interactive physical hands: reach, grab, drag, hold. No action buttons, no clicks, no hotkeys. Every door, lever, and chain requires your hands to move further.

title: Infamous Keepers
description: Defend your dungeon AND your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

title: Hypnagogia: Broken Dreams
description: A protector submerged, a mirror shattered, and a dreamscape left severed. Unravel a new, surreal dream mystery as you platform, solve puzzles, meet unique characters, and much more in this first-person exploration prequel to Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams.

title: Knightstones
description: Deploy your armies on a war table in this tactical roguelike! Plan your formations, trigger tons of chain reactions, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be ready… or perish in the final battle.

title: Obake Nante Kowakunai JK vs. Gakkou Meikyuu
description: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

title: Dithered
description: Dithered invites you to a realm forsaken by the clock—a surreal nightmare where you must platform through the jagged shards of a protagonist's trauma. Guided by two bickering birds and hunted by a ticking horror, you must fight your way through a glitching reality…

title: M.A.Y.A
description: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

title: SnowRunner: Season 20
description: Season 20 of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

title: Deus Exia
description: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo through four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

title: Plagueborn
description: Plagueborn is a 2D action roguelike where you and your allies battle through plague-ridden dungeons. Explore procedurally generated floors, master a wide arsenal of weapons, forge unique builds, and cut down relentless hordes of darkness.

title: Kitman
description: KITMAN is a 1-4 player sports management simulator set in the backrooms of a stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

title: SlashZero
description: SlashZero is a 3D roguelike action platformer. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

title: Void Hunters
description: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

title: Cosmo Cargo
description: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelite game where you fight to preserve the chaos of the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

title: Veiled Shadows
description: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

title: A Little Less Desperation
description: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

title: Villain: Path of the Necromancer
description: You are an Osteurgo, a lesser necromancer risen from the ashes of the Dark Lord. Raise your empire among desolate mountains, subjugate savage tribes, and spread corruption. Build, conquer, withstand enemy hordes, and claim the empty throne of evil.

title: Rules: Motel Horizon
description: Start your job as a night administrator at the mysterious Horizon Motel, where visitors from another world try to pass as ordinary people, and the rules have the highest priority — breaking them leads to… undesirable consequences.

title: Crimson Realms: Relics of the Forgotten World
description: Embark on a colorful adventure in Crimson Realms! Battle creatures with four unique attack styles, defeat powerful demons to claim relics, overcome perilous obstacles, and complete epic missions in a world filled with danger and wonder.

title: Sin Return
description: An obscure adventure begins in the Silent Kingdom, a land decaying under the spread of the Sin-fication plague. This dark fantasy turn-based RPG emphasizes exploration. Reclaim lost memories in this sinful land, defeat formidable foes, and piece together the truth behind the catastrophe.

title: Perceptum
description: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

title: Fossil Quest
description: Fossil Quest is a cozy fossil‑digging life sim where you travel to dig sites, excavate bones, and assemble exhibits to build your own dinosaur museum. Upgrade tools, decorate your home, and curate displays before opening the museum to visitors in a relaxed, collectible‑focused experience.

title: Golf-Like
description: A golf roguelike where the ball never stops. Tee off onto a road over the sea that sinks behind you, steer through the air, shoot down the spiked escorts hunting you and face the Kraken. Pick your route through portals, sports arenas and hidden caves. New road, new deck, every run.

title: Whisk
description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

title: The Granny Detective Society
description: A cozy and quirky detective game where Madeline, a retired little mouse, watches her street and dives into thrilling investigations… until the Granny Detective Society contacts her and she discovers that the whole neighborhood is living a double life… especially the grannies.

title: Twisted Grove
description: A non-violent Roguelike Deckbuilder about befriending critters in a magical forest. Assemble unique decks, pet/compliment/smooch your way into the heart of corrupted flora and fauna, and dismantle the capitalist systems tearing down the Grove.

title: Abismo
description: Abismo is a deep-sea co-op horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet. Descend alone or with up to three friends into shifting trenches, recover classified research, and survive the crushing dark while uncovering an analog-horror mystery buried in corrupted VHS tapes.

title: A Game About Breaking A Cube
description: Take a role of a factory worker opressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facilty and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with the cold can of drinkable meat.

title: Quantum Quartz
description: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles!

title: The Quiet After
description: The Quiet After is a narrative visual novel where players guide Ava, a survivor navigating a quiet but dangerous world shaped by memory, trauma, and choice. Every decision branches the story, influences Ava’s inner voice, and determines how you survive in the aftermath. The game blends choice-driven storytelling, psychological horror, and atmospheric art to create an emotional narrative experience focused on healing, survival, and the consequences of the past.

title: Animal Bakery
description: Manage a cozy subway bakery in an underground animal city - run by a "retired" gangster you're secretly investigating. Serve cute locals, expand the bakery, prepare for festivals, meet strange visitors and explore the subway after hours for fun stories and special rewards!

title: Golden Retriever Simple Life
description: Share your days with an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Feed, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day. Teach tricks, discover new walks locations, and keep your furry friend happy and healthy.

title: Five More Minutes
description: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

title: The Detectorist Guild
description: Explore a quintessential British village collecting artefacts and studying local history. Solve a dark mystery that draws in you and your family. Complete quests for villagers who have a habit of losing their treasured possessions. Donate, trade and sell your ‘finds’ to build impressive collections.

title: Inquisitor Shepherd
description: Become Shepherd, an inquisitor sent to a suspicious village. Unveil the secrets of a world filled with fear, and make an inevitable choice. In this visual novel mystery, your decisions change the world. Can you survive the desperate horror?

title: Eye of Khaos
description: Slay your enemies in this sword and sorcery roguelike! Ancient dungeons, fallen ruins and cyclopean towers and their primordial denizens present a tactical and deadly challenge that can only be overcome by the most resourceful heroes.

title: Ruin: Beast City
description: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

title: Phase Nexus
description: Phase Nexus is an upcoming fast-paced 2D action-platformer starring speedster Cyanser and teleporter Raviel (once again not playable yet). Think of a fever fusion between Sonic (without the loops), Viewitful Joe, Sparkster/Rocket Knight and Luminous Avenger iX/White Steel X. In terms of mechanics and movement from those games, they blend well surprisingly.

title: Helcast
description: Fight your way from the Underworld to the gates of Asgard in a turn-based, merge-puzzle roguelite deckbuilder rooted in Norse mythology. Assemble godslaying builds and battle the unleashed dead by combining weapons, weighing velocity and mass with every shot to chain physics-driven merge combos.

title: Zeroth
description: Zeroth is a run-based action platformer with mechanical depth and interplay inspired by traditional Roguelikes. Learn the rules of Zeroth through hilarious deaths and guide your heroes as they seek to escape the 0th circle of Haell.

title: Shutter Story
description: Your friend is convinced his house is haunted. Examine his family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

title: Ashfield Hollow
description: Ten years after the outbreak, you’re found unconscious and taken in by a camp of survivors. Learn to fight, scavenge, farm, and craft as you rebuild your life, form bonds, and maybe even find love in this post-apocalyptic life sim RPG.

title: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
description: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Set in a corporate backrooms. Played against a creepy puppet.

title: Dwarven Village: Dark Siege Td
description: Dwarven Village Dark Siege is a game that you need to defend your crystals from orcs and goblins, Place Allies on paths, Place towers to the sides and make upgrades in the village

title: Stars of Icarus
description: Assemble your crew and take to the stars in a team-based PvP dogfight. Enter the forgotten arenas of space, master your ship's loadout and strategize with the rest of your ragtag squadron. Victory or death, together.

title: Out of Words
description: Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands — where everything you see is crafted by hand.

title: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
description: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or in treacherous free-for-all multiplayer. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm. Do you have the strength to seize the Iron Throne?

title: Anemorie
description: Anemorie is a visually rich, story-driven adventure game that invites players to step into the life of Anna, a young woman on a journey of self-discovery, love, and resilience.

title: Lemonade Apocalypse
description: Make money selling lemonade. Optimise your product. Build your workforce. Sell, sell, sell. But money is not enough. Become president! Fuel climate change! Manipulate geopolitical events! Lemonade Apocalypse is an incremental game about business decisions that are technically legal.

title: Artius: Pure Imagination
description: Artius is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as four unique artists fighting to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction. Dash, swing, and smash your way through vibrant, hand-drawn worlds inspired by art!

title: Phi: The Broken Strings
description:
Phi: The Broken Strings is a 3D puzzle platformer that takes you on an emotional journey through four levels, each reflecting a key life experience—Happiness, Sadness, Fear, and Anger.
The game is in the prototype stage.

With over 25 unique puzzles, 12+ immersive events, and dynamic NPC interactions, the game blends exploration, storytelling, and platforming into a 4-8 hour experience.

Perfect for fans of Little Nightmares, Inside, Limbo, and Bramble: The Mountain King.

title: Deadly Rehearsal
description: The rehearsal must be flawless. Every sound, every light timed perfectly. You are one of the best stage manager's after all. Failure is not an option. The play is cursed... and it demands perfection.

title: Deserter
description: In this stealth RPG, you play as a deserter who is forced to become a thief in a grim, war-torn town. You'll have access to a rich arsenal of tools and devices: from lock picks and crowbars to grappling hooks and dynamite. Additionally, take advantage of your surroundings: find or create alternate routes, stick to the shadows, stay quiet, or use loud noises to cause distraction.

title: Shine On, My Little Sun
description: When the Sun fell, darkness covered the world. In the snowy wasteland, the town of Svargo thrived under its faint light. But the Sun did not go out. The small Sun sleeps atop a grim lighthouse. What happens when the Sun awakens, seeking a few days of simple childhood?

title: Lords of the Fallen II
description: Lords of the Fallen 2, the highly anticipated sequel to the game released in 2023, is set to arrive in 2026. The team at Hexworks aims to create a sequel incorporating more commercial elements, particularly in visual design, to attract a broader audience of players.

title: Sick Samurai
description: Sick Samurai is a blindingly fast and bloody action game based on instant-death combat. Immerse yourself in lofi hip hop and retro anime aesthetics as you slash and dash your way to becoming the greatest fighter on the island.

title: Dark Queen of Samobor
description: Embark on a journey inspired by Slavic mythology and Croatian folklore in this 2.5D action-adventure game inspired by the likes of Song of Iron, Prince of Persia, Inside and Limbo.

title: Heaven Crawler
description: Heaven Crawler is an atmospheric, isometric action roguelite dungeon crawler with RPG elements. Explore The Womb, a forgotten, man-made tower that reaches the heavens. Collect powerful items and strengthen your character on an epic journey to the top. And remember: Bring her back!

title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

title: Bestiario
description: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

title: Simulacro
description: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

title: Medimon
description: "Medimon" is a health science-themed monster-taming RPG. Players capture, battle, and evolve creatures symbolizing health concepts, turning intricate biology into an interactive and captivating game experience. Dive in and make education an adventure!

title: Squid Grid
description: A squid-squirting, tentacle-bending puzzle game in a steampunk ocean.

title: Nine Rounds Rapid
description: A fast paced, super stylized, roguelike, twin stick shooter. Nine levels of designed, hand painted and procedurally generated, punchy and punky fast mayhem in a uniquely stunning attitude filled world.

title: Becrowned
description: Surreal survival horror in a world standing between reality and dreams. Unravel all the mysteries of the dark world, escape from your own fears, and explore the terrifying world where fire no longer burns.

title: Pineview Drive: Rising Storm
description: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

title: Super Cucumber
description: Super Cucumber is a 16-bit inspired action-adventure game filled with tight platforming, unlockable abilities and plenty of secrets to discover. Traverse more than six towers and overcome dozens of levels, fight your way past devious bosses and become the greatest Aardvark Superhero in the world!

title: Vice Undercover
description: Vice Undercover is a 1980's narco thriller where the only way to stop the deadly cartel is from within. Go undercover. Expose the cartel. Hack the drug war.

title: Demon Spore
description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

title: ReVamp
description: Rule as Dracula in this castle-defense roguelite. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

title: Fold'Em
description: Join the table for a surreal high stakes poker card game experience. Discover creepy characters and survive each round with whatever you can. There is something sinister at play...

title: Rex Summons a Meteor
description: A short game about a large rock. You accidentally summoned a meteor. Oops. Now you have to save the island! Barter with stubborn dinosaurs who only talk in emoji, play absurd mini-games, and solve puzzles in this silly first-person puzzle adventure.

title: Bon Voyage
description: Bon Voyage is an idle game where you conduct your steam train through 19th cent. Belgium. Choose your route and manage your train to deliver the best train service for your passengers. A companion game where the gameplay occurs at stops, allowing you to focus on other things in life during travel.

title: Earth Defense Force 6.2: Invaders from Another World
description:
Earth Defense Force 6.2: Invaders from Another World is the latest entry in the Earth Defense Force series, and a significant update of Earth Defense Force 6, which has captivated over one million players worldwide.

The series' signature appeal—the overwhelming sense of despair and the exhilarating feeling of defeating gigantic and countless enemies—will be elevated to the next level through PS5-specific advancements.

title: Ash and Flame
description: Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

title: Altiros
description: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

title: Category Connections
description: Category Connections is a chill puzzle game where you sort 3,000 things into 100 categories. No timers, no stress, just a big grid of things for you to organize. Perfect for a rainy afternoon.

title: Sakunaverse
description: An upcoming life simulation game about the VTuber Yuuki Sakuna.

title: Road Kings
description: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

title: Phase Zero
description: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Two survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and escape the town in this classic survival horror. Can you make it till dawn?

title: Trainwatch
description: Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper. His job is simple - close the gates at a desolate railway crossing for one month. This is his last chance to earn back his wife's trust. To prove he can stay sober. To become a better man. Join him at the Tower in the middle of nowhere. Help Troy fix his life.

title: Shadow of the Road
description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

title: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell
description: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a roguelite dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to climb a seemingly endless, interdimensional tower filled with monsters and temptation. Reforge your soul and climb ever-higher, or become corrupted by the evils lurking within.

title: Grave Seasons
description: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

title: Balls to the Walls
description: A short incremental physics game about upgrading and annihilating your balls. Equip chaotic special balls and buy physics-altering upgrades to break the simulation and get rich.

title: Backrooms: The Savior
description: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

title: Barbe-Yeux
description: Barbe-Yeux is a single-player comedic narrative adventure set in a pirate world. Players follow a self-proclaimed legendary captain and his two companions on a treasure hunt, exploring islands, meeting eccentric characters and taking part in story-driven minigames. The game combines absurd humour, dialogue, exploration and party-based combat.

title: Byte Bistro
description: Program a little robot crew and bring a neighborhood café to life. Cook, serve, restock, and refine your routines across 24 services. Mix visual programming with hands-on minigames, then keep your kitchen humming in Desktop Companion mode.

title: Gundam Rogue Orbit
description: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

title: Tales of Eldoria
description: The sun is gone. In a world trapped in eternal moonlight, guide Liora and her companions through the Arcadia dungeons in a story driven JRPG about sacrifice and the bonds formed when the world is already broken.

title: Keep Making Games
description: Tycoon for a one-person game studio, starting in 1976. Your only staff: a talking cassette, a bonsai and a chick with a megaphone. Unrealistic, I know. So is taking on the whole games industry alone for 50 years, and that's the plan. Build games from features, beat rivals to the shelves.

title: Eternal Anima
description: Yearning for a better future is considered a capital offense in the kingdom of Urvis Ael. After Wade questions this key tenet of his society, he finds himself on the run in an era-spanning adventure that challenges his core beliefs and reveals an unknown world filled with hidden truths. Alongside an eclectic group of new allies trying to survive a dangerous journey, Wade must travel through time to save civilizations of the past from catastrophes and unravel the secrets of a lost history.

title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
description: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

title: Trine 6: Together in Time
description: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trines iconic fantasy world.

title: Fox Arcana
description: Delve into the mystical depths of the Forest in this captivating roguelike. You play as a courageous fox, wielder of powerful spells, the last bulwark against the growing corruption.

title: NAND²
description: Build a computer from a single NAND gate: wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline, branch prediction and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. A long campaign through the eras of computing, plus a level editor and Steam Workshop.

title: Solar Arena
description: A 2D top-down versus shooter set in a wraparound space arena. Steer and boost your constantly moving craft, block attacks with a barrier, and fight in battles from 1-on-1 to 1-on-3. Customize your pilot’s appearance, with your chosen look reflected throughout the game.

title: Picatso
description: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

title: Breakremental
description: Breakremental is a brick breaker incremental game. Break bricks, get coins, buy upgrades, add more balls and watch everything slowly get out of control. There are bosses too, because apparently breaking normal bricks wasn't enough.

title: Last Haul
description: A mining roguelite where you fly a really small spaceship. Mining calls the enemies in. Haul the crystals home on a tractor beam and turn them into upgrades. Every zone ends on a boss, and if your ship is destroyed, the run is over.

title: Evergrowing
description: Grow the tree you live on in this cozy incremental game. Play as a squirrel, tend its leaves and build along the branches. Travel by balloon to other trees or explore the roots below. Your tree keeps growing while you're away.

title: Raid Haven
description:
Raid Haven is a strategy, wave-based survival game focused on building fortified bases and defending against ever-more-powerful raids. Gear up your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, adapt your defences, and survive wave after wave of increasingly dangerous enemies.

Build walls, traps, killboxes and defences to create an impenetrable fortress.

Face different raider archetypes every wave, each with their own strengths and tactics. Adapt your defences and strategy to survive whatever comes next.

Choose powerful rewards, equip your pawns, upgrade your gear, hire mercenaries, and adapt your defences before the next wave.

Inspired by RimWorld's tactical pawn-based combat, Raid Haven takes that foundation and puts the focus entirely on building, defending and surviving increasingly dangerous raids. Raid Haven is an independently developed game, built from the ground up by a solo developer with a passion for strategy, base building and tactical combat.

title: A Trans-Siberian Tea
description: A journey through the carriages of a Trans-Siberian train buried in the snow to reveal the identity of a legendary gentlewoman-thief as you speak with the frozen corpses of the passengers.

title: Die First
description: Die First is a casual, physics-based party game where the first player dead wins! Run, jump, dash, and use items or map hazards to destroy yourself while saving your opponents.

title: Hearts Gone Black
description: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down survival horror game where you scavenge abandoned homes and gather or mine resources in open world, fight infected, manage survivors, build a base, and endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices slowly wear you down.

title: Cassette Beasts 2002
description: Jump back into the world of beasts in Cassette Beasts 2002, coming to Xbox Series S | X, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC! A follow-up to the critically-acclaimed creature collector, Cassette Beasts, this new journey will have players fuse with over 240 beasts - any two beasts can be combined into over 50,000 combinations, all fully animated!

title: Orbit to Riches
description: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

title: The Concrete Sutra #1
description: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

title: Seasons Turning
description: A farming/life sim focused on exploration and immersion. There's no stamina bar and no broken tools. Aside from the genre's norms, it has four puzzle-filled dungeons, secret locations, irrigation, gene splicing, mafia kittens, and one rusty, well-loved bicycle. Save whenever. Play at your own speed.

title: Vale's Echo
description:
2D cozy horror adventure that blends dark comedy, psychological storytelling, and surreal art.

In Vale’s Echo, death isn’t the end — it’s your last chance. Players take on the role of Vale, a sarcastic and troubled soul who wakes up on a mysterious train to nowhere. No pulse. No past. No clue. Her only company? Echo — a floating skull full of secrets, charm, and just the right amount of mischief.

As Vale and Echo journey through the underworld to confront Death and uncover Vale’s past, players will meet a bizarre and unforgettable cast of characters — from chatty fish-human hybrids to leech merchants and morally dubious spirits. Each encounter challenges not just Vale’s choices, but also the player’s empathy, humor, and sense of right and wrong.

Gameplay in Vale’s Echo revolves around dialogue choices, unsettling puzzles, and branching narratives that shape Vale’s relationships, memories, and ultimate fate.

Beneath its eerie charm lies a deeply emotional story connecting the surreal with the human — all wrapped in cinematic visuals, melancholic music, and darkly witty writing.

title: Join Us
description: Lead a cult and prepare for the end of the world in Join Us, the upcoming co-op, open-world survival experience. Ride bears, build up your perfect base, and prepare for the apocalypse.

title: Kiipluu
description:
Kiipluu is a hardcore stealth adventure set in a brutal Neolithic world.

Every encounter is a tense survival puzzle. Study patrol routes, use tall grass, shadows, sound, and terrain to stay hidden. Set traps, strike from ambush, or slip past unseen. Being discovered can quickly become fatal.

When stealth fails, combat is fast, brutal, and unforgiving. Weapons are primitive. Injuries matter. There are no easy victories.

Along the way, Kiipluu is haunted by dreamlike spirit journeys and visions of his father, a legendary hunter whose shadow looms over every choice. Your decisions shape who survives, who is lost, and what kind of person Kiipluu becomes.

This is a story of fear, survival, and growing up in a world that wants you dead.

title: Crafters Heaven
description: Crafters Heaven is a lowpoly RPG sandbox adventure blending survival, crafting, and exploration. Build your base, fight wild creatures, and discover an open world full of secrets! Demo coming soon!

title: Croak
description: Croak is a nimble -and challenging- precision platformer featuring an innovative grapple mechanic. Use the prince’s tongue to dash and bounce around through hundreds of hand-crafted rooms. Manipulate the environment as you traverse distinct biomes, each with unique gameplay mechanics and bosses.

title: Flearun!
description: A retro, fast paced multiplayer on foot racing game for up to 4 players

title: Ballseye
description: A Goofy 2D Nubby-like featuring Monsters, Shooting, Explosions. There are a total of 8 different areas and their contents are procedurally generated each time they are played. The game can be played Solo, but it also supports Multiplayer PVP, Co-op, Level building and sharing.

title: Blossoming Yandere
description: You've moved into your first apartment. A girl gazes at you, craving your love. What are you to do when you're the center of someone's world? Make choices, explore your new home, piece together a mystery, and be careful. Your actions and words have consequences.

title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity - Definitive Edition
description: Experience the events of the Great Calamity with higher resolution visuals and smoother performance on Nintendo Switch 2!

title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
description: Atelier Karia tells the story of Karia, who has no memories, as she faces her past. New features add to the strategy of battles and depth of alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

title: Fable
description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

title: Yuna and the Spirit Forest
description: A 2D pixel-art metroidvania where you fight using elemental spirits instead of basic attacks. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles in a magical forest.

title: Persona 4 Revival
description: Who’s on Air? Legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journey to prevent more tragedies while uncovering the truth behind the chaos.

title: Among Us Story: On Guard
description: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX
description: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!

title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

title: God of War Laufey
description: God of War: Laufey is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Santa Monica Studio for PlayStation 5. The game follows Laufey, also known as Faye, after she awakens in a strange afterlife realm following her death. To protect Kratos and Atreus, she travels through the Everywhen, an afterlife of the gods where deities from different mythologies compete for power. The game shifts the focus from Kratos to Faye and features sword-based combat, magic, and new supporting characters.

title: Wake Up
description:
Wake Up is a thrilling 2D/3D adventure game made by R16studio. Dive into a world full of mystery, puzzles, psychological horror, and tension where every choice matters.
Are you ready to wake up and find the truth or maybe not.

title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
description: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

title: Spyder: Agent 8
description: Save the world as Agent 8, a robot spider superspy! Crawl across walls, ceilings, and floors, and use built-in gadgets to solve fun environmental puzzles in this brand-new, family-friendly adventure from the BAFTA Award-winning studio Sumo Digital.

title: Encryptid
description: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

title: Wild Life
description: Become the heroine Maya - strong, beautiful and able to call upon her wings, her tribal heritage - in this gripping Adult Action-RPG. Roam the world from fertile forests to dry and sun-soaked deserts, spread your wings and cut through the skies of a world torn by greed and vanity. Find your own way to ensure your survival and embrace the possibilities of fighting and sex.

title: Sagas of Lumin
description: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
description: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

title: Metro 2039
description:
METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

The year is 2039. For a quarter century, the last survivors of nuclear war have been locked in bitter conflict deep in the Metro tunnels beneath the poisoned city of Moscow.

Now, finally, they have been united by a single leader, a fanatical Spartan known as Hunter. But this is no peace: Hunter’s Novoreich regime rules through propaganda and fear, subjugating the population in the name of a new war for the surface against a dark and terrifying enemy.

In the wilderness beyond the city, the reclusive Stranger is haunted by violent waking nightmares. When the ghosts of his past force him out of exile, he must undertake a harrowing journey into the shattered ruins of Moscow, to the one place he swore he’d never go. The Metro.

Experience the most shocking METRO adventure yet in a powerful single-player story that weaves exploration, survival, combat and stealth across a hauntingly beautiful but deadly world with unparalleled immersion.

Inspired by the worldwide best-selling METRO book trilogy by Dmitry Glukhovsky.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
description: Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

title: 11 pm
description: A minimalist factory game that doesn't quite work the way you expect. Choose modules carefully, place them on your machines, and watch them drastically change how each machine produces. Build your own factory with its own rules. Optimizing it can become an obsession!

title: Flock Off!
description: Flock Off! is a first-person action adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off zombified sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

title: Shatterswarm
description:
Shatterswarm is a narrative-driven 2D space shooter that combines direct ship combat, fleet command, tower defense, and base building into a strategic colony survival experience. Command Captain Hope's hero ship as you defend Earth's last bastion, The Citadel, against the relentless Voxan Empire.

Take control of your hero ship in intense 2D space combat while simultaneously building and managing a fleet of ships, constructing defensive networks around your citadel, and managing resources to survive wave after wave of alien invaders. Every decision matters as you balance offensive capabilities with defensive structures, all while facing unique enemy types that require different strategies to defeat.
