The game features a diverse roster of challenging enemies, each with distinct mechanics: parasites that hack into and take control of your own ships, motherships that spawn smaller vessels, deflectors that fire your projectiles back at you, and robotic enemies that latch onto your ships and tear them apart. Face off against epic multi-phase boss battles against Voxan commanders Gordox, Gudrak, and the dreaded General Mortex.

With its perfect blend of action, strategy, and base building, Shatterswarm offers a unique short game experience where tactical thinking and quick reflexes are both essential for survival. The Citadel's survival depends on your strategy—will you focus on overwhelming firepower, impenetrable defenses, or a balanced approach?

title: Rookie Raiders
description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

title: C3 Nightfall
description: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

title: Elta: Defy All Gods
description: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

title: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
description: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

title: High Typer
description: High Typer is an intense typing roguelike where every keystroke, word, and mistake feeds a physics-based scoring system. Build your run, improve your flow, and chase better results through sharper, faster typing.

title: OxyDungeon
description: You wake up in a bizarre pop-art world, armed with a baseball bat and only four buttons: Up, Down, Left, and Right. Input dance-game-style arrow combos to create items, then smash and launch them with your bat to obliterate enemies and survive the chaos!

title: The Infinite Shift: Backrooms
description: The Infinite Shift is a psychological horror exploration game. As a pool cleaner caught in an unending shift, traverse eerie liminal spaces from submerged Poolrooms to Level 0. Solve environmental puzzles, evade lurking entities, and try to escape—before you drown in the depths of the Backrooms.

title: Lunar Crypt
description: Journey through the spirit world to exorcise the twelve zodiac animals and save Chinese New Year in this zero-gravity precision platformer inspired by Chinese mythology and folklore.

title: Yeommae
description: Yeommae is a point-and-click game about traditional Korean shamanism. Investigate objects, witness past memories, and solve puzzles. Uncover the truth through the four senses and untangle the twins' twisted fate at the hands of the Mudang.

title: Alchemist
description: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

title: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria - Chapter One
description: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria is a 3D metroidvania set in Seoul — a ghost city run by AI after humanity's population collapse. Explore a twisted Seoul and discover new abilities.

title: GTJ: Grand Theft Japan
description: Grand Theft Japan is a tribute to GTA and Yakuza, set in Japan. Featuring stories inspired by real events: soaring rice prices, roaming bears, yakuza clans, otaku culture, and shocking political incidents.

title: Every Wednesday
description: When Hideki steps inside for the first time, he does not yet realize that this is where he will finally stop feeling invisible after a long time. Meet new friends alongside him, uncover their stories, and support them through life’s challenges. They might even help you rewrite your own story …

title: A Date with Death 2: Remnants
description: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

title: Demi and the Fractured Dream
description: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

title: Aftershock
description: Put yourself in the shoes of a combat veteran. Can you handle the hardships that come with a life of solitude?

title: Bonebuilder
description: Fight imposing enemies in this 3D third person action roguelike. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through Bonebuilder's unique crafting and talent systems!

title: Brain Hack Squad
description: Build and lead your own cybernetic hit squad as you battle rival groups. Use real time tactical combat with pause to direct your cybernetic agents in combat. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants to gain control of the city.

title: Destiny Is Dice
description: A dungeon of chaos determined by a few dice rolls. The only one you can rely on here is Grin, the witch who rules the all of this place. She’ll gladly rig the dice for you. Use this to create options that never existed before and build the strongest team! Until, one day, you no longer need her help.

title: Elemental Lands
description: Build a base to support heroes in turn-based tactical card battles & defeat enemy breaches overwhelming your land! Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck, weakens foes & heals heroes. Position 3 heroes & use spell cards to seize enemy objectives for buffs. Cards are tactics, not damage.

title: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto
description: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto is a coming-of-age fantasy visual novel that depicts the summer of nine boys and girls. The game will be released in multiple installments, with each installment focusing on one protagonist and two heroines, together weaving a single story that unfolds over the same period of time.

title: Metroid Ravenous
description: It’s eat or be eaten! Take control of Samus Aran, a renowned bounty hunter ambushed by unknown attackers and marooned on an unfamiliar moon. Gather your arsenal, navigate a maze of corridors, hunt down powerful bosses, and use your newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour your foes. You’ll need to strike quickly and aggressively with beams, missiles, and more—lest you become the enemy’s next meal.

title: Until Dawn 2
description:
Ready to die for likes? Join a team of ambitious ghost hunters as they chase their next viral hit on a remote island haunted by a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena.

When the tale begins to manifest in terrifying ways, the group will have to fight their own fear—and anything else that gets in their way – to get off the island alive. Their lives are in your hands. Make every choice count.

title: Tropico 7
description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

title: Fate/Extra Record
description:
The “Moon Holy Grail War” begins anew…

The setting is a Spiritron virtual world called “SE.RA.PH.” built on the moon. Masters and Servants team up and fight for survival in pursuit of the “Holy Grail,” an omnipotent wish-granting device, in the Moon Holy Grail War which begins once again…

This is a remake of Fate/EXTRA, the first Fate series RPG originally released on July 22, 2010, now revamped for modern hardware with an expanded scenario, refreshed character graphics, and dramatic command battles utilizing a highly strategic deck-building system.

title: Fallgrade
description: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

title: Prison of Husks
description: A nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses and seek your lost love.

title: Demon Slayer Rome
description: A dark fantasy turn-based RPG. Battle demons and absorb their abilities, uncover secrets and progress in power, and save an Empire lost to sin as you go up against eight demon princes and the hordes of Hades! Demon Slayer Rome is turn-based Mega Man set in the time of the Roman Empire.

title: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
description: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools is a first-person anomaly-spotting horror game set in a looping complex of liminal poolrooms. Players study tiled corridors, pools and flooded chambers, turning back when something has changed and continuing when everything looks normal. In the Survival Stage, players photograph multiple anomalies before time runs out.

title: Tide of the Depths
description: Build a team of mighty sea creatures in a lane-based tower defense where the battlefield reshapes your strategy. Harness environmental powers, trigger elemental chain reactions, and adapt your defenders to stop the corruption.

title: Smashteroids
description: A twin-stick Asteroids roguelite where you stack 190+ absurd upgrades until one fragile ship fills the whole screen with firepower. 22 ships with unique kits, 22 handcrafted bosses, mini-boss packs that crash your stage, 100+ colour palettes, and a branching campaign toward a dying star.

title: Dead Reckoner
description: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

title: Arizona Sunshine
description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

title: Wandering Sword
description:
The hit pixel-art RPG set in the world of Chinese martial arts is finally coming to PlayStation!
Play as a young swordsman gravely injured after being caught in a violent conflict.
Having narrowly escaped death, you set out on a journey to master the martial arts and fulfill your destiny as a true hero in a vast wuxia world.
Includes Original DLC
All DLC released on other platforms is included:
“Immortal Trails Across the Blue Sea”
“Mount Pack: The Supreme Steed”

title: Lelu
description:
Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

Navigate your way through the toy factory, a labyrinthian tower filled with puzzles and traps set by the factory’s eccentric guardian. Use your wits and agility to overcome challenges, from conveyor belts and electrifying circuits to sentient toys and towering toy titans.
As you delve deeper into the world, uncover hidden abilities to aid you in your quest, alongside a variety of secrets and other toys sharing your desire for freedom.

Will you find your way to the elusive exit, or will you just be another toy on the shelf?

title: Calx
description: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

title: Zombillionaire
description: Incremental FPS game where Millions of Zombies came from the dead... AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!!!!!! Demolish Millions of Zombies. Buy Insane Weapons. and become a Zombie Oil Billionaire

title: Murder Meet Cute
description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

title: Plush Rangers
description: Survive waves of wacky mutated constructs and defeat powerful bosses with your team of Plushie friends in this quirky chaotic Survivors-like. Collect loot! Acquire merit badges! Dodge and dash your way to victory!

title: Demra: Rifts of War
description: Real-time strategy in the spirit of the 90s classics, with a twist of its own. Build your base, seize mines and lead your army with a spell-casting hero against a demon invasion – or command the demons yourself. 15-mission campaign, skirmish and online multiplayer.

title: Usual June
description: Hang out, fight monsters, and discover your town’s darkest secrets in Usual June, a third person action game about summer break and the end of the world.

title: Cogito: Requiem
description:
Cogito: Requiem is a 2D action game where you dash freely through a harmony of music and sound effects.

The setting: a world where humanity has migrated into the digital realm and vanished, leaving behind only the SI—artificial intelligences who once had humans as their masters. As Cogito, you race through this world where their remnants linger, set on "ending" the SI that have fallen into error.

title: Fit Boxing: Touken Ranbu - Shutsujin! Exercise Honmaru
Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of the U.S.A.
Echoes of Agony
description: A dark turn-based roguelite where you are hunted by your own inner demons. Master the dynamic turn economy, collect loot and push your limits. The more you suffer, the greater the rewards. How much are you willing to endure in the pursuit of power?

title: TankRat
description: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

title: Stranger Than Heaven
description: Stranger Than Heaven is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The game follows a multi-decade story across five eras and five cities, centered on men searching for a place to belong. It combines close-quarters action with narrative elements, historical urban settings, and activities connected to music and performance.

title: Ananta
description: Take on the role of an elite Agent within the A.C.D. (Anti-Chaos Directorate) embarking on an exhilarating adventure through a world that breaks all the rules. Meet a variety of interesting characters, jump into exciting combat, solve challenges and safeguard the balance by overcoming threats to humanity, all while enjoying unparalleled freedom to traverse and discover Nova City on a journey to find out who you really are.

title: Sturmjäger
description:
Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up for everyone who wants to skip the cinematic fluff and dive straight into unadulterated, chaotic, and adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Master ten unique missions, either solo or with a friend in local co-op.

Every single stage features its own distinct visual theme and a custom-tailored soundtrack, taking you from the deepest corners of outer space straight to the bottom of the ocean, merciless boss fights included.

With three different game modes and three difficulty levels, maximum replayability is guaranteed, no matter how fast your reflexes are.

The rules are simple: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't move... shoot it anyway, just to be safe.

Genre veterans are in for a treat: The deep, finely-tuned scoring system rewards aggressive and flawless gameplay. Rack up massive score multipliers with quick kills, kill chains, risky proximity close-quarters attacks, no-death runs, and much more. Perfect your strategy, climb the global online leaderboards, and test your mettle against the best pilots in the world!

title: Terranigma
description: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

title: Everfront
description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

title: Danganronpa 2x2
description:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

title: Flask
description: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials
description: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

title: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.
description: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, and the explosive power of chemistry. As a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter, you’ll craft potions for the resistance, engineer devastating bombs, and dismantle tyranny from the shadows.

title: The Hambagu Shop
description: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror narrative simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

title: Stellarch
description: Stellarch is a deterministic, provably-fair trading-card game on the Hive blockchain. Draft a seven-card team of Fighters across eight elemental affinities and let a seeded combat engine resolve the battle; every match replays byte-identically from its seed, so any result can be verified. You own your cards on-chain, and a smart deck beats a deep wallet. Fair, not free. The alpha is ongoing at stellarch.io.

title: Midgardr
description: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

title: Zaos
description: International Free to Play Fantasy MMORPG game, featuring incredible journeys through a beautiful expanding world.

title: Armatus
description: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

title: BrokenLore: Ascend
description: BrokenLore: Ascend is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness—and to the truth about themselves.

title: Stranded in the Abyss
description: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

title: Blood Covenant
description: Blood Covenant is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror job-sim. Players are a hazmat cleaning crew taking night jobs at farmhouses, barns in the woods and an abandoned psychiatric hospital. Each shift they scrub blood, bag remains, seal breaches and repair fences, then return to the van before the entity that has moved in comes for them. Players spot anomalies, read messages written on the walls under UV light, and must identify the entity before lighting the ritual altar; naming the wrong one turns it against the crew. Can be played solo or with up to three friends.

title: Hephaestus Protocol
description: Hephaestus Protocol is a mythology centric Bullet Heaven Action Roguelike where players forge weapons mid-battle, and carve through endless waves of enemies, including mythical beasts, as well as the Gods themselves.

title: Cascabel
description: Cascabel is an online western role-playing game set in a valley in the Brazilian countryside, played in the PC web browser with no download. Players arrive as travelers and choose their own path: learning trades, fishing, hunting, raising a ranch with crops and livestock, and riding between villages. Goods are sold and traded with other players in the village Market, and duels in the street only start when both players accept.

title: Count on Chaos
description: Your computer is infected. Help Buddy, a tiny calculator, fight through the Wallpaper Kingdom. Give a plain answer to strike and brace, or build an equivalent equation to hit harder while viruses throw pop-ups, steal keys and play dirty.

title: Last Man Running
description: Last Man Running is a physics-based parkour party game in which players race across procedurally assembled rooftops while escaping a zombie horde. Players can tackle, grab and throw rivals in free-for-all or team elimination matches, cooperate to survive, or chase high scores solo. It supports local and online multiplayer, including mixed couch and remote players.

title: Kristi Sky Islands
description: Kristi Sky Islands is a turn-based strategy game. Lead a group of heroes, face various foes, upgrade and equip your heroes, fuse your items to obtain higher-rarity items, and conquer bosses.

title: Clean Tides
description: A cozy ocean-cleaning game where every haul builds a better boat. Sail a sunny bay, collect litter, clear oil spills, and power-wash coral reefs. Sell your haul to upgrade and customize your boat, hire cleanup boats, and feed wildlife. Bring a little sparkle back to the sea at your own pace.

title: Kill the Thing
description: Kill The Thing is a challenging roguelike turn-based tactical RPG. Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin. Undertake missions across four distinct regions, targeting key resources, upgrading your base, and building your roster of heroes. For the final confrontation.

title: Burger Smash
description: Plan your kitchen, grill burgers, and keep orders flowing in this fast-paced singleplayer cooking game. Design efficient layouts, prepare and serve orders under pressure, unlock unique playable characters with unique perks, and adapt to demanding customers.

title: Roll or Die
description: The roguelike dicebuilder. Build your dice bag and go as far as you can in this underground casino! Earn chips, place your bets, combine unique dice, and create absurd synergies as you advance through increasingly exclusive rooms. Bet it all, challenge your luck, and reach the top — or die trying.

title: Hardcore Cyborg
description: Take on the roll of a cybernetic soldier on a mission to destroy the enemy force before your world is consumed by an all encompassing corruption.

title: Ruptured Floor
description: Ruptured Floor is a puzzle horror game set in surreal office spaces. It tells a story about depression and work. The protagonist needs to find a way to escape, and uncover dark secrets in the process.

title: Brave Billiards
description: 《Brave Billiards》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelike building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

title: Hellcrown
description: You are dead. But your ghostly hand still commands. Hellcrown is a roguelite strategy game where every run unfolds into a chain of random stories, sieges, and consequences.

title: Long Shadow
description: Guide one family across centuries of collapse, evacuation, settlement and interstellar expansion. Preserve memories, establish laws, command crews, inherit ships and face the Afterless as every choice becomes part of history.

title: Joint Venture
description: Run the prison commissary from behind the window: match IDs to prisoner numbers, obey the guards' daily rules, and fill orders for profit. Then build a contraband empire in drugs, shivs, and smuggled goods, dodging patrols, cameras, and pat-downs. Serve your time, or smuggle your way out.

title: One Billion Ducks
description: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

title: Cytokine Storm
description: Cytokine Storm is a retro survival horror set inside a coma patient's body. Battle parasites, viruses, and a defective immune system to wake yourself up. Explore a surreal biological world where you must use your wits, weapons, and unique costumes to survive grotesque locations and puzzles.

title: Polymorphite
description: Polymorphite is a rhythm-adventure hybrid game that fuses keyboard-and-mouse rhythm dodging gameplay with a deep narrative following three concurrent Tokyo residents as a bizarre serial murder case unravels the fabric of reality; and the question of what it means to be “human” becomes more important than ever before.

title: Stinker Golf
description: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you edit the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold
description: Prepare for Evercold, the sixth expansion pack in the ever‑expanding world of Final Fantasy XIV Online.

title: Crash and Conquer
description: A thrilling, Carmageddon/Twisted metal-inspired roguelite game blending high-octane driving and action with strategic elements.

title: CyberQuest
description: Explore CyberQuest, where your decisions define you. Journey from a novice freelancer to a skilled hacker. Choose your path: white hat, black hat, or hacktivist, and embrace the cyber challenge!

title: Wizard 64
description: Destroy incoming enemies as a flying wizard. Collect points to grow stronger. Unlock new weapons and abilities, and use different builds to defeat endless monster hordes.

title: Built by Force
description: Merge Titanfall-style gunplay with Satisfactory base-building and Minecraft exploration in a living, randomized world. Transform at will, master a single-resource economy, and join with up to 11 friends to face adaptive AI enemies.

title: Cellscape
description: Experience life as a microbe in a dynamic, living ecosystem. Hunt bacteria, dodge hazards and predators, and divide as many times as you can!

title: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
description: A fan-made roguelike action Touhou game. Due to a Kedama incident in Gensokyo, Flandre Scarlet eagerly takes the initiative to resolve it. Or rather, she's actually just causing chaos, definitely not trying to solve anything!

title: RockBeasts
description:
Lead a band of misfits on a roller-coaster ride to stardom in the age of MTV, rock anthems, and bad haircuts. ROCKBEASTS is a story-driven, role-playing management game that puts you in the shoes of a manager of an up-and-coming rock band.

Rock ‘n’ Roll Band Manager: This band has real potential, but they need your help to live up to it. Their tunes can revolutionize the music industry and redefine genres - but what good is a great song if no one hears it? It’s your job to land your clients a record deal and negotiate the terms on their behalf. Will you help them fight for their creative freedom, or sell them out to the industry bigwigs?

Coffee and Cigarettes for Breakfast: Sex, drugs, and rock ’n’ roll can only get you so far. Somebody has to make sure the band is in shape to play the next gig. This is where you come in. Make sure they eat a half-decent meal every now and again, fix their gear, get them to rehearse… Hope you like herding cats!

Don’t Stop Me Now: It’s your job to book the venue, finalize the setlist and ensure the gig goes according to the plan. Each successful performance is a step toward fame and glory. Sure, that “club” was just a grimy basement, and the audience barely outnumbered the band - but even rock legends have to start somewhere, right?

title: Idle Casino Empire
description: An idle casino tycoon where you build the floor, then rig it. Turn casino psychology into upgrades. Play blackjack, roulette, and slots in Owner Mode. Use the Owner's Edge to cheat: nudge reels, peek at hidden cards, read marked cards. Eight venues, a prestige loop. The house is you.

title: Name of the Will
description: You are informed to be a resident of Hope, a suspiciously harmonious community. Dodge the secretive governors, establish a rapport with your neighbors who monitor you, and solve puzzles to find out how you got here. Are you willing to sacrifice for the truth? Or, are you choosing a life of oblivion?

title: Kloa: Child of the Forest
description: Consumed by a mysterious curse, restore a once lush forest and its inhabitants to their natural state in this action adventure tale. Experience fast-paced combat, puzzles, and the beauty of nature captured in handcrafted pixel art.

title: Outliers: Incrementum
description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

title: The Hundredth Floor: Extraction
description: A 3D dungeon crawler ARPG blending looter-slasher & extraction mechanics. Delve into a 100-floor abyss where you must choose: play it safe or risk it all! Craft unique builds with massive talent trees & 1,000+ affixes. Defeat bosses and extract with epic loot, or lose everything to greed!

title: Agency
description: Play as π (Pi) in a weird game that makes you figure out the rules of eight very distinct challenges. Discover the meaning of the game and email us your thoughts on it.

title: Afterwork Apocalypse
description: A horde-survival roguelite in a cursed office tower. Weaponise the stapler, the hot coffee and the all-hands microphone, keep your panicking colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and ride the elevator up floor by floor. Overtime is not optional.

title: iWin Daily Challenge
description: Play a suite of daily puzzle games to earn rolls on the game board and unlock badges.

title: Woks & Works
description: Build and automate your restaurant empire. Manage chefs, customers, supplies, and production chains in a living food economy.

title: Drainbound
description: You are Drainbound, it is your time. A roguelike adventure where you must fight, suffer and sever to discover your true destination.

title: 72 Seconds
description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

title: Feet in Food
description: What could possibly be better than food? That's right! Feet in food! LOTS OF FEET! Create food arrangements around the girls, then wash their feet clean of all the food and sauces afterward. You wouldn't want them to stay dirty, would you?

title: 9Clock OverPack
description: You have until nine. Ransack the room, decide what actually matters, and cram it into a suitcase that is always one slot too small. Everything you leave behind comes back - as a story about how your trip went.

title: Address The Mess
description: Address The Mess is a single-player narrative sim. Clean up the scattered post, use magic, solve puzzles, find props and assemble furniture. Unlock & use magic spells and be unstoppable, or relax and enjoy the narrative sim at your own pace, with a spirit doggo, cat and your friendly mail pigeon.

title: Speed Card Eatery
description: Hurry!Hurry!I'm going to become a legendary card-stall master—right this second!

title: Wakesurfer: Get Gnarly!
description: A free wakesurfing game you play in your browser, on your phone or computer. Ride behind real wake boats, toss the rope and surf the wave: airs, spins, flips and wake-to-wake transfers across 17 levels, from a glassy local lake and a wave park to river waves, races and a Mega Yacht's giant wave. Made by a Wisconsin wakesurfer.

title: Pawn Shift
description: You're working the night shift at a pawn shop on an isolated road. Haggle with every customer who walks in, inspect what they bring you, and decide what goes on your shelf. Some of it should not be here. Nothing is supernatural, and that is the scariest part. A PSX-style horror shift.

title: Shore
description: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

title: Cozy Shores
description: You find yourself stranded on an abandoned island with your beloved cat. Clean the island, recycle all the trash, build a bond with your pet and create a cozy paradise.

title: Station 12
description: Station 12 is a chaotic sci-fi horror party game for 4–6 players. Team up to escape a doomed space station while one of your friends hunts you as the monster. Scream over proximity chat, rescue your crew, and turn a desperate escape into a hilarious disaster.

title: Rampartloom: PvP Tower Defense
description: Tower Defense meets 3v3 Tower Wars. Build mazes with defensive towers, send assault units, and grow your economy in free-to-play team battles. Draft from twelve factions and coordinate with your team to break the opposing defense.

title: Magically Sorted
description: Tidy up a magical shop by sorting scattered potions, ingredients, and books back onto their shelves, uncovering curious lore behind them as you go. Brew potions in the cauldron to unlock magical skills and find lost recipes for legendary potions, while enjoying the shop's relaxing atmosphere.

title: Little Witch’s Lodge a Cozy Magical Cleanup Game
description: A young witch has accidentally cast the wrong spell and turned her cozy lodge into complete chaos. Books, potions, bottles, and magical objects are scattered everywhere. Your task is simple: explore the lodge, collect every item, and return it to the correct place.

title: Pray & Slay
description: Pray & Slay is a short-form action incremental where you wield holy light, tear through fast-paced runs, and unlock increasingly powerful—and increasingly unholy—ways to destroy everything in your path.

title: Dancing Zombie
description: A sudden zombie outbreak has swept the city. You barely make it to a shelter, only to discover that five Host Dancing Zombies are hiding among the survivors, disguised as humans. Want to find them and take them down? Then, dance!

title: Liminal Angel
description: Demons have possessed the wildlife, turning animals against humanity. As an angel in human form, you must prepare for a perilous journey. Meet the survivors without revealing your true identity, gather your gear, and evade demon-possessed beasts before dawn breaks.

title: Tidy Tech
description: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

title: Expedition of the Guild
description: Lead your guild into epic raid battles! Recruit heroes from different classes, build your own team, and challenge powerful bosses with unique mechanics. Unlock talent trees, collect endgame gear, and grow from a small squad into the strongest guild. Relive the golden age of MMORPGs!

title: Aegis Vanguard
description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

title: Calibration Sequence
description: Calibration Sequence is a bullet hell game where you play as a nanobot undergoing its factory calibration.

title: Divided Empire: Sengoku
description: Lead your clan through Japan's turbulent Sengoku period. Craft wise strategies to expand your domain and use cunning tactics to defeat your enemies on the battlefield. Emerge victorious, restore order, and claim the title of Shogun!

title: Find Bunny: A Little Hidden Journey
description: Find Bunny is a cozy hidden-object game where you peel stickers to find and collect hidden pictures. Join Coco and Matcha on a journey to uncover the secret of the misbehaving crops. Cross the sea, ride the train, fill your album with stickers, and help new friends bring peace back to the farm!

title: Dig! Dig! Dig!
description: DIG Company hires you as a "Digger." Descend into abandoned mines to complete a mission - press the red button. Ride the elevator and DIG crystals to power it, choose characters with unique abilities, and escape terrifying monsters from the depths of the mines.

title: Arcanum Solitarius
description: Poker solitaire with an arcane twist. Each row and column of the 5x5 grid is a poker hand, scoring as it fills. Repeat a hand and it's worth half. Purify the cursed Arcana, corrupted tarot cards that penalize your play. Draft Jokers for unique powers and power up your deck and board for bonus chips.

title: Simmer Down
description: A cozy co-op cooking game for up to four. Chop, cook and plate real recipes, serve tables that eat together and furnish your own restaurant, then follow a family of caterers through forty years of other people's big days, always from the kitchen.

title: Littlest Catalyst: Swarm Defense
description:
A small scale real-time strategy/base defense game with roguelite elements

Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

title: Anvilia
description: Run a medieval blacksmith shop in co-op. Gather resources, forge tools, stock your shelves, and grow a thriving business.

title: Alchemy Duel
description: Alchemy Duel is a card game that combines elements of alchemy and roguelike gameplay. Alchemize monsters suited to the situation and unleash powerful combos by making use of synergies between your cards!

title: Fork the Rich
description: Billionaires should not exist. It's time to Fork the Rich!

title: Doomsday Train
description: Doom falls and civilization collapses entirely. The roaming train becomes the last hope of mankind. You will take charge of the vehicle, manage and equip survivors, allocate food and daily tasks, collect resources to resist zombie swarms. The fate of everyone hinges on your decisions.

title: Muritura
description: A mouse wakes in a tiny community after a terrible storm brings more than just weather with it. Fight or flee monsters, mouse around puzzles, engage with locals, and uncover the source of the unnatural storm in this old-school, adventure game.

title: Unburied
description: The Unburied King's funeral marches home, waking every grave it crosses. Keep the vigil alone or with friends — hold until dawn, and the dead burn to ash. Free demo out now.

title: Sapphobos
description: Sapphobos is a mystery and horror VR game. Explore, find clues, make deductions, choose the right conclusions, and maybe you will understand what happened to your missing colleague...

title: Wizards Never Lie
description:
Wizards Never Lie is a four-player online social deduction game set in a members-only club for wizards that stands in the space between worlds. Four players take seats at one table in first-person 3D, where nothing anyone claims can be verified — the round settles it a few seconds later, in front of everybody.

The house keeps four games: Revolvers, Hidden Figures, Cards and Poison. All four share one set of actions — Ask, Declare, Check — so the rules carry from one game to the next, and a single evening may only get through two of them. Any claim can be challenged with a Check at any moment, but each player holds only a few: catching a liar pays, and accusing an honest one costs.

Every claim a player makes goes on a public record, the Truth/Lie Trend. A long run of lies builds a streak and a readable pattern; a long run of honesty makes the first lie harder to see coming.

The table talks on three channels. Each player’s live webcam sits above their seat — optional, off until the player turns it on, and never scored; it changes what the table believes and nothing else. Voice chat is available and not required. A wand draws glowing glyphs in the air for accusations, warnings and jokes, so no shared language is needed at the table, and the game ships in 14 languages. Free Table mode removes scoring entirely, for players who want to sit, talk and take in the club.

title: Pages of Tomorrow
description:
Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

Take on the role of Alex, a teenager struggling with mental health, as she finds herself in the middle of a supernatural mystery. There are secrets to uncover in this ward, but putting the pieces together will not be easy. Forge your own destiny in this tale of recovery and finding happiness—is it true that fate cannot be changed?

title: Inner Eko
description: A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of. Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

title: Chiki Poki: Rush
description: The world's cutest extermination job. A fast, hands-on incremental shooter.Hunt down the Cheepy — cuddly critters that mimic anything — and gather 5 kinds of star candy to keep your ultimates chaining, endlessly.Grow stronger every run with what you collect. Until the Cheepy King falls!

title: I Just Wanted to Fish
description: A stranger, a fishing rod and an island full of closed paths. Fish, explore and help the townsfolk until every shore is yours to fish.

title: Psycorp
description: Three siblings are given AI-Powered cybernetics by their dying CEO father to permanently bring out the worst in them. How much of your mind are you willing to lose to control your family's company, and the future of surveillance in this narrative driven AI corporate dystopia?

title: Dead Hand
description: A post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are both your actions and your resources. Play them to act now, keep them to last longer. There is never enough for both.

title: Lone Lines: RPG
description: Roguelite RPG set between a shifting desert and the flipside of a grim dark future. Explore the world in the body of the Pilot, command a living, katana-wielding Rover, and forge your own path through a non-linear story. Fight, level up, and make choices where absolutely everything is on the line.

title: Refuel Together
description: Run a gas station with 1 to 6 player as Co-Op in Refuel Together. Build a large gas station from a single gas pump. Upgrade and expand your gas station as more cars arrive. Become popular as you meet your customers' demands.

title: What Killed Rachel
description: A story-driven psychological horror that chases the truth behind Rachel's death. As you follow scattered memories, you slowly come face to face with the reality of the tragedy. Blaming someone is easy. But answering what truly killed her is not.

title: Hell-A
description: An online co-op horror action game. Enter the bureaucratic Hell and prove your worth through the Seven Deadly Sins. Master physics, combine magic, and face the trials together or turn on your friends. Maybe they hold you back?

title: Something Is Wrong With the Library
description: Shelve hundreds of real books in a library haunted by blood and meat. A spooky narrative organizing simulator by the studio behind I Am Your Beast and Clickolding.

title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands
description: Pharaoh Lands is a DLC for the side-scrolling micro strategy game, Kingdom Two Crowns. Adventure within the Valley of Kings and discover the domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting as you uncover the source of the chaos throughout the land.

title: Onward! Autobattles
description: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onwards! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

title: Aphasia
description: Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back? Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are. As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

title: Super Terrestrial
description: A roguelite autoscroller, where you control a spaceship navigating procedurally generated levels. Use limited aerial jumps and hover abilities to dodge hazards, collect gems, and explore alternate biomes. Each run features upgrades, power-ups, dynamic enemies, and challenging bosses.

title: Routes and Forges
description: A resource manager/RTS set in a medieval world with a voxel-art (Minecraft-like) visual style. It allows players to build villages, establish logistics routes, and create production chains.

title: Shole Soccer
description: Shole Soccer is a chaotic online soccer game where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

title: Elandrake
description: Elandrake is an incremental, twin-stick shooter game where you protect a cosmic entity as it emerges from another reality. Consume matter to gain abilities and use them to blast fleets back to where they came from!

title: Interregnum
description: Build your deck and outwit your opponents in a love letter to classic deckbuilders like Dominion. Outflank your opponents in a deep, strategic game where superior tactics reign supreme. Defeat a cadre of unique AIs in campaign mode or play online and outwit your friends!

title: Jo & Rubi: A Cozy Expedition
description: Join Jo and Rubi on a cozy archaeology expedition. Sort artefacts, clean up the garden, pull trash from the ocean, and explore a dig site. 19 relaxing mini-games across 3 chapters.

title: VCR83
description:
VCR83 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras and report strange anomalies.

Spot anomalies, survive your shift, and earn Tokens to unlock new levels and push deeper into the story. Reporting is simple: see something wrong, click it. Just make sure you're right.

Meet Pete, your small virtual assistant. At first, he's just there to help. As you progress, Pete reacts to the outcomes of your shifts, talks to you, answers your questions, sings, plays around with you, and becomes increasingly interested in what you're doing.

Maybe a little too interested.

title: CodePhantom
description: "CodePhantom" is a 3D action game where you pilot the humanoid combat mech PHANTOM and take on a variety of missions. Experience the thrill of controlling a powerful mech with smooth, responsive gameplay. Enjoy intense, no-nonsense mech action designed for fans of authentic robotic combat.

title: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

title: Keep Farming Aura
description: Keep Farming Aura is an active 3D incremental game about turning attention into power. Perform stylish moves to farm Aura, attract a crowd, build your crew, and buy upgrades. Unlock permanent progression, customize your character, and face rivals in Aura battles. Optional Twitch integration brings viewers into the scene, with their names and chat messages appearing in-game.

title: The Wokest
description: You just want a job. Instead, you're trapped in an endless office. Solve puzzles, follow the rules, and reach the 10th floor. Don't anger the anomalies. If one snaps, run.

title: All Rats on Deck
description: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

title: Chess Army
description: Build your army, merge your units, and dominate the battlefield in a chess-inspired turn-based strategy game.

title: United Online
description: United Online is a free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG where thousands of players share one persistent world. Choose your race and class, level up, master professions like fishing, mining and crafting, join a clan to conquer fortresses, and fight in duels, tournaments, Battle Rooms and Capture the Flag. Explore cities full of living NPCs with their own stories, take on quests and dungeon bosses, and play on PC, Mac, Linux, Android, iOS or straight from your browser.

title: Stockroom Syndrome
description: Build flatpack furniture and decorate showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store, while demonic creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls. HØLM. Build the room. Survive the store.

title: Fallbearers
description: Fallbearers is a co-op dark-humor simulation where you and a colleague transport the deceased, grappling with volatile ragdoll physics, changing terrain, and pesky obstacles in the Victorian streets. Please ensure the client arrives in one piece (we certainly won't).

title: The Royal Restoration Society
description: Tidy up a cozy castle, solo or with 3 other friends! Queen Zoe has called upon you to clean and redecorate her family home. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Go at your own speed or try to beat your best time against your friends.

title: Castle Crew
description: In a vast magical castle, everything has ended up out of place! Sort books, scrolls, runes, and potions, find where each item belongs, and watch as room after room transforms from total chaos into a satisfyingly organized space - on your own or with friends.

title: Honey or Else
description: Honey or Else is an incremental game about bees forced to make honey for their bear captors - while secretly plotting to free their Queen. Plant flowers, hire bees and upgrade the hive. Sweet, sticky, cute and quietly rebellious.

title: Corpse Burger
description: Grind humans into tofu burgers, keep your customers hooked, and fight or avoid twisted mutants. Manage your secret meat supply, don't get caught, and deliver the most addictive meals in town.

title: Be the Block
description: Be the Block is a Sokoban-inspired 2D puzzle game where you dont just push the blocks, you ARE the blocks. Solve a collection of carefully hand-crafted puzzles that are by design simple yet challenging.

title: Pla-toon 2
description: A chaotic, stylized, light-hearted, whimsical, cartoon party-style shooter.

title: Daily Life with the Herb Girl
description: A slice-of-life visual novel steeped in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Befriend Linglan, a girl manifested from medicinal herbs, learn herbal properties, and guide her through the modern world. Features Live2D.

title: Exit Liquidity
description: You have a few dollars and a hunger for more. Navigate decades of economic booms, tech revolutions, and devastating crashes in this deep turn-based simulation. Will you build a legacy through meticulous analysis, or seize power through hostile takeovers and political shadow-play?

title: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!
description: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement. Find thousands of scattered dice, identify their sets and return each one to the correct display. Play solo or in co-op, choose a fantasy class and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier.

title: Bet Shop Simulator
description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

title: Topple
description:
Topple is a free asymmetric action brawler for web browsers. One player controls a giant ape called a colossus, using motion controls in virtual reality or a keyboard and mouse, while up to four Fighters join from desktop or mobile browsers. Fighters choose from four classes and combine melee attacks and movement abilities to reach the colossus's vulnerable nape. The colossus can grab and throw Fighters, destroy buildings, and win by defeating the squad or toppling all four shrines.

The game features destructible and rebuildable environments, private online matches, ranked play, and solo survival with AI teammates. Both sides progress through character levels, talent trees, and equipment, across ink-and-paper arenas.

title: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge
description: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge is an idle crafting game in which Brokk, a pixel-art dwarf blacksmith, runs a small forge in a strip just above the Windows taskbar. Every key press or mouse click anywhere on the PC counts as one swing of his hammer, turning ore into ingots and ingots into finished items. His wife Brygida sells the pieces in the shop, and the gold pays for ore, new patterns and upgrades that unlock better metals, from copper up to mithril. Items come in 49 patterns and five rarities. Regular play needs no clicking, and the game counts inputs without recording what is typed. It runs offline.

title: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread
description: Gangsta Bean, Krazy Karrot, T-Mato, and Brock Lee gang up to fight hordes of reanimated rotten food zombies in this retro arcade-style twin-stick beat 'em up sequel to the classic Flash games.

title: The Park Keeper
description: Manage a national park where something is clearly trying to get out. Screen visitors, cover up incidents, and keep everyone convinced that everything is under control.

title: Noema
description: Take your place at the terminal. Follow the procedures, process the records, and read messages never meant for you. Noema is a quiet, unsettling narrative experience about work, obedience, human connection, and what routine teaches us not to see.

title: 80's Disco Brawl
description: 80's Disco Brawl is a rhythm-based beat ’em up that throws you into the spotlight of the wildest dance floor in history, where every fight is a rhythm, every hit a beat, and every move a performance. Step into a world where combat and music collide, and your timing becomes your greatest weapon.

title: Harvest Looper
description: Harvest plants, unlock upgrades, and expand your farming loop through skill trees, perks, and powerful harvesters. Collect fragments, complete Hidden Book sets, and optimize your incremental growth.

title: Needle in a Haystack Simulator
description: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.

title: Totally Safe Railway Co
description: Run a railroad company with your friends in the Wild West! Operate a physics-driven steam train. Transport goods and passengers, fight off outlaws, explore the frontier and use your lasso on practically anything.

title: Mosaic of Life
description: Mosaic of Life is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring an ENORMOUS single puzzle that retells the history of life on Earth.

title: The Hollowing
description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

title: Denpa Virus
description:
You meet four girls infected with the "Denpa virus."

What is happening inside our brains? A towering radio tower... thoughts becoming interconnected... They search for a cure...

title: Deck Beasts
description: Build a squad of pixel-art beasts and battle your way through the warp in this deck-building auto-battler roguelike. Draft beasts, equip abilities and items, collect relics, and destroy other players with broken builds.

title: Bombernaut 67
description: Bombernaut 67 is a physics demolition game with chaotic and satisfying destruction.Select your explosives, aim carefully, and blow apart everything standing between you and the objective.

title: Tales from the Watchtower: The Conjurer
description: An episodic psychological horror game set in La Mancha, the rural heart of inland Spain and land of Don Quixote. Inspired by real events near the mysterious Watchtower of Ciudad Real, each episode explores current legends and local folklore where reality and myth blur.

title: Dylio's Adventures
description: Imagine waking up transformed into an armadillo after fleeing an indescribable trauma. Step into Dylio's shell and venture through dimensional portals and perilous paths to recover the treasures stolen by a mysterious crow… and uncover the truth behind your transformation.

title: Indoors: Trespasser
description: May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to continue the investigation in this short horror and detective escape room.

title: Unclouded
description: Unclouded builds upon the simplicity of a minesweeper with some basic resource-management mechanics to create an engaging, replayable, singleplayer experience that feels both fresh and familiar.

title: TidyUp 2000
description: A cozy desktop organizing simulator where you sort thousands of scattered files into their correct folders. Upgrade your computer as you organize more files and turn a messy desktop into a perfectly sorted one.

title: Dice Knight
description: Craft a unique set of dice, encounter monsters, and discover items of great power in Dice Knight!

title: Ame Nochi Hare Onna
description: Co-developed by Game Freak and CHRONOGATE, Ame Nochi Hare Onna is set in modern-day Japan, depicting magical girls called Hare Onna (“Sunshine Girls”) who transform weather into magic to lift people’s spirits. Together with their cute cloud-themed partners Kumorin, their mission is to bring clear skies and brighten up Japan.

title: Tandem Together
description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

title: Meowmunitions Survivor
description: Meowmunitions Survivor is a bullet-heaven arena shooter with the unique augmenting system incorporated from Meowmunitions.

title: BrickOps
description: Play. Build. Customize. BrickOps is a colourful multiplayer arena shooter. Battle over objectives, create your own maps and make your character your own with outfits, accessories and loadouts. Build cover, bring the flag home or light up the sky in Defuse.

title: Blue Bite
description: Your "fingertips" will save the world! "BLUE BITE" is a fully voiced 3D romance action adventure set in a world inhabited only by women. Six heroines are threatened by the mysterious disease "bluebite", and the only cure is... your "massage"! Explore the 3D world and save the girls!

title: Basic Parade or: "you should be depressed."
description: Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books... Until her eyes fell out. You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression. There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

title: Story of the Needle in a Haystack
description: They say finding a needle in a haystack is impossible. Time to prove them wrong. Clear millions of pieces of hay from an old barn, upgrade your tools, sell what you collect, and search every last pile until that tiny needle finally shows itself.

title: Void Keeper
description: A scientist locked a dangerous discovery inside her own mind. Dive in, break through her defenses and recover the memory.

title: Kebab Dynasty
description: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

title: Escape From Argos 7
description: A retro computer incremental game about escaping a hostile alien planet. Explore an old desktop, gather resources, install programs, unlock upgrades, automate your progress, and find a way off Argos 7.

title: Island Raiders
description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

title: Highways & Co.
description: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!

title: Nyancrement
description: Nyancrement is an incremental game about a cat that has wandered into a mysterious world. Collect coins with cat punches, strengthen relics, and steadily increase the value of each punch while working toward the 10 billion coins needed to return home.

title: Verse of Birth
description: Your words rise as allies in this roguelike tactical battler. Collect "Logos" whose form and abilities are shaped by the words you type, craft a build that's yours alone, and fight your way through the dungeon in turn-based auto battles!

title: Eightfold
description:
Eightfold is a poker-based deckbuilding roguelike. Players build hands from a deck of playing cards, with hands scored to defeat Bosses using standard poker rankings (pairs, straights, flushes, and so on). Runs are structured around selectable decks, each of which modifies core rules — altering hand size, discard counts, scoring conditions, or deck composition. The game features 22 decks, drawing on a circus and stage-performer theme (including Juggler, Sword Swallower, Tumbler, Contortionist, and Mime decks) alongside decks based on illusion and misdirection (Magician, Mentalist, Escape Artist, Cardist).

Additional systems include card enhancements, which apply permanent modifiers to individual cards, and curses, which introduce a drawback in exchange for a offsetting benefit. Progression is run-based, with players building a strategy across a sequence of acts using the cards, enhancements, and curses acquired along the way.

title: False Myth 2
description: The true sequel to False Myth— a true classic JRPG × beautiful-heroine adventure! Rouge, the agile assassin, sets off with his companions to uncover the truth behind the mysterious girl Sylphina, weaving the most heartrending and fiery “Tale of Hearts.”

title: Myriad
description: Myriad is a star themed 2D falling blocks puzzle roguelite game. Complete and clear lines with falling blocks or just plain destroy tiles for points until you reach the score. Combo them with new bonuses that you can purchase from the Nebula store to aim for ridiculous heightli

title: Palm City
description: A first-person co-op action game set in a sunny open city. Play solo or with friends, explore the streets, plan heists, and escape with the loot. Use vehicles, the environment, and physics to your advantage when even the best-laid plan descends into chaos.

title: Fibbtry
description: A Poolcore atmospheric exploration game. Wander freely, drift in thought, until you're ready to wake and carry this rain back into the real world.

title: Ratchet & Clank
description: A port of Ratchet & Clank, originally released on PS2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Cubic Color Confusion
description: A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos. Can you sort out the confusion?

title: RippleLoop
description: Chain together stone skips in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the best stone skipper.

title: Rob Run
description: Rob Run is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.

title: Demon Crisis
description: A classic On-Rails Shooter, compatible with every modern USB lightgun with live recoil. Hide in cover to avoid hits and reload, then emerge to shoot your way through a horde of bloodthirsty demons.

title: SE3 Protocol: Last Drop
description: CE-III Protocol is a horror puzzle RPG set in an SCP-inspired world. An amnesiac girl wakes in the darknessfrail, timid but not alone nor defenseless. Face deadly entities: observe, evade, exploit or simply eliminate them. Lead her through this surreal nightmare, and uncover the secret behind it.

title: 5-Star Taxi
description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

title: Cortesia Rising
description: Cortesia Rising is a space captain simulator that combines tactical ground combat, crew & ship management, and broadside naval combat in a hand-crafted Sci-Fi universe, developed and self-published by an experienced team of industry veterans and artists.

title: The Third Surveillance Bureau
description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

title: Feastfall
description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

title: SinEater
description: Climb and parkour through procedurally generated towers of memories in search of your own sins in this third-person exploration platformer. Survive in the world after the second great flood. Manage resources and needs, scavenge and trade with fellow sin-eaters.

title: Revertices
description: Directed by one of Cuphead's developers, Revertices is an action combat sidescroller where you will be forced to fight the corrupted remains of your friends: your duty is to reset the cycle at all costs, but in doing so you doom yourself and your companions to repeat the same horrors.

title: First-Person Jigsaw
description: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

title: IllumaNet
description: Build a living network across the dark. In this strategic incremental game, connect distant stations with pulse bridges, turn every cycle into Data, and manage limited Grid Power as you scan the unknown and expand into strange new biomes.

title: Re:Red
description: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

title: Merge Day: Office Girls
description: Merge Day: Office Girls is a casual merge puzzle and dating sim game set in a bustling office! Combine various items, complete daily quests, and unlock romantic visual novel stories with charming female colleagues. Build relationships, discover their secrets, and enjoy the daily grind!

title: Pulse Drive
description: Tap to the beat to build speed! Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with rhythm.Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

title: What Goes Up
description: A chaotic co-op physics-building game where you stack, balance and jury rig gigantic junk towers to ridiculous heights for collection using the power of grav guns and friendship before the clock runs out

title: Quadrillion Carrots
description: Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos.

title: Sugar Lies
description: That love tastes like a sweet lie. A young man who hates lies. A girl who lives by them. A short visual novel about a classic summer boy-meets-girl romance.

title: Alexus 2040
description: Relive that pure arcade thrill that you haven't experienced... in a long time! Load up on unique power-ups to create deadly combinations, unlock new ships with unique abilities, and defeat numerous bosses along the way.

title: Meow Star Archives
description: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats' severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. No timers, no pressure. Just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place, and the cozy moments spent with adorable cats.

title: Eldritch Wildlife Tours
description: Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a cozy, Lovecraftian 2-player co-op / solo exploration and adventure game where one role charts a course to cosmic sea creatures based on collective sightings and takes promotional photos while the other safely steers a tour boat full of paying passengers.

title: TapRacer
description: Two keys, strictly alternating, as fast as you can. TapRacer is a drag racer with real vehicle physics: torque curves, clutch slip, tire temperature, weight transfer. Burnout, launch, four shifts — and the quarter mile is over.

title: Wurst and Glory
description: Wurst and Glory is a competitive dueling game for noble athletes. Settle royal disputes through SAUSAGE COMBAT. Every duel offers 3 random sausages—pick one new to add to your arsenal. Master floppy meat physics, counter foes, and duel for honor, glory, and sausages.

title: World of Slime
description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

title: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Fog of War
description: Fog of War is a DLC for the Diplomacy is Not an Option. In the new story campaign, you’ll build cities, conquer strongholds, and defend against waves of enemy hordes in epic battles. Continue the story of the Ironbrow dynasty and help the young Prince save the long-suffering Samreignia.

title: Minato
description: Minato combines classic minesweeper with roguelike elements. Progress through increasingly challenging stages, discover unique items, and face guardians that add unexpected twists before proceeding to the next floor.

title: Message From Aliens
description: In year 2057, Earth received a large number of mysterious symbols from space. Who are they? Where are they from? And more importantly, what are they talking about?

title: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
description: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

title: My Fairy Princess
description: My Fairy Princess is a life sim set in an Eastern fantasy world, featuring multiple endings. You take on the role of a parent, raising your daughter in a fabled realm of spiritual beauty and tranquility. How will you guide your daughter into an uncertain future?

title: Farmbound
description: An addictive idle farming simulation where you build a massive agricultural empire from a single wheat plot. Harvest crops, adopt cute animals, automate production, unlock powerful skills, and prestige to multiply your yields into astronomical profits.

title: Cable Arrange
description: Every room has one outlet on the wall, two to eight appliances, and cables that do not reach. Plug power strips into power strips, run extension cords across the floor, and turn on everything in the room. An isometric puzzle game with no timer, no score, and no way to fail.

title: Schedule: Rehab Business
description: Play in co-op at the worst rehab center in town. Manage patients, deal with disasters, and try to help everyone recover without losing control.

title: Hunter's Journey: Nightmare Hunting - Collector's Edition
Stay in Your Lane
description: Stay in Your Lane is a side-scrolling real-time strategy game inspired by Age of War and Swords & Soldiers. Mine gold, research your tech tree, summon idiom-powered units that march and fight on their own, and cast spells to turn the tide. Story campaign, puzzle challenges, and online 1v1 and 2v2.

title: Scawy Game
description: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

title: Borrowed Sight
description: A mysterious epidemic violently killed millions in hours. Sealed inside a darkened van, your only connection to the silent, altered city is a damaged remote-controlled car. Navigate using coordinates, angles, and camera feeds to uncover the truthwithout drawing the attention of what remains.

title: Theocracy
description: The prophecy is clear: you have one hundred years to unite the Aztec tribes and prepare for the Spanish invasion. Theocracy is a unique blend of RTS, grand strategy and city building. Develop towns, raise armies, cast spells and conquer provinces - build an empire that can change history.

title: Sanitarium Enhanced
description: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

title: Idle Squares
description: Claim tiles one by one in this cozy idle fantasy strategy game. Harvest resources, unlock upgrades, and prestige to grow stronger, then automate it all. No single path to victory. Click your way across each map or play hands-free. Clear every tile, complete every map, and conquer the whole Atlas.

title: T-Shirt Kingdom
description: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.

title: Leadville
description: Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying to outmaneuver their rivals.

title: Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy Up
description: In Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy up you will have to organize more than 4000 copies of games from your childhood and put them in the right shelves. Relax with the nostalgic atmosphere and check out what games you can recognize. Pick up, sort, organize. Repeat!

title: Grass Cutter 9000: Director's Cut
description: Grass to cut, guys to meet and things to eat. Get upgrades, increase your currency and explore different locations in this short incremental Video Game.

title: Abort Sequence
description: Scour your desk, find the right pages and decipher their content to find the defusal codes in this fast-paced puzzle experience! Beat multiple difficulties, optimize your solving strategies and find the right codes among thousands of possible combinations!

title: Clinical Memory
description: This is not just a walking simulator. This is a new genre: a memory simulator. Explore Ward 7B, survive distorted cycles, collect fragments of memory, and face a truth that changes everything at the end.

title: Discharge Pending
description:
Discharge Pending is a psychological anomaly horror game set inside an abandoned hospital. Trapped on the upper floors, the player must descend one level at a time while carefully observing the environment for anything that has changed. At the end of each floor, they must decide whether an anomaly is present. A wrong decision sends them back to the top.

Each run features randomized anomalies, locations, variants and audiovisual events, ranging from subtle environmental changes to surreal encounters and active threats. As the descent continues, the hospital becomes increasingly unreliable, forcing the player to question what is real and what should not be there.

title: Streamer vs. Chat
description: Streamer vs. Chat is a next-level interactive game where a Twitch streamer competes directly against their viewers. By typing chat commands, viewers influence matches in real time, triggering combat actions, mini-games (like Marbles and Quiz), and effects like flashbangs or screen changes. Featuring leaderboards with a points system, it transforms traditional livestreams into an unpredictable, competitive, and chaotic experience.

title: Marble Mill
description: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

title: Carnosis
