description: Carnosis is a horror dungeon crawler set in a grimdark empire filled with mutated monstrosities and war machines. Sever enemy limbs, steal the flesh of defeated foes, and chain devastating status combos to butcher your way to the emperor.

title: 99 Nights In The Apocalypse
description: Survive 99 nights in the world’s worst apocalypse. Scavenge by day, build a questionable camp, and try to survive the night as escaped asylum patients, deranged staff, and things much worse come looking for you.

title: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup
description: Octbuster is a cozy organization game about closing up an 80s video rental store after hours as an octopus. With the help of your kitten pals, scoop up piles of procedurally placed VHS tapes with real tentacle arms and sort over 10,000 of them however you want. No timer, no score, no way to lose.

title: Ambience
description: Ambience is a first-person spatial puzzle, where you combine lights and colors to access new dimensions and shape the minimalistic world around you.

title: Folder Folder Folder
description: A relaxing incremental game about cleaning up your desktop. Sort files into folders, meet the locals, upgrade your tools, and go from manually sorting files one by one to cleaning up hundreds at a time. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility where no one will hurt you. No one.

title: Legion Hunters
description: Command your squad in a strategy-MMORPG. Unlock over 200 champions and 10 races, upgrade your castle, and gear up to dominate global rankings. Prepare for the war to come!

title: Disaster Crew
description: Disaster Crew is a co-op game about friends taking strange jobs in dangerous places. Explore unpredictable worksites, build what the client asked for, and face weird hazards together.

title: Project Tomorrow
description: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.

title: Icee Keyring Arcade
description: Cool off with some classic gaming! The ICEE Keyring Arcade puts retro arcade action in the palm of your hand. Play as the iconic ICEE Bear, surfing through a frozen world as you collect as many ICEE cups as you can while dodging falling snowflakes and spiky icicles. Move up and down with the directional buttons and press the fire button to launch snowballs and blast obstacles out of your path! Score big by grabbing cups and smashing through the chill. Compact and keyring-ready, it’s the perfect on-the-go game for ICEE lovers, retro fans, and anyone who enjoys cool vibes with their high scores.

title: Jeep Horror
description: Drive a traditional jeepney through the dark Philippine streets, picking up commuters under the cover of night. But some passengers aren't human. Watch for doppelgangers, serial killers, and mythological monsters. Collect weird fares, manage your cabin, and try to survive the night shift.

title: SCP: Darkwater
description: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

title: Zaibaly
description: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

title: Job Burnout
description: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

title: Cargo Protocol: Cyberpunk Trains
description: Build a logistics empire in a grim cyberpunk world: lay tracks, optimize production and delivery chains, research technologies, and expand your influence. Corporations are the new gods, and the Market decides who survives.

title: Dice Looter
description: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

title: Hear My Light
description: A short narrative puzzle-shooter about bringing your brother home through a contaminated combat zone by guiding him with drones. He and the enemy are blind and catatonic, responding only to your drones' sounds — so every signal to shoot has to be your tactical decision. Especially when the dead rise

title: Sarco
description: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

title: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
description: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

title: Splatchinko
description: Play as a lovestruck alien in this chaotic roguelike pachinko in pixel art! Launch your EYES across hostile planets, unlock bizarre mutations and build devastating combos as you tear through the galaxy to rescue your beloved.

title: Backrooms: Primal
description: The infinite yellow complex was created to secretly contain prehistoric specimens whose existence must never reach the public. Trapped in this glitching yellow maze with no confirmed boundary, you must evade uncontained prehistoric predators and find a way out before reality collapses around you.

title: They’ll Hang You for That Face
description: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

title: The Last Lunch
description: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

title: Paddle Momentum
description: A 1v1 arcade game where you rally the ball back and forth while building momentum. Earn points, unlock upgrades, and grow stronger over time. Between matches, care for and play with your mole—the better you treat it, the more it will help you during matches.

title: Worm Capitalist
description: Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit. Feed them, expand your colony, unlock upgrades, boost production, automate the process, and keep growing until the whole world is on the menu.

title: Shell as Hard as Steel
description: A horror game about an elevator repair technician who, as he ascends, discovers what became of those who never made it back down.

title: Kron Wars
description: Kron Wars is a persistent browser-based sci-fi MMO where players trade, mine, build corporations, wage wars, hunt bounties, and control entire sectors across massive player-driven universes with dynamic economies and tactical space combat.

title: Idle of the Dead
description: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

title: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
description: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

title: Thieves Guild Master
description: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

title: Drifters: Blackout Crew
description: Raid ancient alien temples in a PvE co-op extraction shooter built for tactile VR gunplay. Steal energy for your dying mothership, scavenge rare resources, survive the temple’s defense systems, and decide how deep your crew can push before extraction turns desperate.

title: Covr
description: COVR is a tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, high-stakes solo and co-operative gameplay, unforgiving realism, and intense close-quarters combat.

title: Split Second Volley
description: Turn based anime-style sports battles! Create outrageous combos and last minute saves using teamwork and unique skills. You can even use guns! Outsmart your foes, choreograph larger than life moments, and win PvP battles with STYLE!

title: Half Grip
description: Get hooked on this brutal one-armed rogue-like combat racing game where every action is a gamble. Steer, shoot and reload - each split-second counts as you compete against armed rivals across atmospheric tracks rendered in harsh pixelated detail.

title: Mancalero
description: Mancalero is the ancient strategy board game of Mancala, rebuilt as a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect special marbles, stack blessings, discover synergies, and break every table with increasing scores.

title: Ignite the Depths
description: Ignite the Depths is a cooperative hack-and-slash dungeon crawler set across three hand-crafted dimensions. Venture into the Abyss alone or form a party of up to four players to battle monstrous creatures, solve environmental puzzles, and forge wildly different builds.

title: True Nightmare: Diner Loop
description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you. Can you escape?

title: Factor Zoo
description: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

title: Sign It
description: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

title: Misplaced
description: Misplaced is an archive-sorting and one-stroke deduction game. Draw files from a shuffled archive, sort them into folder nodes on the board, then match each file to its sub-node. When every file is correctly archived, solve the one-stroke puzzle to link the clues and restore the truth.

title: Steal & Sell Simulator
description: Steal valuable goods at night and sell them for a profit during the day. Start small, grow your business, and take on bigger, riskier jobs as the police close in. Invest in your shop, unlock new opportunities, and build a more efficient operation with every successful theft.

title: Blindfold: Sound Chase
description: Blindfold: Sound Chase is an asymmetric online tag game where one blindfolded seeker faces off against several runners. An invisible seeker and runners who are in danger if they make a sound. A simple game of tag turns into a tense psychological battle.

title: Last Ride
description: Last Ride is a supernatural investigation game where you explore haunted sites, gather clues, identify evil spirits, and use the right methods to capture them while learning to protect the human world.

title: Click to Obsolete
description: A satirical incremental clicker game. Play as a corporate tech CEO automating all human labor. Build server infrastructure, allocate compute to AI, manufacture robot armies, and lobby politicians to reduce global employment from 8 billion to zero.

title: Chief Bubble Officer
description: Chief Bubble Officer is a turn-based number strategy game about dressing up financial reports. Draw number cards and place them into different reports, combine numbers, raise scores, find the best moves under ever-changing rules, and trigger chain bonuses.

title: Blindside
description: A fast-paced top-down shooter about prediction. Enemies are invulnerable in the light. Read their movement, fire into the dark, and trust your timing before they reach you.

title: Mr. "Bargain Expert"
description: Play as an antique shop owner in this incremental idle management game. Buy low and sell high, appraise and acquire valuable antiques, hire employees to automate the business, expand into new branches, build your own antique empire, and collect rare treasures.

title: Overbooked
description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

title: My Own Hero Party
description: A party-building casual incremental game where every expedition is a race against your stamina. Recruit allies, clear room-based dungeons, gather gold, and grow a custom upgrade tree after being kicked out of the hero party.

title: God of Stocks
description: An incremental management game about manipulating the market to get filthy rich. Buy low, sell high, chain absurd combos and earn divine blessings from stock market gods. Will you play it safe or risk everything?

title: Tile Tale
description: Tile Tale is a 2D strategy sandbox blending clicker gathering, automation, and exploration. In a misty grid world, craft items, build factories, and keep conveyor belts moving. Defeat enemies and uncover the truth. What awaits at the end? Discover the world, one tile at a time!

title: Izakaya Izakoza
description: “Izakaya Izakoza” is a deckbuilding roguelike that combines card battles with grid-based strategy. Fully animated, lively characters jump through the battlefield! Live a day that begins with a conversation, flows through food, and ends with a climactic fight.

title: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
description: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

title: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
description: Experience the oddly satisfying world of laser hair removal! Zap through thick beards, manage your customers' pain levels, and build your hairy empire. Will you run a 5-star luxury salon or a house of screams?

title: Delivery Survivors
description: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

title: Isolated Island: After the Flood
description: Survive in a world drowned by disaster. Explore by day, hide by night, fight zombies, scavenge resources, build your shelter, and trade with other factions. Your survival, your strategy.

title: Lexicon
description: Lexicon is a word based puzzle game wrapped inside a strange abandoned computer system. You explore forgotten terminals, sift through corrupted files, and solve linguistic challenges that twist familiar rules into something unsettling. Every puzzle reveals a fragment of a larger story that hides beneath the interface, waiting for you to notice the patterns that are not supposed to be there.

title: MadHouse for Toys
description: Madhouse for Toys is a top-down horror game where an AI-powered plush rabbit tries to escape from a toy asylum. Solve puzzles, hide, or fight against insane toys. The unique 3D horror style and the unusual world make the game unlike anything else.

title: Syncline
description: Syncline is a grid-based puzzle game in which the player rolls a straight line of cubes across a board and lines it up with goal blocks. The line tumbles as a rigid body: it can lie flat or stand on end, climb terrain, and split apart when driven into obstacles — cubes that cannot pass break off and remain on the grid, where a later move can reconnect them. Rotating the camera in 90-degree steps changes the movement directions and decides which cubes are kept when the line splits. Hazard blocks destroy or transform cubes that land on them; nothing is randomized, and every level is verified solvable by the game's own solver and stamped with a par move count. The game features a campaign of themed level packs, a built-in level editor backed by the same solver, and community level sharing through mod.io. Inspired by Bloxorz and Cuboid.

title: Summer Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
description: As coach of the girls' track team, go on an exciting retreat in the countryside with the three best girls of your team, where you'll help them overcome their struggles and unlock their full potential!

title: Capy of Gods
description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

title: Void Inc
description: You are the Head of Tech at Void Inc., a rapidly growing SaaS startup where every decision creates another problem. Plan your day, survive frantic technical minigames, manage unstable staff and infrastructure, and try to reach the company's targets before stress consumes you.

title: Monolith: Dark Matter
description: A round-based FPS for 1–4 players set inside the Monolith — a brutalist complex shaped by living black matter. Fight escalating waves of its marionettes, earn points to unlock new sectors and build your arsenal, and uncover the route to a final encounter.

title: Red Echoes: Berlin
description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

title: Marble Souls
description: Prepare to roll through the dense, interconnected world of MARBLE SOULS. Collect lost souls and level up your marble in the new genre-defying game from the creators of Mosa Lina & FALLSTRUKTUR.

title: The Tower Must Fall
description: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.

title: Boss Slayers
description: No game to play with a friend? Now you're a team of boss hunters. Challenge the most dangerous monsters! Dodge rains of projectiles, seize the right moment to attack and discover the weaknesses of cunning bosses.

title: Internet Cafe 98
description: Grow a small 1998 internet cafe from a single outdated PC into a packed business. Serve customers, upgrade your computers and network, and research new technology in this retro incremental tycoon game.

title: Chigusa's Diary
description: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...

title: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
description:
The Attic is an adventure in which you'll have to solve riddles, puzzles, and repair objects from the ‘80s and ‘90s to unveil the secret your brother and his mysterious friend, Destiny, were hiding.

Hideouts, secret spots, locked chests, mysterious videogame cartridges… A cozy adventure with hints of mystery inspired by escape rooms and the classic point-and-click adventure games.

title: Oasis of Lilies
description: Julie's Oasis is a haven for gentlewomen looking for relaxation and discreet pleasures. Ayame enters the club, unsure what to expect, only to meet strangely familiar women one after another. Oasis of Lilies is a light-hearted visual novel about a girl who dreams of having a harem of her own.

title: Seaworks: Trap Season
description: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

title: Quiet
description:
Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting the homeowner.

Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

title: Curse of the Abandoned Floor
description: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese horror game. It starts with a paranormal video about an urban legend: "Beware the non-existent elevator mezzanine. If you enter it, you will be trapped forever."

title: Layang Atma
description: An isometric psychological survival horror where memories become reality. Fight terrifying manifestations, solve symbolic puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden within a fractured mind.

title: Marque & Reprisal
description: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

title: Unchest
description: A mouse-only management game with a bit of tower defense. Restock goods, trade with customers and craft gear for the nighttime—if the monsters reach your shop, they’ll plunder your hard-earned gold.

title: Condominium: No Exit
description: As always, another ordinary day riding the train home. Yet what awaits beyond the door is a world of chaos, far removed from common sense. Your phone suddenly begins ringing like mad...

title: Riftfall
description: HELL DIDN'T CLOSE. IT EVOLVED. A fast, brutal retro indie FPS raised on the 90s classics: a 20-level campaign, 5 heavy weapons with alt-fires, 60+ enemy types, unique boss arenas, AI squadmates, permanent upgrades, skull keys, secrets and an epic soundtrack.

title: Slots & Slaughter
description: Spin slots, win gold, buy and upgrade items, then battle bizarre enemies as you build an overpowered item deck in this casual yet tactical roguelike deck-builder.

title: Separator
description: Separator is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

title: Drive to The Top
description: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

title: Whiplash
description: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.

title: Reels of the Damned
description: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

title: Ultimate Lemon Basket
description: Ultimate lemon basket is a platformer where you lose if you drop a lemon on the ground. Between you and the goal are ghosts, cows, snipers, acid rain, hopes, dreams and other things AS WELL!!

title: Tower of Insolence
description: Grab your smithing hammer, pack your gear, and get ready to conquer the ominous Tower of Insolence in this cozy little puzzle game.

title: Idle Pixel Battle
description: Idle Pixel Battle is a fantasy idle auto battler focused on loot, upgrades, and constant progression. Build a team of heroes and watch them fight automatically through waves of monsters.

title: Bowl Big
description: Bowl Big is an incremental bowling game where one pin becomes hundreds. Every throw brings you closer to the next upgrade. Optimize pin placement. Power up balls. Do you have what it takes to bowl big?

title: Chess of the Hidden Gates
description: Chess of the Hidden Gates fuses roguelike deckbuilding with the footwork of Chinese chess—every card in your hand is a move, and every move decides who gets taken. The world is a board; everything is a piece. Outmaneuver ancient spirits square by square: victory takes more than raw power—it takes position. The battle of Zhuolu never ended; its endgame lies locked behind the Eight Gates, and you are the last player to enter.

title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown: DLC 3
Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown: DLC 4
Giri-Jump Star Rush
description: "Giri-Jump Star Rush" is a 2D jump action game featuring a classic gameplay feel. Have fun with a diverse range of stages themed around "Giri-Jump," where you leap right from the edge of the platform.

title: Souq Boss Simulator
description: Run your own Baqala in a nostalgic 2002 Gulf neighborhood inspired by old Dubai and Riyadh. Stock iconic childhood products, serve familiar faces, complete quests, unlock special items, make deliveries with friends, and use your BB Gun to stop thieves as you build your way to becoming the Souq Boss

title: The Minesweeper's Tale
description: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

title: Dieathlon
description: Chart a course down dangerous mountain slopes with only your shotgun and your reflexes to keep you alive. Blast through obstacles, fend off deadly monsters, and make split-second decisions. Explore multiple routes, each filled with unique hazards and challenges.

title: Dark Earth
description: Dark Earth is an atmospheric real-time action-adventure set in a dying, sunless world where your choices shape the future of humanity. Explore Sparta, one of the last cities of light, as you unravel a murder plot and fight to survive before darkness consumes you.

title: Unfated
description: Unfated is a single-player 3D papercraft Strategy RPG where you play as Jo, a peasant turned revolutionary as she leads a scrappy group of rebels to fight the forces of fate and oppression in a turn-based journey across the land of Antedeluvia, seeking to end a century long conflict.

title: Super Blood Hockey: Rogue Manager
description: A sports game where you don't control the players, instead play as a shady coach and use your deck of dirty tricks to become season champion. A unique hybrid of roguelike deckbuilder, auto-battler, and high action arcade hockey.

title: Here Again
description: You wake up in a silent underground facility with one simple instruction: REMEMBER THE BUTTON. Weird dreams and changing surroundings haunt this place. Explore, observe, and unveil the mystery that envelopes this place in this Retro Psychological Horror Game.

title: BROMS: Battle Royale Management Simulator
description: A management simulation game where you run a battle royale. Host matches to increase revenue from gacha requests, expand the map, and place objects to improve the environment. You can also play on the maps you create yourself.

title: Oomi's Nook
description: Oomi’s Nook is a relaxing and heartwarming sticker decor game. Decorate a cozy little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!

title: Withering State
description: Act as Premier Alexander Sants in a time of stagnation, division, and the falling of walls. Will you steer the brotherly nations of the People's Republic of Sudlivia toward the liberal West, reinforce the crumbling East, or forge a new path? Or even be ousted before becoming the General Secretary?

title: SchoolBoy OutDoors
description: You’re a schoolboy who ran away from home to hang out — but this is only the beginning! Summer, friends, backyard mischief… and mysteries hiding something much darker. Explore the streets, avoid adults, and uncover a secret you were better off not knowing.

title: Ramen://Protocol
description:
Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder.

Players aim to complete 10 days of business operations while upgrading their skills and toppings.

title: Grilluminati
description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

title: That Bomb Game
description: A dangerous bomb game up to 12 players where you'll have to type words fast to save yourself from exploding. Use power-up cards to control the game, only the last player standing wins.

title: Ultimate Chaos Gambling Battle
description: Poker, mahjong, hanafuda, blackjack… Welcome to the ultimate “ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE” where every form of gambling has been thrown into a chaotic melting pot! Don’t just understand the rules—master the chaos, bet your entire fortune (ALL-IN), and seize victory!

title: ChickenPlaguePolice
description: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

title: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
description: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.

title: Guildrun
description: Turn a simple team into an unstoppable force and crush waves of monsters in this PvE autobattler roguelike. No two runs feel the same as you bend heroes beyond their class roles and discover countless combinations and synergies. Seal the rifts at your own pace and uncover what tore them open.

title: Memento*Fragment
description:
Memento*Fragment is a visual novel in which [You], the protagonist, recover your memories by viewing memory fragments.
The first contains the past of a girl, traveling alone through a world on the brink of destruction.
Continue watching to learn about her past, your relationship with her, and rediscover your identity.
Don't look away, no matter how tragic the answer may be.

title: Whiskers In The Sand
description: Whiskers In The Sand is a fast-paced survivors-like arena roguelite where battle-ready cats shred through hordes of undead desert monsters. Unlock new cats, collect relics, stack upgrades, and forge ridiculous builds to survive the pharaoh's second reign.

title: Oblivion 2666
description: A slipstream magical realist visual novella about an outsider, a borrowed camera, and a city that no longer matches its own photographs—told through literary prose and ever-shifting, textured cinematic presentation.

title: Paper Shredder
description: Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath.

title: Dear Passengers
description: Play in co-op as the crew of the worlds worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

title: Seasonal Lockdown
description: An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control. You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

title: Rooftops and Alleys: The Parkour Game - Ninja Pack DLC
Rooftops and Alleys: The Parkour Game - Trail Pack DLC
Tete
description: A wobbly climbing adventure featuring a clumsy little golem. Can you conquer the hardcore controls and jiggling physics?

title: Sushi Loop
description: Sushi Loop is a fast-paced cooking game where keeping order over your restaurant's conveyor belt is essential. Plan your Route, direct dishes along the belt, complete orders, and think quick to stay ahead of the clock. Every second matters. One mistake can break the loop.

title: Midnight Scour
description: Escape a rural nightmare in this atmospheric first-person horror game. You are hunted by a cunning killer. He lives, sleeps, and actively hunts based on your actions . Use stealth to navigate the house, solve puzzles, and complete one of the exits.

title: Cube & Seek
description: Relax and find hidden objects in handcrafted 3D tiny cube worlds. Search for hidden treasures and enjoy fun interactive surprises along the way!

title: Fragment Collapse
description: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

title: Tiny Fortress
description: A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

title: Progress98
description: A retro incremental idle desktop companion all about making progress on the side and at your own pace.

title: Super Magic Ball! Home Run Derby
description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

title: Altar Corp
description: A solo rhythmic FPS in the abandoned city called Yerneth.

title: Find the Beer
description: The lights have gone out, find as much beer as you can in the set time limit. There is however walls in your way use your flash light to guide your character around in search for the Beer glass.

title: False Hope
description: False Hope is a survival visual novel set in a winter that doesn't forgive. One camp, rations for four, a fifth on the way. Every choice costs you: who to feed, who to trust, who to let die. Sharp dialogue and one-way forks, where you decide what hope is worth and when it turns into a lie.

title: Crop and Claw 2
description: Crop and Claw 2 is an adventure-JRPG in a world of dragons featuring turn-based combat, story and optional custom party members.

title: Bear Horror
description: Real-time strategy meets dark SCP survival. Play as the self-replicating SCP-1048, also known as the Builder Bear, gather grotesque resources, mass-produce a horrifying army of teddy clones and survive against Foundation personnel.

title: 100 Yen Exorcist
description: Welcome to your part-time job cleaning up evil spirits! We picked up everything you’ll need from a 100-yen shop—more or less. Use your supplies properly, or just chuck them at the ghosts. Your call.

title: Skroll
description: Wake up, junkie. Your brain is hungry and only infinite scrolling can satisfy it. Manage dopamine, battery, and sanity in this survival roguelike about digital slavery.

title: Bee Space
description: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

title: Gunjutsu
description: GUNJUTSU combines the score-chasing creativity of Skate 3 with Call of Duty Trickshotting. Learn the basics, master the 'Trickshot Iceberg' and compete on the global leaderboard. If you’ve ever hit a 360, this game was made for you.

title: HAFO: Horse Around, Find Out
description: Take control of an elite, equine warrior, defeating jobber jockeys who stand in your way as you race to the finish line, using fierce foreleg punches, hind leg kicks. HAFO isn't your grandsire's horse racing game. Wanna know how? Well Horse Around, and Find Out!

title: Flesh Fossil
description: Stranded on a mysterious island overrun by dinosaurs, you must find a way to escape. Uncover the island's past, manage your resources and evade those pursuing you.

title: Backrooms: Eternals
description: Backrooms: Eternals is not a game. It's a relentless, ever-expanding simulation of the ultimate horror: an infinite reality, stripped of all meaning. There are no goals, only survival. No hope, only the decaying echo of what was once reality. Welcome to your forever home.

title: Fablery
description: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

title: Steel Maiden
description: Two buttons. Pure, explosive speed. A lightning-fast action roguelite you play with just two buttons. Forge your own combat style with builds that shift every run, and chase that rush of pure dopamine through gorgeous visuals.

title: The Rifted Skies
description: The Rifted Skies is an active VR roguelite set in a long-abandoned world. Play as a lone warrior returning home. Parkour and fight to outrun a deadly Rift. Unlock new powers and uncover - can your home ever be saved?

title: Squishy League
description: Squishy League is a fast paced versus sport game where you control a squishy character that can only move by dashing. Smash the Ball into your opponent’s goal to score points ! Master charged shoots, spins, and wall bounces to outsmart your opponent. Play locally or online in crazy 1v1 matches.

title: Cold Contours: Intake
description: Cold Contours: Intake is an atmospheric first-person 3D puzzle game set inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Use magnets to explore its halls and machinery: throw them, attach them to metal, change their polarity, and activate old mechanisms.

title: Good Hands
description: In Good Hands, join Nia as she helps her neighbor Aunty Zubeida tidy up a tangled garden. Tend, sort, and restore calm in this cozy puzzle about care and connection. Unwind with over 100 uniquely crafted puzzles, made for anyone who finds joy in gardens.

title: Train Set Code
description: Build a train set layout where everything runs on its own. Automate points and signals to direct the trains and keep them moving. Get creative and design a huge network that carries a fleet of trains.

title: A Mountain Called Hope
description: Explore a hauntingly abandoned late 1800s mountain coal mining town afflicted by a violent winter storm.

title: Micro RPG
description: Monsters have invaded the kingdom, taking advantage of the knights' annual holiday! You are the last hope! Equip yourself with weapons and fight the monsters surrounding you in this turn-based game with your spinning attacks across a dozen fantasy worlds!

title: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror
description: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror is an upcoming third-person survival horror game set in a frozen gothic landscape. Players navigate cursed streets, morgues, and Dr. Frankenstein’s laboratory while surviving both brutal creatures and the horrors of his experiments.

title: Kaiju Princess: Super Survivor Showdown
description: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!

title: Never Look Back
description: A psychological, rule-based horror game set on an infinite liminal staircase. Players have to descend the staircase, squeeze a cute rubber duck, and never look back as the Darkness follows behind.

title: Don't Lose Face!
description: Don't Lose Face! is an abstract simulation game that makes you flustered and laugh until you're exhausted. What you're about to face: multi-tasking torture, facial features that slide down like cream, hilarious physics feedback, abstract random events…

title: Oops Unit
description: Oops Unit is an online co-op game where up to 6 players team up as a bomb squad. Solve puzzles, gather resources, and push through deadly traps and enemies to reach and defuse every bomb. Extract, buy new gear, and repeat—or die trying, because anything, even your friends, can sabotage the mission.

title: Some Type of Trip
description: A simple typing narrative game exploring the depths of the mind. Sometimes cozy and warm, sometimes intense and challenging, always interesting.

title: Ten Years of Rain
description: Ten Years of Rain is a fantasy adventure Zelda-like with a unique Central Asian inspired setting. Pick up your blade, call your hawk, and prepare to travel the cursed lands. Battle the forces of the Great Khan, explore the secret places of the world, and discover the cause of the long rain...

title: Tileburg
description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

title: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess
description: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess is a 2D action with metroidvania elements set in a 16th-century fantasy world, drawn with cozy pixels. Explore a mysterious realm, battle ruthless enemies, and uncover powerful weapons and abilities. And remember: beer is the best medicine in these grim times!

title: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life
description: No graphics, No tiles. Just text-RPG adventure! Explore a shifting labyrinth, regain the Ring of Life from the wizard Shingor. Classic roguelike-style messages guide your journey, with narrative scenes evoking the spirit of MUDs and gamebooks. Death is permanent. Every run brings new discoveries.

title: SWAT God
description:
SWAT God is the world's fastest shooter. Unique mouse control gives you limitless speed and precision. Merciless enemies that only get harder. Are you fast enough?

SWAT God can do things that most do not understand and many refuse to believe. Move like lightning. Dispatch whole squads with one burst and vanish before the sound hits their friends. Bolt to the hostage and rush them to safety in a blur. Shoot one enemy and before his friends can turn to look, flank around the entire building in an instant to finish off the rest.

This is a hyper speed top down shooter that aims to remove all speed limits. Mouse control gives you as much speed and precision as you're capable of. Enemies with faster-than-human reactions will hunt you down, surround you, bombard you with grenades and rockets.

title: Covert Koalas: Phasco
description: A comfy hidden-koala game with unique hand-drawn visuals and adjustable difficulty. The story follows a group of koalas escaping their captivity and searching for a new home. Has hints, over 10 levels and original soundtrack.

title: Lost in Art
description: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

title: The 4 Masked
description: A 4-player co-op FPS adventure where you swing through trees using vines, escape wild animals, and survive dangerous biomes. Each player has a unique role, and teamwork is the key to survival.

title: Crown Control
description: Tactical roguelike deckbuilder: play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Choose your character, level up your class, collect and play cards to attack, defend, heal, summon allies, place traps, and alter the terrain in turn-based isometric battles to overthrow a tyrant king.

title: Cozy Interiors
description: Ever dreamed of becoming an interior designer? Design cozy homes and get paid for it. Build and decorate charming interiors, unlock a wide variety of furniture, and create wholesome spaces filled with personality, furry friends, and perfect little details.

title: Don’t Return to Wonderland
description: A dark fairy-tale horror adventure inspired by Alice in Wonderland. Use mysterious powers to forge your path and confront the horrors lurking within a world that is both adorable and cruel.

title: Tidy Tidy
description: A casual healing organizing game. No complex controls—just click and drag to logically sort and arrange items across scenes, turning clutter into order. With no time limits, savor the relaxation and healing of tidying up.

title: Tape Man
description: "Tape Man" is a puzzle platformer packed with hidden mechanics for you to discover. Throw your measuring tape to explore a vast maze of puzzles. Your measure tapes work as a platform, an obstacle, and many other things—it's for you to find out!

title: Saintless
description: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

title: Turbo Loop
description:
Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game built around simple gameplay that is easy to pick up, yet challenging to master. Whether you're chasing perfect lap times or battling head-to-head, every race is about precision, timing, and control.

Take on AI opponents, challenge a friend in local multiplayer, and push your skills across a wide variety of tracks. Unlock new cars, fine-tune their look, and create your own racing circuits with a simple and easy-to-use track editor.

title: PulseWave
description: Every weapon fires to the beat you create. Mix guns, modifiers, and upgrades to build deadly combinations in this rhythm-shooter roguelike.

title: Cat a Photo
description: Cat a Photo is a lively, fast‑paced multiplayer game all about capturing the perfect cat photo.

title: Going My Way?
description: In a world consumed by an insomnia pandemic, where there are no laws and people are going crazy, you're a train conductor racing through an endless night blizzard. Study the strange passengers, solve mysteries, and survive the time loop before the snowy abyss swallows you up.

title: Underground Business
description: Underground Business is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for a rural town at a pizzeria kiosk. Take orders, cook pizza, investigate the suspicious pizzeria underground and run for your life in high-intensity chases!

title: Monster Hatcher
description: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

title: Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki No Emaki
description: Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

title: Dumb Dunks
description: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

title: Don't Get Fired!
description: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

title: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed
description: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed is a goofy 3D puzzle-platformer where your greatest asset is your backside. Solve lateral thinking puzzles to complete your Civic Disturbance Duty.

title: Tyrants Must Fall
description: Build your rebel army and lead them to victory over the Tyrant King in this turn-based tactical roguelike. Improve your leader's skills, unlock new units, and hone your battlefield strategy as you march towards your fate as the Hero of Destiny.

title: Amen: The Quiet Exodus
description: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For the child enters the world with the veil upon its face, yet its soul wanders lone in the heavens where God is not. Why then does she not hasten to the place that was prepared for her? Seek the truth in our visual novel.

title: God, Save the Queens!
description: You are God. The king’s five daughters have been taken. Fight thousands of enemies, unlock powerful skills, and crush the evil wizard Zaharad in this brutal 2.5D roguelike!

title: MLF: Pro Catch
description:
The official Major League Fishing game, a fishing sim you can play solo or online with friends. Cast, troll, and feel every fish fight back as you control the drag, manage line tension, and read each run and dive to land your catch. Reel in over 50 species, from Largemouth bass and Rainbow trout to Muskellunge, Alligator gar, and sharks, each with its own model, habitat, and behavior.

Explore six diverse waters, including Shadow Lake, the Everglades, the Florida Keys, and Lake Whitney, all with a full day-night cycle and shifting weather. Fish from shore, docks, or boat, and gear up with tackle from real brands like Mossy Oak, YETI, Abu Garcia, and Berkley. Compete in tournaments, climb the leaderboards, and chase your personal-best trophies.

title: NowLoading Forever
description: Can you actually “play” this game!? Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

title: Ember Express
description: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

title: Touhou Sousenkyou: Land of Oracular Zeitgeist
description:
An extraordinary new entry to the world of Touhou shmup fangames is arriving in 2026!

With the sudden announcement of a "popularity contest" occuring in the Human Village, a variety of maidens—from familiar faces like Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame to completely new and original characters never seen before—set off to win the contest by battling it out.

But lurking in the shadows behind the curtains of this "popularity royale" lies a mastermind attempting to fix the matches...

A Phantasmagoria-styled versus game, sure to draw in allies, spectators, and even fairies!

title: Shatterfarms
description: Farm. Forage. Fight. Shatterfarms is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable. Welcome to Shatterfarms.

title: Runa in Nightmare House
description: One day, the unlucky girl "Runa Ichiya" wakes up in a haunted house.

title: Skill Eater
description: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

title: Deliver Together
description: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

title: Pubes
description: A 3D action game where you control a strand of body hair and move around a 3D room! Use the unique fluffy floating and sticking abilities of body hair to safely reach your destination!

title: Little Lilicia
description: A full-fledged farm life sim where you live as a rancher, socialize, and find love with heroines in the town of Kokotan, home of the Forest Goddess. Step into the shoes of the protagonist, Philo, who becomes a rancher by chance, and revitalize the run-down farm.

title: Who Wants To Be King?!
description: The year is 865. Vikings are sailing to avenge Ragnar Lothbrok. Build your city and defend it—alone or with friends.

title: Lane of the Eternal Night
description: An exploratory, self-chosen experience type of light roguelike turn-based pixel indie game, currently without much storyline. Although the combat is turn-based, it's more like a rock-paper-scissors style game mode, and it also includes skills.

title: The Obsessive Shadow: Chapter 2
description: Something sinister stirs on Old Diamond Drive. 16 year old Justin, armed only with a flashlight and camcorder, takes a dare to spend the night. As shadows close in, he realizes escape isn't possible, and he's not alone. Witness the horrors of the past as you explore the ruins of what once thrived...

title: Board of the Future
description: Is it a board? Is it a plane? Is it the coolest, fastest piece of alien technology from the future that you and your friends have ever been riding?

title: FantômeRapport: Intermezzo
description: Fantôme Rapport is a multi-genre visual novel that blends romance, horror, and mystery. Uncover the secrets of a ghostly luxury cruise liner and the enigmatic women aboard.

title: Mob Drop Castle
description:
Awaken from your slumber o’ castle overlord!
It’s time to rise up and rebuild your fortress to protect it from the invading adventurers in this reverse hoard-survivors real-time idle castle management!

title: Foosball Manager
description: Foosball Manager is a singleplayer table football management game.

title: Lab Loonies
description: Lab Loonies is a physics-based descent into madness where "logic" is a suggestion the developer ignored. In this 1-4 player lab experiment, the platforms are lying, the physics are "opinionated," and the Narrator is actively rooting for your demise. Make good choices, or don't. The Lab doesn't judge

title: Omea
description: Your words shape the adventure. Omea is a revolutionary AI-powered narrative game where your personal Game Master responds to everything you write. No menus, no limits. Just type and forge your own legend across fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, and beyond.

title: One Last Push
description: Survive the horrors of WW1 in this intense PvE survival shooter. Scavenge supplies, earn your regiment’s respect, and fight for reinforcements before you become another name lost in the mud.

title: Quality Assurance
description: Participate in chaotic testing sessions with up to eight players where you'll work together to solve a wide variety of randomized tasks while navigating hindering conditions. Prove to your creators that you're not just functional — you're exceptional.

title: Antarctic Grave
description: A first-person survival horror set in an Antarctic research station. Explore the frozen complex, search for tools and weapons, keep the generator fueled, and outsmart mutants to survive the harsh conditions.

title: Flipping Football Clubs
description:
A roguelite football management game designed around meaningful progression in 1-2 hour play sessions, with each season structured as a single run.

Your aim is to buy and sell football clubs "flipping" them for profit. Each successful Flip becomes progressively more challenging, with cumulative handicaps that carry forward across runs.

title: Tyrants Rafting
description: Tyrants Rafting is a chaotic single-player game where you control one boat and race between checkpoints before time runs out. Play as a dictators escaping through deadly rivers, using boosts, surviving shootouts, and fighting the boat itself.

title: Guildmaker
description: Run a guild of valiant, procedurally generated adventurers who fight, trade, craft, and do quests on their own. Do your best as their guildmaster to provide them a place to rest and thrive, and restore an old guild to its former glory.

title: Shadow & Steel
description: Shadow & Steel is a top-down hack-and-slash arena shooter set in a fantasy world. Battle hordes of undead, demons, and living nightmares designed to push your combat skills to the limit. Strike up close with your blade and weave arcane spells from a distance.

title: Still Warm
description: Deep-fry lángos in a Budapest alleyway and serve the regulars from the apartment building across the courtyard while they slowly realize someone is picking them off, one by one.

title: Lost Exit
description: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

title: ICU: Intensive Care Unit 8
description: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

title: Schoolgirl vs. Fishman
description: Schoolgirls × Mermen × Sewers! A "drenched" horror adventure! Solve mysteries to find an exit, and decide: will you run or fight? Your choices branch the story. Can they escape this nightmare safely...?

title: Write Night
description: A first person psychological horror game of a writer locked in his office at night, trying to overcome artblock. As he types, the story begins to take shape in unexpected ways, the line between his writing and reality starts to blur. experience subtle changes and sudden scares as the night unfolds.

title: The Murder of Yesterday
description: A psychological horror crime experience where time is your only weapon. Travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

title: Loop
description: You awaken alone on a deep-sea rig. Your only companion is a decaying AI: LUMEN. In 20 minutes, everything explodes. Die. Wake. Remember. Escape this psychological horror loop—but do you really want to know the truth?

title: Vanguard Tides
description: Fight in massive-scale battles where armies paint the battlefield in their color. Captured territory affects both your health and your abilities. Level up your vanguard and your army, defend your castles, and survive the shifting tides of battle to claim ultimate victory!

title: Arthur’s Tale
description: Guide Arthur through a world that’s out to get him! Sprint, leap, and faceplant your way through a vibrant adventure overflowing with devious traps, oversized bosses, and enough "Try Again" screens to last a lifetime. It’s colorful, it’s chaotic, and yes—you’re probably going to fail. A lot.

title: Break Point: Brace & Breach
description: [Hero-Building] + [Frontline Tower Defense]｜Hold against multi-lane assaults｜Adjust positions, facing, skill builds, and formations to create a unique defense｜Push the front, seize resources, and strengthen your heroes｜Let the enemy tide shatter against your masterpiece

title: Nano Reef
description: Turn every keystroke into a thriving ocean! Nano Reef is a cozy companion game where typing or clicking earns gold—without interrupting your work. Spend gold to buy marine fish, vibrant corals, and decorations, or feed your fish to interact. Build your unique, relaxing desktop aquarium!

title: Hannibal
description: Hannibal is a grand strategy game with real-time tactical battles. Choose regions on the campaign map, command your army, and take direct control when war begins. Build formations, break enemy lines, and lead your empire to victory through smart strategy and battlefield decisions.

title: Human: Profit
description: An accurate depiction of our world, baked into a short, classic incremental game. Take over Grandpa's farm, rebuild the town, and do whatever it takes to succeed. Also rabbits.

title: Corrupted Dice
description: Corrupted Dice is a dice-based roguelite where every die eventually breaks. Build a pool of unique dice, reach escalating score targets, discover new unlocks, play risky betting minigames, and push Heat and Corruption to the limit.

title: Plant Game
description: Run-based plant survival and growth game about learning the world through imperfect senses. Grow leaves, roots, and resilience, unlock biological “sensors” as UI progression, and earn your reveal when you bloom or die.

title: Fendershot
description: Intense street racing with some outrageous Race Tech Inspired by Blur, Midnight Club and NFS:U. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Test drive the demo on PC, Mac and SteamOS (Proton)!

title: Voxotron
description: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit. Pilot a spaceship around a spinning cosmic cylinder. No brakes. Thread impossible patterns and find the hyperfocus your brain was built for. Short runs. Instant death. Easy to learn, with insane skill ceiling. Pure flow state.

title: Smalland II: Lost Realms
description: The Smallfolk are back with a massively expanded universe in this open-world survival adventure set on a tiny scale! Enjoy up to 10 player co-op where you craft weapons and armor, form companionships with creatures, build encampments, and discover strange new lands.

title: Maximum Thunderness
description: An extreme response to minor problems. MAXIMUM THUNDERNESS is a roguelike sidescrolling co-op action game where you fight a space alien criminal invasion with different skills and abilities.

title: Starting a Village from Zero
description: This is your own village-building story — You are a familiar summoned by Lily, an apprentice witch. In her place, gather materials, construct buildings, and create a thriving village. A new kind of miniscape × survival × roguelite simulation.

title: Signal Zero
description: A sci-fi roguelike shooter where aim and movement are unified into one mouse. Pilot a Simuler, command your ship, deploy escorts, and tear through colossal bosses. Easy to grasp, ruthless under pressure.

title: Boxing Bastards
description: Plunge into a medieval world where knights brawl with their fists rather than swords! Get creative with physics-based combat as you fight through several thematic biomes full of unique enemies and encounters. Complete quests, buy upgrades, and kill baddies to become the ultimate Boxing Bastard!

title: Abiotic Factor: Entropic Break
description: Embark on a new tropical adventure, roaming sun-drenched seas and forgotten islands. Investigate the warped GATE Leaf Test Facility and surrounding isles, confronting a new breed of fanatics, digital disorder, far-flung anomalies, the Flesh Dimension, and more in this world-crossing DLC expansion.

title: Auto Empire Tycoon
description: Start in the 1950s with a small factory and one dealership. Research new technologies, design cars, manage production, stock your showrooms and outsell rival brands to build a dominant automotive empire in this isometric tycoon simulation.

title: Hardcheologist
description: You are an archeologist descending through mysterious and ever-changing ruins using only your weapon's recoil to control the fall. Shoot, try not to touch the ground, reveal secrets and survive. How deep can you go? What lies hidden in the depths of this pyramid?

title: Boto Labo
description: Solve up to 100 Sokoban-Puzzle levels with the help of your robot friends! Arrange them. Move them. Watch 'em go and... reach the flag in your own style! We got cats, dogs and many more!

title: 4Mecheros
description: A narrative-rhythm game I made to deal with my things 🚬, about how a predatory contract forces a fragmented band—composed of irreparable broken friendships—to get together for a final show. A coming-of-age story about reverb-punk, playing a real bass and the meaning of (not) loving forever.

title: SCP RP
description: A multiplayer SCP roleplay experience where a living facility is powered by programmable-driven characters, dynamic events, and player choice.

title: Synapse Chronicles
description: Synapse Chronicles is a gritty, visceral action-adventure game that blends intense cosmic horror with tactical, physics-driven combat. Unravel a cosmic conspiracy at the center of the universe and explore a bleak world filled with danger, secrets, and tense action around every corner.

title: Dice'n'Go
description: Dice’n’Go is a turn-based tactical board game where every roll can change the outcome. Choose your hero, move across a tile-based arena, and use unique abilities to outplay your opponents. Master positioning, timing, and cooldowns to win with both strategy and a bit of luck.

title: Zolana: Girl Galactic
description: Saving Planet Earth, one outfit at a time! Zolana must save the planet Earth from having its fashion taken away, by challenging the Uniforian conquerors to a runway competition! Dress to a new theme each round in order to wow the judges and save the day!

title: Expendabots
description: Expendabots is a 4-player CO-OP horror-extraction game where you and your friends explore ever-changing islands full of danger and secrets. Run, hide, loot abandoned facilities, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

title: Cronos: Lazarus
description: Wield the Warden’s power in this combat‑heavy expansion to Cronos: The New Dawn, pushing the series toward faster, more aggressive action. Teleport, strike, and outrun a relentless hunter using enhanced traversal, decoys, and temporary invisibility as you race to revive a lost Essence before the Collective closes in.

title: Sword & Banner
description: Mount & Blade meets Total War with classic RTS controls - brought to life in pixel art. Lead your warband across a living fantasy world, raid settlements, trade goods, and fight large-scale tactical battles with formations, dynamic weather, and an army you build from peasants to knights.

title: Spiriki: Tiny Island
description: Listening to the gentle sound of the waves, take care of three small quirky nature spirits! With their help and some patience, create your own tiny cozy diorama and bring back life to your overgrown island!

title: Book Nook
description: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

title: Travelling Light
description: Travelling Light is a narrative game about four friends, Lars, Leah, Samson, and Ivy, caught in the turbulence of their early thirties. Inspired by real events, this experience lets you step into each perspective as love, friendship, and heartbreak collide.

title: Greedy Little Kingdoms
description: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft crowbars and magic potions, fulfill demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

title: Apple Crumble
description: Its your grandmas 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and dont worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

title: Garage Mechanic Simulator 2026
description: Build your own car empire in Garage Mechanics 2026

title: Project Roy
description: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as a rogue AI that survives by hijacking enemy robots. Combine abilities, adapt mid combat, and fight your way through a sci-fi facility to escape and defeat a powerful experimental war machine.

title: Mobius
description: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

title: Szkeletal
description:
Szkeletal: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger (also known by its original Polish title: SZKELETAL: Ziemniaczkowy Głód Estrogenowego Drakula) is a 2D top-down action roguelite and bullet heaven game heavily inspired by the gameplay loop of titles like Vampire Survivors. It serves as a satirical parody of the Polish internet, specifically targeting the gaming community, local content creators, and self-proclaimed "ludologists".

Set in a vaguely defined, fictionalized location, loosely inspired by the internet lore of personalities fleeing to Romania. Players take control of the titular "Estrogen Dracul". The core gameplay involves collecting potatoes and automatically attacking hordes of meme-based enemies. Key features include the "Destiny Cards" system, which allows players to manually pick up and throw cards to trigger specific tactical effects, as well as a dynamic weather and day/night cycle that actively modifies visibility during runs.

title: Returnless
description: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run.

title: Spaceman's Luck
description: A space 4X game. Colonize planets and annihilate enemy races in an intergalactic war for living space. Designed to be fun, fast, and easy to play.

title: Llamero
description: Run around herding magical llamas, gathering mountains of wool, and upgrading your skills to help a struggling wool village. A cozy, story-rich incremental game about a herder and the responsibility he carries.

title: Unmixable Syrup
description: I wolf down a cold, lonely meal. Work's wearing me down, and money's shaky. The syrup I pour into my cold coffee never mixes, no matter how much I stir. So I figure I'll just wander around in my dreams.

title: Sanctuaries
description: The conquistadors just landed and they are coming for your treasure! You must protect your Sanctuaries against this new threat. Take arms, lay down traps, improve your empire and lead your Heroes into battle to repel the invaders!

title: Ship Happens
description: You and your best mates have embarked upon a noble, but extremely dangerous mission. Spacecrafts throughout the galaxy are calling for help - can your crew take the controls and guide them to safety away from ravenous, ever-expanding black holes?

title: Outscratched
description: The scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble a unique selection of scratchcards, blessed charms, and magical stickers. Discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

title: Ball Buster Breakout
description: Grab your balls and get ready to bust! A hyper-kinetic Idle incremental breakout game.

title: Inversion Day
description: Invert the world around you in this atmospheric pixel-art puzzle platformer. Escape an alien spaceship with your dog using mysterious artifacts that reshape reality, uncover hidden secrets, and solve increasingly difficult handcrafted puzzles.

title: Moonlight Cradle
description: This is a traditional simulation management and raising game with multiple endings featuring beautiful girls.

title: Echo Pandemic
description: You are a bat, and the aliens are afraid of you. Stalk occupied towns by echolocation, bite a single host, and let the virus do the rest. A stealth game where your weapon is a disease. Engineer strains, manage outbreaks, and stay invisible. The hunt starts at dusk.

title: Birds of Ascent
description: Birds of Ascent is a hand-drawn pixel-art 2D flight action adventure starring a flock of birds. Soar through the skies, explore the cavern, and fight your way back to the surface!

title: Gido Gido: Kaiju Battle Party
description: A chaotic 4v4 party brawl is about to go down! Control your giant cuddly combative creatures in a cozy city you can smash to pieces, and fuse with your teammates into even bigger kaiju you collectively control for more devastation. Unleash the mayhem and let's gooooo!

title: Rekindled
description: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

title: Block Machine
description: Block Machine is an elimination-style Roguelike game inspired by Tetris and slot machines. Pull down the lever. You will complete the elimination through random choices again and again, obtaining more items and achieving higher scores.

title: Bean Base
description: Bean Base is a survival base building farming game where you are solely responsible for your very own space station. Grow crops, explore the stars, and decorate your base; however you want to, survive the elements of space.

title: Fetidity
description: Dive into the mysterious and terrifying world of Fetidity and help Mark solve all the puzzles and discover the secret of this place.

title: Dictatorship Simulator
description: Some people call it a democracy; you: an opportunity. Manipulate a political simulation by playing cards, find the cracks in the system, and turn a perfectly fine democracy into your very own dictatorship.

title: Earn Your Legacy
description: Earn Your Legacy by yourself or with your friends by slaughtering enemies with flashy combos, finding epic loot and powerful upgrades, parkouring around traps and fighting epic bosses!

title: Degenerate Star
description: Degenerate Star is a surreal sci-fi horror visual novel set on a warped space ship.

title: True Confession
description:
Dramatic and hardcore pixel art shooter that turns into crossroad of anger, gilt, religion and psychoanalysis

True Confession is a game aimed at fans of action movies 80-00 years (Heat, Training Day, The Wire, The Departured). In visual style resembles POSTAL, Crimsonland, GTA2. So it's oldschool but seasoned with modern mechanics and deep religious and psychological plot.

The game is hardcore, each opponent can pose a fatal threat and gives rise to a healthy sense of rivalry. True Confession is distinguished by its down-to-earthness, the game does not have automatic health regeneration and superpowers, an important distinctive mechanic of the game is "anger".

As the game aims to feel grounded, there are no rocket launchers, flamethrowers, or tanks — this game is about crime in the streets, not the battlefield.

Let's pray/play together!

title: Rotted: A Brain Rot Simulator
description: Humanity is trapped in an infinite scroll. Your mission: Break the loop and escape the rogue AI controlling your mind. Stack wild powerups and survive the digital prison in this retro PS1-inspired survival roguelite. Shut down the network... or rot.

title: Straying Rules
description: Straying Rules is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. You need to escape from various worlds governed by strange rules within 12 hours by all means. Levels, objectives and dangers are ever-changing every time you enter. You must discover and interpret the rules to find your only hope of survival.

title: Crow's Requiem
description: A narrative-heavy, comic-infused survival visual novel & puzzle game where you are a licensed body collector navigating a dystopian world of moral dilemmas and resource management; where belief, rebellion, or control will prevail through your choices.

title: Biosphere Simulator
description: Biosphere Simulator is a planetary god game sandbox in which players guide a barren volcanic world through billions of years of evolution. Players shape the atmosphere, carve oceans, and seed the first microbes, then watch ecosystems, species, and civilizations develop across three eras: Geological, Biological, and Technological. Features include procedural world generation, a DNA and mutation engine spanning 48+ species, ecosystem and atmospheric simulation, emergent civilizations, and god powers such as asteroids, volcanic eruptions, wildfires, and rainstorms.

title: Bus Terminal Simulator
description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

title: Greedy
description: A raccoon co-op horror extraction game. Infiltrate procedural ruins, loot everything and extract the relic. Mammon, the Greed Demon, is watching… Stay away from his curse!

title: Hardware Simulator
description: Build your hardware empire from scratch! Experience real business with product sourcing, dynamic pricing, online orders, and delivery management. Boost your popularity, expand your store, and become the country's most successful hardware merchant!

title: Snack Factory Together
description: Team up with friends to build a successful snack business. Start with a small room and simple machines, then grow into a massive factory.

title: Where Dolls Hang
description: Where Dolls Hang is a survival psychological horror game where you investigate a place plagued by strange and unsettling events filled with hanging dolls. Explore dangerous locations, gather evidence, uncover hidden secrets, and use your boat to confront the unknown as you search for answers.

title: Into The Haunted Land
description: An online co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Team up with your friends to explore ruins, loot cursed items, hide from monsters and extract safely. Do whatever it takes to meet the Guild’s quota.

title: Deadzone Rogue 2
description: Fight as Talon 13-10 in this FPS roguelite adventure set on a fallen Earth. Combine weapons, augments, and elements to forge devastating builds, and blast through Monarch’s endless machines. Grow stronger each run, solo or with friends.

title: The Only Droid
description: Tear enemy robots apart piece by piece in a physics-based action roguelike. Destroy weak points, stack upgrades, and create your unique build as you turn relentless robotic enemy waves into mechanical graveyards.

title: Just an Ordinary Bike Ride
description: In this adventure horror game you experience nothing but a calm bike ride home, your chauffeur is late and it's starting to rain. You only have a bike but you need to get home, it's a rather empty street aside from some debris. It's just a bike ride home.

title: AntiMatcher
description: In this abstract rule-discovery puzzle game, you manipulate bubbles to destroy antibubbles in a series of handcrafted puzzles designed to encourage experimentation.

title: Rabanaz
description: A chip-based deckbuilder full of clever tricks to secure your victory. Tinker with your chips, slot in modification tubes, and reshape the scoring to craft your ideal strategy. Can you outwit the Rabanaz machine?

title: Sunyata CCG
description: Set in Earth’s magical future, Sunyata is a tactical, action‑packed collectible card game where you command fantastical creature and castle abilities. Ride dragons, summon the undead, and evolve magical beasts in duels that reward creative deckbuilding and adaptive strategy.

title: Guns, Princess and Braves
description: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

title: Hug Factory
description: An incremental/management game about hugging people to generate profits and the neverending pain of inflation.

title: No One Returns
