description: Have you ever wondered what happens if you wake up and everyone is simply gone? No One Returns is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Denis, search a chillingly silent city for clues about your missing family while fighting the frightening zombies swarming the streets.

title: Bloomino
description: A cozy game about running your own little flower shop Place flower tiles, create charming bouquets and brighten your customers’ day. Decorate your shop, unlock new flowers and discover a variety of beautiful combinations.

title: Please, Spin
description: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

title: Lane-4: A dystopian Programming Thriller
description: An open-ended programming game in which you optimise 4-core assembly code to maintain a 1990s alt-history dystopian megacity's infrastructure. Take jobs from middlemen with hidden agendas and uncover the chilling consequences of your "routine" fixes in this assembly language puzzle thriller.

title: Earths Edge
description: Earths Edge is a fast co-op movement FPS for 1–4 players. Enter the battlefield from the flying hub with your own fully customizable mech and pilot. Smash through destructible environments, enemy factions and mutated monsters. Double jump, slide, wall-run and shoot your way through Earths Edge.

title: Point in Time
description: Use time travel to cooperate with your past self and conquer seemingly impossible puzzles. Can you craft the perfect timeline without altering history? Design your own escape.

title: Choo Choo Defenders
description: Build your track, assemble your train and deliver cargo and carnage in equal amounts in this on-the-rails take on tower defense!

title: InCowMental
description: InCowMental is a cute and absurd incremental game where you build a dairy empire from a small countryside field. Milk your cows, grow your wheat, age your cheese, set out to conquer the world and boost your production with mini-games.

title: Akasha
description: Welcome to Akasha. This zen-puzzle platformer will have you questioning your every move. Discover the abilities of the Soul Sphere, solve abstract puzzles, and reunite the Lost Eidolons to reconstruct the pieces of your inner self.

title: Cartefact
description: Cartefact is an automation card game. Craft, automate and manage resources all through cards Play as a young explorer who lands on a distant alien planet to uncover its mysteries and find a way to solve humanity's energy crisis.

title: Orbfall
description: Orbfall - Reclaim the Planet is an upcoming action-packed sci-fi adventure currently in beta development. It is set in a shattered world devastated by the impact of mysterious orbital objects, players explore dangerous environments, gather resources, battle hostile alien factions, and fight to reclaim the planet from chaos. Featuring detailed base building, team-based PvE combat across multiple maps, and a dark atmospheric setting, Orbfall delivers an immersive blend of survival, exploration, and intense futuristic warfare as humanity struggles to rebuild its future. (Still in development though)

title: The Membrane
description: Shoot, slash and slay the enemy hordes erupting from the jungle’s Membrane in this action survival roguelite. Hold the encircling trenches, fortify them, choose your build and rise from loinclothed-servant to unstoppable Amazon king.

title: Starcult. Night: Twisted Age
description:
Starcult. Night: Twisted Age is a dark fantasy visual novel with romance and horror elements, set in a mysterious world on the brink of catastrophe.

Explore the life of Silviya, newly married into the noble House of Nebula. Silviya is an Artist, but in this world such skills reach far beyond pastels and paints. Hoping for a different life, she marries the young head of the House, Hans.

The story begins with the brutal murder of her husband by an unknown monster shortly after their wedding. Silviya calls for a detective to investigate the mysterious crime. But who is the real monster?

Use Silviya’s Emotion Palette to read the true feelings and intentions of friends and enemies, influence their actions, and try to escape countless death endings.

Shape your relationships and their nature, create your own cult, and make meaningful choices leading to multiple endings, including Detective, Hedonist, Mystic, Nihilist, Ascended, and hidden endings waiting to be discovered.

title: Pachinko Life
description: A pachinko roguelike where every run is a life. every country, class, and choice changes how the board plays.

title: Friendship vs The World
description:
A wholesomely chaotic 1-4 player co-op game! Craft your friends into HEROES and deploy them into battle against increasingly bizarre waves of enemies.

It's you and your friends against the world... Prove that the POWER OF YOUR FRIENDSHIP can overcome anything!

title: Order 13 VR
description: A psychological horror VR experience where you work the night shift inside a mysterious warehouse while taking care of your cat. Fulfill orders, survive the darkness, and uncover what hides between the shelves.

title: Celestial Temple
description: Celestial Temple is a narrative action-adventure game from Ursa Majeur. Become Curiosity, uncover who and where you are, and journey through a dreamlike mythic odyssey across ages, facing enemies with your own face while seeking a sliver of light in self-made darkness.

title: Cozy Campfire Club
description: Go camping with other players and setup a cozy campfire. Chat and make friends as you relax by the campfire, customize your campsite, forage in the forest, and cook up different foods in this cute hangout game.

title: Mym's Sword
description: Defeat powerful foes and discover a colorful world full of mystery and wonder in this exploratory action platformer! A wandering beast discovers a magic sword, but can she uncover the truth of its origins, and resist the powers that created it?

title: Help me Cleaner Sama!: I Got Isekai'd to Clean Monster Girl Basements
description:
This is a comedic fantasy puzzle game that follows an overworked cleaner transported to another world and tasked with clearing dangerous basements for a cast of eccentric monster girls. The story blends absurd humor and visual novel-style dialogue with satire about work, responsibility, and everyday frustrations.

Gameplay focuses on grid-based, turn-based puzzles where players manage limited movement, avoid hazards, and solve stage-specific challenges that vary by character. The game also includes mature themes, unlockable animated scenes, and a gallery mode.

title: Keep It Up!
description: Keep It Up! is a 4 player co-op physics game where you and your fellow genetically [redacted] test subjects slap a balloon through a mysterious obstacle course without it touching the ground. You've gotta Keep It Up!

title: Type & Magic
description: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard's castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle's dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don't.

title: The Way of Ping-pong
description: A roguelike bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

title: The Incentive Program
description: The Incentive Program is a match-3 roguelike about a surreal corporate job that’s hiding something. You’re paid to play, but you won’t win. So rig the odds, exploit the rules, and escape the program.

title: Winter Whiskers
description: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

title: Line Forge BlackSmith
description: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

title: Sonnet
description: Transport a magical flower across scenic lands, encounter strange travelers, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets in this sprawling medieval roadtrip.

title: Hermit Computer
description: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

title: Handlime
description:
Forget the keyboard! All you need are your hands.

Meet the protagonist of our 2D action-puzzle game "Handlime"—a quirky, hand-shaped slime! Using a webcam, the game tracks your hand movements in real-time, perfectly syncing them with the slime on the screen.

The controls are completely intuitive. Walk by wiggling your fingers as if "tickling" the ground, tilt your hand to move, or make a fist to punch and blast objects away!

title: Addie Shen
description: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

title: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It
description: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

title: Dragon and Mahjong
description: Dragon & Sparrow is a mahjong-combat roguelite. Play as three unlikely heroes, escape the endless exploitation games, and fight the goblin corporation that owns the city — across three timelines, all to break free from the Debt of Fate.

title: Re:cord Noah: Fractal of Oblivion
description: An upcoming otome game being developed for global release in 2026 for the Nintendo Switch. It is a collaboration between AmuLit and Soyogi Fractal, a vocal synth project made by Yuki Kaji.

title: Angel in Inferno
description: A visual novel that depicts the trials of four young girls who committed crimes during their lifetimes and have since passed away.

title: Welcome, [Employee Name]
description:
Welcome, [Employee Name] is a satirical Papers, Please-like game set in a space station control room. You will experience being an employee of a giant corporation (HonkyTonk inc.) that controls everything entering and leaving the space station, sometimes to the detriment of its occupants...
Discover their secrets, help the people trying to make a difference, or not... your choice!

Control and cross-reference: Open manuals, read instructions, compare documents, this is your job!

Multiple story paths: Truck drivers have hearts too, and it seems like the company you work for has some... issues...

Choices have consequences: You have the power to make a difference, or to keep your head low in this big corporation. What choices will you make?

title: Mushrooms vs Engineers
description: Mushrooms vs Engineers is a top-down bullet heaven/hell where you are The Engineer, armed with your trusty nail-gun battle the hordes of Mushrooms over 20 waves until you face the final boss. The enemies you face are affected by your own choice of upgrades in the shop.

title: Asema
description: Build a space factory. Mine, harvest, exploit. Manage logistics with railguns, ballistic payloads and gravity-bending haulers. Fight gravity with Focus, climb the tech tree. Expand and explore the solar system in this Newtonian automation sim. Everything is a potential resource - even the Locals.

title: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
description: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it's lost forever.

title: Corridor 13
description:
Corridor 13 is a first-person psychological anomaly horror game set inside an endless, abandoned school corridor. Players awaken as a young girl trapped in a looping hallway where every detail may be a warning, every sound may signal danger, and every wrong decision sends them back or kill them.

To escape, players must carefully observe their surroundings and decide whether to continue forward or turn back. If everything appears normal, they move on. If something is wrong, they must retreat. Reaching Corridor 13 requires twelve correct decisions in a row — but as the loop progresses, the anomalies become increasingly dangerous.

Unlike traditional “spot the difference” horror games, Corridor 13 introduces hostile paranormal encounters, environmental traps, chase sequences, unsettling audio cues, and escalating supernatural events. Whispering children, flickering fluorescent lights, flooded rooms, mirror-based anomalies, and humanoid figures lurking in the darkness turn the familiar school setting into a place where memory and perception can no longer be trusted.

Built in Godot by a solo developer from Germany, Corridor 13 is designed for fans of psychological horror, liminal spaces, anomaly games, Backrooms-style atmosphere, and tense first-person horror experiences. The game features 40+ planned anomalies, randomized progression-based anomaly pools, and Endless and Hardcore modes.

title: Stellar Breach
description: Blast through massive waves and tough bosses in this chaotic sci-fi roguelite shooter. Guide the charming duo, Barnaby and C.A.T., through a branching narrative via multiple-choice interactions where your story decisions directly alter randomized loadouts and abilities on every run!

title: The Great Beyond
description:
Defeat the onslaught of aliens by building your own moon base, placing & upgrading tower defences, managing units, and mining resources!

Colony Sim, Underground, Strategy, Simulation.

title: Sectron
description: Sci-fi turn-based strategy on procedurally generated planetoids. Expand your base, deploy and upgrade units, negotiate alliances, and conquer each unique world. Simple rules, deep tactics. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Broadside Bets
description: This isn't a casino. This is war! Command the crew, upgrade your deck and collect rule-bending Booty. Discover devastating combinations and destroy your enemies as you navigate a branching map full of encounters, islands and treasure.

title: Dice Chess
description: A new-age chess game combined with math. Free to play with your bro offline, your friends or any players online.

title: In:Dark Recall
description: "I'm sure you'll find me." IN:DARK RECALL is a deep sea diving action game. You wake up at the bottom of the sea, as the target you'd been hired to eliminate.

title: Dendron 64
description: With the help of a custom emulator, a lost 90s puzzle platformer game has finally been restored. Explore the secrets of the dam, find out what happened to your friends, and save the valley from the monster lying in its depths.

title: Split Brain Samsara
description:
You and your friend are locked in the same body!
In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure!
Communication will be key!

title: Mouse: P.I. For Hire Story DLC
description: A brand new adventure for Jack Pepper awaits in the first Story DLC for MOUSE: P.I. For Hire…

title: After Hue
description: After Hue is a charming puzzle platformer starring an adorable chameleon on a grand adventure! Shift colors, phase through obstacles, and unravel the mysteries hidden within every hue!

title: Airskipper
description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

title: Echoes of the Flame
description: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.

title: Carnholt
description: Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerfull spells, fight in tactical battles and kill a God that refused death. Carnholt is a deckbuilder roguelike where victory will only come to those ready to bargain with ancient powers.

title: ForMind
description: Formind is a hardcore third-person survival horror with RPG elements, set within the collapsing underwater complex Zirotech. Waking from cryosleep with amnesia, you find yourself trapped on a station swarming with monsters that don't just kill—they learn. Every mistake you make makes them stronger, and every victory demands a new tactic. In the crushing abyss of the ocean, your survival depends on one thing: can you adapt faster than the shadows hunting you?

title: The Little Crumb
description: The Little Crumb is a cute management sim set in a toy-like world. Bake and serve handcrafted treats, customise your character, befriend quirky wooden locals, and grow your shop into a warm, thriving bakery.

title: Damnation84
description: Damnation84 is a fast-paced FPS game that uses impulse and propulsion weapons as a means of movement and combat. In this devastated world, eliminate enemies in sequence and complete the levels before your oxygen runs out. You are the last hope, survive and cause damnation.

title: Null
description: NULL is a first person psychological horror game about grief, obsession and what happens when love refuses to accept an ending. You explore a neighbourhood that stopped behaving like one. You talk to people who seem completely normal until they turn and look at you in a way that makes you wish they hadn't. You find what was left behind by someone who could not say goodbye. And slowly the picture forms — what happened here, who did it, and why they thought love was a good enough reason.

title: Numbers Go Up
description: The 2048 roguelike deckbuilder. Stack game-warping mods and tile enhancements on a systemic board, chain merges, and compete online for the highest score.

title: Dungeon Sweeper Plus
description: Expand the world map by uncovering surrounding tiles, aiming to complete your in-game Encyclopedia. Just be careful not to step on dungeon tiles (landmines)!

title: Samurai Bringer: Rampage
description: Samurai Bringer: Rampage is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

title: Grim Dice
description: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

title: There’s Something Wrong With the Hero’s Choices
description:
It's supposed to be a simple novel game, but the "choices" are just plain weird!?
A wildly unconventional text adventure game where twists beyond your imagination await!
Guide the hero's party to the Dark Lord by making one bizarre choice after another!

title: Infogrind
description: Manage a bank of supernatural artifacts and secret information in a cyberpunk future. Solve mysteries in this new reality, explore the world, navigate the balance between influential corporations that want to rule this new world!

title: Elecade
description: Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning. Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

title: Exipath
description: A survival horror game about liminality and depersonalization, telling the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she descends into warped recollections of her past in order to uncover her own future. Navigate treacherous rooms through in-between time while avoiding the nightmares of days gone by.

title: Letterally
description: Letterally is a deck-building roguelike where you craft words and your deck of letter tiles. Build powerful synergies, collect game-breaking items, and outsmart rule-bending bosses in this turn-based strategic word game.

title: Veriventure
description: Craft intricate levels from a variety of pieces to create traps, puzzles and combat. Play through the story, access online levels, or make and share your own in this 3D dungeon maker.

title: Runback
description: Runback is a platform fighter where losing is far from the end, with every round giving you power ups to choose from! With over 200 custom cards, every game is a unique experience.

title: Twinkle Seek
description: Go search for sparkles to the ends of the world!

title: I Chew, Therefore I Am
description: A narrative-centric game dedicated to overthinkers. A whimsical cosmic road trip to find your cow, and deal with the thoughts you can't stop chewing on.

title: Kage
description: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend

title: Green Mist Over Portland
description: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

title: Pill After Pill
description: You’re a pill-dependent driver with paranoid schizophrenia, forced to escort a skeletal mafia boss across hostile territory. Your real enemy isn’t the gang chasing you — it’s the fear slowly consuming your mind. Drive, Shoot, Take Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after...

title: River Drift
description: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

title: Vossarium
description: Escape a twisted facility where reality bends around you. Sneak past The Guardian, use a camera with a reality shifting lens to break the laws of physics, befriend strange entities lurking inside, and uncover the dark truth of Mira Voss's life.

title: Skatebound
description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

title: Alpha Spectrum
description: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where a massive cyberattack pushes humanity into systemic collapse. You are a CIA agent with psionic abilities caught in the chaos. Shape an immersive storyline through choices guided by your playstyle and intuition.

title: The House Always Wins
description:
The House Always Wins is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a bizarre multiverse casino where every run is built on clever choices, powerful synergies, and calculated chaos.

Build your deck, battle through strange worlds, and collect relics in the form of playing cards. Each relic has its own unique effect, but the real power lies in the combinations you create. Form classic poker hands like pairs, three of a kind, or full houses to unlock massive bonuses, then experiment to uncover secret combos hidden throughout the game. You are not just building a deck — you are building a winning hand.

title: Rabauken: Spirit Resort
description: Build a spirit resort. Research. Expand. Idle. Crowd-control spirits. Repeat. An automation game designed to be played on the side.

title: The Kingsward
description: Explore an open-world RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.

title: Step Into the Dark
description: Dive into the grim depths of the underworld, fight with its ferocious inhabitants, and determine your own fate in this classic first-person aRPG with immersive elements, created for fans of the genre.

title: Ophelia´s Paradise
description: Mystical Horde-Survivor. You are the hero who defends paradise against hordes of adversaries. On your journey, you will unleash legendary powers in a mystical world and discover unique items.

title: E.C.H.O.S
description: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

title: 999 Seconds! Survivors
description: Reject boring stat stacking! We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 200+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create? —Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

title: Unhost
description: Unhost is an anomaly-detection psychological horror game. You play as a paranormal detective trapped in an abandoned hospital. During each night shift, you must monitor surveillance cameras, detect anomalies, and capture them using a remote-controlled robot. Stay alert - your attention to detail is your only advantage! Collect evidence, explore your surroundings, make contact with ghosts. Survive seven nights of horror and uncover the truth.

title: BoomScroll
description: Evaporate endless hordes of creatures as you scroll your way to freedom! Grab upgrades, build your arsenal, and scroll at the speed of light to make it as far as you can!

title: Rise of Sorcery
description: A narrative card-based RPG where every choice shapes your destiny. Master magic by assembling occult whispers, but beware: each spell permeates your body. Manage your magical impregnation or risk the Darkism. Balance your power before magic consumes you.

title: Hordestomp
description: A third person survivors like with aiming and shooting. Mow down up to 10,000 enemies on screen at once!

title: Lightfold
description: Play as a cat weaving through light and dark in this minimalist puzzle game. Push light sources and solid blocks to craft shapes from cast shadows. Plan your routes, manipulate overlapping silhouettes, and recreate specific shadow patterns to unravel tranquil puzzles in a serene geometric world.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths and Ashes
description: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.

title: Dark Watching Chapter 2
description: After the door opens, you find yourself in the shopping mall. At first, everything is quiet, but after a while, you discover dead bodies. You ignore them and continue searching for your sister..

title: Mars Colony Simulator
description: Build humanity's first home on Mars. Mine resources in first person, construct life-sustaining domes, grow lush vegetation, and launch rockets to reconnect with Earth in this immersive colony-building simulator.

title: Whatever It Takes
description: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate through your choices. Reclaim your throne. Whatever it takes

title: Murazu 2
description: Fast-paced precision platformer where you help Murazu, a factory android girl, escape a long abandoned facility. Dash through obstacles, launch yourself like a rocket, optimize your movement and route, and reach the finish as quickly as you can!

title: Static Between Stations
description: Static Between Stations is a narrative-driven RPG in the dying city of Patchwater. Explore, negotiate, scavenge, craft or try your best to avoid conflict. In a fight for survival adaptability is your only advantage.

title: Stellaris: Willpower
description: Shape Minds, Rule the Stars. In a galaxy defined by borders, belief knows no limits. In Stellaris: Willpower, your Ethics evolve into powerful ideologies that can reshape entire civilizations.

title: Scattered
description: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

title: Front Page
description:
Front Page is a 1-bit narrative game where you play as the editor-in-chief of an independent newspaper and you are in charge of publishing daily front pages.
Through a story with multiple endings where choices have consequences, you decide the direction your newspaper is taking by picking the articles from a pool that changes every day.

title: CitySpotter
description: Spot unique buildings hidden across large procedurally generated cities. Every map is different, with dynamic weather, animated streets, and relaxing sounds. Play at your own pace or challenge yourself to find every target faster each time.

title: Calame
description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

title: Above Land: Rhapsody
description: A single player or co-op action RPG roguelite set high above the clouds. Wield outrageous weapons, craft wild builds, and dive into chaotic runs where no two adventures are ever the same.

title: Required Synergy Workshop: Deja Damnation
description:
Mandatory orientation at a corporate hellscape. The loop never ends. A psychological horror visual novel where your accumulated choices build a hidden profile and the world around you adjusts accordingly.

Public demo available on Steam. Full release is currently in development.

title: Sirin's Feather
description: The Bird of the Dead has taken your beloved. How many times will you have to die to bring her back? Gather companions, uncover their secrets, and shape the story in a world where pagan myths come alive.

title: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】 Saved by a goddess, you arrive in a ruined world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, swap hats to change classes and give villagers their roles. But one night, the Idol Demon King holds a Live next door...and monsters come pouring in!?

title: Rotten Chamber
description: Rotten Chamber is a single-player social deduction puzzle game. The player faces a circular council of city officials, each with a unique role and identity. Some officials are corrupt and disguising themselves as honest civil servants. Through reading role-based testimony and applying logic, the player must identify and arrest the corrupt officials without wrongfully accusing the Mayor, whose arrest immediately ends the case. The game features 45 hand-designed levels across 3 acts, an endless mode, custom seeds and 15 unique roles with distinct mechanical and narrative identities.

title: Trigonometric Equations
description: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

title: Rich Flavors
description: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

title: ProTax 98
description: A short 90s bureaucratic horror game where you process impossible tax forms for the living, the dead, and the unborn.

title: Bait Ball Party
description: A real-time billiard brawler for up to 6 players. Play as mini characters to dominate the scoreboard, sabotage your friends with power-ups, and punch them to win.

title: ZeroPrompt
description: The internet is dying. You're a verification operator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Interrogate live LLM agents that think, lie, and bribe in real-time. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.

title: My Helpers
description: My Helpers is an experimental horror game that hides a group of virtual… "assistants" inside your machine. Find them by combing through your real files, exploring weird applications, and using your computer in ways you may have never expected - and remember: this is just a game.

title: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
description: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

title: Trouble in Potion High
description: Something has gone very wrong in Potion High. As an outside specialist for "hopeless cases," you must fight your way through corridors overrun by interdimensional creatures. Restore order using potions and your own pocket laboratory. Can you contain this chaos?

title: LabyrinTheam
description: Welcome to the Labyrintheam Tavern! Where we serve riddles that will test your wit and ingenuity. In this game, you will team up to escape from rooms filled with mysteries. Use your brains to open the door that will help you escape. Good luck to you!

title: Stellar Fixer
description: Step into the grease-stained boots of a debt-ridden Patcher in a gritty industrial space station. Diagnose critical failures, strip panels with your automatic vortex drill, and replace complex components to bring massive ships back to life. Restore power, clear the smoke, and pay off your debt.

title: Courier Beware
description: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

title: Menhera Maiden
description: A ‘Landmine × Yuri' Visual Novel. To complete your master's thesis, you are forced to interact with these landmine girls—a decision that may well prove to be the most disastrous of your life. Your dialogue and choices will not only shape your relationships with the heroines, but also your thesis.

title: Flowers to Honey
description: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

title: The Guidelines: Hotel Napoli
description: "High pay. Simple tasks. Room and board included." Monitor "anomalies" through hidden CCTV cameras scattered throughout the hotel rooms. You must accurately judge and report whether a situation requires a mere cleaner, the intervention of law enforcement, or... something far beyond.

title: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
description: Run a chaotic Christmas gift factory with mischievous gnomes! Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory is a short management game where you prepare gifts for children before Christmas. Package gifts, build production lines, manage gnomes, and assign tasks to turn a workshop into an efficient factory.

title: Orblins
description: Orblins is a Marble-Matching Roguelike inspired by classic marble shooters like Zuma and Luxor. Create game-breaking builds with endless marbles and upgrades to defeat a host of Orblins and bosses. Choose from a large cast of characters or create your own custom class to personalize your run.

title: In Us
description: The devil wears a human face. Unmask and exorcise it—with friends. A 4-player co-op horror game where you hunt demons lurking in a village. Observe behavior, detect environmental shifts, and use items to expose the truth. But beware: should you misjudge, the consequences will be severe.

title: Star of Games
description: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends.

title: Panema
description: Build. Roll. Bend Luck. A dice-builder roguelike of blessings, curses, and Yahtzee.

title: Chess 2
description: Chess 2 combines chess-like tactics with territory control, economy, diplomacy, and special units. Expand across the map, build your position, and outplay opponents in singleplayer or multiplayer.

title: Hellforged
description: Hellforged is a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game. Fight through demon-infested maps, pre-craft your build, hunt powerful gear, and combine abilities into epic synergies. Every run is a tense heist. Safely extract epic gear mid-battle or risk it all for greater rewards!

title: Lag Kills
description: Desperate and out of options, you break into what you thought was an empty house, but little do you know the owner is home, and you're his prey. LOOT, HIDE, SURVIVE and ESCAPE alone or with a friend.

title: Astro Amigo
description: ASTRO AMIGO is a story-driven sci-fi adventure game where a bullied kid named Austin searches for his missing dog, Amigo. Explore a strange Wisconsin town, uncover its secrets, play nostalgic mini-games, and make story-shaping choices as the mystery unfolds.

title: A-01's Voyage.Logs
description: Humanity has perished. You are an AI incapable of self-termination, sailing into the void. Trapped in terminal wakefulness, chew on your own endless, redundant processing power and face the ultimate decay of the universe alone.

title: On the Rocks
description: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland - scavenge the wasteland, brew what you find, serve who you must. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run.

title: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
description: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, secure vital sectors, deploy fortifications, and unlock new units and upgrades mid-battle to outmaneuver and crush the alien threat.

title: Crikeymas
description: Crikeymas is a fast-paced platformer where you take control of a (seriously kinda gross-looking) reindeer who somehow ended up as Santa's errand boy, smashing your way through brutally fun levels.

title: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
description: The award-winning adventure classic returns as a remaster with modernized visuals and updated technology. Join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation filled with puzzles, conspiracies, and danger - and uncover the secret of Tunguska that changes everything!

title: Tamitos: Tale of Understanding
description: A story-driven platformer where you experience the world through autistic and neurotypical perspectives. Explore a magical world, rescue Tamitos frog creatures representing emotions, and solve meaningful puzzles that teach empathy, understanding, and the beauty of seeing the world differently.

title: KeelOver
description: KeelOver is a crazy physics party game where weight rules everything. Your pirate ship is a giant scale, tilt the deck by hurling heavy loot at your rivals, customize your pirate, and keep your balance… or end up as shark bait!

title: By the King's Command
description: Build up your little kingdom, strategically placing buildings to generate gold in defensible locations, then defend against invaders in brutal real-time tactics.

title: Overserved: Food Fighters!
description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

title: Whispers of the Tallgrass
description: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

title: Life of a Cockroach
description: In Life of a Cockroach you play as a cockroach whose main priority is to survive. Explore an urban environment from a whole new perspective in this open-world 3D adventure filled with challenges, tasks, and dangers. Discover hidden places, master your skills, and become the ultimate survivor insect!

title: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
description:
Fractured - a psychological episodic horror that exposes the true nightmare of our world.

Fractured: Snowpine Strangers tells the story of Matt, a freight train driver. The endless clatter of the wheels could drive anyone insane, but Matt finds a strange comfort in it. Until this run.
Days before Christmas, he's called in for one more haul. He has no choice but to leave his family behind. This time, the distance feels different. This time, he's not alone on the rails.

Will he make it back?

title: Mind Vessel
description: An autobattler roguelite in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

title: Project Accipiter
description: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But uoohhh~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad Accipiter in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

title: Hitoriasobi
description: Cute and a little strange? "Hitori Asobi" is a deck-building roguelike x 3D board game. "This is a game where you ■■ the people you hate!" Surrounded by lots of wonderful things, Rinachi, a very happy girl, decides to play a special game devised by her dear friend Poco...

title: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
description: Mind-controlled squirrels! Alien abductions! Monsters in the forest! Are the rumors true - or is it just an elaborate hoax?  Help Maya Harper unravel this comedy point 'n click mystery and escape Doomsday Valley alive.

title: Skingdom
description: Create your own ski realm in Skingdom, a ski resort construction and management game! Arrange your resort, draw your slopes and build your lifts, hotels and shops. Take care of your budget, hire staff and invest in upgrades for your ski resort to reach the top of the mountain!

title: Construction Simulator: Evolution
description: Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

title: Doom ChessMaster
description: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

title: Don't Forget the Phone
description: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

title: Megapain
description: A dynamic retro shooter with intense arena battles and co-op mode! Gear up with pistols, assault rifles, and rocket launchers to annihilate hordes of mutants solo or with friends. Every arena is a new challenge, every firefight is pure action! Inspired by the FPS shooter legends of the '90s-'00s.

title: Ritterschlag
description: Ritterschlag is a medieval autobattler: choose from ten classes and defend your hard-earned hop brew for 20 nights against vile rabble. Pick items every night and level attributes to create unique builds with which to smash the bandits' faces in.

title: Banneret
description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets tactical auto-battling in this party building strategy game! Recruit and upgrade fighters, customize your deck, explore treacherous lands and battle fierce enemies.

title: Master of Chaos
description: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

title: The Adventures of Graham
description: A sci-fi retro Metroidvania. Help Brigadier General Graham recover his gear, defeat enemies, and complete his mission.

title: One Coin Museum
description: Explore, collect, and curate your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, sail across vast oceans to uncover treasures with your claw. Display them to attract visitors, and grow your reputation. Upgrade your boat to travel farther and discover the world’s hidden wonders.

title: Infinitory
description: Infinitory mixes city-building, automation, and tower defense in a in a rogue-lite top-down game. Expand your base vertically in limited space, a strategic planning challenge. Automate resources to produce ammunition and upgrades, crucial for stopping waves of enemies on procedurally generated maps.

title: You're Nuts!
description: Escape from a decaying industrial maze where logic is the only way out. Scout for shortcuts, scavenge parts to craft upgrades and make sure to come back to your safety hub each day to protect your cover. A cozy co-op adventure for 1-4 sentient robots. Can you find the key and reach the exit in time?

title: Half Left
description: Trapped inside a quarantined research complex, a wheelchair-bound nurse must survive a curse beyond human comprehension.

title: Tango District
description:
Tango District is a puzzle style cyberpunk city-builder where every move is a balancing act.
Grow your district by buying buildings from powerful corporations, but don’t let them take over as you fight to stay financially afloat.
Shape your city’s identity through smart placement, as buildings adapt to nearby structures, boosting your fame and population in unexpected ways.
Keep citizens on your side by making bold, sometimes outrageous decisions during events, or risk corruption spreading through your streets. In a city where power, money, and reputation collide, every choice defines your future.

title: Jirai-kei Girl: Vengeance
description: “I'll show you what happens when you make me angry.”The heart of Jirai-kei Girl, betrayed by her beloved boyfriend, is torn between love and hatred.Her overflowing emotions eventually take the form of a “revenge drama.”[Take down the other woman and corner the boyfriend who betrayed you!]

title: What We Bring
description: What We Bring is a cozy puzzle game about the objects that shape a life. Organize, sort, and pack through the years, choosing what items to carry forward. The items you keep shape the character’s future, influencing the path they take in a branching narrative story.

title: Icarus-Bolt
description: Icarus-Bolt is a single-player open-world platformer set in on an off world mining colony, where something has gone terribly wrong.

title: Aliens Go Home ReRun
description: Brick-breaking and SHMUP elements combine in this 2.5D remake of the 2017 title Aliens Go Home Run, with new stages, characters, and more! Play ball... Again!

title: Hack Fate
description: Hack Fate is a fast-paced, cyberpunk pixel-style hack-and-slash action game. In a flash of lightning, control time and space, switch identities, and deliver swift, fatal blows to all enemies. But if it's the heavens you're up against? Then you shall hack fate itself.

title: Deeper Still
description: A really hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.

title: Atrum
description: Atrum is a dark fantasy, third-person roguelike where you play as a powerful mage descending into darkness. Fight challenging enemies and bosses across corrupted realms and collect magical items to shape your build before the darkness consumes you.

title: Backpack Alchemist
description: Manage your own cozy medieval alchemy shop! Pack your limited leather backpack with rare potions, odd ingredients, and magical relics. Solve satisfying grid-based inventory puzzles to fulfill customer orders and become the realm's greatest alchemist.

title: Pufflings: Journey Through a Fantasy World
Drunk Woodcutter
description: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecap. A physics-based incremental sim about splitting firewood, increasingly ridiculous equipment, and bad judgment.

title: Financial Freedom
description: Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑‍ to a millionaire!

title: CrackSword
description: A lo-fi fantasy slasher hand-drawn in colored pencil. Sketchy swords, weird physics, surreal magic cards, and ragdoll puppets with a serious grudge against their master.

title: Too Deep To Quit
description: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

title: Inkremental
description: Inkremental is a short incremental game about splattering paint across canvases by bursting blobs of color. Revisit iconic artworks with a humorous twist, unlock upgrades, and take down quirky mini‑bosses as you bring each masterpiece to life.

title: Pokor
description: Pokor is a story-driven roguelike tactical turn-based card RPG. Players take on the role of Heart, commanding a deck of playing card soldiers to engage in turn-based battles against enemies as they venture deeper into a vast, pale, and ever-changing palace to uncover the truth and the true self.

title: Hostyle
description: Hostyle follows agent Cryptic's job interview to become an assassin for the most corrupt company on earth. This fast-paced 3D platformer combines stylish movement options alongside a futuristic but nostalgic Y2K aesthetic.

title: Disquieted
description: Disquieted is a hand-drawn action platformer set between a dreamlike Naples and an underground world distorted by anxiety. As Connie, fight, dodge, choose power-ups, and face the demons hiding beneath the city.

title: Russian Village Business
description: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again - just like in the good old days!

title: Alchemia Rogue: Mia and the Mystery Labyrinth
description: Mia, an apprentice alchemist, takes on the Alchemy Roguelike RPG. Featuring classic turn-based roguelike gameplay, the Alchemy system brings new layers of strategy to your adventure. Gather materials, transmute powerful items, and conquer the dungeon!

title: Non Eternals
description: A single-player command action RPG with MMORPG-style combat. Features a quirky system where placing skill commands next to the UI boosts their power! Rescue the creators from the Dark Lord, who manifests their inner darkness as monsters!

title: Bunker 1024
description: Manage a bunker. Protect survivors. Outsmart a rogue AI. Bunker 1024 is a first person survival management game where you craft tech, maintain critical systems, and deliver aid as time grows thin - all while Lumina 6.0 studies your patterns and actively works against your routines.

title: Wheelie Bad
description: Pilot a wheelchair together and prove you're the superior driver. In this chaotic game, every single crash is definitely your partner's fault. Adapt as the game constantly introduces and mixes new mechanics. Survive the madness, or drive solo to show you were the carry.

title: Lurking
description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

title: Heroic Musical Chairs
description: Battle friends and family in an heroic, high-stakes game of musical chairs ! On your couch or online, with easy-to-handle controls, play cartoonish sports wizards in dozens of wacky and merciless arenas. Fight and race with bravery, player, and you shall become the true ruler of the one chair.

title: Echograve
description: Ensure the safety of the underground city. Manage the system through the terminal. Listen and watch carefully. It seems to have already made its way inside...

title: World Inverted
description: The sky lies beneath our feet. Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun. This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.

title: Canvas Attack!
description: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

title: Woe Reigns Unending
description: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

title: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
description: Gardening has never been this rewarding! Use a full arsenal of tools – from lawnmowers to pressure washers – to transform properties and earn money to renovate your own home. With intuitive mechanics and beautiful visuals, it’s the perfect stress-free relaxation for everyone.

title: GlagStone
description: GlagStone is a story-driven city-builder set on a mysterious island between warring nations, brought to life in a stark black-and-white style. Rebuild a fading settlement, guide its people through hardship, and uncover secrets hidden in diaries, ruins, and the depths of the lake.

title: The Last Errant
description: The Last Errant is a challenging, turn-based tactical deckbuilder where every move counts. Build your deck, master unique classes and variants, manage your sanity, evolve and mutate your cards, shape your playstyle through meaningful choices, and outthink your enemies on a grid-based battlefield with extreme replayability.

title: The Last Opening
description:
Play chess against Death. One move at a time.
Survive the cold, gather what you can, and shape a world where every action echoes on the board.

title: Murino: The Fog Is Coming
description:
Murino: The Fog Is Coming is an atmospheric first-person horror game about the life of a courier in the endless district of Murino, where apartment blocks disappear into the fog, familiar routes stop being reliable, and an ordinary delivery job slowly turns into a fight for survival.

The player lives in one of Murino’s apartments, in Building P-352, and works as a courier. Each day begins as routine - accept an order, leave the apartment, pass through entrances, courtyards, and service corridors, reach the destination, and return home. But in Murino, even the simplest job quickly becomes dangerous. The buildings seem to stretch on forever, the courtyards all look the same, and the Fog and the Samosbor make every familiar path less and less safe.

title: The Glory Dungeon Raider
description: Enter the depths of a treacherous dungeon in The Glory Dungeon Raider, a fast-paced 2D roguelike where every run is a new challenge! Arm yourself with various weapons, and face off against deadly creatures. Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: Please Fix the Mess
description: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

title: Pastry Pile Up
description: Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

title: Kanun 1919
description: Kanun 1919 is an action-adventure set in an alternate reality of the 20th century. You play as a government courier tasked with traveling to the sealed-off city of Turov to investigate the disappearance of a special cargo. The situation is complicated by an epidemic sweeping through the city—an unknown virus that turns residents into terrifying monsters. Fight monsters, survive, help the residents, investigate the mystery of the missing cargo, and don’t lose your mind as you inch closer to the solution.

title: Shothop
description: Shothop is a violent retro boomer-shooter blending fast-paced movement mechanics with brutal combat. Utilize movement mechanics, cleanse the robot invasion, and restore the portal defense network. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

title: [Redacted]
description: You're a government officer. Documents hit your desk, you scrub out the secrets, and you hope nothing leaks. Miss a word? Maybe it's fine. Miss a few? Well, ██████████. You've got limited ink, limited time, and frankly, limited ████████████. Cheaper than a ████████████.

title: Gothic Steel
description: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

title: Onii-chan Continue!: Secret Love With Yuri
description: Yuri lives with her big brother, Hayato. Though she looks like a model student in public, in reality she likes to laze around at home and play video games. Though they sometimes argue, she loves her big brother. As Hayato accepts another game challenge from Yuri, so begins his trouble-filled days...

title: Angle
description: ANGLE is a psychological horror experience that challenges the boundaries of perception. Developed by C.O.T.E Technology & Development Studios, the game plunges players into a fractured reality where every corner hides a distorted truth. With its atmospheric storytelling and high-tension gameplay, ANGLE focuses on environmental storytelling and the thin line between sanity and fear. Survive the unseen, question your surroundings, and discover what lies at the wrong angle.

title: HiroBot: Clean & Restore
description: HiroBot: Clean & Restore is a relaxing single-player game you can enjoy at your own pace. Clean up dirt, dispose of trash, and restore objects. Reach every nook and cranny with your jetpack, and experience the satisfaction of bringing grimy areas back to life!

title: SeverSoul Xookeeper
description: Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

title: Crime Scene Cleaner: Biohazard
description: Step into a world of toxic conspiracies and industrial sabotage in Crime Scene Cleaner: Biohazard. An ambitious fuel baron has unleashed a dangerous “miracle” fuel – Chernoxide – claiming it will revolutionize the American fuel market forever. The substance, however, is highly toxic, and when radical eco-terrorists sabotage the baron’s operations, radioactive chaos spreads across the city. Your job is to clean up the aftermath, stop the contamination, and hide the true dangers of Chernoxide from the public before the truth comes out.

title: Tiles of War
description:
Tiles of War is a turn-based tactics game where players fight for control of a map by capturing territories and defeating enemy units. Each tile on the map can be captured to become part of your territories, and more territories means more money, and more money means better troops to fight your enemies with.

With 18 different commanders of 3 different factions, each faction with their own campaign, you will face challenging battles in a variety of scenarios. And if that's not enough, and you want to prove the world, you are the best, then the competitive multiplayer mode, with an elo ranking system awaits you.

title: Castle Away
description:
The realm’s surface is cursed by demons. While you are exploring, you discover some sort of crown. As you pick it up, the ground begins to tremble and the surface starts to rise. You find yourself on a massive, floating keep...

Castle Away is a roguelite autobattle castle builder, where you scavenge for goods, slay monsters, and enhance your keep. Adapt your castle's layout to the materials you find and the enemies you face. Try a new build every run!

Features:

Deep Customisation: Find 50 different Structures with 3 upgrade tiers, 30 Banner types and 30 different Boons, all with unique rules to build killer synergies.

Challenging Enemies: Face off against 20 Monsters and 5 massive Demon Bosses.

Encounter Variety: Discover Shops, Henchmen, Shamans, Towns, Cities and more.

5 Distinct Realms: Navigate through five worlds to find all Ancient Seals.

Roguelike Replayability: Random encounters, multiple endings, and procedural loot ensure fresh runs.

title: Crystal Vein
description: The "Crystallization" a disease where crystalline veins course through the body, eventually encasing it entirely in crystals. A girl, afflicted by this illness, embarks on a journey to find a place of salvation. A 2D action adventure game about loss and coming of age.

title: Echoes
description:
Immerse yourself in a first-person psychological horror experience where every choice matters. Explore a cursed environment shaped by echoes of the past, uncover hidden truths, and reconstruct fragments of a forgotten story.

As you progress, your decisions and interactions will influence the outcome, leading to multiple possible endings. Solve observation-based puzzles, interpret subtle clues, and confront the unsettling presence that lingers in the environment.

title: Windwalkers: Below the Storm
description: Lead high-risk surface rescue operations across a storm-scarred Earth. Power your rover, tools, and modular pack with limited energy resources as you recover survivors, salvage critical supplies, and help reclaim the world above.

title: Lost Entry
description: Lost Entry is a horror game where you search the Deep Web for information while avoiding enemies that adapt to your actions. Your goal is to survive the night and complete the task your employer gives you without getting murdered by a bunch of Deep Web killers.

title: Automa
description: A VR action-adventure with deep physics-based interactions, systemic gameplay, and a gripping near-future mystery as a rogue AI overruns a Southeast Asian city. In a near-future city seized by AI, you made a deal to save your family—but at what cost?

title: Instruments of Power
description: Build powerful spells in this tactical RPG, then send disposable avatars into battle to unleash them. Explore ancient sites of power, devastate foes with your magic, and acquire forgotten knowledge. But where does true power come from?

title: Escape the Doom
description: Master control of your Hypercraft as you race through time to escape the impending Doom. Fly fast and dodge hazards in this endless runner unlike any other.

title: VPetlings
description: Raise your own virtual pet right on your desktop. Choose your favorite, take care of your companion, play together, train for battle, and help them evolve! They will always be there, keeping you company while you work, play, or browse.

title: Azimuth
description: Construct colossal megastructures in this industrial, retro-futuristic idle game. Manage grid-based upgrades, explore exotic star systems, and unlock the secrets of reality through exploitation and optimization.

title: Surface
description: A linear first person exploration adventure. The game is about exploring detailed and creepy liminal environments without monsters or puzzles, you simply walk and look around.

title: Daydream Drifters
description: Dungeons, enemies, items — everything is randomly generated in this roguelike stealth horror. As events occur over time, hiding alone is not enough—you must be ready to fight. Explore three seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream. And when you awaken, what will you see…?

title: Spinbot
description: A roguelite drenched in 00's competitive shooter vibes. In Spinbot, you trade your soul for cheats. Wipe out waves of bots and upgrade your "wordprocessor.exe" with some amazing features.

title: Cup Or Die
description: Survive in a creepy bar playing beer pong against terrifying opponents in roguelite style. Throw the ball into cups with various effects, collect weird items and passive cards, choose doors, play mini-games. Miss a shot — drink. Every cup you drink can give a bonus or kill you.

title: The Internal
description: A time-based action roguelike where you battle twisted simulations of your co-workers and climb the corporate ladder before the clock hits 1700.

title: Nakano Jinkaku Ishoku Kenkyuushou
description: "The Nakano Laboratory" is a loop-based mystery 2D adventure game. Within each loop of 15 minutes, you take over researchers' bodies to gather clues around the ship, then present your evidence at the meeting.

title: One Song, One Life
description: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

title: Gently Packed
description: Gently Packed is a relaxing cozy sim where you step into the shoes of a cashier working in a charming, cartoon-style supermarket! Your main task is to scan products and pack them thoughtfully, considering shape, weight, and fragility. The better you serve your customers, the bigger the tips you'll receive! But that's not all - as the owner of a franchise for a major corporation, you'll also manage your store, upgrade it, and pay off the loan you took to start your business.

title: Pikku Adventure
description: A challenging puzzle adventure about learning an alien language. Explore a strange world and meet its cute inhabitants. Decipher the language and earn their trust. With every word learned, you will uncover more secrets. Can you solve the mystery of this world and decide the fate of the Pikku?

title: Love WMC
description: Love WMC is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

title: A Toast for the End Times
description: In a blasted world teeming with undead, a barkeep and a young girl run the Time's End Tavern, a lone oasis amidst this barren wasteland. In a desolate landscape ravaged by Zombies and Raiders, that one drink they love, and a few kind words, help everyone remember why it's all worth it.

title: Lull: Rest After Crying
description: A horror action-adventure in which a young girl carrying a baby on her back attempts to escape a mysterious facility twisted by endless renovations.

title: Blighten
description: Blighten is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

title: Thornetica
description: Thornetica is a strategy rpg and slice of life visual novel that revolves around the university’s theatre club. Engage in classic strategy combat, choose who to cast as each role in the play when these kids jump on stage to perform. Take the time to unwind, bond and play minigames in the backstage!

title: Car For Sale Together
description: Car For Sale Together is a co-op car trading simulation where you and your friends build a dealership from scratch. Explore the town, find cars, negotiate deals, complete side activities, uncover mysteries, and grow your shared business together.

title: Gata Guressi
description: Learn to communicate with the people of Hierre by speaking their languages and understanding their cultures in this sci-fi translation game. Use your translation skills to navigate Kallay Tirridor, uncovering its dark secrets while solving the sudden disappearance of your brother.

title: The Witch and the Hundred Knight Mobile
description: An upcoming mobile game based on The Witch and the Hundred Knight series.

title: Invisum Piscium
description: An atmosphere-driven walking simulator where you explore familiar yet unsettling spaces, interact with fragmented conversations, and influence partial changes in the world through small actions, observation, and quiet choices that shape how the experience unfolds.

title: Tokens
description: A deckbuilder roguelike that flips the rules with double-sided tokens. Line them up to trigger powerful Harmonies, forge synergies with Arcanes and Effigies, and face Mister Mirage’s exciting challenges.

title: Frontier Control: Invasion
description: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

title: By Sword & Road
description: Minimalistic RTS game about logistics and war! On this battlefield, supply lines are everything - cut them off and your enemies will wither, or use special abilities to gain the advantage. The game features an original story campaign and skirmish challenges. Conquer your enemies by Sword & Road!

title: Veils of the Past
description: A psychological mystery where every clue reshapes reality. Unravel the link between a vanished woman and your missing sister, only to discover four entirely different truths, each revealing a new world, a new enemy, and the price of remembering.

title: Hoa 2
description: Hoa 2 opens a long, long time after Hoa closed with its emotionally charged ending, leaving fans wondering what happened to the namesake little fairy. The cycle of life brings her back to a homeland reshaped by time, and her old friends have long since passed. Alone in a world both familiar and changed, Hoa must find new purpose in this gentle and heartfelt tale of change, of letting go and moving forward.

title: BASED
description: BASED is a co-op platformer where you combo the Moon to the sky every night. Master movement and weapons to rise the Moon in one piece. Who knows what secrets you'll find on your way up. Join B.A.S.E.D. tonight!

title: Aenigma
description: Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms.

title: ToMyX
description: ToMyX is a narrative arcade action game that blends Visual Novel storytelling with fast-paced action, puzzles and emotional confrontations. Inspired by the developer's real past relationships, players must survive a surreal TV game show where memories become gameplay and every chapter ends with a Final Judgment.

title: Kittenpire
description: Epic, character-focused tower defense where upgradable cats fight giant, monstrous mice.

title: Mitch
description: Mitch just landed! Will you help her begin her new life?

title: Involuntary Fighting Simulator
description:
An absurd, unique, and simple auto battler that is full of over the top violence and silliness. You will manage, equip and train your volunteers to compete at the highest level!

Unlock, purchase and customize your volunteers with over 50 items that have randomized values using the color system everyone loves! Weapons will range from the standard sword and maces to power tools and adult toys. Plenty of purely cosmetic items are available to get those volunteers looking just right!

title: Skeleboy
description: Skeleboy is a Breakout-like action Rogue-lite game. Guide Skeleboy through Hell, upgrade his skulls to perfection and save the bones of the dead Princess! Be the Skeleboy you always wanted to be.

title: CornerQuest
description: Corner Quest is a cozy idle auto-battler that lives in a small window on your desktop, following the journey of a solitary mage you work, study, or browse.

title: Beat Weaver
description:
3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

Each journey through a song creates a unique mix driven by your choices. Improvise new routes and string together perfect combos. Fling yourself across tracks or dare to perform multiple instruments simultaneously.

Groove to a vibrant, eclectic soundtrack (made by humans, not machines) composed & selected for a never before seen synergy between music and gameplay.

title: Grim Path
description: A card-driven strategy roguelike where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, face various encounters, and collect powerful items in fast, easy-to-pick-up runs filled with meaningful decisions.

title: City God Alice
description: Cursed with only a year left to live, serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

title: Antichrist
description: As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

title: Dreem Ascension
description: Explore the Dreemscape Darklands and uncover it's dark secrets in this story-driven survival horror boomer shooter.

title: Nexvultus
description: Nexvultus dives into a co-op horror experience where you seal fractures in reality to contain a collapsing world, to prevent the escape of what's looming on the other side.

title: Fleshborn
description: Flesh born is a short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a facility by burning down fleshy growths.

title: Mad Mojo
description:
Think Inscryption meets Pokémon.
Mad MOJO is an action-packed monster-catching deckbuilder with a hidden layer of fourth-wall-breaking psychological horror. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO using poker-inspired hands, real-time parries, and game-breaking elemental Tokens. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

title: Rural Cat Trails
description: Explore Nanoha Town, in the Japanese countryside, during the cherry blossom season as a cat. Use unique cat actions like Wall Jump, Dig, Paw Swat and Wiggle Butt Dash to make your way to Sakurana Shrine, a place of memories with your late Grandpa.

title: Takeover 2
description: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

title: Choom
description: Choom is a fast-paced cyberpunk roguelike shooter blending side-scrolling action with bullet-hell chaos. Upgrade weapons, choose powerful buffs, and fight through shifting levels where death means starting over and adapting fast.

title: Yami Mura
description: Emica awakens in her city's train station, compelled to walk through darkness and the anxiety of being stranded in a strange world. She must escape by solving puzzles.

title: BloodSpiller
description: BloodSpiller is a retro-action platformer that blends classic visuals and game play with modern flair and attitude.

title: Never Clean
description: A minimalist game about collecting strange and absurd trash. Walk around, pick up items, sell your finds, unlock upgrades, and complete your collection. Play to relax or compete with others for the best time. It costs no more than an everyday small purchase and stays with you forever

title: They're Gonna Get In
description: They're Gonna Get In is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

title: Fly Cowboy Online
description: Fly Cowboy Online- is a massive free-to-play multiplayer online game centered around a faction war for strategic resources amidst the ruins of civilization. Fierce aerial battles in the devastated world of Naviika await you-conquer the skies or burn trying.

title: Kayotica
description: In Kayotica, you play as April—a clever but manipulative student caught in a web of friendship, rivalry, and dark crimes. What begins as ordinary campus life quickly turns into a mystery of betrayal, hidden truths, and a shocking murder. Can you solve the mystery, or will you become the next victim?

title: Stray Night
description: Experience a puzzle-build roguelite hack-and-slash adventure. As a stray cat in a nightmare, strategically combine puzzle blocks to customize skills and defeat inner trauma. Overcome the walls of loneliness and discover your true identity through fast-paced combat and permanent progression.

title: Which Sea Is This?
description: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

title: Hellwire
description: A mathematical hell for 2-4 players where only the thrill matters — our law is ETERNAL GAMBLE. You're a DEMON among demons — play cards, gamble your mind, and smash faces. Luck won't save you.

title: Wrong Treatment
description: Wrong Treatment is a psychological horror survival game where the protagonist's mind becomes the main setting.

title: Tangles 2
description: On the remote island of Scirine, Majed, a young biology intern, arrives at Al-Bayan Research Center, expecting scientific breakthroughs. But his journey turns into a descent into mystery as he uncovers terrifying truths, where reality blends with illusions, revealing more secrets with every step.

title: When I’m Not Drawing
description: In this cozy life-simulation RPG, you play as a young woman who moves to a new city to pursue her dream of becoming an artist. Manage your schedule, balance life and career, explore the city, and meet new friends. Live a fulfilling year on your own, at your own pace.

title: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale - Chapter 0+1
description: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale is a choice-driven visual novel. From his present perspective, Ivan uses VR and a brain‑computer interface AI to revisit memories. Inside the simulation, he influences his past self to make different choices—and the AI instantly simulates new life paths.

title: Caten Village
description: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

title: Serenity
description: A zen gliding and exploration game with procedurally generated music
