title: Oddinary Farm
description: Stuck on an alien TV show where your death is entertainment, you must escape a variety of bizarre islands filled with riches and deadly creatures before impending doom consumes you.

title: Trypan
description: TRYPAN - A survival horror experience centered on exploration, resourcefulness, and sheer will to survive. Investigate your father's disappearance in the abandoned town of Stagmon.

title: CityZen
description: CityZen is a game about building small cities without stressful mechanics like confusing traffic systems, unexpected disasters or constraining resource management.

title: Artemis VR
description: As an Artemis astronaut, face the challenges of space flight in the newest manned system that will take humanity back to the Moon thanks to NASA resources and consultation in terms of Artemis MIssions. Manage the mission using VR glasses.

title: Lost Call
description: Lost Call is a top down pixel art 2D Zelda inspired game with a metroidvania style map. Take off on a quest through an abandoned and ruined town to stop your phone from ringing all the time, and learn more about the characters who still remain within it.

title: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD
description: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

title: Protagonist Complex One
description: Enter a world of mystery, danger, and lightning-fast action in PROTAGONIST COMPLEX one, a pulse-pounding action game that blends the intensity of razor-sharp combat with eerie atmosphere.

title: Spaceborne Fighters
description: Spaceborne Fighters is a dynamic action platformer featuring arena battles against hordes of enemies. Explore 10 diverse maps, develop your character through skill trees, and craft items to face challenges in the most spectacular way.

title: Novel Simulator
description: Novel Simulator is an interactive fiction game blending writing and roleplaying. As both author and protagonist, you explore worlds and unlock "cheats" to craft stories across cultivation, sci-fi, wuxia, and urban settings through dynamic choice-driven gameplay.

title: Astra Sentinel
description: Astra Sentinel is a wave-based survival RTS where endless alien hordes relentlessly assault your planets. Build defenses, colonize planets and manage resources under constant pressure. Will you be able to recover the control of the galaxy?

title: Stranger Tavern: Brawl
description: Combines auto-chess, cards, and war-chess with PVP. Use 75+ cards and 52 heroes, each with unique skills. Six summoners offer strategic bonuses. Explore 12 synergies and factions with creative tactics like economy or hero devouring. Rise through ranks in PVP with stunning hand-drawn art!

title: Horus: Desert Survivor
description: Survive the sands of mythological Egypt in Horus: Desert Survivor, a survivor-like action game with deckbuilding. Build divine weapons, fight corrupted gods and mythical beasts, cleanse the fallen, and unleash godlike power.

title: Akegarasu: Journey to the Underworld
description: An Ultimate-Speed × Hardcore Runner where a jet-black avenger cuts through the darkness. Cut down enemies with fast and thrilling moves like a hero from manga or anime, and rescue your beloved imprisoned in the depths of Yomi.

title: CapyBash
description: Jump, stomp, laugh and dominate. Think you can beat your friends in the ultimate capybara showdown? Prove it!

title: EverCastle
description: Evercastle is the story of a young girl who sets out on an adventure to the mysterious castle. In this magical action RPG, you must master various spells to overcome monsters and traps, defeat powerful enemies, and reach the castle's depths to rescue beloved family.

title: Code of Shadows
description: Code of Shadows is a fast-paced real-time roguelite where you fight alongside powerful support drones. Pause on demand, evolve mid-fight, and push back relentless rift-spawned hordes across shifting dimensions. Adapt your build, master the chaos, and survive each run.

title: Throw a Life!
description: "Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players! Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island. Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

title: Radical Zomboarding
description: Radical Zomboarding is a roguelike snowboarding game that's all about shredding powder and shooting zombies. Do tricks, buy perks, and soak the slopes with blood!

title: Sato
description: Manipulate space and time in this planetary puzzle-platformer. Learn the rules to unravel more of the world and the secrets within. Do you remember? 183 15.

title: Blemdeck
description: Ruin your deck to make money and avoid Penalty Points. Start with a deck of playing cards and use stickers and stationary to change the value of your hand. Add effects to make more money or to mess with your opponents!

title: CatLands
description: CatLands is a cozy puzzle game about matching landscape elements in a cute cat world. Explore charming scenery and build your own village to attract fluffy folks!

title: Bash Moto
description: Tear up the streets in this 90s themed beat'em up motorcycle racing game. Kick and bash your way through a slew of roughneck bikers all trying to claim victory and the cash prize. Take your hard earned cash and buy yourself a new bike to keep up with the pack or leave them in your dust.

title: Project Blood Sword
description: You are a lone ex-mercenary, turned Demigod, the embodiment of wrath – an unstoppable force seeking revenge on a cult that has enslaved humanity, draining the blood of thousands each day with the means to resurrect the god of hatred.

title: Factomancer
description: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
description: PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package. Choose your faction, amass an army from thousands of "willing" participants, and lead them to greatness! (or agonizing defeat)

title: Charlie Spotlight
description: Meet Charlie, the next King of Comedy! Or at least its' Little Prince. It's a steady grind to get to the top, until on a night like any other, after one of his sets, Charlie is approached by a couple of rather unusual fans.

title: The Guiding Spirit
description: Mix and match hundreds of traits, flaws, and skills to design unique heroes with complex personalities and ambitions. Watch them love, hate, help, and hinder each other. Roll the dice and become the Guiding Spirit of your group of misfits in this story-rich fantasy campaign simulator!

title: A Baby CEO?!
description: A struggling book company has decided to hire you, a baby, to be the new CEO? All you need to do is manage the budget, keep the company brand strong and make the employees happy. You can't talk? No problem! Give a thumbs up or down and try your best.

title: Jacmena
description: “Tin bòta, Jacmena!” A strange little girl always out of place and with a special power befriends the old keeper of a cemetery. Experience the story of Jacmena and Zvan in this hand drawn point-and-click adventure that draws inspiration from the legends and traditions of Romagna folklore.

title: Pileus Bad Trip
description: Put yourself in the role of a surviving village mushroom and try to fix what happened while you were asleep!

title: Primal Survival
description: A realistic prehistoric survival game where you play as Homo habilis or Homo erectus. Craft primitive tools, build shelter, hunt massive beasts, and survive the harsh forces of nature in a vast multiplayer world.

title: Shadow Dwellers: Deliverance
description: Deliver, or take it back. An observation-based horror game where you process packages while watching for subtle irregularities in the same apartment building. No correct answers are given. What remains are your decisions—and the recorded “variations.”

title: Star Wrath
description: Star Wrath is a multiplayer space extraction-action where you design your own ship and fight other players for resources in intense PvP and PvE battles.

title: Cannabiz: Weed Shop Owner
description: Build, customise, and grow your cannabis empire from a tiny shop to a booming city-wide business!

title: Math Is Hard
description: math is hard! or is it? Push, calculate and solve your way through challenging Sokoban-style puzzles. Strategically manipulate numbered blocks and operators to reach the target value and clear the level. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Poodle Kick
description: The world’s most accurate poodle-kicking simulator. Made for horrible people like you.

title: Meowniverse
description: Merge endless cats on your desktop! Every cat you adopt becomes a unique part in your Collection. Evolve your cats, complete the Collection, and enjoy their company. They’ll embark on adventures, bringing you coins and fish! Get ready to huff cats and let their sweet meows lift your spirits!

title: Smash Simulator
description: Inherit a failing company and transform it into a destruction empire! Build and manage your own Rage Rooms, let clients smash objects to relieve stress… and turn it all into profit!

title: Starnded: Gardens of the Rubellite
description: Starnded: Gardens of the Rubellite is a first-person sci-fi survival RPG. Explore an alien planet, gather resources, build your base, and survive a world that's both beautiful and deadly.

title: Scumbag Streamer
description: Scumbag Streamer is a story RPG game where you play as a streamer. Interact with NPCs and the environment to get as much money and viewers as possible! Your choices will determine the type of streamer you are and the audience you get.

title: Combo Vectors
description: Evade enemies and their attacks and fight back using the Braille alphabet in Combo Vectors, a short and minimalist action roguelike.

title: Scrybe
description: SCRYBE is an incremental game with multiple playstyles. Battle cities for hidden resources, unlock secrets and gear, and progress at your own pace. There’s no right way to play — choose your path and enjoy the journey!

title: The Postman Cometh
description: Deliver mail in a strange little town in the middle of nowhere. Meet a colorful cast of villagers as you try to figure out what happened to the previous postman.

title: Rentcthulhu
description: A dark fairytale deckbuilder where you serve Ancient Gods. Reconstruct shattered stories using card suits and racial synergies. Stack high scores to complete Oracle challenges in this twisted roguelike adventure. Can you mend the fragments before the darkness wins?

title: Flipper of Eridanus
description: A fantastical sci-fi pinball experience featuring advanced physics, unique table mechanics, mini-games, and a full pinball tutorial!

title: The Quiet Days of Dorothy
description: During the 2020 lockdown, Dorothy spends her days caring for jars of sourdough starters. By sharing them with others, she builds unexpected connections and discovers small acts of kindness that bring warmth in difficult times.

title: Chrysanthemum: On the Way to Sweet Dreams
description: A high school senior with superpowers longs to confess her feelings to her chemistry teacher, but the island’s mysterious anomalies turn her world upside down. A non-linear otome visual novel filled with sinister mysteries and complicated choices.

title: Rich River
description: Forage the nature for treasures, sell your finds, and use the profits to build a thriving city. Explore, trade, upgrade your tools, and transform the reaches in this cozy clicker life sim.

title: Bhangarh: The Untold Story
description: A story driven survival horror game that puts you in the shoes of a journalist investigating a real-life haunted site, pulling you deep into its cursed corridors as you solve environmental puzzles and struggle to survive the malevolent force that stalks you from the shadows.

title: Low Earth Orbit Adventures
description: Low Earth Orbit Adventures is a relaxing space sim set in the near future where the space around Earth has become a frontier of science, commerce and diplomacy. Retrieve the Hubble, rescue astronauts, assemble space stations and many other missions in this realistic but friendly adventure.

title: Royal Verdict
description: A medieval court simulation where every verdict matters. Hear cases, uncover lies, and balance the King, the People, and the Church as your reputation shapes the fate of the kingdom.

title: TomaDo!
description: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

title: Friends of a Feather
description: An absurd adventure RPG: ruin weddings, break into dinosaur mansions, and sleep with 3 or 4 opossums.

title: Posse of 3
description: Posse of Three is an RPG Maker game that takes place in a wild west setting with heavy fantasy elements! You will play as 3 main characters. Sammy a young settler, Ahiga a native man, and Fennic a wild fawn. Expect traditional turn based rpg combat with a gripping wild west story.

title: Captain Speedfin
description: Ahoy, matey! The clock is ticking for Captain Speedfin. Trapped with an hourglass that never stops, this pirate has only one choice: run. Your mission is simple but brutal: navigate 60 intense platforming levels to reclaim your chests before the last grain of sand falls. There are no special powers here—just pure skill. Every jump, slide, and dash is a test of your reflexes. In this world, the slightest mistake is fatal.

title: Floating Frontiers
description: A minimalist strategy game about growing your infinite floating town. Combine wacky 3D blocks to optimize synergies, build idyllic scenery, and chase your high score.

title: Iris
description: Control Iris, a messenger who walks through a spiritual realm, guiding lost people who seek peace. An action-platformer focused on music, combat, and atmosphere.

title: Orbrix
description: Orbrix is an incremental idle breakout game. Break endless layers of bricks, purchase powerful upgrades, and unlock visual themes. Play actively or as idle as you want. Create a swarm of upgraded bullets to defeat your enemies. Can you grind your way to level 1000 to escape the Orbrix prison?

title: Girl of the Ruins
description: “Girl of the Ruins” is a horror-mystery adventure game set in the future. One day, a girl who looks exactly like you suddenly appears. As you follow this suspicious girl, you will eventually uncover the truth of the world.

title: Ghosts With Hats
description: Ghosts With Hats is a fast-paced top-down arcade racing game where ghosts compete on dynamic tracks. Collect relics, upgrade your unique character, and dash to victory!

title: Deg
description: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

title: Logistics Simulator: America
description: Drive across the United States as a professional trucker. Deliver cargo on highways and backroads, manage your fleet, develop your warehouses, and run a realistic logistics business. Plan routes, manage fuel and time, and take on the real challenges of life behind the wheel.

title: Tidewake
description: Enter the uncharted seas of TideWake in this single player naval roguelite. Explore uncharted oceans and defend your vessel from dangerous foes. Collect and customize your ship with powerful parts and mystical trinkets to become the most powerful pirate in history! Sink into chaos. Rise a legend.

title: Frog Up!
description: Jump, Rise, and Pose! This 3D action game challenges you to climb steps from a third-person view. Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don't fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards. How high can you go?

title: The Last Mothership
description: A short incremental game about harvesting planets to feed your mothership. Mine, manage resources, grow your fleet, and unlock upgrades to evolve your species. You are the devourer of worlds.

title: Idle Garden
description: This little garden quietly grows at the bottom of your desktop. With a bit of patience and care, it brings you more delightful plants and decorations. Arrange your desk garden with love, and let it be your gentlest companion through work and rest alike.

title: Starburst Fever Night
description: Enjoy fast-paced match-3 puzzle battles! Quickly move star blocks and aim for chain reactions!

title: Mystic Tavern
description: Mystic Tavern - co-op simulator tavern and farm with a mystical twist. Build your homestead, explore multiple map regions, harvest and mine resources, cook dishes and brew potions. Customize your character, bond with charming NPCs, and face subtle horror after sundown as you uncover hidden truths.

title: Undergone: Before
description: Explore the story of Kale Vortex in a world where nature thrives — until every step begins to change it.

title: Fast & Fractured
description: Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places and prepare for Fast & Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful elderly characters and battle in stereotypical Spanish maps

title: CoinClave
description: Summon humans through coin tosses and engage in intense battles — a Coin Toss × Card Battle game. Whether you can summon them depends on luck. Manipulate that luck with strategy and seize victory.

title: Stillwell
description: Minesweeper meets horror. Deterministic grid puzzles with clear rules. Use your lantern, flashlight, and chalk to escape before your oxygen runs out.

title: To Be Connected
description: To Be Connected is a relaxing, minimalist strategy game where you shape the land, connect your sites, and maintain a balanced, harmonious landscape. Build a world that expands forever, or craft real-country layouts by shaping land and connecting important locations.

title: NPC Simulator
description: NPC SIMULATOR is a game where you can finally become that boring NPC! No swords or spells. Your job is to give out quests, fix crooked textures, and do whatever it takes to keep players from reporting bugs. Hang in there!

title: Death Pong
description:
A brutal beer pong game where losers are getting electrocuted.

A skill-based challenge set in an underground bar full of illegal, deadly matches.

title: Neural Drive
description: Neural Drive is a cyberpunk action rogue-lite. Use acceleration powers to reflect bullets, dodge attacks, and counter enemies. Master weapons and upgrade your skills to overcome relentless enemies and deadly bosses.

title: MioAquaria
description: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.

title: Exorcism:Nuo Rituals
description: Exorcism:Nuo Rituals is a horror pazzle game. A late-night delivery goes horribly wrong, pulling you into the city's supernatural underbelly. Saved by Nuo mask, you enter a hidden world where Nuo Masters against unspeakable horrors. But you'll soon discover this mask didn't choose you by accident.

title: Donnie's Delicious Nuclear Funeral
description: A point-n'-click choose-your-own-adventure game about Susie, a kind girl in the post-apocalypse who must arrange a funeral for her dearly-departed brother Donnie in the town that hates his stupid, dead guts!

title: The American Dream of Gunther Aims
description: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

title: When Voices Died
description: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

title: Don't Drive Dead
description: Drive, shoot, and survive huge zombie swarms in a top-down roguelite where you build a squad, upgrade your car, and create wild hero synergies. Procedurally generated characters, weapons and levels.

title: Deep Hunger
description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

title: Only Tactics
description: You lead a tactical group in a series of turn-based battles with other groups. A limited number of actions and rules create an infinite number of tactical combinations. The levels are balanced so that the one who finds the right tactics wins. Get ready, that will not be easy

title: Mount Noire
description: Get cash, get meds, get home. Survival horror set in a forgotten ski resort.

title: SkyRen
description: Race, climb, and free-run through dynamic cityscapes! Build your character, master movement, compete with players, earn gear, level up, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate free-runner in this anime parkour MMO!

title: Loot And Defend
description: A short, relaxing incremental game about slaughtering millions of attacking zombies. Take a load off, the end of the world doesn't have to be stressful.

title: Kiosk 199X
description: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

title: Chop Chop for the Old God
description: Chop trees, throw logs into a wormhole, unlock upgrades, brew potions, find teleporters, unveil the map, and explore multiple endings.

title: Wing-It
description: Adapt or crash! WING-IT is a 2.5D shooter where your arsenal is a slot machine. Shoot down drones to trigger the Toy Box Gacha and swap weapons on the fly. Fight through Medy's house, survive the bullet hell, and defeat the mechanical monstrosities ruling the house.

title: Delucid
description: An atmospheric horror game set within an inescapable dream. Trapped in a dark forest, you must explore, forage, and uncover rare ingredients to craft the one potion capable of waking you up.

title: Lounge Café
description: Lounge Café is an atmospheric coffee shop simulator where you play as Sara from Lucerne, running a small café in Binoville. Choose beans, craft drinks, and compete in the city’s major coffee tournament to become the best.

title: Sepium
description: Investigate and localize abnormal activities in this 1-4 players survival horror game. Find your way to various locations where something odd is happening, while trying hard to keep your crew alive.

title: Kafak
description: KAFAK – Survival Card-Building & Base Management Game Build your deck with 150+ unique cards, upgrade characters and your base, craft Thai dishes, hunt and farm to survive, and face 10+ powerful bosses in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: Dream Village
description: Immerse yourself in the cozy world of village life! Set up your home, buy groceries or order home delivery, cook delicious soups, manage your farm and earn real estate. Dream Village - dreams become reality!

title: Santa's Burnout
description: Santa has officially quit. The kids are too spoiled, and the magic is gone. This year, the Toy Factory has been converted into a strip mine. Click rocks, crush hope, and manage a cynical coal mining operation in this dark industrial idle game. Your goal? Ensure everyone gets coal for Christmas.

title: Michael Test
description: Michael Test is a point-and-click adventure game where you uncover hidden truths within classical paintings and follow faint traces of sound to deduce and choose the final ‘sin.’

title: World Without Time
description: World without Time is an atmospheric adventure about a fire alicorn exploring a ruined world, using magic, and confronting their past self. Experience exploration, flight, light combat, and choices that shape the fate of the protagonist.

title: Scicry
description: A first-person sci-fi action-horror. After a catastrophic event, the station’s crew has mutated, turning its corridors into a deadly labyrinth. Explore the station, scavenge resources, and fight monsters to survive.

title: DoDoon
description: Defend your castle from approaching monsters! Upgrade your defenses and survive all 30 fast-paced waves in this addictive defense shooter.

title: Become
description: Experience life's fantastical journey as one of millions of sperm. Survive the microcosm dangers, wiggle, dash and compete through the human reproductive system and create new life.

title: Kubika
description: Guide charming cubes through a dreamlike world in Kubika, a Sokoban-inspired 3D puzzle adventure. Manipulate gravity to your will to solve thoughtful, elegant three-dimensional puzzles. Bring your vision to life with the built-in Level Editor, and share your creations with the Community.

title: Wong
description: Wong is a 2D platformer designed for speedrunning, where you will clear levels, learn their shortcuts, and compete for the best score in a fluid, precise, and perfection-focused gameplay experience.

title: The Day That Wasn't
description: Relive the same day without remembering it. Your choices feed four inner alter egos (Shadow, Mad, Alex, and Bully) — shaping reality, glitches, and one of 16 possible endings. The day repeats. Your mind doesn’t. Or does it?

title: Aelwater
description: Memory has weight. The departed are not gone. Step into a village drowned by flood and memory, and search for the final answer about guardianship and farewell among the shattered past.

title: Deluge: Raintime
description: Some things don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge that sleeps under the soil for decades— An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.

title: Chronicles Meteorfall
description: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

title: Avernoth
description: Sealed away in an ancient alternate dimension, you must find a way to break free. In this fantasy action rogue-lite, uncover a variety of spells to cast your way through waves of hostile magical apparitions. Discover the secrets of Avernoth to make escape possible. Do you have what it takes?

title: BattleBoat X
description: BattleBoat X is a combat roguelike where you command a heavily armed gunship through a chain of hostile islands. Fight dangerous enemies, upgrade your vessel, and save the world from certain doom!

title: Rogualik
description: Rogualik is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where you uncover dark, scary secrets of a surrealistic sweet-filled world. Use ridiculous makeshift kitchen weapons, upgrade your croissant with "Mise en place" assets and defeat all the crumbs that stand in your way!

title: DishDash
description: DishDash is a single-player time management restaurant game where you prepare meals, serve customers, and manage limited resources under constant time pressure, turning kitchen chaos into smooth rhythm through speed, focus, and smart decision-making.

title: The Last Wizard: A Goblin Detective Mystery
description: Investigate a murder as the first goblin detective in a comedic fantasy world without magic...where a wizard is the prime suspect!

title: No More Pesticide
description: No More Pesticide is an active incremental game about a cute frog exterminating swarms of mutant bugs, building a farm, and taking down an evil pesticide manufacturer.

title: Whispers of Appalachia
description: An atmospheric horror walking simulator inspired by Appalachian folklore. Explore a hostile forest, survive multiple nights, and avoid the creatures that roam within. No puzzles. No combat. Just you, the forest, and what hunts inside it.

title: Dreamera: Figment of Dreams
description: Point-and-click puzzle adventure about exploring surreal dream worlds, solving layered environmental puzzles, and navigating between realities through a central Dreamgate.

title: Soundscapes
description: Soundscapes is an interactive music sandbox where your songs shape the world around you.

title: Ever Flip
description: Ever Flip is an incremental coin-flipping game where consecutive 50% chance wins create powerful streaks, bigger rewards, and increasing automation.

title: Diskette Dungeon
description: A magical diskette opened a portal in your office, pulling you into endless dungeons where survival depends on adaptation, destruction, and corrupted data collected to reach the next world.

title: Dead 4 Now: Escape Together
description: A 4v1 asymmetrical horror where survivors escape by solving shifting puzzles. Use always-on proximity voice to manage sanity, but speak too loudly and the monster will find you.

title: Cozy Farm
description: A cozy farming game where you grow crops, raise animals, freely build and move farm structures, craft products, and sell fresh goods to villagers in a peaceful, cartoon-style world.

title: Static Shift
description: A Lovecraftian, psychological co-op horror where the powers from above are tormenting you and your co-workers, warping reality with anomalies and using any means necessary to stop you from leaving or finding out the truth: Can you do it?

title: Fractaloid Attacks!
description: Fractaloid Attacks! is an arcade mix of pinball and brick breaker set inside a living digital world. Bounce, glide and blast through fractal caves, unlock powerful technologies, survive chaotic hazards and build your own collection of strange fractaloid creatures.

title: I Never Late for Work
description: This is a life-simulation roguelike card game. Harness item and skill cards to shorten your commute, continuously boost yourself through diverse events, forge connections with different friends to help each other out, and become the best employee who never arrives late.

title: Peglotto!
description: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!

title: Watch Eye
description: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.

title: Reroll Routine
description: Reroll Routine is a rolling clicker inspired by autobattler-style shop systems. Buy ROUTINES, earn R€COINS, win the ROLLYMPICS and REROLL your life. One of the past champions, Relder, is here to help you achieve it.

title: Heartseers Grove
description: Gather, craft, build, and explore in Heartseers Grove, a cosy survival game set in a peaceful world of forests, hills, and caves.

title: Tome Improvement
description: A co-op dungeon crawler where you and your friends name the spells. Catch critters, combine them in your staff, and hope your friends remember which spell is "DIVORCE BEAM" when you are surrounded by skeletons.

title: Kingdom Heroes
description: Kingdom Heroes is a fantasy medieval survivor-like blending action, exploration, kingdom management, and local co-op for up to 4 players. Battle massive hordes, vote on the group's fate, build your kingdom, and dominate other players through asynchronous multiplayer.

title: Masackra
description: A tactical game with grid-based combat, classes, and synergies. Assemble your squad, strengthen it through events, and make decisions that determine the outcome of each battle.

title: 4Below
description: A co-op extraction roguelike with active ragdoll chaos. Descend into ancient underground ruins, recover priceless relics, survive the unknown, and escape with enough to meet the quota—together.

title: Mira: Shadow of the Past
description: Travel. Go back. Erase your regrets.

title: The Kingdoms of Ædloran
description: The Kingdoms of Ædloran is a 2D top-down pixel RPG. Explore a living open world, encounter strange and fantastic creatures, level up and learn new abilities, battle savage beasts and monstrous foes, delve deep into perilous dungeons, and claim legendary loot.

title: Slopeside Kings
description:
Slopeside Kings is a multiplayer snowboarding combat racing game.
In Slopeside Kings you shred down the slopes, catch big air, and pull off tricks to build boost then use chaotic items to battle your way to the finish line.

title: Crosstown
description: An overload of 8-bit-style action mayhem, Crosstown hands you a toga and a gun, and lets you loose in an ever-changing maze full of monsters and explosions! 40 levels, up to 4 players, and an endless mode!

title: Helenland
description:
Helen finds a mysterious video game on her doorstep and starts playing it.
But as she progresses, strange events begin to happen around her...

Helenland is a single-player, first-person psychological horror.
The game features deep narrative, exploration and puzzles.

title: OS95 Plus!
description: OS95 Plus! is the newest first person puzzle adventure game from Gev Creates. You're stuck in a mysterious facility and are forced to indefinitely partake in software testing. You must navigate rooms and solve puzzles to escape and uncover the truth behind the experiment.

title: The Ashen Oz
description: A fast-paced dark fantasy action roguelite where you chain attacks and parries into fluid, combo-driven combat through a twisted fairytale world.

title: Land of the Dead Trees
description: Land of the Dead Trees is a roguelike extraction RPG. Walk the thin line between life and death as you struggle to restore a shattered world. Lands of the Dead Trees draws you into a breathtaking realm beyond your wildest dreams - where danger lurks at every step, and survival demands courage.

title: Stunt Paradise 2
description: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

title: The Whispering Bones
description: The Whispering Bones is a roguelike psychological horror where you gamble with a mysterious stranger in the depths of a nebulous wood. Speak to him, unravel his secrets, make bets and win a chance for a better life.

title: Essentia: A Monster Catching Adventure
description: Isometric dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. A wide variety of cute monster characters to collect. A turn-based battle system with unique mana mechanic. Uncover the secrets of the calamity that has left this world in chaos.

title: Dwarven Mining Company
description: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

title: Corridors
description: A shooter / gem collection game that lives in your files. Corridors combines high-score action with a fully functional, intuitive file and media explorer. Play in our preset world for competition, or turn your PC and its files into the setting. Lightweight, portable, runs native on most systems.

title: Void Diver: Escape From the Abyss
description: Manage 'Balusha' antique shop in an anomalous city. Command 'Divers' into the abyss to recover artifacts from city dungeons. Survive and escape alive in this high-quality pixel art extraction action RPG. Face bizarre threats alone or with friends.

title: Less Miserables
description: A point-and-click parody of 'Les Miserables', set in the French Revolution

title: Killing Things With Your Friends
description: Rip limbs off mutants and use them as weapons in this chaotic co-op survival game about dark humour and dismemberment. Hack through mutant hordes, work as a team, and survive lethal challenges for profit!

title: Jibbers
description: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.

title: Veros Veros Veros
description: Maybe a waitress simulator. Maybe an arcade game where you play as a waitress, but in reality, it doesn’t really matter.

title: Bullet Time Agent
description: Bullet Time Agent is a sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell. Slow time and dodge storms of bullets as you punch your way through robot-filled arenas. Thread laser gauntlets with super-powered jumps. Take down increasingly intense bosses as you rewind your own death again, and again...

title: Remote Control
description: Remote-control human proxies to explore a derelict spaceship. Type your commands, manage risk and decide how disposable a life really is.

title: Toymaker: Threads of Joy
description: Toymaker is a toy-crafting and store management simulator set in the 1910s Spain. Meet unique customers and colorful locals in a bustling city, and discover a magical story based on a folk legend. Follow two different mythic paths, and change the future of your hometown!

title: Prison Fury
description: Prison Fury is a 2 player co-op puzzle platformer game. Pair up across mirrored prison stages to solve interdependent puzzles—door sequences, platform chains, patterns, levers and more. Runs are intense and can take 16–45 minutes.

title: AlterMage
description: AlterMage is a first person metroidvania that combines spell-slinging action with a cerebral exploration experience. As an aspiring mage seeking to learn sorcery, you find yourself upon the shores of a forbidden island fortress. Take up your staff and set out on a journey that will challenge your mind, body, and spirit as you uncover the truth behind the citadel's origin.

title: Drift Market
description: Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

title: Isekai HKV
description: “Isekai HKV” is a 2D top-down pixel-art roguelike themed around VTubers traveling to another world. Players take on the role of the hero “DD,” gain the cheat skill “Unlimited Gacha,” and adventure with VTubers to defeat the Demon King!

title: Bloomies
description:
Bloomies are cute little creatures born from seeds and eggs, growing while you go about your day on your PC. But peace doesn’t last forever because Shadow Bloomies are waiting for the right moment to invade and take over your taskbar world.
In Bloomies, you plant seeds, grow eggs, and hatch over a hundred unique Bloomies, each with different ranks. Raise them, collect rare Sparkle Bloomies, and watch your tiny companions live their lives.
When Shadow Bloomies attack, your Bloomies automatically jump into battle. Defeat powerful bosses in order to unlock new seeds and items.
Prefer a calmer experience? Cozy Mode lets you disable combat entirely and simply enjoy collecting, decorating, and customizing your Bloomies at your own pace. You can even automate your experience through the skill system.
Bloomies is a cozy monster-collector with light farming and idle elements that runs directly on your taskbar . But it doesn’t have to stay there. Resize it, move it anywhere on your desktop, and create multiple profiles to match your mood. Decorate your world with tons of items, dress your Bloomies with adorable hats, or even turn Bloomies themselves into hats.

title: Don Memo
description: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

title: Meaningless Random Numbers
description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning cash through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching.

title: Late Night Duty
description: A short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school.

title: You Remembered
description: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

title: Escape Tsunami: Take Brainrots!
description: Dive into a chaotic arena where brainrots are scattered everywhere, just waiting to be taken and brought back to safety.

title: Death a Live
description: Pack the house in 15 daysbefore your "Yandere Fan" stabs you. Survive a live stage swirling with love and madness in this rhythm-action RPG. Manipulate "Sound" and "Emotion" through rhythm inputs, where your performance and your choices dictate the "Girl Voltage"!

title: Final Orbit
description: Master the cockpit of highly realistic spacecraft in this Newtonian physics based sim. Take off from surface to space, plot a course between the planets and dock with space stations. Trade commodities or take shipping contracts to buy upgrades and optimize your build - every choice matters.

title: Dungeon Treaders
description:
A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort. Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

Create your character by choosing a name, selecting from five races and eight classes, and form a party of up to six members.

In addition, you can freely replace face icons and full-body portraits with your own images. Build a party that truly reflects your style.

Dungeon Treaders is a classic-style dungeon crawler RPG based on the original web novel Dungeon Settlers (2022 to present), written by the same author.

title: Fortune Teller Simulator
description: Step behind the curtain of an occult salon on a Victorian street of London. Play as a Fortune-teller who decides fates with Tarot readings.

title: Essomenic
description: You are the surgeon navigating patients' memories via crude, retro machinery, under the command of a strange, occult organization. Keep your patients alive long enough to uncover your exact role in this surreal mess of an operation.

title: Hellcard II
description: Hellcard II is a cooperative roguelike deckbuilder that can be played solo or with a team of up to four players. The game takes place in the paper dungeons known from Hellcard and Book of Demons, expanding into new biomes and storylines.

title: Manifesto
description:
Manifesto is a new management sim about burnout, layoffs, and making shitloads of money.

You’ve climbed the ranks, left countless competitors in your wake, and proven you have what it takes to survive in this cut-throat business. With this latest venture, you’ll have to put any human feelings you’ve ever experienced aside, and attempt to satisfy shareholders who can never truly be satisfied.

title: Shadowstone
description: Shadowstone is a 1-4 player tactics game where players must master strategic positioning and powerful hero synergies to survive against the unrelenting horrors of the Sunderlands.

title: Wingmine
description:
Wingmine is a narrative puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper, entirely based on logic.
Your special unit has been scattered behind enemy lines: analyze the terrain, defuse the mines, and save your team.

title: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery
description: When renowned P.I. Clair V. Is called to a Louisiana town on reports of a ghost, what they find is a mystery cloaked in a nightly calamity. With spirit abilities and the gift of foresight, Clair must loop through futures to uncover the roots of the haunting and stop a curse.

title: Eye of Syn
description: Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

title: Asylum 1966
description: Asylum 1966 is a first-person psychological horror experience set within the decaying halls of a long abandoned mental institution. Players step into the role of an investigator drawn to the asylum by a series of unexplained events, only to uncover a place where time fractures, memories distort, and reality becomes unreliable.

title: EVO Card
description: EVO Card is a roguelike card game in which players evolve creatures by assembling biological components through deck-building mechanics. Each run features randomized encounters and progression, encouraging strategic adaptation across repeated playthroughs.

title: Petrichor
description: Petrichor is a JRPG about a space cub going on a quest to find the perfect houseplant. Make friends, defeat monsters, help people, save the stars and maybe get his plant. Maybe.

title: InterViolence
description: Wander through a secret lair. Help a young supervillain move out of his lifelong home. Think about your past, and his uncertain future. The third entry in the Violence series.

title: Party Pop Bubblyz
description:
Jump into the Ultimate Penguin Party!
Break the ice and have fun at the Park! Join the 20-player party to be the star!
Explosive Fun in Just 10 Minutes

title: Broom Broom
description: Grab your broom, fly over to people in need and brew them potions after a catastrophic snowstorm has hit your village! Talk to your lovely (but mostly grumpy) neighbours as you find your place in this short and cozy adventure.

title: Making Lovely
description: A romantic comedy where you play as a “love advisor” at the counselling office Making Lovely for a group of quirky, romantically challenged heroines. You, The protagonist becomes a “temporary boyfriend”. As you comment on their every move, you help them discover their true charms.

title: Typeoids
description:
Typeoids is a fast arcade-style typing game inspired by the classic Asteroids.
Wield your keyboard to protect yourself against the incoming asteroids threatening to crush your ship, and get performance statistics and track the progress in your typing journey.

title: Tom Lander: The Exiled King
description: Pilot wacky aerial vehicles with silly key-based controls through an epic action packed campaign. Struggle to stay airborne while performing deliveries, rescues, firefighting missions, bombing runs, and chaotic dogfights. This game will remind you that flying is hard, but landing is harder.

title: After the Wane
description: Retracing the footsteps of a mother she never knew, Lena's trying to make it as a dancer in the city. Caught in a quarrel between dance companies, dealing with love and heartbreak and the challenges of young adulthood, she must also cope with the voice in her head commenting on everything she does.

title: Fate’s Loop
description: An upcoming souls-like RPG game. It is a stylised medieval fantasy adventure where you play as Thalor, a retired hero who must save their village from a time loop curse.

title: Resolute Bay
description: Forelegs are better than two as you journey across mountains, thickets and plains in search of your lost herd. Master Fight, Flight and Freeze responses to fend off foes in snappy, turn-based battles of wits, then take in the scenery and have a good roll before trotting on.

title: Ghost Scout
description: Identify invisible ghosts using mundane and strange objects. Find the Anchor without getting killed, reveal the ghosts true form and attempt to get out alive.

title: Barely Alive
description: A co-op survival party game - hunt your friends or survive until sunrise. Use the in game proximity VOIP and radios to form alliances...or betray.

title: Towerlings
description: Watch autonomous adventurers climb a 100-floor tower while you guide their fate through strategic intervention. No direct control — only decisions. Choose when to summon, strengthen, or protect, and decide whether to build an army or raise a few elite heroes.

title: Inganock of the Raging Flame: What a Beautiful People
description: A remaster of Inganock ReBORN with upgraded resolution and new features.

title: Ravelle: Last Draw
description: What starts as casual matches in a humble café becomes a shared effort to protect a place that matters. Ravelle is a free-to-play turn-based strategy card game with visual novel elements, blending tactical card battles and personal character stories.

title: Cardoom
description: Cardoom is a roguelite deckbuilder where you start with a basic deck. You collect new cards and items that affect your gameplay as you go.

title: Train Goes Right
description: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

title: Doomtrain
description: Hell has gone CORPORATE! DemonCorp's evil executives force demons into eternal overtime. Armed with the powerful DOOMTRAIN, unionize Hell and free the demon workers. Build a medieval steampunk town, upgrade your train and turrets, unionize demon workers, and defeat DemonCorp's corporate overlords!

title: CaraVanguard
description: A rogue-lite action RPG with co-op for up to 7 players. Choose from 7 classes, master 70+ weapons and 100+ skills, and battle through a world where elemental interactions can weaken—or empower—your enemies. Inspired by traditional action RPG's and classic titles.

title: Gargoyle Garden
description: Sit back, relax, and grow many magical and mystical plants in your very own greenhouse! Collect rare plants, upgrade your tools, and earn enough money to unlock new greenhouses.

title: Dadum The Dice
description: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

title: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

title: Comeback
description: A Visual narrative about overcoming the status quo, Fight in a series of different Arenas Levels, In your downtime cook different meals with unique effects and craft equipment to increase your chances.

title: Path of Glory
description: Path of Glory is a deck-building, roguelite game, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Offering endless replayability, unlockable characters with unique tree skills and card deck's. Fight all beast on your path to become a Hero.

title: Zombie Craft
description: Zombie Craft is an open-world survival, farming, ranching, factory-building, and trading game inspired by many beloved classics. Explore the continent freely, rebuild villages, and earn your fortune. And whatever you do—prepare for the night. They are coming.

title: World of Tanks Blitz: Reforged
description: World of Tanks Blitz: Reforged is a massive technical overhaul of Wargaming’s hit MMO action game. Rebuilt from the ground up on Unreal Engine 5, it introduces next-gen graphics, dynamic lighting, and advanced physics. Experience intense 7v7 tank combat with stunning PBR textures and enhanced environments, while maintaining full cross-platform progression in the most visually advanced version of Blitz to date.

title: Another Hero's Adventure
description: A pixel-art RPG rooted in modern wuxia novels. This spin-off continues the spirit of the original, letting you embark on an untold tale of the jianghu where your choices shape the chaos and forge a new heroic saga.

title: I Can Offer You Flowers
description: 'To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist!

title: Liv
description: You are accused of the disappearance of a young woman. To prove your innocence, you must solve the case. Use the computer, the victim's diary, and her videos from the last months. You can use specialized software and the police datas. Make deductions, solve puzzles and find out what happened to Liv.

title: The Curator
description: The Curator is a gallery-management roguelite about managing your own traveling exhibition. Upgrade your van and constantly re-organize artworks to unleash synergies while satisfying picky visitors. Prepare for special events and curate a collection that pleases everyone, including the Baron Family.

title: Foxy Dumplings
description: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

title: Wild Terrain
description: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

title: TreasureTails
description: A cozy, relaxing and casual adventure game where you play as a curious cat searching for treasures. Explore peaceful landscapes, follow treasure maps and solve clues to find and unearth many hidden wonders and mysteries.

title: Send In The Vampires
description: Maniacs have taken over the asylum. Restore order with your fists in the ultimate gothic arcade beat em up. Supports up to 4 players in couch coop/remote play.

title: Sushi on Wheels
description: Run your dream sushi truck in Sushi on Wheels! Prep ingredients, customize your truck, and serve handmade sushi to hungry locals. Upgrade your gear, discover new recipes, and build your reputation in this cozy management game set in a charming Japanese town.

title: My New Paranormal Life
description: My New Paranormal Life is a story-rich, erotic visual novel focused on its dating-sim and sandbox aspects.

title: Drunken Hog
description: Drunken Hog is a story-driven pub management game focused on brewing, running a bar, and narrative depth. It is set in a small open city where you are free to explore, meet locals, and uncover the story at your own pace.

title: Wish Of Hers
description:
Wish of Hers is a round-based 2.5D roguelike about surviving in unstable dreams.
Each run is shaped by unlocked abilities, combined aspects, and your decisions.
Experiment, adapt, and break your own builds!

title: Rudravati: Curse of Bhankilla
description: A first-person supernatural horror inspired by the legends of Bhangarh Fort. Explore India’s most haunted place, uncover your brother’s disappearance, and survive the ancient curse that still haunts the ruins.

title: The Dreadthorn Therapist
description: A mysterious black fog covers the skies, plunging Dreadthorn into endless night, corrupting some residents. In this horror therapist-sim, run your business, decide your clients’ fate, and survive what seems like end times.

title: Nano Dash
description: Nano Dash is Boulder Dash like action puzzler game but with a lot of new elements and also some Metroidvania features like tiny story-line, power-ups and a lot of secrets and hidden dungeons. The graphics and sound is 8 Bit like and close to the one from the original from 1986.

title: Remnants of Sin: Deck & Puzzle
description: This is a roguelike deckbuilder where cards become tiles. Place shape-based cards onto the board, clear rows and columns, and turn every decision into damage, defense, or special effects. Fight through creatures of the underworld, refine your deck and relics, and see how far your strategy can go.

title: Kitty Haven
description: A cute and cozy logic puzzle game about cats.

title: One Last Sacrifice
description: PvP Autobattler meets character progression. Draft your board from a rotating shop. Build a semi-persistent deck and refine it through crafting. Discover powerful synergies. Outwit your opponents in sync or async duels and ascend the Arenas of Naskarr. A card battler without pay-to-win mechanics.

title: Toxoplasma
description: You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any anomalous signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here.

title: Wiz Hunter
description: Wiz Hunter is a rogue-lite deckbuilding card game. Embark on a deadly quest to hunt down wizards through strategic, turn-based combat. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

title: Lydia Was Here
description: A horror RPG about how not to handle grief, identity, and the delusions of bringing someone back.

title: Abyssal Merge
description: Merge fish to blast horrors! Abyssal Merge is a Suika-shooter roguelike where every merge scales your power. Shoot fish down to grow, and auto-fire up to survive eldritch waves. Featuring boss fights, unlockable ships, and a unique coin-shooting shop. Hold the line!

title: Mechborn
description: Protect Earth and her colonies in a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by ’90s mech anime and Greek mythology. In MECHBORN - YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK - Unlock mech parts and pilots, craft custom decks and unleash devastating combos as you fight to repel the Kaiju incursions!

title: The Other Order
description: A surreal tile-based roguelike where you build and reshape tile combinations to attack your enemies.

title: Legacy of Ashes
description: Dive into a horror adventure where you solve puzzles, explore a mysterious island, battle vicious dinosaurs, and escape terrifying chases—all while uncovering the hidden goals of Nova Corp. Secrets await at every turn.

title: Rise of Chi
description: When Chi finds her eggs are stolen by sneaky snakes, she is forced to leave everything behind. A brave journey that begins with a personal mission and escalates into something far bigger. Guided by unlikely allies and haunted by self-doubt, Chi must face enemies far greater than she imagined.

title: Attack of the Astrals
description: Cosmic warriors invade! Command a champion trio in tight grid battles where every turn is a movement puzzle and every skill and spell is positionally targeted. Adapt your team to each realm's challenges and rewards to thwart the Attack of the Astrals!

title: Shadow of the Moonlight
description: A dark fantasy visual novel set in a medieval world. You are the privileged son of a wealthy family, seeking revenge, even if it means becoming an outlaw. Will you dare to face your weakness and strength? How far will you go to find your true enemy? Uncover your roots' secrets. Survive… if you can.

title: Poolside Vigil
description: Based on a true story. Navigate through ever-changing pools where the path can never be memorized. Solve puzzles with physics-based interactions and survive the entity on your trail. Experience the grim consequences of phone addiction. Can you solve the mystery of that fateful day?

title: Sweep Squad
description: Sweep Squad is a 1-4 player arcade sweep-em-up where you and your ambiguous rodent friends team up to sweep away the bad guys and hit your quotas. Crank up the earnings with overtime and use various sub-weapons at your disposal to sweep away the competition.

title: Campus Confidential
description: An LGBTQ slice of life/supernatural dating sim

title: Martyr
description: Rise as a martyr in a plague-scarred, heretical Europe. Surrounded by disease, paganism, and relentless foes, you will fall, return as a Shade, and forge power from sacrifice. Death is not the end. Every fall strengthens you, every relic will help you, but enemies will hunt you for your faith.

title: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon
description: Help a mighty dragon break a terrible curse in this incremental game. Hire workers, collect resources, construct buildings, unlock upgrades, and become a powerful king.

title: The Beginner Investor
description: Start from scratch, learn the market, and build your fortune in this accessible stock market tycoon game. Buy, sell, and diversify your way to wealth!

title: From Basement with Love
description: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the peak of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher encrypted communications to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, manipulate targets through social engineering, connect the dots, and escape before it's too late.

title: Void Raid
description: A cooperative space horror about raiding derelict ships: breach compartments, grab the loot, and make it back to your own vessel before the oxygen runs out — or before something lurking in the dark gets to you.

title: Ether Void
description: New York, the 90s. Detective Frank Miller investigates a murder in a grim metropolis. Your window to the truth is an old terminal. Analyze data, crack codes, uncover digital trails. Remember: not everyone here wants you to succeed.

title: Tiny Tree Talk
description: Find a new sense of belonging on TinyTreeTalk – a wholesome old-school bonsai forum. Decorate miniature scenes, grow & shape bonsai trees, and bring people's diorama requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props, and embark on a chill and vibey journey across mid-2000s Japan.

title: Game Company Simulator
description: A weary ex‑developer, tired of pay‑to‑win and toxic workplaces, creates a simulation where you play as a game company boss. Recruit staff, push their potential, battle rivals, and aim to dominate the market with blockbuster hits to reach the pinnacle of success.

title: Trapped on the FlipSide
description: In this Puzzle Platformer, follow the narrative of three explorers, kidnapped by a mechanical megastructure. Play as their assistant spherical robot in an effort to save them from this brutal place. By powering up the system, area by area, the secretive past and dark truth may make itself known.

title: Soul Hunter
description: A team of young paranormal researchers ventures into the cursed corners of Japan to prove the existence of the spirit world. Ghosts feed on fear and the sanity of the living, luring you into traps of illusion. Your only defense is a special camera, capable of banishing spirits and unveiling secrets.

title: Tiny House Finds
description: Search inside and around cozy 3D houses, floor by floor, in a relaxing 3D hidden object game full of tiny details.

title: Backroom Cleaners
description: Purge the unknown Backrooms in this 4-player co-op TPS roguelike. Experience endless combat with fresh build combinations every run.

title: Blindfold
description: Blindfold is an asymmetric co-op game: one player is a blindfolded prisoner, the other a guide with a map and bodycam. Work together to escape, avoiding guards, traps, and creatures. Each level adds new hazards and dynamic weather. Communication is key.

title: Your Painting, Sir
description: Recreate paintings using newspaper cutouts — Analyze the painting, search the newspaper for similar elements, carefully cut them out, and place them on their correct position. Will you fool your boss with your arts and crafts?

title: Absolute Cinema
description: Build your movie empire! Create blockbusters by combining 44 topics and 22 genres, hire star actors through auditions, develop your studio and technologies. Crazy random events, references to real stars, and tons of humor. Prove you're the best director!

title: Jigrift
description: Leap and swing around the lost tropical paradise of Jigrift as you assemble the island like a massive jigsaw puzzle.

title: My Little Sister Is an Angel
description: "Hey, wanna try becoming a god?" After saving an angel, introvert Yuki gets pulled into divine training, and the Archangel moves in as his “little sister” to guide him. A warm supernatural romance VN where your choices lead to 4 endings.

title: Insanity Path
description: A plague spreads alongside a spree of sudden disappearances... You don't need more to get on with your adventure. Step into the world of an Auto-battler Roguelite, where each of your mistakes will send you further down the path of Insanity. Will you be able to free the forest from this tragic curse?

title: Abracademia
description: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

title: Nebula Veil
description: Only tiny, fragile shuttle between you and open space. Beyond it, wreckages drift in blood-red fog. The longer you’re alone, the less dead the cosmos around feel. Survival isn’t enough. Seek answers, analyze data, examine anomalies. To unveil fog’s secret, every detail matters.

title: Ashes: Undertow
description:
Ashes Undertow is a semi linear 7 map campaign that tells the story of the nascent scavenger Porcelain as she searches for the mythical Northern Line, a way to bypass the worst of the irradiated ruins of Atlanta. Navigate new faces in a familiar but changed world, and beware: some choices have consequences!

Porcelain has a new set of agility focused movement options and an arsenal that includes 6 new guns including but not limited to: the deadly semi automatic Riot Gun, the stylish .357 Magnum, and the makeshift soda can grenade launching Popgun. Get ready to blast a new set of enemies as well... and potentially a much more serious nemesis who stalks in the shadows.

title: Mr. Grin's Final Act
description:
Thirty years ago, a tragedy silenced the studio.
Now you're back... and so is Mr. Grin.
In this first-person survival horror, scavenge badges, rewire circuits, crack safes.
Stay out of sight. One sound and you die.
He's not hunting you. He's directing you.
His script. Your survival.

title: Curse Chapter: Dawnthief
description: Plunder all the treasure worth taking from the exotic wilderness with your band of rogues. Jump, kick and sling your chain mace to smash and climb your way through any obstacle. Face off against beasts and hopeful heroes that rise up to stop you.

title: Factory Time
description: 2D automation game set in a time loop. Only time anchored factories and knowledge can be carried through multiple loops, until a way to escape time is discovered. Manage factories, production, research and bonuses to reach the end. What will you carry an what will you leave to the mercy of time?

title: Neidfyre
description: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.

title: Nick's Recursive Videogame About Deciphering Word Puzzles to Discover Your Identity and Redefine the Universe!
description: A recursive word game for (mostly) clever people! Use your imagination to define things that define things that define things...in an unpredictable reality where there are NO wrong answers & your mistakes pile up (and up and up)! Playful, lighthearted, and charmingly offbeat.

title: Orium
description: Aboard your ship, exterminate the enemies of profit, exploit planets and expand the corporation’s commercial empire across the stars. Orium is a roguelite infused with streamlined 4X elements.

title: Feast of the Beast: Unleashed
description: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampire clans as you advance towards the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that consumes the world."

title: Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow
description: Voyage across and beneath the salt-stricken seas in this thrilling nautically-themed expansion of Hollow Knight: Silksong, free for all players in 2026!

title: Loco: Rails & Tails
description: Chaotic co-op for 1-4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

title: Pollinate or Die
description: Pollinate or Die is a fast-paced action roguelite set in the hazardous wastelands left behind by humanity. As one of the last surviving bumblebees, you alone can revive Earth's flora. Fight through swarms of enemies as you search for flowers to pollinate and bring life back to the planet.

title: RadCity: a post-apocalyptic adventure
description: Scavenge for food and escape a dead city in a broken, post apocalyptic world. Gather enough food for 40 days and prepare for a train journey to a place of refuge. Featuring a top-down perspective and a finely crafted 3D world.

title: Dungeon Gambler: All In, No Out
description: Hit the jackpot in this gambling-infused dungeon crawler. Pay what you owe. Survive the dungeon. Play your cards close to your chest and defeat Skelly.

title: Beandejo
description: BEANDEJO is an action-packed spin-gun roguelite. Enter the Old West, where the cattle roam, and drunken vegetables terrorize the local saloons. Spin your gun, time your draws, and gun them down to become the toughest sheriff in town!

title: Shibuya Sushi Master
description: Cyberpunk sushi master adventure

title: Dyadem
description: Become the greatest tactician in this love letter to classic handheld SRPGs. It falls to you to forge the bonds of your Prince's followers, develop their skills, and shape their strategies as you fight to reclaim your homeland and save the world.

title: Elevator
description: Embark on a journey through The Elevator. This is not a simple trip to the top. Each stop will open your eyes to the mysteries of the Elevator. What floor will it stop on? What will it show? The Elevator decides your fate now!!! From the makers of Elevator: Source comes Elevator, the sequel.

title: Memoware
description: Memoware! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle videogame.

title: Where Winds Meet: The Imperial Palace
PinKeep
description: PinKeep is a pinball deckbuilding roguelite – use the ball and flippers to collect resources and defeat your enemies! Place buildings from your deck on the playfield to defend your Keep. Create powerful synergies to eradicate the hordes of attacking Knights!

title: Safo and The Moon Warriors
description: In a world where the sun no longer rises, Prince Safo must rescue his sister from Argus, a mysterious one-eyed monster. Joined by diverse companions, this adventure RPG features beautiful illustrations and a novel-like story as players uncover secrets in this sunless world.

title: Astromine
description: Astromine is a co-op survival game about scavenging fully destructible voxel planets. Land on planets and gather enough materials to fight off alien creatures, build structures and spaceships, and conquer the solar system

title: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
description:
Humanity Echo is a tactical turn-based RPG set in the rusted harbour slums of Odesa, 2044.

You play as an Engineer - not a soldier - using sabotage, environmental manipulation, and raw intellect to outsmart a corporate machine. In this high-tech, low-life world, every explosion carries physical weight and every shot leaves a unique acoustic imprint.

title: FireFly
description: A momentum-driven 2D platforming adventure where mastering movement unlocks exploration. Leap, slide, and swing through vibrant open maps as a grounded firefly searching for family and hidden secrets.

title: The Dark Curiosity
description: First-person sci-fi psychological horror set on a secret corporate station. Left alone to secure it, you navigate oppressive corridors where every sound, shadow and choice punishes. "Curiosity always leads you further than fear ever could."

title: Odd Jobs: On The Lot
description: A physics-powered, 1-4 player co-op set in a vibrant Australian carpark. Teammates race to complete a rotating roster of odd jobs avoiding hazards and losing wages. Manage chaos collecting stray trolleys, unloading delivery trucks, cleaning up trash, or delivering groceries directly to car boots.

title: Better Than Us
description: Better Than Us is a sci-fi narrative game about secrets, deception, and what happens when a few people hoard most of the world's wealth. By maintaining a complex web of lies, you'll convince the freakishly ultra-rich you belong among them long enough to take what they treasure most: their stuff.

title: Gap Year
description: Gap Year is a story-focused point & click adventure played through comic book panels that reconfigure as you explore Vera Novak’s one-bedroom apartment. Vera is a bright young scientist, but the arrival of an unexpected guest and a strange fixation with a cosmonaut may derail her academic pursuits.

title: Opona
description: The reality TV show Popworld is a one-way ticket to pop stardom, and Mia and Noah came here to win! Fight your way through turn-based dance battles (and a whole lot of drama) in this hand-drawn idol adventure game.

title: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits
description: Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

title: Console War Giant
description: Console War Giant is a turn-based management game that puts you in charge of a young company producing video game consoles! The year is 1980, and the gaming industry is still in its infancy. A place under the sun is yours to claim!

title: Guardians Planetfall
description: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across space and dangerous planets filled with aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines.

title: Do Crimes!
description: Hey, how'd you find this game?? Do Crimes is an upcoming chaotic competitive co-op extraction game where you and your friends drop onto randomized islands and cause criminal mayhem - then try to escape before you're squashed by the law...or just give each other the finger. Do Crimes! Or Don’t!

title: About Fishing
description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

title: Neath
description: Manipulate the turns of friend and foe alike in this Eldritch roguelike tactical RPG by the makers of Rogue Legacy. Ascend the inverted tower. Kill an indolent god. Control every "moment".

title: Ad Iterum
description: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

title: The Remains
description: The Remains is a multiplayer co-op survival horror game (4 players) where players must make use of stealth to complete objectives and escape enemies and progress through levels to advance their story.

title: Ceaseless
description: Create, Customize, and Command each module on your starship, explore ceaseless space filled with unique environments, and battle endless combinations of enemies in timed, turn-based combat.

title: Pizzapocalypse 2
description: A 3D platformer with a pizza moveset that's accessible & engaging to all skill levels! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the evil corporation ruining Pizza!

title: Pingbert's Snow Ride
description: Slide, soar, and deliver! Join Pingbert, the upbeat penguin mail carrier, in Pingbert’s Snow Ride—a fast-paced, platformer where you'll slide down snowy slopes to deliver mail at high speed!

title: Everhome
description: Become a sky architect in this relaxing, cozy, building and management sim. Meet charming characters and design unique houses just for them! Go shopping for new decorations, renovate their homes and discover the keys to their hearts.

title: The Gas Station: Graveyard Shift
description: Congratulations, You've been hired as the new nightshift employee at silver lake gas station. Can you survive the night?

title: Mooshie's Kitchen: Reheated
description: Mooshie's Kitchen was once a place of fun and joy for decades until it shut down in 2023. Since then, it's been surrounded in rumor and mystery. What could have happened on the day of Mooshie's Kitchen's closure?

title: Shadow Hills Manor
description: Shadow Hills Manor is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and looting. Break into the manor left behind by greed and decay. Search for valuables, but the more you take, the angrier the manor becomes. Your choice of greed shapes how the manor reacts.

title: Boundless Evil: Awakening
description: A first-person horror experience set in a desolate highlands village. Track your missing archaeologist sister, unravel her clues through exploration and puzzles, scavange for loot and face the dark force she accidentally unleashed.

title: Biryado
description: Biryado is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where rules are made to be broken. Collect Billy’s bizarre artefacts, customize your balls with wild abilities and combine their effects into absurd combos. Master shifting tables, overcome eccentric bosses, and send your score into another dimension!

title: Rostov
description: You've been kidnapped and need to escape a serial killer. In this first-person horror game, you're constantly being hunted and never know when he'll find you. Grab anything you find along the way and try to survive.

title: Age After Age
description: Age After Age. Build a thriving settlement, shape society across multiple eras, and dominate a living world economy. Choose your path — classic history, Steampunk, Gothic, and more — in a deep city-building strategy with evolving logistics, citizen classes, diplomacy, and research.

title: Adventures of Caine McDowell: The Porkian Encounter
description: Tap into your space pilot intuition as you explore an alien world, fighting monsters and fleeing from a vicious bounty hunter in this retro, puzzle-based, sci-fi epic!

title: Shy Cats Hidden Tracks Collection
description: A musical hidden object game where you search the streets of 9 CITIES for singing kittens from a choir and money bags to hire and assemble a cat band. As orchestra conductor, you'll be able to configure the musicians as you wish, creating your own music and choir melodies. Find them all!

title: Chrono Seoul
description: Chrono Seoul’s unique Turn Table combat lets you use the hero’s mechanical arm and future-reading ability to predict enemy actions and respond with precise attacks, defense, and evasion. Each run offers new patterns, and at every chapter’s end, an Existence corrupted Seoul awaits.
