title: Jinni 2: The Ritual
description: JINNI 2: The Ritual is an atmospheric, high-tension horror game based on a dark Anatolian mythology tale. Are you ready to face the entity lurking in the depths of the house?

title: The Rusted
description: The world belongs to machines now. Join a loyal robot dog on a journey through a haunting post-apocalyptic world in search of its lost human family. The Rusted is a hand-drawn 2D action-puzzle platformer.

title: Blast Racer
description: "BLAST RACER" is an arcade-style bullet hell game. You’re humanity’s last hope. Drive an upgradable, transformable battle race car. Blaze through deadly tracks, dodge waves of bullets, and save the world in flames!

title: Avemary Rocket: Captain Patchwork
description: Join our brave captain on this action adventure in space! You'll be riding The Patchwork, a less than ideal spaceship, but enough to get away from pursuers. However, you'll be facing malfunctions, fires, enemies attacking... When it rains, it pours.

title: D
description: A new game from Parco Games.

title: The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth
description: A new collaboration by Acacia, the developers of Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban, and G-MODE. Explore dungeons and face a story of sickly sweetness, alt accounts, and a girl band with issues in The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth.

title: Robot Recycler Ryn
description: Build your own custom combat robots, piece by piece! Weld, saw, and shape metal to perfection. Lead your creations into battle as you follow Ryn in Story Mode, or craft freely in Construction Mode.

title: Kindling Hour
description: A brief, atmospheric text adventure of flickering candlelight, forgotten memories, and a quiet search through the dark.

title: Fri: The Unforgettable City
description: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

title: Resequence: The Orchard
description: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.

title: Alea
description:
Alea is a fast-paced hero arena brawler where skill, timing and strategy collide in explosive multiplayer combat. Players choose from a diverse lineup of unique heroes. Each with signature abilities, distinct roles and skills. Battle across dynamic arenas designed to reward creativity and precision.

Matches are intense and fast-flowing, encouraging clutch plays, coordinated team tactics and high-impact duels. Fight for the core objective and increase your damage, health and regeneration.

Whether jumping into quick skirmishes or mastering high-level competitive play, Alea delivers an action-packed experience where adapting on the fly is the key to victory and every fight is a chance to forge your legend.

title: Sublustrum
description: Step into the space between subconscious and reality. Explore strange liminal worlds, solve sound-driven puzzles, and unravel the secrets behind the enigmatic device left by a vanished scientist.

title: Elemency Island
description: Elemency island is a cozy farm coop game. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

title: Amelorn
description: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

title: The Abyss Break
description: Hardcore first-person co-op horror extraction game. Explore the parallel worlds of the Abyss alone or with a team, gather resources, and make life-or-death decisions that will determine your survival.

title: Nia and The Abyss
description: Join Nia on her journey to breathe new life into the ocean depths. Clean the seafloor, plant seeds, and attract unique marine life. Cultivate a thriving ecosystem as you uncover the remnants of humanity lost beneath the waves.

title: Noble Steed
description: A fast, funny 2D platformer where every level throws you into chaotic combat and questionable heroics, all to rescue your runaway horse… again.

title: Flap de Clap
description:
Take on Mount Snoepje by flapping your way up with up to three friends. Be careful not to bonk too much or you might end up at the very bottom again.
Hunt for highscores in the endless runner mode, dodging and defeating various enemies and bosses.

title: Beware of Dog
description: Beware Of Dog is a fast paced Action Adventure game with RPG elements set in eclectic insane world where our heroes grandpa Domkrat and his faithful Dog embark on their journey to buy some meat.

title: Beyblade x Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Metal Coat
Momolitos
description: Explore vibrant zones, collect ingredients, and feed adorable Momolitos to help them evolve into hundreds of unique forms. A cozy creature-collecting adventure that blends exploration, discovery, and the joy of caring for your own lab full of curious life.

title: Vena
description: Roguelike deckbuilder meets hex-tile city builder! Build a resource engine to survive the center’s rising demands. Place producers, converters, and combo-rich tiles. Roll dice to shop, pick perks, and chase wildly different builds every run.

title: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
description: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in Cardaire: Eternal Aces, a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world, hunt down powerful cards, and build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

title: BunnyOps
description: BunnyOps is a tactical PvP shooter where bunnies are the apex herbivore, carrots are scarce, and everything can be destroyed.

title: Vision Quench
description: An online co-op dark fantasy looter shooter set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

title: Paccarat
description: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

title: Strigoi Town
description: Combine your potions and refine your deck to withstand waves of vampires in a Compact Deck-Refiner where every card matters. Draft your starting deck, discover powerful effects by mixing flasks and recruit allies to uncover the dark mystery threatening your home.

title: Brightfall
description: Lived through the Plague, did you? Now try surviving till morning on an island erased from the maps. Gather, build, and fight to keep your light alive in Brightfall - a co-op open world survival-craft roguelite where the darkness wants to swallow you whole.

title: Shardpunk 2
description: The Empire may have fallen, but humanity continues the fight. Shardpunk 2 puts you in command of a human outpost in this potent mix of turn-based tactical strategy, RPG, survival and resource management as you gather your team, scavenge for resources and prepare for a new, evolving threat.

title: Doomed Crew
description: Co-op Horror for 1-4 players. Dive into a brutal corporate environment, complete deadly objectives for your promised freedom. Trust nothing.

title: Athelan Battlegrounds
description: Athelan Battlegrounds is a free-to-play, turn-based tactics game with no meta progression and no pay-to-win. It's a game made for players who thrive in a skill-based competitive environment. A game that promises to be easy to learn but incredibly difficult to master! Build your team of champions and engage in unique matches against players or AI!

title: Imperial Bureaucracy Hero
description: IBH is a rich role playing game at the end of time. You're a mid-level official in a dying sci-fi regime, given the impossible task of fixing a faltering machine; explore a vast world, define your mind, flex your authority, and become a sinner or a savior in countless other stories.

title: Spectral Report
description: Enter abandoned locations as Spectral Reporters to prove the existence of ghosts. But beware: sanity is fragile, and not everything you see is real. Cooperate with your team, investigate the place, take evidences, and finally prove that ghosts are real.

title: Gothic Scythe
description: An high-difficulty action game where you must slip past your enemies attacks and crush them. Take back the city controlled by homunculus with your scythe.

title: Faro
description: Faro is an immersive visual novel set on a sunless planet. Everyone tries their best to survive in these barren lands. Make your choices as you set forth into this unforgiving world.

title: The Last Poem
description:
5 years have passed since then.
The sequel to "Christmas Tina" by the original team.
Here and now. A "Chinese" and a "Japanese" meet once more in a non-romantic encounter. At the end of the century, a journey begins—from the first (her) to the last (her)...

title: Verdge
description: Verdge is a dynamic speedrun plaformer, where the player can decide which content is generated.

title: Scraps of the Machine
description: FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay. Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

title: Triarchy
description: Sail your ship, explore islands, fight monsters, choose your abilities, and craft legendary gear to hunt for deadly bosses. Play Triarchy your way! Activate Boss Challenge Modes or enable Assists to suit your playstyle. Open-world, Co-op, Action Adventure (1-3 Players)

title: Full Steam Undead
description: VR STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE ACTION. Zombies infest Necropolis island and Queen Victoria is not best pleased. Grab your shotgun, ride the rune train and slay the undead. It's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

title: Aberrate Inc.
description: Aberrate inc. is an upcoming 3D box-and-button puzzle game where the fabric of reality bends—and breaks—at your command. Harness the power to ABERRATE, splitting batteries into two coloured copies. Manipulate phased objects to solve puzzles, unlock new areas, and discover the world of Aberrate inc.!

title: The Maze
description: In a pitch dark maze like factory, you must avoid He, secure secret documents, and escape with only a flashlight. If He finds you, He’ll charge from the dark with an axe. Can you survive and escape?

title: Hop & Seek
description: Hop & Seek is a multiplayer egg hunt game set in a game show for Easter bunnies. You can hide eggs, seek eggs and trick your friends.

title: The Diamond Adventures
description: The Diamond Adventures is a multi-genre, single-player adventure game packed with minigames and exploration. DanTDM is taken back through the old eras of his YouTube journey, allying with old friends and facing old foes as he makes his way through the memories into the present day.

title: Andromis
description: Play as two heroes a soldier and a doctor in a third-person action adventure packed with explosions, vehicles, and survival missions. Switch between characters, drive cars and tanks, rescue survivors, and fight deadly robots across 50 story missions in a post-apocalyptic world. Coming in January.

title: Grubkins
description: An autobattling dungeon-crawler! Hatch them from eggs. Equip them with gear. Lead them into battle! It’s up to you to guide these grubkins from helpless runts into skilled adventurers as you plunge into the depths together.

title: Slaughterhouse
description: A 90s style point and click game. Blizzard. Stranded. Eight days. Enemies — kill them all.

title: Trial By Magic
description: There comes a time for every spell caster when they must face the TRIAL BY MAGIC. Those who overcome the challenge are forever known as Wizards, a title carried with pride. Those who fail are branded Wimps, forever shamed. So the question to you, spell caster, is: ARE YOU A WIZARD OR A WIMP?

title: Hoozuki no Yakusai
description: Hoozuki no Yakusai is a compact horror-leaning visual novel set in a rural town haunted by an old superstition linked to the hoozuki (Chinese lantern plant). You follow a protagonist drawn into a string of strange incidents and escalating misfortunes as local secrets, folklore, and interpersonal tensions unravel.

title: Eternity Breaker
description: Build your class, break the cycle. A 2.5D turn-based roguelike where the skills you gain become your class.

title: Retrospect
description: "retrospect" is a novel game consisting of five chapters. Trace the memories of the ghosts and learn about them. That is the only mourning you can do.

title: Dynamite Dashers
description: Throw bombs, upgrade your skills, and survive endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced roguelike action game. Build your explosive arsenal, discover powerful combos, and see how long you can stay alive!

title: Roughly Crafted
description: Roughly Crafted is a craftsman simulator where you slap together monster bits and odd materials into one-of-a-kind weapons. Run your own shop: experiment with designs, bargain with adventurers, and grow your collection of crafting parts. Remember: the right tool can save a hero’s quest!

title: RoboFarm
description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

title: Mega Man: Starburst
description: A new adventure starring Mega Man!

title: No One Leaves the Field
description: A first-person folk horror game set on a cursed farm where the wheat shifts each time you enter. Search for your car keys, uncover the family’s dark ritual, and beware—something ancient walks between the stalks.

title: Error: Ai.lien
description: "ERROR:Ai.lien" is a bishoujo horror adventure where she watches, learns, and slowly invades your everyday life— ordinary routines twist bit by bit, until the AI’s love transforms into madness.

title: Badass Brigade
description: Throw a dude at another dude! Badass Brigade is a light-hearted 2D action game where you shoot, punch, grab, and throw your foes. Take on missions where you can explore the world and uncover a wide variety of weapons and gear for new ways to fight.

title: Dystopia RPG
description: Dystopia RPG is an 8 bit style fantasy RPG where You lost a duel to a government's shaman and ended up trapped and sealed in a Cell Phone application. Explore the Dungeons, Combat monsters, Collect and Trade Items, Glitch the game & break free.

title: Karate Rogue
description: A stance-driven, turn-based combo roguelike—turn defense into offense and fight your way out of the abyss.

title: Dual Fire Walled City
description: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.

title: It's Always Happy at Chubby's
description: Welcome to the night shift at Chubby’s, a 24/7 burger joint in the 90s. It's in the middle of nowhere, so you'll be mostly entirely alone. Just keep the store clean and occasionally serve the drive-thru counter. But whatever you do... always follow the rules.

title: Object Impermanence
description: A first person puzzle game where your vision defines reality, and only the things you can see exist. Learn and master the strange behaviours of objects outside your vision. Traverse the ancient structures of a world forgotten by the universe.

title: Slam City with Scottie Pippen: Respect Edition
Under Heaven or Hell
description:
You wake up in Hell with no memory of how you got there, and no clear way out.

To return home, you will have to survive the brutal politics of this realm and forge alliances with two dangerous devils and an enigmatic angel, each with their own secrets, and temptations that may pull you closer.

Will you escape with your soul intact, or will your path become forever tied to those who linger within the flames?

Your choices will shape your fate, and perhaps, the fate of Hell itself.

title: Dungeon Tourists
description: Explore procedurally generated dungeons with up to 4 players. Take photos of the curiosities you come across. Throw stuff at them, unlock new floors, get rewards, and complete your collection!

title: Descent Of Lunaris
description: Investigate a signal emanating from deep within the moon and fight through a dark reflection of human nature. Are you being tested, or punished for the actions of humanity? Descent of Lunaris is a classic dungeon-crawling turn-based RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

title: Snug
description: Snug is a cozy game about packing bags just the way you like. Stack, sort, and squeeze everyday objects into oddly shaped spaces with physics, jiggling, and the satisfaction of fitting things neatly into place.

title: Watamari Part2: A Fake Marriage?
description: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

title: UvsU: You vs. You
description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days 2 - Card Unlock Vol.6
Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days 2 - Card Unlock Vol.7
Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days 2 - Card Unlock Vol.8
Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Ingrid & Outfit 2 & Outfit 3 (Sagat, C. Viper, Alex, Ingrid)
Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Alex & Outfit 2
Brainshell
description:
Did you ever wonder what it would be like to become an Intercontinental Ballistic Missile?

BRAINSHELL is a psychological horror experience focusing on immersion, storytelling and audiovisual torment.

title: Dumb Ways to Party
description: The worlds dumbest party game is here! Play as your favorite Bean, and go head-to-head with up to three other players to become the Dumbest of the Dumb. Will you use skill, sabotage or sheer dumb luck to win?

title: The Nobody Woods: Lucy
description: The Nobody Woods: Lucy is an adventure game set in Nobody Woods, a place on the border between life and death. Escape from those who want to take Lucy's life, explore the forest, solve puzzles, and meet new friends.

title: Frankenstein's Monster
description: Compete to build the perfect monster. Then unleash it to hunt your rival scientists. - In roguelite single-player, or social hangout multiplayer.

title: Paper.Void
description:
Navigate an infinite monochrome dimension where many mysteries are yet to be discovered. You are merely a paper plane, flying through space as you collect VOID Cubes which further distort the world around you...

The VOID may be infinite, but as you progress further, it becomes increasingly challenging to navigate as you leave behind a permanent deadly trail of light. Your sense of scale, gravity, and depth do not exist here.

When reality reaches its END, can you survive your own self-made labyrinth? Or will your journey lead to an inevitable PAPER CUT...

title: Delta
description: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

title: Lost Patient
description: The game is a surreal horror RPG, containing puzzles and enemy battles, it features a mix between pixel art and 3D low poly art!

title: B.O.D.E.
description: From the creators of Devil's Drizzle, B.O.D.E. is a pixel art metroidvania lite shooter with a satanic theme (and a healthy dose of blasphemy). Use your shotgun to move around and annihilate everything in your path. Destroy hell in search of revenge!

title: Bellochia: Love Powered by Gears
description: Find your first love in the kingdom of Bellochia, use your skills to talk with our 4 main protagonists, invite them to dates and live a school life in a day-by-day gameplay.

title: Goodbye Page
description:
Page visits the house of her absent father, who has completely disappeared out of the blue. The landlord mentions that, oddly enough, his belongings were left in packaged boxes, but he himself could not be found.

However, her arrival at the house suggests that there is something even stranger about her father’s disappearance than she had expected. What could her father have been hiding? And how will all of this affect Page?

title: Pakku Pony
description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

title: Spirit Vendor
description: I built Spirit Vendor as a solo indie dev, and I'm excited to share it with you! In this charming world, you decide how your day unfolds—run your shop, tend your fields, and care for your animals. Explore a lively village, meet unique characters, build friendships, and perhaps even find true love.

title: QiuQiu Town
description: You have come to this new world, where you will start a new life, have many options, run the farm, scale up, and become a great agriculturist. Or run a store and become a business mogul. Or ordinary life every day, if you were given the chance to do it again, what would you choose?

title: Windwoven
description: You inherit forest edge land. Daily, till soil with your hoe grow radishes, rear chicks, bond with oddball neighbors. Spring seeds yield summer gardens; autumn's firelit pumpkins reveal woodland mysteries. Nighttime under trees, fireflies dance like starlit constellations, this is your idyllic life.

title: Polaria
description: Polarium is a relaxing idle game set in the serene world of Antarctica. Discover peaceful marine life, learn about polar ecosystems, and find comfort in nature. Inspired by real research, the game blends healing gameplay with subtle messages on climate and biodiversity.

title: Project Sara
description: A man who has lost his wife and seeks to escape loneliness and grief begins working as a firewatch in a forest. He meets a girl named Sarah and encounters strange occurrences while uncovering deep family secrets. He learns that not every voice is human and not every farewell signifies an end.

title: The Black Bahr
description: The Black Bahr is a sandbox colony simulation RPG blending ocean exploration, crew management, and dynamic faction politics. Freely chart your course as a pirate, merchant, or honorable captain, shaping your destiny across the open seas.

title: Abyss Lord
description: What awaits the young man in the future? A long and happy life next to loved ones? Losses and suffering leading to an inglorious death? The throne of the enemy of humanity? A harem of all sorts of races, from pretty goblins to graceful vampires? The one and only love until death?

title: Plantverk: Perfectly Plantastic Plant Simulator
description: Create your perfect little Greenhouse with fantastic plants, fun decorations and more in this cozy idle game! Throw your harvests around and cause havoc, and then use the vacuum to clean up your mess (for profit of course). Use your well-earned money to buy decorations, unlock new plants and pots.

title: Warp Marked
description: Warp Marked is an incremental space exploration game. Explore a mysterious uncharted dimension, navigate around its dangers, learn its secrets, and return stronger with every launch!

title: Sherpa's Caravan
description: Explore a cozy open world as a sherpa driver in your van! Deliver cargo, cook food, craft gear, and explore mountains, lakes, and hidden trails. Sail in boats and kayaks, dive underwater. Meet old friends and upgrade your van! A camping atmosphere and next-gen graphics.

title: Chain Shotgun
description: Chain Shotgun is a fast paced movement shooter where your only weapon is the multi-barrelled CHAIN SHOTGUN. Two barrels are way too few! With an up-to-infinite amount of barrels, it can shoot anything from sniper rounds, rockets, slime - LEGS? Why not even load it with yourself?

title: Nonetbeat
description: NonetBeat is a TPS action game starring three charming heroines. Each with unique combat styles, they obliterate hordes of monsters with magic! Sandbox stages let you destroy terrain for dynamic battles. Collect magic and unleash dazzling combos in thrilling hack-and-slash action!

title: Ekholux
description: Ekholux is a mind-bending VR experience where language collapses and motion speaks. Solve sound-based puzzles, break through walls, and race on gravity-defying rails. Created by VR visionary Hsin-Chien Huang, it’s full-body storytelling like never before.

title: Cairns
description: Balance. Patience. Perfection. Cairns is the quintessential Stone Stacking game. Experience diverse and atmospheric environments, and master the art of building the freestanding stone towers know as Cairns.

title: Human Planet
description: 500,000 years ago in the Stone Age, explore uncharted lands in search of a settlement. Survive hunger and predators armed with only crude weapons and your wits.

title: Innerwhy
description: You just dissociated from reality. Unfortunately, the imaginary world you've landed in is as disturbed as your mental state. Gather your courage and confront your darkest thoughts in this 8-bit psychological horror RPG.

title: Down Forward
description: A fast-paced roguelike FPS where you survive shifting liminal nightmares and VHS-era horrors.

title: Someone's Inside Me
description: Your teacher Ms. Morbid has trapped you and your classmates on a deadly multiplayer field trip inside a human body! With proximity chat, two teams must scavenge, sabotage, and outwit each other to see who escapes first.

title: RabbitHole Island: Turn-based Vtuber Battles
description: Turn-based battles against powerful vtubers. Free to Play!

title: B-Ricky High School
description: Meet Ricky in this exciting arcade game mixing flipper, brick smashing and fight. Get ready for the challenges of Arcade or Story mode and for the tough ones, settle the score in the double 2-player mode.

title: Cairn: Stone Towers
description: Build balance, one stone at a time. Stack stones into tranquil cairns in this meditative physics-based puzzle game. Explore serene landscapes, master gravity and patience, and create harmony through careful placement. No timers. No stress. Just you and the stones.

title: Zombie Typing
description: Zombie Typing is a tense survival game where every action: moving, looting, reloading, and fighting off the undead, relies on your typing skills. Type fast and stay sharp, because one wrong key could mean the difference between survival and being devoured!

title: GrappleBurger
description: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

title: Secret of Havendor
description: Survive the shadows of your past. Forge your path in a world where blood and targets are currency. Will you cling to your humanity or become the monster they see?

title: Operation Purge
description: Operation Purge is a story-driven sci-fi survival game set on Titan, Saturn’s mysterious moon. Explore the terrain, manage limited resources, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the surface. Will you survive long enough to find the truth?

title: Soulscape 2: Fragments of the Present
description: Soulscape 2 is a Turn-based RPG set in the dystopian near future. Featuring an isometric exploration, party-based combat, and a branching dialogue that is shaped by your choices in the game.

title: One With the Unicycleverse
description: A precision platformer where you maneuver and weave your unicycle through hundreds of dastardly obstacles across dozens of levels and side modes. Upon mastering the controls; the game becomes a meditative experience and you will discover what it means to be ‘One with the Unicycleverse.’

title: Spider Hotel
description: Run, hide, survive in SPIDER HOTEL—an asymmetrical 1v4 chase. Hunt as the wall-crawling Spider or cooperate as the Insects to rescue allies and escape. Traps & abilities decide who gets cocooned.

title: Project Obscure
description: Solve the physics-based puzzles in a steampunk atmosphere "Enlighten" dark mysteries of an old facility. Delve into a unique experience and KEEP YOUR LIGHT ON.

title: Gladiators of Roma Revixit
description: Gladiators of Roma Revixit is a unique, story-driven roguelike, set in world in which, after the nuclear fallout, a new Rome and thus a new colosseum rises from the radioactive-ashes. Rise the ranks, enjoy the celebrity of being a Gladiator, and make decisions that impact the story.

title: PooPig
description: Shoot, dodge, and chase your acorns in this absurd, cartoon-style Bullethell filled with humor and visual gags.

title: Runic Tower
description: Stand as the last guardian of the god-bound Runic Tower in a groundbreaking 3rd-person roguelike tower defense experience. Command evolving powers, confront relentless invading factions, and utilize strategic planning to overcome your foes!

title: No Exit
description: No Exit is a small chapter based indie horror game. You'll have to face challenging enemies, and perhaps make some allies, as you try to escape the crooked dimension you're trapped in.

title: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
description: A traditional yet wildly unique 1990s-style Point & Click adventure. Journey through a realm of rich fantasy—and, er... the midlands—as you fumble your way toward saving both worlds from almost-certain doom! Make choices, solve puzzles and enjoy a hilarious final chapter to the Brownie universe!

title: The Man Who Walked
description: The Man Who Walked invites you to solve relaxing puzzles by switching between two worlds: in 2D you rearrange the environment, in 3D you explore it. Only by combining both perspectives will you uncover the end of the story.

title: Neighborhood Video
description: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and scouring shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

title: Citrus Summer
description: 以都市职场生活为背景的百合视觉小说， 作为在大城市游戏行业996的独身社畜， 想要改变却无能为力的吴依， 偶然间得到了一次改变命运的机会……

title: Ashen Vow
description: You are a knight sworn to God’s word, wielding only a sword against the darkness. But not all believers walk in good faith. The Black Maw has sunk its claws into the misguided, twisting their devotion into madness. Explore a once familiar castle now warped by evil, and cut down the corrupted horde

title: Brass Rain
description: Fight iconic battles of World War II in Brass Rain. Choose your side and take part in crew-based combats as infantry, tank crews, bomber gunners, or naval teams. Support your Brothers and shape the course of history.

title: Decay of Worlds
description: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.

title: My Eerie Lair
description: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

title: Lóng Shén de Xīnniáng Wàizhuàn: Yù Líng Qǐ Tán
description: A Japanese-style fantasy x fairy-tale narrative adventure ADV, telling the story of an unnamed god and a wandering miko…

title: Metro Rivals: New York
description: Reputation is paramount; strategy is key, and all-out speed can make or break everything. Welcome to Metro Rivals—a genre-defying subway simcade game where you battle Track Titans in solo play or clash with friends in fierce PvP.

title: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
description: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

title: Motion Wulin
description: "Motion Wulin" is a fast-paced martial arts action game where you play as a time-traveling warrior fixing broken timelines.

title: BunkerZ
description: Stylized WWI trenches meet explosive co-op mayhem. Hold the bunker as a Rifleman, Medic, Engineer, or Machine Gunner. Fight back with era specific WWI weapons, shovels, and flamethrowers, then launch undead sky-high with grenades and explosives. Solo or multiplayer survival at its most chaotic.

title: The House Dreams Along With Them
description:
A first person horror puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity. Solve cryptic puzzles with logic and careful observation while dreaming in different rooms of a mysterious house in the woods. Completing a dream-puzzle makes the dream real in the house.

The game is inspired by Myst, Blue Prince, The Witness, The House of Leaves, Twin Peaks Season 3, liminal space games such as Pools and Limscape, anomaly horror games such as The Exit 8 and Cabin Factory as well the metafictional rabbit holes of games such as Fez, Braid, Tunic, and Animal Well.

title: Face Interrogation
description: Become the detective. Try and outsmart the killer by picking the right way forward. It's up to you to figure out clues, takes notes, then use your Command Computer to unlock and confirm core behaviors in the subject. Once you understand him, you may solve the case. Or you might just end the world.

title: Joyful Masks
description: Step into the subconscious mind of a brilliant professor, where memories twist, logic bends, and hidden truths await discovery through intricate puzzles

title: Malleus Maleficarum
description: A Metroidvania inspired by the mechanics and style of classic games in the genre. Help Mirabel find different ways to explore a haunted mansion and hunt terrifying witches while gaining new weapons and discovering more about the macabre experiments carried out by demonic beings.

title: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive
description: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads. Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

title: Gingerbread Holiday
description: Learn to love a broken Holiday through romance. Build a gingerbread house as you form your new home.

title: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
description: Follow the exploits of five fugitives as they fight their way through the horrors that lurk under Duskraven Manor. With the promises of a clean slate, wealth and freedom from the pasts that haunt them, they fight through unimaginable terror while uncovering a reality-shattering mystery.

title: Re:Curse
description: A time-travel mystery visual novel about found-family, connections, and hope in dark times.

title: Cosmic Composer
description: Casual puzzle game on a cosmic scale. Build stars, planets and other cosmic objects. Evolve your cosmos using abilities of the stars from stellar winds to supernova.

title: Silence of Elven Mage Rin
description: A puzzle game featuring a beautiful elven sorceress.

title: Through Hell and Back
description: Through Hell and Back is a timeline based roguelike deckbuilding game. Place your spells on the Timeline to outsmart your enemies. Choose your power ups carefully, trade spells and upgrade the Timeline to unleash devastating combos.

title: Potat
description: Potat is a quirky, physics-based 3D adventure where you play as a sentient potato trying to escape a house before you get cooked alive. Roll, flip, and flop your way through a bizarre home filled with deadly traps, chaotic layouts, and unexpected obstacles.

title: Installation 19
description: Alex Carter, part of The Abducted UFO group, acts on a tip about nighttime sightings. Unknowingly, he wanders into a top-secret military base, triggering a suspenseful journey.

title: Jump Frog
description: A determined frog leaps ever higher, risking its life in a perilous climb where every slip could send it tumbling back to the start. driven by the call to find the perfect mate. Will this frog have what it takes?

title: Reng Azure Requiem
description: Face the soul guardians in your quest for the 7 master keys in this pixel art Action RPG. Evolve your abilities and rely on the help of your protector raven to explore and fulfill this purpose in the grim world of Tartarius.

title: Divine Tactics
description: Lead your team of divine allies to victory in this roguelike autobattler. Position your units, unleash their unique powers, and outsmart rivals in this asynchronous multiplayer competition.

title: Broken Sword: The Smoking Mirror - Reforged
description: The award winning adventure returns with 4K visuals and remastered audio. A mysterious escapade of intrigue and deceit, in which journalist Nico Collard and her adventuring companion George Stobbart must overcome powerful forces from fulfilling their evil ambitions

title: Office Party
description: Take your escapades into the Office and other new locations in this long awaited sequel to House Party! You've made it through the interview process and you're starting a new job. Make a good impression and get promoted. Make the wrong choices and get demoted. Work your way up the corporate ladder in this hysterical, story-rich 3D adventure game with a lot of new surprises and upgrades from the traditional House Party game play.

title: Channel 51
description: A first-person psychological horror thriller. Explore glitched channels, solve puzzles with your remote, and uncover clues about your missing son. Retro sitcoms, post-apocalyptic landscapes, and haunted mansions draw you into a tense, immersive narrative.

title: Bellum
description: Bellum is the next evolution of platoon-scale tactical shooters, built in Unreal Engine 5 and shaped by die-hard fans who demanded more from the genre. Set in a fractured Africa of the 2030s, players are thrust into counter-insurgency campaigns where global powers engage in proxy wars across dense jungles, open savannas, and broken urban sprawl. Our unique limited-life system captures the tension of immersive milsim operations while keeping every match accessible, focused, and intense.

title: Duck Norris Tales
description: Duck Norris Tales is a run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Play as a brave duck saving the world from an alien invasion. Make friends, discover secrets, wield face melting weapons and most of all shoot first and ask questions later.

title: Slingbox
description: Slingbox is a minimalist, physics-based 2D platformer where precision and momentum are everything. Master your dash and rope mechanics to swing, launch and race through clean abstract levels. Beat the clock, earn medals and chase perfection.

title: Trickshotterz
description: SCORE IN THE TOP OF THE CUP. Pick abilities, grab wild powerups, and pull off absurd trickshots that hit harder the crazier they are. Play with up to 4 players locally, online, or hop into public matchmaking.

title: Cyte
description: Blaze your path as CYTE, a being created to guard the flow of time, as you dash and slam your way through a mysterious enemy’s mechanical army in this first person 3d action game. Fight through a unique science fiction world in the perfect blend of intense combat and lightning-fast movement.

title: Icy Tower
description: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

title: The Everything Building
description: Press up and down, elevator goes brrr! Deliver customers to the correct floor and max your score. Serve many customers including but not limited to surfers, astronauts, cars, ghosts, cheerleaders, horses, and cheerleader horses. 1-2 players! 50 different floors! HORSE MODE included!

title: Erebus-9
description: Erebus-9 is an immersive first-person psychological horror. Explore the derelict space station, solve puzzles, and run from the horrors that reside onboard. As you descend deeper into the station, uncover its dark secrets and the tragedy that unfolded.

title: Kingdom of Foundry
description: Kingdom of Foundry is a pixel-style tower defense meat pigeon game. In the game, you will play as the king of a city-state, and ensure the safety and stability of the city-state by dealing with different events in each battle and recruiting different types of soldiers to repel waves of demons.

title: Now Hiring
description: Now Hiring is a top-down narrative adventure where you play a job seeker trapped in a scam syndicate. Across 21 days, your choices in dialogue battles and moral dilemmas will shape your fate, reveal human struggles, and lead to multiple endings.

title: The Bold Bogey
description: The Bold Bogey is a 3D golf adventure that combines open exploration with satisfying platforming. Explore a vast world filled with dungeons to dive into, bosses to fight, and new ways to upgrade your ball in a golf game unlike any other. Do you have what it takes to become the Boldest Bogey?

title: Odds Chronicles
description: A tactical roguelite RPG where every roll matters. Fight on a strategic grid, shape your hero’s path through dice-driven choices, and uncover a story-rich world inspired by tabletop adventures.

title: Daibadestructor
description: Become a minion of a nefarious corporation and jump into the sea from Odaiba to destroy an underwater base in this easy-to-play retro-style FPS.

title: Hardkill System
description: Take control of a powerful mech, scavenge for different weapons and upgrades, and complete missions to help the last humans recover from the AI apocalypse in this top-down real-time tactical action-roguelite.

title: Curse of the Abyss
description: Curse of the Abyss is a Traditional Roguelike with a twist. Manage your resources and explore the abyss and slay the various Guardians of the Abyss and remove the curses.

title: They Come in Fives
description:
A story-rich collectible card game with a dark, horror-tinged atmosphere, set in a world where urban legends turn into devilish contracts.

Play as the Reaper on Lucifer’s payroll. Hand over souls, keep bodies, and build an army to overthrow the boss. Unravel urban legends and fight the hidden world government.

title: Parasite Mutant
description: Parasite Mutant is a science-fiction horror RPG set in the distant future. Psionic agent Nova was sent on a mission to an abandoned and secluded island city filled with horrifying creatures, not knowing that what happened on the island will completely change her fate.

title: House Flipper 2: Pets
description: House Flipper 2 is getting rowdy! With dozens of pets to choose from, you can now adopt your new best friend. Let them accompany you during the pet-centered jobs or relax by petting them with your friends in the Co-op!

title: Cursed Memory
description: A psychological dark fantasy visual novel with turn-based combat. Unravel the mystery of a curse that erases memories and transforms people into demons.

title: The Name of the Night
description: We were completely different, but back then we were both obsessed with the same thing in the same place... “The Name of the Night” is a text-based adventure game that explores the arcade music game culture of 2000 through the story of two girls' delicate emotions.

title: Demondemon Demon Tamer
description: Demondemon Demon Tamer combines swarm-survivor and monster raising. Manage, take care, and train your demons during the day. Survive the swarm of attacking demons at night. Raise your reputation among three factions of demon tamers, and unravel their hidden motives in this doomed city, Laknakarta.

title: Advent Arena
description: A PvP card-game/tower-defense hybrid.

title: Infinite Bloom
description: Embody beings from vast cosmos to tiny plankton, and even your mind in Infinite Bloom! Use your hands to flap or swim. Power, identity, and scale become fluid. Faced with the vastness of the world, human is only a drop in the ocean, part of a continuum of life far greater than us.

title: Lootbane
description: Lootbane is a roguelite RPG about risk, reward, and loot-fueled power. Explore changing regions, build synergistic warbands, push deeper into dungeons for legendary treasure, and lose it all to your insatiable greed

title: Petit Planet
description: Petit Planet is HoYoverse's brand-new cosmic life sim that's free-to-play and cross-platform. Here, you can build your home, live alongside fuzzy neighbors, and discover the infinite possibilities of life on this planet!

title: The Darkness Delivers
description: A haunting horror story set in an isolated abbey. Jeanne, a naïve young nun, struggles to save her lover, the angelic Sister Séraphine, from a wasting disease which has ravaged their home - but what is Jeanne prepared to sacrifice for Séraphine's sake?

title: Thesis of Love
description: During the endless summer in Chishima, you join a graduate program hoping to become worthy of your crush. Little do you know what awaits... In this otome dating sim, experience campus life with three lab members trapped in toxic relationships. Your choices may lead them to new paths.

title: Despa
description: DESPA is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter built for after-work warriors with more bills than free hours. Neon kill-boxes, railguns, and carbon katanas meet a five-second respawn loop, so every death flips into revenge before your coffee cools.

title: External
description: RPG extraction-shooter in a post-apocalyptic setting. Survive in the ruins of the old world, loot gear, level up skills, improve your equipment and shelter. Fight various factions, or complete missions to become their ally.

title: Aerocube
description: AEROCUBE is a Ski-Fi Roguelike + First-Person Boomer Shooter in a huge mysterious cube that always rotates randomly. Each room of AEROCUBE is different, but one thing stays the same: something’s always behind you, ready to kill.

title: Hoptale
description: 《Hoptale》 is a casual and strategic Rougelite game that combines slot machines with combat. Players will use the slot machine to determine the character's next behavior, the damage caused to monsters, and the loot obtained!

title: Still Stars Echo
description: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

title: Rite of the Dealer
description: Rite of the Dealer is a roguelike multi-deckbuilder where you guide charming rat companions through a peculiar, otherworldly hotel.

title: Manaftory
description: Collect resources, build machines, and automate everything. Explore magical lands, face hostile creatures, and turn their loot into part of your factory system. This is your Manaftory — a magical factory powered by mana.

title: Short Short Fictions
description: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

title: I Saw a Flying Saucer
description: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

title: Surface Labyrinth Kurumabu
description: Neo-2D Action Puzzle Game !

title: Captain Corgi: Planetary Problem Solver
description: Mr Wolf is up to no good and Lil Red might be in trouble! It's up to Captain Corgi to investigate and figure out what's really going on.

title: Trick Eight
description: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?

title: Over the Radio
description: Local co-op game about flying a plane. One player is the pilot, the other the navigator. The pilot has no map. The navigator guides the pilot using only words. Work together to reach your goal in a remixable national park map.

title: The Dowsing
description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

title: Cozy Forest
description: Restore a sleepy forest with adorable animals. Explore, craft, and decorate a cottage-core haven at your own rhythm—no timers, no hassle. Progress continues while you’re away!

title: In Harness
description: IN HARNESS is an online co-op 3D jumping game for 1–10 players. With simple move and jump controls, pets team up to clear tough stages and reunite with a girl in heaven, bringing the warm “Helper’s High” of saving friends.

title: Spark! Photon Blast
description: "SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-" is a sports action game where players face off in a futuristic stadium, rendered with stunningly beautiful photorealistic graphics. Your goal is to score by launching a sphere into your opponent's goal. Enjoy the heart-pounding, high-octane action where every second counts!

title: Delivery Issues
description: Delivery Issues is a side-scrolling package-throwing time-attack action-platformer that tests your package delivery skills against a zany world of characters and events that just happen to make an easy job... difficult.

title: IPS 13: All Signals Lost
description: Take command of the massive VOD(Vehicle of Destruction) and journey across planet Gaiganthra with your IPS(Inter-Planetary Squad)-13 crew to uncover the mystery of humans there. Be prepared for the worse and ready to fight. Upgrade your VOD, hire new crew factions, to be the ultimate War Machine.

title: Cat Girl Survivor 2: Beyond the Veil
description: Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls. Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses. An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!

title: Imitation
description: A choice-driven adventure where you play as a young girl in a world where immortality is the norm. In this world, immortal humans are referred to as "Players." Your choices affect Stress and Affinity. Through multiple playthroughs, get closer to the hidden truths and endings.

title: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
description: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action is a top-down bump combat action game where you control Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies!

title: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith
description: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith is a medieval forge management sim. Craft unique weapons, satisfy demanding customers, or take risky deals for profit. Rebuild a crumbling forge with two struggling blacksmiths.

title: Cutting Edge: Roots of Mutation
description: Perform life-saving operations in this fast-paced surgery sim. As lizard surgeon Dr. Peri Maddock, you'll treat injuries, excise tumors, and hack corporate organs with speedy, surgical precision. The patient's life is in your claws!

title: Arkheron
description: In this fast-paced, dynamic PvP game from Bonfire Studios, teams of three battle to ascend a mysterious Tower built from fragments of their life before. Here, items are the heroes - each one imbued with powerful abilities that shape how you fight, adapt, and outplay other teams. Build your strategy and identity on the fly by looting and combining items in real time, creating unique builds throughout every match. What you choose to carry defines not only what you can do, but who you can become.

title: The Midnight Barber
description: A narrative ASMR adventure about a supernatural barbershop in late 70s Barcelona. Trim and style your supernatural clientele, gain their trust, and uncover their darkest secrets.

title: Crimson Rest
description: Fight relentless hordes of bloodthirsty monsters and choose which room lies beyond the next door in this retro-style dungeon crawler, where death is not an option. But tread carefully, do not awaken Count Dracula, or his curse will be unleashed upon you.

title: Underground Security Inc
description: Defend your dungeon against "heroes" in this rogue-lite base defense game. Assign minions, build traps, and mine ores. All in the name of becoming the most profitable dungeon!

title: Anima Shin Gun
description: A Bullet Hell Rail Shooter where you get shot to survive. Engage enemies and absorb their bullets as “seconds of life” by switching to the right color frequency. Thus, surviving long enough to break the time loop you’re trapped in and complete the ENTIRE adventure before the countdown gets to zero.

title: Eggspedition
description: Enter the Eggspedition - a terrifying survival horror with dinosaurs! Play solo or team up with up to 4 players to explore unknown planets, abandoned facilities, complete missions, and make daring extractions. It’s inhabited by… dinosaurs. Furious, massive, and very much alive.

title: Devoid
description: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

title: The Hearth and Harbour
description: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

title: The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
description: A dark fantasy style pixel ARPG. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

title: After Hell Freezes Over
description: Venture into the desolate frozen wasteland in this open-world survival horror. Struggle to survive in the cold, where strange creatures roam in the darkness. Build a shelter, collect supplies, fend off unimaginable threats, and fight for survival After Hell Freezes Over.

title: TrailRail
description: Your path taken is the key. "TrailRail" is a physics-based action puzzle game where the trajectory of your movement becomes a tangible object. Control the girl and aim to escape from the mysterious research facility.

title: Night Shift: 1999
description: Balance work, vampirism and socialising as you explore Kings Cross, Sydney during the last year of the millennium. Keep a lid on your darkest desires and be rewarded with a deeper understanding of what it means to live again. Or don’t — no one will stop you. You’re a vampire, after all.

title: Inspektor
description: Play as the INSPEKTOR, sent to crush a violent uprising on a dark, industrial planet. Blast through rebels and machines in a savage mix of 90s-style shooter action, neon-soaked sci-fi, and nonstop blood-soaked carnage. Retro pixels, brutal combat, zero remorse.

title: Piano at 5 am Encore
description: The paid, complete version of Piano at 5 a.m.. It includes additional episodes that depict the characters' pasts and narrated voiceover.

title: Fractured Library
description: A cozy 2D pixel art adventure where you explore magical worlds, solve whimsical puzzles, and collect crystal fragments to restore a misbehaving library: no combat, just curious discoveries and a dash of chaos.

title: Red Moon Kingdom
description: When a group of outcasts is sent to retrieve a wondrous artifact, a fatal mistake brings chaos upon the world. Explore, solve puzzles and card battle your way through a unique medieval fantasy setting full of magic with 3 controllable characters and in stunning 4K hand-drawn visuals.

title: Barista Dream
description: Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee. Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.

title: Full Moon Guildhouse Simulator
description:
Full Moon Guildhouse Simulator is a cozy cooking game where you serve drinks to our loyal guild members! You might even run into some familiar Vtubers!

Man our drinks bar and learn the ins and outs of each station. Each station has different equipment and drinks to master.

Our state of the art coffee station offers espressos, lattes, and americanos!

We have a wide selection of tea and boba combinations at our boba station!

Make something healthy with fruits and vegetables (or not) at our smoothie station!

title: Trip Movie /Mosaic: Shounen Alice Satsujin Jiken
No Tithe for Olaf
description: A grimly humorous single-player tower defense roguelite set in 17th-century Norway. Defend your farm from the King’s tax collectors, build bizarre towers, and lead a farmer’s uprising as a goat-riding rebel! Upgrade your farm, manage resources, and weaponize onions in escalating rural chaos.

title: Blackwood's Dilemma
description: Step into detective Brian Storm’s shoes and unravel a grim 17th-century mystery. Interrogate villagers, gather clues, and piece together the evidence in a deduction system where every secret matters.

title: Taisho Romance Theater
description: This is a dark and diverse romance visual novel set in 1920s Taishō-era Japan, where amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma is pulled into long-buried secrets after a friend's mysterious death. As he becomes entangled in magic, conspiracy, and haunting blood ties, his search leads him toward a darker truth.

title: Intersecta
description: In a nutshell, Intersecta is an intense and intuitive tactical top-down shooter with a distinct arcade feel. It blends fast, twitch-based gameplay with the intelligent use of tactics. The game has a unique audio-visual style, utilising the power of Unreal Engine 5 for a stunning 2.5D experience.

title: Cinema Manager Simulator
description: Manage and expand your own cinema. Upgrade equipment, customize interiors, schedule movies, set ticket prices, hire staff, and handle repairs to create the ultimate movie-watching experience!

title: Crossover Clover
description: Second project of novamicus

title: A Kingdom of Soil
description: A Kingdom of Soil is a pixel-art RPG set on a contested medieval frontier. Farm, hunt, and forge to survive; manage your tavern and sway allies; plot in shadows or confront rivals in the open. Every choice shapes the legend you leave behind.

title: The Grand Planto Heists
description: The neighborhood will never be the same! Play as a raccoon obsessed with the front gardens of The Grand Planto Heights in this 3D digging adventure, dodging Animal Control with your woodland critter friends and stealing whatever you can scamper away with in your paws & jaws!

title: Spaceships and Cellular Automata
description: Spaceships and Cellular Automata is a tower defense game set in space! Place different towers to defend your ship against the waves of aliens. The enemies are simulated based on Conway's Game of Life. Even just one of your bullets is enough to cause a destabilizing chain reaction to destroy them!

title: Meritaton
description: A 2D adventure story about the daughter of a pharaoh who tries to change her predetermined destiny in the dark and mysterious Ancient Egypt.

title: Versalis
description: A fast-paced, grid-based, card-flipping tactical CCG for up to 4 players! Archetypes and team Dynamics bring powerful abilities to move, defend, swap, or reorient cards. Capture the board and flip your way to victory!

title: Tiny Shop
description: Leave the hustle and bustle behind and bring your dream of a cozy little shop to life! Create, decorate, and watch visitors fall in love. Let your imagination run wild and craft a beautiful, inviting space they'll want to return to again and again.

title: Roguebound Pirates
description: Loot, upgrade & dominate! In this action roguelike, your inventory IS your ship. Combine weapons to become absurdly powerful, search for epic treasures, and claim your place as a pirate legend!

title: As We Unite
description: As We Unite is a political strategy simulation game where you play as a high-ranking Consul of a secretive cult aiming to unite the world before an impending global calamity. Instead of controlling a country, you manage agents across different nations, each run has a crisis you have to resolve!

title: War of Banners
description: War of Banners is a sandbox turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval open world. Recruit companions, lead your army, and claim victory across brutal battlefields. From a wandering mercenary band to an empire-ruling sovereign — your fate is shaped by strategy and choice.

title: Dosmic
description: In a world consumed by darkness, a boy embarks on a perilous journey to rescue a lost girl. Navigate through cosmic horrors and unravel ancient mysteries in this cinematic puzzle-adventure. Experience a hauntingly beautiful tale of despair and hope.​

title: Quest & Rest: Inn Simulator
description: Run a cozy fantasy inn where adventurers rest, restock, and head off to glory. Assign quests, serve buff-granting ales, sell magical gear, and manage your guests—then watch their stories unfold from the comfort of your inn.

title: Cards of the Abyss
description: Cards of the Abyss is a movement based roguelike deckbuilder between Slay the Spire and Dofus. Move on a grid, dodge enemy attacks, and unleash explosive card combos to explore the Abyss and uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.

title: Rotten Survivor
description: Rotten Survivor is the ULTIMATE 2D top-down horde survivor game! Fight massive hordes of bizarre enemies! Upgrade your equipment, create crazy combinations between all of the different weapons and modifiers and become an unstoppable force!

title: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
description: Jump, dash, and brawl your way through beautifully animated 2D platforming levels, then shift perspectives into dynamic top-down 3D street zones to gather rare ingredients in chaotic, GTA2 - style street battles! Every fight feeds your menu. Every level is a recipe for madness.

title: Hollow Stories: Lockdown
description: A neo-retro survival horror noir game where you explore, solve puzzles, and fight to survive in a city ruled by corruption and cults.

title: Plinkidle
description: Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

title: The Next Stop
description:
The Next Stop is a narrative adventure about a murder full of contradictions, where the clues don't add up and everything hides something darker. It blends point & click mechanics with the depth of a visual novel, all set in a haunting subway filled with secrets.

Eight people are on board. Eight stories. Eight hidden truths. Each stop on the train reveals a new chapter. Each carriage is a different experience. Every decision you make has consequences.

title: Turning Manor
description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to unravel the mysteries of Turning Manor.

title: Jacob's Ladder
description: Jacob’s Ladder is a haunting first-person puzzler where YOU are the solution. Swap bodies and stack puzzle pieces to please The Maker. Question the nature of the soul and earn your humanity - before it’s too late.

title: Antenna Dilemma
description: Antenna Dilemma is a witty point-and-click adventure game in which you follow C432632, a finicky grey cube that loves watching TV and Alfred, a sphere who discovers a new world where, surprisingly, cookies don't exist.

title: Children of the Spring
description: Embark on a quest to find your missing family in a world slowly being consumed by disaster. Explore the unknown, fight dangerous enemies in real time, utilizing variety of unique equipment to your advantage. Upgrade your ship and face the dangers of a boundless ocean.

title: Project Kepler: Delivery Included!
description: Project Kepler: Delivery Included! is a roguelike base-defense game where players control a lone cyborg stranded on a hostile planet. The objective is to survive waves of evolving alien creatures while managing resources, constructing automated defenses, and deploying drones for combat and support. Key features include procedurally generated runs, upgradeable drones and turrets, automation systems, daily randomized upgrades, and an ultimate fail-safe: an orbital strike to eradicate the planet.

title: Obitus
description: Obitus is a multiplayer survival game where players are thrown into a deadly wilderness. Scavenge for weapons, avoid traps, and eliminate your opponents – only one will survive. Inspired by Hunger Games, it combines strategy, tension, and life-or-death combat.

title: Verismo
description: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic tragedy set in 1920s Sicily.

title: Agecraft
description: Agecraft is a historical strategy and city-building game where players guide a civilization from the Stone Age to the space age. The game combines settlement building, resource management, and technological progression. Players construct cities, manage the economy, provide for their people, and expand across different eras, unlocking new buildings, production chains, and methods of transportation as history advances.

title: Eggson
description: After being captured by EGG CORP for failing to comply with them, it’s now your mission to escape their facility. Run, jump, and fight your way out in this fast-paced 3D platformer heavily inspired by KARLSON

title: Shadows of the Deepforge
description: An assassin weaving through ruin, striking fast and vanishing faster. The halls test your cunning, the darkness tests your nerve. Torchlight betrays, silence protects, and every shadow is both a hiding place and a threat.

title: Wildekin
description: Wildekin is a 3D pixel-art adventure where up to 4 friends can build, explore, survive and thrive—or at least try to before some creature tries to turn you into a light snack!

title: Farmageddon
description: In this Action Roguelike, defend your farm from waves of enemies attacking with live vegetables. Dodge, catch, and use their own projectiles against them to survive. Uncover the conspiracy driving their revenge—a secret they don't even know themselves.

title: Frozen Feathers
description: Frozen Feathers is a charming multiplayer game where cute penguins engage in fun snowball battles, scoring points in frosty PvP encounters.

title: Soup-of-War
description: You are a clumsy one-armed pirate cook desperately trying to prepare meals for your crew by grabbing, cutting, and throwing ingredients into pots while your ship heaves violently on stormy seas, turning every simple cooking task into a chaotic physics-based struggle against time and your own limitations.

title: Couch Planes
description: Couch Planes is a fast-paced airborne party game where the craftiest pilot wins. Dodge missiles, grab power-ups, and race through hazard-filled maps in various game modes in chaotic local or online matches. Easy to learn, wild to master, always a blast.

title: BPM: Bitcrushed
description: BPM Bitcrushed: A retro roguelite where every shot, dodge, and jump must sync to the beat. Battle through dungeons where enemies attack in time with the music. Find epic loot and even import your own songs to create a custom, rhythm-fuelled soundtrack for your destruction!

title: Project ReMind
description: "Welcome to the end. My end" Manipulate machinery, open secret passages and bypass computers to remember your life, from your first discovery to your own death bed. In this first-person narrative puzzle game investigate a mysterious presence looking for the answer that haunted you since THAT day.

title: Magical Girl: Taboo Village
description: The girls awaken in a mysterious village cursed by flowers. Every night at 8 PM, one girl is chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged. Unravel the village’s tangled mysteries and sever the ritual’s endless cycle. A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel from Acacia.

title: Can't Even See the Sky
description: Your character is a man with a troubled past who finds himself trapped in a city on the brink of civil war. Look for ways to get out of the city and make peace with the past. Will you pull yourself together or drown in the abyss of despair?

title: Infinite Soul
description: Infinite Soul is a breath of fresh air for competitive fighters. Every battle will test your skill, cunning, and resolve. Attack and defend with Water, Earth, Fire, and Air; choose wisely because each one has a strength and a weakness.

title: Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök
description: Battle the End of the World in this Norse horde-survivor roguelite. Unleash godlike powers, collect powerful runes, and build insane combos. Survive endless waves, crush epic bosses, and fight to save Asgard from the Hordes of Ragnarök.

title: Late Amusement
description: Were they all just accidents, or were they? Late Amusement is a first-person survival horror from a small indie studio. You play as young student Liam Snow and survive for as long as you can to uncover the secrets of the theme park.

title: Grindworm
description: A short horror game where you're buried alive in a collapsed underground mine, and your only hope for survival is an old mining machine. Workplace safety rules no longer apply. Just remember: Don't. Stop. Digging.

title: Omicrox
description: Omicrox takes Ultimate Tic Tac Toe and adds powerful one-use ability cards for unlimited strategic possibilities. Earn abilities as you play, like swapping boards, blocking moves, or stealing cards, and use them to outsmart friends or AI in this battle of tactics.

title: Forge the Fates
description: This roguelike deckbuilder transforms your classic hand of cards into a grid of runes. Play a rune and the ones behind it shift forward, so every move shapes what’s next. Build a unique deck, trigger match-3 combos, and outplay your enemies.

title: Breadieval
description: Create unique baked goods by combining ingredients you find at the market. Befriend the puppet villagers by baking their favourite recipes or by combining tasty flavours. Have fun, you don't have to follow a recipe here.

title: The Sword Game
description: The Sword Game is a semi-fast paced retro styled 3D platformer, made to mimic shareware games of early 2000's. Your mission is to get the lowest time possible on all levels. You can cheat, find shortcuts, you have all the freedom in the world.

title: Wonderfall
description: A third-person adventure game in a dystopian 1920s Paris consumed by Entropy. As buildings crumble into sand, Léon, a young orphan with the ability to manipulate this sand embark on a quest for truth and confront the remains of a city collapsing beneath his feet.

title: Clerks & Quirks
description: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Win them over ♡♡♡ to unlock powerful bonuses while you craft items, serve demanding customers, and scramble through the weekly rush in this co-op roguelite, where every shift put you under pressure.

title: Bloodseed: The Last Helsing
description: Bloodseed is a game that combines two very distinct but terribly addictive genres; card combat and survival.

title: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
description: Your judgment, Inquisitor Medieval Spain. You serve as an Inquisitor in the shadow of the dreaded Tomás de Torquemada. Cast out demons from the possessed. Burn heretics. Spare the innocent — or condemn them. Every wrong choice will bring you closer to the wrath of the Church… or the fury of the mob.

title: Crimson System: VɅΔ Protocol
description: A dark retro-FPS born from a solo AI-creation experiment. Blast your way through a vampire-ruled station, slay twisted enemies, and uncover the secrets of the VɅΔ Protocol

title: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
description: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

title: Chumaky
description: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

title: DDoD
description: DDoD is a single-player and co-op tactical roguelite shooter set in the near future, deep inside an abandoned industrial zone. Explore, fight, and mutate your way to the source of a semi-sentient biological AI anomaly.

title: Rot Together
description: A first-person co-op horror game for up to four players set in a medieval world. Explore a procedurally generated map and fight a mysterious cult. Brew potions, kill monsters, chat with your friends. Survival is not guaranteed!

title: Aerosurge
description: Perform daring aerial stunts, destroy your enemies and weave through hazardous environments to complete fast-paced missions. Upgrade and customize your jet to handle any situation and show off your piloting skills in this fast-paced arcade flying game.

title: Live Fire Exercise
description: Inspired by classic training missions from your favourite FPS games, Live Fire Exercise is a time trial arcade shooter that challenges you to complete rounds as fast and accurately as possible.

title: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
description: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

title: After Work
description: After Work is a short, atmospheric first-person exploration game. The workday is over and it's time to head home. But a familiar way out begins to lead somewhere unfamiliar, gradually taking you further from the ordinary.

title: Frob
description: The happy life of a whimsical little frog called Frob was turned upside down when his tadpoles were tadnapped by a heron. Now it's his quest to collect them all in this silly 3D platformer!

title: Bring Me Home
description: A small point and click game about helping a dog to get back home.

title: Diceville
description: Build your city, roll the dice, and outplay your rivals in Diceville — a card-based strategy game inspired by tabletop classics. Trigger building effects, upgrade your HQ, and race to victory in a game of luck, planning, and clever combos.

title: Survive: The Alien Tracing
description: A survival game where you uncover the mystery of the alien civilization "The Fallen of Elun". Navigate a dark world, solve complex puzzles, face hostile creatures, and use many weapons to survive while searching for the truth behind your missing son.

title: Papa Needs a Headshot
description: Papa Needs a Headshot is a brutal western-steampunk FPS soaked in kin blood. Rip through flesh and bend the battlefield with your cursed metal arm. Use every bullet wisely to slaughter freaks and abominations on your warpath. Keep enduring only to put a bullet in the skull of the man who made you.

title: Mark My Words
description: The word-building roguelike. 'Mark My Words' is an addictive deckbuilder where you assemble high-scoring words, discover fancy Stickers, and utilize Glyphs to unleash intriguing combinations. Master the Art of Wordplay in several different Game modes!

title: My Bookshop Dreams
description: A cozy bookshop management sim where you run, customize, and expand your dream bookstore. Restock shelves, host author events, play mini-games, and collect literary works as you grow your reputation across cities—and maybe even planets.

title: Pikmon Flower White
description: A rom hack of pokemon fire red set in the world of Pikmin. Catch over 170 unique creatures, fight familiar characters from across the Pikmin series, and uncover the mysteries of PNF-404 in this fan-made sequel to all 4 mainline Pikmin games.

title: DOBA: Dogs Battle Arena
description: All urban packs of dogs need an alpha, and when it comes to rule over parks, dogs have their own ways! Splat pee all around to claim territory or knock your rivals using your crafted set of the craziest skills ever found in a battle arena.

title: HyperTyper 2000
description: Type, dodge, parry, and survive in HyperTyper 2000! A hybrid typing/bullet hell game where both halves of the action are nonstop! Test your typing skills with one hand and dodge with the other.

title: Warfactory
description: Warfactory fuses planet-scale automation with real-time strategy and lite 4X elements. Build sprawling factories, design modular robot armies, and lead thousands of units into battle. Conquer a galaxy with a supply chain — one conveyor belt at a time.

title: Coffee Shop "Keyhole"
description: This is a mystery adventure game where you run a coffee shop and explore the mysteries of this coffee shop and this town! This coffee shop has some secrets Main character quit his job as a locksmith and rented a property last month to run a coffee shop. But this property seems to have a history...

title: Bher
description: Delve dungeons, craft items and build relationships as you work to recover your memory. Bher is a town under siege, and you are an amnesiac with nothing to your name. Search dark woods and caves for resources and craft powerful weapons to delve into infested mines, forgotten swamps, and worse.

title: Frostliner
description: The moon shattered. The world froze. Take command of a nomadic train city hurtling through a war-ravaged frozen wasteland. In this survival city builder on rails, gather survivors, scavenge resources, and do whatever it takes to keep the engine running and stay ahead of the frost.

title: Starfinder: Afterlight
description:
The first party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well — save the galaxy while you're at it!

In Starfinder: Afterlight, you will assemble a crew of misfits from across the Pact Worlds and become the legends in this single player party-based RPG: find unique companions scattered across the stars, each with their personal stories and dilemmas.
