Create your own Bloodhound character, choosing from 10 iconic Vampire lineages with a set of signature lineage power skill trees.

Lineage powers include physical prowess enhancements, shapeshifting, controlling the minds of mortals, and acts of eldritch sorcery.

Fuel Vampire powers by preying upon mortals via stealth, seduction, or brute force.

Elude Mortal Law Enforcement and Monster Hunters, masking your dark nature.

Solve the mysteries of gothic New Orleans by taking quests, discovering clues, and exploring the supernatural underworld.

Battle, evade, or outwit, natural and supernatural foes, using your powers, weapons, and tactics.

Side with a Nightborn faction, the ruling Establishment, the reckless Libertines, or the fanatical Orthodoxy; or eschew them all to forge your own path.

title: Tower Deckfense
description: Tower Deckfense is an exciting blend of tower defense and deck building. Build your deck strategically, upgrade your towers, and equip them with powerful modifiers to discover the best combinations and devastate your enemies.

title: Near the Sun: Chapter 1
description: God's punishment burns the earth to ashes, and eventually consumes the underground world as well. A stylish 2D stealth action game where how you explore determines your fate. A boy carries his sister on his back and races through the underground world.

title: The Lightkeeper is Gone
description: A retro-styled horror adventure set in the 1930's on a lone island. Take on the job of keeping the lighthouse while discovering the story of those that came before.

title: Biofactory
description: Build your living factory using organs and fleshy biomachines. Combine your pulsating machines to automate and scale up production. Mine, harvest, produce and assemble weird materials in a grimdark biopunk setting. No enemies or pressure, the hive mind has only one instinct: The factory must grow.

title: Sangra
description: Classic survival horror with a modern feel. Solve puzzles, search for items, manage your inventory, and pray you'll return to the safe room alive in this decaying twisted facility consumed by a mysterious metallic corruption.

title: Melt Away
description: People end up forgetting about the dead.

title: Gretel's Honesty
description: A comic-like visual novel, expressing a new story based on the fairy tale “Hansel and Gretel”.

title: Liminal Point
description: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

title: Baba Yaga
description: A turn-based roguelike game of strategic combat and sinister magic. Decimate the king’s loyalist forces, grow your powers, and discover the reimagined origin story of Baba Yaga, the most feared witch of Slavic folklore!

title: Pico Drift
description: Explore the city as your ultimate drifting arena. Dodge traffic, outsmart the cops, and challenge your friends. Experience official campaign tracks and game modes, or create your own playgrounds. This is your world - drive it your way

title: Zaleste
description: Shmup collaboration between Compile Heart and M2.

title: Dragon Realms
description: Be the dragon! Customise, upgrade, and dominate a vast fantasy world. Destroy castles, battle foes, gather treasure, and rule Dragon Realms!

title: Three Verses3
description: THREE VERSES is a first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

title: CitaDrill
description: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

title: Bugboy
description: Catch, train and battle creepy crawlies and uncover the secrets of Spider Town in this retro Gameboy-style RPG.

title: Null Path
description: Your skill, patience, and ingenuity will be tested in this homage to precision platformers and metroidvanias! Traverse various biomes, from caves to volcanic wastelands and mysterious towers. Each environment with it's own deadly traps, puzzles, and challenges designed to push you to your limits.

title: Re:Ver Project - Tokyo
description: Co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

title: The Dropouts
description: Heist your own school to get the exams' answers and discover why so many students have disappeared in Noirmont High. Spooky and nostalgic.

title: Project TurboBlast
description: Drift, boost, and spin around corners at BLASTING SPEEDS in this stylish Singleplayer + Multiplayer Arcade Racing game, Blending the familiar drifting of Kart racers and tight responsive handling of classic Anti-Gravity racing games. With a focus on being easy to pick up but difficult to master.

title: The Gambit Lost to Time
description: Become a time-travelling advisor seeking to shape this world towards her ideal future. Choose between one of four kingdoms to support, with the realization that today's friend is an enemy in another timeline. Bring out your best Gambits and lead your troops to victory!

title: Nightmare Circus
description: Nightmare Circus is an action-adventure game where the player takes on the role of a Puppeteer trapped in the Nightmare Realm. Set out on a journey to find his friends and escape the nightmare!

title: Catfall
description: A lone astronaut cat survives a spaceship crash and now embarks on a journey to find the crew: his feline friends and his dearest human.

title: Elflock
description: Elflock is a single-player third-person adventure. You are a princess returning to your home on the brink of war and it's up to you to navigate the machinations of the nobles surrounding the king. Engage in intricate dialogues and uncover mysteries in this branching fantasy tale!

title: Bat Galaxy
description: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.

title: Froggo's Adventure: Drifting Sky
description: A 2D side-scrolling platformer with cute and dreamlike aesthetics. The ever growing colossal tree known as "the witch's hand" is growing out of control. Froggo sets foot on a journey to investigate the tree in hopes of finding a solution to save his home.

title: Star Life
description:
Sandbox "Zero To Hero" RPG in futuristic setting. Game features deep economic gameplay with realistic economy and full freedom for a player.

While on a planet, range of opportunities is wide, from being employed practically at any building (should there be a vacancy) to owning any non-government building, influencing economy directly. Entire planet economy is based on real buildings present in the game and therefore player can shape it to his liking (if player is rich enough). Player can also choose to be anyone - from local business owner, to criminal or politician (or as it might often be - all at once). Skill development is only possible if player performs tasks which require those skills.

Player can travel from planet to planet and own or rent any spaceship, mining, pirating or simply trading goods between planets. While game has no quests & restrictions, there is a main story present which implies that player need to achieve certain results and actions to meet win condition, which does not stop player from continuing game thereafter.

Choose any path or all at once. Model employee, Business owner, Politician, Merchant, Pirate, Criminal, or just explore game as it feels.

title: Dream Bar Simulator
description: Become the Owner of Your Own Dream Bar! Create unique cocktails. Manage bar resources, buy alcohol and consumables. Expand and customize your bar, buy furniture and interior items, create the most comfortable atmosphere for your clients. Hire unique employees.Reach the top of the bar industry.

title: Unearther
description: Journey into different places and environments in search of resources and valuables. Make tools and equipments, survive the dangers and lurking monsters. Craft your way of living and discover the unknown world hidden in plain sight.

title: Work In Progress
description:
It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout...
Here is your gun, your contract.
Now go fire some people.

title: Already Dead
description: Classic 90's style survival horror, reimagined for VR.

title: Golf With Your Friends 2
description: Tee off in Golf With Your Friends 2! Dive into 12-player chaos, wild new course mechanics, a revamped level editor, and nonstop fun—play together no matter how and where your friends play!

title: The Patient: Can You Escape?
description: The Patient is a tense first-person escape game set in an atmospheric 1930s German sanatorium with subtle horror Elements. Explore the mysterious location, solve cunning puzzles, and hide from the doctor using a refined stealth system, while uncovering the disturbing truth about yourself and this eerie place.

title: Deprision
description: Deprision is a psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying AAA experience. Survive human madness, amnesia's power, and navigate parallel worlds via a deadly virus. Solve your world's problem, survive, prevent more deaths, and escape before it's too late.

title: Ask Gear Re:Boost
description: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

title: Iseikan Renai Guide: Interplanetary Love Guide
description: This PC game is a love simulation game set in the distant future where interstellar travel has become commonplace. Slavery, crime, violence... Interact with unique aliens and form close relationships with them in a world where anything is possible, where high technology and low technology coexist.

title: Snake in the Dark
description: Sure, you've played Snake. But could you play it blind? Snake in the Dark is a total re-imagination of the timeless arcade and puzzle game classics like Snake and Sokoban. Fun gameplay you know delivered with more puzzling twisssts than you expect!

title: Flexible Frosty
description: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

title: Feltopia
description: In this hand-felted, stop-motion "cute-em-up," the realms of Feltopia have been infected by a mysterious Smog Spirit. Skyrider flies on their pegasus through wondrous landscapes to save their magical sheep, transform creatures, and battle bosses on their quest to uncover Feltopia’s secrets.

title: Cosmorons
description: A mix of gravity-defying gameplay, slapstick-tinged parody, and a classic low-poly-inspired aesthetic all wrapped up in an addictive arcade shooter for 1-4 players!

title: Pinbleton Park
description: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

title: Pararecords
description: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

title: Steampunk Shinobi
description: Steampunk Shinobi is a roguelite action game set in a Steampunk/Medieval Japan-inspired world. Play as a lineage of Shinobi, where each death passes the quest to the next generation. Procedurally generated maps evolve with your actions, making every playthrough unique!

title: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
description: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.

title: A Tiny Wander
description: Buu must deliver a package through a deep forest. Despite many attempts to challenge the forest, he has not succeeded. Chat with passersby, explore, and take breaks at campsites, while searching for a way to get through the forest. Let's go on a small nighttime adventure with Buu!

title: Karting of Banban
description: Grip your steering wheel and join your favorite Banban characters in the race of a lifetime! Drift around tight corners and zoom through locations both old and new. Use power-ups and boosts to dodge your opponents and claim first place!

title: Pebbles Quest
description: The Princess has been kidnapped by evildoers! It is now Pebbles Quest to breach the Castle, face a gauntlet of traps and trials, all to rescue his one true love.

title: Chi Project
description: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel that combines a turn-based combat system with murder investigation elements.

title: Expedition: Into Darkness
description: Expedition: Into Darkness is a medieval third-person cooperative dungeon crawler and extraction looter. Assemble weapons, customize gear, and join forces with up to four other allies. Survive the ruins—or lose everything you carr

title: Scorched Warfare
description: This is a strategy action game set in a fictional fantasy world. You play as a warmaster, commanding troops in battles. Use the roguelike system to customize your gameplay style: will you be a one-man army, standing against thousands, or a mastermind tactician controlling the battlefield?

title: HitTube
description: Top-Down arcade where you're a vlogger — Travel around the world, make streams of how you destroy everything around and play dozens of minigames!

title: Nox Mortalis
description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

title: Haunted by Femboy
description: In this choice-based NSFW visual novel after inheriting a strange house from your parents, you stumble upon an ancient book and accidentally summon a mischievous femboy ghost. Now bound to your home, the ghost becomes your roommate, and it's up to you to find the missing pages of the book while navigating your unusual new life together.

title: Rottenroots
description: Rottenroots is a branching narrative role-playing game set in a dystopian world where conformity means survival. Guide Salem through moral dilemmas, time-pressured choices, and dynamic character interactions. Your decisions shape his personality, relationships, and fate in this gripping story.

title: Void Dungeon
description: Void Dungeon brings you a 2D Action RPG with intense hack & slash combat, deep character options, and unyielding enemies, which you can face solo or with up to 4 friends. Oh, and quirky costumes. Because it’s better to look good when the void consumes you.

title: Don't Wake the Beast
description: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

title: Manipulus
description:
Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times.

As a Manipuli general, form strategic defensive lines and manoeuvre your followers to activate wild abilities to defeat the oncoming monsters and lead your band to safety. Re-play your cards, re-live your actions, and fight to keep your refugees alive in this dark and captivating adventure.

It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

title: Nonolith
description: Discover the countless secrets of the NONOLITH. Copy and paste blocks to reach new areas, and master hidden mechanics that let you do the seemingly impossible. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

title: Animal Use Protocol
description: In this first-person, narrative-focused survival horror, you play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee. Hunted at every turn, your only chance of survival lies in scavenging, crafting, and exploring Anchorage Station. An epic story awaits. Be quick and quiet. Time is running out...

title: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
description: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

title: Wild Haven
description: Wild Haven is a nature ecosystem builder. You will build the forest and create a thriving ecosystem. Clean up polluted land, strategically place wildlife together, discover more complex plants and animals and rebuild the ecosystem your way!

title: Owl Force
description: Lead the legendary Owl Force and your wingmates on an epic journey defending the galaxy against the nefarious Darktail Order. Take on missions, upgrade your ship, and engage in heart-pounding battles to uncover the hidden secrets of the universe.

title: Alex's Journey to the Grave
description: Alex's Journey to the Grave is a visual novel about a boy trapped by fate and a girl in dire need of a friend. Help guide them through some of the hardest decisions of their lives as they experience warmth, connection, tragedy, the inevitability of death... and the antics of a mysterious black cat.

title: Problem Solver Club
description: Solve school problems, face problematic girls

title: Looppip
description: Looppip is a magical seed that carries an ancient hourglass with the power to turn back time. Your mission is to save the bee hives, essential for the survival of life on Earth, and reverse the environmental collapse threatening nature.

title: Killer Chat: Extended Edition
description: Killer Chat is a dark satire romance chatsim where you date serial killers. Pretend to be a serial killer, get inspiration for your book, fall in love, and try not to call the cops through a whirlwind six months with your murderous beau of choice. Who knows? You might find your happily ever after... or headline the news as a gruesomely lovesick corpse. It's honestly up to you.

title: Ten Ten
description: Ten Ten is a unique game that combines shooting, puzzles, and bullet-dodging.

title: Hark the Ghoul
description: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! Hark the Ghoul offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

title: Stratagem Lost
description: Brave perilous turn-based strategy encounters and uncover dark conspiracies in a broken world. Draft your team of unique characters and have them learn skills from each other.

title: Entwine
description: ENTWINE is a terrifying first-person narrative psychological horror game. Explore horrifically detailed environments in a hand-crafted story-driven campaign as you uncover the story of Lucas Hale. Run. Hide. But try not to scream, it might hear you.

title: Nerd: Tracing Dayline
description: An adventure game created with the concept of "a game for a single song."

title: Akaku Forest
description: Akaku Forest is a game that blends puzzles, platforming, and thrilling boss battles in a Metroidvania-style format. You take control of Aki-Maku, a courageous forest spirit. Use your torch to solve puzzles or face off against your enemies. Save the forest!

title: Spook-A-Boo
description: Spook-A-Boo is a ghost-hunting couch co-op game for up to four players. Team up with friends and family to locate and capture sneaky ghosts hiding in plain sight.

title: Depth Loop
description: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

title: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

title: ArcheAge Chronicles
description: Explore Auroria, a vast and vibrant world brimming with rich lore and thrilling action. ArcheAge Chronicles delivers an immersive experience that will capture players' hearts, whether they are newcomers to the setting or seasoned adventurers.

title: Inazuma Eleven Re
description: The story that started Inazuma Eleven will be revived in a remake!

title: Dragon's Brew
description: Dragon's Brew is a board game cafe simulator! Serve customers while fulfilling takeaway orders and delivery requests and build up your reputation in the vibrant seaside town of Pebblebrook. Source and grow your own ingredients, craft a variety of seasonal recipes, and expand your board game collection. Discover and unlock 100+ board games, each with its own effects and bonuses. Pair them with specific menu items to trigger unique effects and create powerful synergies that enhance your cafe’s operations and profits.

title: Agni: Village of Calamity
description: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

title: Aetherian Chronicles
description: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

title: Cain & Iddo: Break Week
description:
Cain the dog and Iddo the hyena are two plucky 24-year-olds navigating life alone in the East Coast American metropolis of Westside City. Their zany misadventures don't turn out exactly as planned, wacky unforeseen circumstances arise, and hijinx ensues...

Cain works as a barista at the local mall's Starbuzz franchisee. Due to requirements from higher Starbuzz management, his boss Sergio has to give Cain a week off work for the summer. Cain and Iddo have decided to get some bucket list activities done over this week-long break... but you can probably guess that finishing that list is not going to be as simple as it seems.

title: Match In Peace
description: In this terrifying, genre-busting strategy game, find and match monster pairs to unleash their terror on your enemies. Battle in PvP, conquer the Tower and Roguelike modes and find alchemy components to craft new powerful monsters. Can you keep your calm under pressure and Match In Peace?

title: Shadows of the Werewolf
description: Shadows of the Werewolf is a cinematic, third-person action-adventure game that places players in a suspenseful, horror-filled world. The story unfolds across various locations, including a suburban home and a mysterious forest retreat, where an innocent couple faces a relentless werewolf and other monstrous creatures. Players will engage in tense exploration, object interaction, and combat, using stealth and strategy to hide, fight, and escape from supernatural threats. The game blends elements of classic horror films and survival horror games, offering a narrative-driven, single-player experience filled with fear, suspense, and the challenge of survival under the full moon.

title: Psycho Dead
description: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

title: Galactic Economy
description: Can you become a leader in the Galactic Economy? Buy spaceships and spacestations on you way to get some additional income. Roll the dice and see what you can achieve in this board game.

title: CrisisX
description: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and build your own territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world.

title: Barkour
description: Step into the paws of a brave, four-legged special agent! In BARKOUR, you work for a secret organization where all agents are exceptionally skilled animals brought together by one goal: to save the world from the forces of evil (and mischievous cats)!

title: Umblight
description: Umblight is an Inscryption-like card game adventure where you're trapped in a dark, machine-filled room that changes as you go. Build your deck of shadow and light cards, make new cards by combining them and play mind-bending synergies as you try to defeat your dungeon master!

title: Gaming Raiding
description: Third-person shooter games

title: Dashoot: Abya's Adventure
description: Shoot to move in a hardcore precision platformer. As ABYA, a robot from ruins, use your floating cannon to trigger mechanisms, flip platforms, and launch through a post-human world guided by AI Deus. Every shot counts; one mistake resets. Uncover the truth.

title: Trifoil
description: Trifoil is a minimalist, cerebral line drawing puzzle game, that explores how lines can interact with themselves. It has multiple puzzle mechanics, secrets to discover and mysteries to solve.

title: Wire Throne
description: Blast your way out of captivity, upgrade your ride, and unleash devastating firepower to take down the Wire Throne! One life, one car in this roguelite top-down looter shooter!

title: Airsoft Range
description: Play against AI in free play mode with difficulties ranging a walk in the park to fighting a literal aimbot or get lost in the immersive campaign going from a no one to a superstar. All in VR

title: Mini Worlds
description: Mini Worlds is a cozy building game about creating tiny cities on a small world.

title: Noblemen: 1941
description: Set in an alternate reality World War II, Noblemen: 1941 mixes strategy, tactical decision-making, and 3rd person combat. Gameplay is a blend of realistic combat mechanics, historic influence, and fictional elements such as melee combat, heavy armor, mechs, battle suits, vampires, and more.

title: Chemist Wanted
description: Chemist Wanted is a crafting game with a difference! In this lab simulator, you use practical chemistry to make compounds and sell them. Set up your equipment, run the experiments and create your products. But be careful who you cut deals with - you might get more than you bargained for!

title: Footsy
description: Footsy is a chaotic multiplayer soccer party game set inside grandma's house! Smash furniture, shatter bottles, and tumble TVs as you compete in wild, goal-scoring action. Customize your characters, challenge your friends, and embrace the crazy destruction in every room!

title: Dungeon Baller
description: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball, where every bounce is a battle.

title: Gravitee Wars
description: Battle across the galaxy in this turn-based space artillery game. Use the gravity of destructible planets to launch your shots at the enemy until only one team remains.Unlock new gear for your team members in the single player campaign and online multiplayer modes.

title: Dawn of Defense
description: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

title: Dungeons & Furries
description: ✨What's more alluring than the charm of fantasy worlds? Answer: the same, but with sex. The more sex and magic, the better. Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!✨

title: Effective Immediately
description: All intergalactic travel passes through the orbital relay checkpoint. Verify ID discrepancies, repair vehicle systems and struggle against ethical dilemmas as you negotiate a shifting political landscape. Report for duty, effective immediately.

title: Iso-Core
description: Farm, craft, build, and explore a Beautiful isometric pixel art world. Explore new places and find new biomes to expand your list of items, buildings, and recipes.

title: Star Child
description: Star Child is an explosive new action-adventure set on a sinister alien planet. Fight numerous aliens and formidable bosses, wield powerful explosives and destructive laser weapons, find secrets and unlock new abilities as you progress. Can you survive your dangerous mission?

title: Shop Crush
description: Run a mysterious thrift shop in a story-rich Visual Novel. Meet eccentric customers, uncover hidden illusions, and unveil the sinister secret of your shop.

title: Tempus Triad
description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

title: Guns are Funs
description:
Guns are Funs is an arcade game that combines elements of a shooter, runner, and tower destruction. Immerse yourself in the world of toy soldiers who wage fierce battles for power and influence in the room. Bright dynamic battles, unique missions, and a variety of game modes await you.

The story campaign is divided into chapters, each offering distinct missions that challenge your skills across different aspects of the game. And if you're looking for some non-stop fun without the narrative, dive into the sandbox mode — where you can explore all game elements and compete for the highest score.

Assemble your army of toys, crush your enemies' towers, and prove that even the smallest soldiers can become the greatest heroes!

title: Cosminers
description: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

title: Fruit of Choice
description: Casual arcade game. Stay on the move and survive for a long time. Dash to dodge, attack, and explode bombs!

title: Blightwreck
description: Stuck at the bottom of the sea floor, escape a sunken ocean liner in this handcrafted 2D Metroidvania! Find powerful upgrades, and fight strange bosses. You may be isolated from your shipmates, but you're not alone...

title: Brutalist
description: Brutalist is a third-person meditative game where you need to follow paths, find passages, solve riddles, watch out for radiation and monitor oxygen levels. And all this is surrounded by an atmospheric abandoned concrete world.

title: Polyaris
description: Polyaris is a single-player, first-person survival skiing game set in a post-nuclear, procedurally generated Arctic world. Survive the cold, ski through icy wastelands, find essential resources, fight enemies, and uncover the mystery of why you are the last one alive.

title: To Kill a God
description: An immersive action roguelite experience with a groundbreaking skill system that allows you to craft your own skill tree. unlock the true potential of your character, delivering an ever-evolving experience.

title: Mizuki and the Crimson Moon
description: Journey through a yokai-filled Japan in this 2D Action Platformer! Control Mizuki, a carefree and playful kitsune, as she investigates evil events happening around her village. Use her signature ability of teleportation to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies in this unique platformer adventure.

title: Sigils of Nightfall
description: Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines dungeon crawling with elements of the award-winning RPG, Mörk Borg. Embark on a dark journey, improve your character, and survive at all costs — or be consumed by the horrors lurking in the darkness.

title: Heart Dungeon
description: Heart Dungeon is a roguelite action game with visual novel elements that follows a boy called Leo who gets inside a video game that manifests elements of the psyche of whoever enters it. He will use this dimension to fight the illness that afflicts his mother and understand what is going on in his own heart.

title: Sloppy Forgeries
description: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced, two-player local multiplayer painting game. Each player is given a mouse, a blank canvas, and a few simple paint tools. Each round, a famous painting from art history is revealed. Players race to copy the painting as quickly and accurately as possible.

title: Backrooms
description: Explore an abandoned liminal space. Uncover dark secrets through eerie exploration and environmental storytelling. Evade unpredictable supernatural entities and face psychological horror. Will you reveal the truth or become another lost soul?

title: Five Laps at Freddy's
description:
Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring you favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

Select one of 12 of your favorite animatronic #FNaF characters and race on sixteen tracks set across 4 cups! Each track is based on your favorite locations from Five Nights at Freddy's lore, including Fazbear Hills, Midnight Motorist and more!

title: Whiskers Wonderland
description: Whiskers Wonderland: a game where your pops sent you to find something that was lost in a restaurant, but be warned, Mr Whiskers doesn't like trespassers and you unfortunately are one, so he's after you... You do remember another robot named Dr Mouser. Ready to find what happend to him?

title: Free Stars: Children of Infinity
description: Experience a stellar space adventure and the sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters. Travel through hyperspace, engage in fast-paced combat, discover weird worlds, and meet a unique cast of truly alien aliens as you uncover a mystery that threatens the galaxy.

title: Skylark 64
description: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

title: Gummy Nightmares
description: Step into the enigmatic world of Gummy Nightmares as a little boy who wakes up in a mysterious amusement park with no memory. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover lost memories while evading sinister plushie robots. Use weapons, set traps, and find hideouts to survive and reveal the truth

title: Path for the Seeker
description: Path For The Seeker is a detective adventure in which a young nun investigates the disappearance of a famous inventor in a city on the border of two worlds.

title: Curilemu
description: Curilemu is an adventure-horror game inspired by the myths and legends of Chilean Patagonia. Immerse yourself in a haunting world filled with Lovecraftian horrors and ancient mysteries. Fight colossal beasts and discover what is behind the plague to heal this island and restore the cosmic balance.

title: Petal Runner
description: Hop on your bike and join Cali & Kira as they explore the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and train to become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a wholesome slice-of-life story about growing up and letting go.

title: Junxions
description: Build a traffic intersection nobody has ever seen before. Use your wits to manage lanes, rails, crossings, traffic lights, and rights of way. Test it with advanced AI adapting to the rules of the road you decide on. Become a traffic engineer with the most comprehensive road tools in a game to date.

title: 1 AM Moscow Time
description: A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.

title: Playable Alpha
description: Surviving a post-catastrophic event, your mission is to survive. In this VR First Person Looter Shooter, you will get weapons, gear, upgrade it and have fun blasting them aliens to shreds.

title: Bleakwood
description: Bleakwood desecrates the foundation of chess in this roguelike deckbuilder. Enter a sinister fantasy world where corruption is key to success. Grow stronger with each run by unlocking cards, improving units, and making sacrifices, ultimately conquering your enemies. But remember, absolute power corrupts absolutely. Will you defile your morals to reclaim what is yours?

title: Potion Punch Rivals
description: Potion Punch Rivals puts your shopkeeping, potion punching skills to the test. Race against your rival to see who can take orders first, prep fastest, and serve best.

title: Stop The F
description:
Stop The F is a first-person puzzle. Use a camera capable of capturing objects from reality into subspace and bringing them back.
Use various filters that enhance the camera's performance.

The project aims to recreate and reimagine F-stop, a canceled prequel to Valve’s Portal. While Stop The F draws direct inspiration from it, it is ultimately an original creation by an indie team, crafted with its own vision and identity.

title: Cozy Dungeons
description: Explore deadly dungeons, clear them out of enemies and renovate them in Cozy Dungeons, a one-of-a-kind adventure/interior design game!

title: Malvinas: La Ultima Carta
description: The last survivor of a battalion (a teenage soldier) must protect the last letter of his fallen comrades. Undergo the hunger, cold and violence the Argentinean soldiers had to endure during the war on the islands.

title: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
description: Cute 2D Point-n-Click of the adorable comic book characters Jordi and Oslo the dragon.

title: HyperFatal
description: AIR STRAFE, ROCKET JUMP, and SURF your way through dimensions in this HYPER-intensive skill-based movement shooter of old. The onslaught of foes in your way are invading worlds, and the only way to stop them is to show you will be FATAL.

title: Dangerous Connections
description: As a crisis brews in the Soviet Union, all of your skills as special agent Dan Morris are in demand. Explore the dark machinations of your opponents in a gripping story with exciting and unforgettable characters and use weapons and vehicles typical of the time, as well as a series of spy gadgets.

title: Contract Cafe
description: As Riko Feen, you manage a quaint café teetering on the edge of closure. But when a surprising letter arrives, everything shifts—now you must adopt Niya, a girl with a mysterious past. Amidst your efforts to rescue the café and navigate peculiar customers, secrets about the shop begin to surface...

title: Earthborne
description: Explore, fight, craft and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

title: Kai
description: KAI is a game of Exploration and Adventure between the sidereal space and underwater depths. Skillfully lure and guide groups of fish to solve puzzles, access new areas and uncover the truth behind the mission entrusted to you, Akira, and the other crew members aboard the ship.

title: Ultra Mushroom
description: Hey! Wanna rise to the top at a festival stall? "Ultra Mushroom" is a high-energy game where you run a mushroom stall at a three-day festival and see how much you can earn. Gather mushrooms in the mountains by day and sell them at night. The key? Rhythmic banter and Ultra Mushrooms that bring joy!

title: Revelation of Decay
description: Zombies have taken over our homes! Pick up guns, organize a brave team, and fuck up those monsters! Farm land, scavenge a large apocalyptic world, and fight various of zombies! Modify your weapons, defeat scaring bosses, and finally uncover the truth behind the zombie outbreak and save our home!

title: Skyblivion
description:
Skyblivion is the ultimate fan-made experience for the Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, bringing the game into the newer engine of the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. This process combines Oblivion’s impressive award-winning open-world that is renowned for its incredible gameplay, memorable quests, and expansive world space with the advancements in gaming that have been made in the last two decades. Set in the Elder Scroll’s Third Era, during the cataclysmic Oblivion Crisis, you must help to restore the Imperial throne and repel the demonic Daedric invasion.

Skyblivion will feature the remastered entirety of Oblivion’s mainland, Cyrodiil, from the wintery slopes of the Valus and Jerall Mountains to the swamps of Blackwood and warm-beachy shores of the Gold Coast. Skyblivion will bring the return of many classic Oblivion mechanics like spell crafting, a complete class and attributes system, underwater combat, and NPC disposition.

In addition to recreating Oblivion’s systems and porting them into the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim’s engine the project has taken great care in providing new improvements and additions. Skyblivion offers fans remastered graphics, weather, and lighting, an expanded soundtrack, new gameplay mechanics, and even a limited selection of bespoke minor quests with original voice acting to further flesh out barren areas of Oblivion—all for free!

Once Skyblivion is released in 2025, fans will have access to the entirety of Oblivion’s pre-DLC world space, systems, and quests available for play. But that’s not the end of the project! Following a period of bug-fixing and community-supported updates the project development team will move on to working on Oblivion’s nine additional content releases plus the Shivering Isles expansion.

With Skyblivion you experience the best of both worlds: The complex and detailed RPG experience of Oblivion paired with Skyrim’s newer systems, graphics, and quality of life improvements. Will you close shut the jaws of Oblivion once more in 2025?

title: Food Devils
description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Strategy-RPG Roguelike.

title: Serial World
description: "SerialWorld" is a comedic yet serious RPG. Whether you've played deck-building games before or not, everyone can enjoy this adventurous tale. Embark on a journey into the mysterious world to solve the city's disturbances!

title: Critical Upload
description: Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!

title: Lost in the Roots
description: A 2D adventure with a twisted story about guilt, where a girl is kidnapped and held in an attic somewhere in the countryside. Why and who took the girl to this godforsaken place? What to do when there is nowhere to run?

title: Airsoft Online
description: Airsoft Online offers a realistic virtual airsoft experience for veterans of the community and beginners alike. Take part in team-based multiplayer battles, with customizable weapons and realistic physics.

title: Hope Timbre
description: Guide a mysterious creature through imaginary realm at night, or help two siblings awaken their broken world during the day. In dreams, you traverse the colorful environments and solve puzzles to find various hope instruments. Later, use them to summon the spring and escape the never-ending cycle.

title: Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand
description: Gold and Sand is a CRPG with turn based tactical combat, with limb based targeting and bleeding and maiming mechanics. Several mini games such as cooking, fishing, and others.

title: Estilhaço
description: Immerse yourself in a world where technology blurs the boundaries of reality, solve puzzles, or escape from a relentless monster. Are you ready to face the horror lurking in the shadows?

title: Veil of Madness
description: Veil of Madness is a Lovecraftian Deck Builder game that merges the strategic charm of a deck builder with the immersive experience of a first-person RPG genre. Unravel eldritch secrets, battle insanity, and shape your destiny in this chilling journey.

title: The Tale of Mara & Moa
description: Mara and Moa have made a terrible mistake and now they need to find the Spirits of the Forest to save their village. Explore a world full of secrets with dynamic and fast-paced combat, alternating between the two characters and channeling the powers of the Sun and the Moon.

title: Love and Demons
description: Dive into the fearsome demonic world! Step into the shoes of Max, a lazy prince who will be accompanied by three odd girls. Can you find a way to get him back home?

title: Cosmic Holes Junior
description: COSMIC HOLES Junior is a puzzle game where you must follow logical placement rules while constantly keeping an eye on the speed of the pieces you’ve placed. If the pieces spin too fast, they’ll explode. To slow them down, you must take into account their relationships based on the five elements theory of Chinese cosmology (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water): Water nourishes Wood and controls Fire; Wood nourishes Fire and controls Earth, and so on. This game is suitable for both adults and children.

title: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
description: Psychological horror, puzzles, platforming, adventure, dungeons, action, intrigue and a touching story are all terms that should be used to try to define the essence of «Permanent: Hope & Vacuum».

title: Mecha Simultactics
description: Mecha Simultactics is a simultaneous-turn-based competitive tactics game with customizable mechs, isometric battlefields, destructible terrain, anime-inspired battle replays, and online PvP.

title: Byte Breach
description: Embark on a chilling sci-fi co-op survival horror in a dystopian future ruled by AI corporations. Navigate through real and digital domains, filled with dark secrets and sinister entities. Utilize stealth, strategy, and teamwork to survive intense, unpredictable challenges. Will you outsmart the AI?

title: Trizna
description: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

title: Blood Peace
description: Blood Peace, a hyper-violent FPS, immerses players in intense cybernetic warfare. Unravel a cryptic story or dive into chaotic action. Hunt Easter eggs, survive diverse environments, and master unique skills. Join the ultimate killing machine in this fast-paced adventure!

title: Alonecats
description: Colorful mischief-makers have settled in this valley. Solve puzzles to find them all in a new unique game in the genre of animal search.

title: Cut the Cards
description: Create your own cards in this roguelike deckbuilder by cutting and pasting throughout your deck! Journey to the chasms, fighting off dragons and Boviks alike as you manage scarce resources.

title: Goeland: Seagull Adventure
description: Take off as a mischievous seagull, and soar into a captivating escapade! From playful pranks to selfless deeds, be the ultimate feathered troublemaker or a helpful hero. Solve puzzles, unravel secrets, and engage with an interactive world. Let your wings decide the fate of this charming adventure!

title: Headlice
description: Headlice is a reverse horror game where you play as an escaped biological abomination fleeing an inept corporation. Embrace your parasitic nature and become the monster you were meant to be.

title: The Endarkenment
description: This is a narrative-based psychological horror game where the apocalypse itself is just the beginning of The Endarkenment. Explore the enigmatic lands of Antarctica and its surrounding areas all while the world ends.

title: Reports from Vera Cruz
description: Investigate the country of Vera Cruz in this journalistic first-person adventure! Solve puzzles, take photos of clues and report news exposing the horrific truths behind General Galba and his bizarre government!

title: Cube Guy
description: Cube Guy is a 2.5D platformer with simple yet fun dodging, turn based boss battles, secrets, and a lot more!

title: Suspended Animation
description: A sci-fi first person exploration game about a ship in danger, and the evil AI tasked with saving it: you.

title: Antidote City Hall
description: You play as a former policeman who founded a private detective agency. Investigate a chain of mysterious murders, plunge into the world of crime, gain former glory, restore your good name. An exciting storyline, explore the city, a lot of characters, an atmosphere of fear and hopelessness.

title: Bleak Remastered
description: Immerse yourself in the dystopian world of Pinnacle with BLEAK Remastered. Experience stunning new artwork and enhanced gameplay in this dark adventure. Can you navigate the relentless hostile world and save your sister, Asha?

title: Greenfeet Haven
description: Greenfeet Haven is a colony sim set in a fantasy world where you start from nothing into the wild. Cultivate the land, collect resources, craft valuable items and discover new technologies. Organize your village according to your desires, then watch your inhabitants lead their daily lives!

title: Incoherence
description: What started as a relaxing day off with your partner suddenly takes a turn when you find yourself waking up alone at the metro station of a creepy, abandoned complex owned by a mysterious megacorporation...

title: Confined: Leaving OKB-134
description: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person horror game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. You got trapped! Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

title: Bounce Gun
description: Bounce Gun is a challenging arcade roguelike shooter with a huge number of item combinations, unconventional controls and an unusual approach to difficulty progression.

title: FPS Pro Team Manager
description: Recruit and manage the team of FPS players of your dreams, create your own strategies and rise to the top of the world's elite.

title: Reggie, His Cousin, Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World
description: Control the direction of gravity as you run, jump and explore in an outrageous time-traveling adventure as Reggie, an unlikely hero from the 16,000th century on a mission to save science and ultimately the entire universe!

title: Deperson
description: Are you ready to step into a dark and mysterious world with Aaron, who is afraid of his own shadow? A file that has been closed for years is opened again, the forgotten ones wake up from their sleep and the silence is broken by screams.

title: Polda 8
description: It´s the eight entry in the point and click adventure series Polda and the final game with Pankrác as the main character. Just like previous entries is this one focused on puzzles and crazy humor, however this time there are also action minigames and three controlable characters.

title: Kelp Keeper
description: Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.

title: Ichorous Moon
description: Run! Race through the corrupted streets of Türme to stop the rising of the Ichorous Moon

title: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
description: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

title: The War in Chiapas
description: Control a group of young people who enter the jungle of Chiapas, Mexico, in the eighties, to form a guerrilla whose objective is to create an army to overthrow the government through a new revolution, however, a paramilitary group appears unexpectedly.

title: V.E.D.A: The Awakening of Souls
description: V.E.D.A is a Soulslike training game with weighty combat and exploration. The protagonist, awakened with no memory, undergoes combat training in a training simulator and uncovers hidden secrets. You too can enter the Soulslike genre. Don't hesitate.

title: Ascent: Rivals
description:
Ascent Rivals is a competitive, skill-based racing game that fuses high-speed precision driving with intense combat. Sitting between the mechanical mastery of Trackmania and the competitive energy of Rocket League, players earn ARC for placement finishes and kills to customize their ship throughout the race.

Currently in Alpha and available free on Steam, players can compete in multiplayer or chase top times on the global Time Trial leaderboards.

title: Red Snow
description: Experience the ultimate fusion of snowboarding and combat in RED SNOW! Navigate perilous slopes, battle enemy forces, and execute stunning tricks to earn cash in this epic board-n-sword adventure.

title: Wiblu
description: Wiblu: The Search for the Fire Tea, is a captivating video game with German mythology, following Wiblu's quest to find the legendary Fire Tea to save her sick grandmother.

title: DI: Debt is Inevitable
description: DI is an endless wave-based FPS where you must micromanage the ever-increasing shop prices in order to defeat ever-increasing hordes of enemies. Powered by GZDoom.

title: Lost Hellden
description: Lost Hellden is a unique 3D hand-painted J-RPG from Artisan Studios, enhanced by dynamic lighting and weather effects. Follow Cyphel and his allies as a mature story unfolds. Customize your characters as you see fit and dive into a battle system that mixes action and strategy.

title: Neon Auto Party
description: Build a party to auto-battle through waves of enemies in a futuristic fantasy setting. Each unit has its own deck of cards that determines their performance in battle. Find and buy items while leveling up units to take advantage of powerful synergies and reach the end of the dungeon!

title: Decurion
description: Combine the unique abilities of Mechs and Pilots in strategic synergy. Team up with friends in local co-op to conquer dynamic levels with different geometry, shaping your strategic approach. Watch out for anomalies introducing unexpected challenges as you defend your base and strive to stay alive.

title: DearMyFriend
description: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

title: Junklands
description: Embark on a journey to transform a polluted world shackled by its toxic overlords. Explore the lands, brave the environment, battle polluting foes and clean up a dying world in an epic 3D action-adventure metroidvania.

title: Sunkissed City
description: Sunkissed City is a life-sim set in an upbeat, sun-kissed seaside metropolis full of funky vibes and quirky characters. Stake out your new life in the city, tending to DIY gardens, learning new skills, and making life-long friends and help bring life back to its once-vibrant streets!

title: Backrooms Game No. 999999
description: Backrooms #999999999 is a singleplayer/4 player co-op horror exploration game. Unlock the puzzles, survive the entities, escape the deadly geometry and try to reach the final level in one piece. Good luck, wanderer!

title: Dungeon Automata
description: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!

title: 100 Cats Pakistan
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Pakistan! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats Argentina
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Argentina! Can you find them all?

title: Hellfire Poncho
description: Hellfire Poncho is a western rogue-lite isometric shooter. Shoot little demons with your upgraded weapons, die, and try again stronger. Bet your upgrades against the creatures you meet in the saloon, and develop your best build. Don't push your luck....

title: Knights of Fresco
description: Raise your own band of Knights and fight beasts from medieval paintings. Knights of Fresco is an open world party building RPG with auto-battling combat that tries to emulate medieval depictions of battles and wars.

title: Enginefall
description: Enginefall is a player-driven crafting shooter set on colossal, post-apocalyptic megatrains. Start in the tail alone or with friends as you scavenge, craft, and build your way to First Class. Seize better gear car by car, and escape with high-value loot to upgrade your personal home on the rails.

title: 100 Cats Greece
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Greece! Can you find them all?

title: GameChanger: Episode 1
description: Take on the challenge to close the four Portals in this varied 2D-Action-Adventure with shoot 'em up elements! Explore the open Interworld, solve tricky puzzles in complex dungeons, shoot your way through the hordes of counter viruses and stop the dragon!

title: Match Tree
description:
Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game).
Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep.
Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

title: Wildsite
description: Crash-landed on an unknown planet filled with plasma and toxic weather. Your only hope? Bob, a sarcastic-genius AI who will question your every survival decision. Explore, build your mobile base and try to avoid death alongside up to 3 friends in Co-op.

title: L.OD
description:
A 2D exploration adventure.
The main character, Yoi, receives a letter from his dead sister, Chitose, saying that she wants to tell him a secret.
In order to find out the truth, Yoyi heads to an abandoned laboratory.

title: Moonshire
description: Embark on a journey to save Moonshire as you navigate through a mysterious world filled with dungeons, weapons, upgrades, and fast-paced combat!

title: Trade Tales
description: A cozy farming simulation meets entrepreneurial adventures. Create your legacy, Immerse yourself in a world of creativity, social interactions, and unexpected twists. Shape your story, build your own brand, and discover the joy of life in "Trade Tales." Your adventure begins now

title: Growth
description: Journey to a place where even DEATH doesn’t stop your GROWTH…

title: Meat Grinder
description: You’ve opened your own hot dog shop. Prepare, cook, and serve sausages to your customers. But if you run out of stock… you’ll have to get creative. Discover the town’s dark secrets and decide how far you are willing to go to keep your shop running.

title: Kitty Cat Combat
description: A unique tactical military simulation RPG that fuses fantasy with modern warfare. Unite under the pawprint banner!

title: The Milgram Experiment
description: A first person narrative game, based on one of the most controversial psychological experiments of all time. Step into the shoes of an unwilling subject faced with the toughest moral choice: who lives and who dies. You alone will decide who to kill and who to spare. Please wishlist!

title: Greed Realm
description: Greed Realm is a Roguelike Deckbuilder fused with Monopoly elements. As Priestess Gladis, enter the "Soul Tree" to cure your mother. Master deck building, dice manipulation, and backpack management to survive the gap between desire and nightmare.

title: Ink of Fate
description: Explore the world of books, discover its secrets and collect every page in Ink of Fate. A narrative 3D puzzle game in which you will help Helena, a half elf who embarks on a journey to rewrite her destiny and avoid the tragic end imposed on her by her author.

title: Digested
description: Digested is an open-world horror survival game in which you must evade a giant snake intent on eating you alive. Utilize various tools and abilities to formulate an escape strategy, and use the map to navigate through unfamiliar terrain. Locate your extraction pod and don't get digested.

title: Northanda Chronicles
description: Master role-driven combat in Northanda Chronicles, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit three heroes from countless combinations, craft a shared deck of powerful abilities, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

title: Rise & Reign
description: Washed ashore on a strange medieval land, its up to you to choose your destiny. Harvest resources, craft weapons, and build your kingdom. Raid other players or work together. Serve the king or take the throne for yourself. This land is harsh, can you survive?

title: DDS x Narcos
description: Spinoff of the hit game Drug Dealer Simulator and the legendary show Narcos. It’s the 1980s, you are a disgraced CIA agent turned drug dealer. You will run your business in Mexico and the US in this story-driven simulator about the life of crime.

title: England in London
description: England in London is a surrealist satirical dark comedy adventure game with an emphasis on atmosphere, characters and mini-games. Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

title: Dungeons Deep
description: Plunge into the Dungeons Deep! A dark-fantasy ARPG featuring vast underworlds full of horrifying monsters and ancient treasures. Liberate the old lands of Antioch for those who still remain.

title: Sound Mind
description: In Sound Mind, you and a friend (or a bitter enemy) play as Kaine or Mabel. The goal is simple: Keep all of the inheritance to yourself.

title: Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room
description: Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room is a community run experimental story game. With the end of the world fast approaching, Dr. Gumphrey Finklestein announces his plans for a groundbreaking scientific experiment. What will it entail? Does even he know?

title: The Hydra Experiment
description: Solve puzzles as a mad scientist in this action-adventure RPG.

title: The Lumenites
description: Build a cozy village on your flying turtle. Land on floating islands, recycle, upgrade your village, repeat! There's no combat, or wrong answers - just explore and go from chaos to control as you shape your perfect paradise.

title: Rewind And Reclaim
description: Rewind and Reclaim is a turn-based adventure inspired by 90's horror movies. Explore different B movie scenarios by creating scenes in which victims outsmart villains. Investigate their terrifying behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all.

title: Bendy: The Cage
description:
Test your sanity as you take control of Henry in this third person horror experience taking place during the events of Bendy and the Dark Revival.

Condemned to the Keeper prison known as "The Pit", Henry must survive the horrific inmates and mangled experiments set loose to devour him. A labyrinth of steel industrial dread lay before him as his mind is invaded by the past.

Discover the hidden blood-stained truth behind the monsters as you explore the dark levels of The Pit, slowly making your way to the very top of the facility.

Take on the darkness with your axe in brutal melee combat: Unleash fast and heavy strikes, block and parry incoming attacks, shove foes away, stomp on enemies with a vengeance, and time dodges to avoid being torn apart by the things that hunt you. Dive into the shadows for limited supplies as you embark on a twisted tale of Henry's self discovery while facing down new and familiar creatures of the ink.

Find the maestro. Escape the prison. Fight the madness.

title: Detective Fantasia: Excalimurder
description: A dead orphan has been found slashed next to Excalibur... Explore the orphanage to gather clues and uncover the truth in this colorful Game Boy-inspired mystery game, Detective Fantasia: Excalimurder!

title: Soul Blade
description: "Soul Blade" is a 2D platform action game with classic hand-drawn 2D animations that provide a smooth and immersive visual experience. The combat system is built around the "swordplay" mechanism, delivering intense and exhilarating battles.

title: Isolation One
description: Exciting action with puzzle elements and an interesting plot, which takes place on the huge spaceship Transporter P18. In this game, players will encounter an incredible mixture of science fiction and horror. Immerse yourself in a dark world where t you need to survive at any cost.

title: Five Day Detective
description: The Five Day Detective is a point n click whodunnit featuring multiple cases and a twisted sense of humour.

title: Fat Goblins
description: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & weapons, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

title: The Bugs Manor
description: The Bugs Manor is a free 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay, focused on direct interactions with the environment. Can you survive your first night in this haunted house and uncover its mysteries?

title: Cavern
description: Experiment, Explore, and Swap in Cavern, a roguelike sandbox. All objects in the world can be swapped out at will. Swap slimes into harmless pots, turn enemy projectiles into countless health potions, and discover hidden interactions to conquer the ever-changing depths of Mirror Cavern.

title: Sligga Trigger
description: Suit up and sling some shells at sadistic, superpowered sci-fi slugs. Snag some secrets, suffer some shrapnel, and shoot the shit out of some Sliggas in this one-of-a-kind twin-stick shooter.

title: Owlet's Embrace
description:
An owlet afraid of flight sets off to explore a vibrant mysterious world and rediscover itself. On this heartwarming adventure, you'll confront the owlet's deepest fears as only the greatest challenges can lead to the most profound growth.

Owlet's Embrace is an action exploration platformer, blending fast paced grappling hook manouvers with combat and emotional discovery.

title: 4am
description: A tiny gimbap café in a back alley, lights on until 4 a.m. Lured by oddly high pay, you take the night shift — greet customers, cook, walk home through the dark. Night by night, something slips out of place. Where did the last clerk go?

title: Music Power Up
description: As a musician in the 1980s, create music for early video games. Make your own sounds and melodies from scratch, or use pre-composed patterns. Play games, upgrade the music app, meet programmers, editors and musicians, find your next music job, in the crazy decade that started the digital revolution.

title: Blood & Chaos
description: Blood & Chaos is a roguelike tribute to the golden era of '80s RPG gaming. Create a fellowship of 6 heroes and embark on an epic journey. Explore a thriving world with quests to accomplish, cities to discover and dungeons to explore where your mastering of turn-based combats will keep you alive.

title: Dead Meat
description: Lucia's just killed her husband... probably. Can you get a confession before her lawyers arrive? Use your own words to manipulate, persuade, threaten, or even seduce her into 'fessing up. This billionaire has a terrible secret. And time is running out.

title: Hexrite
description: You are a sorcerer part of a group of mysterious characters embarking on an adventure to fulfil an ancient magical ritual. Fight, quest and explore in this stylized action-adventure indie title!

title: Design & Conjure
description: Join Dalia, a young witch, in her cozy adventure to fix her hometown. Reconnect with nature and bring beauty back as you clean, decorate, solve light puzzles, and help magical creatures affected by the mysterious corruption.

title: Power Line Rider
description: Power Line Rider is an Action-Packed Endless Runner with retro 8-bit inspired graphics & sounds! Dodge Birds, Squirrels, Monkeys and Fight Bosses as you race across a post-apocalyptic world where the fastest means of travel is riding on old Power Lines!

title: Codename Incubus
description: Slice, dash, and parry your way through your inner demons in this fast-paced psychedelic journey! Dodge an onslaught of deadly projectiles and unleash your blade upon nightmarish foes that lurk within your subconscious. Follow a dissident dealer and a jaded philanderer on their never-ending trip.

title: Exploration: Light
description: Experience large space ship battles. Uncover the secrets of the mysterious alien race. Upgrade your ship or even start a fleet. Survive

title: FrostFire: Battle Frenzy
description: This is FrostFire -Battle Frenzy-, a 2D anime fighting game perfect for new and experienced players of the genre.

title: Rogue Mech
description: Pilot your trusty Phoenix in this isometric, post-apocalyptic mecha survival game with base building elements. Trade, plant, hack, dig, talk and fight your way through the wastelands. If you survive, you might be able to restore a little green to this ash-ridden world.

title: Tower of Tears
description: A 3D Survival-Horror Metroidvania in a vast, interconnected tower ruled by cryptic systems, strange residents and esoteric mysteries...

title: 500 Caliber Contractz
description: 500 Caliber Contractz is a momentum-based 3D-Platformer in which you play as a contract killer hired via crowdfunding to murder CEOs, Disgraced Sinister Ex-Doctors, Private-Prison-Owning DJs, etc. With your handy high caliber sniper rifle and a chest full of anxiety, you can and will propel yourself to where you need to be. Collect tokens that float around for a reason I haven't bothered coming up with and then murder your target. Do it. Please.

title: Kardashev
description: Kardashev is an open-world, procedurally generated, factory building game, set amongst a voxel asteroid belt. Your mission is to harness energy and ascend the Kardashev Scale.

title: The Lab Thing
description: The lab thing is a first-person survival horror game. Explore a mysterious secret lab and play as the only human left alive. Gather all the scientist's notes about the monster, upgrade backpack items, record information and try to escape before you join the body collection of the lab thing!

title: Fantastic Haven
description: Restore the equilibrium of magic by saving endangered fantasy creatures. Build your shelter to welcome and protect them, explore unique regions, rally neighboring populations to your cause and rehabilitate creatures in their natural environment.

title: Folder Dungeon
description: Dungeon crawler roguelike inside computer folder!

title: The Journey Home
description: The Journey Home is a cinematic and meditative platformer adventure set in a surreal world where you travel beyond the boundaries of time and space. Make your way through stunning and mysterious settings, solve surreal puzzles, and find answers to the life-long questions that haunt Walter.

title: Infernae
description: Fear is not a shield. Only those who face it will survive this adrenaline-pumping bullet hell boss rush.

title: Kosmocean: The Endless Sea
description: Adventure and submarine exploration game. Control your Bathyscaphe with the help of a logbook. Through the game puzzles, bullet-hell sequences, and skill-based challenges, you will be plunged miles and miles into the depths where the ocean seems to have no end.

title: Swordeye
description: A hardcore MMO slasher with brutal directional combat. Explore massive, persistent PvPvE dungeons where every fight matters. Fight your way to the top, or die trying.

title: Hollow Home
description: Hollow Home is an isometric narrative RPG about the russian invasion of Ukraine, told from the perspective of a teenager trapped inside an occupied city. Learn survival skills, build relationships and face tough choices as each passing day brings new tragedies and destruction to your childhood home.

title: Angry Mother Earth
description: In "Angry Mother Earth", step into the shoes of Mother Earth and her alternate forms: Father Earth, Midgard, and Gaia. Each offers distinct abilities and introduces diverse strategies to the gameplay.

title: Paver Simulator
description: Did you ever dream to become a paving artist? Perform tasks, during which the most important thing is creativity and precision. According to your design you lay different types of paving stones, so you earn money and raise the level of your reputation. Test your skills in the Paver Simulator

title: Mayhem Brawler II: Best of Both Worlds
description: A perfect fuse of '90s arcade vibe and modern rogue-lite / RPG mechanics in a time transition-themed beat 'em up. Play solo or online with friends and shape the story through your choices. Be amazed by the hand-drawn comics-inspired art, frame-by-frame animated characters, and kick-ass soundtracks.

title: Ghost Vanguard
description: Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements. Grab your sword and step into treacherous evil dungeons, using stylish and magnificent combos to defeat the sinister forces from the darkness!

title: Fishing Echoes
description: Step into the cozy realms of Fishing Echoes, a game that beckons you to shorelines filled with rare fish and whispered legends. Ready yourself for the ultimate angling challenge as you embark on a journey to mastery.

title: Killa
description: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

title: Archetype Blue
description: Archetype Blue is a rogue-lite deck building game where you form your own adventure team and deck before facing the challenges this fantasy world has in store for you. With all the options in front of you and the circumstances surrounding your expedition, do you have any chance of succeeding?

title: Ascent Quest
description: Enter the world of Aelys in this incredible online RPG made for virtual reality ! Meet hundreds of players, form your party of adventurers (or go solo) and fulfill your destiny in this high-fantasy story-driven universe … or hang out laughing in the local tavern with your friends!

title: Alpine Lake
description: Kick back in the fresh mountain air and craft your ideal haven on the shores of Alpine Lake! Build, and decorate your inn to bring joy and prosperity to the community. Welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Farm, cook, and entertain them in your own unique way!

title: On a Summer Night
description: "Today, I would like to tell you about one night. One night that changed my life." On a Summer Night is a short point-and-click visual novel.

title: Nether Spirits: Beyond the Gate
description: Mend your shattered soul in Nether Spirits, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark, fantastical afterlife corrupted by sin. Choose from seven distinct classes, explore a vast world, and fight your way to salvation - alone, with friends, or in real-time PvP!

title: DollHouse: Survive or Death
description: "for that child's future." "I must ...... I must to do this. The eight children who came to the mansion were waiting for a series of horrible dreams... A series of horrible nightmares... Who did this? and for what? And who did this for whom...? Only by entering the DollHouse can we find out.

title: Small Kingdoms
description: Rule a small fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals as you build up cities and armies on the world map and command troops on the battlefield. Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and RTS game with small procedurally generated world maps, and campaigns you can complete in a weekend

title: Summer Sprint
description: Ride your bike across beautiful landscapes. Overcome obstacles. Help Lisa catch up with the thief.

title: Janet DeMornay is a Slumlord (and a witch)
description: Live the anxieties and horrors of what it is to be a renter in a world run by landlords. …and your landlord is a witch.

title: Conquest of Eldinar
description: Conquest of Eldinar is a 2.5D Action RTS where you can choose from 16 different epic fantasy Factions to play as while you build bases, train armies, and engage in thrilling battles in either dynamic singleplayer campaigns or competitive online multiplayer.

title: Escape from the Collector
description: In "Escape from the Collector", you will be trapped in an old house full of puzzles and secrets. Explore its rooms searching clues that will guide your adventure. Each puzzle solved brings you closer to freedom or dooms you to be trapped in the Collector's sinister game. Will you be able to escape?

title: To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora
description: Delve into the captivating realm of Faenora in our upcoming real-time strategy RPG game, To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora. Drawing inspiration from timeless classics like Final Fantasy Tactics and Ogre Battle, we're modernizing the elements that made these games unforgettable.

title: Ardent Passions
description: Ardent Passions is an adult visual novel where Heroman uncovers his girlfriend and her friends' vigilante secrets on a camping trip. With the fate of these relationships at stake, the game unfolds through decisions that determine if these vigilantes become allies or enemies.

title: Psychotic Bathtub
description: Have a psychotic episode in your bathtub. Argue with a rubber duck, flood your bathroom and drown dad. Find your very own ending – or all of them.

title: Frame of Mind: A Game of Thoughts
description: Frame of Mind is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you discover a character trough thoughts and mementos they find while moving out of their parents home. It's an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.

title: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion
