description: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion follows three high school friends; Haruka Nanami, Nemu Takanashi, and Maria Hitsugi, as they explore the Amare Est Vivere Hospital, testing a local urban legend as the streamer Nemu seeks to boost her subscriber count. Unfortunately for the three girls, the legend of “Ayame’s Mercy” is true, and they trigger a decades-old curse that sends them into a dark realm. Together they must avoid the vengeful spirit of Ayame Kirishima and other horrors from the hospital’s dark past as they search for a way to dispel Ayame’s curse once and for all.

title: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
description: Somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago a man wakes up with no memory of who he is, how he got there or what happened to him. A short point-and-click adventuregame about a man overboard survivor.

title: Water Me & You
description: Water Me & You is a cozy two-player co-op adventure in which you play as a water droplet or a seed-like creature that can change states, on a quest to regenerate a world left behind by humans.

title: Soul Devourer
description: Soul Devourer is a metroidvania action-platformer with a classic 2D horror style. You'll explore the vast, cursed Sakuradoki High School, master unique abilities, fight twisted monsters and uncover the long-buried secrets concealed under the school.

title: Lunr.Rdio.Taxi
description: lunr.rdio.taxi blends drifting and rhythm into an exhilarating spacetime 'Drifthm' adventure! Slide and boost your way through the solar system to the beat of Brazil's best DJs and earn big as an interplanetary taxi pilot trying to pay an infinite debt in this hypercapitalistic BrazaFunk future.

title: Cook, Serve, Delicious: Remustard!
description: The million-selling cooking sim is BACK in this all new re-imagining of a classic! An all new campaign, expanded music, new foods and art, and new gameplay modes round out a celebration of the ten year anniversary of this massive series.

title: Doubumon
description: Doubumon is an RPG monster collecting/battling game. Experience tactical battles as you choose 4 Doubumon to fight with on the battlefield. Grow, evolve, and customize your attacks while developing different strategies in order to win, as you fight and explore your way to become the Doubumon champion.

title: Black Box LSS: The Merciful Savior
description: Immerse yourself in a pixel-art AVG that blends love, crime, and romantic comedy. A story of a young man forges connections with his online friend, and gradually falls in love. If you're a fan of love story, yandere, and don't mind a touch of thrill and crime, you will greatly enjoy this game.

title: Lazy Jiangshi
description: A visual novel about lazy jiangshi Mao and her even lazier mistress.

title: LightSup!
description: LightSup! is a couch-action co-op game for 1-4 players with rogue-lite elements where you play as adventurers encounter ferocious monsters crawling from the Eclipse Dungeons. Prepare your weapons and protect the Altar of Light at any cost, or the world will be doomed into darkness forever.

title: Wish Upon a Llama
description: Embark on a delightful journey of breeding and raising adorable animals like llamas, bunnies, and capybaras while building meaningful relationships with the residents of Llama Town. What unique animal breeds will you discover and whom among the townsfolk will you befriend? Adventure awaits!

title: Save My Human
description: This is the story about a little girl who is taken to an evil world inside a video game, and her dog embarks on an adventure to save her. The dog will not be alone, he will encounter other pets who are also searching for their owners.

title: System Purge: Hollow Point
description: Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a massive expansion which adds a surreal new campaign, challenging new gamemodes, and more.

title: Cyber Paradise
description: Revive Mini the Dog digitally through 2D roguelite actions; craft her cyber paradise with beloved moments, like sniffing dog butts XD. Uncover a deeper dystopian narrative and strengthen friendships in cafe chats—a frenetic yet cozy journey.

title: AI Kills All Humans
description: AI Kills All Humans is a Tactical RTS game in which you play as an AI sending robots to kill all humans. You however don't have direct control of your robots, but robots independently decide how to execute your commands, like a general telling troops to attack, but troops themselves decide how.

title: Little Monster
description: Little Monster is a hand painted side scroller beat ‘em up where you play as Stormy, a monster under the bed who protects us from our nightmares. Protect the dream! Explore the realms! Rescue your friends!

title: Dreadwinter
description: Dreadwinter is a single-player, fantasy coffee shop RPG, where the game's story and experience is centered around how you play. Whether you want to run a thriving business, explore the world, or just make good coffee, how you run Dreadwinter is up to you!

title: The One Who Stands Behind
description: Survive hordes of monsters in a deck builder with a tactical grid while engaging in existential conversations with your avatar.

title: Rebirth of Arcadia
description: Rebirth of Arcadia is a turn-based tactics game with roguelike elements and contemplative story. Experience the journey of two groups of people working together to escape from the Abyss. Explore, defeat monsters, wield and modify the power of runestones to uncover the secrets of the Abyss.

title: Exodus: Sunflower on the Horizon
description: You're given a chance to find out what really makes the earth turn... But will you like what you see? Exodus is the ultimate sci-fi RPG experience about love, friendship, and deadly monsters.

title: Death the Guitar
description: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".

title: Specters of the Sun
description: Specters of the Sun is a challenging 2D action platformer with action-packed levels. Take on the role of an elusive specter to reclaim your old corpse, now possessed at the heights of your former kingdom.

title: Overhours
description: From building makeshift traps, to defending her new friends from danger and taking back precious time. Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a dystopian media agency that steals time. One employee, together with an unexpected ghostly partner, is trying to retrieve it all.

title: Mearcair/System Pulse
description: Dive into System Pulse, a rhythm-fueled roguelike bullet heaven where you must outmaneuver swarms of robots moving while attacking to the beat. Unleash your reflexes, survive rhythmic encounters, and master the symphony of chaos in this electrifying action game.

title: Dread Pilots
description: Dread Pilots is a space survival game where you explore a mysterious and hostile pocket universe called the Dread. Scavenge resources, upgrade your ship, make friends, and fight monsters as you try to carve out a little piece of the Dread for yourself.

title: Surviving Deponia
description: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!

title: Toxic Crusaders
description: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

title: Light Odyssey
description: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

title: Ebola 4
description: You open your eyes, it's dark all around. Are you in an underground bunker, alone with your thoughts... or are you not alone there? Fear, apocalypse, darkness swallowed the world, most people are infected. You are at the epicenter... And can you change something?

title: Telluria
description: One Soul. Two Lives. Separated by 1400 Years. Unravel an ancient prophecy in a 3D narrative adventure spanning two different eras where an entire reality is at stake. When they finally find each other, you will decide what survives — and at what cost.

title: April '86
description: April ‘86 - is a mystical first-person thriller which has our protagonist journeying to the abandoned city of Pripyat, to confront the secrets of the past.

title: Dead Detective: Zombie Conspiracy
description: Take on the role of Margh, undead private detective, in this humorous and wacky graphic adventure that combines point-and-click mechanics with an elaborate “deaduction” system. Use your brain (or what's left of it) and solve bizarre and unconventional mysteries in a world ruled by zombies.

title: Haruka: Beyond the Stars
description: Haruka: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya. Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.

title: Spaceman Memories
description: Spaceman Memories is a retro JRPG that takes place in a distant future but draws inspiration from ancient Japanese folktales. A story full of wonder and nostalgia as you take on the role of Ichiro 94, an astronaut who wakes up from hypersleep to go on a journey to find the remnants of his past.

title: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets
description: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets is an indie Action RPG made as a tribute to the Game Boy Advance era of gaming. A spiritual successor to Save me Mr Tako, play in a world where Octopuses were erased from history.

title: Enlightened
description: Enlightened is a survival horror game with strong focus on puzzle solving. Explore the hotel in which you woke up, find clues about what happened, solve puzzles and find a way out, while surviving horrors that awaits you there.

title: VISK
description: Face your fears in VISK, an open-world online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. Escape from a strange village, uncover the dark secrets of this place and solve puzzles to discover new areas. But beware, deadly creatures are after you and your friend!

title: Elder's Grace: Rise of the Mobley
description:
Join this epic battle to take back a magical homeland. Help Mobley heroes explore, build, raid and defend in an effort to regain & hold what's rightfully theirs.

Build and protect customized strongholds while creating specialized teams to explore and plunder others.

title: Danger is Near
description: Danger is Near - sessional hardcore multiplayer shooter that includes several genres: FPS, survival, weapon and combat simulator, RPG with MMO phenomena. The game will immerse you in a realistic gaming environment imbued with a gloomy post-apocalyptic atmosphere...

title: Alien Boom Boom
description: Join the fight against an alien invasion in this fast-paced, old-school FPS. Battle in your hometown, around the world, and even in space. Take on unique enemies and wield powerful weapons, all with a touch of classic fps sensibility. Can you save humanity from the brink of destruction? Boom boom.

title: Rich Dad Simulator
description: Run your own chain of markets. Start from a small shop to the biggest business in town. Manage staff, control inventory, set prices, and keep customers happy. Build new locations and expand your retail empire. Can you succeed and become the king of retail?

title: Bogdan's Cross
description: Embark on a journey of redemption as Bogdan, a fallen Templar seeking to make amends for his past sins. Explore a stunning world filled with ancient mysteries, uncover hidden secrets, and battle fierce enemies in this immersive action-adventure game.

title: 5 Star Fishy
description: Explore, bite, talk, and swim to the bottom of this semi-linear aquatic metriodvania! The world isn't particularly happy with a tiny pink fishy trying to nuke them, and they may try to kill you, so stay sharp and don't bite off more than you can chew.

title: Corr
description: Corr is a difficult Souls-lite Boss Rush Action RPG where you Run-n-Gun & Hack-n-Slash your way through challenging boss encounters. To endure the strange, dark and whacky world of Corr, level up and customize your warrior build with berserk powers, tonics, talismans and more.

title: 3 Last Chances
description: 3 Last Chances is an Action RPG game with challenging combat and progression system that allows to create your own unique playstyle. You get 3 chances to replay a year, complete quests and find just the right method of weakening and overcoming the seemingly unbeatable final boss.

title: VICCP 2 Core
description: The Very Important Central Control Panel is back. Keeping the mysterious atmosphere and with even more mysteries. Control the omnipotence remote, experiment, and find many endings. Brainstorming in retro sci-fi style / Puzzle / Quest / Point Click.

title: Snap Quest
description: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

title: Back to the Collis
description: Back to the Collis is a story-rich, fully hand-drawn 2D Point & Click adventure puzzle. Embark on a journey alongside the main character, Benjamin, to solve lots of engaging puzzles and explore the town of Collis, outstanding by its memorable populace.

title: Starship Colony
description: A deep starship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

title: Cosmic Holidays
description: Help Cibo find his way in an unknown world. Through gorgeous flora and fauna, Cibo can glide in the wind, bounce, propel or block, absorb impacts or roll, using his power to inflate his head. Learn from hostile nature to make it your ally. Earn Cibo's trust until he reaches his vacation resort!

title: Laws of Nadragia
description: Become a prosecutor in the totalitarian state of Nadragia. Study the laws, use the court facts to convict the guilty or unwanted by the government... Can you keep your conscience?

title: Dr. Emmerson's Nocturnes
description: Dive into the worlds of the best classic weird fiction and cosmic horror writers. Try out our original approach to bringing literature into the interactive medium. Relax and let Dr. Emmerson guide you through all colors of dread.

title: Midnight Horde
description: Midnight Horde is a gothic horror casual action game with rogue-lite elements where you battle thousands of enemies and upgrade the castle. Discover the secrets of the castle and upgrade weapons and fortifications to keep darkness at bay.

title: Legends of Castile
description: Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It tells the story of a village girl who must investigate the myths and legends of Castile to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun. Advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meeting all kinds of characters, defeating fantastic creatures with your wit, and exploring places all around Castile.

title: Goblin's Journey
description: Goblin's Journey is a humorous adventure game with a stupid plot and even more idiotic characters. You play as a greedy bastard goblin named Alastar. You are about to save you king's life - in exchange for gold of course! An adventure full of gold, mischief and innapropriate content.

title: Bloody Horror Plant
description: Bloody Horror Plant – probably the bloodiest casual point and click adventure game ever! Help Horror Plant solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, kill evil dwarfs, save the forest and its creatures!

title: Neebota: 99 Fails
description: Neebota: 99 Fails is a surreal 3D adventure with demanding 2D precision-platforming challenges. Explore Zeebo's recurring nightmare, master his changing forms, and uncover his story, with music by David Wise.

title: Moki: The Escape
description: Moki wakes up in a strange environment. The only memory: the own name. A peaceful world... or is it?! Join Moki in a challenging 2.5D jump & run platformer with many puzzles. Meet lovable and sometimes oddball characters and experience a occasionally emotional story.

title: HexLands
description: HexLands is a turn-based, roguelike city builder set on procedural medieval islands. Grow your empire and adapt to harsh environments! Customize your deck, manage your resources, complete quests, and synergize perks! How far will your empire reach?

title: Tails of Fate
description: Fulfill this tale, as darkness swarms the fantasy lands of Fauna. Venture epic kingdoms and treacherous dungeons in a 2D action plaformer, with Metroidvania elements in a hand-crafted pixel art world filled with souls-like boss fights, dungeon platforming, and difficult dynamic enemy combat design.

title: Four Hundred Catapults
description: City builder & Survival. When the dead get close enough, they can use the deadly fog to take control of your settlements. Build a strong economy to supply your warriors with long-range weapons and massive fortifications. This is the only chance to survive.

title: KaiJu Girls
description: Kaiju Girls is a Visual Novel full of Monster Girls. The protagonist lost his memory in an accident and became a KaijuTamer, with the Kaiju girls in the Kaiju world full of danger adventure! In the wonderful and exciting adventure journey in the protagonist will slowly recall his memories.

title: Valley of the Old Masters
description: The World has been in the midst of the winds of change. As a wandering artist, you end up in a mystical valley on your journey. Do you find inspiration for your art there?

title: Rina to Akumu no Kan
description: One day, the unlucky girl "Runa Ichiya" wakes up in a haunted house.

title: Quadremor
description: A first person shooter where you take a role of one of the last human mercenaries, who has to take his revenge for annihilation of humanity. A deep dive into a dark and unforgiving realm, which will stay in your consciousness for ages.

title: Zwaard
description: Explore a world where you try to preserve the still existing life forms. Technology has taken over and will try it's best to stop you in your adventure. Whilst those technologies try to stop you they could also be the only reason you're still alive.

title: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
description: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

title: Unwound
description: Lose yourself in a surreal candyland adventure about transformation and escapism. Descend into a land of weirdos and forgotten memories as you assemble a new you from whatever you find.

title: Timeless Heart VR
description: Timeless heart VR is an action VR roguelike game, As the second work of Timeless Stories series, this work further simplifies and enriches the unique sword skill system of the series. Advancing in the unknown labyrinth with Lycanea, and break through this blockade from fate!

title: Captain Disaster and the Two Worlds of Riskara
description: A new Captain Disaster adventure; this time he is more of a hero than a disaster! ... Or is he? A point and click adventure game with cartoony graphics, epic storyline and more bad jokes than you can possibly imagine. Buy this game. It is your destiny...

title: Space Scavenger 2
description: Space Scavenger 2 is an Action-Roguelike where you scavenge for modules to build a hodgepodge spaceship. Upgrade and customize your ship on-the-fly to make the best of a terrible situation. Playful and colorful - who said you can't smack aliens with a huge hammer in space?

title: Life After End
description: Life After End is a harsh and cruel representative of the Survival Horror genre, where you have to survive in post-apocalyptic Siberia. Be prepared for harsh climatic conditions and realistic gameplay.

title: Death By Misstep
description: Death By Misstep is an upcoming First-Person Rhythm, Stealth and Horror game set on a party cruise where a massive massacre by robots is happening.

title: Xanniban
description: Evil has been unleashed. Don the Trespasser's suit as you dash across facilities, manage resources, and confine hostile machines to change the fate of humanity. Lure your foes into containment as a grim epidemic festers beneath the surface...

title: Nuclear Sub
description: A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country.

title: Vocaless
description: Vocaless is a unique platformer game with rhythm elements, you must perform all of your actions to the beat! Not only that, but everything in the game, from enemies to obstacles, follows the beat of the music.

title: Tsurugihime
description: Tsurugihime is a side-scrolling action RPG. The last battle is in 100 days. It is up to the player to decide how to live until the day. Battle, ikusei, exploration, story, and even sister. "Craft" everything. An RPG that "crafts" fate.

title: Loot List
description: Loot List is a thief simulator and action game about robbery. There's one difference though — here, every heist has to have a list.

title: In Stone
description: In the late 19th century, a sculpture is confined in a monastery asylum. It's in your hands to follow the blue vision to explore the monastery's deeper secrets, or to escape the stone prison by gathering clues inside the hospital.

title: Anomalistic Revolution
description: You stand before a pit at the city's heart, then your gaze drifts to a deeper void, one you fear even more. Wield your invention to unravel mysteries, reclaim lost memories, strengthen your skills, and battle nightmare-born horrors in this multi-ending RPG.

title: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
description: A 2D platform game about the ancient stories of the Huni Kuin indigenous people, who live in the Brazilian Amazon. The entire game was produced in collaboration with the Huni Kuin communities of the Jordão river, in Acre.

title: Murder on the Stella
description: It's a murder mystery. It's an adventure. It's a cruise vacation simulator. It's different each time you play.

title: Twin Jet Racer
description: Two jets. Two triggers. That’s all you need to swerve, drift, corkscrew, loop or even fly to reach the next checkpoint and top the leaderboard. Master the controls and the physics to progress to the next class of racer and unlock greater challenges. Compete against friends or against the clock.

title: Hyper Drill
description: Hyper Drill is a speedrunning runner game, where you fly at supersonic speed and destroy everything in your path. Drill through any obstacle, jump between different galaxies, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

title: Total World Liberation
description: Open World Survival Automation Crafting Building Turn-Based game, yup that's a huge mix of genres and it works!

title: Red Rebellion
description: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

title: Nowhere Manor
description: House of stolen devil bargains and indolent angelic aristocracy: Nowhere Manor is doomed to disappear. You can leave if you’ve got a soul … but that’s not an option for an artificially created servant such as Liber. Just how far are you willing to go escape?

title: Astromeda
description: Astromeda is an adventure RPG, featuring unique fast-paced and turn-based battles in a mysterious, charming world. You are a human who returns to an Earth inhabited by intelligent Bacteria. Explore a rich world, befriend or fight quirky characters, and uncover the mysteries of the Bacteria race. The game is inspired by Undertale, H

title: RunMan Turbo
description: The indie legend returns, now in a 2D platformer where you speedrun randomly generated levels. Bounce, slide, jump, and run fast as heck. Easy to play and challenging to master, with an awesome soundtrack and a style that will make you go, "Oh snap!"

title: Littlelands
description: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

title: ChaseTag
description: Come participate at ChaseTag ! A tag competition where athletes are candy ! Face your friends in intense Player-versus-Player matches, that will make you sweat !

title: Bunker Builder Simulator
description: Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune. Will you be able to meet the expectations?

title: Kaiju Catastrophe
description: Crush, smash, and eat thousands of enemies showing humanity what the meaning of destruction is! Kaiju Catastrophe is an arcade game with roguelite mechanics. Mutate devastating weapons, unlock permanent evolutions, and wreak havoc with a variety of monsters to tear humanity apart! Wishlist today!

title: Furcifer's Fungeon
description: Furcifer’s Fungeon is a loot-based dungeon crawler action roguelike. Forge powerful character builds using common, rare and legendary items and upgrade your collection for following runs!

title: Feudums
description: Feudums is a medieval strategy simulation with a detailed player-to-player vassalage system, full modding support and community-driven narrative. Balance diplomatic, economic, and military aspects while making your play for the throne. Is it your destiny to rule?

title: Daomei Village
description: You have been banished to Daomei Village for your offense. In order to return to the Emperor's favor, you must make an effort. Repair, build, cultivate fields and fight various adversities. Meet new friends and learn their stories. Do whatever it takes not to be banished forever!

title: Orc Warchief: Strategy City Builder
description: Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

title: Snowtracked
description: It's a simple snow exploration game, and stickbuilder.

title: Virtueror: The Virtual Conqueror
description: Virtueror is an RTS with 4x and RPG elements. Your mission is to conquer new worlds and to extend your domain over the whole galaxy. Build your base, command your units, gather resources, set up defenses and crush anyone challenging you. Have no mercy and the universe will be yours!

title: Farm Renovator
description: Buy a ruined farm and give it its full glory back. Clean, repair, restore, improve. Repair machines, manage the work on your farm, take care of your animals, and choose your development strategy. We're sure you'll have many satisfied customers.

title: Wonderland Quest
description: Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.

title: Kvlt
description: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

title: 34Everlast
description: This is a super-concentrated action entertainment for busy working adults. The game is an action puzzle game where your discoveries and actions unravel a complex and intertwined world of breathless action in a dying world.

title: Bloody Hell Hotel
description: In Bloody Hell Hotel, you embody a vampire. You wake up from a coma that has lasted for centuries, only to find your once-grand estate is now in ruins. It's time to turn it into a prosperous hotel! It's no easy task, though, as times are tough and resources are scarce. There are shortages of food, supplies, and workforce. Being a blood-thirsty monster doesn't help with customer satisfaction either. Luckily, underneath the estate lies a crypt and a system of caves. By foraging, farming, crafting, and fighting your way through the monster-infested dungeons, you'll find the resources you need to restore greatness to your mansion and turn it into a thriving hotel business.

title: Adventures of Ruby Rabbit
description: "The Adventure of Ruby Rabbit" is a light action shooter adventure game. In the game, you can control Ruby the cute bunny, fight the bunny balls, and grow as she grows.

title: Glaciered
description: Glaciered is an action-adventure indie game that takes place on a glacier-covered Earth 65 million years in the future. Play as a Tuai, a species evolved from birds, to soar through the seas and fight against the threats to this new golden age of life.

title: Dungeons of the Amber Griffin
description: Play as a group of daredevils who explore the world of dark fantasy in search of fame, amber and gold. Experience the classic mechanics of the iconic ‘90s Dungeon Crawlers with a new twist. Solve the mystery of the ghost that haunted the ruins and discover a bestiary based on Kashubian beliefs.

title: Dimakerus
description: Disguise as anyone. Mimic their ways. Ambush your friends. Discover cursed Roman relics in ever-chanading catacombs and wield their might to obliterate those who stand in your way.

title: Paws and Leaves: A Last Tale
description: Life flashes before your eyes when you die. Help Me Fox by finding his memories beyond life and experiencing a touching, cute, and scary tale.

title: Almost My Floor: Duality
description: Almost My Floor: Duality - a noir detective horror-adventure game about the internal struggle with depression and the impending darkness in a provincial town. The gameplay is based on decision-making mechanics and a branching storyline.

title: Magnetic Bonds
description: Magnetic Bonds is a fusion of the visual novel and turn-based RPG genres inspired by shonen manga where players explore a vast galaxy, befriending characters and building relationships as they progress through the story and take down enemies and bosses.

title: Summer Road
description: Summer Road is a new RPG based on the concept of playing RPGs more casually. It targets people who are tired of AAA RPGs and want to play in a short time, and want to immerse themselves in nostalgia.

title: Abyss Fantasia
description: The city "Cynthia" on the edge of the abyss, the "missing" girl who didn't know where she came from began to step into the abyss. Experience the complex emotional, mysterious biological environment under the Abyss. Finally face the deepest darkness of the abyss.

title: Deep Alchemy Dungeon
description: D.A.D. is a dungeon crawling game were alchemy skills play crucial role. Young witch ominous plans were destroyed when she was put in a jail. But she founds ancient laboratory full of secrets and new shining perspectives behind the broken wall.

title: Tales of the Death
description: Join a comic adventure in a hand-drawn book with a life of its own. Rearrange the panels of an animated comic to reveal the stories of the world of The Death.

title: The Walker
description: The Walker is a single-player survival horror game. Find out the truth behind what is happening while surviving the zombies. Feel the tension and fight your fear because they await you!

title: Echoes of the Stars
description: Echoes of the Stars is a modern action-JRPG standing on the shoulders of the classics. Follow Rin and Eldric in a tale of two souls, bound together by fate in an epic tale of time, space, love, laughter, and the human condition as they challenge those who seek to destroy existence as we know it.

title: Death Ring
description: Death Ring is a casual action roguelike in which you will have to force your way through hordes of undead in search of the human world’s main artefact. Numerous scenarios of each character’s development based on random dropping items will make your runs unique.

title: Cursed Dungeon Raider
description: Embark on an exploration adventure with spooky and horror elements, tasked with recovering real historical artifacts from excavation sites around the world. Beware of local traps and monsters inspired by the mythology of each region.

title: Multi Idle
description: Multi Idle is an idle game that features Exploring, Adventuring, Hero's, Dungeons, Raids and many more in its own kind of idling way. Get stuck in an endless loop of trying new things every time you play!

title: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns
description: An epic 2D pixel art style Metroidvania, inspired by Moroccan culture and spiritual traditions. Wield powerful ancient weapons and forge your way through unrelenting deserts, crumbling necropoli, floating islands and dangerous mountains as you try to uncover the secret of the last Djinn.

title: Astrolander
description: Astrolander is a revolutionary action-packed reimagining of platformers. Embark on a thrilling adventure featuring innovative 2.5D fused with 3D environments and gameplay, unique mechanics, and breathtaking worlds. Take control of a curious robot on a roll named Feedback and an adventurous rocket powered sidekick named Haptic on a quest to save the Most Valuable Programs (MVPs)!

title: Hero Chest
description: The perfect combination of Roguelike, Hack Slash and Card Game! In Hero Chest you are an angry chest that got tired of being looted and decided to finish them all! With powers and special cards create the dungeon and strategize to reach your goal. An adventure full of combat and gold!

title: Critias Empire
description: Turn-based strategy game with 4x elements. Build your empire while surviving frequent disasters rained down by the ancient Gods.

title: Mirai #167
description: MIRAI #167 is a 2D pixel-art runner where you control two characters at once, rewinding time and jumping through portals. Embark on a frantic adventure to save humanity in a world where AI surpasses human control - upgrade your characters, break records and rewrite history before it’s too late!

title: Eternal Remnant: The First Chapter
description: Dive into the unforgettable tale of two siblings on the run in this emotional RPG journey. With only their wits and a cursed power too dangerous to control, they must fight, explore and scavenge to survive in an unfamiliar world. Will their bond be strong enough to endure the road ahead?

title: The Bornless
description:
The Bornless is an FPS action shooter packed with a variety of gameplay modes. Dive into last-man-standing co-op gameplay or try the thrilling demon versus disciple mode, all within a terror-filled world. Players pair up and form teams, conjure demons to aid in combat, and utilize strategic planning and resource management to survive. Whether you choose an aggressive playstyle or prefer a more cautious approach, the choice is yours.

Join or create a Faction and amass various resources to upgrade and enhance your Safehouse or personalize your gear to give a new look to your arsenal as you go to war with other Factions.

You will also experience deep lore and storyline involving all the characters within The Bornless universe, which will be revealed as facts are discovered by players.

title: Abyss Delvers
description: Abyss Delvers is an Online Action RPG. Adventure out alone or party up with your friends on an epic journey and fight the monstrous hordes of the Abyss. Featuring randomly generated campaigns, dungeons, items and more!

title: Christine
description: Christine is a young orphan who works at the Paris Opera, with an unexplored talent for singing. If history sometimes repeats itself, will an Angel of Music help her to achieve her dreams?

title: Candela
description: Manipulate colors and conquer challenging puzzles in this mysterious 2D platformer set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the overworld, uncover hidden secrets, and bring light to this dark, desolate land

title: Droid Escape
description: In this adventure, help Droid 07 to overcome challenges, discover mysteries and free your friend from the miniaigas.

title: Dagada's Story
description:
Dive into the depths of a snowy world in this adventure game. Explore a mountain where a tribe of strange creatures, the Daoudaounes, lives among ancient ruins, while seeking answers to the mysteries that surround you.

Dagada's Story is a Puzzle-platformer game inspired by Super Nintendo-era games. This adventure emphasizes the balance between exploration, platforming, and puzzle-solving, with responsive controls and beautiful storytelling.

Particular attention has been given to the creation of the universe and each of its graphical, sound, and game design elements. The animation aims to be smooth and lively, reminiscent of pixel art from such game as Yoshi's island or the Super Mario bros series ...

title: Ardenfall
description: Ardenfall is a first-person RPG set in a world of intricate politics and ancient cultures. Explore rain-drenched wetlands and forgotten dungeons full of danger. Meet countless interesting characters with unique dialog and quests, and leave your mark on this mysterious world.

title: Mars Tactics
description: Classic turn-based tactical combat with some modern twists. Use stress to manage RNG. Master advanced suppression mechanics. Grow troops who develop abilities, personalities & relationships based on what happens in battle. Procedural, destructible maps. Realistic bullet physics.

title: Killbot General
description: Satisfying real-time tactics packed in 5-minute battles. Create a customized cause and lead it to glory as its hero Killbot General in the crazy, dynamic story campaign for single-player or co-op. Simple yet deep, controller-friendly, with emphasis on strategy, not micromanagement.

title: Our Life: Now & Forever
description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

title: Showa American Story
description: Showa American Story is a brand new RPG and an enthusiastic love letter to the 80s' pop culture that features a strong taste of B-Movies. Follow Choko's journey of truth and revenge across North America as she grows stronger.

title: Recursor
description: An action roguelite inspired by platform fighters

title: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
description: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen as he attempts to romance girls based on e-book tutorials. Will desperation win out in this desire for love, or will knowledge, patience, and logic pave the way to success?

title: Crystals of Irm
description: Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.

title: Townseek
description:
Townseek is a relaxing exploration-trading game where you embark on a journey across the world of Explora and discover the lost legacy of Sir Reginald Sharkingston! Discover exotic landmarks, trade with faraway towns, fish, mine, and farm as you complete your journal and make a name for yourself!

The whole world is your sea now, so be sure to see all that it has to offer!

title: The Inspector
description: The Inspector is a short-form first-person adventure about exploring the human mind. As an Inspector, you have the delicate task of investigating the human mind in search of those elements that will bring our loved ones back to life

title: Fragile Existence
description: Take command of the last surviving fleet of humankind in Fragile Existence, a sci-fi RTS with fully 3D planet surfaces and vast solar systems to explore. Dispatch expeditions to find resources, build settlements, construct vital parts and supplies, and evolve your technology to meet new threats.

title: Potata: Foxy Tale
description: Potata: Foxy Tale is a fairy tale themed platformer adventure game in a beautiful world of dark forests. Your goal is to restore the balance and assemble the fragments of the Woodland Spirit.

title: Island of Winds
description:
Island of Winds takes you to 17th century Iceland, plunging them into a magical world teeming with trolls, giant spiders, and mythical creatures. Experience all of this through the eyes of the magic-wielding Brynhild, a member of the Balance Keepers who draws her magical power from the natural world.

Brynhild's journey has her on a quest to find her mentor, Hrymja, that will take her through nine incredible landscapes that draw on Iceland's stunning natural beauty. These locations range from the fiery Lava of Skjól to the treacherous Jökla lagoon and gleaming Obsidian Shore. Brynhild will face legendary creatures on her journey, such as the powerful and majestic Bear King, Hafgúfa - Guardian of the Sea and the majestic elven lady Vör of the Oasis.

title: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
description: "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story" is an action-adventure platformer following the story of a failing musician named Sondro, who must seek and recover the wish-granting Mystic Orbs to repay his debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Can he find them before the many rogues of Sunova beat him to the punch?

title: Determinant
description: Post-apocalyptic physics-based open-world survival adventure game. Planned to include combat, base building, crafting, puzzles, survival and a compelling story to drive it. Building will be a core gameplay mechanic where you build structures to overcome challenges and solve puzzles in the world.

title: Wandering Wolf
description: Survival-Action experience in a dead world destroyed by civil war. You have to complete your own story, fighting for survival with monsters and nature.

title: Rules of Alchemy
description: Defy fate as you blast your way through a procedural open world, in this spell combo roguelike with thousands of items and hundreds of spells.

title: The Mysterious Cat Tower
description: A turn-based J/W/GRPG. Find spells to add to your arsenal, pick impactful talents, tune your attributes, acquire powerful allies, freely reset your build and try something new. Find your own way to play as you experience the harsh life of the strongest pussy in Brazil.

title: Super/Human Identity
description: An RPG/Visual Novel hybrid where your choices affect both your own fate and the fates of your companions. Dynamic relationship system, romances (LGBTQIA+ or straight), and Quick Time Event superhero action.

title: Check x Mate
description: A fantasy visual novel set in a magical world of chess. Gameplay consists mainly of decision making and chess puzzles that represent what is happening in the story. There is a beginner difficulty for those new to chess and expert difficulty for those who seek more of a challenge.

title: Explory Story
description: Play as a world famous detective who is stuck inside one of his own works! Be careful and watch your step. The words on the page can come to life.

title: Jury Trial
description: In this law simulation RPG you join a group of innocence lawyers. Set in a fictional country deeply divided by racial profiling, prejudice and social injustice it’s your job to find a jury who’s willing to listen. Study case material, discover new evidence and convince the jury in the court of law.

title: Midnight Laundry
description: Midnight Laundry is a short first-person horror game where a long night at the laundromat takes an unexpected turn.

title: Yuha's Nightmares
description: This is a simulation game about the nightmares that our main character Yuha suffers from. You will explore the surrealistic world that is full of unexpected events. The deeper part of Yuha's consciousness is depicted through the flip side of the 3D world.

title: Mad Chess
description: Mermaids, Angels and Dragons join the classic game of Chess as 3 additional factions with their own units and abilities. Madness? No, this is Mad Chess!

title: Synthalgia: Retro Arcade Racing
description: No checkpoint timers — FUEL is your clock. Speed and danger keep you alive. Chase down tankers and cargo trucks to refuel and upgrade. Score big across miles of scenic highways and become #1 on the leaderboard!

title: HeartLinks: A Puzzle Called Love
description: Solve puzzles with the power of friendship! Each student you befriend gives you a unique item that lets you unlock new areas and explore a wacky anime school! To deliver a confession to your crush, can you clear every obstacle? Can you overcome your feelings? Can you solve the puzzle called love?

title: Building Relationships
description: Roll, jump, and dash around as a house on a date in this silly adventure game. Meet eccentric structures, romance eligible bachelorx pads, and uncover the meaning of life... or you could go fishing instead (though we replaced the fish with cars to make more sense).

title: SacriFire
description: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

title: Eden.schemata();
description: EDEN.schemata(); is a multi-ending sci-fi mystery adventure game, featuring headless corpses, a sealed laboratory, a limbless android suspect/heroine, and an amnesiac protagonist. The game design and gradually UI change in reflection of your actions.

title: Insect Worlds
description: Immerse yourself in the world of insects. Explore fascinating forests and learn about their way of life. Complete quests and mini-games, fight or collect resources and cards. Admire the microcosm from a completely different perspective and learn new facts about plants and insects.

title: Meteora
description: Be a meteor in a constant race for survival in a young and chaotic universe by dodging, chasing & taking down other meteors in Meteora. Power up, strategize and put your skills to the test in our spectacular arcade combat racer!

title: Eternity Guards
description: The main idea of the game is a fantasy alternative to Valhalla. Scandinavian mythology is a thematic focus - the same style, ornaments and atmosphere where heroes fight for a place in eternity, there will be only one.

title: Gravity Blasters
description: Gravity Blasters is a fast, fun and addictive multiplayer artillery action game that is recreating the classic artillery style of aiming and shooting by adjusting the angle and power.

title: Pocket Wheels
description: Pocket Wheels isn't just a racing game, it's an objective-based 3D platformer. Take a seat in various toy cars with special abilities and explore a house full of themed rooms filled with collectibles, objectives and race tracks!

title: Disc Creatures World
description: Embark on a grand adventure through a world full of mysteries, uncovering ‘Discs’ to collect your own party of creatures! Engage in strategic battles, enjoy an assortment of collectables, and meet unique characters along the way. A monster taming RPG with a blend of nostalgia and novelty!

title: Treasure Islands
description: Help Nick and Pippa find a selection of new artefacts and exhibits for the Grand Museum in an exciting adventure across a number of islands, each with their own quirks, characters and strange events!

title: Heart of Muriet
description: Unique voxel fantasy real-time strategy. Experience the land of Muriet and reunite your family in this epic real-time strategy game! It's a game for people who love RTS games, but intense micromanagement stops them from playing.

title: Your World
description: Create beautiful multiplayer worlds, games, simulators, and theme parks with this easy-to-use sandbox title.

title: Divided Land
description: Join the fight for survival in a vast medieval open world. Explore, hunt, craft powerful gear, raid and plunder enemy villages, or forge your own path. As darkness falls, the dead awaken—prepare your defenses or seek shelter. Join allies in co-op PvE or test your skills in savage PvP.

title: Skyclimbers
description: Build your kingdom, choose your class, and tame monsters in this Multiplayer City-Building/Open-World Action RPG that takes place in a procedurally generated anime-themed metaverse.

title: The Cabbage Effect
description: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter on procedurally generated stages that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

title: RevenBlade
description: RevenBlade is team-based third-person hero shooter with MOBA elements and a focus on melee combat with fast-paced action and mechanical outplays.

title: The Pope: Power & Sin
description: Take on the role of the Pope, strengthen the authority of the Church State, fight for spiritual and political independence from pagans and the renewal of church structures. The rule of Pope is a torrent of numerous scandals, excesses and signs of moral corruption in the authorities of the Church.

title: Neverlooted Dungeon
description: Venture deep into the Neverlooted Dungeon and face its treacherous, deadly traps. Armed with your creativity, trusty weapon and magical items, find your own ways to outsmart the dangers in a highly immersive world. Be careful, become paranoid, be the first to loot!

title: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant
description: Trade, traverse, and earn coins in this strategy merchant game set in a handcrafted world shaped by secrets and volatile markets. Join Viia, the fox merchant, as she defies the mighty Basilisk Company in the hunt for the truth behind the Golden Merchant.

title: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
description: While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive, but properly manage time, space and energy to achieve the goal.

title: The Lewd Knight
description: Help the girl - a superhero in the fight against evil

title: Rune Fencer Illyia
description: Rune Fencer Illyia is an intense, atmospheric action-platformer with a heavy focus on exploration and combat. Traverse an enormous and dangerous world, meet strange allies, and outfight your numerous foes with fast-paced swordplay and stolen runic magic.

title: Last Moon
description: The Moon is falling, malicious creatures appear, the world falls in chaos! Last Moon is an Action-RPG greatly inspired by the mythical titles from the 90s! Explore a mesmerizing, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers, face tainted creatures and upgrade your abilities in a classic hand-drawn 2D style.

title: The Way of Wrath
description: The Way of Wrath is a story-driven turn-based tactical RPG set in an ancient world governed by shamanistic laws. You explore the beautifully handcrafted landscape, rebuild defences of an old fort, take on quests and unite war torn people against the imminent wrath of enemy forces. Will you lead with an iron fist, diplomacy or trickery is up to you, but with every choice you make be prepared to face the consequences.

title: Port Valley
description: Port Valley is a (not so) classic Point & Click game where a certain choice changes everything. Witness 3 points of view of the same story and find out what's really going on during Port Valley's Election Day!

title: Witchbrook
description: Experience the thrills and pitfalls of school-life in Witchbrook! Discover a spellbinding isometric pixel art world full of charm and intrigue in this richly detailed magical school and town life simulator.

title: Infinitesimals
description: Infinitesimals is a story-driven, 3rd person action adventure where you play as tiny aliens who stand only 1mm tall. Though a diminutive species, they are technologically advanced and space faring.

title: Rest Stop
description: Abandoned and alone at a highway rest stop in the middle of the Appalachian Mountains, the night breeze begins to caress your cheek. The scent of wet pine whispers that you’re home. The taste of iron in your mouth reminds you that you can’t stay here forever.

title: Wishknot
description: You've fallen into an endless wishing well, with nothing but a rope and far too much momentum. Swing, snare and squash to survive in this difficult physics platformer with roguelite runs and secrets worth falling for.

title: Power Racing Bundle 4
description: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!

title: Gnom
description: Build and defend a settlement with an increasing number of gnomes. Gnomes chop wood, build things, and fight. Some become giants. Some become nanognomes. There are 52 buildings and 900 tech tree perks. The gnomes have options.

title: Outvote
description: Outvote is a free online party game about the people you play with. Every round asks one question – everyone answers yes or no in secret, then guesses how the room voted: estimate the share of yes votes, or call every single player's answer. The closer you get, the more points. Play with Steam friends or join in any web browser at outvote.de with a room code – crossplay between Steam and browser, up to 20 players. A streamer mode lets viewers play along from the browser and scores them separately, and community question packs or your own custom questions keep every round fresh.

title: Beyblade X Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol.9
Beyblade X Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol.10
Sunsoft is Back! Retro Game Selection 2
description: The "bad game" classic is back! Mysteries to unravel! The second installment in the “Retro Game Selection” series is here. Includes four classic titles ranging from major Sunsoft hits to hidden gems. New save and rewind features! Find rare never-before-seen game materials in Gallery Mode!

title: Sakurairo Prism: Beyond the Bloom
description: A coming-of-age romance visual novel set in a disbanded high school photography club. Three fully voiced heroines — a childhood friend, a playful junior, a mysterious senior. As love refracts like a prism, what will Hikaru's camera capture? A remake of Sakurairo Prism. "You can always start over."

title: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
description: Dominate the lanes in PBA Pro Bowling 2027! Customize your bowler’s unique style and arsenal with in-depth ball mechanics and Perks. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode and Online Leagues, and defend your title in Online Tournaments and Ranked Play. This is where champions are made.

title: Sakura no Uta: To Dance Over the Cherry Blossoms
description: SCA-DI's award-winning visual novel masterpiece is finally available in English and in full HD! Sakura no Uta is a story of those whose paths stop short—and of those who walk on.

title: Demon With a Candy Crisis
description: A quick and easy 3d platformer playing as a demon that needs to quench its thirst for candy. Travel through hell to get to the surface to find someone's secret stash of candy.

title: Hunter From Hell
description: With your friends, form a team of paranormal experts to unravel the mysteries of the most terrifying places. Armed with sophisticated gadgets like EMF detectors, infrared cameras, and incantation books, your mission is simple: gather evidence of the beyond and survive chilling encounters.

title: Whispers From Below
description: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, two detectives investigate their mentor's disappearance. With different visions of their surroundings and a shell as their only tool and bond between them, they must cooperate to solve the puzzles, unravel the cult's story, and make it out alive.

title: Fall off Reach
description: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

title: Mystic Cleaver
description: Wield a long cleaver in a deadly world filled with zombie hordes. Master perfect timing and combo attacks to survive. The game features a unique faded art style, blending cold weapon combat and intense action. Each slash is polished for a smooth and impactful gaming experience.

title: Talk Of The Tavern
description: A co-op autobattler roguelike where rival guilds journey toward the King’s castle, stopping at taverns to outbid each other for mercenaries and shape their builds with powerful scrolls. Survive the road and conquer the King’s Tournament.

title: Narnok: Little Bean Glandoid
description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

title: Carpet Daddy
description: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this first-person cleaning simulator. Vacuum, pre-spray, agitate and extract with professional tools, treat stubborn stains, and move furniture to reach every dirty corner.

title: MMOS: MMO Simulator
description: Build and run your own fantasy MMO in a single-player management sim. Design the world, classes, loot and raids, then watch simulated adventurers play, form guilds and chase rare drops. Keep them happy, keep them subscribed, and decide what your MMO needs next.

title: Ladder Knight
description: A small hero, a trusty ladder, and a world full of trouble. Explore strange lands, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and face mighty bosses in this pixel-art platformer. Put your ladder to work in ways it was never built for.

title: GreeDrill
description: You owe the Company $2,000,000. Pay it back in ore. A push-your-luck mining roguelike: drill deeper for a bigger payout, surface before the hull cracks, outrun the Bailiff and face the five Guardians of the deep.

title: Parasite Core
description: Buy time to harvest resources in this incremental tower defense game where you defend your core from the native species that want you off their home! Play actively and unleash your abilities, or idle and let your turrets take care of the pests.

title: Dibaro: CryptoHunter Dice Battle Royal
description: Online battles for up to 6 players. Roll dice, command Fire, Water, Earth and Wind mana, and clash on a hex board where six factions fight at once. Affinity settles every attack, and reordering your mana is deckbuilding. Raise over 60 Hunters across Challenge, Survival and hidden-role Demon & Hero.

title: Down to Floor Zero
description: Down to Floor Zero is a survival horror experience set in an unreasonably large hotel. Your only means of transportation is an elevator that can solely go down. Each floor may host useful items and structures, as well as horrors beyond comprehension. Try to reach the ground floor intact.

title: That Mountain Needs to Fall
description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

title: Just Until Morning
description: Just Until Morning is a first-person horror game set during a single night shift at a 24-hour rural gas station. From 23:00 to 07:00 the player serves customers at the register, restocks shelves, takes out the trash, resets a faulty pump and watches four CCTV feeds that sometimes show people who are not there in person. There is no health bar: unanswered calls and ignored camera intrusions put the station's lamps out one by one, and a station left too dark ends the shift early. A full night takes about 80 minutes and can end in seven different ways.

title: Dorifto!
description: Push your car to the limit of grip and chase perfect lap times on winding back roads where drifting isn't just a technique, it's the only way to drive!

title: Find Kittens 13: Cave Town
description: Light your lantern, traveler, for a journey into the depths of the earth awaits you! What are you waiting for?! Explore and find cute cats to fill this black-and-white world with different colors.

title: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
description:
Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded is an arcade-style beat ’em up that combines baseball and martial arts, this action game has players battling through side-scrolling stages with pitches, swings, grabs, throws, combos, and special attacks. Up to four players can team up in shared-screen co-op to reclaim a stolen trophy.

Expanding on the original arcade release, the game adds a playable character, new stages, an arranged mode with revised enemy layouts, minigames, and newly arranged music alongside the original soundtrack.

title: Caladrius 2: Dark Element
description: A dark gothic world ruled by beauty and darkness... Over a decade after its debut, the infamous Shame Break system returns. Discover striking characters brought to life by acclaimed illustrators, and master enhanced Element Shot and Shame Break systems in this exhilarating 2D bullet-hell shooter.

title: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
description: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career simulator set in an original fictional universe. Create a prospect, choose a College, International, or Pro path, shape skills and mentality through RPG decisions, and earn a role through performance, form, and consistency. Play or simulate games in the Live 2D Match Center while teams, rosters, markets, standings, playoffs, records, contracts, coaches, agents, sponsors, injuries, media pressure, and national-team selections evolve across multiple seasons.

title: Dice Mice
description: Dice Mice is an fast paced arcade puzzle game inspired by classic 90s gameplay. Score massive combos or better yet, steal them from your opponents. Choose a mouse and roll some dice.

title: Attack on Titan 3
description: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

title: Railway End
description: This is a hidden object puzzle game with a railway theme. Compare photos and correct differences in the scene, interspersed with a few puzzles. There is no text in the game.

title: Stage Tour
description: Stage Tour is a rhythm-action game that blends familiar, accessible note-highway gameplay with exciting modern twists. It’s poised to rekindle the flame of plastic-instrument rhythm gaming with new features and modes, diverse bandmates and instruments, competitive depth, and seasonal events.

title: Hakuoki Ibun: Berezinskii no Majo
description: A new Hakuoki game for Nintendo Switch, set in 19th century Europe.

title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
description:
Professor Layton and the New World of Steam depicts the world one year after the events of "Professor Layton and the Unwound Future".

Due to a mysterious incident in Steam Bison, a new adventure for Layton and Luke begins!

title: Ultracapitalism
description:
Ultracapitalism is a company-building roguelike autobattler where corporate greed is weaponized into deterministic combat.

Pick a founder, survive fiscal years of questionable business decisions, and assemble a 10-slot Board of Assets — unpaid interns, offshore tax havens, union busters, automated server racks, AI agents, and more. Then sit back and watch your corporate engine auto-battle rival corporations to the death.

title: Adventures in Tower Defence Land
description: Go on an epic tower defence adventure collecting rare parts and craft the ultimate combination of towers while meeting silly characters on your way.

title: Pup & Mole: Gold Rush
description: Join Pup & Mole on a cozy mining adventure across 7 historical areas. Hop into your minecart, build rail tracks, and dig deeper for hidden artifacts. Upgrade your gear, unlock new tools, and complete your collection while earning money by selling gold and rare treasures.

title: Tiny RTS
description: Tiny RTS is a 2D Pixel Real time Strategy game revolving around multiple factions that all have different Playstyles

title: Pond Thing
description: PondThing is a micro-horror narrative puzzle game. It mainly tells the story of the narcissistic youth Shen Qingheng who, after being drawn into a sacrificial ritual, gradually becomes numb and collapses mentally, only to be ultimately saved by his familys love.

title: Diorama Tactics
description: Diorama Tactics is a strategic roguelite auto-battler inspired by fantasy board games. Players build a team of unique units, place them on a grid-based battlefield, and watch them fight automatically. Each unit has different strengths, roles, and abilities, while positioning and team composition determine the outcome of battles. Players progress through increasingly difficult encounters, collect new units, and face different enemy factions and powerful bosses.

title: The Cardian: Light the Shrines
description: The Cardian is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding card-defense game where positioning is everything. Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and set your cards in advance. See the future, outsmart the swarm, and defend the last Shrines of Light!

title: Guns of Eschaton
description: The worlds first soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-opgo West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

title: Drunken Goddess Reflux
description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

title: The Glued
description: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

title: The Edutainment Vortex Diner
description: It's time to make learning fun, with sandwiches and smalltalk at the Edutainment Vortex Diner, in retro PC game style! Take classes from ageless and immortal teachers. Get good grades or embrace your inner bratty problem child! Unpack the mystery of this cosmic eatery and perhaps you'll inherit their burdens.

title: Desktop Drill
description: Every keypress fires up your drill! Desktop Drill turns your typing into a mining adventure that lives on your desktop. Blast through blocks, unearth rare resources, and unlock new drill parts as you dig deeper with every key you press.

title: Slickwave
description: Slickwave is a dark-fantasy top-down action roguelite in which players shape a six-spell build while surviving 14 escalating waves inside the Moonlit Observatory. Spells branch at higher levels and can evolve when paired with the right relics, creating increasingly dense combinations against swarms, elite enemies, and bosses.

title: Unharvest
description: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows and upgrade your plagues as the land slowly dies. How far can the decay reach?

title: shatAAAAp!
description: Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction. Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

title: Abductables
description: An arcade game about abducting humans, turning them into alien human hybrids to make money and get the highest score possible.

title: Did You See That?
description: A 2 player psychological horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

title: Squid Hunt 1923
description: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

title: The Comyths
description: Stop, slow, and rewind time in a bullet-hell action game. The Comyths is a reality-bending character-driven game where you wield the fundamental forces of Space, Time, Matter, Life, Mind, and Void. Chase S-ranks, unlock art rewards, and uncover story logs.

title: The Industrial Council
description: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

title: Witch War I
description: Wage a war...with witches! Take control of islands one battlefield at a time in this team-based action roguelite. Play alone or with friends and become the last witch army standing!

title: Muri: Wildwoods
description: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

title: Planet No More
description: An arcade-incremental game where you DESTROY planets! Build a fleet, upgrade weapons, max out your skill tree and destroy your target slowly. You'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

title: Cult Crasher
description: Twenty years ago, Val Thorne's family was taken from her by a sinister cult. Now armed with nothing but her dad's old pistol and a fresh bottle of whiskey, she's vowed to get her revenge...

title: Gemheart Valley
description: Grow crystals instead of crops. Crack geodes with the most satisfying tap in cozy games, fill a museum with one-of-a-kind gems, befriend a mountain village (and one very determined rival), and bring a sleeping valley back to life, season by season.

title: A Game About Digging A Hole Together
description: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand.

title: James Pond Collection
description:
The James Pond Collection cartridge for Evercade brings together four classic 16-bit games starring the underwater secret agent:

- James Pond: Underwater Agent — Agent Double Bubble Seven dives beneath the waves to take on the dastardly Dr. Maybe in this environmentally-themed action game.
- James Pond 2: Codename RoboCod — Armed with a new Robosuit, James Pond leaps into action to rescue Santa's toy factories from Dr. Maybe in this colourful platformer.
- James Pond 3: Operation StarFI5H — James Pond blasts off on a lunar adventure to thwart Dr. Maybe's plan to mine the Moon's cheese.
- The Aquatic Games Starring James Pond and the Aquabats — James Pond and the Aquabats compete across 10 crazy events in this cartoony multi-sports title.

title: The Last Ninja & IK Collection
description:
The Last Ninja & IK Collection cartridge for Evercade brings together two of System 3's most celebrated series across their original home computer platforms (ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64, Atari ST):

- The Last Ninja — Take command of Armakuni the last ninja, seeking to avenge the assassination of his clan, in the original 8-bit release.
- Last Ninja 2: Back with a Vengeance — Armakuni's action-adventure continues in modern-day New York.
- Last Ninja 3 — The trilogy's conclusion, as Armakuni chases the evil Kunitoki through time to a final confrontation.
- Ninja Remix — A remixed version reimagining the first Last Ninja game with new gameplay.
- International Karate — The original one-on-one martial arts fighting classic.
- IK+ — The sequel adding a third combatant for free-for-all three-way karate battles.

Each title is included across its original ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64 and Atari ST versions.

title: Space Industry
description:
Manage your own modular space fleet by gathering resources, processing them, and expanding your fully automated drones.
Space Industry is a 2D space automation sandbox game in which players build and expand a modular spaceship, mine asteroids, automate production with drones, research new technologies and explore a galaxy filled with hostile fleets. The objective is to prepare the ship for humanity's most dangerous expedition: a journey to the black hole.

title: Town of Tinysville
description: Town of Tinysville is a deck building roguelike set on tiny maps with huge stakes. Strategically place buildings, grow your deck, and master powerful synergies. Enhance your run using unique chance cards, landmarks, and powerful laws that permanently affect your town.

title: Alien Archeologist
description: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

title: North Pole Workshop
description: Play as one of Santa’s elves to create, gift-wrap, and deliver toys. This 1-4 cooperative toy-making game can be completed at your own pace in easy difficulty(1 star). For more challenge and to test your team's coordination, you can attempt the harder timed difficulties (2-3 stars).

title: King's Haven
description: Build your deck, expand your kingdom, and defend your Haven! Recruit citizens, construct landmarks, and build powerful combos in this roguelike deckbuilder where each card is a citizen and each season brings new rewards, new threats, and new choices.

title: Death and Tactics
description: A post-apocalyptic turn-based strategy game where death is permanent and every decision counts. Experience unique events based on how you play, sell the organs of party members you don't like, transform your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

title: Acts of Blood
description: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandung, Indonesia.

title: Defenders of Cinderkeep
description: Defenders of Cinderkeep is a dark fantasy incremental auto-battler. Battle endless waves of orcs, demons, dragons, and other mythic creatures in defense of the last bastion of humanity. Upgrade your heroes and equip them with a variety of spells and powers to unleash upon the demonic hordes.

title: Click Bait
description: Click Bait is a rhythm roguelite where the worst monsters of the internet finally face justice, requiring you to master the art of timing your clicks around a continuous spinning wheel to defeat these online threats.

title: Sombras: Negative Frames
description: ‘Sombras: Negative Frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description: Traverse massive, fantastical landscapes and master seamless real-time RPG combat that has all been enhanced to run at 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

title: Rayman Legends Retold
description: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

title: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
description:
When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream.

Enjoy Rayman Origins like never before with 4K resolution, 60 FPS, and modern enhancements, including new quality-of-life features. Discover 60 hidden Relics across the adventure and track your progress in the Snoring Tree.

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
description: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the Dragon Quest series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

title: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots
description: A dwarf farm sim! The days of dragons'-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King has commissioned you to reclaim the ancient halls. Grow crops, harvest crystals, mine ores, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich your home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

title: Step Theater
description: Welcome to the "step theater". "Step theater" is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

title: Vanguard Valiants
description: Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

title: Freestyle Football 2
description: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
description: A story-driven, atmospheric thriller with pixel-art graphics and survival-horror elements. Short, intense, and unforgettable.

title: Akashic Slingshot
description: Fight your way through a diverse world in this action-adventure side scroller, where you are given one weapon and die in one hit. Can you earn the right to peer beyond the Zeroed Abyss?

title: Edge of Memories
description: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent.
