On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

title: Waltz and Jam
description: Waltz is a pure and innocent soul who awoke in Downtown, and Jam is the lovable dog who was there waiting. Join them on this amazing and heartwarming journey.

title: Aeterna Lucis
description: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

title: Fall Up
description: Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

title: Fieldmade
description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

title: Tidy Up the Backrooms
description: An organizing simulator about sorting found footage and research video tapes recovered from The Backrooms. Transform a chaotic mess into a neatly organized archive. But be careful - you are not alone!

title: System 21
description: Manipulate a blackjack game from the inside as a dealer subroutine in this minimalist roguelike deckbuilder. Read the visible card's queue, execute illegal code exploits to alter the upcoming cards, and fleece high-rolling patrons before the system anti-cheat detects your anomaly.

title: Sheeple
description: Cast cards to turn the tides of the battlefield, gather your army, and fight to regain The Original Sheep! Sheeple is a grand real time Auto battler with roguelike and deck-building elements.

title: Night Machine
description: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

title: Drop Dead Party
description: Drop Dead Party is a chaotic 2-4 players PvP arena of a bomb tag. Pass the ticking bomb before you explode, drop dirty power-ups on your friends, and survive fast-paced chaotic circus rounds. Invite your Steam squad and ruin your group chat!

title: Room Movers
description: Room Movers is a cozy two-player online co-op game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama workplaces such as a café, a flower shop and a dentist's office. Small boxes can be opened alone, while big boxes and heavy furniture need both players to grab an end and pull together. There is no grid and nothing snaps into place: every item is moved by hand with physics. There is no score, no timer and no fail state. When both players press Done, the camera circles the finished room and hands them a polaroid that is added to an album on the menu wall and can be saved to the desktop.

title: Rejoin Me After Brexit
description: An adult romance visual novel about Owen Pascoe, a struggling English coach operator sent across the Channel on a civic errand. Choose one of three distinct routes as a herring fair, a hungry local paper, and two watchful towns turn private romance into public news.

title: Senti Metrica
description: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

title: The First Pixel
description: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

title: GigaStriker
description: GIGASTRIKER is a 3D football survivors-like where every goal sends enemies flying. Your striker kicks automatically as you dodge swarms, slide-tackle through crowds and stack upgrades into devastating builds. Recruit teammates, take down bosses and unlock new strikers for your next run.

title: Ink and Lore
description: A 99-floor roguelike of cards that vanish the moment they're played. Lead two guardians of living stationery into a picture book someone stopped drawing. Your cards are finite—choosing when to spend them is life or death. And at the end of the world waits the one who—

title: Noël Macabre
description: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

title: Echoes of Another Sky
description: Echoes of Another Sky is a fantasy action role-playing game about a boy and a talking bell exploring thirteen skies. Combat combines action combos with tuning-fork magic.

title: Super-Type
description: Super-Type is a brutal keyboard-driven arcade score attack game. Use the entire range of keys to target multiple threats at once, and try to survive an invasion escalating faster than you can control.

title: Trash to Trees: Tidy Up the Forest!
description: A cozy first-person nature restoration game. Explore a polluted forest, collect litter, sort it at the recycling station, and watch the world come back to life, one piece of trash at a time. Solo or co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator
description: Transform messy homes into cozy, beautifully organized spaces. Clean up, arrange every room, and place objects wherever you want—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and make every home feel just right.

title: Zaploopa 4040
description: Zaploopa is a post-apocalyptic dark humor competition game show. Set in 4040, in space. You are the contestants. An online 3D party game for up to 8 players: complete outrageous fill-in-the-blank sentences, vote for the funniest, sabotage your rivals with jokers. No place for snowflakes here.

title: That Corridor in the Backrooms
description: Descend into the Backrooms. Walk through an infinite yellow corridor. Inspect the doors and try to find a way out.

title: Desktop Rave
description: Desktop Rave is an audio-reactive desktop companion and idle management game. Use your own music to drive the in-game economy and create your own unique club.

title: Elf Shift
description: Only 4 real time days left until Christmas. Flawlessly pack 10,000 toys, unlock new products, and improve your skills to speed up the production line. Deliver the boxes on time, don't get too curious about the weird things happening around you, and most importantly... do not anger Santa.

title: Void Skirmisher
description: Void Skirmisher is an arcade co-op shooter for up to 8 players: jump the gate before the front line even exists, and face down hostile fleets as the first wave out where nobody's been before.

title: Books & Blood
description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic bookstore in this horror game. Fetch books for your customers to complete your daily quota. Explore the abandoned bookstore, and don't get caught by the horrors stalking the shelves.

title: The Sky Project: Land of Noris
description: Hand-drawn monster collector where every creature lost might be gone forever. Explore four unique planes and train 200+ mana creatures.

title: Snackrifice
description: Feed a hungry demon overlord in this 1-4 player roguelike dungeon crawler. Adapt to perilous curses, craft powerful relics and overcome the many faces of Purgatory.

title: Call of Blood
description:
The game takes place in 2009-2011.

Call of Blood is a cinematic single-player first-person shooter that immerses you in a gritty survival experience. The world is engulfed in a zombie outbreak, but the walking dead are far from your only problem.

You became the most wanted target after eliminating an influential politician who launched three dangerous reactors that could kill half of humanity.

Now, regular groups of enemies and elite operatives from the (Vurs) are hunting your head. A group of scientists is the only key to salvation. They offer you the dangerous deal of a lifetime: break through the cordon and blow up the sinister reactors from the inside.

title: Meltdown Crew
description: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

title: Last Train to Yotsuya
description: Last Train to Yotsuya is a short first-person narrative experience. Explore different locations, observe your surroundings, and interact with the objects around you to gradually uncover a personal story through the details and events of the journey.

title: Tinker's Nook
description: Own and run a workshop in a steampunk fantasy world! Craft, fix and sell items to make a living while meeting countless townsfolk and listen to their stories.

title: Graven
description: A Frankenstein-inspired Gothic RPG. You’re an eccentric physician’s apprentice whose unique skills (and shortcomings) shape every conversation. Explore the city, follow leads, and find your missing mentor and the man you helped raise from the dead. Save them, condemn them, or alter death itself.

title: DNA Nemesis
description: Survive in the wildest Battle Royale! Choose from 10 animal species, each with its own unique ability based on its natural attack and defence mechanisms. Master an extreme experience and become the ultimate species. In DNA NEMESIS there are no heroes; only predators and prey.

title: Dumpster Gang
description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

title: Groundwork
description: The humans are coming. Someone has to get the place ready. Scan what grows here, gather and mine. Repair the robots from crashed ships, and they'll teach you new recipes and take over jobs. Build a new home for the humans, and a home for the robots you found. No combat, no timer, no fail screen.

title: Kaperfahrt
description:
Kaperfahrt is an open world pirate sandbox set in a simulated Caribbean during the age of sail. Around 200 AI captains sail, trade and wage their own wars independently of the player, so conflicts and trade routes exist whether the player takes part in them or not.

Players engage in naval combat, board and capture enemy vessels, and command a fleet of up to four ships that fight in formation. Trade runs between five rival houses whose economy reacts to player actions, so blockading a harbour shifts prices across the map. A bounty list of 23 named pirates, each with their own crew and fighting style, forms the long term goal.

Kaperfahrt is developed by Kleinod Games, a one person studio from Germany, and is built in Godot.

title: Hacking Into Erebus
description:
Hacking Into Erebus is a hacking game centered on taking control of a spacecraft named USS Erebus.

The ship is stranded on a remote alien planet. The crew is in cryogenic sleep. The player physically navigates inside the ship using robots while simultaneously gaining access to its network systems. The ship's central operating system, ARIA, protects the system but operates aggressively against the player.

The player must manage robots and interact with panels and terminals to successfully take control of the ship's systems.

title: Wizalign
description: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.

title: Goodnight, B
description: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore various environments, meet wacky characters, find secrets, and wall-jump your way towards that coveted midnight snack.

title: No Elevator
description: A claustrophobic guy refuses elevators and climbs a massive building.

title: Affictionate
description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.

title: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
description: Dive into a world consumed by the biblical apocalypse. As a fallen priest seeking redemption, battle demonic horrors, cleanse the tormented, and gather what remains to rebuild the Sanctuary of Ash - the faint light in a dying world.

title: SpringTale
description: Explore, fight and play together in a roguelike platformer MMO. Adventure through changing worlds, meet other players along the way and team up to take on challenging bosses. Collect powerful gear that shapes how you play.

title: Skate Mates
description: A chaotic multiplayer skating game where each player controls one skate! Only epic teamwork and swift communication will get you through the brutal obstacle course! Dodge the blades, jump the canyons, and avoid the lava, because one mistake sends you all the way back.

title: Pistol Cat
description: A cat. A gun. Recoil-powered movement, leg kicks, and a fart thruster. Shoot your way through a living open world town, smash everything in sight, and survive the Blood Moon: all as a small, physics-driven cat with a big pistol.

title: Salmon
description: SALMON is a speedrunning platformer game with ridiculously satisfying movement that really shouldn’t be possible for a salmon.

title: Moto Trial Turbo
description: Moto Trial Turbo is a physics-based 2D arcade motorcycle trial game. Players can look forward to exciting tracks, devious traps, secrets, and even player-created levels! Complete challenging tracks against the clock and compete with players from around the world on the leaderboards.

title: Fishing Fever
description: An incremental roguelike fishing game. Start with one tool, end with five. Draft, upgrade and stack them, then hunt 70 species across eight oceans until the whole sea is biting at once. Rivals steal your cards. Something in the dark already knows your name. One more round. Always one more round.

title: Oogies Chicken Quest
description: A short, quirky 3D action adventure where Oogie sets out to find his legendary chicken, Cluck Cluck, who lays diamond eggs. Explore small open worlds , solve puzzles, battle odd enemies, and uncover hidden secrets in vibrant levels!

title: Bold: Networked Newt Action
description: Bold: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

title: You Will Fall
description: A brutal vertical parkour game where every fall costs real progress. No checkpoints. And now the water is rising. Master momentum, learn the map, find faster routes, and climb before everything below you disappears.

title: They Are Rising
description: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

title: Swifty
description: A fast-paced 2D platformer where speed, precision, and perfect timing are key. Dodge traps, master challenging levels, and become the ultimate "Swifty".

title: Hag's Hand
description: A tower defense game that blends Brazilian folklore myths with card management. Protect the forest by summoning the creatures that dwell within the wilds. As invaders push deeper into the untamed woods, the witch Cuca merely watches their movement, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

title: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
description: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advents calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this cute HOG by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cats game creator!

title: Merry Crisis
description: Three loves. One week. Zero chill. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you’re headed?

title: Omertà: Mafia Novel
description: Noir visual novel set in 1950s New York. Infiltrate a prison, build a smuggling network, and shape fates through tough choices across branching paths.

title: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued
description: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is a courtroom simulation RPG where every trial is a battle of wits. You’ll take on the role of Harold Beagll, a golden retriever attorney navigating a legal system filled with sharp-tongued rivals, eccentric clients, and unpredictable witnesses.

title: Chronal Chain
description: "TIME CONTROL" bullet hell action. Overcome impossible odds by slowing, stopping and rewinding time!

title: Patricide
description: Patricide is an adventure RPG about girls who killed their father. It features a story of love and hate, hybrid action and turn-based combat, and cute anime-style heroines. Master the "emotion system" to weaken enemies through empathy, and survive a ruthless, suffocating modern society.

title: One More Tower
description: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

title: Slide Soldiers
description: Slide Soldiers is a cozy sliding puzzle game where you aim for the enemies instead of reaching the exit. Play at your own pace and discover the perfect path in 5,000 levels. Pick your targets and plan your moves, cause once you start sliding, there’s no stopping!

title: Silicone Heart
description: Survive on a junkyard planet filled with broken robots, machinery, and resources in this adventure sandbox game. Recycle resources, repair robots, invent items, create new plant species, grow them, and uncover the mysteries of this planet.

title: SweetCanvas
description: An untimely transfer. An unexpected encounter. A chance meeting between two students sets in motion a chain of events that will fundamentally change both of their lives... Or, perhaps, just their love life!

title: Blitzpoint
description: A minimalist modern military strategy tower defense game where you build and defend a forward operating base. Strategically place defenses, manage resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies. Build by day, defend by night, and command your forces in fast-paced, action-packed gameplay.

title: Rise of Fati
description: Step into the mythical world of "Rise of Fati," an epic adventure game where ancient African folklore and legends come to life. Embark on a journey with Fati, a young and brave warrior destined to restore peace and harmony to her homeland. Explore rich landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and battle formidable foes as you uncover the secrets of your heritage.

title: Former Dawn
description:
After a failed terraforming mission on an exoplanet light years from Earth, humanity dies out but leaves behind a child species(called the “Formers”) that forgets its own origin. You play a common hunter who rediscovers the truth and struggles against the faceless Organization which will stop at nothing to defeat you. Along the way, you recruit a motley crew of brave Formers who are willing to risk everything for Justice.

Former Dawn is, in a nutshell, a story of discovery, resistance to evil, and exploration of the human condition. The world is rich, the plot complex, and the characters dynamic and multi-dimensional.

title: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

title: Black Mesa: Classic
description:
This is a GoldSource project aimed to recreate Black Mesa: Source feel within Half-LIfe 1 and its assets.

Our main goals for this project is to give a new feel, look to the original Half-Life, with adding more features, improved level design that many people love from Black Mesa remake but with additional things, to make it a bit more unique. Black Mesa: Classic aims to be capabile on any PC without high requiremnts, with better visuals and effects to make your Half-Life 1 campaign experience the best!

title: Shadow Mate
description: A horror action adventure game in which you work with Belial, a life form that has possessed the body of a young girl named Cynthia, to escape from a mysterious laboratory.

title: Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories
description: Immerse yourself in The Neverending Check-In: The Hotel Stories, a pixel RPG filled with mystery, quests, cats, humor and life universe. Rebuild a once-glorious hotel and uncover its secret past in this captivating journey of deep plots, lively characters, and abundant quests.

title: Knights Province
description:
Become medieval lord. Build and defend your town. Train your army. Conquer the enemies.

Knights Province is intended to be an old-school RTS game. Unlike many modern RTS games, which are fast-paced and often are more about tactics, KP planned to emphasize on “strategy” component. Slower-paced gameplay, base-building, resources collection and processing, in-depth strategic choices, variety of resources and units, attention to details.

title: The Previous Owner
description: Run a secondhand bookshop in London, 1994. Every book remembers who owned it before pressed flowers, letters, notes in the margins. Across books that should never have met, the same hand keeps writing. You inherited the rules with the shop: shelve carefully, and do not read the margins.

title: Paint Gang
description: Mix colors by eye, race across a giant canvas, and try not to step in the wet paint. Paint Gang is a chaotic online co-op game for 1–4 painters where every masterpiece becomes a team-made disaster.

title: PixelHeroScramble Plus
description: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

title: Aposis: Infinity Hero
description: A sci-fi roguelike RPG about an agent from the past awakened deep inside the Cradle, a colossal AI-controlled megacity.

title: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
description: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

title: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket
description: 1 Billion chocolate bars! One golden ticket is hidden in a mountain of Winky chocolate bars. Open them, rewrap the chocolate as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell it. Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

title: Iskra
description: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

title: Sorcerous 2: City of Cults
description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

title: Sort My Pigs
description: Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn coins, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

title: Am I Nima
description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

title: Fool's Trigger
description:
Fool’s Trigger combines Russian roulette and card tactics in a deadly multiplayer game for up to six players.

Inspired by Buckshot Roulette, it puts a different spin on the formula: everyone acts simultaneously. Each player has cards, chips, and a revolver — the tools to outsmart opponents and knock them out of the game.

Bet on the outcome of other players’ shots, then spend your winnings on new cards and ammunition. Combine your actions, strike deals across the table, and betray your allies when the moment is right. With overlapping decisions and unexpected outcomes, every match can take a different turn.

Your goal is simple: be the last player at the table.

title: Happy Weekend
description: An all ages port of Happy Weekend

title: The Pogo Witch
description: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

title: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
description: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

title: Reshine
description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

title: Ghost Master: Resurrection - Sands of the Damned
Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou
description: Sprite's 15th anniversary game. A share house receives an odd purchase offer one day and, around the same time, a new girl with suspicious behavior moves in.

title: Appulse
description: Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.

title: Mix Dunk: King of Basketball
description: A new project in collaboration between B.LEAGUE’s professional basketball club Kawasaki Brave Thunders, the idol group AKB48, and the otome game brand Otomate.

title: Fireworks Incremental
description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

title: Turbo Turkey
description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

title: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
description: A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

title: Last Watchtower
description: A short tower defense game where you gather resources and survive waves of monsters. Spend your resources on a variety of upgrades to incrementally grow stronger. Experiment with different builds and discover powerful synergies.

title: A Drop of Magenta
description: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

title: Gothic 3 Classic
description: This overhauled console version of the Cult Classic RPG integrates the community patch 1.75 and further gameplay improvements, features tailor-made gamepad UI & controls and delivers advanced optimization to offer the smoothest Gothic 3 experience yet.

title: ArcaneBound
description: ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG. Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.

title: Hoard
description: Two goblins, six worlds, and a dragon's hoard at the end of the road. Forge keys, crack open chests, dodge (or slay) the mimics, and pour your gold into upgrades and goblin helpers. A short, funny idle adventure where every chest could be loot... or teeth.

title: Circuit Keep
description: Circuit Keep is a grid‑based tower defense game where players build and upgrade circuit‑themed defenses to repel escalating waves of intrusions. The game features a campaign of handcrafted lattices, a research system, and multiple enemy types with unique behaviors. Players manage resources, optimize layouts, and adapt to changing threats across increasingly complex maps.

title: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
description: Ancient customs vs. Detective Zomby—what could possibly happen? Investigate a tragedy caught on a VTuber’s livestream in a village frozen in midsummer. Dive into minds, connect testimony in your Journal, and crack the case in this comedy-mystery adventure.

title: The Debtician
description: Buy items to gain debt in this level-based Credit Card deckbuilder game!

title: Tanks Sweet Tanks
description: Tanks Sweet Tanks is a sugar sweet yet intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends.

title: Nightmare Conquest
description: Nightmare Conquest is a game focused on strategy, planning, and build creation. Assemble your team of monsters, position them intelligently, and evolve their abilities to face increasingly difficult challenges. Every decision matters — from the upgrades you choose to how you combine your monsters on the battlefield.

title: Football Survivors
description: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS STARTED! Thousands of raging fans are storming the field. Defend against the fan invasion! 50+ unique heroes and abilities, 50+ upgrade items, position your heroes strategically, crush the waves of fans!

title: Widget Idle
description: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness.

title: Neo Light
description: Every room wants you dead in Neo Light. A brutal precision platformer where you master 9 short-burst powers while Glitch, your sarcastic assistant, guides, judges and mocks your failures in real time.

title: Spinful
description: A fantasy roguelite slot-builder. Upgrade, enhance and customize your slots into a powerful combat machine!

title: Disco Ball Simulator 2000
description: You owe 1 million $ and all you have is a disco ball! A hectic but satisfying incremental swiping game about creating the perfect party night with light effects. Juggle cooldowns, upgrade equipment, earn $$$ and most importantly: Make numbers go up!

title: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
description:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings.

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?
Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards.

title: Tilemancer
description:
Tilemancer is a strategy roguelite deckbuilder where every battle plays out like a tactical board puzzle.

Build two parts of your army: a deck of units that determines the soldiers available to you, and a deck of cards that supplements your units. Different unit types, terrain types and card effects interact through simple rules that can combine into increasingly complex situations.

title: Let Me Die
description: Let Me Die is a short incremental game about a hero trapped in a loop, fighting a monster. Unable to win, unable to die. Unlock upgrades, complete quests, create unique builds and maybe you will find a way to break the loop.

title: Hold the Dawn
description: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

title: Salt of the Earth
description: An isometric medieval city builder. You hold one manor by charter: lay the roads, work the fields, and raise hovels into town houses by meeting what each household needs. Winters take stores, the Crown takes dues, and raiders take whatever will burn.

title: CyberKitty: Neon Merge
description: Suika games have evolved! CyberKitty: Neon Merge is a cozy, yet action-driven, dynamic 2D physics puzzle game for 90s retro, pixel art, and match-3 fans! Instead of watermelons, merge a cast of colourful cats. With the CatCade system, swiftly match kitties to boost your multiplier for mega scores!

title: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
description: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

title: Microscape
description: Heavily inspired by Runescape, Microscape is a tiny community idle game for Twitch streams. Channel owners can add their community to the world. Players then earn playtime by being in these communities.

title: Flick
description: Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your family's twisted past. A psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Vintage Vice City Pack
description:
All Grand Theft Auto VI pre-orders and purchases before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack, a collection of items that flash back to when the neon burned brightest.
Featuring a timeless '55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside Ocean Beach, decadent outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an iconic weapon pattern that echoes the excess of the past.

title: The Legend of the 4 Elements
description: The Legend of the 4 Elements is a platformer with elemental combat. Control heroes of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, use unique abilities, overcome challenges, battle dangerous enemies, and restore balance to the world of the elements.

title: Lord of Undead
description: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

title: Dungeon of Departure
description: an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe which follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.

title: Shrike
description: Pickpocket rival birds to build a deck. A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder about a tiny bird's grim migration north through a wretched medieval kingdom. Steal abilities, chart your migratory route, survive.

title: Iona's Island
description: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

title: Axyn Adventure
description: Axyn Adventure is a retro style 3D platformer. You take control of the titular character Axyn and embark on many adventures with your friends Yunn and Leaf. Play in the vast open levels using your big set of moves to get around. Collect as many items as you can to advance the story and unlock tons of content.

title: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
description: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI
description: Grand Theft Auto VI heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the Grand Theft Auto series yet.

title: Strato Alto
description:
Strato Alto is a 3D aerial combat action rogue-like game.

Features two game modes, Classic and Journey.

Classic is an arcadey timed round survival mode. Down enemies, choose upgrades, and gain currency to unlock new planes and equipment for future rounds.

Journey mode is a rogue-lite campaign. Outfit and upgrade your aircraft as you journey across three world maps in pursuit of the legendary Red Baron to prove your own mastery of the stratosphere!

title: Please Confirm the Deceased
description: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Bodies arrive with paperwork that has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

title: Whitopia
description: Experience pure calm through a short relaxing 3D painting simulation. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

title: Frog is Crime
description: good criminal open world game of 2026. drive cars, commit crime, kill peoples and become crime king in world of humans as frog

title: Mr Mageboy
description: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage trying to start a business selling resources. Upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and help your village!

title: Dark Rail
description: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

title: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
description: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

title: Space Station Designer
description: Space Station Designer is a construction and management game that puts you in charge of creating and expanding a network of orbital outposts in Earth and Lunar orbits.

title: Dravora
description: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.

title: Pluck Em!
description: Fight off annoying feathered pests in this addictive arcade shooter inspired by the classics of the 8- and 16-bit era. Explore strange biomes, discover bizarre bird species, earn medals, upgrade your gear and uncover secrets that are probably better left undiscovered.

title: Game Shelver 99: I Must Organize My Steam Library and Defend It Against Pirates With a Shotgun
description: Game Shelver 99 is a satirical first-person organizing game set in a retro PC game store. Sort game boxes onto shelves by genre, tags, year, developer, title, or price, then defend your carefully arranged collection from waves of software pirates. Play solo or team up with up to three friends, or choose a peaceful mode focused entirely on organizing.

title: AsterMaster
description: A beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Every step, shot and dodge lands on the rhythm as you dig into a dead mining asteroid — stack weapon mods, chase synergies, break bosses, and haul your ore back out alive. Full controller support, Steam Deck friendly.

title: Steel Gullet
description: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

title: Monkeys!!
description: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!

title: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
description: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

title: Zero Sum
description: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

title: Okurek
description: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

title: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
description: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem is a fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

title: Milki Delivery
description: Grab your bike and milk bottles, let's hit the road! Explore the countryside in this short cozy delivery adventure. Befriend folks and gently help them rebuild their community, one bottle at a time. Upgrade your bike, your dairy farm, and venture deeper into a once-lively region.

title: Chrono Cards
description: Chrono Cards is a digital PVP card game that puts you in the role of a time traveler, summoning cards from across history and manipulating time itself to triumph over your opponent. The game is built around its unique Timeline mechanic which splits the board into Past, Present, and Future regions that move on every turn, forcing players to carefully plan ahead and adapt to a constantly evolving board state.

title: White Christmas
description: White Christmas is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

title: Feed the Vessel
description: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

title: Dreadgence
description: A deterministic horror autobattler. Bind extinct monsters as Pacts, arm them with Rites and Relics, then deploy. Your units fight automatically with no mid-battle commands you win by building the right answer before combat begins. Conquer wounds, deepen your Pacts, and automate what you've mastered.

title: Watermellionaire
description: Watermellionaire is a dark battle royale fruit-matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

title: One More Claw
description: 3D physics claw machine + roguelike building. Land it in the chute; blast the target with base times multiplier.

title: Night of the Idle Horde
description: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.

title: Dungeonbound
description: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

title: Aurora Requiem: The Lullaby of Calvaris
description: Year 41 without the sun. Inside the skeleton of a colossal sea creature, the lighthouses burn memories for light. A late-90s-style JRPG with pre-rendered backdrops, three discs, time-gauge battles and a mechanic with a giant wrench who always keeps his word.

title: My Little Ranch
description: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch hands and grow your ranch.

title: Of Dice and Minions
description: Of Dice and Minions is a pixel-art dice-rolling auto-battler roguelite developed and published by Foorbytes. Each turn the player rolls five dice, holding and rerolling them in the style of Yahtzee. Every die represents a minion type, and the number rolled determines how many of that minion are summoned. The resulting poker hand grants a bonus, such as extra units, increased damage or health, or sending all five dice into battle, after which the army fights automatically. A run descends 100 floors across ten zones, with a boss every tenth floor whose own dice rolls summon reinforcements, and continues into an Endless mode after the final floor.

title: Rock and Found
description: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through thousands of rocks.

title: Trafficity
description: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, or sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

title: Who Gave Them Weapons
description: Build your crazy squad in this cartoony auto-battler and watch as it turns into total chaos! Equip teams with the silliest gear, crush friends online, or beat enemies in solo challenges. Mix and match warriors, discover powerful combos, and prove your strategy is more insane than the chaos.

title: Topdeck Automat
description: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself. Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

title: Clicky Islands
description: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

title: Trees Hate You
description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

title: Scopecreep
description: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

title: World 23
description: Battle through decaying mega-cities, abandoned metro tunnels, and guarded enemy facilities in this fast-paced top-down hack and slash. As Theo and Leo, you master abilities and switch weapons during combat to match your play style and the challenge ahead.

title: IWA Fighting Adventure
description: A feature-packed autobattler where you build and develop your own settlement, gather resources, prepare for battle, and lead your forces on dangerous expeditions and auto-battles.

title: Fate/Empire of Dirt: Stella Splendens
description:
The second and last append for Fate/Empire of Dirt, taking places after Made in Heaven and adding new routes for Morgan and Musashi.
Anastasia, Murasaki Shikibu and Consort Yu are also upgrated from sub-heroines to heroines roles.

title: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
description: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

title: Zombie Crawlers
description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! Zombie Crawlers a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

title: Parcel Inspector Simulator
description: Parcel Inspector Simulator is a first-person inspection sim set on the night shift of a transit post office in 1962. Every parcel that crosses the desk is weighed, X-rayed, checked under a UV lamp, listened to with a probe and looked up in the terminal, then stamped: approve, return to sender, hold, dispose or confiscate. Regulations change from night to night, wages pay for desk upgrades and for a brother's sanatorium bills, and a 20-night story campaign with seven endings follows a favour that somebody upstairs keeps asking for. After the campaign the shifts go on as endless nights with special conditions.

title: Dice Hoarder
description: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

title: Extract Survivors
description: Extraction survivors-like meets deep ARPG Loot. Fight endless hordes across deadly floors, extract, then roll, gamble, and upgrade gear across 10 tiers of modifiers and powerful Uniques to forge a game-breaking build. One life. Permadeath. Infinite loot. How deep can you fall?

title: Warrior Quest
description: Warrior Quest is a single-player, text-driven dark-fantasy RPG where old-school dungeon crawling meets next-gen, free-form, offline AI diplomacy. Fight, sneak, negotiate in your own words, recruit unlikely companions... and whatever you do, roll well.

title: Satelital
description: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

title: Fancy Farm Brawl
description: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

title: Powerfuel
description: Powerfuel is an action FPS set in a gritty dieselpunk world. Play as the legendary ex-criminal known as the Cricket, and harness the mystical properties of powerfuels. Fight your way through the gangs of New Lyon and shed light on the conspiracy plaguing the city.

title: Rasen
description: Strike with precision, time your deflects and fight flawlessly to your own rhythm. Step into atmospheric PvP or PvE arena duels and fast-paced clashes with a variety of lethal characters.

title: Cannon Keep
description: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

title: Netherwake
description: Experience a nerve-racking adventure as a thick, dark fog begins to roll into the small town from the surrounding forests, and with it come ancient, cosmic beings from outside our reality. Try to survive and pray that you will one day see the sunlight again.

title: UnderMire
description: UnderMire is a 1-4 player first person co-op roguelite adventure where you descend into a magical, ever-changing bunker to confront the dark forces that lie within. Battle fear-fueled monsters, SMUSH everyday junk into magical weapons, master evolving tools, complete tasks from a cantankerous spirit cat, and survive the chaos alone or with your friends using proximity voice chat.

title: Derelikt
description: Survive the dark corridors of a space station in Saturns orbit in this narrative retro FPS with faithful PS1 aesthetics. Meet over a dozen unique NPCs, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight against the eldritch abominations!

title: All Eyes on Me
description:
All Eyes on Me is a horror delivery game with cozy elements. More than 100 items, 15 areas to explore, and over a dozen ene,

As a new hire at the BlinkTwice delivery services, purchase (or steal) items and deliver them to your customers. Or find new ways to make profit like fishing, mining, recycling bottles, garbage picking, and more! Just make sure to reach quota by the end of the day and avoid the eyes...

title: Tiny Havoc
description: Smash crates as Tin, a tiny salvage robot with a hammer, and free the memories locked inside ten vaults. A handful of crates grows into total havoc of lightning, saw blades and drones in this 5–7 hour incremental game with a real ending.

title: Terrahold
description:
Terrahold is a strategy sandbox about building and defending a colony on a living procedural planet. Starting with a teleporter and a single drone, the player explores the world, establishes resource outposts, expands a shared power grid, and develops the colony toward the energy output required to open a permanent tunnel home.
The planet reacts to the colony's expansion through spreading alien vegetation, hostile creatures, eggs, spores, and other environmental threats rather than conventional scripted attack waves. Players can use autonomous robots, defensive structures, force fields, bridges, radar, and terraforming to reshape terrain, protect infrastructure, and expand into hostile territory.

title: Wizzy the Wood
description: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

title: Ninja Noboken Episode 2
description: A brutal 2.5D ninja action game built by a solo developer. Fast combat, precision platforming, and intense boss fights inspired by classic hardcore ninja games.

title: Not My Dad
description: Dad is acting strange, and maybe you're the only one who noticed. Meet Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game where evil may be lurking inside your own home.

title: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
description: In a single night, your father's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Brewing the best drinks and retake the town... or, you know, kneecap the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

title: Fakin It XL
description: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.

title: PocoDoro
description: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives in a little handheld device on your desktop, next to whatever you're working on. Hatch a squishy slime, poke it, stretch it and throw it so it splats against the walls. Feed it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It grows up in real time, even while you're away.

title: Tick & Tired
description: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

title: Beyond The Blight
description: A short first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

title: Ball x Pit: Risen Ballbylon
description: Risen Ballbylon is a transformative expansion for BALL x PIT, adding new levels, characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, and buildings, to the smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite. Will you rise to the challenge?

title: Procedure Zero
description: You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information and take over the prison before they come for you.

title: Carmilla: Crimson Moon
description: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

title: Princessfall
description: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.

title: Metaphor: ReFantazio: Shin Megami Tensei V Jouin High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Shin Megami Tensei IV Samurai Garb (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona St. Hermelin High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 5 Shujin Academy School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 4 Golden Yasogami High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 3 Gekkoukan High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 2 Seven Sisters High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Etrian Odyssey Class Costumes (7) & Battle BGM Set
Desktop Plinko
description: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

title: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
description: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

title: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
description: Give Oatchi commands using your voice and put your Dandori skills to the test in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy.

title: Find Kittens 12: Pirates
description: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

title: Hordia
description: Cut down endless hordes of monsters and become absurdly powerful! Loot, upgrade, and stack augments into wild builds. Hold the island with cannons and traps, hunt down the bosses waiting out on the map, and survive as long as you can. Solo or online co-op!

title: ChromaFlow
description: Build a color-powered factory. Extract red, green, and blue, transport them across networks of conveyor belts, and blend them to create an expanding spectrum. Fulfill the demands of the Chroma Core, unlock technology, and optimize every production line.

title: Echo 9
description: Echo 9 is a tense first-person horror. You are Yon, a maintenance android. Navigate a failing shuttle through deep space, stabilize the dying reactor, and bring Eva to the evacuation point. Radiation is rising, the evacuation point far. Eva is in stasis. You are all she has.

title: The Totemist
description: Run an occult shop in a quietly strange town, crafting totems and talismans inspired by real witchcraft. Help townspeople with their burdens at your own pace while uncovering an ancient darkness beneath the town, one only you can stop.

title: PlanetOrbit
description: Turn a bare rock into a neon-lit casino planet. Win chips at poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro, roulette and slots, then spend them on buildings and watch the dry ground turn green. Drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit. Grow the liveliest planet in the galaxy, your way.

title: Barbie Rewind
description: Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.

title: Moomin Midsummer Madness
description: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

title: Sonic Pico Park
description: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

title: Lost Zion
description: Lost Zion is an atmospheric cyberpunk horror game. Awakened by a faint signal as a service bot, explore the forsaken megacity of Lost Zion. Uncover the Emperor's horrific secrets. Obey your sole command: Activate the Gravity Core.

title: Portabellows
description: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

title: Phantom Gear
description: Gear up in your battle armor and take on the sinister Ocular Force! Become Josephine and put a stop to the power-mad cult and the mysterious phantom force behind their spree of carnage!

title: Lilifel
description: High roll your way through an everchanging dungeon in this roguelike, turn-based dungeon crawler. Fight enemies using your elemental runes to conjure powerful spells. Synergize your elements as you loot items that combo with just about everything. Ever Low roll? Just SLAM your way out of it!

title: Lost Hope
description: Lost Hope is a short, First person Atmospheric walking simulator set in the distant future, in the deep space, a lone man tries to survive and get a cure for mankind.

title: Grab Your Deck
description: Build real skateboard tricks from cards: an Ollie paired with a Kickflip and two Shove-its fuse into a Tre Flip. Roll each trick into a manual or grind and land the line before bailing. Beat bosses that tape over your stickers to climb the ranks from AM to PRO. A press-your-luck skate deckbuilder.

title: Thronefall: Craaghelm
description: Conquer the mountain in Craaghelm, the first expansion for Thronefall.

title: Headshot Holdout
description: Headshot Holdout is a retro styled co-op shooter where squads of 1-4 players slaughter their way across a hand-authored, zombie infested stronghold on a quest to rescue DEATH itself.

title: John Gleep
description: John Gleep is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

title: Hill-Z
description: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

title: Bottled by Bears
description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

title: Apotheosis Engine
description: An accident causes a lost space probe to become self aware. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game. Grow from a piece of engineering into a galactic superdeity by navigating an alien OS.

title: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
description: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

title: Springs, Eternal
description: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

title: Monomoon
description: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

title: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
description:
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world.

In the single-player interactive novel villain team-up game "There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.," you play as his greatest adversaries. Can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. (short for a "Very Important Collective of Terrorists, Operatives, and Rogues") defeat the only man standing between them and world domination?

To the V.I.C.T.O.R. go the spoils!

title: Mythfall
description: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg. Face deadly bosses, forge alliances, and carve your legacy in a world where every fight could be your last.

title: Imperial Grace
description: Imperial Grace is a unique mix of romance, medieval intrigue, and strategy. Play as the new Empress of Calidya through a visual novel rife with ambition and deceit. Make choices that will change your fate and that of your nation, rule wisely to make your Empire prosper, and find love along the way!

title: Expiration
description: A first-person psychological horror strategy where diabetes becomes a deadly table duel. Balance blood sugar with insulin, manage your supplies, and defeat Doctor Dealer to claim the cure.

title: Please, Tell Me Why?
description: You live alone. Or so you think. Stream live. Explore your apartment. Talk to your viewers. Everything seems normal… until the little details stop making sense. A first-person psychological horror film about identity, isolation, and the terrifying price of facing the truth.

title: Drawmi: Terraform Sim
description: An alien planet terraforming sim where you can draw all of the plants, animals, and bugs that you use to make a thriving ecosystem.

title: Nick vs. the Brick of Ick from space
description: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

title: Shrek 2 Remastered
description: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

title: Grazed: Incremental Arcade
description: Grazed is an incremental arcade game where every kill means getting within range of death. Push your kill combo high enough to ignite absurd powers and chase the highest score. Every run earns upgrades, so you always come back deadlier.

title: Amusement Factory
description:
Amusement Factory is a cozy theme park builder with a bright, stylized look.

You start with an empty field, a bus stop and a bank balance, and you lay out everything else: roads, queues, rides, shops, arcades, and a lake with boats running laps of a route you painted yourself. Guests arrive by the busload with their own energy, hunger, thirst and patience, and their mood is blended from everything the park does to them, so a filthy path costs you as surely as a broken ride does.
Play the ten campaign locations in order, each with its own land, budget, wage bill and goals, or take free play and build for the pleasure of it.

title: Ashen Swarm
description: Ashen Swarm is a single-player gothic arena roguelite in which abilities are based on the seven deadly sins. Players combine skills during each run and choose between keeping an Oath or gaining powers through Corruption. Decisions in recurring narrative events grant lasting artifacts. A gathering court culminates in a battle against the Collegium.

title: Hamster Wheel Isekai
description: Hamster Wheel Isekai combines incremental progression with role-playing mechanics. Players power a wheel, change gears and time shifts to build speed and advance.

title: Calmaria: Wild Growth
description: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

title: Last Chance: Birth
description: Enter the magic school of Academia! Last Chance: Birth is the mix of a narrative game and casual puzzles, where your performance impacts how the story is told. Solve puzzles to cast spells, to craft potions, to enchant artifacts and more!

title: Marvel Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
description:
Marvel Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are joining the fight against Annihilus!

Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom head to Marvel Cosmic Invasion for an intergalactic adventure that will see them face off against the fearsome Annihilation Wave!

The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt!

title: Protocell
description: Mutation is evolution. A lab cell broke containment — pilot it through swarming arenas where every upgrade you take drags you closer to meltdown. Grow billions of one-of-a-kind protocells, hand any of them to a friend with a 16-character code, and dive into the Primordial Abyss.

title: The Adventures of Tango Rio
description:
A humoristic point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn 2D art, comedy, and investigation. As Tango Rio, explore a tropical archipelago, meet quirky characters, and gather clues by solving puzzles in the search for your mysteriously vanished father.

Tango Rio hasn’t seen his father in two years—not since he left with his uncle on “a journey that would change the world.” Or so he claimed. Then, silence.

The only clue: the name of a Polynesian archipelago... and the feeling that this time, the escape is different.

What awaits him? Tropical legends, strange rituals, time travel, dark prophecies, and a bunch of totally crazy characters.

title: Football Manager 27 Mobile
description: FM27 Mobile will be available on iOS and Android exclusively via Netflix.

title: Football Manager 27
description: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline in FM27, as foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a richer footballing world to explore.

title: Rense
description: A fast roguelite FPS. Make your build from level-up power choices and chest items, and fight through three maps of hostile drones. The longer a run goes, the stronger they get. Die, unlock more, come back stronger.

title: It Thinks!
description: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

title: Clogwork
description: CLOGWORK is a factory-automation game where you turn random pieces into final shapes. Build conveyor belts, glue, cut and rotate parts, wire logic signals, and send the finished shape to the hub to fulfil ever-changing orders.

title: Drawmi: Creature Collector
description: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

title: Warpack
description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

title: The Sea Is Our Stage
description: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

title: Dustbloom
description: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build a massive mobile base, automate your production, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

title: Piggy Monte
description: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

title: Pray Your God!
description:
Pray Your God! is a retro-styled comedy game about founding a cult and guessing numbers.

The player names a cult, recruits a flock and then prays: they pick a number from one to a hundred, and an Inquisitor picks one after them, with a die that does not cheat.
A wrong guess costs a follower and earns a fresh piece of paperwork; a correct one triggers one of 16 endings, each with its own animation, its own obituary and its own achievement, assigned at random. Runs last two to four minutes.

The whole game is played through a text interface drawn in a Commodore-era palette.

title: Carve The Cave Together
description: Dig a cave with a friend, one cell at a time. Throw balls into solid rock in zero gravity and they never stop, so the more cave you open the further everything flies. Mine ore, feed the machine, unlock a roster of balls that each dig differently.

title: Rebirth TD
description: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.

title: Never Sort By Color
description:
Never Sort By Color is a first-person zen organization game where you use magnet gloves, part detection, sieves, and quick hotkey tossing to sort an enormous pile of plastic bricks into a labeled workshop. Instead of sorting by color, you sort by part type, rebuilding drawers and organizing bays as the floor area opens up.
As you complete categories, instruction books guide you to pull exact parts from the right drawers to assemble MOCs that snap together brick by brick, turning the quiet sorting loop into satisfying, functional model building.

title: Thieves and Gold
description: Smash containers, grab the gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves in this medieval loot-heist incremental. Race the clock in Heist Mode or play relaxed in Casual Mode.

title: Torawase: The Girl in the Mirror
description: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

title: Patience Balls
description: Patience Balls is a minimalist physics-based puzzle game focused on tilt mechanics and precision. Players navigate one or more balls through intricate labyrinths and mazes to reach designated goal spots. The gameplay emphasizes steady control and logic across multiple themed worlds. It includes global leaderboards and unlockable achievements within a performance-optimized, clean visual style designed for short, meditative sessions.

title: Fragments
description: Your mind is shattered. Step into a first-person psychological horror where you must relive your deepest trauma, uncover fragments of your past, piece them back together and face the tormentors that haunt your mind.

title: 1999 Tokoyo Building
description: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... Did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

title: Warhammer Survivors
description: Thrust into a universe of relentless war, become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, collect and evolve iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

title: Elixir of Moonglow
description: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

title: Deiity (Under Ice)
description: A dungeon crawler about working smart, not hard. As a fallen god, climb a buried Antarctic temple to use humanities own weapons to destroy the earth. Use magic abilities to manipulate physics, enemies, and the environment as you fight man-made biological creations. The temple's secrets await.

title: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
description: Join our mercenary team: high-risk, low-benefit positions available! Defend cargo trains in this innovative Turn-Based Tower Defense meets Reverse Bullet Hell. Deploy units, merge them to create powerful new types and variations, withstand relentless waves, deliver the goods.

title: Ashes of the Singularity II
description: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

title: Hope in the City
