description: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

title: Shock
description: In SHOCK, you play as a disabled war veteran, hunted by a cybernetic creature. With only a wheelchair for mobility, use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape. Survive the horror and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

title: Hillthorn
description: A disappearance in a secluded mountain. A village hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Hillthorn's investigation system encourages you to use logic and imagination. Combine actions, clues and characters to uncover the mystery.

title: Shadey's Quest
description: Shadey’s Quest is an autobattler roguelike featuring character building. Shadey is a monster who wants to be a hero, but the only thing he is good at is eating. Guide him through a rich fantasy world, feed and equip him, and help him defeat the fearsome King of Shadows!

title: One More Plate
description: One More Plate is a physics-based quirky funny game. Here, you'll serve food on ANYTHING but proper plates! Keep your balance, aim carefully, and then you will be rewarded with…… One More Plate!

title: Nocturnal II
description: Nocturnal 2 is an action-adventure game that lets you explore and rekindle the dark depths and towering heights of the city of Ytash.

title: Annihilated
description: Dungeon-crawling adventure where you must choose a single survivor from a hero's party that has been annihilated. The Hero can only say "Yes" or "No," the Mage cannot use magic, the Warrior has been turned into a cute doll, and the Cleric worships an evil god. The choice of who to save is yours.

title: Menthal
description: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

title: Waifu Curator
description: Restore a chaotic waifu museum by finding, sorting, and displaying collectible scale figures. Collect, organize, and build the perfect exhibition!

title: Cards of Bellum
description: A roguelike deckbuilder of strategy, dice, and luck. Master suit-based combat, turn defeat into glorious victory with a roll of the dice, and recruit unique heroes, powerful wizards, and legendary knights. Build your deck, storm the capital, and claim the throne

title: Metro Anomaly
description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

title: Towers of Babble
description: Towers of Babble is a tower defense game where you play words to create towers with powerful synergies.

title: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn
description:
Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn is a first-person organizing game set in a two-story medieval armory with 50 rooms. Players collect scattered weapons and place them in their assigned racks and displays. Completing rooms awards skill points that unlock abilities to help locate and organize weapons.

The game supports single-player and online multiplayer for up to four players, with cooperative and competitive modes. There is no countdown to failure; dawn arrives when the final piece is in place.

title: Seferia Matrix
description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

title: Just A Dice Game
description: A relaxing dice rolling roguelike about chasing score targets and trying to break the game. Build up your collection of dice while buying upgrades, relics and other powerups to build wild synergies and laugh in the face of RNG.

title: The Big Suck
description: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Destroy fields, cars and buildings, gather wreck to grow, and spend the payday on upgrades in a huge skill tree. Past a certain size the storm stops being weather and picks its catastrophe — fire, flood, winter, or the void — while the county answers with fire crews, bomb squads, tanks and jets.

title: Mini Mart Survivors
description: SHIFT24 is a mysterious convenience store chain. As night deepens, strange customers swarm endlessly. Ramen, snacks, and coffee become weapons. Fight them off, and clues hidden in branches worldwide begin to emerge. Follow the clues and pay down your debt to uncover the truth behind SHIFT24.

title: Borbs
description: Reunite chonky borbs with their flock in this relaxing puzzle game, brought to life by hand-drawn artwork from a longtime bird keeper.

title: Ho Ho Ho Sokoban
description: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

title: Fraga
description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

title: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
description: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

title: Funeral for the Sun
description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

title: Casualties: Unknown
description: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 5 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

title: Neo Junk City
description: Dive into Neo Junk City, a cyberpunk adventure where you’re an android detective unraveling your own murky past. Navigate neon streets, engage with unique characters, and race through the rain-soaked city. Uncover secrets in this twist on point-and-click gameplay.

title: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal
description:
Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal is a single-player action roguelite built around an incremental power curve. The knight's corrupted sword drains his own health for as long as he stays in a level, so the health bar doubles as the level timer and there is no separate countdown; upgrading maximum health buys survivability and time in the same purchase.

Attacks fire automatically as a 360-degree pulse, leaving positioning as the only moment-to-moment decision, and every kill shortens the player's ability cooldowns. Death is the progression system rather than the fail state: banked gold and the permanent skill tree both survive it, so each run funds the next. Five biomes end in boss fights, and an elemental infusion system lets the player commit to fire, frost or lightning — or to the corruption itself, which is stronger and changes the ending.

title: My Lovely Nurse
description: Spend ten nights in the hospital with the mysterious nurse Lilith. Make choices, complete sensual mini-games, unlock explicit artwork, and watch professional distance turn into mutual desire. Adults only.

title: Silver Service
description: Silver Service is a cozy tidying game where you put 11,132 portions back where they belong aboard a cruise liner, solo or with up to 3 friends. Fill your tray, find the right display, unlock upgrades, and to unwind, grab your fishing rod and see what’s hiding under the water.

title: Nutshot Simulator
description: Throw things at people. Aim low. Nutshot Simulator is a physics comedy set in Kumquat Cove, a perfectly ordinary town with a doctor's office, a church, a frat house and a moon base. Every hit gets a slow-motion replay, the town has a life of its own, and if you can see them, you can hit them.

title: The Christmas Bakeshop
description: Supply festive breads, pastries, and sweet treats while serving cheerful customers and keeping your shop warm and welcoming. Expand your bakery, discover new recipes, and make your cozy little corner the heart of the town this holiday season.

title: Hidden Cat Islands
description: Hidden Cat Islands is a relaxing 3D exploration game where you search for hidden cats across uniquely themed islands. Move your camera freely, use helpful hints, discover interactive objects, and find hidden photos along the way!

title: Tank Mates
description: Tank Mates is a chaotic physics-based co-op platformer where one or two players share a single tank to tackle a brutal military obstacle course. Coordinate, survive deadly obstacles, and try not to destroy your friendship.

title: Trap Testers
description: Traps Testers is a co-op physics-based deathrun game where you're the one placing the traps! Compete against your friends to reach the finish line first, and try to kill them along the way.

title: Sora: Oasis Treasures
description:
Embark on a breathtaking journey through the jungle skies in Sora - Oasis Treasures. Play as a vibrant parrot and soar across tropical islands, dense canopies, waterfalls, and ancient ruins. Your goal is simple yet meaningful: stay close to your flock as you all travel across the wild, untouched archipelago.

Each of the handcrafted levels features 40–60 sky markers guiding your path as your flock leads the way. Fly through wind boosts to gain speed, discover hidden shortcuts, and enjoy the feeling of freedom as you glide above treetops and turquoise waters. The world is full of life and color, rewarding you with beautiful vistas and relaxing moments of harmony in flight.
Though the skies are peaceful, you must stay alert—fall too far behind, and you risk losing the flock. Crashes don’t punish you harshly; you simply return to the most recent waypoint and continue your journey. The focus is on enjoying the adventure, soaking in the serene atmosphere, and experiencing the thrill of flying together.

With smooth controls, gentle pacing, and vibrant flocks that vary in speed each run, every flight feels fresh. Whether you're racing through the breeze or drifting lazily over a jungle river, Sora - Oasis Treasures offers a warm, relaxing escape into tropical skies where unity and exploration take center stage

title: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store!
description: Silk Collector is a cozy organizing simulator where you shelve 4,012 scattered clothes in a magical fashion house. Shelve the clothes to collect silk, then spend it on spells that speed up the sorting. Keep an eye out for the clothes that wander the store like ghosts.

title: Cozy Corner Cafe
description: Brew, upgrade, and relax! Build your dream coffee shop in Cozy Corner Cafe, a charming idle tycoon game. Automate prep stations, hire staff, handle in-store and online orders, and unlock upgrades through an extensive skill tree.

title: Mind the Clown: Reborn
description: A first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus shaped by childhood memories. Move carefully and hide from the demonic clown stalking you. Explore dangerous attractions and burn circus posters to break the curse and save your life.

title: Siege of Akanor
description: Siege of Akanor is a third-person medieval tower defense game in which players prepare a castle's defenses, command troops, and fight directly on the battlefield. Between waves, players can deploy and upgrade defenses before joining the battle with melee and ranged weapons. The game features a single-player campaign, cooperative multiplayer, progression systems, multiple enemy types, siege weapons, and fantasy elements including dragons.

title: Grimoire of Blanks
description: Grimoire of Blanks is a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder for 1 - 4 players. Players build spells during combat by filling blanks on cards with collected words, combining effects, modifiers and conditions. It features single-player and online co-op, with multiple playable mage classes and procedurally structured runs.

title: High Voltage
description: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

title: American Gold Rush
description: Dahlonega, Georgia. 1829. You've got a shovel, a day's food, and a hole in the ground that gets richer the deeper you're willing to go. Every step and every swing costs energy and daylight, so the real game is deciding when to push one more swing of the axe, and when to climb out.

title: Boneyard Bounce!
description: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

title: Pith
description: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

title: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
description: Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games; Monopoly, The Game of Life, and Clue to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

title: Deathly Delights
description: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

title: Brothel Virgin: The Crimson Reverie
description: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

title: Lost Media Agency
description: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

title: A Dogs Dream
description: Test your sixth sense. Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks? Every choice is yours to make. May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

title: Homepage
description: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

title: Escape: The Cabin
description: Trapped, alone, and hunted by a captor who knows your past. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover the truth, and escape before the cabin breaks you. With 70+ randomised puzzles and solutions, every nightmare changes as you fight to get back to your family.

title: Manus Sors
description: A puzzle and mystical horror game in which Grandma's cozy house hides dark family secrets. Explore every room, solve the puzzles, and stay alert: every detail counts here!

title: Mono Chameleon
description: Mono Chameleon is an online hide-and-seek game for 2 to 10 players, drawn in four dithered shades of olive and cream. Hiders sample colors from walls and floors with an eyedropper and paint their own bodies with brushes, down to the thin mortar lines between bricks, to blend into the scenery. Seekers search in first person with no radar, relying on their eyes, a five-shot catch-gun and a whistle that sounds late in each round. The game has five modes (Normal, Infection, Double, Tag and Prop Hunt), and bots fill empty slots.

title: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
description:
Out of the highly successful Don Bradman simulation series comes Don Bradman Cricket JR, the hard-hitting arcade cricket game. Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot, smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

Complete the Bradman Challenge Round and you'll unlock Sir Donald Bradman himself as the captain of the Australian side, along with the Bradman vs Water Tank Mini Game. Easy to pick up…impossible to put down.

title: Prehistoric Pit
description: Prehistoric Pit is a bullet heaven roguelite with voxel graphics. The player controls one of nine dinosaurs in an arena that fills with waves of Ice Age mammals, while weapons fire automatically. Between waves the player picks upgrades, limited to four weapon slots per run. Every weapon evolves into a second form at level 30 with its matching relic. A run lasts about 30 minutes across volcanic stages. Each dinosaur has its own exclusive starting weapon, active ability and passive; eight of them are unlocked through in-run challenges.

title: Spice Pound
description: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

title: Drain the Galaxy
description: Thousands of space dwarves vs. one planet. The planet loses. Land, strip it bare in short runs with pickaxes, lasers and missiles, haul the loot home and grow a huge upgrade tree. You can't lose. You can only get richer

title: Continuum
description: A generation ship roguelite where no one aboard survives the journey. Travel the stars one world at a time as each generation shapes your ship and writes a new chapter in the chronicle.

title: Zone L.O.S.T.
description: Your body is your weakness. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

title: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts
description: A 14 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

title: Derail
description: Derail is a horror anomaly game where instead of spotting anomalies you have to cleanse them with you holy camera to escape the loop.

title: Last Inspection
description: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

title: Rules of the Inn
description: A Japanese horror-mystery. In an inn room at the edge of the afterlife, you follow a rule added nightly and judge what slips in; by morning, open the ledger for the truth. The rules never lie, but some nights something not in them arrives disguised as something that is. Obey, or doubt? Mouse only.

title: The Goddess Told Me: Steal That Loaf of Bread
description: A fantasy adventure about a five-millimetre ant sent by the goddess Kona to steal a seventy-two-centimetre loaf of bread. Players navigate a world built around differences of scale, crumbs and narrow passages.

title: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
description: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

title: Scrolls of Alexandria: Tidy up the Lost Library
description: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria, reading the colour of 21 real ancient alphabets. Every cat guards one and won't let go until you pet it! Eat a golden apple for optional magic, or take a quiet afternoon in the stacks :)

title: Soulstack
description: Idle card RPG on a table. Drag cards onto each other to do literally everything. 200+ weapon recipes (only ~40 are worth keeping), 140 pet evolutions, 12 prestige classes. Yet still feels like a Jira and Trello child.

title: Next of Kin: Epiphany
description: Become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

title: Dark Alley
description: A British detective has vanished in Kyoto. Step into Detective Bennett's shoes and uncover a mystery that reaches far beyond the Yakuza.

title: TerraLounge
description:
Players decorate and spend time in a terrarium, and play match-3 puzzles to earn currency to use in the terrarium. This currency is used to buy toys, decorations, music, and floors.

The game features 3 game modes: Endless, with procedurally generated boards; Story, hand-crafted levels across 5 worlds; Terrarium, where players decorate and spend time with slimes.

The intent of the game is to be a second screen, fish tank kind of game, where it exists with the player as a companion, but not draw attention to itself.

title: Dialshift
description: Dialshift is a single-player score-attack arcade game played on a circular dial. Players control a continuously moving cursor with two directional inputs and time hit attempts against targets while maintaining combos and Stability. Seven modes vary the rules with directional targets, forced reversals, sustained holds, and multi-hit targets. Each mode has its own scores, ranks, and leaderboard.

title: Swarm Harvest
description:
Congratulations, you're hired!
Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

title: AJ's Anomaly
description: First-person anomaly horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer investigating her gallery the night before a big exhibition. After months of exhausting work and a series of troubled business relationships, she may be starting to lose her mind.

title: Where the Seeds Fall
description: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

title: Manic Miner
description:
The legendary platforming classic is back!
Jump, collect, survive - Rediscover one of the greatest and most challenging video game classics of all time!

title: Feed Me More Brains
description: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

title: K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine
description: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game! Dance and sing your way through the competition and rise to glory. Customise your character to your image, it is your time to shine!

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
description: The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

title: Dominus Gladiatus
description: Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly 160-day tournament against rival Domini.

title: Bros of Bench
description: Bros of Bench is a chaotic co-op platformer where two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Alternate between lifting each other and flying with jetpacks while mastering coordination, physics, and timing.

title: Chivalware
description: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

title: Crymelight
description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

title: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
description: A city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

title: Payday: Aces High
description: Mask up as one of The Aces, an elite group of heisters with access to bleeding-edge tech, black-market toys, and weapons no sane dealer would list. Framed by business titan Warren Jupiter and thrown in jail, the time has come for you to hit him where it hurts: banks, museums—hell, even his so-called “untouchable” penthouse.

title: Build a Bot
description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

title: Underkeep
description: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear and descend into the depths of the Underkeep to uncover what lies hidden below.

title: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
description: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!

title: Wielders of the Essence
description: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

title: In Full Bloom
description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for anything around it. There is only one way.

title: Psycho-Sleuth
description: Psycho-Sleuth is a psychological mystery where cognitive disorders twist the logic of murder. 13 afflicted participants — each bound by strange rules like “no lying,” “no left side,” or “no faces” — are trapped in a deadly game where the sickness spreads and truth itself becomes unreliable.

title: Eternal Palace Sakura
description: "Eternal Palace Sakura" is a rogue-lite 3D action game where you power up your character and take on thrilling dungeon challenges packed with flashy combat. Step into the shoes of Retla, a brown-skinned, cat-eared dual-wielder, and explore the ever-shifting dream labyrinth!

title: Glory On Pluto
description: Bring prestige back to Earth by building your engines and finding Glory on Pluto in this offbeat and unique deckbuilding rougelike.

title: Faraway
description: "I am a shooting star! A spark meant to shine and vanish in a blink. But I will travel! I will mark my trail in every firmament. I will live to see the universe." Faraway is an immersive, both challenging and chill, procedurally generated audiovisual experience about creating constellations.

title: Cat-Astrophy
description: Guide Polo, a brave abducted cat, through a vast universe of exotic planets. Face challenging combats, customize your abilities, and choose your own path in this epic space odyssey to uncover Polo’s lost memories.

title: Emery Hearts
description: Immerse yourself in this thrilling action JRPG and uncover the secrets of Emery crystals as you face challenging enemies that will demand all your skill and ingenuity to defeat them.

title: Tirade
description: An idle clicker about playing on 16 chessboards at once. Do you know how to play chess? You won't need it here.

title: Prigod Idle
description: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.

title: Hidden Cats in Beijing
description:
Centuries ago, the ancestors of Beijing's hidden cats traveled the legendary Silk Road to reach the Emperor's palace. Now, they are hiding all over the city!

Relax and enjoy a journey to the Far East and find +700 hidden cats in Beijing!

Celebrate the Spring Festival by breathing new life into dragon dances and ancient legends, all set to the rhythm of traditional Chinese music.

title: Compactor Baron
description: You're broke and the bills keep coming. Smash scrap into cubes, sell them, pay up. A short active incremental: aim, let the hammer swing, upgrade your tools, go bankrupt on purpose, and build a scrapyard that pays for itself.

title: A Game About Picking Fruits
description: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

title: Yukizuki no Seisou
description: High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream…

title: Break the Piñatas
description: An incremental game where the goal is to smash 1,000 piñatas! Earn candy, buy upgrades, and unlock unique skills to become the strongest. So, are we stopping at the last piñata?

title: Spellchain
description: A first-person action fantasy RPG where you create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events, grow your magical power, and ultimately slay the king.

title: Rip It! Card Collector
description: A single-player incremental game where you hunt down 1,809 collectible trading cards. Sell dupes and upgrade your retro-futuristic gear to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and completing the ultimate card collection. It’s time to get cracking!

title: Imouto Choukyou Nikki
description: A censored port of Imouto Choukyou Nikki.

title: Wildixir
description: Wildixir is a single-player action roguelite set in enchanted lands. Combine automatic weapons and alchemical reactions, restore shrines, and face each region's boss. Between runs, spend seeds on permanent upgrades and unlock new characters and locations.

title: Kokuhaku Confessional
description: Just as you’re finally ready to ask library crush Shiori out on a date, mean girls Maika, Rin, and Aoi swoop in with a twisted new game: Kokuhaku Confessional! Can you resist their charms and stay true to your beloved? Survive to Day 5, and maybe—just maybe—you’ll win Shiori’s heart.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever
description: World of Warcraft: Forever is an invitation to take your first steps in a legendary world of untamed frontiers, warring factions, untold perils, and unseen mysteries. Experience an Azeroth that grows from the roots of WoW’s first age, continually evolving through regular content patches and updates that promise never-ending adventure.

title: Cardsharp
description: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

title: Node Crown
description: Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here!

title: On The Hook
description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

title: Armory Keeper
description: Restore order to a massive armory. Find and sort over 1,500 weapons, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment scattered throughout the facility, placing every item on its correct rack. As you organize the armory, unlock abilities that help you sort faster and more efficiently.

title: Old Man's Sushi
description: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

title: Cleanup On Aisle 3
description:
Cleanup on Aisle 3 is an arcade management game about running failing grocery stores. Each day, the player stocks shelves from incoming pallets, rings up customers before their patience runs out, wrangles shopping carts back from the parking lot, and mops up whatever got spilled along the way. Between days, the player drafts upgrade cards to expand the store, hire staff, and automate the chores that are getting out of hand.

The campaign spans seven stores, each with its own layout and its own set of problems. Corporate sends the player from store to store with a memo and a promise that this one will be different. Miss the daily sales target too often and the run ends in a firing. Play solo, or bring a second player in local co-op or Steam Remote Play Together.

title: Slots & Skulls
description: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Spin to attack, open chests for new symbols, strike deals with cats, and risk your symbols at the anvil.

title: Theos: Cities of Myth
description: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

title: Hull Rupture
description: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

title: Cozy Game Restoration
description: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

title: Lost Host
description:
Lost Host is a story-driven adventure puzzle game about a small toy car searching for its missing owner.
When the boy mysteriously disappears, the toy car begins a journey through the house and beyond, exploring dark rooms, hallways, foggy streets, and abandoned places while following clues to uncover what happened.

Players control the toy car as it navigates dangerous environments, solves physics-based puzzles, and interacts with objects to progress. The world is full of hazards for a tiny toy car - heights, fire, water - as well as enemies such as dogs, robotic vacuums, and hostile toy creatures.

The game combines atmospheric exploration, light horror elements, and emotional storytelling, creating a family-friendly adventure centered on mystery, discovery, and survival in a large, human-sized world.

title: Cat Secretary
description: Keep your job by day. At night, sneak around the office and solve your colleagues' problems. Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!

title: BrouHaHa
description: Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

title: Terminidle
description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, run hack contracts, and upgrade your rig until it boots a whole desktop OS and maybe more! Then wipe it all for permanent power and climb back faster!

title: Kitties on Planets
description:
Get ready for a space adventure full of strategy in Kitties on Planets! Control two astronaut cats with different abilities and use their unique skills to place every supply box on its respective objective. Switch between the characters, combine their abilities, and discover the perfect solution for each puzzle!

The white cat can push supply boxes, causing them to keep moving until they collide with an obstacle. The black cat cannot push boxes, but can move the magnets scattered throughout the environment. These magnets attract boxes and the inactive character when they enter their range, allowing you to change their positions and create new paths.

Magnetic attraction works in a straight line and cannot pass through walls or other objects that block its range. Observe the environment, switch between the two cats, and carefully consider every move to prevent a box from becoming stuck in an unreachable position.

title: Hold the Levee
description:
Hold the Levee is a strategy simulation game focused on real-time fluid dynamics and water physics. Players must dig trenches, raise levees, stack sandbags, and build dams, then watch how the water reacts to the structures.

The gameplay simulates realistic water behaviors such as seepage, undermined walls, flood waves, and ice jams across 24 unique missions. The campaign ranges from defending a town from natural disasters to flooding enemy villages guarded by the AI. The game also includes a sandbox map editor, local or online co-op, and a unique 1v1 "Water vs Defender" PvP mode.

title: How Empires Work
description: An incremental strategy game about history, expansion and development. Grow from humble beginnings to take your place on the world stage!

title: Spark of Tales
description: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

title: 4:12 AM
description: December 1999, the eve of Y2K. Twelve nights as the 911 operator of a dying Pennsylvania coal town. Speak with your own voice; a fully offline local AI plays every caller. Every night at 4:12 AM the phone rings: a girl missing for fifteen years. Who lives and who is lost depends on how you answer.

title: One More Floor
description: A small box dungeon crawl for one player. A deck of rooms, a handful of dice, four numbers on a character sheet, and five floors that do not care how well you did last time.

title: Heart Harvest: A Detective Game
description: Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls. Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game. Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..

title: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
description: Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a short, satisfying incremental about steering a black hole and swallowing everything in sight. Devour colorful cubes for XP and coins, grow bigger, and pour it all into a deep upgrade tree. Bigger cubes, wilder chaos, just one more run.

title: Hold My Wheel
description: HOLD MY WHEEL is a 5-player online co-op action-adventure set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. You and your idiot twin brothers must visit grandma, living in a bus you can never leave thanks to the collars she put on you. Keep the bus running, fire junk from its roof-mounted Scrap Cannon, lift, flip and throw it with a magnetic gun, and build bridges from scrap. Go hungry too long and you start eyeing your teammates; get bitten or irradiated and you turn into a zombie. Death is not the end: keep playing as a ghost, zombie or floppy ragdoll until a Hell-Kitty restores your human form.

title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park
description: A narrative-driven DLC expansion where you explore a decayed Central Park and Upper West Side gripped by paranoia over a mysterious virus variant. Guided by a narrator recounting events as a flashback, you uncover what happened in the park while battling a new apex threat and familiar foes. You're joined by three companions with distinct fighting styles and backgrounds, each offering unique tactical support and reactions to situations. The endgame shifts you from hunted survivor to hunter, letting you dictate engagements and pursue enemies on your own terms, with your performance affecting future challenges and exclusive rewards. New skill variants and an exotic weapon round out the expansion.

title: Traffic Architect
description: The city is the easy part. Making it move isn't. Lay out roads, shape junctions and time the lights, then watch thousands of simulated cars find every flaw you missed. Take cars off the road with buses, trains and metro — or build the whole city yourself in Creative mode.

title: The Wake Event
description: The Wake Event is a first-person science-fiction psychological horror and puzzle adventure set aboard the abandoned ARGUS research station. Awakening alone with no memory of what happened, the player must restore station systems, solve interconnected technical puzzles, and uncover the truth behind ARGUS, the station's autonomous intelligence, and their own presence aboard the facility.

title: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
description: This is a first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles.

title: PeeVPee
description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

title: Light Source
description: Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.

title: Pocket Adventurer
description: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

title: TCG Card Chaos
description: TCG Card Chaos is a first-person casual simulation game in which players explore a chaotic card shop and sort more than 5,000 collectible cards. Players inspect card types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and return every card to its correct place.

title: Let’s Sing 2027
description: Sing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.

title: Aetheris Core
description: A fast-paced sci-fi action roguelite where you battle escalating enemy waves, combine powerful abilities, and take on challenging boss encounters.

title: Sortilège
description: A dice duel with someone on the other side of the table. Roll, hold what you like, and commit. Both players reach into the same pool of powers each turn, so every one you take is one your opponent can't have. Climb a ladder of ten rivals in a solo run, winning their dice as you go, or duel a friend online.

title: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
description: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

title: Wilderdark
description: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

title: Iron Colony
description: After crash-landing on a mysterious island, confront hostile robotic creatures in intense combat and strategic duels. Explore forgotten ruins, uncover secrets, and fight for survival in a world where corrupted technology dominates every corner.

title: Death at Fleming Manor
description: "Your job is to write the death certificate." Investigate a mysterious death in a grand British manor, 1959. Explore eerie scenes and complete forensic documents like death certificates and medical reports. Stylish 1960s detective comic art. Perfect for fans of vintage whodunits.

title: Radiant Starlets
description: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

title: Kick
description: Kick It is a Jump'n Run with a soccer ball. Navigate your ball with skill and finesse through a happy adventure.

title: Havker-Man X
description: Havker-Man X is an open world, post-apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

title: Angel Guardian
description: Angel Guardian is a side-scrolling action shooter where players take on the role of Kita, a warrior guardian, tasked with saving a prince from the forces of evil. Players can use action shooting, stealth, and hacking to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles

title: Backdraft
description: The deckbuilding brawler. Backdraft is a hero vs hero roguelike battle for board control. Draft your deck, summon your minions, and unleash game-flipping combos. Conquer the six realms solo, or challenge your friends online.

title: Heart Abyss
description: In a world where there is an eternal war between the unions of the human race and beastmen, accidental deaths and slave trade are not rare. But what happens if two slaves by chance unite and survive together, being wanted? Leon and Ray are one of those.

title: The House Before
description: You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

title: Bastion Rivals
description: Bastion Rivals is a fantasy strategy game in which players control a builder, develop an economy and construct buildings that produce troops automatically. Armies move and fight across two lanes toward the opposing stronghold. Four factions provide different units, structures and counters, with spells, items and upgrades supporting army composition. The game includes solo battles against AI; ranked and unranked online modes are planned for launch.

title: Make the World Great Again
description: Infiltrate a private island where the elite meet, and every room, every piece of paper and every locked cabin hides something or someone they paid a great deal to bury. Uncover every secret and escape before they catch you.

title: Shin'ai Rewritten
description: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.

title: Nightcup
description: Pull up a chair: in Nightcup everything is played at one table. Four classics on the shelf, plus various modes and house rules you can switch on. Fill the empty seats with bots or invite your Steam friends straight into your lobby. No long loading screens in between.

title: The Arcane Archive
description: Step into the mystical halls of The Arcane Archive! In this cozy and atmospheric 3D puzzle game, your task is to sort and organize over 100 glowing magical potions on ancient shelves. Bring order to the chaos and unwind in the ultimate relaxing wizard's library.

title: Verdreamia
description: A cozy gardening sim where you create the gardens of your dreams. Plant dreams in twelve places: a meadow, a conservatory, a window of stars. Tend them at your own pace, in your favorite world style, and frame the views you love into your gallery.

title: Figure Me Out
description: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

title: Verdant Requiem
description: “SRPG in Search of Balance" On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

title: 20 Floors Down
description: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

title: Highway Station Simulator
description: Run a highway station with up to four players. Somebody has to work the pumps, somebody has to stock the shelves, and somebody has to answer for the mess. A first-person co-op management sim about a very long shift.

title: On Your Own: Survival Inventory
description:
Rotate the grid and break groups of boxes to move your character, loot items and avoid enemies.
Explore places with different loot and levels.
Recycle items to get materials and craft new ones until you fix the radio and ask for help.

title: Perfectly Folded
description: Perfectly Folded is a cozy organizing game set in a clothing store turned upside down. Fold, hang and shelve every last shirt, hat and shoe, design your own fashion, and enjoy turning the mess into a perfectly folded store at your own pace.

title: Blastlane Racers
description:
Blastlane Racers is a top-down arcade combat racing game inspired by classics of the genre.

Race across 24 hand-crafted tracks, use powerful weapons to take out your rivals, and upgrade your vehicles and equipment between races.

Choose from 10 unique vehicles and compete in championships, quick races, time trials, and challenges in the Blastlane Academy. Play solo or challenge your friends in local split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players.

Fast racing, explosive combat, and plenty of chaos – cars and guns. What else do you need?

title: Chair Chase
description: Chase the chair before someone steals your seat! Chair Chase is a chaotic 2-8 player online party game set in a big house full of living chairs that do not want to be sat on. They run, hide and parkour away from you, and they panic more the closer you get. Catch one, then win a quick balance fight while everyone else tries to knock you off. Grab jetpacks and glue guns between rounds to chase chairs and stop your friends. Seven rounds, most points wins. Play in private lobbies with friends or join public matches.

title: Cellar Cleanup Simulator
description: Cellar Cleanup Simulator is a relaxing single-player simulation game where players organize hundreds of bottles in a mysterious cellar, place them on the correct shelves, and restore the collection to its former glory. Completing shelves grants Skill Points that can be used to unlock abilities, while a drunkenness system introduces a balance between increased power and reduced control. The game also features realistic physics based bottle handling, breakable bottles, scoring, and online leaderboards.

title: Critical Ward
description: Treat patients, build massive combos, create absurd builds, deploy automated medical infrastructure, and survive the escalating arcade chaos before hospital saturation reaches 100%.

title: Crime Podcast: Welcome to the Neighborhood
description: Jesse Turner, a 29-year-old employee of an insurance company, moves to a neighboring state after being assigned to a local branch. As he settles into his new place, he encounters unusual events that soon turn his life into a real nightmare.

title: Dread Line: Metro
description: A time sensitive horror collectathon where you avoid getting ripped to pieces by mutant monsters

title: Drum Incremental
description: Drum Incremental is an incremental game built around real percussion rudiments. The player taps patterns on a practice pad using the left and right mouse buttons (with keyboard keys for flam and drag ornaments), earning Rhythm Points that unlock new rudiments and upgrades. The game features 40 rudiments from the PAS list across five progression phases, each gated by a boss exam judged by an on-screen teacher; a metronome with four speed tiers; a Study Companion that generates points passively, including while the game is closed; golden notes that fall during play; and a jam mode that recognizes the rudiments the player performs. The soundtrack is original and synchronized with the metronome tempo. Single-player, with full controller support and localization in ten languages. A free demo is planned for Steam Next Fest in October 2026, and the full game releases on Steam for Windows on November 2, 2026.

title: Heroll: If
description: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

title: Blobby and the Milkshake
description: An octopus stole your milkshake. Why? Who knows! Ride robot crabs, fly fire hydrants, sled in bathtubs, and fight power-hungry pirate clams in this goofy, open-ended 2D platformer. Explore dozens of levels, branch your path, and do whatever it takes to get your drink back.

title: Mafia Hotel
description: Mafia Hotel is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 16 players. Talk, lie, accuse, and vote by day, then return to your hotel room at night—where the Mafia may come knocking. Survive the night and uncover who you can trust.

title: SpaceShooter
description: Blast through endless waves of deadly meteors in a fast-paced 2D arcade space shooter! Fight through 20 challenging stages, battle powerful bosses, customize your ship, discover unique meteor types, unlock weapons and upgrades, and survive the Endless Mode.

title: Snot Pop!
description: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

title: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
description: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique! Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Year 1 DLC Character: Phoenix Cyclops
description:
Phoenix Cyclops, the first DLC character included in the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, is coming to MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls!

Inspired by his Phoenix Five incarnation from Avengers vs. X-Men, this iconic X-Men leader harnesses the overwhelming power of the Phoenix Force, bringing a fiery new look and devastating abilities to the battlefield.

title: Southern Lights: Broken Frequency
description: Lead a stranded Antarctic research station where every decision matters. Manage your crew and its scarce resources while an unseen cosmic threat slowly tightens its grip.

title: The Ice Is Watching
description: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

title: Bolariki
description: The match-3 roguelike. Stack relics, shatter rules, and pull off outrageous combos, all inside a puzzle game that boots like a fever dream from 1995. Crunchy, retro, and dangerously easy to start. Impossible to stop.

title: Caaahr!
description: Your voice is the engine. Literally. One player screams to make the car go faster, the other somehow tries to steer it through chaos. A coop friendship test about communication, panic and losing your voice at 2 AM.

title: Survive the Apocalypse
description: Turn-based roguelite in a post-apocalyptic world where you will have to make meaningful decisions (sounds familiar, capitalist world maybe). Make your way out of this ruined city, with eleven quarters (levels) and countless zones. Eat well, sleep well, decide well.

title: MyDear.exe
description: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old DIY PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short 2 hour experience.

title: Brotato: Primal Dread
description: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

title: Boost Vector EX
description: Run fast. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

title: Tales of Tonbrook
description: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid. When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it! Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

title: Manual Teller Machine
description: In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager. Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise! Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

title: Dirtborn: Colony Rising
description: Ants are fascinating insects, and they have taught mankind what the power of teamwork can accomplish. Develop your own colony of ants, dig every tunnel, and protect your queen from the numerous enemies you'll encounter! No two games will ever be the same and online PvP ensures fun to the thorax!

title: Chief? About That File...
description: Step into an atmospheric 1990s police archive. Inspect, classify, and organize 3,360 unique criminal dossiers, crack safes, and uncover crime syndicates in this immersive first-person archival detective simulator.

title: Disk-Y
description: Show Yuu—a transfer student struggling with psychological issues—around the school and become a source of emotional support for her. This is a minimalist retro visual novel featuring elements of psychological horror.

title: Gimbap Heaven
description: Run a Korean snack bar with your own crew! Hire staff, hand out kitchen tasks, plan the menu and juggle wages, stress and bills in this card-based restaurant management sim. Jump in to cook and serve by hand when it gets busy, and stay afloat for 15 days.

title: Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator
description: Travel through 2010–2025 and trade historical stocks and cryptocurrencies with the benefit of hindsight. Build a fortune, survive unexpected costs, and uncover the story behind it all.

title: Deadly Match
description: Deadly Match is a singleplayer thirdperson murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

title: Obolus
description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

title: Welcome Back to Aeris
description: Welcome back to Aeris! A point-and-click psychological horror about reviving a Frutiger Aero minigame console shutting down in 7 days. Restore its dead channels with your guide Mora — and follow the strange traces appearing beyond the screen.

title: Defense Front
description: A new charm of traditional tower defense.Hordes of unknown aliens have descended upon Earth. On dynamic scene maps, you need cleverly build defense towers to construct their path of advance, combine with controllable targeting strategies, and stop the aliens' assault.

title: The Cozy Funemployment
description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

title: Akgwi Slash
description: Endless hordes of ghosts swarming in. Become a Joseon exorcist, ride the 'Geogugoe,' and shout, 'Sleep the vengeful spirits. Slay the evil spirits!'

title: Rune Delvers: Idle RPG
description:
It's a game where you're an explorer traveling through different dimensions. During your journey, you'll encounter enemies that you defeat by getting close. These enemies drop a strange silver coin, which you can use the power of runes to convert into a gold coin. This allows you to upgrade your equipment chest and summon better gear.

Equip yourself with the best gear you can and enter different dungeons to obtain souls in the form of colored orbs from each boss. Use these orbs to access and upgrade a skill tree, boosting your stats and unlocking the magic of your runes.

Unlock various artifacts that will aid you on your journey by reducing currency conversion costs, upgrade costs, increasing your stats, and providing other bonuses you'll discover as you play.

Unlock new dimensions where you can obtain more resources and unlock new features and mechanics.

Explore a new world under construction...

title: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach!
description: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach! is a first-person beach cleanup and restoration simulation. Collect and sort 7,621 items across the beach, ocean and pier, tidy clothing stores and surf rentals, put beach chairs and toys back in place, and restore the coral reef while helping turtles. Earn money to buy cleaning tools and skills, use an auto-sorter, and hire a dog to carry trash. Play alone or with friends in online, LAN and local split-screen co-op. Character customization unlocks as stores are sorted, and players can use water guns, throw coconuts and crabs, and play with a seagull gun.

title: Anomaly Archives
description: Trapped within shifting liminal spaces, you must rely on keen observation to survive. Inspect your surroundings, detect subtle anomalies, and make the right elevator decisions to break the loop and escape.

title: Spell Code SlingerZ
description: Weave codes and sling spells as a punk Y2K Spell Code Synthesizer in this 2-4 player, couch/online, 2D party brawler. Annihilate the opposition, acquire powerful new Spellcodes, and beat them down again in a first-to-3-wins style tournament.

title: Ablation
description: A first person puzzle game where you carry one material at a time, and what you take from one surface, you can give to another.

title: Silent Noise: The Park Shift
description:
Silent Noise: Chapter 1 – The Park Shift is a first-person, story-driven psychological horror game. It combines cinematic storytelling, immersive atmosphere, and unique mechanics that challenge both mind and heart.
You play as David, an 18-year-old scarred by tragedy. At age five, his father died from chemical exposure at a factory, leaving David emotionally broken and unable to continue his education. His mother, weakened by grief and illness, depends entirely on him. To support her, David takes a job as a night security guard and caretaker in a park that was abandoned for years but has recently reopened.

title: The Idle Shard
description:
The Idle Shard is a free, classless MMO inspired by Ultima that runs in your browser. Grow any of 40 skills, from Mining and Blacksmithing to Magery and Animal Taming. Your character keeps working for up to 8 hours after you close the tab, and the ore, hides, kills and skill gains are waiting when you return.

Everyone plays in one shared world. Raise 14 towns together, battle 13 bosses across 13 dungeons solo or in a party, trade on a player-run market, build anything from a cottage to a castle, found a guild, sail the High Seas, or follow the 8 Virtues.

title: Ezalm: Magic's Memory
description: A narrative-driven action RPG where each spell you use will punish you, requiring you to be strategic in the combat styles you will build. Lost in the land of your ancestors, unravel the secrets of magic to return home and defend the people you swore to protect.

title: Heirs of the Fountains
description: Heirs of the Fountains is a pixel-art action-platformer starring two siblings with unique powers. Explore the kingdom of Elarion, overcome dangerous levels, defeat fearsome creatures and legendary bosses, and rescue Lady Julia from the clutches of the witch Morwenna.

title: Feed The Frog King: Incremental TD
description: A short incremental tower defense game with a massive skill tree! Recruit a team of cute and deadly animal friends, shop for powerful hats, construct buildings, assign workers, and unlock powerful upgrades to Feed The Frog King!

title: Resettle
description: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

title: Carnor City
description: Escape Carnor City by any means necessary. As a rogue MKUltra agent in a rustbelt dystopia, outsmart a brutal AI ecosystem where G-Men and local crooks clash in dynamic crossfire. Leverage darkness, trigger chaotic physics, then die, adapt, and rewrite your tactical approach in a true immersive sim.

title: DinoBox
description: Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger! DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

title: Tarot Tokens
description: The Fools Journey

title: Jester Under Pressure
description: Diskarte is a Filipino-inspired visual novel where you play as a nonbinary jester trying to entertain a queen who explodes heads. With 33,000+ words, 60+ Filipino terms, and four branching routes (including romance), it blends humor, danger, and vibrant storytelling. Can you survive her wrath?

title: FFFF: Fatal Five Finger Fillet
description:
Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite.
Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them.
Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score.
Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

title: Spell Unbound
description: One spell. It is a circle. Spell Unbound is a pixel-art roguelite where you bind beasts by looping them with the mouse - no sword, no staff, nothing else in your hand. Draw tight. Something is always crossing your line.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
description: Become a magical mermaid and plunge into the waters of the Keepsake Sea! Uncover what secrets lie beneath the waves and embark on a thrilling new ocean adventure.

title: Find All 10: Greece
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

title: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey
description: A difficult and cozy sokoban-like puzzle game. Pick up and drop different masks to change the way you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, uncover secrets, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.

title: Drawmi: Card Shop
description: Drawmi: Card Shop is an immersive simulator where you and your friends can draw all the cards you sell and run a thriving card shop together.

title: Desiderium
description: A brief essay on desires and the consequences of having them. Feed an insaciable sovereign, explore surreal environments, and seek the hiddens ambitions within those who surround you.

title: Meltdown
description:
Meltdown is a nuclear reactor management simulation where you, a new recruit, must urgently operate the reactor to prevent a city-wide blackout.

Your primary objective is to maintain the alignment of power grids, regulate the water flow and ventilation to keep the reactor cool, and deal with your manager’s nonsense.

title: Plum
description: Plum is a short (about 1h) contemplative 3D collectathon, where you play as a plum, rolling and bouncing your way through a colorful world, searching for your way home. Your journey will take you through lands, caves, snowy mountains and more. Each area with ghost plums to meet, each with a story to tell.

title: Build the Hole
description: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

title: It's About Pirates
description: Command your ship in an action-packed pirate roguelike. Combine deadly weapons, powerful items, and a fearless captain to create unique builds and survive the dangers of the high seas!

title: Agebound
description: A fast-paced farming idle game where each year lasts under a minute. Plant crops, automate production with workers, and advance through Ages to build a thriving, high-yield farm.

title: Tiny Survivors
description: Fight through endless hordes of enemies in this action-packed roguelite. Collect powerful loot, level up, unlock new characters, and combine upgrades to create wild builds as you grow stronger with every run. How long can you survive the onslaught?

title: Love D3ath Love
description: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

title: Slotbound
description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

title: Green Inferno
description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

title: Locked in Love: The Office
description: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

title: Graveyard Orbit
description: A satisfying incremental where you build the ultimate mining ship, loot every piece of an alien megastructure, and upgrade your abilities with an array of unlockable parts and skill trees. MINE. BUILD. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

title: Wanderdawn
description: Explore various worlds in a hack-and-slash action game - In a world ravaged by an unknown disaster, face various monsters with the diverse weapons you find.

title: Too Hot to Be True
description: “Finding a wife in a week? Are you for real?!" Your parents are visiting next week, and they expect you to show up with a bride. With only days left, your only hope may be the five gorgeous women staying at your seaside guesthouse. As feelings shift fast, who will you choose?

title: Jigenro
description:
"JIGENRO" is a 3D color-matching puzzle game.

Click to grab and move panels on the field.

If you can connect all panels of the same color, you clear the stage.
Some stages feature fields with side walls or fields with elevation changes.

title: Infinity Ship
description: Combine cards, pilot unique ships, and survive cosmic chaos. A frantic space roguelite where every fusion makes you an unstoppable force. Defeat colossal bosses and prove your worth as the Guardian of the Universe.

title: Parralysis
description: You open your eyes in a surreal space, paralysed. The only thing you can do is to scarcely move your right arm, and scribble. Scribble in a notepad before you to move forward. Towards a goal you must reach, despite something horrific trying to reach you. Create the cure. You don't have much time.

title: Alchemortis
description: Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies. Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

title: Of the Devil: Episode 3
description: Morgan finds herself centerstage as the State conducts a witch trial to exorcise itself of one of its most outspoken critics, but she refuses to play the fool in the oncoming torrent of political theater.

title: Magic Kingdom
description: Self moving chess, RTS, Meat pigeon game. In the game, you will control the hero, lead a powerful army, release powerful magic, have a strong city defense, and coordinate resource collection to resist the enemy's strong attack

title: The False Alice: Retold Tale
description: A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice gacha game. It will features a new scenario and new CGs, backgrounds, BGM, character facial expressions and pose differences.

title: Eona
description: Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers—and Mélusine, the evil fairy who rules over it—for she has waited so long for a soul to torment. Escape this cursed place with your loot, hoping to save your mother.

title: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

title: Demon Bluff
description: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

title: M.E.M.O
description: Rely on nothing but your own wits. A first-person cryptographic adventure game that play with paper and pen. As you wander through the maze of memories, can you find the key to saving the future?

title: Pozionista
description: Travel through a world surrounded by nature, collect plants and use them to create potions, invent new recipes, sell potions in stores and explore the world.

title: Exitus
description: You woke up, and you have no idea where you are. What a coincidence, you don't remember anything at all; could you have been kidnapped? There is only one way to find out.

title: Light of Atlantis
description: In this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania you dive into the ruins of Atlantis. As a small robot you control the water level in various rooms to solve puzzles and discover the mysteries of an ancient society.

title: Moonlight Knight
description: Moonlight Knight is an action-slasher with RPG elements. Use sword, bow, magic and hook to fight your enemies. Loot gold, upgrade character stats, find unique items and unlock ultimate abilities to make it to the very end!

title: Hospital Rhapsody
description: Build your hospital and form special bonds. From daily management to private moments, discover their stories amid the bustle of work. As trust and affection grow, uncover another side beneath the white coat…

title: Last Lawn Standing
description: Shape enemy paths with towers and barricades, then fight alongside your defenses as a garden gnome armed with auto-firing weapons and powerful potions. Protect bonus-granting shrines, upgrade without limits, unlock permanent rewards, and survive solo or in 4-player local co-op.

title: Cult of the Red Heifer
description: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

title: Temple of Your Mom
description: A puzzle RPG with turn-based combat and a darkly silly story. Estimated playtime is 4-6 hours.

title: Talaire
description: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.

title: Scared Puppies
description: In Scared Puppies, you dive into the paws of adventurous puppies on a mission to find their lost owner. Set in a vibrant world, the game blends puzzle-solving with light adventure elements, promoting teamwork and clever strategy.

title: Alice in Pumpkinland
description: Alice In Pumpkinland is a third person over-the-shoulder-camera comedy horror game.

title: God Is Not Here
description:
God Is Not Here is a first-person psychological horror game. The player explores an isolated house, investigates paranormal phenomena, solves environmental puzzles, and follows clues through recordings, surveillance cameras, and the surrounding environment.

The game focuses on atmosphere, narrative exploration, environmental storytelling, and encounters with hostile supernatural entities.

title: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
description: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

title: Baptiste
description:
Submerge yourself in a first-hand experience that will make you feel each chill as if it were real. The line between the game and reality blurs further with each step you take.

Explore a mansion where horror awaits in every shadow. The masterful dubbing and sound track will drag you to the depths of a nightmare. Darkness will become your most feared enemy, putting your bravery to the test in each corner.

Play as Tom, a young man still suffering from the tragedy. After the loss of his father, he accompanies his mother Sara on what ought to be a new beginning. However, the ghosts of the past threaten to consume him. Can you keep control against the siege of his inner demons?
