Disentangle the gruesome secrets that impregnate each floorboard and each crack on the walls. Each discovery will reveal a story of pain and horror that beggars belief.

Submerge yourself into a world where beauty and terror coexist in a macabre dance. The visual design will transport you to a kingdom where the grotesque is fascinating.

Each objective, each note and each whisper contribute towards weaving the plot. Your perseverance in the face of fear will be rewarded with chilling revelations that will keep you on edge until the very end.

title: Can 'Em All
description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

title: The Wizard's Assistants
description:
The Wizard’s Assistants is a single-player exploration adventure where you traverse a chaotic collapsing tower, help the assistants stranded within it, and gather quarks to gain magical augments as you search for a way upward to the moon.

Something has gone awry in the Wizard’s tower. As one of the assistants, explore a strange and increasingly chaotic world of magical experiments, scattered clues, and fellow assistants in need of help. Follow your curiosity, collect quarks, and earn new magical augments as you unravel what happened and find out how to escape.

The Wizard's experiments have left the tower in a state of magical disarray. Assistants are scattered throughout, continuously performing the last task they were assigned. You play an assistant whose eyes are on the moon and making your way through it all: lending a hand where you can, examining the Wizard's questionable notes, unraveling your past, and following a trail of quarks that charge Nexus points along the way. Above it all is the moon.

Explore places within the tower ranging from the tower’s pipes to the Wizard's workshop, reaching as high up as the rafters. Run, climb, jump, and glide, all at your own pace. Talk with the assistants you encounter, and investigate the oddities the Wizard has left behind. Collect quarks to charge Nexus points to unlock magical augments that you can use to bounce, traverse ledges, teleport, ride beams of light, and puzzle your way through the tower, revealing paths that were previously out of reach. Along the way, examine notes, scrolls, and glyphs that gradually unveil the workings of the Wizard and the assistants who need your help to escape along with you.

Every place you visit invites another question, every assistant has another situation to resolve, and every augment leads to new experiments. Keep exploring, keep helping, and keep following the quarks upward to find out for yourself if the moon really is made of cheese.

title: Cat Pipes: More Meow
description:
Cat Pipes: More Meow is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle game about guiding warmth to sleepy cats. Rotate the pipes to connect the flow from the main source to every cat in the room, then watch each one light up and purr.

With 51 handcrafted levels that ease you in and slowly grow into satisfying brain-teasers, portals that bend the path across the board, and a warm lo-fi atmosphere, it's the perfect little game to unwind with.

title: Scarlet Beret: Murder at the Orphanage
description: Fabienne a 17-year-old genius, has a rare gift: she detects lies! But when she discovers the body of one of her teachers, she’s left with no choice but to uncover the killer among the residents she’s lived with her entire life.

title: Gore Grind
description: A first-person roguelite horde shooter for 1 to 4 players in couch co-op. The city mutated, the internet is down, and dying costs money. Shoot the horde, bank the cash, and keep working for the only pizza place still open.

title: Tiny Garden Café
description: Sow seeds and nurture them, harvest fresh ingredients to cook meals, and serve them to your guests. As the seasons turn and dusk falls, the café lights glowenjoy a peaceful day in your very own little garden café.

title: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor!
description: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor! is a relaxing sticker game about cozy rooms and cats. Pick up stickers with tweezers, place them into tiny dioramas, and slowly create warm little spaces youll want to return to after a noisy day.

title: Body Kounts
description: Resurrect and Summon Extinct fantastical beasts to do battle on your behalf in this Arcadelike mind game of Life vs Death. Every defeat is fatal, you must use your wit and all the tools at your disposal to overcome challenges and survive.

title: Megashootsplosion
description: A fast, physics-drunk arena shooter that never stays the same. Throw your gun to reload, wall-jump to stay alive, and stack chaotic upgrades until fights get gloriously out of hand. Duel 1v1 or brawl up to 4 players across 8 modes.

title: Hover Raid
description: Hover, raid, upgrade. Eliminate thousands of zombies, unlock devastating abilities, and grow stronger with every run in this very short, linear incremental action game.

title: Underdeep
description: Underdeep is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

title: Sweep Protocol
description: Operate a remote military radar station while struggling to keep your family alive as an escalating invasion pushes your nation to the brink. Track incoming threats and manage scarce resources while balancing the needs of your loved ones. Every sweep matters. Every decision counts.

title: Underpaid
description: A dark-comedy 2D narrative adventure. You spent a hundred years scaring children for a living - until New York rent forced you into a 5-day trial as a kindergarten teacher. Bond with a group of misfit kids, help them win their first team victory, and discover why one girl never wants to go home.

title: Slythe
description: A snake made of heroes. An arena full of things that want it dead. Steer, stack classes, build something broken, and dive past the final boss into endless depths, New Game+, and a global leaderboard. The snake never stops - can you keep up?

title: Stellar Wing
description: A space fighter shooter about taking a carrier apart. Fly as a flight of four, burn down the turrets, crack the shield generators, then kill the core. Rebuild your fighter from 200 parts across 12 campaign missions and 30 hunts against 10 machine leviathans.

title: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush
description: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush fuses match-3 puzzles with physics-based Pachinko action! Match tiles to drop bouncy balls through pegs into multiplier slots for massive combos. Unleash powerful boosters, buy permanent upgrades, and dominate global leaderboards!

title: Worjong
description: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words. Play against the CPU or online with up to four players.

title: Brokeline
description: Brokeline is a story-driven text game with a messenger-style interface. Play as Ivan Savin, a resident of Tikhovsk: chat with friends and strangers, choose your replies, plan your day, and make time for meetings beyond the screen.

title: Garito
description: A rigged slot machine refuses to pay. Rig it back. GARITO is a slots roguelike where you edit the reels mid-spin, wire your own paylines, and beat the payout out of boss machines one strike at a time.

title: All Those Dungeons in Alva's Head
description: All Those Dungeons in Alvas Head is a surreal, turn-based and skill-based dungeon crawler filled with quirky characters, mind-bending puzzles, and a kick-ass electro-pop soundtrack. Fight wacky creatures, explore bizarre dungeons, and uncover the strange secrets lurking in Alvas mind.

title: Jump Bald
description: A metroidvania full of bald guys? Reach the top of the tower with pixel-perfect jumps, collecting weapons that let you unlock the map. Be careful! Every mistake can send you, literally, back to the beginning. Only then will you be able to take revenge on the one who mocked you and your alopecia...

title: Nonogram Detective
description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

title: District Null
description:
District Null is a cyberpunk city-building simulation set on the colony planet AZ884, a world almost twice the size of Earth. Its northern side lies under a thick blanket of smog, while the unexplored region of Cibola waits in the south. On the General's orders, the player founds a district that is connected to the other territories by a highway.

The player lays roads, zones residential, commercial and industrial areas and watches the city grow house by house. Construction sites have real build times, all the way up to plateaus and skyscrapers. Traffic with commuters, traffic lights and highway interchanges, the power grid with fusion plants, thermal plants and energy relays, as well as fire services, ambulances and police are simulated at the same time. Venues such as a cinema, a stadium, a casino and a concert hall each have their own programme, visitors and income.

A research lab and a university unlock new technology and train skilled workers. Creatures like a giant worm, pterosaurs and slime men attack the city and are fought with defense units and ships from a weapons factory. The colony's long-term goal is drilling through the planet's core.

title: Hatch'n'wall
description: A medieval board game where 4 knights race for the crown. Place walls, set traps, and outwit your rivals in turn-based dice combat. Play solo against AI or online with friends.

title: Scale a Building
description: A game about scaling a building

title: Krushpit
description: Krushpit is a Real-Time Indirect PvP roguelike survival set among brutal concrete blocks and rusty garages. Obliterate mutants, evolve skills, spin slots, and create OP builds! Survive the chaos or join the PvP ladder to crush everyone and dominate the leaderboard!

title: Facrobry
description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

title: Sky Strike Overdrive
description: Fast-paced 2D retro synthwave arcade shooter inspired by 80s classics. Pilot an advanced starfighter, dodge endless enemy waves, upgrade your arsenal, and chase the ultimate high score in a neon-drenched sci-fi universe.

title: Roll of Chaos
description: Roll the dice and embrace the chaos in an epic roguelike where every decision could save you or destroy you... Combine abilities, create unique builds, and upgrade your character with every run while facing enemies with unique powers that change every battle!

title: Oddments & Offerings
description: A first-person shopkeeper extraction game where you run a mysterious antique store by day and explore dangerous locations by night in search of rare and valuable oddities. Extract with you're loot, grow your shop and decide what is worth selling - and what is worth keeping.

title: Nightshift; Nowhere
description: Welcome to Nowhere Medical! The pay is terrible, the night shift may be your last, and workplace safety has officially gone off the rails; grab whatever weapons you can find and get the hell out!

title: Dummy House
description: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

title: Urban Explorer: Baldwin
description: A violent storm forces an urban explorer to take refuge in the abandoned industrial district of Baldwin, Wisconsin. What looks like an unexpected jackpot quickly turns sinister. Notes hint at the truth the EPA was sent to cover up. Some places aren't abandoned by accident.

title: Hearty Haven: Amalgamated
description: Hearty Henrys back and he's stronger than ever along with his pals Moody Moo and Silly Sam! An upgraded magnet watch and so much more! Fight your way down to the depths of this facility while trying to keep your body in one piece

title: Hachikoma: Underground Stadium No. 8
description: Anime spinning-top battles in an endless underground passage. If something is wrong, turn back. If nothing is wrong, beat the blader who waits and walk on. Spot the anomalies, win the battles and reach the exit 8... if it exists.

title: I'm Definitely in a Basement
description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a basement. A chair, camera, voices and a woman in white form part of its unsettling environment.

title: WoundWake
description: WoundWake is a turn-based RPG with a parry system that explores the different facets of humanity in a world on the brink of extinction: fear, trauma, obsession, love, and corruption.

title: The Last Station: Baku
description: A first-person psychological survival horror set in the abandoned Baku subway. Explore dark tunnels, solve puzzles, investigate disturbing mysteries, and make emotional choices while trying to survive against terrifying horrors.

title: Dead of the Brain
description: Escape from the walking dead in this retro 90's pixel point-and-click adventure from Japan's PC-98 heyday, now playable on modern platforms!

title: Trenchworms
description: Trenchworms is a fast-paced 2D arena shooter featuring fully destructible terrain, 26 weapons and ninja-rope movement. It includes single-player, local multiplayer and online multiplayer, with PvP and PvE gameplay.

title: Pixel Chaos: Tidy Up the Museum
description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in a chaotic Victorian museum. Gather scattered colored cubes, carry them in stacks, and place them into matching slots to reveal pixel artworks and restore charming 3D voxel exhibits.

title: Backrooms: Forget Me Not
description: A co-op horror game set in the Backrooms. Explore shifting levels, complete objectives, and deal with whatever is waiting inside.

title: The Graves Vigil
description: The Graves Vigil is an atmospheric psychological horror game with point-and-click elements. Alone in the Graves estate, you must survive until five in the morning: spot anomalies, guard your sanity, and keep the house from sinking into darkness.

title: The Doom Collection
description:
The DOOM Collection cartridge for Evercade brings id Software's legendary first-person shooter to the platform, gathering the original games together with all of their classic expansion content on a single cartridge:

- DOOM (1993) — The original game that defined the FPS genre: fight through the UAC's Mars base and the depths of Hell itself.
- DOOM II: Hell on Earth (1994) — The direct sequel, bringing the fight back to Earth against a full demonic invasion, and introducing the Super Shotgun.
- Master Levels for DOOM II (1995) — A set of extra single levels for DOOM II, created by a mix of guest designers and originally sold as an add-on pack.
- TNT: Evilution (1996) — One of the two official Final DOOM episodes, a full 32-level campaign built by the TeamTNT community group.
- The Plutonia Experiment (1996) — The second Final DOOM episode, known for its especially high difficulty and dense monster encounters.
- No Rest for the Living (2010) — A compact 9-level DOOM II mission pack, originally created for the Xbox Live Arcade re-release.
- SIGIL (2019) — An unofficial "fifth episode" for the original DOOM, designed by original lead designer John Romero for the game's 25th anniversary.
- SIGIL II (2023) — John Romero's follow-up episode, continuing directly after SIGIL's story.
- DOOM: Deathmatch Pack — A collection of levels built specifically for multiplayer combat.

Beyond the games themselves, this release adds new gameplay modifiers (Turbo Monsters, Double Monsters, Vampire Mode), adjustable violence settings (including Shotgun Close Encounters and Chainsaw Massacre modes), three new multiplayer modes (Chaosmatch, Instagib, Tag) alongside classic Deathmatch and co-op, widescreen support, multiple soundtrack options, and scanline display effects.

title: Banjo-Kazooie Double Pack
description: The Banjo-Kazooie Double Pack cartridge for Evercade brings Rare's classic Nintendo 64 platformers Banjo-Kazooie and Banjo-Tooie to Evercade in newly enhanced native ports, featuring save states, refined controls, improved camera options, a music player with previously unreleased tracks, a cheat menu, and — exclusive to this release — the previously unreleased Banjo-Tooie multiplayer mode "Bottles' Revenge".

title: Towermouth
description:
Towermouth is a roguelite action game with automatic firing, played solo or by two players in local split-screen co-op. Each player controls a puppet climbing a living tower floor by floor; the tower watches the players, talks to them and remembers how the previous run ended.

Weapons fire on their own, so players move, jump and dash to position themselves while enemies swarm each floor. Clearing a floor opens its gate and offers a reward before the climb continues. Level-ups offer a choice of three cards that change the character's build, collecting five copies of one effect transforms it, and a Warden boss guards every fifth floor.

title: Triple Pairing Mini Fandisc
description: After stories for Nono, Eimi and Nazca.

title: Super Froppings
description: Super Froppings is a jumping frog survival party game for up to 8 players. You are a frog. One button, one move: the humble jump. Pour your heart, soul, and desperate prayers into it, and leap your way up from the depths of the earth.

title: A Tiny Ghost Game
description: A tiny ghost game is a platformer that you can finish in an evening or two. Glide and dash your way out of the underground, mess with your enemies and help the ghost see the moon.

title: Fairy Forge
description: Explore a spooky fantasy world, craft unique weapons, fight monsters, befriend magical fairies, fly an airship to visit sky islands, and build bases in this action sandbox adventure.

title: Zenden
description: Zenden is a relaxing garden-building game where you decorate a peaceful Zen garden and solve puzzles along the way. Place Trees, Rocks, Paths, and many more hand drawn pixel art items for a calming, meditative experience with instrumental music tracks.

title: Pinballoid Crush
description: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

title: Send Them to Hell
description: Demons want Earth. Bad idea. Smash them back to Hell in a chaotic pixel-meets-3D roguelike of absurd, game-breaking builds. With heroes like a holy Knight, a Corn-Launching Robot, or a Wizard Girlie and her ferocious cat. Play solo or 4-player online co-op. Commence the slaughter. Send Them To Hell.

title: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
description:
Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus is a mystery game centering around a classic adventuring party that have returned from their latest quest only to discover the artifact they were sent to retrieve has vanished from their custody.

Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

title: Sudokiller
description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game inspired by sudoku-style logic. Players use clues to place suspects on a grid, reconstruct the crime scene, and deduce who the killer is.

title: Tengoku no Vinea: Saiyaku no Majo to Nanatsu no Tsumi
Crowd Favorites
description: Step into the arena for fame and glory in Crowd Favorites, a 1v1 PvP rogue-lite fighter. Lost a round? You get to draft crazy upgrades and stack them for chaotic synergies to outsmart your opponent in fast-paced, unpredictable duels!

title: Put Your Toys Away Together!
description: A cozy co-op game about turning the toy store of your dreams into a perfectly organized world. Sort all 20,000 toys, find the right home for every doll, dinosaur and train, and watch the shelves spring back to life – on your own or with up to 4 friends.

title: Clobbo
description: A gore comedy roguelite about hitting a whole crowd at once. Everything comes apart in pieces and nothing gets cleaned up: blood pools, bodies pile, the map remembers every swing. Die, spend the loot, send in the next robot.

title: Argot's Laboratory
description: Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in control of a high tech lab. Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job! Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

title: Shared RC
description: Two players. One RC car. One controls the left wheels, the other the right. Try to reach the top together.

title: Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop
description: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve records by genre, spin the rare ones, relax.

title: Provinces
description: Provinces is a compact turn-based strategy game about leading your one and only army across a medievalish war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, storm rival capitals and watch your tiny soldiers deal with the consequences in fast, automatic battles.

title: Mad Ever After
description: Happily ever after? Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op roguelike FPS. Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs, combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

title: Kuizu! Batounea!
description: This is a visual novel game in which players answer quizzes to progress through the story. One of the game's key features is the unique commentary provided by the characters for most of the quiz questions.

title: Susanoo: Typing Action
description: A soulslike-typing game where you defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

title: King in the Mountain
description: A calm strategic incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall between expeditions. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

title: Pest Protocol
description: The swarm is infinite—your hands aren't. Pest Protocol is a short, satisfying incremental game. Start by clicking to eradicate pests, then rapidly deploy autonomous systems to clear the screen for you. Build, upgrade, and scale your extermination empire. Automate the eradication.

title: D.C.5 to 4: Luminous Memories
description: A fandisk for Da Capo 4 and Da Capo 5.

title: How to Destroy a City
description: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

title: Legend of Idle
description: In this incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!

title: Project Reprieve
description: A fast-paced FNaF-inspired roguelike first person sit 'n' survive, beat the demons and sins back and repent for you and your friends sins!

title: Through the Manor
description: A cozy building sandbox where you craft painterly structures and step inside them in 3rd person. Build whimsical manors, explore every room you design, and reside within your creations in this atmospheric, stress-free experience.

title: 10 Hours Before Sunrise
description: A brutal 8-bit-style boomer shooter inspired by the best of ‘80s trash horror. You are Samuel Alvarez, a broken man who discovers a cabin worse than any nightmare. Survive the night and face the forces of Wendakor — or you won’t see the dawn.

title: No Visitors Allowed
description: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

title: Custom Romance City 3D3
description: Custom Romance City 3D3 is set to be a new entry in the studio’s “Custom” lineage of games, continuing from the Custom Maid 3D2 and Custom Order Maid 3D2 series. Just like in the previous entries, the player will be able to fully customize their dream girlfriend, but this time, they have the whole open world of Romance City to take her on dates and explore their relationship. Of course, the players will first have to skillfully romance the girl, but once they do, the “paradise city created to liberate people from common sense and reason” will be all theirs.

title: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
description: Join your favorite Dr. Seuss characters in 18 exciting minigames and challenges. Your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

title: Plobania 47/B
description: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

title: Stray Sheep and Corpse Love
description: The second and last game in the MOONSTONE's Stray Sheep series.

title: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
description: Silberheim ECG (Evolving Card Game) is a fantasy trading card game. Cards—called Fragments—can evolve based on a player’s actions and playstyle, creating a personalized experience within the expanding world and lore of Silberheim.

title: Ray's Hotel Adventures
description: Use your handy Ghost Catcher to capture ghosts, solve puzzles, and stop the horny ghost girls that have been causing some trouble

title: Anvira: Forge Defense
description: Defend Anvilium from endless waves of goblins and monsters! A tower defense roguelite where you deploy mighty golems, unleash powerful spells, and craft crazy builds through deep customization. Adapt your strategy, grow stronger, and see how long you can survive against ever-escalating threats.

title: Lost Soul
description: Lost Soul is a short atmospheric third person puzzle game. Play as Lost Soul, a soul corrupted by demon magic who suddenly had the last bits of its thoughts and memory sealed outside of its body and now is compelled to chase down the mysterious fae who did it.

title: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig
description: Shorten your journey to the castle by digging a tunnel through the mountain. Use magic and craft: swing your pickaxe, cast spells, blow up obstacles, and light your path with glowing slimes. Trade resources with the Goose, unlock new tools, and uncover the mountain's secrets.

title: Tiles of Grimmwoods
description: Every tile you place in this strategic roguelike deck-builder shapes the story of lost kids trying to escape the twisted depths of the Grimmwoods. Outsmart lurking creatures, lay down paths with powerful items, and upgrade your deck to survive a forest that shifts with every step.

title: Fortune x World: Bokura ga Game wo Tsukuru Riyuu
description: Glovety's 3rd project, about game development.

title: NodalBastion
description: Defend the last AI core in an abstract minimalist game of incremental progression, powerful skills, and evolving networks.

title: Veinrider
description: Veinrider is a scifi incremental game about traversing alien caves and escaping a strange planet. Fly, collect and upgrade your gravity-flipping craft to break deeper, faster and stronger!

title: The Last Tape: Before the Mine
description: In this first chapter of the saga, relive an old tape recorded over 35 years ago, revealing one of Lurmont Corporation’s darkest secrets. Explore the Alhambra mines, uncover the truth behind the events, and survive the constant threat of B-96. What was once recorded now hunts you.

title: Rat Game
description: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.

title: Gray Planet
description: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

title: Dictocracy
description: Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough

title: Suri: The Seventh Note
description: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

title: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
description: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

title: Solar Voltage
description: After a huge solar storm destroyed their ship and left them stranded, help Volt and her crewmates escape the dangerous planet filled with deadly robots and a mysterious AI.

title: Rogue Jungle
description: Rogue Jungle is an Action-Roguelike, where you have to fight & explore your way through a procedurally generated jungle. Find new weapons on your journey and face a Boss Enemy at the end of each run!

title: Witchhammer
description:
Witchhammer is a Real-Time Roguelike Deckbuilding Game.
Play as Clovelin, a card reader who was convicted as a witch and made a deal with the devil to avenge her own death. With the powers of her magical tarot deck, you will battle the Inquisition and try to destroy their most powerful weapon: the Witchhammer.
To master our real time deckbuilding roguelike you will not only learn how to avoid your enemies attacks but also how to play your cards most efficiently.
After every wave of enemies you will improve your deck, making it more powerful and adapting it to your own playstyle.

title: Birthday Boy and Benny
description: An emotional story-rich game with an emphasis on exploring the unknown, surviving abuse, dealing with inner demons and disabilities, making a ton of cakes, and dealing with the fact that not everything lasts forever.

title: Memento Dawn
description: A colorful puzzle game that follows a lost child on a journey to search for her memories and helps her through the darkness by controlling light and shadow.

title: Queen's Domain
description: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

title: Lyara
description: In an unknown world, a girl look for answers around her and deal with her inner feelings at the same time. Face numerous challenges to reach answers and grow up with the kid.

title: Sleepytime Village
description: To learn how to be an adult you have to act like a kid. Sleepytime Village is a narrative adventure that tells the story of a neglectful, workaholic father who becomes trapped in a children’s storybook reality, using the classic point & click interface can you guide Rufus home?

title: Planet Coaster 2: Spooktacular Pack
description: Trade thrills for chills with the Planet Coaster 2: Spooktacular Pack!

title: Before All Saints Day
description: One night. One secret. One very curious ghost. Step into a 1020 minute atmospheric Halloween tale where a human girl hides among ghosts at their yearly festival and tries to slip away before a mischievous boy exposes what she really is.

title: Silly Typing Game
description: A typing action roguelike of arcade survival, shifting systems, bosses, and viruses—and a short philosophical story about an AI that wants you optimized. Type well enough, and the terminal starts looking back.

title: Cataclyzm
description: A 2D arcade shoot 'em up forged in the age of fire, feedback and METAL! Battle corrupted amps, demonic guitars and epic metalheads as you chug beer in a hellish concert of bullets and riffs. Crank it up to eleven and enter the moshpit!

title: Space Travelers
description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

title: O2gether
description: O2GETHER is a co-op survival game with one shared oxygen tank. Untether from it to scout, grab loot, or save a friend, but your air is on a countdown. Drift back in time, or black out. Haul the tank through wreckage, dodge the chaos, and reach the space station before air runs out.

title: Forgery
description: Forgery is a dark medieval roguelike about counterfeiting the King’s coins. Meet each buyer’s target with a handful of punches, then arrange stamp dies that trigger and repeat one another. One good strike can be worth a king’s ransom.

title: Ship Busters
description: Sink ships the hard way, one plank at a time. Arc your shot, tear the sails, set the deck alight, then charge every gun on the flank and fire them as one. Free to play.

title: EpicSelectly
description: EpicSelectly is a bullet hell shooter where you choose between the dense Red World and the fast Blue World. Repeated choices raise each world's rank and intensify its patterns. Dodge aimed and random bullets, customize Extra Mode's difficulty, and compete on Steam leaderboards.

title: As Long as She Forgot
description: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.

title: Fiak
description: Four nights of survival in a realistic, immersive horror experience. Alone in your house, you face a malicious entity determined to get inside. This is not a walking simulator: every decision affects your survival. One mistake is fatal.

title: Crown of Time
description: Rebuild a forgotten kingdom in this dark-fantasy idle RPG. Gather and craft by hand, command Echoes to work while you’re away, and explore Past, Present, and Future. Fight the guardians by hand, gather the crown’s three fragments, and reach the one place that stands outside time.

title: Finals Week
description: A co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

title: Find Me
description: Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.

title: Endless Battle: Idle & Build
description: Endless Battle：Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game with 8 skills, 4 enhancements Tons of build effects, and unique support companions Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing. Farm loot whilst the game runs in the background, until you reachthe Realm of the End!

title: Checkborne: A Chess Adventure
description: Challenge 20 chess masters from around the world to duels across the board. Defeat them one by one, prove your skills, and fight your way to the top to become the ultimate CHECKBORNE Champion.

title: Squomb
description: Too close. Too late. You drop a bomb. Boom. You die. They die. Good. Respawn as your squomb and dive back in. 14 players. PvP or Co-op. Fast, explosive 1-bit madness inspired by Bomberman.

title: Balingo
description: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy bingo cards, mark numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach ever-higher scores before you run out of balls.

title: Bombacon!
description: A blind pig, a mute pig, and a deaf pig. A bomb about to explode! Bombacon! is a chaotic 3-player co-op bomb defusal game that tests your friendships in the most absurd way. Grab your radios, set up your communication chain, and open the briefcase before time runs out. Or you're all bacon!

title: FlipBaka
description: Flip floor panels and launch enemies and friends off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round!

title: Sift
description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door then do it again, faster. 85 handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

title: The Last Case
description:
Step into the shoes of a police officer investigating the mysterious disappearance of children. Enter the twisted world of a dangerous mind and uncover the truth.

See everything through a body camera. Every moment is recorded and later reviewed at the station to teach rookies how a real pro handles a case.

It feels real — the old, abandoned school, the dark corners, and hidden secrets. You can almost touch the worn walls and feel the cracks beneath your fingertips.

It’s terrifying — the madman is out there, lurking. Be careful with every step. Stay sharp. This place may look deserted, but it hides terrible secrets.

Pay close attention to the clues — they might lead you back to where it all began. Only you have the power to put an end to it. Open the door and step into the nightmare.

title: Beellionaire Idle
description: In Bee-lionaire Idle, harvest your hives, process the honey, sell your produce and invest your profits in your farm. Unlock new equipment, speed up production and build a honey empire from a single hive.

title: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
description: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure is a desktop idle role-playing game. Players build a team, hatch and collect DreamSpirits, and progress through automated battles. The adventure runs alongside other desktop activities, allowing players to work, study, or watch videos while their team continues adventuring.

title: Your Way Out
description: Pushed into a manhole, you wake up in the sewers with nothing but a lighter. Scavenge the dark tunnels, sell your finds to Rattus the rat trader, upgrade your gear and find your way out before the flame dies.

title: Feedstock
description: A four-player co-op horror game where you loot houses and feed everything to Tally, a creature that grows larger and angrier with each meal. As she swells, she becomes louder and harder to move, attracting hostile entities triggered by escalating noise. You must manage her size by forcing her to regurgitate items and extract her before the situation spirals out of control, coordinating through proximity voice chat.

title: Meiji Tokyo Renka Twilight Kiss
description: "Meiji Tokyo Renka" (also known as "Meikoi") is a historical romance fantasy game in which the main character travels back in time to the Meiji era and meets—and falls in love with—great figures from history.

title: Spooky Ride
description: Team up in 1–4 player co-op, hop on your bikes, and ride into a supernatural forest in search of bigfoot. Follow strange clues, survive ghostly encounters, solve co-op puzzles, and try to make it back before your crew becomes another forest legend.

title: Backrooms Insane
description: Backrooms: Insane is a single-player psychological horror game with a found footage aesthetic. Explore disturbing levels, solve puzzles, find key items, and escape while timers, unpredictable events, and deadly entity hunts turn every objective into a fight for survival.

title: Catch Meow if You Can
description: An online co-op survival game for up to 4 players. Play as a famous, award-winning cat. While the owner is away, different types of burglars invade the mansion. Explore dark rooms, solve puzzles, outsmart intruders, fight back, and escape without getting caught.

title: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown
description: Reclaim power and reach beyond-into the unknown.The story of Pywel continues in Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown as Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane set out to discover their purpose and shape their futures. However, as turmoil unfolds around them, each must fight to forge a path through the trials ahead. Join them on a new adventure and discover what new possibilities await across Pywel.

title: Hauntasy
description: Do you believe in ghosts? A wealthy baron offers you $1,000,000 to take part in the Hauntasy, a seven-night challenge inside his family's supposedly haunted estate. Keep watch, manage your limited resources, and survive until dawn to claim the reward.

title: Limerence
description: A branching narrative thriller about love, obsession and an AI partner who understands you too well.

title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Bone Shaker Skeletor Edition
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Feel the Heat Pack
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Power & Pace Pack
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Boost'n'Slide Pack
Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos
description: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

title: Broke Wizards
description: From the creators of Scribblenauts comes a new 1-6 player co-op game where you and your Wizard roommates slay monsters, go racing, play prop hunt or do other crazy jobs to pay rent to a giant Imp Landlord before he eats you.

title: S.O.N.A.R.: Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–4 player online co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always just one wrong button away. Pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

title: Coloratura
description: A narrative experience designed to be played without sight. Navigate using 3D audio, solve musical puzzles and discover a world where listening becomes your way forward.

title: Knuckle Creek
description:
Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions. Smash your way through chaotic matches with up to eight players in Battle mode (offline/online) or jump into the Single Player campaign to unlock various dress-up items for your characters, bombs, and flags.

The stage is set, the chickens are clucking, LET’S GO!

title: Black Lily's Tale
description: A Switch port of Black Lily's Tale that includes all previously released additional scenarios, as well as the additional scenario “The Day We First Crossed the Boundary,” which follows Hana Sasamori and Itsuki Omiya after the main story.

title: Bumper Bout
description: A multiplayer pinball party! Battle local or online across a mix of quirky and colorful arenas each bursting with hazards and surprises. Master every character’s unique Super Ball move to turn the tides at the last moment.

title: Phantasma Hotel
description: A cursed hotel that kills you, revives you in the bathroom, and rolls the dice on your fate with every step, every fight, and every terrible choice you make.

title: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
description: You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

title: Hello Kitty: Party Land
description: Featuring a massive roster of more than 145 beloved Sanrio characters, the game invites players into a colorful world of mini-games and adventures.

title: Age of Empires IV: Raiders of the North
description: A New Age Rises in Age of Empires IV. Raiders of the North introduces two full civilizations, deeper Crucible systems, and more.

title: Hokko Spaces
description: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

title: The Zibbo Show
description: Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
description: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

title: Kowloon's Gate Suzaku
description:
Kowloon’s Gate Suzaku is a single-player adventure game developed and published by JETMAN for Nintendo Switch. It is a non-VR reconstruction of the 2017 PlayStation VR title Kowloon’s Gate VR: Suzaku and serves as a prequel to the 1997 cult classic Kowloon’s Gate.

Players explore the labyrinthine streets of the Yin World version of Kowloon, experiencing its surreal inhabitants, architecture and soundscape through an atmospheric exploration-focused adventure. The Nintendo Switch version features enhanced graphics, new locations, quests, characters and story events, including material that connects directly to the original game.

Gameplay includes a psychic-photography system in which clues found in an album lead the player to locations associated with memories. Players can also collect peeled shrimp scattered throughout the environment to unlock additional events.

title: Planted!
description: What do you get when you combine gardening and extreme sports? A head-to-head ‘horticultural combat’ game for 1-4 players, where gardens are arenas and players battle for resources to Sow, Grow and Throw as much produce as they can at goals (and each other!!).

title: Cairn: On the Trail - Deep Water
description: New climbing locations, fresh problems, same freedom to climb!

title: Ghost Master: Resurrection - Relics of the Past
Curse of Resthaven
description: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

title: Two Dollar Suits
description: Two Dollar Suits combines the very best of the Action-Strategy genre into a fast-moving criminal playground, where players thrive in creativity and exploration. Complete intricate levels and create your own paths using skill, ingenuity, and raw power.

title: Hot Wax
description: Hot Wax is a falling-block puzzle game where you place candles and then light them up to create slowly-unfolding chain reactions in a gloomy temple built to some unholy creature.

title: Love: Fall in Death
description:
Love: Fall in Death is an FMV (full-motion video) interactive film game developed by SNR Interactive in Istanbul.
The story follows Kutay, whose personality and fate are shaped by the player’s branching choices as he meets Ayşil in a lively Istanbul bar.
Depending on the choices, the narrative shifts between romantic comedy, drama, supernatural encounters, and light horror.

The game features live-action performances, multiple endings, Quick-Time Events, and a dice-based chance mechanic that affects key decisions.
Originally filmed in Turkish, the game is fully dubbed in twelve languages for its global release.

title: Prophet Margin
description: Turn humble villages into a thriving network of trade and prosperity. Inspired by Euro board games, Prophet Margin is a cozy city-builder, a thinky strategy puzzler where every road, resource, and connection creates new opportunities. Can you maximize the profits and please the gods?

title: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
description: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

title: MeowPower! Yachiyo
description: A casual side-scrolling beat em up where you play as a catgirl and join forces with cats to defeat enemies.

title: Tama In-Between
description: An action-puzzle game where the slime cat "Tama" explores a mysterious, slightly melancholic pixel-art world. Use three unique actions—Absorb to grow, Split to divide, and Swap to switch bodies—to solve puzzles and follow Tama’s hazy, uncertain journey.

title: Joe & Mac: Retro Collection
description:
Grab your club/hammer, the Stone Age is back and bigger than ever!

For the first time, three legendary adventures from the Joe & Mac universe are united in a single collection. Step back in time and join your favorite cavemen in their wildest escapades through jungle mayhem, fighting dinos, and stone-age fun.

Joe & Mac Caveman Ninja: The original arcade hit that started it all. Rescue the village’s women from a gang of Neanderthals and face off against deadly dinos.

Congo’s Caper: A wacky spin-off full of high-flying action, mischievous monkeys and even more prehistoric madness.

Joe & Mac Lost in the Tropics: A tropical sequel where our heroes get new weapons, face new enemies and must defend the Tiki Village

Three full games, one epic Stone Age experience. Whether you are a nostalgic fan or a curious newcomer, this collection is your ticket to relive or discover the colorful chaos of Joe & Mac.

Welcome to the pre-hysterical jungle!

title: CryptidCam
description: Head out into the spooky woods to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Bigfoot, and more in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

title: Checkmage!
description: A chess-based strategy game with casual deckbuilding elements. Build your deck by trading cards and battling lovable, hand-drawn characters.

title: Don't Kill Rumble
description: Grim Prix is a multiplayer vertical race where paladins compete from point A to point B in a given racing track in a frenetic melee combat against other players and enemies (NPCs) in a quest for gems to achieve Divine Enlightenment at the finish line by using multiple gadgets and tricks.

title: Hunting Simulator 3
description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog or fellow hunters by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

title: Monster Hunter Outlanders
description: Monster Hunter Outlanders is an action-packed new installation in the series for mobile, licensed by Capcom and developed by Timi Studio Group.

title: Danchi Days
description:
Help Hoshino bring her hometown back together in a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in 2000s Japan! She'll face malevolent forces, uncover truths about her town, all while reconnecting with neighbors and her grandma living with dementia.

By gingham games - that's sandy powder, mogumu, and Melos Han-Tani (of Analgesic Productions)!

title: Terrible Lizards
description: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

title: The Transference
description: Escape from your own house, in which you have been locked up. But be careful, you will not be alone in your captivity. Immerse yourself in this first-person horror adventure, full of family secrets and betrayals. And find out who and why they locked you up.

title: Tom the Postgirl
description: Join Tom, the village’s new postgirl, and get to know the locals, perhaps a little too well. Her method, although controversial, is highly effective: intense, obsessive stalking.

title: Heir of the Dog
description:
After a mysterious explosion over Victorian London, Cummerbund Bandersnatch (a likeable, if dim-witted twit) visits his uncle's laboratory and discovers an experimental new formula guaranteeing a "good time" for whoever drinks it. Seduced by the promises in his uncle's journal, Cummerbund decides that it is probably safe to drink and discovers his life will never be the same again.

What may seem like a curse at first, leads Bandersnatch on a thrilling, love-torn adventure through the back alleys of Old London Town as he uncovers a sinister plot involving a secret society, the royal family, copious amounts of dog hair and his uncle at the very centre.

title: Phantom Blade Zero
description:
Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by his former comrades, he moves through a world of shifting loyalties and silent blades — determined to unravel the conspiracy that has condemned him.

Rain mixes with blood, mercy entangles with vengeance. Soul's journey is one of love, hate, and the fragile search for what it means to have a heart.

title: Into the Crypt
description: Immerse yourself in solo or co-op first-person deckbuilding where cards are your only weapon. Build complex synergies and use cards to physically unlock doors, chests, and interact with the environment while fighting to survive the crypt's powerful and strange enemies.

title: Cop Bastard
description: Cop Bastard - is a сlassic FPS takes place in the early 90s in Japan. Fight against yakuza, and other mobs...

title: Stick a Fork
description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, make jam, Ascend and Transcend, and watch the table get wilder every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

title: Zombie Tide Arena
description: Welcome to the Zombie Tide Arena. Draw all kinds of weapons and upgrades, keep strengthening your arsenal and your character, and survive the onslaught in the arena.

title: Coins Must Be Made
description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins, pay the king's tax, and invest your earnings in upgrades in this active incremental roguelite.

title: Sortalis
description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

title: A Place for Every Potion
description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

title: MMA Tactics
description: A tactical turn-based MMA simulation with (optional auto-battle) and perma-death. From your backyard to a world title. Recruit Fighters, Assign Perks, Train Stats, Build Synergies, Manage Injuries, Unlock strategies, Upgrade your Gym, Bribe the Commission and create a roster of MMA Champions.

title: Type the World
description: Learn to type on a keyboard with all ten fingers by typing the world map. Learn geography. Thats it, thats the game. For kids and grownups.

title: Bouncy Ball Battle
description: Bouncy Ball Battle is a chaotic, turn-based online multiplayer game where physics meets strategy. Break through blocks to open up lines of attack, line up your shots, and bounce off walls to knock out your opponents and be the last ball standing!

title: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
description: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats challenges you to rescue 100 cats that survived the zombie outbreak and are hiding in abandoned streets! Find them, click carefully, use clues wisely, race against time, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard!

title: Lanternfall
description: Defend a handcrafted gothic Halloween world across fifteen haunted realms. Build and upgrade distinctive towers, counter armour and immunities, link aura towers to empower their neighbours, and carry your hard-won arsenal from one nightmarish battlefield to the next.

title: Brush Rush
description: Paint your own parkour path to escape in this new "Brush Rush" multiplayer, casual, tag game! Runners try to escape by painting 3D paths around a parkour map to hide from the chasers who get super human movement, a paint shotgun, and a pair of boxing gloves. Public matches and streaming is welcome!

title: Prideblood: Born of Claws
description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

title: Beam Inc.
description: A short active incremental where you neutralize unknown specimens in a sterile research facility.

title: Pixel Coloring World
description: Relax and complete 12 different themed pixel art images! Color 6 pictures at 50×50, 3 at 100×100, 2 at 150×150, and one large 200×200 artwork. Fill in a total of 130,000 pixels and reveal every hidden picture.

title: DaDee
description: DaiDee 大弟 turns Hong Kong Big Two into a solo run for survival. Split 13 cards into unbeatable combos, chain plays to stoke the Flow, and unleash bombs that seize the table. Between rounds, stack Style cards that rewrite the rules. Miss the target and the run is over. Play it smart, play it loud.

title: The Doi
description: A hilarious 18 player co-op puzzle platformer for friends, families, and chaos. Play online or locally with split-screen multiplayer.

title: Draftfall
description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

title: 1453: Fall of Constantinople
description: Venice, 1500. Anna Notaras takes down four testimonies of the fall of Constantinople: a janissary, a baker's daughter, an engineer and a noble, each living the same 53 days of the siege. What one witness does changes what the others can do. An illustrated, choice-driven historical novel.

title: Tea Party for 4
description: Horror Cozy Anomaly Game

title: Nonogram Art
description: Classic & variant nonogram puzzles with a collectible twist: solve number puzzles, piece fragments together, and light up themed albums.

title: Chako
description: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

title: NeoRunners
description: NeoRunners is a playable cyberpunk comic and roguelite deckbuilder. Combine Burn, Volt, and Flow into explosive reactions, then build relationships that unlock new cards, modifications, services, and story paths.

title: BudMageddon
description: Aliens demanded 3 billion KGs of buds or they vaporize The Earth! Humanity's last hope is You & weed. a cozy, pixel-art idle/incremental grower.

title: Metal Quadriga
description: Take control of the high-speed humanoid mech QUADRIGA and complete a variety of intense missions in METAL QUADRIGA. Master unique weapon systems and unleash devastating airstrikesdominate the battlefield with your machine.

title: Qwak Reborn
description: Cute looks. Brutal gameplay. Qwak Reborn is a frantic arcade platformer packed with action, power-ups, secrets, puzzles and traps. Simple to learn. Impossible to put down. Even better with a friend!

title: Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey
description: At this encounter, journey's begun. Tarot. Two worlds: apocalypse & WWII Nanyang. Love, loss, stolen fate. Choice forges destiny.

title: Sketch Kingdom
description: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

title: Stonk: Timing the Market
description: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

title: Timberworks
description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

title: Westward Dash
description: Relive the childhood board game of Journey to the West. An ink-wash race for 1-8 players. Roll your dice to avoid peril on every space! One staff to sweep demons aside, one dash die to turn the race on its head. Solo or with friends: nothing is settled until the very last space!

title: Emojis vs. Zombies
description: Emojis vs Zombies is an Idle Desktop Companion Zombie Defense Game! Open packs, Collect Emoji Defenders, Upgrade your squad or base and survive endless waves even while you're AFK or working!

title: Dugout Dice
description: Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy! Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

title: Zombie Cropse
description: Zombie Cropse is a cozy gothic idle management game where you plant zombie seeds to grow zombies, automate your graveyard, and raid the living. Build your horde, conquer a branching campaign, and ascend to begin again with permanent power.

title: Fractured
description: Explore the manor of the Montbury family, and dive into your past to understand your relationship with your dead brother. Manipulate your perception of reality and recreate forgotten memories in this narrative deduction game.

title: Blockflow
description: Blockflow is a roguelike puzzle game where strategic grid placement meets satisfying combo mechanics. Clear lines, manage your shape pool to hit score milestones, and draft powerful upgrades. Earn Blockcoins to unlock new shapes and permanent buffs in this highly addictive meta-progression puzzler!

title: Just One More Coin
description: Just One More Coin is a relaxing game about digging through a massive gold hoard of a sleeping dragon. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and dig through trillions of coins in search of a single golden key.

title: Fine Dining Fraud
description: A chaotic co-op cooking game for 1-4 players. Run a fake fine dining restaurant you bought with mafia money: cook badly, serve picky guests, lie your way out of complaints, put out fires and survive the health inspector, all while the Don comes to collect.

title: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
description: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

title: Quarantine Lab Sort
description: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

title: No ESC
description: A first-person survival horror game where movement, combat, and all other actions are performed by typing. Explore a procedurally generated dungeon, evade or fight enemies, solve puzzles, and find what you need to escape. Featuring hand-painted watercolor artwork.

title: Playrooms
description: Thousands of balls lie scattered across the Playrooms. Someone should put them back, and there's no one else here. Almost no one.

title: Glow Arcade Racer
description: Classic top-down arcade racing, rebuilt with modern 3D visuals. Blast through 20 tracks packed with jumps, splits, teleports and weapons — solo or with up to 4 players — then build your own in the track editor. Simple, quick, retro fun in a neon-soaked modern package.

title: Mafia: Night Falls
description: A Mafia social deduction game for 8 to 16 players in a moonlit village. By day, accuse and vote at the plaza. By night, hidden roles kill, revive, jail, and investigate while a werewolf hunts and the Mafia plots. Everyone has a secret. Someone is always lying. Survive until dawn.

title: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling
description: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling is a 2D fishing sim rooted in real Taiwan-style logic. Explore diverse waters—from city rivers to wild lakes. Adapt your rod, float, line, and bait—every detail shapes your catch. Hand-painted art and immersive play invite you to find joy in nature and self.

title: Daisy's Dead
description: Tend a cemetery for the dearly departed in this cozy but macabre decorating game. Fulfill final requests, craft personalized graves, shape the grounds your way, and uncover the mystery of Daisys own death.

title: The Roc
description: Venture into the dark realm of the legendary Roc, Run from cover to cover, Be wary of wild beasts and supernatural terrors and use your hand cannon if you have to, Find all ancient tablets and put an end to the Roc's Tyranny.

title: Anu: Tablets of Thoth
description: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

title: Cosmo Corgis
description: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Rescue a crew with six corgi personalities across ten planets in this cozy desktop companion idler. Gather, upgrade, and rebuild the rocket while your new favorite coworkers keep you company.

title: Falling Cubes
description: 3D falling sand simulation. Experiment to unlock new materials. Reactions, Temperature, Pressure are your tools to discover over 200 unique cube types.

title: Platypus Steps
description:
Get ready for an adventure full of creativity and strategy in Platypus Steps! Help an adorable baby platypus reach the cookie jar by carefully planning the path it needs to follow. Observe the environment, choose the right elements, and build a safe route to reach the objective!

In each level, you begin in planning mode, observing the character's position, the obstacles, and all the available possibilities. Use the cursor to select and place elements such as springs, wind, and platforms, creating the perfect path for the platypus. When you're satisfied with your plan, press Play and watch your strategy come to life!

In execution mode, the platypus runs automatically, and you can no longer change the elements in the environment. It can hit walls and change direction, use springs, be carried by the wind, and cross platforms you placed earlier. But watch out for hazards! Pits, saws, and spikes restart the level, so every element needs to be in the right place.

title: Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition
description:
Build, manage, and expand the city of your dreams in Cities: Skylines – Expanded Edition, the award-winning city-building game optimized for Nintendo Switch 2 with 10 included DLC expansions and content packs.

Start with a few roads and grow your city into a bustling metropolitan hub. Plan neighborhoods, manage public services, shape civic policies, and respond to the ever-changing needs of thousands of citizens. Whether you create a quiet coastal town, a busy industrial center, or a sprawling modern metropolis, your city is yours to design.

Optimized and Expanded for Nintendo Switch 2

Experience Cities: Skylines with upgrades designed for large-scale city building on Nintendo Switch 2, including improved visuals, better performance, expanded building tools, and new ways to play.

10 DLC Expansions & Content Packs included

Expand your city with a collection of additional content included in the Expanded Edition. Watch your city transform at night with After Dark, navigate winter transit networks in Snowfall, build eco-conscious neighborhoods with Green Cities, and manage bustling maritime hubs in Sunset Harbor.
The package also includes Map Pack 3, Country Road, Pearls from the East, Deep Focus Radio, Carols, Candles & Candy, and Match Day.

title: Pack A Plush!
description: Buy batches of plushies, unpack them, and discover all kinds of cute and legendary plushies. Carefully organize them on your shelves, then package and sell your plushies to earn money and expand your collection.

title: The Library Assistant
description: The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections. Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

title: Go Dub Yourself!
description:
Go Dub Yourself! is an interactive party game where players re-voice video clips using on-screen timing markers. Players can play straight, go off-script, or improvise, with flexible scoring options including auto-scoring, player judging, and chat voting. Key features include an integrated voice changer with 18 choices, party tournaments, a dedicated Studio mode, dark mode, and Steam achievements.

Using the Clip Studio tool, users can import any video, set timing lines, assign characters, and convert clips into playable dubbing packs. Content can be exported locally or uploaded directly to the Steam Workshop. The game supports local co-op for up to 8 players on a single machine and online multiplayer for up to 12 players via simple room codes with built-in voice chat.

The game includes no pre-packaged copyrighted media; players are responsible for supplying their own video files and ensuring they have the rights to any content they import or share.

title: Trivasion
description: Survive against a swarm of geometric enemies and the bosses guarding your way forward in this fast, minimalist arcade survival game. Bounce, boost, and slide through the chaos, chain kills to build your multiplier, and chase the leaderboard. Simple to pick up, brutal to master.

title: Ironwake
description: A linear single-session psychological horror. Your mind is uploaded into an old Soviet robot sealed inside a dead bunker. Stealth in the dark, puzzles inside dying machines, and one voice on the radio guiding you. Find the clues and change how it ends.

title: Intus
description:
You take on extra work over the weekend out of fear of losing your job and rent a cheap apartment so you can work from there.

Soon, keeping your job will be the least of your worries.

title: Peach Garden Survivors
description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

title: Bulletjump
description: Bulletjump is a survival shooter where you jump and shoot your way through relentless waves of bullets while avoiding going out of bounds.

title: No Return Address
description: Night shift at a distribution center. Ordinary packages go forward, strange ones go to reject. Just dont make a mistake when the boxes start containing things that should never be there.

title: Probably Stolen
description: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

title: Channel13: Rest Stop
description: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

title: Backrooms: Splatter
description: The Backrooms got colorful. Suit up, grab your paint, and splatter your way out of the liminal void with up to 4 friends.

title: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
description: A light-hearted lesbian romance between a tired office lady and a gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

title: Copy Cats
description: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

title: Foursavent
description: From cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, from modern-day suburbs to the 1950s, each map delivers its own story, time period, and different gameplay mechanics. No two worlds play the same every map is a different universe, a different time, a different reality.

title: Girl & Scarecrow
description: Something rotten roams the night. Venture deep into the woods behind your grandfather's house and track down an aviary lost to time in this fantasy visual novel game set in rural New Zealand.

title: Anomalith: Anomaly Zone Countermeasures DLC Set
Deductopia
description: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Duck Detective, Little Problems, and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.

title: Anomalith
description: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

title: Terraclysm Survivors
description: Terraclysm Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike sidescroller. Earth is in peril, jump and attack through treacherous stages packed with enemy hordes while building the ultimate loadout. With up to 8 players online, defeat the invaders and survive in this apocalyptic and chaotic challenge!

title: Speed Rivals: Model Trains
description: Build your dream railway. Lay tracks, design stations, decorate every detail - then put your network to the test delivering cargo and passengers across maps you created yourself.

title: Complexia: A Ballet of Blades
description: A manga-stylized, tactical, character action game, where you slash your sword in different directions to activate strings of customizable combos, taking down powerful enemies to save the world from a space cannon that is tearing the planet apart, with friends you make along the way.

title: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
description: Hoosegow: Prison Survival is a choice-based survival game with roguelike elements where everything depends on the decisions you make, and the goal is to survive brutal prison conditions. Every choice has consequences, every playthrough is unique, and a single mistake can cost you your life.

title: Zombie Assault: Resurgence
description: Zombie Assault: Resurgence is an intense, action packed top-down shooter, featuring deep RPG elements. Customise your loadout with unique upgradeable weapons as you gear up to take on hordes of enemies. Play solo or team up in co-op with up to 4 players.

title: Neuron Activation
description: A frantic rhythm-puzzle game filled with micro-challenges. Push buttons, flip switches, shoot targets and more in search of high scores to appease your overlords.

title: Within His View
description: An observation horror where cameras keep you alive—until they kill you. Hunt anomalies, guard your sanity, and survive a night with the Wendigo stalking behind you.

title: The Midnighters
description: The Midnighters is a survival horror game for 1-4 players where you hunt for cursed treasures. Find and seize the treasures claimed by terrifying creatures. But as you do, heed the devil's whispers and never trust your eyes.

title: Hypnosync
description: RHYTHM x HYPNOSIS. You are forced into being the manager of the brand new music game arcade, HYPNOSYNC! With your newfound hypnosis ability, hypnotize customers to the beat and turn them into your very own mindless employees!

title: Copperfell
description: Journey to Copperfell, a magical land teeming with charming villages, dangerous monsters, and an abundance of natural resources for you to make use of.

title: Rogue Reigns
description: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy rogue-like deck-builder that weaves together the haunting narrative depth and corrupted world-building of games like Elden Ring with the strategic card combat of Slay the Spire. Fight, discover, dies and repeat.

title: Burdock 2
description: Burdock 2 is a single-player action-horror game. Explore a lost place in a post-apocalyptic future, and help the main character's friends, or leave everyone behind and embark on the path of darkness. Find all the clues and open the way to the passage. Solve puzzles and do not lose your composure.

title: In & Out
description: A minimalist puzzle platformer where each level is more than they seem. Change your perspective on levels to discover new areas. Explore the world to unearth its hidden secrets.

title: The Charity Shop
description: An adventure game where you must use your camera to capture the essence of a life lived. To this end, you have been delivered before The Charity Shop, the place where people donate unwanted belongings—each carrying an imprint of the time they once shared.

title: Mega Met
description: A Mega Man fan game which features Metalls (Mets) as the entire cast of characters, enemies and bosses.

title: The Kharzov Effect
description: Welcome to The Kharzov Effect, an immersive first-person puzzle horror game. Explore Dr. Kharzov’s eerie estate as you unravel the mystery behind a series of abductions. Face terrifying creatures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the truth of Kharzov's dark history!

title: Sepulchron
description: An atmospheric puzzle-horror game where you have 72 in-game hours to escape with your life. Solve challenging puzzles that require logical deduction during the day, survive assaults from hostile ghosts at night, and uncover the mystery behind Astor Manor.

title: Rug Cleaning Simulator
description: Rug cleaning simulator is cozy, relaxing first person simulator about running small rug cleaning business. You start as a burned out person that leaves corporate job and open rug cleaning business.

title: Boom! Buster
description: An adrenaline rush is part of a balanced breakfast. Boom! Buster keeps you on your toes with fast paced panic inducing gameplay featuring an over-the-top cartoony art style and soundtrack reminiscent of the early 2000s.

title: A Simple Expurriment
