description: A cartoony, combat-free metroidvania with puzzles, stealth and genetically modified kittens. Help a cat mom rescue her abducted children by doing typical, not-so-typical and definitely atypical cat things: run walls up and down, turn to liquid and rearrange parts of the alien ship like pieces of a puzzle.

title: Gennady
description: An old-school action platformer with rogue-lite elements. Imagine your grumpy neighbor blowing up the backside of an alien world with a blaster instead of resting after his shift. Blood, noir, and green slime.

title: Grimmlins Tale
description: Grimmlins Tale is an action adventure monster tamer where you catch, train, and bond with all fairy tale inspired monsters. Fight alongside your monster friends in deep, real-time strategic combat, and hop on their backs to explore in the whimsical world of Never Everland.

title: Airport Contraband
description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

title: Cloud Patrol
description: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

title: VPet Sort Together: Cozy Tidy Up
description: A cozy organizing sim for 14 players: sort 9,600+ virtual pet toys egg keychains, boxed pets, watches, rings and more onto the shelves of a pastel VPet shop. Toss, stack and tidy up the chaos together, unlock skills and perks, no timer.

title: Dying Patience
description: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

title: GemCremental
description: Craft a variety of gems and become the greatest witch! It's a cozy incremental crafting game.

title: Block Battlefield
description: Block Battlefield is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

title: Capsule Arcade
description: A cozy first-person tidying game in a neon capsule-toy arcade. Crack open capsules, sort 216 cute figures into their display cases and bring six dark floors of Hoshizora Capsule Hall back to life, one glowing machine at a time.

title: Dungeon Cleared!
description: Pick four heroes and enter the dungeon. Hopefully four come back. The rules are simple. The dungeon maybe not. Position your party, manage spells, avoid traps and survive ten procedural levels of old-school turn-based tactics—one short adventure and one questionable decision at a time.

title: Idle Demon Lord II
description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

title: Tidy Arcana
description: Tidy Arcana is a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library. Return 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to their matching shelves, working at your own pace with help from a customizable wizard cat.

title: Cutset
description: Cut pipes and close valves until no route from source to sink survives. 80 industrial puzzles, each with one unique, provably optimal shutoff and exactly enough torch fuel to match it. No partial credit. One-time purchase. No in-app purchases, no ads, no internet required.

title: Pickie Grappy
description: A satisfying claw-machine arcade sim where every click counts. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, and get rich by catching every satisfying item.

title: Bathroom Please!
description: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

title: Better World
description: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

title: Tropic Industry
description: Build your tropical industry. Grow, process, and export resources — from simple plantations to complex production chains. Optimize logistics, increase efficiency, and grow your business into a global export network.

title: Trash to Cash
description: Trash to Cash a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

title: Special Delivery
description: Take the night shift at a crusty motel with strange guests. They might be weird... or they might not be human. Use their odd behavior to deduce which guests are hiding their true forms. Features randomly generated guests and monster behavior.

title: Rogue Links
description: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where every shot is a tradeoff: longer drives save strokes but unleash more monsters. Play the Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily runs and Head-to-Head, or build and share your own courses.

title: Halloween Pumpkin Simulator
description: Become a pumpkin on Halloween night! Absolute zen, midnight melancholy, and zero fuss. The perfect evening plan!

title: Medieval Bust
description: Assemble a party of powerful heroes, create devastating synergies, and battle through relentless hordes in this fast-paced auto-battler roguelite.

title: Kritsana
description: A Thai anomaly-spotting horror game. In 1997, a man swore something was in his house. His psychiatrist said no. Now the case is yours. Go through his old CCTV tapes, report every anomaly, and figure out why this case never made sense.

title: Idle Necronomics
description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

title: Tax Empire
description: Build your own Tax Empire! Collect taxes, expand your city, hire tax officers, control traffic, enact new policies and squeeze out as much revenue as you can on your road to riches.

title: Gnomes vs. Knights
description: Gnomes vs Knights is a chaotic multiplayer heist game. Sneaky gnomes complete tasks and steal treasure while powerful knights hunt them down, haul them to jail, and try to stop their escape.

title: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
description: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats is a hidden object game where you race against time to find 100 cats hidden across the world's most iconic locations. Spot the cats, click carefully, use hints wisely, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard.

title: Skysunder
description: An auto-battler fought on floating isles. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics, item upgrades, and unique unit modifiers called imprints! Strategize by giving every squadron its orders, and casting spells in real-time to change the battle!

title: Lintbreakers: Night Shift
description: Survive a haunted laundromat in a top-down bullet-heaven roguelite. Move, dodge, collect lint sparks, build automatic cleaning tools, evolve weapons, defeat machine bosses, and spend quarters to make every night shift last longer.

title: Dive Log: A Focus Voyage
description: Dive Log is an idle treasure-hunting game driven by a pomodoro timer: every stretch of focus becomes a deep-sea voyage. Collect treasures, upgrade your submarine and hunt the relic hidden in each sea. Play your own music and ambience, and design the sea's treasures to share with other captains.

title: Fantasy Idle RPG
description: From the solo developer of Idle Trillionaire, set in a world of knights, dragons, dungeons, and magic. Purchase cards to earn gold and experience, unlock new quests, and watch your character grow. Every card is hand written with a touch of the developers signature humor.

title: Romul
description: Romul is a co-op looting horror game. Together with a voice-controlled robot with early-stage AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity and use it to your advantage. Survive among monsters and extract valuable cargo.

title: Picofender
description: Picofender is an incremental defense action game where you guide a hero with your cursor and defend a village with automated allies. Defeat monsters, earn gold, upgrade skills, gear, and active abilities, then push through escalating waves toward the Demon Lord.

title: Scrappers Paradise
description: A physics based incremental game about scrapping junk to collect scrap and components. Build machines and buy powerful upgrades to become more efficient.

title: Cat Eats Sushi
description: Place sushi to guide a sushi-loving cat in this unique puzzle game.

title: Idle Slots: Casino HQ
description: Ever wanted to build a casino empire without the risk of actual luck? Start with a single Penny Slot and click your way to a multi-trillion-dollar galactic syndicate! Automate your floor, exploit corporate synergies, and sell the whole lot for a profit in this dangerously addictive idle clicker.

title: Flipocalypse
description: One button flips the world upside down. Race, dodge and outlast up to 8 players across seven party modes in a neon city that never stops trying to kill you. Run the walls. Sprint the ceiling. Last one standing wins.

title: Black Market Space Station Shop Simulator
description: Newly released from prison, you've been sent to a distant space station to manage a general store. This is your last chance at redemption and the authorities are watching. Can you keep your nose clean and still earn a profit in this trading simulator?

title: Stellacore Defense
description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

title: Demon Rising
description: Rule as the Demon Lord in a dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Recruit AI-driven demons who talk back, build deadly class synergies, equip relics, and survive brutal heroes, bosses, and events.

title: Labyrinth of Doom
description: A dark fantasy multiplayer dungeon crawler with real-time combat fully playable solo against challenging AI bots. Fight, scavenge, and outwit rivals in procedurally generated labyrinths Battle Royale or Co-op, up to 10 players, with legendary artifacts drawn from world mythology.

title: Cyberlife
description: CYBERLIFE is an online hacking game played through a terminal, in one world shared by every player. Break into companies, bring your loot back to your localhost, and take the crossroads every other operator has to go through.

title: Inearth
description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

title: Arctic Roll
description: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

title: Dribble Basket
description: Bounce your way to the basket in this physics-based basketball challenge. Master your dribble, overcome obstacles, and guide the ball to victory with nothing but timing and control.

title: Undermoon
description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Step through portals, plan your moves on a square grid, choose a race, and combine weapons and skills. Use fire, ice and lightning to shape battles, explore themed areas, face bosses and find a way out of this moonlit world.

title: Tainted Tide
description: The world is drowning, and the Tainted are evolving. Scavenge, upgrade your raft, and survive each passing day in this roguelite survival RPG. Master match-3 combat, dodge deadly attacks, craft powerful abilities, and fight to finish a mission humanity cannot afford to lose.

title: Parrygon
description: Deflect energy orbs, land a perfect parry, and survive as the arena collapses around you. Take on 36 campaign missions, chase Steam high scores in endless Arcade, or challenge friends in local Versus for 2–4 players.

title: Junkyard Astronauts
description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online co-op for 14 robots, Mac and PC together.

title: Special Case
description: You won't win a war as a one man army, But because you keep fighting you are still alive_Mohamed Mostafa Battle the Occupation with unique super powers! Destroy helicopters, drones, and armored vehicles. Explore "The Strip," protect its people, and rebuild a war-torn world. Welcome to Special Case

title: Inkborn
description: You wake inside an unfinished comic, with paper underfoot and ink lines all around. Trace outlines by hand in your sketchbook to create tools and weapons. Every stroke costs ink, and your accuracy matters.

title: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade
description: Blast your way onto the leaderboards in a twin-stick arcade shooter built around rapid destruction, evasion, kill combos and overwhelming firepower. Fight escalating fleets, merge power-ups and face 20+ unique bosses solo or in co-op. Play roguelike Anomaly runs that stack risk-reward mutations.

title: Goddle
description: A word race where your whole chat plays against you from their phones. No download, no account, just the room code.

title: Happy Propaganda
description: Approve or censor live chat in Happy Propaganda. Balance viewer anger and the host's well-being, choose broadcast topics, and talk off-air. Five days of choices lead to multiple endings.

title: Winter Wraith
description:
You are tasked with investigating a mysterious disease in the south west. Armies are moving rapidly in the trench. You don't have much time before more important matters call to your attention. Solve your first task and get back to the Harmonium for the next.

You will play as one of the great heroes of the continent, leading and managing your own minor faction: Ankh among others at the great Fortress of Harmonium.

The game includes everything a classic infinity engine RPG usually does, you will solve quests and gain experience, many times by fighting. It also includes huge field battles (on table top), faction management, romance and friendships, crafting and alchemy, resource harvesting, as well as many many others.

title: Broken Soccer
description: Pick one of 38 ridiculous teams, roll the die and unleash a dinosaur charge, a zombie infection, a bull market (with an actual bull) or Nietzsche off the bench. Tied at full time? Boots off, fists up. Solo, co-op or online versus up to 4v4.

title: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements
description: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

title: Ascended Snake
description: Ascended Snake is an incremental game based on the gameplay of the classic Snake. Earn points in your games to buy upgrades!

title: Bravest!2
description: The sequel to “Bravest!,” the classic front-view RPG that was a hit during the feature phone era!

title: Re:Draw
description: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

title: Rate & State
description: Rate & State is a macroeconomic simulator where you take control of a country’s economy. Manage inflation, set tax rates, invest, and overcome unexpected crises. Can you build an economic powerhouse and avoid debt? Your choices shape your future!

title: Pucked Up
description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

title: Move the Freak Out!
description: In Move The Freak Out. You are a contracted mover who specializes in haunted homes. Your job is to move furniture out of homes that are claimed to be haunted by the people who left in a hurry! Get in, get out, and don't die in.... Move The Freak Out!

title: Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol
description: You are on the night shift at a desolate robot logistics facility. Prepare orders, pack them, and deliver them. The routine appears simple, yet every night something shifts a little more out of place. Ten nights. Two endings. Free demo: the first 3 nights.

title: Hallucination
description: Takumi, a high school student, gains the power to make others experience hallucinations indistinguishable from reality. What begins as a tool for revenge soon changes his fate forever. A psychological suspense visual novel where your choices shape the ending.

title: Primal One
description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

title: Scuttled
description: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

title: Throughput
description: Wire yourself into a vector-bright city that runs on the beat. The system you built for people develops a pulse of its own. Build the city. Watch it breathe.

title: Lord of the Grind
description: Lord of The Grind is a single-player 2D Action RPG focused on dungeon grinding, resource gathering, loot, crafting and long-term character progression.

title: Touhou Bansho Cards
description: Fight to the end! Once a card is played, don't stop. Push the Combo higher, break the damage limit, and blast through anything in your way! Touhou Bansho Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect cards, explore the Bansho Card Corridor, defeat Echoes, rescue Gensokyo's girls, uncover the truth.

title: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween
description: The single-player Halloween special edition of the beloved long-nosed retro stoner, Toey Weedz! Save the famous rapping cow from her doom, defeat the witch, and experience 9 levels of pure retro FPS madness built on solid shooter gameplay.

title: The Sin of Ritter
description: The Sin of Ritter is a first-person horror game where the pursuit of justice becomes a journey through guilt, obsession, and consequences. Explore dark and disturbing environments, survive the horrors that await you, and uncover the truth behind the murder of your wife.

title: Fire. Hold. Repeat.
description: The only desktop companion shooter on Steam. Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke fires a shot fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day.

title: Fly&Goal
description: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

title: Space Cadets: Engineering Corps
description: Survey planets. Obliterate the locals. Invest in your ship. An action packed rougelite where the engineering crew you hire is either your greatest asset or your worst enemy, sometimes both at the same time. Don't fret, they always mean well.

title: Deep Frost
description: Single-player social-deduction horror in a failing Antarctic station. Question the crew, compare conflicting accounts and decide who to accuse or defend before the vote. The person you defend may be the one deceiving you.

title: Off Course
description: Off Course is a narrative boat-parkour game in which the overthinker Noi finds herself stranded in the depths of her flooded subconsciousness. Will you manage to overcome her roaring thoughts and doubts to stay in the flow?

title: Fragments of Ember
description: Explore the ruins of a forgotten kingdom in this atmospheric pixel-art platformer. Light ancient torches, solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and master challenging platforming as you restore the fading flame.

title: The Legend of Celia
description: A fantasy real-time turn-based dungeon RPG. Play as the Arcane Knight, lead 5 heroes with front/back row tactics & magitech. Explore procedural dungeons, collect billions of gear & rune attributes, make choices at Obelisk Stones, rebuild a lost civilization. Native KB&M, remastered for PC.

title: Evoruption
description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

title: Chronoseum
description: An action roguelite where you fight through arenas and unlock epic upgrades! Defeat the Bosses and challenge the Emperor. Die, upgrade, die and descend again.

title: Tsukumo Snap!
description: Tsukumo SNAP! is a spirit-photography RPG in which a flip phone reveals spirits inhabiting everyday objects. Players collect spirits and arrange a six-slot battle wheel, with three active spirits and three resting. The adventure uses a real calendar and includes a 50-floor tower.

title: Sneaky Purr
description: Get ready for a sneaky adventure in Sneaky Purr! Control Bill, a mischievous cat and expert little thief, and help him steal all the food pouches before making his way back to the exit of each level. But be careful: escaping with the loot can be much harder than it looks!

title: Dead Prints
description: PSX style psychological horror where you run an overnight print shop. Identify sinister customers, manage print supplies, make copies, and manage your insanity as your mind gets more and more unstable.

title: Tokyo Wanted
description: Hide-and-seek meets tag, in a crowd of 100. The stage is TOKYO. Slip through unseen and reach the goal, or work the wanted poster and stop the escape. A 3v3 team game between fugitives and hunters. Up to six players online at once; CPU fills any empty seats, so you can play solo.

title: Next Station is...
description:
Next Station is... is a first-person psychological horror and anomaly-detection game set aboard a subway train during its final service of the night.

As the train's driver, players must inspect each station for unusual occurrences before deciding whether to open the doors or bypass the platform. Using the driver's cabin window and CCTV cameras installed throughout the train, players must identify anomalies hidden among seemingly ordinary passengers and environments.

Each decision affects the journey. Opening the doors at an anomalous station may allow unwanted passengers or entities to board the train, carrying the consequences into subsequent stations. Players must make their decisions before the station timer expires, as failing to act causes the doors to open automatically.

Featuring PSX-inspired visuals, environmental observation, surveillance mechanics, and psychological horror elements, Next Station is... focuses on identifying subtle abnormalities while navigating an increasingly unsettling subway route.

title: Tetric
description: Tetris-style puzzles meet horror and dark medieval fantasy in Tetric. Battle enemy blocks with magic, logic, and tactical cards. Buy, grade, and sell cards to fund your quest, unravel sinister mysteries, and help Don Femur save the kingdom of Calaberia.

title: Sort The Bunnies
description: A cozy organizing simulator for 1–4 players. Sort 500 bunny designs, fill colorful shelves, and turn a messy shop into a collection worth admiring. Unlock handy upgrades and make a little mischief along the way.

title: IncrementalOS
description: An incremental love letter to the 90s desktop. Start with a blank desktop and one icon, unlock programs, systems and minigames, make more money, and build your way up to a system worth bragging about.

title: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum
description: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum is a first-person jigsaw and tidying game set in a museum where thirty paintings have come apart. Find the pieces scattered around the building and put every painting back on the wall, at your own pace.

title: Abyssal Moonlight: Chapter 1
description: No light. No names. Only numbers. In the lowest city of the deep, a boy raises forbidden jellyfish to buy his friend's dream — and every choice can end the story.

title: Way Too Many Fish!
description: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

title: Pull Me In
description: Pull Me In is a supernatural life simulation where you build a home, form relationships, pursue strange Purposes and survive a town plagued by ghosts, demons, possession and unexplained phenomena. Live an ordinary life in a place where nothing is ordinary.

title: Dark Harvest
description: Dark Harvest is a retro-styled stalker horror inspired by Resident Evil and Signs. Your dog is trapped, and something is stalking you. Explore the manor, solve puzzles, and do everything in your power to survive.

title: Mirror Backrooms
description: A first-person psychological horror game about looking too closely. Two mirrored corridors move with you and appear identical, but one of them is always wrong: a chair has shifted, a light burns the wrong colour, a figure stands where nobody remembers one. The player carries no weapon, only a sonic ring that marks an anomaly. Firing it at the wrong thing carries sound through the floor and wakes the nearest Crawler, which then knows where the player is standing. Over 100 Crawlers inhabit these floors and no two of them share a rule, and room laws rewrite darkness, direction, distance, time and the mirrored views themselves. 100 named floors and 1,000 procedurally recombined rooms can be played alone or online with up to three other players.

title: Dog Man: Bark in Action
description: Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! Packed with boss fights, awesome gadgets and up to 10 playable characters, each with unique abilities.

title: Get Outta My Gut
description: A rogue-lite tower defense where you control the horde. Draft randomized bio-turret cards, reshape tissue into lethal killzones, and manually slice open pathogen sacs to unleash fluid swarms on your terms. Evolve across 10 organs, don't let the contagion reach the heart.

title: Welcome to Sunnybrook
description: Welcome to Sunnybrook, an idyllic community where residents come to escape. Play as a burglar breaking into affluent homes when something prehistoric descends on the unalert residents. Sneak, steal, and survive as you escape a community turned hunting ground that gives new meaning to "eat the rich"

title: Screen Stocks
description: Screen Stocks is an online multiplayer trading game featuring a real-time simulated market. Buy, short, and sell stocks to gain unprecedented levels of wealth. Team up with other traders or outsmart them all. It's time to make some money!

title: Spooky Land Defenders
description: A spooktacular strategic monster defense roguelite. Protect your haunted house from interdimensional corporate real estate investors by collecting horrific monsters, dreadful decor, terrible traps, and bizarre curios. Easy to sink your fangs into, but also a FRIGHTENINGLY deep strategy game!

title: Shift Chess
description: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis. It also features a usable notation system and several customizable board rules.

title: 1930: Ink & Bullets
description: A turn-based tactical strategy game featuring a 1930s cartoon art style. Face your opponent in a tense tabletop duel, use your perks wisely, manage your resources, and try to survive each round in this suspenseful noir universe.

title: Bloom Busters
description: Bash & blast mutated creatures, restore infested gardens and defend the once-peaceful Bloomland in this frantic solo or local co-op action arcade game. Gather resources, grow flowers, feed animals, complete garden chores, and master handcrafted levels with adaptive difficulty.

title: Junkpot
description: A roguelike about bidding blind on sealed storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast — the quota doubles every round.

title: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

title: Carcelera
description: Carcelera is an exploration and light puzzle game. You are in prison, and so is the Moon. Forge your own destiny, you can repent later.

title: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
description: Just in time for the 20th anniversary, You Are Empty has been revitalized for modern systems, with fixes, new features, and QoL additions, including all the official localizations. Our team carefully went through the entire game whilst faithfully preserving the intent of the original release.

title: Rolling Stock
description: An online co-op train loading game for up to 4 players. Keep an eye out for labels, ensure a tight fit, and help your friends when things get heavy. This new fully physics-based puzzler is rolling out cross-platform on Windows and Linux!

title: Veyrasol
description: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

title: Anti-Anti
description: A choice-driven psychological mystery visual novel, Anti-Anti. In a world once devastated by slime monsters, you are forced into a suspicious audition. A locked-room mystery, ensemble drama, adventure, thriller, and romance!

title: Cosplaying in Costalia: The Tororo Sisters!
description: When Souta’s cosplay-filled camera gets broken, the Yamakake sisters volunteer to be cosplay models for him. After gratefully accepting and whipping up a flurry of cosplay outfits for the girls, they head to Costalia, a cosplayer’s paradise. But will their photo shoots go off without a hitch?

title: Wordventures: The Vampire Pirate
description: On the night of the full moon, a handful of children have seemingly disappeared in the sleepy seaside town of Mistyvale Oaks. Solve word search puzzles to track down leads, uncover clues, and solve the mystery of the ghost ship in this narrative puzzle adventure game.

title: Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Expansion
description: Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in Catuaí, a South America-inspired region shaped by coffee terraces, red soil and lush hills. Grow coffee beans, raise alpacas and Brahman cows, start new production chains and operate 25+ new machines!

title: Duel: The Game Show
description: Duel: The Game Show is a 2-player party game show with 30+ mini-games spanning trivia, memory, reflexes, and guessing challenges. Matches use a scoring pyramid across several rounds, with online multiplayer via Steam. Match length is adjustable, from quick 6-round duels to full 15-round marathons.

title: Magical Girl ER
description: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

title: Vampy's Big Day
description: Sneak through the shadows as a clumsy vampire learning to avoid deadly sunlight… with a little help from a sun fairy. Will you find redemption, or embrace the darkness?

title: Anomalous Veil
description: Anomalous Veil is a psychological horror experience that can be completed in 30–90 minutes and features branching endings.

title: 8 Hours Till Dawn
description:
Play 8 Hours Till Dawn solo, or with up to five other friends, a survival party game where you plan out your actions and movements ahead of time. Navigate your survivor to the center room to grab a weapon then make it to an outer room with a window and hopefully stop the infected. Can you last 8 hours till dawn?

During each in-game "hour" you will plan your actions using the 8 Action cards you draw under a timer. This timer gives you the same amount of time every round, but as the night goes on, the decisions stack up, the horde keeps growing, and the weight of every choice gets heavier. Harder difficulties give you even less time.

title: Coal Duty
description: Coal Duty is a 1-5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy. Meet the state coal quota in procedurally generated mines, coordinating over proximity voice chat while something in the dark listens in. Spend your tickets, plan your escape. Some miners get out. The state does not confirm this.

title: Tiny Capsule Collector
description: Run a cozy capsule shop at the bottom of your screen. Attract cute animal customers, collect charming capsule toys, and build a relaxing, ambient world in this idle sim bringing you small moments of joy while you work. Make your desktop a place you’d rather be.

title: Senior Survival Club
description: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

title: Slop Simulator
description: Make slop out of trash, junk and pretty much anything and serve it to customers! A chaotic multiplayer first-person fast food simulator with barely any safeguards where you use only "local and fresh" ingredients.

title: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
description: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.

title: Prismarch
description: A colorful chess roguelike! Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy while you fulfill a chess power fantasy - your pieces gain abilities as you construct a juiced up roster capable of surviving the onslaught! Only - seven mysterious prismatic kings stand before you and the one true crown...

title: Little Boo and the Spectral Orbs
description: A challenging single-screen platformer inspired by 80s arcade classics. Help Little Boo rescue his lost friends across 40 deadly levels. Dodge traps, outrun enemies, and race against time. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.

title: When the Embers Wake
description: When the Embers Wake is a third person narrative adventure with a cause to create awareness about the very current and real threats on wildlife. You play as a red panda that needs to survive amidst environmental challenges, threats and also grief.

title: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
description: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

title: Flashbound
description: Sam agrees to help his friends by staying the night in their house while they leave for urgent business. Outside, a heavy rainstorm rages, with loud thunderclaps shaking the walls and creating an oppressive atmosphere.

title: Asylium
description: Trapped in an abandoned mental hospital, you are hunted by a deranged doctor. Hide, fight, and outsmart your enemy as you uncover the dark secrets of the asylum. One wrong move, and you won't survive the night.

title: Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services
description: Relax with Bao Bao in this cozy 2D pressure washing sim. Clean pastel environments, chill lo-fi beats, and no stress, just peaceful vibes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. A peaceful pressure washing game for quiet minds and cozy days.

title: General Tactics: An Shi Rebellion
description: In November 755, the An Shi Rebellion broke out, with most Tang Empire's cities falling to the rebels. You will be appointed as Military Governor of Shuofang to confront them. Form legions and strengthen your power to completely defeat the rebels.

title: Empty Box
description: Psychological horror dating sim for women. Navigate a seemingly perfect school life where every sweet moment hides a lie. Why is the rooftop locked? Why is *they* so obsessed? Why only ‘L’? Your choices shape the truth—and every move is watched. Discover chilling endings.

title: Lacey's Flash Games
description: These are the REAL girls’ games. In the mid 2000s, Charlie (Charchar887), discovers the Laceys's Flash Games and their disturbing secrets. Step into the virtual world to uncover the whereabouts of the missing website creator, Rocio Yani, and explore all the games and activities with Lacey!

title: RPG Chess
description: A turn-based RPG, except it's also chess! Every capture becomes a 1v1 battle decided by stats, elements and abilities. Build your team, climb the roguelite campaign, or duel friends and CPUs.

title: Something Something Spaceship
description: Explore a malfunctioning spaceship and retrieve the items needed to fix it, while avoiding a colourful cast of enemies. An isometric platform puzzler inspired by games from the 8-bit era.

title: Cyber Delivery
description: Take high-risk delivery contracts across Neon Spires. Swing, grind, wall ride, defy gravity to find the fastest, flashiest route, then upgrade your gear, build your reputation, become the city’s legendary courier.

title: The Beast Awoke to Eat Your Darlings
description: The Beast gets hungry. The Beast devours your cats. The Beast sees you. The Beast comes for you. You have no weapons. You have rules to learn and turn against them. Know each nightmare, outsmart the Beast and its Sentinels, and carry your darlings to safety. Every cat you save counts.

title: Tidy Farm
description: Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.

title: Hot Mic
description: A party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 friends online. Give a museum bust a voice or do your best cockerel, then vote for a favourite before you find out who made it. Free to play. If anyone at the table has VIP, everyone gets the full game, your own pictures included.

title: Spook & Sell
description: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.

title: Your Friends vs. Hidebehind
description: A co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. Record your real scream and it plays back when it takes you. Explore a procedurally generated forest, deny it by facing the terror, and escape before the forest decides you're staying.

title: Hidden Raccoons in Winter
description: Hidden Raccoons in Winter is a cozy pixel art hidden object game! Search for adorable raccoons hidden across handcrafted winter landscapes. Relax, take your time, and find them all!

title: Towertower
description: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

title: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
description: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

title: Gorgeous Baby Bella
description: While her husband is away, Liora is forced to spend her days alone. But solitude is not as quiet as she thinks.

title: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

title: Room Zero
description: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

title: The Spectacular Evermore
description: Learn each room of the theatre, spot anomalies, and photograph them to restore the room. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual, from living statues to possessed paintings.

title: Five-Star Courier and the Fog That Reeks of Death
description: Experience the work of a courier in a city of living rumors and legends. Pay off your debt by carrying out strange requests from mystical customers. Uncover the reason behind the appearance of a mysterious fog that smells of decay.

title: Mahjong Rush
description: Mahjong Rush is a relaxing ink-wash roguelike. Score by matching mahjong tiles into combos — no mahjong experience needed, an interactive tutorial teaches you from scratch. Collect Flowers, Fu cards, and Relics to grow small scores into huge ones. Every run is randomized. This round — clean house.

title: 3 Switch Problem
description: A casual, 3D, observation and puzzle game. Flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you work your way through the nine challenges of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids and play outdoor activities along the way.

title: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & the Ghost Guitar
description: Play rock and metal songs and compete against zombies, witches, ghosts in the guitar battle to get all your guitars back. You are going to perform at a Halloween party but zombies have stolen all your guitars. Collect all the guitars before the Halloween party starts!

title: Skullf!
description: You are Skullf! Disembodied skull of terror & mini-golf action! After another hilarious night terrorizing locals it's time to return to your grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs and even go head to head with friends (Friends not included). Never before have you had so much fun a graveyard! (Probably)

title: Our Church and Halloween RPG
description: A Christian-themed, story driven, black and white pixel art, Japanese styled RPG video game in the Our Church and Halloween franchise by Breakthrough Gaming!

title: Heavy in the Hand
description: Cock the hammer, pull the trigger, count to six. Release the cylinder, eject the shells, count to six again. You hold death in your hand, and death is heavy. Descend to the abyss, shoot the horrors you can comprehend, and survive the horrors you cannot.

title: OddBrawl
description: OddBrawl is a free 2D fighting game played in the web browser and linked to Twitch. Players sign in with their Twitch account, answer ten questions and get a unique fighter from one of +13 species, including goblins, ogres, skeletons and mushrooms. Fights play out as animated duels; at key points, Destiny Moments let the player choose how to turn the fight, from playing it safe to risking everything. The game is built around short daily sessions: three fights a day, stat points to assign, equipment to find and forge, a community boss and seasonal rankings. Each partner streamer leads a clan that viewers can join.

title: Grim Guild
description: A management game about sending other people into danger. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: write each contract (the pay, how plainly the danger is written, whether they may turn back), never see the fight, read the report, and count who comes back at the door. Monsters, grief, trust and ale. A year ends at the old quarry and is bound into a book. Optional asynchronous shared towns of up to 100 halls over Steam.

title: Chimpy Protects
description: At night you feel something ominous, you must be courageous and brave to find Chimpy. Something is watching and spirits are haunting you but Chimpy will protect, the soothing light will guide you and he will finally help you sleep.

title: Hirugao
description: A mystery psychological thriller visual novel set in 2000. Follow a serial murder case through many eyes, including the woman, the man, and the detective. With live-action backgrounds and silhouetted characters, every choice branches the story, and one wrong move means game over.

title: Wren Falls
description: October 1994, 2:14 a.m. A 911 call from a farmhouse on Quarry Road: a child's voice, using his mother's name. You find his parents dead and the boy silent on the stairs. Investigate by day. By night, follow him as he sleepwalks, and don't wake him.

title: Tiny Fishing Club
description: A cozy desktop fishing companion you can leave beside your work. Fish solo or hang out online with friends, catch rare fish, customize your tiny angler, collect pets, and grow your little club.

title: Idle Hoops
description: An incremental idle basketball game. Shoot hoops, sign a roster that ends with an actual goat, and let your team keep scoring while you're away. Win championships, hang your retired jersey in the rafters, and work your way up from the driveway to a court in outer space.

title: Night Drive: Anomaly
description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

title: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean Into It.
description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

title: Hack and Slash Fury 2
description: Destroy the dark warriors with your sword at the rythm of heavy metal and see epic cinematics while you master the complex combat system to humilliate your rivals online or offline, here you will find fun, satire, and war created and combined like never before by his developer.

title: Legacy of Mind
description: Legacy of Mind is the first gothic soulslike FPS where nightmares and reality have merged. Face colossal Monarchs that rule over the world overrun by living nightmares. Unlock otherworldy powers hidden within your mind, but with every power unlocked, something in the dark wakes with you...

title: The Halloway Haunting
description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore six abandoned buildings in the town of Halloway, solve the puzzles that turn their lights back on, and get away from the thing hunting you in the dark. Play online, in splitscreen, or alone.

title: ShredDead
description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

title: Stay With Me
description: Answer a late night call to care for an elderly woman with dementia. Explore a haunted house, solve environmental puzzles and uncover a terrifying truth in this first person psychological horror experience.

title: Rune Caves: Eternal Echo
description: Match runes and unravel layered boards while moving Echoes disrupt your view and clicks. Remember hidden symbols, track shifting targets, and reveal ambush pairs. Clear 20 campaign floors, unlock a tougher Endless mode, and customize your symbols, backgrounds, and music.

title: Forged Cards
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

title: Split Out
description: Split Out - The Ultimate Auto Battle Racing Experience Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in Split Out, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street kart and rise to the global championship glory.

title: Kleromancy
description: Awaken as Unit-01 in the Ark of Theseus. In this roguelike, your cards are 3D dice: roll them, spend energy, and conquer 7 corrupted biomes. Overcome narrative events and minigames, survive multi-phase bosses, and expand your generational station with every victory.

title: Eternal Chamber
description: A psychological horror about repetition, isolation, and the need to keep moving forward. Keep pushing. Don't stop. Break through.

title: Huntsman: Protect & Serve
description: Huntsman: Protect & Serve is a DLC where you discover a hidden section of Atherton Labs teeming with ravenous creatures. Unlike the base game's evasion gameplay, you're armed and must stand your ground against multiple threats. Combat requires strategic ammunition management, careful reload timing, and awareness that gunshots attract more creatures. Puzzle-solving is essential to escape the facility's depths.

title: Two-Fifteen
description: A first-person PSX horror game. Your baby is gone, and the things wearing your in-laws' faces are still in the house. Get the lights back on, hide when you hear footsteps on the stairs, and never trust a voice that sounds like someone you love.

title: Crack
description: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. Crack is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.

title: Scopa Sweep
description: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

title: Hunter's Moon
description: Hunter’s Moon is a first-person historical narrative folk-horror set over the course of one fateful night. Meet mummers dressed in folk costumes, evade capture by the witch hunters, and eavesdrop on a characterful cast of regular folk worn down by war and misfortune. Discover the secrets of this dysfunctional village on the brink as you embody an accused “witch” on the run for her life.

title: Ecstatica
description: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

title: Ecstatica II
description: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

title: Leikkaus
description:
LEIKKAUS ("The Cut" in Finnish) is a horror game where all you are trying to do is collect your student benefit. Living in a dystopian world might not be easy, but at least something is coming your way. Or... is it her? Little did you know, your benefit is not the only thing about to be cut!

✂ Retro Horror: Explore the pixelated, dark, abandoned corridors of the old University building.

✂ Tense Gameplay: Your hunter will not give up on their prey easily.

✂ Cut for perfection: About one hour of entertainment and you should have your benefit... for now.

title: Leviathan: Rhino
description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
description: A slow-burn psychological horror train simulator. Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

title: Space Savory
description: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

title: Possessed Kingdom
description: Defend your kingdom or rush the enemy in this Deckbuilding RTS. Build your base, scale your economy, and draw custom paths for your troops to break enemy defenses. Win battles, steal the king's cards, and build the ultimate deck.

title: Eyes Wide Open
description: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

title: Galactic Bounty
description: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

title: MarsCity3026
description: A game for kids and adults. Grapple, swing, move mechanical puzzle pieces. Play as a robot that solves mazes and mechanical puzzles. Each puzzle brings the terra-forming machines back online so that the humans can wake from cryo-sleep.

title: Unending Aqua
description: Explore a mysterious tropical island resort. Collect items and solve puzzles to progress. Survive against dangerous enemies. Piece together the story of the hotel and uncover the dark secrets that it holds.

title: Last Floor
description:
Last Floor is a first-person psychological horror game focused on observation and anomaly detection. The player navigates a looping hospital corridor and must identify subtle changes in the environment.

Each run begins in an elevator and progresses through an identical hallway. The player must determine whether an anomaly is present during the loop and choose the correct elevator direction to continue. Incorrect decisions reset progression.

title: Droste Detective
description: You're stuck in an office corridor with no exit that has a painting of the same corridor on the wall. But then you notice the corridor in the painting is not quite the same. You decide to inspect the painting...

title: Scramble Knights Online
description: Welcome to Scramble Knights Online! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracotta! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training.

title: Night Plane
description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

title: Residuum
description: RESIDUUM is a first-person psychological horror game set in a decaying research facility. With only a dwindling flashlight and faulty heartbeat sensor, manage power, seek answers, and escape what hides in the dark.

title: Deliverance Protocol: Ironrot
description: Atmospheric first-person retro horror. You are a courier — a disposable tool of the System. Sort, deliver, collect archives. Obey… or uncover what lies inside.

title: Recycling Shift
description: Work at a recycling facility! In this tactile cozy job simulator, sort discarded items into categories, process them into raw material and sell valuable items for money. Could be trash or treasure! Upgrade your workflow, sort and process efficiently.

title: The Mailroom
description:
A horror job simulator where you work in the mailroom of a small regional office of Hell located in Modesto, California.

You just started working in the mailroom of that weird building on 5th. The job was easy enough at first. Sort the mail and use their creaky old pneumatic tube system to send it to the correct departments. But then shit started getting weird. Can you figure out what's really going on in this place and find a way out?

title: Flipping Phantom
description:
A puzzle platformer where you can’t jump?! Phase into the ground and flip upside-down to find your way around this spooky playground!

Flipping Phantom is a 2D pixel-art puzzle platformer with a simple twist: you can’t jump. Phase into solid ground to navigate negative space with reversed gravity and float to slow your descent.

title: Fangtopia
description: Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.

title: Fishing Up
description: Catch 48 unique fish and complete collections in a relaxing fishing game. Explore different locations, use various baits and rods, and enjoy a peaceful angling experience.

title: Breach Signal
description: Breach Signal is a 1-6 Player Co-op Psychological Horror game. Enter a special unit operating for The Agency, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

title: Giggleland
description: Giggleland is full of adventures and fun! Will you be the next to discover why our guests are always smiling? This game is not suitable for children.

title: Cardtographer
description:
Cardtographer is a stylized 3D-Graphics Roguelike Deckbuilder, in which you choose one or more Champions to fight the evil, which has overcome the lands.

During your adventure your chosen champions gain gold and experience during the fights and enhance their deck to overcome their opposing enemy finally.

You also can ally with your frineds in online coop.

title: Pao Pao
description: Pao Pao is a wild mix of culinary diving and animal madness—where you become the ultimate restaurant boss and management guru! Gather ingredients, go fishing, and expand your spot solo or with friends. Every order turns into an epic adventure… Jump in and experience it for yourself!

title: Calvar: The Darkest Gate
description: First-person horror survival game that plunges players into a dark and disturbing world. As Leonard Valentin, you must fight against supernatural threats while uncovering the mystery behind the cursed piano and the sinister plans of a dark cult.

title: Operator: Observation
description: Operator: Observation is a Game based on the "Watch Rooms, and Report Anomalies" Concept of "Observation Duty" but now the Anomalies are way more aggressive and have way more ways to make you lose your Mind. Your Instructor will follow you on the way to becoming a good Operator.

title: Timeless Rain
description: Explore this foreign world and use manipulate time to defeat any creature who dares to stand between you and your goal! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

title: Sincognito
description: Sincognito, is a 5-15 players SOCIAL DEDUCTION, horror, stealth game in which players, split between two distinct teams - Humans & Sins - must use communication with proximity voice chat, teamwork to complete tasks, skills for combat, betrayal, and ultimately mind games to defeat the opposite team.

title: Outcast Tales
description: Assemble a squad of characters with robust personalities and abilities, and their relationships unfold. Engage in deep tactical battles, make tough decisions , and choose your own adventures - write an Outcast Tale that’s unique to you!

title: Village of the Mirror
description: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

title: Where Is My Pet?
description: Where Is My Pet? is a hidden object, sorting, and animal game! Run your cozy shelter: place animals, sell them to loving homes, upgrade your shelter, build your dream house, and search the city for pets. Can you turn a shabby shelter into a profitable business?

title: Donkey Jump: In the Loop
description: Jump, build, and survive! Guide a goofy donkey through endless loops with card-based paths and unpredictable challenges.

title: Tensei Brave
description: Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed. In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned. Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord. Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

title: Pokémon World Frontier
description: A Pokémon Fangame where you revive the Battle Frontier challenge. Battle in quick matches in an island full of different challenges and aim to be a Pokémon Master!

title: 7 Millimeters
description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

title: Fish with Friends
description: A co-op fishing game for 1 to 4 players. Catch fish, sell your haul and buy better rods and bigger boats. Head further out for bigger catches, but keep an eye on the weight. Every fish goes in the boat, and too many will sink it.

title: Strikem
description: Fast, physics-driven 2D platform shooter built for chaos. Battle across Team Deathmatch, CTF, Free-For-All, King of the Hill & Coin Confirmed, survive co-op Zombie waves and the Iron Directive campaign, then grind 108 ranks of loot. Squad up with friends or drop in solo vs AI.

title: Hubble Bubble
description: Co-op hookah shop sim for 1 to 4 friends. Run Ghalyan's Hookah Lounge on a space station: pack the bowl, light the coals, serve the aliens and act normal. Nothing on this station is normal.

title: Five Nights at Frickbear's 3: Four Layers Down
Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
description:
Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

In this monster-raising RPG, control Yomi as she does everything in her power to help manage the monsters of the underworld. Gather monster parts and experience to get stronger! Farm them and release the monsters back into the caverns to gain even further stats. Delve deeper and deeper, discovering all the secrets... and maybe even make a few friends along the way! Being a sacrifice isn't all bad, right?

title: Moon Sweepers
description: Stop being lazy, youve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.

title: Matchmaker95: A Programming Simulator
description: The programming simulator. MatchMaker95 is a cozy(ish) coding tycoon where you write real C++, grow a chaotic dating app startup, unlock game-changing upgrades, and turn lines of code into profit all inside a lo-fi Win98 desktop.

title: Railroad Swap
description:
Get ready for a journey full of challenges in Railroad Swap! Help Mat, an adorable train-driving cat, build the tracks needed to guide his train to the final destination. But be careful: the available pieces aren't enough to complete the entire route, so you'll need to think beyond the tracks!

On a hexagonal grid, select, rotate, and reposition pieces to build the perfect route. Along the way, you'll find swap tiles that let you assign colors to tracks or empty spaces. When the train passes over them, their positions are swapped, transforming the board and revealing new possibilities for continuing the journey.

title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Prophecy Pack
description:
New character skin and additions to the cat creator.
The Prophecy Pack gives you more options to enhance your Warrior Cats experience with additional content.

The Prophecy Pack includes:

• 8 Accessories to use in the cat creator

• 12 Wearable accessories

• Cel-shaded characters skin

• 4 cat poses for photo mode

• 4 photo mode effects

title: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
description: Something has made a spectacular mess of this cozy Halloween shop. Put pumpkins, potions and sweets back where they belong, uncover curious clues, and meet a mysterious new friend. A relaxing first-person tidy-up, with a little mischief.

title: Want a Bomb?
description: Blow up mountains with your friends in this chaotic online co-op game. Collect minerals, buy bigger explosives, build chains of explosions, and experiment with bomb-loaded drones, explosive baseballs, and a launcher that can send your friends flying.

title: Holy Shroom!
description: Holy Shroom! is a photorealistic mushroom-foraging game for solo or co-op. Pick mushrooms by day and earn money to repair your van. At night, the forest fills with the most valuable mushrooms, but ghosts, monsters, and other strange residents wake up too. The bigger the reward, the greater the risk.

title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
description: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

title: Snap & Print
description: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

title: One Piece: Grand Gourmet
description: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a first-person shooter and the follow-up to Modern Warfare III (2023), continuing the rebooted Modern Warfare storyline. The campaign is set during a North Korean invasion of South Korea and features dual perspectives: a young South Korean soldier named Private Park facing his first combat deployment, and Captain Price operating outside official channels on a personal mission. The game also includes multiplayer with 6v6 core maps, large-scale vehicle combat maps, and a dynamic map system called Kill Block that reshapes layouts between rounds. A DMZ extraction mode is also featured. The game is released exclusively on current-generation platforms and PC.

title: Echoes of Pinebridge
description: A slice-of-life college story that gradually develops into a supernatural mystery, all guided by your choices.

title: Protect the Pit
description: A short incremental clicker game that blends the strategy of tower defense with the depth of sprawling upgrade trees. Build your own winding mazes to repel the oncoming hordes!

title: The Hero Is Too Powerful so Let's Pleeeease Settle This Peacefully!
description: How strong is too strong? Find out from the hero's victims in this adventure RPG as you talk things out (or destroy everything) on your way to save the hero's childhood friend!

title: The Last Keeper
description: Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote island. Maintain the machinery, use the radio and the map to guide ships into the harbor. Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

title: Aspis
description: ASPIS is an atmospheric mystical thriller set in an alternative USSR of the late 80s. You play as a scientist who has lost his family and is involved in a dangerous experiment to create a reality simulation. Explore the cybernetics institute, travel between worlds and encounter a distorted reality

title: Killer Santa 1990
description: Step into a chilling 1990s horror story. After returning to your late grandfather's old house, you uncover missing people, a cursed DVD, and a murderous Santa Claus hunting you down.

title: Death Rabbit
description: The city that never sleeps has taken a sinister turn, and the dark tunnels of the MTA have become the epicenter of a horrifying outbreak. As Alisa, you must navigate through a labyrinthine underground world fraught with danger, where unspeakable horrors lurk around every corner.

title: Sawad
description:
In Sawad, you and your friends are content creators desperate for FAME and subscribers.

Break into haunted locations, eliminate whatever is there.

Hidden CCTVs record it all. Make the clips go viral and get filthy rich!

The only catch? You must survive long enough to hit upload.

title: Bigger Bang
description: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

title: Narnok: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug in My Power Cables
description: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a puzzle to solve haha

title: Mojo Is Loved
description: Mojo invites his ex and an old friend to hear his new EP. Their kindness is real... until the room starts rewriting every sign of rejection. A short psychological horror visual novel about love, reassurance, and the cost of demanding certainty.

title: QUByte Classics: Gaelco Sports Collection
description:
Relive the thrill of 90s arcade games with 5 legendary, action-packed hits from Gaelco, a pioneer in the world of arcade gaming! Forget complex simulators; this collection is all about pure reflexes, instant fun, and high-speed adrenaline.

Take the wheel in the award-winning isometric masterpieces World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, executing precise drifts against a relentless 60-second countdown. Blaze a trail through icy tunnels and loops in Snowboard Championship, dominate the digital courts with quick shots in Squash, and unleash devastating spikes in beach volleyball in Touch and Go.

Play with friends in the chaotic local multiplayer mode and enjoy modern, convenient features like instant saves and retro CRT screen filters that perfectly recreate the glow of the original arcade cabinets!

title: Spray Trace
description:
Grab your spray can and step into a colorful adventure in Spray Trace! Control a talented graffiti artist and move through each environment, painting the tiles along your path. But you can't just paint everything you see: each color has an exact number of tiles that must be filled!

Move across the environment in four directions and carefully plan your routes. Every tile you pass over is painted with your current color, but retracing a path already painted with the same color makes the paint disappear, allowing you to correct part of your route and discover new solutions.

Along the way, you'll find sprays in different colors. Collecting them permanently changes your paint color, completely transforming the possibilities of the level. Choose when and where to change colors, and think a few steps ahead to avoid leaving paint where it shouldn't be!

title: Evercursed: Act I
description: Evercursed is a narrative-driven, atmospheric horror experience that delves into the world of sleep paralysis, and the demons that lurk within it. Step into Amelia's haunting nightmares, where the line between dreams and reality is blurred.

title: Battle Nap
description: Battle Nap is a procedural roguelite twin-stick shooter developed by 1050 Studio. A dad dozes off on a lake floatie and wakes up in a subconscious warzone. Armed with two swappable weapons and a choice of floatie-based dodge mechanics, he must fight his way through 4 dream worlds, full of bizarre creatures and bosses. The arsenal of 15 weapons, stackable perk system, procedurally generated levels, and both temporary and permanent upgrades make every run different, balancing moment-to-moment action chaos with meaningful progression.

title: The World's Shortest Horror Game
description: Press one button. Regret it immediately. A bite-sized analog horror comedy made to be finished in minutes, streamed for reactions, or gifted to a friend as a tiny act of betrayal. Headphones strongly recommended. Friendship not guaranteed.

title: The Archivist
description: A psychological horror experience set in the Backrooms. Explore a failed government facility, hack corrupted systems, and descend into a story where memory and reality collapse.

title: The Dead We Knew: Open World Survival
description: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

title: Final Fantasy Resonance
description: Return to the pixelart world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort
description: Get up and move in 12 motion-control sports! Gently swing your racket, pull back and aim like an archer, and more in 12 sports with intuitive motion controls. Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, and even battle with one thumb in Thumb Wrestling - there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together!

title: Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch
description: Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch is an asymmetrical cooperative horror game where one player explores a mysterious house in first-person while being hunted by the Gloam, while the other observes through security cameras and guides them. Survival depends entirely on communication and trust between players who see the world from completely different perspectives.

title: Terry's Terraforming
description: In Terry's Terraforming, your job is to transform dying planets and make them fit for new life. Meet an intergalactic cast of quirky aliens, reshape and rejuvenate worn-out worlds, and discover a charming sci-fi story – all while keeping the shareholders happy.

title: Red Chat Ritual: Tsumimi Time
description: An idol livestreamer is searching for her missing partner. You are not just watching her stream. Interfere with her broadcast, investigate clues on and off stream, and uncover the truth behind her partner’s disappearance.

title: If You Stay
description: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

title: PhaigeX: Confiners
description: Welcome aboard, Confiner! As PhaigeX Megacorp’s newest specialist, you’re tasked with curbing the AI incursion into hyperspace sectors. Choose your ship, upgrade your modules, accept commissions, and deploy adaptive strategems to fend off the relentless AI invasion.

title: Midnight Launch: A GameShop Sim
description: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

title: Demons' Night Fever
description:
Misdeed, Theft, Abduction, Plunder. This is a tale of “Evil,” where anything goes.
Where the hero is a dull boy named Kyoshiro, who hates the world. And a self-proclaimed evil god having lost his powers appears to him. Team up with the evil god and go beyond the limits of evil! Steal! Abduct! Terminate! Let your evil show!

title: Lost Liminal
description: Lost Liminal is a quirky first-person exploration and deconstruction game based on the BackRoom urban legend! Players will take on the role of a wanderer lost in the backroom hierarchy, determining the ultimate outcome based on your choices!

title: Tow Game
description: Your beloved old car has broken down and needs to be towed! Hooked and hauled - time for the garage! But will you get there in one piece? The tow truck is in a hurry!

title: Alyssa
description: ALYSSA is an adventure horror game, in which you play as a little girl who wakes up in an unfamiliar place… Or rather, she’s awakened by Emily, who has a… strange mask permanently attached to her head. Armed with nothing but a small lighter, Alyssa must attempt to escape from this cursed place. Meanwhile, her tormentors lurk in the shadows, waiting for a single wrong move…

title: Moadra
description: Endure... Evolve... Or Die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

title: Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
description: Thrown into a dungeon after delivering your king's ultimatum, you have one goal: survive 72 real gameplay hours until his army arrives. Drink, sleep, keep the rats away, and wait...

title: Arcade Archives 2: Ace Driver Victory Lap
Turtles Go Fast
description: In Turtles Go Fast, you must make your way to the other side traversing various biomes to reunite with your family; with the help of upgrades and other useful utilities, or by spicing things up with challenges.

title: CyberBot: Zero
description:
Jump, hack, and escape the facility!
Solve system puzzles and survive dangerous laser traps in CyberBot — a charming 2D pixel art platformer where your mission is to override the security networks and find your way out.

title: The Wrong Way
description: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

title: Deckbound
description: Summoned to a world ruled by the Demon Lord, your only power is your deck. Dodge bullet-hell attacks in real time, fight with a 4-card hand, and loot a permanent card collection from procedural dungeons. Teleport home before you lose it all. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

title: Arcs
description: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

title: Halloween on Goober Street
