description: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences. With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

title: CrazyFood
description: Cook in the back of a food truck while a friend drifts through the city at full speed. Grill, chop, stack, and deliver on foot before your customers lose patience. Chaotic online co-op for 2–4 players, or team up for 4v4 Versus.

title: Jigoku Yugi
description: Jigoku Yugi follows a delivery boy who dies after winning the lottery and joins an underworld contest. One hundred souls compete across thirty-two games, and only the last survivor can return to life.

title: Adelaide: A Tiny Adventure
description: Four worlds. Four guardians. One tiny hero finding her way home. Run, double-jump and swing your hammer through 40 pixel-art levels filled with secrets, challenges and little memories worth keeping. A heartfelt adventure made by a dad for his daughter.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.3 - Journey to the Sky
Dig to Escape
description: Dig to Escape is a co-op digging game where you search a mysterious island for buried objects. Turn your discoveries into scrap, upgrade your tools and uncover the missing boat motor parts you need to escape. Play alone or dig irresponsibly with your friends.

title: Myrridon
description: The land of Myrridon awaits: a living, text-driven fantasy world inside a modern graphical client. Set out from castle Steepmarch into human-voiced quests, RNG dungeons, raids, and a sprawling Mastery Tree. Fully playable by screen reader. Read the world, type your intent, and go deeper.

title: Messa Anomaly
description: Messa Anomaly is a first-person psychological horror game set in an endlessly shifting museum. Observe each corridor, spot unsettling changes, and choose the correct path. One mistake can send you deeper into a night shift that refuses to end.

title: No Murders in Grimwick
description: Investigate a murder at Grimwick’s harvest festival in this hand-drawn point-and-click mystery. Question suspicious locals, collect clues, use items, and uncover the truth behind a town that insists there was no murder.

title: Revenant Dawn
description: Survive a zombie outbreak as Eric, Sarah, and Kate. Explore the town and uncover the mysteries behind the incident - Fight or flee the monsters while managing your resources in a classic survival horror adventure.

title: Crash Relay
description: Crash Relay is a chaotic multiplayer racing game where 10 players share 5 vehicles in teams of two. One player controls acceleration and braking, while the other handles steering and weapons. Use weapons, special abilities, and teamwork to survive chaotic races and reach the finish line first.

title: Escape from Playtime
description: An online 1-4 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

title: Gemcraft: Legacy Collection
description: Experience the original three GemCraft games in one collection. GemCraft 1, GemCraft 0, and GemCraft Labyrinth! Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in one of the most beloved Flash-era tower defense series!

title: Woim
description: If you were a woim, could you still solve puzzles? in this rock pushing, egg cracking, woim snipping, puzzle game, you'll use your long, wriggly body to solve brain teasing puzzles, and find your way through the underground world of dirt you call home.

title: One Dumb Wizard
description: One Dumb Wizard is an action roguelike where you play as a wizard hell-bent on getting their money back from the Bartender. Find charms to power up your wand, parts to craft new wands, and strategically sling spells in your singular mission to get your money back.

title: Wartide
description: An incremental desktop defense game that lives on the corner of your screen. Waves get harder, upgrades get stronger, progress never stops. Build your base, unlock permanent bonuses and grow your army while you work or relax.

title: Bruisers 2D Boxing
description:
Step into the ring and fight your way to the top in Bruisers 2D Boxing — a gritty, retro-styled boxing RPG where every punch counts and every decision shapes your career.

Welcome to the unforgiving world of professional boxing. Build your legacy from the ground up — train hard, fight smart, and manage the life of an up-and-coming fighter chasing glory. With in-depth 2D boxing action and a rich career mode, Bruisers 2D Boxing captures the raw intensity of the sport like never before.

title: Stupid Never Dies
description: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

title: Inky's Sleep
description: A haunting yet enchanting 2D horror-adventure with surreal touches, led by an endearing little cat Inky. Explore dark dreams, unravel uncanny puzzles, and evade otherworldly creatures.

title: Mowit: Grass Cutting Simulator
description: Mowing lawns has never been this much fun! Relax with your friends in online co-op, upgrade your equipment, shape beautiful gardens, and enjoy the experience. Join the fun with 1-4 player co-op!

title: Cutout Village
description: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!

title: The Killing Stone
description: Beat the Devil at his own game. The Killing Stone is a deckbuilding card battler wrapped in a 17th century folk horror narrative. Clean the sins of a cursed family by bargaining against a series of demons - and outwitting the Devil himself.

title: Horror Tales Eats The World
description: Move silently through dark and desolate areas with a photorealistic bodycam perspective. Find the hidden tapes cassettes scattered across the map each one unveils a different paranormal horror story… stay silent, stay alive.

title: Lighthouse of Madness
description: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you in this island. Explore the enigmatic lighthouse, solve challenging puzzles and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity when facing the darkness of your mind.

title: The House in the Hollow
description: With stunning graphics, inspired by the 1920's Art Deco period, and a chilling soundtrack, the "House In The Hollow" will take you on a journey like no other. A journey filled with mystery, horror, and magic, where you are the master of your own fate.

title: Formula Z: Controlled Dose
description:
Formula Z: Controlled Dose is a first-person open-world pharmacy simulation game where you start as a pharmacist, manage your own pharmacy, serve customers, and grow your pharmaceutical business.

Expand into factories, manufacture medications, purchase properties, and explore a large open world filled with activities, vehicles, and business opportunities.

Travel between four different eras: the modern world, medieval 1419, post-apocalyptic 2049, and futuristic 2079. Each era features unique environments, pharmacies, factories, medications, and opportunities.

title: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld
description: Action-RPG Top-down view of Anubis in the Egyptian afterlife: fast melee combat, dashes, relics, and battles with hordes of the dead and ancient gods.

title: Achtung Royale
description:
Achtung Royale is a free multiplayer browser game based on the 1995 DOS game Achtung, die Kurve! Each player steers a worm using only two keys, left and right. The worm trail grows behind them, and touching a wall or any trail ends their round; the last player alive wins.

The game adds online play for up to 30 players, a drop-in Play Now mode, a 30-player knock-out Royale held every half hour, ranked 1 vs 1 and free-for-all ladders, private game rooms, 13 power-ups and local play for up to 10 players on one keyboard. It runs in the browser for both PC and phone. Play and App store apps are in development.

title: Beatrice
description: You are sent to inspect an old abandoned estate before its demolition. Locals refuse to speak about the place, only whispering of a doll named Beatrice left behind. Uncover the horrible events that took place chapter by chapter, solve the mysteries, and find a way to escape. Are you brave enough?

title: Pixel Solo Ops
description: Pixel Solo Ops is a retro-inspired 2D action-platformer. After a covert mission goes wrong, your closest comrade is captured by a ruthless military faction. Fight through enemy troops, infiltrate fortified bases, and survive intense pixel-art firefights to rescue him. With tight gunplay, fast-paced challenges, and nostalgic visuals, you’re the last hope. One soldier. One mission. No backup.

title: Sivers
description: Sivers is an RPG-roguelike with a unique style, where waves of enemies test your strategy. Use spells and build defenses, develop your hero, and fight bosses and varied foes. Victory on the first try is unlikely — every attempt brings you closer to success!

title: Parawyrm
description: Parawyrm is a unique horror experience like no other where enemies and hazards will challenge your very senses. Explore a seamless world with collectables to find and secrets to uncover...

title: Austin Lost in Maze
description:
Austin wakes up trapped in a maze that seems to shift every time he turns around. With no map, no clear way out, and strange sounds echoing through the corridors, he must explore carefully, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the place he’s been trapped in.

Navigate winding passages, search for clues, and keep your bearings as the maze twists into something far more unsettling than it first appears. Every discovery brings Austin closer to an exit—and deeper into the mystery of why he’s there.

Can you guide Austin out before the maze closes in?

title: Sloptoberfest
description: A chaotic festival tent simulator for up to 4 players. Run your own Oktoberfest beer tent, serve beer and food, expand your business, hire staff, brew your own beer, and sabotage the competition.

title: Candlemates
description:
Get ready for a bright adventure full of strategy in Candlemates! Control two enchanted candles and push the fire stones onto their matching braziers, but be careful: each candle has a limited number of moves, and every step can make all the difference!

Switch between the two characters to take advantage of their positions, create paths, and complete each puzzle. While one candle is active, the other remains still and can even be pushed like any other object in the environment. Use both wisely, plan your moves, and avoid wasting precious steps too soon!

As you progress, new challenges make the puzzles increasingly complex. Pressure plates, stone barriers, and other obstacles require precise movements, careful planning, and perfect coordination between the two candles.

title: Dementium II
description: The DS horror sequel, reborn. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull, inside an institution for the criminally insane, where the walls keep peeling back to expose something worse. Fight, solve, and survive your way out. The cult classic, remastered for PC.

title: AiRhythm
description: A hand-tracked VR rhythm game where you play the DJ: strike, hold, swipe and throw your hands through notes as a packed club moves to the music.

title: FingerLaserX
description: FingerLaserX is a neon arcade shooter for iOS and Android. Swipe at the enemy to fire, keep the base standing, and take down bosses the size of your screen. It is a ground-up rebuild of the 2012 iPhone game FingerLaser by its original solo developer. No forced ads, no stamina system, no account, and it plays offline.

title: I Am Your Beast: Quitting Time
description: Remember: you're one of the good guys. Fight a shadow war in Southeast Asia in this story prequel DLC to indie hit I Am Your Beast.

title: Modern Sonic Collection
description: A collection of 3D Sonic games.

title: Classic Sonic Collection
description: A collection of side-scrolling Sonic games.

title: Folk-Tography
description: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

title: Passage Zero
description: Passage Zero is a short psychological horror game about observation, limited controls, and paying attention.

title: Dino Crisis 2
description: A port of Dino Crisis 2 originally released on the PlayStation, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Dreams of a Visionary
description: Dreams Of A Visionary is a first-person exploration adventure set in a mysterious Victorian mansion. Explore richly detailed rooms, solve challenging puzzles, and gradually uncover the hidden secrets of this surreal dream.

title: What the Dog Remembers
description: A retro style psychological horror game. Survive a week in a claustrophobic trailer, spot reality breaking anomalies, and document your findings. Every night tests your perception. Every mistake costs you. Your dog knows.

title: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
description: Lead your crew across strange new worlds in this narrative driven outpost builder! Research, explore, and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens a new ally. Your adventure awaits, Captain!

title: Bytes and Knights Adventure
description: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale digital TCG set within an RPG world, packed with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets of your new city, collect cards, build your own deck, and battle increasingly challenging opponents. Each new card unlocks new playstyles and brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

title: SnowRunner: Season 19 - Research & Restore
description: Research & Restore Season of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

title: We Were Here Tomorrow
description: You and your partner are taken to a mysterious facility where communication and cooperation are your lifelines. This asymmetrical co-op adventure will have you uncover secrets that will shape the fate of Tomorrow…

title: Tiny Monster Village
description: In this cozy village simulation game, you'll help the minions create a unique village and experience a relaxing pastoral life: growing crops, fishing, exploring treasures, and more.

title: Only Fans
description: Only Fans is an object finding game where you find mildly boobs and mildly butts objects in a gooning rehab full of fans.

title: Out of the Shadows
description: Out of the Shadows is a cooperative game (up to 4 players) that blends exploration, tension, and coordination. Infiltrate abandoned locations, solve complex puzzles, and survive the unsettling presence of those who still linger there...

title: Mycopunk
description: A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

title: Cucina Stellata
description:
Gastronomy meets horror in an unsettling narrative experience set in 19th-century Romagna, Italy.

Step into the shoes of a solitary writer and gourmet, inspired by the historical figure of Pellegrino Artusi, as a midnight snack spirals into the unexpected.

Cucina Stellata ✦ Starred Cuisine isn't your typical horror game: no frantic chases or cheap jump scares, but rather a thick atmosphere of tension, disturbing themes, and chilling twists that will linger in your mind long after the credits roll.

title: Baron
description: Baron is Turkey's first RPG Themed, Realistic Mafia game. Growing up in the seediest underworld, Alparslan vows to fight all his enemies until he becomes the most respected bully in Ankara. An action game with a Deep State Mafia storyline set in Ankara from a TPS perspective.

title: Blue Ridge Hunting
description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game where you and your friends investigate, document, and hunt cryptids in the Appalachian Mountains.

title: Fall of Bali
description: Fall of Bali is a historical strategy simulator city set in Bali set around 19th century. Divided in many kingdoms after fall of Bali Empire, Bali has fall in warring era for nearly 2 centuries and now the threat of imperialism come. With all your kingdom potential, can you survive and win this era?

title: A Sister's Journey
description: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

title: Loop Dungeon: Incremental
description: A short incremental dungeon RPG with a finite campaign. Unlock heroes, gather resources, upgrade your party, and reset progress for prestige rewards. Heroes fight automatically, but skills and upgrades need your input—not a fully hands-off idle game.

title: Patients
description: Psychological horror with a retro atmosphere,solo or co-op experience for 2 or more players,Inventory and, resource management, interactive and explorable environment, unpredictable events

title: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia
description:
Anomalia is a puzzle adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds

Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles within fractured memories.

Play as Ai'Lynn, a scientist capable of entering and manipulating memories, as she searches for a mysterious fragment hidden deep within her own mind.

title: Ladykiller in a Bind: Ladykiller Unleashed
description: The original lesbian ladykiller is back after ten years! Return as the Beast for a full run's worth of new Ladykiller in a Bind content, featuring new romances with brand new characters, threesomes with old love interests, and of course, the return of the IGF award-winning experimental choice system that you told all your friends was the real reason why you played the original game. Spread across 78 000 words, 14 new scenes, and six new sex scenes, Ladykiller Unleashed threatens a whole lot of new sexy trouble for the Beast to handle with her characteristic wink and smug grin.

title: Chamber: Atom Breaker Inc
description: A reactor made of breakable pixels. Stir the atoms with your hand, fuse them up the ladder, and chew through the chamber wall layer by layer until the fuel runs out. The playing field is what you spend.

title: Just One More Fly
description: Hunt pesky flies in this first-person swatting game. Clear rooms, earn upgrades, and tackle bigger infestations with swatters, electric rackets, a hand vacuum, and a flamethrower. Place traps, beat your best time, and catch that one last fly.

title: Greed for Glory
description: In this chaotic board game, take on the roles of creatures straight out of fables. Use your wits and think carefully about every move to become the richest among your friends and claim the throne. Then, watch your plans unfold before your eyes, because in a fable, nothing ever goes quite as planned.

title: Her Revenge
description: You are stuck inside a sealed apartment, and have to uncover a massive misunderstanding. Discover what happened to Grandma, and be completely silent. It's not your apartment. You are STUCK

title: Hehehe Game
description:
Hehehe game is...

- 10 unique levels: sell crates just for the sake of crates, and then participate in cart-racing (and all of this in a single level).
- Two narrators: who will constantly mock you (no hard feelings).
- Total absurdity: inspired by The Stanley Parable and all kinds of memes.
- Perfect for streaming: tons of unexpected twists (WW cargo bringers).

This is the second installment of the game. The first part was released only on itch io and was not registered on IGDB

title: Howling Woods
description: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!

title: Universal Tidy Up
description: Explore different ways to "tidy up." A puzzle-focused first-person tidy-up game with 20+ stages to organize! Put scattered belongings on shelves, shelves inside bigger shelves, and delve into new spaces. Figure out the rules of each stage and keep tidying.

title: The Ramen Bar
description: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...

title: Wild Draw
description: Play cards. Screw over your friends. Then shoot it out. WILD DRAW is a first-person party game for 3–6 players where every round starts at the saloon table and ends in chaos.

title: Gay It Loud
description: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

title: Saros: Zenith
description:
Saros: Zenith adds Overlord Rush, a brand-new mode where players take on the powerful Overlord enemies from the main game back-to-back, chase a high score, and compete with players worldwide on integrated leaderboards.

This update also brings "Eclipse Layers", a new game+ mode which allows seasoned enforcers to put their skills to the ultimate test. After clearing Saros, players can return to the beginning and take on a more challenging version of the game. You can rise to meet these trials with even more progression options and new Carcosan Modifiers to customize your experience. Players can also discover new secrets and trophies.

New accessibility features, including High-Contrast visuals, gyro aiming with the DualSense wireless controller, and the toggleable "Slow Game Speed" option, have been added.

title: Beyblade X Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol.8
Beyblade X Evobattle: Bey Coating Pattern & Color Add-on Kit Vol.2
Pidgeon Pocket
description: Pidgeon Pocket is a chill incremental game about a rooftop pigeon-keeper who sends a flock of trained pigeons into a living city park to pickpocket small valuables from park-goers and bring the loot home. Each round the park transforms into a different live event, from a marathon or a street parade to a market, a concert or a dog show, while an intelligent police force reacts to every theft. Progression runs through a skill tree of abilities and rotating talents, growing the flock from a single pigeon into a full squad where every pigeon has its own superpower. Localized into 31 languages, fully playable with mouse, keyboard or controller, and built to run on Steam Deck.

title: Sender Unknown
description: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

title: FirstPlate
description: FirstPlate is a first-person multiplayer cooking game about preparing orders, managing kitchen chaos, and working together under pressure.

title: Big Dig
description: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway spanning the entire Animal Republic!

title: Coin Harvest
description: Harvest coins with robotic arms, unlock islands and conquer realms. An incremental idle desktop widget game that runs while you work or game.

title: My Name Is...
description: Survival horror about sanity balancing affecting gameplay in a steampunk world of phobias, full of dangerous entities, anomalies and randomly generated puzzles.

title: Warding Witches
description: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

title: Bank Simulator
description: Take your customers' money and invest it to grow your bank. Lend it out, buy bonds, stock ATM Rooms across the city and keep the profits. Catch scammers, hire staff and turn a small branch into a global powerhouse in this business management and banking tycoon sim.

title: Eletta
description: Explore an unfamiliar place filled with powerful enemies, advanced technology and scientific advancements in Eletta, an action game about a young girl looking for a way back home.

title: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
description: In this sequel of the LGBT visual novel Reborn a Zombie, Dawn, a trans girl turned zombie, now has to confront her past. However, the Demon King is approaching and his presence will change everything.

title: Athanasia
description: Athanasia is an action survival horror immersive sim where you explore a mysterious facility and use everything you have to survive with an arsenal of equipment as well as your wits against time traveling predators from prehistory and the future.

title: Crooked Frames
description: Crooked Frames is a stealth puzzle game about an art thief who cannot walk past a crooked painting. The player sneaks through museums at night, levels each frame with touch controls, and stands still when a guard turns around. The game has a training night, three museums and a final heist, four kinds of guard, and 99 public-domain paintings by artists including Van Gogh, Monet, Hokusai and Vermeer.

title: Desperate Kart
description: Desperate Kart is a free-to-play racing game and a spinoff of the YouTube series Danganronpa: Desperate Heart.

title: Boulito
description: Boulito is a top-down arena survival action game. Players control Boulito, a small repair robot, and fight off waves of enemies in a closed arena using six upgradeable weapons. The game features 20 handcrafted waves with boss fights, an endless mode, an in-game shop between waves, and online leaderboards. Developed by the independent French studio PixelRed Studio with the Godot engine, it is available on PC (Windows) and Android.

title: Mall Corp
description: John is an ordinary security guard at a shopping mall who has been working there for 40 years. It was supposed to be just another routine shift. But this night hits different.

title: SurgePoint
description: Craft weapons mid-run, strafe through chaos, chain recoil jumps, spawn platforms out of thin air. Pick cards. Break runs. Repeat.

title: AI Olympius
description: Join forces with rebels and their technologies to have a chance to restore freedom in a world that has fallen to the uncontrolled dominance of supreme artificial intelligence.

title: As Above So Below
description: As Above So Below is a Survival Horror Open World Action/RPG. You play as a recent college graduate offered a job in a small town, but upon arrival things are not what they seem. Face a series of unexplained events that unravel history, and ultimately change the future. Explore, Fight, Survive.

title: Surrounded
description: Surrounded is an up to 6-player cooperative horror game where you will encounter a lot of different variations of paranormal activities, strange sightings, and creatures capable of ending your life. Grab your gear, and be ready to experience the strange mystery of the Surrounded world.

title: WB Solitaire
description: WB Solitaire is a collection of seven solitaire card games: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, TriPeaks, Pyramid, Golf and Yukon. Deals are drawn from pools that a solver has confirmed can be won, and each deal has a number that can be replayed or shared. The game includes hints, a full-solution option, a Daily Deal for each game and weekly goals.

title: Letrazo
description:
Letrazo is a TV game show style quiz in which two teams, Blue and Orange, compete for every letter of the alphabet. Each match moves through several rounds, One of Four, The Clue, Crosswords and Where Are They?, before the final letter wheel, where every answer has to start with or contain the given letter. Players answer by typing or by voice, and the team with the most correct answers takes the jackpot.

Matches can be played online from 1 vs 1 up to 4 vs 4, with bots filling any empty seats, or in private rooms with friends using a code. A single-player story mode pits the player against eight increasingly difficult rivals in 1 vs 1 duels, ending with a trophy.

title: Ruby's Trick or Treat
description: Welcome to Ruby's Trick or Treat, a fully voice-acted anime VTuber horror game for Halloween, starring VTuber RubyWhiska. You walked out of her party once. Now she's coming trick-or-treating at your house.

title: Lost Odyssey: Recompiled
description: An experimental native PC port of Lost Odyssey for Xbox 360.

title: Five Nights with Maids
description: In this survival horror game, play as a night guard watching over a mansion and its maids for five nights. Use lights, shutters, and cameras to spot suspicious activity. Each night grows more intense as the atmosphere shifts and the maids begin to behave strangely. Can you survive till the end?

title: The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just for the Two of Us
description: Take on the role of Derek — the police chief in a small town. Make decisions that will change the course of the story. Unravel the mystery behind the peculiar behavior of Derek's boyfriend, Chris, and his younger sister. The graphic style is inspired by bara-manga and colorful line art.

title: Cat Life
description: Cat Life is an adventure and survival solo game, allowing you to explore a vast open world as a cat. A series of quests will lead you to solve the mysteries of this island, if you manage to face all its dangers!

title: Memories of Magic
description:
Memories of Magic, formerly known as EvilQuest, is a browser-based MMORPG set in a dark fantasy world, built around old-school combat, skilling, quests, and character progression. With a retro online RPG feel, Memories of Magic invites players to create an adventurer, explore the world directly from the browser, and build their account through classic MMO activities. The game leans into familiar scapelike systems such as skill training, monster hunting, rankings, and persistent progression while wrapping it in a darker, more ominous fantasy atmosphere.

In Memories of Magic, players can train skills, fight enemies, complete quests, compare progress through hiscores, and explore a growing online world alongside other adventurers. For players who enjoy browser MMOs focused on gradual progression, skilling, combat, and community-driven discovery, Memories of Magic offers a fresh dark-fantasy take on the classic scapelike formula.

title: Teacade
description: Teacade is a tea pouring puzzle game. Slide the teapot along its rail and let go: each serving falls through porcelain gutters, looping glass tubes, funnel portals, valves you tap, a water wheel, a cup on a belt, see-saws, switches, trapdoors and a cutter, and many of these pieces change with every serving. At the bottom a bunny, a fox, an owl, a hedgehog, a bear and a cat each hold a glass with a line on it: fill every glass to its line without stopping short or running over the brim. Nothing shows where the tea will go, so you read the table and work out the way down. 120 tables in six valleys, no timer.

title: A Game About Needle in a Haystack
description: A first-person game about finding a needle in a giant haystack. Dig through the hay by hand, sell it at the cow, buy tools and upgrades in the workshop, and search the pile until you find the needle.

title: Boatrocker
description: Boatrocker is an arcade game played by tilting the phone to keep a small lobster boat from capsizing as a storm builds from a calm dawn to a night gale. The player leans into waves, steers around debris, hauls lobster buoys, collects crates and answers Coast Guard maydays. Earnings buy boat upgrades at a boatyard, three boats can be skippered, and twenty logbook pages found in bottles tell a lighthouse mystery.

title: Ace Attorney: Memories and Turnabout
description: Ace Attorney: Memories and Turnabout is an unofficial Ace Attorney fangame featuring an original story told across five interconnected cases.

title: Shores of the Fallen
description: Shores of the Fallen is a first-person, open-world zombie survival game set on a storm-battered island. Zombies track the player by sight and sound, making stealth a core part of play, and night fog brings larger hordes. The surrounding water is patrolled by sharks. Players scavenge buildings and wrecks for supplies, hunt wildlife, fish, craft tools and weapons, and build a base piece by piece. A drivable truck and boat are used to cross the island, and a day/night cycle and storms shape each run. The game is in Early Access and is developed by a single developer.

title: Maldhalla
description: Just one more minute. Then another. Outlast endless hordes and a new boss every three minutes in this survival roguelite with 21 characters, 32 weapons, and relics triggered by weapon combos.

title: Who's Cheating?
description: Everyone is gambling. One player is cheating. In this social deduction game for 3 to 8 players, the Cheater uses glasses that reveal the next winning bet while the Security Guard studies the tables, reads the bets and decides who gets the shotgun. Lie, steal and larp over proximity chat.

title: Severed Chains
description: Severed Chains is an unofficial port of Legend of Dragoon for PC and Steam Deck, created by Monoxide.

title: House Music Incremental
description: A music based incremental in which progress in the game through buying instruments also changes and progresses the music.

title: Moto X
description:
Revive the moto racing sipirit with this game, developed in 1994.

Compete against motorcycles of 250cc, 550cc, and 750cc in different tracks full of obstacles and the best riders.Skills aren't going to be enough to win. Throughout the race you will find items that will give you power ups to help you beat your opponents. Use them to your advantage!

Compete against a friend in 2 player mode (split screen) and discover once and for all who is the best Moto X racer.

title: Alice Nation
description: Explore, talk, and solve puzzles with cards in a solo tabletop adventure! Play as Alice, a girl trapped in the Beyond. Drag cards to craft items, meet curious companions, and find your way home. Stuck? Try a different card—and a different approach. This charming fairy-tale world has its secrets.

title: Matryoshka
description:
Matryoshka is a spooky spot-the-difference puzzle game that tests eyes and nerves.

Cursed entities that devour humans have gotten into the Matryoshka dolls. Inspect them with extreme caution. If you encounter a cursed doll, you must immediately burn and seal it away.Miss a curse, or burn an innocent doll—even once—and... you will find out

title: Mercenaries Of Vector
description: First-person mech combat where everything is made of lines of light. 100 missions in open battlefields, inside Battlecruisers and Dreadnoughts, and out in deep space! 10 Mega Mech bosses and a salvage economy that pays for every piece of hardware you rip from your dying opponents.

title: Todd The Technician
description: A first-person puzzle game where you're guided by a slightly sarcastic AI earpiece named A.N.D.I., you will use tools, warp reality, and solve a variety of mechanical and logic-based puzzles to keep the strange technology of the Anomaly Corporation running, all while hoping you won't get fired!

title: What He Left
description: Every night at 3:03, someone knocks on your door. Through the peephole you see a hood, but no face. He wants to play a game: you step away, he changes one thing in your apartment, and you have to find what. Miss it, and something else comes through the door. He also asks you questions, and your answers come back later. A short first-person psychological horror game about spotting changes in your own apartment over seven nights, with a cat named Tisha and five endings.

title: Take My Bomb
description: An online party game where up to 16 players shove a bubblegum bomb onto each other. It pops after 30 seconds, and takes anyone nearby with it. Only the one holding it can see the timer. As long as it's not you. Take My Bomb.

title: Video Store Chaos
description: Video Store Chaos is a single-player simulation. Pick up, sort and shelve over 2,500 movie, game and VHS cases to turn a messy video store into an organized collection. Unlock upgrades to carry more and work faster, find clues on the covers and explore the hidden basement.

title: Joker's Knock
description: A competitive online card game where every player fights for themselves. Draft powerful Jokers, outplay your opponents and climb the Ranked ladder. Easy to learn, hard to master—with fair competition, achievements and cosmetic progression, never pay to win.

title: Resonurgy
description: Build an automated factory where machinery meets alchemy. Explore a technomagical world, scan matter and extract its hidden principles. Connect production lines, assemble research circuits and contain the Dissonance your factory creates. Play solo or with friends.

title: Sproutrex
description:
Take control of Sproutrex, a small nature-powered mechanical sphere equipped with a propeller, and explore a colorful pixel-art world where plants and machines have grown together.

Run, jump, glide and fly your way through 28 handcrafted levels filled with hazards, enemies, moving platforms and environmental challenges. Use Sproutrex's unique abilities to reach new areas, overcome dangerous obstacles and discover different ways through each stage.

Along the way, collect coins and mechanical seeds hidden throughout the levels. Find every seed in a stage to earn its Perfect Level medal and prove you've mastered the challenge.

But Sproutrex is more than just a machine. In this strange world, nature has found a way to thrive among gears, metal and forgotten mechanisms — and this little robot is living proof that the two can grow together.

title: Diceminoes
description: Diceminoes is a score-chasing roguelike where you roll dice, pair them up to make dominoes, and connect them into scoring patterns. Discover powerful upgrades, bend the rules, and turn clever placements into huge scoring cascades.

title: Lotwick Hill
description: Buy plots. Run shops. Outsmart your rivals. Lotwick Hill is a business tycoon set in a living town. Choose from 72 shop types, set prices and keep your shelves stocked. Customers have different budgets and tastes, and those tastes change as the years pass. Bid for plots when leases expire, react to your rivals, and zoom down to street level to watch customers queue outside your shops. Play single-player against AI, or compete online with up to four players and up to six competitors in total with AI.

title: Lights On My Screen
description: Lights On My Screen is a 2D adventure RPG set inside a video game. Help Kid navigate the colorful world, solve puzzles, talk to characters and fight (or don't fight) the enemies. And find the one who brought them to this world...

title: M!racle Home_Page
description: They were going to be social media millionaires! ...Five years later, they have only eighteen subscribers. Now Roo’s bedroom has been rebuilt, his friend is missing, and strangers laugh at everything he does! A choice-driven psychological horror visual novel about finally being watched.

title: House Zero
description: A social casino where the only thing at stake is bragging rights. Play 20+ games, from slots, Plinko and Crash to live poker and case battles with friends, using free play-money chips. Climb weekly leaderboards, finish quests and unlock cosmetics. No real-money gambling or payouts.

title: Money Burner
description: Slice banknotes, smash gold and torch piles of cash in this cartoon first-person incremental game. Earn rewards, upgrade your weapons and break into new rooms. Start with scissors and work your way up to a flamethrower and a massive laser cannon.

title: Mendicant Sea
description: Assume command of a five-floor containment facility. Manifest 200 strange PTF species, study their needs, direct staff, and build a live defense line for the moment containment fails—then field your subjects in 1v1 or 3v3 Containment Combat.

title: Tidy Up the Town
description: What have you done to the market?! Practising your amateur sorcery in the town square might not have been the best idea… You should really tidy up the market stalls before everyone arrives for a hard day’s work!

title: Manorbound
description: Explore a manor trapped in a time loop and solve puzzles to uncover the manor's deepest secrets and break the cycle.

title: Solemnfable
description: Fight and forgive in this QTE based RPG, and travel the Earth and stars with those who matter most. SOLEMNFABLE - A journey of acceptance.

title: Sleep Walk
description: A son attempts to bridge the emotional divide between himself and his father in an attempt to get them both to stop dwelling on the past and create a new path forward together. Sleep Walk is a story about forgiveness and self worth.

title: VHS World '89
description: A cozy first-person sorting sim set in a 1989 video rental store. All 3,360 VHS tapes have spilled across the floor — pick them up, read the covers, and shelve them by genre. No timers, no pressure: just the quiet satisfaction of putting every last cassette back in its place.

title: Stream Train
description: Stream Train is a co-op adventure where up to 6 players livestream their trip through the Uncanny Valley. Grow your audience by taunting cryptid creatures, doing dangerous stunts, and pranking your friends. Can you make it through the valley alive?

title: Flecto
description: Flecto is a puzzle game where you place blocks in order to deflect bullets and shatter targets. Strategically use your tiles to split bullets, bounce them around each level, and destroy every target.

title: Tales of Eternia: Remastered
description: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

title: Online: 404
description: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

title: The Little Land
description: The Little Land is a strategy god-sim where you play as a god worshipped by the Littles. Command the forces of nature, protect them from danger, and help their village survive for as long as possible!

title: Vanisha
description: Vanisha is a sci-fi arcade shooter where you dodge bullet waves, craft builds from collected cards, and climb through six sectors of increasingly dangerous space. Level up, spend skill points, hit shops along the way, and see how far your build can take you.

title: Dawn of Irkalla
description: Dungeon. Horror. Survival. Dawn of Irkalla plunges you into a terrifying world of dungeon exploration: find loot, outsmart monsters, and uncover hidden artifacts for a shadowy government agency. Build your deck, use your items wisely, and escape before time runs out. Your survival depends on it.

title: Supermarket Guard Simulator
description: Play as a supermarket security guard. Build security systems, conduct surveillance, catch thieves, stop criminals, and drive company profits. Use security devices and weapons to bring more value to shareholders. Do your best and grind that promotion!

title: A Game About Opening a Chest
description: Open a Chest of infinite loot, collect legendary items, and create game-breaking synergies in this unique incremental roguelike. Grow your fortune, use NPCs to your advantage, and survive the perils of the dungeon in this addictive game of luck, risk, and rewards. When in doubt, open more Chests!

title: Purranoia
description: Purranoia is an action roguelike with a twist to the genre - you have no control over your characters movement. Instead you control a variety of powerful scientific inventions to protect poor cat Mousti from waves of enemies.

title: Dreadline Express
description:
Investigative odyssey into the minds of fading passengers facing the end of the world aboard the last human train.

An adventure game that doesn't set specific goals. It naturally encourages you to make your own decisions and draw your own conclusions, providing a highly immersive experience with a fair amount of story branching.

title: Futa Slug EX
description: Futa Slug EX is a top-down shooter roguelike where you collect and fuck beautiful dickgirls. Build your team and discover powerful upgrades as you pilot your SLUG through procedurally generated dungeons.

title: Sparky Rush: Purrils in Pawsville!
description: Sparky Rush is a lost media 3D Platformer PS1 game with elements of Psychological Horror where its developer descends into complete sorrow and madness. Play as Sparky and discover all the morbid secrets left by its creator before his sudden disappearance.

title: Poem for the Caged
description: You wake in a monster’s cage with no memory and 30 days to act. Choose to escape, obey, or become its favorite.

title: Dimenshot
description: An intense, fast-paced FPS that seamlessly blends parkour and shooting. Master fluid movement, engage in dynamic close combat, and unleash devastating firepower across diverse worlds and unique themes, each filled with dangerous enemies and epic battles.

title: The Guardians
description: The Guardians is a decision based RPG with flight simulator and first person shooter mechanics. Every decision you make has consequences, your actions will shape the outcome.

title: Penguin Colony
description: Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories.

title: DayZ: Badlands
description: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

title: Flipping is Hard
description: A flippin' hard game where rotation is your only motion. Flip, fall, and climb through the land of lost things to return to your boy.

title: Order: The New Dawn
description: Order: The New Dawn is a colony sim with space adventure. As a legendary captain from the United Stellar, build a base on the desert planet New Terra and face the perils of the Wastespace—how will you shape the destiny of the stars?

title: Terradune
description: Terradune is a hand-drawn 2D action RPG where you battle monsters, discover hidden treasures, and shape your hero’s fate. Explore scorching deserts, moonlit forests, and thrilling dungeons to uncover secrets in this fast-paced, immersive adventure.

title: Season Island
description: Season Island is an interactive role-playing experience in which you guide Spike, a human stranded in a mystical seasonal globe…

title: Doomed Otaku
description: "Real friends exist in the online world!" The Doomed Otaku is a multi-ending adventure that follows a wandering 20-something otaku as they navigate both the real and cyber worlds, experiencing various events along the way.

title: Mahjong Sex & Girls
description: Mahjong, Sex & Girls is a lighthearted adult mahjong game. You are the part-time worker at the mahjong parlor. Besides getting entangled in various heart-pounding interactions with the female characters, even the boss lady has her eyes on your body...

title: Night Blood W: Cutthroat Wolf
description: "Nightblood W: Cutthroat Wolf" is a cyberpunk action role-playing game. You will play the role of an ambitious gang cadre. Your goal is to challenge and eliminate the rebellious Frey Gang alone, prove your strength, and eventually reach the top of the gang to control the entire city.

title: A Dungeon Is You
description: Tower defense X Incremental idle! Design your own dungeon (maze). Summon and place different defenders against hundreds of personally designed waves. Explore multiple systems, including an arpg like item system with every system improving each other. No resets or prestige! Continuous combat!

title: Ducking Grenades
description: Ducking Grenades is a physics based game in which the protagonist traverses the world in a very unconventional way: With grenades! Hunt down the evil General Goosey and his minions and bring peace to the universe in this hand-made, fast-paced 2D side-scrolling action game!

title: Shards of the Past
description: A trading trip with a nearby village turns into an epic adventure when you discover a hidden truth about your world. You will meet new friends and foes, explore amazing places, and face a choice that will shape the future. Your actions and choices will determine the outcome of this story.

title: Feed the Cups
description: Feed the Cups is a game made of drinks. It will make you experience every bit of a drink shop. You will work in various beverage stores: preparing materials, ordering for customers, making drinks, making cups, and so on. You can cooperate with up to 2 people on the screen!

title: Beyond These Stars
description: Journey on the back of the space whale Kewa, building a city for your people as you travel across the galaxy seeking purpose and answers, and developing deep relationships with the universe around you.

title: Tenebris Somnia
description:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

title: Console Archives: The Drug Store
description:
The Drug Store was released by Human in 1998 for a 32-bit home console.
This is a simulation game where you manage a drug store, aim to open many stores, and increase your capital.
Manage your business while considering locations, the types of products sold, customer demographics, and build the ultimate drug store!
Sometimes, an employee you've become close with might even propose Original products...?

title: Brushpath
description: Brushpath is a painting puzzle game. Each pixel of a picture is a small puzzle on a honeycomb grid, painted by dragging a single brush from cell to cell and loading or mixing colours from paint pots along the way. Each finished puzzle becomes one pixel of a larger picture. There are 112 pictures across eight themed shelves, with no timers or failure; stars reward clean routes.

title: The Fame Game II: L.A. Heartbreaker
description: Shot across Los Angeles by a team with Hollywood experience, this live-action interactive drama stars Zhong Chenyao as Ayaka, with a cast shaped by 200,000+ votes. As a cash-strapped student posing as a wealthy heir, navigate five dangerous relationships—and risk losing yourself behind the mask.

title: Hero Chains of Destiny
description:
Hero Chains of Destiny is a fantasy dungeon-crawling, deck-building RPG developed by TavernCatGames. Players build and manage their own guild, collect cards, assemble a party of three characters, and venture into dangerous dungeons filled with monsters, treasure, and encounters.

Combat combines turn-based strategy with collectible cards, character abilities, equipment, summoned monsters, and a shared Power Stone resource system. Players can expand their collections through dungeon expeditions and card packs, experiment with different party and deck combinations, and challenge increasingly difficult enemies.

The game also features arena battles, multiplayer activities, card collection management, and optional town activities such as fishing and the Wheel of Fate.

title: Under Review
description: Under Review is an anomaly-hunt horror game. Inspect uncanny hotel rooms, document discrepancies and survive the strict, unforgiving bureaucracy of the Manager.

title: Kings of Antikva
description: Turn-based strategy with hidden information. Position your army, outsmart your opponent and capture the enemy flag before it’s too late. Easy to learn, hard to master. Ranked online multiplayer and offline mode versus AI.

title: Amanojaku Nightmare
description: Based on the Touhou Project, this is a fantastical and intense bullet-hell Shoot 'em up. Dive into a nightmare where Gensokyo’s strongest fighters gather, and aim to conquer it. There are no special systems or complex controls. From Beginners players to those who have “graduated from being human,” we await your challenge.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Lost Savior
description:
This is a port of a JRPG originally developed exclusively for mobile devices by Bandai Namco Entertainment.
Embark on your adventure by choosing from six elements — Fire, Wind, Earth, Water, Dark, and Light — and a wide range of jobs, including Fencer, Scout, Mage, and Cleric.
This story is a sequel to the previous title, LOST CHRONICLE.

title: Colors of V
description: A vector dungeon on a monochrome tube, lit by three subtractive colour gels. Drop a gel and half the room stops existing: a wall you cannot see is not solid, an enemy you cannot see is frozen and cannot be shot. The colour channel is the collision layer, so sight and physics never drift.

title: Delenar TD: Remastered
description:
Delenar TD Remastered is an old school Grid based Tower Defense game, where you control the path of the mobs. Build towers, place mazing rocks, and adapt to the mobs in each level. The game is difficult, but the strategy of solving each level is completely up to you!

Game comes out tomorrow 10/15/2026

title: Shanwen
description: 1990s: Windswept mining town Linshan, dependent on fading coal mines, worshipped a mountain god’s stele. After it cracked and oozed brown liquid, a strange illness spread. Lin Tianqing returned for his sick father, uneasy as the eerie town neared, having overheard whispers.

title: Ampanic
description: AIM × Shop Management! Gather, process, craft, and serve customers — all with your aim. Let a customer escape and it's Game Over! Master flick & tracking aim and survive the chaos. 3 difficulty levels, from mouse beginners to seasoned veterans! Online co-op & competitive multiplayer!

title: The Factory in the Shadows
description:
Some places are abandoned. Others are left behind for a reason.

The Factory in the Shadows is a psychological mystery horror experience that takes you into the remains of forgotten places, where traces of the past still linger and unanswered questions wait beneath the surface.

What happened here? Why was everything left behind? And what secrets were buried before the world moved on?

Explore, investigate, and uncover fragments of a story hidden across time. Every room, every recording, and every discovery brings you closer to the truth or just lies.

The deeper you look, the more you realize that the shadows are not empty.

They are hiding something.

title: Silly Souls
description: Silly Souls is an online hide-and-seek party game for 2–8 players. Hide your soul, throw props, and taunt a friend playing the Grim Reaper to steal time—or grab the scythe and hunt your friends. Expect close calls, silly escapes, and proximity voice chat.

title: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
description:
Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town! is a first-person building and tidy-up game that supports solo play and online co-op for up to five players. Players collect and sort 18,490 scattered bricks by shape and color, then place them according to building plans to reconstruct a small town.

Players unlock helpful abilities and use equipment such as a wheelbarrow, scaffolding, and a magnet to collect, transport, and place bricks. Completed buildings light up and gain decorations, gradually transforming the town as reconstruction progresses.

title: Solid Void: Halloween Nonograms
description:
Solve a nonogram, and watch the picture come alive. Fifteen haunted scenes are waiting to wake up. Start with quick 5x5 grids and work your way up to 15x15 monsters.

It is Halloween night and you have the good chair. A candle burns on the desk, rain drums outside, and every so often lightning throws the whole room white. In front of you: a grid with numbers along its edges. Fill in the right squares and a shape shows through, like frost wiped off a picture. If you know these as picture cross or griddlers, you already know the dance.

Every grid you crack hands you a piece of a bigger picture. Set it on the paper, turn it until it fits, press it home. A gentle tutorial teaches the rules from nothing. No timers, no lives, nothing to lose but the evening, and your progress is saved wherever you stop, so play for five minutes or stay until the candle is out.

title: Troll Slayer
description:
The forest near the kingdom has become overrun with trolls, and only one brave knight stands between them and the kingdom.

Take up your sword and venture into the forest in this simple and challenging 2D pixel art platformer. Jump across dangerous terrain, avoid deadly hazards, and fight different types of trolls standing in your way.

Each troll has its own behavior and abilities, requiring you to learn their patterns and choose the right moment to strike.

title: Fishy
description: Fishy is a free-to-play social VR fishing game for Meta Quest, developed by ENVER. Built around fishing, friendship and discovery, FISHY lets players cast out together, explore colorful locations, collect an ever-growing variety of fish and upgrade their rods, bait, clothing and gear. Along the way, players can take on challenges, hunt for rare catches, tackle larger-than-life boss encounters and get caught up in unexpected multiplayer moments. Designed as much for hanging out as it is for fishing, FISHY turns a familiar pastime into a shared virtual world built to be explored with friends.

title: Wolfsschanze: Operation Götterdämmerung
description: In this uncompromising first-person shooter, storm the Wolf’s Lair in 1944, the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership. Fight your way through bunkers, defensive positions and Nazi troops using weapons, explosives and vehicles, and eliminate officers all the way up to Hitler himself.

title: Reason & Rhyme
description: Birds of a feather solve puzzles together! An online co-op puzzle adventure for 2 friends (or soon-to-be-friends)

title: Folded Fables: Tidy Up The Dragon Hoard
description: Unwind in a relaxing first-person Tidy Up game where you'll sort and arrange 5,648 treasures in a papercraft world. Level up, unlock new skills, and tally every coin. Play solo or tidy up together with friends in online co-op.

title: Sole Mates: Tidy Up the Shoe Store
description: Two thousand pairs of sneakers are scattered across the shop floor and every shelf is empty. Find each shoe's match, read its model and size, then put it where it belongs. Alone, or online with friends - 2 to 4 players. No timers, no score, no way to fail.

title: Vanirya Legends
description: Vanirya Legends is a browser-based fantasy idle role-playing game. Players progress through maps and boss encounters with automated combat, collect and upgrade equipment, customize character builds, and ascend to continue their progression. The game also features pets, expeditions, castle defense, guilds, a player market, and player-versus-player battles.

title: Mimic Busters
description: Model, paint, and mimic everything to hide from the Busters! Mimic Busters is an online multiplayer game where you are either a cube with a sentience or a hunter with no mercy. Mimics create their disguise using simple 3D modeling tools and Busters hunt the Mimics before the time runs out!

title: Scam With Your Friends
description: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.

title: Houm
description: Houm is a point-and-click adventure game filled with mystery and intrigue created in the spirit of the classic MacVenture games.

title: Bonkhope
description:
Use your wits and acrobatics to push, confuse and defeat hordes of monsters in room after room. Don't lose hope, or you might never escape.

A turn-based roguelike where what goes up must come down.

title: Good Job
description: Take charge of a business that no one could put on their resume. Manage the girls at the underground massage parlor, delight customers with herbal blends, expand your e-commerce business, and grow your empire without drawing too much attention!

title: Gran Turismo 7: Spec IV
description:
The Spec IV Update includes:

October:
• A new circuit, 'Sportsland SUGO'
• Six new cars
• A new 'Spec IV' opening cinematic
• Vintage: a section featuring cars not available to purchase as new
• Car Concierge: a service for ordering Used and Legend cars
• Experience: a mode featuring brand-specific driving challenges
• Car Viewer: a feature that lets you admire the cars in your garage
• Collector Level cap increase.

December:
• A new circuit, 'Autumn Ring'
• Six new cars
• Family: a new mode to be enjoyed by the whole family, from kids to adults
• Shuffle Race: a luck-based race with randomly selected cars
• Online Drift Trial: a new mode where players can test their drifting skills against others worldwide
• The next evolution of Gran Turismo Sophy
• New difficulty level in Power Pack for advanced players.

title: Silent Wounds: The Doll
description: Silent Wounds is an episodic psychological horror anthology. Each episode offers a compact and intense narrative experience. In this first episode, a man returns home and trades reality for the dangerous, silent obsession with a perfect doll.

title: Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
description: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. Ball Picker - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse - Bonus Contents Pack
FreshWomen: Season 3
description: FreshWomen is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the best parts of life. You're a college freshman who just earned a mansion. Bring girls to your home to romance, date, or fuck them. Your journey will be filled with comedy, love, and lots of sex.

title: SCP: Antimemetics Division
description: No, it's not your first day. The Amnestics have kicked in, and Site-48 has locked down. Scavenge restricted gear, gain clearance to forgotten levels, and bend reality to escape lethal SCP anomalies. Tactile survival horror where remembering too much will get you annihilated.

title: Loot Goblins
description: Crack open chests, chain buffs, upgrade and recruit the ultimate goblin crew. Send them deeper into dungeons. Get better loot. Repeat!

title: The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand
description: In The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand, you step into the shoes of a disgraced magician who, in his quest to regain his former glory, unleashes an interdimensional invasion while experimenting with a mysterious book.

title: Not My Son
description: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

title: Sword Flinger
description: Throw swords to fight in this roguelite chain-action game. Weapons bounce off walls and enemies, chaining hits from one foe to another. Build damage bonuses with every chain and dive deeper into ever-changing dungeons while collecting swords, spears, axes, staves, shields, and more.

title: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3: Complete Edition Double Pack
description: Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3: Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. Toy Story 3: Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles.

title: Toy Story 3: Complete Edition
description: Toy Story 3: Complete Edition brings the definitive version of the game inspired by the Academy Award-winning film to modern platforms for the first time, including previously platform-exclusive content from the PlayStation 3 version and an enhanced experience with upgraded visuals, higher resolutions and improved performance. Toy Story 3 is best known for its groundbreaking Toy Box Mode, a massive, open-world sandbox that allowed customization of the environment and characters and featured non-linear missions that allow players to unlock new toys, vehicles and characters from other Pixar movies.

title: Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
description: Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features four Toy Story titles and A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with quality-of-life improvements and behind-the-scenes content.

title: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
description: Farm, explore, and discover! Embark on an unforgettable journey in the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure!

title: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
description: It’s the golden age of game nights with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Play 5 brand-new party games designed to turn your standard bash into a sidesplitting blast. You bring the friends, we’ll bring the fun. Coming this fall to screens near you!

title: Echoes of the Unread
description: Jump and sing to unlock the secrets of the library. Singing will change the world around you and your abilities improve as you explore.

title: Pavane: See No Evil
description:
Melody Green saw something she shouldn't have.

A music teacher at a local elementary school finds herself in the midst of something bizarre and unexplainable: an abandoned building, a thick fog enveloping the area, and no wi-fi or phone signal to allow her to call for help.

Faced with strange riddles, eerie messages from her past, and something horrible haunting her from within the screens, Melody realizes that someone or something is calling out to her, trying to show her a truth that could shatter her world and turn her life completely upside down.

title: Bluey's Happy Snaps
description:
Explore Bluey’s world like never before in Bluey's Happy Snaps!

Join Bluey and her family in a new photo-powered adventure game. Discover familiar locations, play with loads of toys, and use Bluey's camera to capture and keep all your favorite moments.

title: Cuboy Adventure
description: An exciting and incredibly cute platformer full of parkour, puzzles, action-packed moments, and boss battles awaits you! Collect stars, unlock new abilities, discover secrets, defeat your enemies, and overcome every challenge!

title: Hypnostasis
description: A survival horror game about psychological trauma. You wake up from your room to an unsettling world of disturbing creatures. The world you know has warped into something sinister. Navigate nightmarish worlds, uncover buried memories, and confront the shadows. Will you find the path to salvation?

title: Chant Wizard
description: Scream to win! Shout over-the-top spells in this hilarious voice-controlled battler. Assemble your magical deck from the five elements for 1v1 duels testing your wits and shame. Warning: Play safely—don't let your roaring summon the neighbors before you beat your rival!

title: Navy Island Confidential
description: Discover the secrets of Navy Island in this captivating and funny story, and follow the misadventures of Archibald Figg: a slightly clumsy secret agent in this colorful and relaxing point‑and‑click adventure!

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
description: 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

title: We Are So Cooked
description: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

title: Don Pepe & His Balloons
description: Welcome to Don Pepe's hit game show! Grab your water balloons and outsmart your rivals in this explosive, fast-paced party brawler for up to 4 players.

title: A Blade for the Emperor
description: An interactive fiction epic fantasy.

title: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction
description: A terrible syndicate has infiltrated society, explore cases, listen to what the citizens have to say, and use that information to route out the good from the evil in this roguelike 'clock-like' deduction game. Can you uncover the head of the syndicate? Or will you be duped like the rest?

title: Realm of Taiwu
description: Demons ravage, calamities rage. Xiangshu's scourge devours the mortal realm. In this ink-wash dark fantasy world, you'll wander, unearth rare treasures, reclaim divine swords. Seek like-minded companions to save the world. Survive—in this dimming world, you can still kindle a faint light.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2
description: Discover 500 hidden cats across 5 artistic hand-drawn scenes. Relax with color-by-numbers and add life to every detail. Play solo or in cozy co-op, while Meow FM sets the perfect creative mood.

title: Fatal Train
description: Murder on the train? It doesn't matter, it's no longer our concern! Ladies and gentlemen, don't worry, we have four detectives who can handle this! After all, there's nothing complicated about murder investigations, right?

title: Thalia
description: Thalia is a fast paced roguelike action game. You as Thalia has been summoned to this ancient place where death is not the end, it is only the beginning. Fight hoards of enemies, giant bosses and improve in an infinite mechanic where death only makes you stronger!

title: Game of Fitna Vol. 1
description: Game of Fitna Vol. 1: A thrilling death game visual novel set in 2030. Play as Zayn, a high school student thrown into sinister survival games known as "TEST." Fight for your life, uncover shocking truths, and face intense moral dilemmas in this mature, thought-provoking experience.

title: Chained Beasts
description: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

title: Frosthaven
description: From the creative mind of Isaac Childres, the highly acclaimed board game moves to the digital realm in the video game adaptation of FROSTHAVEN! The dark fantasy tactical RPG features deep mechanics and challenging yet satisfying gameplay both in Single Player and Co-Op Online Multiplayer.

title: Pestilence
description: Players can expect to enter a 90's narrative-based psychological horror, where they get to experience a series of grim, dark, and very immersive environments while solving puzzles and unravelling the horror within.

title: Whispers of The Shadow
description: Detective Grace Lawson sets out immediately upon receiving a tip about her missing stepsister Amy, and when she gets there, she suddenly finds herself trapped inside the house. Now, Grace has only one goal: to find her missing sister and escape this nightmare.

title: Area 37
description: Area 37 is a 16-bit retro action platform game, set in a post-apocalyptic world dominated by machines, where the protagonist, Pink, risks his life performing dangerous missions to earn money.

title: Odd Town
description: Odd Town is a retro-styled first-person adventure about being stuck in a town where everything feels just a little wrong. Explore a handcrafted, bite-sized open world, meet suspicious locals, take odd jobs, steal sandwiches, dodge cops, and uncover a conspiracy hidden under the pixels.

title: Pixel Washer
description: Pixel Washer is a cozy, zen-like game where you play as a cute piggy power washing beautiful pixelated worlds. Wash sprites, upgrade your power washer, and find hidden secrets.

title: Ratatan
description: Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

title: Enshrouded
description: You are Flameborn, last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival Action RPG for up to 16 players.

title: Alveron: Withering Roots
description: Dive into the magical realm of Lyhjem and help save the World Tree. In "Alveron" you take on the role of Valec, who is drawn from the human world into the world of the Alveri.

title: CyberPunk Sex Tower
description: The world of the future, modern technologies make it possible to create a super realistic sexual experience ...

title: Desolus
description: Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game.

title: Twin Drive
description: Twin Drive is an online co-op racing game built around one gimmick: a single car split in half. One player drives the front, the other drives the rear. Stay in sync to steer straight, or fight each other into a screeching donut. Climb a giant stunt tower and race up to 4 cars to the finish.

title: Grave Odds
description: Grave Odds is a roguelike in which the player digs graves in a haunted graveyard. Each headstone shows the chance of loot and the chance of waking what is buried, and clearing a grave raises the odds on its neighbours. The game has 78 items in five rarities, quick turn-based fights against undead enemies, crypt bosses, and a branching map for each run of about 5 to 10 minutes. Bone Dust earned in every run buys permanent upgrades and hires diggers.

title: Keyboard Chaos
description: 2,692 keycaps. 32 keyboards. One messy desk. Find the right keycaps, match them to their positions, and complete every keyboard, square or round. Search, organize, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning chaos into perfectly assembled keyboards.

title: Catnip Arcade
description: Catnip Arcade is four small cat games for iPhone and iPad. In Herding Kittens you steer a litter of hungry kittens to the food bowl with a laser dot and catnip. Kitty Jump is a 3D box climber starring Space Cat. Balloon Pop calls a color and you pop it, and every color also has its own shape. Emergency Stress Relief! is the same balloons with the rules taken out. You can pet the cat, and the purrs are the developer's own two cats, Samantha and Sabrina. Free, no ads, no account.

title: Lootkeeper: Tidy Up the Loot
description: An adventurer has returned from his journey with 1834 items he'll never use. Now it's your job to sort his loot. Organize weapons, potions, relics, and all kinds of RPG junk, and use magic and upgrades to speed up the work. The loot chaos awaits!

title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Expansion Pass
description: Expand the saga with new stories, allies, and more! Discover additional stories, enlist gods to your side, and more in DLC for the Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game.

title: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.6: Sanctuary of Ink
description:
Version 1.6 of Arknights: Endfield includes:
• New Operators: Si, Argent Flow
• New RE-Factor Headhunting: Tangtang
• New Areas: Si's Painting
• New Story Content: New story chapter and missions
• New Gameplay Modes: Contingency Contract, Arena of Games
• New Systems: Gear Plans, Auto-Farmer
• New Events and Rewards

title: Arcade Archives 2: Thundercade
description:
"THUNDERCADE" is a shooting game released by SETA in 1987.
As a member of the special forces, use a high-speed motorcycle equipped with machine guns to reach the enemy stronghold.
Destroying structures such as buildings will reveal power-up items in the form of sidecars equipped with gun barrels. Sidecars come in various types some fire bullets further, while others can only shoot sideways so choose the right one for each situation!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Stinger
description:
"STINGER" is a shooter released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1983.
Take control of the "STINGER WOLF" and head to the center of an enemy base where evil life forms roam.
In an emergency, you can call on the friendly robot "BONGO" to automatically destroy the enemy.

title: Veilborn
description:
Veilborn is a single-player 2D action roguelite set in a dark fantasy world.

Players explore hostile regions, battle dangerous creatures and powerful bosses, and develop their heroes across successive expeditions.

The game features multiple playable heroes, character progression, equipment preparation and a camp that serves as a base between expeditions.

Players can explore two distinct regions: the mysterious Lands of the Veil and the volcanic Crown of the Furnace, home to the Colossus of the Last Forge.

Death is part of the experience, with each fallen hero contributing to an ongoing legacy.

Veilborn was developed by BLACKSHADOW using the Godot engine and was released as a free-to-play PC game on October 14, 2026.

title: Love Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily
