description: Love Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily is a heartfelt spot-the-difference puzzle game about love, memory, and a lifetime shared together. Restore Riku’s fading memories across 21 illustrated chapters, solo or in local co-op.

title: Gallery Organizer
description: Tidy up the gallery, sort and hang all the paintings where they belong. Choose a gallery size. Enjoy the satisfaction of turning a messy gallery into a perfectly organized collection. 1,000 artworks by real artists.

title: BitWise
description: BitWise is a puzzle game about electricity. Players place parts on a board, wire them by hand, and a circuit simulator runs the result. It starts with a battery and a lamp and climbs through relays, logic gates, adders, latches and counters to a small stored-program machine. The grader checks what a circuit actually does, so a strange build that does the job passes. 238 levels across seven chapters end with the telegraph, with a Koch-method Morse trainer, a Sandbox, a level editor and Steam Workshop sharing.

title: My Recycling Center 2
description:
Keep recycling - new challenges, containers, improved models, garbage trucks, management and much more.

Design and expand your new recycling center in this first-person simulation game. Take care of unloading, sorting and compacting the waste.

The new level editor allows you to freely design the yard, place upgrades and set it up the way you like.

With increasing experience, multiple customers will show up simultaneously and might create a queue if unloading does not happen fast enough.

Completely new shaders for containers and vehicles bring realistic graphics and more possibilities. You can not only clean containers with the pressure washer but also restore worn paint jobs with the paint gun.

title: Where It Happened
description: You wake up to find yourself standing before an old house. The painful memories buried deep within your heart suddenly return. You don’t remember it well, but you used to live here. This is where it happened.

title: Parallel Park
description:
Parallel Park is an action game about time travel and parking cars. Each time you successfully park, time rewinds and another car is added to the map. Fill the map with cars as you cleverly dodge all your past selves and unravel a story about a future that's in danger of never happening.

Competitive multiplayer allows you to out-park your friends - adding more and more cars to the map as you go.

A built in level editor allows you to make custom levels too, and play the creations of others.

title: Kyoufu Yawa: Dai-ni-ya
description: On a rainy night, three ghost stories are told in an old-fashioned café. As a writer for an occult magazine, you listen to three people recount their experiences. A psychological horror visual novel that slowly builds a sense of dread.

title: Deunocta
description: In a realm where witchcraft evolved along side technology, a lone marauder, Cassidy Chrome seeks vengeance against a tyrannical demi god who enslaves souls to conquer worlds and prolong his immortality. Cassidy, trained in the black arts fights against undead corrupted entities in a forsaken world.

title: Halley's Big Catch
description: A cartoon cat who loves to fish. Come home to Hidden Pond, fight real fish, and follow a trail of relics to waters around the world. New shores, new tackle, and a story that unfolds one cast at a time.

title: Spooky Dwellers 5: Collector's Edition
description: Dive into this spooky Match 3 puzzle adventure by conquering eerie levels, exploring hidden object scenes, and solving minigames to decorate your ultimate party parlor and banish the ancient shadows! Destroy the evil of Kthal-zghor!

title: Thank You Bus Driver
description: Thank You Bus Driver is a chaotic bus driving game where you take on the role of a town’s bus driver just trying to get through the day with minimal rulebreaking and maximum gratitude… in the form of Thank Yous!

title: Phobos
description:
A social deduction horror game for 4-8 players. Solve puzzles that need real coordination, outsmart infected players armed with unique abilities, and survive monsters that each hunt differently.

Play with a full friend group, or jump into a public lobby to fill out your crew.

title: Annalog
description: Annalog is a "Zachtroidvania" homebrew NES game, combining Zach-like programming puzzles with Metroidvania-style platforming, exploration, upgrades, and bosses.

title: Cheap Screamer
description: Try to survive the experiments being conducted on you while you attempt to uncover the truth about why you are there.

title: Keysaster
description: On your way to meet a friend at a cafe, you suddenly black out for reasons unknown.... awakening in a place that is clearly not the human world. If you want to survive, evade hostile entities and search for key items to escape.

title: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
description: Run the logistics center of the future! Hire robots, deliver packages via drone, drop off urgent shipments in your truck, and become the biggest package pickup place in sunny Cranelock.

title: Ferry Good Day
description: Set sail and bring your passengers to their destination. In this relaxing boat simulation you explore different maps, plan your routes and ensure your reliable arrival at port. Utilize currents, locks and catch fish to experience the best possible journey with your ferry.

title: Eternally
description: Build one of four Eternals from 260+ skills across 17 skill trees. A dark fantasy tactical RPG where every attack is a dice roll on a hex grid, with an eight-chapter campaign, gear to forge and elite monsters. Play alone, online with up to 3 friends, or with 1 friend on one PC.

title: Cozy Builder
description: Build, design, and decorate your dream château in a cozy vineyard valley. Live among your creations, harvest grapes from sunlit vineyards, and craft artisanal wine blends in a relaxing sandbox builder where every home helps restore beauty and balance to the countryside.

title: Signal Lost
description: A short horror game where you keep a spacecraft operational as it reaches Venus by completing tasks and repairs.

title: Astrolite
description: Astrolite is an arcade-styled bullet heaven in a race against time. Conquer each planet before the forces of the galaxy overpower you. The Galaxy stands united. The World Guardians prepare a final stand against their greatest enemy... that enemy... is you.

title: No Such Place
description: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

title: Fire and Ashes
description: You wake up in a terrifying psychiatric hospital. Fire and Ashes is an immersive horror game where madness and reality blur, and every monster hears your scream… even beyond the hospital walls.

title: Block Trucks Multiplayer Racing
description: SuperTrucks is a competitive, real time, ranked multiplayer racing game. Race against real opponents on challenging track surfaces, upgrade your truck and rank up as you win races.

title: Over the Hill
description: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

title: Slowburn
description: Your kill count matters. Your life doesn't. Absorb, aim, kill. Hunt the "Gemstones" to find the truth about yourself in a post-apocalyptic city in this isometric action game.

title: Nientum: Opus Zero
description: Nientum - Opus Zero is a 2D action game that brings platformer, runner and music interactive genre all together. A fantastic journey of the director and singer, and the storytelling of music from the world. Run through the stage to complete their fate!

title: Nowhere
description:
Nowhere is a Nordic inspired narrative mystery/horror game, revolving around Nordic mythology and what happened to these Gods after Ragnarök and how the rise of Christianity impacted them and their worship.

Featuring the mixing styles of detective gameplay and survival horror, It's going to appeal to people who love a good mystery and also love to be scared, wandering through these haunting atmospheres, feeling something watching them at every turn while the tension builds and builds until the world turns into a nightmare and its fight or flight.

title: The Witch's Bakery
description:
The Witch’s Bakery is a 2D Adventure Puzzle game where you play as a joyful witch who opens a bakery in modern Paris.

She has a special power: she can heal emotions with her bread.

title: Thanks, Light.
description: [Thanks, Light.] is a first-person 3D geometry puzzle game where you shine and absorb light to transform 2D and 3D states.Watch as one boy saves a world that has lost its light.

title: Kamigami: Spirits of the Nature
description: Get ready for another card battling adventure on Kamigami! Easy to play, hard to master, collect brand new cards, face over 80 opponents, build your strategies and restore peace to the gods!

title: Among the Trolls
description: Among the Trolls is a first-person, survival, action-adventure game where the secret mysteries of Finnish forests are unraveled. Venture deep into the Finnish wilderness to uncover family truths and master the art of survival

title: Frog Garden
description: Grow a garden with friends or strangers. Plant flowers, decorate your patch, collect hats, and occasionally swallow or cast spells on your gardening partners.

title: Two Winds
description: Two Winds is a gentle hot-air balloon puzzle made for the whole family. Your balloon rides two winds over the board, a warm wind down low and a cold wind up high, both drawn as air currents you can read at a glance. Move square to square towards the meadow, step into a current to be carried along and tap the balloon to climb into the cold wind or drop back to the warm one, while clouds drift, storms chase you after every move and lightning glows the turn before it strikes. 120 levels in six valleys, from First Flight to Fiesta, add more balloons, flocks of birds, eagles, cloud walls and storms, plus a daily flight. Undo is always free and every level plays offline.

title: Not A Drone
description: Not A Drone is an arcade flying game in which Gus, a pigeon disguised as a delivery drone, delivers packages through San Francisco, New York and Tokyo, built from real map data. The player taps to flap and steer, finds the way by street names and written directions, and avoids raising suspicion; a full suspicion meter sends a security drone in pursuit. Perks are chosen between deliveries, and coins buy 21 permanent upgrades.

title: World Simulation: Drive & Fly
description: Drive, fly and sail anywhere on Earth. Type any address and it's there: real roads, real buildings, real terrain. Race a Formula car through Paris, pick up taxi fares in New York or fly over Tokyo at sunset, with 45+ vehicles, live weather, live flights and 150+ hand-built landmarks. Free roam is free, with no ads. On iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro.

title: One Million Coins
description: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

title: Hegemarch
description:
Hegemarch is a real-time space strategy roguelite played in the web browser.

Players choose one of several dynasties, colonize planets, manage an economy and command fleets against AI-controlled rival dynasties to take control of a star sector. Each run takes place in a newly generated sector, and a daily run gives all players the same seeded sector. All graphics, sound and music are generated procedurally in code.

title: Nebula
description: Nebula runs Super Mario Galaxy natively on Windows.

title: RyGT
description: Gran Turismo Sport running as a native Windows program.

title: Invincible Vs.: Angstrom - Multitudes Skin
description: I am Angstrom Levy and Invincible made me into a monster! I've walked through more realities than you could ever comprehend. Worlds where empires rose, worlds where they fell, worlds where your greatest heroes never existed... and worlds where they became monsters. Every step taught me something. Every dimension made me stronger. This? It's simply the attire befitting a man who has seen them all.

title: Invincible Vs.: Atom Eve - Everyday Eve Skin
description: No super suit. No dramatic entrance. Just a comfy outfit, a day off, and absolutely no intention of fighting off multiverse versions of the world's greatest superheroes... unless it becomes really, really necessary. Turns out matter manipulation powers don't come with a dress code.

title: Invincible Vs.: Angstrom Levy - Additional Fighter
description: From a thousand worlds comes Angstrom Levy, the genius transformed by tragedy and obesssion. Once driven by a desire to unite infinite versions of himself, Angstrom now carries the memories of countless realities. This brilliant and dangerous dimensional traveler can tear open portals to teleport, control space, and always keeps his opponents guessing.

title: Invincible Vs.: Like Father, Like Son - Skin Bundle
description: Before the battles, before the betrayals, before the fate of worlds rested on their shoulders... there was a dad cheering on his son, and a kid who couldn't wait to become a hero. Some memories are worth holding onto.

title: Meaningless
description: Meaningless is a narrative-driven 2D adventure focused entirely on its characters and their inner worlds. Follow the footsteps of Violet and Jack, explore the details of a seemingly ordinary world, and find your own meaning along the journey.

title: Dozens
description: Dozens is a number puzzle with no clock. Each turn the player gets a tile from 1 to 11 and places it on a free cell of an 8×8 board, where it joins the neighboring tiles into a block. A block that adds up to exactly 12 clears and scores; one that would go past 12 is not allowed. Levels have no end, walls appear from level 3, and the player has three wildcards per run. Single player, offline, free, no in-app purchases.

title: New Worlds
description:
New Worlds is a space-faring universe simulation game where you navigate gravity to explore, complete missions, trade, upgrade and improve your ship fleet. Adventure to uncharted planets, to settle and develop the “New Worlds” of the last great frontier!

Features a 2D space simulation built on multi-body Newtonian gravity. The player starts with a single ship in the Solus system and flies by planning burns and adjusting their trajectory: moons can capture a ship, gas giants can slingshot one, and an efficient orbit can reach a target with a fraction of the fuel a direct burn needs.

Stations and worlds are markets in a simulated economy, where rival powers expand whether or not the player takes part. The player hauls cargo and passengers, trades between markets, takes on missions and builds a fleet of scouts, freighters, starliners, carriers, colony ships and drones. Earnings pay for ship upgrades, stations, settlements and infrastructure. The player can join a faction or found their own and compete for territory through politics and diplomacy. Settlements grow from outposts into cities, and hostile worlds can be terraformed until they are habitable.

The game spans three star systems with 38 worlds. It supports co-op multiplayer for up to four players, has an original 19-track soundtrack and plays in the browser as well as on Windows, Linux and Android.

title: Heartfall: A Tale in Three Lives
description: From making new friends — or enemies — to exploring this island for secrets, how will your story end? Play as Grian in this visual-novel RPG and encounter new, shocking twists that you wouldn’t expect!

title: Whispers Of The Lost Ticket
description: Whispers of the Lost Ticket is an exploration horror game centered around uncovering the events surrounding Guilded Hollow Carnival through story and event interactions while shadowy forces try to stop you. Uncover the secrets of those who came before you, as the carnival welcomes its final visitor.

title: Smiley Arena
description:
Smiley Arena is a single-player game that combines tower defense with
direct, action-based combat. The player controls a smiley character on the
battlefield, moving with WASD and aiming with the mouse, while placing and
upgrading turrets across five lanes to stop incoming waves of enemies.

Six classes are available, each with its own ability: Fire (burn damage),
Ice (slowing and freezing), Shadow (invisibility and critical hits), Medic
(regeneration and healing), Bomb (splash damage) and Speed (a high-speed
dash). Defeated enemies yield currency, which is spent on building turrets
and upgrading them through several tiers. Level-up choices are made while
the game continues to run, without pausing. Boss enemies appear at regular
intervals between the standard waves.

The full version features endless waves, all six classes, the complete
upgrade tree and an achievement system. A free browser-based demo covering
the first nine waves and the first boss encounter is also available. The
game supports English and German.

title: PigPonyPocalypse
description: PigPonyPocalypse is a twin-stick shooter built entirely around boss fights. The game consists of four bosses with no levels in between, and each boss has its own mechanics: a fight in darkness, a collapsing bridge chased by a wall of fire, floor tiles that explode in a sequence the player has to memorize, and a final boss with four phases. Every boss can be fought on two difficulties, Forgiving and True Challenge, the latter adding new phases and mechanics. Victories post the player's damage per second to per-boss Steam leaderboards, and achievements unlock color variants for the heroine.

title: The Conjuring: Unspoken
description:
The Conjuring: Unspoken, a new Netflix game, is coming October 13.

Set in a decaying English pub where a family is haunted by an ancient evil, use your phone as a paranormal investigation tool and make life-or-death choices that shape your story.

Developed by Supermassive Games.

title: Leg It: Don't Stop
description: Leg It: Don't Stop is a fast-paced melee survival arena game in which the player fights continuous waves of enemies and elemental bosses. Across 32 arenas, players can choose from 35 character sets and mix and match arenas and characters, while pursuing higher scores, facing increasingly difficult bosses, and unlocking additional content.

title: Triogram
description:
Triogram is a cosy puzzle game where three flat Nonogram grids come together to reveal a 3D object. Use the number clues to work out its front, top and side silhouettes and watch the model take shape.

There are 480 puzzles across four worlds, arranged into 40 collections of 12. Start with small, straightforward objects and work your way towards intricate sculptures.

Three views, one object. Solve the front, top and side grids for each puzzle, meaning 1440 grids in total!

Watch it take shape. The 3D preview changes as you fill the grids.

title: Roll Pick Go!
description: Build a team of pixel monsters in a free-to-play strategy auto battler. Buy, merge, and equip your squad, discover powerful combinations, and turn battles around with unique abilities and ultimates. Can your team reach 10 wins?

title: Handle with Care!
description: A co-op delivery game where you play as tiny postal workers in a town that’s trying to kill you. Deliver everything from coffins to ticking bombs, escape rabid dogs and berserk drivers, and stay in business for six days to earn your pint on Sunday.

title: Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition
description: Experience the updated, enhanced, and complete version of the grand strategy classic; Total War: Shogun 2 and all of its DLC, including the Rise of the Samurai and Fall of the Samurai campaigns. Battle across an exquisite, authentic realisation of Feudal Japan stretching from 1175 to 1876, combined with Total War’s seamless blend of turn-based empire building and massive real-time tactical battles.

title: Dub Night Live
description: Grab a mic and redub the internet. Dub Night Live mutes the cast of a short clip and hands the roles to you and up to 8 friends. Everyone records at once, nobody hears anyone, then the whole party watches the finished cut together. Build your own clips with the in-app editor.

title: Witch Cabin Cleanup
description: Witch's Cabin Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,313 curios in a cluttered witch's cabin. Clean, learn spells, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

title: Attic Antiquities
description: Precious dolls haunted by evil spirits have appeared on your doorstep. Use the tools of the Beaufort Family Workshop to exorcise them and learn why they've come to you.

title: Maneki Mania
description: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside.

title: Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Arjun & Outfit 2
Trash Day
description: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen shopping cart, and work together to get back home. Live your best raccoon life.

title: Murder Castle
description: You are trapped inside a masterpiece of madness. Unravel the chilling mystery of H.H. Holmes Murder Castle. In this atmospheric true crime escape simulator, every room is a puzzle and every document a shocking discovery. Can you escape the architect of death?

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: National Championship Air Races
Bio-Submariner DX
description: You're the captain of a Bio-Submarine! A living submarine that gains power from flesh! Cruise through the Deep Sea and devour your enemies!

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 4 - Arjun
description: Like an aggressive bull jumping in the dust of the fields, Arjun moves heaven and earth with his powerful breathing techniques!

title: Legion Breaker
description: A short active incremental game about defending from undead hordes. Wield an arsenal of spells, raise a holy army, and fight across ever-expanding battlefields. Start from nothing and progress through a massive skill tree to become the ultimate battlemage.

title: Office Manager
description: Build and manage your own office empire. Design buildings, find tenants, negotiate contracts, and keep them happy. Research new technologies, expand your business, and handle unexpected events in a living office world.

title: Double Dealers
description: A 3–6 player auction game built around bluffing, deception, and manipulation, where you must outsmart your opponents in tense bidding wars, hide the truth, and turn risky trades into profit. Every round is a battle of mind games where trust is fragile and strategy decides the winner.

title: Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn
description: Dive into Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn! Rebuild an Atlantean capital amid coral and ancient magic. Manage resources, explore the abyss, and revive a sunken kingdom in this unique marine city builder. The legend awaits you beneath the waves.

title: Poly Fighter
description: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with a choice of simple or motion inputs to master your moveset and claim your title!

title: Planet Zoo 2
description: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.

title: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel to Me
description: A dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Quietly wander through it, solve opaque puzzles, meet strange figures, and uncover the subtle threads of melancholy from which this place was born.

title: Roguefort
description: A deeply simulated turn-based open-world roguelike on a vast magical continent. Explore, dungeon crawl, sail, steal, fish, build, spellcraft, become a vampire, and live out your wildest dreams.

title: Rolla
description: Play as the monster from the movie series that never existed, ROLLA. ROLL. EAT. REPEAT. Fast paced arcade game with chunky old school 3d graphics: eat people, destroy whole cities and battle with cops, army and government agents! Uncover the secrets of what ROLLA is and where it is from.

title: Pixel Survivors: Defense
description: Pixel Survivors: Defense is a pixel roguelike defense game where you fight off endless waves of monsters. Collect skills, upgrade your heroes, combine items, and survive as long as you can!

title: Valor Mortis
description: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

title: Feudal Craft
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting medieval settlement simulator where you will have to fight for your place in the feudal hierarchy. Use a smart strategy to develop your settlement. After all, it is the skills and equipment of each peasant that can make the difference.

title: Legion Was Here
description: You are Legion, a secret agent who can change his appearance at will. Use your investigative and chameleon skills to infiltrate enemy ranks!

title: Hungry Horrors
description: Face legendary creatures from British and Irish folklore in this roguelite deck builder where cooking replaces combat. As a princess, you must prepare dishes to feed these monsters or risk becoming their next meal.

title: Deep Dish Dungeon
description: Co-op online multiplayer game where you must unite to survive the treacherous depths of a mysterious dungeon, navigate puzzling passageways and gather resources to improve your camping site. Encounter enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and unravel enigmas within its depths.

title: Allogloom
description: Chaos has descended upon the town of Gruesome Grove and its fate rests in Nora’s hands. Join her on an oftentimes gory journey through a beautifully hand-drawn world. Discover forgotten truths, make peculiar friends, encounter monsters and solve puzzles in this mysterious and macabre adventure.

title: Evard the Hermit: Through Fears
description: Evard's gift and a curse — the ability to absorb other people's fears and phobias. Immerse yourself into Evard's story and discover the secret of his origins. Explore his medieval Metroidvania world, look for the sources of fears and overcome them.

title: Warmachine: Rogue-Scout
description: Warmachine: Rogue-Scout is a sci-fi tactical strategy game where you build a squad of machines, upgrade your loadout, and fight through dangerous missions using cards, factions, and powerful combat abilities.

title: Next time... I'll work from home
description: Eric Stokes, a 27-year-old office clerk, finally found a new job after a long unemployment. As a new father, he eagerly starts his new job, but quickly finds that something about this office is off.

title: Evergallery: Jigsaw Museum
description: Evergallery: Jigsaw Museum is a jigsaw puzzle game set in a museum whose paintings have fallen to pieces. The player restores public-domain artworks from collections including the Cleveland Museum of Art, the Art Institute of Chicago and The Met, at sizes from 16 to 100 pieces, with no timers. Each restored painting adds a short note about the work, and restoring three works by one of sixteen artists brings that artist back to walk the museum.

title: Half Haunted
description: Half Haunted is a puzzle game with roguelike elements in which the player cuts haunted objects into two halves of equal weight to free the ghosts trapped inside. Objects hide heavy parts such as pits, cores and lumps of iron, so the player turns each one before drawing a cut. The game spans 19 rooms across four floors of the Halverson family manor, each floor ending in a boss object, plus 12 more rooms in a second house, Kringle Keep. Relics, Seance cards and coin bets change each run.

title: Project RE: Visited - Resident Evil 3
description: A native PC port & clean-room static recompilation of Resident Evil 3: Nemesis (1999, PlayStation 1) for Windows.

title: Kirr
description: Cooperative horror where surviving isn't enough: you must locate and destroy the thinking brains behind a collective hive mind before it finishes calculating your end. Stay alert, trust no one — not even the voices in the dark. Coordinate, move fast: hesitation is what it's counting on.

title: Miecze Valdgira I+II
description: Swords of Valdgir is without a doubt a true legend of the Polish retro gaming scene, having achieved cult status on 8-bit Atari computers. Both parts take players on an unforgettable journey into a dark world of sword and sorcery, where finding the titular weapon grants unimaginable power. The mechanics masterfully combine arcade elements with demanding puzzles, guaranteeing high-energy fun.

title: Embers of War
description: The Tang has fallen. The realm has no master. Fifteen years. Five dynasties. Emperors come and go like post-horses. Grain costs more than a man, a life is worth less than grass, and there are bones along every road. In an age like this one trade always pays — selling your life by the day, following the coin and not the flag. They call it soldiering for hire. That is the company you command.

title: Scary Baboon: Spooky Baboon
description:
Scary Baboon received its Halloween-themed “Spooky Baboon” update on October 9, 2026.

The seasonal update introduces a Halloween makeover across the game, alongside themed enemies and activities. New additions include Pumpkin Meatman, a Halloween variant of the existing Meatman boss, and the Mimic Monster.

The update also adds a limited-time Trick or Treat event. During the event, players have eight minutes to collect 50 pieces of candy while exploring the game.

Spooky Baboon is available as a seasonal update for Scary Baboon on Meta Quest.

title: OpenCMR2
description: OpenCMR2 is a work-in-progress native port of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 (PC, 2000) to modern platforms.

title: No More Pain
description: No More Pain is a first-person psychological horror adventure game. Stepping into the shoes of different characters, you will examine personal belongings, gather photos, and inspect clues within mysterious environments to unravel the truth buried beneath past memories.

title: Refund This Game
description: Fling yourself up to the top in this “Getting Over It”-like 3D platformer! Stick your pole to walls, bend it and fling yourself with great speed! One mistake means falling all the way down. Can you reach the summit in under 2 hours and earn that refund?!

title: Space Manager
description: Take on realistic space missions, manage your economy, and explore the solar system. Build and expand your space center on Earth, accept contracts, and launch satellites into orbit. Research, adapt and collect valuable scientific data to commence your growing aerospace empire.

title: Road to Verdant
description: Immerse yourself in a massive magical world where you will start as a humble archer and grow to become a legend. An auto-runner with RPG elements where you can craft your equipment, upgrade your character, trade items, and complete quests... some of them very well hidden!

title: I Was Reincarnated as a Bosozoku Hamster, so I Became a Racing Champion to Return Home
description: A bicycle hits you, you die, and you wake up as a hamster in another world. There is only one way home: down the pass at night, five exhaust pipes over your roof and a rival on your bumper. A touge racing RPG with the full bosozoku kit welded on.

title: Keepshore: Hearth Seal
description: A ceremonial hearth at the heart of every town you build. Host a Hearth Festival and the fire roars three times as long. The town gathers there. Beauty first — duration only, never a standing production bonus.

title: Smoke.exe
description: One cigarette is all the time you get to break in. Lay out nodes, wire them into an auto-hacking routine, then light it and let it run. A cyber-noir roguelite about how deep you can get before the smoke runs out.

title: Mushroom Marketplace
description: Run a whimsical mushroom café by day and explore a quiet village by night in this cozy tea-brewing roguelike!

title: We Are Cooking
description: Grab your apron and enjoy chaotic cooking action with your friends or solo! Prepare dishes before time runs out and prove yourself a worthy chef.

title: Not An NPC Game
description:
Not an NPC Game is a 2D arena game where you never attack your opponent directly. Use walls, speed, and the arena itself to manipulate monsters, trap your rival, and make the monsters attack for you.

Every match is about strategy, prediction, and skill. The monsters don’t take sides — the better player knows how to use them.

title: Voidtrain: Big Catch
description:
Who said you need water to go fishing? The Void has plenty of wildlife of its own—all that's left is to grab your gear, try your luck, and see what you can catch.

Catch different species of fish and earn Scales with every one you reel in. Upgrade your rod and reel, and use familiar resources as bait.

title: Ghostpunk
description: Investigate paranormal cases using a 1990s CRT terminal. Analyze photos. Decode audio. Interrogate suspects and decide what’s real, what’s fake and who’s lying. But the deeper you go, the more the system starts watching you back.

title: The Last Flight
description: Rebuild a forgotten airplane, manage your survival, and soar across a hauntingly beautiful world. Balance your stats, scavenge for parts, and chart your course through a post-apocalyptic sky. Every flight is a step closer to freedom... If your past doesn’t catch up first. Prepare for takeoff!

title: Demersus
description: Demersus is a first-person atmospheric walking sim that explores the horrific reality of alcohol addiction through environmental storytelling and puzzles. Navigate the protagonist's fractured psyche, rendered as a beautifully haunting, hand-crafted clay mindscape and see what lies beneath.

title: Dinerz
description:
Dinerz is a diner simulation game, where you manage you own diner.
Cook meals, server customers, clean tables, wash dishes and hire staff, you can play alone or with your friends.

title: Monkey Bizniz
description: An online co-op physics game about collecting bananas for the Monkey King's feast — fill your cart, find the summit, and try not to blame your friends when it all goes wrong.

title: Last Round at the End of the World
description: Dream the riddle. Question the village. Choose who drowns. A poetic folk-horror game about divine messages, guilty villagers, ritual games, and the terrible cost of keeping a place safe.

title: For The Cat! Sorcerer's Revenge
description: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

title: Contract Cooks
description: We're a staffing agency. We send cooks to kitchens. The cooks are you. Today, a bubble tea kiosk. Tomorrow, an economy flight galley. Contract Cooks is a co-op cooking roguelite where you go where the agency sends you and try not to get fired.

title: The Traveller's Sight
description: Vincent Dumas, an investigator with supernatural powers, is sent to a small town in France with a murky history to uncover the truth behind the death of Laurène Delgado. Using his ability to communicate with the dead, he sets out to find clues that will lead him to the killer.

title: Wheel Make It
description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

title: American Cooking Simulator: Multiplayer
description: Team up in chaotic co-op shifts at Joe’s Freedom Burgers! Cook with guns, serve hungry customers, and travel across a totally normal, definitely accurate version of America in the most patriotic cooking sim of all time.

title: Desire's Burgers
description: It’s your first real job—and you get to keep all the profits! But your boss? She’s a seductive succubus who drains your energy at night. Run a cozy burger joint by day, survive her temptations by night, and shape your fate in this rhythm-infused visual novel.

title: Vicarius
description: A small handcrafted open world focused on exploration and combat. Leave your safe zone to gather the resources that will help you craft better gear. The further you go, the more dangerous it gets but the resources are also better. Dying means losing everything that you are carrying.

title: Haunted Heist
description: Haunted Heist is a 3-8 player round-based PvP horror party game where Heisters find and retrieve gems in a procedurally generated mansion, while Tricksters use chaotic abilities to distress, disrupt, and dispose of them to protect their home.

title: Pursuit of Mercantile Power
description: Pursuit of Mercantile Power is a single-player economic sim with light RPG. No money spawns—money only moves. Control the village’s cash flow, use proposals and loans, buy shares, and take over enterprises to seize GuYuan’s commercial order.

title: Daily Burden
description: Daily Burden is a chest-opening roguelike parodying mobile games. Experience short runs where you’ll learn to crave ads, build your way out with over 100 items and to keep up with key inflation… but beware of (FAKE) microtransactions !

title: Spy Drops Gaiden
description: Infiltrate enemy bases and undertake a series of covert ops in thrilling, old school 2D stealth action.

title: Bandit Simulator TD
description: This is a Tower Defense + Base Building game where you establish a bandit stronghold from scratch. With Tower defense at its core, you can ambush travelers, develop characters through profession and equipment systems, and expand your stronghold by researching, forging, and constructing!

title: Barfender
description: Barfender is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op bar sim where you pour drinks, clean disasters, stop fights, and try to keep the bar alive while everything falls apart. Build the place, serve the crowd, survive the night.

title: Battleplan
description:
Battleplan is a historical, WW2 real-time strategy game of unparalleled realism and simulation.
Fight across massive battlefields created from real-world geographic data.
Create your army by customizing your order of battle and chain of command.
Draw directly on the map to create elaborate plans.

title: The Doll Shop
description: The Doll Shop is a hand-drawn narrative game – part romance, part horror – set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a young dollmaker who reunites with his childhood friend in an eerie snowbound village. Will you dare confess your secret?

title: Spoofs Playland
description: Play, paint, fish, collect and decorate! Spoofs Playland is a relaxing, family-friendly collection of point-and-click minigames where you collect decorations and bond with the adorable Spoofs. Earn rewards, complete quests, buy new backgrounds and hundreds of items, and make your ideal room!

title: Julio's Adventure 3
description: Survive in Tamixa School in this horror adventure. Explore the school without attracting the attention of the mysterious creatures until they leave the area. Use the school cameras, your flaslight and your stealth skills to avoid getting caught before it's too late...

title: Colorbound
description: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

title: Hubert
description: Step into the paws of a loyal shepherd dog in this atmospheric third-person adventure. Track scents, herd sheep, and navigate the rugged northern wilderness. Face rough weather, natural predators and not so obedient sheeps.

title: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror
description: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror is an open world, survival horror experience where you play as a caregiver for the elderly. Navigate the dark streets of Tokyo, choosing where to go and whom to care for. Not everyone can be saved. How many deaths will be on your watch this week?

title: Ward Off Evil
description: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

title: Hyperfight 2
description: The next evolution of HYPERFIGHT! The fast-paced, no-block fighter returns with fresh knockout mechanics and a colorful cast of new and returning characters.

title: Meow Garden
description: Welcome to Cat Island, a cozy farming sim where cats sprout from the soil! Plant seeds, care for your cats, and discover over 40 breeds. Decorate your home, train your cats, fulfill orders, and grow your own cat estate.

title: Moonfrost
description: Moonfrost is an isometric, next-gen pixel art, lo-fi multiplayer life-sim set in a fantasy version of the modern day that offers a premium experience but as a free-to-play game.

title: Life of a Thug
description: This game throws you into the shoes of a character struggling to survive in a corrupt ghetto overrun by gangs, mafia bosses, and crooked politicians. This is no ordinary RPG; Life of a Thug is designed for players who dare to delve into the heart of darkness and pay the price of their choices.

title: Burn With Me
description: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

title: Alpha Nomos
description: It’s time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!

title: Ghost Villa
description: In Ghost Villa you farm and cook during the day, by night you fight hordes of ghosts that want to haunt and take possession of your home.

title: 9 Kings
description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

title: Ghost Hunter
description: Ghost Hunter is an online collaborative psychological horror game that can be played by at least one and up to five players together. Unlike other ghost hunting games, it incorporates rich Taoist elements and experiences traditional Chinese supernatural culture.

title: Time To Wake Up
description: Time To Wake Up is an atmospheric psychological thriller where one night you find yourself stuck in a dream. No worries, though. You are not alone. You hear a voice, in need of your eyes and willing to help you out.

title: BoomGround
description: BoomGround is a solo/multiplayer voxel destruction game.

title: Pitch & Power: Football Club Owner
description: Pitch & Power: Football Club Owner is a football club management simulation in which the player is the owner of a club rather than its coach. The player runs the club's money, squad, transfers and contracts, the stadium and facilities, and business ventures in the club's town, answers the press and manages supporter expectations. The club world is shown in 3D, with an office, dressing room, press room and stadium, and matches are presented as staged 3D broadcasts with highlights and replays. The game was released as an early beta for Windows on itch.io.

title: Splinter Cell: Double Agent - Recompiled
description: An unofficial native PC port of the original Xbox version of Splinter Cell: Double Agent via static recompilation.

title: Snaptic
description: SNAPTIC is a physics-based puzzle-platformer that takes place in an offline laptop, and it's up to you to remember the Wi-Fi password.

title: Within
description: Immerse yourself in the atmospheric world of a first-person thriller. You will face a cunning criminal. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and try to escape the nightmare. But be careful: you can become not only the hunter but also the prey.

title: Legends of the Pitch
description: Football meets roguelike deckbuilding. Choose your nation, build your team, and combine cards in tactical battles. Upgrade your deck, explore branching paths, and defeat legendary bosses across five regions on your journey to football glory.

title: The Human Bench
description: Three thousand words, one ending. Made for EctoComp 2026's La Petite Mort with contributions and revisions by Lacunova.

title: Nova Warp
description: Nova Warp is a free multiplayer game with three player factions. Team up against the creatures of deep space, collect resources, master co-op dungeons, level your ship and equip your individual loadout. Dive into massive faction battles and conquer the stars, pilot!

title: God of War III Remastered for PC
description: A native port of God of War III: Remastered (PlayStation 4) for Windows 10 and 11.

title: Kyro
description: Kyro is a top-down pixel art action-adventure game inspired by classics like The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, Shadow of the Colossus, and the Souls series. The player controls Aiden in Ka'a, an Amazonian sci-fi setting, with the core objective of exploring, growing stronger, and defeating a series of challenging bosses, subtly unraveling the world's mysteries through environmental storytelling.

title: Bar Keeper
description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 3,235 scattered bottles, glasses, casks and more throughout a three-storey bar. Match every item to its proper place, combine half bottles, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

title: Evenin' Shift
description: Comedy horror set in Somerset. You're on the night shift again. Look lively, you get all sorts turning up round these parts. Let the right ones in, send the wronguns on their way and try not to make any enemies— there are strange folk about.

title: Rusty Prison: Horror
description: You probably shouldn't be here.

title: Rage Mountain Rally
description: Rocket League and Happy Wheels had a baby, and someone gave it a mountain to climb! Drive, crash, bounce and rage your way to the summit while trying to keep your oversized balls under control.

title: Sort Labs
description: Sort Labs is a casual, first-person organization simulator with a laboratory experiment theme, daily puzzles and leaderboards, dynamic levels, and all the shape-sorting you could ask for.

title: No Stars Football
description: A retro pixel-art soccer game with old-school arcade action on the pitch and a deep management sim underneath - play or simulate every match, build a squad, and take a club from the lower divisions to the title over a full multi-season career.

title: Textorio
description: Textorio is a factory automation game made entirely of text characters. You crash on the dead planet Kepler-442b with a wrist terminal and 50,000 colonists asleep in cryo below you, and the reactor keeping them alive is off. So you mine, smelt, automate, and dig down through four stacked worlds toward the core. The systems are real: electricity flows along grids that brown out, fluids have pressure, steam condenses back into water, and there is a pneumatic logic language you can build computers out of. It runs on almost anything. Free demo on Steam.

title: Lord Liberty Quest II: Pure White
description: Someone is secretly hastening the revival of the "Black Devil" that assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades. Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital entrusts the tower's investigation to a church priestess. But that priestess is a young, innocent maiden…

title: Danganronpa: Dungeons & Despair
description: Danganronpa Fangame which takes place in the Dungeons&Dragons Universe. This isn’t your average DND Campaign

title: Euphoria: Supreme Mechanics VR
description: A first-person virtual reality puzzle game. Immerse yourself in a high-tech sci-fi world where everything is built on logic and interaction with the environment. Solve puzzles, control lasers, and find your way through mysterious high-tech laboratories.

title: Make the Empire Great Again
description: A simulation + turn-based auto-battle game. The "Dusk Apocalypse" nears; the empire teeters! Your people need food, work, maybe some thrilling fun. But monsters seize Your lands, plunder Your fields & mines! Fight, reclaim lost! Build, forge grandest! Fear not the "Dusk", for a new "Sun" has risen!

title: Beat, Heart, Beat
description: Beat, Heart, Beat is an autoscrolling rhythm-platformer centered around slashing through enemies to the music to maintain your momentum and traverse your way towards your own heart. There are three directions to slash - up, down and right in front of you. Slash in the correct direction to aim your attacks at enemies and dash into them. Performing a series of slashes to the correct rhythmic pattern is the key to reaching the end of the stage and advancing onwards to your heart.

title: Dice Keeper
description: Play chill or try to beat the world record in this dice-based Puzzle Game, Dice Keeper the very first game of Zanarka Studios.

title: Buitopia DVD
description: A short interactive DVD game. Today is Jess's Birthday! Can you find her a suitable gift? Just don't get distracted and forget about Jess. DVDs can't be cursed... right? Yeah it's fine.

title: Pigeons Away
description: Pigeons Away is a logic puzzle game set on city rooftops. Each pigeon can only fly in the direction it faces: tap one with a clear path and it flies away, tap a blocked one and it bumps into its neighbour, which costs a feather. Find the right order to clear the roof across 120 levels in six districts, from a sunny park to the harbour at night. Every ten levels a new kind of bird or rooftop surprise arrives: sleepy pigeons, big pigeons, weathervanes, crumbs, gulls, tied pairs, gusts, twin lofts, the cat and night lamps. Optional challenges earn medals, and a new daily puzzle works fully offline.

title: Rotor City
description: Rotor City is a single-player helicopter game with a mission-based career. Starting with a bubble-canopy trainer and a timber hangar, the player builds up a helicopter operator with 14 fictional helicopters across five living cities: a seaside town, a river-mouth port, a mountain valley with a ski resort, a tropical island chain and a skyscraper metropolis. Jobs include firefighting with an underslung bucket, air ambulance flights, hoist rescues, police pursuits, air taxi and tour flights, offshore crew changes, heli-skiing and cargo sling loads. Every flight starts with a cold engine, fuel can only be refilled at headquarters, and earnings pay for new helicopters, hangars and heavier landing pads. It has day and night, weather, and keyboard or controller support.

title: ClaimLand
description:
ClaimLand is a location-based multiplayer game played on a real-world map. The Earth's land surface is divided into a grid of plots of roughly 25 × 30 meters, and players can only visit and buy the plots near their actual GPS position. Owned plots earn in-game gold every minute, and other players can buy them away at a price that rises with every sale.

Players level up from 1 to 40 to extend their reach, build on their land in five stages from a tent to a castle, and compete on worldwide and per-country leaderboards. All currency is earned by playing; there are no real-money purchases and no payouts.

title: Another Tavern Simulator
description: Open your own tavern in a fantasy valley. Mix unusual cocktails, cook hearty meals, furnish the hall and hire a helping hand. Restore the old inn and rent out rooms to travelers. Get to know your neighbors and join their little adventures. Just remember who that drink was for.

title: Light Work
description: In this first person experience, you are returning home after a long day of work. Turn off all of the lights on each floor of the office before you depart. Use the elevator to travel between floors, and be on the lookout for any unusual behavior from your coworkers.

title: Final Selection
description: Fast-paced action adventure with brutal close combat. Lose limbs, learn the dungeon, and survive a seven-day trial beneath a ruined castle.

title: Polda 5.5
description: Polda 5.5 is a comedic point-and-click adventure game featuring full Czech voice acting, stylized environments, and classic inventory-based puzzle solving. Players control three distinct characters across dozens of locations to uncover what happened during Pankrác's time as a pharaoh.

title: Webs of Reverie
description: Webs of Reverie is a first-person Survival horror game where you must explore the halls of Ironveil Psychiatric Hospital, solving puzzles, avoid detection from the staff, and managing your sanity levels. Will you decipher the clues and safely escape or fall victim to what hides in the shadows?

title: Obsessed
description: OBSESSED is not a classic horror game focused on jump scares, but a psychological thriller-drama where Halloween night takes a terrifying turn. The mysterious One Wish Walnut can grant any wish... as long as you're willing to live with the consequences.

title: Eyes Behind 2
description: Eyes Behind 2 is the sequel to Eyes Behind, a retro-graphics FPS survival horror game inspired by cult horror classics. The killer has been caught and is behind bars. The file is closed. So why are you still finding notes on your car?

title: Rootabasis
description: Play as Jimmy, a little seed who ended up in a peculiar cave. You'll need to help him find his way out, and escape the creatures (and people?) lurking around... But will you go through the correct path?

title: Dungeon Quest
description: Dungeon Quest is a fast-paced 2D platformer focused on exploration, precision, combat, and challenging dungeon environments. Players take full control of the character as they run, jump, dash, overcome deadly traps, defeat enemies, and interact with different mechanisms to progress through each stage. Across 40 handcrafted levels, new mechanics and increasingly challenging situations are gradually introduced, keeping the experience varied while rewarding players who master movement, combat, and the game's different environmental challenges.

title: Cozy Meowmory
description:
Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats, and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color, or hide somewhere you least expect!

Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help.

title: Tiny Techie in Puzzle Land
description:
Help the crafty pink-haired gearhead complete a series of intricate puzzles in a beautiful pixel art world! Push, pull and trade places with objects to reach the end of each level! Create bridges by pushing minecarts or boxes into lakes, and navigate objects within complex railroad systems!

Buttons, boxes, minecarts, magical crystals, rails - there are too many objects and possible interactions to count! But don't worry, levels don't have a time limit and you can even skip the ones you think are too hard. Can you help the tiny techie beat puzzle land?

title: Whisker Mess
description:
Get ready for a feline adventure filled with adorable pieces, clever combinations, and toys scattered everywhere in Whisker Mess! In this fun tile-fitting puzzle, you must place cat-shaped pieces across the board, create lines, and clear the way while earning points and making room for new moves.

By completing horizontal, vertical, and, on certain levels, even diagonal lines, you clear pieces, remove toys from the board, and turn every move into a new strategic opportunity. But be careful: blockers act as extensions of the walls and can completely change the way lines are formed!

With 30 levels divided into 3 biomes, Whisker Mess gradually introduces new challenges. As you progress, you'll encounter special toys with different behaviors, requiring you to carefully observe the board, adapt your plans, and discover how to make the most of each effect.

With no time pressure, Whisker Mess offers a relaxing and accessible experience, while still providing plenty of possibilities for those who enjoy thinking several moves ahead. With different board layouts, varied blockers, and combinations of special toys, each level brings a new challenge to test your creativity and spatial reasoning.

Fit the pieces, create lines, clear the mess, and help turn this feline chaos into pure fun!

title: Conquisterra Roguelie
description: A 2D roguelike about escaping a dungeon nightmare, and choosing between a comforting lie or a painful truth.

title: Cybernetic Strategy
description: Cybernetic Strategy is a flamboyant sci-fi auto-battler with an emphasis on being easier to play, powerful unit fantasies, and social competition!

title: My Cat Scattered Games: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
description: My Cat Scattered Games is a cozy single-player organizing simulator. Put 5,798 games and consoles back on the shelves, restore your video game store, and free your mischievous cat from the claw machine!

title: Rhythm Roll
description: Roll into a universe of rhythm and light! Feel the beat, master the high-speed motion, and test your reflexes.

title: Dreamer's Wake
description: A stylized third person collectathon set in collapsing dreamscapes. Play as a Haniwa, a Japanese clay figure, and explore surreal worlds to restore them from static.

title: Hazmat Simulator
description: A chaotic cleaning simulator and exploration game. Explore strange and mysterious environments, clean up massive messes, uncover hidden objects, complete each level. You never know what you’ll find along the way—so keep your eyes open and hope for the best.

title: Overdue
description: OVERDUE is a co-op multiplayer horror game for up to 6 players set in a massive shifting industrial warehouse where survival is based on productivity. Navigate through an anomalous industrial maze, manage your orders, and fulfill your mandate in time.

title: Touhou Garden of the Yukkuri
description: Raise your very own Yukkuri in this free-to-play Yukkuri raising simulator, featuring 3D environments and multiplayer. Take it easy!!!

title: Podstakannik Rails
description:
Podstakannik Rails is a first-person social co-op game set aboard an overnight sleeper train. One to four players board the same car, take their berths, and spend the trip together. There are no quests, scores, or progression systems: the host sets the trip to 10, 15, or 20 minutes, the train pulls into the station when time runs out, and nothing carries over to the next trip.

Players talk over proximity voice chat, so voices are clear inside a compartment and fade down the corridor. Around the car, they can fill a glass of tea at the samovar and carry it in a metal glass holder called a podstakannik, tune the radio by hand through the static, make up a berth and lie down for a nap, and work the reading lamps, ceiling lights, and compartment doors. Non-player characters include the sleeping car attendant, a police officer, and passengers who tell stories to anyone who sits down to listen, while the countryside passes outside the window by day or by night.

title: Mortality... Please
description: Penelope falls for someone with an impossible condition. Then an elderly former fiancée arrives with his letters. A short psychological horror visual novel about growing up and choosing what to do with an impossible situation.

title: Game Market Mayhem
description: Game Market Mayhem is a cozy organization simulator where you sort 5,120 scattered game boxes according to their genres and platforms. Transform a massive pile of boxes into the perfect game store. Fill the shelves, unwind, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything being in order!

title: Words of Power: Logos
description: A galaxy enslaved by ancient words. Type fast, spell true, and fight back — every word is a weapon. Duel bosses, battle across a neon-vector galaxy, and prove you're eloquent enough to save the universe. Multiplayer coming soon!

title: Japanese Ramen Simulator
description: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

title: Shelf-Employed
description: Restore order to a chaotic magical warehouse in this cozy first-person organizing simulator. Sort 4800+ packages into their proper places, unlock useful spells, and speed up your sorting. Turn towering piles of boxes into neatly filled shelves, one satisfying row at a time.

title: Horse Club Ride West
description: The Horse Club is visiting the Wild River Ranch! Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, and win the crown at the Western riding tournament!

title: Doamari
description: Doamari is a RPG game about strange places and strange things. Meet people, fight enemies, uncover secrets, and more. This is my diorama... I made it for you.

title: WildRoot
description: A cozy colony sim where survival is gentle—but life is alive. Build, farm, cook, craft and grow your settlement as colonists form relationships, help each other, and shape small, meaningful stories together.

title: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen
description: This is a bundle containing both Dragon's Dogma II and the Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion.

title: Magical Girl Yusya-chan and the Labyrinth of Lust
description: Everyone's favorite idol "Yusha-chan" stars in a new turn-based roguelike! Conquer deep dungeons, grow stronger, and seize victory, or taste a brutal defeat! Guide Yusha-chan, brought to life with fluid Live2D animations, to her destiny. Streamers welcome!

title: Sign: Broken Kether
description: Sign is a visual novel series that blends fantasy, urban life, and adventure. The story follows Lyra, a high school girl who encounters Cygnus, a witch from another world. Together, they embark on a journey to reclaim the witch’s lost powers.

title: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
description: Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow. There’s so much to do with Elmo and your Sesame Steet friends. Enjoy exploring their world, growing beanstalks, cooking tasty food, and helping your new friends throw a big party for the neighborhood.

title: The Hat Man
description: A first-person psychological horror game inspired by The Hat Man urban legend, focusing on sleep paralysis, fear, and the terror of being unable to move.

title: Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
description: Become part demon and fight in the demons' proxy war, conquering your rivals to help your species claim dominance!

title: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion
description:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Based on feedback we received after the initial release of Dragon's Dogma 2, we established three goals for ourselves when we set out to update and expand the game:
Enhanced gameplay. Expanded adventures. Enticing value.

title: Colorfall
description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op match-3 game where you and your friends each control only 1 color. Survive the falling grid by pulling and throwing orbs to trigger chains and finish tasks before time runs out. If your color piles up, it’s on you to clear the path.

title: Sealed Fortress
description:
Sealed Fortress is a dungeon-crawling RPG in which you take a party of 3 through the treacherous halls of a castle corrupted by wild magic.

Facing dangerous monsters, finding treasure and sharing soup together are all part of the adventure!

title: Botlings
description:
A factory automation game where workers become buildings and develop sentience.
Lead a swarm of mindless robots in a factory automation game where your workers are also your machines.
Direct your forward-walking robots through turners, splitters and bridges, transform them into production buildings, have them transport your resources, and design ever-growing production networks in all 3 dimensions. In Botlings, every robot is a resource: guide them to work, reroute their paths, or sacrifice them to construct the infrastructure your factory needs.
But be wary, the more your factory grows, the more unpredictable your workforce becomes.

title: Celestay Craft&Slowlife
description: CELESTAY is a calm idle building game where you fish for materials and grow your home toward the sky. In a world sunk beneath the sea, you stack pieces of a house and spend quiet days fishing and watching the stars. The higher you build, the more constellations and memories fill your world.

title: Escape: Immersion
description: Escape: Immersion is a horror adventure inspired by Inside and Little Nightmares. An atmospheric survival adventure with puzzles, platforming, and unpredictable challenges inside a collapsing underwater lab.

title: Tied to the Beat
description: A music-driven arena survivor where lyrics trigger effects across the battlefield. Pick one of 8 instruments, fight through 4 themed worlds with more than 50 included songs, or import your own music. Over 1,000 lyric-triggered effects, Steam Workshop support and an interface in 31 languages. Your music. Your weapon.

title: The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths
description: You can’t understand them—yet. Decode the “Second Reality” through talk, mind read, and translate in an empathy-driven psychological mystery adventure.

title: Lost & Found
description: LOST & FOUND is a free to play dynamic sorting game. Match forms to the right items and build your own warehouse, or compete with your friends in multiplayer mode after your shift is over.

title: Car Park Capital
description: The car industry needs you to design and build the greatest car parks that simple town life hasn't seen before. Introduce the need for car commuting and turn neighborhoods into car parks! Use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it. Fight people that see through your oily business.

title: Truckful
description: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

title: Permafrost
description: Embark on a brutal journey of survival in a perpetual winter. Hunt and gather resources for building and utilize deep survival mechanics to craft your way through a harsh, unforgiving landscape. Forge alliances or dominate the remnants of humanity in this chilling open world saga.

title: True Love For Her
description: True Love For Her (TLFH) is a Yandere game inspired by Yandere Simulator and Life Is Strange that doesn’t compete with the original games. This game involves murder and other methods of killing, so it is not suitable for kids. We are not responsible for any actions taken by kids replicating activities from TLFH in real life.

title: Paperhead
description:
PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced FPS game set in a world where everything is made out of cardboard and paper but is infested with horror!
Use a pencil as a weapon and explore what exactly went wrong in the secret research facility and why suddenly papercut people were able to...bleed.
Paperhead's Main Features

- Cardboard cute style with a horror twist. Cute but horrifying!

- Brutal and fast-paced combat. Slide to throw enemies in the air, kick explosive barrels into them (or enemies themselves!), and jump onto them Mario-style.

- Use a Pencil as a weapon. Draw a bomb to explode enemies!

- Use a Pencil as a reality-warping puzzle-solving tool. Not sure how to get through? Try to draw a door on the wall!

WHY WOULD PAPER...BLEED?

title: Console Archives: Ripple Island
description:
Ripple Island was released by Sunsoft in 1988 for an 8 -bit home console.
This is an adventure game in which the player takes on the role of the protagonist Kyle and goes on an adventure while operating 9 types of commands. Whether you can rescue Princess Nasareru, who was kidnapped by a monster calling himself Emperor Groaker, bring peace back to Ripple Island, and be united with the heroine depends on your judgment and actions.

title: The World of Dokkaebi
description: Set 300 years before the events of the popular web novel/webtoon Demon Exterminator's Cultivation, World of Dokkaebi is a 2.5D dot-art MMORPG set in a world governed by the balance of natural order and corruption. Players step into the shoes of a Taoist cultivator during an era when humans and Dokkaebi (Korean goblins) are still learning to trust one another, embarking on a journey to combat rising demonic forces and restore harmony to the realm.

title: Cricket Franchise Master
description: A T20 cricket Franchise builder allow you to put together your squad and challenge people across the world in daily and weekly events

title: Hood Warfare 2
description: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

title: Manggis: Night Market Survivor
description: Manggis is an arena survival roguelite set in a Southeast Asian night market in 1997. The player controls Manggis, an unsold mangosteen armed with a frying pan and a bottle blaster, who must survive thirty nights against waves of rats, ants, cockroaches, stray cats, macaques, seagulls and dogs. The blaster aims and fires automatically, the frying pan swings at nearby enemies, and the player moves, dashes and switches between ten kinds of fruit ammunition held in a revolving drum. A boss appears every third night, nine mini-bosses and a final boss on night thirty. Between nights, a broker sells items and ammunition paid for with banknotes collected during the fight.

title: SpeedBreaker
description: Most Wanted, the way you remember it. The definitive Need for Speed: Most Wanted recompilation. Built from the 2005 Xbox 360 version, the best-looking one, and made sharper, wider, and smoother for the modern era.

title: Log Away: Halloween DLC
description: Turn your Log Away cabin into a playful, spooky hideaway. Add pumpkins, cute spiderwebs and ghosts, then follow a calm Halloween soundtrack into a cozy night. Nothing grim, nothing urgent. Just a warm glow, soft shadows, and gentle magic.

title: VHS Tapes
description: VHS Tapes is a 1-4 player, online co-op horror. Experience a collection of mysterious video tapes, each one containing completely different stories, locations, puzzles and nightmares to endure. INSERT. PRESS PLAY.

title: MOBA Manager 2026
description: Pick and run a professional MOBA esports club with a goal of becoming the best team in the world through management of drafts, training, transfers and many other gameplay elements.

title: Monkey
description: Welcome to monkey, play different gamemodes, explore different maps and make sure to have fun!

title: Dragon Quest VIII: Recompiled
description: An experimental native port of Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King for PlayStation 2.

title: Astral Ascent: Expedition 33 - For Those Who Come After
description: A free crossover update bringing Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 into Astral Ascent, featuring three new bosses, three themed rooms, and special summons based on Expedition members. Encounter Golgra, the Mimes, and Pétank, then choose an ally at the Campfire, each with unique combat abilities. The content unlocks after completing the game on its base difficulty.

title: Drowse
description: DROWSE is a first-person psychological horror game set in the 1990s. A late-night favor brings you back to the office for a few photocopies. Explore, examine objects and solve puzzles as familiar places give way to memories you would rather leave behind.

title: Demon General Kirsten
description: Kirsten is a soldier troubled by her current way of life. During her adventure, she'll encounter a wide variety of people, and those warm exchanges will shape her in one direction or another...

title: More Slots More Money
description: A short incremental casino management game where you fill the floor with slot machines and table games, hire staff, expand to new rooms, and upgrade towards the ultimate automated casino.

title: Beyond the 10th
description: First-person anomaly horror game. Spot what's wrong, advance the levels, survive what's hunting your soul and go Beyond the 10th.

title: Thunder Hoop Collection
description: The adrenaline of 90s coin-ops is reborn! Thunder Hoop Collection unites the cult-classic 2D side-scrolling platformers in one definitive package, bringing the original 1992 masterpiece and its massive 1994 sequel, TH Strikes Back, straight to your screen.

title: The Residual
description: The Residual is a short, free atmospheric narrative platformer about loneliness, memory, love, and a collapsing world that may or may not be real.

title: The Clown's Forest: Shadows of Blood
description: Set during the events of The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows, join Officer Dragon as he is kidnapped by Chester, and taken to a very familiar location. He isn't the only victim stuck in the forest though. Meet familiar, and unfamiliar faces as you fight to survive, or succumb to your death.

title: Sort the Capybaras
description: Sort the Capybaras is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,800 unique capybara toys onto the correct shelves. Play with friends or go solo. Enjoy the satisfaction of using powerful skills turning a messy capybara store into a perfectly organized collection.

title: Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics
description: Step right up! We're searching for Funfair Experts to transform the new location Riquetti Gardens into a one-of-a-kind mix of museum-meets-amusement park, or as we like to call it, a museum-ments.

title: Soggy Froggy
description: This froggy wants to get soggy. Stir the pot to temper that temperature. Be sure to hit those sweet spots, for froggy's sake!

title: Gloom Gate
description: Gloom Gate is a reaction-based action RPG that combines old-school dungeon crawling with soulslike elements.

title: Earth Defense Force 5: Wing Diver Support Device - Reverse Core S-Type
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger Vehicle - Light Truck
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger Support Device - Detector S-Type
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger Piloted Weapon - Omega Freesia
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger Piloted Weapon - Blacker Number 4.1
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger & Air Raider Weapon - EDF: WB Decoy Set (ver Soldier)
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger & Air Raider Weapon - EDF: WB Decoy Set (ver Civilian)
Earth Defense Force 5: Fencer Weapon - Happy Body Pillow
Earth Defense Force 5: Fencer Weapon - Grim Reaper Shield
Earth Defense Force 5: Fencer Support Device - Wild Skeleton
Earth Defense Force 5: Air Raider Weapon - FZ-GUN
Earth Defense Force 5: Air Raider Vehicle - Caliban Armored Ambulance Joyful Marking
Earth Defense Force 5: Air Raider Piloted Weapon - Combat Frame Phantasia Shield Nyx
Earth Defense Force 5: Air Raider Piloted Weapon - Blacker Number 5
Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up
description: Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up is an alchemy organization game enjoyable solo or co-op. Clean up 1000+ ingredients, refine them in multiple ways and brew almost 200 unique recipes to place them into correct shelves to transform the laboratory into a place filled with harmony & peace.

title: Big Market Simulator
description: Build and manage a massive supermarket. Order products, stock shelves, serve customers, and expand your business into the ultimate shopping destination.

title: Boku to Tsuri Nikki
description: Boku to Tsuri Nikki is a freshwater fishing game set in a peaceful, nature-filled world, where players can enjoy an immersive fishing experience.

title: Once Upon A Katamari: Rolling Live Highlights
description: This paid DLC features ten stages originally featured in "Katamari Damacy Rolling Live", twelve new songs, six new cousins, and 18 new accessories.

title: PlantUp
description: Grow plants, process your harvest, and serve impatient customers before chaos takes over your shop. PlantUp blends cozy farming with fast-paced time management, clever upgrades, and a campaign full of challenges.

title: Garden Cleanup Simulator
description: Turn overgrown, messy gardens into clean and beautiful spaces. There is no rush. No stress. Just you, your tools, and the simple pleasure of turning chaos into order.

title: Kill Your Friends
description: Kill Your Friends is a chaotic 4-player combat party game where every round twists the rules and no two rounds play the same.

title: Rainbow Islands CS
description: Experience 6 different versions of the magical world of Rainbow Islands! That comical place full of dreams is back!

title: Keep Watering
description: Keep Watering is an incremental game with a cozy, hypnotic loop where every drop of water grows into something extraordinary.

title: Harold Rabbit 3: The House of Mysteries
description: Harold Rabbit and Maud Bumblebee have been invited to the mansion of Archibald Squirrel, for a great game of wits. Can Harold and Maud solve the riddles and puzzles Archibald Squirrel has prepared for them?

title: Kingdom Hearts Collection [I-III]
description: Play Kingdom Hearts I–III together in one unforgettable collection. A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: Kingdom Hearts -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind (DLC).

title: Duelist: Idle Expedition
description: Build your elite team in Duelist: Idle Expedition, the idle auto-battler that lives on your taskbar. Recruit from a pool of 90+ JRPG pixel-art roles and lead your traveling camp to victory against all the powerful Guilds on the Continent. Your epic journey continues even when you are busy!

title: All You Can Fish!
description: All You Can Fish is an active, relaxing incremental fishing adventure where every voyage matters, every upgrade counts, and every fish brings you one step closer to maritime legend.
