title: Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts
description: Death comes for us all - Overcome powerful curses, strange new enemies and deadly trials as two new Survivors but never forget for a moment She is watching.

title: Click & Mine
description: Click & Mine is a relaxing incremental mining game. Mine various resources and use them to buy upgrades, allowing you to descend deeper and deeper while unlocking new biomes, ores and skills.

title: Maid Cafe Simulator
description: Run a maid café with five charming kemonomimi maids! Make drinks, serve customers, and tackle troublemakers in this first-person management sim. Get to know the girls behind the aprons as you turn a rundown café into a thriving business and aim for three Maidchelin stars.

title: Anomalous Cleaning Detail
description: A first-person cleaning simulator where you scrub, vacuum, and restore a troubled town plagued by supernatural disturbances. Complete contracts and use environmental clues to prepare for the exorcism, because when the mess is paranormal, a standard clean won't be enough.

title: Chicks in Trouble
description: A peaceful farm is thrown into chaos when a mother hen's chicks mysteriously vanish! Team up with the brave father rooster and embark on a quirky, obstacle-filled adventure to bring them home. Grab your mouse or gamepad—it's time to save the flock!

title: Dino Time Raiders
description: Travel back in time to capture dinosaurs and turn them into profit! Lead a team of scientists through chaotic time-travel missions, catch prehistoric beasts, and build the ultimate dino park. Manage research, upgrades, and disasters - all in the name of science and the free market.

title: DungeonOS
description: Crawl Dungeons, Loot and Equip your Adventurers! Log in to an old-school operating system. Manage your adventurers and use puzzles to damage your enemies. Are you ready to find the five artifacts you always dreamed of?

title: Run Giraffe Run
description: Run Giraffe Run is a multiplayer fast-paced giraffe racing 2D platformer. Poop bombs. Spit banana peels. Slip on banana peels. Race against friends through chaotic and colorful levels. Have you tried farting?

title: Dragon Dinner
description: Cute but chaotic restaurant simulator where you play as a dragon waiter in a fast-paced dining rush. Set tables, serve hungry dragons, deliver the right dishes, and keep the place clean! After each day, customize the layout of the restaurant and learn new abilities to improve.

title: Order of the Sinking Star
description: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a narrative adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

title: Ship Shape Slam!!!
description:
Out-dodge, out-dash, and outlast your friends in chaotic 1–4 player bullet hell arenas. Side effects may include shouting, betrayal, and broken couches.

Enter arenas with up to 4 players where you can only move and dash. Bullets fly in from every direction with wild properties, forcing you to dodge, weave, and time your dash just right. Dashing isn’t just for escaping—it builds temporary invincibility and can even send friends flying. Land a charged dash to earn a full second of invulnerability against all bullets!

title: Drillbound
description: Drillbound is a short incremental game about mining your way to the planet’s core. Crush layers of rock, gather resources, upgrade your drill, and unlock powerful technologies as you descend into the depths.

title: Tower Tactics II
description: The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.

title: Cyan Heart
description: A horror exploration puzzle adventure where you relive events through a selfie viewpoint. Alone, with only voice communication from comrades as support, she simply keeps the camera rolling. Witness the record she wished to leave behind.

title: Dancing with Ghosts
description: A cozy wholesome narrative about a young teen girl who befriends a ghost that only she can see. Weighed down by the death of her parents, the girl finds healing through friendship, dance, and helping others. Created to share the message of joy and appreciation for the gift of life.

title: Invokyr
description: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

title: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
description: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

title: Neon Abyss 2
description: Plunge into the chaotic cybermyth roguelike world of Neon Abyss 2! With diverse combat styles and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic and action-packed experience you won't forget.

title: Wildaria
description: Wildaria is an Action-Adventure RPG Pet Collector set in an Infinite Fantasy World. Explore diverse open-world biomes as you collect and train unique pets to aid in your quest to conquer dungeons, slay gods, or defend the natural world from the kingdom.

title: Silver Pines
description: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

title: Echo Weaver
description: Time is your greatest resource and secrets are your only upgrades. Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

title: Forever Ago
description: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting people, and even make some new friends.

title: Afterbeat
description: A musical bullet-hell where all things beautiful are deadly. Dodge well little nanobot, you don't have much time.

title: Puzzle Arrows: The Original
description:
One click. One direction. The right order

Arrow Puzzle is a calm single-player puzzle game about clearing crowded boards one arrow at a time. Click any part of an arrow to launch it toward its head. If the route is clear, it leaves the board. If another arrow blocks the way, you lose a life, and it returns. To solve each level, study which arrows block one another, choose the right sequence, and think several moves ahead.

title: PokéSurvivor
description: PokéSurvivor is a Pokémon survival game inspired by Survivor.io and Vampire Survivors. It’s free to play in your browser: choose a companion, move around an endless map, and let your attacks fire automatically as hordes of wild Pokémon try to surround you. How long can you survive?

title: Arcade Archives 2: Fighting Golf
description:
"FIGHTING GOLF" is a golf game released by SNK in 1988.
Choose one of four characters with unique strengths in distance and accuracy, and take on 18 varied holes filled with three types of rough, two types of bunkers, oceans, rivers, and dense trees.
Advice is displayed before starting each hole, and the optimal club is automatically picked for you based on the distance to the pin to guide your strategy!

title: Oink Splash Party
description: Oink Splash Party is a chaotic multiplayer physics-based party brawler where adorable pigs battle it out across colorful inflatable waterparks! Punch your opponents, inflate yourself to bounce and launch across arenas, and compete in a variety of competitive and team-based game modes. Customize your pig, tackle interactive obstacles, and dive into the mayhem with friends in online multiplayer or private matches.

title: P.T. for PC
description: A native PC port of P.T., the 2014 PS4 teaser by Kojima Productions.

title: Do You Remember?
description: A realistic psychological experience where you undergo psychic tests while living a repetitive routine in a kind of psychiatric clinic.

title: Shelved
description: Sort 1,560+ cursed VHS tapes across 20 genres as a tiny orc! Master magical powers, upgrade your gear, and outsmart a chaotic poltergeist who scatters your work. Features Hidden secrets, 26 achievements, and a Spooky-Free Peaceful Mode. The ultimate cozy horror organizer!

title: Highway Blossoms: Gold Rush Edition
description: A yuri VN about two girls on a roadtrip through the southwest United States.

title: March of the Red Queen
description: March on a rival Queen. Choose who eats and who doesn’t, who sleeps and who burns the midnight oil, who keeps walking by your side and who is left behind. Then pay the consequences.

title: Gridlords
description: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

title: Blyte
description: A wacky and hilarious walking simulator that throws you into a surreal universe alongside EVA (who cares about her name, anyway?), filled with improbable misadventures and traps worthy of a master troll. A breath of mocking fresh air in an industry that's far too tame!

title: Superhero Simulator
description: Superhero Simulator is an open-world superhero game where you fight villains and save lives! But being a hero isn’t free! You’ll need to work, pay rent, and survive. Can you handle both sides of the superhero life?

title: Insomnia
description: Insomnia is a top-down shooter with psychological horror elements. Take part in fierce firefights, perform tasks covertly, act on intuition. Will you be able to survive all the enemies, stop moral outrage around you, and save others without losing your mind?

title: Horde Arena
description: Horde Arena is a third-person shooter roguelite where you survive endless enemy waves. Pick a character, upgrade your stats and weapons, and evolve to dominate the battlefield. Play solo or team up with up to four players in co-op mode.

title: RaidKids
description: Still, the boy keeps walking.

title: Idle Rocket Miner
description: Idle Rocket Miner is an idle game with a hands-on core. You pilot a rocket by hand, taking off from the Command Centre, landing at mines and hauling atoms home to sell, until the periodic table is complete. Every flight you make is recorded as a route, and autopilot then replays it while you’re away.

title: Mimic Party: Halloween
description: Listen, imitate, and laugh through every replay. Play solo, pass the mic with up to 6 local players, or join an online Halloween party.

title: Overwatch: Reign of Talon - Season 5: A Grim Doctrine
description: The wait is over! Our newest Support Hero is here with the arrival of Doctrine. Freed from his volcanic prison by Doomfist himself, this sinister foe can manipulate life using his Eternal Scepter and mechanical drones, while also empowering each ability with his signature Infuse.

title: Expand TD
description: Expand TD is a tower defense roguelite where you build and upgrade towers and traps while gradually uncovering an expanding map between waves. As you explore new locations and terrain, you'll discover resources, rewards, and unexpected threats that can shift your strategy. When your base falls, the run ends, but you earn Technology Points to unlock permanent upgrades for future attempts across four distinct biomes.

title: CyberSprawl: Survivors
description: CyberSprawl: Survivors is a single-player cyberpunk bullet heaven with loot extraction. Players combine automatic weapons, upgrades, and evolutions to fight hordes and hunt for equipment. They can extract early to secure their haul or stay for greater rewards and risk losing it. Secured gear shapes later runs, while chapter progression unlocks operators, permanent upgrades, Doctrines, and relic hunts.

title: Moge
description: Moge is a multiplayer VR Game with gamemodes including, Tag, Horror & Casual, The Tropical Beachy Main Map And The beach itself. Moge is meant for all users of all ages for max fun.

title: Plates of Peril
description: Plates of Peril is a chaotic cannibalistic restaurant-management game. Play solo or team up with up to 5 friends as you harvest limbs, prepare dishes, and screen guests for undercover cops to become the ultimate 5-star chef.

title: Snake King
description: Snake King is a single-player arena snake game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players collect food to grow, spend mass to boost and try to make rival snakes collide with their body. Opponents are computer-controlled and marked BOT. Six shrine powers, arena events, a tutorial, death replays, daily missions and achievements accompany unlockable skins and cosmetics. It supports mouse, keyboard, gamepad and touch controls, with local progress saving. The game is free to play in web browsers in English and Turkish. Artwork was created with generative AI and the code was developed with AI assistance.

title: Ring Release
description: Ring Release is a single-player ring-untangling puzzle game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players rotate linked rings until their gaps align and every piece can lift free. It includes 60 handmade puzzles across three collections, introducing fixed pins, closed loops and beads. The game has unlimited undo, solution-checked hints, an inspect view and local progress saving, with mouse, touch and keyboard controls. It is available free in web browsers in English and Turkish. Artwork was created with generative AI and the code was developed with AI assistance.

title: Stick Life: The Daily Grind
description: Start in a tent with twenty-five dollars and a whole city to work out. Climb a career to the corner office, gamble, fight, date, adopt a stray, buy the mansion on the hill, and try not to miss rent. An isometric life sim where every day lasts 24 real minutes.

title: ClearIt M4
description: Test your aim and puzzle-solving skills! Shoot colorful balls, match them by color, trigger chain reactions and overcome unique obstacles. Explore challenging levels, use powerful special elements and compete against the computer!

title: StarL 9 Ashes Of The Past
description: Enjoy a magical Match-3 journey through a mysterious island filled with secrets and adventure. Complete colorful levels, solve challenging puzzles, restore ancient magic, and uncover the truth behind an unforgettable legend.

title: Escape the Playground
description: One hears your voice. One only moves when you look away. One doesn't follow rules at all. The playground is open. Bring friends. 1-4 player co-op horror.

title: Forgery: Before the Law (Study)
description: Push the box and go beyond the gate. A warehouse keeper-style 3D puzzle adventure inspired by Kafka's novels and myths. A short game exploring an absurd inner world across 6 stages.

title: StreamQuiz
description: StreamQuiz is a free live quiz tool for Twitch streamers (Czech language interface). Build your own questions with up to four answers, show them on stream and let viewers answer in chat or on a web page. Faster correct answers earn more points, the leaderboard and end-of-quiz stats appear right on the overlay. Made for community nights, events and interactive streams.

title: Olympus 2249
description:
Olympus 2249 is a single-player, turn-based cRPG set in a post-nuclear dieselpunk America.

A journey through an atmospheric world packed with meaningful choices, branching dialogue, and brutal, bloody battles.

title: Weekend Solitaire: Grace in Motion
description: Over 200 exciting levels, three game modes, beautiful natural environments, a variety of bonuses, and unique obstacles. A relaxing solitaire adventure that both newcomers and seasoned card puzzle fans will enjoy.

title: Cliax Codec
description: It's time for a change in perspective! Explore an adventure full of tricky action and puzzles in this third-person and top-down shooter hybrid!

title: The Call Button
description: It's a psychologial observation-based horror thriller. Every day you wake up in a hospital bedroom. You notice anomalies? Take your pills. You think it's safe? Use the call button. But survive long enough, and you must face your interactive nightmares...

title: Lostbound
description: Find all the Artifacts before you’re caught in this Roguelite Action RPG. Embrace your destiny and escape a collapsing world. Darkness is alive. The Hand erases your path and drags you into the Abyss. Every step shapes your run.

title: Paunchy Pets
description: Paunchy Pets are your chubby little monsters that love to battle almost as much as they love to eat. Train them in flash-style mini-games, Feed them junk food in a cozy farming sim, Battle opponent’s pets in an autobattler based on skill, and Breed rare Paunchies to bolster your roster.

title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
description: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

title: Gears of War: E-Day
description: Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

title: Devil Peach Soda
description: Carve your way through a twisted and demonic manor in this fast paced roguelike. Devil Peach Soda combines quick arcade gameplay and RPG mechanics, featuring a variety of ways to build and customize your character each run.

title: King's Cup
description: King's Cup is a drinking game played online with friends. Players each pull a card from the circle and have to drink, give drinks, or a mini-game is started to determine who should drink. King's Cup comes with default rules or you can host games using your own custom rules!

title: Gambapets
description: Spin a slot machine to summon pets, nudge the reels and merge dupes to evolve them, then watch your army grow! Feeling lucky?

title: Starbloom Ranch
description: Build an alien homestead in a cosy creature-collecting farming RPG. Tame 300 companions to fight in turn-based battles and work your ranch. Grow crops, harpoon fish to feed your team, decorate your cottage, and brave the mines with sword combat. Play solo or with friends—100% free to play!

title: Retro Survival
description:
Retro Survival is a fan-made, single-player survival action game set in the DOFUS Retro universe, playable directly in your browser. Play as a Feca, Iop, Sram, Enutrof, or Osamodas and battle waves of monsters in iconic locations such as Astrub, Litneg Wood, and Wabbit Island.

Real-time combat combines movement, spells, and unique class abilities. As you progress through each run, earn experience, choose upgrades, and combine equipment and spells to shape your character. Take on bosses, collect rare items, and gather the Dofus as you strive to survive for as long as possible.

The game brings the graphics, animations, and sounds of DOFUS Retro into a roguelite survival experience with progressive character development.

title: Lugano Bay Tycoon
description: Build and manage your lakeside business in Lugano Bay Tycoon. Rent out pedal boats and boats, serve customers, reinvest your profits, and expand your operation in a relaxing management game set on the shores of an Alpine lake.

title: Werfast
description: A dark metroidvania where you pilot a powerful mech to explore a surreal underground world. Unlock new abilities, discover hidden areas, battle deadly enemies, uncover ancient secrets, and survive the horrors lurking below.

title: Turkish Hairlines
description: Turkish Hairlines is a single-player puzzle and simulation game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games, set in a fictional Istanbul hair-transplant clinic. Across four chapters and twelve patient cases, players plan hairlines within a limited donor supply, harvest and place grafts, manage freshness and see a twelve-month result based on their decisions. Some cases involve declining an unsuitable procedure. The game is a parody and is not affiliated with any airline, airport or clinic; it does not provide medical advice. It is free to play in web browsers with English and Turkish text, mouse, touch and keyboard controls, and local progress saving. Artwork was created with generative AI and the code was developed with AI assistance.

title: Hello, Luigi!
description: Luigi is ready to play! Touch Luigi's face to play together with your children in Hello, Luigi! Hello, Luigi! is part of the My Mario series – a collection of products designed for young children and their parents to enjoy together.

title: Veillombre
description: Multiplayer pixel-art horror for 1-16 players. A manor drowned in darkness, a candle as your only ally, a monster on the prowl — and maybe traitors among you. Scavenge, barricade, hide, vote… and survive the night.

title: Cosmo Solitaire 4: Edge of the Galaxy
Sinever: First Seal
description: Sinever: The First Seal is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror game. Explore an isolated Victorian estate, operate paranormal equipment, manage your sanity, and uncover the truth behind its imprisoned entity before the house claims you too.

title: The Listener
description: "The Listener is a first-person investigation game. Play as a Yugoslav radio amateur at the height of the Cold War. Use your equipment to pick up mysterious transmissions, analyze cryptic messages, and gather hidden clues to uncover a sinister conspiracy"

title: Midwest Goodbye
description: A narrative deck builder that mixes 2D and 3D art and makes you want to say goodbye just a little longer.

title: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands
description: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found futuristic loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find unknown artifacts and learn details about the faraway lands... at least supposedly!

title: Chill Cat
description: Chill Cat is a cute and chaotic 3v3 multiplayer top-down shooter where adorable cats battle for turf with colorful paint blasters!

title: The Drawn Hour
description: The Drawn Hour is a haunted-terminal card roguelike. Dial into a cursed dial-up BBS as one of three operators, build a deck, and claw through three corrupted sectors. Manage your rising Corruption, hunt relics, and face what waits at the drawn hour — alone, or in 2–4 player online co-op.

title: FAFO Executive Order Simulator
description: F around and find out! A ruthless no F's given dark comedy where you play the president of the United States of America, abuse executive power, crank up the FAFO meter, deal with robot overlords, alien invasions, drain swamps, flip off allies, crush protests, and destroy all that oppose you!

title: Shroomwood
description: Top-down bullet hell with challenging roguelike progression. Unlock and upgrade your town as you fight through procedural levels.

title: Mycopsychosys: Project Jupiter
description: Explore, investigate, and survive this new infection. Collect clues, meet and interact with people, and bond with the main cast. Solve the mysteries like a true detective and follow the non-linear narrative. Are you ready to face this new deadly infection?

title: Stickility
description: Explore vast and deep interiors of an underground research center Biotec, filled with creative foes, bosses, NPC's, and more. Find the burrowed truth and close this facility for good.

title: Uppercute
description: Uppercute is a 3D action platformer where, with the help of your sister and the use of your runner skills, you’ll dive into people's minds, face challenging opponents and retrieve valuable information to solve the mystery of your brother's disappearance.

title: Bony Bones Adventures
description: Bony Bones Adventures - is a 3D platformer where the lands of Zagrobiya have been enslaved by a necromancer. Help those in need, drive away the invaders, become a hero of Zagrobiya and return its freedom.

title: Pedal Rebel VR
description: Pedal Rebel VR is a adrenaline-pumping cyberpunk motorbike street racing game that completely transforms any exercise bike and any VR headset into an immersive racing experience!

title: SystemCrash92
description: Face the machines of the evil hacker in this action roguelite. Your avatar will assist you in battle as you improve your skills with items and level up to build a powerful strategy. An unforgettable adventure for survival fans!

title: Ascendant's Roguelike
description: A fantasy based roguelike. Ascend and slay endless hordes or monster while gaining the abilities of each creature you slay.

title: Gear Puzzle: the inheritance of grandpa
description: Carl is an ordinary teenager who works in a mechanical factory far from home for a living. To celebrate his sister's birthday, he returned home and met two unkind people. The story began.

title: Touhou: BlackEight
description: If there is an anomaly, do not put the lights out. Survive eight nights at Eientei in this first person Touhou Project horror fan game. 99 ruinous anomalies warp the sleeping girls in the dark, and the distance between Reimu, Marisa, Kaguya and Mokou shifts night by night. Exit 8 like, yuri horror.

title: GeoFußball
description: GeoFußball is a daily football geography quiz in German. Every day there are five football moments – famous goals, finals, stadiums and players' birthplaces. Read the hint, drop a pin on the map where it happened and score points by distance. Play the free daily round and timer round, challenge friends to duels via link and play for your club in the Fan League. Pro adds private groups (Stammtische), custom rounds and the archive. No ads, no betting.

title: The Truth Written by the Stars
description: When you start the game, the narrator will instruct you to “close your eyes.” At that moment, whether you actually close them or keep them open will change the course of the story. Listen carefully to the voice as you proceed, and find your way to the truth.

title: The Voice Party
description: The Voice Party is a voice-mimic party game in which players listen to short sounds, record imitations through a microphone and compare scores. It includes solo practice, local pass-and-play for two to four players, private online rooms, a scene-dubbing mode and local custom audio packs.

title: The Empty Suitcase
description: A psychological horror game following a detective investigating the murder of Roland T. Owen in Room 1046. The investigation begins normally, but as strange events unfold, the case takes a disturbing turn.

title: Dumpling Delight
description: Welcome to Dumpling Delight! Drop adorable dumplings, merge matching pairs, and watch them grow! Chase high scores, master satisfying physics, and enjoy a cozy, relaxing experience where every drop brings a little joy. How big can your dumplings get?

title: Bramble Sling
description: Bramble Sling is a single-player browser physics puzzle game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players launch woodland heroes from a slingshot to dismantle clockwork beetle towers made from glass, timber and stone. Four heroes provide dash, split, slam and burst abilities. The game includes 24 levels in four worlds, golden acorns, three-star objectives and local progress saving. Keyboard, pointer and touch controls are supported. Artwork and code are AI-assisted.

title: Jono
description: Work together to complete one million levels, one player at a time. Continue where the previous left off. Chat with others while you wait for your turn. How long will it take?

title: Jolly: Anniversary Edition
description: "Jolly: Anniversary Edition" is a fan-remake made from the ground up of the original "Jolly 1" by IvanG. This is designed to give the original game a fresh new coat of paint with better polished gameplay and a new story that helps it connect to the wider Jolly story.

title: PostApo
description: It’s a post-apocalyptic game set in the year 2067. The game will feature full voice acting and all in-game texts and descriptions will be localized. It will be released in 9 languages. Unreal Engine 5.4.4 Unreal Engine 5.2.1

title: Banana Clicker
description: Click. Upgrade. Conquer. Build a banana empire, unlock powerful upgrades, and uncover a wild banana-fueled conspiracy. Meet silly NPCs, test your luck in gacha, and unleash Banana Storms! With skills, achievements, and endless growth, the bananas never stop!

title: Piworld
description: First pixel 2D game, which include MMO and PVP system for anyone, who wants to try something new.

title: Private Mining Company
description: Private Mining Company is a tower defense game with perma-death and extraction elements. Keep your soldiers while you complete contracts, as long as they aren't killed. Make money defending mining outposts on hostile alien planets. Balance mining upgrades and growing your army.

title: Rabbit Simulator
description: An Action-Adventure game. Gameplay consists of mainly bullet-hell and shooting, but also features puzzles and mini-games.

title: Intercept Line
description: Intercept Line is a strategy and simulation game in which you command Ukraine's air defense on a real map of Ukraine. Every night swarms of Shahed drones, cruise missiles, ballistic and hypersonic missiles strike your cities and infrastructure, and there are never enough interceptors: deploy SAM batteries, anti-aircraft guns, mobile fire teams, radars and fighter jets, and decide what to protect. By day it is your turn: plan long-range drone and missile strikes on enemy refineries, airbases and depots, routing around enemy radars and air defenses or suppressing them to open a corridor for the next wave. When orders are not enough, take the controls of a fighter jet yourself. Online co-op for up to 4 players.

title: The Incredimental Horse
description:
Help your horse win the race at the fair! Buy various updates with tickets that you won in previous races to increase your chances.

Credits

Programming: Pianfensi
Art: nova_linah
Plushies: AnnoyingEdu, POLYmechanical, tanybunny
Sounds: TamelessNee, POLYmechanical
Music: Julius H., Kevin MacLeod

title: Exit Please
description: Exit Please is a single-player browser platform adventure developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players guide a night-shift courier through glasshouse terraces, rooftops, canals and clocktower bridges. Twelve scrolling missions combine guarded relays, moving lifts, low tunnels, collapsing platforms, checkpoints and four guardians. Actions include jumping, stomping, dashing and deflecting projectiles. The game also includes 60 practice and mastery rooms, daily challenges, route ghosts and a local room workshop. Keyboard, touch and gamepad controls are supported. Artwork and code are AI-assisted.

title: Screw Workshop
description: Screw Workshop is a single-player browser puzzle game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players remove screws from layered enamel plates to complete color orders while managing a limited spare tray. Plates pivot around their final screw, and later boards introduce keyed locks and linked pairs. The game includes 36 restoration puzzles across six collections, a daily commission, undo, hints and local progress saving. Artwork and code are AI-assisted.

title: Warspace
description: Warspace is a free first-person tactical shooter that runs in the browser, with nothing to install. Two teams fight over bomb sites in 5v5 and 2v2 matches: one life a round, the Ts plant the C4, the CTs defend or defuse it. Every map is built on the same 55-metre planet, so the horizon is close and fights come over the curve; a lap takes about a minute. The guns follow Counter-Strike 1.6's numbers and the knife and grenades follow CS:GO's. Play against bots in practice, open casual rooms with friends, climb 18 ranked tiers with a Discord account, and build and publish your own maps in the in-game editor, CREATORS. Warspace is independent and not affiliated with Valve.

title: World of Mixed Martial Arts 6
description: World of Mixed Martial Arts 6 is the latest MMA release by developer Adam Ryland and makes a massive step forward in the series. In WMMA6, you run your own MMA organization in a lively, vivid, competitive game world that evolves over time. Play with companies, fighters, and teams from all around the globe. WMMA6 adds over 100 new features to the series. Deal with contracts, morale, promotional work, hype and more…this is the deepest MMA sim available.

title: Timefract
description: Move through time. Back and forward. Create clones across timelines and cooperate with yourself to solve impossible puzzles.

title: The Epic (Sort of Not Really) of Koneko: A Game Made in 4 Hours
Save The President
description:
The bodyguard has only a few seconds to save the most important man in the world. Does he have what it takes?

Suit up, put on your sunglasses, and get ready for the most stressful job on the planet! In Save The President, you are a bodyguard tasked with protecting the President from imminent threats during public speeches and official events.

title: Dream Hike
description: A peaceful adventure through a beautiful world.

title: In These Hallowed Halls
description: In These Hallowed Halls is a first person, psychological horror puzzle game. Make your way through a decrepit, abandoned mental Institution as you solve puzzles and unravel the story behind what lurks in the darkest corners of the building.

title: Unknown Horizon
description: Retro styled, top-down, space exploration adventure where you will meet new alien races, learn their secrets and build their trust to get their help to find a way home.

title: Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined
description: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you…

title: Spring Me Up
description: A challenging physics-based 2.5D platformer. Use your spring to bounce and land with precision, navigating tricky platforms and obstacles. Every miscalculation can send you back, testing your skill, patience, and self-control.

title: Keine's Terakoya: A Schoolhouse in Gensokyo
description: Play as Keine Kamishirasawa, the half-beast teacher of Gensokyo! Teach humans and yokai, grow their minds, hearts, and bodies, and guide them to graduation. Balance tradition and change, expand your influence, and build your ideal school. Write your legend on the education frontlines!

title: General Idler
description: General Idler is an idle conquest game set on a parallel Earth — 195 nations, real borders, and one objective: total world domination. You start with a single home country and nothing but ambition. Build industries to generate cash. Fund military units to generate Army Power. Accumulate enough AP, declare war on a neighbor, and add their flag to your wall. Then do it again. And again. Across every continent on the globe.

title: Dreamspring
description: Dreamspring is a dark fantasy styled, open world souls-like game. Explore a dying kingdom and it's different realms in first person action combat, styled in a mix of retro and vaporwave aesthetics.

title: Demon Lord: Clicker
description: A Steam-Drop Clicker with real game mechanics in a high fantasy setting. Click for drops, then choose to combine them for stronger/rarer variants, equip them for power! Amass wealth and glory! Be the hero, assault the Demon Lord! (No fruit is harmed during gameplay)

title: Snow War
description: Snow War is an FPS (First Person Snowball) Game! No blood is shed, but that does not mean the stakes are not real.

title: Marked
description: In a world ravaged by climate collapse, flee a ruthless mafia alongside fellow survivors in this cooperative turn-based strategy game: manage hunger, thirst and resources while journeying together toward safety.

title: Major Mutt
description: Play as a combat ready pup in this 3D survivorlike. Blast through swarms of giant critters with auto firing weapons attached to your harness, but don't just survive, Do Your Job! Herd lost sheep to safety to earn permanent stat boosts and become the ultimate Good Boy

title: Save Amani
description: The city in the game has been destroyed beyond recognition by war; its former prosperity now lies in ruins. The rubble everywhere, the smoke filling the air, and the gloomy sky all convey the cruelty and ruthlessness of war, delivering an immersive experience to players.

title: Gartic Rush
description: Draw and guess in 7 seconds! Gartic Rush is a fast-paced drawing and guessing game played in pairs. You draw words for your partner to guess, and you guess the words they drew for you. The catch? You only get seven seconds for each drawing and each guess.

title: Keepshore
description: A calm 3D island town-builder spanning nine ages, from stone huts to electric streets. Raise workshops, wire production chains, work a living market, and grow a town that keeps producing while you're away. Settle a new island to advance the age — every shore you leave sends tribute home forever.

title: Dude, Trust Me
description: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

title: Intravenous 3: Borderline
description: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the shoes of Gideon, a feared mercenary with nothing left to lose, and carve a bloody path of revenge through deep systemic stealth and brutal tactical gunplay.

title: Rooftops Jam
description:
Quake Rooftops map jam, ran from August 4th to September 15th.
The theme is "Rooftops", and mappers were free to interpret it however they wanted.

title: Factorized
description: A 2D side-scroller about killing robots with janky guns as a morally questionable main character.

title: Scary Cave
description: Scary Cave is a survival-horror game released by Alex After All Glazer Infinity. The game can be downloaded for free on Itch.io or Game Jolt.

title: Kawaii Push
description:
Kawaii Push is a casual and relaxing Sokoban-style game in which players must push boxes to the correct locations.
The protagonist is a red-haired girl who explores cute and colorful anime-style environments.
With moderately challenging puzzles, the game offers a fun and accessible experience for players of all ages.

title: Five Hearts Under One Roof 2: Winter Trip DLC
description: After leaving the boarding house, relationships with familiar characters begin to move in new directions. From new episodes with Suzy, Gyu-ri, and Yu-jeong to unexpected moments where you become entangled once again with the original boarding house members. Experience the closer distance that unfolds during the winter trip and a special romance that changes depending on your choices.

title: Stone Run
description:
The ultimate test of reflexes and nerves!
A giant, unstoppable rolling stone is breathing down your neck, and there’s only one golden rule to survive: never look back!
Dive headfirst into Stone Run, a fast-paced, hand-drawn retro arcade experience designed for non-stop adrenaline and pure fun. Outrun disaster, dodge unpredictable obstacles, and push your reaction speed to the absolute limit in a beautifully crafted world that feels like an interactive cartoon.

title: Amanda's Magic Book 16: The Dragon Chronicle
Urbanism
description: Explore abandoned environments, complete objectives, and survive an entity you cannot see with your own eyes. Your only advantage is a video camera that reveals what is hunting you.

title: Connected Hearts: Vanished Beauty - Collector's Edition
Wizard Harder or Get Laid Off
description: An evil baron poisoned the king's mind in the kingdom you hail from, convincing him that enchanted objects in the hands of simple goblins meant he could reduce headcount - that means you. Explore this new town, complete quests, fight goblins, and increase your power to gain the favor of the king.

title: Sediment
description: A pixel-physics sandbox. Fifty materials, and every one of them is physics: sand finds its angle, water freezes, lava crusts into stone, gunpowder blows. Build your own materials and worlds, and share them in the Workshop.

title: Tidy Up the Flower Shop
description: The grand opening is tomorrow, and someone has helpfully unpacked the entire delivery onto the floor. Pick the flowers up an armful at a time, sort them by species into baskets, paint them in patterns, and have the place ready by morning. No timers, nobody watching. A cozy first-person tidy-up.

title: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!
description: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop! is a single-player organizing game set in a chaotic video game store. Sort 4,290 cases by genre and order, fill 96 racks, progress and unlock powerful abilities, and complete 650 parody-filled series - with questionable help from Jeff, the coolest cat ever.

title: Aery: Calm Horizon 2
description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

title: Nova Slash
description: Play as Veil, a hooded rebel infused with the cataclysmic energy of a collapsed artificial star. Tear through the corrupt mega-nation of Giaath in Nova Slash, an intense action platformer featuring roguelike progression and lethal melee combat.

title: Dub Party
description: Dub Party is a party game where players replace every voice in a video with their own. Import a clip or pick a community scene, claim the roles, record each line, then watch the finished dub together. Play solo, pass one mic around the couch, or invite up to seven friends online.

title: Penis Bird
description: Slide into the role of arcade gaming's first feathered phallus! Dodge attacking wildlife, poke through tight spaces, and chase high scores across frantic danger filled runs. Collect all the power-up costumes! Features full controller support and a stream-safe Eggplant Mode.

title: Dark Are the Crypts: The Lost Idea
description: Dark Are the Crypts: The Lost Idea is a psychological exploration horror set in surreal, weirdcore-inspired liminal spaces. Use your camera to solve environmental puzzles, fight enemies, and uncover the secrets hidden within the fractured mind of a tormented artist.

title: Murmuring of Moth Mouth
description: An eleven-year-old video shows Yuna's car on the road today. Its instructions promise to get her to the interview that could change her life... A short psychological horror visual novel about desperation and dependence.

title: Night Shift: Something Is Wrong
description: Your night shift was supposed to be simple. Watch the cameras, patrol the building, and report anything that changes. But the longer you stay, the less certain you become of what is real. Follow procedure. Pay attention. Something is wrong. Endless Mode and Speed Run Mode included.

title: Space Snatcher
description: 6-player co-op horror chaos where you're trapped aboard increasingly dangerous space stations. Scan every monster the Company demands, scavenge for powerful items to help you survive, and keep the ship's systems repaired. But the biggest threat might just be your friends.

title: Screaming Halls: Horror
description: The halls never end...

title: Monster Museum: Tidy Up the Collection!
description: Step into the relaxing world of Monster Museum! Team up with your favorite creature companion and begin your journey to restore the museum by sorting 2614 monster figurines.  Unlock new abilities, collect badges and uncover hidden secrets along the way. Cozy, single player, no timers.

title: Let's Tidy Up!: Treasure
description: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room after a particularly lucrative year. Complete full shelves to unlock skills and abilities. Sort, stack and shelve 8,888 unique items as you slowly unravel the secrets beneath...

title: Rally & Hypercar Bundle
description: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!

title: Monster Nursery
description: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.

title: Crack the Pack
description: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 600 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !

title: Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles
description: Play as Agent Eva to follow the trail, or as Analyst Miles to manage the operation. Dual Protocol is an asymmetric noir puzzle game where two players progress only through conversation. Without seeing each other’s screens, combine the data you have and uncover the truth behind the Castellari murder.

title: Bering Tonnage
description: Build and automate a cargo fleet across over 250 real-world ports in this maritime tycoon. Route ships through strategic canals, navigate tropical cyclones and geopolitical sanctions, and grow a small shipping company into a global logistics empire.

title: Infinite Museum
description: A psychological game where you spot anomalies in a looping museum and choose the correct exit to reach G Floor.

title: Unpossess 2
description: A 1-4 co-op exorcism simulator game set in the late 1900s. Play as exorcists responsible for addressing cases of demonic possession.

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Customizable Cosmetic Set
description:
This set contains the following items usable in ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE:

Aircraft Skins
- F-4E Mobius Squadron 25th Anniversary Skin
A Mobius Squadron 25th anniversary skin for the F-4E Phantom II
- F/A-18C Team Zvezda Skin
A Team Zvezda skin for the F/A-18C Hornet

- Online Lobby Avatar Outfit: Tasha
An outfit inspired by Tasha, the pilot of Joker Flight's third aircraft in Campaign Mode.
*Exclusive item for the online mode ACE COMBAT ONLINE.

- Aircraft Upgrade Part Missile Smoke [Scarlet]
An upgrade part that changes missile smoke color to Scarlet when equipped to an aircraft.
*Exclusive item for the online mode ACE COMBAT ONLINE.

*The Deluxe Edition also includes the Customizable Cosmetic Set. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Playable Aircraft: F-14A
description:
Grants Playable Aircraft: F-14A for ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE.

The initial model of the carrier-based fighter series that would later be upgraded to the Super Tomcat.
Its role of using long-range missiles to outrange and eliminate threats to the fleet has remained consistent from its creation. Its nickname is Tomcat.

title: Horror Scenarios: The Redwood Estate
description: Investigate the Redwood Estate as officers Tim Rieff and Kim Hansbury in this classic top-down survival horror game. Face terrifying creatures, manage scarce resources, and uncover the dark secrets behind the mysterious events that took place within the estate.

title: Birb
description: Start as a humble birb, eat popcorn, and evolve into a cosmic force of nature! Birb blends addictive idle mechanics with active roguelite expeditions. Build your nest, catch rare fish, challenge bosses, and compete on the global leaderboard. How many pecks will it take to rule the world?

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
description: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

title: Bloodspill
description: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, pvp retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest!

title: Spencer's Spaghetti Quest
description: Play as Spencer, a chaotic demon as you experience vastly different games, styles, and genres in an arcade-like world

title: Cyber Cleaner Simulator
description: Vacuum space junk, polish derelict ships, and clear alien worlds of debris as you upgrade your high-tech cleaning gear.

title: Vexcell
description: Vexcell is an elegant, minimalist puzzle game. Embrace the satisfaction of everything falling into place.

title: Obstacle Overdrive
description: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.

title: Origin Hunt
description: A kidnapped monster in a foreign country caught in a secret war between seven of the most powerful mages alive.

title: Sump
description: A short baroque atmospheric horror game. Manipulate a labyrinth of levers and unnatural shadows. Find courage in a place that only goes down.

title: Bball Destiny
description: Bball Destiny is a text-based basketball career simulator for web browsers, iPhone and Android. The player creates a 16-year-old prospect, picks a nationality, a position and a build, then guides the career one decision at a time. The road runs from high school in the United States or a European youth league, through college or the pro ranks overseas, to the NBA draft, contracts, trades, injuries, playoff runs and retirement. Each season unfolds as written scenes whose choices move the player's ratings, health, money and reputation. A finished career is ranked on a legacy ladder and can enter a public Hall of Fame. A full career lasts 10 to 20 minutes. The game uses no real players, is free to play, needs no account, and is available in English and French.

title: MXGP 26: The Official Game - Scrubdesignz Liveries
description: This DLC gives you access to 6 SCRUB Designz liveries for your bike.

title: OCDust: One Room. Every Last Speck. One Way Out.
description: You woke up in a room full of dust. The only way out is to clean it all. All one million specks.

title: Blindsight
description: Your voice lets you see. It also lets them find you. BLINDSIGHT is a co-op horror game for 1 to 4 players about hauling loot through the dark and knowing when to shut up. Bring friends. Preferably ones who can handle five seconds of silence.

title: Arlasoft Soccer
description: A Sensible Soccer inspired game for the C64 and C128 in C64 mode - for an extra speed boost!

title: In Your Dreams
description: A short survival horror experience where you must elude a bloodthirsty shape-shifting beast. Created in one month for spooky season!

title: My Desktop Cat
description: Bring a cozy animated cat to your Windows desktop. Care for your companion, play with toys, decorate every screen, unlock new cats and achievements, and play mini games while normal apps stay unobstructed.

title: SpyCat: Codename Wu
description: SpyCat: Codename Wu is a 2D action-adventure platformer starring a feline secret agent. Run, climb, sneak, and fight past traps and pursuers. Every conversation walks the line between trust and betrayal. Uncover the truth, expose the conspiracy, find your place between humans and animals.

title: Antes del Sur
description: Juego MMORPG ambientado 200 años antes del aclamado Tierras del Sur. Está desarrollado sobre la base del mítico Argentum Online. Actualmente disponible para la plataforma Windows.

title: Crabrun
description: Face an unforgiving arcade ecosystem made up of simple rules and filled with subtle interactions. Learn to walk sideways, dash through danger, and combo your way to an absurdly high score. The gods of the sea reward persistence and style in CRABRUN.

title: Comet's wayfaring odyssey
description: Born from a graduating students' capstone project featured on the 2025 BAFTA Student Awards Longlist and the Unreal Engine Student Showcase 2025, discover an adorable and zany physics-based puzzle adventure following a dog training to become a stellar superstar.

title: Starlathe
description: Command your ship and fleet in a galaxy that truly lives: 150 sectors where six factions mine, haul, trade, build and wage war whether you're there or not. Trade it, rob it, defend it - or forge your own fleet and carve out your place in it. Play solo or in online co-op.

title: Le Shampoo War II
description: Fight through floors, build a deck from 146 cards, and take on 6 bosses in Le Shampoo War II, a roguelike deck builder. Beat the final portals gauntlet and the terror at the end to discover what controls the universe.

title: Algorithomus
description: Algorithomus is an interactive puzzle and "found phone" simulator set in the Mundo Torajo universe. Players explore a mysterious smartphone, play embedded minigames, and solve codes to uncover the secrets of the Tyrant Algorithomus.

title: Sumoo
description: Sumoo is a minimalist grid puzzle where numbers slide, meet, and add up. Every stage demands one exact number. Use pits, portals, and multipliers to land on it.

title: Console Archives: Chack’n Pop
description:
Chack’n Pop was released by Taito in 1985 for an 8 -bit home console.
Control "Chack'n" skillfully to take back the Heart inside the maze taken by "Beluga".
The Technique of character "コ" to run along walls and ceilings to evade enemies, the Technique of Hanabi to detonate bombs simultaneously... By using various advanced techniques, "Chack'n" can defeat "Beluga".
With just a single technique, "Chack'n" can do an amazing job!

title: Wiz-herd
description: Wiz-Herd is a local and online party game where 2-4 players compete in fast-paced minigames. Herd sheep, cast spells, and sabotage your friends to claim victory!

title: QuestAway
description: QuestAway is a free-to-play idle RPG that runs in a small window next to the Windows taskbar. The player builds a party of heroes that fights on its own while they do other things. Every so often they check in, equip the loot that dropped, spend skill points and send the party somewhere harder.

title: Helping Your Boyfriend
description: A cute-turned-creepy horror visual novel

title: AeroBloom
description: AeroBloom is a single-player first-person action game set in a coastal city. Players throw bouncing discs to destroy the environment block by block, earn credits, buy upgrades, and unlock powers. The city includes parkour challenges, areas to explore, a tornado flight ability, and nighttime fireworks. Casino Brisa offers blackjack, roulette, and other minigames using currency earned in the game, with no real-money gambling.

title: Beta Bar
description: Beta Bar sends you and your friends partying on 4 floors of bars and an active dance floor. Talk to the ladies to build your confidence and be ready to swing back when one of your friends throws a punch. If things get serious, grab a drink and make sure you're the last man standing.

title: Zero Parades: Director's Cut
description: From the creators of Disco Elysium comes Zero Parades - the acclaimed espionage RPG, now expanded with the Director’s Cut. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on one final desperate assignment. Prove yourself on the world stage - or blow it all up again.

title: 007 First Light: Extended Operations
description: Adds new activity “Valhalla Protocol,” new operation “Jungle Heist,” new weapons and outfits, New Game Plus, Photo Mode, and more

title: Backrooms Adventure
description: You were walking home, and then the ground wasn't there. Now it's damp carpet, a hum that never stops, and yellow rooms that go on longer than any building could. Someone came through here before you. Follow what they left behind, solve the puzzle, and find a way out.

title: Ballshit 2D
description: Eggy, an otaku, wakes up one day to find himself transformed into a cute girl?! Ballshit 2D reimagines the original live-action story as a 2D visual novel. Follow Eggy through campus life, friendships, awkward romance, and absurd surprises, with new 2D art, CGs, and the original voice acting.

title: Scraplings
description: A 2D side-view recycling and automation game set above an infinite trash sea. Salvage waste left behind from the Lost Century, process it through advanced production lines, and grow your factory to keep it afloat in this harsh ecosystem while paying your rent on time.

title: Society Chess 3D
description: Society Chess 3D is a multiplayer chess game for up to 32 players. Each player preselects their move, and the most popular move is the one played on their side. The key to victory is to convince your teammates using the chat function to secure the win. An offline mode is also available.

title: Disconnected
description:
What if your largest audience became witnesses to your own death? In Disconnected, you play as Robex, a successful streamer who gets trapped in a supposedly deserted property during a live Urbex exploration.

The connection drops, the doors lock, and your only window to the outside world is your smartphone screen. To get out, you’ll need to do more than just solve puzzles; you’ll have to manage a chaotic chat and survive a presence that doesn’t take kindly to trespassers.

title: Better Chaos
description: A massive supermarket, over 32,141 products scattered everywhere, and one mission: put it all back in order. Explore every aisle, find where each item belongs, and use powerful abilities to turn this total chaos into a perfectly organized store.

title: My Sexy Boss: Office Romance Girls
My Sexy Boss: Office Romance Boys
description:
Every promotion has a price.
He's about to show you his.

title: Emberlost
description: The world went cold a long time ago. One ember remembers the light. A wordless, atmospheric journey through ten chapters - carry the last fire through fog, ruin and silence, and rekindle the Hearths of a world that forgot how to burn.

title: Flowers and Deities: Thief Prince Expansion Pack
description: A destitute prince fighting for vengeance has joined the Arena! This DLC unlocks two exclusive Backgrounds, and adds 16 mechanically unique Cavefolk units: thieves, Explosive Detonation infantry, assassins, powered armor, Drills, Psionic Power... and even two mighty Demigods!

title: Cradle of Ash
description: Survival horror in a quarantined company town. You wake alone at the edge of Ashbrook, where the dead get back up from anything you do to them - unless what is left of them burns. Play solo or in co-op for up to four players.

title: Exit_ComputerLab
description: Stuck in an infinite loop inside a computer lab. To escape, you need to find the necessary anomalies to break the loop, making it possible to get out of this place. Good luck ;)

title: Chiasmus
description: Viktor finds himself in a mysterious apartment with no way out. He discovers an amazing ability to move between two parallel worlds. This discovery helps him piece together the scattered fragments of what is happening and find the key to solving the mystery.

title: Eden Camp
description: Arrive at Eden Camp as John, the newest counselor at a remote summer retreat. Three women welcome you warmly perhaps too warmly. As bonds deepen and nights grow darker, you'll learn that devotion has a price. Every choice matters. Not everyone makes it home.

title: Seek
description: A survival horror game where you play as Alice, trapped in a shifting, nightmarish orphanage. Explore eerie environments, manage limited resources, shoot at lurking enemies, and solve puzzles to uncover dark secrets. Classical music underscores the psychological tension as you navigate the mystery of your imprisonment and confront the cruel truth behind it.

title: Crown Of Blight
description: Crown of Blight is a dynamic top-down 3D metroidvania. As an elite Hunter of the Church, descend into cursed dungeons to find the source of the Blight. Annihilate hordes of enemies, unlock new paths, and uncover the grim truth hidden in the depths.

title: Pusheen's Place
description: Pusheen’s Place is a cozy casual game centered around collecting, caring for, and spending time with different versions of Pusheen. Players can create their own little Pusheen paradise by decorating rooms with hundreds of items and mixing furniture and decorations from different themes. More than 100 Pusheens can be collected, ranging from Common to Legendary, including special variants such as Pusheenicorn, Laptop Pusheen, and Pancake Pusheen. Players can feed, pet, and play with their Pusheens while completing a variety of bite-sized minigames and puzzles. With its relaxed pace, colorful rooms, and emphasis on collecting and customization, Pusheen’s Place offers a simple and cozy place for fans of Pusheen to unwind and make their own home for the beloved cats.

title: Biodome Bastion
description: Crash-land on a hostile alien world in this classic tower defense game and defend your outpost against relentless waves of evolving insectoid creatures. Build powerful defenses, unlock new technologies, and uncover the mystery behind a species capable of adapting to any environment.

title: Oath of Stigmata
description: In a world shattered by the Starfall Calamity, sanctuaries, city-states, and surviving factions fight for their last hope. Lead characters with unique beliefs and abilities on a perilous journey. Build your deck, deploy your units, and make tactical decisions that can turn the tide of battle.

title: Sculpturillo
description: You get a secret word and you have to sculpt it in 3D clay while your friends spam the chat guessing absolute nonsense. Are you an artist or a disaster with hands? An online party game for 2 to 10 players, with characters you create yourself and matches in 6 languages.

title: Puckoff: Reloaded
description: Puckoff: Reloaded is the latest, and greatest, version of the (in)famous game, Puckoff, previously available only for personal computers. Enter the world of no-rules hockey as a total newbie and work on your skills and attitude to meet with the mythical terrorizer, Dominator. Build your team of has-beens and legends while learning different playstyles to defeat a plethora of colorful characters around the globe. Team up with the ever cheerful Sarah, the best beer-league goalie Eddie, and the ever grumpy seen-it-all Coach. So grab your skates and Puck off!

title: Corid
description: CORID is a first-person hardcore psychological horror game that draws you into a dark, ever-changing world. Explore your surroundings, solve puzzles, and question your own perception—because even when nothing happens, it does not mean you are alone.

title: So Close
description:
So Close is a cooperative platformer for one to four players in which a team escapes a linear level filled with unpredictable traps. The players wear explosive collars that detonate if they move too far apart, and the death of a single player restarts the run for the entire team. Two modes are available: Realism, which restarts the full level after each death, and Easy,
which resumes from the last checkpoint. The game is hosted by an in-game gamemaster named Proxxy.

title: Beefy Boi
description: A job simulator horror. Gather ingredients, assemble orders, and hand them to customers. Your boss is a massive meat monster and we intentionally broke him. Pay your bills when you get back to your room.

title: Grape by Grape
description: A cozy vineyard idler with no clicking and no game-over. Hover to water your vines, then turn grapes into wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez across your own little estate and sell them at your shop. 14 grapes, gentle automation, and a vineyard that works while you're away.

title: Flippy the Spider
description: Jump, glide, and swing your way through increasingly challenging levels, eating flies and searching for your way home. Master tight, physics-based controls, explore 5 distinct worlds, and collect trophies along the way!

title: Enarian: Orbital Command
description: A spaceship based RTS/RPG Hybrid, take command from your own outpost and lead wings of fighters, bombers, frigates and more, against powerful enemy fleets. Defend, Assault, Hack, Repair and Recover cargo for corporations and pirate factions building the strength of your ship and notoriety.

title: Elsewar
description: Master the unpredictable forces of Elsewar, a roguelike deck-builder where tactical synergy meets high-stakes fantasy combat. Draft powerful cards, uncover game-changing relics, and adapt your strategy on the fly as you battle through an ever-shifting, perilous world. Can you build the ultimate deck and survive the onslaught?

title: Extravalence
description: Lead a party of living chemical elements through a fractured world where every bond changes the battle. Switch between unique heroes, combine their abilities, manage volatile reactions and restore the stability.

title: Infested DX
description: Escape a space nightmare as the sole survivor of an alien infestation. Search for clues and solve puzzles as you avoid deadly encounters with zombies, mutants, robots and unseen alien pathogens. Find a cure and a way home in this retro point and click adventure!

title: Seven Nights With Hanako
description: Ancient Leylines, a once in a 10 millennia blood moon, and one seriously bratty ghost! Seven Nights, Seven Challenges, Seven Hearts; Survive a week in Hanako's Hell realm or become her eternal play-thing!

title: Carry the Count
description: Carry the Count is a co-op adventure game for 1 to 4 freaky little freaks. Carry your vampire master across a medieval fantasy world to his bloodthirsty lover Romilda. Fight barbarians, solve puzzles, outsmart evil fish guys, and don't let the masters coffin break. Maybe one day, Igors will be free?

title: Absolutely Nothing Good
description: Do you believe that on Halloween night, the line between the world of the living and the dead becomes thinner? If not, then youre probably used to simply buying children off with candy. But imagine being stuck on a night shift in an ordinary roadside minimarket...

title: The Gastarbeiters
description: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Raise a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

title: Tile & Error
description: A word-game roguelite. Place words to crack escalating score targets, enchant single tiles until they detonate, freeze or pay gold, and tilt the whole board when nothing fits. Bosses rewrite the rules, the shop rebuilds your bag, and every run digs deeper into the alphabet.

title: Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition
description:
The award winning epic returns. Become a different kind of warrior in this definitive edition of the standalone Ghost of Yotei experience.

The Complete Edition includes:
• Ghost of Yotei
• Echoes of Sekigahara - A New Story Expansion
• Most Wanted - A Combat Survival Mode
• In-game Mask
• Charm of Hokkyokusei
• The Snake Armor
• Digital Deluxe Armor Dye
• Digital Deluxe Horse & Saddle
• Sword Kit
• Traveler’s Maps (Early Unlock)
• Charm of Amaterasu

title: The Roach Hotel: Chapter 2
description: Continue the story of The Roach Hotel, descending deep below, where the air grows heavy and the shadows feels alive. Down here, the cockroaches are the least of your concerns… something far worse is waiting to play.

title: Pinched
description: Multiplayer horror game about being lost in pitch-black tunnels with nothing but a flashlight and your voice. Four players spawn in a procedural generated maze in total darkness, where proximity voice chat echoes and bounces down the halls, so you hear each other long before you find each other. Race for the exit, climb ahead of rising floodwater, or survive the thing that hunts you by sound. Every map is generated fresh each round, and nobody has the layout memorized, including the developer.

title: Not Monsters
description: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

title: BeBalance
description: Balance brooms, reeds, feather dusters, and one deeply uncooperative crowbar on a single fingertip. Chase the center of mass, survive crosswinds and parrots, earn coins, unlock skills, and consider an important question: is staying upright really more impressive than being caught?

title: Down Pit
description: Dig. And Get Paid.

title: Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat
description: Build a global industrial empire on a 3D planet earth. Mine resources, manufacture complex goods, trade across continents, and shape your companys reputation through powerful policies. Control every step of the supply chain and turn industry into influence.

title: Let's Tidy Up!: Konbini
description: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. Completing shelves unlocks new skills and abilities that you can use to help you stack over 5000 unique items as quickly as possible!

title: Sanasana
description: To bring her deceased sister back to life, a young girl sets out to steal the Golden Apples from three witches. Dodge beautiful yet merciless bullet patterns in this dark fantasy bullet hell shooter filled with madness.

title: Train Station Tycoon
description: A punctual train is never an accident. In this immersive management game, take control of a bustling railway station with your friends. Assign platforms, coordinate teams, expand your infrastructure from 2 to 30 tracks, and manage real-time crises to keep the traffic flowing smoothly!

title: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of Continental Europe
description:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe, featuring species from across mainland Europe!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, distinctive European bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from diverse European habitats never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Enjoy the variety of familiar and lesser-known species, each with its own call and charm.

title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown: Equinox
description: Adds the USS Equinox as a playable ship for Q-Trials Mode with a harder difficulty due to reduced building space, crew capacity, and warp power. Includes an exclusive questline exploring the Equinox's tragic backstory and three recruitable heroes: Captain Ransom, First Officer Burke, and Crewman Lessing.

title: Black Hollow
description: Black Hollow is a dark fantasy roguelite FPS where you play as a lone plague doctor defending a remote farmstead from waves of plague-stricken villagers. Fight through the night with your staff, lantern, and unstable plague mixtures, then use the remains of the infected to unlock new attacks, potions, and upgrades at an ancient runestone.

title: No Witnesses
description: No Witnesses is a 2-16 player party game. Play online or with your friends. Somebody in this lobby is a Killer. Nobody saw it happen. Killers hide in the crowd, Bystanders scramble to survive and a Detective works the forensics - while buffs and debuffs drag every round into chaos. Trust no one.

title: MXGP 26: The Official Game
description: Dominate the track, feel every impact, every rut, every victory. The most intense and realistic motocross experience is finally available. Experience the entire 2026 championship, with its official tracks and riders.

title: Crescent Break
description: Blast robots, use their pieces to start chain reactions, and navigate your way through destructible levels in this platformer ROGUELIKE. Crescent Break fuses together NES-era robot hero goodness with indie classics. Augment your cyborg suit for ridiculous synergies, and try over and over to survive!

title: Backrooms: Research
description: A multiplayer backrooms extraction game up to 4 players where you manage your own base and enter open, non-linear levels to complete objectives, explore unknown environments, and gather resources and items needed to survive.

title: Bureaucromancer
description: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

title: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles - Medieval Houses
description: Medieval style timberframe houses for that high fantasy or Laketown style Bulwark settlement.

title: Shady Business
description: Make lamps for villains! As a Villux employee, you create eclectic lamps for ominous clients of the underworld. Receive your design brief, build your lamp, and shape the sinister plans of your customers across a treacherous network of villains.

title: Hex Tower Boogie
description: Hex Tower Boogie is a tower defense game combined with factory-style automation, played on a hexagonal grid. Players build conveyor belts, splitters and mergers to route ammunition to their towers; towers only fire when supplied by the production line. It mixes logistics and supply-chain management with wave-based defense. Developed with the Godot engine.

title: Kitty Found a Camera
description: A First-and-Third-Person Photo Shooter (FATPPS) where you take photos to solve problems and get into mischief.

title: Grapixo Arte em Guerra
description: Scratch in a 2.5D world that blends hip hop aesthetics with action/platforming, where urban art has come to life. Explore dynamic environments, face cleaning robots, and uncover secrets of this vibrant world as you reclaim your identity in this intense and colorful adventure.

title: Crow's Curated Closet: Shop Simulator
description: Step into the role of a boutique owner with a flair for the unusual. Decorate your shop, unlock new collections, and create a space your customers won’t want to leave. Grow your business, optimise your layout, and watch the numbers climb. Turn your tiny shop into a thriving gothic fashion powerhouse

title: Whistling at Night
description: A short horror experience inspired by Indigenous Folklore

title: Goldfish Simulator
description: Goldfish Simulator: “Endless Move” is a meditative idle goldfish simulation game. The goldfish react as if they were alive, and their movements are realistic and elegant.

title: Vertigo Enigma
description: Congratulations! You have been chosen for Vertigo Enigma. A narrative puzzle experiment where your logic and observation are the test. Until it glitches. Until you understand what "chosen" means...

title: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
description: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

title: Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
description: Tower Defense + Auto Chess + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

title: Reversi2048
description: Reversi meets 2048. Every time a piece is flipped, its score doubles. Having more pieces isn't enough if your opponent's total score is higher, you lose. A fresh take on a classic strategy game.

title: D-Extinction
description: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

title: No Register
description: Cross the threshold between existence and non-existence in search of a forbidden singularity. Decipher the logic of an abstract realm, solve puzzles, and survive the vigilance of the Guardians who protect this domain. Accept the destiny set before you or break the silence to forge your own.

title: Faybound: Veils of Magic
description: An ancient darkness threatens the balance of a magical world. Take on the roles of different fairies and unite their powers. Use their unique abilities to confront the emerging threat. Experience a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania full of danger and mystical secrets.

title: Umbral Coterie
description: A dark city simulation with procedural generation and emergent storytelling. Observe, befriend, manipulate, and betray hundreds of fully simulated citizens as they live, work, scheme, and die around you. Shape bloodlines across generations and uncover the sinister forces moving beneath the city.

title: Penguin Weapons
description: Penguin Weapons is a dynamic action roguelite about penguins that collect artifacts, creating absurdly crazy weapons, fight monsters and bosses, unlock stylish clothes, and explore increasingly difficult worlds full of unique combinations and unpredictability alone or with friends.

title: Spooky Market
description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

title: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted
description: With this collection, you’re not just getting one fantastic shoot ’em up, but two! This Boosted re-release features a fully arranged soundtrack with brand new tracks from a fresh lineup of arrangers. (These differ from the 2011 console version.) In addition, you get several different game modes, including Arcade and Arrange, Online Rankings that let you compete with players worldwide, and Local Replay Support where you can save your best runs for review. A tasty deal indeed!

title: Ake no Yosuga: Twilight Loop
description:
This is a loop-based psychological horror visual novel.

Every day at 5 PM, a girl named Akane dies.
The protagonist, Keita, becomes aware of this loop and struggles to change her fate.
However, no matter what choices he makes, her death is inevitable.
As the story unfolds, a shocking truth emerges—
Akane has been dying repeatedly to protect Keita.

title: Havoc Heirs
description: A fantasy turn-based RPG in a massive interconnected world. Monsters are everywhere, and you may end up being one of them.

title: The Legend of Chalkvania
description: A bite-sized retro action-adventure set in a quirky, cursed land. Fight monsters, meet strange characters, and uncover hidden secrets in this fast-paced homage to classic 2D side-scrollers. Choose your path—embrace the light or the curse. Your legend begins in Chalkvania.

title: Spline: Part One
