description: A narrative-driven psychological horror game in which a man searching for his missing wife becomes trapped within a distorted reality known as the Spline, navigating hostile environments, persistent threats, and fragmented clues that reveal the nature of the world around him.

title: Sullyland Nursery Rhyme
description: Sullyland Nursery Rhyme is a dark fantasy romance visual novel set in the religious city of Marenis, where reality has merged with the mysterious world of the dead known as Sullyland.

title: Castle Wars: Legacy
description: Strategy card game where you need to crush enemy caste or raise yours by playing the right cards. With 3 types of cards, build, attack and magic players need to balance their resources and manage castle and wall better than the opponent in order to win. This is version of castle wars has both single player mode for playing campaign levels or vs the AI and multiplayer and advanced multiplayer mode in daily tournaments.

title: Bravery
description: BRAVERY is a third-person 3D adventure game in which players guide a fragile matchstick character through vast, detailed environments that appear enormous in scale. Gameplay focuses on exploration, tense chase sequences, and interactive fire mechanics that allow objects to be ignited. Throughout the journey, players discover hidden areas and capture enigmatic orbs that are sealed within restored magical mirrors, shaping progression through the world.

title: No Service
description: Uncover, experience, and survive service. Tasked with exploring and reporting any wrongdoing, you are the last train inspector on shift. descend into madness as this surreal comedy sonders your psyche.

title: The Gardener
description: Solve tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

title: The Calamity Trials
description: Complete platform parkour featuring multiple unique weapons and obstacles while IT chases you. These weapons will increase speed, or become another obstacle you must overcome.

title: Hollow Faces
description: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

title: Occult Hand of the Blood Lily
description: A Gothic-Punk yuri visual novel about a magician on the run and her mysterious vampiric guardian. Journey by airship across a war-torn Europe and search for a legendary flower with the power to destroy nations.

title: Corinne
description: Navigate Corinne through a realm of pixel horrors, surrounded by neighbors that are turning into bloodthirsty monsters. Discover the secrets of this twisted dimension before it's too late for Corinne and her friends.

title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Avatar Legends Pack
Minute Man
description: Minute Man is a 2D beat 'em up platformer game where you can freeze time as you're fighting enemies to secure an advantage. Fight through various waves of enemies and defeat bosses in several levels, keeping time frozen as you chain combos against your enemies!

title: Super Chillers: The Chat Room
description: Travel back to the 90s in this campy point-and-click horror adventure inspired by classic YA horror books like Fear Street and Point Horror.

title: C4: Classical Caliber Combat Contest
description: The Arena Shooter Party Game with Item Boxes, Minigame rounds, loads of Weapons and Modifiers, and a card-based Party Mode! Classic action meets stage hazards, comeback mechanics and comic style in this retro multiplayer FPS with modern twists.

title: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered
description: A striking modern revival of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3" and "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends," which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Aim for the peak of 1 vs 1,000 action in this even more enjoyable and thrilling revival.

title: Sous Raccoon
description: Play as a raccoon sous chef managing restaurants while defending customers from monsters in this action-packed roguelike that blends cooking with combat!

title: What Is The Ghost
description: Ghosts haunt the living, and only your company can identify them. Search haunted apartments, collect suspicious artifacts, and reveal cursed objects. But beware: the longer you stay, the stronger the ghost’s presence grows - and the deadlier your investigation becomes.

title: Steel Ark
description: A first-person survival sandbox game where you explore a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge resources, craft production chains, and keep your train base running against all odds.

title: End of Abyss
description: Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility's derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

title: Star-Coat
description: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

title: Fiefdom
description: Change the world, one battle at a time in FIEFDOM: a multiplayer action melee game set in a playerbase-driven story. Clash swords, cast spells, rain down arrows & more in in battles of up to 100 players both at land & at sea. Dive into a world where your victories define the outcome of entire wars. Who will you be fighting for?

title: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
description: Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play, swift reflexes, and exploration as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell"

title: Ominous Recall
description: Ominous Recall: A chilling survival horror game set in a photorealistic Middle East. Confront a terrifying Jinn possessing Stephen and unravel its dark power in this intense psychological thriller.

title: The Depths of Despair
description: Get ready to unleash your inner warrior as you battle goblins, demons, orcs, and more in a thrilling souls-like adventure. Your quest is to help an angel named Amelia find her sister, who has been captured by demonic entities.

title: BloomTale
description: BloomTale is a cozy flower shop simulation game where creativity meets management. Arrange beautiful flower compositions that speak the language of flowers, manage your shop, and satisfy your customers in a world of blooming possibilities.

title: Gus Game
description: Gus Game is a multiplayer party game that immerses you in a fantastic world full of hilarious and competitive mini-games. Gus Game allows you to compete against your friends in challenges such as cannonball throwing, obstacle courses, and much more...

title: Mystic Land: The search for Maphaldo
description: An old-school RPG game inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

title: Crying Booth
description: Sacrifice, survive, trick or treat, and go home. Experience four first-person scenarios with stealth, survival, and puzzle elements along with one side scroller platformer.

title: Monsters & Memories
description: Monsters and Memories is an independently created, niche Fantasy MMORPG that harkens back to the classic MMO era of the late '90s and early '00s.

title: Retrospace
description: A space station has been swallowed by a black hole, mutants roaming the corridors, and everything seems to have gone mad around you. Be sneaky or blast your way through the station and find a way home, all in a disco-punk atmosphere, as if you were the hero of a 70s B-movie that never existed...

title: Rhythmic Keyboard
description: Rhythmic Keyboard is a music-based typing game with integration of a talent system that allows for the player to increase their effectiveness. Procedurally spawned keys inhibit pattern formation, so reaction speed and hand/eye coordination are a priority -- not memorization.

title: Huckleberry Fields Forever
description: Huckleberry Fields Forever is a co-op mystery action-platformer. Track thieves in scenic real-world locales, run and jump through procedurally generated levels assembled from hundreds of handcrafted challenges, gather clues, interview witnesses, uncover secrets... but can you solve the case in time?

title: Restart Zero
description: Restart Zero is an action shooter in cyberpunk style. Experience a fast-paced adventure single or local coop multiplayer.

title: Ozark
description: OZARK is a dark, story-driven 2.5D indie action horror game made for a short, intense playthrough. Crash-land in remote mountains, enter a derelict facility, survive macabre human experiments, and uncover what lies beneath. Play solo, couch co-op, or online co-op through Steam Remote Play Together.

title: Involved
description: Build ships block by block, launch, mine, trade, and explore a procedurally generated low-poly solar system—solo or with friends. Crash, rebuild, repeat. And now, PvP: turrets, shields, missiles, and raids.

title: Esc Ape, You Died?
description: Esc ape, You died? started as a project to recreate a game that fits on a single floppy disk (1.44 MB): a platformer where you solve puzzles with the ESC (menu) settings UI and every other piece of UI.

title: Snakes & Ladders
description: Snakes & Ladders is a turn-based race board game played in a web browser on the Boardit site, for two to eight players who join one table with a short room code, each on their own phone or computer. Players throw one die per turn and move along a numbered board towards square 100. Landing on the foot of a ladder carries a piece up it, and landing on a snake slides it back down. A six gives no extra throw or bonus move. Square 100 must be reached by an exact roll; a throw that is too high leaves the piece where it is. Each turn is timed, and when the clock runs out the table throws for the player, so nobody can stall the game. There are no computer opponents.

title: Draw and Guess
description: Draw and Guess is a drawing and word-guessing party game played in a web browser on the Boardit site, for two to twelve players who join one table with a short room code. On each turn one player picks one of a few secret words and draws it on a shared canvas, without writing the word, while everyone else types guesses into the chat. A right guess is hidden from the others and scores points, and a guess one letter off tells only that player they are close. Earlier guesses score more, and every player who guessed before you lowers your share; the drawer is paid for how quickly the table read the drawing. The dashes show the word length and letters are revealed as the clock runs down. Everyone draws once per round, and the most points after the last round wins.

title: Who's the Spy
description: Who's the Spy is a social deduction word game played in a web browser on the Boardit site, for three to eight players. Everyone at the table shares one secret word except the spy, who is told only the category; the host can deal more than one spy. Players take turns giving clues that describe the word without saying it, typed on their own screens or spoken around a single shared phone. The table can call a vote after set laps of clues, accuses whoever sounded least convincing, and settles ties with a runoff. Everyone who votes for a spy scores a point, as does every spy who escapes; a lone spy then gets one guess at the word for another point. The player with the most points after the last round wins.

title: Trivia Tavern
description: Trivia Tavern is a multiple-choice quiz game played in a web browser on the Boardit site, for two to eight players who join one table with a short room code and answer on their own phones or computers. The host picks the question categories or leaves the game on Mixed, where every category gets an equal share. Every question has four answers and one is right; there are no lifelines and no passing. By default everyone answers every question, every right answer scores and a quicker one scores a little more; the host can switch to a race, where the first right answer scores most. Rounds run from easy questions to hard ones, the last round is worth double points, and the highest total at the end wins.

title: Ludo
description: Ludo is a turn-based race board game played in a web browser on the Boardit site, for two to four players who join one table with a short room code, each on their own phone or computer. Each player races four pieces from a corner base around the board to the centre. A six is needed to leave base; a six, a capture or a piece reaching home earns another throw, but three sixes in a row lose the turn. Landing on a rival sends that piece back to base, except on the eight starred safe squares or against a pair of one colour. The centre must be reached by exact count, and the first player with all four pieces home wins. Turns are timed at 30 seconds. There are no computer opponents.

title: Property Rush
description: Property Rush is a turn-based property-trading board game played in a web browser on the Boardit site. Two to six players share one table, each on their own phone or computer, joined by a short room code. Players move around a board of cities grouped by country, buy the cities they land on and collect rent from opponents. Owning a whole country doubles its rent, declined cities go to auction, and a player short of rent owes the rest and raises it by mortgaging, selling or trading. There are no computer opponents. With no round limit the last player still in wins; with a limit set by the host, the richest player wins.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Balloon Bomber
description:
"BALLOON BOMBER" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Control the anti-aircraft gun and destroy the balloon bombs as they gently sway through the air.
However, destroying the balloon bombs is no easy task. Aim and shoot so your bullets hit only the bomb itself.
If your shot hits the balloon instead, the bomb will fall and blow a hole in the ground. Be careful, as the anti-aircraft gun cannot pass over holes, narrowing your movement range.

title: Gnomicide
description: 100,000 Gnomes have overrun the realm. It's time to clean up.

title: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files
description: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files is a cozy incremental sorting game set inside a fictional 2007 fan wiki. As its new moderator, the player restores 10,324 deleted item entries by sorting them into categories, subfolders, and rows. Sorting earns points for userscripts that make the work easier, while restored pages and messages reveal the community's history.

title: GalaxyQuest
description: GalaxyQuest: Super Mario Galaxy in VR on Meta Quest 3, a native port built on the Petari decompilation.

title: Crusader Kings III: By God Alone
Mia's Journey
description:
An accident has transformed Mia into an adorable little cat, and now she must find a way to return to her human form. Guided by the enigmatic Cat God, Mia embarks on an enchanting journey filled with puzzles, souls, and discoveries!

In Mia's Journey, you will face 32 carefully crafted levels, where each challenge requires you to push souls across the environment and place each one on the purifying altars to progress. Sounds simple? Not quite! Every move can completely change the path, and if you're not careful, you may end up trapping a soul or blocking your own way.

As Mia moves forward, the challenges become increasingly creative, requiring observation, planning, and plenty of brainpower. Think before you act, find the perfect sequence of moves, and discover how to overcome each puzzle without leaving a single soul behind.

But the adventure doesn't take place only on the puzzle board. Between challenges, charming cutscenes reveal more about Mia's story and her relationship with the mysterious Cat God. Find out more and help Mia return to her human form.

With cozy visuals, Mia's Journey offers a comfortable adventure that is easy to learn, yet capable of challenging even the most dedicated puzzle fans.

title: Dead City: Red Protocol
description:
A once-thriving city has become a dangerous battlefield. Hostile forces control the streets, armed enemies patrol the urban districts, and every mission brings a new threat. When the red protocol is activated, there is only one objective: enter the city, complete your mission, and survive.

Dead City: Red Protocol is a third-person action shooter focused on urban combat, exploration, missions, vehicles, and intense encounters.

Explore a large city environment filled with streets, buildings, traffic, enemy-controlled areas, and hidden locations. Move through the city on foot or take control of different vehicles as you travel between objectives.

Engage enemies using a variety of weapons and combat tactics. Fight through dangerous streets, respond to hostile attacks, complete missions, and navigate an urban environment where danger can appear at any moment.

title: Spaghetti Celesti
description: A falling block puzzle game, made in 7 days for Falling Block Jam 2026. Combine strands of pasta with garnishes before the hunger bar depletes for a high score.

title: Conker's Bad Fur Day: Reloaded
description: Conker's Bad Fur Day: Reloaded statically recompiled with N64Recomp into a real Windows (and Linux) program, so it runs at full speed with modern graphics, widescreen, and proper mouse and controller support.

title: Neverness to Everness: For Whom the Verses Mourn
description: Version 1.4 of Neverness to Everness, which includes: • New Characters: Blackbird and Akane Rin • New Main Story Chapter • New area: Pukaland • New events and game modes • ...and more!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Crazy Balloon
description:
"CRAZY BALLOON" is an action game released by TAITO in 1980.
Guide a swaying balloon through a thorny maze and attempt to reach the goal while avoiding traps such as moving thorns, scrolling mazes and more.

title: Penguin Clash
description: Penguin Clash is a 3-minute multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game played in a web browser on phones and computers. Teams of penguins meet in 1v1, 3v3 or 5v5 matches: players tap or click to move, tap an enemy to focus it and fire a single power, and win by destroying the enemy's Moon Beacon or by having the healthier beacon when time runs out. In the last minute the moon rises and beacons take double damage. Each fighter is one of 10,000 hand-drawn penguins, whose outfit sets its role (ten roles, such as Brawler, Rogue, Scout and Shieldbearer) and whose hat sets its power. Online matches start with real players, and bots fill any empty seats. The penguins are also an NFT collection on Base, but owning one is not needed to play.

title: Bad Dogs
description: High-speed highway racing meets classic arcade madness. Drift through branching neon routes, survive dynamic roadblock mini-games, and compete across 5 endless arcade titles, weekly world events, and custom seeded runs. Will you ignite the revolution or sell out to the Syndicate?

title: Project Sakura
description: An unknown outbreak has erased people’s good emotions, turning them into hate-filled Kagebito who can still use their intelligence. Asumi, journeys through a world in chaos to save her friend Yuna.

title: Cicada Communication
description: A school life-focused RPG brought to you by MF Future. Setting out on his own, the protagonist begins his new dormitory life. Study hard, ace your tests, befriend your classmates, and deepen your relationship with others. Perhaps you may even find a special someone to spend the summer festival with.

title: Sukuji to Teikyou ni Kansuru Kousatsu
description: This work is structured around a full-length novel and consists of exploration of a 3D space, various materials such as images, audio, video, and documents, and questions that require careful consideration.

title: VHS Chaos
description: Thousands of VHS tapes are scattered across a chaotic 1980s video store. Pick them up, sort them onto the right shelves, unlock new abilities, and turn chaos into order. Play solo or with friends, restore the store, and uncover what happened here

title: Dungeon Crawl 94: What Was Taken
description:
Dungeon Crawl 94: What Was Taken is a grid-based dungeon-crawling RPG focused on exploration, turn-based combat, character progression, and procedurally generated environments. Players choose a class and develop attributes including Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, Speed, Constitution, and Luck while discovering randomized equipment, spell books, cursed and legendary items, crafting supplies, merchants, animal companions, mimics, and bosses.

The game uses a 2D grid-based world with a perspective rendering system that allows outdoor environments to display a visible sky and horizon. The player's view can also be rotated through four orientations while exploring.

The story follows a traveler returning home who discovers his home in flames and his family missing, beginning a journey to discover what was taken and find them.

title: Wheel Estate
description: Become the wealthiest Business Hamster in the world! Expand your office space, build hamster wheels, hire hamster employee's and hamster managers! Provide water and decorations for your hard working Hamsters and reap the reward!

title: Shelfbound
description: A storm has torn through, sending shelves and their contents flying across the room. In Shelfbound, it’s your job to clean up the mess, sort through scattered items, and put everything back where it belongs, one labeled shelf at a time.

title: Cat Music Chaos
description: Catch flow state on a 70 BPM timer. You don't need to read notes to play. You might learn by accident. Warning: prolonged exposure to classical music. Side effects include humming Ode to Joy at bus stops.

title: Creator Shelter: DLC Cuisine
description: Expand your Shelter with a fully equipped kitchen, new chef and service outfits, and a collection of culinary accessories that let you personalize your Creators and bring fresh stories to life throughout the Shelter every day.

title: Fickle Allies
description: Collect and deposit every crystal to escape in this first-person multiplayer thriller game. Form shifting alliances, steal from rivals, protect your haul, or eliminate threats as you explore a mansion, subway, and abandoned facility where trust never lasts.

title: Endless Mall
description: Endless Mall is a roguelike city-builder card game. Carefully select your shops, mind your layout, build a powerful economic engine, and rake in profits beyond your wildest imagination!

title: Prop Revolt
description: A prop hunt where being seen is a resource. Hide as an everyday object and survive - or let the hunter stare, charge the Revolt, and fight back as a team. There's often a fine line between hiding and attacking. Will you defeat the Hunters, or will you hide until the end? You decide!

title: Seven Minutes in the Closet
description:
You're pushed into playing 7 minutes in heaven at a party with a stranger. Everything goes wrong and you are stuck in there with him.

Warnings: Depictions of murder and violence, screen shaking.

title: Still Rooms
description: A cozy, pixel-art decorating game where you design and furnish unique homes across 7 themed locations — from modern apartments and rustic houses to retro 80’s interiors, student rooms, rooftops, and even a spaceship.

title: Knightbane
description: Survive 12 minutes. Then the final boss arrives. Shatter the terrain to escape, loot its contents, or funnel the horde into a killing trap. Cleanse the lands for boons and ASCEND your abilities: not merely empowered, but altered. An action survivor-like.

title: Creator Shelter
description: Build an underground shelter for content creators. Recruit new talent, construct specialized rooms, manage your resources and grow your operation into a thriving creator empire.

title: Magic Shop Chaos
description: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

title: Pokémon Monomyth
description: Pokémon Monomyth is an original character-driven GBA game set in the Pokémon world, with an emphasis on exploration, storytelling, and complex Pokémon gameplay.

title: The Missing Threads
description: Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

title: Last Rites
description: You're ten years old and live with your grandparents. Father Aldous has come to read your grandmother her last rites. Now he says the house must be cleansed of sin. Stay out of sight.

title: Bonki D Bonk
description: Survive relentless enemy waves in a fast top-down survival game where your weapons attack for you. Move, dodge, and stack 30+ weapons with 100+ items into screen-filling chaos.

title: Select Eleven
description:
The best in class management game for cricket. Take charge of the club and lead them to glory.

Major features include Scouting, Transfers, Youth academy, 180 clubs across 7 nations

title: Football Club Builder
description: Build, manage, and grow your own football club from Division 4 to European glory. Expand your stadium and facilities in 3D, compete in league and cup competitions, and create a football dynasty by making the right decisions in this fast-paced football manager game.

title: BloodJack
description: BloodJack, a 2-4 player PvP blackjack battler where every player hides card, manipulates opponents, uses rule-breaking items, and bets the blood keeping them alive as the stakes rise.

title: Cute & Dead
description: You might look like a typical nerd, but even a zombie apocalypse won't stop you from asking the girl of your dreams out on a date. All you need to do is find and rescue her from hordes of the living dead.

title: Lisia
description: Drive your truck on deadly roads. Use the winch, build bridges, and spray-paint the body. Reach the summit alone or in co-op with friends. And remember the main rule: don't look down!

title: Vessels: Noiret Mansion
description: A retro-inspired PSX survival horror game set in the mysterious Noiret Mansion. Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, uncover the fate of the Noiret family, and survive the horrors lurking within its walls.

title: The Sinkhole
description: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouseyour real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

title: Yots
description: Cooperative survival horror for up to 4 players. Complete the Quota, fight the creatures birthed by City of Mist, and build your own powerful loadout using unique artifacts.

title: Card City Nights Forever
description: It's cards! It's a city! It's night! And this time it's forever! Card City Nights Forever is the third and final installment of the series, with the best core TCG gameplay yet, a whole new huge 3D adventure, and an online mode that will last forever!

title: The Bed Above My Head
description: Youre playing a game in the dark. Something in your room is not. In this Sit & Survive type psychological horror game, you're a child playing on your console, while something roams your room. Observe your surroundings, listen carefully and manage your stress to survive this nightmarish night.

title: FleetLord
description: A space RTS about decisions, not menus. Conquer planets, link them to fuel your war machine, and level up your empire with randomized perk cards. Crush all opposition.

title: Hack 42: Typing Incremental
description: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

title: Sandwich Shop Simulator
description: Run your own sandwich shop! Stock your ingredients, prepare delicious sandwiches, take payments, customize and expand your store, and become the best sandwich shop in town!

title: Art Studio Simulator
description: Bring your wildest imagination to life in your art studio. Paint, sell, build your own gallery, and invite friends to admire your art.

title: Rune Tavern
description: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

title: Human Resources
description: You work in Human Resources. In this dystopian document thriller, use your terminal to scrutinize records and expose human-like AI. Spot contradictions to detect the impostors. Efficiency is mandatory. Failure is unforgivable.

title: TankFall Arena
description: TankFall Arena is a fast-paced top-down tank combat game where precision, ricochets, and weapon mastery decide every battle. Fight solo or with a friend, adapt to changing arenas, and outmaneuver opponents using unique weapons and environmental strategy.

title: Fairy Springs
description: You are a magical Fairy tasked with your first assignment: aid the critters of the glen through the seasons of a year. Take your time getting to know the valley's inhabitants in this cozy little adventure. Every day has a new task to complete with each animal neighbor having something fresh to say.

title: Switch Shapes
description: A rhythm and reflex game where thinking means death. Switch shapes, dodge obstacles, and immerse yourself in a cyberpunk audiovisual experience powered by dynamic music that evolves with your performance.

title: Electric Sheep
description: Dredge the memories of an old Butler Robot to piece the past together and solve a Murder at a family home.

title: Resurface
description: Escape the ocean depths in this casual incremental mining game. Mine, upgrade, and explore biomes as your strength grows to crazy proportions!

title: Industronaut
description:
Industronaut is a first-person survival engineering game set on a hostile, radiation-heavy planet.

You were left behind after a failed evacuation. Alone on the surface, you must build a sealed habitat, produce oxygen, water, and food, mine raw resources, and turn them into the systems that keep you alive.

Expand from a small survival shelter into an industrial base. Process resources through production chains, unlock new machines, manage power, storage, and logistics, and use drones to scan for ore deposits and move materials between machines and storage.

There is no combat and no rescue waiting for you. Survival depends on engineering, automation, and your ability to keep the base running.

title: Gun Monkey!
description: Help your fellow monkeys escape back to the jungle by gunning your way through obstacles and challenges. Test your skill in a open environment and find your way home! Choose how you want to play, save companions (or don't) and unlock guns that help you traverse the world!

title: Blackout
description: Normal. Or Paranormal. A job sorting through ghost photos. Five days to finish. But it won't end there. Mysterious visitors. A fear that bleeds into reality. And—— Can you escape this curse?

title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Processional of the Damned
description: Venture into the Processional — a massive, otherworldly graveyard of ships lost to the void. What begins as a search for riches turns into a descent into the unknown. Navigate shifting corridors, avoid ancient traps, and uncover strange truths that defy logic. A new companion joins your crew — someone shaped by this impossible place. This expansion introduces new story, a mysterious new region, unique enemies and some fresh gameplay mechanics.

title: Proto Zero
description: There is no point in looking back. The only way left is forward. - O. Escape the mega complex and find out what happened to the world our protagonist Yuuto once knew after his long slumber, in this new generation 3d action sci-fi brawler.

title: Onigashima: Awakening
description: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

title: Inner Rooms
description: Wander through vast, unsettling liminal spaces as a quiet presence grows alongside you. Inner Rooms is a psychological atmospheric exploration game set in a world that appears calm and peaceful, yet constantly radiates unease.

title: Homo Sovieticus
description: Homo Sovieticus is a short, indie psychological horror that tells a story of a secret Soviet experiment that you are now a part of. Will you be strong enough not to break and let yourself slip into madness?

title: Backrooms Dream With Tung Tung Tung Sahur
description: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur is a first-person psychological horror game about a lonely man trapped in a surreal dream loop. Explore strange levels, solve eerie puzzles, survive terrifying chases, and uncover why Sahur keeps appearing in your nightmare.

title: Medium Chronicles: Room 644
description: You must speak to survive. But speaking might kill you. Whisper rituals into your microphone — while a demon hunts every sound you make.

title: Hang Out
description: Hang Out is a visual novel with multiple gameplay elements. You awaken in a bizarre town ruled by the “Sea of the Sky,” guided by a familiar yet unreadable figure. As residents mutate and factions clash, you uncover buried memories and a truth meant to stay forgotten

title: Renegade Run
description: Renegade Run is a rogue-lite deckbuilder that puts you in the pilot seat of an experimental starship. Discover anomalies, carve your path, and face powerful enemies as you battle your way back to Sector 0.

title: Interred
description: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting.

title: Fluff Up
description: Fluff Up is a charming yet challenging game where you control a chubby little bird flapping through a fantastical sea of clouds. Master your speed, manage your stamina, and ride the clouds to reach the highest skies.

title: Where Control Ends
description: Where Control Ends is a psychological visual novel about Astra, a young girl trying to hold herself together after a night she cannot fully remember.

title: Broom Racer
description: Broom Racer is a first person, multiplayer party racing game on flying brooms. Race your friends or players world wide through mountains, tight tunnels, forests and more. Evade enemies, pickup items to gain an advantage and fly risky maneuvers to gain a speed boost. Don't fall of your broom!

title: Bodian's Bay Wash
description: A relaxing underwater VR cleaning simulator! Use pressure washers and scrapers to clean boat hulls, smash barnacles, and expand your very own underwater wash. Buy furniture, upgrade your equipment, and get ready for clients of colossal proportions!

title: Dearbnb
description:
Dearbnb is a cozy management game where you build a real estate empire one room at a time.

Start your journey by renting a small apartment in a modest neighborhood. Carefully decorate rooms, place furniture freely, set prices, and welcome tenants and customers. As you gain experience and reputation, unlock new zones — from poor districts to luxury neighborhoods and expand into residences, shops, and massive commercial properties.

Every room matters.
Every decision shapes your path to becoming a true property tycoon.

title: Posthumors
description: Have you ever wondered what happens to people after they die? We created “Posthumors,” an online project that allows you to experience death and communicate with the afterlife through words. Now then — take up your pen, and face death.

title: Beatcore Zero
description: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

title: Growing My Manhole
description: Consume the universe, grow from Manhole to Black Hole in this insatiable incremental game.

title: OneStarHotel
description: Run a chaotic one-star hotel with your friends. Cook meals, serve guests, manage the restaurant, and survive the night while hiding the hotel's darkest secret

title: Queueue
description: An abstract, tile-based puzzle game where the moves you make are for turns not-yet done. Dodging through traps you will arrive at 2 turns in the future quickly becomes a mind-bending puzzle as the levels grow more complex. How hard can a level with only 6 tiles be?

title: Minesweeper: Next-Gen
description: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

title: Dark Bros
description: A chaotic online multiplayer arena brawler focused on physics-driven combat, bizarre abilities, and fast matches with friends.

title: Catnip Cosmos
description:
A short incremental shooter.
Shoot. Upgrade. Incrementally progress further. Pilot cat-operated spaceships on timed Zoomies runs in this space shooter. Combine pilots for powerful synergies, defeat boss challenges to unlock new weapons and improve exponentially.

title: Grisaia: Shuuketsu no Hyakka - Les Rassemblement Cent Fruits de la Grisaia
description: A gacha game sequel to Grisaia no Rakuen.

title: Dodgebrawl
description: An FPS reimagining of the best gym class sport, DODGEBRAWL is a transformation of iconic shooter game modes into the context of an athletic activity. It's a multiplayer PvP dodgeball-themed FPS, full of maps, game modes, equipment, and chaos.

title: Only Humans On Board
description: Buy supplies and manage your resources. Serve customers quickly from your trolley, but stay sharp: be aware of the unknown. Some passengers are only pretending to be human...

title: Reel Greed
description: Reel Greed is a slot machine incremental game where players spin reels, earn payouts, choose temporary run cards, and buy permanent upgrades to increase payouts, unlock patterns, and scale future runs.

title: Exorcist Hotline
description: The world is full of ghosts. So who you gonna call? The Exorcist Hotline! A multiplayer investigative survival horror puzzle game for up to 4 players. One operator. Three exorcists. And a demon. Work together or die trying.

title: Folders on the Run
description: Escape the factory reset! Control two adorable folders in a failing OS. Play solo or coordinate your movements with a friend. Master shifting mechanics to survive. Perfect for testing your skills and friendships!

title: Worlds Explorers
description: Explore alien planets with carefully designed ecosystems, weather, resources, dangers and unique phenomena. Hunt animals for food and collect resources to craft equipment and repair devices on your ship. Escape each unique planet and unlock crew members and new ships.

title: Sadko
description: Monsters are closing in from all sides, and all you've got is a gusli… and the letter O? Dynamic combat with Slavic folk music, hero progression, and building a unique build to take on each location and its boss - so you can finally face Koschei himself.

title: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
description: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction.

title: Cohen 1939
description: "Cohen 1939" is a top-down shooter set in Birmingham, England in 1939. Players take on the role of a woman seeking vengeance for her murdered gangster husband . You will be immersed in classic British gangland scenes of the 1930s.

title: Salvation Denied
description: Salvation Denied is a chaotic co-op building sim for 1–4 players where a crew of small, yellow, mischievous construction robots attempts to build massive structures with heavy machinery and absurd tools. Physics rules everything. Every block has weight, every mistake shifts the balance, and disasters will push your creation to its absolute limit.

title: The War Disorder Hexa
description: War consumes the Kingdom of Node as an empire marches forward. Six protagonists stand on different sides of the conflict, each driven by their own motives, struggles, and paths to survival.

title: Redhowl
description: Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. 3 factions clash: use your unique powers, unmask them or be devoured before the Blood Moon turns against you.

title: Fame or Folly
description: In a world where wars are fought on stages, compete for a single royal request from the King. Fame or Folly is a deckbuilder of deckbuilders where you draft a new trouper every turn. Recruit wisely, unlock powerful synergies, and survive the critics in this handcrafted pixel-art strategy roguelite

title: Scrappy Craft
description: Scrappy Craft is a shopkeeping game where you run a small forge. Scavenge trash and combine it to craft over 10000 absurd weapons like banana swords or Frisbee shields, buy upgrades, unlock new recipes and sell your bizarre creations to quirky customers like tie-wearing otters or spaghetti monsters.

title: Polydangerous
description: Build and defend a mining operation on a distant planet in this tower defense bullet heaven shooter. Build and upgrade defenses, fight off waves of enemies from a rival corporation, and earn enough credits to buy your body back and escape this deep space hellhole.

title: Chinese Strange Stories
description: Step into a living Chinese painting that blends the mystical, supernatural, and the struggles of daily life in the final years of the Ming dynasty. Experience a unique mix of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling, where strategy and fate intertwine.

title: Purr-fect Chef: Cats Can Cook
description: Purr-fect Chef is a cute cats time management cooking game. But instead of running restaurants, your goal as the chef is to pass as many fun stages as possible with changing mechanics and also explore the story.

title: Good Catch!
description: Good Catch! is a relaxing fishing game about cozy fishing spots, rare catches, small quests and friendly characters you unlock along the way.

title: Southbound
description: Fight endless enemies and become powerful! Get loot, level up, buy vehicles and upgrade to create unique builds to improve your chances of survival

title: Wrecked
description: 失败作 Wrecked is a visual novel game developed and published by ShanProject. Players advance the story by clicking key points on the screen. Featuring multiple routes and rich narratives. The game is music-themed, telling a fateful journey full of unforeseen twists.

title: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
description: An alluring oiran dances through the blood-soaked nights of Edo. Where beauty and violence collide — a dopamine-fueled survival action.

title: Flipper on Recoil
description: Flipper on Recoil is a fast-paced 3D platformer where a fish with legs and a shotgun takes on gravity. Use recoil, power-ups, and absurd tricks to blast through handcrafted levels and chase your best times.

title: Purrfect Tanks: The Yarnpocalypse
description: Command adorable cats in chaotic cardboard tanks and battle for the last yarn on Earth! Explosions, lasers, catnip-fueled madness — and lots of cardboard.

title: PGA Tour 2K25: Clubhouse Pass Premium Season 8
Freelance Dead
description: A roguelite top‑down twin‑stick shooter. Rain, shine, or zombie outbreak—nothing stops a Courier on a deadline. Shoot, loot, and scoot through hordes of undead with ridiculous item synergies. Earn cash, unlock weapons, and grow from broke gig worker to a walking apocalypse.

title: Barefort
description: "The fewer defenses you have, the more you become yourself." On the board, the score spreads over time, and corruption erodes. Stack units to create chain effects and turn the tide with minimal placement. Placing too many units will destroy you, while placing too few will prevent you from defending.

title: Reel Tiny
description: Welcome to Critters Crick! Catch fish, upgrade gear, and explore the mountain’s creek in this loveable micro-fishing game! You play as The Shrew, a mammal with a burning passion for fishing. Bask in the variety of rods, lures, reels, and fish that keep folks in this cozy community busy year-round!

title: Sol and Mani the Artifact
description: Visual novel that combines elements of fantasy, romance and adventure. The story of the adventures of one young accidental traveler named Max, told from the perspective of the inhabitants of another world. Сharacters would join a team of adventurers and search for the artifact that grants any wish.

title: Local Zombies
description: Death is just a career change. Shape unique characters in this turn-based life sim, then resurrect them as zombie companions. Transform their past talents into tactical advantages to take over the city.

title: Beyond The Cupola: ISS Simulator
description: You are the ISS crew, where the station's fate depends on everyone. Oxygen leaks, system failures, meteorite threats — repair with your own hands and make real-time decisions. Complete missions, perform spacewalks. Experience life in orbit: in space, nothing goes according to plan.

title: Farming With Lasers
description: Incinerate various pests with your giant laser, as you grow your farm. Purchase incremental upgrades to expedite the process.

title: Soul Maze
description:
Soul Maze is a cooperative game where failure has consequences.

You play as Light Souls trapped together in a maze between life and death.
Work together to recover soul fragments and escape.

If you fail, the group must sacrifice one of its own.

title: Nero
description: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

title: AGX GP
description: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

title: Wukong Survivors: God Slayer
description: Wukong Survivors" is a TPS + ROGUE game where players control Sun Wukong and his friends, sweeping through all visible enemies and rescuing their captured master.

title: Chromascape
description: Step into a gentle, hand-drawn world in Chromascape. As Luna the hedgehog, you hold the power to absorb and share colors in a land fading into gray. Use warm hues to light fires, cool tones to freeze paths, and restore vibrancy to this heartwarming 2D adventure.

title: Alonitaire
description: Break the rules of solitaire in this atmospheric roguelike deckbuilder. Unleash forbidden sigils while the Jack of Spades begs for your help in secret. Forge game-breaking combos under the Joker’s watchful eye and uncover the truth behind the deck. Don’t investigate… just play.

title: Myth of Valderit
description:
Myth of Valderit is a psychological horror experience set in the cursed village of Valderit, inspired by the abandoned Catalan village of La Mussara. You wake up as Nil, separated from your friends Julia and Enric, and soon uncover the dark secrets lurking within the village…

This single-player, first-person experience combines exploration, survival, and puzzle-solving. Nil must endure and remain alive, evading the fanatical devotees of an unimaginable entity.

title: Shinjuku Anomaly
description: You have a part-time job taking photos of anomalies in the night in Shinjuku.

title: City Party
description: City Party is an 8-player simultaneous turn-based party game. All players act at once—no waiting! Roll dice on beautifully crafted global city maps, use skills, control special tiles, play combo cards, challenge opponents, and collect legendary treasures. Win this urban adventure your way!

title: Wrongly Accused
description: Explore historical locations, find and analyse evidence. Unmask the real perpetrator so that justice can be served and the Wrongly Accused can be found innocent. Use problem solving, deduction and critical thinking skills to uncover the truth and maybe even expose a conspiracy in your own time.

title: Torii: Beyond the Gates
description: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why there has been broken links inside the spirit realm. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

title: Starlet Disorder
description:
A psychological horror visual novel/RPG hybrid set inside a neon-noir reality television competition about fame, romance, surveillance, and public collapse. Players take the role of Adam, a rising entertainer with an uncertain past, as he enters the second season of Starlet Disorder alongside seven other contestants.

Each week combines life simulation, investigation, relationship-building, broadcast manipulation, and timed social combat in the Live Chamber. Through the PRISM system, player stats shape perception, access, and pressure choices as relationships turn into comfort, rivalry, scandal, evidence, or weapons in the show’s official narrative.

title: Diffusion
description: Build defenses to protect your mining sites from the hostile native alien species. Explore the planet and discover the true reasons you've been sent here for. A true old school pixel-art experience.

title: Nion Forge
description: Nion Forge is a blend of roguelite gameplay and modular shipbuilding, set in a stylish cyberpunk world. By carefully selecting the right modules, you'll have a chance to conquer all 9 districts of the city, defeat their district bosses, and attain your freedom.

title: Bloons Blitz
description: Embark on the ultimate road trip adventure across the Bloons universe! Get ready to dive into exciting battles against hundreds of menacing Bloons and unleash your arsenal of attacks in action-packed, roguelike gameplay.

title: Solaria
description: Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Akaza (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Doma Character Pack
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Giyu Tomioka (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Shinobu Kocho (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Tanjiro Kamado (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Dear Poe
description:
You have received a mysterious email! After the death of an underworld citizen caused by a strange letter, Poe and Arthur are called in to investigate the case and prevent further tragedies. But what appears to be a simple crime soon reveals something much bigger, involving wandering demons and a much more complex dark plot.

Dear Poe is a spin-off of Dark Light, set 6 months before the main events of the game.

title: Another's Memories
description: Another's Memories is a first-person psychological horror video game located in Argentina. Explore a sinister country house, solve puzzles, and survive ruthless enemies in an immersive experience where every shadow hides a disturbing story.

title: Hemobloom
description: A psychological horror game where you explore a twisted realm of nightmares, confront grotesque monsters and piece together the mystery of the Hemobloom.

title: Armada Pet Wars
description: Armada Pet Wars is a 4X-lite asynchronous turn based space-themed strategy game... with pets. Design Starships, make or break alliances, setup your fleets for victory in this strategic, space-themed, auto-battler.

title: Raccoon Valley Tycoon
description: Raccoon Valley is a cozy incremental game about restoring a forgotten raccoon village to its former glory. Dig for resources, collect everything in sight, and watch your little town come back to life.

title: ShipCrafter
description: ShipCrafter is a naval sandbox simulation game. Build you ship, unlock new components and defeat increasingly powerful foes in the campaign !

title: Jupiter
description: A survival adventure on a mysterious Jupiter-like planet. Explore, gather resources, overcome dangers, and uncover hidden secrets in the depths of an alien world.

title: Souls Alive: Origins
description: Souls Alive: Origins is a Lovecraftian survival horror game set in a dark sci-fi future. Explore a world where reality bends, ancient cults return, and Cthulhu stirs once more. With a strong focus on story, atmosphere, and visual detail.

title: Astra Bestiary
description: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

title: Micro Titans Wrestling
description: Micro Titans Wrestling is a nostalgia fuelled roguelike deck builder themed on the golden age of professional wrestling. Prepare to step into the ring with a roster of era defining characters and take it to the mat with a unique card battle system.

title: Economic Miracle
description: Build your own state in the most detailed economic simulator! Playing for the government of any country in the world, you will have to conduct domestic and foreign policy, pass laws, carry out economic reforms and fight. Try a real simulator of modern times!

title: Project Octavia
description: A stylized third-person spy action game with infiltration, gunplay, Close Quarter Combat (CQC) and innovative and dynamic sabotage gadget crafting with brand new science-fiction based stealth action multiplayer gameplay!

title: Pigeon Guild
description: Pigeon Guild is a non-combat, single-player action RPG where you play as Jules Corso, a rookie cadet in Cassandria's most prestigious airborne postal service. Navigate your flying cargo boat through a world of floating islands, where every delivery tells a story.

title: Cinema Theater Tycoon
description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

title: Sketchy Driver
description: An arcade, roguelike endless racer where you dodge traffic, jump ramps, perform tricks, earn points, and level up to make the run more entertaining, aiming for the best score. No story. No brakes. No problem.

title: Exofactory
description: Awaken as a forgotten AI on an alien world, your every choice reshapes your technology, environment, and identity. Automate deeply transformative factories in a chill open world, where the story evolves uniquely around you.

title: GTL Schedule
description: In a post-apocalyptic world where food has become contraband and hope is on the brink of extinction, you quietly ignite a revolution to warm the world with a spatula and love.

title: Spinning My Wheel
description: Build a physics‑powered hamster‑wheel, master rocket‑boosted moves, to lead a brain chipped enhanced hamster through puzzles, mining, and laboratory‑runner mayhem.

title: Mahou Shoujo Escape
description: Let's escape the room before the countdown ends, or☆……?

title: Deck of Stabs
description: Every card is a weapon. Every decision matters. Battle through strange worlds and dangerous dungeons. Discover exotic weapons, powerful gear, and deadly skills. Burn, curse, explode, and smash your way to victory. Every run is different—just bring your best blades.

title: Survivesmith
description: Reverse bullet-hell game with a crafting twist. Shoot hails of bullets, missiles, nails, lasers and whatever is at your disposal at your enemies and make tactical choices to overcome all obstacles. You are here to find and extract the 'Life Essence', and you're not leaving without it!

title: Local Supermarket Tycoon
description: Design the perfect neighbourhood supermarket! Research customer needs, carefully stock your shelves, and plan every aisle to maximize traffic and boost impulse sales

title: Judgment Day: Pacific Assault
description: In this game, you will personally drive a vehicle and use your machine guns and artillery to judge the Japanese fascists. You will participate in General Li Mei's barbecue of Tokyo and ultimately drop the atomic bomb on Hiroshima, bringing the dawn of peace to the world.

title: Nomad Drive
description: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can. Every journey offers a unique experience!

title: Okko the Exiled
description: Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure, where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the demon lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

title: Penguin Festival
description: You are a penguin! Lend a helping flipper to your community as it prepares for an annual festival. Complete some last-minute festival to-dos during the day while you explore the vibrant penguin town. When night falls, join everyone and enjoy the festivities with games and music!

title: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos
description: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos is a third-person fantasy Action-RPG. Explore numerous locations ravaged by the dark power of Death, face various creatures consumed by Chaos, and harness the power of Life to save the continent of Aspiel.

title: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached
description: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.

title: Hats and Guns
description: Become a cardslinger in this roguelike deckbuilder with tactical elements. Fight, gather weapons and items, face unexpected events and upgrade your cards for hundreds of possibilities. Every run is unique and so are you, the best shot of the Far West looking for your upcoming revenge.

title: 100 Caliber Dash
description: A high-speed run-and-gun shooter with roguelite deckbuilding upgrades.

title: PhantomZone Labyrinthos
description: ”The nightmare that never allows waking lasts forever.” You wake up from bed and a girl appears before you. She calls herself “Entourfe,” a management support android. The stage is a strange facility, and you will explore the inside of the strange facility with her.

title: Collapsed Horizon
description: Travel between galaxies, dig planets, collect ores, sell them, upgrade your equipment, and earn your ticket back to Earth.

title: A Forest Tale: Porasy
description:
Embark on a journey through a new mythological realm as Porasy, an Indigenous warrior. Explore uncharted landscapes, unleash the power of Muiraquitãs, unravel your story, and vanquish the Seven Legendary Beasts to carve your own legend. Are you ready to dive into this epic adventure?

Porasy is an indie platformer that combines the thrill of classic 2D action with the rich, untold stories of the Tupi-Guarani mythology. Inspired by childhood favorites like Sonic and MegaMan, Porasy brings a fresh challenge to the platforming genre, immersing players in a dangerous, atmospheric world of Brazilian folklore.

title: Panzer Strike
description: Authentic RTS gameplay straight out of the 2000s. Command your troops, develop strategies, and win World War II battles. Huge maps, thousands of units, long-range firepower, and no building mechanics!

title: Reality Drift
description: Reality Drift is a roguelike racing game where your choices matter. Race through a series of strange worlds, choose upgrades for your car and decide which track will be next - your decisions are just as important as how you drive!

title: Codebreakers VR
description: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

title: Princess Maker: Children of Revelation
description: 「Princess Maker: Children of Revelation」is a raising simulation game that returns after 18 years as part of the "Princess Maker" package series, where you raise a young girl into adulthood. Become a parent in the game and help fulfill your daughter's dreams!

title: Countryballs: The Heist
description: Countryballs: The Heist is PWA's comedic stealth adventure where you become a master thief for eccentric clients. Customise your Countryball's disguise to explore maze-like countries. Plan, sabotage, hide and trick to outwit guards and traps - or create your own thrilling heists for the community.

title: 9 Dystricts
description: Build your own flying vehicles in this action-packed roguelike dystopia.

title: Radiosol
description: RADIOSOL is a journey through a desolate world burned by a planetary cataclysm. In search of answers, you will have to navigate through the ruins of megastructures and abandoned cities, avoiding the scorching rays of the Sun.

title: Endless Tactics
description: Endless Tactics is a turn-based roguelite game. Play as the commander of a high-risk planetary mining operation, defend your base from alien creatures while trying not to get overrun. Use resources to upgrade your starship, unlock new technologies, powerups, and deadly new worlds to harvest.

title: Counter Clash
description: Lead religious zealots, spiritual nomads, or scientific warmongers in a fast-paced, tactical strategy game. Discover different troop combos, counters, and environmental hazards to crush the opposition!

title: The Midnight Walkers
description: Fight, Scavenge, and Extract in The Midnight Walkers, a hardcore FPS game with deadly zombies, dangerous players, and valuable loot. Craft weapons, armor, and consumables; trade items; and maintain your hideout. Escape Liberty Grand Center mega complex, and thrive...or die and lose everything.

title: Mithra
description: Unravel an ancient cult conspiracy in this hand-drawn mystery adventure. Travel across London, Beijing, and Rome, crossing paths with eccentric characters while piecing together clues in an odyssey that blurs the line between myth and reality.

title: Weefager
description: Guide this pink being with the power of the ether in a metroidvania where nothing is as it seems. Infuse souls into objects, create minions to help you, and explore vibrant landscapes with a great soundtrack. Shape your destiny on this captivating journey.

title: EVE Vanguard
description: EVE Vanguard is an upcoming sci-fi sandbox FPS where every deployment onto a hostile planet is high stakes. You fight, scavenge, and adapt in brutal warzones - and every choice leaves its mark on a player-driven universe at war.

title: Mikene's Aspects
description: Guide Mikene in the search for the 7 Aspects of Balance to achieve Omnipotence and put an end to the problem plaguing the city of Farzin once and for all. Dive into hordes of enemies in this frantic hack n' slash in the best Soulslike style!

title: Mokete
description: Mokete is a turn-based roguelike game with cartoon graphics and an alien theme. You'll take control of a brave alien who uses abducted animals in thrilling battles on Earth to become the zone champion and face mythical beings.

title: Veredilia: The Sacred Forest
description: Veredilia: The Sacred Forest is a 2D platforming game that takes inspiration from classic platformers such as Sonic, and fighting games like Mortal Kombat. The game aims to be a combination of classic 2D platforming with 1v1 fighting whilst also exploring the large forest of Veredilia across various locales with a wide range of characters, technical movesets, and flashy combos. You can take control of one of 3 characters, each with their own special moves, combos, and super moves. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and kick, punch, and slash your way to victory, before it's too late. Do you have what it takes?

title: Power Network Tycoon
description: Manage a power network on a growing island. Use industry simulation methods to handle electricity demands, weather challenges and ensure safety. Developed by a Power Engineer, it offers realistic electricity management gameplay, combining strategy and real-world engineering challenges.

title: Industrix
description: Step into the world of industrial production and become a master in factory-building! Create efficient production lines and manage your resources. As you progress through the game, you'll need to complete challenges for a certain company in order to rank up and unlock new technologies!

title: Lillysia
description: Find herbs to cure your pet from illness.

title: Illegal Plantation
description: It’s time to leave it all behind and do a dance with the law. Build your own illegal plantation, plant your weed, water them, maintain good air temperature and good lighting. Deliver your goods or hire local dealers for it. Get rid of the competition and build your own monopoly.

title: Mion and the Cursed Killer Hamster
description: The Magnificent Mion is a warrior queen from Wharevarland. She battles a malignant verse-making kraken, tries to win the love of Count De Loboda, studies at an ordinary magical school, and she's also... crazy! Absurdism. Ridiculousness. Idiocy.

title: The Human Story
description: The Human Story is a hidden object game set in a colorful, historically accurate miniature world. Explore different cultures and ages. Find characters, objects and little stories about our ancestors. Learn about their lives and piece together the history of humankind.

title: Band of Mercenaries
description: Band of Mercenaries is a couch one-hit kill respawning arena game in which your lives (respawns) are the mercenaries you hired. To win you can either be good on the battlefield or have money sense to make the battle unbalance from the start.

title: There's no way that tsundere girl I met in the infirmary will be my girlfriend
description: "B-baka! Who said you could get in!? I'm not prepared yet!" "Oh well... since you're already here, why not stay for a while?" "D-don't misunderstand, okay? It's not like I asked you to stay because I like you or anything..."

title: Songs of Glimmerwick
description: Become immersed in a musical woodland fantasy world where casting a spell is as easy as playing a song. Attend classes, grow the university garden, make friends with classmates and townsfolk, and explore the island’s many oddities and mysteries in this story-driven witch academy RPG.

title: Behind the Beyond
description:
Behind the Beyond is a point & click adventure set in a magical world of Hungarian folklore. Johnny, the youngest son of a poor man sets off to find a job, and on his way uncovers all sorts of magical mysteries in the kingdom.

The game mixes classic point & click mechanics with some RPG elements e.g. skills that can be improved, or equipment that can be changed.

title: Leonardo's Island
description: Leonardo's Island is a video game for PC. Follow the story, discover the mystery of the Island and find the Treasure! It is all about sandbox, exploring, battles and trading with another players. Build your own ship and sell it to other players! Build a flying machine and go to another Island!

title: Creep
description: Experimental dark platform game that takes place inside a struggled man's inner world represented as the worm world. You control the worm form of this man as he shows why this world exists and how it's like to live there. You also visit past memories/analogies and gain new abilities.

title: Fish the Web
description:
Fish the Web is a multiplayer fishing game on a small pixel art island. Every other fisher you see is a real person, so the pier and the pond fill up with people casting lines and cheering each other's catches.

When something bites, hold to keep the fish inside the green bar until it gives up. Sell what you catch at the stall to buy better rods and bait, and fill your Fishdex with over 200 fish, from minnows to a Kraken that only comes out on stormy nights. Day and night follow your own clock, and plenty of fish keep their own hours. Later on you can fix up an old wreck on the beach and sail it out to a big shared ship on the open sea.

title: Fuck This Job
description: Play as Jake, a janitor threatened to be replaced by AI machines, then subsequently fired. Grab your super vacuum cleaner, use it to hoover and destroy everything in your path in this AI-infected company! Shoot and kick everything that is in your path to show your capabilities as a great employee.

title: The Wheelchair Man 2
description: Steal $5,000 from a new apartment complex full of shady business owners while avoiding their demented landlord - The Wheelchair Man.

title: The Great Release
description: Don’t get caught farting in the meeting! In this stealth-comedy game, you must strategically vent your mounting "pressure" by timing farts around office distractions.

title: Wuthering Waves: Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination
MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
description: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights is a Sudoku game set in an observatory at night. Every day all players get the same Nightly puzzle, and each solve adds a star to the player's sky, where the stars gradually join into constellations. A cat sits on the observatory's window ledge and walks along the top of the board, reacting to mistakes and to streaks of correct answers; it can be petted and given one of eight coats. The game also includes 5,000 offline puzzles across four difficulties, ten switchable background worlds, an in-game lo-fi radio with optional ambient sounds, and an optional account for Nightly leaderboards.

title: Divergence: Fracture
description:
Divergence: Fracture is a top-down tactical space combat game featuring single player battles against AI opponents and online multiplayer. Players control individual warships equipped with different weapon systems and abilities across several arena-based game modes.

Combat features Newtonian movement, directional armor, projectile penetration, localized hull damage, and internal ship modules that can be damaged or destroyed. Players manage weapons, energy, and repair systems while engaging enemy vessels. The game includes multiple ship classes, customizable weapon loadouts, and progression based unlocks.

title: Wreck Below
description: Wreck Below is an underwater horror game where you dismantle wrecks and avoid the unseen threat of The Arbiter.

title: Foxy's Potion Shop
description: Join Foxy in its little cabin in the middle of the Magical Forest as the new potion crafter! All the inhabitants of the Forest are thrilled that you moved in to perform the art of brewing in a cauldron!

title: Cargo Delivery Simulator
description: Cargo Delivery Simulator is a relaxed delivery game where you ride motorcycles through a 3D city, completing 10 timed routes with multiple stops while managing fuel and meeting deadlines. Earn credits from successful deliveries to unlock new bikes from a garage of 11 motorcycles, each with its own handling. Navigate using clear route guidance, monitor your fuel and time with a motorcycle-inspired interface, and enjoy a laid-back urban soundtrack as you progress through increasingly complex delivery assignments.

title: The Hermetic Tower
description: The Hermetic Tower is a narrative-driven dark fantasy visual novel with dungeon-crawler elements about desire, consequence, and the choices we justify when something important is waiting at the end.

title: Cosmo Cat: A Cozy Desktop Idler
description: An emotional desktop idle game where you spend time with your own cat floating through space and record your day as constellations.

title: A Walk Through Kramfors
description:
Wake up inside your own forgotten life in A Walk Through Kramfors, an eerie point-and-click adventure set in a decaying industrial town in northern Sweden. The streets feel familiar. The rooms feel occupied. But reality keeps shifting, and nothing is quite where you left it.

Wander through Kramfors, pick up what you find along the way, and solve small, unsettling puzzles to piece together what happened. Some chapters break the pace with side-scrolling sequences, and the whole story can be played in about 30 minutes.

title: Possessed By Fate
description: After a ghost takes her apartment, a ghost hunter becomes the hunted—with her body the prize. This yuri visual novel is fully voiced and around 20k words long.

title: House Rules
description: Ten rooms of a castle on a hill, and one house rule in each. House Rules is a first-person horror game set in a Toronto castle: learn each room's rule and keep it, and fight off what you can with the furniture, because if you break a rule, the Butler comes for you, and he can't be hurt.

title: Way of the Hunter 2: Night Hunting Pack
Way of the Hunter 2: Heirloom Pack
Way of the Hunter 2: Lodge Decoration
Praise Be Evangeline
description:
Praise Be Evangeline is a horror yandere visual novel, play as Saintess Evangeline and her ever-loving knight Therion to bring joy back to the realm, one smile at a time.

Once upon a time, in a kingdom weary of war and hunger, there was a little girl who dreamed of becoming a Saintess.

For a hundred years, the holy seat sat empty. Then, at last, the light chose her.

She walks among the suffering and lifts their grief away with her own two hands. Villages that once wept now greet her with smiles. Clerics bless her name in the halls, and even the far eastern provinces have heard of her miracles.

And, oh, of course. every Saintess needs a knight.

Someone who swears his whole life to her, which is rather more than the oath asks for. He guards her door through the night and counts her every breath, so that not a single one goes missing. Isn't that so very romantic?

Together they will travel the kingdom, soul by soul, until there is not a tear left to fall.

Surely that is the happiest ending of all!

title: Drill Bird: Cursed Mode
description: In Cursed Mode, a demon offers to make your child supremely powerful - but to do so you must be reincarnated into a brand new world filled with new puzzles, enemies and secrets. You’ll find the difficulty has been raised a notch, designed as a natural continuation of the base game.

title: QuizLobby
description: Create your quiz lobby here and invite your friends. Choose a format, join using a code, and start playing together right away—featuring colors, country silhouettes, German license plates, and an "imposter" mode.

title: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - Moshimo, L'Antica ja Nakattara
The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - A.X.E.8: Houkago Climax Girls
description: The third story chapter in the A.X.E.8 Project, which will redefine all the idols groups. This one focus on Houkago Climax Girls' Kaho, Juri, Rinze, Chiyoko and Sakuya

title: Camp Whittlewood
description: Camp Whittlewood is an old-school horror RPG. You've been dropped off for a weekend of outdoor fun, but soon find bullies are the least of your problems when a twisted campfire story begins to come true.

title: Island of Rebirth: NTR and Love
description: A mysterious island suddenly appears at sea. Rick, a protagonist suffering from amnesia, encounters two beautiful girls, Sienna and Mila. The three embark on a journey of exploration across the island.

title: Cancel Subscription Simulator
description: Cancel Subscription Simulator is a dark comedic puzzle game about navigating 30 levels of absurd corporate dark UX patterns, evasive buttons, impossible CAPTCHAs, and manipulative chatbots.

title: Needle In A Haystack
description: The original game. Find a needle hidden in millions of hay pieces with your friends.

title: Late Checkout
description: A short atmospheric horror about a night shift at a snowed-in motel. Winter 1999: a highway cut off from the world and a list of chores. Clean the rooms, drink your coffee, cross off line after line. But when the lights go out, ordinary work becomes survival. Just a flashlight, a cat and 3 endings.

title: Pigkour
description: Pigkour is a third-person parkour game where you play as a pig escaping the Bacon House. Leap across flying food, kitchen equipment, and chaotic obstacles as you climb through the nightmare restaurant. Find your way to freedom and chase your dream of becoming a Wizard Pig.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered
description:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered modernizes the acclaimed role-playing game with a range of upgrades and enhancements. Become monster slayer for hire Geralt of Rivia and journey across a dark fantasy open world in an epic quest to find your adopted daughter Ciri.

The Remastered update is free for players who own The Witcher 3 and includes both Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions.

title: Tiny Flock
description: From the creators of Human Fall Flat – Tiny Flock, a cosy, physics-based VR puzzle game for all ages. Help guide your adorable wayward sheep through beautiful hand-crafted diorama puzzles using the environment around you to get them to safety!

title: Tempest Rising: The Vetis Wrath
description: Take command of the fractured Veti to reclaim what is rightfully yours. Subjugate your foes and use them as tools to sacrifice for your goals in the conquest for vengeance against enemies both new and older than humanity itself.

title: Minecraft Dungeons II - Deluxe DLC
description:
Includes:
• Soul Cape
• Blub Pet
• 4 Hero Skins

title: Endless Rails
description: Protect your train with your drones as it rolls through a monster-infested wasteland. Reach new stations to buy new weapons, wagons, and upgrades. Keep rolling until you or the game crashes. Isometric bullet heaven roguelite.

title: Late Order
