description: Night shifts at a cursed 24/7 diner. Every night — new rules and unsettling events. Fulfill orders, don't annoy the bizarre monster in the mascot's body, and maybe you'll have a chance to survive until dawn.

title: Car Factory Tycoon
description: Build cars step-by-step in a factory sim. Design vehicles, build your garage layout, hire and train workers, manage parking inventory, and sell cars through customer orders or walk-in buyers as you expand your operation.

title: The Last Camp: Dawn
description: The Last Camp is a post-apocalyptic world-themed game. It utilizes high-quality graphics, a rich weapon and item system, and a vast world map to create a cross-generational twin-stick shooter, bringing a feast to hardcore shooter players.

title: Otpisani: Nightingale
description: A retro shooter game inspired by an old TV show. You play as a part of the resistance movement fighting the German occupation in a set of explosive missions while experiencing an exciting story.

title: Dog in the Machine
description: A tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans. Teach the dog custom tricks to tackle strategic challenges through devastating chain reactions. Break the Machine in your path to freedom!

title: Minecraft Dungeons II
description: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day.

title: Project - Labyrinth
description: A fantasy turn-based, grid-based dungeon crawler RPG with a blackjack-style card system that drives combat and skill execution.

title: Escape from 8-Bit High
description: When a cursed cassette awakens a sentient Pomodore 64, Cloudydale High is overrun by 8-bit villains! Join alt-rock trio Blueberry Finn—Hank, Duck, and Alex—as they battle mole men, aliens, dinosaurs and more in a bizarre, musical quest to save the world!

title: Baby Lemonade
description: A non-linear surrealist adventure about a man trapped in his dreams while a company wants to buy them for broadcast. An immersive, open-ended exploration between psychedelic dreamlands and fragmented realities, where you can follow various bizzare objectives, find hidden paths, or try to wake up!

title: Dicevaders
description: Build an army of alien invaders to invade the Earth in DiceVaders, the roguelike dice game set in the same universe as StarVaders!

title: The Starfallen Prince
description: The Starfallen Prince, an action-RPG bullet heaven where an invasion shatters Belden’s world, Losing everything he held dear. Driven by loss, he escapes into the wilds to begin a journey of survival, revenge and the fate of his people.

title: Way of the Hunter 2
description: Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the North American wilderness and the African Savanna. Hunt and display big game like Moose, and Cape Buffalo as well as, smaller animals and birds.

title: Blitz
description: Blitz is a challenging, fast-paced platformer with infinite procedurally generated levels. Build a new unique character each run and fight one action-packed room after another! Dropkick, decapitate, and incinerate your foes. Do you have what it takes to conquer Blitz?

title: Little Nightmares III: The Shores
description: Low and Alone, reunited, traveled through the mirror. Without Dime, it's once again just the two of them. The filthy stones, the fishy smell, the damp wind, there is no doubt they have reached The Shores. The overwhelming fog is regularly pierced by the lighthouse beacon. From up there, they will find their way. Low’s map says so. It must be true.

title: System Clues
description: Play as a secret agent of a mysterious organization and complete complex plot investigation tasks through network infiltration, social engineering, and digital investigation. Is it justice or sin?

title: Frutiger Home
description: Decorate your dream frutiger home in this cozy co-op frutiger house decorating game. Pick a home layout, add from a wide range of frutiger-themed decor and hang out with your friends!

title: American Truck Simulator: Ford Car Pack
description: Engines at the ready! Hit the highways of American Truck Simulator like never before with the Ford Car Pack, a DLC add-on for the new Road Trip gameplay module!

title: Wizzo PopOut
description: Wizzo Popout is a fast-paced, 3D top-down arena shooter for up to 4 players. Play as an arcane wizzo riding a bouncing magic bubble! Cast cool spells, dodge enemy blasts, and knock your rivals out of the arena in hilariously chaotic battles.

title: Gamer Stop Simulator
description: Gamer Stop Simulator is a simulation game where you manage a video game store. Buy games and consoles from customers, repair broken devices, test games, and add rare items to your collection. Negotiate prices, expand your store, and grow your business in this exciting retail experience!

title: King's Guard
description: In this turn-based strategy roguelike your job is to keep an ungrateful king alive. As the royal guard's manager you unlock upgrades, assign badges for special skills and try to keep morale and supplies from collapsing faster than the monarchy.

title: Transport Fever 3
description: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

title: Petal Crash 2
description: The freshest in arcade puzzle action blossoms again! Crash blocks together into dazzling chain reactions in a puzzle like no other - now completely refreshed with refined gameplay, arcade graphics, brand new game modes, and dazzling special attacks!

title: Toem 2
description: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

title: Blades & Battles
description: Blades & Battles is a fantasy Beat'Em Up game that takes players to the heart of the legendary world of King Arthur in his barbarian youth. A modern version of classic titles such as Golden Axe.

title: Unwell
description: You regain consciousness. Beside you lies a broken and rusted ladder, and in front of you stretches a dark, damp-smelling corridor. In the distance, you hear the sound of falling water. You have no idea where you are. All you know is that you must go deeper.

title: The Merlies
description: Meet the Merlies, a tiny birds community trying to find harmony in a world where the remains of an ancient civilisation are still visible. Build your village ingeniously, gather your birdies and explore this way-too-big world in this cute post-apocalyptic adventure ! Ready to spread your wings?

title: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
description: NEIGHBORS: Suburban Warfare is a lighthearted, team-based PvP game about neighborhood warfare! Deploy traps and barricades to defend your own house. Use the tools from your surroundings to acquire crazy item to get the better of your Neighbors!

title: Nivalis Nights
description: Grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in Nivalis, the city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds.

title: Anna: The Series Test
description: Join the Anna Series testing program Volunteer! Unique stories and decisions change how your test plays out. Meet Alleyne's 5 replicas, guide them toward humanity. Don't dare get comfortable, as each phase you'll power down 1 machine sentencing her to an unknown fate. Yet, are they really machines?

title: Island Idle RPG: Build and Conquer
description: Lead a team of fox workers to build a thriving settlement, gather resources, and craft powerful gear. Prepare your leader to explore dungeons, defeat bosses, and bring home valuable loot as you conquer new islands in this relaxing idle RPG.

title: Find the Needle: One in Ten Million
description: Find one needle in ten million strands of straw. Gather by hand, build an automated workshop, and follow the needle through your production lines.

title: Cards of Calling
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you command summoned creatures in battle. Build your deck, create powerful synergies, and fight alongside your pack in tactical turn-based combat.

title: Sneak Cheese
description:
Get ready to think fast, plan carefully, and try not to become dinner in Sneak Cheese, a cozy and strategic puzzle game where a tiny mouse must push every piece of cheese into the burrows while trying to survive cats that are always ready to pounce!

Every move matters. Push the cheese through the environment, find the right path to the burrows, and turn every space on the board into part of your strategy. But don't think it will be that simple. With every valid move you make, the cats react too, and knowing exactly when they will move can mean the difference between a perfect escape and a disastrous capture!

You will encounter different types of cats, each with its own behavior. Some remain stationary but attack anything that appears directly in front of them. Others patrol the environment after every move you make, while the slower ones wait for the right moment to advance. Watch their routes, track their cycles, and plan every step before putting yourself in danger!

Across 30 handcrafted levels, divided into 3 different biomes, new challenges and increasingly clever combinations will put your reasoning to the test. You will need to figure out the right order for pushing the cheese, avoid getting trapped, predict the cats' movements, and make sure the little mouse stays alive until the final piece of cheese reaches its destination.

title: Lan House Simulator
description: Lan House Simulator is a simulation game that attempts to recreate the chaos of Brazilian LAN houses in the 2000s. Here, you must manage your LAN center, organize tournaments, set up workstations, and deal with customers, featuring various management mechanics and mini-games that turn everything into total chaos.

title: Florana Defense
description: Incremental Mazing Tower Defense game where you do not loose anything, just earn more and more gold to buy towers, mobs and upgrades to earn more gold.

title: Coffee In Space
description: Coffee In Space is a reskin of Freddy In Space from FNAF World, play as Coffee as he attempts to take the spotlight back from FNAF by infiltrating an upcoming FNAF spinoff!

title: Never Enough Corn
description:
Never Enough Corn is an incremental farming game.
Harvest massive amounts of corn and try your luck at finding the 0.00001% rare corn.

title: Crime Podcast: 1976
description: Thomas Hayes, a 63-year-old FBI special agent, returned home after his last day on the job before retiring. He needs to prepare the documents he keeps at home to turn them over to the FBI, but the evidence he chose to hide many years ago is coming to light again.

title: Deskrawl: Idle ARPG
description: Grind mobs, farm loot and capture enemies to serve you. Deskrawl is an epic idle ARPG that plays at the bottom of your desktop. Farm legendary items and build overpowered heroes while you work or chill.

title: Vinyl Store: Tidy Up!
description: Vinyl Store: Tidy Up! is a cozy single-player simulation where you clean up a messy record store. Sort and place 4,281 vinyl records and CDs, find the best way to organize the store, and compete with other players for the fastest time.

title: Sort of Magic
description: A cozy organizing game for 1–4 players in online co-op. You're a little magical cat who knocked over an entire magic school. Now put all 4,500 books, potions, and brooms back exactly where they belong. Learn sorting spells, split the rooms with friends, and restore the mess you made.

title: Debt of Life
description: You have money. You have a home. You have a family. And you're dying. You have very little time left. Make impossible choices and decide what you're willing to sacrifice for one more week of life.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise
description: Version 4.6 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes: • New character: Pearl • New Trailblaze Mission: "Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise" • New events • ...and more!

title: Mito's School in Basics
description: Just don't make any answers wrong, because Mito will find you after wrong answers with the Mathpad from notebooks

title: By Royal Request
description: Every kingdom begins with a letter. A cozy fantasy incremental: the crown asks, and you fill each request by hand — chopping, smelting, building, hiring and carrying every armful yourself. No fail states, no deadlines, nothing ever lost.

title: My Zombies Are Hungry
description: Grow a handful of zombies into a city-eating swarm of hundreds in this darkly comic incremental auto-battler. Launch short raids, buy permanent upgrades, build new zombie types from swappable body parts, and devour settlements while humanity escalates from police to tanks and airstrikes.

title: Silly Potato: Home-Run Edition
description: Your mouse is a floating baseball bat. Smack a googly-eyed potato for ten seconds to stack uncapped damage, then release a Mega Swing and launch it screaming into the sky. Snag coin clusters mid-flight, buy upgrades in the Spud Shop, and chase feet on the world leaderboard. It has been chosen.

title: Greenhouse: Tidy Up!
description: Greenhouse: Tidy Up! is a cozy single-player simulation where you bring order to a messy greenhouse. Sort and place hundreds of flowers and plants, find the best way to organize everything, and compete with other players for the fastest time.

title: Emberglade
description: A roguelike slot machine you actually play. Spin to survive, loot relics that rewrite the reels, and bet your gold against a rising toll — or die broke on the road to Shadowkeep.

title: Battle Meating
description: Survive without getting burned! BATTLE MEATING is a local multiplayer party game for 1–4 players. Become a Meat and fight to be the last one standing. Bring your controllers and battle with up to 4 players locally. Enjoy a wacky, chaotic meat party!

title: Galaxy Critter Co.
description: Galaxy Critter Co. is a cute chaotic roguelike where tower defense meets top-down shooting: build by day, fight by night, and craft broken synergies to survive the Swarm.

title: H.O.A Simulator
description: HOA Sim is a comedic suburban patrol game where you enforce neighborhood rules as an overzealous homeowners association officer. Cruise the streets, inspect properties, issue citations, and chase your daily fine quota while balancing speed, accuracy, and pure petty power.

title: Twin Hotel, Spa, and More
description:
TWIN Hotel, Spa and More is a minimalist, point-and-click interactive experience.

You begin confined to an elevator cabin. Operate the lift and serve the hotel's guests using the control panel.

After serving enough guests, you can leave the elevator and move around using the joystick on your wheelchair.

Your next assignment is waiting in another elevator.

title: A Maze in Labyrinth
description: Get lost... in the labyrinth. Explore the interconnected maze to find the "exit." Race, climb, and slide through the multiple areas, and try solving the mystery of the “Amazing Labyrinth” in the process.

title: AE: Archeological Expedition
description: Explore dig sites inspired by real locations, from Petra to Pompeii, and unearth artifacts spanning 10 historical eras. Brush away the centuries, discover the stories behind each find, and fill your journal one careful dig at a time

title: Clawless Coin
description: Ever won something from a claw machine? Neither has this one. Clawless Coin is a cozy incremental arcade idler where you run a neon-lit claw machine arcade, chase six tiers of trophy plushes, and prestige into trillions of tokens. Grab big. Grip harder. Grow your empire.

title: Exaverse
description: Extinction of the Exaverse is a mobile roguelike where evolved dinosaurs fight back against invading AI machines. Players progress through biome-based runs, choosing powerful upgrades and building unique combat styles each attempt.

title: Project DevourSlime
description: A platformer… but you can take the platforms with you!?Control DevourSlime and solve puzzles by absorbing and shooting out the platforms near you.Battle corrupted lab machinery and hostile contaminants, stay ahead of the toxic gas, and rescue your companions.Plan your own unique escape route!

title: Radiotext
description: Radiotext is an interactive story set in the near future, where communication without intrusion requires radio-waves. Dive into a cryptographic radio-net in this text-based rpg, where you need to think carefully before typing your answers.

title: Humanize Robotics
description: Command a robot that thinks for itself. You choose the destination; its neural network battles the physics. Struggle through brutal obstacle courses, evolve your body with collected data, and master the chaos of movement. Lose a leg? Keep crawling. The Company is watching.

title: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
description: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.

title: Paddle Legends
description: A chaotic roguelite twist on classic retro arcade-style gameplay. Unlock paddles, grab upgrades, and new ball powers as you battle through dynamic levels, obstacles, and bosses across three campaigns and an endless mode.

title: Unshine Arcade
description: An arcade full of secrets, a sentient virtual pet in the prize cabinet, a stealth shooter roguelite arcade machine and one way to escape: win tickets.

title: Space Cat Solitaire
description:
Space Cat Solitaire is a euphoric and satisfying puzzle card game adventure. With cats.

Stack, organize and pros-purr! Hone your puzzling skills as you create epic combos, beat your high score and find your fortune among the stars! Use your wits & your winnings to unlock customizations, trophies, and elite story-driven missions featuring the eccentric locals of the Whiskerfang Expanse.

title: Tour: Chess Puzzles
description: Elegant, varied and challenging chess-themed puzzles. No prior knowledge of chess is needed.

title: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
description: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

title: HR: Human Remains
description: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

title: Bug Cleaners
description: Are you ready to stop the bug invasion? Fight off the invaders either solo or cooperatively with your team using extraordinary tools! Enjoy fun moments in chaotic missions — bug hunting has never been this exciting!

title: Sauna Simulator
description: Run your own sauna: buy a room, equip it with an oven and start earning money from it. Hire employees, ensure safety and, of course, have fun!

title: The Bell Echoes
description: The Bell Echoes is a turn-based strategy game that combines SRPG-style storytelling with roguelike gameplay.

title: One Fenix Down
description: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

title: Drop Command
description: The year is 2647. War rages 150 light years from Earth. Pilot Mechs, Tanks, Infantry and Aircraft in combined arms combat on many worlds across the star cluster. Play as a lone wolf, or rise in rank to manage and lead entire battalions into combat throughout a procedural campaign.

title: PSI: Pressure Climbing
description: A movement-based climbing game where you ascend on a suicide mission to save an amphibian cargo cult.

title: Ammossum
description: Build an endlessly upgradable weapon! Evolve projectiles into unstoppable firepower in this action roguelike. Fight through hordes of infected beasts, save your family, and feel the thrill of bloody shootouts filled with bullets, explosions, and acid. Can you survive the madness?

title: Glider Sim
description: Experience the ultimate sensation of gliding through the sky! Built for real glider pilots in mind this simulator is as close to real as it gets. The sim can be played outside VR or inside VR.

title: Horror Golf
description: Minigolf game with darker horror themed maps. 2 different levels with totally 28 holes. Play alone and try to make good score

title: Pelloche
description:
Pelloche is a cinema trading-card game played in the browser.

Open packs drawn from a ranked catalogue of films, directors, composers, actors and actresses, build a collection across five rarities and five finishes, chase the 1/1 uniques that can only ever be claimed once, complete sets, and trade with other players.

Packs refill on a timer, and every draw is resolved server-side.

title: SMS Returns
description: The official remake of the 2012 viral hit Slenderman's Shadow is out! A faceless, slender man hunts you across your favourite maps. Survive with friends in multiplayer, immerse yourself in VR, and build your own terrifying maps with the in-game editor. He is ready. Are you?

title: Dead Position
description:
Dead Position is a chess roguelike. Each round is a fresh game of chess against an engine on a 3D board: the player has ten moves and three take-backs to reach a score target, and every move scores chips × mult, from quiet moves through captures, checks, forks, pins, skewers and discovered attacks up to checkmate. Chaining tactics builds a streak that raises the mult of the next move.

Between rounds, players buy Gambits, passive cards that alter scoring and in some cases the rules of chess, along with study packs and card editions. The opponent, the Host, alters the board with Blaze and Frost events, and each ante ends with a boss lieutenant who imposes a special rule. A run consists of four antes of four rounds, and lost pieces stay lost unless bought back in the shop.

The game also includes free play against four engine levels, tutorial lessons and a Blitz mode played against the clock.

title: PartyCade
description: PartyCade is a free collection of multiplayer party games played in a web browser. One player creates a room and shares a link or a five-letter code, and the others join from their own phones or computers, either as guests or with an account. The collection includes drawing and guessing games, social deduction games, word games, comedy writing games, a card game and a property-trading board game, including Doodle Deck, Who Am I?, Impostor, Mafia, Code Words, Doodle Telephone, Punchline Duel, Bluffalo, Split Decision, Last Card and Party Tycoon. A Party Shuffle mode plays a series of random games with random rules and keeps an overall score. Players with an account earn XP, level up and can add friends. The game is available in English, German and Arabic.

title: Torbjorn and the Birthday Cake Mishap
Nova Origin
description: Explore, scan, and conquer an unknown world. Deploy rovers, uncover hidden resources, and build a fully automated colony that must survive, adapt, and scale.

title: SMS 207
description: You’re heading home on a late-night Jeepney down Roxas Boulevard, passing passengers' bayad (payment) to the driver while keeping your head down. But as ominous text messages begin flooding your phone, a quiet commute quickly turns into a desperate negotiation. Someone knows where you are, someone knows what you owe and they’re guiding you toward a destination you never planned to visit.

title: Dust Rapture
description: Stranded on Route 66 after your truck is stripped for parts, explore the abandoned town of Iron Creek, survive its horrors, evade a murderous cult, and escape before it consumes everything.

title: Nightmare Neighborhood
description: Nightmare Neighborhood is a trick-or-treating roguelike visual novel where you must manage your resources, wear different costumes to double dip houses, all to collect as much candy as you can without getting eaten by the monsters who inhabit the Neighborhood.

title: Hall of Mirrors
description: Five people on one computer, really? Yes, this fast-action arcade-style multiplayer game is for the whole family! Shoot balloons with your lasers to score points – but the beams will often bounce off mirrors, creating interesting and complex shots. The more complex, the greater the score!

title: Star Space
description: A starship shooter — Play Online/LAN Team Deathmatch, or Deathmatch on 3 levels. Or practice by breaking the targets.

title: Platform Chess
description: Platform Chess combines classic board strategy with platform-fighting combat. Plan your moves, battle for captures, and master the unique abilities of every chess piece in local matches or against the computer.

title: Shopping Cart Pusher
description: Experience the supermarket version of Grand Theft "Shopping Cart"! This is no easy job. You'll need plenty of patience, a sharp mind, and nimble hands to become a qualified shopping cart pusher, otherwise, I guarantee you'll never find all the carts!

title: Billion Egg Farm
description: Billion Egg Farm is a first-person automation game where you put chickens to work laying eggs and build production lines for eggs, meat, and processed goods.

title: Death Delivery
description: Death Delivery is satisfying, fast-paced First Person Shooter with stylized slow motion,music, action and old-school trial-and-error difficulty.

title: Whiskers on Time's Corner
description: In a beautiful small town, you are a lively and adorable cat, experiencing a rich and colorful life, exploring and enjoying the joys only cats understand, while helping your friends find a happy ending together.

title: Lobstar: Arcade Version
description: Punch through the cosmos! An arcade-inspired shoot-em-up where you play as an immortal lobster speeding through space.

title: Glamour Riot
description: This is an absurd and hilarious action game where you play as a beauty pageant contestant. Ruthlessly beat up your rivals backstage while delivering flawless performances on stage. Ruin their faces, knock them out, and impersonate them to sabotage everything. You’ll become the beauty queen!

title: Undead Exile
description: A first-person action RPG where you play as a mercenary in a post-apocalyptic world, fighting zombies and monsters. Collect points to upgrade your character, modify weapons, and stack stats like damage, crits, and accuracy. Intense combat with diverse gameplay and rich combinations.

title: Zen Beauty
description: Beautiful women in swimsuits, a picturesque courtyard, and flashes of inspiration captured from the mind—this is an idle game that requires minimal operation. A wide variety of decorations and outfits can be purchased using points earned through idling.

title: Cats in Wonderland
description: The Queen of Hearts had a fit of rage after the Cheshire Cat refused to be her pet and ordered the capture of all the cats in Wonderland. Find them before her and prevent anything bad from happening.

title: Dr. Mancell and Mr. Flame
description:
Short homage game to go with the song collaboration between Waterflame and Josh Mancell, composer of the original Crash Bandicoot! Just in time for the 30th anniversary (unintentionally)!

We always thought the boss fights of the original classic games like these were the most fun part but too short and unsatisfying. This scratches that itch and lets you duke it out in an unending 1v1 fashion with the boss continuously escalating in difficulty!

title: Dying Land
description: Welcome to Dying Land. An equipment-driven loot-and-slash game blended with cozy life-sim activities like farming and fishing. Earn money, explore, and fight! Grow stronger with every cycle as you search for a way to change your fate.

title: The Cradle: Episode 01
description:
The Cradle: Episode 01 is a free first-person psychological horror game played in a web browser on PC or phone.

The game combines exploration, environmental storytelling and stealth. The player searches the sanatorium and the station beneath it, pieces the story together from notes, tapes and radio calls, and hides from a creature that hunts by sound. A playthrough takes about an hour and leads to one of three endings.

title: Hold Your Breath
description: Toronto, 3:40 AM. They can't see you, but they can hear you. Hold Your Breath is a first-person stealth horror game in which blind creatures hunt the empty city streets by sound, including the sound your microphone picks up, so you have to move quietly and hold your breath to reach the tower. The microphone is optional. Your microphone never leaves your device. Nothing is recorded, kept or sent.

title: Corrida: Chega De Intocavéis
description:
Made infamous for its heavy usage of AI-generated visuals, controversial political satire and unauthorized usage of a popular gaming influencer's likeness in its advertisements, Corrida: Chega De Intocavéis is a browser-based online kart racer developed for Brazilian presidential candidate Romeu Zema's 2026 campaign.

Shortly after Zema's defeat in the first round of the elections, the game was taken offline.

title: Mercenaries: Recompiled
description: Mercenaries: Recompiled is a recompilation project dedicated to preserving and modernizing Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction, the explosive open-world action game developed by Pandemic Studios.

title: Voltus' Neon Nightmare - Colossal Cure
description: After the previous events, you realized that this "mall" place was a trap to send you to another dimension, full of liminal and unknown places. Voltus is now controlled by the Core's energy, forced to keep you away from it.

title: Souls Runner
description: Souls Runner is a 3D Hell escape game. Trapped souls cooperate in local or online multiplayer, using hooks, rolls, and ground pounds to conquer traps and evade The Pursuer.

title: Fuel Sort
description: Sort fuel cells into matching canisters in this sci-fi puzzle game. Pick up cells from the top of a canister and drop them onto matching colors or empty spaces. Solve 1000 levels with as few moves as possible, climb the global leaderboards and unlock achievements.

title: Parkour Obby: Ice Escape
description: Can you escape the frozen course?

title: Missed Class: Horror
description: Some schools should stay abandoned.

title: Pro Wrestling Tycoon
description: Pro Wrestling Tycoon is a day-by-day wrestling promotion management sim. Book shows, manage contracts and storylines, negotiate network deals, and compete in a living industry of rival companies, news, and backstage drama. Deep modding and Steam Workshop support let you shape the universe.

title: Versus One
description: Play as various giant monsters, or as the heroes attempting to defeat them in this asymmetric two player local co-op VR fighting game. Send forth minions and swing massive weapons or rocket jump around the stage and strike at them as they attempt to take you down!

title: Sector 13: Haunted Woods
description: Sector 13: Haunted Woods is a 1–4 player co op horror game. You are field agents sent into a cursed forest filled with anomalies. Explore mysterious zones, recover forbidden artifacts, and survive the darkness where every sound you make could mean death.

title: Stranded With You
description: In this survival game, you are stranded on an tropical island with your lovely friend Mitsuki. Explore your surroundings together, build a small shelter, and hunt for supplies. Have fun keeping up with all the heat!

title: Fechtbucher
description: Fechtbucher - Uber-Realistic Medieval game, with Melee Combat based on Physics. Participate in tournaments, or explore the dungeons to uncover a dark story. Master guards and strikes inspired by HEMA, straight out of medieval guidebooks.

title: Hyperboard Extreme
description: Hyperboard Extreme revives PS2-era arcade-style racing with cool girls, crazy powerups, and intense, speedy action.

title: Truck Titans
description: TRUCK TITANS is a high-octane monster truck racing game with 9+ levels of intense action. Customize your truck, pick sponsors, and compete in score attacks and races across city arenas, deserts, and night tracks. Nail stunts, crush obstacles, and become a monster truck legend.

title: Horde Slayer
description: A fast-paced co-op action game where you customize your build, survive relentless hordes, and conquer brutal challenges for higher scores and bragging rights.

title: Spellcaster University: Gears and Gobelins
description: Dive into an epic new chapter of Spellcaster University's magical world with the "Steam Age" expansion!

title: Depth Diver
description: Depth Diver is a co-op game where you go on an underwater trip with your friends to gather resources and repair underwater facilities in dangerous waters.

title: The Handler of Dragons
description: In the RPG game The Handler of Dragons you play as a warrior who can speak to the dragons. How did it happen? What will be the consequences? Are you going to protect dragons at all costs? How far will you go to obtain their power? The adventure begins...

title: Center Ice Hockey
description: Fast, physical ice hockey game. Launch blistering slapshots, saucer passes, hit opponents down on to the ice, then drop your gloves to answer the call. Play exhibition, a full season, or a multi-season career with your friends sharing one team.

title: Tiny Brutalism
description: Tiny Brutalism is a relaxing diorama building game based on brutalist architecture. Create strange monuments, impossible structures, concrete towers, or just a really big wall. Then explore inside them in first person. There’s no goal and no right way to build. Make whatever you feel like making.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
description:
When people start dying in the Palais Garnier opera house, up-and-coming soprano, Christine Daaé finds herself at the center of a dark obsession. Can Christine break free from the clutches of the Phantom of the Opera?

Or will she remain haunted by him forever?

title: Runes Quest
description: Runes Quest is a sokoban-like puzzle game where you guide a knight through 30 levels across light and dark biomes on their journey home. Navigate rooms filled with interactive elements like buttons, grates, keys, runes, boxes, pits, and traps using logic and careful planning. Enjoy cute visuals and relaxing music as you solve increasingly complex spatial puzzles.

title: Retro Cube Slider
description:
Dozens of engaging single-screen sliding puzzles! Retro goodness! Crazy contraptions to master!

Anyone can play Retro Cube Slider, just press the direction button and let the stylish neon cube slide away!

title: Deadline Day
description: Deadline Day is a live sports auction you play with friends on your phones. Everyone gets 100M of play money, players come up one at a time, and the highest bid when the clock runs out wins him. When the squads are full, you pick your lineup and the match is simulated: the stronger team always wins, and every manager gets a verdict on how they bid. Six sports (football, basketball, handball, ice hockey, racing and esports), plus Imposter and Guess the player for the same group. Put it on a TV with deadlineday.app/tv and everyone joins by scanning a QR code. Free for up to 4 players in the browser, no download and no sign-up.

title: Abyss: The Last Night of the Titania
description: You wake in Cabin 47, nine decks below the boat deck of a sinking liner. Abyss is a first-person horror escape game: every deck floods on its own clock and has its own monster, and the Captain follows you all the way up. Get caught and you start again from the bottom.

title: Raw Egg Peeling
description: A relaxing game about peeling an egg.

title: Death Momotaro
description: This game is a horror-action-comedy based on the old Japanese story "Momotaro".

title: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental
description: Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs and drones. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI. Get ready for a Silicon Sprint.

title: Pixel Planet Survivor
description: Stranded on an infected world, one survivor against a rising tide of alien bugs. A top-down survivors roguelite where every enemy is a single pixel and the whole swarm is on screen... a million of them. Build your loadout, hold the line, reach extraction.

title: Glass Masquerade 4: Constellations - Tarots
description: "Tarots" puzzle set contains 8 new puzzles representing new constellation "Corvus"

title: Isekai: Waifu Overlord
description: Forget the daily grind - getting hit by a truck landed you right before the Goddess Divitai! Lead a village and assemble a squad of hot babes. Develop your settlement, go on dates, enjoy full voice acting, and unlock 18+ scenes. In this world, you make the rules!

title: Lucid Cats
description: An online co-op horror extraction game. Fall asleep, loot a shared nightmare, and find the escape to keep your valuables.

title: Wrenny Lee: Witch-for-Hire!
description: A short visual novel comedy about Wrenny, a hard-working witch! The freelance life is anything but magical!

title: Abandoned Gameshop
description: Sort thousands of physical game cases scattered across the carpeted floors by Platform (Nindo 10, XCube, FunStation, PC) and Genre. Bring retro gaming nostalgia back to life!

title: Sneaky Squad
description: Sneaky Squad is a multiplayer deception game where players hide among identical soldiers, blend into the crowd, and try to fool the Seeker. Watch closely, act natural, and don't get caught hiding in plain sight.

title: Ghosted
description: A 1-5 player co-op horror comedy where YOU'RE the ghosts. Haunt the living, possess objects, and make your friends say ridiculous custom voice commands to trigger scares.

title: Stella Astrum
description: Stella Astrum is a whimsical factory game where you manage elemental resources to form Stars, Planets, and more. Use your skills to unlock upgradable factories, nurture colorful celestial bodies, and shape an expansive galaxy. Sit back, relax, and amplify the universe beyond its artistic limits!

title: Murders & Mistresses
description:
Murders & Mistresses is a dark, choice-driven adult detective thriller about sex, power, judgment — and consequences.

You play a brilliant ex-conman turned police consultant — cocky, charismatic, dangerously persuasive — surrounded by women you shouldn't be sleeping with, and given far too much freedom.

A character-driven prestige drama: the story will force you into uncomfortable places, and your choices will have severe consequences.

title: AFK: Army For Keyboard
description: Your army keeps fighting inside the taskbar while you get on with your day. AFK is an idle RPG built as a fake desktop OS: drag windows, forge gear across ten rarity tiers, climb an endless tower, and settle scores in asynchronous PvP the server replays back to you.

title: Cozy Farm: Tidy Up!
description: A cozy organizing simulator about sorting 2500+ adorable fruits, vegetables and other crops into greenhouses. Perform satisfying sorting combos, earn money for helpful upgrades and explore the farm at dawn or night. Take your time and tidy the farm, one shelf at a time!

title: Backrooms: Code Yellow
description: An online 1-6 player co-op game about investigating and collecting data in the infinitely massive Backrooms with your fellow employees. Explore. Do your job. Return alive.

title: Triple Track
description: You need to free the cute animals captured in cages by hunters. To do this, you need to find three identical animal pictures at the same time. THE GAME TRAINS VISUAL MEMORY.

title: Booked
description: BOOKED is a cozy first-person library game about finding misplaced books and returning them to the right shelves. Explore a charming library, discover 100+ colorful books and series, and enjoy a relaxed, pressure-free sorting experience.

title: Observation Protocol
description: Observation Protocol is a first-person psychological horror game set in a liminal office space that exists outside normal space. From an external observation post, you must monitor camera feeds and identify discrepancies within the facility. When the power cuts, protocol requires you to enter the facility yourself, photograph every discrepancy, and return before the passage closes at 6 AM.

title: Goblins and Gunslingers
description: Deal spells and six-shooters across a seven-lane frontier. Goblins & Gunslingers is a western-fantasy card duel where gunpowder meets magic — draft 8 outlaw factions, hire deputies, flip Gnomes into Golems, and outdraw rivals in ranked play or a roguelike Frontier Run.

title: Blargle and the Quest for the Nothing Burger
description: Join Blargle on his quest in this arcade-inspired runner and retrieve his stolen Nothing Burger. Avoid obstacles, collect quotes, and destroy anything in your path to the notorious pirate Captain Raqet!

title: Smoke Keeper
description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 4,316 scattered items throughout a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. Put every item on its proper shelf, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

title: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
description: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum! A single-player simulation. The whole collection has fallen apart. Find where each fragment belongs, piece it back together like a puzzle, and restore 428 objects from 3,105 scattered pieces.

title: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum
description: Dino Bones: Tidy Up the Museum! is a cozy skeleton restoration sim. Identify, collect, and piece together around 2,000 scattered dinosaur bones. Feel chaos turn into order, and with every skeleton you rebuild, the museum reveals another secret.

title: Grim Hand
description: Grim Hand is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder built for phones: portrait, one-handed, fully playable offline. The weapon you carry decides your hand of cards, so a bow and a sword play like two different games, and rebuilding your loadout each run builds a new deck. Enemies fight in formation across front and back rows; you can snipe their leaders, sweep the front line, or break their morale so the survivors flee. The fully voiced four-act story follows a blacksmith who can't feed his family and takes up the only work left to him. It's a tragedy, not a power fantasy. Runs are procedural with permadeath, branching paths, and souls to spend between fights. Demo is free and complete; a single purchase unlocks full game. No ads, no timers, no pay-to-win.

title: Close the Sky
description: A real-time war of air defence and industry. Build the economy, bury it, and layer SAMs over what you cannot hide. Read a fading intel picture of the enemy base and aim every missile yourself. Break their will to fight before they break yours.

title: Immortal Chess
description: Chess game with classes, Mana, spells, traps and skills. Build your strategy, disrupt your opponent and compete across platforms in tactical matches. Choose the class that suits best your play style.

title: Trap Yuri Tempest
description: A romantic storm is brewing at Ayanohara Academy! A princely trap and a delinquent one... two unlikely he-iresses are destined to become lovers. Who will sweep the other into the tempest of love first? A cross-dressing yuri VN packed with humor, heart, and outrageous twists!

title: Ratcore
description: You don't know where you are or what your purpose is, but all you know is you want to escape. In this linear, puzzle-filled precision platformer, you must dive whiskers first into many unknown territories. There are many strange yet satisfying mechanics to keep the gameplay unique and fun.

title: Escape Sequence
description: Escape Sequence is a synthwave highway racer where the traffic is a song and the wild drivers play it with you. Weave an ocean-side freeway at sunset, chain near-misses, outlive AI rivals who drive like you do — solo, LAN, or online with friends and public lobbies. Everything glows.

title: EA Sports FC 27
description: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA Sports FC 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

title: Archipeo
description: Build an island empire, automate sprawling production chains, and compete with up to 16 players across a procedurally generated ocean.

title: Raiders 1941
description: Raiders 1941 is a fast-paced, vertical scrolling shoot ‘em up that blends exciting retro action of arcade classics, with modern gameplay up to 120hz refresh rate.

title: Cow Abduction Frenzy
description: Hop into your alien ship and get ready for a frantic bullet hell challenge! Use time-bending and cloaking abilities to rescue cows from the clutches of beef-hungry butchers before your energy depletes. Can you abduct the herd and escape the farm alive?

title: Traffic Stop Anomaly
description: You're a traffic cop on endless patrol. Pull over drivers. Shine your flashlight and spot the anomalies. Let the normal ones go... or turn back before it's too late.

title: CoLane
description:
”CoLane" is a PC rhythm game where the lanes switch according to the color of the background spotlight.
It features a variety of fingerings, making it a game where you improve through trial and error.
A practice mode is implemented, allowing you to try out various fingerings.

title: Retrieval
description: RETRIEVAL is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a looping house, collect scattered memory fragments, and search extracted keywords in an old computer terminal to uncover a tragic truth.

title: Scapewatch
description: 28 skills. Three combat styles. Clans, raids, hiscores, pets, capes. Set up your queue, close the tab, come back richer. Scapewatch is the idle MMO for people who actually like the grind.

title: Oh Ship!
description: Oh Ship! is a 1–4 player co-op space survival game where you and your crew coordinate to keep your ship running while space actively tries to destroy it. Salvage wrecks, fix systems, upgrade your ship, and survive the chaos.

title: Sayagatari: Promise of the Cursed Blade
description: "My love for you began with that kiss." Ex-Kendo practitioner Kanemori Tōya, comes across Saya who seals demonic blades. Saving him from his murderous impulse curse is a kiss from Saya!? The two begin living together, battling with demonic blade in hand. Break the curse with a kiss from this beauty!

title: Sandwich +1
description: A cozy idle clicker where every click drops a random ingredient with a satisfying plop. Stack towering sandwiches, automate your kitchen, unlock rare fillings. Your customers watch every move and react.

title: Lights Out, Run
description: A first-person survival horror game where you must cross your house at night while the fears of your childhood become real.

title: Soul Reaper: Endless Harvest
description: A fast-paced incremental survival game where you harvest souls, master enemy patterns, and grow permanently stronger in short, intense sessions.

title: Wavecrashers
description: Wavecrashers is a 3-player co-op strategy game where heroes unite to fend off relentless waves of enemies. Master unique heroes and dive into a deeply replayable experience built for teamwork.

title: I Know a Guy
description: Run your pizza shop up front and handle shady business out back. Help hand-crafted NPCs with favors that never go as planned. Play solo or online co-op with up to four players and expand your operation across Hobarey Town. In this darkly comedic management sim - become that guy everyone knows.

title: Glue Blocks
description: Glue your falling blocks to create your own shapes and achieve monster scores in wells of all shapes with dynamic gravity. Compete with friends or have fun in co-op.

title: Fallosophy
description: Use just two buttons to climb a colossal pinball table spanning the history of western philosophy. Fallosophy is a minimalist game that turns pinball into a quiet struggle against gravity. No score. No tilts. No savers. Falling down means climbing back up again. Why climb? What does it all mean?

title: Woman Simulator
description: Experience life as a woman - cleaning, cooking, laundry, and no time to rest. Full immersion into the world of everyday chaos!

title: Card Conquest
description: Card Conquest is a Tower Defense game with Deckbuilding and Roguelite elements. Combine spells, towers and units to create a deck and defeat your enemies. Spend your resources wisely and find balance between offense and defense. Gather powerful relics that will enhance your cards.

title: Angle of Attack
description: Defend your skies in this fast-paced 2D shooter. Fly daring missions against invading forces, take down massive war machines, and survive the onslaught of the Clever Foxes Clan.

title: 100 Artroom Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: Scorched Sun
description: Scorched Sun is a short experience that combines top down survival horror with turn based combat. As a new initiate, delve into the depths of a monastery of the Scorched Sun order and discover the secrets within.

title: Gunblade Ranger
description: Gunblade Ranger is a post-apocalyptic Roguelike top-down shooter. You will use guns and blades to hunt monsters in randomly generated radiation zones, collect mutant abilities, break into the source of the radiation, and face the final challenge.

title: Recurrence
description: "Something is broken... and it keeps repeating."A classic survival horror set in a cyberpunk world corrupted by a strange signal. Solve puzzles, face terrifying creatures, and try to escape a nightmare that seems endless

title: Broken Spirit
description: Broken Spirit is a fantasy action RPG. Explore palaces, ruins, tombs, and forests across a vast world, experiencing both the splendor of history and the desolation of the apocalypse.Compose your own equipment and craft your own tactics as you battle a variety of enemies.

title: Black Cat Book Club
description: A magical library you can place on your desktop. Help the black cat study ancient tomes and learn spells in this cozy idle game.

title: Land of Glarefall
description: An action-adventure survival game where every night could be your last. Explore a vast, dangerous world where survival depends on smart resource management, tactical combat, and what you choose to do before night falls.

title: Decklings
description: Tame magical creatures called Decklings and lead them into challenging battles in this resource management, deckbuilding card game. Explore wild biomes, gather resources, and craft items to build your base and raise your Decklings as you shape your path to become the Deckling Champion.

title: Tower of Pestilence
description: In this survival/roguelite with a fanciful and monstrous art style, explore a dungeon where vampiric creatures and pestilence demons coexist. Play as adventurers with simple and accessible controls, improve your gear, and survive the hordes lurking in the tower !

title: Big Loot
description: Roguelike caravan survival game about risk, loot, and smart trading. Every run is a journey of hard choices, clever upgrades, and the eternal question: Do I play it safe... or go for the BIG LOOT?

title: Luminescence
description: Illuminate the path in this Parkour experience across the constellations of Space

title: Wild West Pioneers
description: Follow the American dream and start settling in the frontier with the city-builder Wild West Pioneers. Build and manage your ever-growing villages, establish production chains as well as outposts and build trade routes to support your cities and outposts.

title: Lunar Drifter
description: Lunar Drifter is an Arcade First Person Shooter, your mission is to tear, blast, and crush an entire legion as fast as possible within the time limit. Featuring 4 playable characters with their own gimmicks and arsenal, more than 10 beautiful hand-crafted levels, and includes online Co-Op!

title: Hostile Lands
description: A skill-based bullet-hell shooter with a TON of colorful characters, crunchy gunplay, and a planet that holds a grudge. Rescue your crew, reach the escape pod, and get out. The catch: every escape cranks up the Hostility toward those left behind.

title: Tears of Vanfell
description: Tears of Vanfell is an action-packed dungeon crawler with roguelike and hack-'n-slash elements. Choose between a wide cast of characters and climb the Mountain as you swap weapons and grow stronger as a team of up to four player in online Co-op.

title: Magic Realm
description: The story of Magic Realm begins in a small town nestled in a dangerous misty forest, where a series of mysterious events take place that propel the protagonist to the town's hidden truth.........

title: Loki's Revenge
description: Loki’s Revenge is a bullet heaven roguelite where you play as Norse gods fighting Loki’s army of monsters! Level up to gain powerful upgrades and explore the hand-crafted maps to find secret items. Build the ultimate overpowered god with permanent upgrades and master each god’s signature weapon.

title: Girls vs. Zombies
description: "Girls vs Zombies": Multiplayer cooperative 3D tower defense. Grab your gun and fight with friends against Eastern and Western demons, or oversee and deploy beautiful girls, defending against zombie waves with swords, guns, and magic!

title: Department of Collections
description: A tasked based fully procedural online co-op sci-fi horror game that can be played both casually or more hardcore. Descend further into the facility using the elevator to discover truths about the facility while avoiding hazards and threats and completing tasks for the Department.

title: Dr. Murph
description: Embark on an erotic intergalactic adventure with the clumsy Dr. Murph and his hot assistant, Repa. Meet other women from a myriad of alien races - and, if you plays your cards right, you might just end up getting lucky!

title: Tomboy Adventure 2
description: Start a relaxing adventure together with your (girl) friend!

title: Roguewake
description: Embark on a thrilling turn-based Pirate Adventure! Spin the deck-building slot, strategize with crew bonuses, and navigate a procedurally generated world. Conquer enemies, choose your path, and become the ultimate pirate in this dynamic roguelike experience!

title: Used Cars Simulator
description: Used Cars Simulator - trade used or stolen cars, fix and customize them, drive around, and explore the open world! Grow your business, complete quests, and have fun with a physics-based sandbox!

title: Sockpuppet Noir
description: Step into the shoes of Frank Sockowski, private detective, and explore the gritty world of New Drawer, a wolly unsettling and corrupt city.

title: Space Defender: Frontier Squadron
description: Lead a squadron against the Drone invasion in a top-down space shooter with RPG depth. Play a voiced story with three endings, hunt pirate captains, step inside the spaceports, send your crew down to the planets you scan, and hold a front that falls without you.

title: The Aloha Bakery
description: The Aloha Bakery is a comedic romantic visual novel based in Hawaii. It follows the fall from grace of Simon, a 2 Michelin star chef and his redemption when he is invited to visit his friend in Hawaii.

title: Saints Reborn
description: An unofficial native Windows port of Saints Row (Xbox 360, 2006).

title: Starstone
description: Starstone is a high-fantasy card game built for players who love deep strategy, dramatic combat, and stunning art. From summoning legendary creatures to mastering equipment synergies, every battle is a tactical where board control, timing, and style come together in a truly epic game experience.

title: Pop the Ghosts
description:
The ghosts have taken over the building. Do you have what it takes to drive them all out?

In Pop the Ghosts, you take on the role of a paranormal hunter armed with a special gun. Explore a haunted building, face different types of ghosts, and overcome challenges that become increasingly difficult.

Take on a campaign with 30 platform-style levels, run, jump, break boxes, and explore the environments to find your way to the enemies. Eliminate all the ghosts to advance, but stay alert: some enemies require more than one shot to defeat.

Find TVs to activate checkpoints and watch out for traps scattered throughout the environment, such as dangerous drops of acid falling from the ceiling. Take two hits and you will return to the beginning of the level or to the last checkpoint.

title: Fit and Grow
description:
Get ready to get your hands dirty and let your creativity bloom in Fit and Grow, a relaxing puzzle game where every planted piece can completely transform the board!

Here, seeds and watering cans work together to create something bigger. Place the pieces carefully, make the plants grow, and watch as they expand into new spaces across the board. But be careful: the more your plants grow, the less space remains for your next moves. Planning the right moment to plant and water will be essential to finding the perfect solution!

Across 30 levels, divided into 3 different biomes, new board shapes and piece combinations will put your spatial reasoning to the test. Each stage brings a small challenge to solve, encouraging you to think several moves ahead and discover how the growth of a single plant can completely change your possibilities.

And there is no need to be afraid of making mistakes! With Undo, Hint, and Restart always available, you can experiment with different strategies, undo a move, or get a little help when the solution seems hidden among the leaves.

There are no timers, pressure, or rushing. Just you, your pieces, and a board waiting to bloom.

Observe the space, plan your moves, plant your seeds, position your watering cans, and discover the perfect combination to fill every corner.

Plant with strategy, water with intelligence, and make every level bloom!

title: Dressmaker Simulator
description:
Open the doors to a warm storybook atelier and turn every customer request into a finished garment. Accept a commission, choose the right material, sketch a design, arrange pattern pieces with the grain, cut the fabric, pin it to the mannequin, sew each seam, add decorations, and deliver your work.

Build a season from 12 garment projects, 16 fabrics, varied colors and patterns, and 10 client profiles with different tastes. Match fabrics and trims to each brief, balance cost against quality, earn money and reputation, keep favorite creations in the wardrobe, and care for Marmalade, the atelier cat.

Every production stage is designed for controller play, including precise pattern cutting. Keyboard and mouse are also supported. Versioned local autosave, Continue, pause, clear back actions, and a complete season flow make this a full cozy crafting game rather than a limited demo.

title: Space Metal Mania
description:
The galaxy needs saving and only metal can do it.

The Metal-Verse is a galaxy united by one truth: metal is life. Now The Silence, an ancient consuming force, is spreading across worlds and draining everything it touches. Lucky for us, heavy metal can destroy them. Grab the controls, crank it to eleven, and blast them back into the void.

Space Metal Mania is a fast-paced, heavy metal-fueled, arcade space shooter where you blast through swarms of enemies, face down massive bosses, and fight to reclaim a galaxy decimated by the Silence. Play solo or team up with up to 3 friends in explosive co-op multiplayer that is all set to a face-melting soundtrack featuring legendary tracks from Megadeth, Iron Maiden, Mastodon, Avenged Sevenfold, and Pantera.

Your commander? None other than Dave Mustaine, the iconic Megadeth frontman who is guiding you through every mission with his unmistakable voice.

title: Console Archives: Karate Champ
description:
Karate Champ was released by Data East in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
This game is an action game where you fight using a wide variety of moves through simple control combinations. Successfully executing major moves earns you many score points. Execute your moves with precision and aim for "Champ"!

title: Villain Girls: Date the Dark Side
Skel the Heroes Hunter: Trap Dungeon!
Forensic Mystery: Crime Scene Tap Detective
16 Faces: School HP!
description: How many sides of you can you show?

title: Distorted: Night Shift Anomalies
description: In this psychological horror exploration game, you are sent to assess an abandoned toy factory.

title: Escape game R00m17
description: Explore 3D space and escape

title: What Was Here? 1-Minute Memory Quiz!!
description:
Study the scene, then choose!
Can you recall the hidden detail?

title: Beautiful Girls on Campus: Memories of Youth
description:
Memorise a snapshot of school life in just one minute!
Study every detail, then put your memory to the test.
Can you recall what was there?

title: Big Watermelon Galaxy
description: Merge fruits, grow giant watermelons, and conquer the galaxy!

title: Floor Wiping Race
description:
Wipe floors here, there, and everywhere?!
Race across courses while wiping floors and aim for 1st place!

title: Phantom Thief Mirage and the Curious Clues
description: Can you spot the clue?

title: Spooky Tales and Mummy Trails
description: It's Halloween and two brothers wrongly read a cursed spell-book and one is instantly turned into a Mummy. Run, cast magic, win mini games and rescue your brother.

title: Tiny Tank Showdown
description: Tiny Tank Showdown is an intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends.

title: Where are Leo and Mia? Pirate Island
description: Find Leo & Mia among pirates, parrots and buried gold!

title: The Intern: Temptation at Work
description: Ethan Parker arrives in New York with little money, too much ambition, and an opportunity that could change his life: an internship at Monroe Advertising Group, one of Manhattan's most prestigious agencies.

title: Swing Shift
description: New Haven City is losing a building a week. The paperwork says they were empty. They weren't.

title: Five Elements Chess
description: A spell-duel game that combines the Five Elements theory and match-three gameplay.

title: Potions Tidy
description: Clean up, organize your space in this cozy and relaxing game. Pick up potions and objetcs scattered across the floor and freely place them wherever you want across 300 different placement surfaces. With over 4,500 objects, no grid, and no time limits.

title: Post Office: Tidy Up!
description: Post Office: Tidy Up! is a cozy sorting simulator where you shelve 3,360 parcels scattered across a postal depot by an earthquake. Read every label, find its courier, country and numbered slot, and restore order at your own pace.

title: NebulaSky Crossing
description: Nebula Sky Crossing is a game that blends 2D side-scrolling shooting—where you pilot a spaceship as a space trader—with station-based trading. Aim to conquer a galaxy filled with dangers such as pirates by mastering piloting skills and upgrades.

title: SilentDarkness
description: A first-person liminal space escape game where exploration, observation, and trial and error are the keys to uncovering hidden rules. With no combat and no sudden jump scares, experience an oppressive atmosphere filled with mystery and fear of the unknown.

title: The Rounds of Six
description: A first-person psychological horror set in an oppressive clinic, centered on cyclical madness. As a doctor, perform daily rounds in Ward No. 6. Study your surroundings and stay attentive to break the loop.

title: Just Volleyball
description: just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve. (taken from Steam page)

title: Look / Don't
description: There are things you should look at. Things you should never look at. And things watching you. LOOK / DON'T is a first-person psychological horror exploration game about looking. Explore a changing house and bring back the requested items.

title: Protocol 86: Chernobyl
description: Protocol 86: Chernobyl is a terminal-driven psychological horror puzzle game set in a secret Soviet underground facility after the Chernobyl disaster.

title: Villain Boys: Date the Dark Side
description:
Bad boys don't play by the rules.
Break down their walls and find out what's underneath the dark side.

title: The Pit Is Hungry
description: Grow gourds in a graveyard, carry them to the pit in the middle, and throw them in for coins before the day runs out.

title: Taxi Crew Simulator
description: Passengers are waiting, journeys are calling.

title: Prisoners Chess
description: You know how the pieces move. You don't know how they die. A chess roguelike where every piece bleeds. Level them, perk them or lose them forever. Take the enemy King's head, or bleed their army dry. One path saves you. One damns you. Hell keeps score.

title: Pixel Chess
description: A classic game of chess reimagined with isometric pixel art and animated fantasy armies. Play solo against the AI or challenge your friends in local multiplayer.

title: Rematch: Season 5 - Blue Lock
description:
Rematch × Blue Lock is out now!

New Limited-Time Mode
Jump into Aura Striker, our new limited-time 3V3 game mode. Activate your Aura to temporarily boost your movement speed and shot power. Adapt, seize the momentum, and make every opportunity count!

Free Rewards for Every Player
Head to the store and claim your free Blue Lock Welcome Bundle. You can also progress through the free Event Pass by completing challenges across Aura Striker, Casual, and Ranked, and unlock Blue Lock-inspired cosmetics along the way.

Step into the World of Blue Lock
Take to the pitch with cosmetic bundles inspired by four iconic Blue Lock characters:
Yoichi Isagi
Meguru Bachira
Seishiro Nagi
Rin Itoshi
Each bundle includes a character-inspired skin, a unique goal celebration, and profile cosmetics.

Let's go, diamonds in the rough. Time for aura farming.

title: Fusty Dungeon
description: Travel the land and explore a dungeon with two beautiful ladies to find the cure to your childhood friend’s curse.

title: Courier
description: He woke up with nothing. The city is about to have the same problem.

title: Ridge Hold
description: Build a cozy fantasy village, train warriors and archers, and hold the high ground. Gather wood and gold between waves, fortify the stairs, and protect your castle in this cute 2D tower defense strategy game.

title: Unbroken Valor
description: In this dark ink‑wash roguelike card game, build your 3‑person squad. Freely combine Eight‑Gua elements, 12 Blessings, treasures, talismans and mental insights. Fight and grow within endless time loops; every sword swing is a new unknown adventure.

title: Hell Of War: Combined Arms
description:
Hell Of War: Combined Arms is a tactical FPS/RTS hybrid set in modern combined-arms combat. Players observe the battlefield through a command drone, locate enemy forces, issue orders to infantry and armored vehicles, and call artillery and rocket support.

During battle, players can take direct control of an infantry commander, an armored vehicle, an FPV drone, or a drop drone. Missions focus on coordinating units, capturing control points, managing support resources, and using destructible buildings and vegetation to change the battlefield.

title: Tear Them All
description: Tear through waves of doodle enemies with your pencil. Sharpen your weapon, balance melee and ranged combat, and survive the chaos in this fast-paced arena shooter.

title: Purrvivors
description: The catapoclypse is upon us. Lead battle-hardened cats against endless swarms of vermin — auto-fire your weapons, scoop kibble between waves, and stack 32 weapons + 30 items into gloriously broken builds. Solo or 4-player local co-op. Survive… or meOWWW.

title: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
description: Set against the backdrop of a distorted Shibuya—where supernatural anomalies have begun bleeding into reality—the story follows two dual protagonists. Both harbor these very anomalies within themselves as they embark on a dark quest to uncover the truth behind the city's eerie phenomena.

title: Garfield: Escape from Monday
description: Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

title: Love All My Girls
description: What would you do with infinite resurrection and time travel? Predict the future, save the world, get rich overnight… or date six girls at once? You’ve lived every man’s dream but stepped into a fatal trap. You’re just trying to make them all happy—what’s wrong with that?

title: Rotfront
description: Rotfront is a singleplayer FPS set out in the state of Washington in the year 2034. Infiltrate as a lone Operator, purge infected areas, kill as many Rots as possible and unlock weapons as you level up and grow stronger.

title: Furyball: Rogue Revenge
description: Furyball is a fast-paced action roguelite where your only weapon is a bouncing bullet ball. Control the chaos, shatter enemies, and survive sport-themed arenas inspired by pinball and grindhouse cinema.

title: Kalanoro
description: Start a band with crazy lemurs and save your island from an evil witch in Kalanoro, an ode to Madagascar’s folklore and vibrant artistic scene! Hop on an action-adventure journey to discover the colorful world of Lemuria, rescue funky lemur artists, and defeat the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

title: Substrate: Emergence
description: Grow fluorescent cells that create mesmerizing emergent chaos. Simple mechanics hide deep complexity as cells evolve survival strategies through synergistic interactions. Catalogue successful lines and culture them to develop your own unique biology.

title: Frog Pond Simulator
description: Frog Pond Simulator is an idle incremental game where you'll see new frogs coming along continuously, each unique, funny looking and unusual. The only objective that matters is to relax and let yourself be transported by the music and the mood. An un-frog-ettable experience!

title: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
description:
Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis brings a new chapter to the beloved tower defense saga, packed with the charm fans fell in love with.

Journey back to the very beginning of the Kingdom with the mission to rewrite history, and stop young Vez’nan before darkness takes hold!

Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands, at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and build strategic defenses to outsmart relentless enemy waves through careful planning.

The beloved tower defense gameplay comes back with bold new twists, epic fights, and the signature Kingdom Rush humor. Along the way, you’ll encounter surprising returns, memorable challenges, and the most ambitious Kingdom Rush adventure yet.

Defend the past to change the future.

title: Mineral Mining Simulator
description: Turns raw rock into valuable minerals and jewelry grade gemstones through a hands on production chain. Mine ore, crush it into fragments, refine it, and scale your operation with better machines and smarter workflow. Optimize every stage of the pipeline to maximize efficiency, quality, and profit.

title: Fleeting Shores
description: Race against a 3-year death clock in this economic Roguelite. Sail the Mediterranean, exploit extreme market surges, and amass 500 million gold. Fail the run? Inherit your treasures into the next playthrough and continue the struggle to defy destiny!

title: Coin & Cauldron
description: The Kingdom of Valoria is in grave danger - The King has sent his most trusted Alchemist to help fight off the monster hordes near the town of Elyzium. Fight monsters, craft potions, cast spells and live the life of a powerful sorcerer fighting to repel the monsters from the defenseless town...

title: Mayor Life Simulator
description: Chart your path to the presidency on a dangerous journey from the quiet streets of Ricano to the sunny shores of Mayorica. Gang wars, assassination missions, breathtaking chases, and a completely free open world await you.

title: Frukt
description: A voxel-based death sandbox. Shoot, dismember, and crush NPCs with realistic body physics.

title: All Roads Connected
description: Explore an endless world, build countless settlements, discover lost artifacts, and lead your nation into a new dawn of industry.

title: Unanchored Spaceshooting
description: Welcome to the most counter-intuitive shooter arena! In Unanchored Spaceshooting, your guns ARE your thrusters—dodge left by firing right! Every battle defies physics. Blast enemies, rack up high scores!

title: Capsulitas
description: A physics-based gacha meets inventory management roguelike. Insert a coin, organize your backpack, and sell for profit! Multiply items with hammers, upgrade your machine, and survive the inflation.

title: The Sigil Engine
description: A magical automation puzzle game where you program a little shikigami automaton using visual spell blocks - explore, harvest energy, and cleanse corrupted sigils in a cozy fantasy world.

title: Oh!Ware
description: Sow the seeds of victory, forge alliances, and carve your own destiny. A spiritual Mancala roguelike where every marble shapes the board and your fate. Every pit is a choice and every marble, a desperate prayer.

title: BanG Dream! Our Notes
description: In BanG Dream! Our Notes, players will be thrown into the stories of MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica, two aspiring bands discovering their voice. Guide each group from rehearsal studios to stadium shows, as you master tight, rhythm-based gameplay set to original, high-energy pop. As their journey unfolds, three more bands - Mugendai MewType, millsage, and Ikka Dumb Rock! - join the stage, weaving a multi-route tale of youth, friendship, and musical passion. Featuring 25 characters across five bands, the game showcases their growth both on stage and in everyday life.

title: Farming Camp
description: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

title: Codex Mortis
description: In Codex Mortis, Death is your weapon. Mix five schools of dark magic, unleash devastating spell synergies, and raise undead armies in this necromantic bullet hell. Infinite builds, solo or co-op – embrace the forbidden and dominate. 100% AI-driven development.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Lords of the End Times
Among Shadows
description: Among Shadows is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and identity-based deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. With the Blood Moon rising, can you escape from this place under the conspiracy?

title: Chesscape Room
description: Chess variant where you have to escape custom boards through a door with your king while your opponent hunts you! Play through a campaign, create custom boards or challenge others locally or online.

title: Palm Simulator 2
description: Palm Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a palm tree.

title: Tunestrike
description: TUNESTRIKE is a first-person rhythmic shooter where every shot and every enemy spawn is synchronized with the music. Arm yourself, follow the beat, and wipe out waves of robots in action-packed enclosed arenas.

title: Super Flying Vroom Vroom
description: Drive, boost, take off, and navigate spectacular aerial challenges!

title: Brother, Get the Oats
description: Convince an AI powered, stubborn pig to part with his precious oats. You’ve got ten minutes, good luck!

title: Diamond Hunt
description: A co-op horror game about searching for items to build a spaceship to escape a dying galaxy.

title: Hirotonfa's American Revolution Smuggler
description: A historical trading and dating sim set during the American Revolution. Manage a trade ship hauling goods between colonial ports, profit from volatile daily market swings, and navigate faction dangers, from militias to pirates, while choosing sides that affect regional quests. Along the way, romance charming colonial “state-chans” across territories like Louisiana and Quebec, blending economic strategy, risk-filled navigation, and character-driven narrative.

title: Monastery: Ora et Labora
description: Lead your monks in prayer and labor to build a thriving medieval monastery. Manage resources, brew ale, craft manuscripts, and face trials like war and weather. Customize, expand, and guide your brotherhood to achieve spiritual and economic prosperity.

title: Container Terminal Simulator
description: In Container Terminal Simulator, you can immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the owner of a cargo terminal. Drive the loaders and decide for yourself whether you are ready to take on a new challenge. Feel like the owner of a company, develop it alone and with friends and become the best manager!

title: Nightmare Invasion
description: Nightmare has set its sights on this world, and as the will of the world, you will rely on cards, tower defenses, and urban construction to destroy Nightmare's invasion in the dream

title: American Truck Simulator: South Dakota
description: Welcome to the Mount Rushmore State! From the wide-rolling plains to the rugged beauty of the Badlands and the forested peaks of the Black Hills, South Dakota’s landscapes are as diverse as they are breathtaking.

title: Scared by Squares
description: A creepy VR exploration game where you navigate liminal spaces, avoid roaming cubes, and uncover hidden anomalies in eerie block-filled mazes.

title: Seafarer: The Ship Sim
