description: Embark on the ultimate maritime experience with Seafarer: The Ship Sim. Choose between careers, take the helm of a variety of ships, and expand your fleet. Navigate a vast open world and become immersed in the beautiful expanses and rolling waves.

title: Drapline
description: "DRAPLINE" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. Feed her a variety of things to increase her abilities, combine various skills to build your own strategy, and defeat the impending catastrophe!

title: 3-Bit Explorer
description: 3-Bit Explorer follows its predecessors, being a game focused on world exploration. This time you find yourself lost in a forest that seems to have even more bits than you, making this world even stranger to our hero. Once more, the world does not need saving, but you need to find your way home (and also a good adventure).

title: Mars Attracts
description: Mars Attracts is a park management sim set in the iconic universe of Mars Attacks. Build rides, hire staff, manage guest needs, and abduct humans to serve as the star attractions. You'll face demanding visitors, environmental hazards, and the ever-looming threat of human escapes!

title: The Witch's Redemption
description: Step into a world shrouded in mystery and peril in “The Witch’s Redemption,” an RPG teeming with narrative depth and strategic intrigue. Unravel the mysteries that hold Alice captive through captivating dialogues, thrilling battles, and cunning investigations.

title: The Magus Circle
description: Magic is Art. The Magus Circle is a vampire-survivors, rogue-lite game where you draw to cast spells! Meet other mages and unlock their abilities. Discover the secrets hidden inside the Circle. Draw the sigil, protect the circle, save the cosmos.

title: Dragon Shelter
description: Dragon Shelter is a farm sim set in a fantasy world. Take on the role of a hero who will revive the long-lost friendship between humans and dragons. Take care of wondrous creatures, explore the magical world, and restore destroyed biomes!

title: Survivor Challenge TD
description: Survivor Challenge TD plunges you into an epic struggle for survival against an oncoming horde of monsters. Arm yourself with the most formidable and thrilling weapon combinations and abilities as you brace for an ultimate showdown against a powerful boss!

title: Reflection Witch
description: "Reflection Witch" is a new rougelike spin on classic brick-breaking games. Join a witch on her journey to uncover the secrets of the arcane, fighting brick-laden baddies by drawing lines to reflect and enchant your Magic Ball with powerful spells while simultaneously blocking incoming enemy attacks.

title: Hack 'n' Stack
description: Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game for up to 4 players. Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.

title: Doggy Don't Care
description: Unleash adorable chaos as a mischievous pup! Explore, collect, and smash your way around the house & beyond in this cheeky adventure. Fetch the approval of your feathered friend, Rocko the Parrot, by digging into a list of fun-filled tasks. It's sure to be a pawsitively unforgettable day!

title: Control Resonant
description: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

title: PuPu's Adventure Park
description: Build an Adventure Park from the ground up! The PuPu clan had just rented a new "playground" from the Dark Goblins. Manage the park, construct park facilities, and grow your clan to serve the expansion of the Park for "hero" customers summoned from other planets!

title: Silent Hill: Townfall
description:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine, luring players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

title: Goofy Dungeon
description: Goofy Dungeon is a light-hearted puzzle game built from the ground up for VR. Explore dungeons, interact with objects and the environment, solve puzzles, complete quests and collect trophies!

title: CapoeiRogue: Dandara Cordão de Ouro
description: CapoeiRogue is a rogue-like capoeira game that mixes Afro-descendant culture in Brazil and fantasy, through the game mechanics you will experience elements that were of great importance to our history.

title: Sin: Reloaded
description: Nightdive Studios and 3D Realms have joined forces to bring you SiN: Reloaded, a completely remastered experience of the classic 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. SiN was a groundbreaking story driven FPS brimming with memorable characters, horrific enemies and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now in 2020 SiN has been Reloaded!

title: Birthday
description: A little present in the forest! A short puzzle game that can be cleared in 10-20 minutes.

title: Legend of St. Stephen: St. Stephen Preaching / St. Stephen before the High Priest and Elders of the Sanhedrin
description: This is the first part of three. Based on a painting by Mariotto di Nardo.

title: Noir
description:
Noir is a colorful, dynamic, and die-and-retry 2D platform game. Collect the orbs in each level to reveal the exit portal. Play through hundreds of levels to beat this fast-paced and exhilarating game !

The game is released on Steam since September 23rd 2026 : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851170/Noir/

title: Arcade Archives 2: Xevious 3D/G
description:
"Xevious 3D/G" is a shooting game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996.
The classic masterpiece "Xevious" is reborn in polygons! Everything is rendered in 3D with diverse screen angles and camera work, plus new weapons and enemy characters have been added.
Conquer all 7 areas, including the desert with the geoglyph and the space fortress!

title: Gassed Up!
description: Gassed Up! is an online multiplayer party game about surviving the workday with a growing gas problem. Complete tasks, sabotage coworkers and use unique employee abilities to clock out first. Keep your gas meter under control, avoid getting caught farting and catch others in the act.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Variety Vault Plus!
description:
A brand new Variety Vault release has hit the scene! Now including more content than ever before! Revisit the magic and fun of 12 beautiful games, now on your Personal Computer! All of these wonderful games have been powered up with a refreshing rhythm-based twist on their standard gameplay; made possible only through the hit Newgrounds game, Friday Night Funkin'! All neatly wrapped together into one wondrously bountiful package titled;

Friday Night Funkin': Variety Vault Plus!

title: Rocket League: Season 24
description:
Season 24 is the thirty-eighth competitive season in Rocket League and the twenty-fourth competitive season after the Free To Play update. It is themed around a specific concept and features the Dominus GT 76, Pareto 5S and Volkswagen Golf GTI Edition 50 Bodies in the Rocket Pass.

This season introduces the ability to directly invite a player from a match to initiate an Honor Duel, as well as the ability to trade-in Black Market items for new ones the player might not have.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Season of Scares
description: The 25th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings new content inspired by Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas - including Oogie Boogie as a new Villager. It also finished the Grand Exhibition questline, added Decoration Preset code sharing and started both the Haunting Elegance Star Path and the permanent Astronomer's Journey Star Path.

title: Jalecolle Famicom Ver. Shatterhand
description:
A project bringing Jaleco Famicom titles back-to-back!
Now comes +α Vol. 2—“Operation Steel Fist,” Shatterhand!

title: Throrbs
description: A game about having a little bit, but not too much.

title: Simian Shakespeare
description: One Bard. Infinite Monkeys. Hire apes to type at random until Shakespeare appears. Starting with a monkey pecking one character at a time, and scales all the way up to hundreds of monkeys hammering away and even a Monkey on your GPU typing millions of characters a second! Will they fill the book?

title: Vinyl Freak: Unsorted
description: Relax and tidy up 2,880 handcrafted vinyl records. Unpack the warehouse, clean up, and rearrange shelves & decor as you bring new life to a one of a kind record store. Unlock fun abilities and upgrade your skills with the help of your cat. Prepare for Vinyl Freak's grand opening!

title: Still Sorting
description: A game about putting 4,344 volumes of manga back where they belong. They're heaped in front of the counter or packed away in boxes. Listen to the rain, take your time, and shelve them one at a time.

title: Chomp Garden
description: A bite-sized puzzle adventure in a garden full of deceptively cute plants. Play as a tiny glowing lamp and shape them with your light to make your way deeper and find your pup.

title: My Racing Car
description: Drag rusted wrecks from the scrapyard and rebuild them from scratch, one part at a time. A raw open-world driving life-sim — fix your car, fuel it, and hit the road. Race for cash, explore a living forest town, and survive the grind. Drive. Don't stop.

title: Nature Hike
description: A short and sweet fully voice-acted Visual Novel where you'll join Tendou, a recent friend and local tanuki hunk, on a hiking date... though, perhaps, just "friends" is not exactly what you'll end up being.

title: Tank-a-Boom
description: Tank-a-Boom is a fast-paced multiplayer PvP action game where players pilot heavily customized tanks in neon-lit arenas to compete in the ultimate "Tanksport" league.

title: Snowflakes in the Sun
description: Off-the-grid survivalist Dan and 2-inch-tall Holly have settled into their living arrangements together. But despite their close bond, they have some things they're still trying to figure out.

title: Foole's World
description: An absurd personality testing experience with a whole lot of questions for you.

title: Stillwake
description: StillWake is an atmospheric first-person survival horror. Explore an abandoned psychiatric hospital, uncover its dark secrets, solve puzzles, and survive terrifying creatures. Stay quiet—your microphone picks up your voice, and enemies can hear you

title: Antartida
description: No instructions, no manual, no help of any kind. Just you and a polar exploration vehicle. Are you capable of completing the mission, or will you be buried forever in Antarctica?

title: EuroDrive Albania
description: The new update adds Albania to the existing map mod for Grand Truck Simulator 2.

title: Echoes in Darkness
description: Echoes in Darkness is a first-person psychological horror experience.

title: Warframe: Iceblade of Narin
description: On the summit of a familiar peak on Earth—the place where you first learned to master your Void powers—a mysterious frozen monument has sprung up, sparking strange happenings aboard the Zariman and a new threat from the Man in the Wall.

title: FluxWerks
description:
FluxWerks combines the logistics of a large-scale factory game with a procedural voxel world in which every block can be mined, moved or built on. Players start with a swarm of nanobots that harvests terrain and 3D-prints structures. From there they build a production chain that runs from hand-fed smelters to automated science and computing.

The world is a simulation that the factory works with, not a backdrop. Fluids such as water and lava flow through one shared simulation and react when they meet. Heat spreads block by block through the terrain and into machines, so where and how a factory is built matters. The weather plays a part as well: wind speed decides how much a wind turbine produces, and machines caught in a blizzard wear down faster. There is no combat and no pressure to rush. Pollution does have a consequence: an alien growth takes hold around a heavily polluting factory and has to be cut back, which gives players a reason to think about how cleanly they produce. It is forgiving, and it can be switched off entirely for a more relaxed game.

title: Genshin Impact: A Rekviem for the Underworld
description:
Version 7.1 of Genshin Impact. This update includes:
• New characters: Vesna and Vodyanitsa
• New main story quests: "White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking" and "A Rekviem for the Underworld"
• New main event: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
• 6th anniversary celebrations

title: Stella Supernova: The Astral Vale
description: Jump, dash, dodge, and battle numerous stellar bosses in a 2D action-platformer playable solo or with up to 8 players locally, featuring unlockable powers, upgrades, cinematic QTEs, and an emotional story.

title: Bibi & Tina: Ready, Set, Ride!
description: A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness: Ride with Bibi, Tina and Alex as they compete for the cup, stand together against unfair rivals – and dive into varied horse-riding adventures. Action-packed carriage races are among the special highlights.

title: The Decree
description:
The Decree is a 1–3 player cooperative horror game about hunting souls, surviving a relentless 90-second clock, and making impossible choices when The Button appears.

Track wandering souls, capture them under pressure, fight Soul Drainers, and fulfill each Order before time runs out.

When The Button appears, choose PROCEED or STAY without knowing what either choice will cause.

Push your run further, survive the Orders, and decide when to extract—or keep going until the Decree breaks you.

title: Bunker Tidy Up
description: Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing game about organizing a bunker. Arrange 17,276 supplies on shelves, categorize resources, and relax!

title: Mini Airways: Map - Busy Skies
description: In the upcoming DLC for Mini Airways, we will take you to major aviation hubs around the world, bringing busier skies, more dynamic airspaces, and brand-new air traffic challenges.

title: Bombs vs Bots
description: Bombs vs Bots is a chaotic action game featuring physics-based destruction and light environmental puzzles. As a support engineer for Cola Corp, you are tasked with defeating an army of AI-powered bots that have taken over the company's new headquarters.

title: Mantis Clicker
description: Mantis Clicker is a pixel-art incremental idle game about raising a magical mantis colony, battling strange creatures, and expanding a colony of your own. It combines clicking, automation, evolution, combat, crafting, farming, fishing, building, and prestige progression across a colorful world filled with quests, loot, abilities, and secrets.

title: Wand & Order: Tidy Up the Magic Shop!
description: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!

title: Union Max
description:
Union Max is a Gay Adult / Yaoi Visual Novel that features the adventures of Max, the unlikely hero chosen to become the next Light of the Kosmos!
Join Max on his journey across the Realms of the Kosmos, gathering the sparks of Romance, Desire, Angst and Happiness.
Reclaim the lost sparks – together as one!

title: Dig Too Deep
description: Throw goblins at all your problems in this Action Tower Defense Roguelite. Craft upgrades. Choose Perks. Build defenses. Defend your Base! Angry baddies want to turn you to pulp! Stop them the only way you know how: throwing goblins! Don't miss.

title: Ironblood
description: Run a dark fantasy fighting promotion. Sign gladiators, book matches across five weight divisions, negotiate contracts, and stage Blood Nights. Champions die, legacies rise and fall, and rival promotions hunt the same talent. A living dark fantasy MMA management sim.

title: Rogue Planet
description: Veloria is the only world Reva and her friends have ever known. Is escaping the village's walls a good idea? Play as Reva and explore both the horrors and beauty of the outside world in Rogue. And most importantly, never, ever let the bad guys win.

title: Gobble
description: Gobble is a 2D action platformer with eating as its central theme. Venture out into the world searching for your missing family, armed with a “sickle” that devours monsters to get stronger.

title: Island Restoration
description: Bring procedurally generated islands back to life. Explore different biomes and damage scenarios. Relax as you clean, upgrade your tools, rescue wildlife, and watch each island return to its natural beauty. Customize your ship and decorate your own private island.

title: Flow Legends
description: Fix the pipes, solve wild problems, and build your own thriving town! Flow Legends is a colorful puzzle adventure with 100+ levels, deep customization, pets, and creative city-building progression.

title: Waaaaaa: A Prehistoric Adventure With Aliens
description: WAAAAAA is a silent, funny prehistoric adventure full of grunts. Solve puzzles, recruit quirky companions, and save the world in this 'Solo Dev' labor of love. Sometimes, a scream is all you need to make yourself heard!

title: Bait Soul
description: Bait Soul is a top-down Dungeon Crawler Roguelike. It blends dungeon exploration with Survivors-style auto-attacks. Accessible yet deep, it retains the thrill of looting, with unique, game-changing mechanics hidden everywhere.

title: Mystery Egg Shop Simulator
description: Run your very own mystery egg shop! Stock shelves, manage customers, and grow your business. Every egg hides a surprise, you can sell them sealed, or open them to discover what’s inside? Unbox action figures, trade collectibles, and build themed dioramas to increase their value.

title: Bullet Chain: Vessels
description: Fast-paced, brutal and chaotic. A "Use Your Enemies", Roguelite, Deckbuilding, FPS. Fight through hordes of enemies, and travel through time, on your quest to kill the last Archangel.

title: Corpus et Spiritus
description: Corpus et Spiritus is a roguelite deckbuilder about alchemy. You signed a pact with a Homunculus, and it was a bad idea: it will guide you on the path of alchemy, but as the cost of your life force. Use your workshop to craft new cards, transmute metals and discover magical talismans. Become smarter than your dangerous partner before it kills you!

title: Idle Monkey Theorem
description: **Idle Monkey Theorem** is a charming idle/clicker game that brings the famous *Infinite Monkey Theorem* to life. Watch as your adorable team of monkeys frantically type away on their typewriters, randomly producing words that against all odds slowly but surely recreate the complete works of William Shakespeare.

title: It's Fine
description: Idle / Incremental about developing a game with your dog Joe. Unlock unique mechanics, evolve with multi-layered prestige, find secrets, beat all alt endings, and deliver your game on time!

title: Tattoo Shop Simulator
description: Run your dream tattoo shop! Provide tattoo and piercing services, customize your shop, and manage staff. Unlock new skills and roam the living city freely on your motorcycle. Buy real estate, fight off thugs, and grow from a small shop into the city's biggest brand!

title: Stunted Gravity
description: Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game set in a neon-dystopian future. Race, jump, and improvise lines across arenas where gravity pulls in any and every direction. Execute stunts, evade hazards, and battle enemy drones as you pilot though the interplanetary Stunted Gravity Circuit.

title: Bonetox
description: A fast-paced arena shooter where you grind demons into piles of bones and meat. Choose your favorite weapon and unleash uncompromising carnage. Survive as long as you can, break your limits, and drown the arena in blood.

title: Apocalypter
description: Apocalypter is a post-apocalyptic, driving, survival, fps, open-world game. Fight, help, trade with different factions. Find different cars and customize them. Scavenge, loot and survive the procedurally generated, open world of Apocalypter.

title: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2
description: Head to the USA and grow your own business with a realistic and relaxing lawn mowing experience! With brand new grass tech and reworked systems based on player feedback to the original, plus licensed equipment from around the world.

title: Monitor State
description: You are an operator in a dystopia world, watch and punish citizens. Experience a deep narrative with moral dilemmas. Obey, resist or find another path.

title: The Piper of Dawn
description: Welcome to Diamond City—a sealed-off “Paradise”. You play the role of an alchemist running a one-stop empire: farming, "people farming," shopkeeping, and alchemy. Choose your companion and set out on a fantastical journey where rich storytelling blends seamlessly with deep simulation gameplay.

title: WinMon
description: Raise, feed, and farm your cute little monster—right on your desktop! A relaxing idle game to help you unwind, even on stressful days.

title: Yami Kids
description: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.

title: Otterly Lost
description: Play as Otto, a curious sea otter swept far from home. In this story-rich adventure, explore wild forests, dive underwater, glide over rocky canyons, and climb your way back. Meet friendly animals, complete heartfelt quests, and enjoy soft challenges, at your own pace!

title: Silky Rails
description: Take on a roguelike adventure along the dangerous Silky Road. Build your train with unique carts, fight tough enemies, and collect new weapons for your character. Each run is full of strange events and deadly zones. Can you make it to the end, or will the Silky Road defeat you like so many before?

title: Evergrow: Shards of Tomorrow
description: Explore the ruined world of Evergrow, where echoes of a lost civilization whisper through the remnants of a once-thriving planet. Solve puzzles to piece together the truth of what led to its downfall. Can you restore what was lost, or will the shards of tomorrow shape its fate forever?

title: Heroes' Vow: Three Kingdoms
description: "Legend of Heroes: Three Kingdoms" is a single-player RPG where you shape the Three Kingdoms era. Choose to be a ruler, a loyal advisor, or a cunning mercenary. Marry, build homes, or train in martial arts. Restore peace through diplomacy or conquer with mighty armies.

title: Babelomania
description: A technogothic horror where a beautiful wedding turns into a death trap... Who will survive?

title: Stick It to the Stickman
description: Stick it to the Stickman is a practical guide for anybody seeking to climb the corporate ladder in the fastest way possible. A groin-kicking, staple-gunning, chainsaw-wielding roguelike brawler loaded with high-impact, physics-based combat, copious amounts of coffee, and weaponized farts!

title: Nomori
description: Nomori is a mind-bending puzzle game where you need to control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.

title: Nios
description: NIOS is a futuristic anti gravity obstacle racing game arcade where you run along a point to point paths in a open world map. Get your best score overtaking the greatest number of opponents in sequences without hit them. P.S. Remember to follow the green arrow otherwise you could get lost. :-)

title: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
description: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an epic adventure set in a vast magical world where you’ll fight dangerous beasts, defy corrupt gods, and face many challenges, all in an attempt to bring balance back to your world.​Embark on this journey with Hira, a mysterious young boy who seeks the truth about his forgotten past. Along the way, bond with many fully-voiced characters to unlock new skills and abilities that will aid you in your battle through environments that constantly change and react to your choices - all in classic, hand-drawn animation.

title: R.I.P.
description: A co-op horror game where you manipulate your own gravity to traverse a procedurally generated 3D maze filled with supernatural threats. Work alone or with your team to rescue kidnapped victims.

title: Catson Files: Wizard Town
description: All one hundred cats of Wizard Town are gone. The mayor promises a reward, the Academy asks that no questions be asked. Good advice. I need someone with a free evening and a good pair of eyes. — the Client

title: Purple Shift
description:
Purple Shift is a psychological mystery visual novel set in a world touched by an anomalous phenomenon known as the Purple Storm.

What begins as an ordinary shift slowly starts to fracture. Familiar places feel wrong. Conversations repeat in ways they shouldn't. Memories become unreliable. And somewhere behind it all, something is listening.

Over the course of seven days, your decisions shape the people around you, the information you uncover, and the version of events you ultimately believe.

title: Bubble Stomp
description:
Get ready for an adventure packed with jumps, bubbles, and creativity in Bubble Stomp! Here, every obstacle is an opportunity to test your skills and discover new ways to move through stages filled with exciting platforming challenges.

Use temporary bubbles, Ground Pound, and cannons to reach impossible places, cross dangerous areas, and overcome increasingly challenging obstacles. Combine these mechanics in unexpected ways to create new paths, gain momentum, defeat enemies, and reach the final objective.

Across 30 levels, new enemies, hazards, and mechanics are gradually introduced, making every stage bring a new surprise. Breakable platforms, cannons, obstacles, enemies, and optional collectibles fill the environments with possibilities to explore.

Checkpoints help you continue your adventure without losing all your progress, while collectibles scattered throughout the levels encourage players who want to explore every corner and completely master the challenges.

Observe the environment, plan your next move, create a bubble, use Ground Pound, blast yourself from cannons, and discover how far your creativity can take you.

Jump, pop, smash, and master every level!

title: Imberite Idle
description: Open chests, collect rare structures, and optimize your build to maximize production in this steampunk idle incremental game.

title: Vs. Tricky: Clowned Out
description: Tricky Mod is back and swinging hard!! Enjoy this visually recreated from the ground up take on Vs. Tricky. The mod includes full recreations of all 4 phases including some goodies for those who poke around the freeplay!

title: Questfarers of the Stone
description: A Dark fantasy themed 2D hand-drawn point and click adventure, following Kabe on a quest into a corrupted part of the Stone. Solve the puzzles of this world, or be lost in it.

title: Farm Harbeest
description: Farm Harbeest is a top-down farm shooter with light incremental progression. Become an armed bee, fight, harvest, gather resources, and upgrade as firepower, efficiency, and harvest range continue to escalate.

title: Skibidi Stones
description: A stone skipping rhythm game where you try to escape from an island.

title: Beyond the Broken Veil
description: Beyond the Broken Veil is a heavily inspired RPG of the 90's. As a retired war veteran, uncover the mysteries that plague a war torn continent. Decide rather to embrace the darkness, or become the benevolent protector.

title: Flutter Plane
description: Flutter Plane is a one-button pixel art arcade game. Tap to keep your little plane in the air, weave through trees and clouds to touch down on the landing pad. Each flight takes about 40 seconds, so there's always time for one more try. Finish the handcrafted levels, then take on Infinitely Random Levels with a new course every time across four difficulty settings.

title: Screenside Fisher
description: Sit back and relax with a desktop fishing game that stays in the corner of your screen. Catch fish, cook recipes, upgrade your gear, and complete your collection guide. Customize your character’s look and even design your very own custom fish to catch!

title: Return of the Twin Peaks
description: Return of the Twin Peaks is an unofficial fan game that turns the story of Twin Peaks into a deduction game, in the 1-bit style of Return of the Obra Dinn.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - The Viking Sagas
description:
The Viking Sagas is an expansion for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition that adds the Danes, Saxons, and Varangians, each with distinct technologies, units, and strategies. New shared units, including Varangian Guards, Mounted Crossbowmen, and Longships, expand the options for land and naval warfare in campaigns and multiplayer.

The expansion also includes three interconnected campaigns following Harald Hardrada’s rise from exiled prince to Viking ruler. Fight across Scandinavia, the Mediterranean, the Kyivan Rus, the Byzantine Empire, and England as Harald pursues wealth, power, and a return to the throne.

title: Astromental Incremental
description: Mesmerizing idle clicker incremental game where you build your own star systems and mine matter amid the ever-rising chaos of colliding asteroids, comets, and planets. Upgrades, Skill Tree, Abilities, Research, Perks, crits, chain lightning, burns, and more. Idle build or clicker build - you choose.

title: Jarred Defense
description: A difficult maze-building tower defense about Yuki, a cat trapped in a teleporting jar. Protect it from robots and endure its unhelpful comments. Build your own paths, adapt as levels change, unlock powerful items, and uncover Yuki’s story. A love letter to Warcraft III custom maps.

title: Somnius
description: Somnius is a chaotic co-op extraction game for up to 6 players. Dive into collapsing dreams, turn anything into ammo, feed the portal to buy more time, and save the Dreamer before the dream burns away.

title: Horta Maluca
description: Defend a mad garden in this top-down action roguelite. Face waves of mutant pests, collect seeds, fuse weapons, choose powerful upgrades and grow each vegetable hero through permanent progression. Build your arsenal and survive the final wave.

title: Aeonfall
description: Command the Unwoven—heroes erased from history—in a tactical 2D Roguelite where every turn shifts the battlefield. Lead your squad through a fractured Greek timeline to dismantle the Loom of Fate and dethrone a paranoid King of the Gods.

title: Dune: Awakening - Filmic Archive
description: Bring the Imperium to Dune: Awakening with gear inspired by Dune: Part One and Part Two. Wear iconic armor and stillsuits, build a Sardaukar base with 73 construction pieces, and finish it with exclusive décor, weapons, and emotes.

title: Medieval Dynasty: Hunting Pack
description: Demonstrate your hunting skills with the Hunting Pack DLC! Choose between special outfits, grab one of the unique weapons, and prove to everyone you are the best hunter around. Let the hunt begin with the set of new legendary items.

title: Breakout Garage
description: Breakout Garage is an open-world driving and racing simulator built around old-school American muscle, deep tuning, drag racing, and the garage life.

title: Memeology Club
description: For 3-6 players! Play from anywhere in the world. Get together online, talk with built-in voice chat, and laugh like you're all sitting at the same table.

title: Minibus Simulator
description: Build your own minibus business and transport passengers across the city. Load luggage, maintain and wash your vehicle, unlock new routes and grow your transport career in a living city.

title: TocoToco
description: TocoToco is an addictive platformer where every jump matters. Explore colorful levels, dodge challenging obstacles, and uncover hidden secrets while testing your reflexes. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Lucky Break
description: In this roguelike deckbuilder you’re an addict. Deep in debt to the mob, a little drunk, and out of time. Just one more spin, and then you'll quit.

title: Framework Zero: Terminal Panic
description: You are hurtling through space aboard an industrial freighter. The crew already had their hands full with failing systems. But now there is a new threat on board. Something is hunting you. Terminal Panic is a survival-horror "interactive fiction" text adventure RPG with '80s terminal aesthetics.

title: Crown of Hispania
description: Rewrite the Reconquista in a grand strategy game set in 11th-century Iberia, where population, religion, and war evolve dynamically based on your decisions. Move armies freely across 300 hand-built provinces, manage a deep medieval economy, and face an AI that actually fights back.

title: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey
description: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey is a role-playing card game set in the Seekers Alliance universe. Venture into the mysterious Sovereign's Island with a diverse cast of Heroes, strengthening your decks through battles and encounters; confront powerful foes and uncover the Island's hidden secrets.

title: Airport Control 27
description: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

title: Overdrive Reloaded
description: Drop into a stunning reimagining of Overdrive, built from the ground up with relentless PvE combat, action-packed Arena modes, an open world Survival experience, and all-new skill tree and roguelike progression systems. Prepare for Overdrive, you are cleared for deployment.

title: Graveyard Keeper II
description: The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!

title: Realindustry
description: Realindustry is a hyper-realistic industrial automation simulator that blends deep strategy with authentic scientific principles, challenging players to build, automate, and optimize complex production chains using 236 real-world materials and 354 production processes. Developed by AssemblyPrime, the game features a unique "mystery" theme where your industrial expansion is monitored by an unknown entity, adding narrative tension to the core loop of resource management, automation, and technological progression. Across multiple technological tiers, players must master genuine chemical engineering, metallurgy, and increasingly advanced automation systems to transform basic elements into advanced products, offering an exceptional level of technical depth for fans of the automation genre on Windows and macOS.

title: Pool Loop
description:
You are trapped in an endlessly looping indoor swimming pool. Inspect the pool carefully and look for anomalies.

If anything feels wrong, press the RED button.
If everything seems normal, press the GREEN button.

Make the wrong call, and the loop continues.

title: BuGarden
description: 《BuGarden》 is a cozy idle flower-growing game that lives in the corner of your desktop. Plant seeds, water and fertilize them at your own pace, harvest cute flowers and fruits, and deal with a few playful bugs—nothing messy, just a calm little garden keeping you company.

title: Dash Dot Die
description: Dash Dot Die is a first-person Morse puzzle game set in a maze of forgotten rooms, hallways, and airducts. Your past has caught up with you. Someone is determined to make you suffer just as they once did. Trapped in their twisted game, you must endure the same fate and overcome every challenge.

title: Trailquest MTB
description: Race against the clock, conquer technical challenges, and take on the quest to master the trails in this open-world MTB experience.

title: Gunclone Arena
description: Gunclone Arena is a top-down looter-shooter roguelite. Fight as a super-clone that can wield 6 weapons, a Beam and Shield in a dystopian TV show! Loot thousands of weapon variants with ricochet, detonate, shock, pierce and more. Stack build-changing Mods. Notice: Escape is grounds for perma-recycle.

title: Rogue Hanafuda
description: A roguelike deckbuilding game meets Hanafuda. Never played Hanafuda before? No problem. Jump right in and discover an addictive roguelike card game that's easy to learn but impossible to put down.

title: Sea Sweeper
description: Sea Sweeper is a relaxing incremental game where you clean the ocean with your ship. Collect garbage, manage fuel, earn money, and upgrade your ship to clean faster and sweep larger sea areas each run.

title: Isernsmith
description: Isernsmith is a gothic action-adventure RPG where you have to explore dungeons, gather resources, and forge new weapons and tools to overcome a tyrannical order.

title: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: Evolution
description: Evolution is the next major story expansion for Terminator: Dark Fate – Defiance, the gritty real-time strategy experience set in the dark future of Dark Fate.

title: Rivage
description: Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

title: Slay the King
description: Lead a tribe of warriors to defeat a corrupt king and reclaim your land

title: Panzer Deck
description: Panzer Deck is a tactical card-based war game. Deploy resources to recruit units and equipment. Use maneuver cards to reposition forces, maximize their potential, and synergize units for powerful combos. Secure victory on WWII’s Western Front battlefields.

title: Well Dweller
description: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer- a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

title: Important People of History: Presidents - Abraham Lincoln
description:
Learn all about Abraham Lincoln in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of Lincoln’s hat from the day he was shot, the Lincoln Memorial, where he gave the Gettysburg address, and much more. Lawyer, President, Emancipator - this is Abraham Lincoln!

Part of the Important People of History series:
1. George Washington
2. Thomas Jefferson
3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Proudly made in the Washington DC area

title: Sproutmart: Grocery Store Simulator
description: Run your own grocery store. Stock shelves, scan items at the checkout, and keep the store moving — solo or with friends. Farm, process, and fish for goods to expand what you can sell.

title: Packed Lair
description: You are an evil lord with a hero problem and not nearly enough floor space. Draft buildings, pack them into your cramped lair, toil to earn money to expand, create powerful monster synergies, and send your chaotic army of minions to repel wave after wave of heroic do-gooder pests.

title: Anomaly Protocol
description: Anomaly Protocol is an online horror game set in an exploded radiation laboratory! Rescue injured survivors, collect items, and find the exit by meeting the quota in each level. Remember! Radiation poisons you, and survivors may mutate!

title: Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild
description: "Welcome, adventurer! What quest have you completed today?” A classic fantasy guild reception simulation — 『Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild』

title: Rogue Snake
description: Rogue Snake is the latest evolution of the classical snake game. We've added combat and roguelite mechanics - earn levels, upgrade your Mecha Snake and defeat bosses while dodging enemy attacks!

title: Gravebound
description: Gravebound is a 6-player co-op extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by rogue machines. Scavenge valuable loot, survive intense firefights, complete dynamic objectives, and extract alive to keep what you earn. Push deeper for rarer rewards, tougher enemies, and higher stakes.

title: eXoSpace Combat Engineer
description: Design your ship, choose your target, and embark on a hunt through a randomly generated universe. Each hyperjump leads to a new and unexpected encounter, forcing you to make tough choices. What kind of bounty hunter will you become?

title: True Vikings
description: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

title: Parasited Will
description: Enter this story of survival against the new alien domain with the help of the warriors of the Anti-Chaos Brigade in intense, fast-paced Arcade-style combat.

title: Ved: Recure
description: Ved: Recure is a fast-paced action roguelite where you play as an adult trapped in the 1000th game you bought but never played. You’ll wield fully customizable buff chains to face off against formidable foes and strategic builds to conquer this 1000th game and make your way back to reality.

title: Stuntboost
description: Race against time on tracks of cardboard and toys to break records, climb leaderboards and become the fastest skater your online-neighborhood has ever seen!

title: Moonwakers
description:
Dive into a survival roguelite by taking control of a S.E.E.D, an advanced reconnaissance android! To accomplish your mission, explore exoplanets to determine if they are suitable for humanity.

Thus, you'll need to search for vital elements necessary for life: Carbon, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, Oxygen, Phosphorus, and Sulfur. But beware, danger lurks on this unknown land, and your survival will depend on your ingenuity and skills. Traps abound, and you'll need to strategize to make it through.

Regularly, you'll have to shelter your character to escape ionic storms. Exploration will allow you to acquire new skills and enjoy more autonomy, speed, and gliding. Your biggest challenge? Managing your energy to avoid extinction.

title: False Hero
description: False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos. Explore the corrupted Land of the Gods and put your combat skills to the true test in challenging boss fights. Will you fight for the Gods or become an apostle of Death?

title: EbiTapes
description: Go on an adventure to meet fun new friends, help them out, and create delicious beats along the way! Record the sounds of the world and make your own cool music.

title: Obscurity: Unknown Threat
description: Obscurity: Unknown Threat is a horror shooter game where a team of soldiers must survive against a hidden foe. The game contains both conventional symmetrical FPS game modes as well as asymmetrical battles vs the Obscurity.

title: Nocturne
description: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

title: Nighthawks
description:
"Nighthawks is the brand new urban fantasy RPG from Wadjet Eye Games (The Blackwell Legacy, Unavowed, Technobabylon) and writer/designer Richard Cobbett (Sunless Sea/Sunless Skies, The Long Journey Home)."

"Nighthawks is a mix of story-driven RPG and undead life-simulation, where every decision you make is another move in your chess game against the world. Invest your time into learning new skills or honing your fighting style as you uncover the city's mysteries and venture deep into its darkest secrets. Gather fellow outcasts to your side, binding them with favours and choosing when to cash in. Manage your eternal thirst, legitimately, or balancing the risks of being caught stalking unwary victims and working the black markets."

title: Curve Fever
description: Curve Fever is a high-energy, multiplayer snake game with powers. Survive each round and battle-it-out online against opponents, utilizing your own customized ship to win. Climb the ranked ladder and level up, earning new powers with each new level!

title: Little Ghost
description: Chill metroidvania maximizes non-linear exploration & puzzle-platforming. Frequent checkpoints, no currency, no combat. Gain friends & abilities. Collectables-as-media; tarot cards, weird podcasts, and songs from over 20 bands; all found within a surreal papercraft world.

title: Foxhollow
description: Foxhollow is a fully native port of Star Fox Adventures for modern platforms.

title: Tenfold: Number Puzzle
description: Tenfold is a number merge puzzle for iPhone and iPad. Drag shapes from your tray onto the grid. Neighbouring tiles with the same number merge into a bigger number, and any group that adds up to exactly 10 clears. The run ends when nothing else fits. Play is endless: as your score climbs, the Heat Level rises and brings trickier shapes and ice blocks. Chain clears for combo multipliers. Fully offline, with dark and light modes and haptics. Free with ads.

title: Problems Jogo
description: A game of precision and patience designed to be intentionally frustrating. The player's goal is to guide the character along a narrow sand path to the finish flag. Stepping on the grass results in immediate failure, forcing a restart of the level. As the game progresses, the character's size and movement change drastically to make advancement more difficult.

title: Hardware Store: Tidy Up
description: A cozy sorting simulator about calmly putting a chaotic hardware store back in order. Pick up tools, find their shelves, and enjoy the relaxing rhythm of organizing.

title: Grim Siege
description: Grim Siege is a 1v1 dark-fantasy card duel. Raise your own tower or tear down your enemy's. Six classes and a deep status system turn every turn into a puzzle of combos and counterplay. Take on the AI or other players in quick matches and ranked battles.

title: Non-League Manager
description: Manage one of over 1,000 real non-league clubs through the English football pyramid. Day jobs, ground grading, gate receipts, cup runs, and a world where clubs can fold around you. Football management at its most real.

title: Core Keeper: Riders of the Underground
description: Core Keeper: Riders of the Underground update introduces rideable mounts for faster underground traversal, a new peaceful Moss sub-biome to explore, and enhanced magic gameplay for Mages and Summoners. A new Hookshot tool lets you cross dangerous pits, while three adorable new pets assist in combat. The update also adds dozens of new weapons, armor, rings, and necklaces, alongside quality-of-life improvements like gear comparison and customizable cursors.

title: Museum Disarter
description: The Museum is a complete disARTer! Organize hundreds of paintings, figure out which absurdly informal description belongs to each artwork, and restore order to the gallery. Deduce and sort in this cozy single-player first-person simulator.

title: Sylv and the Ancient Tree
description: The balance of Sunroot Island is fading. Join Sylv, guardian of the Ancestral Tree, in a vibrant platforming RPG adventure. Reclaim the elemental energy stolen by the egocentric Umbra before the biomes collapse and the corrupted wildlife takes full control.

title: Ludus Deceptor
description: Ludus Deceptor is a dark roguelike card game about risk, deception, and cursed bets. Battle at the card table, build powerful combinations, use bonuses, curses, interactive cards, and various items to escape prison, survive the royal court, and claim the throne.

title: Darrell 3D
description: Darrell 3D is an autonomous first-person dungeon crawler where you play as the spectator: gear Darrell up, choose his patches and loadout, send him back down, rescue dogs, witness bizarre FMVs, DMs, and events, and watch him fight his way through the dungeon to break free from his prison.

title: GridEnergy
description: Become the ultimate energy tycoon in this strategic incremental game. Start with humble coal mines, build complex supply chains, manipulate the stock market, and fund cutting-edge research to build the ultimate power source: a Dyson Sphere.

title: Guinea Pig Gunner
description: Guinea Pig Gunner is a run-and-gun platformer with boomer shooter DNA. It fuses skill-based action platforming with a massive arsenal of weapons.

title: Ashrun Survivors
description: Fight endless hordes in Ashrun Survivors, a dark fantasy bullet heaven roguelite. Build powerful weapon evolutions, unlock lasting upgrades, and push deeper into dangerous runs where every choice shapes your survival.

title: Thanks for the Soup
description: The job's simple: Go around town and satisfy your customers with some nice and hot soup. Hop on your bicycle and go around town, make some money, buy items, take care of your cat, and much more in this immersive horror simulator.

title: Escape Simulator 2: Apocalypse DLC
description: The Apocalypse DLC adds 4 new escape rooms set in a near-future world devastated by an unknown catastrophe. Civilization has gone quiet. Cities are overgrown, systems are failing, and the only way forward is through the clues left by those who came before you.

title: Back to 21
description: A narrative RPG life-sim about the dreams you talked yourself out of. You’ve been given a chance to go back to 21. Build relationships, explore new paths, and pursue the passion you once buried. Beneath it all lies a deeper truth about the world that contains you. Or perhaps… that you contain.

title: Rogue Kingdom
description: In Rogue Kingdom, Online Roguelike meets Settlement Building! Clear dungeons, claim them, fill them with NPCs, and defend them in an online world. Grow stronger through loot, mining, crafting, magic, and help from other players.

title: Lootborne
description: Lootborne is a dark fantasy desktop autobattler. Build your character, loot gear, push through PvE stages, and challenge other players in async PvP duels while battle rages at the edge of your screen.

title: Eon Survivor
description: Harvest vital resources behind enemy lines and survive relentless waves! Deploy from a carrier forced to retreat, collect fast, and secure your cargo before time runs out. Push your luck in this fast-paced rogue-lite space shooter—or be left behind.

title: Veil of the Damned
description: Beyond the veil of the damned, face danger and treasure. Master your skills to survive the labyrinth.

title: Yandere Virus
description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Play solo or with your friends to collect Platonic Pumpkins and save your precious friend infected by the terrifying Yandere Virus.

title: Guys with Magnets
description: Guys with Magnets is a co-op physics parkour game about using a supercharged magnet to move through island courses with up to 8 players. Pull, repel, swing, explode, solve magnetic puzzles, and try to reach the finish together, even when everything goes wrong.

title: Citadel
description: Awake from your slumber and venture out to the mighty Citadel.

title: Nullbreak Protocol
description: A sci-fi arcade roguelite of fast, escalating runs. Launch your core, shatter every block, survive what the room fires back. Draw stacking protocols to build your run, push deeper into the system, and beat your record — the descent never ends.

title: Video Game Menu: The Game
description: A short game about the very best part of video games: the menus.

title: IGTAP: An Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer
description: Amass an army of clones to follow your tightly-optimised path. Generate massive amounts of power to upgrade your production and movement abilities.

title: Crystant
description: Crystant is a top-down roguelike set in a post-apocalyptic underground facility. Explore tangled tunnels, face strange mutants, and survive with limited resources. Hidden events, deadly traps, and clues await. Will you uncover the truth or fall into the darkness?

title: Tung Tung Together: Online Deathrun Party
description: A multiplayer deathrun party game where you activate traps as Tung Tung, and if someone clears the course, the role switches. Cute characters, online competition, chaos, and fun-filled maps—collect the highest score and dominate the mayhem!

title: Tiny Cat Fishing
description: Set off on a bright adventure across a magical island Catch fish, unlock adorable animal heroes, collect unique rods, and explore rivers, lakes, and the open ocean. Search for rare species and become the ultimate angler!

title: Upload Aliens
description: The rule: DON'T LET THEM TOUCH GROUND! Become the Cyberpunk Knight and launch aliens skyward. Use foes as missiles to trigger chain explosions in infinite aerial combos. Unleash this pixel-art roguelite spectacle with just three buttons: Move, Jump, Dash.

title: Pawns Survival
description: Pawn Survival is a turn-based survival strategy game where you command a small community of pawns struggling to survive, send them to gather resources, explore unknown lands, grow your village, and forge powerful equipment to withstand whatever this brutal world throws at you.

title: Fruitbearer
description: A visceral reimagining of the Suika-style physics puzzler, rebuilt as a punishing dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Awaken as forgotten deity of bounty, stripped of grandeur, now facing sunless barrens and monsters. To restore balance, you must grow. To grow, you must sacrifice.

title: Roadhouse Simulator
description:
Roadhouse is the prelude to Gas Station Simulator where you take on the role of the uncle and explore his humble beginnings. Start as a bouncer at a roadhouse on Route 66 and work your way up to running the entire business.

In this 1st person view simulator game you deal with a multitude of customers and various biker gangs, manage the roadhouse, tend to the bar, master the grill, stock the right supplies and acquire more territories to widen your influence.

title: Food for Frog
description: Food for Frog is a cozy cooking puzzle game about experimenting with ingredients to create dishes requested by a cast of froggy characters. Get to know your customers, learn new recipes, relax and enjoy the cute artwork.

title: Deified
description: Forge your strategy around powerful relics in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Choose your slots, manage their constraints, and face formidable bosses.

title: Aenoic Abyss
description: Swap between two heroines (Paladin/Mage/Assassin/Centaur Archer) instantly in this 2D pixel-art roguelite platformer, forge permanent Diablo-inspired builds with 200+ affix combinations to conquer cycle-reborn abyssal labyrinths and rend the holy veil of the Purification Ritual.

title: Formula 2.5
description: A retro-style 2.5D arcade racing game inspired by the golden era of Formula 1. Drive through four decades of racing history, master cockpit-view controls, and battle changing weather conditions across iconic circuits like Monaco.

title: Dressmaker
description:
Dressmaker is a cozy game inspired by real dressmaking.

Become a dressmaker, choose dress designs, cut out fabric and sew them all together to satisfy (or sabotage!) customers.

title: Echoes of Mora
description: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

title: Carnaval Marbles
description: A tactical billiards roguelike inspired by French carom. Activate magical balls, tweak the rules by choosing talismans, and chase ever-higher scores. Each round is a challenge of physics and strategy. Find the balance between skill and luck…

title: Normal Golf Game
description: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.

title: Backframes: Escape Together
description: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

title: The Stickman
description: The Stickman is a movement-based FPS inspired by Titanfall 2 and Trackmania! Shatter PvE leaderboard records, battle friends in PvP, or create custom stages with the built-in Level Editor!

title: Brave New Wonders
description: Automate, optimize, and build vast factories in a post-apocalyptic automation game for those who have evolved beyond conveyor belts. Command intelligent robots that obey your plain-text commands in any language, explore the ruins of a lost civilization, and rebuild humanity one machine at a time.

title: Scirocco Thugs
description: Roundhouse Kicks, Six shooters and rusty Lead Pipes become your vehicles for revenge against the Don.... Grab some scrap and engage in brutal, breakneck melee combat in this FPS Beat 'Em Up!

title: Invasion Survivors
description: Invasion Survivors is a fast-paced bullet heaven and bullet hell arena shooter with roguelike elements. Explore a colorful and chaotic world where survival depends on your skills, quick reflexes, and every choice you make.

title: Project Solaris
description: A rogue-lite RPG about the 100-day challenge of Solaris, a Less magic power witch, and her sidekick Homu, with beautifully animated combat, quick-time events, and charming characters to interact with!

title: Mad Metal
description: Mad Metal is a vehicle combat roguelite set in a dying America. Customize your vehicle, master precision car-to-car combat, and fight through dynamic arenas as a broken cop races to rescue his daughter and stop an AI-driven apocalypse.

title: Nettle
description: A survival RTS game about exploring the vast cosmos, the many planets inhabiting it and their countless secrets. You'll need to explore, gather resources and research new technologies in order to survive, thrive, and eventually build a colony on a bizarre, foreign world.

title: Ghoul Fright
description: Ghoul Fright is a physics based FPS Survival Beat em up with a 90/2000s cartoon vibe, fight dangerous Ghouls as you cause destruction and chaos in your way while hell unleashes in heated Ghoul waves. ¿Ready to Fright?

title: Delverium
description: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this vast procedurally generated survival adventure for up to 4 players. What you do is up to you, but the deeper you delve, the more you uncover the hidden truth. Could you be the hero to restore stability to the land and put an end to the invading "Faults"?

title: Soggy Beans
description: Fish will come, fish will go. Take photos, collect beans, decorate your seascape, then relax or do other things while your friends swim by in this calming side-idler.

title: The Rabbit Haul
description: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

title: Cuckoo Mask
description: A Eroge visual novel game visual novel by smut artist Hasselnut- in Cuckoo Mask you're the biggest bulliable bottom in a masked party! With 5 character routes and one true ending, you will explore different kinds of domination.

title: So Below
description: Gear up, hunt, adapt, survive. Engage in a co-op survival horror experience with up to 4 players online. Explore the haunted location, find the clues and tools needed to complete the ritual and defeat the entity. Will you be able to survive?

title: Eagle Knight Paradox
description: Eagle knight paradox takes you (the player) into a doble experience, one of them is the role of a powerful mecha trying to protect a space city from space fanatics. On the other hand, the game sets you as the role of Ian (the pilot) building relationships around the city or whats left of it.

title: Attention, Dear Passengers
description:
Welcome aboard Flight ROSE-204. It should have been an ordinary flight. Then the cabin starts to break apart.

Attention, Dear Passengers is a single-player, physics-driven survival game where every round turns a routine flight into a fight to stay upright. Brace in your seat, move through a collapsing cabin, avoid dangerous debris, and keep going after the wreck hits the ground.

You are not alone. Six AI passengers react to the disaster around them: some seek safety, some panic, and some make a bad situation worse. Grab a passenger when the moment calls for it, pull them from danger, or fight to keep your own footing while the world shifts beneath you.

Each flight uses fresh random seeds for its disaster events. Lightning, ruptures, decompression, floods, fire, acid rain, aftershocks, and tornadoes can reshape the round and force a new survival plan.

title: Unearthed Memoirs
description:
A 2D platformer where you go through each level collecting what is golden to you.

Featuring 3 levels each with their own new gimmick to try and speed run through, the faster you are the more points you get!

title: The Meridian Paradox
description: A traveller opens his eyes to a world that has already ended: ash on the wind, silence where cities once stood. He knows the cause. It began with a single choice, and the choice was his. Now he must slip backward through time and stand in the shadow of his own past, because the man he used to be is coming to erase a visionary whose work the world could not survive without. To save what remains of tomorrow, he must stop himself.

title: DIY Dadish
description: Create your own adventure and share it with the world! Everyone's favorite radish dad is back, but this time the story is up to you! in DIY Dadish gives players the ability to design any Dadish level they can imagine.

title: Lumiric Stage
description: Create musical content with real-time MIDI visualization, Magic Piano, real-time sheet music, built-in camera tools, and cinematic Stages. Design and share custom particle effects as portable .mvfx files. Built for creators, pianists, educators, performers, and streamers.

title: The Confined: Basement
description: Wake up in a dark basement as a victim with no memory of your past. Can you uncover your true identity and solve the mystery of your past by collecting the cryptic notes left by your captor? Face the brutal truths and find a way to escape this nightmare alive.

title: Dear Journey...
description: Run your own little travel agency. Plan itineraries with the cards you are dealt. Satisfying traveller moods and needs to help grow your agency’s reputation.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe
description: Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe is a full game mod of Battle for Bikini Bottom created by Gravity. It is an expansion of the original Battle for Bikini Bottom featuring 200 Golden Spatulas, over 30 new areas, new collectables, Game Options, and so much more.

title: Darby is Here Forever
description: Help our little vampire Darby getting out from his eternal prison. Log on into a difficult 2D pixel platformer, find out secret rooms, defeat great bosses and end up discovering why Darby has been imprisoned in his own castle!

title: Slime Trader
description: Summon, place, and merge slimes to stop the larvae pouring from the pen. Collect 111 slimes across 12 grades from F to XXX, grow through runes and rebirths, trade eligible Steam Inventory items, and climb the stage leaderboard in this casual pixel-art horde defense game.

title: L'Empire Banger V3
description: L'Empire Banger V3 is an incremental browser game based on the fictional universe and recurring themes associated with Algator37. Players build a growing empire by producing resources, purchasing upgrades, automating production and unlocking new progression elements. The game combines traditional clicker mechanics with references to characters, concepts and creations from the Algator37 universe. As the third version of the project, L'Empire Banger V3 expands the original concept with a broader progression system and additional content centered around the "Banger" empire.

title: Only Farms
description: Hot days. Dirty secrets. Endless temptation. This summer is about to get hotter than you planned. Take on wild festival challenges, get dangerously close to tempting girls, uncover their hidden desires, and let every choice take you somewhere unexpected.

title: Screw It
description: Screw It is a cozy, realistic organizing simulator where you sort 777 nails + 1 screw and tidy up your workbench. Use different tools to fix and organize various types of nails. No abilities No pressure, just fix, sort, stock and enjoy the satisfaction of stocking nails in a relaxing environment.

title: Emberwall
description: Emberwall is a roguelite tower defense game where you reshape enemy paths with tetromino walls, harvest resources, reveal a fog-covered wilderness, and combine powerful towers and elemental upgrades to defend your castle.

title: Deep Nightmare: Phobias
description: Travel between the real world and your dreams, dive into your subconscious, and survive your own fears. In this mix of Survival Horror and Psychological Horror, you'll play through a collection of the scariest phobias out there while being constantly hunted by fear itself.

title: That Cloud Looks Like
description: Huh? This cloud looks like... something! What do you see in a randomly generated cloud? The drawer adds clues inside the cloud, while the other players try to guess the answer from as few clues as possible. Compete using your imagination and intuition in this online drawing quiz game.

title: Bound by Destiny
description: Control a dark dungeon as the Viber Lord, in an attempt to trap Princess Mistynail. Place and trigger traps, unleash creatures, and strike at key moments to block her path as she tries to find the exit. Prevent her escape and pave the way for your rebirth and revenge on her bloodline!

title: Parkour Obby: Magma Run
description: Keep moving!

title: Red Hallways: Horror
description: The exit is right there... but you can't leave.

title: The Furry Protocol
description: Survive and escape from the scientific research complex in the Siberian forests and uncover the secrets of the corporation that built this complex.

title: Night Record: Thin Walls
description: Vadim, a maintenance worker in a decaying post-Soviet apartment, leaves town to care for his sick mother, asking his wife to take over his duties. As she settles into the routine, the building begins to feel off quiet in all the wrong ways.

title: The Options Menu
description: The Options Menu is a game where you play as a 'Player' and experience a life filled with Options. Explore countless endings to uncover a game that may surprise you as the real friend all along was your Options Menu in this Comedic Story.

title: Server-Admin Simulator
description: Build your datacenter empire from scratch. Buy hardware, manage contracts, hire staff and outsmart rivals. Face random events, hack the competition and survive the market. Moddable. Multiplayer. No two runs alike.

title: Night of the Living Bubble
description: NOT YOUR AVERAGE NIGHT SHIFT... When clocking into work, you find that your business has been overrun by monsters borne from the products on the shelves. Constructed by a mad scientist bent on world domination, only YOU can stop them and save the world by shooting monsters with your Nailgun.

title: Panic Files: Buried Sanity
description: Your first day at the local mine got a hell of a twist when the tunnels caved in. Can you escape when the only way out is going deeper? Avoid the deadly creatures, push through hallucinations and remember: Don't panic.

title: Trash Wars
description: A 3D hybrid tower defense game! Defend against trash, send trash. Manage resources, build turrets, automate defenses, and survive against pollution.

title: Rusted Awakening
description: A gothic horror shooter set in a rusted industrial nightmare. Inspired by John Romero, David Lynch, and Doom 64.

title: Sperme d’Éros: Garden of Earthly Delights
description: This DLC will expand the universe of the original Visual Novel, Gardens of Earthly Delights. We will follow this story from the point of view of the couple Eros and Venus. We will follow their materialistic and carnal desires as they delight in pleasures in our real world.

title: Day Off Simulator
description: Unwind and have a blast in the "Day Off Simulator"! Give your boss a slap, relax with interactive musical instruments, and enjoy various leisure activities. A unique blend of excitement, relaxation, and creativity awaits you!

title: Ashworth
description: Something has been waiting for you. Explore a forgotten place buried beneath the earth, solve twisted puzzles, and piece together a dark story one clue at a time. But the deeper you go, the more it wakes. Survive what hunts you, or become part of Ashworth's story.

title: Sonic Adventure: Recompiled
description: The Dreamcast adventure, recompiled for PC.

title: Where Are My Cats?
description: Explore different regions, find hidden cats, and unlock new areas! Discover all 100 cats across 5 main regions while enjoying a relaxing exploration experience with cozy sounds.

title: Shadow Cat
description:
Darkness has swallowed the land. Only one unlikely hero is brave enough to fight back.
Shadow Cat is a focused 2D action-platformer that puts you in control of a fearless cat boy on a mission to save a world overrun by evil creatures. Run, jump, and dash through 25 handcrafted levels set across dark forests, abandoned factories, dangerous caves, and forgotten tunnels.
Straightforward controls make it easy to begin, but every new stage introduces more demanding platforming challenges. Time your jumps, dash across deadly gaps, avoid spikes and moving hazards, and launch fireballs to defeat the creatures standing in your way.
Explore each level to collect life points and replenish your fireball ammo. Activate checkpoints to protect your progress when danger strikes. Taking damage costs one life and returns you to the latest checkpoint—but lose every life, and the level must be faced again from the beginning.
The journey becomes more dangerous as new enemies, traps, and environmental threats test your timing, awareness, and resource management. Master your movement, use your fireballs wisely, and keep pushing forward until the final confrontation with a giant spider and its relentless minions.

title: Death Simulator
description: You are Death's newest employee, tasked with collecting souls across a supernatural world where the afterlife operates as a sprawling corporation. Armed with spectral chains and soul-hunting arrows, you must meet daily quotas while navigating dynamic combat encounters—from rooftop pursuits to hellish battlegrounds. Precision timing determines success as you hunt souls in first-person perspective, with every collection feeling immediate and consequential. Progress through Death's hierarchy, unlock new abilities, and advance your eternal career across photorealistic environments rendered in Unreal Engine 5, where otherworldly horror meets meticulous detail.

title: Air Race Assault
description: Air Race Assault is an arcade air racing game that blends high-speed flight with aerial combat. Pilot agile aircraft through obstacle-filled tracks featuring dangerous curves, alternate routes, and dynamic scenery while engaging opponents in mid-air dogfights. Use machine guns, missiles, and mines to attack rivals, while shields and repairs provide tactical defense. Manage boosters strategically, discover shortcuts, and outmaneuver competitors across three difficulty levels and multiple game modes—Championship, Arcade, and Time Trial. Local split-screen multiplayer lets you compete head-to-head on the same console, and progression unlocks new content and tracks as you climb the leaderboard.

title: 101 Cats: Melbourne
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Melbourne landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Party Party Time 3: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
Ragdoll Kart Simulator 2026
description: Drift. Boost. Race. Overdrive.

title: Le Fishe
description: Le Fishe is a cozy fishing adventure where every cast of your line leads to something new. Catch a wide variety of fish, upgrade your fishing gear, and unlock new locations as you progress. Talk to an interesting cast of characters and try your best to catch the biggest fish of them all!

title: Vibe Taxi
description: VibeTaxi is a top-down driving videogame heavily inspired by the saga Crazy Taxi. where you work as a taxi driver, with a slow car. The game's gimmick is music, once you pay attention to what the passenger has to say, you tune the right music on the radio and enter the Vibe Mode, where you drive faster and unlock drifting.

title: Parasite Elevator
description: A space where parasites in human form lurk. You are trapped inside this bizarre and unsettling place. Count the number of parasites hidden throughout the corridor, then use the elevator to proceed to the correct floor. Choose the wrong floor, and the elevator will begin to consume you.

title: Dashing Krew
description: After a tragic crash, dash across an unknown planet using your crew's wacky UFO abilities to find a way home.

title: Violarium
description: A puzzle game where you need to touch blocks in the correct order.

title: Yes. A Bottle Flip Game. In 2026.
description: A physics-based arcade game about the bottle flip challenge.

title: Sweet Orgasm
description: A relaxing erotic anime puzzle game. Complete five different mini-games to unlock new artworks, and enjoy your hot collection in the gallery.

title: Night Alley
description: Every night in this narrow alley is never the same. Light all 10 candles before something in the dark decides you shouldn't. One mistake... and the flame goes out for good.

title: We Are Sisters
description: We Are Sisters is a psychological horror experience that takes you deep beneath the forests of Eastbane. Solve puzzles and uncover dark secrets as you venture further underground, drawing ever closer to discovering what happened to your childhood friend, Aleks

title: Go! Go! Horse Run!
description: A free Steel Ball Run browser mini-game, lets players race as Gyro Zeppeli, dodge obstacles, and compete for SS rank.

title: Poopy's Playland
description: Play as a grieving mother whose child went missing in a playland one year ago. Use your trusty flashlight to navigate through the dark, solve replayable puzzles to progress forward, and hide from the unstable killer mascots! Investigate the mysteries and find out the truth...

title: Dead Margin
description: Survival is optional, rent is mandatory. Team up in Dead Margin, a brutal 1-4 player co-op horror. Whisper to survive, avoid anomalies, and scavenge scraps. Sell it to pay the greedy customer. Out here, everything has a price. Especially you.

title: Aetherfall
description: Jump, explore, and master new mechanics as you make your way deeper into the world of Aetherfall.

title: Needle in a Haystack: A Time for Goats
description: Find the needle in a haystack! Use your bare hands and upgrade a variety of tools to search through a giant pile of hay and win the local competition!

title: Skyreach
description: Climb a 960-metre tower in this single-player 3D precision platformer. Every platform moves, crumbles or blinks on a rhythm you can learn. There are no checkpoints and no fall damage: one misjudged jump can drop you all the way back to the ground.

title: Megastore Chaos
description: Turn massive messes into perfect order. Sort 30,281 items across 6 unique stores — from supermarkets and bookstores to electronics, games, wine and shoes — while unlocking skills that make organizing faster and more satisfying.

title: The Rhapsody of Zephyr Remastered
description: 28 years later, Cyrano’s tragic journey of revenge begins anew. The War of Genesis: The Rhapsody of Zephyr returns in a remastered edition with HD 16:9 widescreen, full voice acting, and quality-of-life improvements. Rediscover an epic tale of tragedy and destiny.

title: Eternity Lost: Mystery of Aurum - Collector's Edition
description: Follow a mysterious girl into a hidden underground city built centuries ago by a secret order of Alchemists. Reveal a dangerous conspiracy, search for clues and items, solve puzzles and mini-games, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten world. Will you bring truth to the light?

title: Cozy Fishing Life
description: A cozy little fishing game that lives on your desktop. Adorable animals fish on your wallpaper while you work — collect 300+ fish, grow an aquarium, build your boat fleet, and relax. Idle-friendly, wholesome, always cozy

title: Backlot: Hollywood Studio Tycoon
description: A deep Hollywood studio simulation, 1930 to the streaming age. A back lot, a million dollars and no pictures. Commission scripts, sign stars to seven-year contracts, book dates against rival studios, and survive television, home video and everything else that came for the movies.

title: Youkashi no Haitokuai: Junshin Tenshi ha Dakarete Iromeku
Catskill Mine: 10,000ft Below
description: A single-player horror game set in a decrepit roadside mine attraction. Descend to uncover the mine's dark history, and find a way to escape from the lurking horrors within.

title: Runner Gunner
description: Race through the streets in this third-person action runner, dodging obstacles or shooting them out of the way. Collect points, buy powerful upgrades, and optimize your run to beat your high score.

title: Medieval Squad Tactics
description: This game is focused on turn based tactical combats. The complexity of the game comes from having to carefully manage your various formations in order to defeat your enemies. Carefully plan your actions to win the battle.

title: Black Hole Grow Forever
description: Shatter drifting matter, feed a growing black hole, and build a sprawling web of permanent upgrades. Every short run unlocks wilder skills, from screen-wide lasers to chain lightning, bombs, and gravity.

title: Pillagers: The Poisoned Throne
description: Lead a band of goblin rebels through a brutal turn-based tactics campaign. Train your roster, rebuild your fortress, manage scarce resources, and survive a war where every mistake can leave your army weaker than before.

title: Neural Maze
description: 2 neurons. 2 joysticks. One brain must control both at the same time: yours. Guide your lost neurons through increasingly convoluted mazes – reversed controls, power cuts, memory mode – under the watchful eye of an overwhelmed doctor. Is your brain ready?

title: Olimpia OT
