description: Olimpia OT is a Greek mythology-inspired MMORPG that combines classic Tibia-style gameplay with modern RPG systems and original content. Players explore a dangerous world inspired by the myths of Olympus, choose their vocation and divine allegiance, fight monsters and powerful bosses, discover dungeons, craft and upgrade equipment, and develop their characters through unique progression systems. Olimpia OT features eight distinct vocations, Divine Paths, a Devotion system, custom combat mechanics, ranked monsters, crafting, item upgrades, arenas, PvE and PvP content, and a persistent online world.

title: Cat a Loop
description: Lead a cat in a tactical roguelike auto-battler! Fight your way through 4 dangerous biomes, combine 200+ items to create powerful synergies, and unlock passive abilities. Unravel the mystery of the portal, defeat unique bosses, and save the feline world from the encroaching evil!

title: Paver: Tidy Up Together
description: Transform a chaotic area into a satisfying work of art. Follow the paver layout plan and place 4,064 pavers in their correct locations. Work alone or together with friends, develop useful skills, and restore the plaza piece by piece.

title: Amanatsu Location
description:
You visit a private resort on a southern island.
There, you find several girls enjoying their vacation...
The character creation feature has been revamped!
The feel remains the same, but even more beautiful girls await your encounter!

In addition to normal communication, you can tease them with massages and water guns, and sometimes share intimate moments to deepen your bond with each other.
You can fully enjoy a sweet and stimulating summer!

title: NASCAR 26
description: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26! Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase!

title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Arcade Apocalypse Pack
description:
The Arcade Apocalypse Pack includes:
• 2 Weapon Skins - Tactical Magnum and Unlockable Mystery Weapon Skin
• 1 Character Skin - Civic Republic Military Rick
• The Walker Pit - Endless Survival Combat Mode
• HELL ON EARTH Difficulty mode - Hardcore Mode without Checkpoints
• Digital Soundtrack

title: Dravo's Twisted Show
description: You and up to 4 players are victims of a horror show, having to collaborate to solve multiple puzzles and use cooperative dynamics to find your way out, while surviving the creatures lurking around, hunting you, watching out for haunted events that can be a blessing or a bane for your survival.

title: Noctiria
description: Noctiria is a horror roguelite deckbuilder set in a decaying 1990s city. Choose one of six heroes, combine brutal status effects, manage your Sanity and consumable relics, and permanently upgrade your arsenal between descents.

title: The Grinch: 2 in 1 Game Collection
description: The Grinch is back!

title: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
description: Play as the Grinch, collect ornaments, master gadgets, and tackle festive challenges to decorate the ultimate Christmas tree for the Whos.

title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
description: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon and Michonne in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

title: Sharehouse
description: An otome horror visual novel set in a mysterious sharehouse filled with strange rules. Forge bonds with your fellow housemates as you unravel the secrets hidden within the house, where breaking the rules may mean losing more than your life.

title: Gyaru to Papakatsu: Yarichin Chuunen Oji no Enjoy PacoPaco Life
description:
Middle-aged, still single, no lover, no hobbies, only dull, unsatisfying and repeating work-filled days.
One day, you meet a group of unique gals through a certain matching app, and you end up forming secret relationships with them.

title: The Door Factory
description: The Door Factory is a first-person horror game where you inspect mysterious doors before they are sent into production. Step inside, observe the environment, spot anomalies, and decide whether each door should be approved or reported.

title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Sinister Pack
description: Bring the chaos to Gotham City with the Sinister Pack. Embrace your inner menace with 7 DC Super-Villain themed suits, 1 for each of the original playable characters, plus a sinister-themed Batmobile and Batcave prop set to complete your rogue-inspired style.

title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Mayhem Mode
description: Cause chaos on the streets of Gotham City in the all-new Mayhem Mode, featuring new playable characters The Joker and Harley Quinn.

title: Noxcode
description: Reach the TOP by any means possible. Run, jump, climb, fly, or even fall your way up in this chaotic jump quest platformer. Master crazy movement, discover wild shortcuts, and push your skills to the limit!

title: Too Many Balls
description: Too Many Balls is a satisfying incremental clean-up simulator. Start small with basic pickup tools and a tiny basket. Collect golf balls, basketballs, tennis balls, ping-pong balls, and more. Drop them off, earn money, and reinvest every run into faster tools, bigger hauls, and better upgrades.

title: Havelyn
description:
The game is a relaxed open-world building and exploration experience set in a large, quiet landscape. Players can explore alone or with up to four friends in co-op.

You choose where to settle and build a home anywhere in the world. Resources are gathered from the surrounding land, crops can be planted and harvested, and daily life is shaped by farming, crafting, and expanding your settlement. Nearby villages allow trading and interaction, and over time new residents can join, turning a small home into a growing community.

The world includes forests, meadows, villages, ruins, and hidden locations to discover. The focus is on exploration, settlement building, and gradual development at your own pace.

title: Anymaker
description: Embark on your creative journey of vehicle design, as you create and operate vehicles to navigate this dangerous open world. Anymaker is a detailed and technical vehicle building game. Design your chassis, build your engine, connect components and cables, program controllers, and test performance.

title: Toxic Yuri
description: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box in an alleyway and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Experience the most toxic love story the world has ever seen.

title: Chief Cenab: Şahmaran
description: Follow Chief Cenab on the trail of the Şahmaran legend. Told in a black-and-white comic book style with color accents unique to each part, this point-and-click adventure draws you into a deep atmosphere and mysterious events.

title: WomboCombo
description: Fight through hordes of mobs in a roguelike-style challenge by hitting the correct key sequence. Test your reflexes, build your character, and survive the chaos as each stage ramps up. Rack up massive combos and push your limits with every run.

title: Crown Siege
description: A short incremental siege game centered around growing and strengthening an army to defend your kingdom. Seize the crown from an endless wave of enemies for your best chance at survival!

title: Nightwater
description: Forage, craft and automate to grow your factory, unlock new technologies and expand your island to discover new biomes. Progress through the ages from sticks and stones to the Bronze Age, the Industrial Era and into the future to uncover the secret of the Lighthouse and escape this reality.

title: Biovoid
description: Biovoid is a creature-building roguelike game that tests your creativity. As a fragile hatchling alone in the abyss, your only objective is to consume and adapt. Will you survive the perils that await and evolve to the top of this alien foodchain?

title: 100 Goldmine Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

title: ZuOnline
description: Return to the legendary world of Zu Online - a martial arts MMORPG reborn. Explore ancient skies, master cultivation, and battle for immortality in a world inspired by Chinese mythology.

title: Dewdrop
description: A physics-based generative music sandbox where droplets collide with hand-drawn vines to create evolving, melodic soundscapes. Create music easily with no prior experience in a calming and ethereal atmosphere.

title: Boardlike
description: Classic tabletop games meet roguelite elements and card-based combat. Dice rolls, fate cards, deadly encounters, minigames, and countless unknowns await you in this strange adventure.

title: Tooned Out Duo Dippin
description: Welcome To Tooned Out Duo Dippin!!! This game is a body of work that has been painfully derived from years of suffering/studying Become A Monster Player! In this All Out Fantasy Arcade Racing heart pumping new franchise. Let your jaw drop as you duo dip through Pure Imagination and Hard work.

title: There Is More
description: In this procedurally generated mining roguelite you dig for precious ores by day and defend your city from relentless monsters by night. Each night the waves attacking the core are getting deadlier - upgrade your gear, unlock powerful spells, and descend deeper. Can you survive 10 nights?

title: Save Mom
description: A cartoon-inspired co-op action game where you and your siblings must protect Mom as she drives her old motorhome across a bizarre post-apocalyptic America. Gather resources, upgrade the RV, build defenses, and fight off mutants and cultists — all while Mom insists on seeing the good in everyone. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in chaotic family co-op fun.

title: Waterjacked!
description: Waterjacked! is a roguelike puzzler where you are a cactus with a gun. Chosen to wield the GRID, construct ever-more complex Rube Goldberg machines to outwit the invading robots keen on stealing all the water in The Valley. Will you be the hero to save your people?

title: Bot Slash Bot
description: You click - You dash - You slash. Bot slash Bot is a fast-paced, top-down Hack n‘ Slash in which you control a rogue robot slashing & dashing through your former co-machines holding you captive! It's all about speed. Time is running out.

title: Wail of Despair
description: "Wail of Despair" follows a non-binary shut-in, trying to recover from their isolation and face the world once again. Facing a horrific, overstimulating, colorful and judgmental world Confronted with their past scars and mistakes, taunted with everything they've lost by a strange shadow that won't leave them alone and always follows. Can they readapt and learn to return to being something resembling okay? Or will they be swept away by the vibrant pulsating horror that threatens them back into the darkness?

title: Unmurk
description: You only see the outer edges of the puzzle. Put the puzzles back into place to reveal a hidden voxel object.

title: Parisian Bistro Simulator
description: Manage your own bistro in Paris and turn it into the place to be! Create menus, serve customers, and master every detail to grow your restaurant. Manage supplies, ensure top-notch service, and make your mark on the city of lights. Will you become the next Parisian brasserie institution?

title: Deeplanders
description: DEEPLANDERS is a relaxing, minimalist strategic building game where you must satisfy the needs of the Deeplanders to populate the depths. Explore, build, and decorate your own underground kingdom... and when you're ready, embark on a journey to new, unexplored depths!

title: Tape 101: Liminal Descent
description: A psychological horror descending through liminal spaces shaped by the Kübler-Ross model - the five stages of grief: denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance - where your perception and an RC car are the only tools to grasp what’s real

title: Litter ShiFu
description: Little ShiFu is a first person horror puzzle game. A sudden night visit broke Zhang Qingyi originally quiet high school life. Think the little girl Xuanxuan looking for the lost little Mi as the source, the old community in a strange murder unexpectedly slowly surfaced...

title: Word Sylla
description: Hexa Word Sylla Word Submit Puzzle offers a dynamic gameplay experience that will keep you hooked for hours. Delve into the depths of your vocabulary and logic skills as you unravel syllabic mysteries and unlock the full potential of the English language.

title: ToonSouls Maker
description: Create, play, and share your own chaotic 2D platforming levels! Inspired by classic cartoons, powered by your creativity, and fueled by one simple truth: My game is good. The algorithm just ignores me.

title: Fortune Avenue
description: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?

title: Rogue Racer
description: Race across the continent against the police and rival racers alike, survive bizarre encounters and become the Rogue Racer.

title: Cube Crusaders
description: Mow down all who stand in the way of your Crusade. Become a benevolent conqueror, or a brutal oppressor to those you achieve victory over. Your actions decide the fate of the planet.

title: Draco and the Seven Scales
description: Take on the role of a pirate captain as he sets sail to save his greatest treasure of all. Draco and the Seven Scales is a retro-inspired adventure that hearkens back to an age of top-down dungeon crawlers and lovable, crunchy pixel art. Melodic shanties will guide your way through this sprawling world full of dangerous enemies, items to collect, and a dark force that seeks to corrupt. Will you break free from a kraken's dooming bargain, or be another victim?

title: Neighbor Fight
description: Multiplayer first person strategy game with lots of destruction. Destroy the house of your neighbor by throwing furniture and build a business by selling weed!

title: Sunken Realms
description: Descend into an abandoned underground city to battle orcs, solve puzzles, collect loot, and then return to the surface to upgrade your gear and stats in this modern, old-school dungeon-crawler.

title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Echoes of Kassandra Pack
description: A cosmetic pack themed around a famous Spartan hero, adding Greek-inspired aesthetic elements to your empire. The pack includes the Hall of Echoes, a buildable structure with epic melodies, harbor ornaments, ship cosmetics featuring colors and sigils from the hero's voyage across the Peloponnese, and large ornamental statues to commemorate the hero's adventures.

title: Panda: Shards of Aurora
description:
Panda: Shards of Aurora is a challenging platformer set in a frozen world trapped in an endless winter.

Take control of a young panda and embark on a journey across 30 handcrafted levels, guided by the mysterious Ancient Bear, an ancient guardian who will help you uncover the secrets of the frozen valley.

Navigate icy platforms, slippery surfaces, deadly spikes, fragile terrain, and dangerous environmental hazards as you search for the legendary Shards of Aurora.

But the frozen lands are not empty. Hostile penguins and aggressive seals stand in your way, testing your reflexes and precision as you progress through increasingly challenging stages.

Explore every corner of the frozen world, discover hidden gems, overcome challenging obstacles, and restore the Shards of Aurora to bring the light back to the valley.

title: Owlbound Tomes
description:
Get ready to enter a magical library where even the paths can disappear! In Owlbound Tomes, you follow a small owl librarian on a mission to recover runaway magical books, deliver them to the correct Book Return Tables, and finally reach her cozy perch.

But there is one important detail: the paths are not permanent. Some tiles collapse after one passage, others survive two, while special tiles can withstand up to three crossings. Every movement must be planned carefully, because a path used too early may simply disappear when you need it most.

Before starting, study the board, connect the paths, arrange the movable tiles, and think about the best order for collecting and returning each book. Once you press Play, there is no way to change the route. The owl will automatically follow the path you created, carrying multiple books and turning every crossing into a strategic decision.

Across 30 levels, divided into three magical biomes, the challenges become increasingly creative and require you to think not only about where to go, but also when to pass through each location. Can you make a round trip without destroying the path you need to return?

With a cozy atmosphere, charming visuals, and puzzles based on spatial planning, Owlbound Tomes delivers calm, clever, and deeply satisfying challenges. Observe, organize, calculate your passages, and create the perfect route for the little librarian.

Recover the books, preserve the paths, and find the perfect perch!

title: Cranium Planet
description: Sketch, solve, hum, and act it out! Cranium Planet blasts the classic party game onto your living room screen. Gather your favorite people on the couch, scan the QR code, and your phone becomes the controller. Split into Team Red and Team Blue and race your pawns around a vibrant alien world packed with more than 1,000 challenges. Roll the die, move across the planet, and take on activities that put a different talent to the test: doodle an ice cream cone in Cloodle, hum a familiar tune in Humdinger, untangle scrambled letters in Zelpuz, or put your random knowledge to work in Factoid. You might be drawing one turn, solving a puzzle the next, then acting something out while your teammates desperately try to guess what you're doing. And because this is Cranium, you don't have to be great at everything. Artists, performers, puzzle-solvers, trivia buffs, word nerds, and enthusiastic guessers all get their moment. HOW TO PLAY 1. Gather your crew. Play with up to 8 players, or take on Cranium Planet solo. 2. Grab your phones. Scan the on-screen QR code and your phone becomes your personal controller — no extra controllers required. 3. Choose your team. Split into Team Red and Team Blue and get ready to race around the planet. 4. Roll, move, and play. Roll the digital die and take on drawing, performing, word, puzzle, and trivia activities inspired by the classic Cranium experience. 5. Mess with the competition. Fire off Distractions to rattle the other team at just the wrong moment. 6. Race to the finish. Keep completing challenges and moving your pawn. First team around the planet wins! EVERYONE SHINES Cranium has always been about more than knowing the right answer. Want to be center stage? Act and hum in the Star Performer category. Have artistic flair? Sketch masterpieces as a Creative Cat. Data Head is for players who know all sorts of facts, while clever wordsmiths show their stuff with Word Worm puzzles. One challenge might reward the friend who knows something obscure; the next belongs to the doodler, the word wizard, or the friend who's willing to make a complete fool of themselves for the team. YOUR PHONE IS THE CONTROLLER No passing around a controller. Everyone joins with their own phone to draw, answer, choose, flick, and play while the action unfolds together on the big screen. PLAY TOGETHER OR GO SOLO Bring the whole room together for a Team Red vs. Team Blue showdown with up to 8 players, or explore Cranium Planet on your own with solo play. A PLANET THAT KEEPS GROWING With more than 1,000 challenges available at launch, there's already plenty to discover — and the party keeps growing. New content arrives monthly, with fresh prompts and brand-new activities added throughout the year to keep game night fresh. Welcome to Cranium Planet. Everyone shines. Do Not Find It: Anomaly Photo Files
Obby Sword Master
description: Upgrade your blade, cut down endless enemies and collect loyal pets. An incremental action game where every swing makes you stronger. Become the Sword Master!

title: Math Pals: Monster Mania
description: Learn math with friendly monsters and fun challenges.

description: The classic Humming Bird Soft RPG is back! Defeat Demon King Ruu as Ral's descendant and find the true ending.

description: Chilling tales to freeze your spine Uncover the terror in each picture

description:
Uncover the mysteries hidden around the school!
Study each scene, spot the clues, and solve the case.
Can you crack every mystery?

description: Build your kingdom, raise an army, and conquer the realm.

title: Psychopath Mind Quiz: Unmask Their Dark Nature
description:
Can you spot
the dark twist?

description: Your choice. Your fear. Your ending.

title: Werewolf Online
description: A strange night falls on the village... This werewolf game features 30 roles. Some protect the innocent... others hunt in the shadows. And a few play for themselves, without any side or faith. Each role has a secret power, a unique mission..

title: WordBuzz 4
description: Build words, score points, and master the hive.

title: Zombie Siege
description: Defend the city from relentless zombie waves!

title: Rogue Vault
description: Fight your way through dangerous rooms filled with relentless enemies, deadly traps, and intense bullet-hell action.

title: Arcade Archives: Mr.Do!'s Castle
description: Run, trap, and triumph!!

title: Bamboo Grove
description:
You are a hired game tester, brought in to playtest an unfinished VR horror game.
At first, everything seems routine. Then the line between the virtual world and reality begins to blur. The game starts behaving in ways it shouldn’t.

title: Bullet Train
description: Welcome on the Bullet Train: destroy enemy towers, collect powerful orbs and improve your train! Fight through escalating enemy territory to defeat the creatures that destroyed your town!

title: Drums Rock: Slipknot - 'Duality'
description: Get the track 'Duality' from Slipknot! This track is part of the 'Slipknot Music Pack'.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Dacholer
description:
"Dacholer" is an action game released by Nichibutsu in 1983.
Kick a turtle with your powerful legs and take down enemy animals! Watch out for the kappa jumping out of the river!

This title also includes a slightly modified version, Kick Boy, so you can enjoy the differences in visuals and gameplay.

title: Alchemess: Tidy Up Your Potion Shop!
description: A cozy first-person sorting game. 2080 hand-named, physically reacting bottles scattered across the floor. A real mess. No, wait.. A real Alchemess! Join the mesmerizing flow of clicking each potion into its individual correct position. Tidy alone, or bring a friend. Or race one. Made with love.

title: Fat Chance
description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

title: Console Archives: Crazy Climber
description:
Crazy Climber was released by Nichibutsu in 1986 for an 8 -bit home console.
Watch out for falling objects from above! Ascend a skyscraper while dodging annoying enemies such as Ojamaman, Iron ball, and Gorillas. Successfully reaching the rooftop of the building completes the level. Keep going, climber!!

title: DJMax Respect V: Dungeon & Fighter PACK
Shockface
description: The job interview from hell. Chelsea enters a nearly abandoned office building for an interview and gets trapped inside with a serial killer. Explore, solve item-based puzzles, hide when he gets close, and escape. A short 90s-style survival horror with fixed cameras, tank controls and no combat.

title: Hiragana Word Challenge
description:
Build hiragana words,
one clue at a time?

title: Solitaire Companions: Cats
description:
A classical Solitaire game with a purr-fect twist.
Play classic Solitaire in a cozy, cat-filled world.

title: Pixel Hunters: Turn Retro Consoles into your Girlfriend
Taxi Life Simulator
description: Pick up passengers, drive, repeat. Your taxi career starts here.

title: Tap Monster Duel
description:
Thrilling timing battles with just one finger!
An adventure to find the ultimate legendary card!

title: Sweet Land Survival
description: Your adventure may be sweet, but survival won't be easy.

title: SuperSharket
description: Welcome to the supermarket where fish shop and sharks work!

title: Yummy Yummy Cook Book
description: Bake, mix, and level up in this cozy kitchen adventure inspired by grandma's recipe book!

title: Homebound Plush
description: Unfortunately, the teddy bear was left behind, and now your mission is to help it find its way home.

title: Block Shop
description: Block shop is an automation puzzle game in which basic blocks are transformed and combined to create increasingly complex blocks.

title: Cat Adventure
description: Jump into a world of adventures.

title: Pixel Hunters: Turn Retro Consoles into your Boyfriend
description:
Your dusty old console just blinked.
Catch it before it runs and it might just become your boyfriend.

title: Hollow Parish: Dead Frequency
description: Supernatural investigation and management, played from one desk. Read the evidence, identify what is out there, choose who to send, then guide them by radio while the timer runs. A wrong theory kills the people who trusted you. You hear the horror; you never see it.

title: Brixonia
description: A cozy multiplayer building sandbox where every world is shared and persistent. Place and break blocks, farm crops, fish, craft gear, and decorate your space alongside other players. No combat, no death penalty, just building at your own pace.

title: Limbus Company: Season 8 - Punctum
description: It consists of the game's tenth Story Chapter (Canto X: The Gaze Bearing) , the eigth Mirror Dungeon and Line 7 of Refraction Railway, as well as the release of Identities based on story content and E.G.O exclusive to the Season's Pass

title: Mepekyon Racing
description: "Mepekyon Racing" is a casual racing game where you can freely drive around an open world. Explore the vast map to discover race courses and aim to place in the races. Enjoy customizing your car and its parts as you strive for the overall Grand Prix championship!

title: Bebe Miner
description: Bebe Miner is a fast-paced arcade mining game where every level brings new surprises. Swing your hook, collect valuable treasures, avoid hazards, defeat bosses, unlock characters and climb the online leaderboard.

title: Gem Quest: Rush
description: A short and replayable time attack game. Enter the dungeon and collect all of the gems as quickly as possible.

title: Cards Everywhere!
description: Cards Everywhere! is a cozy organizing game where you sort through 2,000 scattered cards, collect over 1,500 unique ones, and place them in your collection album. Discover dozens of unique sets and unlock helpful abilities as your collection grows.

title: Dub Rumble
description: Dub Rumble is a voice-dubbing party game where you and your friends are the voice actors. Pick a scene, listen to each line once, then record your own performance over the backing track. Solo Booth lets one player dub every character; Couch Party passes the mic around a single PC; Online Party uses room codes, Steam invites and built-in voice chat, ending with a shared screening of the finished dub, "voiced by" credits and automatic performance scoring. Scenes come from community-made dub packs shared through the Steam Workshop, and the game is compatible with existing Choicer Voicer packs. Finished dubs can be exported as video clips to share.

title: Chill Drive Together
description: An endless road that builds itself as you drive, and no reason to hurry down it. Playable with 1 or 2 players. Press B and the world around you changes on the spot, with no loading. Rain, snow, night skies, real traffic, photo mode.

title: Concrete Burial
description: Equipped only with a weapon that consumes your own blood, explore an ancient brutalist catacomb. Beware the Eyes of The Whispering Crypt. Find the 4 artifacts of desire. Confront God.

title: Shape Wars
description: Command. Build. Conquer.

title: Tristia: Chronicles
description: Revitalize Tristia in this updated collection!

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Fun Shapes
description: Discover a fresh twist on classic jigsaw puzzles in Jigsaw Puzzle Fun Shapes! Complete 30 colorful and entertaining levels featuring unique puzzle pieces in all kinds of fun and creative shapes.

title: Tiny Ramen Shop
description: Run your own Tiny Ramen Shop! It's tiny, yes, but customers are already lining up to try your delicious ramen. Prepare food, stock your warehouse with fresh ingredients, upgrade and decorate your establishment. Hungry customers are waiting for their favorite ramen chef!

title: Hunter: The Reckoning - Day for Night
description: These monsters aren’t just in the movies! Will you hunt the vampires, werewolves and others stalking Hollywood, or will you become a monster instead? An interactive, text-based game set in the World of Darkness shared story universe.

title: Dawson Oaks Trailer Park
description: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.

title: Pop! Pachinko
description: Pop! Pachinko is a pachinko roguelite with city pop vibes. Build up your collection of enchanted balls to fire into the machine. Collect charms to build up powerful synergies between your balls. Listen to some pop music as you expand your Chibi Pop collection!

title: Frog It Up
description: Frog It Up is an incremental clicker game where you lure frogs to a pond and help them build their own cozy little city. As the pond grows, you’ll decide which upgrades to unlock, shaping how the city expands over time and steering progress in the direction you prefer.

title: Tumblebee
description: Captured and lost, you search for your scattered family as you tumble through a hostile cave of silk.

title: The Bird of the North
description: In 1921: a kidnapping, a revolution... Investigate and uncover the truth behind a dark, mysterious story.

title: O.B.O.L
description: Gamble your life on a coin flip against a mysterious old man sent by the CORPORATE to decide whether you keep your job. Trapped in a claustrophobic collapsing metal coffin deep under the ocean, you'll slowly lose your sanity in this eldritch, Lovecraftian horror.

title: Eco Balance
description: The object is to keep a balance of O2 and CO2 in your world as you build it.

title: Unmourned VR
description: Unmourned is a first-person psychological horror game where Jason moves into a new house only to be haunted by escalating paranormal events. Driven by fear, he must uncover the truth behind the previous owners' disappearance. Can he solve the mystery before it's too late?

title: 33 Days till Extraction
description: 33 Days till Extraction is a top-down sci-fi action RPG shooter with roguelike progression. Harness brutal firepower and necromantic skills to survive.

title: Police Chief Simulator
description: Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

title: 20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes
description: This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes.

title: Slash-Out: Fantasy Dueling
description: In Slash-Out, master the sword and shield to survive in a land where every fight is a boss fight. Darkness is rising. An ancient evil has returned. Embark on a quest to restore peace, but be warned, a gauntlet of fearsome opponents stand in your way. Many have tried and failed, will you prevail?

title: Operation Eventide
description: Adelle, a former magical girl, wakes up in a robotic body. Still picking up the pieces after her untimely demise, she seeks the truth of her new life. Experience as this 'love song' resounds in the rift of magic and logic in this nostalgic, thrilling yuri sci-fi visual novel.

title: Le Mirage Mystique
description: On that beautiful island, a girl witnesses a terrifying miracle.

title: Condemned: Nightfall
description: A survival horror PvE and PvP set in a Noir Futuristic NYC! Team up with up to two others, or go in alone, and search creature-filled semi open-world map for arcane clues that lead you to a lucrative Bounty. Featuring permadeath consequences, only the best hunters will make it out alive..

title: Huglings
description: Huglings is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you can help the huglings restore their village, which was damaged by the goblins. Create peace as you farm, craft, and decorate your dream home. No pressure, just a peaceful world to explore and a heartwarming journey of friendship and helpfulness!

title: Another Eden Begins
description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

title: Sniper Dan
description:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren’t always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

1. Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…
2. Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!
3. Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly, and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?

Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities, and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards, and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.

It did. It was Dan!

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub, and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt, and Photo Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colorful, and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast, and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.

title: Driving Rogue
description: Arcade driving meets roguelike chaos - fast, intense, and ridiculously addictive. In Driving Rogue, every run is a new story: the city keeps changing, and you’ll need pure focus to push your score to the limit. After each race, hit the shop and craft your build for the longest streak possible.

title: Civics Scribble
description: Test your knowledge of U.S. Civics while drawing lines for the inquisitive Mr. Apple to roll on or bounce off of to navigate challenges such as spikes, bouncy blocks and teleporters. Make your way through 96 levels across nine scenic locations based on real-life state and National Parks.

title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
description: A remake of the second installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel of Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter. The game follows Estelle as she sets out on a new adventure following the events of the previous game, where she will be joined by comrades both old and new.

title: United Heist: Facility Zero
description: Work together in separate locations, each filled with unique puzzles that only your partner can help solve. Every move depends on sharp communication through in-game voice chat. Can you crack the code and escape before time runs out?

title: Akiba Lost
description: Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “Akiba’s Spirited Away”. Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?

title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
description:
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is a turn-based strategy RPG centered around the Heroic Games, a tournament where warriors with different motivations compete for a chance to have their greatest wish granted by the Divine Sovereign. The game builds on the tactical foundation of previous Fire Emblem titles, featuring turn-based combat with combat arts, gambits, and crests. A new mechanic called Blaze Arts lets units spend health to perform powerful special abilities on the battlefield.
The game appears to be set in the same world as Fire Emblem: Three Houses, though in a different era, and follows characters like Cai, who enters the tournament to save his father's life.

title: The Guild 1 Remake: Europa 1410
description: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

title: Warag
description: Old-school boomer shooter in a world where Slavic myths have merged with technocult. Cut, shoot and survive among cultists, cyber-mutants and traitors in armor. Restore the glory of the Varangian Guard - through blood, steel and ancient wrath.

title: Shiba Sweet
description: Woof! You step into the paws of a novice Shiba chef who inherits a dessert shop from your retired grandma. You'll buy ingredients, bake desserts, and sell them in bento boxes. Use your earnings to upgrade the kitchen, decorate the shop, and unlock new recipes to create the best bakery ever!

title: Dig & Deal
description: Dig & Deal is a game where you dig underground to find valuable items and bargain with customers to sell what you find. Upgrade your tools, grow your shop, and make the best deals to build your fortune.

title: Flamecraft
description: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

title: Trivia Murder Party 3
description: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

title: OpenFront
description: A massively multiplayer real-time strategy game pitting hundreds of players against one another. Over one million nuke each other every month.

title: Endless Legend 2
description: With a mysterious, ever-changing world, unique factions, and epic storytelling, the much-awaited sequel to the strategy game classic ENDLESS Legend is here, opening a new chapter of the award-winning ENDLESS universe. Write your legend and unveil the secrets of a dreamlike ocean-planet on the verge of extinction.

title: Witch Please!
description: Help Petra navigate her new life as Head Witch of Fenloft Academy! Juggle classes, train skills, make friends, and solve mysteries in this charming choose-your-own-adventure-style visual novel.

title: Lily's World XD
description: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… A fourth wall-breaking psychological horror experience featuring LilyPichu.

title: Kernel Hearts
description: Gather your allies. Eliminate Angels. Transform into a Magical Girl. Slay god. Kernel Hearts is a Multiplayer Co-Op Roguelike Action RPG about four magical girls and their attempt to save a world that's drowning in ashes

title: Two Sides of Hell
description: Blast through procedurally generated alien hellscapes in this twin-stick roguelite platformer. Transform between human and demon to unleash devastating combat and survive the endless cycle of chaos.

title: Rooster
description: A heartfelt, story-rich casual puzzle adventure celebrating the best of ancient Chinese culture. Explore an exquisitely hand-drawn world with delightful surprises, from cooking, finding hidden objects, paper crafting, and more. Guide Rooster in an emotionally rewarding tale about family and love.

title: Convrgence
description: Convrgence is an immersive single-player VR shooter with survival and horror elements. Explore the Chernokamensk exclusion zone: scavenge for loot, fight bandits and hunt for mystical artifacts. However be sure to return to base before duskfall, for when night arrives the hunter becomes the hunted.

title: 13 Playing Cards of Demon
description: This is a strategy game. Collect and use demon‘s poker skills (similar to Texas Poker rules), regular card skills, abilities, and equipment to defeat enemies.

title: Emberward
description: Emberward is a unique tower defense game that focuses on maze building and interesting tower mechanics. Construct mazes with blocks of different shapes and set up defense towers on them to withstand the onslaught of monsters!

title: YesterSol
description: Unleash your magical spear! Explore a vast inter-connected world, battling enemies sent by Culex, the dark mosquito deity. Throw, recall, and use your spear as a platform through this minimalistic metroidvania made by one developer!

title: Spartan VR
description: Welcome to Ancient Greece! Become the main hero of the story of the battle of the Titans, defeat Medusa and save Hermes from death!

title: Harvest Tycoon
description:
Harvest Tycoon is a farming simulation set in a 3D valley, in which the player expands a few starting fields into a large estate. Crops grow in real time, from two minutes for wheat to a full day for sunflowers, and longer crops keep growing while the player is offline. Crops and animal produce such as eggs, milk, wool and honey are turned into goods in production buildings, then sold at a market whose prices change daily or delivered to customer orders, while quests, daily challenges and levels unlock new crops, buildings and helpers such as a tractor.

Players can join farm families of up to ten members that work toward shared weekly goals and compete in tournaments, take part in timed events in leagues of players at a similar level, fish at a farm pond and chat with other players. From level 100 a second world opens: a mountain village with its own market, crops, mine, forest, smithy and fishing lake. The game is free to play with optional in-game purchases, requires an internet connection, and keeps one farm per account across the web browser, Android and iOS versions.

title: Mind Gazing
description: Mind Gazing is a lateral thinking puzzle game where players solve mysterious scenarios by asking yes-or-no questions. Play solo or with friends, uncover hidden clues, and use creative thinking to solve intriguing mysteries. Create your own scenarios, explore a variety of puzzles, and challenge your reasoning skills.

title: Free Time Puzzle
description: A puzzle game with square pieces instead of jigsaw shapes for a cozy and relaxing experience. 56 puzzle photographs by artist Dray Potts from locations across the western United States, each with 6 levels of difficulty.

title: Text Battle Royale
description: Step into the Ultimate Type and Death Fight! in Text Battle Royale, an online multiplayer game where you test your typing skills against players in a unique battle royale experience.

title: Bowling Mayhem
description:
Sketch, solve, hum, and act it out! Cranium Planet blasts the classic party game onto your living room screen.

Gather your favorite people on the couch, scan the QR code, and your phone becomes the controller. Split into Team Red and Team Blue and race your pawns around a vibrant alien world packed with more than 1,000 challenges. Roll the die, move across the planet, and take on activities that put a different talent to the test: doodle an ice cream cone in Cloodle, hum a familiar tune in Humdinger, untangle scrambled letters in Zelpuz, or put your random knowledge to work in Factoid. You might be drawing one turn, solving a puzzle the next, then acting something out while your teammates desperately try to guess what you're doing.

title: Chit Chat Party!
description: It's a great time when you're on the same page, but get your wires crossed and it's pure mayhem!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Mr. Do!'s Castle
description: Take control of a clown character and defeat the unicorns. Use your hammer to knock blocks down and crush the unicorns to defeat them. Make clever use of the stage mechanics by changing ladder directions to alter your path or trapping unicorns in holes to immobilize them!

title: VHS Nights: The Tidy Up Shift
description: It’s 1992 and the VHS store is counting on you! Sort 1,120 unique movies by genre and year with no title repeated twice. A true sorting game for movie lovers! Discover hilarious parody titles and blurbs, unlock abilities, and enjoy optional tape rewinding.

title: Sort The Toys
description: Sort The Toys is a relaxing organizing simulator where you place over 3,400 toys onto their designated shelves. Play at your own pace, unlock helpful skills, and enjoy the satisfying process of bringing complete order to a cluttered toy store.

title: Hostile Paths
description: A challenging top-down survival roguelike where scarcity is the real enemy. Manage limited resources and inventory space, explore unknown procedural routes, learn from every death, and decide which risks are worth taking.

title: Old Market Restored
description: Replace the misplaced products with your friends and step back into the Old Market universe and take control of the mess before the doors open.

title: Tidy or Treat
description: Halloween is coming and a restless spirit has emptied every shelf onto the floor. Sort out the pumpkin toys, learn tricks to work faster, and bring friends in to help.

title: Shadows of the Republic
description: A visual novel RPG set in WW2 China. Play as a student turned intelligence asset among a political arena of nationalists, communists and Japanese collaborators.

title: PaperBoat
description: A native PC port of the storybook RPG classic, unfolding on modern PCs with high framerates, sharper visuals, and mod support

title: Motivation Monsters
description: A productivity tool made by and for burnt out gifted kid ADHD gremlins. Get stuff done the fun way by collecting and customizing cute bottom-of-the-screen creatures who transform to reflect your real life growth as a person.

title: Midnight News Report
description: You watch a news program in the middle of the night featuring an unsettling reporter. As you watch, the world around you begins to warp and become unrecognizable. This is one broadcast you won't soon forget.

title: Akiba Lost: Original Soundtrack & Pixel Character Costume Set
Akiba Lost: Drama Movie & Pixel Character Costume Set
We Are Football 2027
description: We are football 2027 is the ultimate challenge for all football management fans! Accessible, deep, tactically demanding, and featuring over 200 simulated countries. Now with a comprehensive creative mode that lets you perfectly tailor the entire gameplay experience to your preferences.

title: Beatmania IIDX 34 Zinrai
description: beatmania IIDX tasks the player with performing songs through a controller consisting of seven buttons and a turntable. Hitting the notes at the correct time increases the score and groove gauge bar, which if equal to or above 80% on Normal difficulty will allow the player to clear the stage.

title: JettFuel+
description: In JettFuel+, you play as Jett: a robot used by a factory until its sudden closure. You managed to escape the factory before it was destroyed, but the whereabouts of your brother and fellow coworker Brody, are unknown.

title: Veridus: The Walking Nightmare
description: Battle through fifteen escalating waves in a dark-fantasy action roguelite. Wield seven distinct weapons, combine abilities and imbuements, collect powerful equipment, rescue Abigail, and confront Lord Veydris before entering Nightmare Mode.

title: Lucent
description: Lucent is a logic-based puzzle game, where you aim to hit the target within the provided moves.

title: Liminal Sorting
description: Liminal Sorting is a relaxing organizing simulator set in a mysterious liminal space. Sort more than 6,000 objects, discover strange rooms, unlock abilities, and enjoy a peaceful experience with moments of suspense and timed challenges. Who knows what secrets that mysterious cat is hiding...

title: Panchito Delivery: Project Elevator
description: You're a delivery guy whose routine drop-off turned into a nightmare. Survive the terror of this first-person roguelite, manage your elevator, and reach the Top Floor.

title: Garage: Tidy Up!
description: Garage: Tidy Up! is a cozy first-person organizing simulator where you restore order in a messy auto workshop. Sort tools, parts, tires, paints, wires, and garage equipment into their proper zones, upgrade your skills, and turn chaos into the perfect dream garage.

title: Oops! You're the Hero!
description: Oops! You’re the Hero! is a fantasy adventure about a Thief who has stolen an artifact that deems him the ‘Hero’. Choose to fight or avoid the bosses who have sworn to defeat you, explore the world of Othaya, and return the artifact before more shenanigans befell you because…Oops! You’re the Hero!

title: Tidy Up History
description: Tidy Up History is a cozy cleaning sim where you inherit a chaotic museum. Tidy messy rooms, unlock new abilities, and find hidden keys to open new wings. Uncover historical knowledge to properly identify and showcase artifacts, returning the museum to its former glory.

title: Ride Up Together
description: Ride, climb, kick, and survive! Ride Up Together is an online co-op motorcycle climbing game for 1–8 players. As you try to reach the summit, kick your friends to knock them off, overcome crazy physics-based obstacles, and don’t let even the smallest mistake send you back to the bottom!

title: Decide Your Fate
description: Decide Your Fate is a tense psychological horror game about escaping a nightmarish house. You must navigate silently and secure your escape by evading a blind killer.

title: Special Force Remastered
description: Special Force Remastered is a modernized, team-based tactical first-person shooter (FPS) developed by DRAGONFLY GF CO., LTD. that officially launched in Early Access on March 24, 2026. Rebuilt completely in Unreal Engine 5, the game serves as a faithful visual and technical upgrade to the iconic 2004 classic military shooter Special Force 1. It preserves the nostalgic combat flow, precise skill-driven movement, and distinct gun recoil of the original while adding modern matchmaking, structural gameplay balance, and tactical progression layers.

title: Driving Test Simulator
description: Test your driving skills by completing challenging driving tests and precise, skill-based scenarios. Offers various scenarios and environments.

title: Patlabor the Case Files
description: Relive iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor" in this 3D console action game. Experience dual perspectives: Main Missions as the SV2, and Another Side Missions as their rivals. Hone your pilot skills in Simulator Mode, featuring shooting ranges and Labor duels.

title: Alex & Arty
description: Two souls, one mission: restore a dying world together! A planet is on the brink. Two unexpected allies. Combine exploration, engineering, and magic to save a world devastated by greed… and build new hope.

title: Sky Scaffold
description: A semi-idle incremental factory game where you tame the void of space. Terraform planets, build a colossal Sky Scaffold, and create a galactic industrial empire. Hardcore sandbox gameplay with a blend of simulated markets. [!!]

title: Axiomatik
description: VR action puzzle platformer. Beat the clock as a robot with a draining battery. Shoot to see: Use your light ray gun, find your way in the dark to a charging station before you shut down. Shoot glowing neons to solve spatial puzzles. And open a Schroedinger Box, get a cute kitten - dead or alive.

title: Brazilian Drug Dealer Before 4: Demons From the Portal to Hell I Opened Are Still in the Favela and Now I Have to Save Mamadas From Ronaldo
description: The standalone sequel of the Brazilian boomer shooter game made using the id tech 2 engine! Shoot, jump, double jump and dash! Embark on a journey throughout the state of Rio De Janeiro, São Paulo, Salvador, hell and even heaven! Save Brazil!

title: The Plant Shop
description: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.

title: R.I.P.: Reincarnation Insurance Program
description: In this virus-ravaged, post-apocalyptic world, you will wield the power of infinite resurrection to delve into perilous ruins, gather legendary gear, and draw strength from the gods—growing stronger through endless cycles, until you become a true savior legend.

title: Professional Ship Simulator
description: Take the helm in this realistic, large-scale maritime simulation. Command your fleet from agile rescue vessels to massive LNG tankers and perform precise maneuvers in challenging conditions. Navigate a living open world where weather, traffic, and every wave shape your career

title: Blackwood
description: By day, you run a DVD store in 2012 New York. By night, you’re a ruthless assassin. BLACKWOOD is a cinematic third-person shooter with grounded melee combat, brutal takedowns, responsive gunplay, and a double life to manage.

title: Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection
description:
Behold the Full Health Collection, bringing you ALL of Two Point Hospital’s DLC in one easy to swallow bundle! This complete collection of DLCs offers you a wealth of new locations, new hospitals, new items, new gameplay and more! It's time to build, cure and improve in style.

• Two Point Hospital
• Culture Shock
• Fancy Dress Pack
• A Stitch in Time
• Close Encounters
• Retro Item Pack
• Off The Grid
• Speedy Recovery
• Two Point Hospital Bonus Campus Items
• Two Point Hospital: SEGA 60th Items
• Two Point Hospital: Free Zombie Costume
• Two Point Hospital: Hospital Pass (Golden Toilet)
• Two Point Hospital: Jingle Jam (from Humble Bundle)
• Two Point Hospital: Convention-al Rug (from Twitch, both Venus and Violet variants)

title: Harvest Scream
description: A co-op farming horror game about raiding unstable dimensions for seeds to grow and harvest for a hungry monster's daily quota.

title: Night Club Simulator: Party King
description: Step into the vibrant world of nightlife! Create, manage & customize your own nightclub, solo or co-op. From hiring staff and organizing events to setting the perfect atmosphere with music & lighting, every choice you make will shape your club. Are you ready to become the ultimate nightclub tycoon?

title: BloomKeeper
description: Spread nature and breathe life back into a world of ash by guiding the Pouics, naive and curious little creatures. They dream of reawakening the world, but they can’t do it alone. Guide them, calm them, protect them and help them restore life to a forgotten land.

title: Paratopic: Overdub
description: Paratopic: Overdub revives the award-winning 2018 liminal horror classic: a twisting 3-in-1 remaster, remix, and sequel to the original.

title: Duo Quest
description: Dive into a fantasy world where your bond is your greatest weapon! Team up with a friend to battle monsters by answering quirky and thought-provoking questions about each other, while building decks and exploring an ever-changing world. Can your relationship survive the ultimate test?

title: Tinker Shot
description: Tinker Shot is a turned-based Spell Building rogue-like, You fight enemies by creating custom spells and launching them at enemies. Grow an arsenal of spells and items to overcome the world of Tinker Shot.

title: Runeomicon
description: Cast runes to summon the goddess of death, unleash eldritch horrors to fend off villagers, and wield dark magic in this unique tower defense. Balance your power between summoning and fortifying as waves of enemies close in. Can you complete the ritual before your defenses crumble?

title: Gladio Mori
description: Gladio Mori is a cutting-edge physics-based multiplayer fighting game where you use razor-sharp weapons to cut down your enemies or die trying. Pick your blade, choose your armour and create a fighting style unique to you. Enter the arena to face your friends or hone your abilities against the AI.

title: Monowave
description: MONOWAVE is a puzzle-adventure platformer built around four emotions: happiness, sorrow, anger, and anxiety. Players use each emotion's abilities and pass emotions to other spirits through song to solve puzzles and explore the world. The game supports solo play and two-player local co-op, with one player controlling Mono and the other controlling Prism.

title: Welcome to Mars 9
description: Welcome to Mars 9: The Tale of River is an old-school graphic adventure about a person adrift in space, rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you will be drawn into a world of comfort and pleasure, only to soon discover that the station hides a dark secret.

title: Roman Sands RE:Build
description: Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

title: Good Heavens!
description: Good Heavens! Is an open-world crafting and building RPG. Embark on a solo adventure or team up with up friends, picking your tool of choice – sword, wand, or carpenter's hammer. Navigate the quirky races and cultures of the promised lands and restore them to their, ahem, intended glory.

title: Woodo
description: Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.

title: How to Wait for the Bus
description:
The bus will arrive when it arrives. In the meantime, make some tiles explode.

Fire coloured tiles into the board from any edge. Line up three or more matching tiles to make them explode, trigger chain reactions, and gradually clear the board.

Every shot can solve a problem, create a spectacular cascade — or leave you with an even worse problem than the one you started with.

No ads. No energy timers. No daily chores. No in-app purchases. Just a small puzzle game with exploding tiles.

title: DiceyTable
description:
Your table. Your games. Your rules.

Welcome to DiceyTable, a 3D tabletop gaming playground where new and classic games come to life, competition gets fierce, and your imagination sets the limits! Roll realistic dice, shuffle and deal cards, and move pieces across a fully interactive, physics-driven tabletop—all directly in your browser, with nothing to download or install.

Challenge your friends, take on AI opponents with adjustable difficulty, or battle your way up the leaderboards in ranked multiplayer matches. Discover a growing collection of classic board and card games, some featuring fully scripted rules and automated gameplay, while others simply let you experince the freedom of a traditional tabletop. Gather up to ten players around a table, keep your cards hidden with private hands, and even step into the action with VR support.

Why just play games when you can create them? Unleash your creativity with DiceyTable's built-in game editor, where you can design, customize, and share your own tabletop experiences with players everywhere.

Whether you're a casual player, a fierce competitor, or an aspiring game creator, there's always a seat waiting for you at DiceyTable.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: George Washington Pack
description: The leader George Washington is now available in Sid Meier's Civilization VII as part of the Hall of History Collection DLC!

title: Bootline: Desktop Simulator
description:
Start from a blinking cursor. Bootline hands you MorrowDesk, a small fictional personal computer, and a neighborhood of people who need things made on it. Draw a badge, save it as a picture, set it as your wallpaper, attach it to a mail, publish it on your home page. Everything you make stays on your machine, and the machine slowly becomes yours.

Everything in Bootline is fictional and local. No real drive, operating system, network or account is ever changed.

title: Dave the Diver: GGST
description:
Rhythm Game: The Disaster of Passion
Experience a special rhythm-game powered by the electrifying GGST track 'The Disaster of Passion'.

Feel the beat, hit the notes, and dive into the action with signature GGST flair.

Bancho Sushi: GGST Vibes All Night
Bancho Sushi welcomes cosplay customers inspired by iconic GGST fighters, bringing high-energy atmosphere to the night.

Enhance the restaurant’s vibe even further with the 'May Speaker', adding a stylish, rock-infused presence to your interior.

May’s Anchor: A Dolphin-Charged Strike
Equip the special weapon 'May’s Anchor' and unleash a powerful, dolphin-charged impact during your dives.

title: WhoIsHe
description: WhoIsHe is a narrative-driven point-and-click escape room. You play as a young man who was found 7 years after being kidnapped. Now, one year after his return, he wakes up locked in a police detective's office - covered in fresh blood and suffering from severe amnesia. As you solve logic puzzles and dig through old police files, you are forced to face one chilling question: Are you the real Henry Grudge, or a dangerous impostor who stole a missing child's identity?

title: Art Rally Simulator
description: RACE. DRIFT. CONQUER.

title: Knucklebones Neon
description: Knucklebones Neon is a turn-based dice game in which two players place rolls into columns, combine matching dice to increase their scores, and remove matching dice from opposing columns. It includes computer opponents with three difficulty levels, local two-player play on one device, and online ranked matches. Collectible runes and alternate game modes introduce abilities and variations on the scoring rules.

title: Seed Shop: Tidy Up!
description: Restore a vintage seed shop by sorting thousands of scattered seed packets, bulbs, potted plants, and saplings. Read the labels, carry stacks, fill more than 300 plant slots, and unlock faster ways to bring order back one shelf at a time.

title: Diablo IV: Season of Hell's Legacy
description: Season of Hell’s Legacy is live in Diablo IV. Step into Waking Nightmares that bring some of the most infamous moments from Diablo’s past into the present. Guided by the lost soul of Deckard Cain, confront echoes of legendary foes, explore familiar locations reimagined in Diablo IV, and contain the fearsome powers of the Prime Evils.

title: Neo Trick
description: Neo Trick is an addictive deck-building game! Each round you'll be delicately balancing dealing enough damage to the firewall and stealing enough money to spend in the shop! Card's can permanently affect other cards. Increasing their power or adding new effects will carry into future rounds.

title: Ikebana Dones and the Great Adventure
Bonitāka's Aquarium of Medusae
description: Help a marine biologist's research by piloting a submarine, as you tune in to the souls of jellyfish... and maybe help her learn a thing or two about life too!

title: DR Dominoes
description: Dominican partner dominoes in 3D, with proximity voice chat: you hear every player from where they're sitting. Private rooms, a room browser, offline AI, and games to 100, 120, 150 or 200 points.

title: Game of Mods
description: Game of Mods is a voice-driven adventure and creation platform for Apple Silicon Macs in which every character is driven by a language model running on the player's machine. Players speak or type to characters, who answer aloud in their own voices, remember the conversation, and stay in character; nothing is sent to the cloud and no account is required. The game includes a spoken tutorial and short authored stories called journeys, plus a Studio for building NPCs, player characters, journeys and spaces as data-only mods (JSON with VRM and GLB assets) that can be shared through Steam Workshop. Rendering uses Metal 4 with VRM avatars, dialogue is generated by an on-device Gemma 4 model, and speech uses Apple's speech recognition and synthesis. Every voice path has a keyboard equivalent, and the game is designed to be playable without seeing the screen.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Update 1.5.0
description:
Update 1.5.0 adds the True Start Location Earth map, with historically based starting positions, recognizable terrain, navigable rivers, resources, and Natural Wonders. Terra Incognita and Shuffle maps have also been updated to provide more varied and unpredictable layouts through different map-generation styles.

The update introduces an option to remain neutral when an ally enters a war by spending Influence, along with interface improvements such as the Radial Ruler, expanded plot and unit tooltips, and clearer information about Syncretism options.

title: Fallout 76: The Slasher
description: The Slasher Update features an all-new series of eerie & exciting emergency broadcasts airing in parts over multiple weeks. These broadcasts lead players to unravel the mystery behind these macabre masked murders, with tasks ranging from fighting Infestations of fanatical Slasher supporters to digging up unmarked graves for clues.

title: Nuclear Design Bureau
description:
Nuclear Design Bureau is a hardcore sandbox engineering game where you design and test nuclear devices.

You are a junior engineer at the Kurchatov Institute. The State gives you a target and a warehouse full of dangerous materials. Some directives limit what you are allowed to use. Your job is to build a device that does what the directive asks.

title: Rollout Inline
description: Rollout Inline is a brand new Aggressive Inline game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. This game aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new, modern, and intuitive inline skating game!

title: Eternal Memento
description: Phasmophobia X Spelunky roguelike

title: Detstvo
description: Relive the last day of school before summer break in a nostalgic Soviet neighborhood. Wander through faded apartment buildings, dusty playgrounds, and forbidden construction sites, playing hide-and-seek with friends, scoring goals, watching cartoons, and rediscovering old games on an ancient phone. The world comes alive through period details, dynamic lighting, and an atmospheric soundtrack capturing everyday sounds—a neighbor's guitar, a tape recorder, the kitchen radio. This quiet experience asks you to simply be present in a day you'll always remember but can never return to.

title: Cube Boy
description: A point-and-click puzzle adventure set in a surreal cursed house, with a whimsical spooky-comedy tone.

title: Ares: The Iron Vanguard
description:
Ares: The Iron Vanguard is a sci-fi action RPG featuring fast-paced, suit-switching combat. Players can equip two different combat suits and switch between them in real time, combining weapons, skills, and combat styles to adapt to each battle.
Choose from multiple combat classes, including the Engineer, Warlock, Warlord, and Hunter, each with distinct weapons and abilities. Mix and match different suits to create your own combat style and take on hordes of enemies and powerful bosses.
Explore vast futuristic battlefields using advanced mobility options such as hover boards, the Goliath mech, and the Valkyrie. The game also features multiplayer content including raids and strike missions, allowing players to take on challenging battles together.
Combat emphasizes timing and action-based mechanics such as parries, perfect dodges, combos, and real-time suit switching.
Set across the solar system, players take on the role of a Guardian fighting against the threat of Nemesis in a war to protect humanity and reclaim the battlefield.

title: Bluy Leaves Home
description: A turn-based bullet-hell JRPG game.

title: Game Store Cleanup
description: A cozy-chaotic first-person sim about restocking a wrecked game store. Sort every scattered item back onto its correct shelf and watch a total mess become a tidy, ready-to-open shop again.

title: Blue Sun Saga
description: Go on a quest to restore life to the world in this retro inspired shooter! You must be skillful and tactical as many will try to stop you! You are an exile after all which is a death sentence. But things may be as they seem on this journey.

title: Minecraft: Wilderness Bound
description: Wilderness Bound is the third Minecraft game drop of 2026, focused on exploration and camping. It introduces the Dappled Forest biome, featuring poplar trees with red, orange, and yellow leaves, shelf mushrooms, and red shrubs. The drop also adds abandoned campsites, straw beds, cushions, and new decorative blocks made from poplar, wool, and concrete.

title: Starbase Tactics
description: Starbase Tactics is a fast 1v1 rts autobattler about planning, scouting, timing, and tactical choices. Play compact, competitive matches designed around clear decision-making.

title: Mega Man X: Command Mission
description:
A port of Mega Man X: Command Mission, originally released on PlayStation 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Cyborg superhero Mega Man X must protect the endangered Giga City from the lethal attentions of the Liberion Army.

Fight across more than 50 missions in this full-throttle future-themed RPG. Joining the illustrious Mega Man on this colossal quest are familiar faces like Axl and Zero, together with a whole bunch of new characters.

Combine with your team-mates mid-battle to perform dynamic combat techniques - with challenging side quests to master and devastating boss encounters to overcome, the success of this Mission is by no means assured...

title: Train Sim World 7
description: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

title: Look to the Birds
description: A cozy first-person birdwatching game about slowing down, noticing nature, and finding peace in small moments. Photograph 30+ bird species across five hand-crafted dioramas and fill your journal as you travel through the Canadian Maritimes.

title: Take Care of My Heifer
description: "Take Care of My Heifer," reads the job listing. Sounds simple... until you step inside the house.

title: Side Out
description: Hold one side of a collapsing arena and keep the ball out. Miss twice and you are gone, then you come back as a saboteur dropping traps on whoever is left. Up to 20 players, cross-play with web and mobile.

title: A Game About Flipping Cards
description: Did you read the title? That's the game, I promise. Flip cards to make money to buy upgrades to make more money to buy more upgrades to make more money. There is an arbitrary goal that has been set by the developer, but you can actually play indefinitely.

title: PawMart Tiny Market
description: Build and manage a cozy idle supermarket run by cute animals at the bottom of your screen. Produce goods, stock shelves, automate your store, hire employees and expand your tiny market.

title: The Laundry That Won’t Open
description: A short first-person horror game where strange anomalies slowly begin to appear in a laundromat you casually visit. As you return again and again, you move closer to the ending waiting in this place.

title: Idle Bookstore
description: A cozy idle bookstore you grow from a tiny shop into a thriving business — solo or with friends. Co-work together, write books as a group, and sell each other’s books for profit.

title: Snuggle Nightmare
description: Snuggle Nightmare is a first-person mascot horror adventure set in an abandoned theme park. The player must solve puzzles, craft tools, avoid a deadly animatronic, and uncover the secrets hidden within Brain World Rots.

title: The Solyani's Code
description: A Sci-Fi story set on the moon Selene, featuring LUMA, a glowing companion that assists you with unique abilities.

title: Station Command
description: A strategy RPG autobattler with branching story set in a far future corporate dystopia

title: Death Penalty
description: You are sentenced to death... Slither your way through an impenetrable fortress crawling with devils faster, stronger, and more cunning than any human. By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?

title: Medieval Juice Crafter
description: Craft your special recipe juices and sell them in medieval villages. Expand your business with new recipes, machines, properties, and workers. Play online with your friend or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your business.

title: Throttle Trace
description: Slot cars meets simulation racing. Master grip, timing, and race strategy using only throttle and brake. Push to the limit, outsmart rivals, and fight for every corner in intense wheel-to-wheel competition.

title: Batomon Showdown
description: Batomon Showdown is a monster taming asynchronous pvp autobattler. Discover and battle with hundreds of Batomon! Assemble the ultimate team to take down other players! Play at your own pace while you discover new deadly team combos and synergies! Break the game by training your Batomon to overpowered levels.

title: Hope 01
description: Hope 01 is a single player extraction survival RPG with multiple endings. Explore, Loot, and Fight your way through the dangers of the hab cluster and solve the mysteries of the legendary HAB 01.

title: The Bow: Ultimate Weapon
description: A top-down shooter incremental game where you defeat enemies, sell loot, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat bosses for special items, and shape your own combat build through steady progression.

title: Neon Dodge
description: Neon Dodge is a frantic, vaporwave-themed bullet hell where you cannot shoot. Master the dodge to survive the impossible challenges that a mysterious Voice throws at you... Or watch your death counter ascend to infinity.

title: Primal Reign: The Age of New Kings
description: A story-driven VR action adventure where you uncover lost tombs, battle dinosaurs, and clash with Nazi soldiers in a fight to rewrite history.

title: Paperman
description: Want to become the new boss of a thriving paper company whose owner mysteriously died? Track down the culprit and catch them to become the new boss. But beware, your adventure will be littered with some tricky obstacles...

title: Rushcremental
description: Rushcremental is an active incremental journey about searching the wasteland for scrap resources and building a racecar to rule over all the territories.

title: Sublight
description: Sublight is a survivor-like game set in space. Upgrade, evade, and burn through waves of progressively stronger foes. Unlock new ships and make powerful builds: all to fend off the encroaching fleet.

title: Fright Train
description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror game.

title: Arcany
description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

title: Once Before Us
description: A cooperative, narrative puzzle adventure for two players. Explore a mysterious world, solve interconnected challenges, and communicate to progress. Once Before Us is a game about thinking, perception, and discovery through exploration and problem-solving.

title: Mixed Spirits
description: Run a cozy bar, make cocktails for fun customers! Mixed Spirits is a Job Simulator where you work as a bartender. Take orders, mix custom drinks, and discover secret recipes in a chill, creative night-shift experience with no timers or stress, or rush orders in Happy Hour mode!

title: Cloudbreaker
description: Cloudbreaker is a roguelite, inventory management, bullet heaven. Explore a sky-world, finding relics and defeating hordes of enemies. Unlock and upgrade airships, each with its own unique layout, abilities, and strategies, to grow your power over time.

title: Fleetbreakers
description: Fleetbreakers is a modern blend of classic strategy and fast-paced combat. Build your fleet, upgrade your units, and manage your squadron as you battle through a unique roguelike campaign in the quest to liberate space from the evil Voltari.

title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
description: On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft to survive in this co-operative (1-4) survival crafting game. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can they hope to slay the Dragon Queen—alone or with allies.

title: Knuckle Jet
description: What's this? An off-the-wall, riveting jetpunk nose-breaking ricochet action platformer, lovingly crafted by the oddballs behind the Teslagrad series?

title: Cake Up
description: Play as a cake courier who delivers an order to the king in the midst of a magical war! Dodge the magic projectiles, deliver the cake safely and try not to fall into the clutches of the evil cake robbers!

title: Suqare: Hired Gun
description: Take on mission after mission as you attempt to become the best Mercenary ever. Shoot, stab, protect, steal, lie, betray, and much more as you complete jobs from corporations and special interests. Will you assist or destroy them? The choice is yours... And watch out for that pesky Cricle.

title: Hand Cooking Simulator: Multi-Chef
description: A fun physics based hand simulator in which you prepare food.

title: Active Matter
description:
You’re an operative stuck in a time loop, always brought back from the dead to the same point.

Choose your loadout and enter quantum unstable zones rich with active matter — a substance capable of warping and ripping the very fabric of space and time.
