Fight against rivals from other timelines, survive physics-breaking anomalies and try to stay alive. Harvest active matter, gather loot and extract to a safe place before the whole zone ceases to exist with everything inside it.

title: TCG Card Shop Simulator
description:
Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

title: Heroes Suck
description: Defend your dungeon against an onslaught of heroes in this physics-enabled tower defense. Build your dungeon tile by tile, placing deadly traps to protect your loot. Upgrade your defenses and powers as you amass wealth and unleash havoc on these cheese wheel-stealing 'heroes'.

title: The Event
description: The Event is a first-person psychological horror game that offers immersive gameplay and a rich narrative. Find yourself stuck in mystery and struggle in the dark against paranormal activities, demons from other worlds and much more. Will you be able to find out the truth and return home?

title: Dimraeth
description: A 1-8 player fantasy RPG set in a handcrafted pixel world. Build your hero across 8 races and 6 classes. Explore ancient lands, master elemental combat, forge relationships, and shape a stronghold to call home. Fight for the fate of Dimraeth—together or alone.

title: Secrets of Temple Isle
description: Explore ancient ruins and diverse biomes, fight in third-person combat while collecting gear and powers. Design your space and decorate with items gathered in the world. Become the legend in this exciting single player adventure.

title: Marvel's Wolverine
description: Marvel's Wolverine is a single-player action-adventure game and a standalone entry in the Marvel's Spider-Man series, sharing continuity with those titles while telling its own self-contained story. Players control Logan/Wolverine in close-quarters combat, using his adamantium claws against enemies drawn from the X-Men comic book mythology.

title: Airmash
description: Multiplayer missile warfare browser game.

title: Score
description:
Warning, this game is in Early Access Alpha stage bugs and constant content changes are to be expected.
Score, is a Sport and Profession Driven Open World Multiplayer Game where players compete for fame, glory and wealth on a global scale on and off the pitch. Score's Legend City environment is a very large open world which is to 100% user controlled through their professions.

title: Dungeon Swipe
description: Dungeon Swipe is a portrait action role-playing game with pixel art and deckbuilding. Players swipe through dungeon encounters, fight enemies using timed attacks and defenses, collect equipment, and develop a roster of heroes. Cards modify combat, while exploration includes treasure, puzzles, companions, and persistent progression between expeditions.

title: Rikogol
description:
Rikogol is a top-down 2D arcade soccer game driven by physics. Every player is a disc with just two actions, move and kick, and matches have no fouls or offside, so goals come down to positioning, passing and timing.

Matches range from one-on-one duels to full eleven-a-side games, with bots taking any empty spots. Each team can have a head coach who sets the formation and draws plays that only their own team can see. Two people can also play on one computer, either as teammates against bots or as rivals.

title: Don't Stop Cutting The Trees!
description: Don’t Stop Cutting the Trees! is a colorful incremental game where you play as a determined lumberjack journeying through increasingly dangerous forest regions. Cutting down trees, collecting Wood, earning XP, unlocking skills, recruiting companions, and chopping down Boss Trees.

title: Trinity Trigger DX
description: The power of three can defy destiny.The classic fantasy action RPG Trinity Trigger arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 in a definitive edition packed with DLC!

title: I Can Smell You from Here
description:
You are an incel going on his first-ever date, with his first-ever match from a dating app.
What could possibly go wrong?

title: Stones Keeper: Director's Cut
description: Stones Keeper: Director's Cut reveals Stones Keeper in a new way: an updated campaign, a reworked story, new tactical mechanics, expanded character progression, and new equipment make every battle more compelling and the journey richer. Revamped animations, portraits, interface, world map, and flying fortress round out the game's distinctive world and tie its story to the sequel.

title: Astrosaurox
description: Astrosaurox is a tribute to the videogames of the late 70s and early 80s. Pilot an Astrosaurox tank and battle the space mafia. Depending on your age, either discover or relive the challenge, fun, and addictive nature of those classic games. Beat your highscore in solo or co-op mode.

title: Kickslaught
description: Lace up your boots and rise from the lowest league to the top! Blast through defenders with powerful shots, collect and upgrade gear, train around the neighborhood, defeat the goalkeeper, and build your footballer into an unstoppable champion.

title: Declan Moses
description: You are Declan, and Declan kills thugs. Kick in the doors and clear the building of anyone who shoots at you. Night by night, Declan will use an array of weapons to clean an underworld one house, store front, or wherever at a time.

title: Fish Lab
description: A short incremental game where you collect fish for your lab. Synced to music.

title: Sakura Branch: Blossom Puzzle
description: Grow a magical cherry blossom tree in this relaxing and addicting puzzle game.

title: Kas Mind
description: The most lawless taunt-em-up has arrived! Smack them with a paper fan, then mock them while they're down, mock them from a distance, mock them out of pure spite — spam taunts and victory is yours. "So... how does it feel?"

title: Shakugan no Shana: Blaze Edge
description: Shakugan no Shana: Blaze Edge is an idle role-playing game based on the Shakugan no Shana anime series. The player raises Shana, a Flame Haze, through stages set in the Shadow World, enhancing equipment obtained in battle, collecting artifacts and learning Unrestricted Spells. Equipment can be worn for its appearance independently of its stats, so Shana's look is customized separately from her build. More than twenty characters from the series, including Yuji Sakai and Hecate, can be recruited as allies, among them figures who opposed her in the anime. Growth materials accumulate while the game is closed.

title: Happy's Humble Burger Cult: Trial by Fryer
description: Trial by Fryer Update introduces a new PvP mode ("Trial by Fryer"), two themed restaurants ("Roost" and "Pig Pen"), and a massive cosmetics overhaul with 76 masks, 17 outfits, and 19 hats. The update also adds co-workers, progression changes, enemy reworks, and significant performance improvements, including rebuilt materials and better reflections. It also adds new soundtracks, voice packs, and accessibility options.

title: Drill Core: Anniversary Update
description: Drill Core Anniversary Update enhances the strategic mining game with new features like end-of-game statistics, contract escalation, and additional specialists. The update also introduces Relaxed Mode, new platform skins, and quality-of-life improvements, including a x3 game speed option and a refined tutorial.

title: Hozy Hideaways
description: A free DLC for all Hozy players, invites you to explore three new levels - each with its own unique atmosphere and personality. Meet the characters who call these spaces home, discover the little details that make each place unique, and take your time turning them into something special.

title: Am I Cringe?
description: Am I Cringe is a little web toy that calculates or clinically screens your posts' cringe score. But it has more packing to it; it features Cringe Battles where people can duel others to cringe battles, or Cringe Royale: 99 strangers competing to see who's the least cringe.

title: Mining Rail Adventure
description: Mining Rail Adventure is a tunnel and railway game that combines free cavern exploration with high-speed roller coaster elements. Players travel through branching tunnels, vast caverns, and hidden chambers deep within a mountain to search for radiant crystals. The gameplay focuses on a mix of exploration, searching for collectibles, and fast-paced rail navigation.
"771" is a first-person psychological horror game consisting of 7 unique gameplay segments, each created by a different developer.

title: Gamble Life
description:
Gamble Life is a four-player Five-Card Draw poker game that combines poker with special abilities and roguelike elements. Use powerful abilities to manipulate the rules of poker, build unique combinations, and win money from your opponents.

Play through a limited number of days, manage your funds, and fight to repay your debt before the deadline.

title: Put Back Stuff
description: Put Back Stuff is a cozy organisation simulator where you put items back where they belong. Enjoy peaceful, play at your pace organisation.

title: 911 Dispatcher: Unknown Caller
description: 911 Dispatcher: Unknown Caller — a first-person psychological horror game in which you work as a night-shift emergency dispatcher. Take calls, decide when to send a police unit, and get to the bottom of a mysterious call connected to an old closed case.

title: Stack Together: To the Moon
description: Work together to build towering structures and reach the Moon! Build massive towers, launch rockets, slow down the incoming meteor, and discover anomaly boxes to keep your structure balanced. A chaotic physics-based co-op adventure for up to 4 players!

title: Suba Pogo
description: An emergency call echoed through the peaceful Hololive!! Subaru from the Oozora Police Department picks up the phone and rushes out on an urgent dispatch...!!!

title: Distorted Minds
description: Distorted Minds is a chilling anthology of SGG’s original psychological horror stories. Seemingly harmless tales twist into something far darker, each branching into multiple endings and hiding secrets that were never meant to be uncovered.

title: Skate Felon
description: Experience Classic Arcade Skateboarding in a small Action packed world. Discover a small city, skate throughout the world, and engage in an Immersive Storyline + Skateboarding Goals that can be discovered by exploring. The world is your playground.

title: GameZone: Game Store Simulator
description:
GameZone is a first-person store management simulation game playable solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

Players operate a game shop by ordering stock, arranging products, setting prices, scanning purchases, serving customers, and fulfilling online orders. Revenue and reputation can be used to expand the business and unlock new products and abilities.

The store, furniture and player characters can be customised, while physics-driven object handling is used for everyday shop tasks.

title: Rehaunted
description: Enter a house where every clue feels wrong. Investigate a brutal crime scene, uncover hidden evidence, and use your detective tools to piece together a disturbing truth buried beneath the silence.

title: Pilot Force Simulator
description: Pilot Force Simulator throws you into the heart of a chaotic space battle. Dodge waves of bullets, feel the thrill of near-misses, and unleash powerful attacks in an intense, fast-paced fight through the stars!

title: Spaceship Pro Simulator
description: Spaceship Pro Simulator. Strapped in and ready. One ship, one missionsurvive the unknown. Enemies ahead, systems online. This is my journey through deep space, and I'm not going down easy.

title: Boxing Pro Simulator
description: Boxing Pro Simulator throws you into the ring with the roar of the crowd in your ears! Unleash unstoppable punches, lightning jabs, and crushing hooks in adrenaline-fueled bouts where every hit could be the knockout blow!

title: Dinosaur Hunting Simulator
description: Go back in time in Dinosaur Hunting Simulator, grip your rifle tight, and feel the thrill as you track massive tyrannosaurus, triceratops, and more across wild, untamed landscapes. Every hunt is a heart-pounding adventure.

title: Battleships Simulator
description: Battleships Simulator puts you in command of mighty shipsstrike, sink your opponent, and claim victory! Feel the thrill of naval battles and outsmart your foe in intense, turn-based war action!

title: Bar Darts Simulator
description: In Bar Darts Simulator, grab a few beers with friends, crack a few jokes, and challenge each other across 10 fun dart games. Aim, throw, and take a sip of your drink while you listen to the lively bar atmosphere.

title: F1 Simulator
description: F1 Simulator puts you in the cockpit, where every turn, every boost, and every second counts. Feel the adrenaline, chase insane speeds, and carve your name into the record books as the ultimate racing legend!

title: Hunting Pro Simulator
description: In Hunting Pro Simulator, your hearts racing, hands shaking BAM! Take the perfect headshot! Feel the thrill, aim the target, and celebrate as the beast hits the ground. Hunting has never felt this easy!

title: Mini Golf Simulator
description: Mini Golf Simulator is a calm, cozy mini golf experience made to help you slow down and unwind. Enjoy peaceful courses, the sound of birds on a fresh Saturday morning, and the simple satisfaction of mastering each hole and landing the perfect hole-in-one.

title: Supermarket Life Simulator
description: Run your own supermarket! Buy, stock, and sell items, expand your store, and manage customers. Customize your layout, explore new locations, and hire staff. Keep things fresh with variety and new challenges as you grow your business.

title: Schedule Store Simulator
description: Rise from a small-time drug dealer to a feared kingpin as you manufacture and distribute narcotics across the gritty underbelly of Tokyo. Grow your empire by acquiring properties, running businesses, hiring employees, and dominating the streets.

title: How to Grow Your Sausage
description: Every [key]stroke makes your sausage bigger. Let it sit in the corner of your screen and watch it grow while you use your computer. Feed it different meats, upgrade your butcher, and see the magic happen. Have you ever dreamed of growing your sausage? Now it’s finally possible!

title: Meeple Incremental
description: Roll dice to move Meeples around the board and collect money, skill points, and capsule tickets. Unlock unique skills and minigames, powerful collectibles, and automate dice rolls to increase your income.

title: Pibcremental
description: A cozy, chaotic idle-incremental clicker about growing a civilisation of tiny creatures called Pibbles in a giant tree, set in a post-human world. Gather resources, build wacky structures and play mini-games to push your production to its absolute limits!

title: Animaly Bar: No Humanity!
description: Run your bar as a gorilla and hunt down the humans in animal costumes hiding among your customers. Observe them closely, spot the clues that give their disguises away, test their slogans, and blow the imposters away with your shotgun. Choose your targets wisely... or become the hunted.

title: Neat
description: Neat is a game about helping people organize their lives by organizing their spaces.

title: Apple Man Sam
description: Apple Man Sam...is a little Apple Man! Shoot your way through hordes of moustached vegetables, as you level up, upgrade your weapons, and obtain items to grow absurdly strong. Defeat the final boss and complete quests to unlock more maps and loadouts, for endless fun!

title: Grid
description: Grid Slash is a fast-paced, grid-based visual debugging action game where you dive into consecutive battles and wipe out system-breaking bugs.

title: The Headlands
description: A cozy top-down farming management game focused on planning and steady growth. Manage fields, machinery, and resources, upgrade your farm, and develop efficient processes at your own pace in a calm, strategic experience.

title: Depth of Mind
description: In this turn-based strategy game, you must assemble the strongest team of mental operatives to overcome mental illnesses inside a person.

title: Creator Chronicles
description: A game within a game. In this entirely new kind of simulation RPG, become a guild master, develop your town, recruit guild members, and conquer dungeons. Every decision you make becomes your own chronicle.

title: Blood Lily: Killers Can't Sink a Yuri Ship
description: A B-horror mystery comedy adventure game. Having a crush on your bestie is hard enough without serial killers in the way! Lily's vacay plan to romance her crush Sally goes wrong when killers keep cropping up and ruining the mood. And that means war. "How dare you come between Sally and me!"

title: Cloudscrapers
description:
Cloudscrapers is a minimalist strategy game with a relaxing atmosphere.

Start with simple tools and build the tallest tower you can. With each climb, you’ll improve, unlock upgrades, and reach new heights. As your tower rises, you’ll discover ancient relics and uncover secrets hidden deep within the clouds.

Designed for players who enjoy thoughtful gameplay without unnecessary complexity, the game blends replayable puzzle-strategy, meaningful progression, and a hand-drawn world you can get lost in.

title: Ragnar
description: In this epic Norse myth-inspired roguelike dungeon crawler, wield divine power to challenge Loki and uncover the secrets of the Nine Realms through the branches of Yggdrasil. Grow stronger and reshape Ragnarok’s fate with legendary weapons of the gods.

title: Rig Riot
description: A fast-paced third-person mech-action roguelike

title: The Thrill of the Fight 2
description: The fully reimagined sequel to the greatest VR boxing game ever made is now available. Glove up your fully personalizable avatar and test your skill while working up a sweat in the new online player-versus-player mode. Challenge friends or enter the ring through skill-based matchmaking as you battle through breathtaking arenas.

title: Soul Injector Commando
description: FPS where you are tasked by God to give souls to the wealthiest people on Earth, helping them get normal jobs and be productive members of society.

title: Dunebound Tactics
description: Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain to your advantage and make life-or-death choices in Dunebound Tactics, a Roguelite Turn-Based Tactical RPG.

title: Sigilfarer
description: Sigilfarer is a roguelite adventure where every decision rests on the roll of your dice. Master a dice-building system while navigating a sprawling, procedurally generated world. Strategize your route, manage resources and push your luck to the limit!

title: Squirrel Day
description: Squirrel Day is a non-violent VR platforming game that lets you climb, explore, and collect nuts through the eyes of a squirrel using an intuitive, physics-based movement system.

title: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor
description: A dark fantasy JRPG. The imperial princess Chrysoberyl must fight the Bloody Emperor who has usurped the throne. However, her army is small and her allies are conniving. It is a bloody war where she will have to choose between peace and lives...

title: Tenebris: Terra Incognita
description: A turn-based tactical RPG in which you will explore a harsh planet teeming with terrifying monsters. Experiment with talent builds for 23 heroes. Combine abilities with equipment and other characters. Assemble a squad and learn the secrets of the planet Tenebris!

title: Spiritus Astrum
description: Spiritus Astrum is a persistent, open-world roleplaying sandbox with multiplayer support. It features an infinite, procedurally generated universe which players are free to explore without restriction. Spiritus Astrum is more than a game, it is a world.

title: Craftomation 101
description: You land on a frozen planet in a tiny rocket with a robot inside. Harvest and combine materials to discover new ones. Use visual programming to make the robot do the tiresome work for you. Slowly build a gang of self-sustaining robot workers and watch them terraform the planet.

title: SquirrelTower
description: SquirrelTower is a pixel-art arcade stacking game in which a squirrel builder constructs a tower by dropping floors from a crane. Players time each drop to align the floors, earn stars and combos, and improve their best height. The game features one-tap controls, changing weather and time-of-day scenes, and daily, weekly and all-time leaderboards through Google Play Games. Community events let players compete toward shared floor goals.

title: Lanky Looters
description: Steal everything and run! "Lanky Looters" is a sneak-and-snatch game where you'll grow thick as Thieves. Swipe loot and escape before you're caught by pesky Officers. With quiet feet and sharp eyes, you might just survive as you steal your way through 4 varied maps...

title: Multi Modal Transit
description:
A traffic-management puzzle game in which the player designs the transport network of a growing city. Houses and workplaces appear over time, and the player connects them by drawing roads so that residents can commute. A queue forms at every destination, and a run ends when one of those queues overflows. Each night the city adds new houses and destinations, so the player has to keep extending and reworking the network.

As the city grows, more transport options become available: buses, trams, river boats and underground lines.

The campaign is set in seven cities: London, Las Vegas, Venice, Rio de Janeiro, Stockholm, Mexico City and San Francisco. Each city has its own geography and its own set of transit modes. Venice has water buses, Las Vegas has an elevated monorail instead of an underground, and Stockholm uses boats instead of trams.

Besides the campaign there is a Sandbox mode with no fail state and unlimited resources, and a Custom mode where the player chooses the terrain, the available transit modes and the growth rate.

title: TDS v0.1.3
description:
TDS is definitely just your run-of-the-mill top-down shooter, nothing else to it at all!

...Or is it?

title: Mole Escape
description: A little mole has had enough of living under the rule of the tyrannical Mole King. He wants only one thing — to escape the underground kingdom and finally be free.

title: The Zium Railway
description:
In the Valley of the Underground Mountain.. In the picturesque land of Lyptch...

The Zium Railway is an open world gallery.

Experience a hand crafted open world, the open rails, a new collection of artists, a collaborative video game, and a new exhibition from The Zium Society.

Features works from Ada Null, Charlotte Madelon, Christopher Ferris, Farfama, Jacob Potterfield, John Flannelly & Virtual Neighbors, Julian Palacios, Michael Berto, Pippin Barr, and Zilasaule.

title: Argonauts Agency: Patterns of Morpheus - Collector's Edition
EuroDrive
description: Explore Europe in an all-in-one map for Grand Truck Simulator 2.

title: Gravity Knight
description: Gravity Knight is a 3D, third-person puzzle platforming game that requires you to manipulate gravity and complete various puzzle rooms to escape the dungeon!

title: Orba
description: ORBA is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art action game where you race a fragile Orb up a deadly tower. Dash through shifting floors, use powerful Lucky Charms to outpace destruction, and push your limits before the Orb shatters.

title: Gun of Fate: The Silver Gun of Ylia
description: A shooting adventure RPG game, where you play as a gunslinger in Westland. The main combat system of the game is gun shooting. You can complete quest and side missions, unlock items and equipment, and also play fishing and horse racing mini games.

title: Daemon
description: Daemon is an action-packed first-person shooter with expressive and customizable gameplay that can be built for tactical assistance, controlling space, or dealing oppressive damage. Combine a wide variety of weapons and abilities to out-strategize your opponents and claim victory.

title: Backyard Defenders
description: Defend your picnic from hungry bugs in this strategic tower defense game! Place unique defenders, upgrade their abilities, and survive increasingly challenging waves of ants, beetles, mosquitoes, and epic boss battles. Can you protect your backyard feast?

title: Quest Industries
description: An incremental factory builder where you build a factory that produces fantasy RPG gear for adventurers. Gather resources and craft items to sell. Invest your earnings to discover exotic resources and legendary items blueprints that will make you a fortune.

title: Spirit Animal Survival
description:
SAS is a Open World Coop Multiplayer Game.
Set in a vast environment that features building,crafting,taming,riding,flying and exploring wildlife, dinos and dragons as well as horrific creatures and instances with the ability to morph into Spirit Animals.

title: Survivor's Notes
description:
Survivor's Notes is a zombie survival FMV. Players will take on the roles of both the male and female protagonists simultaneously, advancing different story branches through choices and various quick-time events during gameplay, and ultimately unlocking distinct endings based on their decisions.

This is not a story about "how the apocalypse destroys the world", but a tale of how humans choose to believe, take responsibility, and make sacrifices in the face of despair.

It does not depict how heroes conquer disasters, but how ordinary people, without divine intervention or retreat, shoulder the cost of saving the world with reason, courage, and sacrifice.

When the world is redeemed, the deeds of salvation are erased. What truly remains is only the possibility for the continuation of human civilization.

This is a work dedicated to "the survivors".

It is also a post-apocalyptic fable about memory, trust, and human dignity.

title: Supermarket Simulator: Grocery Store
description: Build your store, serve your customers, and grow your business.

title: Hyranies CCG
description: Hyranies CCG is a tactical and strategic card game where players build their deck, take control of the battlefield and face other players in strategic battles.

title: Next Girl, Please
description: Screen fantasy girls for a bold urban adult studio in this “Papers, Please”-style experience. Make tough calls, build your reputation, and outshine your rival across 10 intense days to unlock multiple endings. Who’s in… and who’s out?

title: The Infectious Adventure
description: You have to save the world, by destroying cases, avoid infected cars...

title: Level P
description: You are trapped underground with one way out. Find your car, follow the sound, and dont let the car park fool you.

title: Friendly Fire
description: A story driven visual novel with interactive shooting challenges where you learn the fundamentals of modern FPS games while helping a cast of stranded characters save their new home from being shut down.

title: Mother;Above
description: Matoki is about to flood to protect the inhabitants of the city above... Vik and his companions head for the flood controls, but his search for his missing mother threatens to consume him. A psychological horror VN about sacrifice, and what desperation makes people willing to do.

title: Space Parkour Obby
description: One small hop for a frog, one giant leap through space!

title: Kilnborn
description: Test your platform fighting-game fundamentals in Kilnborn, a fast-paced platform fighting game where you die in one hit. Kilnborn's pottery protagonists may be fragile, but all play differently with depth to discover in every match.

title: Luduvo
description: Luduvo is a user-generated content (UGC) sandbox gaming platform built on a proprietary engine. The platform allows players to create, share, and play community-designed games using a suite of built-in development tools and custom avatar configurations. Emphasizing digital safety and moderation, Luduvo features an in-game economy driven by virtual currency (Lunes).

title: Splimbo City
description: By day, you're just another data entry drone at Splimbocorp. By night, you fight in underground clubs. But someone at the top is pulling both strings.

title: The Last Login
description: The Last Login is a psychological hacker thriller where you use GHOST//OS to exploit websites, intercept data, control cameras, and make dangerous choices as the voice in your head pushes you deeper into crime.

title: Chud Logic's: Gockbound
description: Chud Logic is isekai’d into a cursed commentary world. To escape, he must recover his leaked DMs and reach the elusive Princess Gock. A darkly comedic, turn-based RPG parody with retro pixel art and internet drama.

title: NightClub Simulator
description: seduce girls or get into fights, you can do anything in a virtual nightclub that you can't do in real life whether its in multiplayer or single player.

title: Pool Ball Battle Royale
description: Control your own pool ball and try to knock your opponents into the holes in this action-packed game. Outmaneuver and defeat your opponents with strategy and quick reflexes to emerge victorious.

title: Cyborg Earthworm
description: Ever played Snake and couldn't hit the fruit because it's going too fast? Automate it! Develop a strategy, let the computer do the hard work, sit back and watch it play the game for you.

title: Mebula Legends
description:
Mebula Legends is a free-to-play idle RPG. Your empire produces gold and resources around the clock, even while you are away. Use them to recruit Mebulis, level them up and send a team of five creatures into automatic battles.

More than 100 Mebulis in six rarity tiers, each with its own element, family ultimates and element bond bonuses. Story campaign with elemental realms, the Shadow Journey and the Prism Rift. Arena and league with leaderboards and a weekly tournament. Roguelike dungeons and the Endless Tower. Guilds with guild wars, a guild merchant and chat with built-in translation. Equipment with a forge, jewelry and the Resonance Chamber. Prestige system with an energy tree for long-term progression.

All content can be reached without paying. Mebula Legends is an online game and requires a Bitmeup account.

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 10 - Butcher's Blasphemy
description: Even the gods can die. After wielding the power of All-Black the Necrosword against the would-be gods of Thebes, the God Butcher's dark crusade brings him to Yggsgard. As long as gods existed, mortals would be shackled to illusions and useless prayers instead of believing in themselves. His mission was clear: assemble the God Bomb and obliterate all things divine. But the King of Yggsgard stands at the ready to defend his kingdom, the sound of thunder close behind him. Will they be enough to save the heavens from true mortal vengeance?

title: 101 Cats: Lisbon
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Lisbon landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Car & Moto Simulator Bundle: Racing & Driving
description: Feel the engine. Hear the world. Every road becomes a story — and you’re the one behind the wheel.

title: My Mart
description: Grow the goods and rule the retail market!

title: Naughty Baby
description: Small Steps - Big Troubles!

title: Garbage Incident
description: A short psychological visual novel about a girl, a bag of garbage, and an ordinary evening that takes an unexpected turn

title: Arcanefall: Darklands
description: Arcanefall: Darklands is a dark fantasy survivor-like game where you take on the role of a spellcaster fighting to survive endless waves of undead horrors in a cursed, crumbling world.

title: Backrooms Escape
description: Escape the endless Backrooms in a fast-paced endless runner. Keep moving as the path continuously changes, dodge deadly spikes, rolling saws, and other dangerous traps, and react quickly to survive. Run as far as you can, escape the dangers behind you, and challenge your best distance!

title: Shadowlight
description: A turn-based stealth roguelike with classic ASCII graphics where light and shadow decide who lives. Slip through procedurally generated dungeons as a thief who strikes from the dark for triple damage, dodges torch-carrying guards, and loots a manor heist — or dies in the light..

title: Bob-omb Blitz
description:
Bob-omb Blitz is a remake/reimagining of the minigame Bob-omb Squad from Super Mario 64 DS and New Super Mario Bros.

Bob-ombs are attacking Peach's flowers! The Toads are counting on you to hold them off as much as you can. Use the slingshot to attack the enemies and blast them out of the sky!

title: TomoTomo
description: TomoTomo is a platformer semi-open world city with an early 2000s Japanese aesthetics. Roam freely through the streets and rooftops of Yōhōbakoto, our goal ? Collect batteries, unlock your RAM upgrades and restore your lost abilities, all while staying one step ahead of the city's patrol units.

title: Lustpunk 69
description: Lustpunk 69 is an explosive mix of roguelike action, card battles, and wicked pleasures in the neon slums of City77. Five years behind bars turned you into a weapon. Walk free under a new name, build a harem of the city’s most dangerous beauties, and make every traitor beg for mercy on her knees.

title: Perfect Heist 2: Pietsmiet DLC
description: Plan your heist with 6 brand-new PietSmiet-inspired characters! Cause chaos with Sep's zap grenades, burn your way through the bank with Chris, or gamble away your money with Dennis!

title: Poker: Texas & Omaha Hold'em - Silver Edition
Nano Punk Mecht
description: You are a young conscript extracted from a shelter and trained to pilot MECHTs in a future post-apocalyptic world of civil war and environmental collapse caused by an anomaly known as The Phage.

title: Drift Club: Street Legends
description: Own the streets. Master every drift.

title: Dino Odyssey
description: You have to complete this dangerous journey to survive extinction!

title: 100 Romantic Hidden Cat
description: Can you find every cat hiding in this romantic world?

title: Dwarf Core
description: Dwarf Core is an idle-management game about small colony of dwarves who love to mine. Send them to the mine to gather resources, gain experience, upgrade their stats and craft new pickaxes. Looking for more active gameplay than idle? Take control of one of the dwarves and help them mine!

title: Rotfang: The House
description: A short horror game where you play as the family dog. Everyone is gone from the house and the town. Set in a suburban house and small town, explore each room, complete tasks, and find the dark secrets hidden under the house.

title: Exitrance
description: Exitrance is a single-player psychological horror game set in a constantly shifting loop. Explore a confined environment where each cycle subtly changes, altering objects, sounds, and events. Observe your surroundings, and solve environmental puzzles to break the loop and escape.

title: Chessplosion
description: Chessplosion reinvents chess with an explosive Giant Pawn that occupies a 2×2 area. Face the AI or other players, solve puzzles, and customize special rules to create tactical, unpredictable matches filled with surprising turns.

title: Half Hour RPG
description: Up to 30 minutes of epic adventure. Half Hour RPG is a hand-asset-flipped RPG designed with uncompromising respect for your time. Every unnecessary system was deliberately left unimplemented.

title: Lichtung
description: Enter a calm and unfamiliar world, lying dormant as you arrive. As you explore its surroundings, the world gradually opens up, revealing its light. The more you engage with it, the more you become enveloped in a soothing yet lively awakening, full of surprises.

title: Ripgraze
description: A few-minute deep-sea score attack. Flip gravity to rise or dive, graze reefs and jellyfish to charge OVERDRIVE, then spend it for a burst of slow-motion scoring. Playing it safe is the losing move. The deeper you go, the more the ocean changes.

title: Quinn
description: Quinn is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op & solo game set in a high-tech AI research facility. Monitor the lab through your tablet, operate physical control panels, work together, and deal with whatever goes wrong. Quinn is always watching.

title: Ball Scratch Simulator
description: Your balls itch. You are in public. This is now everybody’s problem. Covertly scratch your balls through multiple public incidents, battle your useless hand, and stop before everyone finds out what kind of person you are.

title: Quiz Challenge Multiplayer
description: History & Science quiz, 1 to 4 players, in English, French, German, Spanish.

title: Cursed District: Horror
description: The curse never left.

title: Proper Tosser
description: Proper Tosser is an incremental physics game where you toss boxes properly. Become a Proper Tosser by purchasing upgrades and tossing farther each time. Do you have what it takes to be a Proper Tosser?

title: NHL 27
description:
EA Sports NHL 27 brings the identity of every NHL team to life on the ice, in the arena, and through the broadcast.

Experience Authentic Atmospheres across all 32 NHL arenas, each designed to capture the sound, spectacle, and identity of its home team. Real-world goal songs, new pregame introductions, and a fully overhauled crowd bring every building closer to its real-world counterpart.

title: Backrooms Protocol
description: Backrooms Protocol is a 1–4 player co-op horror game focused on exploration, research, and survival across the levels of the Backrooms.

title: Dig Raiders: Anomaly Extraction
description: DIG Raiders: Anomaly Extraction is a co-op digging sim where you and your crew burrow through 10+ layers of the unknown—team up to uncover the truth, battle rivals, and race to secure alien gems. Dig deep. Extract the anomaly. Get out alive!

title: Moon Garden
description: A cozy incremental game about growing your way home. Strategically plant flowers, optimize machinery, and grow your tree tall enough to escape!

title: Increbouncer
description: Increbouncer is a short incremental ball game where you launch balls, earn two different currencies from wall bounces and ball collisions, unlock new balls, and level up a skill tree to maximize your income.

title: PegPigeon
description: PegPigeon: casual physics peg action—launch through bright boards, chain hits, settle in slots. Limited shots; between rounds draft one upgrade or relic. Varied stages; gold funds meta upgrades, pigeons, skins; achievements and per‑stage bests add goals. Cute, snack‑sized, easy to replay.

title: Starweaver Express: Per Aspera Ad Astra
description: "Starweaver Express " is a unique visual novel that blends poetic storytelling with dreamlike visuals. As the mysterious transfer student Tsubaki Ueshima, you'll step into a cloistered academy and follow the paths of girls searching for starlight, love, and meaning.

title: Burger Shift: Team Rush
description: Run the world's most chaotic fast food joint! Play solo or with up to 8 friends as you take orders, make burgers, and hustle to keep customers happy. Grow your business with every shift.

title: Scale2fit
description: A simple puzzle game about scaling blocks to fit them together.

title: Kill Spewy
description: Collect components. Build the flow. Kill Spewy. A cozy idle game where your only goal is to kill Spewy as many times as possible, earn Bread Slices, and unlock endlessly growing component builds.

title: Anomaly Company
description: You and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game. Memorize the environment. Spot disturbing anomalies. Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over.

title: Blurry Shopping
description: Did you think going to the supermarket was easy? Ha! Welcome to Blurry Shopping, the ultimate simulator of getting lost between endless aisles, fluorescent lights, and products that all look the same… because they literally are, at least for you.

title: Nightpark Journal
description: A dreamcore roguelike deck builder. Explore the mysterious Nightpark as three youths, each with distinct abilities. Build unique decks for each of them, defeat enemy adults and fiends, and uncover hidden secrets.

title: Pieces of the Kingdom
description: What if Chess…was a roguelite? Assemble your party and battle your way across a broken kingdom in a fantastical, tactical take on Chess. Loot epic gear, recruit powerful pieces with unique abilities, and strategize your way to victory.

title: The Loopler
description: The Loopler is a idle-like roguelite simulation of a car driving in loops. Pick upgrades, place gates and sit back and relax as the mesmerizing loop gets going and the dopamine hits of numbers going up fills your brain. See if you can go endless and beyond.

title: 100 Tavern Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: Bible Trivia: Alchemy
description: Combine the elements of Creation and reveal the stories of the Bible! In Bible Trivia – Alchemy, each new fusion unlocks biblical characters, objects, and events. Experience the joy of discovering the sacred world — one element at a time.

title: Riruri Tachibana: Reincarnated
description: Haruka, who streams as the popular virtual streamer Riruri Tachibana. After a streaming accident, her everyday life quietly begins to crumble. What awaits her is a new stage—or an endless nightmare. A short first-person horror story themed around “reincarnation.”

title: Deep Sheol
description: In a dystopian future, Agent Seth investigates a corporate geological facility where a biological gas turned people into bloodthirsty monsters. Fight through enemy hordes, uncover a dark corporate conspiracy, and face Lovecraftian nightmares in this tense retro FPS with survival horror!

title: Darkodai
description: The land was absolved, it fell to an ancient darkness, a spell cast by a mysterious force. Two beings from a pure realm of light are the only hope for this consumed land. Many adventures against the darkness await you in this small, RPG adventure known as Darkodai!

title: AutoParts Simulator
description: AutoParts Simulator puts you in charge of an auto parts store, where every decision you make influences your success. Manage inventory, expand the product range in your warehouse, serve customers and grow your business. Conquer the automotive market with strategy and efficiency!

title: Your Story: Games with Death
description: A medieval text quest in the "Choose Your Own Adventure" genre, where each choice could be your last. Create your story with more than 2,000 events, 200 of which will prove fatal. In a world where death plays against you, can you outsmart it and write your own story?

title: Sporting Goods Shop
description: Run your sporting goods shop. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, hire workers, expand your store, and run little contests to entertain your customers. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.

title: Anime Shop Simulator
description: Manage your own anime shop. Play solo or team up with friends in 4-player co-op mode to grow your business. Stock shelves with manga, figures, and collectible cards in this immersive first-person game.

title: Animal Striker 2
description: Animal Striker 2 is a fast-paced multiplayer FPS where animals fight in intense arenas. Pick up magical weapons with unique projectiles, customize your loadout, and compete in team-based or free-for-all modes. Unleash your power and dominate the battlefield!

title: Gun Shop 3
description: Do you like guns? Many people sure do! Gun Shop 3 is a real-time storefront simulator with a sprinkling of first person shooter mechanics on top. Choose your location, design your store, stock the shelves, and then flip that sign to “open for business”! The demand is there. Can you supply it?

title: VR # Avoid
description: AVOID THE GRID

title: Mega Man: Wily Tower
description: The 8-bit demake of Wily Tower is finally finished! Play through the Wily Tower mode from Mega Man: The Wily Wars as a standalone game, with modern quality of life features and bonus content! It includes a playable Proto Man and Bass, optional "improved" versions of the weapons, bonus stages, extra bosses, a boss rush mode, cheats and more!

title: Master of Pottery
description: Master of Pottery is a pottery-themed creation + simulation game. Create unique works and run your own exhibition hall.

title: Chronime Puzzle: Animals
description: Chronime Puzzle: Animals is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Vehicle Pass
description: Keep the race alive with the Hot Wheels Infinite Rush - Vehicle Pass and add 44 vehicles to your collection, including some fan-favorites from the Acceleracers and Highway 35!

title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Just for Fun Pack
description: A vehicle pack containing four cars for Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: the Mazda MX-5 Miata, Mighty K, 1969-1978 Nissan Fairlady Z, and RD-09.

title: Flipi Rivals
description:
Flip the cards. Turn the tide!
An exciting card battle with adorable rivals!

title: Kpop idol Dress Up
description: Design amazing looks for your K-Pop Idol and stand out with endless combinations of dresses, hairstyles and accessories. Your creativity has no limits!

title: Graffiti Rush
description: Graffiti Rush is a chill, creative multiplayer game where you and your friends can paint the world your way—no pressure, no rules. Grab your spray cans and explore a vibrant open city filled with blank walls, hidden alleys, and rooftop spots waiting for your art.

title: Primitive Shades
description: Explore an abandoned school, solve puzzles, and survive the Shades: living creatures formed from primitive geometric shapes. What begins as a late night exploration becomes a desperate fight to uncover the truth and escape.

title: Bugs. Billions of Bugs.
description: An incremental swarm tower defense. Play solo or 2–4 player Steam co-op. Defend a doomed mining colony through a full campaign, infinite procedural maps and Workshop creations. Build towers. Call orbital strikes. Kill billions. The only good bug is a dead bug. Do your part!

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero / The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure
description: A bundle including Trails from Zero and Trails to Azure for the PS5 and NS2, with 4K resolution and 120 FPS support and the option to switch between the original and upscaled textures.

title: Divine Throne
description: Divine Throne: Idle RPG is a anime-style fantasy strategy RPG where players assume the role of a chosen commander destined to restore order to a shattered, mythic realm.

title: Mondice
description: Roll the dice and push your luck in a strategic board game encounter against exotic monster girls. Survive their unique mechanics while managing your health to unlock special scenes and artwork.

title: Borderlands 4: Bounty Pack 5 - Amara and the Vile Shadows
description:
Amara and the Vile Shadows is a repeatable story mission for Borderlands 4 in which Amara investigates unstable Phase rifts spreading across Kairos. Track the anomalies to an abandoned laboratory, battle enemies warped by Phase energy, and confront a new boss alongside two mini-bosses.
Completing the mission can reward a Pearlescent weapon, six Legendary items, a Vault Hunter skin, a vehicle, and an ECHO-4 Drone skin.

title: Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart
description: Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart is a 2D pixel-art tactical RPG set in a nostalgic 1980s school era of rival gangs, heartfelt drama, and youth rivalry.

title: Asphalt: Car Racing Game
description:
Feel the rush of high-speed arcade racing!
Master every turn, push your car to the limit,
and race your way to victory!

title: Brick by Brick
description: Sort thousands of colorful bricks, organize them onto shelves, build whatever you can imagine, and unleash the occasional earthquake. Play at your own pace alone or invite friends to join you online in this relaxing first-person brick sorting and building sandbox.

title: The Supreme Chicken
description: The Supreme Chicken is a short comedy game with absurd humor, where you'll have to cook the Supreme Chicken by following the 3 steps of the recipe.

title: Time Gamers: Guardians of the Marble Man
description: Guardians of the Marble Man is a historical adventure set in 1864 Columbia, South Carolina, recreated through years of research. As a Time Gamer, you search for the lost Roman statue of John C. Calhoun, uncovering secrets tied to secession, war, and hidden history beneath the Old State House.

title: Rhythm Flow
description: Feel the rhythm and hit every beat as you test your timing across a variety of energetic songs in this fast-paced music game.

title: Roll Golf
description: Tilt the entire course to guide your golf ball through creative obstacles, avoid hazards, and sink the perfect shot across challenging levels.

title: War the Knights
description: With great explosive barrels comes great responsibility.

title: Learn English with World Ghost Stories
description: Ready for haunted English?

title: Chained Drivers
description:
Two cars. One chain. Total chaos.
Drive, survive, and try not to drag your partner into disaster.

title: Bug Error 404: Anime Girls Not Found
2048 Battles: Sylvan Sirens
description: Combine tiles and battle cute elves in a realm of fae!

title: Aim for 1 Million! Influencer Dream
description: Will your post fly—or flop?

title: How True Is This Rumor? Urban Legend Mystery
description: Can you sort myth from fact?

title: Party Fun! 8-Player Common Sense Battle
description:
Can you spot common sense?
Put your knowledge to the test.
Up to 8 players. Battle now!

title: The Truth of the Empty Room
description: Can you read the room?

title: Console Archives: Nobunaga's Ambition II
description:
Nobunaga's Ambition II was released by Koei in 1990 for an 8 -bit home console.
In this authentic simulation war game, play as a Sengoku Daimyo (warlord), command a vast array of unique officers, and utilize every strategy and tactic at your disposal to unify all 38 fiefs spanning regions such as Kanto and Chubu.
Expanding upon its predecessor, "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION", this entry features a multi-scenario system with two distinct scenarios, HEX battles expanded to include both open battles and siege battles, and a roster of approximately 400 real historical samurai!
Enrich your fief, skillfully lead and manage your unique retainers, and expand your domain through warfare and diplomacy to achieve the ultimate goal of unifying Japan!

title: Artillery Miner
description: An incremental mining game, where you mine through massive blocks using guns, fire, lasers and nuclear missiles. Discover new ores, unlock new worlds and weapons as you progress through the upgrades tree and become the ultimate Artillery Miner!

title: Borderlands 4: Story Pack 2 - FL4K and the Last Resort
description:
Welcome to the jungle, where a tropical resort made for the Timekeeper's chosen is about to become a warzone. Team up with FL4K, an unequaled beastmaster who lives for The Hunt, to save their loyal skag companion Mr. Chew and teach the Tediore corporation a brutal lesson about primal nature.

On the remote island of Providence, upper-crust Electi once vacationed in a luxurious retreat neighboring lush wilderness and a majestic volcano. In a ploy to secure Providence's precious Ordonite resource, Tediore has sent an expeditionary group led by five elite generals who serve the ruthless Lieutenant Harmony.

Venture into the verdant wilds and aid FL4K and their pet in the urgent fight against Tediore. Hunt down the generals however you see fit and show them that Vault Hunters can never be tamed.

title: RV There Yet? St. Búttin Bay
description:
New map expansion for the game 'RV There Yet?'.

Once again our fellow vacation aficionados are on the lookout for a way home via Route 65, but this time they’re traveling from the wonderful beaches of St. Búttin Bay. So crack your fingers, clean out the sand between your cheeks and get ready to finish this EPIC TRILOGY with ONE LAST RIDE home!

title: Drag'n Wash
description: Enjoy a narrative involving 3 male dragons. Wash them, chat with them, touch them, and more! A 3D dragon washing experience.

title: Swamp and Luig
description:
Welcome to the swamp.
Luig is in there somewhere.
Actually, three somewheres.
Play to find out (or don’t, he’s not judging… probably)

title: Core Runners
description: Core Runners is a 5v5 tactical hero shooter for Android that blends elements of popular games. Dive into the stylish, vibrant world of Core Runners, where every hero brings a distinct style and signature abilities to the battlefield.

title: Glyphwing: World Geography
description: Glyphwing: World Geography is an educational world geography and cultural discovery game designed for elementary and middle school learners. Players guide a stylized paper glider across continents, oceans, and distinct biomes to explore global landmarks, analyze physical geography, and study world heritage through hands-on simulations.The game pairs exploration mechanics with historical, scientific, and cultural learning labs, making cross-platform learning both engaging and interactive.Key Features:Continental Exploration: Navigate all 7 continents while tracking coordinates, regional borders, major river systems, and geographic landforms.Historical & Cultural Labs: Deep dive into interactive studies including ancient cuneiform and hieroglyphic scripts, archaeoastronomy solar alignments, and continental drift models.Mini-Game Challenges: Test retention with compass bearing exercises, timed geography capital quizzes, tactile postcard jigsaw puzzles, and traditional textile pattern matching.Inclusive Design: Equipped with accessibility tools such as high-legibility dyslexia-friendly fonts, read-along text formatting, and offline play functionality.

title: Echo Canyon Band
description: Echo Canyon Band is a magical, multi-sensory rhythm and musical pattern-recognition adventure designed for kids, preschoolers, and families. Set in a sunny, echoing red rock canyon, players interact with a traveling band of ten cute animal musicians to replicate sweet acoustic melodies.Guided by intuitive visual elements and auto-playing musical demos, children tap colorful drum pads to watch radiant visual echo rings glow and bring the canyon to life with joyful acoustic harmonies.Key Features:10 Cute Animal Bandmates: Play alongside unique characters like Jasper Bunny, Silas Coyote, and Barnaby Bear, each featuring their own custom acoustic instruments.Interactive Concert Hall & Jukebox: Assemble a full 10-piece animal orchestra to hear individual solos or play cumulative grand concerts together.Dynamic Sky & Weather Themes: Explore 10 changing backdrops including Golden Sunset, Starry Night, Rainbow Breeze, and Aurora Borealis.Multi-Sensory Accessibility: Features color and shape-coded pads alongside animated sound wave rings to ensure full accessibility for colorblind and hard-of-hearing players.

title: Door Runners
description: A 4-10 player online social deduction party game. Only one player knows the safe door, but that knowledge will not get them out early. Bluff and survive over live voice chat, round after round, until only two doors and two players remain.

title: War of Genesis: Idle Loot
description: Just leave it running. The rest takes care of itself. In a small corner of your desktop, a 3D character fights and loots all on its own. Snag good gear and trade it on the Steam Community Market. It's idle, yet you can't stop watching. Addictive looting at its finest.

title: Dead or Alive 6: Last Round - Minato
Shalnor: Silverwind Saga Bundle
description: Two RPG/Action Adventure games. With focus on gauntlet-style combat, traps, boss fights and beautiful pixel-art scenery.

title: Zumba: Magical Marble Saga
description: Master the mystic arts—match arcane orbs and save the kingdom from the surge!

title: Tennis Legend 2026
description: Get ready for intense clashes on the most challenging courts!

title: Chicken Miner
description:
Chicken Miner is an incremental game where you can gather massive amounts of resources with the help of chickens. Capture chickens in the hunting grounds, bring them back to your mine, and put them to work mining!
The chickens do the work for you!

title: Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition
description: Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition is a newly reimagined version of the acclaimed underwater adventure for Nintendo Switch, featuring a new third-person perspective, enhanced visuals, new music, improved navigation and other enhancements.

title: Big Breakfast 2
description: In a world without Breakfast, one man decides to challenge fate! The debut RPG from Stahmpin' Grounds Studios, Big Breakfast 2, is an old-school turn-based RPG in the style of classic fantasy RPGs from the 8 bit era.

title: Super Takoyaki Battle
description:
Experience takoyaki-making like never before!
Make as many as you can in an all-out battle!

title: Bug Error 404: Anime Boys Not Found
description:
He shouldn't be there. The error screen says so.
Track him down and see for yourself.

title: Quiet Hour
description: The prohibition is back! Build, decorate and manage your very own underground speakeasy. Just make sure to keep it down, or you will spend the night in handcuffs!

title: A Wind-Shaped Love
description: In a world ravaged by disasters, a young rescuer meets an android girl who feels too deeply—and falls in love. When fate tears them apart, he spends ten years chasing a ghost in white. Can love outlast even death?

title: Elegorithm
description: Hack and optimize inefficient elevators in Elegorithm, a Sci-Fi simulation. Connect nodes to build custom algorithms and route endless passenger waves. Clear strict wait time and power targets to upgrade your system. If floors overflow, your hack is detected—game over!

title: The Things We Don't See: 10 Interactive Stories of Horror, Mystery, and the Unknown
description: Ten Storiees. Dozens of impossible choices. Every choice decides who survives, what they become, or what they never should have seen. A branching visual novel anthology of horror, conspiracy, and quiet dread — with dozens of endings.

title: First Draft
description: First Draft is an arcade flight shooter where you enter intense aerial battles with enemy paper airplanes, survive challenging encounters, and take on powerful bosses as you push your piloting skills to the limit.

title: Crafty Survivors: Wicked Winter
description: Two new characters added to the roster of the game with their unique skills and mechanics. A whole new region with its own perils to conquer and a brand new type of stage.

title: Hitherto: School of Swordcery and Shieldjuration
description: Welcome to Hitherto High, his Majesty's Magic School of Swordcery and Shieldjuration! Train your students in the ways of magic to ready them for their final exams!!

title: Black Wolves Saga: Weiβ und Schwarz - for Nintendo Switch
description: A port for Nintendo Switch of the original Playstation Vita Bundle.

title: Dumb Ways to Build
description: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!

title: Circuit Flow
description: Route the signal. Power the board.

title: Barko
description:
A good boy never gives up.

Barko is a story-rich 2D adventure about a very good dog with a very questionable sense of direction.

Barko's story begins in a dog shelter. He doesn't know where he's going, what he'll find out there, or why the world seems to be getting progressively weirder.

He only knows one thing:

Somewhere out there, a human needs him.

title: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall
description: Black Friday Janitor is a organization game that hands you the biggest clean up job of the year. Tens of thousands of items: misplaced products to return to their correct spots, rubbish to collect and dirt to tidy up. Don't expect to finish it all in one go!

title: Slime Slayer: Endless Loot
description: Click to aim, reap souls, enjoy pop-bubble hack-and-slash. An incremental ARPG focused on looting and build crafting. Build unique setups from 20+ classes and 100+ core talents. Change combat rules with hundreds of uniques and Gemword system.

title: Shady Job
description: A co-op adventure game. The mafia wants to get rid of a body. You’re construction workers. Your job: carry a body bag to the top of a skyscraper. Bury it in concrete. Two problems. First: You have to build the way up. Second: The body’s not dead. It fights back.

title: HimaNatsu: Of Churches, Sunflowers, and Long Summers
description: The classic visual novel "HimaNatsu" from the critically acclaimed developer Makura is finally available in English for the first time! Weave a cheerful yet sometimes painful tale of promises and redemption together with the Oboshiro Choir Squad in this never-ending summer vacation.

title: Betrayal Banquet
description:
Betrayal Banquet is an indie medieval multiplayer party game that combines cooking simulation with social deduction. Players take on the role of royal servants, preparing and serving meals for the kings while racing to complete orders before time runs out. At the same time, hidden Betrayers secretly work to poison the feast without revealing their identity. Every player must decide who to trust, watch for suspicious behavior, and work together to protect the banquet before it's too late.

Genres: Social Deduction, Party, Cooking Simulation, Multiplayer, Co-op.

title: HoloTrials: Case Covered
description: A graffiti mocking the Student Council President appears on the walls, and your best friend is the prime suspect! Play as a student detective in HoloTrials: Case Covered. Investigate the high school campus, face off against your rivals, and clear her name in this legal mystery.

title: Living on Plain Pasta
description: A conversation adventure where you spend the worst, best summer visiting your booze-loving senpai, making weird food, and sneaking out together at midnight.

title: A Night at Moka Efti: A Babylon Berlin Story
description: Are you ready for the session? Let yourself be hypnotized and dive into the dazzling world of Moka Efti, known from the series *Babylon Berlin*. As a journalist, you’ll follow the clues to a mysterious case at the famous nightclub. But can you trust your memories?

title: Ding! Pocket It!: Rogue Simulator
description: A Roguelite deck-builder with pool-style controls. Refine your cap combos, hone your shot skills, and use Base × Multiplier to rack up a high score!

title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV Complete Edition
description: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV Complete Edition includes the Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV base game, the downloadable content “Diplomacy and Strategy Expansion Pack Bundle,” Season Pass, Season Pass 2, and new content added in the Complete Edition.

title: I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard)
description: Dig through junk, find rare parts and lost collectibles, rescue dogs, complete odd customer orders, hire helpers, and relax as you slowly rebuild your dad's dream car in this cozy junkyard simulator.

title: Monster Shop Simulator
description: Build and manage your own monster shop. Stock magical eggs, hatch and collect monsters, set your prices, hire employees, host monster cage events, and grow your business.

title: Arc Salvo
description: Arc Salvo is a fast-paced online turn-based artillery game featuring explosive team battles, a growing arsenal, and deep character customization.

title: The Last of RAM
description: A fast-paced parkour FPS where movement is survival. Break into secure facilities, fight through enemies, and keep moving or die trying.

title: Black Plague
description: A fast-paced bullet heaven roguelite where you battle endless plague hordes, collect powerful upgrades, and create game-breaking builds to survive as long as possible.

title: Punch Monkey Revenge
description: They took his favorite toy. Now this little monkey is fighting through the whole school to get it back.

title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
description: Jump into a Hot Wheels-sized world with four islands packed with events, challenges and full-throttle mayhem. Collect iconic vehicles, assemble your Rush Squad, build epic tracks, and earn the title of Rush Master.

title: Loop Miner
description: Loop Miner is a mining incremental game where a cute mole miner endlessly digs through mines, gathers resources, collects artifacts, and ventures deeper underground. Experience the satisfaction of growing stronger through endless mining loops.

title: Monster Alchemy
description:
Monster Alchemy is a Monster Collector RPG where instead of catching monsters, you create them using alchemy.
Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.

title: Squadika
description: Top-down arena shooter roguelite where fallen Steam friends & Twitch chatters become your power. Control a squad, survive relentless waves and defeat powerful bosses. Compete on leaderboards! Bullet hell Brotato-like with wild builds, random events & high replayability.

title: Axe And Claw
description: Axe and Claw is a challenging 2D pixel-art action-platformer. Follow the story of Samuel, a father who embarks on a perilous journey to climb an unclimbable mountain in search of his lost son, Jonah. Face dangerous terrains, master the flow of movement, and overcome intense escape sequences in this emotional quest for family.

title: Would You Love Me If I Was a Snake?
description: A puzzle game where you play as a snake. Push objects, block lasers, teleport, and bite your tail off to escape dreamy puzzle rooms.

title: Octopticom 3D
description: Octopticom 3D is a major upgrade to your favorite open-ended puzzle programming game about designing and optimizing optical computing devices. Featuring 3D graphics and gameplay, refined ui, rewritten simulation, all original levels and components plus new additions, histograms and more.

title: Not My Child
description: A psychological horror where a father returns home, only to find toys and haunting notes that whisper a truth he refuses to face.

title: Spiritus Sancti
description: Spiritus Sancti is a first-person psychological horror where your voice is your weapon. Speak sacred rites through your microphone to repel, stun, and exorcise the forces of darkness. Every encounter is real-time, every word a test of faith. An experience like no other.

title: Garden Ink
description: Paint, merge, and explore! Garden Ink is a cozy sandbox/exploration game where you shape and grow your own world. Merging decorations and coloring tools help you customize your world. With hand-painted visuals and a soothing soundtrack, it’s time to discover every cute surprise.

title: Dig for Riches
description: Dig For Riches is a realistic mining simulation. Dig the earth, extract valuable minerals, haul them to the surface by cart and sell them. Use your earnings to upgrade your equipment, dig deeper, and face increasing dangers.

title: Football Club Inside
description: Lead a small football club through one unforgettable season. Make tough choices, face the media, manage morale and ambition — every decision shapes your story in this cinematic, story-driven football management drama.

title: Astralis: Dawnblades
description: Astralis: Dawnblades is a turn-based tactical RPG that combines stronghold management, dungeon exploration, loot-based equipment crafting, and optional rhythm-based combat tied to an orchestral soundtrack.

title: Wardogs
description:
Wardogs is a first-person tactical multiplayer shooter built around large-scale combined-arms battles for up to 100 players. Three teams compete to control randomized objective zones across destructible battlefields, using infantry weapons, vehicles, logistics, fortifications, and proximity voice chat.

Players earn cash and XP through combat, support, transportation, and objective play, then spend persistent cash on custom loadouts, equipment, and vehicles across lives and matches.

title: Grandpa's Bee Haven
description: Grandpa's Bee Haven is a desktop-idler and a beekeeping sim that sits at the bottom of your screen letting you to do other things while managing your bee haven.

title: The Alighieri Circle: Dante’s Bloodline
description: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

title: Frontier: Path of Shadows
description: Fight enemies, upgrade your squad, and explore new planets! Make tough choices and shape the fate of an entire sector in Frontier: Path of Shadows. Experience a richly crafted 25th-century world and tactical combat where X-COM meets Final Fantasy.

title: Fresh Tracks VR
description: The critically acclaimed rhythm roguelite, Fresh Tracks, is now in VR! Jump, dodge, and fight to the rhythm of the gods in this thrilling music-action game on skis. Take on obstacles and menacing enemies as you ski further into the darkness that has befallen the snow-covered land of Norwyn.

title: Magical Blush
description: Magical Blush is a top-down action-adventure where fast-paced elemental combat meets Metroidvania-style exploration. Chain spell combos, exploit elemental weaknesses, rescue survivors, and team up in local co-op as you battle the powerful Elemental Lords and explore the wondrous world of Wyn.

title: The Lightkeepers
description: Grab your weapons and face an unequal battle against the nightmares of the deep! The Lightkeepers is a cooperative action game where you’ll fight for your life until every dawn!

title: Push Push
description: Push Push is a cute and relaxing idle balloon game! Pump balloons, unlock adorable cats, and discover quirky pumping gadgets and fun item combos. Perfect for quick breaks and stress relief.

title: Under a Desert Sun: Seekers of the Cursed Vessel
description: Under a Desert Sun: Seekers of the Cursed Vessel, is a single-player and co-op action RPG set in WWII-era Egypt. Battle soldiers and undead hordes, explore ancient tombs, and uncover a dark curse. Play solo or with friends in local co-op, with new heroes and content coming in Early Access.

title: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
description: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

title: Project Cobalt
description: ️ Project Cobalt is a survival action game set on a hostile island . Scavenge containers, mine resources, craft tools, hunt animals, and endure storms as you fight hunger, disease, and exhaustion all while uncovering the dark truth behind a failed experiment.

title: Orebits
description: Smash through alien rock with oversized mining gear, collect rare ores and uncover strange secrets. Orebits is a gritty sci-fi idle game full of mystery and metal.

title: Legends of Aria Eternal
description: Legends of Aria Eternal is a sandbox MMORPG where players shape the world. Now with faster skill gains, a reworked prestige and enchanting system, full in-game knowledge base, and powerful new tools to run your own custom server.

title: Destiny Spire
description: Destiny Spire is a party-based RPG with active time battles inspired by the classics. Not your traditional turn based combat: The battle continues even while you select your actions, you'll need reflexes and wits to survive. Pick your party and set off on a retro, non-hand holdy adventure!

title: Ex Sanguis
description: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

title: Escape Toon Kingdom
description: Escape From Toon Kingdom is a 1–4 player co-op horror game. Play as mascots trapped in a dying theme park. Explore. Solve. Suffer. Every attraction holds a secret—and a piece of your escape.

title: Shroom and Gloom
description: Gather and grow cards in Shroom & Gloom, a moody first-person, roguelike double-deckbuilder bursting with fungal foes and mountains of mega-combos!

title: Platina: Lab
description:
‘PLATiNA :: LAB’ is a rhythm game that features a classic top-down note drop play style.
Play a variety of tracks across different genres, connect with unique and charming DB(character) units, and discover the distinctive appeal that only PLATiNA :: LAB can offer.

title: Sunken Engine
description: Sunken Engine is a Lovecraftian Ship Repair Simulator. Restore the old shipyard you inherited from your father. Every arriving ship carries a dark mystery waiting to be uncovered. While keeping your customers happy, you must also deal with the strange and eerie events happening on the island.

title: Forsworn
description: Step into a realm torn by divine conflict where every defeat is just another beginning in this rogue lite, turn-based tactics adventure where no hero fights alone. Build powerful synergies to overcome unforgiving battles and defy fate in a world controlled by the gods.

title: Horrors Glade
description: You are a young scientist whose experiment turned into a disaster. When you wake up in the heart of a creepy forest, where every whisper of the wind hides a threat, you realize: there are no rules here. There is only hunger, fear, and shadows hungry for your flesh.

title: Kollectomaniac
description: A man offers you a job. Work at a log in the middle of the woods. Spend your money at the shop and improve your store. Don't stop collecting. Never miss collection day. Sell to the nine walkers. Stay away from the computer game.

title: Effulgence RPG
description: Effulgence is a party-based RPG in a sci-fi setting. Players will explore a distant, possibly extinct world, battle its hostile inhabitants, craft gear, and develop their characters. All graphics in Effulgence are made of text symbols, making it visually unique.

title: Tinymon
description:
Tinymon RPG is based in an isekai world that resembles Japan. The natives here speak Japanese, however thanks to higher powers you're able to communicate with them in English. Although, if you so wish, you can enable settings from the in-game menu that let you experience parts of the game in Japanese (or romaji). These settings can be toggled on or off at any time, so players that want to turn Tinymon into a full-fledged learning experience can enjoy toggling these settings on at their own pace, as they become more comfortable with their Japanese skills (which you'll have opportunities to learn and practice in the game). Of course, you can leave all of these settings off, and experience the full game in English. Alternatively, you can toggle all of these settings on, and experience the game in complete Japanese.
Tinymon's world setting is greatly inspired by Japanese culture, meaning you can learn about the real world Japan. Thus, Tinymon provides for a laid back experience that focuses on exploration, and education of Japan's locations, customs, culture, and language (to those that are willing). We will even teach you how to use the trains system, some things you should avoid doing in Japan, and the first things you should do after landing in the Japanese airport! (Some of them even should be done before leaving the airport).

title: Welcome to Elderfield
description: Welcome to Elderfield is a spooky farming RPG. You can farm, fish, mine, cook, craft, befriend townsfolk, beseech the old gods, investigate mysteries, watch unsettling news programs, get lost in the dead mall, die in your sleep and more. There's lots to do in Elderfield!

title: Millumi
description: You've never thought about playing as a sheep solving mirror puzzles—until now. Millumi is a minimalist puzzle game where you are guided by a crow, directing light beams through mirrors to solve various puzzles. You'll face obstacles, mechanisms, and progressively challenging levels.

title: Karjala
description: VHS bodycam horror in the atmosphere of Soviet Backrooms. Karelia is a country of rivers, forests and lakes, where the modern world comes in contact with superstitions and ancient rituals. Soldier Solnyshkov agrees to take part in a strange experiment of his command.

title: Hazard Pay
description: In this dark and mysterious block-pushing puzzler, you'll navigate through a secret, hazardous laboratory complex. Discover creative methods to destroy evidence and cover up the crimes of your employer.

title: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics
description: Pick your champions and fight in merciless 1v1 turn-based matches. Send your fighters in the arena, position them strategically, create synergies and give the crowd a brutal show! Unlock your ultimate attacks, influence the course of the game and dominate The Hexadome!

title: Gunman Contracts: Stand Alone
description: "Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone" is an action-movie inspired shooter playable both in VR and in Non-VR (First Person). As a professional hitman, the player takes on ruthless forces in the criminal underworld, bringing justice and order in the world beyond the reach of law - one contract at a time.

title: The Crust
description: Build and automate a lunar colony that Earth depends on. Mine regolith, run conveyor-and-drone factories above and below the surface, manage colonists, trade with rival Earth factions — and play a story campaign with multiple endings.

title: Black Gold
description: Join the early 20th century oil boom! In this game you will hire people, build your own oil field, extract crude oil, fight obstacles and crises what eventually will bring you fortune you’ve never dreamt of!

title: Penn Guiny's Lightmare
description:
Penn Guiny's Lightmare is a 3D collect-a-thon platformer with a horror twist!

Play as Penn Guiny, who has to collect stars while being chased down by the Sun!

title: Sahrtkom
description: Sahrtkom is an interactive game platform for live streamers, allowing Twitch and Kick viewers to participate directly from chat through mini-games such as a personality wheel, trivia challenges, flag and capital guessing, fastest word, and drawing challenges.

title: Bookstore Incremental
