description: A cozy incremental game where you run your own bookstore! Buy hundreds of upgrades, unlock new customers and book types, hire different staff members and build the most profitable bookstore in the world!

title: Increvaders
description: A short and chill incremental shooter where you destroy waves of thousands of aliens. Unlock upgrades and collect power-ups to become absurdly overpowered. No game overs, play at your own pace.

title: Reverse T-gotchi
description: What if the roles were reversed? In this first-person horror game, you are a Tamagotchi and your owner sets the rules. Satisfy their whims or your own needs will go unmet.

title: BaseRogue
description: BaseRogue is a turn-based baseball roguelike deckbuilder and dice battler. Draft historical baseball legends from over 150 years of baseball history, spanning from 1871 to 2025 across all classic eras. Build tactical era and franchise synergies to activate combat bonuses and shields, roll dice with dynamically calculated outcome thresholds against rival pitching rotations, and collect cards with retro foil packs and career stats across multiple game modes.

title: Stall Quest
description: A shopkeeping simulation RPG for those who loved leaving shops open in old-school MMOs! Open a stall in Rei's dream, sell items gathered from dungeons, buy gear, and dive back in.

title: Toro 2
description: The ultimate Bullfighting experience

title: Arcade Archives 2: Karnov
description: "Karnov" is an action game released by Data East in 1987. Defeat the Emperor of Darkness and reclaim the stolen treasures.

title: Planet Killer
description: A physics-driven sci-fi destruction roguelite. Orbit hostile worlds, unleash devastating weapons, and carve real craters into fully simulated planets while escalating planetary defenses fight back.

title: Just Coffee with the Café Guy
description: A short narrative game where you talk with a café owner at a café that serves nothing but coffee.

title: Planet Nine
description: Planet Nine is a planet-merging puzzle game with billiards-inspired mechanics. Players aim shots to merge matching planets into larger ones and work toward creating Planet Nine. The game features short play sessions, online score leaderboards, and unlockable background themes and music.

title: Aretias: Cursed Island
description: Travel to an isolated island, use your camera to reveal what the naked eye cannot see, and uncover the truth behind a forgotten curse. Aretias: Cursed Island is a story-driven first-person horror game focused on exploration, environmental puzzles, and atmospheric tension.

title: Warlord: Awaji
description: An army management simulator taking place in feudal japan made by Darkmatter games

title: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon Classic HD
description:
A thousand adventures in one! — Discover the roots of the Mystery Dungeon series. Originally released only in Japan, the first entry in the Mystery Dungeon series and prequel to Torneko: The Last Hope is finally making its international debut!

Set after the events of DRAGON QUEST IV, this is the story of Torneko, a man who dreams of becoming the world's greatest weapons merchant. One day, he hears rumors of a mysterious dungeon said to contain incredible treasures. In search of a legendary treasure that no one has ever managed to bring back, Torneko sets out for the Mystery Dungeon.

title: Valheim: 1.0
description: The time has come to finally venture into the Deep North and Valheim 1.0.

title: No Man's Sky: Cosmos
description: Become director of a space station, join a galactic alliance, construct a space base and discover deep-space marvels in No Man's Sky Cosmos. Navigate space with a new star system map, strip colossal hulks for parts before hull integrity fails, recover and haul physical salvage to remote space outposts, celebrate 10 years of No Man’s Sky in the Our Journey Continues expedition, and much, much more.

title: Silent Hill f x Urban Myth Dissolution Center
description:
Konami's psychological horror game Silent Hill f joins forces with Urban Myth Dissolution Center, a mystery adventure that unravels paranormal phenomena!
This collaboration features a special mini-game created by Hakababunko, starring Hinako and Azami.
Hinako finds herself lost in a strange building amid an eerie fog, where she encounters a figure as she pursues the mystery behind the strange phenomena surrounding her.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.2 - Their Secret Histories
description:
Version 3.2 of Zenless Zone Zero includes:
• New Characters: Claret and Roxy
• New Main Story: Their Secret Histories
• New Agent Specialty: Armorer
• New Gameplay Mechanics, System Updates, and Events
• Adds new achievements

title: Catal Carta
description: A mystery visual novel set in a fading secondhand bookshop. Five childhood friends confront small-town scandals armed only with what they've read — drawing on the themes of unrelated books to unsettle the things people won't admit. 15 cases, 5–10 minutes each.

title: The Forlorn
description: Fight for your life through five nights (technically six) in this hand-drawn 2D game of resource-management and survival. Keep the fire lit, sharpen your sword, and fend off progressively angrier creatures in the Cursed Forest. Comes with a 4/20 mode, cryptic lore, how to draw, and many secrets!

title: Moon Shop Simulator
description:
Moon Shop Simulator is a first-person management game where you run a small shop beneath the lunar surface.

From your terminal, order goods from Earth, manage cargo taxes, receive deliveries, organize your stock in numbered racks, and prepare customer orders.

Each product has its own weight, volume, and size. Your purchasing, storage, and shipping decisions directly affect your shop’s profitability.

title: Crosstalk
description: Crosstalk is a hardware architecture design sandbox with a built-in simulator and emulator. Players build designs ranging from LED controllers to complex computers using SystemVerilog. It has a gate-level simulator, a terminal emulator, an oscilloscope, introspection tools, a compiler, and more.

title: Code Vein II: Mask of Idris
description:
Beyond time and space...another story of history alteration.

Several worlds that had vanished due to historical changes.
Now, on the stage of the "Discard World," where the passions of those who lived there gather, a new exploration with fresh characters and another battle to save the world unfold.

title: BeaterCore
description: beaterCore is an arcade racing game for those who prefer cheap rusty beaters over specialized sports cars. Buy, repair, restore, and race your dream project car

title: Iron Wasteland
description: After the bombs fell, civilization collapsed into chaos. Scavenge the ruins of a shattered world, gather vital resources, and fight off hostile enemies determined to claim what little remains.

title: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
description: Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.You control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, dodge barrages and shoot at enemies. The background music features complete rearrangements by ZUN.

title: Roomrush Racer
description: Race through 20 chaotic rooms with 27 characters in a fast-paced arcade racer. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local split-screen, collect items, master speed classes, and win cups together.

title: Code: Terraform
description: A deep programming game on a frozen alien planet. Write real code to drive rovers, run power grids, fabricate parts, and fly drone fleets across the world. Your scripts run while you plan your next move. The more you terraform, the more the planet responds.

title: Slay the Horde
description: Slay the Horde is a roguelike deckbuilder about building a screen-clearing engine of destruction. Build a deck of spells, stack upgrades, abuse elemental effects, and annihilate increasingly unreasonable numbers of goblins.

title: Squingle Arcade
description: Experience Squingle’s trippy VR/MR evolution in its FREE-TO-PLAY sequel, Squingle Arcade. Guide twin orbs through 100+ morphing 3D mazes in your room. Master hand-tracked “Squingles,” chase high scores, and climb global leaderboards in a psychedelic arcade puzzle journey.

title: Model Kit Shop Simulator
description: Build and run your own hobby shop in this first-person store management sim. Order stock, fill shelves, set prices, match kits with paints through the Hobby Basket System, and let customers bring their projects to life at Build Tables.

title: Sunset Summit
description: A co-op group climbing game for 1-8 friends! Head out on a chill but challenging climb with regular checkpoints. Use axes, ropes, pogo sticks, item delivery drones and more to reach the summit. Just remember to watch your step!

title: When We Arrive
description: When We Arrive is a co-op travel game set in a fantasy world, where you and your friends embark on a shared journey. Play as a hunter, mage, or warrior, manage your supplies, discover hidden treasures, and make sure you all reach your destination safely.

title: Elemental Witches
description: In Elemental Witches world, you command Fire, Wind, and Thunder to craft unique spells from three elemental orbs. Merge identical elements to summon powerful pets. After each battle, upgrade elements, unlock items, and shape your own playstyle as you face new adventures.

title: Pizza of the Gods
description: A humorous 2D hand-drawn platformer where you’re on a quest to deliver a pizza to Zeus and pursue your dream of marrying your boss’s daughter. Fight funny enemies, switch between two characters to solve puzzles, and explore a world drawn entirely on paper.

title: Pegture
description: Pegture is a peg solitaire-themed roguelike, deck-building game. Build your deck, enhance your pegs, perform frenetic combos, beat bosses, reach the highest score and get the best peg solitaire experience.

title: Golden Swirl
description: GOLDEN SWIRL is a Roguelike Deck Builder blending fast-paced action with strategic card play in a dark fantasy world. Journey through shifting dungeons, uncover swirl secrets, and adapt to challenges with unique cards, relics, and a depravity system.

title: In Falsus
description: In a world bound by truths: connect. In Falsus is a mesmerizing rhythm game tied to an intricate card system brought together through a layered narrative. Taking place in a near-future world, traverse an atmospheric soundscape through the eyes of 5 interconnected protagonists.

title: Cosmic Fear
description: Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one big picture. What lies hidden in the depths of the cosmos? Explore, solve puzzles and survive in this disturbing Lovecraftian horror adventure.

title: Cordels & Spells
description: Cordels & Spells is a thrilling cooperative twin-stick shooter action adventure based in the culture of cordel literature. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle gangs of bandits, and recover the Enchanted Cordels, magical artifacts that hold the history and essence of Northeast Brazil.

title: Backseat
description: Backseat is a horror game where you play as a taxi driver forced to transport sinister passengers and survive the ride. An unknown man has kidnapped your wife and demands you gather information on each passenger. Can you survive the night and uncover the mystery behind your wife's kidnapping?

title: Olga: Episode 1
description: Relive Olga's childhood memories as she visits her grandparents' home in Belovodica, a secluded mountain village where some discoveries last a lifetime.

title: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
description: A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

title: Asgard's Fall: Viking Survivors
description: Embark on an epic saga in Asgard's Fall, a norse Arena-Shooter-Roguelite. Fight your way through hordes of creatures and let the gods feel your relentless wrath. How will your saga unfold?

title: Folklands
description: Folklands is a grid-based, relaxing settlement builder with simulated citizens. Grow your settlement from humble beginnings to a bustling town. Harvest resources, manage food supply and make sure your folks are happy, employed and safe.

title: Valheim
description:
Valheim is an open-world survival and exploration game set in a procedurally generated world inspired by Norse mythology. Playing alone or with up to nine other players, you explore dangerous biomes, gather resources, craft weapons and armour, build Viking settlements and longships, and battle powerful creatures and bosses in order to prove yourself worthy of Odin.

Progression is tied to exploration and defeating the Forsaken, with each biome introducing new enemies, resources, crafting possibilities and challenges. From the peaceful Meadows to the frozen Deep North, players can build, farm, sail, fight and explore the tenth world at their own pace.

title: TO-KAY: Thailand Quest
description: TO-KAY: Thailand Quest is a single-player 2D auto-running platformer set in Thailand. Players guide a gecko through tropical coasts, jungles, islands and waterfalls using one-tap controls, with up to three consecutive jumps. Levels combine fruit collection with obstacles, vines, crumbling platforms, trampolines and air currents. Collecting fruit earns stars that unlock further routes and optional bonus levels, while discovered fruits are recorded in a collection.

title: Drone Scout
description:
In Drone Scout, every mission starts with something missing and one tiny drone ready to save the day.

Pilot a nimble quadcopter through a bright low-poly neighborhood, scanning streets, yards, parks, rooftops, and hidden corners to track down misplaced objects. From baseball bats and library books to keys, gift cards, and one very important guitar case, each level gives you a new item to recover and a new slice of town to explore.

Simple flying controls make it easy to lift off, look around, and enjoy the search, while each successful find brings a satisfying little rescue moment. Whether you are sweeping over sidewalks, hovering near backyards, or carefully checking around buildings, Drone Scout is all about calm exploration, observation, and the small joy of finding what was lost.

title: King Assassination
description: A fast-paced multiplayer deception game where Guards protect the King and Assassins hunt their target. Work together, deceive your enemies, identify threats, and strike at the perfect moment to claim victory.

title: Dark Bone Prison
description: This is a dungeon-based game full of oppressive atmosphere. You will delve into the maze filled with monsters, collect, combine and upgrade weapons, and fight for a glimmer of hope in the successive waves of attacks.

title: Fill the Void
description: Start Small. Consume. Get huge. 'Fill The Void' is a physics-driven incremental 3D platforming collectathon where you play as a black hole.

title: Die Diver
description: Here's an indie game idea... Build your Dice Pool and dive through the canopy of the 'Forest of the Dead' - the place where all who die will go.

title: Dicewayfarer
description: A dice-building roguelike where you shape a 25-dice board to unleash powerful chained attacks.

title: Mandato
description: A short, first-person horror narrative set in the Philippines. While your journalist wife investigates town hall, you start uncovering brutal secrets tying your beloved mayor to local crime. In a place where the powerful control the law, knowing the truth is fatal.

title: Far Primal Survival
description: Can you become the ultimate hunter in a world ruled by nature?

title: Doti Golf
description: Putt, bounce, and boost your way through a wildly inventive mini golf adventure!

title: Three's a Crowd
description: A rogue-lite physics based match three!

title: Monsters Are Coming!: Madness Builds
description: Madness Builds introduces a new biome, 3 townhalls, a new hero, weapon, buildings, challenges and more themed around laboratories, dangerous experiments and brilliant insanity.

title: Kid Kirby Recreated
description: A recreation of a cancelled Kirby game that Nintendo contracted DMA design to make in the mid-90's, using information and assets shared publically by some of the old developers.

title: Razing Core
description:
Razing Core is a vertically scrolling shoot 'em up for the SEGA Master System and Mark III console.

On a routine deep-space mission the Horizon encounters an unknown object, the Core. Without warning it pulls the Horizon into its slipstream at light speed and heads for Earth.

You are about to drop out of hyperspace into a war zone.

With the Horizon's firepower and the Core's unexpected aid at your disposal, you must destroy the invading alien armada to save humanity.

title: Zero Players Online
description:
Zero Players Online is an interpretation of RuneScape (and Old School RuneScape) as a sort of fancy text-adventure, framed as a long abandoned MUD that nobody has played in a long time.

In the decades since any players joined things have started getting a little strange around Gielinor. NPCs aren't quite acting they way they should, and some areas have changed or become unkempt due to a lack of maintenance.

title: Bangkok: City of Legends
description: Bangkok City of Legends is a choice-driven narrative RPG set in the vibrant streets and nightlife of Bangkok. Explore the city, meet memorable characters, complete quests, and make decisions that shape your relationships, reputation, story, and ending.

title: Wishing Well Simulator
description: You are a wishing well in a small seaside town. Eight people return for eight days, tossing coins and whispering what they want most. Your power is limited: every wish you grant makes another impossible. The town remembers everything.

title: Seven Blasphemies
description: Seven Blasphemies is a traditional turn-based roguelike where every dawn may curse your run forever. Explore a dying world, choose from doomed classes, survive lethal OSR-inspired encounters, and race against extinction before the seventh blasphemy ends all.

title: KnitBone
description: KnitBone is a story-driven psychological horror visual novel, where the therapist is more traumatized than the patient.

title: Card Revolution Soccer
description: Card Revolution Soccer is a football card game that simulates on-field action through simple card reveals via clicking on them. Level up entire nations or yourself as a Head-coach and play World Tour- or Cup-Modes. Fine-tune the gameplay to your liking with customizable sliders.

title: Surviving Mars: Relaunched - Feeding the Future
description: Follow the dreams of humanity's boldest pioneers in Surviving Mars: Relaunched "Feeding the Future". Master the art of feeding a colony and face the challenges of life on Mars. Contains new buildings, food resources, colonist traits, technologies, and laws.

title: Flood With Friends
description: Nail a raft (or a plane) out of junk, load it with everything valuable or ridiculous and sail for the next island before the water swallows you up. Co-op physics chaos for 1-8 friends.

title: Goi Coins
description: Roll coins engraved with Japanese kana and build words from what lands face-up — a calm tabletop word game set in a quiet Japanese room. A play of luck, vocabulary, and knowing when to stop. Solo high-score, local 2-player, and online versus.

title: Voldark
description: Voldark is an open-world survival crafting game set in a dangerous forest filled with mutant creatures. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, level up your character, build and defend your base while surviving relentless nighttime attacks.

title: Desk Top Racer
description: Turn your desktop into a living racetrack with this idle racing management game. Acquire cars, equip parts, and compete online against other players. Win championships and expand your garage through Mastery, Collections, and new rewards.

title: Trudge
description: A slow, minimalist psychological pixel experience about living the same empty routine in a silent city. Wake up. Work. Eat. Sleep. Beneath the depressing monotony and liminal surroundings, something slowly begins to break.

title: Horse Magic
description: Horse Magic is a choice-driven visual novel about Kaiah and her roommate Iris, whose bond is tested by a surreal event. Navigate love, identity, and forbidden desire through branching choices, emotional drama, and futa-themed intimacy.

title: Nuktedan: The Forgotten Emotions
description: Rediscover the 7 emotions lost by a bird with Alzheimer's. Every memory is a color, every color is a power.

title: Undying Flame
description: Survive a minimalist wave-survival rogue-lite. Keep the fire alive. Read its flame. Defend your fire against creatures that crawl from the dark across endless waves. Every wave survived, the fire grows. Over time, it consumes everything.

title: Permaban
description: It's 2007. You're a forum mod with dial-up, a rulebook that contradicts itself, and a community spiraling into chaos. Ban trolls, cite rules, survive burnout. Papers Please meets early internet culture.

title: Syntax: Overload
description: Compile. Execute. Overload. A strategic roguelite where Syntax is Everything. Drag & drop modules to optimize your execution queue, install .EXE software to break the rules, and face off against legendary viruses like ILOVEYOU and WannaCry. Can you crash the system and escape?

title: Suicide Mr. Fury
description: Suicide Mr. Fury is a Meta-Otome adventure that deconstructs the absurdity of falling for someone who doesn’t exist. Navigate branching paths, meta-narratives, and a multiverse of madness with the overbearing CEO, Mr. Fury, between digital delusion and harsh reality.

title: Orc Incremental
description: Start with a single orc and build an unstoppable dark army to conquer the realms in this incremental auto battler. Perfect your formation, summon mighty beasts, unlock powerful upgrades, and grow stronger with each rebirth.

title: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike
description: Dice Tavern is a medieval Farkle dice roguelike. Roll, lock, and bank through six taverns, from village tables to the King's throne. Collect unique dice, equip badges and coatings to craft your build. Every run is new, every roll a gamble with fate.

title: Sprawl Zero
description: Sprawl Zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

title: Chop Chop Together
description: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op party game where housemates take on ridiculous jobs, earn cash, and put their friendships to the test during the wildest workdays imaginable. Work together under pressure, face unpredictable hazards, and survive fast-paced chaos where teamwork is the only way out.

title: Acceptable Losses
description: Acceptable Losses is a phase-based WWI management game. Assign squads to missions, face random events, and manage the endless paperwork of war. Navigate morale, fatigue, and cohesion across a brutal 20-day trench campaign.

title: Tangent
description: TANGENT is a physics-driven climbing game where you’re a small marble grappling and swinging through a vertical world. Build speed, recover from bad falls, unlock new movement abilities, and reach the top faster as you master the movement.

title: Cyberpunk Store Simulator
description: Cyberpunk Store Simulator puts you in charge of a neon lit shop in a dystopian city. Manage stock, serve customers, sell cybernetic implants, and explore the streets. Build, customize, and grow your store into a futuristic empire.

title: Tiny Bakery
description: Run a tiny bakery for sweet-toothed slime customers! Adapt to changing weather, seasons, and festivals as cravings shift. Unlock new recipes, welcome new guests, and prepare each night for the day ahead.

title: Between Adventures Idle
description: An Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources in a magical world, battle powerful creatures, and upgrade your gear. Explore new locations through main and side quests; your progress continues even in the background. A simple and enjoyable idle experience awaits you.

title: Halloween: The Game
description: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

title: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists
description: Four heroes descend into hell in a tactical narrative game blending mythology and surrealism. Recruit your team, choose your path, and overcome the trials of the underworlds. A new systemic storybook experience from the designers of King of Dragon Pass and Six Ages.

title: Bus Simulator 27
description: Get ready for Bus Simulator 27, the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise. Look forward to our most comprehensive bus fleet yet, with new officially licensed brands and bus models, as well as iconic buses from the series.

title: Pinballers
description: An incremental pinball roguelike to satisfy the flipping nostalgia of the 80s

title: Wanderburg
description: Drive your Castle on Wheels into battle in this minimalist medieval roguelike of roaming fortresses! Devour entire villages, build your modular arsenal of siege weapons and arcane machinery as you grow with every stronghold you crush.

title: Pragma Twice
description: You've awoken deep within a research facility in a new, programmable robot body. You have holes in your memories. At least you no longer have that hole in your head...

title: Arcade Galaxy
description: A fast-paced party platformer where you race, jump, and outplay rivals as customizable animal Cubs. Create and share your own levels with an intuitive editor, or tackle hundreds of player-made maps filled with traps, boosts, and surprises.

title: Pit of Fears
description: Pit of Fears is an atmospheric horror, mystery, 2D platform, puzzle, action and adventure game, face all the challenges and dangers of the Pit of Fears, survive the bizarre creatures and solve the mysteries of this distorted alternative dimension to the real world.

title: Cat Me If You Can
description: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

title: Kitty Kitty Bounce Bounce
description: Good old-fashioned arcade game in which you bop around a kitty using various cushions. Your goal is to break all breakable block without falling onto the floor. Difficulty levels, in-game shop where you can buy pick-me-ups with points you get for destruction, cute art and soundtrack, and much more!

title: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
description: Honeycomb: The World Beyond is a sci-fi survival adventure set on the vibrant alien planet of Sota7. Adapt by building your base and crafting essential tools. Explore diverse biomes and use your bioengineering experience to uncover mysteries and secure humanity's future.

title: Galactic Speed Legends
description: Buy a craft or build a new one from the scratch, bet it, repair it, upgrade it, push it to the limit and take high-speed turns like never before. Prepare yourself to challenge elite drivers in the galaxy through a series of championships, and personal head to head races.

title: Hidden Saga: Xamadeon Stone
description: Are you good at finding things and like the interactive various levels? You are at the right address! You need to dig for artifacts, look inside a lion's mouth, beep-boop the cars and much more of them in Hidden Saga!

title: Pokémon Contingency Contract: Operation Masquerade
description: Based on the Contingency Contract gamemode from the Arknights games. Tiana has gotten an invite to a convention, with a whole new battle experience as its main feature. Set battle modifiers, change your teams and customize your Pokemon, and aim to reach the highest score you can! Gamble your hard earned credits on obtaining new pokemon, items, and unlocking their full potential, or simply enjoy your time at the convention.

title: To Raise a King
description: Rule a kingdom and prepare your heir in this fully voiced, free medieval strategy game. Choose one of six queen storylines and make decisions that lead to many different possible endings.

title: Shelf Happens
description: You (alone or with friends) need to place scattered vinyl records on the right genre crates in a retro record store. Complete crates and earn XP to unlock abilities that improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to sort hundreds of records by genre fast!

title: Spellbound & Shelved
description: A wizard-academy library has vanished under its own books. Hire gnomes, unlock shelves, and let the tidying run itself — a cozy idle game about turning magical chaos into calm, one neatly filed spellbook at a time.

title: Cosmo Arena
description:
Cosmo Arena is a real-time space strategy game where you command a single
capital ship instead of an army. Pick your hull, take it into a contested
system, and out-fly five other commanders in fast 3v3 online space combat. No respawns

title: SmashCore
description: SmashCore is a short, physics based incremental game about smashing asteroids into dust with your gravity cursor and feeding it to the Core. Discover ancient technology and new ores in deep space and use your cash to buy upgrades in the huge skill tree.

title: Toilet 101
description: A liminal space anomaly detection simulator.

title: Ultra Realistic Mine
description: Minecraft texture pack that transforms blocks and items into realistic real-life photos.

title: Night Maniac: The Origin Of Steven
description: A narrative horror set in Red Valley, 1948. Amidst the slaughterhouse, the rain, and the silence of a rotting town, follow Steven Watson in a dark story about isolation, control, and the origin of a legend.

title: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - A.X.E.8: Illumination Stars
description: The second story chapter in the new A.X.E.8 Project, which will redefine all the idols groups. This one focus on Illumination Stars' Hiori, Mano and Meguru.

title: She Never Left
description: Return to an abandoned family home where old memories refuse to stay buried. Explore its dark rooms, uncover a forgotten tragedy, solve environmental puzzles, and survive the presence that has been waiting for you in this short first-person psychological horror.

title: Mythmon: Mythic Monsters
description:
Mythmon is a hack-and-slash strategy game where you build the ultimate monster party to take down the Demon King's army.

As the commander, you'll combine Mythmon, equipment, and formations before heading into battle. Combat unfolds automatically, so careful preparation is the key to victory.

Recruit from a roster of 30 unique Mythmon, equip them with over 140 pieces of gear, and experiment with countless team combinations to forge the ultimate party and save the world from the Demon King's invasion!

title: The Ash Remembers
description:
The Ash Remembers is a dark fantasy idle RPG set in Veyr, a world where ash has been falling for as long as the chronicles reach — and where the ash does not forget. The player arrives at the city of Emberwake as a nameless wanderer and builds a life there: fighting, gathering, cooking and forging.

Progress continues while the game is closed. Combat, gathering and crafting run offline, so a returning player finds work already done instead of a backlog to catch up on.

Sixteen professions feed into one another. Mining and smelting supply the forge, farming and fishing supply the kitchen, and cooked food is what keeps a character standing in long fights — there is no pure-combat path through the game.

More than 120 enemies, eight weekly titans and a line of world bosses make up the endgame. Each carries its own damage weakness, loot table and piece of story, and matching a weapon to that weakness matters more than raw numbers. The Ashfall lets a character let go of everything and begin again stronger: the world's own form of prestige, and never a resurrection.

The game is menu- and text-driven rather than action-driven, runs in the browser and as a desktop build, and is fully playable in German and English. It tells no chosen-one story — nobody here is saving the world, and the chronicle never claims otherwise.

title: Aquarium Anomaly
description: Aquarium Anomaly is a short first-person observational game inspired by Exit 8 and Platform 8, set in an endless aquarium shark tunnel. Watch for anomalies, and trust what you think is normal.

title: Pierline
description: Pierline is a short first-person psychological horror game about an ordinary night that takes an unexpected turn. You play as Daniel Hayes, a Florida traffic officer who decides to spend the night fishing at an old pier along the coast, after a friend recommends the place.

title: Crazy Pocket
description: Crazy Pocket is a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by classic pocket billiards! Chain diverse ball abilities together to build game-breaking synergies, and execute the ultimate shot to clear the table in a single turn!

title: Dealer's Dice
description: Dealer's Dice is a high-stakes dice defense game engineered for true gamblers. Collect powerful dice, manage your betting table, and test your luck against an endless onslaught. Will you play it safe, or push your luck for the ultimate jackpot? Remember, you only have one life.

title: TwwwT: The Witches Who Weave Timelines
description: A 2D action-focused roguelite where you control “witches from history,” battling endless enemies and dense bullet-hell barrages to correct fractured timelines

title: Dirty Laundry
description: Unable to hold down a job, Emily tries her luck on the night shift at a local laundromat. However, what starts as an ordinary job quickly turns into a nightmare as bizarre customers arrive, and the dark secrets of one particularly suspicious nightly visitor change her life forever.

title: The Ayna
description: The Ayna is a psychological exploration game set in Türkiye, inspired by the music video aesthetics and lyrical themes of a female vocalist. The player is tasked with noticing anomalies in the concert venue and uncovering the truth.

title: Operation: Black Genesis - The Immortal Trials
description: top-down co-op survival horror game where players deploy into deadly Quarantined Zones, fight mutated experiments, and extract with everything you can carry—because if you die, you lose it all.

title: Who Haunts the Haunters?
description: "Who’s real when the air starts to rot? Who Haunts The Haunters? is an Eastern horror social deduction game. Don't just watch for movement; listen for the whispers and watch the candles flicker. Purify the manor before the intruders’ greed consumes every last spirit."

title: Discremental
description: Discremental is a short idle and incremental game where you primarily upgrade your disk, along with other equipment.

title: Wobble Ops!
description: Wobble Ops! is a fun, physics-based co-op platformer. Complete the course as fast as possible and lead your team and country to the top of the leaderboard.

title: Little Ghosties
description: Little Ghosties is a cozy idle desktop companion game where adorable ghosts live inside a glass terrarium on your desktop. Hatch, raise, and collect unique ghosts as they grow from eggs into fully grown adult ghosts.

title: The Well Is Not Empty
description: The well has gone dry. It's up to you to find out why. Traverse through abandoned tunnels. Discover remnants of a ritual never meant to be seen. Power dying machinery to bring light into darkness. Dig into broken earth and crawl your way out. Down here you’re not exploring... you're trespassing.

title: Necrowhisper
description: A tense investigative horror experience for solo or up to 4-player co-op, where you search for clues in the dark to uncover the truth behind a spirit’s death before something else finds you first.

title: Bones and Coins
description: An incremental auto battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero party to slay enemies and loot items. Unlock weapons with unique attack styles. Gear up your hero team and explore new dungeon rooms filled with enemies and legendary drops.

title: Eco Volunteer
description: A peaceful, cozy game about cleaning up trash and other eco-friendly activities in nature. Embark on a journey through stunning natural landscapes while doing good deeds!

title: Locktale
description: Discover a tale about identity and love in this game of ciphers and puzzles... that may force you to think outside the (text)box.

title: Qumino
description: Qumino is a cozy roguelike domino game. Lay back, grab your controller, and enjoy playing. There are different heroes with unique abilities that make every deck playthrough different. Build your deck with different domino tiles and think about what you need for the run.

title: Soft(A)ware
description: Soft(A)ware is a surreal puzzle-platformer set inside a vast, hostile system. You awaken in a virtual world that functions as a prison — a place designed to limit, to control, to erase any trace of freedom.

title: No Sheep Left Behind
description: No Sheep Left Behind, is a simple and casual game where you embody a valiant sheepdog on a procedural journey to gather and protect a growing flock of sheep. Enjoy the chill atmosphere and all the sheep bleats while you try to beat your top score.

title: Curse of Pirates
description: Ahoy, matey! How about slicing up some sea beasts and sending a couple of rivals to feed the kraken? Curse of Pirates be a true action roguelike, inspired by Vampire Survivors and Hades! Set sail upon the high seas, gather ye brave crew, and stand firm against the relentless tides of foes!

title: Leap Tactics
description: "Leap Tactics" is a pixel-art platform puzzle game where players alter mechanism states through jumping actions. Overcome obstacles and chart paths to the goal. Featuring 10+ jump-activated mechanisms, 100+ levels, a gentle difficulty curve, and an undo function.

title: Arcaneering: Beyond Automation
description: Build spell-powered factories, reclaim ancient territories filled with magical secrets, and discover game-changing technology hidden across procedurally generated worlds. Master both engineering and magic in this cozy fusion of factory automation and RPG progression.

title: Nothing Strange Here
description:
Nothing Strange Here is a single-player open-world adventure game with mystery and slice-of-life elements. Set in the small town of Larcenest Gap, players take on the role of a reporter exploring the community, documenting strange events, and interacting with townsfolk.

The game combines narrative discovery with photography and journaling mechanics. Players can photograph scenes, collect evidence, and publish their findings in a customizable in-game journal. NPCs follow daily routines, and the world changes based on the player's actions and the time of day. Additional features include hidden collectibles, such as stickers and gnomes, and dynamic events that encourage exploration and investigation.

title: Soul Chained
description: A co-op souls-lite adventure awaits in Soul Chained. Face brutal enemies, overcome complex platforming challenges, and learn to work together within the constraints of the Soul Chain. You will be chained to your co-op partner so remember to communicate!

title: Exit Ways
description: Test your luck in the extraction shooter with survival elements. Build your camp, exterminate the contaminated and evacuate the civilians.

title: Tiny Eden
description: Tiny Eden is a cozy first-person farming simulation set in a futuristic city. Players grow flowers, berries, and vegetables inside an apartment, selecting planters and soil mixtures and managing light, temperature, watering, and weeds. Harvests can be sold or used to cook meals for the building's residents. Earnings unlock additional rooms, balconies, and a rooftop greenhouse, while furniture, decorations, and a pet cat help make the expanding garden feel like home.

title: Alchemy Factory
description: "Alchemy Factory" is a first-person factory building & shop simulation game. You'll process raw materials, research new recipes, and build fully automated production lines to craft and sell a wide range of alchemical products.

title: Mournight
description: Mournight is a horror game where 1-4 players collaborate to survive and solve the mystery. Explore locked rooms, collect cursed objects, and stay alert against a terrifying creature that hunts you in the dark.

title: Tower Lab
description: Roguelite tower defense where enemies can’t be killed, knock them off with physics instead! Build devastating contraptions that push, pull, and launch enemies. Unlock towers, discover broken synergies, and dominate through creative combinations.

title: Port of Jumanah
description: From a humble port, you set out to clean the ocean of troublemakers. Hack and harpoon through absurd foes, shady allies, and your own bad calls. The world wants a hero… your friends want you to punch an orca. Both valid. Choose wisely—or don’t. The sea remembers everything.

title: Pumpkin Woods
description: Collect magical ingredients and build your cozy witch home while exploring the wonderful sights and secrets of these mysterious lands. Beware though, danger might be lurking deep in these woods...

title: Dataminers
description: Dataminers is a fast turn-based roguelike where you climb and clear highly secured towers full of data. Outsmart guards and hack terminals in this unique combination of strategy, stealth and Minesweeper.

title: Veterum
description: Turn-based tactical strategy with a detailed combat system and interactive environment. Explore the open world, complete quests, search for rare artifacts. Lead the last army of the Order of the Gatekeepers and stop the coming chaos!

title: Sir Galgano: A Medieval Tale
description: Sir Galgano is a side-scrolling medieval beat ‘em up game with RPG elements

title: Deadzoned
description: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!

title: Legacy of the Ark: Beneath the Broken Sky
description: Awaken alone at the crash site of a fallen Ark and rebuild from a single handful of scrap. Gather, wake survivors, level them up, send expeditions, chart the deep, and stabilize a broken sky in this cozy, honest idle game. Play at your pace — online or off.

title: Fishing King: Legend of Black Lake
Grapplehook Midpoint Teleport Killer
description: In this platformer game, Sylvie has a fluffy tail and can teleport to the midpoint of her Grapplehook. What could possibly go wrong? And does this world truly have a kitten?

title: An Ecospace of Epochs
description: You're a paleontologist in a far future from a different planet in an interconnected universe, you've got a new home that's yours in the sparsely populated part of the planet and you help with studying the past life and world spanning nearly a billion years ago

title: Restcue
description: You wake up in your familiar home, only to find yourself completely locked inside. Search for clues, evade an unknown presence, and piece together forgotten memories... In this confined space, the real terror is only just beginning. A intense 30-minute psychological horror experience.

title: Until Death Do We Part
description: Wake up, ruin your anniversary, kill your husband. Lather, rinse, repeat.

title: Phantom 9
description: Phantom 9 is a fast-paced, free-to-play multiplayer arena shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Players engage in Tactical, lightning-fast combat across diverse, dynamic maps featuring destructible environments and strategic chokepoints. Featuring zero-lag responsiveness and tick-perfect hit registration, the game offers extensive tactical loadout customization with dozens of weapons and attachments. Players can compete across 7 distinct game modes and 12 unique maps, climbing the global leaderboards through skill-based ranked matchmaking.

title: TruWorlds
description: TruWorlds is an interactive platform that let’s users sign up, and create their own worlds to share with other players. We have our own custom scripting language, our own custom game engine, and a full custom creator that lets you create your game.

title: Vacation Wonders: Hidden Quest - Collector's Edition
Don't Stop Mike
description: Fight through 34 deadly rooms, each guarded by four enemies. Defeat them all to break through the barriers and advance. Dodge deadly spike traps, survive the intense combat, and clear all 34 rooms to conquer the ultimate challenge.

title: Shalter 03
description: Shalter 03 is an asymmetric first-person co-op puzzle-adventure game where three players take control of characters deprived of sight, hearing, and speech. Stranded in a hazardous facility, players must collaborate tightly to overcome their unique physical limitations, communicate through environmental cues, and balance real-time buffs and debuffs to solve complex puzzles before the clock runs out.

title: 67 Simulator
description: 67 Simulator is a chaotic handtracking party game. No controllers needed. Use your webcam to play, compete with friends and strangers, unlock cosmetics and survive ever changing modes.

title: My Dearest Direst Disaster
description: A new version of Sasasagu that adds 5 new post-game scenarios and new CGs, as well as revisions to all already existing CGs and character portraits.

title: Sync Together
description: SYNC TOGETHER is a parkour game focused on keeping a jet-powered flying vehicle balanced by working together. Use coordination, speed, and teamwork to finish the course as fast as possible.

title: Stella
description: A deckbuilder roguelike where you journey through space. Use star, planet, and moon cards to raise your score and harness the power of elements to reach even further. Discover synergies and combos to reach scores that are out of this world.

title: Hive Havoc 3D
description: Secure the future of the hive in this silly third-person bee experience. Explore hostile locations like the desert, underground labs, and an asteroid. Invade hornet airspace or visit your isolationist juche ant neighbors to steal their nearby resources! This is what they don't want you to know.

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Antalya
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Antalya in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Path of the Idle Cultivator
description: An idle xianxia game about clawing your way from a nobody to a god. Sit, absorb Qi, break through realms, die - and come back stronger. Every death unlocks new paths, races, and systems. Defy the heavens one life at a time... then conquer galaxies, universes and... more?

title: Sex King: From Rags to Sexcess
description: Rise from street kid to tycoon in Sex King: From Rags to Sexcess! Build your empire, stack wealth with luxury cars and penthouses, collect sexy girl cards for hotter intimate rewards as your fortune grows! Ready to rule money, power and pleasure?

title: Worm in Village
description: New part of worm adventures and walking simulation and survival game as player worm and mission to find stars in village and forest themed land

title: The Square Ones
description: Master the Block Path

title: Color Lines
description: Plan your moves, line up the colors.

title: Squad Legends: Battle Royale
description: Enter the battlefield and prove your combat skills.

title: Snap64 Recomp
description: A native Windows port of the Nintendo 64 game Pokémon Snap, made by static recompilation.

title: Rakhem
description: Rakhem is an action platformer roguelite where you decide the enemies you have to face! Collect treasure to progress throughout each of the game's varied areas, choosing between the many different upgrades and foes available at your disposal, as well as spending cash on useful permanent upgrades!

title: The Shadows Of Eldergroove
description:
20 years have passed since Agent Rebecca went missing.

The Fresterous Police Department gave up and the world moved on. But Sarah, the daughter of the lead investigator, Agent Rebecca, refuses to let the mystery rest. Firing up her car, she arrives in Eldergroove, a forsaken place where an entire town vanished without a trace.

Is she alone?

title: Doors Closed
description: To save your sick son, you take a job as a security inspector at a secretive lab, the very place rumored to be causing his illness. Inspect IDs, scan for contraband, and weed out impostors. Do your job, earn your paycheck, and save your family. Just don't let the wrong people in.

title: Exspelled
description: Exspelled is a cozy fantasy life sim mixed with tower defense. Build and customize your village, gather resources, welcome outcast creatures, and prepare your defenses. Expand your settlement, strengthen your community, and protect your new home against increasingly dangerous waves of enemies.

title: Pitchside Empire
description: Pitchside Empire is a business management simulation in which the player runs a five-a-side football pitch rental facility. Customers phone in to book slots and the player quotes a price for each call, negotiating against a hidden customer budget, with regular clients and facility reputation affecting how much teams are willing to pay. Profits are reinvested into changing rooms, showers, a canteen, seating, floodlights that make evening slots sellable, and pitch surface upgrades, while additional plots such as an industrial yard, harbour district, lakeside complex, downtown arena and hilltop campus each hold four pitches and attract a different clientele. Staff including managers, cleaners, cooks, attendants and security can be hired and promoted to run the business automatically. From level 10 the local clubs hold a neighbourhood league season on the player's pitches in exchange for a hosting fee and ticket revenue. The game also features customer reviews, on-pitch fights that damage reputation, and thirty-day history charts for cash, occupancy and level.

title: Kupar: Horror Mystery
description: Some legends should never be disturbed.

title: Frog Parkour Obby
description: Hop, jump, and dodge your way through every level!

title: Level Up, Tiny King!
description: Level Up, Tiny King! is a solo survivors-like auto-shooter platformer. After being kidnapped and thrown into the dungeons, you must fight your way upward. Survive relentless waves of cute enemies while climbing. Grow stronger, recruit magical buddies, and reclaim your throne.

title: Crustacean Station!
description: Work a day job at Crustacean Station checking identification and sending a vibrant cast of sea creatures to their desired destinations!

title: Racing Manager
description: Manage your racing team: strategy, tires, staff, budget, and real-time decisions. Build the perfect crew and lead them to victory in this immersive motorsport management game.

title: Cinnabar Nights
description: Cinnabar Nights is a first-person rpg with turn-based combat. Explore diverse landscapes, unearth powerful equipment, manage your resources, and harness otherworldly powers.

title: Alkurai
description: Alkurai is a 4 player online co-op fantasy horror game. An infamous Alchemist has murdered the king and seized Alkurai's throne. It is up to you and your party to evade his horrid miscreations and restore the kingdom to what it once was.

title: The Case of the Last Shawarma
description: The last shawarma in town is gone. The owner is destroyed. The police have "real crimes". You work for seeds, and you just took the case.

title: Tiles & Vials
description: A strategic roguelike deckbuilder with tiles instead of cards. Fight enemies by collecting unique tiles and merging them to deal damage or defend yourself. Unleash devastating combos by combining powerful artifacts that radically change your run.

title: Glow in the Shadows
description: This is a first-person exploration puzzle game set in a world of absolute darkness. Armed with a fluorescent spray gun, you must paint your own path and activate hidden mechanisms to progress. Each stroke of light reveals fragments of the forgotten world, guiding you through its mysteries.

title: Uppercase
description: Uppercase is a Hang Man inspired free, daily browser based puzzle game in which players guess one letter at a time to reveal the Phrase of the Day.

title: Warnet Life
description: Build Your Ultimate Gaming Hub!

title: Deep miner
description: Unearth the truth about Stonehenge: dig with your shovel, blast through rock layers with dynamite, and grab all the gold!

title: 100 Panda Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats!  Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍♂️ Can you find them all? ️‍♂️

title: Arcade Audience
description: The arcade is packed, and you're the reason! Hit the targets to the beat to impress the audience. Master the different timings and cues to achieve arcade perfection!

title: Jaleco Sports: Faceoffs
description:
Jaleco's classic sports trio puts you up against the toughest competition around, where every serve, dunk, and slapshot is a chance to prove who’s got the most game.

Whether you're delivering a ferocious backhand in a championship tennis match, connecting on a sweet bounce pass in a street basketball showdown, or crashing the crease in a full contact hockey barnburner, one thing is certain – your opponent is ready for you.

title: Random Mix
description:
The rhythm game that writes a brand-new song every time you press play. 50+ genres synthesized live. Tap it, remix it, or build your own: you are the DJ and the producer, no music knowledge needed. Fully offline.

A song that has never existed before builds itself around you: drums, bass, melody, all synthesized live on your machine. No downloads or song packs.

Random Mix is a rhythm game with a composer inside.

title: Hockey Beasts
description: Choose your team, step onto the ice, and see what kind of beast you are when the puck starts moving.

title: Fortress Merge
description: Merge buildings, upgrade your defenses, and protect your fortress from endless waves of zombies. Plan each move carefully, adapt your strategy, and survive as long as you can.

title: Zedfall: Outbreak
description: ZedFall: Outbreak is a fast‑paced co‑op wave survival shooter with twin‑stick controls, evolving upgrade cards, and roguelite progression. Fight through numerous undead swarms, build powerful class combinations, and hold out long enough for extraction. There are 3 main game modes to play; Wave Survival, Tower Defence, Scavenge. Each game mode offers a different objective and gameplay experience.

title: Museum 8
description:
A museum after closing. You only ever walk forward — and the same hall keeps arriving. Look through your camera, read the hall, and open the right door.

Observe the museum. Spot what changed. Choose the right door.

Watch the official gameplay trailer for MUSEUM8 and get a closer look at its core anomaly-hunting gameplay—from subtle changes in the exhibits to encounters that become increasingly difficult to ignore.

Use your camcorder to reveal additional details and unsettling changes within certain anomalies.

title: REM
description:
REM is an atmospheric dream exploration game. Explore surreal spaces and architecture. Collect all of the dream seeds and plant them.

Every dream remembers the last one, and every dream is shaped by the garden you tend when you're awake.

title: Eggstreme Farming
description: Build and manage your own farm! Take care of chickens, ducks, geese, and turkeys, collect and sell eggs, buy new animals, expand your pens, and turn your farm into a thriving egg-production empire.

title: Hug & Betray
description: Hug, or betray. A psychological party game where everyone picks HUG, Sword, or Gun as the host calls each round. Taunt, bluff, and rack up points! A new kind of viewer-participation game — watch the stream, play from your phone! Who'll be the sore loser howling at the moon?

title: Paleo Dive
description: Explore five prehistoric oceans in VR, photograph 48 species, collect DNA samples, and expand your walk-in aquarium. Swim using natural arm movements, upgrade your equipment, and return to base before your oxygen runs out.

title: Sponge Hospital. Five Nights at Bob-Verse
description: A Game Of Neighbor Escape

title: UPG: Underground
description: A first person fighting game where your mouse controls your fists and everyone's a bean. Try Multiplayer to punch zombies with your friends, or just punch your friends instead!

title: The Quiet Flat
description: The Quiet Flat is a first-person psychological horror game set in an atmospheric Soviet apartment. Uncover the mystery of your father’s death as your familiar home slowly transforms into a nightmare.

title: NexusRPG
description:
NexusRPG is a persistent text-based browser MMORPG in which players develop a lasting character through combat, gathering, crafting and trade. Main-hand and off-hand equipment determine the character's class, while stat allocation, crafted gear and Gems in permanent equipment sockets shape the build. Personal and clan dungeons retain progress between sessions.

Players can develop shared Clan Capitals in Heaven and Hell, lend equipment and Pets through a Clan Armory, and take part in personal and Clan Rifts. Pets can be fed, bred, assigned work or used in combat. The shared world also includes a player Market, world bosses and PvP arenas.

title: Proyecto Huemul
description: First-person survival horror inspired by a real Argentine conspiracy. Explore abandoned underground facilities, manage scarce resources, and stay out of its sight. Survive whatever lurks beneath the surface.

title: Pencils Down
description: Pencils Down is an analog horror roguelike where you take a 44-question exam under the watch of an unseen proctor. Wager confidence chips on answers, risk erasers on red-ink questions, and face questions generated from your real-time mistakes. Three exam forms offer escalating dread, while a meta-progression system lets you buy study aids that may help or doom you. Five endings, 400+ period-authentic questions, and a creeping sense of being watched make this a uniquely personal nightmare. Played entirely offline with mouse and keyboard.

title: Burst Noir: Fireworks Simulator
description: Burst Noir is a fireworks show design simulation where the night sky becomes your canvas. Choose fireworks with different colors and shapes, arrange them on a timeline, complete missions to unlock more, and watch your finished show unfold over mountains and water.

title: Trailmarks
description:
Trailmarks is a globe-trotting trivia adventure where what you know pays for where you go. Answer questions to earn your fare, then pick the next flight, train, bus or boat out of whatever city you're standing in - and try to keep going. Your score is simply how far you got.

On iOS, Trailmarks is a card-based trivia roguelike inspired by Reigns, where players makes decision on one card at the time, deciding between answering a question, traveling to a new destination or drawing random cards. All while their mood must be constantly balanced to prevent burnout. It's a calm and casual trivia game structured as a global adventure.

title: Cheap Tattoo
description: Run your own tattoo shop and actually do the tattooing. Dial in voltage and needle depth, line it, shade it, wipe the blood — and keep the customer from walking out. Too shallow and the ink won't hold. Too deep and you'll hear about it.

title: Disaster Response Force
description: Disaster Response Force is a twin-stick 2D top-down hack-and-slash arcade game. Choose one of three characters and gain upgrades to survive longer and get your score as high as possible before you inevitably succumb to the horde. Every moment you stall the onslaught is one more civilian saved.

title: The Night Route
description: A night shift in a quiet suburb seemed like an easy way to earn some extra cash. You're a regular courier on foot. Deliver the orders and head home. But remember: the darkness hides those who stay awake at night, and someone is watching your route very closely.

title: Paper Airplane Flying Game
description: A small flight. A big journey.

title: My Hero Academia: All's Justice - Playable Character Izuku Midoriya Overlay Full Style
Tales of Formentera
description: Tales of Formentera is an adventure game set on a small island inspired by real Formentera landscapes, where you explore freely to uncover a local mystery. Talk to islanders about their stories and legends, solve environmental puzzles, collect hidden items, and complete optional side quests as you piece together clues about what's happening on the island.

title: Penguin Fury
description: Penguin Fury is a 2D roguelite auto-battler where players draft penguins, merge them into stronger forms, equip weapons, and survive endless waves of enemies. The game features interactive Twitch and Kick chat integration allowing viewers to join battles, 70 unlockable skins across 6 historical eras, a deck-building Joker relic system, and full localization in 39 languages.

title: Void Disciple
description: VOID DISCIPLE is a lightning-fast, neon-vector arcade bullet-hell with deep roguelite progression. Pilot a cyber-drone, survive escalating waves, tear through multi-phase bosses, and stack weapon synergies to break the game before it breaks you.

title: Moonbringer
description: Moonbringer is a fast-paced action shmup with a skill tree. Kill the waves, stack the loot and upgrade your ship. Unlock a variety of new abilities and become more powerful every run. Shoot, die, upgrade, and dive into space one more time.

title: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno - Nitro Archive
description:
A web of swirling conspiracies. A whirlwind of bullets. Amidst it all, a poignant tale of a boy and a girl unfolds...

The neo-noir visual novel Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO, originally released in 2000 as Nitroplus's (now NITRO ORIGIN) first title, is now on Steam!
The Steam port is available in three languages: Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese.
*Voiceover is only available in Japanese.

title: Speedy Bundle Speedway & Grand Prix
description: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!

title: Chiqing Meimei Shaxue de Xiongkong Riji
Vespera
description: Vespera is a dark fantasy idle RPG. Fight hundreds of enemies, craft gear, build your character with talents, gems and elements, recruit mercenaries that fight with you, and take on world bosses with other players! Full offline progression. No microtransactions, you buy the game, you own the game.

title: NBA 2K27
description: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.

title: The Last Good Boy
description: A Cozy idle RPG inspired by my real-life dog called Ramon, the goodest boy in the world. Gather, craft, unlock new lands, enchant your gear, and battle monsters on a quest to find out where all the other good boys have gone.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Sword Appearance: Whittled Oar
description: An item that gives Miyamoto Musashi's swords an unrefined appearance! An oar whittled down into a wooden sword. A simple weapon, but in the hands of Musashi it could easily shatter someone's skull.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Sword Appearance: Raizan
description: An item that gives Miyamoto Musashi's swords a striking appearance! Thought by some to be imbued with the power of lightning, but besides their shocking design they are ordinary blades.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Sword Appearance: Enryuu
description: An item that gives Miyamoto Musashi's swords an ornate appearance! Thought by some to be imbued with the power of fire, but besides their intimidating design they are ordinary blades.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Sword Appearance: Bamboo & Panda
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Outfit for the Oni Lady: Snow Camellia
description: A refined outfit for the Oni Lady that supports Miyamoto Musashi! Like a snow camellia blooming in the most frigid of winters, one can sense from this woman a strength of will capable of overcoming any adversity.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Outfit for the Oni Lady: Elegance
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Outfit for the Oni Lady: Bird Call
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Outfit for Okuni: Oni Dance
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Outfit for Okuni: Goldfish Dance
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Outfit for Okuni: Flower Dance
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Outfit for Musashi: Red Armor
description: A gallant outfit for Miyamoto Musashi! Striking red armor that can only be worn by an unparalleled warrior such as Musashi.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Oni Gauntlet: Crimson Lotus
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Moonlight Haori
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Hellfire Haori
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Cloudbiter Haori
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Charm: Oni Lady
description: A beautiful charm modeled after the Oni Lady! It grants a special effect when equipped.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Charm: Mentor
description: A charm modeled after a mighty swordsman who serves as a mentor to Miyamoto Musashi! It grants a special effect when equipped.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Charm: Little Dancer
Not Enough Space
description: Shoot to move. Move to survive. A space action roguelike about momentum, chaotic battles, loot, builds, and bosses.

title: Dissolution of My Self
description: A prince who has lost his kingdom and everything else. His uncle and aide-de-camp, unable to leave him. In a cramped rented room abroad, click on objects and piece together a codependent relationship filled with brutality and endurance. Watch helplessness turn into violence, tenderness into torture.

title: Operation: Outbreak Idle
description: Command automated military defenses, upgrade your fortress, and survive massive zombie waves in this action-packed idle defense game. Build powerful defenses, unlock upgrades, and hold the line against endless undead hordes.

title: Monster Slingshot Smash
description: Launch, smash, and conquer in a colorful slingshot adventure packed with action, destruction, and fun.

title: Serve or Die
description: In Serve Or Die, you work alone in a small sandwich shop during the night shift. With a VHS-inspired style and an increasingly unsettling atmosphere, survive as simple orders turn into something far more disturbing.

title: Craving Wisps
description: Slide in the walls, possess your enemies, and discover a mysterious world threatened by wicked spirits! This short adventure, full of action and humour, will please platformer fans and players looking for an original experience!

title: Kupala
description: “Kupala” is a dark, non-linear horror visual novel inspired by Slavic folklore. Little Anya arrives at a village on the eve of Kupala Night — the sacred night of the ancient Slavs. In the quiet old house, her grandmother tells her tales of unclean spirits crossing into the living world...

title: Magic Quiz
description: Magic Quiz is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer quiz game for 2–6 players. Knowledge alone isn’t enough here—you’ll need strategy, cunning, and a pinch of chaos magic to outwit your opponents.

title: The Swashbugglers
description: A cartoon-style 2D roguelike autochess focused on tactical strategy. Recruit insect "heroes" from the forest to form a team. Develop their skills, equipment, and stone inscriptions through battles to defeat the source of chaos within the time limit.

title: Data Breach
description: Corporate horror for 1-4 expendable robots. Valkyron owns your mind, sets your quota, and drops you into dead facilities to haul out data. Hit quota and catch the train home, or the whole crew gets recycled.

title: Worming from Home
description: Be the Worm of Wall Street in this silly simulation game about working a remote finance job. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to invest in the stock market and earn obscene amounts of money. Buy upgrades, train skills, and worm your way up to the promotion you've always dreamed of!

title: Retro Arcade Shop Simulator
description: Build and manage your ultimate retro arcade! Buy classic Arcade Machines, Galaxy Pinball, and Gift Claw games, or invest in Cinema 8D, Go-Karts, and Racing Simulators. Manage the economy, hire staff, and repair your machines to keep the tokens rolling in!

title: The Boo Croo
description: 4-player cooperative and competitive party game with various minigames where everyone can win... and everyone can lose!

title: A Brown Rabbit's Story
description: A Brown Rabbit's Story is an interactive storybook, a text-driven adventure where your choices lead to branching paths and multiple endings. In a quiet orphanage, a boy wishes his toy rabbit to life… and together, you must face the world’s cruelties and find hope.

title: Town Diggers
description: Dig up items from the earth and trade them in your shop. To grow your business in a ruthless capitalist world: sell items, smuggle, forge items, expand your shop, hire workers. With strong financial power be the town’s mafia boss. Take down the rival mafia.

title: Reality Rivals: The First Season
description: Reality Rivals is the reality show you can play. Compete in challenges, form alliances, and survive the vote in this social strategy game. Every choice shapes the drama. Will you avoid Exile, and beat your Rivals?

title: When the Road Darkens
description: A cooperative action game where up to 4 players battle through themed arenas, dodge deadly attacks, upgrade unique abilities, and survive raid-style encounters in fast paced combat.

title: Cosmic High Schooler
description: This is an AVG visual novel with romance elements, set against the backdrop of a Chinese high school. It tells a story about imagination, the universe, and the youthful innocence of high school students.

title: Future? No Thanks!
description: Future? No Thanks! is a narrative-driven, open-world adventure set in an ecosocialist utopia. You're old, bitter, and scheduled for euthanasia. Enjoy your last day in a future that works for everyone but you.

title: Cattopia
description: Cattopia is an energetic momentum-based 2D platformer where you use a fishing line to swing around! Help Catto swing through many branching paths while catching fish and helping out his friends along the way.

title: Dungeon Raid
description: Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.

title: Scavland
description: Scavland is a hardcore, top-down pixel art survival game set in a Post-Apocalyptic Soviet Era. Explore a world ravaged by war and the deadly Mist, scavenging for resources, taking risky jobs, and seeking refuge in harsh settlements. The wasteland is relentless—everything is out to kill you.

title: Fracture Point
description: After years in prison, you return to a dark megacity ruled by a ruthless corporation. The only way forward is up—through countless floors of a heavily guarded skyscraper—to reach the corporation's leader and take your revenge.

title: Withering Realms
description: A ghost and her doll guardian explore the mysterious town of Penwyll and the sprawling graveyards, tombs, caves and rotting estates that surround it in this Horror Action RPG from the creator of Withering Rooms.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
description:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

title: Hex
description: Dive into unknown dungeons and fight “HEX”. Use many items to survive in the underworld, Hack & slash action RPG to survive in the underworld! Don't wander around, just keep going!

title: Isle of Reveries
description: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve head-scratching puzzles, and fight dangerous enemies in this retro-inspired action adventure.

title: Cupid's Chatroom
description: Find your true love with the help of Cupid's chatroom, a mysterious server that won't let you leave!

title: Dungeon Settlers
description: A colony sim based dungeon crawler where you manage your clan to build a settlement in barren land, provide food and shelter for your people, lead them deep into the merciless dungeon, overcome challenging combat by your strategy.

title: Thorgard
description: Vikings, pirates, and suspiciously organized ducks all want a sip of your legendary mead. Grab your axe, mow down the horde, and defend Thorgard's finest brew.... one swing at a time.

title: Carrot Revenge
description: Rabbit was taken from his family, unknowingly where he is or for what purpose and he will be looking for revenge.

title: Order Automatica
description: A dark tactical roguelite where positioning, synergies, and automated battles collide on a tiny 3x3 ritual grid. Like chess with demons.

title: Sigma World Online
description: Sigma World Online - is an online sandbox with a huge world from many star systems. Choose who to be: space explorer, miner, merchant, farmer, culinary specialist, scientist, builder or hunter, or build your empire.

title: Kobayakawa-san Is a Soulslike 5
description:
Kobayakawa-san Is a Soulslike 5 is a free short adventure game where you must identify the real Kobayakawa-san among five identical girls.

Talk with the five Kobayakawa-sans, look for inconsistencies in what they say, and choose the one you suspect is fake.

title: Toiletocalypse
description:
This is not just a game about running to the toilet. Toiletocalypse is an absurd roguelike survival where you try to survive a work shift in someone else's apartment before your guts take you down. One shift can be calm. Another turns into chaos you can't control. Everything runs on RNG.

You're paid per job. Finish it, you get paid. Don't, you get nothing. Your guts came to work with you they're the main antagonist. Manage water, pressure, psyche and stamina while you build walls, mop floors, craft drinks and race to the toilet. Runs from 10 minutes to several hours. Early Access.

title: Baff E
description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

title: Puzzling Places: Monthly Pack #47
description: From historic breweries to striking modern architecture, Monthly Pack #47 brings six brand-new locations to explore!

title: Mess in the Toy Shop
description: Just the simple joy of putting toys back on the shelves. Dive into a relaxing gameplay experience where every toy has its place. Turn a messy toy shop into a perfectly organized store. Unlock new skills, improve your efficiency, and have fun.

title: Mall Tidy Up Frenemies
description: Chaos in, order out. Sort a mall's worth of misplaced products back onto the shelves they belong on, using each item's packaging as the clue. Unlock perks, climb the standings against your friends, and restore the whole mall in online co-op for up to eight, AI players included.

title: Tavern Farkle GB
description: Tavern Farkle GB is a push-your-luck dice game for the Game Boy. Roll six dice, bank your points or risk it all. Play a quick match against a random villager, or take on six opponents in a row, ending with Lucifer himself and his wild Devil's Die.

title: Broadcast Paranoia
description: Tune in to paranoia! Broadcast Paranoia is an anthology of 7 short horror games about radio and conspiracy theories. Decode signals, seek the truth, and try not to lose your mind. Each story takes 15–30 minutes to complete.

title: Arcade Archives: Arkanoid Revenge of Doh
MineSweeper Galaxy
description: Clear the mines and conquer the galaxy!

title: Owlen and the Starbound Mountain
description: Take flight as Owlen and explore icy mountains, glowing star paths, and realms above the clouds.

title: Pretty Home Run Derby: Re - Return of Kusogaki
Rabbit and Turtle Harsh Jump Race
description:
The World of Japanese Fairy Tales
Simple Jumping and harsh Races
The appeal of simultaneous Japanese and English display

title: Solitaire Paradise: Furry Waifus
description:
A classical Solitaire game with a modern twist.
Play classic Solitaire in a calm, anime-inspired world.

title: Beauties' Thrilling Shots
description: Can you beat the spin?

title: Casual Mystery Solving Bite-Sized Mysteries
description: Can you spot the clue?

title: Eggconsole: Borfes and the Five Demons MSX
description: Become the apprentice wizard Borfes and teach the great demon Naikin Naikis a lesson! Could a pot that summons demons be the key to beating the game?!

title: Evergreen Quest
description: Explore a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, discover forgotten secrets and survive the dangers lurking among the trees.

title: Magic Kittens Merge
description: Merge magic eggs, hatch enchanted kittens and fill the witch's album with every form.

title: Incremedieval
description: An Incremental game about looting dungeons & becoming stronger

title: Arcade Archives 2: Wiz
description: Play as Wiz, a wizard who controls 8 types of magic to fight from the Depths, to the Land Realm, and finally into the Sky Realm. Defeat the monsters standing in your way, and make it to the Sky Realm to face off with a dragon.

title: Best Hits Fun Collection 10 in 1 Bundle
description: This 10-in-1 Best Hits bundle is perfect for players of all ages and interests! You'll find everything you want to play in this one-of-a-kind bundle!

title: Special Forces: Blackout
description: "In the heart of a city reduced to ashes, the unstoppable operation of the elite special forces begins."

title: Secret Photo Memory
description: Can you rebuild the secret shot?

title: Look Closer Dark Traditions
description: Spot it, and normal life chills.

title: Caught You Looking
description: Who gave themselves away?

title: Alluring Neon Night Town
description: Can you restore the glow?

title: Ghosts of the Tozai Line
description: Explore a train stalled after an accident in this side-scrolling mystery adventure. Talk with the spirits of passengers, gather clues, and unravel the mysteries left aboard. Deliver lost feelings and belongings, and see the spirits off on their final journey.
