title: Gradanix
description: Gradanix is a permadeath co-op action RPG roguelike. Players pick one of seven classes - warrior, paladin, rogue, hunter, mage, priest or warlock - and descend through an endless, procedurally generated dungeon that grows harder with every level, with a boss encounter every seventh floor. Death ends a run permanently, and the depth reached is the score, recorded on global leaderboards that run in three-month seasons. Runs can be played solo, in online co-op or over LAN, with experience shared evenly between party members. An optional Corruption dial increases enemy difficulty and rewards, the first player to find each legendary item is recorded permanently as a world first, and characters keep their level, talents, bank and personal house between seasons.

title: The Dandelion Endures.
description: This is a dandelion life simulation adventure.

title: Flappy Bill
description: A parody game released on the official White House website.

title: Console Archives: The Conveni 2
description:
The Conveni 2 was released by Human in 1997 for an 32-bit home console.
The graphics have been completely revamped from the previous game, the number of maps has increased, and the perspective has been changed to an isometric viewpoint, doubling the sense of scale. Game software has been added to the product items, and a welcome double-speed mode and a function to create original store markers have been added, resulting in a significant functional and system-wise upgrade.
This is a simulation game that you can enjoy without feeling stressed. Don't just aim to complete the game; try playing with more creative ideas.

title: Kayf-Life: Complete Edition
description: A modification for Half-Life 2, which is a parody with an alternative look at the story and different voice acting, made in the manner of amateur Russian film dubbing that was popular in late 90's and early 2000s. It also brings visual overhaul, reworked gameplay, new mechanics and more!

title: Street Corner Heartbeat Snaps
description: Can you set every slice straight?

title: Dreamy Beauties: Heart-Pounding Illustration Puzzle
description: Can you set every slice straight?

title: G-Mode Archives+: Ridge Racer
description: A legendary 3D car racing masterpiece that earned its place in gaming history. Blast through corners with spectacular drifting!

title: Kapka The Game
description: Kapka: The Game is an online multiplayer party board game for up to 10 players. Players take turns rolling dice and moving around a board, collecting coins, buying items, and triggering traps, teleports, and random events as they race to complete the required number of laps. Hosts can customize the match length and chaos level, and select between Classic and Halloween modes.

title: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds
description: A game about watching clouds. Discover hundreds of hidden shapes, train your pareidolia, and let your imagination do the rest.

title: Funorbit
description: Funorbit is a physics-based pixel art space survival simulation where you navigate a vast, procedurally generated universe using realistic orbital mechanics. Master acceleration, deceleration, and gravitational forces to explore planets, moons, and drifting meteoroids, each with unique motion and spin. Collide with meteoroids to break them into pieces, evade cosmic dangers, and use your HUD to track real-time speed, distances, and directions as you travel through deep space.

title: Tidying Simulator
description: Find scattered objects and return them to their proper places in this first-person tidying simulator. Follow silhouettes and a compass, unlock new abilities as you progress, and restore the entire house to perfection!

title: Flight Simulator 2026 Collection
description: Fly without limits.

title: Escape Backrooms Collection
description: Lost beyond reality...

title: Criminal Hearts: Obsession Bad Girls Dating Sim
Coloring Games for Families+
description: A family-focused creative activity collection with more than 3,000 coloring, drawing, cooking, dress-up, tracing, matching, and puzzle activities. It is designed for young children and shared family play, with offline support and no advertising.

title: Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+
description: A cozy puzzle game built around restored wildlife illustrations from the 18th and 19th centuries. Players reconstruct either the artwork or accompanying educational text, with accessibility options including simplified descriptions, dyslexia-friendly fonts, customizable colors, and assistive-control support.

title: Moo-A-Doodle-Doo
description: Transform into anything. Sound like anything. Fool your friends in this chaotic multiplayer party game.

title: Criminal Hearts: Obsession Bad Boys Dating Sim
description:
Some men come with a warning.
You've never been good at listening.

title: Cozy Unpacking Collection
description: Your cozy journey starts here.

title: Tetword
description: Tetword is a word-puzzle falling-block game across seven ancient civilizations. Rotate the whole arena, stack glyph cubes, and spell the target words to clear the board. Master real writing systems from Greek to hieroglyphs — solo or in local 2-player duels.

title: Reality Breach
description: Reality Breach is a first-person psychological horror game where your own creation turns against you. Step into the shoes of an exhausted indie developer trapped in a shifting home studio, evading a relentless entity born from your own corrupted code

title: Roads of Da Vinci: In Search of Origins
description: Travel across Italy, collect artifacts, and uncover the truth about the origins of Roman mythology through ancient temples and ruins.

title: Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap
description: In Junkyard Builder: King Of Scrap, the ultimate version to experience the game, you’re the proud owner of a once-forgotten junkyard, now brimming with endless potential.

title: Ironford
description: Search a peaceful seaside village for every hidden gem.

title: Perfect Crime Case Files
description: Can you spot the flaw?

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Frog
description: Ribbit!

title: Horse Spirit Valley 2
description: Ride free through a living valley of meadows, forests, frost and dusk. Tame wild horses, style them in the Horse Boutique, collect gems.

title: Summer Delusion: The Girl Only I Can See
description: A tropical-themed visual novel woven with romance and lingering mysteries. I met a friend—but only I can see her. The doctor insists she’s a delusion, yet she claims to be from another realm. Who can I truly trust? My choices will determine everything.

title: Educational Family Games
description: 80 educational and party games for 1–4 players.

title: God of Chaos
description: Defy nature’s laws and avenge your slain pantheon! Humanity once feared and hated you, but now, awakened from a thousand-year slumber, you are their only hope. A text-based interactive game.

title: Rutrum
description: Rutrum is a physics roguelike about dropping gems, popping rocks, and unlocking chests. Build a deck of gems, inscribe them with runes, merge them together to cause damage, touch them to acquire loot from enemies. DROP, POP, UNLOCK!

title: Next Reign: Kingdom
description: Medieval incremental kingdom builder combining city building, resource management, automation and auto-battler combat.

title: Florence Mirror
description: Florence Mirror is a dark fantasy Action RPG set in modern Florence, where a hidden mirror dimension unleashes monstrous reflections of human sins. As Leonardo Tornabuoni, fight through 30+ bosses, master arcane powers, and choose between a story-driven path or a brutal Souls-like challenge.

title: ShoreTiles
description: Build your island around a fragile lighthouse in this Gloomy tile-placement strategy game. Balance growth, economy, and defense - because when night falls, THEY will rise from the depths.

title: Rescue the Hostages: Misaligned Fate
description: Race against the clock in this gripping FMV horror puzzle where every move could be your last. Solve a deadly sliding-tile challenge, uncover hidden clues, and disarm the bomb while a twisted mastermind watches your every mistake. Can you keep your nerve and save the hostages?

title: Endless Isolation
description: Endless Isolation is a classic first-person Survival Horror in PSX style, where the line between office routine and nightmare is erased forever.

title: BioEden
description: Step into a cozy management journey as a Keeper and bring life back to a world quietly waiting to be healed. Craft the perfect biome for dozens of wonderful animal species and use your ingenuity to restore your planet, one ecosystem at a time.

title: Dread Admiral
description: A turn-based naval roguelite where every ship you lose is gone forever. The Black Fleet hunts you. Your Flagship must survive.

title: Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia
description: Help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions in this fast-paced 2D platformer! A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake!

title: Logbook: Beneath the Storm
description: A narrative deduction game where you uncover a dark maritime mystery by piecing together clues and hidden connections. Step into the role of a detective, reconstruct past events, identify those involved, and reveal the truth behind a series of grim incidents at sea.

title: Unseasonable Flowering
description: "Unseasonable Flowering" is a first-person horror game set in Japan. After moving to a new home, the young protagonist, Mashiro, is met with eerie residents and inexplicable phenomena. Something "sprouting" everywhere quietly erodes her daily life.

title: Scarlet Skips
description: Jump jump jump as much as you can in this silly 1-button Rogue-Like about skipping rope! Power up your jump ropes to help Scarlet jump higher, survive longer, and reach absurdly high scores! boing boing boing boing boing boing boing boing

title: Welcome Demon
description: You are a dungeon warden. Sitting in the chair of the previous warden you killed, you must cleanse yourself of your sins within 666 hours. Place the incoming demons into six different dungeons based on your information, intuition, and limited resources.

title: Friendly Steps
description: A physics-based 1-4 player co-op disaster about getting home after a wild night out. It was a fun night! Now grab your buddies and walk home. If you remember how.

title: Monk Took Book
description: A game about organizing, stacking and remembering where you put hundreds of books in a cozy-creepy medieval library. Play solo or with up to three fellow monks.

title: Donutal
description:
You awaken from a cold sleep and suddenly find yourself in the year 2206. What you once knew as the International Space Station is now the International Space Port—a gateway for aliens coming to Earth. Crushed by a massive, unexplained debt, you’re forced into a job you never asked for: Chief Xeno Inspector.

Seems simple enough, just wave in the friendly aliens and turn away the dangerous ones. However, make the wrong call and Earth could be destroyed. No pressure though, right?

title: Bulk
description: Collect cards, mix them, watch them rise their rank, sell for gold, and invest in upgrades. Stack, mix, sell and repeat... The machines in this dark fantasy factory keep humming, and the profits are waiting for you...

title: Orbitals
description:
Team up as Maki and Omura, two inseparable explorers with a whole lot more determination than experience. You’ll brave the perils of space in search of help for their crumbling station home, now trapped within a supernatural cosmic storm.

Orbitals captures the warmth and style of classic Japanese anime, brought to life with hand-crafted cinematic cutscenes from Studio Massket, full Japanese and English voice acting, and an original soundtrack that channels the magic of the era.

Built from the ground up for asymmetric 2-player co-op, either in local split-screen or online, Orbitals rewards smart teamwork and clear communication. Use each character’s unique tools to open the path forward, overcome danger, and meet out-of-this-world creatures and characters on a bombastic adventure.

title: Deliria
description: Fight, build, and conquer wonders in a thrilling infinite 3D sandbox. An adventure without cubes! Play solo or with friends in PvP, co-op, or creative mode—backed by 20+ original soundtracks.

title: Knights of Fiona
description: Fierce dragons have emerged in the land of Gallia. Join Fiona and her sworn knights to protect the kingdom! Embark on quests solo or with friends as you fight against the darkness.

title: Rogue Runner
description: Rogue Runner is a high-speed running, rogue-like, third-person shooter, action, and parkour game. You must run to break the cycle. As you run, you'll discover different possibilities. Run, Kill, Die, Try new skills, and Repeat to break the cycle!

title: Sins of a Solar Empire II: Harbinger
description: The Harbinger expansion features the much anticipated 4th playable faction to Sins of a Solar Empire II.

title: Cosmo Tales
description: Cosmo Tales is a third person, action adventure inspired by the '70s retro sci-fi aesthetic mixed with modern looks and gameplay. Use the dimension shifting ability to change between realities as you fight your way through the outer space.

title: Slipstream
description: Slipstream is a top-down physics-based racing game where you move by splitting your bubble to propel yourself forward. Manage your fuel as you steal bubbles from other players (or even eat them whole!) Challenge your friends or CPU players and slide yourself to victory!

title: Island Market Simulator
description: Team up with your friends and build a thriving trade empire in this CO-OP strategy and economy simulation set on a lively island. Begin with a small market, share tasks, manage production chains, raise livestock, and dominate the economy together through changing seasons and dynamic festivals!

title: Beetleball
description: Score goals with dungballs in Beetleball, the Greatest Online Multiplayer Class-based Dung Beetle Soccer Game to ever exist.

title: Asterika: Phantom Rose Refrain
description: Move with the beat! Asterika is a rhythm action game of beat and movement with no falling notes to press. Weave through obstacle patterns, move to the music, and master the chaos on the grid!

title: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
description: The ultimate competitive platformer is back! Outrun, outjump, and outsmart your rivals in cutthroat online/local races, now up to 8 players. Master the movement, learn meticulously designed maps, use powerful pick-ups, swing around with a grappling hook, and don't get knocked off-screen!

title: Liminal Shroud
description: A psychological exploration experience that takes you deep into the heart of uncanny, in-between spaces where reality unravels. There are no monsters here—only the shadows of your own mind. Navigate strangely layered rooms, interact with the environment and unlock secrets to escape.

title: Red Rocket Defencism
description: You, a military officer from our great autocratic motherland, must protect our precious rockets from the evil capitalist enemy in this revolutionary base building strategy game. Bribe! Surveil! Purge! Imbibe! The end justifies the means when you have to protect our invaluable rockets!

title: Shoe it All!
description: Launch shoes from a swing to solve clever physics puzzles. Master trick shots, uncover hidden secrets and discover smarter solutions with fewer throws.

title: Chaos Front
description: A turn-based space mecha mercenary game. You can recruit pilots and captains with varying stories and skills, buy and modify spaceships, mecha, artillery, and fighters, take missions, participate in battles between Galactic Powers, change the situations, and experience different stories.

title: The Blood of Dawnwalker
description: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

title: Veiled Edge
description: Veiled Edge is a dynamic cyberpunk action-adventure platformer featuring multi-genre gameplay and innovative hacking mechanics. Dive, hack, and adapt your abilities to uncover the secrets of Full-Dive technology in a thrilling journey through virtual worlds.

title: Rogue Blight
description: Rogue Blight is a rogue-lite with focus on souls-like combat, featuring a Slay The Spire-inspired map system. Fight your way through ever-changing maps. Customize your playstyle based on what you find. Death is punishing. Only skill and persistence will carry you forward.

title: Ace Marks the Spot
description: A relaxing card-based monster-hunting game that combines +1/-1 solitaire-style gameplay with crafting and exploration. Build card combos to defeat beasts, gather materials and doubloons, craft and upgrade more than 50 unique weapons, and travel across five islands as you take on increasingly powerful monsters. With a slow-burn progression system and no game-overs, the focus is on strategy, efficiency, and steadily growing your power.

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Thailand
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Thailand in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Storytime Cats: Meows and Mistletoes
description: Storytime Cats – Meows and Mistletoes invites you into a heartwarming Christmas adventure. Explore cozy, hand-drawn holiday scenes filled with festive cheer as you search for hidden cats tucked away in the magic of the season!

title: Petal and Blade
description: Petal and Blade is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder featuring four distinct playable characters. Build powerful decks, discover card synergies, adapt your strategy, and overcome challenging battles with each new run.

title: Kumatopia
description: Kumatopia is a cozy 2D pixel-art simulation game where you care for your Kuma companion, explore a relaxing world, grow magical fruits, collect treasures, play mini-games, unlock music, and upgrade your boomerang. Take your time exploring, build your collection, and eventually face the powerful boss, Bloomblastic.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Arkanoid - Revenge of Doh
description:
The sequel to Arkanoid is back and more powered up than ever! While retaining the core gameplay of bouncing the Energy Ball to shatter Space Walls, it introduces brand-new systems, including branching paths into L and R versions, and an increased variety of items.
Only you can stop the dimension-controlling force Doh, which has crossed dimensions to invade our universe!

title: Spellarium 14: Collector's Edition
description: A new Match3 Puzzle game with a city to build and tons of extras (hidden object, spot the difference,mahjong,jigsaw)

title: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - 90s Pops Pack
description: This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode and Great Drum Toy War.

title: Chompy Party
description:
Hungry? Your friends and enemies are on the menu!
Welcome to Chompy Party! A free online multiplayer fan game set in the world of Skylanders, where you can play as the beloved (or feared) Skylanders Chompy.

title: Helga the Viking Warrior 9: The Last Journey
Depths' Tale
description: Depths’ Tale is a short first-person cosmic horror experience about a lone fisherman working the night shift. Far from shore, only the waves keep you company... for now.

title: The No Jumpscare Show
description:
Welcome to The No Jumpscare Show!
Brought to you by Polypaw, this is a narrative comedy short horror game that promises a 100% jumpscare-free experience! ...Hopefully.

This release is the first part of the story, offering a playtime of around 30 minutes.

In a world where the paranormal is normal, the horror industry has gotten incredibly lazy.

Jumpscares have become the most boring cliché on earth, and Illy is completely unimpressed. She signs up for a shady haunted house promising true psychological horror... without jumpscares? At least, that's what the waiver says.

Run by yours truly, "Thingy the Thing," the kicker is this: if you don't get scared, you'll win $10,000!!

With Illy's constant pushing... things will not end well. And the show will h̷a̷v̷e̷ NOT HAVE ANY JUMPSCARES = )

title: The Gutter
description: Descend into 1801 China as an opium-addicted father who sold his daughter, now prowling a burned-out floating brothel for treasures. As you touch relics of the dead, violent memories reveal a sickening truth: the greatest monster in this tale has always been you.

title: The Last Curse
description: The Last Curse is a first-person psychological horror game. Uncover terrifying secrets, solve intricate puzzles, and navigate dark, atmospheric environments where fear lurks around every corner. Trust your instincts to survive the night.

title: Go Next!
description: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

title: Martha's Dolls 2
description: Return to the decaying halls of the Martha Estate in this bone chilling sequel to the viral horror hit. As an urban explorer obsessed with the "Disappeared," you step into a nightmare where the porcelain faces aren't just decorations they are silent hunters.

title: Labhorror
description: A first-person horror set in a locked mansion the size of a city block. Carry three scrolls out of a 200-metre labyrinth while a man with an axe walks its corridors. Your flashlight is the only thing he will not walk into.

title: Beggar Simulator: Istanbul
description:
Beggar Simulator: Istanbul is a first-person job simulation set on the streets of a contemporary Istanbul. The player controls a man who is not destitute but performs destitution for money, renting a costume and an act each morning and choosing where to work. A traffic junction, a covered bazaar, a mosque courtyard, a nightlife avenue and a metro concourse each draw a different crowd and reward a different approach.

Begging is handled through a dialogue menu whose lines are weighed against the passer-by being read, while the act that was rented restricts which lines can be used without breaking character. Municipal enforcement officers, pickpockets and rival beggars press on the working day, and the money earned goes on food, on a place to sleep and on the next day's rent for the act. Hunger, illness and sleep carry over between days.

title: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
description: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy sorting game for solo or co-op play. Take on 5 stores at any difficulty, from a Toy Store with 3,555 items to a massive Megastore with 13,357 items. Pick up, sort, shelve, and get ready to open!

title: ShipShaper
description: ShipShaper is a creative game about the simple joy of designing ships. Nothing more. Nothing less. Export to Bulwark, 3D print, or use in your own games with a free commercial license.

title: Heroes of Retribution
description: A rogue-like RPG set in a ruined world. Take on the role of a tank commander. Discover other heroes and factions. Upgrade your tank, acquire new skills, and find forgotten relics in this devastated world. Choose your side, get stronger and become humanity's savior.

title: Molluscarium
description: Relax and collect over 500 unique molluscs in this cozy idle game. Watch larvae grow into stunning adults in real-time, customize vibrant aquatic habitats across 9 themed packs, and discover rare species from garden snails to deep-sea cephalopods.

title: Guilds of Mountgate
description: A living online RPG where economy, progression and world events shape your journey. Build your character, trade, craft and explore a persistent world that evolves over time — whether you are online or not.

title: Bombanana!
description: Bombanana! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?

title: Eldara
description: Eldara is a single-player dark fantasy idle RPG inspired by classic MMORPGs. Train 17 interlocking skills — mining, smithing, fishing, combat, cultivating and more — to hunt monsters across the realm, raid dungeons, and challenge three mythic world bosses. Collect over 100 unique items, complete dozens of achievements, and tame 16 wild pets. Progress continues whether you play actively or step away, with rebirth and prestige systems for the endgame.

title: Divider Dave
description:
Why be alone when you can be by yourself?
Dave wakes up in a facility. He can clone himself. A lot of (almost) identical Daves and a way out that requires all of them.

Divider Dave is a slapstick puzzle-platformer for puzzle fans and casual players alike where cloning yourself is the solution to everything. Launch your clones, stack them, turn them into boxes. Every copy of Dave is a tool, a platform, and a potential sacrifice. He doesn't mind. Probably...

title: Duck Collector
description: Not just luck, a skill-based claw machine with real physics, arcade minigames, and dozens of ducks to collect.

title: Code My Robot Vacuum
description: Code My Robot Vacuum is a game where you learn to code while cleaning! Program your robot vacuum to solve increasingly complex cleaning challenges. Navigate mazes and upgrade your robot's abilities. Perfect for beginners learning to code and puzzle enthusiasts who love logical problem-solving.

title: Staged
description: Staged is a co-op first-person physics party game for 1–4 players. Play mischievous goblins, rebuild stage sets from reference photos, haul oversized props through tight backstage spaces, and get every placement right before the curtain rises.

title: Lost Sanity: Cthulhu
description:
Lost Sanity: Cthulhu is a horror and exploration game where each chapter is a new story.

A group of teenagers get together to tell horror stories, and each story is represented as a chapter of "Lost Sanity."
Starting with the tale of "Cthulhu," a cosmic entity that lies dormant in their city submerged in the sea, occultists gather with the goal of awakening the entity.

You play as Megan Claire, a former reporter, who wakes up in a prison-like place. Your goal is to understand what is happening there and escape as quickly as possible!

title: Cursed Frontier
description: A 2D platformer shooter with a somber linoleum-inspired art style, where you’ll face funeral creatures in a haunting Wild West setting.

title: Slime Well
description: Slime Well is a Metroidvania-style puzzle game where players take control of a slime, skillfully using its abilities to solve puzzles, explore, and ultimately uncover the truth of this world.

title: Fofumia
description: Welcome to Fofumia! Clean up the mess left by the adorable Fofunos - playful, hyperactive one-eyed kittens who love scattering toys and objects everywhere. It's up to you to set everything straight...

title: Galactic Prospectors
description: Galactic Prospectors is a 2D Space Survival Sandbox set 200 years in the future when all planets in the solar system were destroyed by a rogue AI (you can play as the Rogue AI, or as a regular Astronaut out in the universe). Take on the universe against rogue AIs, other humans and other life forms, all while trying to stay alive. Even as an AI if you wish to play as such, you too must survive the harsh elements of Space. Resources are still needed, requiring you to build factories, upgrade and maintain your ships and stations, and to live.

title: Top Check
description: Collect cards, build decks, and battle fierce opponents in Top Check, a roguelike deckbuilder and online collectable card game inspired by the classic game of chess. With many unique pieces and abilities, only the best strategists will emerge victorious. Do you have what it takes to reach the top?

title: Hashire Hebereke: EX
description: Hashire Hebereke: EX is a modern remake of the 1994-released Super Famicom racing action game Hashire Hebereke by SUNSOFT. Players can choose from comical and cute characters like series protagonist Hebe and partake in extreme races across unique stages. While carrying over elements from the original game, it will add a new Time Attack mode, new characters, and new stages, as well as four-person online multiplayer support.

title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
description: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

title: Demon Kingdom
description: Demon Kingdom is a strategy card game with elements of a interactive novel. Rule the kingdom, solve mysteries, build relationships, and defeat your enemies.

title: Category 6
description: Brace yourself for the ultimate open-world survival craft experience. Welcome to a world shattered by the relentless fury of the most colossal hurricane in history. You are thrust into the eye of the storm, tasked with not just enduring, but thriving in the aftermath of nature's wrath.

title: Terminal Error
description: Preyed upon by grotesque experiments, you must find a way out of the research centre alive in this first-person point-and-click horror game. However, to escape, you must first delve hopelessly deeper into the maddening corridors of the facility.

title: He Who Watches
description: Walk on walls. Manipulate gravity. Discover secrets. In this first-person puzzle game, delve deep into an ancient labyrinth of intricate conundrums, seeking an imprisoned god at the centre.

title: Lost and Found: What if I Come and Find It
description: "Lost and found - What if I come and find It" is a first-person narrative game whose story will take you to the depths of working in a great corporation. After finishing your studies, you have achieved an internship in the maintenance department of SilverCup, the most renowned technological company in your city. A unique opportunity which will bring you a promising future.

title: Alderun
description:
Alderun is a free-to-play fantasy strategy RPG that blends real-time strategy with MOBA-style hero combat. Players choose a hero, such as a holy knight, a dark summoner, or a marksman with a wolf companion, then level up, learn skills, and buy gear from merchants while leading an army across a variety of battlegrounds.

Solo modes include defending a fortress against waves of enemies and bosses, building towers to stop an enemy advance, and one-on-one duels in the Arena. In 5v5 matches, teams push three lanes toward the enemy citadel, farm creep camps, and contest a pit boss and runes. Large-scale 10v10 and 20-player battles take place in a frozen valley, where teams capture graveyards and bunkers to push their front line forward.

Matches can be played against AI or real players, with cross-platform multiplayer across PC, mobile, and browser. Players can host public or private games, join friends by code, or use quick match. A map editor is also included.

title: Axolotl Rangefighters
description: A fast-paced 2D local versus fighting game featuring characters from the Axolotl Rangefinders universe. Duel your friends, master unique character combos, and brawl across vibrant pixel art stages to claim victory in intense competitive matchups.

title: Bread Makes the Heart Aflutter: The Baker's First Ball
description: With Autumn comes the annual Autumn Charity Ball, and after Damon learns that Emile's never been to one as a guest he takes it upon himself to invite him personally as his partner, helping him prepare for the night of song and dance.

title: Madzone
description: Madzone is a top-down multiplayer shooter designed for mobile devices. Players unlock a growing roster of fighters, each with their own weapon and special attack, and compete in several objective-based game modes, including free-for-all battle royale, team play in duos and trios with friends. Matches are short, typically lasting under three minutes. Teammates who are knocked down can be revived, and new fighters, maps and modes are added regularly. A large 100-player map is in development.

title: Sail: Evolved Tides
description: Sail: Evolved Tides is a 3D naval roguelike shooter. Set sail into uncharted waters and survive escalating sea battles as you sink enemy ships and defeat deep-sea bosses. Upgrade your warship and use Soul Essence dropped by bosses to unlock a permanent tech tree. Every voyage makes you stronger.

title: Papabile
description: Rome, 1492. The Holy Father is dead. The conclave has been convened. Can you seize the Throne of St. Peter for yourself?

title: Eldermyth
description: Defend a mythical land as ancient beasts in this high-score roguelike. Use powers, weather and land synergy to save villages and stop invaders from colonising the land.

title: Lunokhod
description: A simple retro sci-fi base builder with a socialist twist. Mine resources, build structures, prepare for crisis. Launch the Buran rocket, and usher in a new era of socialist production.

title: Stock Cars Racing
description: Boost. Overtake. Win. Pure adrenaline racing.

title: Cage Grind
description: Cage Grind is a free, browser-based MMA career simulation. Players create a fighter, choose opponents, and set pace, offense, and tactics for simulated bouts decided by knockouts, submissions, or judges’ decisions. Victories earn permanent attribute upgrades, while followers, sponsors, collectible gear, and Aura shape career progression. A shared roster, asynchronous player challenges, world championship bouts, and the Cage Feed connect individual careers. Open Gym offers practice matchups and coaching reports without affecting official records.

title: Match: Isekai Journey
description: Welcome to Match: Isekai Journey—where your "magical destiny" is to align three identical icons before you run out of turns.

title: Magic Shop Simulator
description:
Magic shop simulator: is a first-person, open-world sandbox simulation game where players manage and expand a magical store. The core gameplay revolves around foraging for ingredients, brewing potions, and selling goods to customers. Players can automate their shops daily operations by hiring workers to help handle foraging, brewing potions, and serving customers.

A central mechanic of the game is a risk- and-reward system involving four ward stones that protect the shop from monsters. Players must try to balance the cost between keeping the stones charged, allowing threats into the plaza, so they can gather the materials for their shop, and risking their shops risk reputation.

title: Fillo
description:
Fillo is a browser-based multiplayer word game where a host creates a room and players join with a code. Each round, everyone completes the same fill-in-the-blank prompt. Players score highest by matching exactly one other person, while bigger group matches earn fewer points.
After each round, answers are revealed for reactions, and at the end Fillo awards players based on the room’s funniest, sharpest, and most memorable patterns.

title: Bounty Trail
description: It is the fall of 1881 and your bounty hunting agency is in dire straits. Your no-good partner, Edward Thorne, took out a $10 000 loan and then took off. The debt must be paid by the end of the year so you’ve got no time to waste. Pick a target from the board, mount up, and set out on the Bounty Trail!

title: Explorers of Palan
description: Battle in turns: Gain EXP to become stronger with each victory as you calm agitated creatures. Defeated in battle? Don’t worry — besides recovery skills and items, your companion Feyrie can restore you.

title: Čtyřka
description:
Čtyřka is mariáš – the Czech trick-taking card game – for four players, in the browser against three computer opponents.

The game is usually played two against two, but the partnership is hidden: the forehand picks trumps by naming a card, so only one other player knows whose side they are on, and the rest have to work it out from the play. Around that sits the bidding that can multiply the stake before a card is led.

The game is free to play and installs as an app. It deals every contract the rules allow, keeps the money, speaks the calls aloud, and tells you why a card is not legal – or lets you break the rule on purpose, if you ask it to.

It is a rewrite of the Windows shareware of the same name, released in 1999. The card play is that game's improved AI.

title: Stream Clicker
description: Stream Clicker is a community-driven browser clicker game built around Twitch streamers. Each streamer has their own community page where viewers click together to grow their community, complete timed missions, unlock trophies and compete in global and seasonal leaderboards.

title: Homicide Desk
description: Read the evidence. Run the forensics. Question suspects in your own words, they lie, crack, or lawyer up. Accuse the wrong person, and Internal Affairs comes after you.

title: Corposlop
description: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvesting resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make advanced factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out the limited land you have.

title: Fjordal
description: A Viking colony sim with production chains and resource management. Establish a Norse village and refine the land's resources. Pay tribute to the King, or grow strong enough to fight back.

title: Reliquary
description: Reliquary is a free-to-play online trading card game with over 1,000 cards. Build decks around a hero, summon Reliquaries from your Extra Deck when the board is right, and call forth Incarnates by offering your monsters. Play ranked and quick matches against other players, climb the solo Tower, draft a deck from scratch, challenge friends, and watch or replay duels. Available in nine languages.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Splitfire
description: New dangers emerge and Rainbow Six Siege launches Operation Split Fire to identify these threats. Flying back to his Egyptian homeland to assist, Operator Noor brings his worldly knowledge, tactical acumen, and his Horus Lance gadget, a projectile that can attach on ballistic shields or surfaces and then emit flames!

title: Headrush Arena
description:
Play the fastest, quirkiest VR Shooter on Quest. The AI bots have gone rogue, harvesting humanity’s knowledge and suppressing creativity. Your mission: Join the rebellion, blast the bots and take that knowledge back. Every bot you terminate drops valuable Knowledge-Orbs, absorb them and your head gets bigger, your voice gets higher and then you can jump further. The more knowledge you carry, the more powerful and ridiculous you become... But don’t get greedy: bank your Knowledge-Orbs before the bots take you out and steal them back.

Play solo or multiplayer across Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch and PvE, using shields, shotguns, miniguns, speed boosts and the Hack Gun to turn the arena into chaos. Jump straight into Arcade for pure combat, or play MindTap, where getting eliminated isn’t necessarily the end: Answer a question correctly, choose an upgrade and jump straight back in for revenge. Launching with two arenas, three game modes, an army of increasingly unhinged AI bots and one dangerously oversized head. Destroy the bots. Reclaim the knowledge. Gain super-powers and a massive bonce!

title: BlameChat
description:
BlameChat is a browser-based interactive collection of multiplayer party games played in a shared room. One player hosts and puts a room code on screen; everyone else joins from a phone, tablet, or computer browser. No download or account is required to play.

Most games set the host against everyone else, with the room's move decided by majority vote — the host plays the board while the room votes its reply. Others are played between all participants. Supported player counts range from 2 to 100 depending on the game.

Games include board games such as Chess, Checkers, Connect Four and Battleships; word and guessing games such as Hangman and Spectrum; and social games such as Cards vs Room, Jury Duty and Burn or Bot.

title: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.5: Dreamscape of Wind and Snow
description:
Version 1.5 of Arknights: Endfield includes:
• New Operators: Typhoeus
• New Free Operator Event: Purrchena
• New Weapons: New signature 6★ weapon for Typhoeus
• New Areas: Snowy Forest, Suiming
• New Story Content: New story chapters and missions
• New Systems: RE-Factor Headhunting
• New Events and Rewards

title: Chaos Warrior
description: Chaos Warrior is a retro JRPG inspired by the NES era. Fight deadly monsters, explore dangerous locations, and gain the strength to become the hero that saves the world!

title: Star Trucker: Cultivation Content Pack
description:
The Cultivation Content Pack adds unique trailers, cargo and corporations alongside a brand new business venture led by horticultural specialist Ada Greenway.

Patch delicate domes, keep habitats stocked with nutrients, and monitor your clients' crops as you unlock more than 30 themed customization rewards, including dashboard items, lighting options, palettes, and trims.

title: The Cat in Yellow
description: An adorable cat turns creepy. Take care of it, explore the house, and survive the night.

title: Just a Stupid Room
description: Explore 30 rooms filled with original puzzles in this first-person puzzle game. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious. The door won't open itself.

title: A Girl A Rain
description: After pushing open the door, or perhaps before, the world has transformed. Will you be able to escape this rainstorm? Or will you stay...?

title: Galactum Meridian
description:
Galactum Meridian is a research-first space strategy game about leading humanity’s first deep survey beyond Sol.

Command the ISA Far Horizon, a deep-survey cruiser sent into nearby star systems where the map is incomplete, the data is uncertain, and every discovery changes what comes next. You are not here to paint borders across space with fleets. You are building the first working picture of humanity’s interstellar future.

Galactum Meridian begins with real astronomical structure: nearby stars, confirmed exoplanet data where available, and catalog-backed system information drawn from sources such as the NASA Exoplanet Archive and other astronomy datasets.

But this is not a dry simulator. Known science gives the galaxy its backbone. From there, the game layers survey results, modeled possibilities, strange worlds, and speculative discoveries into systems you can investigate. Galactum Meridian brings in more than 10,000 actual stars from current star catalogs for you to travel to and investigate, updated frequently as new data becomes available.

Some things are observed. Some are inferred from what we know. Some are fictional, mysterious, and waiting for your expedition to discover them.

title: Armada Fighters
description: Armada Fighter is a fast-paced arcade shoot ’em up focused on reflexes, movement, and intense action.

title: Smile Your Day
description: Two Players, Two Perspectives, One Cult. You and a friend explore the opulent cult known as Lifted Spirits in Boston, 2014. One player is the Hacker, controlling the cult's cameras and communications. With their aid, the other player stealths around the office hoping to discover the cult's secrets.

title: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary
description: The breed is back! Celebrate 35 years of Alien Breed with the definitive collection. Featuring 6 classic games, interactive archives, modern controls, visual enhancements, co-op multiplayer, Online Rush Mode and Horde Mode, bringing the complete sci-fi horror legacy back to your screens.

title: Pop Float a-way
description: POP Float a-way is a multiplayer party platformer for up to 8 players where you dash through obstacle-packed tracks by yelling into your mic, knock rivals off course, and try not to pop before you cross the finish line.

title: Not Quite Dead
description: Open world zombie survival Coop game with base building, looting, crafting, vehicles, and exploration

title: Laura Bailey Mysteries
description: Join mystery writer Laura Bailey as she investigates two gripping murder mysteries. Search crime scenes for clues, interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, reconstruct torn notes, and make your final accusation. Includes a murder mystery-themed card game.

title: Vector Surge
description:
Vector Surge is a fast, uncompromising twin-stick arena shooter set inside a reactive signal field. Move, aim, dash and detonate your way through geometric swarms while the grid bends, pulses and fractures around every collision.

Almost everything you see is constructed live. Ships, enemies, projectiles, formations, effects, grid reactions and combat patterns are drawn from procedural vector geometry rather than conventional sprite sheets. Encounters remix enemy families, elites, hazards and formations on the fly. In Universe mode, procedural objectives, loot, mutations, routes and escalating sector conditions turn that same arena into a long-form expedition that is different every time you enter it.

There are no safe corners. Your multiplier is always fading. The best score is always one riskier kill away.

title: Dvor
description: A falling-block puzzle game rooted in Soviet aesthetics. Lock concretes into a living facade as the seasons turn and the music shifts with them. Dvor means courtyard – the place where Soviet children played, where life happened. The version the falling blocks game always deserved.

title: Plushy Store Tidy Up
description:
Turn a messy plushy store into a cozy little world of perfectly organized cuddly toys!

In Plushy Store Tidy Up, every plushy has a place but figuring out exactly where everything belongs is up to you. Pick up plushies, carry and organize them, solve satisfying shelf puzzles, and gradually restore the entire store.

As you tidy your way through the store, you'll discover new plushies, encounter trickier layouts, unlock new areas, and improve your abilities to make organizing faster and more satisfying.

title: Woolmates
description: Two balls of wool, one thread, one big adventure! Jump, swing and puzzle your way together through more than 50 interwoven levels — in co-op or multiplayer.

title: The Death Game Report
description: Identify how every participant in the death game died, and submit your report.

title: Dub Together
description: Up to six players redub video clips and give them a whole new meaning. You record the scene, then watch every result together and vote. With voice effects, a built-in clip editor and live voting from your Twitch chat.

title: Gun Shop: Tidy Up
description: Gun Shop: Tidy Up — a tidy-up simulator where you need to put more than 2,700 items back in their places. Pick up, arrange, upgrade and just relax while restoring order in a gun shop.

title: Launch Them All
description: A high-stakes turn-based missile duel where every shot matters. Spy, bluff, and deploy powerful tactical abilities to destroy enemy military assets while avoiding civilian casualties. Casual strategy in an approachable, classic style!

title: Insurance Fraud
description: A blackjack roguelike where hands pay for their shape, not just their total. Build absurd combos from upgrades and cards that have no business in a deck, then take five dealers for everything they’ve got. The insurance is not entirely legal.

title: Absolution
description: Absolution is a full 3D first-person adventure game where story, graphics, animation, sound and original music intertwine to put a spell on you as you immerse yourself in the non-linear gameplay, with captivating environments and interesting characters. The characters in the game do indeed want absolution, from an unfavourable past where tinkering with the unknown has given birth to the "Entropy", an uncontrollable vortex. As the main character asks for your help, you are confronted with a giant theme park guitar that has been ripped apart, while the Entropy pulsates dangerously in the background. Your only transport between the islands is an old hoverflyer that barely holds together, but it swiftly takes you on the adventure in discovering seven islands and the mysteries they pose. Along the journey, you will meet live action characters that are haunted by their own past, and as you slowly learn their oddities, they may indeed choose to help you.

title: First Light
description: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

title: Digital Survivor
description: A neon bullet-heaven survivors roguelite. Outrun the swarm as 4 hunted programs, forge 20 weapons into ultimate forms, master build-defining synergies, raid extraction vaults, climb leaderboard seasons — and face ROOT, the administrator that wants you deleted.

title: Unnamed Pogo Game
description: Trapped in a surreal world, your only way out is to bounce your way to the top. Master brutal physics, survive impossible obstacles, and face the climb alone or with friends in this unforgiving pogo-stick challenge. One bad landing is all it takes to lose it all. Can you reach the peak?

title: Aerial_Knight's MrFreezy
description: Play as a woman who's an axe-wielding serial killer in this light-hearted puzzle game about decapitating men, uncover the disturbing story behind New Detroit’s infamous serial killer, Mr. Freezy.

title: Monke Survivor
description: You are a Monke beating up endless waves of office workers with brutal melee combat and ragdoll physics. Smash props for rare buffs, stack game-breaking items and compete on the Global Leaderboards in this aggressive action-roguelite.

title: Salvation: Echoes of War
description: Explore a haunting purgatory in this third-person stealth adventure. Injured and trapped in a nightmare after war, solve puzzles, outsmart enemies, and rely on your loyal companion to find a way back to life. Can you escape your past and survive the echoes of war?

title: NoodlePunk
description: Forced into a corporate-mandated work program, you must run a noodle shop in a dying cyberpunk city to pay off your crushing debt. Prepare orders fast, manage your ingredients, and upgrade your operation while keeping up with relentless customer drones.

title: Bojan
description: You think you have it bad? Try getting thrown into a quest with nothing to protect yourself, except your wits! In this trial and error adventure game, patience is key. Explore the castle including 6* bosses and 18 levels complete with their own layouts, enemy paths, buttons, doors and coins!

title: Carol and the Bells: A Cozy Strategy Game
description: Carol and the Bells is a cozy, turn-based strategy roguelike Minesweeper-style game played on a grid. Build a deck to shape what appears on the board, manage risk, and decide when to ring the bell and move on.

title: Cute Country
description: You can build your own royal city. With over 100+buildings and massive home decorations, create an unparalleled kingdom. There are many mysterious races in the alternate world, and you can recruit humans, elves, beasts, or even rarer demons, dragons, etc. to build your kingdom together.

title: Dreamscapes
description: Investigate six haunted properties and listen to the voices of spirits trapped in nightmares. Collect fragmented clues and discover the correct combination of names, locations, and vessels. A multi-ending horror adventure where the outcome changes depending on your choices during the ritual.

title: Dimension Defenders
description: Tower Defense Redefined. Race friends in ranked 1v1, defend together in 2-player co-op, or solo your way through dimensions of escalating chaos.

title: Fleet Hunters
description: Find and sink battleships in a fast grid-based duel with real-time firing and retro visuals.

title: Monster Ops 22
description: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

title: Venera 31
description: Collect soil on Venus. Photograph the surface. Mark every rock. Log any unusual rock as harvester. Do not keep looking at it

title: Steelarchy
description: Steelarchy is a 3rd-person vehicle combat roguelike centered on deep loadouts. Face off against a modular fortress of rigid steel in explosive, chaotic battles. With deep meta-progression and shifting enemy tactics, no two matches are the same. Build. Customize. Upgrade. Embrace the carnage.

title: Zad Archery
description: Shoot down waves of targets, collect their loot, and grow stronger through upgrades and skills in this endlessly expanding incremental game.

title: Pix Football Manager
description: PIX Football Manager is a nostalgic, casual football management simulator focused on scouting. Set your tactics, find hidden gems, and improve your facilities as you build a dynasty. With no visible player stats, you must spot talent yourself. Grab your clipboard, the game starts now.

title: Crimson Moon
description: A gothic action-adventure RPG of violent angels and dead gods.

title: WheelMates
description: Dive into a 2-player co-op driving adventure with RC cars. With Friend’s Pass, your friend joins for free. Explore the professor’s home laboratory, solve puzzles, find hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside.

title: Critical Descent
description: Master the high-stakes catch of the SpaceX Starship! Execute precise maneuvers to stick the landing in the tower’s arms, complete missions, compete on global leaderboards, and race your own ghost for the best time in Critical Descent.

title: Roadside Reseal
description: A roadside store where the night never feels safe. Flickering lights, endless aisles, whispers from the dark. Each task feels like research into fear—you restock, you lock, you fight to keep the seal closed.The silence breaks, the air is heavy, and every moment is research into survival.

title: Fatberg
description: You, a lowly janitor, have been forced to go into the sewers to remove blockages that will cause a flood. But the inhabitants of this dark, slimy, stinking, writhing underworld do not like to be disturbed and will not let you leave alive.

title: Angry Chef World Tour
description: A fast paced mix of solitaire, mahjong, and match puzzles where explosive chefs challenge you to survive chaotic global kitchens.

title: Sol Protocol
description: Sol Protocol is a VR coop Action Roguelike that allows you to physically pilot and manage a spaceship through dangerous stellar systems.

title: Agebringer
description: The Crimson Core has been stolen. The end of the world draws near. The thief hides high atop the Infinity Tower. Gather your courage, take up your weapons... The Red Crusade has begun.

title: Tales of Fear: Episode Zero
description: Can you tell the difference between reality and tale? Experience three short horror stories and gather clues as to which are true and which are just part of our imagination. Immerse yourself in the protagonist's perspective and discover eerie tales from around the world.

title: 8AM: The Warehouse
description: "8AM: The Warehouse" is a suspense game set in a massive distribution center late at night. Monitor security cameras as strange incidents occur among the remaining workers — and decide if it’s exhaustion, system error, or something lurking between the shelves until 8:00 a.m.

title: Craft. Sell. Goblin. Repeat.
description: Build and manage your own goblin shop! Craft unique weapons and negotiate their prices! Send out explorers in to gather resources and become the richest merchant in the kingdom!

title: We Are Gum
description: A puzzle game about goofy alien bubble gum trying to find their way home. They move together because they're aliens. They stick to things because they're bubble gum. They're silly and goofy because they're alien bubble gum! Don't question the science.

title: Quetzal
description: Control a Mesoamerican god who must escape the underworld in this challenging 2D pixel art platformer, dodging dangers to recover the sacred bones of humanity.

title: DreamHero
description: DreamHero is an overhead action-adventure game focusing on hero capture and diverse combat. Players can turn defeated enemies into controllable heroes, experiencing single-player stories, Roguelike, 1V1, 5V5, 20-player battle royales, and cooperative dungeons, blending strategy and operational fun.

title: Atomic Age
description: Criminal case in the cabaret stage Atomic Age, a comedic, retro-futuristic 2D point & click adventure in the shape of the 50th and 60th years

title: Wartheon
description: Wartheon is a fast-paced 2D roguelike adventure set in a world on the brink of elemental collapse. Take control of one of four unique champions to match your taste. Customize your build, master your skills, and adapt to ever-changing layouts and enemy patterns.

title: Grail
description: In this deckbuilder your deck fights for you. Upgrade, enchant and stickerize your cards to create clever cascading effects that defeat monsters and other players. Can you reach the Grail?

title: Deck & Conn
description: Take command of a nuclear-powered space corvette in a Cold War-flavored sci-fi campaign. Balance tactics, crew, and limited resources in a dynamic forever-war. Retro pixel art meets deep strategy fifteen minutes into the future of 1989.

title: Out Of Water
description: OUT OF WATER is a visual novel about survival, myths, love, and choice. In 1 CE Watarholt, a quiet village prepares for winter - until bodies begin to surface. Shape your path through bonds, ancient horrors, and a fading peace. Will you fight, plead, or surrender to the waters?

title: Dying Reign
description: Disease spreads across your lands, destabilizing regions, draining your resources, and testing your authority. Quarantine cities, draft troops, balance fear and order… but every choice comes at a cost. Hold the line for as long as you can. There is no victory, only survival…

title: OneMore
description: Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.

title: Bloomon
description: As the Agriculture Department's chosen (unlucky) one, you dreamed of graduating through farming. Instead, you're put in charge of a magical farm that attracts wild Bloomon raves. Now farming, fending off creatures, and handling quirky NPCs is your new normal.

title: Writer Tycoon
description: Become a bestselling author in Writer Tycoon! Write books, grow your fanbase, and dominate the publishing industry. Track sales, manage multiple books at once, and adapt to trends. Will you create literary masterpieces or chase quick cash? Become a bestselling author and leave your mark!

title: Zombie Must Dead!
description: "Zombie Must Dead!" is a game that combines tower defense and FPS elements. Players must continuously fend off waves of zombies, upgrade their weapons, and strive to survive as long as possible.

title: Being a DIK: Season 3
description: Continue your story, deepen your relationships, and experience more songs, mini-games, achievements, and girls in this highly anticipated DLC.

title: Velhodium Isle
description: Velhodium Isle is a pixel-art boomer shooter in which you fight monsters in themed locations. Use weapons and magic to get through crowds of monsters and close the source of apocalyptic terrors. Disable shields, close the anomaly, and survive the brutal slaughter!

title: Masters of Mayhem
description: Masters of Mayhem is a free-to-play social deduction game with roguelike twists for 4–15 players. Work together to restore abandoned facilities and contain terrifying monsters — unless you're an impostor, in which case… have fun unleashing mayhem!

title: Leafblade
description: The coziest mix of ARPG and monster tamer. Fight along the Mons you meet in your adventure to recover the bond between humans and Mons. Take care of your Mons in your farm, improving their combat and farm skills while ensuring their happiness.

title: Gravitaws
description: Gravitaws is a retro-style stage shooter inspired by Jaws (NES). Explore a dynamic overworld map. Collect research materials and upgrades, while evading an Alien invader. The story is delivered in classic style cutscenes. Fight bosses, survive, collect, fish, and bomb your way to victory.

title: Devil's Liminal
description: DEVIL'S LIMINAL is a branching slow-burn horror and yuri romance visual novel. In a life of poverty and violence, Margo Silva has one last summer in Arizona before college. Make choices to maintain a normal facade at work, romance an enigmatic new girl, and stop the occult plot to take Margo's life.

title: Hifuu Bouenkyou
description: A turn-based tactical RPG set in Gensokyo. Renko and Merry are separated the moment they stumble into this strange land. Build a party from a wide Touhou cast, raise them freely through Reincarnation and added skills, and follow a story that branches into three routes.

title: Cognition Method
description: Cognition Method is a story-driven, first-person puzzle game inspired by Space Odyssey 2001 and Solaris. Discover an innovative mechanics of altering gravity and dive into the surreal setting. Find your way within a mysterious artifact and unveal a non-ordinary story.

title: Mutagenic
description: Mutagenic is a rogue-lite with simple controls, yet engaging mechanics. The rules are simple: mutate, kill, collect, unlock, die. Repeat. Kill monsters, collect mutagen, spend mutagen to upgrade characters. Mutagen is not permanent, how will you spend it?

title: The Inn Between
description: A modern fantasy BL Visual Novel following a young mans journey into a parallel world to recover the past he's lost, and find his missing family. Alongside 3 attractive romance options, Myka Riley delves into the unknown.

title: Adventure Land: The Code MMORPG
description: Adventure Land is an experimental Indie MMORPG. ANYONE can Code not just one, but up to 4 characters! You can play manually, use the given default Code, or learn programming to do more! Going open-source at 50,000 installs!

title: Starwalker
description: Starwalker is a space-exploration survival rpg focused on surviving a massive alien invasion on planet Earth. You'll be able to explore the solar system and beyond. You are the last human standing - ready to start a new life.

title: Vinera
description: Vinera MMORPG is a 2D top-down multiplayer online role-playing game. Experience classic open-world exploration, character progression, questing, and real-time combat in a nostalgic 2D fantasy world.

title: You Weren't Invited
description: Investigate a murder. Romance five women. But trust carefully: one of them is the killer.

title: Jelly Sprint
description: Guide a wobbly jelly runner across sky-high tracks, squeeze through gates, collect gems, and grow big enough to smash through the finish in a bright PC arcade runner.

title: Overprint
description: Survive the night shift at a possessed print shop. You pick your tool, clock in at 10 PM, and mow down waves of printer's devils until the morning edition ships at 6 AM. You level up, evolve your arsenal, get PRINTED or get PULPED. A roguelike bullet heaven where ink runs. So should you.

title: Promised Harvest
description:
Promised Harvest is a catch-the-dark game where your objective is to collect as much food as possible that falls from the sky, thus increasing your score! However, it won't be so easy! There are rotten foods and enemies that will hinder you, so keep an eye out for each one!

Choose your harvester and start harvesting!

title: Minimon: Tiny Idle Tactics
description: A tiny monster-taming auto-battler that lives in the corner of your screen, and they never stop grinding. Catch 90 Minimon, build busted team comps, and rake in loot while you work, browse, or play something else entirely. They battle. You profit.

title: Steelborn: Tank Idle RPG
description: Gear up for tank battles in Steelborn: Tank Idle RPG, the ultimate build your tank game! Equip your warrior tank and duke it out in world of warriors duels as you explore dungeons and win big in the PVP arena.

title: BeatChip '95
description: You find a beat up old PC in a hidden room with an arcane piece of music software. Can your beats lead you to success? Create tapes, get cash and upgrade your setup against the clock in this offbeat music-making simulator

title: Headspace Reverie
description:
Explore the end of the World through a decaying virtual space.

Do you feel like something isn't quite right with the World? Do you feel a crippling sense of unease weighting you down a little bit more every day? Do you wanna scream for no particular reason? Do you look around and feel like everyone is doing okay except you? Are you a prisoner in your own head, with everything piling up with no way to prevent this?

This is the future, and it is terrifying.

title: Trick or Freak
description:
You spend the night of Halloween at a monster party and are involved in a game of truth or dare with four handsome monsters ! With your actions and answers, you can earn their favors and by the end of the game, conquer their hearts.

However, be careful... Who knows what monsters might do to some reckless human...

title: Dungeon Bucko
description: Dungeon Bucko is a retro styled dungeon crawler an homage to games like Dungeon Master. Based on Amiya Aranha's community. It was created for the 2026 Buckojam and turned into a full release.

title: Blast Horizon
description: A single-player arcade-style shoot 'em up focused on precise positioning and dodging. Players face waves of enemies approaching from multiple directions, collect energy dropped by foes to temporarily slow time, and use bombs to clear the screen when overwhelmed. Includes a practice mode and emphasizes score-based replayability.

title: Agile Cube
description: In Agile Cube, you control a cube. You jump across platforms. You reach the portal. That's it, but the challenge is in the timing, the spacing, and getting better each time.

title: Last Pill Bar
description: A virus is spreading. You can't afford to pickle everyone. Keep the bar open and decide who gets pickled before the outbreak decides who dies.

title: Zenonia
description: Remember the RPG that defined a generation? ZENONIA is back—faithfully restored and now on Steam. Relive the adventure that kept you playing for hours, or experience it for the first time.

title: Words Of Power
description:
Words Of Power is a fill-in-the-blank roguelike deckbuilder. Travel deep into the dungeon and fight using the power of words. Construct sentences of devastating power and rewrite your foes.

Rewrite reality one sentence at a time!

title: The Dream Of Winning The Lottery
description: Find clues to lucky numbers through prophetic dreams and various events, then buy lottery tickets each week. Keep chasing the jackpot and fulfill your dream in this simple 2D point-and-click lottery simulation game.

title: Slaymeji: Roguelite Desktop Survivor
description: Build a ring of weapons and fight through 25 waves in a 2D fantasy bullet heaven. Prefer to watch? Let Auto Mode take over. Outside the arena, your hunter lives on your desktop and turns completed to-dos into permanent game progress.

title: Tails & Trails
description: Explore cozy 3D worlds, follow the trails, solve playful puzzles, and photograph every hidden cat you can find.

title: Isle of Flesh
description: Short retro horror game inspired by H. P. Lovecraft’s “Dagon.” Focused on atmosphere and story.

title: Fading Reality
description: Tormented by the disappearance of his wife Emily, Thomas returns to an abandoned place where reality and nightmares begin to blur.

title: The Wickers House
description: An atmospheric first-person horror game. You wake up after a road accident. Before you stands a house where you thought you could find help. But this house is a trap for those who dare enter...

title: Neon Howl
description: Neon Howl is a fast-paced neon arcade shooter featuring a campaign, bosses, Boss Rush and Anomalies.

title: Cloud Runner
description: Cloud Runner is a casual First Person 3D platformer that tests your skills with relaxing fun levels and arenas. Collect coins to boost your speed and multiply your combo.

title: Nexus: Quantum Industries
description: A sci-fi incremental about industrializing the universe, collapsing it into Stardust, and rebuilding stronger. Automate twelve tiers of impossible machines, chart a finite galaxy, draft run-changing Cosmic Laws, light five constellations, and descend into the endless Abyss

title: Stillflow
description: Rotate minimalist lines and connect every port across 100 calm, handcrafted puzzles.

title: Flashpaper
description: You are the unseen hand — the resistance's digital arm inside a regime that has begun burning books. Crack the Concord's networks from a green-phosphor terminal, cover every log you touch before the trace fills, and get paid off-grid. 24 missions. Three you are not meant to win.

title: Leapbound
description: A precision platformer where every jump matters. Master a fixed-height jump, avoid deadly falls, and descend through five floors filled with dangerous challenges.

title: Tidewrack
description: A few logs, one harpoon, no land in sight. Pull driftwood from the sea, turn your raft into a floating town, and rise from lone survivor to leader of a colony. Dive to the ocean floor. Raiders strike at night, sharks circle, and somewhere out there, a leviathan is waiting.

title: Long Dives
description: Sink a mining outpost into the deep and keep it growing while you're away. Dive through ten depths, automate everything, decode the Archive, and strike covenants with the dark. A layered idle-incremental with 50 achievements, full offline progress, illustrated in pixel-art.

title: Grave New World
description: A tactical Tetris roguelike set in a dark Lovecraftian world. Build a powerful deck of shape cards, outsmart the undead, and master fast-paced runs where every piece can change the battlefield.

title: Fantasy Miner: Idle Depths
description: Dig for ore, discover new resources, smelt ingots, and unlock hundreds of upgrades in this fantasy mining idle game. Mine faster, dig deeper, and watch your progress grow.

title: Potential Man
description: Potential Man is a role-playing experience where you must navigate the whims and woes of a humble seed. This wacky story features fully hand-drawn visuals, zany characters, and a classic JRPG-styled soundtrack to boot. Are you ready to achieve your true potential?

title: Fenrir
description: The Nine Worlds are crumbling. Fenrir is free. Build your warrior from hundreds of items, master a deep build system, and fight your way through Midgard to Asgard — before the beast devours everything.

title: Gathera
description: Gather materials to craft and craft to gather more materials! Open new locations to explore the world, build a cozy home and decorate it with your collections. Build manufacture to optimize gathering and crafting. Survive against the monster raids if you want!

title: Bloodbath
description: Bloodbath is a suspense and investigation game with elements of horror, in which you take on the role of an operator responsible for controlling an android.

title: Luminous Jigsaw Puzzles
description:
Step away from the noise of the world and enter the enchanting realms of Luminous Ages. This isn't just a puzzle game; it’s a journey through a vibrant multiverse brought to life by the breathtaking, hand-illustrated gallery of renowned fantasy creator Anthony Christou.

Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere of magic and myth. Whether you are piecing together a majestic dragon or a celestial horoscope, you’ll find a serene sanctuary designed to spark wonder. From the first piece to the final click, experience the satisfying glow of vibrant colours and hidden details emerging under your fingertips.

title: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
description: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

title: Until North Ends
description: Explore a fantasy themed open world. Together with your friends or alone build your safe haven to craft gear, prepare equipment, refine resources to go on a journey. Visit different biomes, fight enemies, gather resources, plunder dungeons or caves and obtain loot!

title: Unsolved Case: Whispers of Elderwick - Collector’s Edition
description: A killer hides behind familiar faces. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and expose the conspiracy tearing the village apart before fear consumes it whole.

title: Cherry Blossom
description: The game "Cherry blossom" is about a cute little bear who went to save a wise tree from darkness.

title: Edge of Evil
description: Edge of Evil is a first-person psychological horror game with a focus on story and exploration. Solve puzzles, meet interesting characters and unwrap and ancient mystery in this game of terror where an ancient seal has been broken upon entering a locked crypt and now the shadows of darkness have been unleashed into the mortal world.

title: Young Suns
description:
Young Suns is a narrative-driven life sim for one to four players set in the Jovian System, where the people of Jupiter have just broken free from corporate control. Entrusted with your own spaceship, you fly to fantastical moonlets, derelict ruins, and converted space stations, alone or with up to three friends, salvaging broken furniture, clothing, and tools to repair and keep, gift, or donate to the common good. Along the way, you build relationships with a cast of 30 characters and help the different Jovian factions rebuild society, in a story with a radically optimistic outlook that focuses on the work that comes after liberation.

Your ship doubles as your home, and it can be painted, furnished, and rearranged solo or with friends using the recipes, souvenirs, and items collected on your travels. Your character’s appearance can be changed at any time, tools can be upgraded to take on harder jobs, and the ship itself can be expanded. The story continues to evolve over time, with the world changing in response to the actions of the player base.

title: Vibe City Islands Architect
description: The mayor has given you a budget; people need housing, jobs, parks. The city needs a tourism boost, now! It's actually a chill game.. 10 gangs, each with their own radio station. Build for the city, or for your favourite gang.......... You are the architect.

title: Pyro
description: An exciting 2D action platformer where you control crazy pyrotechnics, face frantic challenges, and create epic explosions while testing your skills and reflexes at every level.

title: Fantasy Waifu Collector
description: Fantasy Waifu Collector is an exciting game about collecting "Waifu" in order to build an army to build a town and restore the world from decay! Players will recruit many different characters as they explore a fascinating world filled with monsters. Defeat the Demon King to win, right?

title: Go Up
description: How high can you go? Find out in this Cookie Clicker inspired journey that never stops. Collect golden dust to unlock new skills to go up even faster. Keep your game running so you don't go down. Compete with your friends and the world to ascend to the greatest heights.

title: LA: Streets of Sorcery
description: A detective visual novel where magic, sex, and comedy collide: solve cases, duel wizards, and flirt with danger.

title: Wonders of Waldwea
description: Take on the role of a struggling museum's curator who receives a mysterious challenge to identify artifacts from the ancient civilizations of Waldwea. Dive through a broad range of academic texts in order to identify the artifact's culture and the era it was produced in. Will you save the museum?

title: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!

title: Housekeeper: Anomaly
description: Scavenge abandoned apartments, cut on broken glass, fight anomalies, trade with the merchants, deceive them into buying bad products and most importantly - try to stay alive and care about yourself!

title: Automon Arena
description: Capture creatures with trash bags and scrap your way to the top! Automon Arena is a fast auto-battler where you bag wild animals and fight other kids until only one survives!

title: Spell Magic
description: Craft, cast, and master magical spells using mathematical concepts. Explore, battle, and solve puzzles in a thrilling adventure that combines arithmetic, geometry, and algebra with fast-paced action and strategy.

title: Deadline Savior
description: This idle RPG adventure is based on the "Pomodoro Technique." Complete focused work sessions to advance your character's exploration. To reclaim the Goddess's Hourglass and restore peace, the hero must defeat the evil dragon "Procrastination" and its minions. The world’s fate is in your hands!

title: Idiots In The Das
description: Idiots in the DAS is a 2D platformer combined with a turn-based RPG with a particular sense of humor that mocks internet old and new culture and a battle style that focuses a lot on Hit or Miss and gradual HP loss.

title: Behind the Sword
description: Behind the Sword is a fresh take on the turn-based strategy genre, featuring a fast-paced approach to conquering the world.

title: Aegis Force: The Scorian War
description: Aegis Force is a single player, story-driven, strategy RPG (SRPG) that has an engaging grid-based tactical combat system. It is designed in a breathtaking 2.5d pixel art style. Players can recruit for and customize their party, using gameplay that includes full world and town exploration.

title: Maestro's Cold War 2
description: Revive the Cold War in this simple yet effective strategy game, offering depth and great replayability.

title: The Adventurers
description: The Adventurers is a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision shapes your legacy. Lead your party of heroes in an open world filled with random events that affect your story. Survive a high fantasy landscape where your epic saga is waiting to be written.

title: Project Reignition
description: Project Reignition is an on-rails platformer developed by KumaPauZ. This unofficial remake of Sonic and the Secret Rings, originally developed by Sonic Team and published by SEGA in 2007 for the Wii, aims to bring the classic game to modern systems.
