Built using the Godot engine, this free and open-source project features enhanced graphics, refined controls, and a smoother frame rate, offering a fresh experience while staying true to the original.

title: Lady Death Demonicron
description: Lady Death Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword slicing, magic wielding, 15 level, multiplayer beat-em-up that takes the best aspects of the 1990's arcade classics - all mixed together with a killer 90's industrial-metal soundtrack!

title: Tokyo Desire: Deck Builders
description: "Tokyo Desire" takes the deck-building roguelike genre in a bold and innovative direction, inviting players to weave their own narratives deep within the neon-lit depths of Tokyo.

title: JunkTok: Paranormal Investigators Challenge
description: Another 3-player co-op horror slop. But it’s set in 2016, baby!

title: XR22-Seaguard
description: XR22-Seaguard is a PC and VR game that reimagines the classic grid-based game of Battleship. This immersive PC and VR game puts you in the heart of a dynamic 3D industrial environment, where you'll strategically place and sink ships using state-of-the-art weapons and defenses.

title: Breathedge 2
description: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

title: Super Night Riders S1
description: A full remake of the 2016 retro-inspired checkpoint arcade racer Super Night Riders.

title: Just Open the Door
description: Just Open The Door is an incremental idle game where you open doors to earn money. Buy faster workers, unlock powerful upgrades and automate the entire process as endless doors keep spawning. Simple. Satisfying. Weirdly addictive.

title: Eat Not, Want Not
description: You're allergic but so hungry... can you really trust this guy?

title: Get Upstairs
description:
Have you ever had the urge to run upstairs after turning off all the lights? Did you pretend something was going to "get you" if you weren't quick enough?

Anyway, here is a short game about turning off all the lights before heading upstairs.

title: MSO FreeCell Arena
description: Multiplayer FreeCell — same deal, every player, race to solve. Live leaderboards, daily challenges, head-to-head rivalries. Free to download and play, no ads. Free for everyone during beta; the competitive layer becomes an optional subscription later. One flat tier, no microtransactions.

title: Unbaitable
description: After fishing becomes outlawed by the Fish Protection Bureau, a young fisher decides to continue the sport and illegally fish.

title: Grey Cloaks of Aron: The Sleeping Village
description: A story-driven 2D detective adventure set in a mysterious medieval village, where two royal investigators are sent to solve a seemingly ordinary missing-person case that quickly takes a stranger turn. Explore the village, question its inhabitants, investigate crime scenes, and piece together clues to uncover the secrets behind the mysterious events, either alone or in local co-op.

title: Legends of China: Chang'e Flies to the Moon - Collector's Edition
ValkyrieRecomp
description: A native PC recompilation project for Valkyrie Profile.

title: My Fire Is Bigger Than Yours
description: Grow a tiny fire until it's bigger than the Sun! A short incremental game about throwing things into a fire, starting a cult, experimenting with builds, and creating chaotic chain reactions.

title: Banana Kingdom
description: An addictive retro strategy simulation! Simple rules with deep strategy. A powerful, highly flexible map editor. Built by a developer who has sunk countless hours into strategy games, with one concept in mind: the perfect companion for an immortal life.

title: Keywraith
description: An arcade typing game where enemies drift down carrying words. The first letter you press locks onto the most urgent matching enemy and every letter after that fires at it, so choosing a target and typing are the same action. Some enemies change what typing the word requires: one must be typed backwards, one re-rolls its word until you commit, one splits in two when destroyed, and one erases all your progress on a single wrong key. Three paces, six handcrafted levels with a boss, and a daily challenge shared by every player. Free, no ads, no account needed, and it needs a physical keyboard.

title: Word Quest Nature
description: Find your calm. Discover the wild.

title: I Thought I Knew You
description: A coming-of-age yuri visual novel set in a university. Players take on the role of a female protagonist and deepen their relationships with three girls. The game features a multi-ending format where the story branches based on the player's choices.

title: Tank Odyssey
description:
Enter fast-paced tank arenas where sharp movement and quick decisions are the keys to survival. Fight relentless enemies, switch between four distinct weapons and take on a new challenge in every level - hunt for hidden keys, capture zones, complete time trials and more!

Battle through 20 increasingly difficult levels across the Arcade, Void, Paper and Distort arenas, then test your skills in four objective-free Endless modes. Stay mobile, master every weapon and survive the chaos in Tank Odyssey.

title: Fortune Factory
description: Fortune Factory is a luck‑based game where you create dice, sell crates, upgrade your factory and slowly build your fortune. Roll the perfect crate to win — or progress step by step. It’s just you and your luck.

title: Fablewood Chronicles
description:
Fablewood Chronicles is an idle strategy game about a civilization of moveable regions that keeps running whether or not you are watching it.

You buy a region and put it somewhere. Every region type reaches a certain distance, so two placed within reach of each other open a road between them. Money cannot improve that road. It improves because people walk it, and a worn road is faster and kinder to the traveller on it. Wear enough of them in and the lines stop being lines: roads bundle into trunks, crossings collapse into junctions, and highways curve between the places your people actually go. Drag the two regions apart and the road between them is lost permanently.

title: Ball Boy Simulator
description: A first-person lost-item exploration simulator set in a Japanese high school baseball club. Search for missing baseballs while enduring the strict hierarchy and unreasonable treatment from coaches and upperclassmen.

title: Don't Drop The Cake
description: Let's deliver a cake to our customer. To reach them, you must traverse a space filled with monstrous creatures. If fear makes you tremble or you drop the cake in panic, you'll face the customer's wrath. This challenge isn't for cowards. Only the brave and composed will succeed. Are you up for it?

title: Resonance
description: Wield your telekinetic voice in Resonance, a short twin-stick top-down action game. Sweep away enemies, raise and hurl objects, use them as a shield, and escape the dark facility trying to contain your powers.

title: The Delivery Guy
description:
A short psx styled horror game by Unfall Games

You are a broke guy that would take any job to pay his cat's food (and rent).

One day you read about a pizza place that is searching their new delivery guy, the owner of the place has reported that he had to hire 3 delivery guys in the last month only, and that they have never returned. So you decide to send your rèsumé to that place without expecting anything, but during a boring evening...

The place is known for having some strange customers and workers, also, it's the only place in town that makes deliveries at night, but you decide to take the job, the pay seems good and you really need that.

You tell yourself that there is nothing to worry and that nothing will happen to you, but unfortunately... You couldn't have been more wrong...

title: Heroes of Lust and Magic
description: A fantasy idle RPG where desire powers the world. Recruit dangerous companions, cross fractured realms, outmaneuver rival factions, and uncover the truth behind the vanished goddess Amura.

title: Eternal Levels
description: Explore and survive in this 2D game set in the urban legend of the backrooms, with a wealth of objects, entities, levels, and sublevels at your disposal. Will you be able to survive and escape, or will you be trapped forever in this new reality?

title: World Sweeper
description: Each build starts with one unique skill. You have a flag limit. Tap right-click to flag. Hold right-click for skills. Level up to rank skills, steal others, or stack bonuses.

title: Pawned Souls
description: Pawned Souls is a 3D soulslike action game mixed with chess, where players control a pawn fighting hostile pieces bound by strict chess movement through real-time sword combat, precision parries, and spatial positioning.

title: Insectorama
description: A mobile rogue-lite about defeating bugs and collecting upgrades with a Kirby Pinball inspiration

title: Volatility
description: You are a PnL number on a Bloomberg-style terminal. Nothing more. Deep in debt to the creditor whose money you now trade, you read the filings, build the thesis, and work the whole desk — equities, options, futures, bonds, FX, swaps — to trade your way out. Or you don't.

title: Tame Me Hard!
description: Take on the role of a female adventurer with debts to pay in this side-scrolling dungeon crawler. Head into different types of dungeons to encounter various creatures. Fight them, capture and train them, then sell them for profit. Pay off your debt before time runs out!

title: My Friendly Little Island Deluxe
description: A sunny little island, a handful of new friends, and all the coconuts you can carry.

title: Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark
description:
Beasts of the Sea, Soaring through the Skies!
Shoot 'em up arcade classics Flying Shark and Fire Shark together at last!

title: Frogborne: New Lands
description: A colorful adventure awaits!

title: Imperial Knights
description: Become an imperial knight to reclaim your family's honor and discover what drove your sister to abandon her country!

title: Skullchef
description: Skullchef: The Wooden Soup — a cozy idle clicker. Stir the magical cauldron, summon quirky helpers, collect hundreds of charm skins, and ascend through prestige. Relaxing ASMR vibes, daily missions, achievements and global leaderboards. English & Spanish. By SmallCreek.

title: DK64: Rekongpiled
description: DK64: Rekongpiled is a native PC port of the classic N64 title, built from the same developers behind the popular Donkey Kong 64 Randomizer.

title: Backfools
description: One ordinary moment, you suddenly find yourself lost in a strange and unfamiliar place. There, you encounter the beings who inhabit it. Backfools is a first-person adventure game.

title: Formic Fortress
description: Formic Fortress is a local co-op tower defense party game with rogue-like elements. Scavenge and throw blocks to build your anthill and fend off waves of nasty bugs! Protect your queen, survive the swarm, and unleash the dormant strength of your ammo through powerful upgrades resetting every run.

title: Pirate Havoc
description: Unleash Chaos on the High Seas

title: Push and Pull
description: The Push and Pull is a co-op only puzzle platformer about playing as two dualistic bunnies.

title: Every Step Has a Sound
description: An atmospheric horror puzzle game where an independent programmer answers a request from a gold mining company and finds himself alone inside mysterious caves hiding dangerous secrets

title: Last Term, First Love
description: Last Term, First Love is a dating-focused visual novel where you balance romance, academics, and wild campus life. Manage your GPA, navigate social challenges, and pursue love while facing the realities of modern campus culture and the international student experience.

title: In Search of Freedom
description: In Search of Freedom combines close-quarters and ranged combat with environmental puzzle solving. The game rewards creativity: using the environment, combining different Blaster chargers, and coordinating enemy waves are the keys to survival. This isn’t just about shooting — it’s about thinking, improvising, and adapting your arsenal to every threat.

title: Der Anzeigenhauptmeister
description: Slip into the role of the advertising master! Detect illegal parking in a big city and select the correct offense from a list. Collect money for the state and punish traffic offenders for their actions! Law is law!
A horror visual novel about urban legends of Russian town in 2007.

title: Island Off Outer Dancing
description: A narrative rhythm game taking place shortly after the first ending of Island Off Outer Darkness. Meet the new Postman, Utah, as a fresh mystery envelops Rekkieg...

title: Economy Bros
description: Build your dream city from scratch in this sandbox tycoon: start by working or gathering resources, trade businesses and real estate based on market demand, expand your land, and grow your empire—all while surviving and stacking up cold hard cash from your strategic moves.

title: Mighty Aphid: Remastered Edition
description:
His famous father is aging. His mother is dying. And his big sister is on the moon. So it is up to Avery "Aphid" Cavor to stop the villainous Lady Bug from wrecking the town of Victoria with her horde of monsters!

Run, shoot, swim, and fly. Explore huge levels. Fight big bosses. Earn upgrades.

title: GoBlomb
description: GoBlomb is a thrilling arcade game where you control an agile Goblin inside a coliseum created by a God of Destruction. The premise? This whimsical god will only grant Earth one more year of life if the participants manage to overcome his deadly challenge! With simple yet addictive mechanics, you’ll need to collect bombs falling from the sky while navigating treacherous platforms, avoiding deadly traps, and sharpening your reflexes to survive.

title: Toby's Carrot Patch
description: Toby the rabbit hops across your desktop, digging up carrots on top of your open windows. A cozy idle miner who keeps you company while you work — upgrade, collect, and dress him up at your own gentle pace. No combat, no pressure.

title: Ability Roulette: Last Round Express
description: Ability Roulette is a turn-based strategy card game for one or two players set aboard the Last Round Express, a night train crossing a stylized late-1920s Britain. Players see the counts of live rounds and blanks in a shared revolver while the order remains hidden, use 15 combinable ability cards, and choose whether to aim at themselves or their opponent. It includes offline single-player play, private online matches with friends, public matchmaking, and cross-platform multiplayer.

title: Split FPV: Drone Racing
description: Split FPV is a detailed FPV drone control simulator with realistic flight physics and a drone customization system. Here you can learn to fly in a wide variety of flight modes and conditions. Explore the drone's design, experiment with the detailed customization system, and build your own drone.

title: Visco Arcade 2
description:
Visco Arcade 2 cartridge for Evercade brings 8 more arcade classics from Japanese developer Visco, focusing on the later titles from their catalogue:

- Drift Out '94: The Hard Order — A follow-up to the original Drift Out, putting players back behind the wheel for more high-speed top-down rally racing.
- Neo Drift Out: New Technology — A Neo Geo-era sequel in the Drift Out series, offering a full world rally challenge.
- Breakers — A colourful 2D fighting game where players choose a warrior and battle for martial arts supremacy.
- Battle Flip Shot — A sports title that reimagines table tennis with vibrant characters and special attack moves.
- Bang Bead — The sequel to Battle Flip Shot, adding more technical court-based gameplay variations.
- Captain Tomaday — A "cute 'em up" shoot 'em up starring a tomato-powered hero taking to the skies.
- Ganryu — A hack-and-slash platformer based on Japanese legend, with relentless side-scrolling action.
- Bang² Busters — A colourful elimination platformer following Lazy and Refia against the forces of Emperor Honey.

title: PlayIndex
description:
In PlayIndex, games are the stocks.

Every price is driven by one number: how many people are actually playing that game right now. Live Steam concurrent player counts are pulled every 10 minutes and turned into a market you can trade. No fictional companies, no invented charts: when a game blows up on a Friday night, you watch it happen on the tape.

Build a portfolio out of games you think are about to catch fire, and sell before the hype fades.

title: Island Survival: Deluxe Bundle - Craft, Build, Grow
description: Survive the wilderness, explore the unknown, and build your way home.

title: Happy Endings
description: Run an adult pixel-art massage parlor in a fast-paced incremental clicker. Hire hostesses, play pressure-point mini-games, unlock 40+ explicit scenes, automate your parlor, upgrade rooms, and manage heat and raids to build the city’s hottest parlor.

title: Smash Cat
description: Four paws and 192 targets!

title: Age of the Fallen
description: A fast-paced dark-fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite where you battle endless hordes of demons across a medieval world. Choose from 10 unique heroes, collect and combine hundreds of cards, evolve powerful attacks, and create massive character builds as you fight through challenging scenarios, bosses, and story missions. The game also features two-player local co-op, letting you team up with a friend to take on Hell together.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Recompiled
description: A native PC port of Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 3 HD Collection (Xbox 360).

title: Wild Story: Primal Secrets - Collector's Edition
description: A wildfire scarred the reserve — now poachers and buried secrets threaten what remains. Explore the wilderness, rescue wildlife, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden deep within the forest.

title: Arena Blues: Requiem for 35
description: Set in a medieval Roman arena, this is a simultaneous turn-based psychological strategy game. Experience intricate and intense combat based on weapon physics and realistic collision detection. Choose 3 out of 15 slave gladiators, each with their own unique backstory, to form your team.

title: Command Doctrine
description: Describe a battle and AI builds it. Describe a war and get a whole campaign. Command Doctrine is a turn-based wargame with endless generated scenarios. Command armies across seven eras and outthink your enemy with supply, morale and terrain. Will your doctrine hold?

title: Beast Market
description: The hunt is automatic. The reading is yours. Build a stockpile while away, compare values, holdings, and sources in the Market Terminal, then choose the next beast to hunt in this free-to-play idle hunting RPG.

title: 20 Trials to Heaven
description: In Purgatory, death is not defeat, but surrender is final. A lost soul must face twenty trials with one life and no checkpoints. Will your soul endure the journey, or fade into darkness?

title: Momoiro Okami no Honoka-san: Ikenai, O-mo-te-na-shi
Dragonlance: Veil of the Last Sanctum
description: Survive the collapse of reality in a dark fantasy turn-based RPG where worlds collide and planar rifts unleash ancient horrors. Explore frozen seas, ruined kingdoms, and blighted realms as you gather powerful souls to restore or destroy the Veil between worlds.

title: Catnip Wars
description: Catnip Wars is a 1-4 player co-op tower defense game in which players control Catbots defending a catnip farm from waves of monsters. Turrets, walls, farms, windmills and repair stations are placed freely on a hex grid, and the farm doubles as the economy: catnip fields fund weapons and windmills power turrets. Fourteen monster types attack the farm, ranging from swarming chompers to armored giants and boss Necros. Players can man a heavy BFG turret, revive downed teammates, and progress through a 43-node tech tree across matches. The game includes eleven playable Catbots, 100 achievements and global leaderboards, and can be played solo or online with up to four players.

title: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - A.X.E.8: Alstroemeria
description: The first story chapter in the new A.X.E.8 Project, which will redefine all the idols groups.

title: Arrow Puzzle Games
description: Arrow Puzzle Games is a single-player puzzle game where players clear arrow-filled boards by removing each arrow in the direction it points. Classic and Expert levels focus on path-clearing logic, while selected Art puzzles reveal a hidden picture when completed.

title: Daily War Online
description: Daily War — Build an island fortress tile by tile, design its defenses, and declare war on ELO-matched rivals. Drop a battle card to bend the rules, then watch the clash unfold. No twitch reflexes — just sharp building and smart timing. One war a day. Make it count.

title: Escape Hatch
description: Build and operate your own escape room. Seal your friends inside, guide them, give them hints, or leave them in the dark.

title: Slick As The Devil
description: An experimental psychological-horror tabletop game based on 3-Cup Shuffle. Keep your eye on the ball, buy special items between rounds, and see if you can beat the devil himself at the ultimate conman game.

title: Puzzles Fruit
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Puzzles Magic
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Puzzles Snow
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Cold Aisle: Data Center Tycoon
description: Build your own data center business from an empty industrial hall. Order hardware, install servers and GPUs, connect power and networking, manage cooling and capacity, and grow from your first rack into a market-leading company.

title: Warscape Alpha
description: Pilot your Hovertank through 60 levels of old school arcade style action in both single and multiplayer modes. Collect new weapons and bonuses during battle to defeat, outrun and confuse your enemy.

title: Re:Blue
description: A native PC port of Blue Dragon (2006).

title: The Brave Hearts II: False Skies
description: The Brave Hearts II: False Skies is a fully voice-acted, story-driven arcade shoot 'em up. Four years after the Cruabar War, advanced autonomous drones begin appearing across former war zones and civilian airspace. As a newly assigned Brave Heart pilot, players defend Uflein's skies, uncover the origin of the drone threat, and fight through campaign missions featuring aerial combat, boss encounters, QTE moments, and visual-novel-style cutscenes.

title: T7's Basics Plus
description: This is a game of the T7's Basics, but includes cool stuffs like flooding event and more. Players collect 7 laptops and esacpe the schoolhouse to win.

title: Lost Hopes: Day of Betrayal
description: 19 year old Chloe was left at her grandparents George and Helen's country house for a few days due to her parents' trip abroad. Little did she know that this short vacation would turn into a nightmare where she must pay the price of an old betrayal.

title: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - Itsuka Kaze ga Yamu Sono Hi made
Hell Apartment
description: Paranormal streamer Shunya Takahashi sneaks into a cursed apartment where a family vanished. When the door of Room 101 shuts, escape becomes impossible without solving its riddles. Clear the rooms one by one and face the truth of "that day" beyond Room 203.

title: Void Cargo: Equilibrium
description: A first-person sci-fi cargo flight sim. Pilot a physics-driven lander, plan risky routes, manage fuel and heavy cargo, and save deliveries by repairing system failures mid-flight. Earn credits and upgrade your ship.

title: Last Breath
description: Last Breath is a tense side-scrolling shooter in a fungal-ravaged world, where humanity has become “Spore Zombies.” As the older sister Guan Jin, fight through the ruins to find your lost sibling. Scavenge, adapt, survive. But what awaits: redemption or a deeper nightmare?

title: Destined Notes: The Written Fate
description: A massacre. A past that won’t stay buried. As Daniel, dive into a chilling investigation that spirals into pure horror. Explore, solve, survive—but something is watching. The deeper you go, the lesser you escape.

title: Where To?
description: Drive a late-night taxi through a city where no one can be trusted. Pick up suspicious passengers, follow unsettling routes, and face strange conversations and irreversible choices. Tonight, who you take, where you drop them off, and where you go next are all up to you. A retro horror taxi game.

title: Too Many Toys!
description: Too Many Toys! is a cozy organizing simulator where you'll sort 5,517 toys in a messy toy shop. Put every toy back in its correct place, complete rows to gain points, and spend them on upgrades that make organizing faster and more satisfying!

title: Pastimes
description: Pastimes is a calm 2D logic puzzle based on Pieter Bruegel the Elder's painting Children's Games (1560). Players fill a large numbered grid where each clue indicates how many cells must be filled in the surrounding 3×3 area. Solving the puzzle gradually reveals the full painting, divided into scenes that unlock short notes about the historical games depicted. The game can be played solo or in local split-screen co-op on the same shared puzzle, with support for Steam Remote Play Together.

title: Taro Is Back
description: A video you must never play. What happened to the influencer who vanished?

title: Unicycle Journey
description: One wheel. Many challenges. Grab your unicycle, overcome tough obstacles, and make it to the end — alone or with friends.

title: Cycle01
description: A minimalist game about washing contaminated laundry. Wash, sell, upgrade, and buy new equipment. Keep the contamination in check. A small mystery is waiting for you at the end.

title: Alfred's Alien Abduction Adventure
description: Join Alfred in this 3D adventure game set onboard a scary alien mothership. In space no one can hear you s#!t yourself, thankfully.

title: Echoes of Kyria
description: Fight solo or with up to 4 players co-op to take on massive bosses in this stylized 3D action rogue-like bullet heaven. Step into Kyria, battle against relentless hordes, and master the dynamic, fast-paced combat.

title: Make Her Real
description: A young inmate is given a faded body pillow of a girl from an old romance VN. Then she starts speaking... and becomes the only person who still sees him as human. A short psychological horror VN about isolation, guilt, parasocial comfort, and the terror of choosing freedom.

title: Floors of Fate
description: Challenge your skills in Floors of Fate, a single-player Action RPG. Battle through 50 handcrafted floors, customize your character, and piece together the lore of a ruined world. Every floor brings new enemies and tougher trials.

title: Art of Drift: Cozy Drift Simulator
description: Feel the drift, not the rush

title: Peekablock
description: The hide-&-seek party game where the props fight back. Build and paint your own disguise block by block, melt into the map, and pray the seeker walks right past you. Round after round of betrayal, taunts and very bad hiding spots.

title: Bomb Farm
description: Bomb Farm is a free-to-play idle RPG in which a squadron of bombers gathers resources on its own. Players destroy rocks to collect materials and hunt for rare items, forge and upgrade equipment from +0 to +15, and develop their characters through a large skill tree. Squads are built from heroes of different rarities, each with its own set of upgradeable passive abilities. Progression spans five worlds and five difficulty levels across 600 stages. Items can be traded with other players through the Steam Community Market.

title: Skye's Repose
description:
Skye's Repose is a chill Exploration Farming Sim inspired by Myst and Stardew Valley where you gather materials, seeds, and magical elementals from across the land and use them to rebuild, solve puzzles, and unlock new areas to explore.
In your exploration, you'll meet the mages who arrived and escaped from Skye before you ever arrived. And while they'll try to help you, they are deeply broken themselves and in need of restoration and hope. Can you really bring light to others from so far away?

title: The Last Cosmonaut
description: The Last Cosmonaut is a first person survival horror puzzle game set in an abandoned lunar outpost. Collect parts, repair the escape vehicle, and keep the lights on, as something lurks in the shadows...

title: Jonah Lomu Rugby Challenge 4 Remastered
description:
One of rugby gaming’s greatest experiences is back! Re-released and remastered in tribute to the legendary Jonah Lomu.
Enhanced in stunning 4K with massively upgraded visuals, improved lighting and smooth 60 FPS gameplay on modern hardware. Jonah Lomu Rugby Challenge 4 Remastered brings the thrills, spills and intensity of rugby to a new generation. No licensed teams, just fast, hard-hitting rugby and pure sporting fun.

title: The Too-Cute Girl Who Moved in Next Door
description: A 3D romance simulation game with point-and-click exploration and interaction with the heroine. The story branches into a pure romance route or a revenge route, leading to multiple endings.

title: Minesweeper 3D
description: Classic Minesweeper across four true 3D fields: a cube, cylinder, hexagonal prism, and tetrahedron.

title: The Escape From Dungeon Keep
description: A classic text RPG: type commands to explore, fight turn-based battles, manage inventory, upgrade gear, and finish side quests. Chase multiple endings, New Game+ content, achievements, and moddable Workshop maps.

title: OBITT: Escape From the Room
description: You stray from a shrine into a room and become a palm-sized person. This is an escape action game to find your way out through trial and error from a miniature perspective. Manage your HP to survive and break free from this giant room! A time attack mode is included for an extra challenge.

title: Oshikake Oku-sama to, Kimi no Uso
Drown in Yesterday's Sea
description: Xiamen,Fujian Province,2024. Gu Mengzhi, a 19-year-old student at Xiamen University, encounters a "sea spirit" named Coral—who hails from the ocean—and the two quickly become close.However, just as their bond deepens, an uninvited guest known as "The Stranger" arrives and disrupts everything.

title: Package chaos
description: Package Chaos is a cozy package sorting game where you turn a messy warehouse into a perfectly organized delivery center.Pick up, inspect, sort thousands of unique packages and enjoy the satisfying feeling of a perfectly organized warehouse.

title: Dirtnap
description: Dig, fly and fight through fully destructible maps in multiple game modes. Every character has its own unique ability, every biome its own hazards, and the weapon arsenal runs from machine guns to banana bombs to airstrikes. Play with friends, strangers, bots, or all of them.

title: Duelgrounds
description: Duelgrounds is a fast-paced 1v1 FPS where every round brings a new weapon and every decision matters. Master the entire arsenal, manage limited resources, and outplay your opponents through skill, strategy, and adaptation.

title: Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - Ultimate Edition
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - Ultimate Pack
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - Season Pass Bonus
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - Save Data Bonus Pack
Ski Yeet
description: Bomb down an endless, wraparound mountain in this arcade ski roguelike. Chain tricks into huge combos, stack 60+ power-ups across six rarity tiers, and outski a pack of hungry cryptids!

title: Solipsistic
description: Solipsistic is a free psychological horror game. Manipulate the game's files. The game knows you're there. The people inside it know it too.

title: Sunward
description: A deep, relaxed space-industry sim. Mine asteroids, refine raw ore into valuable goods, and trade on a living market while you build a modular station, grow a colony, and expand across the solar system and beyond into a freighter-linked empire.

title: Ghostly Simulator: Your Neighboring Ghost Story Collection
description: Welcome to an immersive horror fiction reading simulator. Every tale within is rooted in the chinese mundane, familiar moments we all live through —like the annual Spring Festival Gala You can shut down the simulator at any time. But remember: reality is always far more horrifying than any story.

title: Cleaning Simulator: Ultimate Mess
description: Clean, organize, and restore different environments in this level-based cleaning simulator. Every level introduces new mechanics, tools, and satisfying ways to turn mess into perfection.

title: Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - 2026 Japan National Team & World Youth Jersey Set
Streets of Miami VR
description: Streets of Miami VR puts you in the middle of 1980s Miami—sun, sweat, and crime. Whether first-person in full VR or third-person classic view, you’ll work your way up from nothing, navigating the Vice strip as a new immigrant trying to survive in a city run by dealers and corruption.

title: Healer
description: Heal your party as you defeat the leaders of the demon lord army. Find your unique playstyle by combining upgrades. As you die, you will learn the patterns and mechanics. Maybe one day you won't have to come back to life to save the world!

title: Meow Box City
description: Meow Box City is a multiplayer, strategy-focused game where, ahead of the upcoming local elections, you build your own lobby against rival parties, thwart your opponents’ plans with devious schemes, and try to boost your popularity in the city by making the right moves at the right time. Collect cards, place your buildings, balance satisfaction–population–revenue… and secure the ballot boxes on election night. Let’s keep this between us: we’re winning...

title: Pro Soccer Manager 27
description: Become the manager of a football team and take full control of your club. Manage scouting, training, facilities, and squad development. Choose your philosophy: focus on coaching and tactics, or invest in developing the next generation of stars. Success depends on your decisions.

title: Alice's Gaze
description: This is an eerie clicker idle game with light puzzles and idle combat. Alice wakes in darkness, trapped in a strange mansion, seeking escape. The Cat God's altar drops gold, Rabbitfolk gather carrots, and dungeon monsters block the way... Can you accompany Alice to the final truth?

title: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon
description: A cautionary tale, or a story better left untold? Legacy of the Bloodmoon is the darkest expansion to date for Vampire Survivors. Discover the path to ruin that this pack of villains is headed down. Unlock new weapons and characters to find new ways to snowball against relentless hordes of enemies.

title: Can I Take Your Order
description: You and your friends play as part time waiters in different restaurants. Use your bare hands to deliver food, taze a raging cowboy who just shot someone and dispose of the body before it starts to stink. Keep your customers happy on your own, or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

title: A Little Age
description: Build and expand a network of settlements, each with its own little economy. Manage the flow of resources between them at your own pace, and watch a civilization emerge in this minimalist settlement builder.

title: Dicetris
description: Dicetris is a falling-block puzzler with depth. Stack dice in columns, sum to hit the target, combo colors to clear overloaded stacks. Twist your strategy around special dice and rule-bending map conditions. Easy to learn. Built to master.

title: A Game About Creating The Universe
description: An idler game where you get to build up the universe from scratch. You are a part of an advanced space civilization that builds universes.

title: The Abandoned House in Yeongdeok
description: She was sent to the abandoned house in Yeongdeok as part of a viewer punishment challenge. But the joke ended the moment the door slammed shut.

title: 100 Mushroom Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all? ️

title: For Stella
description: For Stella is an interactive narrative game centered around psychological disorders. “Why would someone who has spent their entire life suppressing their emotions suddenly pull you aside to talk about love?”

title: Dealmaster
description: DealMaster is a board game where every property is won through auctions. Time your action cards, invest smartly in stocks, build or destroy houses, and strike trades. Master it all across 6 unique roles to outwit your rivals.

title: Mall Rivals
description: Competitive mall simulation. 1-8 players open stores in the same mall, fight for customers, crush rivals. Team up or go solo. Fair play or dirty tricks? Your call. Procedural maps, employee system, physical mechanics.

title: Moorage
description: Moorage is a fishing roguelite where you must travel the ocean to find a way off a desolate island. Meet people stranded like you, level up each time you fail, and catch a bunch of fish!

title: Undying One
description: Undying One is a tactical action RPG where every defeated enemy can be claimed for your army. Unlock new spells, raise the dead, command your forces, and endure ever-growing waves of power.

title: Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters
description: The next episode of Tsubasas riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

title: Nowhere Road
description: Nowhere Road is a winter-themed driving and taxi game set in a post-war city. Drive through quiet nights, deliver passengers, and experience a calm, atmospheric world focused on immersion and slow-paced driving rather than speed or competition.

title: Space Farmer
description:
Become the ultimate planet manager in Space Farm Tycoon!

Build a space farm, manage an alien restaurant, and make a fortune in this addictive idle tycoon game.

title: Inferno Protocol
description: Trapped in a deadly labyrinth, you and 5 friends must scavenge, craft, and survive. Harvest monster parts for gear, inject experimental syringes to gain unique skills, and navigate trap-filled corridors. In this 6-player horror survival, you must evolve to escape.

title: Project: Station
description: A 4-player co-op sci-fi horror game where you stealth through unstable research stations, scavenge vital resources, complete high-risk contracts, and extract before the facility overwhelms your team.

title: Teaching Simulator: Elite Class
description: Jump into the world of teaching with Teaching Simulator: Elite Class. Help your students learn, improve, and graduate from primary school. Decorate your classroom to make learning more fun and exciting. Bring in new students, support your team, and keep your principal happy. Every choice you make affects your classroom, your school, and everyone around you.

title: Resort Island Simulator
description: A world filled with tricksters, pirates, zealots, and treasures. An ocean full of danger and prize. Face dilemmas and encounters. Manage a resort in this wild world and build a thriving business. An Explorer, a Survivor a Resorter or a Trader? Forge your own path to wealth. Make Resort Prosper!

title: Saga of Yurina
description: A 2D action platformer of graceful duels and perfect parries under the falling sakura.

title: Malignant Survivors II
description: Enter a world consumed by nightmares, ancient ruins, forbidden magic, and mountains of loot. Battle relentless enemy hordes, grow stronger with every run, and uncover the dark secrets of a forgotten land.

title: Chronicles of Childhood
description: A story-rich, platform, side-scroller in the coming of age genre. Travel around the Fantasy World of "Chronicles of Childhood", with your slingshot at hand. Fight and avoid imaginative creations, to finish all the levels and discover what does it really mean to grow up.

title: Cats and Seek: Zoo
description: Let’s roam the zoo, meet the animals, and spot those sneaky cats hiding among them.

title: Allumeria
description: Explore a vast and hazardous cave network and uncover mountains of loot. Build a town and trade with NPCs using advanced building and lighting tools. Fight bosses and raid dungeons to unlock abilities. Play with your friends, and build, fight, thrive, in the fully destructible world of Allumeria!

title: Tactical Annihilation
description: Experience turn-based strategy with free-form base building, multi-unit control, colossal units, and powerful battle skills. It captures the depth of an RTS in turn-based form, like Advanced Wars with massive super units!

title: Russian Survivors
description: Fight versus unlimited hordes of lizards and italian brainrot animals in post-soviet environment.

title: BattleGroupVR2
description: BattleGroupVR2 is a virtual reality real-time space strategy where you explore the galaxy and lead a fleet of powerful warships from the bridge of your flagship. Explore, mine, trade, hunt. Grow your fleet, upgrade your ships, train your captains, and battle the enemy from the captain's chair.

title: Trapped Out
description: Get ready for an epic showdown in Trapped out! - the ultimate family-friendly action party game where chaos, fun, and laughter collide in a 3D battle arena!

title: Board Game Society
description: Take on an ever-changing tile-based board with up to 6 players, and see just how much treasure you can scavenge before the big bad boss is defeated! Beware though, your friends might want some of that treasure for themselves.

title: Portal: Alive & Kicking
description: Portal: Alive & Kicking is a full remake and re-imagining of Valve's award-winning title, Portal.

title: Garden of Witches
description: Garden of Witches is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.

title: Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow
description:
Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow is a fantasy visual novel game with a colorful cast of playable characters, each with their own unique mechanics, and all of whom are necessary in solving this mystery. But be careful, as your choices will determine whether their stories end in ruin or victory.

Interrogate your own player characters in this six-chapter murder mystery! Your decisions determine how many clues are uncovered for the final player character, the detective. Explore each stage of grief: Chapter 1 stars Orven as he navigates the shocking deaths of his dream and his hero.

title: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel
description: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel is a 3D third-person puzzle game with platforming elements. The game is focusing on non-textual storytelling, exploration and puzzles centered around fluffy furballs called "Fluffs". It creates a wholesome atmosphere in a stylized and colorful environment.

title: Rocket Engineer
description: Rocket Engineer is a simulation game about designing, testing and launching your rockets to explore. Rocket Engineer focuses on the engineering aspect of rockets, while allowing a fun exploration experience.

title: RUVN Contest Reboot
description: Experience the heated philosophical debate between Orika and her gang in this kinematic visual novel.

title: Skyland
description: In this gorgeous FTL-inspired tactical RTS, you and your crew must take command of a flying castle, and defend it from sky pirates while fighting enemies of increasing difficulty. Originally developed for Gameboy Advance, now available on Steam!

title: Eat the Rich
description: Be a billionaire, team up and betray your friends all at once in EAT THE RICH! A social party game for 6-10 players where you play mini games, vote out the competition, conspire to get ahead, all in a bid to be the richest!

title: House 2
description:
As a terrible storm approaches, two young girls spend a fateful night watching TV and playing games…

House 2 is the sequel to the hit indie horror game, House. In House 2, you play as Tabby & Melody, finally free from their cursed home, in the next chapter of the House saga.

title: Cards of Destiny
description: Cards of Destiny is a VR puzzle game that brings the tabletop experience to a unique interactive environment! Turn your inner child into a god as you draw one-time-use cards that can save or condemn the tiny humans on your desk – and the aliens chasing them. Adapt to different levels and situations as your randomized deck, ticking clock and looming alien threats all keep you on your feet!

title: RunOut: Hothead Paws
description: RunOut is an online party platformer game for 2 to 6 players! Pick a cute animal character, race through unpredictable obstacle courses, collect coins, and be the first to grab the stuffed bear. Prepare for a fun, fast-paced mix of running, fighting, and partying!

title: Big Ambitions
description: Big Ambitions is a revolutionary role-playing business sim. Go from nothing to the biggest entrepreneur in New York by opening small businesses or slowly building huge corporations any way you like.

title: Divinum
description: Divinum is an action-adventure that blends stylish, expressive combat with rewarding exploration. Master devastating combos and craft unique builds to fight back mysterious invaders and uncover your island’s hidden truth.

title: Kubi Meguri
description: Swap your severed head and the hell you wander changes. A Japanese psychological walking-horror: drift a fallen warrior's ghost through absurd afterlives that shift with every head you wear.

title: EM-68's Adventure
description:
You are Experimental Mannequin No. 68. The Corporation didn’t create you to live. It created you to be tested.
They threw you into the grinder. Jump. Climb. Cling. There are no checkpoints here that will cut you any slack. There’s only the drop — and one question: how many times are you willing to fall before you break for good?
Jump. Scramble. Fall. Get back up. The world around you is one massive proving ground packed with strange and lethal locations.
Every leap isn’t just a test of skill. It’s part of the experiment. While you fight to survive and reach the end, the Corporation’s secrets slowly surface. Who are you really? Why are they testing you? And what happens if the experiment slips out of control?
Your choices matter. Three completely different endings await those who make it to the finish. Decide what you’ll become: a obedient tool, a rebel against the system… or something else entirely.
EM-68’s Adventure is a 3D platformer with exploration and meaningful choices, where every step could be your last… or the first on the path to the truth.

title: The Sims 4: Clueless Capsule Kit
description: Ensemble-y challenged? Ugh, as if! The Sims 4 Clueless Capsule Kit has fashion fit for the most popular Sims.

title: The Sims 4: Mean Girls Capsule Kit
Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse!
description: Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse! is a relaxing placement simulation where you organize a huge warehouse full of boxes. Stack packages on pallets, use transport vehicles to place them on shelves, and enjoy turning a messy space into a perfectly organized warehouse step by step.

title: Infinity Nikki: Bloom Beneath Bright Skies
description:
The rustling leaves herald the start of the summer camp in Elderwood Forest!

Tuck your letters into tree hollows and let the campfire light the road ahead.

Take one bold step, then another, and carry laughter and courage toward wider, brighter skies!

title: Scary Stories Grotesque
description: A short horror visual novel inspired by internet ghost stories and urban legends, where familiar places become home to inexplicable and disturbingly real horrors.

title: Wild Justice
description: Wild Justice is a 3D first-person Western action-adventure game inspired by the 1985 ZX Spectrum classic The Wild Bunch. Set in the Wild West, players navigate the frontier while managing survival mechanics, tracking down outlaws, earning gold, and clear their name in a modern reimagining of classic retro gameplay.

title: My Party Is Grinding
description: A desktop idle RPG where your party of five heroes fights, loots, and grows in a small window while you work.

title: Puzigo
description:
A relaxing jigsaw puzzle for people who want to slow down. Choose your preferred difficulty and enjoy the game at your own pace, from a casual 100-piece puzzle to a long-term challenge of up to 2,000,000 pieces.

Without being rushed by time limits or score ratings, immerse yourself in the small satisfaction of each piece clicking into place and enjoy a calm puzzle experience.

title: Save the Eggs
description: Save the eggs from breaking

title: Supermarket Electronic
description: Build your electronics empire! Stock the latest gadgets, serve customers, set prices, upgrade your store, and become the ultimate electronics retail tycoon.

title: Arcade Archives: Satan of Saturn
description:
"Satan of Saturn" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1981.
Fire your missiles and laser beams to take down the UFOs and rockets coming to invade Earth. Clear the Earth stages and blast off for Saturn! Win the decisive battle against Satan of Saturn!

title: Chomp Chomp Carnage
description: Eat everything. Grow big. The ocean's never looked this cozy and deadly at the same time. A fish-eat-fish arcade chomper where every creature is crafted from wool. Devour your way up the food chain in Chomp Chomp Carnage.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Satan of Saturn
description:
" Satan of Saturn" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1981.
Fire your missiles and laser beams to take down the UFOs and rockets coming to invade Earth. Clear the Earth stages and blast off for Saturn! Win the decisive battle against Satan of Saturn!

title: Bomber Angel Bombriel: Forever the Kings
description: Bomber Angel Bombriel: Forever the Kings is a top-down free-scrolling bomb-placement action/shooter that shares the same lineage as classic masterpieces like RoboWarrior (NES). It’s a fresh new game dressed in pastel, cute visuals—nostalgic in spirit, yet with noticeably improved controls.

title: Palabras en inglés para aprender en la primaria
description: Build first English words with a fun quiz!

title: Escape Room: The Secret Portal Puzzle
description: The deeper you go, the darker the truth becomes*

title: Cozy Farm Defense
description: Build your farm by day and defend it by night! Grow crops, raise animals, recruit farmyard defenders and build walls to stop hungry enemies.

title: WordHive 3
description: Build words, score points, and master the hive.

title: Astrava
description: Explore a mysterious alien planet filled with abandoned facilities, breathtaking landscapes, and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.

title: Elden Ring: Tarnished Pack
description: The Elden Ring Tarnished Pack grants additional content including 2 new starting classes, new armor, and a new Torrent appearance customization feature which are usable in the base game and the Shadow of the Erdtree Expansion.

title: Like a dog
description: Inside an infinite laboratory where inhumane experiments were conducted on dogs, a concise story about loneliness, perseverance, and madness is told...

title: Can I Come In?
description: Your parents have left, and you're home alone. What begins as an ordinary evening after school slowly turns into a living nightmare, where every little sound makes your heart race. Remember the most important rule: don't open the door for anyone.

title: Scott Pilgrim EX: Back in the Band
description: Stephen Stills, Kim Pine, and Knives Chau warp into the fight, completing the full band lineup in Scott Pilgrim EX. It's time for a reunion... and a few more greatest hits.

title: The Golden Idol Saga
description:
The Golden Idol series is a new type of detective game that allows you to think and investigate freely. Discover clues, identify victims and suspects, and unearth the mystery of the Golden Idol - an ancient artifact that wields unfathomable power.

Its existence has perplexed those who have witnessed its abilities - and is a myth among those who haven’t. Untangle the web of mysteries for yourself in Golden Idol - The Complete Saga.

This bundle includes the complete Golden Idol story - including the original The Case of the Golden Idol, both of its devious expansions The Spider of Lanka and The Lemurian Vampire, as well as The Rise of the Golden Idol, and all four upcoming DLC expansions.

title: Flekkia
description: A Roguelite board game where every tile counts. Play as an Archer torn between the purity of the Angel and the rage of the Demon. Build your equipment, manipulate the terrain, and turn your movement into a devastating attack. Dying is only the beginning to rewrite your destiny.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: City Update 16 - Italy
IQ Logic Codes: Number & Letter Puzzles
description: Can you crack the hidden logic?

title: Hidden Photo Mysteries: The Truth Gets Scary
description:
What should never
be in the photo?

title: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP
description: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP is a vibrant arcade game where every match turns into a real fight! PvP sports battles, mini football and the spirit of street playgrounds inspired us to create this online game. Here you are a football manager, a goalkeeper, and a striker - in short, a true football star! These are not just football games - players of all ages will enjoy them!

title: Mythical Creature Personality Quiz: 16 Types
description: Which myth suits you?

title: Cursed Objects: Find and Seal
description:
What object caused the haunting?
Read the scene
Seal the curse!

title: Crayon Story: Thumbelina
description: An emotional, creative children's game where you color your own storybook and write your own tales.

title: Quest of Dungeons
description: Choose your hero and enter the dungeons!

title: Court of Darkness: Adoration's Kiss
description: In this world of magic, your kiss is an irresistible temptation.

title: Zumba: The Pharaoh's Marble Revenge
description: Awaken the Pharaoh’s curse—match, blast, and conquer the sands of time!

title: Nightlatch: Haunted House
description: A low-to-mid poly horror escape game across 3 different houses. Find the keys you need room by room, hide from a stalking presence, and uncover the story through scattered notes - each house with 4 difficulty tiers of 10 levels.

title: Big Survival Collection 3-in-1
description: Face the unknown, escape the impossible.

title: Car Sales & Parking Bundle
description: Master the world of cars.

title: Project City
description: Drive, drift, hustle, and survive a city that reacts to every bad decision.

title: Grimveil
description: A classic-style MMORPG built solo from scratch. Pick from 6 classes, grind real progression, loot your gear, and team up with a party or guild in an actively developed world made by someone who loves the genre.

title: Vanishing Evidence: Mystery Cases
description:
Can you spot every trace?
Choose it, erase it
A dark mystery puzzle

title: Therian Crush: Wild Animal Boys
description:
These guys are wild by nature.
Get close, earn their trust, and unlock what they don't show just anyone.

title: Escape game R00m16
description: Explore 3D space and escape

title: Magic Chess
description: Magic Chess, inspired by Chess and Chinese Chess, breaks free from traditional boundaries by introducing brand-new pieces and items, resulting in over 1,000,000 possible combinations. The game supports Single Player, Custom Matches, Local Multiplayer, and Online Random Matchmaking.

title: Orbital Checkpoint
description: Orbital Checkpoint is a sci-fi border control simulator. Check alien documents, scan suspicious luggage, detect contraband, and manage your tight budget on station GSA-42. Regulations change daily, but bills for oxygen and coffee always arrive on time. Will you risk letting the Acid Lemons pass?

title: Mimic Party
description: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

title: Anomaly Tunnel
description: You are trapped in a tunnel where the entrance and exit have vanished. Examine the clues left behind and escape safely.

title: Giraffe Raising Game: Reach for the sky
description: This giraffe's neck grows!

title: Magnetail
description: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor

title: Inside the Cube
description: Lost between endless rooms.

title: Fernkeep
description: Discover the quiet charm of a medieval castle town.

title: Dr. Bowlatzo's Crazy Bowling
description: A quick-play roguelike bowling game. Get strikes, get achievements, get high scores. Try different ball combos for different gameplay strategies. See if you can defeat Dr. Bowlatzo!

title: Train Plus Japan: Drive Western Japan Trains! - Rapid Service Edition
description: Drive real JR-West trains! An authentic, officially licensed railway driving game.

title: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
description:
Turn a quiet patch of land into your own little farm, complete with crops, animals and pets, and watch it flourish.

Start with just a few planting beds and some basic tools. Buy seeds, plant each crop by hand, care for them, wait for the right moment and then sell the harvest for a profit. As your farm grows, you can unlock more space, upgrade your equipment, increase production and become more efficient every day.

title: The Immortal John Triptych
description:
he Immortal John Triptych is the ULTIMATE anthology of the Joe Richardson games. Four Last Things, The Procession to Calvary, and Death of the Reprobate are brought together under one glorious sun with never-before-seen deleted scenes, updated language parity across all three titles, an expanded soundtrack by Eduardo Antonello with new original recordings, manual saves for Four Last Things, backflips in The Procession to Calvary, and a button to trigger a superfluous trumpeted fanfare whenever you need to celebrate. Embrace the absurd, the profound, and the sweet soothing aesthetic of the Renaissance in The Immortal John Triptych.

Immortal John is dying. A holy war has ended in chaos. Sin itself demands reckoning. Three interconnected tales unfold across a world built from Renaissance paintings and Classical music, where the ridiculous and the profound collide.

Help locals with their daily tasks, only to find the Devil lurking in the shadows. Chase a tyrant across kingdoms while assisting inept magicians and negotiating with God Almighty. Navigate sin, death, judgement, heaven and hell, all topped with a cherry of gleeful flippancy.

From quiet countryside kindness spiraling into madness, to holy vengeance wrapped in absurdity, to cosmic philosophy delivered with a wink and a nudge, The Immortal John Triptych proves that the most intelligent thing you can do is embrace the utterly ridiculous.

title: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike
description: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike is a fast-paced action-puzzle roguelike set in a dying black-and-white world. Players control a customizable geometric Painter and must master the RGB spectrum by manipulating Red, Green, and Blue switches. Through mixing colors and utilizing hundreds of ability combinations, players restore corrupted grid-based arenas while surviving dynamic, real-time combat encounters.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: The Magical Girl Childhood Friend Lives Next Door
description: A story-driven romance visual novel where your choices shape relationships, uncover secrets, and lead to multiple endings with your childhood friend.

title: Glow Box
description: A 60-minute adventure where all you do is glow.

title: Super Real Mahjong Venus Returns
description: The legendary strip mahjong game is back with the latest VR technology! Play two-player mahjong against Shoko, Mizuki, Aya, and Akira, and each time you win, they'll take off a piece of clothing. Experience zero-distance stripping!

title: BreakEven: Idle
description:
BreakEven is an idle action RPG for those players who enjoy the cycle - kill, loot, power-up, and destroy even harder.

The battle is automatically happening while you are making all the right decisions regarding the equipment selection, skill building, and overall strategy.

The game plays like an action RPG but values your time just like an idle game does.

The complexity is always ready when you need it but never interferes with you otherwise.

title: PNR: Point of No return
description: You don't dodge. You push through. PNR: Point of No Return is a space opera roguelite where you blast through enemy fleets head-on, forging a new loadout every sortie. Build your arsenal mid-battle, come back alive, hit the jackpot on the Slingshot, and do it all again.

title: Peter The Stash Hunter
description: A business sim + looting + strategy hybrid. Outbid rival hunters at storage auctions, ransack what you win, then run the shop that bankrolls Peter's search for his missing grandfather. Sabotage cards, Dutch vs English bidding, harpoon chases. Every box could hide a secret.

title: U Tsu Tsu Tsu
description: Roam a quiet late-night city in this chill point-and-click adventure. Click anything that catches your eye, check your phone, and reply to viewer comments only if you feel like it. Take your time and enjoy a slow, unhurried night—free from anyone's expectations.

title: The Blood Mage II
description: The Blood Mage 2 is a turn-based Puzzle/Dungeon Crawler RPG hybrid. You play as a blood mage, so your health doubles as mana pool. Fight against different creatures and explore the environments to reach your goal!

title: Plasma Dome
description: Plasma Dome is a tactical tower defense with roguelite progression and no predefined paths. Defend your city from an aerial assault of geometric entities from another dimension.

title: Thoughtless
description: A dark sci-fi psychological Visual Novel where your choices shape who you are. The world has ended and it's been dominated by mysterious aliens who roam the city. Despite that, you only think of what you've lost. Will you be able to rebuild your relationships? Or even... the world itself?

title: Metahustle One
description: MetaHustle One is a fast-paced, frantic FPS with horror elements. Fight through hordes of wicked horned foxes and other corrupted familiars of the «Great Meta-Druid» to escape a glitchy simulation before it turns into a surreal nightmare.

title: Rabbit Claw Party
description: Catch lively rabbits with a claw in a cute scoring stage game. Read each rabbits movement, clear levels, complete tasks, collect stickers, decorate your photo wall, fill the rabbit catalog, and enjoy local two-player co-op or competition.

title: Fractured Universe
description: A Turn based RPG with a focus on team building and character development. Explore the Fractured Universe, and what life would be like if the multiverse was destroyed. Featured various art styles and aesthetics.

title: Mining and Dwarves
description: An incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Play actively for maximum gains, or idle and let the dwarves do the work.

title: Just Keep Fishing
description: A short incremental game about catching a lot fish.

title: Orb Breaker
description: An incremental bullet hell about shooting orbs at enemies, collecting resources, and becoming powerful!

title: Monst
description: Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring humans on Earth with various transformations, fighting against human armed forces, and annihilating the world.

title: The Old Flesh of Nuraga
description: First person psychological horror game about treasure hunting with Grandpa. Search among the sands of Nuraga to unearth what's driving him mad.

title: Hyperdimension Neptunia Unlimited
description: Hyperdimension Neptunia ∞ (Unlimited) is an upcoming entry in the series where the world faces an apocalyptic loop triggered by a mysterious “meteorite.” As reality repeatedly resets, Neptune awakens alone in a white void and gains the power to “retry” fate itself. Alongside new allies, she must endure countless defeats, uncover the truth behind the cycle, and challenge the ultimate ending to save the world by venturing into a new spacetime.

title: Be Kinder and, Like, Be a Rewinder, Dude!
description: 1995, Summer. "Get a job or you're joining the military" shouts your dad. Get your ticket to an incremental game where you'll rewind, loan, buy tapes, buy rewinders, buy food, move to better locations, hire your mates and make a mint at Planet Rewind! Video tape rentals will be around forever!

title: Amel Broat
description: Two heroes. One sword. A world on the brink.

title: Question Roulette
description: Prove your wits and composure in this ultimate fast-paced trivia challenge where knowledge, speed, and strategic risk-taking determine victory.

title: The Cabin Game
description: The Cabin Game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...

title: DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite
description: Cave's arcade bullet hell shooter returns as DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite. New stages, a new character, new music, and other new elements set the stage for a new challenge.

title: Ghost Master: Resurrection - State of Panic
description: Order was their shield. Fear will be their downfall. The system is failing. Make sure these mortals feel every second of it.

title: Chou Shin Jikuu Geimu Neptune: Unlimited
description:
Hyperdimension Neptunia!
The latest installment in the numbered series!

The Gamindustri world is facing an impending doom.
With the addition of a new goddess,
Eleven of them will face the giant meteorite together.
A hopeful adventure woven by goddesses
Now, the grand curtain rises.

title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 Bonus Content
description: As purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes Metal Gear: Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

title: Tiny Misery
description: A sick mother and her young son move into the home of a lonely old woman. A tragic story inspired by the dark puppet animations of the 80s and 90s.

title: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.

Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you avoid combat and complete missions while hiding.

The game take place 10 years after Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater.

Amidst the swirling conspiracies behind the East-West Cold War, Snake confronts them while leading a private military force.

This is the story of how one soldier, “Snake”, becomes “Big Boss”.

title: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version
description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.

Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.

The game takes place five years after the Big Shell incident in Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty, in a world where war has become a business.

To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, Solid Snake throws himself into his final battle.

The battle against Liquid and the Patriots draws to a close, and the mysteries woven throughout the series are now revealed!

title: Cyber Breaker
description: Welcome to the 'Breaker System'. Fight back against the system through a game of cards and free humanity from its systematic embrace as BREAKER. Combine the use of skill cards and powerful artefacts alongside tactical thinking to best the system and break through the advancing array of robots.

title: Nitrokill
description: An action-packed futuristic hovercar racing game in the spirit of legendary Hi-Octane with online multiplayer up to 8 players.

title: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection: Volume 2
description: This second installment to the collection features “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version),” and also a digital soundtrack and "Metal Gear: Ghost Babel" as bonus content.

title: Bump Guardian
description: Bump Guardian is a casual deck-building defense game about protecting a growing life. Build your deck, repel incoming threats, and progress through the stages of pregnancy.

title: Ars Mechanica
description: A PvE idle strategy game where auto-battles unfold on a 10×5 grid battlefield. Customize and position your humanoid mechanical soldiers, defeat the enemies that stand in your way, and build the strongest mechanized army.

title: Pesky Orcs!
description: In "Pesky Orcs!" you take part in medieval fantasy battles between ancient foes: Orcs and humans. Dive into a unique mix of Autobattler, RTS and Roguelike in real retro pixelart fashion!

title: Infected Escaped: Upgrade
description: This DLC is used to unlock some important in-game features.

title: Smack Talk
description: Smack Talk is a 1-4 player online pvp platform fighting game where you must say your moves out loud. Beat your opponents with one liners and finish them off with ultimate moves in this chaotic new fighter!

title: 9mm Roulette
description: Step into a chaotic bar where every turn is a deadly gamble. Spin the revolver, smash tables, dodge bullets, and turn bar items into weapons. With destructible environments, ragdoll physics, and dark humor, it’s all about luck, strategy, and surviving the madness.

title: Lyrvane Park
description: Lyrvane Park is a first-person meta-horror puzzle adventure. Use the Radar of Emotions to harvest children's emotions, power up the train, and unlock the path forward. Beyond the Staff Only signs, the park’s darkest secrets await

title: Rewind 99
description: The year is 1999. You're the last remaining video rental store. From humble VHS clerk to rental racketeer - run your video store and explore Reshoot Springs, building an underground empire. Expand with upgrades, side hustles, store membership, and more. Whatever it takes to survive.

title: Infected Escaped
description: A co-op PvE survival game where you team up with other survivors to scavenge resources, fight infected enemies, uncover the map, and reach the final extraction point.

title: Project II: Silent Valley
description: Project II: Silent Valley is a linear, semi-open world dystopian visual novel with card combat and explore. Play as US Navy Officer Hierophan, joining the docile humanoid weapon Osprey to uncover a conspiracy at the underwater base "Silent Valley" and the hidden truths of his missing friend, Ochira.

title: Shifting Sands
description: Welcome to the Nexus. You died, the sandpit brought you back, and now you have a shift to finish as a scrapper. Scavenge crashed ships, cram your pack with dangerous salvage, meet odd survivors, and make it home each day through a weird desert world before the storm resets the sands and you with it.

title: Aggelos 2
description: With the gods of light about to lose the great battle against the gods of darkness, you must master two powerful forms. Dive into a challenging Metroidvania set across contrasting worlds filled with secrets, puzzles, and intense 2D combat in this action-packed sequel

title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
description: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment. Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, it follows Sophia, a young plunderer, as she travels to Minotaur’s Island and searches for answers about her past. The game is described as an original story set in the A Plague Tale universe, featuring combat, puzzles, and mythological elements tied to the series’ wider history.

title: Race Jam
description: Experience the thrill of the 1990s with Race Jam - an action packed arcade-style racing game! Featuring retro-inspired tracks, high speed gameplay and an authentic throwback vibe. Race Jam: Exhilarating 90's Arcade Racing like you remember, But BETTER

title: Star Wars Zero Company
description: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in Star Wars Zero Company, a single-player turn-based tactics game.

title: AstroScaper
description: A minimalist puzzle city-builder where every placement counts. Build colonies on asteroids using strategic proximity-based mechanics and minimal resource management. Relax in freebuild mode or chase high scores in challenge mode – all against a serene cosmic backdrop.

title: Cocoro
description: "Please make me human." A visual novel about a robot longing to become "human" in a world torn apart by rampaging AI. An unforgettable summer unfolds between a boy who has nowhere to call home and a humanoid girl who dreams of marriage...

title: CozyCat Simulator
description: Experience a cozy and atmospheric feline adventure in "CozyCat Simulator." Defend your territory or form alliances in this cinematic Victorian world. Engage in dynamic mechanics, from hunting mice to mischievous antics.

title: Animal Falling
description: Animal falling is a multiplayer party game featuring cartoon animals in ball form, engaging players in a platform race filled with strategic obstacles and traps to hinder opponents. Unleash your mischief, obstruct rivals, and navigate the chaotic hilarity to victory in this wild, furry showdown!

title: Shrimp Game: Overkrill
description: Become a pilot of a SHRIMP - Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platform. Krill your friends, explore areas for loot and customize your SHRIMP!

title: Tradesman: Deal to Dealer
description: TRADESMAN: Deal to Dealer is a game about a merchant who rides around in his horse-drawn (or bear-drawn) cart. Starting his journey in his home village of Grampstead, the Tradesman heads off to the other towns and villages of the world. Stock up on marine morsels in Fishpool, quench your thirst at Grubgrog Village's renowned tavern, sell basic necessities in Hoboken, and trample the dirt in Normingham, the capital of these lands!

title: Patagon
description: Patagon is a first person open world VR Steam Punk adventure shooter. It's fun and easy to play. The game takes place in an alternate steampunk reality where the British empire has never ended. Battle giant monsters and dinosaurs while you explore Sand Dollar island.

title: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread
description: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread is an action-platformer fan game where you jump, spin, and fight through unknown lands to help Gura reunite with her lost bread!

title: Infection Free Zone
description: Take charge of a group of survivors from your city. Choose your base of operations, then rebuild and readapt the buildings around you to create a self-sustaining settlement. And when the night falls - Defend the zone from the infected! Play on any city in the world, using real geographical data!

title: Lou's Lagoon
description: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

title: Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend
description: Welcome to Eientei, combine multiple colors of mana to build your ideal deck, duel with gensokyo girls, and chase back the mysterious moon treasure. Also, enjoy the unpredictable Roguelike with fantasy Danmaku!

title: MegaBattle
description: Build robots and enter the arena to battle! Robots have taken control of the galaxy and now humans must build bots to fight in the MegaBattle Arena. MegaBattle combines the best of the CCG with innovative mechanics such as unique mana mode, opponent reading attack and a fast card draw system.

title: VCuber
description: Control the light ball and crush the bricks! Nara the girl can destroy the bricks by hitting the light ball and controlling its direction of movement, using the ball to clear all the bricks in the scene, but be careful of the enemies and their bullets.

title: Western Wolf Hunter: The Dead Forest
description:
Western Wolf Hunter: The Dead Forest throws you into a wild and unforgiving world where survival belongs to the strongest.

Explore a vast open forest filled with dense wilderness, dangerous predators, rival animals, hidden territories, and untamed landscapes. Hunt for survival, defend your territory, confront powerful beasts, and fight your way through a world where every encounter can become a battle for dominance.

Take control of powerful wild animals and experience intense animal combat, hunting, exploration, territory battles, and survival gameplay. Track prey through the wilderness, face rival predators, explore dangerous regions, and prove that you have what it takes to become the dominant beast.

title: The Mountain Peak
description: A lost scout, one island, and a summit 190 metres up. Climb marked rock hand over hand, rest on chalked holds before your grip fails, and cross four biomes that each try to stop you a different way. The island is rebuilt every day at 00:00 UTC and every scout climbs the same one.

title: My Adorable Ghost Story
description: A cowardly ghost needs your help to find peace. Complete his final wishes, get closer to him, and unravel the mystery of his death as you search for your own freedom in this short, story-driven adventure.

title: Seconds Until You Die
description: Incremental survival game where you add seconds to your life by eating and drinking increasingly surreal foods, while trying to avoid getting burnt, crushed, dehydrated, distorted, destroyed, and many other things.

title: Quickie Takeout
description: Adult-Only Visual Novel about fast-food shenanigans with your three quirky coworkers. Get into questionable scenarios in this light-hearted, slice-of-life NSFW comedy.

title: A Studied Seduction
description:
Arthur Ruthven's thirty-fifth birthday is fast approaching, but he's worried that his life has started to stagnate.

Arthur was once a history teacher in Edinburgh, but an incident with a former pupil causes Arthur to retire early. Newly uneasy about teaching, and unsure if he can pursue the career he once loved, Arthur returns to live with his mother in their old family bookshop.
