He would prefer to forget his days as a teacher, and the anxieties that came with them...

But Arthur can only keep his past at bay for so long, and his life takes an unexpected turn when his mother hires a new helper at the bookshop over the summer holidays: one Mason Tierney, one of Arthur's former students.

Mason has done some growing up in the five years since Arthur last saw him, and now, he's twenty-one. Mason tries to be friendly with Arthur, but Arthur wonders. Is Mason being too friendly - and will Mason's interest in Arthur stir up uncomfortable memories Arthur would far rather see buried for good?

title: Tower's Gate
description:
A third-person aether-punk open world RPG for PC

You wake on a foreign world with a character you built — not a hero on rails. The world has dozens of creatures and thousands of dungeons to discover and conquer.

Character Leveling, Skills-based, Large Open World (107,000+ Square Kilometers), and over 13,000 Weekly Rotating Dungeons. Multiplayer capable for up to 8 players on a private server.

title: Brick: One Block at a Time
description: Start with a brick and build a life in a Newark-inspired urban survival sandbox. Scavenge the city and forest, unlock blueprints, build and raid bases, drive stolen cars, command recruits, outsmart rival clans and police, or survive with friends in co-op.

title: Axis Football 2027
description: Axis Football 2027 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.

title: Gem Party
description: Match 3 or more gems to channel their power into your cute animal party. Defeat the endless bosses charging toward you.

title: Cartoon Crime
description: Cartoon Crime is an open-world action crime game with third-person and top-down gameplay, story missions, police chases, recruitable bodyguards, enterable shops, and bowling, billiards, and arcade mini-games.

title: I am an Air Traffic Controller: Airport Hero Centrair EX
description: You are the Air Traffic Controller! Issue commands and ensure airport safety!

title: Express 404
description: Drive a storm-ridden night train, manage your speed and your passengers — one of them is a mimic. Build powerful upgrades between stations, reach dangerous quotas, expose the monster, or profit from chaos in this roguelite paranoia simulator.

title: Console Archives: Bubble Bobble
description:
Bubble Bobble was released by Taito in 1988 for an 8-bit home console.
This is an action game where Bub and Bob, transformed into Bubble Dragons, go on an adventure to rescue their girlfriends, Betty and Patty, who have been kidnapped by a wizard.
The game features 100 stages in total. What will happen if you clear Stage 100 and see the "True ending"...?

title: Police Officer
description: Police Officer is a first-person police station simulator where you manage a police station: process suspects, hear citizens' pleas, and manage the daily chaos of law enforcement—one decision at a time.

title: International Obsession
description:
It's signing season for the Provisional Government, and Kissy and Torture Ball have their sights on the most valuable free agent of all. But who else is staking out a claim to the transfigured earth? What is "the millennium", and is it over yet or not?

Part 1 in the Future Jumpers series of pulse-pounding action storygames.

title: Poncik's Little Tragedy
description: Explore an abandoned theater consumed by a mysterious fungal infestation. Use Poncik Bot to solve puzzles, restore power, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Something terrible happened here, and the truth is still waiting to be found.

title: CQ: Calling Any Station
description: An idle/incremental game about a lone radio operator keying into a silent universe. Click or walk away, both work just as well. Build your station, log distant contacts, retune to grow stronger, and slowly decode what answers back.

title: The Memory Library
description: Found the card you need? Then combine it. Even a card that looks completely useless might become surprisingly useful once you combine it. Probably. Collect and synthesize cards, create unexpected synergies, and take on 10 story chapters and an endless dungeon.

title: Kesu-Ji
description: Kesu-Ji is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics. (Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode) You can aim for high scores on the online leaderboards in each mode and earn rewards. Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

title: Hide and Fuse
description: Turn into a lamp. Freeze. Pray. One player carries a live bomb and hunts the room — everyone else is furniture. Blend in, hold your nerve, and pass the bomb before it blows. A party game of disguise, panic, and betrayal for 2–10 players (or grab a few and let the chaos fill the rest)

title: Idle Fleet
description: Build your mining fleet in a persistent online universe where every player helps shape the economy. Train 7 skills, automate production with drones, trade on the player-driven market, and forge the legendary Vanguard hull while your fleet keeps working on the server.

title: Scum's Errand
description: Raid cursed dungeons, claim powerful loot, and escape before it's too late. Scum's Errand is a top-down roguelite horde shooter with extraction mechanics where every run makes you stronger, but greed can cost you everything.

title: Ghostflippers
description: Flip haunted houses with your friends… before the ghost flips you. Reach your quota, grow your business, and survive the night.

title: Crown of the Nile: Cleopatra's Choice
description: Become Cleopatra VII in a historical romance visual novel of power, betrayal, and forbidden desire. Reclaim your throne, navigate Rome’s ambitions, and rewrite the fate of Ancient Egypt through your choices

title: Fell & Sell
description: Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!

title: Flyra: FPV Drone Simulator
description: Flyra is a high-speed FPV drone simulator with Racing, Freestyle, and Survival challenges. Test your reflexes, explore unique environments, and fly a range of drones with realistic physics. Discover the thrill of flying free.

title: Night Rolls Cozy Store
description: Run a cozy late-night store. Prep fresh sushi and rolls, stock the shelves, and serve customers until dawn. A chill store management game where every night shift is yours to own.

title: Click the Button
description: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

title: Crystalyn
description: Start with one bullet. End with hundreds. Crystalyn is a fast-paced top-down bullet-hell looter shooter about pushing your build to its absolute limits. Fight monsters, defeat bosses, and turn their loot into unstoppable firepower.

title: Water You Doing?
description: Your ride is dead, and rough waters lie ahead! Survive aboard a musty boat in a totally chaotic co-op. Collect scrap, patch up leaks, swap your catch for cold brews, and use harpoons to break the laws of physics!

title: Make My Sandwich
description: Make My Sandwich is a cute puzzle game about assembling sandwiches by hand. Read the order cards and drag ingredients onto the board, stacking them carefully layer by layer. Consider your guests' diets and tastes, pick the perfect drink, and follow all order requirements to clear the level!

title: BrushHammer Miniature Painter
description:
BrushHammer Miniature Painter is an innovative mixed-reality experience that lets you live your miniature painting hobby.

Paint virtual miniatures using a robust suite of digital tools. From spray cans and airbrushes to shade washes, edge highlights, dry brushing, decals, high-gloss finishes, and more.

Access original miniature collections crafted by our artists here at Soliton. Each collection includes several models with interchangeable poses, all equipped with various accessories and many basing options.

title: Goblins Can Conquer
description: From a small pack of goblins to a mighty horde: conquer the lands turn by turn! Strategize your expansion, build your village, and collect powerful spells to empower your army. Recruit new goblins and crush your foes: the age of the goblin has begun!

title: Endless Silent Night
description: An all-ages port of 12 no Tsuki no Eve.

title: White Rooms
description: White Rooms is a first-person puzzle game where every room teaches you a rule... then punishes you for believing it. No combat. No reflexes. Just trust, and the moment it breaks.

title: Truck Manager Australia
description: Build a car-transport company across Australia. Take freight jobs, plan tours, manage trucks, drivers and running costs, track profit and loss, and expand your fleet step by step with a clean desktop UI. Play offline.

title: Shadow Dungeon
description: Nightmarish monsters crawl forth from the darkness, while the Demon Lord lurks beneath the abyss. Venture into the Shadow Dungeon, carve your way through blood and chaos, and forge your own legendary epic.

title: Electio
description: Five live rounds, a blank, and a choice. Electio is a short narrative horror game where death carries permanent consequences.

title: States of Power
description: Command your nation's armies, economy, and diplomacy in this WWII grand strategy wargame. Easy to start, hard to master and a full match fits in one session. Play singleplayer and multiplayer, or create, play and share your own custom scenarios with the built-in scenario editor.

title: Optasia: The Last Visit
description: A first-person psychological experience set inside a fading mind. Explore an empty asylum, shifting memories, and the quiet weight of promises left behind. No puzzles. No escape. Just one last visit.

title: SCP: The Beginning
description: A first-person survival horror game set inside a collapsing containment facility. Explore restricted sectors, read unreliable reports, and survive hostile entities where following procedures can be just as deadly as breaking them.

title: Tales of Medieval Duelists
description: Ditch the animations. In Tales of Medieval Duelists, every swordfight is a unique physics-based clash. Master precise, skill-driven combat where timing a perfect parry is your key to victory. Build your legend with deep progression, gear, and a high-risk win streak multiplier.

title: Brigandine Abyss
description: The king of Solginat is dead, and a new would-be emperor stands over the corpse. Confront the dark in one of six different storylines as you manage resources, rally your monsters, and stand against the empire

title: The Grand Slamboree
description:
The Grand Slamboree is a 2D Platform-Fighter, where every hit is lethal for intense, fast-paced rounds. With simplified movesets, anyone can join in the brawl, while leaving plenty for dedicated players to master!

Bash, blast and chomp your way to victory in this tournament of creatures, weirdos and not-quite-heroes.

title: Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026
description: Sniper simulator game with sponge bob graphics

title: Slay the Berserker
description: Slay The Berserker: A solo developer's 3D hack and slash dark fantasy game with 2000's retro style. Find your path with stylish platforming movements as you slay enemies in half. Face challenging bosses across diverse biomes in your quest to Slay The Berserker.

title: Tóng Dāo Yín Jiàn
description: During the Xining period of the Northern Song Dynasty, a treacherous prime minister wreaked havoc on the imperial court. He engaged in militarism without regard for the rich and the poor. Using his position as a court official, he obstructed the lending practices of landlords, favoring the common people over the gentry. Undeterred by the will of Heaven, he attempted to divert the Yellow River, a move that would etch his name in history. Fearing this move would destroy the lifeblood of the Song Dynasty, the underworld rallied around a general, a knight-errant, an assassin, and a thief, known as the "Four Swordsmen," to bring down the treacherous prime minister Wang Anshi.

title: Find My Frogs: Branches
description: Find My Frogs: Branches is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a hand-drawn village nestled high in the branches of an ancient tree. Explore charming corners, discover tiny secrets, and help Uncle Froger find his missing hat.

title: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking
description: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking is a physics-based cooking game full of discovery and playful chaos. Experiment with everything in the kitchen and unlock around 300 recipes on your way to becoming a master chef!

title: Thumps & Blows
description: Chaos and fun are guaranteed in this fighting game, where a quirky cast of stickmen battle each other using ridiculous techniques in fast-paced fights with easy-to-learn yet unexpectedly deep mechanics.

title: Fractured Worlds
description: Fractured Worlds is a dark fantasy action RPG set in the shattered remnants of a ruined reality. Master weighty, precision-based combat, explore diverse realms, and face challenging bosses alone or together with other players of the realm

title: 7 Nights Keeper
description: In 7 NIGHTS KEEPER, take a job to watch over a mansion for 7 nights and uncover a horrifying secret: the elderly occupant is possessed by a demon. Survive the escalating terror and keep the darkness at bay, or become its next victim.

title: Fatal Claw
description: FatalClaw is a high-quality 2D Metroidvania game. Explore the mysterious underworld in your own way with cat “Kisha” who rise from the dead, and find the key to the ground with other survivors through absorbing the power infected enemies.

title: The Lands of Hyberian
description: Welcome to The Lands of Hyberian. The kingdom of Tydrall is ruled by the king and queen who have claimed all The Lands of Hyberian. It is up to the brave knights of Tydrall to answer the kings summon! Prepare your training and bring your wisdom as the king seeks an audience with you.

title: Beware the Depths
description: Get in. Get Loot. Get out. Countless misguided souls have delved into the unknown Depths. Some seek riches, others, long-lost arcane secrets, and for a few: heroic glory for the sake of mankind. No matter what it is that you seek - if you want to stay alive, always remember to Beware the Depths.

title: Folk Emerging
description: Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with in-depth characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the wilderness, hunt megafauna, outsmart competitors in trade & autobattler combat. Discover fire, agriculture, politics... and survive to tell the tale.

title: Zong
description: Zong is a first-person VR adventure game that takes you on a journey through ancient Eastern history and culture.

title: Pickle Pete
description:
A mysterious substance has turned Pete into a pickle!
Darkness has settled over the world, and our hero must find a way to survive against the waves of evil forces. Stack up, gear up, and create countless combinations of unique builds to become stronger than your enemies. Find the antidote and save the world!

title: Barbarian
description: Soulslike-inspired open-world survival RPG for 1-10 players. Master fluid combat with precise parries and dodges, defeat epic bosses, craft & upgrade gear, build your base, and share items with friends. Your progression persists across every world — play solo or with friends.

title: Roots in the Sky: The Hand of Glory 2
description: After five years in hiding, former Miami detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is swept up in another globe-trotting supernatural mystery whose origins trace back to a legend about the creation of Earth itself.

title: Everything Must Fall
description: Everything Must Fall is an action-packed physics puzzle game in VR. You are an outcast among the tinies working your daily job as a demolitioner at Blow Big Stuff Up Ltd. Before you know it, your life is turned upside down. You must save your parents. A Journey of a lifetime begins.

title: Antidote
description: 30 minutes. That is all the time you have left before the infection consumes you. Bitten and lost in the heart of a procedurally generated bunker, your only chance of survival is to locate and inject the antidote hidden within its depths. The countdown has begun.

title: Dead by Daylight: Chorus of Sin
description: Step into the world of divine horror in Dead by Daylight's first community-created Chapter: Chorus of Sin. Play as The Judgment, a divine Killer sent to cleanse the world in flame, and Aurora Stardotter, a resolute Survivor leading her people out of the ashes.

title: Modularis
description: Modularis is a roguelike space shooter where you pilot prototype ships built to contain the chaos of space.

title: Clutter 19: Survey Says What? - Collector's Edition
description: Clutter 19: Survey Says What? - Collector's Edition delivers the most entertaining and challenging Clutter yet, featuring over 1,800 puzzles! Tackle new Clutter Gaps Diamond Style, Rotation Matters, Pop-Ups and Clutter Pics (Pic Jong) Variations, and more in this endlessly replayable challenge.

title: Slum Z
description: Slum Z is a horror incremental roguelike featuring tower defense elements. Fight through relentless zombie hordes, a single-player in a dark survival shooter where every bullet counts. hunt for rare cursed blood, and upgrade your arsenal and prepare yourself.

title: Lord of Tokens
description:
Lord of Tokens is a free browser-based massively multiplayer management simulation
set in the artificial intelligence industry. Each player runs a competing AI company,
hiring researchers, scraping datasets, purchasing server infrastructure, training
models and releasing products to acquire users. Companies can also research
unexplored technologies, contribute to open source and invest on a stock market.

Players compete for market dominance within a shared zone, where prices and market
share emerge from the collective decisions of everyone playing. The simulation runs
on a one-to-one time scale, with one real-world day corresponding to one in-game day,
so a company keeps operating while its owner is offline.

title: Quizumba
description: Quizumba is a browser-based, live multiplayer trivia platform that lets players easily build and customize Jeopardy-style quiz games in minutes. Players can join game nights using a simple room code to compete individually or in teams with real-time buzzers, custom categories, and live scoreboards.

title: Pattern Pulse
description: Put your mind and reflexes to the test in this retro-futuristic challenge!

title: Magic Market World
description: "Magic Market World" is a PvP rhythm game with strategic elements. Place your advertisement spells, sell your products and make sure to stay ahead of the competition!

title: Inseco
description: Para sobrevivir a un mundo agonizante, debes presenciar el fin de la humanidad. Vive un tenso horror point-and-click donde cada decisión brutal sella tu destino. Mientras el mundo muta en un monstruo, ¿cuánta de tu humanidad sacrificarás para sobrevivir al enjambre?

title: Rotting Grief
description: A short psychological-horror narrative in which your choices matter. Journey through the give stages of grief as Liam, a man who just recently lost his wife due to... unknown... circumstances.

title: Tatlone
description: Our protagonist lives an ordinary life, yet something continues to spark their curiosity. One day, a close friend calls and invites them to visit a place where their grandmother also lives. Before long, they begin working on a shared project together.

title: From Below
description: A first-person mystery horror game where you explore a mysterious mansion, interact with objects, collect evidence and records, and uncover the truth behind a past incident.

title: Crimson Desert Enhanced
description:
The Greymane's Journey, Enhanced. Discover an enhanced Crimson Desert, featuring new story moments and expanded voice-over and language support.
Begin the adventure loved by millions, refined since launch with a wealth of updates, including new content, mounts, pets, customization options, various quality-of-life improvements, and more.
Crimson Desert Enhanced is a free update for all owners of the base game.

title: Guardians of Dreamstate
description: Guardians of Dreamstate TCG is a fantasy trading card game where both players share every turn. Draw, Set, LVL UP and battle across five lanes every turn. Your goal of the game is simple, damage your opponents 7 card life deck while they have none remaining and you win the game!

title: Artificial Bloodline
description: Artificial Bloodline is a single-player horror escape game. Explore an abandoned hospital, scavenge for resources, and use your environment to evade terrifying monsters as you search for an escape route and uncover the secrets hidden within. Escape before it's too late!

title: OverInfected
description: OverInfected is a tactical roguelike auto battler featuring parasite management mechanics, where your life is on a timer. The stronger you are, the faster your ‘weapon’ kills you. Death isn’t an option – it’s a core gameplay element. During a run, you’ll need to find hosts to transfer into, freeing yourself from your problems. Sooner or later, your life will start all over again.

title: Wonderstructs
description: Wonderstructs is a Mixed Reality application that lets you build massive, intricate rolling ball sculptures right in your own home! Drag and drop conveyors, track pieces, bowls, funnels, and switches from a virtual palette into your physical environment. The parts automatically snap together, making it easy to put together complex tracks that span your entire room.

title: Ling House: Echoes Within
description: Ling House: Echoes Within is a first-person psychological horror experience. Uncover the hidden tragedy beneath the surface of a haunted house. As reality breaks down, your video camera reveals images of an alternate space. You must see through the connection between both worlds to escape.

title: A Border With No End
description: A Border with No End is a horrorpunk adventure RPG set right in the middle of your normal everyday insanity, psychotic depression and a surreal nightmare, that is both meaningless and interpretive. Fight for nothing and loose it all.

title: Open Up, Michael!
description: Balance strange offerings on a door handle, remember its unsettling note sequences, and find out who Michael really is. A short first-person comedy-horror game about five rituals, readable puzzles, two endings, and one suspiciously well-balanced cheese wedge.

title: A Couple Nights at the Chud House
description: You fell asleep first at the sleepover, and now your friends aren't acting quite the same. Defend yourself from the Chuds in this point-and-click style horror game, uncover forgotten memories, and discover what's really happening.

title: Gold Coast Gambits: Boca Raton & Palm Beach
description: A turn-based digital board game set in Boca Raton and Palm Beach, Florida. Compete for Prestige through property, Luxury Cards, and strategic map play. Tackle 50 Solo Gambits with increasingly challenging bots and varied objectives, or play the full board game solo against bots or with friends.

title: Hide and Moo!
description: Somewhere in this field, someone is doing their best animal impression. It’s you. Record your own animal sound, then try to match it under pressure while hunters close in. A chaotic voice-mimicry hide-and-seek party game with proximity chat.

title: Tsugunohi: The Thread That Beckons to Heaven
description: Just keep walking left. The latest Tsugunohi returns to the series’ roots with its early visual style and atmosphere. On a sweltering summer day, a girl walks home past “righteous” people, a thread of salvation, and her mother beneath a white umbrella. Is that hand salvation—or a curse?

title: Honkai: Star Rail - To Roll the Stars in Astropolis
description:
Version 4.5 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Robin • Summeretto and Aventurine • Waveflair
• New Trailblaze Mission: "To Roll the Stars in Astropolis"
• New Trailblaze Continuance Mission: "How to Lose Your Way to the Top: The Zero-Dollar Strategy"
• New events
• ...and more!

title: SlapGains
description: Train in a neon gym, walk into the arena, slap your way through five leagues. Every rep is on the beat, every slap counts. Your body visibly grows with you: thicker arms, broader shoulders, stronger legs, depending on what you train. Bronze to Diamond. One hit decides it.

title: Vertigo Rush
description: Vertigo Rush is a high-speed VR racing game where your hands are your engine. Climb, swing and fly through visually stunning tracks. Race against AI, compete in global Time Trial leaderboards, or challenge up to 10 friends online with polished, precision hand-based movement.

title: Lawn Order
description: There are 50,000 leaves on this lawn and every one of them is your problem. A first-person leaf blower sim with obsessively real leaf physics and some fun surprises.

title: Twisted Party
description: Survive. Sabotage. Style on your friends. Twisted Party is a retro horror party game stuffed with deadly mini-games and buckets of blood. Betray your way to victory and unlock crazy skins by conquering brutal challenges. Last one standing wins

title: Apidya' Special
description: Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.

title: Holey Ship
description: Holey Ship is a chaotic co-op game for up to four players. Where you and your crew fix boats under pressure. Repair damage, solve fast tasks, and keep customers happy in a fun and chaotic world. Work together or mess with your friends but can your crew stop everything from sinking!

title: Portrait Painter
description: Paint portraits to help a struggling art museum in this relaxing painting game.

title: Chronicles Puzzle: History Path
description: Piece together the shards of time in this historical sliding puzzle game. Experience a journey from the Big Bang to the future through 80 unique levels and 320 challenges. Choose from four difficulties, collect trophies, and unlock the wonders of the world - available in 14 languages.

title: Snap the Cat
description: An incremental game about taking photos of cats. Upgrade your account, unlock new cats, and take photos of them so everyone on the planet will follow you!

title: BoHeM
description: Live an anti-cozy life on the sidewalks of Rainy Street. Fix apartments, tend bars, thrift for clothes, and uncover the wacky mysteries surrounding the eccentric yet seemingly normal tenants as they go about their daily lives.

title: Satawn
description: Satawn aims for a more complete village life experience: farming, building, inventory, scene-based exploration, transitions between zones, day and night cycles, cinematics integrated into gameplay, and a task system ranging from simple requests to neighbors

title: Blood Dungeon
description: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

title: 1666: Amsterdam
description: Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.

title: Leon&Suharto
description: An interactive dramatic thriller novel with immersive elements. Immerse yourself in a dark tale of revenge, where you must find those responsible for the horrors of the Kapella Estate, survive despite your own fears, and face the irreversible consequences of your choices.

title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
description: This is a fight for survival. Xenomorphs swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last.

title: How Asian Parents went to School
description: An online 1-4 player co-op adventure where you experience the legendary struggle of getting to school as an Asian parent. Fight a psychopathic bear, defy physics, and survive the emotional damage from Tablo Escobar : an NPC who roasts you every time you fail.

title: SVETIK
description:
SVETIK is a top-down dark fantasy adventure RPG where the player explores a world plunged into darkness after the sun has been sealed away. The protagonist, Iskra, awakens in a prison with no memory of her past and encounters Svetik, a living fragment of sunlight that becomes her only source of illumination.

Together they travel through the dark lands of Lucida, facing creatures that lurk in the shadows and discovering the truth behind the disappearance of the sun. Light plays a central role in both exploration and combat, allowing players to reveal hidden paths, weaken enemies, and survive in areas consumed by darkness.

Svetik is not just a tool but a companion with its own personality. The relationship between Iskra and Svetik evolves throughout the journey, and the player's actions influence how the light behaves and responds during the adventure.

The game combines exploration, combat, environmental puzzles, and narrative choices while uncovering the mysteries of a world where light and darkness are deeply intertwined.

title: Snack Invaders
description: Slipping into a junk food‑induced coma during a late‑night movie marathon, you wake up as an astronaut stranded in a galaxy overrun by living junk food! Play solo or co‑op online with up to 3 friends (4 players max) to battle hordes of junk food and Souls‑like bosses as you fight to escape alive!

title: Sokogram
description: Sokogram merges Nonogram logic grids with Sokoban box-pushing puzzles. Each level blends both systems into one unified challenge with handcrafted designs that reward deduction over guessing.

title: Sludgineers
description: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, unlock new areas and complete quests.

title: Bard’s Fault
description: Bard’s Fault is a co-op Action Roguelike where you and your friends fight back-to-back against relentless swarms. Craft new builds, sync your abilities, and break the timeline in this multiplayer bullet heaven. Death is just the beginning, go back to the past and unravel a time-travel mystery.

title: Koikata: How Our Love Grows
description: An all-ages remaster of Koi Suru Kimochi no Kasanekata, with upgraded resolution, new features and Ichika route, which was not present in the original game.

title: Astral Court DX
description:
Astral Court DX is an arcade precision platformer! Taking place in Heaven, you play as "The Prisoner" - an infamous criminal who's been to prison one too many times and is sent to death-row! Heaven's one and only court, the Astral Court, is an... odd one... and decides to grant The Prisoner with a series of deadly trials that, if completed, will allow them to get out of prison scot-free!

In these trials, you platform on top of the Scales Of Justice, well several of them, collecting little stars named "Shinies" that spawn around the arena. You must collect a certain amount of Shinies all whilst avoiding whatever foes or obstacles have set up to stop you. Movement is made to give you as much control as possible to avoid hazards efficiently, you have a jump that can be performed even whilst falling and a double jump to get as much height as possible. There are a variety of other characters whom add extra challenge to the trials, accessible in the endless mode only however.

title: Funguys Swarm
description: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire—and it’s very much not fine. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe—just maybe—save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

title: A College of Thirst & Claws: Season 1
description: An immersive, story-driven adult visual novel. As a werewolf joining a supernatural college, you'll be thrown into the deep end of a sinister conspiracy in the town of Lanstone. Develop relationships with beautiful women as you shape the story with your choices.

title: Western Rye
description: Welcome to the harsh and lawless world of the Wild West, where a mysterious fever called the 'Rye Fever' has turned the once-proud frontier into a lawless wasteland. In this world, survival is the only law, and you'll need to be tough, quick-witted, and deadly if you hope to make it out alive.

title: Lorne
description: In a wartorn world you are key to restore peace and order to the lands of Lorne. Equip Evelyn with the right tools you can find, craft or upgrade in this ARPG featuring interactive combat, open world exploration and intimidating temples filled with puzzles. End the corruption and keep Lorne safe.

title: Polylithic
description: The Polylithic is a 3rd person crafting survival set in the Paleolithic/Neolithic era where the player crafts items, unlocks technology, discovers the world, builds bases, and can either grow the tribe and command the settlement or play the game solo.

title: Hero Mania
description: Hero Mania is a bombastic, comic-book themed multiplayer party game where players don the spandex of unfamed, super-powered heroes as they brawl their way to the top using their abilities, wits, and even each other!

title: Crabs: Chef's Story
description: In this Multiplayer Party Brawler, play as one of 'Chef's' crabs! Launch crab ass with 'Crab-fu' and battle online in a number of crazy game modes designed to push your crabs abilities to the limit.

title: Box Knight
description: A funny, silly and irreverent action RPG roguelike. A mix of ‘the Office’ and ‘Lord of the Rings’ with a comic like aesthetic.

title: Kick the Ball
description: Kick The Ball is a physics-based side-scrolling platformer where both you and the ball must reach the goal. Master precise movement, overcome challenging obstacles and beat your best times.

title: Magic Mess: Restore Order to the Wizard's Tower!
description: Magic Mess: Restore Order to the Wizard's Tower! is a cozy single-player organization simulator. Return 3,040 scattered items, including books, potions, scrolls, and crystals, to their proper places and restore order to the wizard's tower. Don't let your dragon waiting outside distract you.

title: Sexy Beaches 2
description: Sexy Beaches 2 is a casual idle dating sim where you upgrade tropical islands to unlock new characters and animated sex scenes. All girls from the first game return, along with many brand-new characters and fully animated collectible scenes.

title: PW7A
description: This is a short, top-down adventure game (with some puzzles) starring a robot.

title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - Magical Library
description:
Dust off your wizard hat and robes. The library is open!

The Magical Library expansion invites you into an arcane sanctuary overflowing with magical books, enchanted artifacts, and new Spirits to discover.

Master the basics of magic by studying dusty grimoires in the grand archives, or spend quiet moments bonding with your Spirit companion, curled up among piles of books.

title: Amazing Trip to Europe 4: Search for Cats
Melon on a Mission
description: Being a watermelon has never been this dangerous. Climb your way to the top by jumping across everyday objects, balancing on tricky platforms, and avoiding a juicy disaster. Every fall could mean a long trip back down — or a smashed watermelon. Stay calm, keep climbing, and complete your mission.

title: Banana Republic
description: In Banana Republic, guerrilla fighters seize the supreme court. Neutralize terrorists, rescue hostages, choose to serve your country. Uncover a history of corruption and violence.

title: The Library on the Lake
description: Library on the Lake is a narrative multiverse where players take on the mantle of the Archivist. Undo a magical curse by traveling into different books to repair corrupted stories. Explore other worlds, meet a unique cast of characters, and play engaging mini games.

title: Trade the Crash
description: A no-rewind trading survival sim set during the dot-com crash. Manage $50,000, pay living expenses, and trade 63 fictionalized instruments across 818 market days. Choose a career path, manage risk, and learn from 86 built-in lessons while every decision carries forward.

title: Olinda Fighters
description: Olinda Fighters is a brawl style fight game inspired by Brazil's northeastern carnival characters. Featuring two different play modes: rounds or last man standing, for 1 up to 4 players. Use power-ups and energy drinks to move faster and hit harder your opponents. Remote Play multiplayer compatible!

title: Scribble Grounds
description: A small game where you can draw on anything, in a 3D space that you share with your friends

title: Backyard Paintball
description: Multiplayer FPS game with cross-play to mobile players.

title: Monster Academy: An Interactive Story
description: A heartwarming visual novel for children featuring a rich story and valuable life lessons.

title: Smashing Bottles
description: Smashing Bottles is a short and satisfying incremental game where you break bottles to earn money, upgrade your bat, discover new bottles, and cause chaos! Will you smash enough bottles to buy the universe?

title: Union of Rivals
description: A deep colony sim and city builder. Manage resources and production chains to build the railroad from East to West. Found towns, harvest and refine the goods that fuel the line, then persuade or outlast the settlements in your path. Every citizen has a name, a trait, and a breaking point.

title: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing
description: Bzz bzz! Hop in chaotic bomb-fueled battles inspired by arcade action classics we all love! Blaster up to 8 players locally with ant-astics Pome-grenades in this bomb-em-up party game and bee the last bug standing!

title: Little Doll Village
description: A Wretch travels to the Holy Land in search of a good time.

title: The Last Road
description: In this narrative-driven casual strategy RPG, you take on the role of The Driver, sworn to deliver goods along The Last Road. With each journey bringing different semi randomized events to challenge the player, you will need to manage your resources carefully in order to survive.

title: Afterlight: The Apartment
description: Explore an mid-2000s Korean apartment complex in this short first-person psychological horror experience.

title: Y2kill
description: A top-down arcade zombie roguelite set in 99's New York City. Build broken combos, unlock a million-dollar arsenal, slay four monster bosses, and survive the party at the end of the world.

title: Trial by Chat
description:
Trial by Chat is a crowd-judged party game built for Twitch streamers. Players answer a prompt with the funniest card in their hand, but instead of players judging each other, live chat decides the winner. Every viewer, across every connected streamer's channel, votes in real time using simple chat commands.

Play solo with your own community, or team up with other streamers for a true crossover session where every connected chat votes together. An OBS-ready overlay displays the game live on stream, and hosts get full control over game settings, pacing, and content.

Trial by Chat is designed specifically to boost chat engagement and interaction, turning passive viewers into active participants in every round.

title: Traveler Stories: Journeys of Real People
description:
“Are you really okay with living like this?” For the players just getting by in their everyday lives.
This is a visual novel with simulation elements. About 80% of the story is based on true events, and depicts the stories of real-life travelers such as Rieko Ayumi, who has traveled to 98 countries as of now.
As a staff member at a bar where travelers gather in Tokyo, you will encounter their unconventional lives and grow alongside them.
In the process, your rigid values and assumptions are bound to be shaken.
This is a simulation for lost souls like you to encounter a new version of yourself.

title: Wordless Forest
description: You are alone in the forest. You remember nothing. In this live-action interactive survival thriller, the story is written not by dialogue, but by your choices.

title: Money for Girls: Amortized
description: Fashion. Corruption. Malice. A girl detective faces her darkest mystery yet, in this horror-romance visual novel with stickers, outfits, and bad ends.

title: Titanic Escape Simulator
description: Investigate a dark mystery aboard the RMS Titanic before the final night becomes a fight for survival. Explore, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and make impossible choices as history’s most famous ship sinks beneath the Atlantic.

title: Shelve the Potions!
description: Shelve the Potions! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

title: Peg Champ
description: Take your best shot in this Pachinko puzzle game! Break pegs, earn money, and unlock a huge upgrade tree in this satisfying physics puzzler.

title: Eslabong
description: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

title: Hell Cleaners
description: A first-person automation game set in hell. Suck up demon bodies, feed them into the Grinder, fuel your Purifier, and deploy a swarm of Doombas to build a cleaning operation that runs itself and takes the rot back one zone at a time.

title: 100 for Justice
description: 100 lives, one justice. Manage 100 citizens in a country falling to shadow forces. Your choices shape a collective timeline across decades. Lead unions, survive assassinations, and leave a legacy of resistance in this text-based political strategy sim. Words are your greatest weapon.

title: Oil Island Hustle
description: An Empty Island, Full of Oil, and your ON IT! Build your Oil Empire and Dominate the World Market! Create oil factories, produce oil barrels and sell them to different countries and earn Lots of Money! Hire workers to automate and remember to pay your 1 million loan to your co-worker

title: Loot Frog
description: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

title: Company is Watching
description:
Dear new employee, we are thrilled to welcome you to our production line. Here, your mission is simple, repetitive, and essential: maintain our quotas. Let yourself be lulled by the routine. Obey the instructions. Screw, clean, and destroy what you are told to destroy.

Optimization is our priority.

title: Bar After Bar
description: Bar After Bar is a co-op game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?

title: Feed the AI
description: Feed the AI. Collect data. Unlock upgrades. Watch the algorithm grow beyond your control. An active incremental where you feed an evolving AI with data and shape what it becomes. Will it save the world… or take it over?

title: Combolands
description: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!

title: Chuck Bonesteel & the Alien Apocalypse
description: Shoot, loot, upgrade, repeat. Fast-paced, gib-filled, over-the-top arcade shooter with stripped-down roguelike gameplay.

title: Burned Horizons
description: A gritty, turn-based tactical sandbox set in 2002. No XP grind. No class rails. No buy-your-way skill trees. // 'They said it wasn't our war. So we made it ours.'

title: Bililitz
description: Bililitz is a vertical roguelike with procedurally generated worlds. Explore mysterious depths, collect items, and discover portals to new challenges. Compete in the global ranking system to prove your skill and reach the top!

title: Table Space: Board and Card Game Sandbox
description: The ultimate tabletop games sandbox for mixed reality, designed for Steam Frame and SteamOS. Make and play board games, trading card games, and more with friends on any compatible XR headset. Use the Boxtree Builder to bring your own decks or create entirely new custom game modes.

title: Ecrazeus Castle
description: A 3D action RPG looter with dual-wielding weapons inspired by arcade games! Run, jump, loot, power up, and defeat monsters before time runs out, then prove your might by dethroning the owner of the castle!

title: Tekken 8: Bob
description: Speed & Weight - Perfect Body Bob is joining the fight!

title: Overtrick
description: A trick-taking roguelike with style! Outplay your rivals, purchase special abilities, and dazzle 1920s high society with your unstoppable cardplay. Call your contract, follow suit, flush trumps, and claim the hand. This isn't your grandma's bridge club... this is Overtrick!

title: DualVerse86
description: A 2D retro speedrunner where every second counts. Switch between worlds, dodge traps, beat the clock.

title: The Shadow Cosmos
description: A 3D metroidvania with retro aesthetic. As master peacock, delve into a mysterious, dream-like world with non-linear exploration and progression, stylish and challenging fights with a powerful halberd, tricky parkour and puzzles. Collect shadows, unleash darkness.

title: Iron Blight
description: Iron Blight is a survival horror game set in a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town. You are trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows, and above all, find your wife, Valeria.

title: Lovebyte.exe
description: A parasocial VTuber dating chatsim where you join a friendly degen discord group to chat about your oshis together, but is your kamioshi actually one of your new friends? Chat, uncover irl identities, & romance a fellow fan - or maybe a VTuber. Inspired by Mystic Messenger, online communities, and internet spam

title: America Against Ants
description: The year, 1951, the place, Nevada, USA. Take command of Task Force Sable and battle through 30 increasingly challenging missions to defeat giant, mutant ants as they swarm from atomic test sites in the desert. AAA features a unique, narrative driven blend of tower defence and real time tactics.

title: Mint's Hints 3
description: Hunt down rogue androids, save trapped spirits, and uncover shocking truths about your past. Mysteries unfold as you fight to free your friends and survive a twisted world. Can you trust yourself? The show’s not over yet...

title: Travellin Cats in USA
description: Find hundreds of cats hidden in multiple iconic cities of the United States of America in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!

title: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos
description: Purrrifiers is a hilarious 4-player co-op game about cleaning while causing chaos. Solve puzzles, drive quirky vehicles, use an array of cleaning tools and team up with adorable cats. Experience absurd humor, diverse locations, and non-stop fun as you collaborate or troll your way to cleaning glory!

title: Din's Champion
description: Mine and gather resources, craft useful items, and explore a dynamic, evolving world all while fighting off the evil gods' minions and machinations in this side scrolling, action RPG. Become a Din's Champion and stop Valta's new scheme to destroy the world. Oh, and beware of exploding barrels...

title: Nerd Simulator
description: It’s never too late to turn your life around! Step into the shoes of a 40-year-old finally ready to leave the nest in this hilarious RPG-Life Simulation mix. Tackle wacky challenges, embrace absurd adventures, and prove that with determination (and a bit of chaos), you can start fresh at any age.

title: Guardians of Restoration
description: Top-down robot action game combining action and bullet hell.

title: Volkolak: The Will of Gods
description: Volkolak: The Will of Gods is an epic 2D soulsvania in a dark Slavic fantasy setting, with hand-drawn animation. Explore an enchanted world full of secrets and enemies. Your choices will lead to several endings: become a warrior, a werewolf, or join the darkness.

title: The Dream Office
description: Welcome to "The Dream Office," an immersive game that allows you to step into the shoes of a master office designer and renovator. Prepare to embark on a thrilling journey where you'll transform drab and cluttered workspaces into stunning, productive havens that would make anyone's dreams come true.

title: Truth Universally Acknowledged: Silver Heart
description: Truth Universally Acknowledged - Silver Heart is a CEO Romance dating sim with 3 routes. Every love interest is a CEO.

title: Cow
description: The steaks have never been higher! Cow is the one and only fast-paced game about a cow riding a skateboard in a volcano above a pool of lava 🤘. Hop on your deck and milk each level, or become a well-done dinner.

title: Never Trust a Girl in a Portal
12 Labours of Hercules XX: Hold My Gold - Collector's Edition
SoulCalibur II: Recompiled
description: A native PC port of Game Cube's SoulCalibur II.

title: Pokémon Survivor Burst
description:
Pokémon Survivors Burst is a free, unofficial Pokémon fan game focused on survival-action gameplay. Players control a Pokémon directly while facing increasingly dangerous enemy waves, gaining experience and choosing upgrades and abilities throughout each run. The game features multiple playable characters, progression challenges, boss encounters, Classic and Rush game modes, and online leaderboards.
Pokémon Survivors Burst is a non-commercial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc. or The Pokémon Company.

title: Portal 2: Project 2009
description: Experience an accuracy focused nearly 1:1 recreation of Portal 2's early 2009 story. Made over the last 4 years by a team of Portal enthusiasts and beta researchers, this 2 hour long digital experience features Mel, the cut GLaDOS hub, new personality spheres and dozens of previously unseen areas.

title: T7's Basics in Birthday
description: Celebrate the original game but collect 7 cakes and get out to win!

title: Rotor Rescue Choplifter
description:
Rotor Rescue is the definitive Choplifter tribute and helicopter rescue action game.
Fly a VTOL gunship through 18 hand-crafted campaign sectors, blow open detention barracks, and extract every last survivor.

title: Outbreak Compound
description: Survive the siege. Burn the dead.

title: Open For Business
description: Open For Business is a shop management simulator, but not a typical one. This isn’t about selling water, food, or random everyday items. It’s about nostalgia — that feeling you get when you pick up a game, a movie, a cartridge, or a VHS, and it actually means something. In this game, you build your own store and sell games, movies and animated films, consoles, collectible figures, and more — from retro VHS tapes and cartridges to modern entertainment.

title: GwenBlade Witcheresque
description: Hack and slash your way through depression in lightning-paced Soulslike to find a way to finally move on from loss in real life

title: Crawler
description: Experience Crushing Co-op Carnage in CRAWLER: A VR Mech Horde Shooter. Blast through hordes of acid-spitting bugs as you earn cash and extract from randomly generated missions. Upgrade your mech’s arsenal back at base while scrambling to meet the needs of an ever-growing quota.

title: Type Ride
description: "Type Ride" is a typing-based tower defense game where you summon units by typing. In a world overrun by ink lifeforms, the protagonist—once known as the "Type Rider" for her high-speed typing skills while riding a motorcycle—decides to ride her beloved bike once again to resolve the chaos.

title: Chimera Pro
description: Step into the role of 'Control' in Project: Chimera, a gripping sci-fi spy thriller RPG and interactive visual novel. You are the remote handler guiding elite agent Chimera through a dangerous infiltration of the mysterious Kronos Corporation. Every text message and choice you make determines their survival.Features a deep branching narrative packed with tension, immersive visual novel elements, intense system-hacking minigames, and crucial resource/stat management (health, suspicion, and assets) to uncover corporate secrets.

title: Feed Them
description: They need to eat

title: Emergency Rush
description: Drive fast, dodge traffic, and save lives in Emergency Rush!

title: Kritzel Krieg
description: Kritzelkrieg is Age of War on squared notebook paper – except you draw your whole army yourself.

title: Sunlust: The Way We Remember It
description: Sunlust: The Way We Remember It is a 32-map [CITATION NEEDED] megawad where we at Broken Lamp Records made tribute to our favourite iwad, I mean megawad, Sunlust by Ribbiks and... and... fuck, who was the other guy? fuuuuck. I'm so sorry. I don't remember. fuckkk I'm so sorry. Anyway, these maps are all faithful recreations of each Sunder map purely from memory, with absolutely no creative liberties taken! However, our memories are not that great. For instance, we didn't remember what complevel Scythe 2 was, so we just went with the funniest number we could think of (21). Turns out this number is only 10 off from the actual complevel so we didn't do that bad! These maps are extremely similar in gameplay and quality [CITATION NEEDED] to the original Speed of Doom, so you know what to expect. We hope you will enjoy Sunlust: The Way Id Did, I mean Sunlust In Name Only, I mean, shit, I mean Sunlust: The Way We Remember It, based on Sunlust by Ribbiks and Et Al. Yeah, that was the other guy! Have funlust!

title: Mado Marks
description: Three students record themselves in a classroom room that shouldn’t exist... The next morning, one of them is gone forever... A short psychological horror VN about memory, proof, and erasure.

title: Superposition
description: An intense first-person psychological horror micro-indie. Keep your gaze locked on the pipe and regulate the valves under pressure. If you blink or look away, the system collapses.

title: Gods of the Grid
description: Fight your way up Olympus in a match-3 roguelike. Match runes to strike and heal, cast spells and claim relics, and find the weakness every foe is hiding. Nine realms, seven demigods, one life per run.

title: Horror Prison: Escape
description: You're not alone.

title: Blocky Powers
description:
Stack the blocks and reach the sky, trust real physics as towers rise high! Use tricky powers, cause a big crash,
and beat your friends in this party bash!

title: Mireglow
description: Step into a peaceful mystical swamp filled with wonder and hidden discoveries.

title: Deadline
description: Deadline is a 2D puzzle-platformer in which the player character, a drop of ink, leaves a permanent trail that becomes solid level geometry. Levels are completed by routing a single continuous stroke to the exit, with medals awarded based on the total length of ink used. Additional mechanics include trail-free pen lift dashes, solvent pools that erase drawn ink, and an antagonist called the Red Pen that pursues or erases the player's trail. The game features a five-chapter campaign of hand-drawn levels, unlockable remix stages, and cosmetic customization. Developed by Geared Games Studio.

title: House Cleaner Simulator
description: Build your reputation with every perfectly cleaned home.

title: Ashes of Kardoria
description: A dark choice-driven RPG where moral decisions shape your path. Face a brutal island torn by plague, hunger, and a growing orc threat. Pick a faction, hone your skills, battle unique bosses, and fight for a future worth paying for.

title: Princess of Frozen Flowers
description: Princess of Frozen Flowers is a boss-heavy dungeon RPG where you transform the legendary weapon Icebreaker, manage frostblood, and reposition across a six-zone battlefield in combat. Conquer one deadly dungeon each day as the world grows more vicious.

title: Three Kingdoms: Shu-han Chronicles
description: A traditional turn-based role-playing game depicting the story of Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the unification of China. Featuring over 200 characters, players can recruit enemy generals (beyond the Shu Han faction) to build unique battle formations.

title: Gravikitty
description:
Planet Aura is a colony of peaceful space cats. It is also directly in the path of an Evil Space Battleship. Gravikitty is the only one of them who can fly.

She's unarmed, so she improvises: a force-field swat that sends incoming fire straight back into the thing that fired it. The rest is paws and physics — thrust, drift, and swing around gravity wells while scooping up gold.

title: Hermes Library
description: Hermes Library is a simulation game in which you will play as the new librarian Rainn Echo. In six weeks, you will be helping people to borrow and return books, while discovering hidden messages in books, meeting new friends and unraveling the mysteries happening at Hephaestus University.

title: Hua Manlou
description: Infiltrate the enemy capital, using the entertainment venue "Hua Man Lou" as a cover, and secretly train six talented and beautiful women as spies to carry out reconnaissance and assassinations. Advance the plot through skill development, and unlock three endings through love, hate, and revenge.

title: Crystal Breaker Inc.
description: Crystal Breaker is a short incremental space game about flying, mining, and upgrading. Destroy crystal formations with your ship, unlock rare new upgrades, mine crystals and credits, and grow stronger through a skill tree.

title: Pixel Pup
description: Pixel Pup is a nonogram game, in the style of Picross, for the Game Boy Advance. Enjoy puzzles from various themed packs, including DIY, The Nineties, Zoology, and a Taiyaki Fabulous crossover!

title: Narrow Holes
description: An relaxing erotic anime puzzle game. Complete five different mini-games to unlock new artworks, and enjoy your hot collection in the gallery.

title: Liminal Space Holiday
description: Take a break from life and enjoy a Liminal Space Holiday. A Relaxing Liminal Space Adventure full of Beautiful Atmospheric Nostalgic Locations and Artwork.

title: Coral Chronicles: Bookworms and Barnacles - Collector's Edition
Desktop Bouncer
description: Desktop Bouncer is a cozy desktop companion physics game where a lively cartoon ball bounces across your screen, colliding with icons, chasing high scores, and turning your desktop into a playful arcade playground while you work, browse, or relax.

title: Print I Love U
description:
"A few weeks ago I came across a second hand laptop. The previous owner had disappeared.

On it, I found this game: Print I Love U. It's a short visual novel with three simple mini-games. Reaching the end takes about 15 minutes. It’s got hand-drawn characters and an original soundtrack that’s been living in my head rent-free since the first time I played it.

At the beginning, there's a note. It says the game was made for someone called Alice. It says: I hope you find this.

I've been trying to find her too.

I don't know who made this game. I don't know who Alice is. What I do know is that something about it stays with you, whether you want it to or not.

There's more than one ending. Not all of them feel like endings.

If you're Alice (or if you think you might know her) please tell me. Maybe you can solve this mystery."

This game may include content that is not suitable for all ages.

title: Pay your Deeds
description:
Pay Your Deeds is a roguelike deck-builder played on a 5×4 slot reel.

You are in debt, and every few days the Sector expects another payment.

Spin the reel, collect Scrap Credits and add new Symbols to your build. Find combinations that work together, remove the ones that don't, and try to make enough money before your next Deed is due.

title: Arkan Solas 2: The Silence of Valemora
My Sexy Fairies
description: Step into the enchanting world of My Sexy Fairies, where you become the trusted assistant of four charming fairy girls. My Sexy Fairies - is a meditative, relaxing game that takes 30 minutes to complete.

title: Strange Zoo
description: Pomerania Games is an independent game development studio based in Gdańsk, Poland. The studio focuses on creating simulation and management games and is the developer of Strange Zoo, a zoo management game featuring animal care, expansion, resource management, and dynamic events.

title: Moo Who?
description: Can you sound like an animal well enough to survive? Moo Who is a multiplayer voice-mimicry party game where animal players hide among NPCs, and make animal sounds into their mic before hunters figure out who is fake.

title: 4096 Space Traders Era
description: Trade the galaxy. Fight for it. Rule it.

title: Tails of Iron II: Blood and Brine
description: Blood and Brine, the free expansion for Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter. Leave the frozen wastes of the North behind and travel to Hardshell Brook, a coastal settlement where new characters, dangerous creatures and something altogether more sinister are waiting beneath the waves.

title: Little Horrors: The Mortuary
description: A midnight call wakes you up. Your employee at the mortuary is trapped in the storeroom and you have to go help him.

title: Galumb
description: Galumb is a chaotic and fun party game where you can compete fiercely against your friends or rivals—or team up to overcome challenges together. Your goal is simple: navigate obstacle-filled courses and be the first to reach the finish line. But remember, you’re not the only one fighting for the same goal.

title: Pokémon: Ghost Grey Version
description:
Kanto, 2049

Welcome to the world of Pokémon... A horror-inspired love letter to the creepypastas and edgy romhacks of the late 2000s and early 2010s, Pokémon: Ghost Grey version offers an original story, taking place in a decayed Kanto region set 50 years after the events of Gold, Silver, and Crystal. These lands have become decayed, and the once vibrant and lively region of Kanto has been overrun by ghosts, ghouls and bad actors, lived in by broken people with no way for escape...

title: Fear of Faith
description: FEAR OF FAITH is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game where cloned soldiers raid cursed WWII bunkers. Choose your class, combine spells and drink BEER to keep your FEAR away, or face a fate worse than DEATH

title: Chaotic World
description: Chaotic World is a top-down PvE arena shooter where your objective is to clear waves of different and unique enemies until you destroy them all. Set across colorful maps, you will have the opportunity to make yourself stronger by leveling up and finding loot on your way to the last wave!

title: Food Fight
description: Food Fight is a cozy but crunchy grid autobattler roguelike. Your snacks fire on their own cooldowns across a grid of 8 slots while you make the real decisions between fights: what to buy, what to upgrade, which risk is worth taking, and which fight to take next.

title: Samba del Tuerto
description: "Samba del Tuerto" is a short narrative video game with voice and text only in Spanish, about the people living in a village haunted by the crows that flock above their heads.

title: The Last Disease Z
description: The Last Disease Z is a co-op survival experience where everything is against you. Abandoned cities, zombies and bandits, a struggle for resources and a place to live. Build, unite, and survive.

title: C.U.B.E
description: CUBE - Survive deadly trials, earn upgrades, and compete for the title of True Subject in this 1-6 player co-op party horror game where cooperation is required, but only one player can come out on top.

title: Hearthwater
description: Escape to a peaceful seaside village and discover every hidden corner.

title: Clickbait Tycoon
description:
Clickbait Tycoon is an idle/incremental simulation game in which the player builds a clickbait media company in a pixel-art depiction of 1980s New York. Beginning with a single website and desk, the player publishes articles to generate views and ad revenue, then reinvests earnings into staff, upgrades, and new mechanics unlocked through a Research Lab system.

The core loop combines active clicking with automation: players staff a newsroom across twelve hire tiers, catch trending topics, fix typos for combo streaks, publish golden articles, and respond to breaking news events by choosing to verify stories, publish immediately, or sell tips. A separate RPG layer follows a field writer through 40 quests featuring boss encounters against editors-turned-monsters, lootable gear, and click-based combat.

Additional systems include an office tower with a 10x10 grid of rooms that grant permanent bonuses across resets, collectible creatures called Pocket Pals that hatch from boss-dropped eggs and can be merged and evolved, staff policies, payroll, scandals, and daily, weekly, and seasonal events. The game features two layers of prestige: selling out resets a run in exchange for permanent website bonuses, while a later buyout trades the entire empire for Legacy Shares. It includes offline progression, over 270 achievements, and cloud saves.

title: Harvest Deadline
description: Plant crops, earn money, and reach the daily goal in this pixel-art farming roguelite. Buy upgrades, discover artifacts, and create powerful synergies in short, strategic runs where every decision can grow your farm—or end it.

title: The Last Portal
description: Build and upgrade a fantasy army to defend the last surviving portal across 150 increasingly dangerous waves, expanding zones, and powerful boss battles.

title: Suncroft
description: Enjoy the sun!

title: The Expansion
description: A psychological first-person horror experience set in endless Backrooms. Explore abandoned corridors, uncover hidden secrets, evade mysterious entities, and survive a world where every turn leads deeper into the unknown.

title: Big Adventure
description: In this pixel platformer, you can play through both the main storyline and an additional storyline, destroy enemies, interact with boxes (and TNT) and much more! You can even create your own levels and share them with other players!

title: Mall: Tidy Up Together
description: Shelve the products, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the mall. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

title: Four Lights: The 4th World - Märchen Route
description: This story is of God and us and our grand revenge against Lucifer.

title: Watering The Plant Girl: Roots & Rehydrated
description: An inflation-kink NSFW visual novel where a scientist named Enora experiences the best and worst week of her life with a cute plant girl. Tons of worldbuilding and sexual-yet-wholesome content!

title: Overhatched
description: A chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op dinosaur management game where you hatch, raise, and ship dinosaurs through increasingly hectic facilities. Order supplies, manage physical inventory, grow food, and try not to run over your friends with the forklift.

title: Doppler
description: Die fast. Restart faster. Scream a little. Meet Doppler: a tiny blue ball of blue nerves with a red bandana snapping in the wind.

title: Around The Core
description: A space-themed incremental shooter where destruction fuels growth. Annihilate asteroids, harvest wealth, and climb a massive upgrade tree.

title: Flora Parasocial
description: Audiences connect to their favorite celebrities all the time. How does it affect these people when put into a game of life or death? Only time will tell.

title: Four Lights
description: This story is of God and us and our grand revenge against Lucifer.

title: Medic Mayhem
description: Toy soldiers fight on chaotic battlefields and you're the medic! Four player local coop with friends and bots. Win the war by saving lives!

title: Spright
description: Spright is a 2D action-adventure about a lone warrior in a diving helm, drawn into the ruins of a fallen world. Craft weapons, bend spacetime, and fight through hostile environments, survive ambushes, and explore strange realms.

title: Chef's Dogma
description: Chef’s Dogma is a roguelite turn-based battler where you journey through the 7-layers of bean dip hell. Upgrade your team through stats, items, or ‘entree’s creating even stronger foods. Experience a multitude of play-styles, Enemies, and locations to help the chef ascend into purgatory…

title: Rejected Draft
description: Rejected Draft is an incremental auto-battler where you play as a discarded doodle seeking revenge on the Artist who threw you away. Battle rival sketches, absorb their powers, and grow stronger through a deep web of upgrades, skills, and progression systems. Unlike traditional RPGs, you decide which enemies appear in your world, shaping your build by choosing which powers become available. Every enemy is a sketch, and many enemies can appear in multiple alternate interpretations, each offering a different artistic take on the same concept. With strategic progression, long-term growth, and randomized elements that make each run feel different, Rejected Draft blends idle game progression with RPG buildcrafting and auto-battler combat.

title: V.A.U.L.T Protocol
description: Vault Protocol is a 1–6 player co-op horror game focused on extraction, communication, and chaos. Every run is different, every sound matters, and survival depends on your team.

title: Loot Gobblin' Together
description: An online co-op game where you and your friends play greedy gobblins invading human houses to steal and gobble loot. Climb, stretch, and manage your stamina to survive chaotic heists and feed your Gobblin King.

title: Buried Below
description:
'An old tape replays your worst memory. A camping trip. A fierce storm rolling in. Your girlfriend vanishing near an abandoned mine. You've replayed this night until the tape wore thin. Tonight you take control, and tonight you go further than the memory ever let you. Can you survive the depths and find her, or will the memory never end?'

In Buried Below, an atmospheric survival horror experience, things start with an interactive intro leading up to a camping trip gone wrong. During a storm, your girlfriend goes missing. Armed with key information previously provided by a clerk about a nearby abandoned mine, you venture out to explore the vast, free roamable forest, needing a map for orientation. Gaining entry to the mine involves using items correctly to solve environmental puzzles blocking your path.

Once inside, your survival depends on managing your lighter's fuel while navigating the tunnels. You'll need to use stealth, either hiding or creating distractions, to evade the creature that lurks below. Can you escape this desolate place alive, or will your memory never end?

title: The Sorting Bureau
description: A cozy sorting game set in a quiet Tokyo workshop. Clients bring you boxes of clutter: buttons, coins, gears, stamps. Sort, match, and piece everything together with satisfying ASMR clicks. No timers. No wrong answers. Just the joy of tidying up.

title: Dungeon Tells
description: The heroes have escaped their cages. Dungeon Tells is a single-player social deduction game where you can read the minds of your enemies. Execute the weak, charm the strong, and defend your dungeon.

title: Rollin Ravioli
description: A physics-based rage game. Control a ravioli can. Fight the physics. Accept the fall. Inspired by an iconic early 2000s ravioli commercial.

title: Skijoring
description: Crash into your friends in Skijoring, the unhinged sport of push and pull. Get wild airtime, screen-peek to survive, and embrace co-op chaos in the world's first, best, and only arcade skijorer.

title: Peace Dice
description: The post-apocalypse. When some are trying to survive in a new world, others join the detective agency "Peace Dice", which searches for evidence of mutants. Go on a raid and don't come back empty-handed!

title: Twin Balls Journey
description: Live together, die together—bound by a single thread. True companions dare to have their fates tied by a rope. Twin Balls Journey is a two-player cooperative action game. Work in sync, manipulate environmental contraptions, and leverage each scene's unique properties to conquer every level.

title: Negative Time
description: Negative Time is a bullet hell rogue-lite shooter where each time you get hit, you are sent further and further back in time, until you are sent into the past they tried so hard to erase. Maybe in there lies the key to your escape?

title: CyberGhitch
description: CyberGhitch is a narrative puzzle game where players team up with an exorcist trapped in a CD to battle "digital evil spirits" born from internet chaos in hilarious, bizarre adventures.

title: Alien Apocalypse
description: Alien Apocalypse is an open-world sandbox survival game set after a devastating alien invasion. Scavenge for resources, craft, build defenses, and harness alien technology to fight back. Play solo or in co-op and reclaim what’s left of the planet.

title: Roll 'n Bounce
description: Roll n' Bounce is a 2d, pixel art, side scrolling precision platformer game. You will need to master the movement and timing to make your way through these progressively challenging levels!

title: Vivere Retro
description: Vivere Retro is a psychological survival horror game about the origins of fear.

title: Tanks: Total Destruction
description: TANKS Total Destruction is a tribute to a cult classic, reimagined for modern action gaming. A top-down view, movement limited to four directions, and intense, tactical gameplay come together with modern visuals, spectacular explosion effects, and smooth animations powered by Unreal Engine 5.

title: Lazy Witch's Factory
description: A run-based rogue-lite factory builder where middle management meets lawless Hell. Optimize production, make questionable deals, and race against the debt deadline.

title: Stuff It!
description: Colorful dolls with voluptuous bodies can come to life, don't you know? All they need to do is meet their Maker. Are you ready?

title: Blood Red Rebirth
description: Drive, shoot, and blow up your way through an East Bloc hellhole with a beaten-up sedan, an AKM and a post-punk soundtrack. Your mission is to steal three nuclear missiles – and so is everyone else's.

title: The Snake Is the Tower
description: What if your entire tower defense army was one snake? Slither through enemies, merge matching segments into evolved towers, and claim territory to victory.

title: Vholume
description: Vholume is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

title: Cicadamata"
description: + follow the white rabbit + hop, skip, and jump to become one with joyeuse, until you are no longer you +

title: AI Pixel Battle
description: AI Pixel Battle is a game where you draw your own original monster that looks like it could defeat the enemy monster. The AI judges the outcome and narrates how the battle unfolds. Unleash your creativity and create your own original monsters!

title: Lord of Mysteries
description: Lord of Mysteries is an upcoming RPG game based on web novel Lord of Mysteries officially licensed by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving.

title: Minsgon Simulator
description: Minsgon Simulator is a Market & Collectible simulation where you can hatch Minsgons from mysterious eggs, manage your store, develop your collection and compete in the Olympics with your Minsgons. Organize your shelves, sell to your customers, train your Minsgons and play your way to the top!

title: Defeat the Goblin King
description: Gear up and leave on a Roguelike RPG expedition to the unknown, strategize your way to victory against impossible odds in turn-based combat. It's time for the tyrannical rule of the Goblin King to end!

title: Taste of the Wind
description: A simulation and RPG game with multiple endings, set in a Chinese restaurant. Play as the owner, and manage the restaurant, form bonds with characters, and explore the lively town. Uncover the secrets behind the restaurant’s mysterious downfall.

title: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker
description: Every character remembers, watches, tests, and may deceive you like a living person. They have emotions, voices, expressions, and buried secrets. Break them with words or evidence — or realize too late that you were only a pawn in their game. A detective game built around truly lifelike NPCs.

title: Taste of Blood
description: A real-time strategy game with a simple economy, designed so you can focus on the battle and crush your enemies.

title: Friday Night
description: Investigate a family’s gruesome fate, communicate using your microphone to uncover the truth, and hide from the spirit. Film the whole experience in your camcorder for the world to see.

title: Clickonomy
description: Clickonomy is a cozy sandbox game where you harvest resources from your very own tiny planet just by clicking. Gather, recycle, and find the rarest treasures to expand your collection as you explore a lively world that’s uniquely yours — all at your own pace.

title: Dwarrf: A Pinball Roguelike
description: Play as a Dwarven 'Pirate' and set sail on your modified minecart into the depths of the mines. Fight enemies in a unique blend of Pinball, Pachinko, and Bubble Shooter whilst collecting game altering balls & relics that ensure no two runs are alike.

title: Settler's Domain
description: Settler's Domain is a settlement-building game with citizen and resource management elements. Build structures, recruit settlers, gather resources, and explore your surroundings.

title: Drunken Rogue
description: The rowdy adventures of drunk-as-a-skunk Rogue Lita and Vampire of Demise Endo! Stagger around traps and stumble through demon assaults. Make your way to the dungeon's deepest depths—rumored to contain the most precious of booze!

title: Zodiac Mountain
description: "Zodiac Mountain" is a roguelike deckbuilder following the journey of a Panda as they adventure to become a Chinese Zodiac. Utilise dual hands of Yin & Yang, encounter fierce mythical characters, outskill your enemies in battle, and climb Zodiac Mountain.

title: Thousands of Heroes
