description: This game is a roguelike where item management is crucial. Since almost all items have a limited number of uses, the choice of whether to use or save each item becomes important. You can also cooperate with other users by sharing dungeon IDs!

title: Dawn One
description: Fight to survive till Dawn One in the most accessible hardest top-down action game ever (Self proclaimed). Mouse only.

title: Of Pawns & Kings
description: "Of Pawns & Kings" is a slightly modernized, visually stunning, point&click adventure in the spirit of Monkey Island, Riven and Labyrinth. (the Jim Henson movie) Solve puzzles, combine items, talk to fascinating characters and advance in the rich story. Can you reveal all the secrets to make a stand

title: The ordinary case of Margaret Luoni
description: The ordinary case of Margaret Luoni is a sci-fi detective game with a deep story. Help Detective Dirk understand what happened, explore a new futuristic world. There are no obvious solutions here, find your own approach to witnesses and look for hidden places and clues to discovery.

title: Pixel Pawns: Chess Duels
description: Chess with pixel-art duels. Play on Windows PC and Xbox, solo or locally with a friend.

title: Harvest Hand
description: A cozy turn-based farming deckbuilder where cards serve as your farming tools. Plant and harvest crops, manage water and energy, adapt to changing weather and threats, and complete increasingly challenging contracts to earn coins and upgrade your deck. Balancing farm management with strategic card choices, the goal is to keep your farm thriving while building an increasingly powerful set of tools.

title: Can Your Otaku Cabinet Grow a Beautiful Girl?
description: Players will take on the role of a savior transported to a miniature world, rescuing flowers through battles and trials, protecting and caring for them, and embarking on a new harem life in a perilous fantasy world.

title: Re:Store the Record Store
description: Re:Store the Record Store is a game about tidying up an indie record store after the owner had to run off to chase down his escaped monkey. Featuring over 1000 items to pick up, sort through and return back into the crates where they belong. Take your time to look through everything or speedrun it!

title: Scavenger Mouse
description: A 3D exploration game where you guide a lonely mouse person named Bruise through a lonely forest area, scavenging for anything you can find.

title: Roll to Ruin
description: Roll to Ruin is a medieval dice roguelite. Roll, hold, bank or farkle — Farkle rules with a deckbuilding twist. Battle through seven taverns, build your dice deck, wield 34 badges to flip the table. Outscore your rival or lose it all. Dice are fate. Every wager counts. Just one more... right?

title: Lumber Tycoon Island
description: One axe. A whole island. A logging empire.

title: With the Devilish Her…
description: “With the Devilish Her…” is a cohabitation romance simulation game. You will spend three weeks living together with your friend’s younger sister, Marina. Her alluring charm will draw you into a heart-pounding shared life filled with temptation!

title: Risky Business
description: A fast-paced adult clicker where every tap brings stunning bombshells to life. Unlock animated scenes, grow your gallery, and enjoy a sleek, one-hand thrill packed with fun stories, gorgeous girls, and very spicy visuals.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: The Light at Dream's End
description:
Version 9.0 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the end of Part 2 of the main story, which includes:
• New Part 2 Story Finale: The Future We Embrace
• New AstralOp: Senadina
• New Featured Event: Captain's Wishing Tree Secrets
• ...and more!

title: Rip N Ship Simulator
description: Build your own card-breaking empire in Rip N Ship Simulator. Open packs for viewers, manage live orders, grow your simulated stream, collect and grade cards, run giveaways and auctions, upgrade your setup, and create custom cards, packs, and complete sets.

title: Media Basket Manager
description: Media Basket Manager is a single-player basketball management simulation game where you take full control of a basketball club. Manage transfers, develop young prospects, create tactics, and make key decisions to build a championship-winning team.

title: Console Archives: Rhapsody II - Ballad of the Little Princess
description:
Rhapsody II: Ballad of the Little Princess was released by Nippon Ichi Software in 1999 for a 32-bit home console.
Set 12 years after “Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure”, this musical RPG follows Kururu—the daughter born to Cornet and Prince Ferdinand—as she sets off on a journey to find her ideal prince.
Enjoy the world of the Marl Kingdom brought to life by richly expressive characters and a newly revamped battle system that adds deeper tactical depth.

title: The Rolling Rolling Rolling Rice Ball
description:
Simple, easy-to-play action game.
Cute illustrations.
Great for learning Japanese and English.

title: Zed and Zee
description: Get ready for 8-bit mechanical mayhem!

title: Arcade Archives: Cyber Cycles
description:
"CYBER CYCLES" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
This game featured a large bike-style cabinet design that stood out at arcades at the time.
Set against the backdrop of near-future motorcycle racing, choose from a lineup of unique machines with different performance features, and cross the finish line ahead of all your rivals!

title: Hotel Tycoon
description: Welcome guests, upgrade rooms, hire staff and build the hotel empire of your dreams!

title: Take Me to Your Leader
description:
Deploy Brain Slugs around the Globe to Save the World from itself.

A Survivors-like on planet Earth, where you Capture Locations designated by Name, Flag, Stats, and More. Fend off Earth's meager resistance by upgrading your ship's weapons systems. Unlock new characters, each with different missions, abilities, and priorities!

title: Maestro: Attack on Titan
description:
Take command of a massive orchestra as the walls tremble and humanity’s fate hangs in the balance!

Lead your orchestra through two iconic masterpieces from japanese animation masterpiece Attack on Titan.
From its haunting melodies to its most raging moments, feel the tension rise and unleash the full force of the orchestra as you conduct two epic anthems that have become legendary among anime fans!

Your Attack on Titan music pieces:

• Kohta Yamamoto – “Attack on Titan” (from Attack on Titan)
• Hiroyuki Sawano – “Ashes on The Fire” (from Attack on Titan)

Raise your Titan Sweeper, the exclusive conductor baton included with this DLC, and bring the world of Attack on Titan to life!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Cyber Cycles
description:
"CYBER CYCLES" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
This game featured a large bike-style cabinet design that stood out at arcades at the time.
Set against the backdrop of near-future motorcycle racing, choose from a lineup of unique machines with different performance features, and cross the finish line ahead of all your rivals!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Ninja Emaki
description:
Ninja Emaki is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1986.
Take control of the young hero Shinbei and fight to rescue the princess from the evil spirit army.
Pick up scrolls to gain access to 8 different kinds of Ninja Magic. Use them wisely, and they'll be the key to advancing through the game!

title: Threshold Warden
description:
upgrade your character
survive hordes
defend crystal

title: Anno 117: Pax Romana – The Hippodrome
description:
Construct the Hippodrome, a monumental five-stage project that challenges your city planning and resource management skills. Once unlocked with the Patricians, it introduces chariot races as a new city event, allowing you to entertain citizens, increase your city’s splendor, and unlock more prestigious competitions.

Assign specialists to train as chariot drivers, turning anyone from a seasoned veteran to a humble baker into a potential racing champion.

title: White Dwarf
description: White Dwarf is a top-down survival shooter about holding onto a piece of empty space for as long as you can. Your weapon fires automatically at the nearest target, so the only things you control are where you stand and when you spend your cooldowns. Everything else comes down to the choices you make along the way.

title: Still Rain: The Arrival
description: Ethan returns to his cousin's old family house, deep in the forest, a place he hasn't set foot in for five years, ever since the family who lived there vanished without a trace.

title: Halo: Project Chozo
description:
A crossover mod for Halo Combat Evolved on MCC with Metroid Prime elements!

Relive the Campaign of Halo as the infamous bounty hunter Samus Aran! With a small but powerful array of weaponry like the Power Beam, Super Missile and Plasma Beam, fight the Covenant Armada and waves of Flood Metroid Prime style!

All enemies and vehicles have weaknesses and resistances to certain weapons, plus rebalanced difficulty, a new health system, improved UNSC AI, and more!

As well as a secret on the final level...

Will Samus Aran be able to claim her most ambitious bounty yet?

title: PokeRank
description: PokeRank is an interactive live-stream quiz and progression game for Twitch communities. Viewers identify hidden creature silhouettes in chat, earn points and XP, unlock entries in a personal Pokédex-style collection, complete daily and seasonal missions, join cooperative Boss events, and compete across monthly leaderboards.

title: Galactic Warfare Collection
description: Face the ultimate threat in a ruthless shoot ’em up

title: False Love: Ghost or Not?
description: Can love survive when you can no longer trust reality? Emily and Ethan leave the city behind to rebuild their relationship in a quiet countryside home. Far from the noise of everyday life, they hope for a fresh start.

title: Chai Glide
description: Slither, collect ingredients, and brew tea inside your snake. Complete cozy shifts in this modern twist on a classic. Classic score attack mode included!

title: WordHive 2
description: Build words, score points, and master the hive.

title: Awaken in Fear
description: Awaken in the middle of the night to a terrifying nightmare. Explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, avoid sinister creatures, and fight to survive until dawn.

title: Dice Nights
description: Roll the dice, chase high scores, and master classic combinations, a colorful and relaxing board game experience for players of all ages.

title: Hollow Hide
description: Hollow Hide asymmetric hide-and-seek with new mechanics. Gather resources for disguise, signal your friends, run from the hunter. Or play as the hunter track down escaped test subjects and shoot them with your rifle

title: Maze of Doors
description: Maze of Doors is a psychological horror puzzle game where every door leads to a new impossible room. Explore a shifting maze, solve puzzles, survive terrifying encounters, and uncover the secrets hidden beyond each door.

title: Sleep Aid
description: Not every game is meant to be fair. Not every player is meant to survive. Bluff, adapt, and outsmart your opponent in tense poker matches where the cards don't always play by the rules.

title: Deep Blue Sushi
description: Deep Blue Sushi is a casual 1–5 player co-op adventure where you explore the ocean, catch fresh fish, prepare sushi, serve customers, and grow your restaurant while uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Deep Blue.

title: ReDraft: The Fantasy Football Simulator
description: A Fantasy Football simulator for PC: make your draft, create your team and win your fantasy league.

title: Smithsonian: Digging For Dinosaurs
description: A interactive adventure where young explorers excavate fossils, discover prehistoric creatures, and learn through play in a safe, engaging experience designed for curious kids.

title: Midnight Anomaly Mystery
description: Can you spot the anomaly?

title: Japan Stigmatized Property 2
description:
Can you survive until dawn?
Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly.

title: Emoji Killer: Casino Massacre
description: Shoot, dodge, kill, upgrade, unlock... do not let a single emoji escape!

title: Fortnite: Chapter 7 - Season 4: Override
description: Your mission is simple - override the system, take back the Island, and stop Geno before it’s GAME OVER.

title: Slot & Learn: World Flags
description: How many flags can you spot?

title: Spot the Difference Ukiyo-e: Fifty-Three Stations of the Toukaidou
description: Can you spot the change?

title: Road Line Puzzle: Connect the Paths
description:
Can you connect every path?
Twist panels, train your brain!

title: Eggconsole The Legend of Heroes III: "White Witch" Renewal PC-9801
description: The dawn of the Gagharv Trilogy. Join Jurio and Chris to uncover the truth behind the White Witch!

title: Fluffy Friends: Cute Preschool
description: Count and discover with lions, monkeys and exotic animals in a magical forest!

title: Get Fit: Furry Edition
description: Train with hot furries, push your limits, and get stronger with every session!

title: Kerf: Sawmill Tycoon
description:
KERF: Sawmill Tycoon is a first-person sawmill sim where nothing happens without you. Every tree is felled by your hand, every plank comes off a saw you operate, and every coin is earned at a counter you built up from nothing. You start with an axe and a single clearing at the foot of a waterfall.

Fell trees with your own hands, saw logs into planks, chop firewood, craft furniture and sell it all to your customers. A first-person sawmill tycoon where you do the work yourself: take on commissions, hire a crew, replant the forest and grow a humble yard into a timber empire.

title: The Final Scene
description: Can your memory catch the last clue?

title: Cozy Pages: Comfy Coloring for All Ages - Paint, Draw & Relax
description: Your cozy corner. Cute, calming coloring for all ages.

title: Aerialia: Wings of Delivery
description: Take to the skies, deliver with care, and connect a peaceful world one package at a time.

title: Trombone Champ Unflattened: Disney Movie Magic Vol. 1
Peaceful Bug Catching Story
description:
Pick up your bug net and set off on a grand summer adventure.
Your bug-collecting summer vacation is about to begin!

title: Just Anomaly: Hospital
description: 15 floors. One hospital. How careful can you be while shaking with fear?

title: Build My Arcade
description: Build your dream arcade from the ground up!

title: Beach Volleyball Boys: Hot Spike
description:
The roster's stacked. One spot open. Every match could change everything.
Think you can win them over before the season starts?

title: Wuthering Waves: Lamplight in Mirage, Sword’s Resolve in Heart
description: Continuing the journey across Solaris-3, Version 3.6 advances the game’s main story while introducing two new Resonators, powerful new weapons, challenging combat encounters, limited-time events, and extensive gameplay improvements across every platform.

title: Dino Hex Trap
description: Traps, Dinosaurs, and Strategic Chaos

title: Closing Shift
description: An online co-op horror game where you're a fast food employee in Hell. You'll need to serve customers, cook food, and meet your night task quotas to keep your job.

title: The Choices Of Priori
description: You wake in an empty room, condemned to endless work—until uncovering a mysterious black cloth, you find a vast underground lab, a group of strange creatures called KB-Cats are plotting a revolution there. Join their uprising, survive in this money-ruled world until you touch the truth and miracle.

title: Mine Defense
description: Mine Defense is a 2D action-adventure game inspired by sandbox survival games. Explore a dangerous world, gather resources, craft weapons and equipment, fight hostile creatures, and build your own base. Progress through the game by discovering new materials, improving your gear, and facing increasingly powerful enemies and bosses.

title: Vice Signalling
description: Vice Signalling is a short narrative game where you infiltrate a secret society of the rich and powerful. Decipher secret signals and use them to uncover a conspiracy against the Emperor.

title: Cataclismo: The Old Kingdom
description: Reclaim a lost realm in a new strategic mode – conquer and defend multiple citadels, marshal supply lines to fuel your advance, and hold back escalating waves of horrors as the final reckoning stirs. Rebuild the Old Kingdom, turn by turn.

title: Left Not Right
description: Control Lefty with your left hand, and Righty with your right. At the same time! Don't worry — it's a single-player game. No friends required. Use both hands to control two characters at once and escape the underground research facility!

title: The First Descendant: Season 4
description:
A hundred years of waiting comes to an end.

In the name of Qliphoth, Karel declares war upon the Descendants.
Prepare yourselves for the ultimate battle.

title: Labyrinthos: The Depths Want You
description: Ascend the sunken labyrinth called the Tower and choose your path to escape to the surface. Battle foes, forge relationships, and find power in this roguelite dark fantasy RPG.

title: Beetle Sumo
description: Beetle Sumo turns Japanese rhinoceros beetle wrestling into a fast couch-party battle. Charge, shove, scramble, and survive as up to 8 beetles fight to be the last one on the table.

title: Backrooms: The Deep Dark
description: Backrooms: The Deep Dark is a 4-player cooperative horror game where you will survive in a mysterious scary atmospheric world, wander through unknown dark corners and get scared of every nook and cranny!

title: Slime Soup
description: Run a grimy fantasy soup kitchen where you drop and link bouncing slimes to trigger messy chain reactions. Build wild combos with strange ingredients, serve bizarre customers, and turn your filthy cauldron into a chaotic score machine.

title: Meowmories
description: Our memories will bring us back together. A bittersweet and heartwarming "Meowmare" adventure about a cat's journey to find its owner. This is your story, and the story of your beloved cat.

title: False Alarm
description: False Alarm is a 2D stealth adventure where you enter each level with nothing, and use whatever you can find to complete your mission. Throw a crowbar, blow up a microwave, brew some coffee, drop a chandelier on someone's head. Stay out of the light and distract your enemies however you can.

title: Play Faster
description: Play Faster is a precision platformer built for fast movement, instant retries, and endlessly replayable runs. Master movement, optimize routes, and climb online leaderboards with built-in speedrunning tools.

title: Ghost Buster:Village
description: An extreme blogger travels to an abandoned village that, according to legend, was deserted in a single day. While exploring, he encounters rituals and entities rooted in Slavic mythology. But the truth waiting there is far more terrifying than any legend.

title: The Birth Cry
description: Mikhail Markov, lives in the city of Nesgrad in Virelia in the 1990s. The city's old maternity hospital, "Riverside Maternity Hospital," has been closed, and many stories and paranormal claims circulate among the public about its whereabouts.

title: How to Kill a Fly
description: You are a corporate flesh object with no way to speak on your own trying to pose as a human by mimicking what other people say. Serve the corporation that owns you, complete your assignment.

title: Odd's Job
description: Jump, bounce, and roll through jobs to unite his family in their new home. Unlock quirky relatives, grab collectibles, and explore differently themed worlds in this wholesome platforming adventure.

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope
description: The first major expansion for Heart of Chornobyl coming this summer, including a huge new storyline that can take dozens of hours to complete, two new regions, new and returning characters, and much more.

title: Sensory Overload
description: A dropper game designed to overwhelm your senses. Twisting tunnels, psychedelic patterns, and breathing walls assault your sense of balance as the chaos escalates with every level.

title: Aluminium City
description: Crush empty cans and sell the aluminium, buy upgrades, automatic can presses, and robots to automatize and speed up your process, and pay off your debt.

title: Graph TD: Cosmic
description: It is a strategy roguelike game. Use cards to form a graph of towers and nodes, tweak heat, power and other mechanics, and minmax what's in your hand. Reverse Earth's fate from the end of time.

title: Slayblade
description: Build your ultimate Slayblade and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts for battle, and combine them for wicked power combos. Skate around the city in all its PS1 glory, making bank on your way to the top. And if you die in the game, you die in real life.

title: DeadEye
description: Stop time and master your revolver in this intense 2D roguelike shooter. Face relentless hordes, defeat brutal bosses, forge powerful pacts, and collect artifacts and pets as you fight for survival.

title: Agro Simulator: Season 26
description: Agro Simulator: Season 26 is a modern farming simulator where you operate machinery, grow crops, protect your fields, and expand your business. Turn a small plot of land into a thriving agricultural empire.

title: Plinkomancy
description: PLINKOMANCY is a roguelite that turns a simple ball drop into explosive chaos. Hit pegs, rack up massive numbers, and unlock upgrades as you push the arcade cabinet to its limits. How far can you go before the machine pushes back?

title: Entity Research Group
description: First-person psychological co-op investigation horror. Players act as researchers, completing tasks and gathering evidence to identify various entity types.

title: Kotamon: My Sis Found a Super-Rare Card in Her Cereal Box, so I Became a Garbage Man to Find the Entire Collection and Earn $1,000,000
description: Clearing trash can feel even better when you not only make the world cleaner, but also find extra-rare cards that have suddenly increased in price! Rummage through garbage, fulfill the orders from the dump site owner, look for hidden treasures... and collect all the Kotámons!

title: Gargantua
description: Build your spaceship-city Gargantua. Forge industries, bend the free market, trade between planets, and defend your growing wealth. Every bullet is bought or produced in a simulated economy where a single mistake can shatter supply chains and trigger interstellar crises. In Gargantua, war is money.

title: Spirited Line
description: Spirited Line is a boss rush hack ‘n’ slash action game where every hit you take is fatal. Master precise, skill-based combat against unique spirits in a surreal, minimalist subway world. Fast-paced duels demand focus, timing, and patience to survive.

title: How to Fish
description: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

title: Feed The Scorchpot
description: A dice roguelike about feeding a dragon for twenty years. Roll ingredients, build your island, and fuse absurd recipes into combos that break the score wide open. Miss a meal and you're next on the menu.

title: Puppergeist
description:
Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

title: Hedgehog's Dilemma
description: A story of love, connections, and separation, a story about philosophy and science. Marharyta and Mykhailo try to figure out their relationships - and cannot help but fall in love over and over again.

title: Drive Me Broke
description: Build your dream car! The cops are always on your back, so stay on good terms with them... Also, be prepared to do any job that requires money.

title: The Stalked 3
description: A late-night thrill turns into a nightmare. Olivia sneaks into Creepwood Wonderland Carnival with her boyfriend, expecting a fun night alone in the park. But something feels off. Distant footsteps. Faint whispers. Someone else is here… Watching.

title: IAH: Internet War
description: "IAH: INTERNET WAR" - a roguelike Turn-Based RTS hybrid survival game. Battle through the internet’s depths and survive as long as possible.

title: Apex Ascent
description: Apex Ascent is a fast-paced climbing platformer where danger lurks on every wall. Dodge deadly boxing gloves that punch out from the surfaces, leap over spinning obstacles, and time your moves to avoid searing lasers. Reach the top or fall trying.

title: Swarmdustry
description: Build a living factory and automate the Swarm. Harvest resources, build mega factories and evolve organic industry. Balance growth, efficiency, creep spread, and survive in a world that fights back.

title: AI Learns To Drive
description: Train AI to drive! Create your own neural network and watch it evolve from chaos to mastery with the power of evolutionary algorithms and natural selection. Fine-tune the learning process to craft the ultimate AI driver, and test your creation in campaign challenges or on custom-built tracks.

title: Gallipoli
description: Land on the battlefields of the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1! Gallipoli brings the most authentic WW1 FPS battles yet, with desert warfare, beach landings, historical classes and realistic weaponry.

title: 2nd Eve
description: In 2nd EVE, a sci-fi side-scrolling combat RPG, you're Zola, Sister Superior of the colony spaceship ARGOS. After a catastrophic hyperspace event, battle rogue machines, twisted crew, and deadly anomalies to protect humanity's last hope—the cryo sleepers.

title: Capote
description:
Capote is an online card game for 2 to 6 players that mixes classic trick-taking rules with bold bets and chaotic special cards. Each match is set around a casual card table full of colorful characters—and in Capote, no win is guaranteed, and any card can flip the game.

Players bet how many tricks they think they’ll win, then play their cards round by round to hit that number exactly. If you win more or fewer tricks than you bet, you’ll take a virtual shot for each one off. Hit four shots and… you’re out. Capotado!

If the cards aren’t in your favor, don’t worry—messing with your friends is also a valid strategy. Play your special cards at the right time to twist the odds, sabotage their bets, or turn a sure win into chaos.

title: Nested
description: Nested is a cute grid-based puzzle game made around the concept of russian nesting dolls. Come twist your brain as you stack, push and interact with the various objects you'll find in each levels. Let's see if you can reach the right combination of nesting dolls to solve every one of them!

title: Gun Shop Manager
description: Gun Shop Manager is a 3D simulation game where you run a gun shop with help from the mafia. Clean, customize, and test weapons to satisfy your shady customers. Order parts, create unique designs, and close risky deals with gangs just be careful not to catch the police’s eye.

title: Mortal Shell II
description: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

title: Grim Trials
description: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

title: Mexican Ninja
description: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

title: PengPong
description: PengPong is a survival roguelike shooter in a vintage cartoon world. Use a hockey stick to deflect pucks and weapons, stop swarms, and test your luck. Spend chips for safe upgrades or risk it at the roulette. New builds and quirky synergies challenge survival every run.

title: Metaneurosis
description: A turn-based RPG blending strategy, surreal worlds, and dark humor. Customize your character, shape the story with your choices, and explore worlds where absurdity meets heart.

title: Roomballs
description: Soccer meets air hockey with an incredible twist: fast-paced, zany robots inspired by your favorite pop culture icons. This isn’t just about speed and strength; strategy, quick moves, and clever plays are the keys to victory. This game guarantees endless fun and high-octane action.

title: Vacation Cafe Simulator
description: Cozy Italian Vacation Cafe ️ No timers, No stress cook traditional dishes upgrade and customize just drink prosecco, relax and grow your dream cafe

title: Ironsand
description: Ironsand is a hardcore rogue-lite FPS. Your team lands on a desert planet full of various enemies. You are given 10 attempts to capture each of the cities and destroy desert monsters, cyborgs and the main goal - the huge Titan combat robots

title: Screw Drivers
description: Crazy physics and high-speed races! Craft vehicles cleverly by combining building blocks and mechanical parts to create powerful drivetrains. Unlock new parts, race for the gold, and challenge your friends in multiplayer.

title: Cozy Marbles
description: Cozy Marbles is a comfy game about building marble runs on a sunny afternoon. Using a huge range of bits and pieces, fit together the marble course you’ve always wanted to build and play with. Unwind to a lo-fi ASMR soundscape and roll with the nostalgia.

title: Repterra
description: Repterra is a base-building survival game set in a world overrun by dinosaurs. Fend off massive hordes while building your colony. Manage resources and grow your army to survive in this dino-infested land.

title: Silent Breath
description: Silent Breath is a horror experience powered by Unreal Engine 5. Featuring photorealistic graphics, fully dynamic scares and microphone detection.

title: Ground Zero Hero
description: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

title: Hyper Primate
description: Speedrun as a Hyper Fast Ape in this parkour focused FPS. Dash, grapple, and blast through deadly obstacle courses using a massive arsenal of weapons. Master momentum, dodge death, and dominate the leaderboards.

title: Frog Island
description: Frog Island is a fully hand-drawn, cozy Frog Collection and Life-Sim game. Start your new life as a caretaker for an island of frogs in this cozy creature-collector! Build your dream island, discover magical wildlife, and uncover the island's many hidden secrets, to try and piece together the past life you've somehow forgotten.

title: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
description: The Horde is coming, but you're ready to fight it! Arm your team to your liking and discover which synergies work best against thousands of the undead. Survive, evolve, and break the limits in this casual yet heart-pumping rogue-lite reverse bullet hell.

title: Amata
description: Rage across the mad realms of a dead god as Charlet, the immortal artificer. Explore a vast, arcane desolation wrought by hatred. Cleanse the twisted inhabitants of ancient, forgotten worlds. Help Charlet find a way home using her powerful and varied suite of combat and platforming abilities.

title: Brigador Killers
description: Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

title: Theropods
description: Face dinosaurs, solve puzzles and travel back to the time of ginormous lizards and pixelated adventure games.

title: SFTP: Super Football Tactics Pro
description: Super Football Tactics Pro drops you into the high-energy chaos of a wild football league where classic checkers meets hard-hitting strategy. Plan your moves, outsmart your opponent, and unleash game-changing special powers that can flip the match in an instant.

title: Super Astro Cat 2
description:
Super Astro Cat 2 is the direct sequel of Super Astro Cat 1. After exploring the universe for a suitable planet for the cats to live, now you have a new mission, protect and develop the bases from aliens attacking from everywhere! But don't worry, this time Agent C have a new arsenal of weapons to help this challenging mission.

Protect and develop your base against relentless waves of aliens. Choose the right weapon for the right moment and complete all the tasks to make the cats thrive in the space!

title: Never Happened
description: “If no one notices, it’s art history.” — Now you haul masterpieces. Rule one: never leave a scratch. But hands slip, and this company has a tradition: paint over it. Three minutes before the inspector arrives. No eyedropper — mix five pigments and match the color by eye. 100+ real masterpieces.

title: Super Algator Bros
description:
Super Algator Bros. is a fast-paced 2D platformer following Algator on a chaotic adventure across eight unique worlds. After the Rabbids trap Harleen on another Discord server, Algator must travel through dangerous environments, collect likes, eat crêpes, defeat enemies, and unlock powerful transformations to rescue her.

Jump across platforms, break blocks, collect rewards, dodge traps, and take on enemies such as Rabbits, Hog Riders, and flying Canaries. Throughout the adventure, Algator can obtain special power-ups including the Crêpe transformation, the powerful MODE R9, and a temporary GOAT power that makes him nearly unstoppable.

The game features a mix of classic platforming challenges, moving platforms, caves, speedrun-style sections, castles, and boss arenas. Players must defeat two major bosses before reaching the final goal and freeing Harleen.

With its pixel-art presentation, original chiptune soundtrack, humorous internet-inspired universe, and arcade-style gameplay, Super Algator Bros. combines classic 2D platforming with the characters, references, and chaotic style of the Algator universe.

title: Ultradimensional
description: Explore over 40 interconnected levels, evade over 20 unique entities, solve puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive a nonlinear backrooms horror experience with multiple routes, and extreme replayability.

title: Gangstar Mirage City
description: Enter Mirage City — a living open-world city built on heists, garages, street clashes, and underground power. Join your crew, take the right jobs, drive anything that can get you out alive, and build a name the whole city will recognize.

title: The Hidden Camp
description: The Hidden Camp is a multiplayer social deduction survival game for 9 players. Work together, complete tasks, identify the hidden traitors, and survive tense rounds filled with suspicion, strategy, and betrayal.

title: The Crew 2: Mega Car Pack
description: Rule every element with a massive garage featuring the Nissan, BMW, Mercedes, Porsche, and Audi Car Packs, alongside the multi-terrain Sky, Dirt, and Waves Pack plus the high-speed Bike Pack.

title: The Crew 2: Audi Car Pack
description: Unleash the power of Quattro. Dominate the streets in the Audi RS Q8, carve up corners with the agile 2017 TT RS, and experience a true wagon legend with the iconic 1993 RS2 Avant.

title: The Crew 2: BMW Car Pack
description: Experience precision German engineering at its finest. Drive the futuristic BMW i8 Roadster, rule the streets with the high-performance BMW M2 F87, and feel the wind in the sleek 2011 BMW Z4.

title: The Crew 2: Mercedes Car Pack
description: Unleash luxury and raw V8 power. Cruise in style with the 2009 Mercedes SL63 AMG, dominate the asphalt in the legendary Mercedes SLR722, and turn heads with the iconic gullwing 2010 Mercedes SLS.

title: The Crew 2: Sky, Dirt, and Waves Pack
description: Master the waters in the high-speed DCB M31 powerboat, slice through the skies with the agile Zivko Edge 540 aerobatic plane, and tear up the trails on the gritty KTM 450 EXC dirt bike.

title: The Crew 2: Bike Pack
description: Rule the open road with high-speed performance. Push the limits on the Ducati Panigale, unleash the raw power of the Kawasaki Z1000, and tear up the track on the fierce 2015 KTM 1190 RC8 R.

title: The Crew 2: Nissan Car Pack
description: Drive the iconic Nissan 300ZX (Z32), unleash the track-ready Nissan 370Z Nismo, and dominate the streets in the legendary 2020 Nissan GT-R Nismo.

title: The Crew 2: Porsche Car Pack
description: Experience the iconic Porsche 911 Carrera RS 2.7, dominate with the raw power of the 2022 Cayenne Turbo GT, and blast down the highway in the sleek 2021 Panamera Turbo S Sport Turismo.

title: Hoshizora he Tatsu Hi
description: ────On that day, the girl rewove the fabric of the world. A Mystic Suspense Visual Novel.

title: My Singing Monsters Karaoke: Day One Pack
description: Hop on the karaoke stage and watch this preposterously peculiar pink Monster come to life!

title: My Singing Monsters Karaoke: Rare Pack
description: The Rare Pack DLC features 7 Rare Monster forms that will be sure to dazzle and delight karaoke fans and fanatics alike!

title: Manorism
description: Solve its secrets or become one in this third-person cozy-horror puzzle adventure about home and belonging. Explore quirky rooms, test unspoken rules, and use magic to solve playful puzzles as strange secrets unfold within a mysterious manor. Refuge is only the beginning.

title: Light & Glory
description: Light & Glory is a short indie horror game where the main gimmick is you can only move when you are completely blind. There is a significant amount of lore and story. "What would you do to become Jacob the second"

title: Sudoku Mansion
description: A story-driven Sudoku adventure by puzzle setter Nurator, featured on Cracking the Cryptic. Explore a mysterious mansion of handcrafted Sudoku variants, master increasingly intricate puzzles, and uncover the secret hidden beyond the grid.

title: Bendy's Nightmare Run
description:
Dodge deadly attacks, collect weapons, and defeat terrifying cartoon bosses in a nightmare-fueled Bendy runner.

Bendy's Nightmare Run is back!

Run as Bendy, Boris, or Alice in a nightmare-fueled endless runner where the goal is simple: survive the chase and defeat crazy cartoon bosses.

title: Keep Her Safe
description: Keep Her Safe is a survival shooting game. Gather resources, fortify your base, and withstand zombie hordes to keep the rocket project alive and bring an end to the acid rain apocalypse. Besides the hard life in wasteland, you can also chill up with friends in different multiplayer gameplays.

title: Ringwold: The Last Collector
description: Ringwold, the last of his kind, is trapped aboard a strange collector ship. Explore the ship, earn credits, use specialized machines, unlock upgrades, and collect creature cards reconstructed from corrupted Earth biology.

title: Incident Archives: Flight 882
description: Incident Archives - Flight 882 is a first person psychological horror game inspired by true events, set on a night flight.

title: Neverness to Everness: Rising from the Moonlit Fog
description: Version 1.3 of Neverness to Everness, which includes: • New Characters: Zankou and Linko • New Main Story Chapter • New area: Duskmoor • New events and game modes • ...and more!

title: My Singing Monsters Karaoke
description: Choose your favorite Monster and hop on the karaoke stage for the performance of a lifetime! Hit the notes, conduct the chaos, and watch your favorite Monster performers squish, stretch, and contort through every song. Whether you’re pitch-perfect or off key, every karaoke concert will be memorable!

title: Desktop Detective
description:
Search for clues in this idle detective RPG that lives quietly in the corner of your screen.

Investigate crime scenes, gain clues, upgrade your stats, and grow stronger across ascensions while you go about your day.

title: Nioh 3: Hell Rising
description: Our protagonist and appointed shogun, Takechiyo, journeys through time and is led to Edo in the future by an unknown yokai he met in his dreams. There, following the death of the future Takechiyo, the era of peace has ended, and Edo has been retaken by the Crucible. With the cooperation of a one-eyed swordsman, Yagyu Jubei, and a Spanish envoy, Rodrigo, Takechiyo faces yet another plot revolving around Spirit Stones and an enemy with a strong resentment towards the shogunate.

title: Lablue Horror
description: LaBlue Horror is a first-person psychological horror game set in a dark Backrooms-inspired maze. Explore, hide, survive and find the exit before the creature finds you.

title: Crownrats
description: Crownrats is a co-op colony RPG where mouse heroes explore locations, capture rooms, mine resources, build a home colony and resist rival warrens. Play solo with bots or together in quick tactical runs.

title: Plodding Recovery
description: "Why did it come to this?" That's what the protagonist asks, his body and mind worn to the breaking point. From there begins a journey of rediscovering the self he had long neglected. A small action at a time, he plods forward — slowly, haltingly — toward recovery.

title: Swarm of the Sea
description: You are a humble lighthouse keeper, working alone on a remote island. Being isolated for months on end really gnaws at your sanity. All those uncanny shadow figures and ghastly noises must be figments of your mind, right? Follow the signs on your path, find meaning in the madness and Save Our Souls.

title: Holey
description: Holey is a co-op horror game where you are part of a crew sheltering in a collapsed tunnel, scavenging loot across maps filled with deadly creatures born from a biological war. Feed the creature, convert its waste into fuel, and reach the radio tower

title: Money Trails
description: Become a billionaire as you venture out in your limousine. Decide what to buy and build to grow your endless procedurally generated island. Add up your money, incrementally increase your passive income and receive random alerts on your Personal Digital Assistant while you travel.

title: Pizza House Simulator
description: Run your dream pizzeria solo or with up to 6 players in chaotic online co-op multiplayer. Cook authentic pizzas, automate your kitchen, customize your restaurant, survive disasters, invest in stocks, gamble and build the ultimate Italian restaurant empire.

title: Escape the Grind
description: Can you retire before 65?? A realistic financial life sim across 10 real economies. Real salaries, real housing markets, real investment products. Every month is a real decision. Three difficulty levels + Play Your Life mode. Six native languages. Play your way to freedom.

title: Still in the Fog
description: A first-person horror adventure that combines environmental exploration, combat, strategic puzzles, and intense encounters in a fog-covered town that refuses to let you escape. Can you find a way out? Estimated playtime: 4–7 hours

title: Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster.
description: "Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster." is a psychological horror adventure exploring themes of salvation, dependency, morality, and ruin, featuring multiple endings shaped by your choices.

title: T.W.I.R.L.
description: It's 3am in your childhood home. Everyone's asleep, but you. Sneak out of your room to do what you always do - "T.W.I.R.L." - whatever that means.

title: Vitalis
description: Vitalis is a TTRPG-inspired Roguelike and Dungeon Crawler where you try to escape an occult forest. Cast your die to move, fight, and flee. Scale your character, collect items, and weapons. Defeat the boss and leave the forest, or run away and bide your time.

title: Tomato Dealer
description: An illegal shop keeping game. Grow tomatoes, dry and sell to customers. Broaden your customer network but be careful, there are undercover cops! Deal with police attention with the help of the mafia.

title: Linerunner
description: A minimalist time trial game. Race down the straights, weave through the turns, and see if you have what it takes to be a world champion.

title: Blood in the Panopticon
description: Enter an ASCII-Art bullet hell war-zone! Guide and maintain your android and enact vengeance upon this corrupted world. Upgrade C424, keep her loyal, and use her to paint the Concrete Plains red. But remember: Panopticon always stares back.

title: Furniture Fu
description: Furniture Fu is a home-makeover, demon-hunting, hoard-fighting roguelike. Lay out furniture strategically to make awesome synergies and cosy houses - all in a day’s work for America’s first suburban ninja.

title: Hearth and Hamlet
description: Gather resources and grow your settlement from a humble camp into a vibrant, magic-filled kingdom! Hearth and Hamlet is an incremental citybuilder game in a cozy pixelart style. Assign workers, unlock new buildings, policies, and magic, trade with faraway lands, and construct your ideal settlement!

title: WWE 2K26: WrestleMania 42 Pack
description: Get the WrestleMania 42 Pack for WWE 2K26, featuring the WrestleMania 42 Arena and three alternate Superstar Personas. Additional content will be revealed and available by Summer ’26 after the live event*.

title: Eggventure
description: Eggventure is a 2D Metroidvania platformer where you play as Egbert, an egg on a mission to rescue his friends from becoming breakfast.

title: Arcade Shop Simulator
description: Run your arcade shop! Bargain for machines, set them up, and let kids enjoy the fun. Earn money, keep your shop clean, and customize it with stylish accessories. Need more space? Expand your shop and build the ultimate arcade empire, then play your Arcades after hours and compete with other players!

title: 100 Goblin Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

title: Project P.I.T.T.
description: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

title: Ashes of the Damned: The Forgotten Ward
description: Trapped in a looping asylum, stalked by something in the dark. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and survive in this first-person psychological horror.

title: Shake It Co!
description: Grow your orchard by shaking trees! Literally shake your mouse! Join Co, a friendly adventurer with a can-do spirit, and plant unique saplings for bountiful fruit. Collect coins, invest in upgrades, and harvest in a charming 2D style!

title: Dreamcards
description: Build your deck during the day and at night fight the monster that haunts your dreams. Will you be able to escape the nightmare in this roguelike deckbuilder that combines strategy, occultism and psychology?

title: Ministry of Truth: False Memory
description: Ministry of Truth: False Memory is a story-driven simulator in a totalitarian society. Become an official, manipulate facts, rewrite history, and provide the ‘truth’ to the public. Choose: obey or fight against the regime. The Great Father is watching you!

title: After Inc: Revival
description: Can you rebuild civilisation after a zombie apocalypse? From the creator of Plague Inc. comes a unique blend of strategic simulation, survival city builder and ‘mini 4X’. Build settlements, harvest resources and shape society as you lead Humanity out of the darkness.

title: Steins;Gate Re:Boot
description: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

title: Space Tales
description: Space Tales is a real-time strategy game set in a retro-futuristic environment. Take on the role of a commander in the Intergalactic Planetary Expansion (I.P.E.) and immerse yourself in a thrilling mission to explore and conquer new planets, pushing the boundaries of the Human Empire.

title: Deadlock Station
description: Turn the battlefield into your ally in this tactical rogue-like with indirect controls. Assemble a unique squad, destroy the alien invaders with precise planning, and uncover the truth about the Event and the mysterious disappearance of humans.

title: Wild Ice
description: When the world froze over, humanity's final stand to survive is left to the blades of it's most unlikely heroes - small town hockey players. Play solo or local co-op as best friends Max and Finley as they take on the frost and whatever lurks within it. Welcome to the a-puck-alypse!

title: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
description: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

title: Rekindling
description: Rekindling is a settlement building and management game. You are tasked with rebuilding society after the ZTD virus has taken over and turned the masses into mindless creatures. Build, Harvest, Mine, and Fight with your survivors to build a sustainable society and take steps towards finding the cure!

title: Chess Folk
description:
ChessFolk is a chess game featuring offline play against hundreds of fictional AI opponents with distinct profiles, playing styles and difficulty levels. Its opponent system combines Maia-2, Stockfish and custom behaviour rules.
Players can compete in Swiss, round-robin and knockout tournaments, track their in-game rating and match history, and practise through guided lessons, opening exploration and game analysis. The game offers 2D and 3D board views, animated battle-style captures, custom time controls, PGN import and export, and local two-player play on one device.

title: Red Tanks vs Lizard
description: Defend the base. Burn the lizards. Take three stars.

title: This Is Golf
description: This Is Golf is a casual but challenging first-person golf game with randomly generated holes. Shot shaping and distance are based entirely on mouse motion. Play solo or in lobbies of up to 8 players, and enjoy a fun, competitive, and slightly goofy golfing experience.

title: Untergrund Raceways: Arena
description: Untergrund Raceways Arena (short: URA) is a kart arena fighter from Vantech Studios, developed in cooperation with the AAP. URA covers a scope that seems somewhat atypical for a first PC game.

title: Finding Ruby
description: A cozy hidden object adventure inspired by classic puzzle books. Join Ruby and her loyal friends on a journey across the world to uncover the mystery of her missing archaeologist parents through beautifully hand-crafted and highly detailed scenes.

title: Nudge
description: nudge is a cozy organization-sim about finding space for your work, mom, and huge assortment of gacha toys. Unbox over 50 collectibles from 8 unique sets, decorate your first apartment, and try to find room for everything in your life, including mom.

title: Gridiron Football League
description: Call plays and take control on the field in a retro American football game backed by a deep franchise simulation. Draft, trade, and develop players, build custom teams and rosters, and chase championships across multiple seasons.

title: Polluted Flesh
description: Very short on-rails collector game where you're stuck in the guts of a cosmic sea creature, polluted by waste.

title: The Sovereign's Board
description: The Sovereign's Board is an online 1v1, 3D, turn-based strategy game. Battle against your rival by utilizing a team of 3 unique characters all with their own strengths and weaknesses.

title: Morningstar
description: Undertale Morningstar is a fan-game of Toby Fox's UNDERTALE made by Geno. Made specifically for people who still hold a "perverted sentimentality" towards UNDERTALE.

title: Toll: The Ferryman's Ledger
description: You are Charon. You take the coins from the eyes of the dead — and one of them, someday, must be your own. A short incremental with a real ending: five rivers, a tribute owed to Hades, and a price on your own freedom. It ends. That is the whole point.

title: Real Backrooms
description: Explore the deepest parts of the Backrooms in an attempt to escape alive, alone or with your friends! Are you ready to face this dangerous world? Or will you accept your fate and die? Choose, or the Backrooms will choose for you!

title: Nocturnal Echoes
description: Nocturnal Echoes is a dark fantasy 2D action RPG set in the haunted world of Elaris. Explore cursed villages, forgotten towers, flooded barrows, and corrupted sanctuaries as a mysterious book pulls you into a story of memory, sacrifice, and ancient Wards beginning to fail.

title: Ayakashi Yokocho no Natsuyasumi
description: A browser visual novel with the main cast of Hatsune Miku: Colorful Stage based on japanese folklore.

title: Assault Wing 3
description: Top-down arcade skillbased multiplayer PvP space-shooter game. Setup your loadout (Ship, Two weapons, Utility and Passive mods) and blast out other players in different game modes.

title: Spongebob Squarepants x One Piece
description: A short two-stage game where you pilot a ship/bubble and collect coins. This was part of a McDonald's Happy Meal promotion.

title: Ready or Nowhere
description: Can you survive the mission without making a single mistake?

title: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
description:
A port of Disney’s Atlantis: The Lost Empire, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with upscaling, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire is an action-adventure game based on the 2001 animated film. Players follow Milo Thatch and the expedition searching for the lost city of Atlantis, controlling several members of the crew across 12 levels. Gameplay combines platforming, combat, environmental puzzles, swimming, and vehicle sequences, with different characters providing abilities needed to overcome specific obstacles.

title: Hook Party Arena
description: Hook, ricochet, rescue, and outplay your rivals in a fast top-down multiplayer arena. Pull enemies into hazards, save teammates, trigger two-hook Headshots, and shape each short match with upgrades and tactical items in customizable Steam lobbies.

title: Crown Chase
description: Crown Chase is a fast-paced multiplayer party game where you compete against friends to grab and hold the magical crown. Run, dash, and use unique abilities in stylized 3D arenas to outsmart your opponents and claim the ultimate victory.

title: Project Sekai: Ayakashi Yokochou no Natsuyasumi
description:
Before you knew it, you found yourself in an unfamiliar place.
It was a mysterious SEKAI inhabited by the ayakashis.
It seems you’ll need to make the summer festival a success to return to your original world!?

Work together with the ayakashis—who look familiar for some reason—to make the summer festival a success!

title: Chiaroscuro Lovers
description: A domineering CEO-like older sister who’s gentle only to her sister, a childhood friend who became her doctor, and a cheerful girl only she can see… Who was Chu Hebai before losing her memories, and how did she become entangled with them? A melancholic yuri AVG about regret and unspoken love.

title: Ragnarok Zero: Global
description:
Rediscover the original excitement of Midgard as Ragnarok Zero’s exclusive UI and simple controls allow all types of players, both new and seasoned, to easily and enjoyably experience the classic Ragnarok journey.

Ragnarok Zero: Global presents an evolved gameplay experience that sets itself apart from the original, including Ragnarok’s first-ever UGC content, localized maps, and Zero-exclusive episodes.

Operating under a subscription-based model designed for the PC MMORPG experience, Ragnarok Zero: Global focuses on balanced progression and long-term gameplay while preserving the spirit of the original Ragnarok.

As the first-ever Ragnarok PC title with a single global client, the game features seven in-game languages and provides a seamless global service connecting Europe, Southeast Asia, and Oceania.

title: October: Survivor's Guilt
description: October: Survivor's Guilt is an first-person psychological horror game where you explore an unsettling house, interact with objects, and try to survive a terrifying night after a simple favor goes wrong.

title: Tail and Сhaos
description:
Tail and Chaos is a colorful top-down action roguelite about a caravan of meerkats crossing a dangerous world. Choose one of three heroes, combine weapons and upgrades across eight shared slots, unlock synergies and evolutions, and survive 30-minute acts filled with branching routes, events, elite enemies, and bosses.

Journey through scorching dunes, a moonlit riverbed, and the Plateau of Dawn in three standalone acts or connect them in an Expedition. Choose a Caravan Law and a rescued specialist, carry one non-starter item between fresh builds, and continue later from a saved camp. Earn coins for permanent upgrades, complete achievements, and fill an encyclopedia as the caravan grows.

title: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
description: Lead your small caravan on a great journey across the ancient world, in a story-driven RTS where protecting your family and friends matters more than conquest.

title: Wheelchair for Two
description: Start a chaotic co-op adventure in one wheelchair. Two players control different sides of the chair and must work together to survive brutal obstacles, dangerous jumps, and physics-based challenges. Play solo, local co-op, or online with a friend — one small mistake can send you both falling down.

title: Cook with Card
description: Run your own cozy restaurant, prepare orders and create efficient kitchen workflows using your cards in this relaxing cooking management game.

title: Bullet Spell
description: Dodge, weave, and coordinate your way through bullets and enemies in this magical spy-thriller! Stress-test your ability to multitask by controlling the twin sisters Aurora and Solana simultaneously, or share control with a second player to coordinate the twins' survival.

title: Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams
description: A port of Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: BeastLink
description: BeastLink is a giant multiplayer Kaiju experience where humans, vehicles, and colossal Beasts collide in urban environments at unprecedented scale where absolutely everything you see can be destroyed. Build your Link and unleash your power before it consumes you!

title: Loot Dungeon
description: "Loot Dungeon" is a dark fantasy incremental roguelite ARPG where death is progression. Crawl deadly dungeons, collect loot, pick perks, and die... to get stronger. Go deeper, unlock new characters, upgrades and features. Will you make a deal with Death?

title: Last Pirates: Die Together
description: Last Pirates: Die Together is a cooperative pirate-themed horror game designed for up to 4 players. Join a loyal crew of scallywags on a high-stakes mission to scavenge mysterious islands and make your old captain rich.

title: Inken
description: Explore mysterious office building suspended in a desolate world! Inken is a multi-genre roguelike that can be a deckbuilder, topdown shooter, auto runner, puzzler, or idle game! Knowledge is the power that can slay the gods that consumed your world!

title: Doctrine: C.U.L.T.
description: Build your own religion from the ground up. Forge dogma. Recruit followers. Expand your influence. Every decision shifts your power - and every power has a price. Will you be a savior or a tyrant? The world awaits your move.

title: Fallin' Glocks
description: Fallin' Glocks is a 2D skydiving action shooter with procedural levels and power-ups. Drop into the pits of a post-apocalyptic Earth and fight against hijacked, classified government weapons controlled by the master weapon, Ares.

title: Anaria: Reborn
description: ANARIA: Reborn is a first-person psychological horror where you're trapped in the mind of a mysterious girl, searching for a way out through endless doors and a haunting nightmare.

title: DDD: Demons Double Down
description: Sometimes loneliness pushes us into strange, risky choices. A nightclub that wasn’t here yesterday. Mysterious strangers—each leaving more questions than answers. Just one short night that simply won’t end. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Stackmon
description: Stack, train and collect 100+ powerful Stackmon in this creature-collector with a card-stacking twist! Build your camp, challenge rival Scouts in combat and face the mysterious corruption spreading throughout your land.

title: HeroInc
description: Can you evolve from a street thug into a savior? Manage your time and stats in this tactical Auto-Battler. Clear threats to stop the rising Fear before the city collapses. Build your hero, decide your fate.

title: Raze
description: Raze is an action roguelike based on randomization. Destroy thousands or tens of thousands of enemies in a single run, adapt to random events, and survive through to your cat reflexes. There are no easy paths here, and no room for mistakes.

title: Dig to China Simulator
description: Dig to China Simulator, is a game about digging a hole in your back yard, until you get to China. Find ores in the holes you dig, sell them, upgrade your equipment to dig faster.

title: Torment Hexus
description: Technofascist cyberpunk CEOs must die! Charge spells with the match-3 grid, then cast them on your enemies in turn-based tactical roguelike combat. Climb the tower, kill the boss, and maybe make the world a better place.

title: Jabb
description: Jabb is an action game where every weapon you see is a possibility if an enemy has it so can you. Play as this leaf thingy and dash through unique levels and fight some bosses.

title: Lugal: Bronze Age Survival Game
description: A survival craft game with RTS elements. Build a base, become the leader of a tribe → village → city → state. Conquer neighboring settlements and become king.

title: Pet Street Story
description: Jinyu, also known as Xiaoli, worked on Pet Street to repay her owner's debt as a way of expressing gratitude for the owner's life-saving kindness. During this time, she made various friends and experienced unusual events. As she matured, Jinyu decided to revive the increasingly depressed Pet Street.

title: Entropy
description: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.

title: Exark
description: Exark is an engine builder about building a city aboard a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, staff them with crew members, and maximise your ark's resource production by exploiting powerful synergies. Lead your Great House to safety at the rim of the world.

title: Last Drop
description: Last Drop is a story you need to experience. Welcome to Nykylä Finland 1994. Seppo Sahtivaara and friends are waiting for you. This is an openworld action game with a story that has an impact. We bring back old good games and action from the best movies from that era. We want you to enjoy!

title: Voidface
description: Face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.

title: Stars Reach
description: Explore a living galaxy in Stars Reach. Discover new planets, build settlements, and shape environments that react to everything you do. Players work together to transform untamed worlds into thriving civilizations across a single shared universe.

title: Starsand Island
description: Leave the hustle of the city behind and embrace life on Starsand Island. Fish, farm, raise animals, and befriend or fall in love with locals to learn their secrets. Customize your world with our DIY system, and invite friends to help build your dream paradise!

title: The Sinking City 2
description: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

title: The World Well: Blood of Caro
description: 814 R.E; the war is approaching. In Redimus, the chaotic world where magic, technology, slaves and vampires coexist, a young girl happens upon a magic gun that sets her on a journey of revenge. There is a burning manor behind her, and the road ahead disappears in the jungles of the night...

title: Twisted Tower
description: Blast your way through an abandoned 1950s theme park crawling with fairy-tale mascots, twisted puzzles, and deadly traps. Uncover the dark secrets of your past as you race to the top to win back the love of your life.

title: Grit
description: Grit is a battle royale shooter set in the wild west. Build the best poker hand from found weapons and ride your horse to escape the oncoming calamity storm.

title: HyperCore: Rhythm Bullet Hell
description: HyperCore is a “Rhythm Bullet Hell”, mixing the frenetic action of classic bullet hell Shoot'em Up with semi-procedurally generated encounters based on the music. As PRISS, survive the action-packed levels in sync with the music and protect what is left of Humanity.

title: Trauma Playground
description: A nostalgic 2000s playground hides something dangerous. Investigate toys and rides, collect Joy, avoid Trauma, and uncover who is putting sharp objects inside them.

title: Cat Meow-tilation
description: Become a U-O alien and gather as many cats as you can to save your home planet! A unique cat-capturing game themed around "Cats" × "Red Light, Green Light"!

title: Tremble of Towers
description: Tremble of Towers is a CO-OP tower defense game where you can build any structure with any resource. Countless of combinations are waiting for you and your friends to be discovered in order to protect your beloved Goal Stone from all kinds of enemies in various maps!

title: Argonauts Agency: The World on His Shoulders
World of Clashes
description:
World of Clashes is a pixel-art desert MMORPG set in a fictional Najd. Two factions — the Light of Sun City and the Dark of Moon City — divide a living open world of dunes, oases, bazaars and snowbound poles.

Players farm mobs for gear across six rarity tiers, take on quests, buy and ride camel mounts, and descend into Kahf Al-Arwah, an endless cave that carves a new maze on every run and supports four-player parties. Open-world faction PvP runs across two realms.

The centrepiece is the ranked arena: two 1v1 ladders, Open and Mirror, where gear is normalized so duels are decided by skill rather than progression. Each duel begins with a ten-second preparation phase in which both fighters choose their build before the fight starts. Warrior and mage each have six ability slots that unlock while levelling, and every slot offers two alternative builds.

The game is free to play with cosmetic-only purchases, and is fully playable in English and Arabic.

title: Cursed Ciddy
description: Follow Betty as she explores the abandoned ruins of Comical Entertainment in search of answers. Solve puzzles, uncover forgotten secrets, and survive the dangers hidden within a once-beloved entertainment center concealing a dark mystery below. Nothing is as it seems.

title: Moon and Away
description: A short, atmospheric, story-driven experience about a young woman searching for meaning in a world that no longer feels familiar.

title: The Eternal Woods
description: The Eternal Woods is a short, fast paced incremental about an adventurer trapped in a never ending Woods. Sharpen your axe, upgrade your skills and conquer the different Forests to escape the Woods!

title: Is That a Human Organ?
description: This is a horror-themed anomaly-hunting game. As a black market cargo inspector, you must carefully check each item to ensure its normal. Please note that when I say cargo, Im referring to organs.

title: LifePaths
description: LifePaths is a browser-based narrative life simulation game. Players live from birth to death in a dystopian 2076, making decisions whose outcomes are determined by their character’s attributes and dice rolls, then narrated by artificial intelligence.

title: Vice Vision Runner
description: Prepare, Vice! Prove you are able - to navigate terrain, in pitch-black shadow beneath the canopy. Discover routes, and estimate time to complete. Immersive walking sim about Hellgate peninsula exploration. Ambient slow-paced runner

title: Crownhold
description: Noble Rulers — grow your realm and expand your castle in this short incremental game! Manage resources, discover foreign lands and build up an army to lay siege to your enemies.

title: Apple Faces Up
description: Alter the inscribed laws and unravel mysteries with knowledge and wisdom. Welcome to the Infinite Library, where all past, present, and future phenomena are recorded. As the one with the power to rewrite these books, you must face 13 trials bestowed by the angel Mimir.

title: Ballskin
description: BALLSKIN is a goofy, n64 horror themed foddian game, where the goal is to make it to the top, with simple yet deep mechanics, where every fall is punishing. Can you make it out of skinball purgatory?

title: Encroacher: Snakes
description: A snake-tossing cryptic adventure. Visuals that remind you of schooltime spent in computer lab. The snakes will not tolerate failure.

title: Hacker vs It
description: DOS old school game showing how a hacker and an IT workers do their jobs. The idea of this game is show the hacking and the IT process with less fantasy elements. Shows a WAY closer perspective the actual hacking strategies.

title: Draft Day Sports: College Football 27
description:
Build the college football program you've always envisioned. Draft Day Sports: College Football puts you in complete control of every aspect of running a successful program—from assembling your coaching staff and recruiting future stars to managing the transfer portal, developing players, creating game plans, and competing for conference championships and the national title.

Every decision shapes the future of your program. Scout prospects across the country, build relationships with recruits, evaluate talent that fits your system, and construct recruiting classes capable of competing with the nation's elite. Develop your roster over multiple seasons, adapt to injuries and changing personnel, and watch your players grow into All-Americans and draft prospects.

Game day is only the beginning. Manage your depth chart, install offensive and defensive philosophies, make critical coaching decisions, and adjust your strategy as opponents evolve throughout the season. Whether you're taking over a perennial powerhouse or rebuilding a struggling program from the ground up, every season presents new challenges and new opportunities.

Featuring one of the deepest franchise experiences available in sports gaming, Draft Day Sports: College Football is built for players who love long-term team building, realistic management, and the satisfaction of creating a dynasty that can dominate for decades.

title: We Are So Dead
description: A co-op seance horror game where one of you died first, and only you can see what's killing the others. Your only voice is a Ouija board your friends keep misreading. Guide them through a haunted house and banish the demon before sunrise. 2-8 players.

title: Fleetfall: Galaxy Domination
description: Fast real-time space conquest for 1-4 players. Capture planets, launch missile salvos, and outmaneuver friends in 10-minute Deathmatch blitzes — or scheme through 30 minutes of diplomacy, trade and betrayal in Hegemony mode. Cross-play with mobile; bots fill empty seats so a match always starts.

title: Mega Man X Regenesis
description: Mega Man X fan-game, featuring an original story set in an alternate Mega Man X timeline.

title: Farewells Clicker
description: Farewells Clicker is an addictive blend of clicker and city builder! Expand your island, develop your city, and produce resources endlessly. Upgrade your buildings and skills through a vast skill tree to progress further and further!

title: Home Store Simulator
description: Run your own home goods store! Sell sofas, refrigerators, TVs and more. Purchase products, set your prices, take payments, design your layout, handle shoplifters, and expand your store to build a successful retail business.

title: Budget Renovation Simulator
description: Turn "Trash" into "Cash"! Buy wrecked houses, hunt for the cheapest materials, and fix them up for a massive profit. Spend the least to make the most in this renovation challenge! Can you finish the job without going broke?

title: Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey
description: Planet Harvester is a relaxing low-poly incremental game. Pilot your crawler across beautiful worlds, chew through resources, unlock new tools, hire drones, and customize your machine for ever bigger hauls. Turn small numbers into massive ones!

title: Balls & Gamble
description: Balls & Gamble is a casino-inspired incremental game where you shoot a LOT of balls, earn money, buy upgrades, gamble, unlock new balls, and eventually break reality itself.

title: Gutted: Infested Crypts
description: Descend into infested crypts beneath a cursed cemetery in this visceral action-horror FPS. Fight through rotting horrors with heavy gunplay, brutal dismemberment, and only a dying flashlight between you and the darkness.

title: Orbit One
description: Take to the stars and explore the solar system. Master the orbital mechanics of N-body physics. Plot a careful course to complete your mission.

title: Jarnasmal
description: Survive a bullet hell where your Wi-Fi signal is your lifeline. Delve into underground facilities, fight off massive swarms of enemies, and strategically build a mesh network of signal repeaters. If your connection is strong, you're a powerhouse. If the signal drops, all you have is a shovel.

title: Mothership Down
description: 130+ unique goals to achieve in over 50 levels in this physics-based retro puzzle game! Control a fleet of tiny, colorful lunar landers, piloting through puzzling moon caves. Scrape by with scrappy first flights, then re-engineer a perfect solution to earn bonus stars.

title: The Pale Mimic
description: The Pale Mimic is an atmospheric horror set in the untamed Alaskan wilderness. As a high profile fugitive on the run, it's just you and your dog surviving in the chilling forests, until something else shows up uninvited.

title: Feed It
description: A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences.

title: Black Flower
description: Black Flower is a strategic roguelike about surviving and growing a fragile garden through a magical calendar. Make tough daily choices, face unpredictable weather, and uncover the secret of a mysterious black seed.

title: PROFITS 2167: Planetary Resource Optimization & Freight Infrastructure Technician Simulator
description: Deliver minerals. Earn tokens. Meet deadlines. Upgrade your infrastructure. Grow the numbers. Deploy human resources. Manipulate the token market. Automate the network with delivery drones. Enjoy the grind. Enjoy the future. Enjoy the profits.

title: Megaris
description: The core is simple and satisfying: rotate, drop, clear. But the expanding grid changes everything. Strategies that worked five minutes ago fall apart when you're suddenly dealing with 30 columns. Adapting on the fly is the whole game.

title: Beat Vector
description: Beat Vector is a 360 degree fully immersive synesthetic rhythm game where each beat makes the environment come alive based on the player's performance. Each genre featured in the game has its own unique environment such as the Club for EDM, the Ballroom for Electroswing or the Alleyway for UK Grime that the player progresses through as they clear levels.

title: Working Class Monsters
description: Do you HATE YOUR JOB? Well, these monsters don't have to. Place workers, open packs, make gold pile up. Ultra-casual incremental strategy where failure doesn't exist.

title: Pachinko Farm
description: Pachinko Farm is a cozy yet chaotic incremental game where you drop balls to grow your farm in a fully physics-based pachinko world. Bonk → Produce → Sell

title: Buster Breaks Out
description: A block-breaking roguelite where every upgrade helps you smash more blocks and climb to higher floors. Help Buster grow stronger, defeat the wardens, and break free from his prison.

title: Submerge
description: A deep-sea exploration company sends you and your friends to investigate a research facility that has mysteriously gone silent. Face terrifying events together, survive as a team, and uncover the truth hidden within the depths.

title: Lurk in Abyss
description: After moving to the village, Lurk begins a new, independent life. However, the place turns out to be no ordinary village on the outskirts of the city, but something far more mysterious... Are you ready to dive into this abyss?

title: Upbeat
description: Jump, bounce, and drum your way up an infinite climb. Build a beat, spawn platforms with your drum machine, and chain physics-powered combos to outclimb the competition in this rhythmic precision platformer.

title: Dash'n'Drops
description: Blast your way through Dash'n'Drops, a platform-fighting inspired roguelite. Build your own moveset, max your stats, and defeat the 7 Eternals!

title: The Lantern of the Laughless Saint
description: A solo or co-op RPG inspired by Morrowind. Drawn by a shared dream, you awaken on an isolated island crowned by a silent Tower. Unravel the mystery of the Laughless Saint, confront the weight of human desire, and decide what deserves to be saved when the light beneath the world finally stirs.

title: Excremental Game
description: You're a little poop flushed away on a revenge mission to cover the world in poop! A chaotic incremental Poop-Shooter where bouncing poop earns points! Level up your poop, and unleash explosive, multi-poop madness!

title: Void Pachinko
description: Build your own pachinko! Upgrade pins and balls, unleash powerful synergies, and help a shattered village rise again in this incremental adventure.

title: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
description:
