Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.

title: Rhythmkill
description: Rhythmkill is a super-fast rhythm action game where your every kill strikes on the beat. Wall-run, dash, slide, and chain lightning-fast katana kills through neon-drenched arenas. Master the rhythm, maintain your momentum, and fight your way to the boss who imprisoned you.

title: Ploink
description: A plinko roguelike where you create crazy setups with random objects then drop balls and watch the chaos unfold. Discover creative interactions, create cross-dimensional setups, break the game, feed cats and ploink it.

title: Medieval Horse Dealer Simulator
description: Trade horses, formulate feed, and breed generations of elite stallions, racehorses, draft horses, war horses, and more. Mine ores, forge equipment and weapons to sell in your store, or equip them to your horses. Dominate the medieval horse trade.

title: Palianytsia
description: In this game, you are a palianytsia — a traditional Ukrainian bread. You escape from the kitchen, solve puzzles, and explore your own nature. Over time, the game shifts from bright and cheerful to eerie and unsettling, and your goal is to uncover what is really going on.

title: Solar Wave
description: A large-scale 4X strategy game with indirect control and a focus on simulating a space empire. Capture systems, develop your economy and logistics, call up hundreds of powerful fleets and watch them incinerate enemies of the Solar Empire.

title: Rag Doll
description: Fighting based on physics. Rag Doll is a 2D game with cartoon graphics, where you control the character's head, and the body moves according to the laws of physics! Play Story Mode, fight in multiplayer or local battle 1 vs 1!

title: Bloodletter
description: A grim medieval deckbuilder where you use your dubious healing methods to protect bizarre villagers from the corrupting influence of ancient evils.

title: Dual Cat: Max
description: Join Max, the brave and clever cat, on a puzzle-platformer adventure to save his best friend, Erwin

title: Provoron
description: It's an adventure game about black&white crows.

title: Nimbit Frontier
description: Embark on daring adventures into wild biomes to uncover fragments of long-lost creatures. Bring them back to life by hatching their young. Build them habitats, and release them into the wild. Become the star Nimbiteer you dream of surrounded by lovely folks in a small cozy town.

title: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
description: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute and cozy puzzle adventure, based on a series of award-winning books by the Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula. Play as the forest spirit Tukoni as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, brew fragrant tea and explore a magical world filled with kindness.

title: Little Sim World
description: Little Sim World is a cosy 2D life sim set in the heart of a little city full of charm, dreams, and surprises. Design your perfect home, meet quirky locals, build your routine, and live life at your own pace. A gentle world, a fresh start, and a story only you can write!

title: Jewel Match Solitaire: Cats and Cards - Collector's Edition
Stellar Odyssey
description: An Idle Space MMORPG where you progress at your own pace, but the universe is built together. Explore a procedural galaxy of nearly 50 million star systems alone — or join a Squadron to pool resources, raise space stations, upgrade shared buildings, and expand across the stars as one.

title: Shinkuu, Shoujo Namida wo Koboseru ka
description:
In June, a girl throws herself from her school rooftop. As class president, Shimabara witnessed her death and becomes determined to uncover the truth behind it. Her investigation leads her to Kusamizu Yuusui, a mysterious girl hiding a dark and troubled past.

But through another perspective, we discover Yuusui’s connection to the girl who died: a fragile bond shaped by loneliness, bullying, and fleeting moments of warmth. As past and present slowly collide, the truth behind the tragedy begins to emerge.

title: Woahblade
description: Be the last uncontrollably-spinning bandicoot standing, in this unofficial chaotic multiplayer spin-off fan game that blends Crash Bandicoot with Beyblade. Build up outrageous RPMs and Dash, Bash, n Crash your opponents off the stage!

title: Lycoris: Underworld
description: Defend against relentless enemy waves in an all-new tactical survival mode! Experience intense, high-stakes combat featuring striking, seductive prone-shooting animations and dynamic waifu action.

title: Sweet Clockwork
description: A dark time-loop mystery visual novel about a fated romance with only one person: I-on Moon. A birthday love letter leads to death at 6 PM, then the same morning begins again. Unmask the killer "X" and save I-on Moon. Multiple bad endings. One true ending.

title: Sora no Hiraketa Basho: Chord:OOC
description: A compilation of "Sora no Hiraketa Basho" and "Code: OOC" with revisions to their scenarios, a new scenario connecting the two works, added presentation elements, and new musics.

title: Internet Survivor Survivors
description: A top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame featuring Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!? Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons! Your very viewer count becomes your life! Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies and survive, survive, SURVIVE!

title: Gift From God
description: Gift From God is a visual novel told through the eyes of Ryosuke Nikaido and Akane Yamamoto. As they face three missions from God, their hearts, pasts, and choices begin to intertwine, leading them toward the true meaning of God’s “gift.”

title: Brainrot Autobattler
description: Brainrot Autobattler is a chaotic roguelite auto-battler/autochess where you buy brainrot units, evolve them into stronger forms, trigger trait synergies, and survive a run full of shops, bosses, boons, and bad decisions.

title: Eggscape
description: You’re a chicken escaping the slaughter line. Find your stolen chicks and free your fellow chickens as you fight through the factory, and survive the hunt from workers and failed lab creations.

title: Peganomics
description: A roguelike pachinko about building outrageous synergies with pegs, balls, and buckets. Chase massive scores, discover chaotic combos, and break the economy of pegs in your quest for the ultimate run.

title: Steam Trigger
description: A riveting steampunk 2.5D platformer set against the backdrop of the sprawling metropolis. Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing fusion of industrial progress and Victorian aesthetics as you embark on a journey throughout the city.

title: 101 Cats in Athens
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens  in the hand-crafted Athens landscape.  Earn lots of achievements. How many  can you find?  Be quick! ⏱️

title: Anime Angels feat. Luca Brasil
description: Solve tile-swapping puzzles to unveil pretty anime girls by the artist Luca Brasil.

title: Monster Girls: You Can't Say No
description: Adult adventure set in a monster college where desire is survival. Host an incubus, manage rising “heat,” flirt, and build relationships to stay alive. Explore, upgrade abilities, and unlock scenes in a mix of dating sim and resource management.

title: Mr. Swop
description: Help Mr. Swop find stars by swapping tiles around.

title: Deeds Were Done 2: Project Ascend
description: A PS2-style indie game about government studies on humans. they were subjects of experimentation to gather "crucial" data for military and medical purposes. you got assigned to work with the other scientists.

title: The Legend of Mala Tokmachka
description: Build, expand, and arm a towering 2D fortress to withstand endless waves of ground and air attacks. Set in a nameless frontier village where a siege has lasted so long it became a legend, "The Legend of Mala Tokmachka" turns survival into myth.

title: Sonic Project Hero Rewired
description: A recompilation of the original Sonic: Project Hero from 2019 with added characters and stages.

title: Hide & Seek
description: An online multiplayer party game with a colorful twist: hiders paint their own bodies to blend into the world. Seekers must find and tag them all before time runs out. Play with friends on PC.

title: Lovesick
description: Lovesick is a psychological horror experience exploring the dark aftermath of "love".

title: Antibiotic Adventures
description: A teaching game for general microbiology.

title: Wired Witch
description: Play as a witch who is trying to recreate a potion based on digital clues. Read emails, search online, and look through downloaded files to finish the recipe.

title: Abyssal Apocrypha
description: Abyssal Apocrypha is an MBF21 project inspired by the "Lovecraft Mythos". Explore Jungles, Caves, Temples, Old Cities, Houses, laboratories, and uncover the secrets of the old gods in this 24-map-long adventure.

title: Blink
description:
This is an indie horror game where you have to inspect 6 statues from a mental hospital but there is something waiting for you!

Explore the horrific structure with real time eye detection, so if you blink in real life, you blink in the game too..

title: FairyLand
description: A casual endless dungeon crawler rogue-like RPG that tasks players with getting the highest score possible, as fast as possible.

title: Five Nights In The Backrooms
description:
After 12-Link Labs discovers 'The Backrooms', they also find a terrifying creature. This creature is very hostile, and no matter how hard they try... They can't contain it.

So they’ve sent you, a very dangerous convict to watch over it and analyse its behaviour. Will you survive five nights in the backrooms?

title: Fungi Simulator
description:
Become a Fungi and spread your spores as much as you can.

Unlock different kinds of Fungi and express yourself.

Take over the world by spreading your spores globally.

A clicker game where you try and get as much spores as you can,
and unlock different types of mushrooms with increasing difficulty.

title: Infinite Backrooms
description: The first truly infinite Backrooms game. Explore a seamless, procedurally generated world with a seed system across interconnected environments. No loading screens. No boundaries. Just fluorescent lights and something waiting in the dark.

title: Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival
description: Will your shark become an unstoppable hunter?

title: Witchpop
description: Witchpop is a physics based matching puzzle game where you cook soup by juggling ingredients. Collect curses over time and try to survive as your dish becomes an increasingly chaotic mess.

title: Trick x Trick
description: Supernatural × Mystery × Death Game: Twelve high school students awaken trapped in a mysterious building. To escape, they must identify the mastermind by vote—choose wrong, and someone is executed. Each student has a unique supernatural power. Uncover the truth and reveal the mastermind.

title: Sister Other Paranoia
description: A dark visual novel created by the team behind NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE. Overly sensitive to other people's emotions, the protagonist—a light novel writer—develops the ability to read minds, only to be driven even deeper into isolation. His sole remaining comfort is his younger sister, gifted yet lonely.

title: Memo to the Underlord
description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler where you play as a disgruntled employee just trying to quit his job - by force. Battle your way through a corporate hell, full of hostile co-workers, feral creatures, and everything in between.

title: Zombolion
description: Zombolion is an arcade zombie shooter where you're the last damn sheriff in the whole county, mowing down undead freaks, holding the line at a top-secret bunker, and trying to science-and-peace-talk your way through a full-blown viral apocalypse - if there's anyone left to talk to.

title: Flowers and Deities
description: Flowers and Deities is a roguelite auto battler where you command a blood-soaked lizardman army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to earn the favor of the Gods.

title: Anime Angels feat. Tomozero
description: Solve tile-swapping puzzles to unveil pretty anime girls drawn by the artist Tomozero.

title: Sands of Skullcreek
description: Sands of Skullcreek is retro style FPS. Your travels have brought you to this town that has been overrun by a gang. You decide to swear in as a deputy and restore order to this once peaceful place.

title: Bounty Hunters
description: Fight in a top down 2d shooter adventure with resource gathering / bullet heaven/hell mechanics.

title: Haunted Resort: Idle Game
description: Build the ultimate haunted resort and become the richest supernatural tycoon! Tap to earn gold, unlock spooky businesses, upgrade your haunted empire, and enjoy relaxing idle progression in a charming cartoon-style medieval world.

title: Gravity Paws
description: Gravity Paws is a pixel art platformer that blends classic challenges with modern movement and exploration mechanics. Play as Duke, a dog who becomes lost in a mysterious forest filled with strange anomalies.

title: Misblood
description:
Misblood is an arcade-style top-down shooter built around short, brutal, replayable missions. The city has a list of 25 contracts with your name on it: drive to the address, kick the door, and fight room by room until nobody is left standing. You are always outnumbered, deaths come fast, and restarts come faster — every mission is a plan you rewrite on the fly.

Fight with whatever the job hands you: pistol, rifle, shotgun or bat, backed by grenades and a split-second dash.

An open pixel-art city to cruise between jobs, and a list that only ends one way.

title: Boss Key
description: One-stop card game development toolbox: visual design, instant testing, AI assistance, and code extensionbuild your own trading card game solo.

title: Gridnova
description:
GRIDNOVA is a top-down bullet heaven roguelike set on a neon digital grid. The player controls the Core, which fires automatically while the player moves through growing swarms of enemies, mini-bosses and bosses. Each level-up offers a choice of weapons and upgrades; pairs of weapons unlock synergies, and fully upgraded weapons can evolve into stronger forms.

A standard run lasts twenty minutes, after which the player can continue into an endless mode where enemies keep getting tougher. Every week brings a new mutator that changes the rules of each run, along with a weekly challenge and online leaderboards.

title: Mafia Queens
description: You’re the new boss in this family, and the queens aren’t hiding their desires. With every meeting there’s less and less clothing, fewer rules and more of what stays only between you behind closed doors. Start relationships and prove you’re worthy of their loyalty.

title: Incredible Dracula: Bloodwood Secrets - Collector's Edition
Halftime Manager
description: A classic football manager in a modern guise: take charge of a club, fine-tune your tactics and experience every matchday as a compact TV broadcast with a 2D pitch, live ticker and half-time dressing room. Six nations, three leagues per country, one shared European cup.

title: PC Fish: Taskbar Aquarium
description: Raise, Collect, Trade! Discover rare fish, grow your collection, and build a living aquarium right on your desktop.

title: Street Food Simulator
description: From Corner Cart to Culinary Kingpin!

title: Survival Legion
description:
Recruit Warriors.
Build Your Legion.
Survive Every Battle.

title: A Sea of Grey & Green
description: A Sea of Grey & Green is a First Person exploration game. Explore your surroundings, find hidden objects, complete Cas' daily tasks and uncover what it really means to see life through their macabre eyes.

title: Go West Together
description: An online Wild West brawler for up to 8 players. Rob banks, haul contraband, weaponize whatever you find, and compete with friends to become the outlaw who survives to the very end.

title: Scarlet Prism
description:
Scarlet Prism is a frenetic, colourful, fast-paced arcade shooter. Eye-melting and senses-burning!

You play as Ciel, an angelic maiden cast into a celestial arena, destined to battle heavenly beings and malignant crystals for all eternity. Survive for as long as you can in this endless gauntlet!

title: Valentine in Bitterness
description: My name is Yuki Katagiri, just an ordinary girl you can find anywhere, without anything I’m particularly good at. But somehow, I’ve found someone I like! When I was about to confess, my meddlesome older brother just had to tease me! I wonder if things will go well on Valentine’s Day…

title: Mafia: The Omertà Collection
description:
Mafia: The Omertà Collection includes:
• Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition, including the Man of Honor Expansion and Deluxe Edition content
• Mafia: Definitive Edition, including the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions with 60 FPS gameplay and technical improvements
• Mafia II: Definitive Edition, including all DLC
• Mafia III: Definitive Edition, including the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions with 60 FPS gameplay, technical improvements, and all DLC

Experience four distinct eras of organized crime with Mafia: The Omertà Collection. Step into the shoes of men bound to the Family across decades of mob history in these immersive, third-person action-adventures rich with cinematic storytelling.

title: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle - Superior Edition
Konbini Cleanup
description: Konbini Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 2,928 products in a messy konbini. Clean, learn abilities, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

title: Game Shop Panic
description: No magic, no skills, no cooldowns. The only things that can clean up this messy store are your own two hands. Pick up retro game cartridges spanning three generations—8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit—stacked high on the floor, one by one, and place them manually onto the shelves of the correct genre.

title: Giantess Playground
description: Giantess Playground: Stomp as a towering Giantess or scamper as a tiny citizen in a city based destruction sandbox game. Crush buildings, dodge feet, play hide and seek in a sandbox map with Giantess girls.

title: Babu Me Baby!
description: Haruki Osanai is just trying to get by in life, but too much stress from work has taken a toll on him. His physician resorts to an unusual method to help him relieve stress... Hypnosis! However, things take an unexpected turn...

title: Quarantine Wing: Horror
description: Some places are abandoned for a reason.

title: No Results Found
description: One computer. One room. And records that were never erased. Search. Can you uncover the whole truth?

title: Blue Sign
description: In the fictional port city of Rissebra, you work as a marine insurance underwriter. Review the documents brought to your desk by shipowners, and uncover the risks hidden in their vessels, routes, and cargo. The decision to approve or reject each insurance contract rests entirely on your judgment.

title: Sura: Shattered Star
description: Sure: Shattered Star is a sword-fighting action platformer set in space. Play as Sura, a mercenary grieving the loss of her comrades, and cut down everything that stands in your way.

title: Mike the Hooper
description: Mike the Hooper is a 2D basketball puzzle platformer where you shoot hoops, open doors, and help Mike get home. Find your way through each level, make tricky shots, and overcome platforming challenges along the way.

title: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
description: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

title: Hextreaming: Deep
description: Hextreaming:Deep is a horror adventure game where you explore an abandoned water park alongside Suzy. Setting foot inside one of South Korea's top 5 most haunted locations. what on earth will she encounter this time? But hey, as long as she's with her viewers, at least she won't be lonely, right?

title: Snowed Under
description: Snowed Under is a first-person game about shoveling snow in the mountains.

title: Handyman Flipper: House Stories
description: From Broken Rooms to Dream Homes.

title: Backrooms Manager: Together
description: A 6-player co-op scavenging and logistics game. Search dangerous sectors for items, break down junk into scrap to sell, deliver shipments on time, and manage your team budget. Use your earnings to upgrade abilities and equipment, meet each quota, and keep your balance positive.

title: Someone's Here
description: Just another night in your apartment soon transforms into a tense game of choices. Answer the door, trust no one, and survive the night. Every choice changes the outcome.

title: Tidy Up Together
description:
Tidy Up Together is a cozy organizing simulator about restoring your fantasy Adventurer's shop. An evil wizard has blasted all 4,000+ of your products all over the floor - and it's your job to put them back!

Item by item you'll build the shop back to its former tidiness. There's an incredible range of products ranging from potions to sushi. Those Greatswords really shouldn't be mixing with the pineapples...

title: Evil School
description: This game is an FMV about anti-bullying. A teenage girl mysteriously disappeared, and the truth was buried by power for eight years. Now, you return to this place of evil with a bloodstained list. The moment of slay & judgment has arrived...

title: My Life as a Vampire's Maid
description: In this suspenseful fantasy visual novel, play as a young man stranded in snowy mountains. Guided by unseen forces, you enter an isolated mansion. As a peculiar daily life unfolds, you live alongside two vampire girls. Immerse yourself in this profound, dreamlike dark fairy tale.

title: Grandpa Needs Fish
description: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

title: Wish Creatures
description: Turn your monsters into stars and wish on them in turn-based battle!

title: Vape Store Miami
description: Run your own retro Miami vape shop in this 1–4 player co-op simulator. Stock shelves, serve customers, craft custom e-liquids, handle phone and online orders, grow your reputation, and expand the business.

title: Fee Payment & Cigarettes
description: Fee Payment & Cigarettes is a first-person psychological horror anomaly-spotting game. Enter a hospital in first-person, finish all payment checklists. Spot anomalies, then head to the payment counter or retreat to the smoking area to calm down.

title: Rhythm Racer
description: Rhythm Racer is a futuristic arcade racing game where music generates the race track. Race through twisting neon tunnels, compete for high scores, and challenge friends in Streamer Mode where Twitch viewers can join races directly from chat.

title: Unusual Tales: After Bark
description: You, a simple dog named Mr Peanut, find yourself in a weird cabin full of secrets... Will you be able to warn the family of the dangers? A horror game filled with mystery!

title: Bloodshot
description: Hardly Hyperbolic’s Bloodshot is a multiplayer FPS inspired by Doom and Quake. This fast-paced experience features a low-poly, pixelated aesthetic and a unique "Superhot" twist: projectile speed is relative to your character's movement. Players wield a modified shotgun that consumes their own blood as ammo; as your speed and heart rate increase, so does your firepower. Bloodshot prioritises pure mechanical speed and high-octane feedback.

title: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor
description: The Man of Honor expansion for Mafia: The Old Country features two new story chapters and added content for Free Ride mode. Players can step into the role of Enzo Favara and work alongside Ennio Salieri, a feared and respected mafioso, as he sets out to settle old scores.

title: Selfie Worm
description: A physics-based puzzle arcade game where players control a quirky, wiggle-happy worm. Navigate through various challenging levels filled with obstacles and traps, stretching and balancing your body to snap the perfect selfie at the key moment. Beyond the comical controls, players will discover a fragmented narrative about the worm's obsession with social media fame.

title: Pegfinity
description: One shot can trigger a massive chain reaction. Launch, bounce, and break the board in this physics-based incremental. Upgrade your build, stack combos, and push every run further into chaos.

title: Let's Cook It!
description: Let's Cook It! is a restaurant management game where you scavenge for ingredients and cook them into tasty dishes with up to four players. You work together as a team to manage your build and get out of debt.You can decorate, unlock upgrades, and recruit NPCs!

title: FD 27: Direct Your Football Club
description: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, manage the finances, and build a winning organization from the boardroom.

title: Tiny Crown
description: A tiny king. A huge challenge.

title: Back Driver Simulator
description: Can you stay calm while every second brings a new surprise?

title: Vambina
description: A third-person dark fantasy action-adventure. Vambina carries both the holy blood of Christ and a vampire's curse. Armed with a scythe and gun, she hunts the Deadly Sins across time. As night falls, stronger sins emerge from the darkness. Two bloodlines. One dark heroine. Chapter One begins.

title: Fellwood
description: Build a wild fantasy lumber empire that bombards a forest across the valley with axes, ballistas, cannons, and magic. Harvest flying logs, stack absurd upgrades, and automate your way to unstoppable woodcutting power.

title: Smile Town
description: Pay off your debts by working part-time in the nightlife district of Smile Town! Buy items from your friend Apple Ginger's shop to get an advantage at your part-time job.

title: One Last Hand
description: Poker meets Battle Royale in One Last Hand, a 2-6 players chaotic party game where poker gets deadly! Forget fair play: attack your rivals with powerful hands, fight for better cards in secret auctions, and bend the rules with powerful relics in thrilling online multiplayer matches.

title: Chinese Street Food Legend
description: A heartfelt game where you run a night market stall, cooking kaolengmian (grilled cold noodles). Customers come and go, stopping by to chat and share bits of their lives, joys, frustrations, and everyday struggles. At this little stall, you cook, listen, and keep living an ordinary person's life.

title: Tank Brigade
description: Explore a tactical top-down tank shooter set across diverse biomes. Each run offers a unique experience with procedurally generated levels and a variety of powerful weapons to unlock.

title: Patisserie Simulator
description: Run your own cozy patisserie and grow your fortune! Serve coffee, fresh pastries, and orange juice to customers, unlock new recipes, and decorate your patisserie to make it more charming and profitable.

title: The Newspapers of the Day
description: In 1920s Gyeongseong, the pen is mightier than the sword, but your hand is trembling. As an editor-in-chief, arrange articles, dodge censorship, and manipulate public opinion. Will you wake the people with the truth or yield to survive? Your editorial choices will rewrite history.

title: Italian Pizza Simulator
description: Become a true pizzaiolo and bring joy to a small Italian village in Italian Pizza Simulator! Help bring back Grandma’s decrepit pizzeria to its former glory, surrounded by the sun-kissed hills of Tuscany, and serve colorful customers from all over the world!

title: Astral Blitz
description: Astral Blitz is a roguelite, twin stick shooter. Control your fighter ship and wreak devastation through the hordes of empire defenses. Create your own play style as you customize your ship to your needs, setting it up for brutal destruction, refined precision, or to become chaos incarnate!

title: Outpost4
description: Outpost 4 is a 2D cartoon-style idle resource management game focused on combat and progression. You will take your mobile base across different alien planets, each with its own unique enemies to conquer. With 20+ weapons and 100+ items, you can freely combine builds and create your own style

title: I.T Never Ends
description: The printer is bleeding, the Wi-Fi is haunted, and Ticket #666 just came in. As the latest hire for a company run by cosmic horrors, your job is simple: Swipe to survive. Make binary decisions to survive the night shift in this dark comedy desktop simulator. I.T truly never ends.

title: Dino Party
description: Fight your friends through a stadium full of chaotic minigames! Dino Party is a 2–4 player party brawler where you score goals, steal stars, dodge hazards, and settle every round with punches.

title: TickWords
description: TickWords is a video game that lets you create and play custom revision crosswords, built directly from your own study materials. It also includes hundreds of pre-made crosswords covering a wide range of high-school and university subjects.
CONNECTION ESTABLISHED...LOGIN TO 137 NEURAL FRAME DETECTED...CREDENTIALS APPROVED...WELCOME USER

title: Static Dread: The Submarine
description: Descend into Lovecraftian horror aboard a claustrophobic military submarine. Assign tasks as a captain’s right hand, analyze sonar signals, make hard decisions, and keep the crew from madness. Dark horrors lurk both within… and beyond the hull.

title: Perk Up
description: Perk Up! is a multiplayer deck-building fighting game where every defeat makes you stronger. Each time you fall, you gain new powers, evolving into an unstoppable force. Keep fighting, adapt, and outlast everyone to become the last one standing!

title: Ricochet Abyss
description: Dive into Ricochet Abyss, a unique blend of tactical backpack management, hero-building, and pinball-style combat. Organize your inventory, equip powerful gear, and send your heroes ricocheting through perilous dungeons—every shot and item choice could be your key to survival!

title: Death Kitchen
description: Death Kitchen is an immersive fast-paced co-op cooking horror game. You must coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you in many situations. You can morph into a variety of characters! Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.

title: Platonica Space
description:
Open the door and step into someone's memories.
Platonica Space is a psychological exploration adventure where you search countless rooms to recover lost memories.

title: Parking in Tight Spaces
description: Test your skills in this relaxing parking game! Park cars, trailers, and buses in tight spaces. Each level pushes your precision and control – can you master every tricky spot?

title: Legacy of Defense
description: Become the hero who protects the fantasy world and stop the monster invasion! 'Legacy of Defense' combines defense with deck-building. Build your deck, use powerful skills, gain experience, upgrade, clear stages, and defeat the final boss. Ready to test your strategy and luck?

title: Lootbound
description: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

title: Astrobuilder
description: The world’s first dynamic world AI RPG. Play as any NPC in a galaxy that evolves in real time. Every quest, dialogue, and fate is generated on the fly — no reruns, just infinite stories shaped by your choices.

title: Shippin
description: Embark on a journey across cozy islands, where you’ll fish and experience magical moments. Uncover the stories of an ocean, where each harbor is a welcoming place, with friendly characters waiting to help guide you back home!

title: Fluff'n'Roll
description: Navigate tricky terrain, dodge obstacles, and roll your way to victory in Fluff’n’Roll! Master your skills to conquer increasingly challenging levels.

title: PizzaBoy
description:
Take control of PizzaBoy, a nimble pizza delivery guy equipped with an air dash that allows him to bounce off walls. This can be used to reach greater heights and distances than the standard run and jump. PizzaBoy must navigate dangerous environments to deliver pizzas to hungry monsters.

Pizzaboy must make it to the end of the level to deliver the pizza but don't expect it to be too simple, as each area is full of pizza-hungry monsters. Don't get too close or they might just steal a slice! The customer won't be happy with a half-eaten pizza.

The path to the customer won't always be straightforward either. Every level is a Metroidvania-style map, with many secrets, collectibles, and areas to explore. Alongside delivering pizzas, PizzaBoy may find opportunities to recover his lost memories and discover the dark secrets of the company he works for. The player's choice in how they tackle the level will determine the ending of each chapter, and ultimately the end of the game.

If the customer is satisfied with your performance, you might just get a 5-star review.

title: Rogue Eclipse
description: A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

title: Subway Outbreak
description: In Subway Outbreak, defend and rebuild your metro station against mutant hordes in this pixel strategy game. Manage tasks like fortifying defenses, launching assaults, and gathering resources to survive 30 days of increasingly fierce attacks. Lose by death or generator destruction.

title: Sobosuba
description: Shoot, squish, merge, amass! sobosuba is a satisfying physics game where you shoot and combine squishy blobs together, creating ever bigger blobs for the high score.

title: Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef
description: An action roguelike co-op dungeon crawler set in a lovecraftian universe.

title: Zankoi's Chronicles
description: A 2D roguelike action game fused with deep deckbuilding. Fight in grueling real-time duels, shatter your enemy's Poise to freeze time, and unleash devastating, custom-built card combos. No meta upgrades — only skill, synergies, and mastery define each run.

title: Fantasy Shop
description: Manage a shop set in the medieval world!

title: Night Guard: The Last Shift
description: Night Guard is a short horror game with retro style, based on the 80s.

title: Barkside Roads
description:
Get ready for a journey full of strategy, breathtaking scenery, and plenty of charm in Barkside Roads. Behind the wheel of a fun dune buggy, a friendly dog from Rio de Janeiro sets off on an adventure through some of Brazil's most iconic locations, where every road is a new puzzle waiting to be solved.

Build routes across a hexagonal grid, connect paths, reach intermediate objectives, and unlock new pieces that open up even more possibilities for your adventure. But think carefully before moving forward: every piece you use stays behind, making every decision count all the way to the finish line.

Travel through 30 levels inspired by famous destinations such as Copacabana, the Lapa Arches, and Arraial do Cabo, facing clever challenges that reward planning, creativity, and the determination to find the perfect route.

title: Zombie Tag
description: Zombie Tag is a fast-paced online multiplayer tag game set in a construction-site parkour arena. Each round, one player starts as the zombie while the humans get a 10-second head start to run, climb and find escape routes. Every human the zombie catches is infected and joins the horde, so the chase gets more intense as the round goes on. Push other players with boxing gloves, stun them with bear traps and use the whole arena to survive until the timer runs out, or hunt down the last survivors as the zombie.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: The Fastest Thing Alive
description: The sixth episode in the Sonic the Hedgehog RPG series.

title: Warden of the Sunken Keep
description: The sunken Aldermere Keep spews demonic miasma across the valley. Those who linger within it slowly lose their sanity and become monsters. Descend into the keep, find the source, and end the corruption in this retro fantasy turn-based roguelite.

title: Inky Fingers
description: An idle game about clicking a pen! Click for ink, unlock crazy new pens, buy powerful upgrades, and hire workers to automate production. Build your ultimate pen collection and grow your ink empire!

title: Black Gold: Shining Town
description: An adult strategy game set in a modern city. Fired from your job, you’re suddenly tasked by your estranged uncle to reclaim his fallen underworld empire. Build relationships with 12 women, retake territories, expand your power, and rise as the true ruler of Shining Town.

title: Hentai Elf: Elaria
description: In Hentai Elf: Elaria, you'll enjoy a combination of engaging mini-games and beautiful anime-style illustrations. Complete levels, unlock new appearances for Elaria, and watch her appearance evolve as you progress.

title: Console Archives: Touki Denshou Angel Eyes
Nicotine Merchant Simulator
description: You're a Nicotine Merchant. Start your production using improvised materials and grow it into a large enterprise. But be careful, just a few wrong moves and everything could fall apart!

title: Overshoot
description: Overshoot is an endless vertical climber where you draw a platform for the ball to bounce off. The aim of the game is to bounce as high as possible without falling down.

title: Grit Shot
description: Grit Shot is a retro-horror basketball roguelite where survival depends on precision shots and fast-paced tactical gameplay in a dark, atmospheric setting.

title: Supermarket Gas Station Simulator
description:
Stock shelves. Fuel cars.
Serve customers and earn profits.
Become the ultimate business owner!

title: K-Pop Karaoke Party
description: Sing your heart out with 10 unique K-Pop idols in this vibrant karaoke experience!

title: Arcade Archives 2: V'Ball
description:
V'Ball is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1988.
Control two young men as they enter a beach volleyball tournament and aim for the championship.
Enjoy a variety of actions, such as controlling where the ball flies during serves and spikes, or delivering a more powerful spike by tapping rapidly.
This is the story of their success. The rest of the story is up to you.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Pinball Action
description: Video game pinball with four separate tables!

title: Glam the Rocker
description:
Face bosses and platforming challenges!

Copy the enemy arsenal to acquire new abilities!

Everything mentioned above is present in this unique fast-paced action game!

title: Moonleap 2600
description: A fan-made demake of the game Moonleap, imagining what it would look like on the Atari 2600.

title: Witchblood
description: Witchblood is a first-person psychological horror game that draws you into the heart of a dark curse. Explore a decaying house where reality begins to unravel. Uncover the truth behind a forgotten family’s tragedy and face what should have remained buried.

title: Lost Chronology
description: Explore Past your Guilt and Denial. This Psychological Puzzle Horror will have you Explore your Psyche, 1 Minute before you Die! Are you Ready to Dig into the Darkness, Unearthing your Deepest, most Shameful Secrets?

title: Pool Glow
description: Pool Glow is an immersive exploration game inspired by poolcore aesthetics. You are free to wander through bright, open pool spaces, observing the gentle interplay of light and shadow. You can slow down, explore at your own pace, and discover a quiet sense of peace and relaxation.

title: Kaboomania
description: A fast‑paced retro maze bomber packed with explosive action, colorful pixel art, and a fresh twist on a timeless gameplay formula. For all retro and pixel art lovers!

title: Clown's Lair
description: Explore a haunted house stalked by a sinister clown. Stay hidden, solve puzzles, destroy cursed objects, and escape before your pursuer catches you.

title: Card of Arcana
description: Embark on a magical roguelike card adventure where every choice shapes your journey. Build powerful decks, discover mystical artifacts, battle dangerous foes.

title: Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey - Collector's Edition
description: Luxury. Romance. Ocean.

title: Crayon Friends
description: Color your own cute animal friends with colorful crayons!

title: Car Dealership Manager 2026
description:
Buy. Repair. Sell.
Build the ultimate car dealership empire.

title: OpenPete
description: A native PC port of Spyro the Dragon. Named after Spyro's name during original development.

title: Dead Stop: No Vacancy
description: Dead Stop - No Vacancy is a short first-person horror game set in an isolated roadside motel. Explore the Paradise Motel, uncover its disturbing history, solve environmental puzzles, and survive a night in which something has gone terribly wrong.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit
description: The officially-licensed mobile game for the hit anime series Jojo's Bizarre Adventure! A faithful recreation of the original world from this multigenerational RPG — JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit is finally here! Take on the "golden spirit" of the Joestar bloodline and set out on a bizarre adventure of your own today!

title: Tiny Paw Academy: Numbers + Fun
description: Fun Learning for Preschoolers

title: Primary School: English Grade 1 & 2
description: Complete Grade 1 & 2 English – fun, guided & smart learning quizzes for kids.

title: Mystery Box
description: Pack it. Ship it. Make their day.

title: Anime Fitness: Summer Sweat
description: Train with pro anime trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and jump into 30 minutes of intense full-body workouts.

title: Omega Pilot Evolution
description:
Omega Pilot Evolution is a high-speed futuristic racing experience that pushes the limits of anti-gravity flight. Race in immersive VR or play on a regular screen in both first-person and third-person perspectives.

Take control of cutting-edge anti-gravity ships and master precision piloting across dynamic tracks built for extreme speed, tight control, and skill-based maneuvering.

title: Rocket Sideswipe
description:
Rocket Sideswipe is a fast-paced 2D arcade football game where cars replace players and every match is a battle of speed, precision, physics, and aerial control.

Choose your team and enter the arena to score as many goals as possible before time runs out. Drive across the field, jump into the air, use your boost, perform flips, and smash the ball toward the opponent's goal.

The game offers several ways to play. Face an AI opponent with four difficulty levels, from Easy to Pro, or challenge another player locally in two-player mode. You can also choose between 2-minute, 3-minute, and 5-minute matches.

The physics-based gameplay allows you to control your car both on the ground and in the air. Jump twice to perform powerful flips, rotate your car while airborne, boost through the arena, and use momentum to deliver powerful shots. The ball reacts dynamically to collisions with cars, walls, the ground, and goal structures, creating unpredictable and spectacular plays.

Boost pads are scattered throughout the arena and can refill part or all of your boost meter. Managing your boost is essential for chasing the ball, defending your goal, launching aerial attacks, and making last-second saves.

When regulation time expires with the scores tied, the match enters sudden-death overtime. The next goal wins.

With neon-styled arenas, energetic physics, local multiplayer, AI opponents, aerial mechanics, boost management, goal celebrations, particle effects, and dynamic sound effects, Rocket Sideswipe delivers a compact car-football experience focused on fast matches and spectacular plays.

Drive. Jump. Boost. Flip. Score.

title: Citadel: Gunship Sandbox MMO
description:
Citadel is a gunship sandbox MMO set inside a huge machine world at war.

Players take ships into short missions to fight, mine, haul cargo, salvage wrecks, protect convoys, or raid other players. Every mission affects the same shared world.

Ships, weapons, and goods are built and traded by players. When cargo reaches its destination, supplies grow. When a ship is destroyed, it is permanently lost. When a faction wins ground, new routes and missions can open while others close.

The mission ends, but its results do not reset. Every delivery, loss, battle, and captured objective changes prices, supplies, faction strength, and what happens next.

Citadel gives you short, focused missions inside a permanent player run sandbox.

title: Hotel Empire: Check Inn
description: Hotel Empire - Check Inn is a charming management simulation in which you build your own hotel chain step by step. Start with a small, simple hotel and expand your empire into more and more cities – each with its own challenges.

title: Eggconsole Onryou Senki PC-8801mkIISR
description: Use your deductive powers to battle spirits in this unique Miyaji City horror adventure!

title: Eye of the Incubus
description: Shiro, an unassuming castle servant, one day comes into contact with a mysterious demon and is transformed into a half-demon. Though baffled at first, now half-man and half-demon, Shiro begins to accept his newfound life. Free at long last, however, Shiro finds himself in the center of chaos and trouble…

title: Find the Sneaky Chameleon
description: Can you remember what blended in?

title: Train Sim World 6: Schnellfahrstrecke Nürnberg - Ingolstadt Route Add-On
description: Accelerate to thrill-seeking speeds with TSG’s Schnellfahrstrecke Nürnberg - Ingolstadt! Experience German 300 km/h operations in Train Sim World; take the ICE 3 faster than you ever have before, and shuttle between stops with the classic DB BR 101.

title: Sort Them Ducks
description: Sort Them Ducks is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy duck store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

title: Tidy Mart
description: Tidy Mart is a cozy organizing game where you arrange hundreds of products across different stores, from a small corner shop to a sprawling supermarket. No time limits. No rushing customers. Sit back, relax, and enjoy.

title: Colorizing: Pleasure
description: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

title: Nightmare Delivery
description:
Nightmare Delivery is a cooperative psychological horror game where players take the role of couriers sent into places no delivery should ever reach.

You do not deliver to houses, streets, or real locations.
You enter the distorted consciousness of different people and carry a package meant for the darkness hidden inside them. Each mission takes place inside a strange mental space shaped by fear, memory, guilt, obsession, or trauma. These places may look familiar at first, but their logic is broken. Corridors lead where they should not, rooms repeat without reason, and ordinary objects can become part of the puzzle.

title: Dot Clicker
description: An immersive aim training game set in a Neo-Japanese landscape. It focused on season-based addictive precision challenges with rewards but also features a narrative alongside with a leaderboard for the top aimers and aiming communities.

title: Star Troopers: Combat Force
description: Move fast. Strike faster.

title: Dream House Cleaning
description: Bring forgotten places back to life in a cozy cleaning and restoration game! Clean dirt and trash, repair damaged areas, decorate interiors with furniture, and enjoy a relaxing experience at your own pace.

title: BlazBlue Entropy Effect X: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
description: Beyond All Possibilities

title: Stack Mates
description: Stack Mates is a co-op puzzle-platformer for 2-8 players built on teamwork and pure chaos. Shift your form between horizontal and vertical, climb on your friends, and reach the portal together. Remember, if even one person fails, everyone starts over!

title: Idle Immortal
description: Build a Chinese fantasy sect, recruit disciples, and forge the ultimate squad for ascension! Are you ready to walk the path to immortality as a true Sect Master?

title: Miniquest
description: A retro fantasy quest shrunk down to mini-size! Challenging turn-based combat meets the tight pacing of an arcade game in this minimalist RPG. Become the Chosen Ones and vanquish the Dark Lord, all in the span of a couple of hours. Then do it again, exploring branching paths and alternative endings. Then do it again! And again. And again... forever?

title: The Finest Spark
description: /You are the captain! Pull yourself together and get us out of here... sir!/ — gather EXPARTS, advance weapons, master space flight, and rain metal onto your enemies in this physics-driven space sim roguelike where playing chicken with asteroids is just as dangerous as enemy fire.

title: Pizza Man Simulator
description: Burned the pizza? Just drown it in ketchup! In your restaurant, microwaving a frozen Hawaiian is literally an everyday thing. Serve picky customers, upgrade your pizzeria and improvise in the kitchen. The most important rules? Nobody gets food poisoning… and the cash actually adds up.

title: Kingdoms vs. Zombies
description: Kingdoms vs Zombies is a blend of strategy, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay, where you must defend your kingdom against endless hordes of the undead.

title: Pin Money
description: Turn a rundown neon bowling alley into a billion-dollar strike empire. Stack absurd multipliers, unlock powerful upgrades, expand to 7 simultaneous lanes, and break the economy in this incremental idle bowling game.

title: Spear of the Sky
description: Grab your magical returning spear in this cozy first-person hunting game! Take your time hunting unique creatures across dynamic skies, upgrade your arsenal, and use baits to discover rare beasts. Relax, enjoy the hunt, and prepare for occasional epic boss fights.

title: Skatesterre
description: Flip, grab and grind like it's 1999! Skatesterre is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game inspired by the golden era of classic skate titles.

title: Dominocalypse
description: The puzzle roguelike that makes dominoes actually fun! Move, manipulate, and match using absurd tile modifiers, game-changing artifacts, and unique starting loadouts for endless chaos and replayability.

title: Scratch the Ticket
description: Scratch the Ticket is a first‑person incremental gambling sim where every ticket is a test of nerves. Print tickets, scratch cells, and decide: cash out now or risk it all. The outcome depends only on your choice.

title: Soulstation
description:
A visual novel between fear and love. Follow Kin as it falls deeper into a rusty world that will one day eat it whole. Will you get on board?

An atmospheric audio-visual narrative of a child who boards a train to the afterlife.

Will you give in to reality? Or crawl your way out? In this beautiful dusk, you need only open your heart.

title: The Pirate Keko
description: The Treasure Is Only the Beginning

title: Madden NFL 27
description: Run the league one decision at a time in EA Sports Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine.

title: Shinkansen Card Pull Simulator
description: Real Shinkansen bullet trains — now collectible cards! Pull gacha, trade on the market, ride the price swings. 50 cards featuring real Shinkansen photographs.

title: Hellbridge
description: Defend the last bridge to the living world in a relentless siege from Hell. Survive escalating waves, draft powerful spells, grow stronger with every run, and enter cursed gates to stop the invasion at its source.

title: Dwarven Forge
description: Master the depths in Dwarven Forge. Use your fireball-flinging lantern to clear paths and mine rare ores. Incrementally upgrade your digging power, node yields, and forging skills to craft and sell legendary weapons. Descend, optimize, and unlock the secrets of the ancient mountain.

title: The Canon of Balls
description: Hardcore, first-person, co-op platformer. Shadow of the Colossus' PSX aesthetics meets Monkey Ball. An easy-to-learn, hard-to-master open-world experience to explore and master together with your friends. A vast open world, with each platforming course bringing its own twist.

title: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
description: The legendary medieval strategy adventure has returned - enhanced for a new generation of knights. Conquer provinces, raise armies, storm castles, and influence the balance of power through bold strategy and action moments.

title: Endless Tactics: Trial Run
description: Endless Tactics: Trial Run is a Turn-Based Roguelite game. Play as the commander of a high-risk planetary mining operation, defend your base from alien creatures while trying not to get overrun. Use resources to upgrade your starship, unlock new tech, powerups, and deadly new worlds to harvest.

title: Panzer Knights: Commander’s Edition
description:
Panzer Knights: Commander's Edition is an anime-inspired WWII tank simulation where you command a German Panzer platoon through the chaos of Europe's battlefields. Engage in explosive third-person combat from the Battle of France to Operation Barbarossa, managing your tank's vital systems, loading specialized ammunition, and targeting enemy weak points. Between missions, assemble an elite crew from 30 recruits with unique skills and backstories, then deploy your arsenal of meticulously detailed tanks.
The Commander's Edition represents the definitive console version, bundling the base game with three bonus tank packs featuring the M4-748 Sherman, M26 Pershing, Churchill VII, Valentine XI, Panzer VIII Maus, and Elefant—tanks not included in the original PC release.

title: Matrix Mahjong
description: A single-player card game adapted from the Chinese National Standard Mahjong, focusing on diverse winning hands and scoring with Faan combinations. Meld the tiles horizontally and vertically and utilize items of rule variations. Experience mahjong within an intricately interwoven tile space.

title: Circuit Stance
description: Circuit Stance is a turn-based strategy game that blends creativity and tactical depth. Players take on the role of a super AI, programming robot AI chips to craft unique strategies, competing in intense arena battles to secure resources and glory.

title: Wild West Miner Simulator
description: You've become the sheriff of a town that... doesn't exist. Nobody lives here, the governor's stupid joke. It's time to get to work and turn this NOWHERE into a bustling metropolis. Mine coal, ore, and gold. Build houses, find oil, bring in new residents, create a paradise in the middle of nowhere.

title: Decimation
description: Sci-fi tower defense meets ARPG-like hero combat. Build towers then fight alongside them with your hero as you battle through a campaign to uncover the fate of a colonization effort on a distant planet.

title: DragonFire: Defense
description: Choose your dragon and defend your castle against endless waves in a systems-driven roguelite. Level up to draft perks, loot chests, and build upgradeable walls as you adapt to shifting enemy compositions and push your run as far as skill allows.

title: Agrocracy
description: A farming management game focused on planning and numbers. This is not a farming sim - no driving, animals, or role-playing. Manage weather, labor, capital, and time on a large isometric map.

title: Future Knight
description: Frenetic action and LCD aesthetic! In this 2D Shoot 'Em Up, switch between a robot hero and his benign tumor to stop a bizarre cult. You have 8 hours to save humanity's memory: defeat grotesque bosses, ride the skies on your Future Board, and master the chaos in a retro-futuristic Tokyo.

title: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
description: A Lovecraftian idle RPG with auto-battles, loot farming, chests, team strategy, town building, gear crafting, Runewords, stages, towers, realms, and seasons. Serve the Old Gods, build your town, corrupt the chosen, and fight for their awakening!

title: Flock of the Seraphim
description: Adopt gun-wielding angels that help you exorcise waves demons in this horde survival roguelite. Gain power by purging depraved demonic enemies, collecting loot, and improving your flock to create unique builds of holy power. Do you have enough faith to survive?

title: Open The Gate: Just A Little
description: Defense your medieval castle from unfriendly legions approaching in this Tower Defense Rogue-lite PvE. Combine your unique team of Human, Goblin, Undead... to defeat your enemies by slaying the Dragon in shortest amount of time!

title: The Core
description: Step into a world of mystery and self-discovery with The Core, an immersive action-adventure game. As an autonomous AI core, you awaken alone in a long-forgotten facility, your memory lost. Embark on a thrilling journey to uncover your true identity and unravel the purpose behind your creation.

title: Blackjack Roulette
description: Blackjack rogue-like with a Roulette "spin". Purchase Insurance Policies with unique abilities give you the edge while taking on a larger Roulette wheels with even larger Buy-In Costs.

title: Dinosaur
description: Create your own island without limits. Populate your island with dinosaurs, choose from over 50 species. Ensure the mutual symbiosis and prosperity of all species on the island.

title: 100Friends
description: The Loneliness Epidemic is coming, and only you and your hundred closest friends can stop it. Rally your party, fight back the Legions of Sadness, and bring the world back together once and for all...

title: Ashes of Paradise
description: Ashes of Paradise is an open-world exploration game blending Medieval, Oriental, and Nordic themes. Defeat powerful bosses and embark on a unique journey in this cooperative action-survival RPG.

title: Cropia
description: Build and manage every aspect of your farm in Cropia. Cultivate crops, care for animals, fish, mine resources, and explore diverse environments, all while supporting and expanding the growth of the local community. Hire the town citizen to help you work effectively and efficiently.

title: Baby Kings
description: Escape a dangerous dungeon with your friends as royal babies. Solve puzzles, dodge traps and laugh through chaotic co-op action for 2–8 players!

title: Karma Keepers
description: Karma Keepers is an idle/incremental souls sim where you guide souls, collect spiritual energy, upgrade and automate to keep corruption at bay, and push karma to the max to banish demons.

title: Memoirium
description: Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
description: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

title: Slampunks
description: Slam, slice, and roll through an evil corporation in this fast-paced 1-3 player co-op action roguelite. Chain kinetic hero synergies, steamroll over endless swarms of enemies, and stack wild augments until your builds are screen-breakingly huge. Grab a punk-mate and smash the machine!

title: Drink Factory Simulator
description: Build your own drink factory, discover recipes, improve production, and fulfill customer orders to grow your beverage empire! Drink Factory Simulator is a fun simulation game that combines creativity and strategy.

title: The Box of Fear
description: A missing daughter. A father without answers. A suspicious company. Solve puzzles, connect clues, and discover what "The Box" hides in this first-person psychological horror.

title: Storm Horse Simulator
description: Run wild and free! Become an untamed stallion in a cozy open-world adventure and set out to rescue your captive family. Outsmart patrols, build a safe haven for your growing herd, and form an unbreakable bond with a native friend. Your homeland awaits - answer the call of the wild!

title: Void Authority
description: A sci-fi roguelike document-inspection game where you approve or deny alien travelers, scan for contraband, and navigate shifting galactic laws across border outposts, with each run shaping the future political climate.

title: Terrol
description: Terrol is a grand strategy game focused on capturing and holding strategic resources. The objective is simple: control all resources and destroy rival empires.

title: Bunnimon
description: Bunnimon is a cozy yet mysterious adventure where puzzles, spirits, and the secrets of a fractured world collide. Dive into Pocket, a handcrafted realm on the brink, where you'll calm ancient guardians and guide lost Wanderers back to themselves.

title: Servant of the Lake
description: Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

title: 999 Hidden Cats: Brazil Together
description: 999 hidden cats and 444 adorable objects are waiting for you on large hand-drawn maps. Explore animated scenes and test your attention in detail-filled worlds. Enjoy a cozy, relaxing experience alone or with a friend.

title: Ledgerbound
description: The world may end, but more importantly: your job is on the line. Step onto the battlefield, befriend (and fall in love with) a ragtag crew of heroes, and go head-to-head against an immortal foe to protect the bureaucratic kingdom you love in this hilarious narrative-driven tactics RPG.

title: Clawed
description: Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must explore the park's grounds to scavenge resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way through diverse biomes, underground tunnels and deadly enclosures. But beware, you are not the apex predator here.

title: Wild Blue Skies
description: Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey!

title: Dinotica
description: Dinotica is a sandbox roguelike set in a mysterious prehistoric world. Tame and collect dinosaur companions, build your own refuge, and combine farming, crafting, exploration, and combat. Play solo or team up in co-op to face challenges together. With roguelike progression and high replayability, every run feels unique.

title: Low-Budget Repairs
description: Manage renovations in 90s apartment blocks! Focus on quick profit and cut costs wherever possible. Client notices defects? Tough luck, the money's already in your pocket. Every day brings new challenges and decisions that can lead to fortune... or trouble!

title: Duskfade
description: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

title: Plungeez
description: Take a dive in the world of Plungeez, a puzzle platformer where Bonnie, a fierce woman who, after falling in the underground, must explore the sewers of Salvador in search of a way out. Light torches, boilers, and use plungers to climb and solve puzzles!

title: VanySlash
description: Heroine, a close-combat magic-user, and her partner, an axe to fight and collect magical Tools!

title: Suika Pets
description: Suika Pets is the adorable puzzle game where you combine your pets to grow your score without overflowing their container!

title: Sandustry
description: Sandustry is a mining and automation game with sand physics. Explore a destructible world, digging and demolishing. Build a sand-processing factory and expand your logistics network. Delve deeper into the mines, unlock new technologies, and discover an ancient civilization's secrets.

title: Creepshow
description: Get lost in a deliciously dark horror anthology. Inspired by Shudder’s Creepshow series, this point-and-click adventure has gone all kinds of wrong.

title: Dagger Directive
description: Dagger Directive is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.

title: Emergency Room Simulator
description: In "Emergency Room Simulator" you become a dedicated doctor in the emergency room, responsible for diagnosing, treating, and saving lives. This professional simulation offers an immersive experience of the challenges and rewards of working in a fast-paced medical environment.

title: Kill the Man in the House
description: A short, visceral first-person shooter about killing a man in a house.

title: Anvillage
description: In Anvillage you are a knight that needs to build a village by harvesting woods and stones. You will also be building tons of buildings and crafting equipment and other itens.

title: Banzai Escape 2: Subterranean
description: Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean is an anime third-person action shooter and a sequel based after the events of Banzai Escape 2

title: Choppa: Rescue Rivals
description: Choppa: Rescue Rivals is a chaotic arcade-style helicopter rescue competition game for one to four players. Take off with your trusty rescue chopper and carry disaster victims to safety before your rivals!

title: Bippo Bot
description: A 2D platformer featuring 30 handcrafted levels where you'll collect hidden Energy Fragments, overcome dangerous obstacles, and unlock the path through three distinct futuristic city districts.

title: 8 Ball Challenge Puzzle
description: 8 Ball Pool Challenge is a single-player pool puzzle game. Aim your cue, plan your shots, pocket the balls, and complete each challenging level. Improve your skills and see how far you can progress!

title: Chronime Puzzle: Dogs
description: Chronime Puzzle: Dogs is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

title: Sparkle Saga
description: Mina was on an ordinary school field trip to the museum, when all of a sudden, monsters from another dimension invaded the museum. Mina stumbles upon an ancient artifact, a wand on display. The wand then transforms her into a magical girl.

title: Cowgirl Maid Milk Cafe
description: Move to the city, start a small business, and build a new life—with your two cowgirl maids! Run your cafe, delve dungeons for resources, train new staff, milk your cowgirls... and more!

title: Backrooms: The Incident
description: Backrooms: The Incident is a cooperative horror game for 14 players. On your own or with friends, you'll explore the game world, trying to figure out what's going on, where you are, how to get out of there, and whether it's even possible.

title: Tough Cat
description: This is a horde shooter. Earn coins by surviving as long as possible. Spend coins in the shop to unlock permanent upgrades outside runs, which is one of the core gameplay loops.

title: Boil Cabbage Make Soup
description: A cosy idler starring an Onion who makes soup anywhere on your desktop! Watch him grow and harvest cabbages to make delicious soup for a cast of colourful customers. Decorate your island and customise your Onion with your hard-earned gold to level him up, and build your very own soup making empire!

title: Xam Delivery
description: Drive your van through routes filled with obstacles and unexpected events, delivering pizzas and decoders to various apartment buildings across the city.

title: Quantum Hell
description: Take on the role of a journalist trapped in a ruthless quantum universe where you'll need a diverse arsenal and the manipulation of quantum physics to survive and progress. Quick thinking, speed, and precision will be essential to surviving in this retro style physics FPS

title: Tung
description: Tung is a niche and tuff first person horror game where you explore a hedge maze and become friends with triple t.

title: 2x2
description: 2x2 is an MBF21 community project hosted by brendondle, and is the sequel to 1x1! Once again, the concept is very simple: the maps only use 2 textures and 2 flats, with the exception of a single switch texture and F_SKY (which was only allowed to be used if a texture was transferred to it!). Double the textures, double the flats, and double the fun! The wad features 24 mbf21-compatible maps made by various authors. The difficulty curve is as steep as a mountain, though difficulty settings are implemented and HMP or HNTR are strongly recommended for first playthroughs. Additionally, many of the maps, especially the later ones, get really long. It is absolutely not recommended to marathon this wad, unless you intentionally want to burn yourself out. Maps are ordered very roughly by difficulty. Pistol starts are intended but we won't put a gun to your head.

title: Night of Restoration
description: Night of Restoration is a short horror game with 1 ending and 2 possible deaths.

title: Bubsy 4D: The Black Hole Update
description: The Black Hole Update (Version 1.2) is a free content update that adds 15 new levels to Bubsy 4D, as well as new outfits and time trial medals.

title: Storehand
description: Storehand is a cozy stocking game about organizing 6,298 grocery items across 14 aisles and shaping your own store layout. Map custom aisles, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy free‑placement mode as you relax and build the perfect shop of your dreams.

title: Province: Suroste
description: Province: Suroste is a handcrafted retro open-world RPG inspired by classic fantasy adventures. Explore a low-fantasy world, investigate a mysterious murder, fight dangerous enemies, trade with merchants, and uncover the secrets of a living world built entirely by a solo developer.

title: Shenmue I & II VR Mod
description: This is a mod by Tensai37 for the Steam version of Shenmue I & II for PC to bring it into virtual reality.

title: Big Bad Pharma
description: A cosy pharmacy-stocking sim with a wicked streak. Clock in, sort the shelves, chase satisfying upgrades, and slowly climb the corporate ladder of a pharmacy that maybe shouldn't exist. Tidy. Satisfying. A little bit evil.

title: AfterMove
description: Move one piece. Everything else moves with you. AfterMove is a minimalist puzzle game where every piece on the board follows its own rule — find the sequence that wins. 180+ hand-crafted levels. Quietly merciless, deeply satisfying.

title: S.O.L School Of Labyrinth
description: A dungeon crawl RPG set in an otherworldly realm beneath an old school building. Explore again and again, restore your base, and find your way back to everyday life.

title: Helldivers 2: Devoid of Liberty
description:
We have watched the Void stretch across the galaxy for too long. The threat posed to our Liberty is too great and we can no longer stand by as the Illuminate gain ground.

Helldivers, you are needed on the battlefield of a new frontier–one more wild and uncertain than any we have faced prior. We must venture into their haunted abyss, the Void, and liberate it back into Super Earth’s control.

title: Echoes of the End: Enhanced Edition
description: Echoes of the End: Enhanced Edition is a free update to the 2025 fantasy action-adventure game.

title: Genshin Impact: Everwinter Without Mercy
description:
The sixth major update of Genshin Impact, also known as Version 7.0. This update includes:
• New characters: Odette, Alyosha and Cryo Traveler
• New region, Snezhnaya
• New main story quests: "Everwinter Without Mercy" and "Wraith's Nocturne"
• New elemental reaction: Stellar Swirl
• New main event: Great Expeditionist Challenge
• New third-person shooter elements

title: Old Coin Pusher Gaiden
description: Old Coin Pusher Friends new evolution: coin-pusher RPG. Train samurai, prepare Action Spheres, explore enemy-filled caves. Shoot coins for rewards.

title: The One Fish
description: An online co-op game for 1-4 players where you fish with your friends to feed The One Fish! Catch fish of all shapes, sizes, and whimsical effects to keep up with its ever-growing appetite.

title: Ghost Soul M
description:
Ghost M is a mobile MMORPG developed by the Korean gaming company Mgame, built on the foundation of the classic online game Ghost Online.

Inheriting the original world, the game seamlessly blends Eastern martial arts with supernatural folklore. It features a charming 2D pixel art style, bringing to life adorable chibi characters and flashy combat skills. Players can now dive into the thrill of exorcising demons and conquering the mystical martial world right from their mobile devices!

title: App Developer Tycoon
description: Quit your job. Build apps from your bedroom. Beat your rivals, survive the rent, and claw your way from a spare room to a Silicon Valley HQ. A turn-based narrative tycoon about the indie developer grind.

title: Casino of Time
description: Casino of Time is a roguelike game where you gamble with your time. Your time ticks down and you must try to earn enough time to survive as long as possible in the casino. A variety of permanent upgrades is provided every 2 minutes to tilt the odds in your favour!

title: Magic Cards Duel
description: A fast-paced magic card game for 2 to 4 players. Use unique abilities to outplay opponents, make tactical choices, and control the match through skillful play.

title: My Tsundere Sister
description: The sequel to "My Cold Girlfriend" is here! Live under the same roof with your tsundere cousin sister sporting red twin tails, experience her daily quiet care beneath her sharp tongue, and unlock exclusive sweet and heartwarming summer moments.

title: Hariti
description: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

title: Junkyard Saints: Scrapstorm
description: Survive endless scrapstorms in a post-apocalyptic Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Build devastating loadouts, collect procedural gear, awaken powerful Saints, recruit companions, conquer dungeons, and create insane synergies in a world where scrap is sacred.

title: Desperate Gambling
description: Win to survive. In this cursed establishment, every chip buys you time. Play blackjack or roulette, open mystery crates to equip powerful artifacts, and survive long enough to discover what lurks in the thick fog.

title: Dark DieMansion
description: A fast paced survival horror game: Escape a dark, randomly generated mansion where creatures stalk you in the shadows. Outsmart them by manipulating the environment, restoring the power, and scavenging supplies to survive.

title: Gold Up
description: Gold Up is a physics-driven online co-op climbing adventure where two players must carry a treasure to the surface by switching roles, throwing it upward, and coordinating every move. Success depends entirely on trust, timing, and teamwork.

title: Burnstation
description:
Deck-burning. Score-chasing. Roguelike in stile plinko.
As a runner, you aim your 4 marbles, trigger retro cartridges, and chain explosive combos to push your score higher and higher. But push your deck too far, and it burns out.

title: Silent Shark
description: A tactical, map-based WWII submarine sim set in the Pacific Theater: Approach, intercept, strike unseen, withdraw into the deep. With realistic instruments, a Torpedo Data Computer (TDC), and including a full campaign with missions, patrol zones, radio intel, and more.

title: Minerals: Deep Core Mining
description: Mine the vast underground and collect ores and gemstones—collect! collect! collect like crazy! “Minerals: Deep Core Mining” is an over-the-top mining game with roguelite elements. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your abilities and take on an endless underground that changes with every run!

title: G.O.D. Global Orbital Defense
description: Take control of the G.O.D. system, the U.P.A.’s tactical satellite. Orbiting in silence above Vel’Aris, your mission is to protect the planet from every threat. Manage orbital fire. But remember: G.O.D. sees everything... even what you wish remained buried.

title: Sunder Siege
description: A short incremental physics game. Swing a wrecking ball to smash monsters before they reach your home! Upgrade your ball and your home for more smashy goodness!

title: Dorts: A Darts Roguelike
description: First-person darts roguelike. Throw darts. Earn gold. Buy upgrades. Survive the chaos.

title: Potato Simulato
description:
Welcome to Potato Simulato: Together , a chaotic physics-based platformer where you play as a helpless potato trying to survive a world full of traps, madness, and pure frustration.

Roll, jump, and struggle your way through bizarre obstacle courses filled with spinning hammers, deadly spikes, collapsing platforms, and completely unfair surprises. One mistake… and it’s back to the start.

This game is not about skill alone , it’s about patience, timing, and how much rage you can handle.

title: Rogue Drone
description:
Rogue Drone is a top-down sci-fi strategy game that blends tower defense, base building, and resource management into a single survival loop.

Gather resources and expand your outpost during the day, then defend it against escalating waves of hostile drones at night. Build and optimize your base layout, manage energy distribution, and deploy defensive systems to withstand increasingly dangerous attacks.

Harvest crystal resources, refine them into higher tiers, and unlock new technologies to strengthen your defenses. Every decision shapes your long-term survival as enemy waves grow in complexity and intensity.

With a focus on planning, automation, and deterministic combat, Rogue Drone challenges players to design efficient systems that can survive without direct control when the night begins.

title: Full Bet: Fighting Casino
