description: A 1v1 turn-based fighting card battle set in a casino!Bet your chips and fight for the right to strike!Luck and strategy, nerve and intellect—everything will be tested ina thrilling battle where the tide can turn in an instant.Outplay your opponent, seize victory, and claim your rewards!

title: Author Sim
description: Have you ever dreamed of becoming a world-renowned author? Now's your chance! Study masterpieces from other authors, craft breathtaking stories, and maintain a public profile in pursuit of your dream.

title: No Knock
description: Break in through the back door, think like a thief, win with theft. Bypass the locks, steal everything, and disappear without a trace! Begin in the gutter, end with the crown — steal your way to the top.

title: Red Tape Rampage
description: You're the boss of bureaucracy. Exploit interns, automate the red tape and climb the corporate ladder in this satirical idle empire builder.

title: Oops! Simulator
description: Oops! Simulator is an absurd slice-of-life game about trying to get home. Ordinary actions lead to unpredictable accidents, strange events, and hilarious outcomes in a world that refuses to stay normal.

title: Survival Log
description: The apocalypse is here, and you saw it coming. Survival Log is an urban survival game about preparation and foresight. Hoard supplies, reinforce your home, and optimize every run before zombies flood the city. Every failure becomes experience. You must adapt and survive this time.

title: Grainhold
description: Grainhold is an open world mining game where player build their own settlement, which they must then defend against waves of enemy attacks. To construct buildings, players must gather resources and grow vegetables, which they can sell to buy better equipment from the merchant.

title: Tileweaver
description: A Tile-placer Roguelike with Puzzle elements. Build your board, empower yourself and slay monsters in this dark strategic game. Discover a variety of arcane skills and enigmatic artifacts to control the board and delve ever deeper into the abyss.

title: Hovertron
description: Hoverboard your way through a physics-based platformer. Easy to learn but hard to master; Flow and flip through a series of levels to chase perfect runs. Compete on a global scoreboard, or hunt down the secrets hidden throughout the game.

title: Ignoble
description: Destroy enemies and harvest blood, bones, and marrow to grow stronger, unlock forbidden skills, and wipe out the Ignoble tyrants who dare threaten your master.

title: Security 51
description: You're a security officer deep within Area 51. Scan the staff, verify clearances, and decide who can enter the elevator and who absolutely mustn't leave. The deeper you go, the less certain you are that anyone standing before you is still human.

title: Konekomi Castle
description: Fifty years in the future, a plucky investigator named Pandora is caught in a snowstorm. Seeking shelter, she unknowingly steps into Konekomi Castle, finding mysterious, one-eyed aliens. You'll need to earn trust, tell lies, and befriend strangers to unearth the castle's extraordinary secrets.

title: Weed Supermarket Simulator
description: Grow weed and grow your business! Run your own weed supermarket, manage stock, set prices, and help customers. Try new strains, choose the best products, upgrade your shop, and keep your store running smoothly so people always come back.

title: Chainsaw
description: Become a God in this real-time turn-based combat RPG with non-stop brawling. Chainsaw is a game where you must create strategies and prepare your team before each battle, because once combat begins, enemies will keep attacking without stopping.

title: Rage Bait
description: Mechanics, you can play first person or 3rd person. puzzle simulator with funny dialouge. It's a walking simulator with narrative choices for different outcomes and is a meta comedy like Stanley parable.

title: Pro Jank Footy
description: Pro Jank Footy is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.

title: Dwarven Rampart
description: Dwarven Rampart is a Fantasy strategy game where you build your Dwarven town, raise massive armies, and choose your enemies to fight against. How long can you survive?

title: Vaulted Valor
description: You are in a post-apocalyptic underground vault where every decision carries weight. As you embark on quests and unravel a deep, twisting story, your actions will permanently alter the lives of your fellow inhabitants.

title: Mandate Order
description: Mandate Order is a strategy game set in the Warring States period. Starting from barren lands, build strongholds integrating production, defense and military functions. Manage resources and the people's will, expand your territory, counter threats, and ultimately rise to prominence amidst the chaos.

title: The Merchant's Eden
description: In The Merchant's Eden, you build a town around a thriving market. Defend your citizens and traveling merchants against raiding bandits. A minimalist game blending cozy city-building and intense tower-defense as you grow and protect your town.

title: Agefield High: Rock the School
description: Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s and you have three months left at school. So REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school!

title: Academy: Become a Hero
description: Time-based challenges, precise jumps, and special abilities in an immersive academy to become the next hero.

title: The Cave Diver
description: Crawl down a suffocating cave system using only your arms in this punishing physics-horror adventure. What morbid force is calling you deeper into the heart of the caves?

title: A Hole in my Room
description: Explore a mysterious place and an atmospheric world filled with horrifying and unusual environments in this first-person psychological horror game. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, hide from darkness, and enjoy a unique experience in the horror genre.

title: Sweyet Dreaming Emulator the Familiar Discomfort of the Unpredictable
description: Learn to live without control while solving dynamic dream scape that change through real-life blinks.

title: Verde
description: Build a small town of seedlets, mysterious seed like creatures in this cozy city builder. Build facilities, put up decorations, and help the seedlets thrive!

title: Star Chef Simulator
description:
Welcome to Star Chef Simulator, where your dream of running your own restaurant is about to become a reality! Immerse yourself in the exciting world of culinary entrepreneurship as you build and manage your restaurant from the ground up. Unleash your inner chef and dive in the art of cooking with more than 10 delicious dishes from around the world. Cook with a variety of different ingredients, techniques and recipes to create culinary masterpieces that will delight your customers. Use various kitchen appliances such as the deep fryer, oven, stove or mixer and create unique dishes!

Hire, train, and manage your employees to keep your restaurant running smoothly. Build a strong team to handle the hustle and bustle of a busy kitchen. Customize your restaurant, from the walls to the floors, from the decor to the equipment. Create a unique dining experience and watch customers flock to your establishment.
Keep an eye on your finances as you make decisions to grow your business. Manage employee costs and invest in upgrades to attract more customers and increase profits. Provide top-notch service to your guests to earn rave reviews. Listen to feedback and strive to deliver a memorable dining experience that keeps guests coming back for more.

Are you ready to take the helm of your own restaurant and become the ultimate culinary star chef? The world of gastronomy awaits you!

title: AI2U: With You 'Til The End
description:
Cute catgirl Eddie, pretty witch Elysia, and stunning AI hologram Estelle all seem to adore you—perhaps to a fault! Learn what makes them tick by exploring their homes and talking to them about nearly anything.

An overarching storyline looms over your adventures together, connecting your narrative to the dynamic NPCs. Solve puzzles and unravel mysteries alongside your lethally charming companions.

Your words and actions shape the outcome of each round, with a variety of endings waiting at the end of each playthrough. Strategize to unlock the best outcome and whisk your captors away!

title: Palm Sugar: A Village Story
description: Embark on a pixel RPG journey in 'పల్లెటూరు - PalmSugar.' Battle drug lords, wield unique weapons, and immerse yourself in South Indian culture. Telugu & English localization. Will you save the village?

title: Hell Galaxy
description: Hell Galaxy is the only game where you can experience the fusion of space battles, eerie specters, and daunting titans. This unique gameplay offers a mix of action, horror, and space exploration. Engage in dynamic mining, looting, and crafting while traversing an RPG-influenced cosmos.

title: Block Catching
description: An online game of block catching with a twist. The catcher is not your friend.

title: Ruin
description: Ruin is a free to play survival sci-fi sandbox MMORPG indie game where you try to survive on mankinds attempt to colonize a distant planet. Chances are stacked against you, but don't give up. You are most likely the last human alive. It is up to you and you alone to do what you must to stay alive.

title: Digital Waste
description: Play as Kevin, guided by ChatGPT, as you travel through a world where countries, objects, conversations, ideas, emotions, technologies, memories, and philosophies each become their own unique game.

title: Astrophobia
description: A PSX-style cosmic horror game where a classified mission to study alien architecture on the Moon leads two astronauts into the ruins of an ancient civilization that predates humanity.

title: Yo Skater
description: A 2D precision platformer/endless skateboarding game that lets you ollie, flip, grind and yoyo your way through an infinite range of terrain, traps and obstacles!

title: Moros
description: Moros is a first-person sci-fi survival horror game. Explore a mysterious research spaceship, solve environmental puzzles, battle terrifying clone creatures, and uncover the truth behind a failed consciousness transfer mission orbiting Proxima b.

title: Ghost Battalion
description: Early 2000's inspired 1st/3rd-person shooter, with vehicles, ships, jet packs, multiple foot‑soldier classes, space battles, and so much more. The game features a Single-player campaign with several uniquely designed missions, and multiple Multiplayer modes such as Conquest, FreeForAll, and Escape.

title: Lin Ling
description:
Lin Ling is a choice‑driven indie visual‑novel game on PC. Step into a realistic‑style story filled with complicated relationships, tough decisions and hidden secrets.

Players will make critical choices that shape the plot and lead you toward multiple different endings. Every decision carries real‑world consequences, and there is no perfectly safe option.

Featuring original hand‑drawn artwork, atmospheric background music and well‑written character dialogues, this narrative experience is great for streaming. Viewers can watch and discuss your in‑game choices, making each playthrough unique and fun for audiences.

Play through different branches, unlock character stories and discover all possible endings. If you enjoy story‑rich games with meaningful player choices, Lin Ling offers you a memorable experience.

title: Aipom's Great Pirate Adventure
description: Aipom's Great Pirate Adventure is a roguelite-ish, pirate-themed, grid-less, grid-full, treasure-filled, light-hearted, auto-chess fan-game made for the Eevee Expo Game Jam 2026.

title: The Unclosed Case
description: A psychological detective thriller. Everyone has already decided who did it. You don't have to. Investigate a double death, question everyone who loved them, and discover how much you can trust your own mind.

title: Smugg.io
description:
Smugg.io is a browser-based multiplayer deduction game - figure out your opponent's secret character before they figure out yours. Everyone gets a hidden card, and you take turns asking yes/no questions to narrow it down, reading your way to the right guess.

There's also a mode built for streaming: up to 100 viewers team up to interrogate one player live - chat proposes the questions, votes on what to ask, then votes on the final guess. High-pressure, high-chaos, fully collaborative.

Players can also build and share their own custom decks for others to play. No download - runs entirely in-browser.

title: FishFishFishFishFish
description: An idle game where you upgrade your equipment and catch fish.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Z for 2
description: 40 years after its initial release, The Legend of Zelda is now available to play as a two-player simultaneous cooperative multiplayer game. Player 2 takes on the role of Link’s Shadow. Either player can pick up and use any item, and each player can select their active item independently of the other. Players share resources and health.

title: Déclic
description:
DÉCLIC is a peaceful photography adventure focused on exploration, discovery, and interaction. Travel through a charming black-and-white world filled with villages, forests, beaches, wildlife, and mysterious characters, while searching for the perfect moments to capture with your camera.

Explore three different locations, each with its own atmosphere, inhabitants, wildlife, and photography challenges. Wander freely through the Valley of Bruyère, the Forest of Kiiru, and the Beach of Stanhamn while discovering hidden corners and unique subjects.

The game revolves around photography. Use your camera to frame subjects, adjust your zoom, and take pictures at the right moment. Animals react to your actions, creating special opportunities that require patience, timing, or creativity. Birds can be scared into flight, frogs can be photographed while jumping, foxes can flee when you run, owls can be awakened, and other animals have their own unique behaviors.

Meet the local inhabitants and complete their photography requests. Each character asks you to capture a specific subject or moment, from a portrait of an elderly woman to a flying seagull, a sleeping cat, a threatening crab, or an entire lighthouse. Completing these requests earns stamps that can be used to unlock travel between different areas.

Your photographs are stored in a personal album, allowing you to build a visual collection of your journey and revisit the moments you captured. A notebook keeps track of your active photography requests and objectives.

With its minimalist black-and-white art style, relaxing exploration, reactive wildlife, character-driven quests, and photography-focused gameplay, DÉCLIC offers a calm adventure where the goal is not to fight, but to observe, explore, and capture the world one photograph at a time.

title: Isaac Desulme
description:
Isaac Desulme ; The Basement of Mom is a dark and humorous roguelike dungeon crawler inspired by classic top-down dungeon games. You play as Isaac Desulme, a frightened child who discovers a hidden trapdoor beneath the carpet after his mother locks herself away.

Descend through a series of randomly generated floors filled with dangerous creatures, locked rooms, obstacles, secrets, and increasingly powerful bosses. Clear each room to unlock its doors, explore the dungeon, collect powerful upgrades, and find the boss guarding the way deeper underground.

Isaac attacks by firing tears in different directions while moving freely around each room. Throughout the run, you can discover a wide variety of strange items that improve damage, firing speed, movement speed, range, tear size, piercing, homing abilities, health, and other combat attributes. Every run can play differently depending on the upgrades you find.

The basement becomes more dangerous as you descend, introducing new enemy types, projectiles, stronger monsters, charging enemies, ghosts, and unique bosses. A minimap helps you navigate the procedurally generated floors and locate unexplored rooms, item rooms, and boss rooms.

Behind the absurd atmosphere is a darker story about Isaac, his mother, fear, loneliness, and what may really be waiting at the bottom of the basement.

Explore. Fight. Cry. Descend deeper. And discover what is hidden in the basement.

title: Z-Sector
description: Z-Sector is an intense zombie wave shooter. Push back endless hordes, get tactical upgrades, and rule global leaderboards. How many waves will you survive? Master your arsenal and become the ultimate survivor!

title: Majo
description: Majo is an apocalyptic witch-cultivation strategy RPG featuring a surreal suspense and bizarre style. In the modern, eerie world of Majo, the senses and minds of all humanity have long been manipulated by a mysterious, higher-dimensional force that transcends human comprehension. To prevent the world from perceiving the truth, 'It' appropriated memory fragments from parallel dimensions and combined them with fabricated responses, disguising reality as the 'dreams, intuition, and sixth sense' that the masses accept without question.

title: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North - Legacy Edition
description: Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost.

title: Grounded 2: Into the Abyss
description: Take the plunge into Grounded 2's largest update yet. Explore a vast new pond area, build beneath the surface, unlock new diving gear, battle deadly creatures, and ride the Toe Biter Nymph Buggy as you venture deeper into the park.

title: Overwatch: Reign of Talon - Season 4: Heroes of Busan
description: Play as our newest Tank Hero, D.Mon, when Season 4: Heroes of Busan launches on Aug 11.

title: Blind Touch VR
description: Experience blindness in VR. Navigate a world of darkness using your guide cane, immerse yourself in a sensory journey through sound and touch.

title: Depths of Providence
description: Depths of Providence is a turn-based roguelike JRPG through 100 procedurally generated floors. Your party enters at level 1 with empty pockets. Fight down through instant-death depths and escape with rare loot before you lose it all. Bank blue-chest relics forever and climb the daily leaderboard.

title: Peak: The Final Ascent
description: Peak: The Final Ascent pushes the co-op mountain-climbing formula into even more hostile territory. This final major update adds two new late-game variant biomes—the ghostly Gloom and trap-filled The Citadel—replacing the Caldera and The Kiln areas as you climb. Along the way, a danger-filled dungeon awaits, and a teased monster may hunt you during your ascent.

title: Sneaky Clean
description:
Sneaky Clean is a social deduction cleaning game where not everyone is squeaky clean.
Scrub down a luxury resort and clean up after the ones playing dirty. Play solo or in co-op, with or without troublemakers and prove you're not all washed up !

title: World of Warcraft: Midnight - Curse of Ula'tek
description: A new threat coils in the shadows as the Curse of Ula’tek content update draws champions to the Coiled Isle. Uncover the secrets buried within its cursed depths, face venomous new dangers, and prepare for fresh challenges.

title: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
description:
Shelves And Sorcery is a cozy fantasy organization simulator where every shelf, crate, and display is yours to perfect. Restore order to a magical shop overflowing with hundreds of unique items, from enchanted weapons and glowing potions to spellbooks, fresh produce, and curious trinkets.

Whether you enjoy tidying a small corner or spending hours perfecting every display, Shelves And Sorcery offers a relaxing experience built around the simple joy of bringing order to chaos.

title: Rooster Booster 3D
description: Rooster Booster 3D is a speedy retro platformer! Play through three unique, vaporwave-inspired zones as you optimize your completion time to unlock new characters and earn the Golden Torus!

title: Hunt Skeletons Together
description: Take on a cursed church in Hell with 1 to 4 players online — co-op or PvP! Hold the line against running, leaping, bone-throwing hordes. Swing above the dead with your grappling hook. Blast off limbs and unlock cosmetics with every kill. Stand together... or hunt each other down.

title: Crypto Trading Simulator
description: Trade volatile crypto markets in real time, build automation bots, and upgrade your home-office into a capable trading setup. With bills rising and pressure mounting, every decision can push you toward profit or wipe you out.

title: Landscaper Simulator
description: Lawns are wild. Parks are buried in weeds. Streets are littered. The world needs a hero, and that’s where you come in. As the Landscaper, it’s your job to turn disorder into beauty. With your weed whacker, pressure washer, and trash vacuum, you’ll trim, wash, and restore every space to perfection.

title: Eon Empires
description: Create and lead your civilization from the Stone Age to a futuristic era. Shape history on customizable maps through war, diplomacy, culture, trade, science, and religion.

title: Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins
description: The world's first twin-stick anthill shooter! Reign terror down on the Gonklins using every bean in your arsenal. Be careful, warrior Gonklins will strike back with their blasters! Upgrade your legume weaponry and defeat King Donklin the Gonklin!

title: Dawn of Horror
description: Dawn of Horror is a high-intensity Action Horror FPS set in the decaying urban sprawl of Cygnus City. Following the collapse of civilization into a digital Dark Age, step into the role of Kage—a survivor seeking vengeance against hordes of Cyber-Zombies and bio-mechanical monstrosities.

title: Regulars
description: Run a late-night diner with up to 8 friends. Seat customers, take orders, and cook meals. Not everyone is who they seem. Study your regulars, spot the anomalies, and decide who gets served and who gets purged.

title: Crime Simulator: Ashen Creek DLC
description:
Welcome to Ashen Creek. This DLC introduces a brand-new neighborhood packed with fresh opportunities and high-stakes scores.

Features:

New Map: Explore an entire new neighborhood with over 9 unique spots ready to be broken into and looted.

New Targets: Plan your break-ins and hit high-value places, including a local jewelry store and a pharmacy.

New Wheels: Search the area and steal brand-new cars.

Deadly Traps: Watch your step and learn to avoid new security measures, such as pressure floors.

title: Heritage
description: Animount has been seized by Drammul, the Lizard King, and his army. The only one capable of stopping them is Oro, the serpent. Trapped in a cycle of reincarnation, choose Scrolls, skills and equipments, and join powerful Sects in this Auto-Battler Roguelike to defeat Drammul and save Animount.

title: The Comeback King
description: The Comeback King is a light-hearted, mildly satirical retro boxing management game set in the UK in the 1980s. Take on a has-been boxer and manage his career. Decide who he'll fight, train him up and send him into the ring! Can you guide your boxer to a title contest against the division Champion?

title: Farming Incremental But With Guns
description: Plant crops and shoot them down with your trusty gun. Earn money, purchase upgrades, and cultivate your farm. Watch your crops physically evolve to gigantic proportions. GROW them. Never stop growing them until their shadows block out the sun forever.

title: Finding Polka
description: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!

title: Deathward
description: Seek Death as you face dangerous foes, solve puzzles, and explore forgotten dungeons to become the ultimate necromancer.

title: Stonewards
description: Stonewards is a solo or co-op mountain-defense roguelite. Protect a bastion and keep your King alive! Dig for resources to unlock character upgrades and fight off waves of monsters.

title: Project Looking Glass
description: 1963. A classified experiment. A grieving mother. A signal that won't stop transmitting. Step through the Looking Glass — a first-person psychological horror told through the static of a Cold War-era apparatus that peers into places mankind was never meant to reach.

title: King's Well
description:
King's Well is a steampunk-themed roguelite deckbuilder where players use high-stakes poker logic to power industrial machine combat.

After a kingdom falls into ruin due to a gambling plague, the King casts the most notorious gamblers into The Well; a deep, industrial pit filled with rusted machinery and failed experiments. To earn your freedom, you must salvage derelict weapons and "fuel" them using your gambling skills. This time, you aren't playing for money; you are playing for your life.

title: Scraps: Hellmouth Creek
description: A scrapbooking adventure. Ride bikes, float down rivers, and explore the woods while capturing photos and arranging your own scrapbook pages.

title: Void Salvage
description: Salvage derelict ships, uncover strange points of interest, and survive hostile ambushes in this incremental auto-combat game. Upgrade your ship, collect loot, stack wild synergies, and become absurdly overpowered.

title: The Carcass
description: A deep roguelike colony RPG inside a dead god's corpse. Procedurally generated events, branching narratives, species with unique traits, and meaningful choices that shape your colony's fate. Every playthrough tells a different story of survival and evolution.

title: Warhounds
description: Warhounds is a turn-based tactics game about an elite mercenary squad with an old-school action movie vibe, inspired by XCOM and Jagged Alliance. Recruit unique fighters, upgrade your base, and fight for Africa’s future. No fake RNG - only true ballistics and lethal tactics.

title: Heart Sequence
description: Roguelike where skills are executed with heartbeats. Build your deck, analyze your options, order skills, and create synergies. Discover powerful items and fight your way through a map full of enemies.

title: DreamEcho
description: Dream Echo is an RogueLite ARPG game where players can explore the world of Dreams and acquire various Concepts to engage in nearly completely free-form combination battles. Additionally, you can gather Memories upon waking, allowing you to bring some Concepts into your next dream adventure...

title: [Herror] Gas Station Case
description:
[HERROR] is a series of short horror episodes where everyday work routines collide with paranormal threats. Each episode is a unique standalone story lasting 1.5–2 hours.

Dan Cooper, a 25-year-old night shift gas station worker in Ohio, recently laid off from a uranium plant, is trying to put his life back together. But everything changes when his friend Michael discovers a mysterious case by the lake. Soon, people begin to vanish in the surrounding woods, and the cozy gas station turns into a deadly trap.

title: Omen
description: Infiltrate the remnants of a fallen empire in this dark sci-fi isometric action game where extraction meets base defense. Extract valuable loot, establish defenses against hostile fanatics, and unlock the gateway to a dimension of cosmic dread that defies comprehension.

title: Hellbound, Inc.
description: HELLBOUND INC is a hellish 2D platformer where you jump & carry packages to deliver against time, demons and HR. Play as an undead courier trapped in a fulfillment center recently purchased by Satan himself.

title: Tiny Monster Haven
description: A cozy idle creature collector that sits on your desktop as you go about your day. Grow crops, care for and level-up your companions and put them to the test in wild monster battles!

title: Deep Water
description: Explore a roguelike RPG set in dynamic, procedurally generated mines filled with diverse biomes. Battle relentless monster waves using a mobile base, gather resources to upgrade your crab, and brave the ocean's depths through shifting weather and day-night cycles.

title: Royalty Free-For-All
description: Royalty Free-For-All is a hand-drawn cartoon Party Brawler featuring an original cast of characters inspired by the public domain! Join Dorothy, Sweeney Todd, Mother Goose, and more as they duke it out in hand-drawn platform fighting mayhem!

title: Echoes of Mystralia
description: Mages of Mystralia's award-winning spellcrafting system enters a new era. Free Mystralia from the Shadows of the Past in this action-RPG roguelite. Create an infinite variety of spells to save the Memory of the World.

title: Riftstorm
description: Storms are coming, and there are rules you must follow. RIFTSTORM is co-op looter-shooter set in a world of myth and secret societies where you can play solo or co-op in a party of three.

title: Sword & Shield Simulator
description: When war overtakes your people, it leaves a cruel imprint in the form of hard sacrifice and the crushing of the village. And here you are on the battlefield, confused and distraught, looking for any way to help your people win the battle. But what can you do if you're a simple craftsman?

title: Swordcery
description: A colossal blade has pierced the Earth, unleashing a storm of enchanted swords from the heavens. Collect and wield an arsenal of these spellbound blades, turning them against the very force that summoned them. In this roguelike ARPG, you will defy the Celestial evil consuming the world!

title: Luminary
description: Luminary is a solo or 3 player co-op Openworld Action RPG that creates a balanced, accessible experience for everyone. Using a unique world and character progression system, explore vast hand-crafted lands together, uncover hidden treasures, level up your town, and push back the darkness with light.

title: Mulligans Golf Game
description: Mulligans Golf Game is an Open Map Arcade Golf Game designed to deliver all the true feelings one gets when playing golf with your friends. The experience has been simplified to allow non golfers to play, but provides depth to challenge those looking for more!

title: No More Room in Hell 2
description: No More Room in Hell 2 is a terrifying 8 player co-op action horror experience. Find your friends in the dark and survive - in a dynamic, endlessly replayable zombie apocalypse.

title: Agent 64: Spies Never Die
description: Relive the golden era of gaming with a retro FPS that captures the essence of 90s console shooters. Embark on a thrilling journey of espionage and action, tackling various objectives while battling cutting-edge 64bit powered enemy AI. Enter a world where bullets and secrets collide!

title: Sente
description: Sente is an abstract strategy board game, with electricity, shields, lasers, and explosions, for 2 to 6 players that move simultaneously, where each move can cause a cascade of consequences while the board seeks to regain balance.

title: The Spirit of Twelve
description: One summer night a mysterious object crash lands in Nidelium, the kingdom where our tale begins. The King and his Wizard retrieves it and returns it to the castle. The wizard inspects it but does not know what it is. He however has an ominous feeling and decides to consult with his guild. That night a thief, looking to steal from the Wizard, seizes the object but mysteriously decides to commits suicide by jumping from the window in the room where the object was kept. The golden band which surrounds the object is ripped off as it crashes on the ground and break in half. The broken shards of the item are empty upon inspection and the wizard decides to takes the ring band, which contains an inscription, to his guild to try and unravel the mystery.

title: Tussle Works
description: Assemble a bench of scrap-built windup contraptions and battle the ghost teams of rival tinkerers. 210 hand-drawn machines, 7 game modes, a ranked ladder, and a collection to complete — a cozy 16-bit auto-battler where every pixel was placed by hand.

title: Vortex
description: You just wanted to play a relaxing game of Sudoku, right? Too bad your PC just got infected. VORTEX is a chaotic deck-building roguelike where malware rewrites the rules of the classic puzzle. Build your deck, adapt to the mutating viruses, and survive the digital chaos!

title: Dark Succubus
description: Explore the labyrinth, collect crystal shards, uncover the truth and escape. The most important thing is: avoid the pursuit of the dark succubus and beware of this sweet temptation. (Female villain costume can be customized)

title: Circulo
description: Circulo is a fast-paced 2D arena survival game centered around geometric chaos. Players control a small circle while facing waves of hostile shapes in an increasingly dangerous battlefield. Defeated enemies provide resources used to improve stats, unlock combat options and acquire upgrades. Runs feature different projectile types, passive upgrades, specialized abilities, enemy variants, bosses, checkpoints and random events.

title: The Somnolent Prince
description:
Goro Akechi's days have all become the same: He wakes up. He watches TV shows, or he reads a book. He leaves his house. He grabs something to eat. He takes the subway. He visits a sleeping Ren Amamiya. He talks to him. He leaves again. He takes the subway again. He… doesn't go home. He goes to Odaiba. He fights. He dies.

…And then he wakes up back home. Again and again.

Every day he hopes the cycle will break, that he will finally be free… and every day he is wrong.

But You can change this. All you have to do is 'Wish' for it. So, press start, and free him from this Fate.

title: Metroid Prime Hunters: Recompiled
description: Metroid Prime Hunters: Recompiled is a native recompilation of Metroid Prime Hunters.

title: Double Golf
description: In this interdimensional golf game, you swap between shooting the ball and swapping part of the world for another.

title: Dead Broke
description: Dead Broke is a frenetic action-arena roguelite with a twist: there is no health bar. There is only your money, draining away with every shot and every hit. Manage your finances while dodging hordes of debtors, bosses that attack your wallet, and a casino that never wants to let you leave.

title: Greatlandia Election Simulator
description: An election based sim on a fictional map, 'Greatlandia', and your goal is to win with a majority. It is made by ChairMapping, and the coding is assisted by GPT

title: Tower of Scherbenmark
description: A turn-based ASCII roguelike RPG set in the shattered dark-fantasy realm of Scherbenmark. Listen for monsters beyond your sight, survive shifting floors, and follow the echoes left by your missing sister Mara into an ancient rift.

title: Knytt Classic
description: Celebrate the 20th anniversary of the indie freeware classic, rebuilt for modern machines! Explore a maze-like planet as the Knytt, a peaceful being abducted by aliens, find your missing ship parts, and get back home in this zen-like atmospheric platformer.

title: Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse
description: Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse is the full and expanded version of the viral puzzle game

title: The Frog Prince
description: The Frog Prince is a 3D physics-based multiplayer platformer where players climb challenging environments, use their tongues to interact with other players, and work together or compete to reach the top.

title: Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake
description: Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake is a first-person, grid-based, real-time combat dungeon crawler RPG that faithfully revives the essence of classic old-school dungeon exploration. Navigate each corridor step by step, feel the tension of every corner, and strike fast in real-time combat.

title: The Crossroads
description: Build the tavern where legends never die. A pixel-art idle game that lives in the corner of your desktop; serve drinks, recruit heroes, send them on quests, and grow from a drink serving shack to a ledgendary tavern.

title: Shopenkraft's Quantum Curiosities
description:
Shopenkraft reaches for the stars! Run a traveling tech shop from the back of your spaceship!

The game features over 50 different modules that you can freely mix and match to create all sorts of useful (or dysfunctional) products.

Some modules cancel each other out, but others create unique effects and functionalities. Experiment with different configurations to discover everything!

And if you feel like some of your creations are useless... Remember that the customer is always right!

title: Blind Rage
description: The voices command you to commit a burglary! Unfortunately for them, you are blind and finding what they seek is a challenge! Chased after you try your best to not get caught and end up in the asylum.

title: Goblin and Recipes: Match-3 Adventure
description: A cozy fantasy Match-3 where every completed chapter unlocks a real traditional Balkan recipe. Cook, match, and fill your goblin cookbook.

title: Hamster Ballers
description: A short, hilariously unfair, two-player obstacle course that'll more than answer the question: "Would I lose my sanity if I were trapped in a hamster ball with this person and had to climb a stupid hazard filled mountain to get out?"

title: Gravity Grove
description: Gravity Grove is a 2D platformer set on the faces of a 3D cube. Walk over the edges to rotate the entire level, shifting gravity in your favor to open up new paths and uncover hidden secrets from the past.

title: Desktop Pinforge
description: A cyberpunk idle pinball game that lives on your desktop. Smash blocks, automate your build, upgrade your Reactor and Launcher, and let your neon machine print profit while you work or play.

title: Manala: Equinox War
description: The swords are fake, the hits don't count and the monster is just a guy in a costume. Manala is a videogame about live-action roleplay (LARP): build a combat deck, fight other players and argue over armor points.

title: Megako Punch!
description: “Megako Punch!” is a fast-paced deck-building roguelike!Jump into a world teeming with monsters and beat them to a pulp with your special moves!

title: BookStore Simulator
description: Open your dream bookstore and begin sowing the seeds of knowledge among locals. Push the boundaries of possibility and immerse your business in a world of magic.

title: Rampallians
description: In Rampallians you build a deck of 40 cards from the nearly 400 cards in the game. It is a PvP where you play gatherers to get the resources to play your other cards and build your settlement. The first decision you make each game is your faction.

title: Father Forgets
description: A short, atmospheric pixel-art story about the late-night moment when a father sees his own mistakes and remembers what really matters. Inspired by a classic essay on fatherhood. A quiet experience in a single sitting — for anyone who's ever thought, "what if I'd done things differently…"

title: Hole Is Mine
description: Hole Is Mine is an incremental adventure about purifying the Hole. Dive inside and launch your Mini'ohs to mine for you. Extract impurities, upgrade your power, and find hidden secrets to grow the Village, customizing your Mini'ohs with incredible powers. The Hole has spoken!

title: Witness the Dark #1: Bloody Burger
description: You escaped a serial killer. Now you're hiding in a small town, working night shifts at a burger joint. But the hallucinations won't stop. The customers seem to know you. And in three days, seven people will die. A psychological horror narrative where reality itself cannot be trusted.

title: Clan and Crown
description: The game is a strategy simulation game where you start a family, raise children, infiltrate various industries in the city (13 industries, 70 professions), run for mayor to control the city's destiny, manufacture weapons to wage city wars, and ultimately establish your family empire.

title: Vivid Intrusion
description: A fast paced FPS roguelike with an emphasis on movement. Imbue your weapon with unique effects that make each run different. Survive a variety of arenas, enemies, and boss fights. Are you able to stay ahead of the curve and complete all your trials?

title: Body Sushi
description: Make sushi. With waifus.Create eye-catching, sexy sushi platters in this playful and sensual simulator.Run a sushi restaurant where the serving plate… is a person.Serve VIP guests, carefully arrange your dishes, and unlock new waifus in this unique body-plating experience.

title: Runt
description: Runt is a rural gothic visual novel mystery where you follow the story of Runt, the youngest of five brothers, surviving a monstrous post-apocalypse.

title: Ballatory
description: Ballatory is a short, 100%-able incremental idler where you BUY, UPGRADE, PAINT, and watch your BALLS bouncing around, hitting the cores and earning you money!

title: Ajnabee: The Unknown
description: Follow Naina’s daily life as it slowly stops belonging to her alone. 🚪 An unseen presence watches ️, remembers , and interferes ️ as her sense of safety slowly collapses. A deeply atmospheric psychological horror set in India, exploring obsession , fear , and emotional vulnerability.

title: Homeostasis
description: Navigate a desolate snowscape in your lone vehicle, keep your systems running, and unravel unsettling clues about the last expedition in this short retro survival horror experience.

title: Bit Breaker
description: Bit Breaker is a short brick-breaking incremental bullet hell. Collect resources to upgrade your balls and fight back against the nodes taking over humanity.

title: The Dungeon Of Horror
description: A dark medieval-fantasy turn-based dungeon crawler where you try to escape the dungeon of your own creation! Place tiles, fight monster and cooperate with friends to find and destroy the pagan shaman Meir to escape this horror!

title: The Severed Gods
description: A fantasy roguelite RPG where heroes reincarnate to stop the mystic dragon Umbra. Master turn-based combat, sever giant bosses, and shape your journey through relics and evolving NPC interactions.

title: Human Parking Simulator
description: Are you confident in your driving skills? Then come and take on this challenge. The goal is simple: drive the vehicle and park it in the designated space. That's all there is to it.

title: Tale of the Bullet Knight
description: All these years, piece was lying around on all of these fields. But one day, a sudden sad moment happened, since by fire and monsters our people got threatened. Nor heroes, nor luck was on our side, but a fallen knight, who had depression on his mind. He lost his home, he lost his sword, but he gain a new weapon, and now he ain't bored. In your hand, dear player, the future of our life, hope that you will be able to save all the people, husbands, kids and wives. The journey will have a lot to tell, but for now we just offer you a trial to tell. Shoot your way through the enemy lines, heal yourself with potions, like you would drinking nice wines. Modify your gun just like how feel, if you would happen to die quick, dont worry, its not a big deal. We all can learn from our mistakes, I hope though you will do whatever it takes. Save the Kingdom, save our lives, so we can offer you more start than fives.

title: Pax Autocratica
description: Build a grand totalitarian colony and personally storm roguelite battlefields with your soldiers. Shape citizens fears, loyalties, bonds, and feuds. Capture enemies, convert them into true believers. Sacrifice the weak. Feed the strong. Wield absolute power and make every life bend to your will.

title: Wicked Little Witch
description: A city witch lost in the woods, face enemies both familiar and strange. In this Action Roguelite, unlock new characters, collect spells, and build your own playstyle and uncover the truth.

title: Cult of Pin
description: Flip, nudge, and destroy in this roguelike pinball deckbuilder. Select from 100+ upgrades to create game-breaking builds and smash through the cursed playfields. Complete missions to trigger explosive special attacks and tear the tables apart, one bumper at a time.

title: Kungfu Card
description: Special Moves! Great Kung Fu! "Kung Fu Cards" is a tactical card battler inspired by traditional Chinese martial arts. This innovative game combines elements of poker and mahjong with Chinese kung fu philosophy, striking the perfect balance between strategy and chance.

title: A Game About Penguins
description: A Game About Penguins is a cozy, online multiplayer experience where you customize adorable penguins and enjoy relaxing activities with friends. Slide, fish, throw snowballs, and socialize in a charming, snowy world!

title: Figure Shop Simulator
description: Run your own figure shop! Produce figures with 3D printers, stock your shelves, set prices, and offer the best shopping experience to your customers. Manage your storage, expand and design your store. Try to complete collection sets, follow market trends, and grow your business!

title: Backpack Boy
description: Backpack Boy is off on one of his treks when he discovers a peculiar flashlight that changes the world around him. Explore a seemingly abandoned structure in this puzzle platformer built around mode-swapping.

title: Touch of Madness
description:
Touch of Madness is a 2D survival horror with 1-bit art. The game is heavily inspired by genre classics, especially Resident Evil and Silent Hill.

Explore the scenarios looking for information and items. Manage your resources through your inventory and survive the horror while trying to uncover the mysteries of the main story.

title: Color Fear
description: Today on the Color Fun Coloring Show they want Viewers to Help them Find out Who is Breaking into Their House.

title: Bottle Cracks
description: Bottle Cracks is a party game where everyone is a bottle. Jump through chaotic levels without breaking! Play solo, online with up to 12 players, or with unlimited local players.

title: Car Wash Simulator
description: Build a local car wash into a massive detailing empire! Master advanced cleaning techniques with vibrant active foams, beat the clock for extra tips, and buy or lease new properties. Play it clean or risk everything with high-paying shady deals and secret backroom plantations.

title: The Black Lily Blooms in Her Eyes
description: This adventure game follows the mystery of a bell said to have the power to grant wishes, as you build your deck and challenge six magicians. A roguelike mode with changing routes and item choices also offers strategic battles separate from the story.

title: Diddy Kong Racing: Recompiled
description: DKR-R is a cross-platform static recompilation of Diddy Kong Racing for Windows and Linux.

title: Welcome to Desal
description: Welcome to Desal is a short psychological horror experience where an ordinary job slowly turns into something deeply unsettling. Forced to work off your debt, you take on simple café tasks-serving customers, cleaning, and following orders-but something about this place isn’t right.

title: Case of 1980
description: A sudden call from your grandfather pulls you back to the family farm. As Nathan, you arrive expecting a routine visit, only to stumble upon a horrifying reality tied to a 1980 crime. Trapped and isolated, you must face the entities lurking in the shadows and survive the night.

title: Shibogami
description: Shibōgami is a physics-driven 2D platformer prototype built around rope-swinging momentum. Fire your rope, connect to anchor points, and swing and fling yourself through the world in search of food for your big, dog spirit companion.

title: SkullBall
description: Have you ever wanted to play Quake, but also wanted there to be something a little extra? Meet Skullball, a boomer shooter where the aim of the game is to grab the Skull at the center of the map and take it to the opposing team's goal!

title: Oniria
description: When the moon rises, the garden falls with it. The insects succumb to exhaustion, all except one...

title: Flavors of Spain
description: Embark on a fast-paced arcade culinary journey! Master the brave bull to shoot iconic dishes to the 52 provinces of Spain. Test your aim and discover the rich gastronomy of Spain in this indie blend of geography, gastronomy, and strategy.

title: Cloud Sculptor
description: Sculpt your way through puzzles and platforming using a frog, a laser beam, and other classic sculpting tools!

title: 100 Mystic Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍♂️ Can you find them all? ️‍♂️

title: Cheated
description:
Hack your friends to make them fall.
You are tiny. Reach the attic. It's easy.
2-8 players, or streamer mode.

title: Samurai Beat Demon
description: A Brotato-inspired roguelike for players short on time, diving straight into combat! Weapon positions unlock 62 unique abilities, each with a buff and debuff. Strategically mix and match based on battle and build for endless playstyles!

title: Catch Flex
description:
Catch Flex is a full-body dance rhythm game played in front of a single camera, with no VR headset, no gamepad and no wearables. The camera sees your whole body, your moves are the input, and even the menus are gesture-controlled. Tracking runs locally on the device, or on a phone running the free Catch Flex: Controller app, which sends only movement data over the local network and never uploads video.

Six kinds of move make up a chart. Slash blocks in the direction of the arrow, catch rings with a hand or a foot, kick the balls or knock them back, stomp floor markers on the beat, ride slide trails to the end, and dodge obstacles by ducking, leaning or stepping over. Vol. 1 holds ten hand-charted original tracks from 96 to 150 BPM, house, electro and techno, all charted within reach of a real body with no jumping needed. An optional no-fail mode lets you move through a whole song without chasing a score.

Beyond the solo run there is local split-screen Versus for two players, global leaderboards and ten achievements. Custom levels are made in Catch Flex Editor, a free browser editor, and loaded into the game over Wi-Fi. The game also reads charts saved in other common level formats.

title: Matchstick: Cosmic Flame
description: A time and space bending cosmic intelligence has found its way to Earth. Your family has been taken. Face the horrors of a twisted world and fight off the infected to save them. Travel through wormholes, explore nightmarish environments, solve cryptic puzzles, and run from demonic entities.

title: Graveyard Shift
description: Scavenge, tiptoe, and fight your way to the surface in this dangerously cute puzzle and stealth game where everyone can hear—but not see—everything you do.

title: Animosity
description: Through claws and bullets, Red must save his friends from the angry ape menace. Procedural levels create a new experience with every play. Companion AI gives you the backup you need. Coop, Deathmatch, and Speedrun for up to 4 player split screen. Xbox controllers recommended.

title: Catetris
description: Catetris is a captivating puzzle game where players must place falling pieces of various shapes to fill horizontal lines on the board.

title: Babylon, Ohio
description: 2016, rural Ohio. After losing her mom, 11 year old Nadja Kováč is moving in with her aunt and older cousin, Marie. See what else she can lose.

title: Sexophobia
description: A dating sim and card-based social strategy game where everyday life collides with the unknown. Build relationships, craft your deck, and uncover a hidden reality where every connection shapes your path—and your fate.

title: Velocrash
description: Velocrash is a party racing game in which players take turns building the track before racing on it together. Each round, every player draws a random hand of cards and places one track piece or trap - such as saw blades, oil slicks, boost pads, or launch ramps - so the track grows longer and more chaotic every round. Finishing a race scores points, but sabotaging opponents is often more rewarding. The game features 3D arcade driving physics, online multiplayer for 2 to 8 players via Steam invite, two game modes (points race and time trial), two worlds, multiple cars and colors, and gamepad support. It is localized in five languages. VELOCRASH was created by a single developer and released into Steam Early Access on August 8, 2026, developed and published by Apolloxian Games.

title: The Twisted Zone: Foreborn
description: In a future of hyper-advanced technology, the unborn can decide whether they should be born by experiencing their future lives in a simulation.

title: Chessmate
description:
Chessmate is a tactical strategy game that transforms the chessboard with card-based commands, dynasty abilities, traps, and cinematic 3D battles.

Pieces are not limited to traditional chess movement. Each card commands a specific piece type and grants it a unique movement, attack, defense, or support ability. Manage your hand, Command Points, and battlefield positioning to defeat every King in the enemy army.

title: Merge Assault
description: Merge Monsters. Smash Every Block.

title: Bubble Shooter: Color Splash
description: One shot. Endless bubble fun!

title: G-Diffuser
description: A native PC port of F-Zero X (N64), including 64DD Expansion Kit support.

title: Super Mario 64: Rogue Chaos Edition Version 2.0
description: Rogue Chaos Edition is back and bigger than ever! Version 2.0 introduces new ways to play the game and brings the total patch count to over 200!

title: Ace Combat 6: Recompiled
description: A native PC port of Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation (Xbox 360).

title: Accident Investigator Simulator: Black Box
description: Step into the role of a federal investigator and uncover the truth behind every disaster. Recover black boxes, cross-reference evidence, expose contradictions, and name the real cause before an innocent takes the fall. Every conclusion matters in this tense investigation sim full of twists.

title: Re:Dream
description: Re:Dream is a walking simulator in which the player discovers photographs. A copy of our world, or a world inside a copy. 3 real life characters, who discover their self of our reality.

title: Donkey Kong Land Remake
description:
Donkey Kong Land Remake is a fanmade recreation for PC of the original Donkey Kong Land, but with looks, sound and controls in the style of DKC!
Featuring 30+ full sized levels, tight controls and a lot of secrets to uncover, so Donkey and Diddy can get all their bananas back, again!

title: Deflect
description: A bullet hell parry roguelite where your shield is the only weapon. Catch enemy fire and send it screaming back through 100 waves, endless hybrid-boss gauntlets, and a mountain of loot. Seven Reapers, one rule: Don't Shoot, Send it back!

title: World Climate Lab
description: World Climate Lab is a real-time planetary climate simulator. Import your own terrain or sculpt a world in the topography editor, then watch a living climate emerge from physics: winds, oceans, cloud bands and ice. Every climate is calculated, not painted.

title: Grand Cru: The Wine Maker
description: Grand Cru: The Wine Maker is a turn-based wine-making tycoon set in Bordeaux. Score your terroir, age vintages in oak, and balance the four pillars of quality — then out-negotiate 25 unique buyers with your own pricing strategy while volatile weather RNG threatens every harvest. From terroir scoring to Michelin-star contracts, every vintage is a high-stakes economic calculation where critics and the public pull in different directions.

title: Alice and the Devil's Prison
description: Escape adventure game. During a tea party, Alice and her friends become trapped in a world created by demons. Will they be able to escape this twisted realm safely?

title: Dead Before Work: The Commute
description: "20 mins to the meeting, or you’re Dead Before Work!" It's Archie's unluckiest day. From broken alarms to a city that’s literally out to get him. Sprint through physics-based chaos, dodge cosmic-level bad luck, and rack up gag points. Can you survive the world’s most lethal commute?

title: Birb Game
description: A racing game where you play as a bird and race in single player or online multiplayer

title: Pight
description: Pight is a minimalist puzzle game inspired by the Minecraft redstone system, in which we try to turn on the light by using pistons and different block types.

title: Super Smash Asteroids
description: "Super Smash Asteroids" is a high-speed, twin-stick, top-down, rogue-like space shooter. Choose from 6 unique ships, upgrade with 70+ items & blast through epic bosses. Level up for intense, action-packed battles in a futuristic universe. Buckle up for a thrilling journey to glory!

title: Cyberpunk SFX
description: What can be more spectacular than a girl armed with rockets and a sense of humor? Yes, she is about to start solving the problems of the 21st century. And if you want to make sure she doesn’t create a few new ones, you’ll have to show her the way.

title: Sector: Cyber Crash Episode One: The Cyber Hour
description: After the fall of her own father Genesis decided to follow in her father's footsteps and awaken her new powers to a brand new world fighting off digital viruses that appear only with in the Cyber Hour.

title: Cocosic: On Pirates' Trail
description: Cocosic and his brother Viki need to save their sister Aivochka, who has been kidnapped by the evil pirate king. On their journey, they will have to visit different worlds, as well as help restore them after the "Collapse" arranged by the villain on the way to his own world.

title: Horny Waifu: Kaiju Strike
description: Protect the world from giant monsters in Horny Waifu: Kaiju Strike! Pick from a variety of hot and, yes, HORNY waifus and battle kaiju in this epic fantasy adventure story! That story is about to keep you hooked with its twists and STEAMY FUN!

title: Don't Knock Again, Sabrina!
description: Don't Knock Again, Sabrina! — a comedic visual novel about a pushy and horny neighbor who's always finding new reasons to knock on your door.

title: White Rabbit's Wonderland 2: Twisted Worlds - Collector's Edition
Era Online: Şeref Savaşı
description: Era Online: Şeref Savaşı is a 3D fantasy MMORPG developed for the Turkish market, featuring full Turkish language support and localized voice acting. Players can explore a vast open world, engage in large-scale guild vs guild (GVG) battles with hundreds of players on screen, choose from multiple classes with awakening and job transfer systems, collect and train over 100 battle spirits (Savaş Ruhu) with strategic team building, trade freely in a player-driven economy, and enjoy a deep social MMORPG experience with guilds, dungeons, and world bosses.

title: Overstimulacrum
description: You are overstimulated. Explore the annals of Your mind through the lens of an FMV point and click museum experience. Watch sensory memories, find what's real. Receive Your gift.

title: Bobrix
description: Explore, play, and create on Bobrix. You can create your own games, make friends, and customize your avatar on Bobrix! Every game is multiplayer so invite your friends to join a new small community!

title: Rome: Card Battles
description:
Rome: Card Battles is a free-to-play collectible card game set in ancient Rome and played entirely in a web browser. Players assemble decks from a collection of more than 250 cards drawn from the legions, politics, gods and arenas of the Roman world, then face opponents in turn-based duels where board positioning, resource management and timing determine the winner.

Content is split between "Via della Gloria", a hundred-level single-player campaign against AI opponents, and player-versus-player duels in both casual and ranked ladders. A separate mode adapts Ludus Latrunculorum, the Roman game of military tactics, into a standalone board challenge, while each new season expands the card pool and rotates the ranked rewards.

title: Command Monster
description: Survive as long as possible by entering the fighting game commands that appear one after another.

title: No Thoughts Just Dodge
description:
The feed is endless. Your attention span is not.

Take control of one extremely overworked braincell—or bring a second braincell along—and survive a neon storm of doomscroll phones, screaming notifications, weaponized lag, and nonstop chaos.

Collect Thought Crumbs, build combos, choose powerful upgrades, grab Mystery Orbs, and fight to keep your braincells online as the screen becomes increasingly unhinged.

title: Max Cross
description:
Procedurally generated levels, randomly spawned enemies, this fast paced endless platformer will have you sweating bullets. It's all about timing and reaction speeds, to see how far you can make it and if you can top the leaderboard.

It's easy to play but VERY difficult to master. Incrementally increasing difficulty the long you survive means the challenge grows along with your experience.

Mix and match 10 unique power-ups with 5 game-changing modifiers, creating over 50 possible combinations that can completely transform how you play.

The further you make it, the bigger the score—and the harder the game hits back.

No two runs are ever the same and it keeps you coming back for more.

title: DustCrow
description: DustCrow is a space-salvaging and exploration zero-G VR game where you strip derelict wrecks for scrap, manage your tools and equipment in a zero-G environment, and play in a live, player-driven economy. It's just industrial tools, tactile physics, and the daily grind in the vast emptiness of space.(from steam)

title: Bartender Simulator & Fast Food Van Simulator 2026
description: Fast hands. Smart moves

title: Zooville Detectives: A Read-Along Mystery
description: Discover the secret guardian of Zooville in this heartwarming visual novel.

title: Sandbox Doodle Playground
description:
Build. Craft. Destroy.
Create Your Own Playground.
Experiment Without Limits.

title: Car Dealer Simulator: Retro Car for Sale
description:
Become a Car Dealer.
Trade Classic Cars.
Build Your Dealership.

title: Miranza Futebol Clube
description: Your team is 3-0 down in the second half and there's nothing you can do. In Miranza FC you're the chairman, not the manager: you sign the cheques, answer to the board, take the heat from the supporters and just watch the match decide whether you keep your job.

title: Okugafuchi Shopping Arcade
description: A timid real estate agent is sent to the abandoned Okugafuchi Shopping District to perform a mysterious ritual for redevelopment. But a wandering female ghost and the town’s cursed past stand in the way. As he uncovers old documents and legends, a buried truth begins to surface.

title: Kobayakawa-san is a Souls-like
description: Talking to the girl you like? You learn by dying.

title: Boba Avoider
description: Rotating twin galaxies - collect tapioca of the same colour while avoiding that of the opposite.

title: Yet Another Avoider
description: Avoid hitting rectangles as long as you can!

title: Captive
description: Leave No Trace. He is Always Watching.

title: Ikarus
description: IKARUS blends the bullet-hell chaos of arcade shmups with the strategic edge of a roguelike deck-builder. Dodge, parry, and shoot through waves of hostile machines while crafting game-breaking card synergies. How close to the sun will you fly?

title: Nitro Horizon
description: Nitro Horizon is a neon-inspired top-down arcade racing game from InfinitByte Studios. Race against AI rivals across six unique circuits, master high-speed drifting and nitro boosts, unlock seven distinct vehicles, and compete across Arcade Race, Time Attack, and Championship modes. Earn credits, improve your garage, and climb the leaderboard in a fast-paced single-player racing experience.

title: One Stroke Hunter
description: A brainy roguelite monster-hunting game fought with a single continuous stroke. Connect grid squares in one unbroken line to build attacks, defenses, and spells, then slay your enemies. Deeper levels bring more complex fields and a new map every run. Draw the perfect path.

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 9.5 – The Hood
description: Season 9.5 of Marvel Rivals introduces The Hood, a new Vanguard who combines dual pistols with dark magic. After stealing an enchanted cloak from the Vault, Parker Robbins rises from New York’s criminal underground in pursuit of greater power, channeling demonic forces as his path leads him into the conflict unfolding in Thebes.

title: Scary Baboon: Bosses Update
description: Scary Baboon is a co-op VR game where teams explore together and create unpredictable moments. Its Bosses Update adds Meatman, a new cooperative boss challenge designed for groups to coordinate, prepare, and fight as a team, with new weapons, explosives, shields, and a boss tech tree to help you take him down.

title: Metroid Prime Origins
description:
A fully complete adaptation of Metroid Prime for the Game Cube in 2D, complimented by a fake-bit aesthetic. This has been lovely to work on, and I had a lovely team of fellow fans by my side this entire time.

This game was made with no generative AI. All sprites and music were created by fans, and all of the in-game lore has been re-written; based on the original NTSC lore.

title: Japan Stigmatized Property 3
description: Can you survive until dawn? Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly. Miss too many… and you will fail.

title: Lowmoor Idle RPG: An Adventurer's Chronicle
description: A zero-player idle RPG in the spirit of Progress Quest, told in a Win9x chronicle. Shape a 2,108-skill tree, face 179 illustrated monsters, earn 100 achievements and find tens of thousands of equipment combinations in two adventures. Watch it run or close the window.

title: Reanimal: The Prisoner
description: Join The Soldier and The Prisoner on a journey through the war-ravaged streets of this once-familiar place, as they stumble blindly down a rabbit hole that will change their lives forever.

title: Dark of the Depths
description: A first-person deep sea exploration game. Use only a torch to navigate through rusted structures, encountering both dangerous and harmless sea creatures. Uncover the mysteries of the trench, and experience the phobia-inducing atmosphere of the ocean floor.

title: Tide of Tactics
description: Tide of Tactics is a medieval turn-based tactics game. Choose a commander to play, each with their own unique unit and abilities, then go to battle on a grid-based battlefield. Use the terrain to your advantage, place traps on the ground, and build the right units to counter your enemy.

title: Cooking Tycoons: 3 in 1 Bundle - Silver Edition
The Castle of Dr. Hoot
description: Welcome to the mysterious castle of spelling extraordinaire, Dr. Hoot! Explore the classroom, the lab, the library and the...detention dungeon? Put your mind to the test with spelling challenges and logic riddles as you avoid the wrath of the strict, cranky spelling teacher, Dr. Hoot.

title: Kitties Solitaire
description: 340 levels of cozy, cuddly card fun.

title: The Prince's Keeper
description: Play as the newest servant to Prince Railan, who's had all of his previous servants fired. While navigating your position, you'll try to pry down his carefully guarded walls as you challenge him on everything he believes about himself and the world. Just try not to get fired in the process.

title: Château Pluie: The New Cellar Keeper
description: A cozy single-player simulation game. You've inherited an old vineyard, and a cellar of 1,600 wine bottles, each waiting for its place. Sort, organize, and shelve them all as the new cellar keeper. Relax into the rain and music. Unlock new skills, trust your instincts, and bring the cellar to life.

title: Dungeons & Donuts
description: Dungeons & Donuts is a co-op action RPG that combines bullet hell dodging with roguelite dungeon runs for up to four players online, and is also playable solo. Between runs, players sell loot in a village, tend a farm, develop the settlement for materials, and craft donuts that act as consumable power-ups shaping the next run. Dungeon runs feature randomized power-up drops and last roughly 10 to 18 minutes, with Delves providing special ores for gear enhancement. Developed by the two-person team at Sas & Sons Game Studio, the game launched in Steam Early Access in August 2026.

title: Toy Shop: Tidy Up
description: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 1,274 toys in a messy toy shop. Every toy has a category. Every display is yours to design. Arrange the toys freely—no timers, no rules, no constraints. Just enjoy the satisfaction of tidy up the messy toys in your own creative way.

title: Nandao Ni Shi Gal Gaoshou
description: An introverted girl who is bad at games, an artist who struggles with drawing human anatomy, a wealthy young lady who wants to play visual novels for the rest of her life, and a younger sister trying her best to understand what anime is—you will play their protagonist and start a romantic comedy!

title: Prison Escape Simulator 2026
description: Can you dig a secret tunnel before the guards discover your plan?

title: Smelly Bubbles
description:
You are in a pool with friends or random players.
One player can fart and others vote who farted, player who got most votes will be thrown out from the pool. Talk to others with voice chat and solve who really farted.

title: The Forbidden Tomes of Olipos
description: What started as an out-of-town gig quickly turns into the journey of a lifetime for Romina! The young librarian will hunt forbidden tomes, fight powerful foes, and discover ancient mysteries in this classic JRPG adventure. What truth awaits at the end of it all?

title: Mini Soccer Manager
description: A compact 2D soccer management game that combines squad development, tactical decisions, club progression, and fast live match simulations.

title: Prison Gambit
description: A 4-12 player online social party game about betrayal, cooperation and trust. No teams, only alliances. No traitors, only betrayals. Only one walks free.

title: WildTrax & Hypercar Bundle
description: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!

title: Grizzy & the Lemmings: Crazy Party
description: Turn your living room into a chaotic playground! 50 mini-games, 1-4 players on the couch, one goal: grab the Yummy before your friends, while Grizzy does everything to ruin it.

title: Task Force Ranger: Breakpoint
description: Lead Bravo Team Into Modern Combat Operations

title: Tailbreak
description: Dinosaurs return in this on-rails action shooter with a feral twist!

title: Hearse Hero
description: Inspired by classics such as Crazy Taxi and Simpsons Road Rage. You are Heinrich, the enigmatic Hearse Hero. Hit your targets and hurtle them to the hereafter while dodging police, pedestrians and more. 20 action-packed levels, plus a custom map editor with Steam Workshop support.

title: The Dare
description: A horror experience where a simple dare leads you into an abandoned construction site hiding something far darker. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and survive using stealth as every sound and decision shapes your fate.

title: Crownborne
description: A fully English-voiced action-romance visual novel. Pulled from the modern world into a kingdom at war, wield an ancient power, romance four heroines, and steer branching battles where every choice you make reshapes alliances, fights, and which ending you reach.

title: Anomalogenos
description: A fishing shooter game where you reel in targets to shoot while dodging enemy bullets! Build diverse strategies using active skills deployable during battle and passive skills that constantly activate!

title: Expeditions: Samurai
description: The sun rises on another civil war, as you land in Japan aboard a battered Dutch ship. Thrust into command of its motley crew, you must navigate the politics of Sengoku-era Japan using stealth, diplomacy, or violence in this party-based RPG where every choice matters.

title: Lucky Shot
description: The flick-shot roguelite FPS. Sharpen your aim, master different weapons, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

title: Grain Rot
description: Grain Rot is a horror co-op extraction builder set in a scorched wasteland where everything burns. Descend with your friends into shifting ruins, rip out furniture, and scavenge for loot before the Corrupted close in. Make it back alive, then rebuild the Outpost to better your chances for the next run.

title: Chop Chop Inc.
description: Build your own furniture empire after getting fired from Furnox Corp . Chop down trees, process wood, automate your growing production lines and sell clever furniture sets for bonus cash. Explore a handcrafted world packed with weirdos, secrets and trees begging for violence.

title: Miseria
description: Miseria is a dark fantasy–themed idle incremental game in which you lead a party of damned souls through the depths of the world.

title: Red the Cook
description: Help Red the Cook chase his dream - quit his dull job and open the best restaurant in town! Balance time and resources, serve delicious dishes to every kind of customer - fluffy or not. Chop, fry, mix, and hustle your way through busy shifts in this cozy cooking simulator with a pinch of humor.

title: Tiana's Fishing Diary
description: This is a pixel art idle desktop fishing game.Catch fish, place them in your aquarium, and let them generate gold for you.Each fish has unique skills—mix and match to maximize your income.Upgrade, customize, unlock new areas, and collect all kinds of fish!

title: Keep It Contained
description: You’re part of a scientific team in a sealed facility, racing against time to keep dangerous anomalies contained. One scientist handles the modules, while others guide them using manuals and procedures. This local co-op experience requires two or more players.

title: Gemblades
description: A roguelite deckbuilder where you draft a deck of heroes called Gemblades and create satisfying synergies between them to save the world from the forces of Onyxion.

title: Worship Demon
description: Worship Demon is a 2D survivor game blending anime art and immortal cultivation. Choose one of the Four Great Demonic Sects, cultivate powers, hunt lost treasures and spells, defeat foes, and forge your unique immortal journey with hundreds of skill-item combinations.

title: Hocus Focus
description: A cozy gamified focus tool to help you work, study, or relax to soothing tunes. Customize your space and summon your focus with productivity tools. You’re a student in a magic university - control time and weather, unlock new locations, collect cute Mitzkins, and level up in-game and in real life!

title: Super Shout Showdown
description: Write your own incantations and cast spells through your microphone! Battle in duels, team fights, or chaotic free-for-all matches with 25+ unique spells to learn, combo, and master.

title: Clappy Cheeks: Lust and Magic
description: Clappy Cheeks: Lust and Magic is an erotic game where you jump to fly and xxx. You will hear the clap clap voices of them cheeks as you play. Let's fly deep into myserious castle of vampire queen!

title: SCP: ReEnter
description: SCP: ReEnter is a free, asymmetrical multiplayer FPS set during a massive containment breach. Players are randomly assigned to Humans or SCPs. Fight to secure the facility, escape, or slaughter everyone with seven playable anomalies.

title: Kings Origin
description: A roguelite dungeon-building tower defense. Build your domain on a tactical board, place rooms and units, and survive relentless waves to rise as the Dungeon Lord.

title: We, Junk Artists
description: A "collage-and-guess" multiplayer game for up to 6 players. Enjoy collaging ordinary items into outside-the-box "masterpieces," guess each other's creations, and unleash your wild imagination around the campfire. Here, everyone is an artist!

title: Fire State
description: Experience hyper-realistic visuals and fluid controls from an unprecedented Bodycam perspective. The world's first shooter with truly playable 3DGS environments. Every pulse-pounding firefight and precise tactical move is captured by your chest-mounted camera for unmatched battlefield immersion.

title: Shirohebi and the Tower of Mercy
description: In this roguelite RPG, Nemesis climbs the Tower of Mercy and discovers its secrets. He can meet and team up with other characters, and learn their reasons for climbing the tower. However, he needs to be cautious as he continues, since an entity is taking his strength away.

title: Together in Forgotten Lands
description: Two souls, one destiny. Embark on a co-op adventure through a forgotten land, where teamwork and wit are the only way to navigate the wonders and dangers of a magical cave.

title: Acrodrift: FPV Drone Simulator
description: A high-speed FPV drone simulator that challenges your skills with precision flying, time attack races, and freestyle exploration. Customize your drone, tune flight dynamics, and master the art of acro flying across immersive environments.

title: No Need for Flowers
description: Dodge through colorful bullet patterns as you shoot down hoards of enemies in this arcade-style scrolling shooter bullet hell about magic dragon girls! Uncover a tragic story about acceptance as you overcome intense challenges that test both your skills and memory.

title: Shadow Breakers
description: Play as Ultra, Apola, and Mozez as they battle shadow demons unleashed by the Cursed, a group seeking to restore balance through chaos. With their robot companions, they must split up to stop the demons and thwart the Cursed’s sinister plans.

title: Frozen Ship
description: Frozen Ship is a first-person narrative adventure in the unique blending of survival, build&craft, and economic strategy genres.

title: John Fox
description: John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor. But now his beloved pet, Milo, has been killed. You have to avenge him!

title: Dragonhold
description: Dragonhold is a multiplayer dragon and melee extraction game. Soar through the air or charge into the melee with a growing lineup of dragons and warriors. Compete head-to-horn with other dragon riders from around the world.

title: Platformer Helmet
description: Achaapur is taken hostage by a local gangster Gundam. You are the only hope left. Each helmet has a unique super power. Switch between different helmets to use those powers. Fight against different goons of Gundam. A Platformer game that has fights and platforming action.

title: Herd Dispatch
description:
