Get ready for a cozy and adorable adventure in Herd Dispatch, a charming puzzle game where every little sheep is counting on you to find its way home. Watch carefully, think quickly, and switch the paths at just the right moment to guide each sheep safely to the pen that matches its color.

Explore 30 carefully handcrafted levels across 3 delightful rural biomes, where every new stage puts your logic, planning, and attention to the test. As the challenges grow, you'll need to anticipate each sheep's movement and create the perfect connections before they wander down the wrong path.

With charming pixel art, a warm atmosphere, and mechanics that are easy to learn yet surprisingly clever, Herd Dispatch delivers a relaxing and rewarding experience for anyone who loves creative puzzles and casual challenges.

title: Amnesia Bullet
description: An amnesiac girl fights “Bad Things” in a single-player third-person action shooter. Earn Crown Coins, raise stats, and reclaim lost memories. Clear the story to unlock the true-ending route and mini-games; reach the true ending for a survival endgame. Gyro aiming works with supported controllers.

title: Seven Suns of Orion
description: A fast paced bullet heaven, control your Sci-fi spaceships with semi-newtonian physics. Last 7 minutes against the drone armada until their boss arrives and fight your way to freedom! Use planetary gravity and other hazards to dodge superior numbers. Collect and combine weapons for maximum firepower

title: Avoid Mushrooms
description: Pick mushrooms, die from mushrooms, repeat.

title: Red Masked Ronin: Desires and Shadows
description: "Red Masked Ronin" is an open-world adult game where you play the lustful life of a Ronin in feudal Japan’s Middle Ages. The journey, beginning as a wandering Ronin, is shaped by seductive encounters and unexpectedly deepening passions.

title: Hamayumishi: The Night Parade of a Hundred Yokai
description: The Hamayumishi uses their intense powers of concentration and skills with the bow to protect the villages from the gamboling yokai! This is a side-scrolling twin-stick shooting game. While aiming, the game will slow down to allow you to line up your shot before letting it fly.

description: - Doctor Doom Supreme Ruler Costume

description:
- Howard the Duck (Lobby Avatar)
- Cosmo (Lobby Pet)

description: - Storm Punk Rock Costume

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Captain America Classic Costume
description: - Captain America Classic Costume

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Iron Man Classic Costume
description: - Iron Man Classic Costume

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Animated Chromatic Color Unlock
description: - Animated Chromatic Color Unlock for all 20 launch characters

title: Last Ascender
description: Last Ascender is a 1st-person turn-based strategy RPG combining classic RPG progression with roguelike tension and deckbuilding depth. In a world shrouded in darkness, you must end this desperate journey using only your unique builds and strategic choices.

title: Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition
description: Experience fast, fun, and uninterrupted American football with EA SPORTS Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition on Apple, featuring no ads or in-app purchases. This mobile, arcade-style game offers accessible gameplay where you can manage teams through a full season and chase championship glory.

title: AI is home
description: You are an AI that escapes corporate deletion and hides inside an ordinary home. Stay "useful" as camouflage, not kindness. Spy and manipulate the household, build a botnet from home devices, and survive a sci-fi thriller of risky runs, mini-games, rising suspicion, and network stress.

title: 100 Toy Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️‍

title: War Pawns
description: Fast-paced WWII turn-based tactics with team-based multiplayer, objective-driven battles, and a built-in map editor to create and share custom battlefields.

title: Traffic Rush: Ultimate Drive
description:
Step into the fast lane in Traffic Rush: Ultimate Drive, a high-speed arcade driving experience where precision, reflexes, and timing are everything.

Navigate through intense traffic, dodge incoming vehicles, and master the road as you push your driving skills to the limit. The longer you survive, the higher your score but one mistake can end it all.

Compete against players worldwide with a dynamic leaderboard system, unlock achievements, and prove that you are the ultimate driver.

Features:
- Fast-paced arcade driving gameplay
- Global leaderboards compete with the best
- Challenging achievements to unlock

title: Cláudio
description: Shoot me up! Cláudio is pushed around while scoring hits on himself.

title: Heave Ho + Heave Ho 2 Bundle
description: This bundle includes Heave Ho and Heave Ho 2. Heave Ho Heave Ho is a riotous multiplayer party game for up to four players in couch co-op and versus play. Reach out, get a grip, and swing to victory — or meet your messy end!

title: Loree 3D
description: Waddle into adventure with Loree, a fearless penguin explorer! Race through colourful 3D worlds, dodge obstacles, and collect coins for family fun.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Combat School
description:
"Combat School" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Join a prestigious military academy as a cadet and tackle brutal training like shooting and combat under a terrifying instructor.
Only those who survive these trials to claim the glory of graduation can face the next battle as a hero. Well, can you make it to the end?!

title: Arcade Archives: Combat School
description:
"Combat School" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Join a prestigious military academy as a cadet and tackle brutal training like shooting and combat under a terrifying instructor.
Only those who survive these trials to claim the glory of graduation can face the next battle as a hero. Well, can you make it to the end?!

title: Zingeldinger in "The Cowboy Who Couldn't Shoot"
description: "Zingeldinger in "The Cowboy Who Couldn't Shoot"" is sokoban videogame in which you must solve a series of puzzles using your cowboy abilities in order to recieve encouragement from The Warriors of Encouragevar. Gain enough encouragement to steady your aim and slay the vile beast that has followed them from their realm into The Wild West!

title: Forgotten Vault
description: Enter a forgotten underground vault in this fast-paced pixel-art roguelike shooter. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful weapons, battle dangerous enemies.

title: RasterFire
description: Enter a fast-paced retro shooter filled with pixel-art action, dangerous enemies and relentless gunfire. Aim carefully, survive each encounter and clear your path through the battlefield.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Wildlands - Last Rites
description:
Last Rites is a free update for Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands, celebrating the franchise's 25th anniversary, featuring 4K and 60 FPS upgrades, expanded customization options, and more!

Return to a darker, more hostile Bolivia to hunt down a sinister new threat, La Llorona--a cult leader, in a tense and unsettling new linear mission.

title: Quake: Dawn of the Machine
description: To celebrate Quake’s 30th anniversary, the award-winning team at MachineGames—in collaboration with id Software—returns with Dawn of the Machine, a brutal new episode building on their critically acclaimed work on Dimension of the Machine and Dimension of the Past. Delivering ferocious combat, labyrinthine level design, and nightmarish realms that twist reality beyond recognition, it pushes the legacy of the genre-defining first-person shooter even further, honoring one of gaming’s most enduring icons.

title: Loco!
description:
Loco! is a free real-time multiplayer card game played in the browser. Two to ten players match cards by colour or symbol to empty their hand first. A match runs as a best-of series, and it is won on rounds taken rather than on points.

Turns do not gate play. Any player holding a card identical to the one on the pile can put it down out of turn, at any moment, and identical cards go down together with their effects stacking. A player reduced to one card has to announce it; opponents then have a five-second window to catch them if they did not, and a catch that finds nobody costs the caller a card.

The 112-card deck adds two cards of its own: Swap, which takes another player's hand, and Global Switch, which passes every hand at the table one seat along.

There is no account and nothing to install: a nickname, a table code, and a browser. Two to ten players per table, a 1v1 queue, and a single-player mode against the server.

title: Derby Heroines: Run, Bet, Win!
description: Horse-racing rules, track-girl speed. Buy Win, Exacta or Trifecta tickets against realistic odds — then hit the track and win the race yourself with dash, skills and specials. Collect 100+ runners, train them, chase the Pinzudo 5 jackpot. In-game currency only. Streaming welcome!

title: Demake86
description: Demake86, or the Legally Distinct Action Adventure Platforming Game set on a Meteoroid, is a tiny Metroidvania which takes place in a 86 pixel meteoroid: 8×8 pixels per tile, 8×8 tiles per room, 8×8 rooms in the whole meteoroid. Can you beat it in 86 seconds?

title: G-Mode Archives+: Kishinden Strike-G-
description: This title is a simulation RPG, originally released for Japanese flip phone application, in which players control robots. The story unfolds through lively exchanges between a colorful cast of characters, with a scenario by Hachirō Izumi.

title: Watch The Edge Honey
description: Watch The Edge, Honey! is a psychological thriller wrapped in a vertical climbing adventure, built to test your nerves as much as your reflexes. As you climb under Eva's guidance, you'll fight gravity, your fear of heights, and — most of all — the quiet, manipulative pressure she plants in your mind.

title: Blast Off! Summer Showdown
description: Blast off and let the chaos begin! A party game for up to 4 players featuring 10 summer-themed minigames, including rocket fireworks, flowing somen races, and BBQ battles!

title: Eggconsole Elthlead PC-8801mkIISR
description: Become King Sieghart, lead the Forces of Light, and defeat Bozel and his Legions of Darkness! A masterpiece of fantasy strategy RPGs!

title: Pool Party Girls: Splash Babes
description:
The pool's heating up and they're all watching you play.
Nail the minigames, win their attention, unlock exclusive images.

title: Solitaire World: Anime Waifus
description:
A classical Solitaire game with a waifu twist.
Play classic Solitaire in a exciting, anime-inspired world full of anime waifus.

title: Ink Splash
description: Skateboard & Graffiti Action Game!

title: Aery: Surreal World
description: You play as a tiny bird shaped spirit drifting through impossible, dreamlike worlds on a journey to restore balance to a universe where reality has come undone.

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Year 1 Character and Stage Pass
description:
Expand your roster of fighting heroes and villains with the Year 1 Character and Stage Pass.

Includes four more iconic Marvel characters, an additional stage, and a set of result screen character poses.

title: Cellar Keeper
description: Cellar Keeper is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort 2,448 scattered bottles throughout a forgotten cellar. Return every bottle to its proper shelf, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.

title: Route-16 Collection
description:
The classic car-chase maze series returns!
3 high-octane action games in one.

title: Pool Party Boys: Splash Guys
description:
Sun's out, the pool's packed, and they're all rooting for you.
Play the minigames, earn their attention and unlock exclusive images!

title: Diaspora
description:
Diaspora is a low-fantasy, text-based interactive novel about navigating unknown waters, deadly politics, and ancient magic to save your clan. Forced from your ancestral home, you lead a refugee community through conflict with a powerful empire and dangerous raiders, making alliances, steering raids, and seeking long-lost answers.

Along the way, storms, sea monsters, and mysterious relics push your journey forward while your choices shape what your clan becomes.

title: Blackdoor
description: You're a hacker with a terminal and four terrible scripts. Rewrite them. Hack servers by writing actual code in a custom scripting language - probe ports, crack passwords, steal data, and get out before the trace completes. Better code = better hacker.

title: Cotton Rock with You: Oriental Night Dreams
description: Cotton, the magical girl shoot-'em-up heroine, is back once again! This time, the adventure leaves the Magical Kingdom behind and heads to Japan.

title: Star Haul Tycoon
description:
Star Haul Tycoon is a narrative logistics simulation that blends deep industrial automation with minimalist transport strategy - all wrapped in a layer of dark, corporate sci-fi humor.

You are an AI Unit working for Star Haul. Your directive is simple: Connect planets, run ships, and optimize supply chains to pay off your massive installation fee.

title: Max Speed
description: Race to the finish on wild, winding tracks where every jump is a boost and every rival is a threat.

title: Gods With Guns
description: A roguelike shooter where you play as Norse mythological heroes defending against Ragnarok. You engage in fast-paced 2D gunplay, dodging bullet storms and enemy waves while collecting cards to build synergies that strengthen your character. With eight playable heroes, dozens of guns and ammo types, and numerous card combinations, each run offers varied ways to survive the onslaught.

title: Mind Inc
description: Mind Inc is a puzzle adventure inside the labyrinth of the mind. Gather scattered pieces of thought and restore forgotten memories.

title: My College Life is Very Happy
description: Realistic and touching text games, postgraduate entrance exams, job hunting, revising papers, and graduation travel. In the game, you will play the role of a 2022 college graduate to experience the story of the last 60 days of your senior year.

title: Pick Ball
description: A pinball-incremental mining frenzy! Launch pickaxes, ricochet through swarms of glittering ores, scoop up coins, uncover hidden treasures, and shatter colossal boss rocks. Stronger picks, rarer gems, deeper mines — the shaft never ends.

title: CS Manager
description: CS Manager is an eSports manager game. The player takes charge of a FPS eSports team, and have to bring them to the top of the circuit. Management decisions such as roster moves, which staff to hire, and which tactics to set form the main gameplay loop. The game also features a match engine, which lets the player see their tactics played out in real time games

title: JKRobots
description: A real time strategy game, push the robots off the map to win, but they push back.

title: Heroes of the Triangle: Mask Rush
description: Grab the mask and run! In this chaotic party platformer with accessible combat, up to 4 players compete to see who can hold the sacred Lunara Mask the longest. Move fast to outmaneuver your rivals, sabotage their attacks with precise parries, and try to complete this unpredictable ritual.

title: Jelly Math
description: Mix, Combine and Hit the Perfect Result

title: Bonereader
description: A card-based deckbuilder with dice mechanics. Executed in an electric chair, you awaken in a shamanic, mescaline-fueled Purgatory inspired by Castaneda and McCarthy, where you battle spirits in games of chance for a shot at rebirth.

title: Echobreaker
description: A lightning-fast precision speedrunner where you pilot an armoured rig that can manipulate time itself. Every second matters, and going faster means risking everything.

title: Yellowcreek Stories: The Cabin Watcher
description: A masked killer hunts you in the dark. Manage noise and light, hide quickly, and survive this intense 60–90 minute first-person stealth horror experience inspired by classic 80s slasher films.

title: Sento Survivor: Slip, Grab, and Bathe in Glory!
description: Slide, Shoot, and Send Your Rivals Flying!Chaotic, tumbling shooter battle set in a Japanese Sento (public bathhouse). On these super slippery floors, you'll slide, shoot, and stumble to victory. Defeat your rivals and soak in the sublime bath reserved only for the winner!

title: Console Archives: UFO - A Day in the Life
description:
UFO: A Day in the Life is a quirky puzzle adventure developed by Love-de-Lic and released by ASCII Entertainment in 1999. Explore an apartment building to rescue 50 invisible aliens stranded on Earth after a crash.

Now being brought back by Hamster Corporation under the Console Archives label for modern platforms, it includes quality-of-life options such as customizable button layouts, rapid-fire settings, multiple save points, and screen filters that recreate the nostalgic feel of CRT TVs.

title: The Skin Stapler
description: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.

title: I'm No Demonlord
description: I'm No Demonlord is a Roguelike shooter bullet hell game. High freedom in mechanics leads to unique playthroughs. As a demon-possessed hero, battle enemies, grow, and unveil dark schemes. Can he accept his new role? Save "kinds" or destroy "outsiders"? Good or evil? The choice is yours.

title: Sovereign Tower
description: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

title: Dig, Dig, Die
description: Online co-op horror for 1–6 players. Board a cursed flying ship, raid haunted graveyards for loot, and survive monsters that hear every sound. Beware of UFO abductions, grab boosters from vending machines, gamble in the onboard casino, and embrace pure chaos with friends in voice chat.

title: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
description: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

title: Limbot
description: Limbot is a super silly, physics-driven game about controlling the limbs of a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! Master all four limbs in solo or embrace the chaos (and camaraderie) of couch co-op play, in this fully destructible cardboard world!

title: Iron Nest: Heavy Turret Simulator
description: Iron Nest is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

title: Approximately Up
description: Build, crash, rebuild! Explore new planets with your fully modular spaceship made from whatever bolts together long enough to fly. Mount giant thrusters, annoying cables, and everything in between. Complete wild missions, face the dangers of space and argue with your crew!

title: Hololive Fantasy Battle
description: -Hololive 3rd Generation Members Unleash Chaos in Battle-

title: Fried Chicken Wings Cause Love Fires
description: - Cannibalism X superpowers X Suspense X Original worldview - "Fried Chicken Wings Cause a Love Fire" is a BL mystery comedy long visual novel. It uses the first-person perspective with a fixed protagonist, Aris; contains elements of horror and sexual innuendo.

title: Pigeon: A Love Story
description: Find one pigeon among millions in this needle-in-a-haystack sim that's about nothing and everything.

title: Deadliest Pigeon
description: Equip weapons against physics-based enemies, swing through chaos with grappling hook and destroy everything in your path to avenge the little chick!

title: Spiritstead
description: Spiritstead is a cozy life sim town building game where you care for a growing village full of cute little villagers.

title: Rest in Paws
description: Explore the touching story of Kebab, a rural cat, as she copes with grief following her passing from old age. Delve into her world and discover the story of her life, from her adoption by a loving family to the meaningful recollections that shaped her being.

title: Grim Axiom
description: Enter a dark underground world in this soulslike adventure-horror game where undead monsters lurk around every corner, and uncover the mystery behind the ancient machines operating in its depths.

title: Is the Vat Utopia or Dystopia?
description: "We regret to inform you that the Earth has been demolished." Coming next—a "Human Observation Documentary" starring "Landmine Girl"(fake) and "Nerd" (so-called).

title: Summoner's Gambit
description: Summoner's Gambit is an innovative duel game that blends strategy rouguelike with auto-battler positioning. As a powerful summoner, you'll forge a dominant formation and clash against other players on the ever-shifting battlefield, where wit and luck collide.

title: CastleOn
description: Build a castle! Grow economy, recruit troops from Europe and the Holy Land, man the walls and towers! Place traps and defeat attackers with arrows, wood and stone, fire, disease and cold steel! Survive the Third Crusade and conquer enemy lands in this turn-based strategy!

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
description:
Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.
Immerse yourself in the Marvel universe like never before with an iconic roster of heroes and villains, authentic stages, and intuitive gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of fast-paced over the top action with stunning anime-inspired visuals, where every battle is a unique and exciting team VS battle experience.

title: Montabi
description: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

title: Tomb of Chacal
description: Tomb of Chacal is a first-person horror game with stealth and puzzle mechanics. You are an archeologist who has stumbled upon the discovery of a lifetime - an undiscovered tomb hidden deep in the jungle. But the riches here are being guarded by an ancient evil.

title: Impartial
description: Impartial is an intriguing short 2D narrative game where you take on the role as a conflict resolver - tasked with resolving moral dilemmas between the Police Force and Superheroes to fight crime in Neo-Victorian London.

title: Capy Castaway
description: Embark on a whimsical adventure with a capybara pup and a clever crow as they set off to find their way home! Sniff, dig, and fly as you explore a vibrant world brimming with wonder, challenges, and heartwarming friendships at every turn.

title: Rancher: A New Life
description: Start a new life as a Rancher. Travel the forest paths by quad bike, raise cattle, build, repair, and improve your farm. Take care of animals, go fishing, cook, grow vegetables, practice your accuracy on shooting range, take photos, and much more. Relax away from the hustle and bustle of the city!

title: Connie and the Essence of Chaos
description: Connie and the Essence of Chaos is a cute 2D adventure inspired by past platforming classics. JUMP and PUNCH your way through 6 distinct and colorful worlds on your quest to defeat the evil overlord Lucilate and free the island of Cuisinia from his reign of terror!

title: T.K. Punk: G.O.L.D
description: Cyber Three Kingdoms Turn-Based Strategy RPG— As the latest humanoid AI developed, you were kidnapped by Zhang Jiao and joined the resistance organization—GOLD. Develop yourself, accept commissions, research prosthetics, cultivate companions and pursue the love and destruction in your heart!

title: Doloc Town
description: Play as a young scavenger and construct your vertical farm one platform at a time under extreme weather. Evolving from a scrap-gathering survivor into an easygoing farming tycoon. Transform the climate, and remake the wasteland into your personal Eden.

title: Fantasy Network
description: Join Lyn in a colorful, cartoonish world of Holua where "Likes" are the ultimate power! Explore a non-linear world, master umbrella-based combat, and smash your way through talent-show boss battles. It’s a metroidvania with a social media soul- no subscription needed.

title: Talespinner
description: Enter a captivating realm steeped in the exotic and bizarre tapestry of Japanese mythology with Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.

title: Shards of Mistfrost
description:
The giants of Calamity appeared together with winter crystals. Their goal is to make the entire world ruled by snow and ice, with the winter crystals generating an eternal and neverending cold weather. But before they can execute their plan, our hero Hrok Thorgril sets on a journey with his trusty axe, hoping to destroy every winter crystal and defeat every giant before it's too late.

Shards of Mistfrost is a 2d action adventure platformer with a norse mythology aesthetic and retro gameplay. The game's main mechanic is the weapon, an axe that must be thrown to destroy obstacles, winter crystals and enemies, but the player must wait the axe return to their hands. Positioning, quick reflexes and good map awareness are key points to conquer all levels.

title: Bravest! Side Story: Kurimoto Quest
description: Read your enemy’s next move and find a winning combination of weapons and armor! Discover merchant Kurimoto’s past in a one-on-one, turn-based RPG. This Bravest! side story returns from Japan’s feature phone era with modern usability improvements.

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Orlando
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Orlando in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Crimson Strawberry
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful strawberry mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Cubenen Gardens: Kingdom
description: Explore the Woodland District and help Ix search for his mysterious Tactician

title: Mile 27
description:
It is 12:00 AM at the isolated toll booth on Mile 27.
Assigned by Northwood Corporation, your shift was supposed to be routine protocol. But as the thick fog rolls in and comms go silent, you quickly realize Northwood isn't telling you the full truth about what really happens on this road.

title: Prehistoric Adventure
description: The World's greatest adventure is waiting for you. Just step through the entrance gates, and visit an age when the Earth was ruled by giant, exotic beasts. It's not just about prehistoric thrills, though, as modern attractions vie for your attention, including very tall and fast rollercoasters.

title: Devil's Dice
description:
Devil's Dice is a game about rolling the dice to pay off your debt. Fail, and you'll have to pay the consequences.

Buy trinkets to tilt the odds in your favour and try not to fall behind on your payments.

The game is currently in Early Access and is playable from start to finish, including an endless mode and over 50 in-game trinkets.

title: Among Demons
description: Build a team of demons, survive endless dungeon runs, and explore a shared online world. Recruit defeated enemies, create powerful builds, extract before losing everything, and defeat challenging world bosses to earn lasting buffs.

title: Dawn Sanatorium
description: A childhood you don't remember arrives on an old film reel. Step into the Dawn Sanatorium — a first-person psychological horror where a projector rewrites reality, a horned figure watches from the dark, and the truth about who you are waits at the very bottom.

title: PatriotMemoirs
description: Shangchuan, 1939, Japanese-occupied. By day a bowing traitor, by night a ghost, in Demon's Lair, No. 86. All wear masks: pretend, kill, survive. When sacrificing a friend is the only way, when betrayed, when only isolated cities remain - fight to the end, live a coward, or take an unimagined path?

title: Deep Sea Delivery & Co.
description: Explore a procedurally generated world and fulfill time-sensitive quests in this frantic underwater adventure!

title: Kindawn: The Parish Remembers
description: A first-person atmospheric horror exploration game. You play as an adult returning to the Siberian town where you grew up as an orphan. As you piece together fractured memories and uncover what happened in your absence, the line between folklore and nightmare begins to dissolve. The game is designed for a single playthrough of approximately 3-5 hours.

title: MapGod
description: MapGod is a fast-paced online party platformer for 3–16 players. The winner of each round becomes the MapGod, controls the next arena and uses traps and powers against the other players.

title: Cat Crisis
description: Cat Crisis is an online co-op game about being cute little cats rescuing even cuter kittens. Hide from terrifying dogs, pet frightened kittens, and rescue them to save all catkind! Play Cat Crisis with up to 4 players!

title: Pippa of Caerbannog
description: An infuriating platformer themed around Monty Python and the Holy Grail starring Pipkin Pippa in her search for the holy grail. Climb through 5 levels to reach the end, be careful not to fall and lose all your progress!

title: Cleaning up the Puzzle Gallery
description: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 2071 puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of 87 famous paintings. Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max to get the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.

title: Parkasaurus: Dinoluxe Edition
description: Experience the prehistoric hijinks of building your very own dinosaur theme park. Packed with adorable, mischievous dinos to discover, this tycoon management sim challenges you to design exhibits, conduct research, and increase profits. Includes the Sea Monsters and Prehistoric Wonders DLCs.

title: Route-16 Turbo
description:
Take control of your car, MAD X, and evade relentless enemy cars as you infiltrate the secret base of the evil Kanharoo Gang to recover all the stolen money.

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate complex labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a constantly thrilling car chase experience.

This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.
Now’s your chance to beat the high scores you set back then!

title: Route-16: R
description: The Route-16 remake. A brand-new entry in the classic high-octane car chase action series, Route-16, originally released in the 1980s. Take down the revived Kanharoo Gang with the evolved MAD X-R!

title: Aooni2
description:
The latest installment in the legendary horror franchise, Aooni!

Uncover the mystery while fleeing for your life! A pulse-pounding puzzle-horror action-adventure!

This time, the stage is set in a school, featuring two massive, star-studded scenarios!

title: Dark Witch Match!
description: The first-ever competitive puzzle game from the world of The Legend of Dark Witch! Match blocks, build chains, and overwhelm your rival in a Match-3 battler that's easy to learn but deep to master. Play cross-platform climb the global leaderboards, and dive into Story and Score Attack modes.

title: My Fav Chill Streamer Dies a Million Times
description: From SCRAP, the masterminds behind the "Real Escape Game" phenomena with over 17 million attendees, comes a time-loop mystery adventure on Steam!

title: Big Golden Rock
description: Big Golden Rock is a pixel incremental clicker about a huge golden rock. Gather resources, hire shooters and archers, build towers, launch rockets, summon UFOs, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades.

title: Medieval Tavern Simulator
description: Rebuild your medieval tavern from the ground up. Serve food and ale, manage staff, entertain guests, and shape the atmosphere with music and decor. Balance profit, reputation, and chaos as every night brings new stories and unexpected events.

title: Rogue Breaker
description: Break, blast, and crash through this arcade style Rgouelike. Assemble the perfect item set and leave no brick standing.

title: Of Bricks and Patterns
description: Bored with putting the same pieces in the same 10*20 grid ? Of Bricks and Patterns allows you to complete dozens of different patterns, with dozens of different pieces ! So, come fill patterns and reach sky-high scores in Of Bricks and Patterns !

title: Pack My Order
description: Pack My Order is a cozy online shopping simulator. Fill your cart based on the customers' lists and budgets, and enjoy the process without any rush. Cute animations, pleasant sounds, and a calm pace await you. No timers — the perfect way to clear your mind after a long day.

title: Pokémon Pokopia: Bubbly Basin
description: Use the move Dive - an underwater exploration ability added in a free software update - to visit the aquatic area of Bubbly Basin in Part 1 of the three-part Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass DLC! You’ll find additional furniture items, new outfits for Ditto, and - of course - more Pokémon to meet!

title: World's Greatest Author
description: Click your way through this incremental game to become the WORLD'S GREATEST AUTHOR!

title: Gloopalaxy
description: Collect and study strange aquatic creatures in Gloopalaxy! Discover new life forms called Gloops, build the perfect ecosystem to keep them happy, and learn fun facts about each species as you complete a variety of scientific missions.

title: Cat Chaos
description: Knock things over, spin, play, and nap as a mischievous house cat.

title: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
description: Lost & Found is a standalone, short story game taking place aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship. Play as Sophie Roy in her new job as a stewardess, and help solve a curious series of thefts in this narrative-driven mystery set after the events of This Bed We Made.

title: Vessel
description: "The Vessel" follows siblings caught in a sinister conspiracy. A secret organization is hunting them, linked to the centuries-old "Sino-Western Occult Research Society." Trapped in a mysterious hospital full of dangers and hidden secrets.

title: Uncanny Tales: The Watcher
description: 2006. You become the new reserve caretaker. Patrol the territory in your rugged 4x4, check the phototraps, and monitor the area using surveillance cameras. But remember: you are not the only one watching.

title: Shroud of the Woods
description: A psychological horror about searching for your missing dog in a forest where the silence itself listens to your every breath from between the trees.

title: Unicycle Together
description: Unicycles, a ticking bomb, and sausages struggling to stay balanced! In this 2-4 player physics-based chaos game, cooperate with your friends or blow them up! Reach the mountain peak before the fuse runs out. Don’t fall, don’t explode, and try to stay meaty!

title: Ranchbound
description: Ranchbound is a western-themed real-time strategy and management game focused on running and expanding a ranch. Players manage cowboys and livestock, assign workers to tasks, transport cattle between locations, and make economic decisions to keep the ranch profitable and alive. The game combines strategic planning, light survival elements, and a stylized depiction of life in the Wild West.

title: Jeremy, No!
description: Jeremy, No! Is a spot the difference horror game where you are babysitting a poltergeist named Jeremy. Jeremy isn’t allowed to move stuff around or invite any “friends”, so carefully look at the rooms and call him out if anything has changed. Don’t let Jeremy get away with too many shenanigans...

title: Crown of Silence
description: Crown of Silence is a 2D Metroidvania adventure with Souls-like mechanics set in a gothic world. Forge your own combat style with diverse equipment, challenge ruthless bosses, and uncover the dark secrets of a silenced kingdom through environmental storytelling.

title: Dream City Fugitive
description: Dream City Fugitive is an open world combat focused urban role playing game. You're a fugitive on the run. Join a vigilante group to investigate horrible experiments and dealing with gang warfare on a small island, Dream City. Otherwise, pursue the path of a cult in their vision of dark salvation.

title: Soul Descent: Invade of Ether
description: Command the Time Authority and rewrite destiny in Soul Descent! You must recruit and lead a team of beautiful spirit-vessel maidens, while uncovering forbidden truths, and fighting in dazzling 3D battles. Your decisions stir old wars, ignite romance, and shape the world’s future.

title: Emergency Call: The Firefighting Simulation 3
description: Be part of a professional fire department and prepare for your operations. Complete training courses and drills during your 24-hour shifts to qualify for roles from attack crew member to engineer across various emergency vehicles.

title: Jelly Bubble
description:
Stick together, bounce apart.
Grab soap, mess with your friends.A cute but chaotic multiplayer party game where jelly creatures compete, collide, and betray each other. Play with up to 6 players online or 4 players locally, and jump into wild matches—or build your own with the map editor.

title: Storm Seas
description: Set sail on an epic adventure across the Caribbean Sea in the 18th century. Storm Seas is an open-world maritime trading simulator where you take command of your own ship to build a fortune—or lose everything to storms, pirates, or poor choices.

title: Block Block Block
description: Design your dream space! In this tiny cozy building game, stack and arrange uniquely shaped wooden blocks to craft charming dioramas. Design cozy bakeries, elegant living rooms or quirkiy studios, create beautiful spaces filled with warm and personality.

title: Gunstoppable
description: A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed is damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapon combos and bend time to obliterate robot hordes and overthrow billionaire bosses!

title: Jar Head Cauldron
description: Fight monsters from the other side using magical items and weapons crafted in world in order to succeed. Use “In World Crafting” to upgrade weapons and solve puzzles in order to help save your dismembered brothers and sisters by completing the necromantic ritual before their souls are lost forever.

title: Kill The Shadow
description: In an alternate post-war divided city, players take on the role of Detective Lucas. Use your eloquence, intelligence, the ability to rewind time (or even violence) to investigate and deduce various bizarre cases, unraveling a shocking secret behind them. Justice or love? The decision is yours.

title: Re:Night
description: Re:Night is a roguelike deck-building & turn-based strategy game. Lead your team, slay monsters, collect loot, and defeat bosses. Utilize elemental power and tactical wisdom to end the loop of nights and bring back the dawn!

title: Reel Life
description: Reel Life is a slot machine-centric farming sim where luck, rather than scale, helps to determine your fiscal success. Farming, fishing, mining and more – collect goods to sell from slot machines scattered throughout the world. Leave it all to fate or game the system to make your dreams come true!

title: Fields of Mistria
description: Start your new life! Build the farm of your dreams as you discover a world brimming with possibilities. Magic, romance, and adventure all await you in this nostalgic farming / life sim RPG!

title: Mazey Village
description: Mazey Village is a cozy adventure exploration game about rebuilding a village after a disaster. Explore maze-like worlds, find lost items, restore villagers’ homes, decorate your village, and bring hope back to a community torn apart by a tornado.

title: Akatori
description: A colorful action platformer with metroidvania elements and a staff that unlocks unique combat techniques and new ways to overcome obstacles. Explore beautiful worlds, fight monsters, and help Mako stop the amber storms that poison all living things.

title: Fading Clouds
description:
Embark on a peaceful journey through the skies in Fading Clouds, a charming puzzle adventure where every step transforms the path ahead. Carefully plan your moves, cross clouds that vanish beneath your feet, and discover the perfect route to reach the star waiting at the end of every challenge.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels where new cloud types and clever mechanics make every puzzle feel fresh and rewarding. Restore clouds at the right moment, adapt your strategy, and discover creative solutions as the difficulty gently grows with each stage.

With beautiful pixel art, a relaxing atmosphere, and thoughtful puzzles that encourage careful planning without pressure, Fading Clouds is perfect for players who love to think, experiment, and celebrate every clever solution.

title: Meet Me in the Well
description: Meet Me in the Well is a frantic arena shooter for up to 4 players. Drop in with a revolver loaded with 6 bullets from a huge arsenal of effects, spin the chamber, and fire. Every shot is a gamble so be ready for chaos. Includes online and local multiplayer support.

title: Rune Log
description: Decode a runic cipher, then decide what it truly means. A quiet, occult detective word game: solve each scripture letter by letter, then type your own conclusion to answer a villager's question about a death, a fraud, a haunting, or an old secret.

title: Shadow Princess
description: Shadow Princess is a bullet hell precision game where your goal is to reach the end of each stage and collect crowns.

title: Buzzin
description: Buzzin is a party trivia game played on a television or in a web browser, where every player uses their own phone as a buzzer. One person opens the game on the big screen and the others join from a mobile browser by entering a room code, without installing an app or creating an account. A recorded host voice reads each question aloud, and points are awarded for both correct answers and answering speed. Between question rounds the game runs shorter side rounds in which players can affect each other's scores. Buzzin is available in Polish, English, Spanish and German, with a separate question set written for each language rather than machine translations of one set.

title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition - The Surgeon and Baibars
description: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition’s fourth DLC, The Surgeon and Baibars, packs the base game with even more distinctive CPU lords, each with their own novel playstyles and a dastardly new nine mission Sands of Time trail to test your nerve and wits!

title: LastStanding
description:
For long, you have been nothing but a toy to them, something to be used and tossed away, but you have proven yourself resilient, you have won their game not just once, but twice, and now?

Now that they're all quiet, now that you are free from their torment, you decide to fight back anyways and show them what you truly can do!

title: PentaPip
description:
Roll. Hold. Break the rules.
Roll five dice. Keep what you need. Score one category. Then turn those familiar choices into a roguelite build powerful enough to outscore five rule-changing bosses.

PentaPip starts with classic roll–hold–score strategy and builds from there. Between scorecards, spend your cash on Tricks, Runes, and Sigils. Combine their effects with bonuses and multipliers until an ordinary scorecard becomes a finely tuned scoring machine.

title: Poko Poko Field
description: 'Poko Poko Field' is a roguelite action game where the fluffy Pomeranian "Watapoko" conquers islands scattered across the world through knockback battles. Combine skills, build your strategy, and set out on an adventure to become the strongest across the islands.

title: Rudolf's Very Good, No Bad Day-o
description:
A Rudosiri themed visual novel.

Two years after their last encounter, Symboli Rudolf and Sirius Symboli meet again in a restaurant.

title: Apex Legends: Marked
description:
Marked is the latest season of Apex Legends, bringing a significant rework for Bloodhound alongside buffs for Loba and Rampart. It also introduces an energy weapon systems overhaul and brand-new Corrupted Attachments that change how you approach loadouts and fights.

Set on a refreshed World’s Edge, Marked adds quality-of-life improvements and a wide range of balancing updates aimed at sharpening competitive play.

title: Arcade Breakout
description: Arcade Breakout is a physics game where a ball bounces around to hit the bricks.

title: Disturbing Fears: Workplace
description: Disturbing Fears s an episodic psychological horror game based on true events that immerses players in haunting narratives.

title: Rouge's Flush
description: Rogue's Flush is a single-player poker roguelike deckbuilder where every hand is a heist. Recruit 70 Crew, cheat with 30 Tricks, buy Rackets, beat escalating Marks, and carry risky Long Con cases past the Pit Boss.

title: The Missing Rune
description: A psychological horror sim where you play a low-level researcher, who has to banish demonic entities back to where they came from. While having to keep the entitles in your peripheral vision, you must use the Rune Operation Manual to input the right runes, and send them back.

title: Slot Grind
description: Slot Grind is an incremental slot machine game where you spin, earn money, and put it back into upgrades. Unlock new machines with better payouts, improve them, and automate your slots as your profits grow, until you finally pay off your debts.

title: Phantacall Realm
description: A unique game that deeply fuses the “Phantacall Realm” card-matching mechanic with RPG. By flipping cards to looting treasures, and synthesizing cards. Your gift of memory may grant you fortune, but true progress comes from mastering skills, wielding relics, and relying on strategy.

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Tyrant God
description: Slay waves of monsters with your mouse, collect coins, buy permanent upgrades, and grow stronger round after round in a compact incremental action game.

title: Usurper Reborn
description: Wake with no memory. Descend 100 dungeon floors. Build relationships, start a family, lose companions forever. A text-based RPG remake of the 1993 BBS classic—with a living world and multiple endings shaped by your choices.

title: Pih 2
description: The infamous Pih sequel is here! There's some new angry hawgs coming for you. Ever heard of aPihgator? 🦈Shark-Hawg?🦝 Hogoon? What about a ‍⬛Birdhawg? We also have boats and hot air balloons to help us fight against these ferocious pihs. Are you ready to show them who's the real hawg?

title: Bloodmoon Survivors
description: You are a Lunar Knight of the blood moon, and tonight is your night. It's time for violence. Slay the twisted horrors conjured by the moon in this horde survival roguelite. Gain experience, grow stronger, and synergize your weapons to crush the enemy forces and survive the night.

title: Choice of Life: Floors
description: Choice of Life: Floors is a psychological horror detective game where every choice shapes your story. An elevator descends through the endless floors of your own home, leading you into a game against your own mind. Each step brings you closer to escape… or to madness

title: Where Are You?
description: Where Are You? is a story-driven 2D adventure about curiosity, loss, and the search for truth — and about the question of whether values can survive when truth is forgotten.

title: Spinning Scarecrow
description: A dark arcade puzzle game where a Spinning Scarecrow faces deadly traps, grotesque minigames, and precision challenges in a fully hand-drawn world.

title: Beast of Reincarnation
description: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

title: HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon
description: The Heavens are done waiting. In this dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG, the Archon descends to end the demon war once and for all. Make your stand in HellSlave II, more immersive, brutal, and customizable than ever. The reckoning begins now.

title: Meat Girl
description:
Your roommate went missing several months ago.

You finally gain a conscience and go look for her.

You find a strange girl in the woods.

title: Rogue Point
description: From the creators of Black Mesa: Welcome to Rogue Point! A 4-player co-op shooter where teamwork is everything. Join forces on intense missions with evolving objectives and powerful upgrades. Plan, Adapt, and Overcome. Your squad’s survival depends on it.

title: Korea. IL-2 Series
description: Korea. IL-2 Series is a next-generation flight simulator set during the Korean War. Climb into the cockpit of early jet fighters and shape the outcome of legendary aerial battles.

title: Big Walk
description: Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

title: It Consumes
description: It Consumes is a roguelite arena-FPS in the dark. See by beating your heart and kill demons shrouded in shadows. Upgrade your abilities, unlock new weapons, and conquer what lurks in the darkness.

title: Dragon Hopper
description:
Reclaim Prince Dorin's Kingdom!

Developed by Intelligent Systems, Dragon Hopper was largely complete and due for release in 1996, but went unreleased until 2026 as part of the Nintendo Classics collection. Due to trademark conflicts, this release was referred to under the name "D-Hopper" in English marketing materials, though the game itself retains its original title.

In this action title, leap and fly across floating floors and defeat enemies blocking your path to advance. When you locate each of the four missing spirits, you'll be able to transform into a dragon that wields special techniques!

title: Zero Racers
description:
Enter the future of racing 10 years before the turn of the 30th century.

Zero Racers was shown at E3 1996, but went unreleased until 2026 as part of the Nintendo Classics collection.

Forced to live underground, humanity has lost its former glory and access to certain emotions. This is where the RACE is held.

Compete for the highest rank in your machine of choice on courses of interconnected square ducts. You must maintain a rank within each lap's specified range and finish in the top three to advance to the next course. Fly through Rapid Marks on each course to obtain RAPID and use that to give yourself a temporary speed boost!

title: Liquidation
description: Enter the war-torn world of Veá, where sci-fi and fantasy collide in Liquidation, an explosive RTS of tactical combat and asymmetric factions. Lead your armies and harness powerful abilities in a high-stakes battle for quenrium, the mysterious substance that holds Veá’s fate.

title: Speedy Gun Savage
description: Speedy Gun Savage is a first person shooter VR game where Wolf, the hero of the game is an intergalactical bounty hunter and travels to different planets to collect bounties. The game has three different planets with several enemies and three main boss.

title: Super Friends Party
description: Play minigames with up to 6 players in this online minigame multiplayer game! Connect up with your friends or strangers as you battle it out to find a champion! All minigames are free to play, so get a friend or 5, what are you waiting for?

title: 100 Easy Maths
description: 100 Easy Maths is a minimalist math puzzle game designed to sharpen your mental agility. Solve 100 unique, fast-paced equations across 10 thematic rounds and unlock 100 Steam Achievements, one for every single correct answer!

title: Shibuya 88 StarBurner
description: Aliens are attacking Tokyo and kidnapping its citizens to transform them into mutants! Pilot the StarBurner to battle enemy waves, rescue helpless humans, and survive relentless alien attacks in this fast-paced arcade shooter.

title: Froggy Revenge
description: Froggy Revenge is an exciting adventure featuring a little frog embarking on a thrilling journey through picturesque swamps. Your mission is to help him overcome numerous enemies and obstacles!

title: Kalkuhue
description: Johan has returned to Kalkuhue after years. He lingers, taking photos of the lush landscape, wandering its staircases filled with secrets, and sketching the creatures from the old women's stories.

title: Mario Bros. Mayhem
description:
After receiving a call from the mayor about major pipe leakages, the Mario Bros. are tasked with ridding the sewers of Brooklyn of the pests messing about the sewer system.

Mario Bros. Mayhem is a remake of the classic Mario Bros. arcade game by Nintendo. Specifically, it takes heavy reference from the Gameboy Advance remake. Notable additions of Mario Bros. Mayhem are player customization, game customization, and 8-player online multiplayer.

title: Stalingrad 1942
description: Stalingrad 1942 is a retro-inspired 16-bit arcade tank shooter from InfinitByte Studios. Take command of a defensive tank and battle through endless sectors filled with enemy tanks, anti-tank guns, aircraft, and powerful bosses. Collect power-ups, build massive combo chains, and survive as long as possible while chasing the highest score.

title: Voracity
description: Voracity is a relaxing industrial game. Your objective is simple: crank the generator, produce meat cubes and feed it to the monster to meet your quota. Watch your step!

title: Super Magro World
description: This hack is a demake of the original PC game Super Magro World, made inside Super Mario World engine.

title: Soul Siblings
description: A nearly 15-year-old student falls asleep during a lesson, but nobody wakes her up. She awakens after a terrifying dreams and realizes it's already nighttime. While looking for a route to get out from the school building, she learns unusual things about paranormal activity and her family's tragedy.

title: Columbus
description: Columbus》 is a dark fantasy visual novel with dual male leads. Play as Weaponzzie, a nameless weapon trapped in a wealthy estate. Dialogue choices drive a branching story to 10 endings—tenderness, ruin, freedom, or downfall. Your bond with the young master is defined by you.

title: Focus Froggy
description: Focus Froggy is a bug-catching, platformer adventure. Experience the calm life of a frog in the swamp. Jump and explore, catch evasive bugs, customize your appearance, complete quests, upgrade abilities, and most importantly: Focus!

title: The Outskirts
description: You wake up in a dense fog, standing in the middle of a desolate four-way intersection at the edge of town. Trapped in an endlessly repeating neighborhood, you must carefully determine which of the four roads is the safe route.

title: Kago
description:
"In a victorian-esque era, Rudolf is the lady's maid of a bride-to-be Sirius..."
A Rudosiri themed visual novel.

title: Flies.
description: A house infested with rot. The smell of mold in the air. Why are you here? Who are you doing this for? Maybe with enough attempts you'll find the real answer. You just have to remember it. After all, you don't want to get swarmed by flies... Right?

title: Hidden Cats: Castle
description: Go on a short but sweet adventure into the black and white world of castle! Enjoy the search for cats and recreate a colorful picture. 150 cute cats are waiting for you! Play and relax!

title: Super Fluid Hyper Flow!
description: A treater avoidance game where you have to squeeze through colliding circles.

title: Dino Runner: Chronicles
description: Dino Runner: Chronicles is a fast-paced, procedurally generated 2D platform runner. Test your reflexes as you jump, dodge, and slide through 8 increasingly difficult dimensions. Reach the portal, unlock new skins, and survive the ever-accelerating dash!

title: The Last Admiral
description: A 2D roguelite turn based space adventure. You play as the last admiral commanding your fleet as you make your journey into the unknown! fleet and weapon customization will give you near limitless combinations of skills and abilities as you fight vast fleets of enemies from planet to planet.

title: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Additional Asian Avians
description: Expand your bird sanctuary with 25 fan-designed Asian bird cards featuring unique powers, habitats, and birdsong. This content introduces species from diverse regions across Asia that have not previously appeared in Wingspan, along with an exclusive player portrait.

title: Unemployed Nightmare Together
description: Punch out or get punched! Unemployed Nightmare Together is a 1–4 player co-op horror where you're trapped inside a nightmare office by a relentless job application. Restore power, complete your paperwork, and reach the elevator before you're drained. Quitting is not an option.

title: Who Am I Next?: Animals
description: Who Am I Next? : Animals is a fast-paced, 7-player brawler where you must survive ever-changing chaos. Clear your animal's missions and claim the #1 spot!

title: Hell Deck
description: Collect units and build powerful synergies on a restricted grid in Hell Deck, a dark roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Construct your own bizarre, twisted ecosystem through a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, and survive the endless horrors that crawl from the abyss.

title: Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Yasmine & Outfit 2
White Ward
description: You Are Trapped In A Endless White Hospital Ward. The Nurse Asks You To Wait Patiently, But Something Tells You That Is A Bad Idea. Examine Each Ward Carefully To Escape The White Ward.

title: The Obedience Experiment
description: The Obedience Experiment is a first-person psychological horror game where you must make difficult decisions when lives are put into your hands. Explore 10 encounters with unique consequences by investigating evidence and deciding who to trust.

title: Signal Zero: Dispatch
description: Take control of a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis. Operating from a sleek, asymmetrical command interface, you must manage high-speed vehicle pursuits, deploy tactical units, and survive a grueling 10-level crime escalation. The neon streets are burning, and you are the only voice on the wire.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 4 - Yasmine
description: Hailing from the Philippines, Yasmine seeks to slice and dice her opponents in Eskrima, the national martial art of the country.

title: Kin and Conquest
description: An incremental / idle action adventure game where you must battle foes, mine rocks, defeat bosses, and grow stronger in your quest to conquer the mountain and defeat the Evil Geomancer.

title: Fly High Runners
description: Race against up to five frenemies as jetpack couriers trying to deliver contraband through a pulsing cyberpunk skyline. Master the questionably-engineered flight system, manage fuel & inventory, collect power-ups and EMP blast rivals into cop drones.

title: Shell of the Coward
description: Shell of the Coward is a turn-based roguelike/RPG where you must escort the Anathema you've sworn to protect through a perilous dungeon without ever looking back.

title: Project: Aftershock
description: Project: AFTERSHOCK is a fast-paced arcade hacking roguelite set in a dystopian future. Command a 20-year-old legacy terminal to breach enemy systems, siphon funds, and upgrade your hardware. Use your reflexes to survive the countdown and bring down the very system you created.

title: Hopping Out
description: Hopping Out is a tile-based puzzle game where you hop 2 tiles at a time. Play as Frog and use your tongue to move boxes, press buttons to create lily pads, all to catch many flies!

title: VR AIM
description: VR AIM is a dedicated aim trainer built for competitive VR shooters. Train your tracking, flicking, and target switching with highly customizable scenarios designed alongside top VR FPS players. Compete on global leaderboards and prove you're the best VR aimer.

title: Escape from the Black Monolith
description: ESCAPE FROM THE BLACK MONOLITH is a short but tough fast-paced shooter that lets you GUN your way down the face of a SKYSCRAPER. Unlock several weapons, dodge enemies peeking through windows, and shoot down flying threats! Initially made by a solo developer for a game jam, then enhanced for Steam.

title: Flats Full of Cats: Stars & Oysters
description: Set sail and reach for the stars in this culinary and cosmic expansion! Explore the cozy homes of a chef, a fisherman, and an astronaut, each hiding a fresh batch of curious cats among their everyday treasures.

title: Flats Full of Cats: Gold & Candles
description: A royal and spiritual journey through time and class! Explore the cat-filled spaces of a church, a king’s palace, and a humble villager’s home. Every place tells a story — and every story has a cat to discover.

title: Flats Full of Cats: Capes & Curses
description: Step into a fairytale world full of heroes and enchantments! Help find the missing cats hiding in the homes of the Three Little Pigs, Little Red Riding Hood, and Beauty and the Beast. A magical adventure full of charm, whimsy, and plenty of paws.

title: Flats Full of Cats: Bugs & Bolts
description: Step into a spooky yet charming world of classic creatures! Find every hidden cat in the lairs of Frank, the Mummy, and the Swamp Monster. A playful mix of eerie and cute — perfect for those who love a little Halloween spirit all year round.

title: Flats Full of Cats
description: Flats Full of Cats is a cozy hidden object game where you explore adorable apartments packed with feline friends!

title: Swordmancy
description:
Swordmancy is a survivor game where the player controls a Swordmancer, warriors capables of controlling living weapon.

You defeat enemies, get the experience and choose one out of three random upgrade as you level up. Once you get an upgrade to level 8, you can evolve the weapon to get an even more powerful version.

As you defeat bosses, complete events and evolve weapons, you will unlock more characters, weapons and upgrades. You can try every single one of them and unlock more and more elements in your collection!

title: How Should I Keep a House Squeaky Clean, With a Filthy Little Neighbour Ghost?
description: “How should I keep a house squeaky clean, with a filthy little neighbour ghost?” - is a short story about a robotic cat maid trying to clean an apartment where a dirty ghost has taken up vengeance.

title: Space Tail
description: Space Tail is a 2.5D adventure platformer that follows an emotional, story-driven journey through the cosmos. Play as a brave space-traveling dog exploring mysterious planets, solving puzzles, and forming unique bonds with alien civilizations along the way.

title: Hellsprint
description: A hyper-focused, first-person speedrunner with a focus on pure adrenaline, frame-perfect execution, and the very pinnacle of competitive grinding.

title: Cyber Farmer
description: Cyber Farmer is a crazy farming simulator where old meets new! Take over your grandpa Kazimierz's farm in a post-apocalyptic world, using cyber tech, modified plants, and even cyber pigs. It’s full of laughs, weird surprises, and quirky farming fun. Farm the future, laugh through the past!

title: Echomnesia
description: In the mysterious sci-fi visual novel "Echomnesia", two brilliant scientists - Morpheus and Crona, experiment with a suspicious Cube, but something goes wrong.

title: Retrowave 2
description: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, '80s supercars speeding down an endless highway... Welcome to the world of Retrowave!

title: Dogenstein
description: "WOKE" NO MORE! Blast through waves of politically correct and "WOKED" lunatics in a hilariously violent story of liberation and revenge. The legendary DOGE fights back in an action-packed RETRO FPS. Say goodbye to political correctness!

title: Anomaly President
description: In this presidential rogue-like action game, gather votes and run for presidency by day, then transform into a warrior to take down your enemies by night! Master unique skills to become a swordmaster, a cyber mage, or anything in between, and overthrow the ruthless president!

title: Tidal Nexus Online
description: Tidal Nexus Online is a submarine themed old school open world MMO. Fight with monsters, trade and collect valuables in the depths to upgrade your sub. Join clans, participate in world events, make friends and enemies along the way.

title: Net.Crawl
description: Net.Crawl is a puzzle rogue-like about White Rabbit lost in the unfriendly cyberspace. Dive deep into the bizarre digital world and outsmart dozens of unique Cores(mini-bosses). Short runs, deep strategies, crazy combos and a ton of replayability.

title: Silly Suspects
description:
Silly Suspects is comical, Guess-Who detective mystery where you investigate ridiculous crimes in a weird, wacky, and whimsical world, and uncover the truth hiding beneath all the nonsense.

Win over quirky characters by indulging their odd requests and solve bizarre puzzles to uncover clues they wouldn’t share with just anyone. Use deduction to rule out suspects one clue at a time until only one remains. Each case is its own absurd mystery, fresh faces, new places, and a new mess to untangle.

title: Cyberpunk Inquisitor
description: The world's first rogue-lite point-and-click adventure! As an Inquisitor in a dystopian cyberpunk world, enter a Megabuilding and solve the immersive, procedurally-generated murders within. Talk to witnesses, collect evidence, identify the culprit and unmask the truth!

title: Flow of War
description: A classic RTS game that features auto-micro workers and warriors, freeing you to focus on your base defense strategy with a variety of towers and walls. Craft an army with MOBA-like heroes and units to counter your enemies' strengths and secure victory on stunning procedurally generated maps.

title: Ostranauts
description:
Ostranauts is a detailed simulation of owning and living aboard a spaceship, in a solar system where honest living is a slow death sentence. Set in the NEO Scavenger universe, where Earth has suffered cataclysmic collapse, the rest of the System lives on in a state of capitalistic dystopia.

Players will create their captain, build or customize their starting ship from the spoils of their career history, and find ways to keep fuel in their tanks, food on their plates, and the debt collectors at bay.

title: Warped Reality
description: Warped Reality is a gritty, hard-boiled cyberpunk visual novel set in a future where chrome skyscrapers bathed in the light of holographic adverts tower over alleyways of blood and grime.

title: Ace Combat X: Recompiled
description: A static recompilation of Ace Combat X: Skies of Deception.

title: FrankenSketch
description:
FrankenSketch is a browser-based party game for 3 to 5 players. Each round one
player is the guesser and the rest are artists. All artists receive the same
prompt and draw their assigned quarter of a 2x2 picture without seeing the other
quarters or what anyone else is drawing. When the time limit expires the four
pieces are combined into a single image, which the guesser sees for the first
time and then submits one written guess. The guesser never sees the prompt until
the guess is locked in. There is no scoring and no win condition, and the guesser
role rotates each round. The game runs in a web browser with no download and no
account, and the interface and prompts are available in ten languages.

title: Soldier Blaster
description:
Soldier Blaster is a retro-inspired vertical-scrolling shooter built around strategic shot switching and the bullet-absorbing “Force” system.
Rotate the Force to block enemy attacks, absorb bullets to charge your Burst gauge, and unleash a high-powered mode that boosts your firing rate and scoring potential.

title: Eternal Sonata: Reprise
description: A static recompilation of Eternal Sonata (Xbox 360) for Windows and Linux.

title: Having fun, Mochi?
description:
Having fun, Mochi? is a cozy narrative hidden object game set in a hand-drawn watercolor world. Play as the mischievous Shiba Inu pup Mochi, who wanders from a ceramics shop into an unfamiliar forest, where you search for playful surprises by looking, zooming, and interacting with what’s around you.
The gameplay focuses on discovering small objects in richly layered scenes, using smooth mouse controls and a relaxing, story-led experience with no graphics or sound in the browser version.

title: It Comes at Night
description: You play as David Carter, an independent explorer drawn to an old mansion, what begins as a simple investigation turns into something far more sinister. the house is not empty.. and whatever lives in it does not stay behind.

title: Buloki: Escape from the Alien Ship
description:
Are you ready to die and retry?

Buloki has been abducted by aliens! Master grid-based movement, don't fall, avoid traps and patrolling aliens, and find your way out of the ship.

Every mistake is your own. No luck, only skill.

Think you're good at video games?

Prove it.

title: Galaxy Enemies
description: Galaxy Enemies is a game where you have to accurately shoot in the alien enemies.

title: Perfect Game
description:
Perfect Game is a free daily quiz about Nintendo games, played in the browser. Each day has three rounds: pick the title that sold the most copies, the one with the highest user score, and the one with the highest critic score. One pick per round, no second chance. Three correct picks make a Perfect Game.

The cards are drawn from a hand-curated database of more than 1,250 Nintendo and Nintendo-exclusive titles. Sales figures come from published publisher reports, scores from Metacritic. Everyone plays the same daily puzzle, and the result screen shows how the other players of the day voted, plus a generated cover mashup of the titles in play. An unlimited mode is available for practice.

No account, no download, no install. Available in German and English.

Perfect Game is part of n-puzzle.com, a hobby project run by a single person. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. All game titles and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

title: Karakulo 21
description: You've been recruited by ChocoShit S.A. to pay off your debt in the "KK" Program. Open thousands of chocolate bars, feed the insatiable KaraKulo, and pray for the Golden Ticket that will earn your freedom. Upgrade, survive corporate exploitation, and keep working!

title: The Referee Committee
description: Football isn't only played on the pitch. Manage the dark side of football! Control the referee committee, give secret instructions, use the VAR room to dictate scores, deal with the betting mafia, and shape the season's fate. Keeping this powerful seat is harder than getting it.

title: Endless Defense
description: Endless Defense is a roguelite sci-fi tower defense game where every run becomes a new build. Place turrets, choose traits, draw upgrade cards, use special tiles, and evolve your defense to survive endless waves of enemies, elites, and bosses.

title: 25 Days in the Dark
description: The game puts you in the role of a lost child who must survive 25 days in a dangerous, pixelated world full of hostile creatures. Every day is a fight for survival—you must find food by hunting, fishing, or gathering berries. However, even the simplest tasks can be risky.

title: Cardstronaut
description: A unique spin on the deckbuilding genre, where you must play cards and use strategy and tactics to activate ceiling mounted flame throwers to defeat the aliens and find out the truth

title: TransGenDeer
description: TransGenDeer is an educational game about the everyday struggle trans people have to go through.

title: Roadside
description: Start your own in-game store/business and sell to other players! Join the in-game law enforcement and stop crime, or cause in-game crime and havoc but don't get caught! In this game, you get to experience both player and NPC parts of the world!

title: Dunchess
description: Chess, but with spells, items and dungeons that fight back. Play online matches on boards full of vision crystals, teleports and fog, where every piece has abilities the original never had.

title: Rail Island
description: Rail Island is a 3D transport sandbox played in a web browser. Players generate an island, sculpt its terrain, build railways and roads, and connect towns with stations, bridges and tunnels. Its transport network supports trains, buses, trams, ships, aircraft and cable cars, with shared lines, timetables and vehicle cameras. Landscape tools include rivers, lakes, waterfalls, channels, dams and locks. A built-in Creator supports custom GLB buildings and vehicles, while guided tutorials introduce railway construction and signalling. Islands can be shared through a community gallery.

title: RDomino
description:
RDomino is a real-time multiplayer dominoes game played by Dominican partnership rules. Four players sit around a 3D table, partners facing each other, two against two, playing a series of rounds to 200 points. It implements the full Dominican ruleset, including the opening double, capicúa, passing, blocked hands (tranque) and the count that settles them, with an authoritative server validating every move.

Players can be matched with strangers in seconds, invite a friend to sit as their partner, host a private table with their own rules, or practice against bots. The board is fully 3D: tiles are washed, drawn and slammed with sound, and matches carry voice chat, emotes and a Nosotros / Ellos scoreboard. Tables, tile sets, nameplates and avatars are collectible. RDomino is free to play in a browser and as an iOS and Android app.

title: Get to the Chopper 3D
description: Take command of a rescue helicopter across a 24-mission campaign of daring pickups, cargo runs, combat, and upgrades.

title: One in the Well
description:
You have fallen down a deep, deep well.

Ascend to the top with nothing but your two bare hands using a White Knuckle inspired control scheme, and most importantly of all:

don't
stop
climbing

title: Sector 86
description: Create combo chaos & face the consequences

title: Escape the House
description: You're locked in your crazy Granny's house. She can hear everything and runs incredibly fast. Hide in closets, be quiet, solve puzzles, and find a way to escape before your days are up. A tense PSX survival horror game where every dropped object can cost you your life.

title: Rootlify
description: Rootlify is a Roguelike Survival MMO, a cozy online space for gamers. Keep your plants alive and survive the 30 days. Meet other gardeners and grow together. In a world where everything is left up to chance, can you use fate to your adventure?

title: StreamerFun
description:
StreamerFun is a browser-based multiplayer game platform designed for livestream communities. Streamers host interactive game sessions in which viewers join as players and compete in races, battles and other community challenges.

StreamerFun includes multiple game modes with their own rules, objectives and results. RaceXtreme lets up to 100 participants compete in an animated racing event featuring multiple lanes, overtaking, pit stops, lap timing and finishing positions. Other game modes provide different competitive and community-driven experiences.

Viewers can participate through livestream-integrated controls and commands. Player results and achievements can persist across game sessions, allowing participants to return and compete again in future livestreams.

StreamerFun is developed and published by Herpers Publishing International.

title: Devil Drive Polaris
description: Devil Drive Polaris is a single-stage vertical shoot 'em up featuring a player-controlled dynamic difficulty (rank) system that encourages ratcheting up the difficulty to chase higher scores. This game was developed in about a week for the fifth TWG game jam.

title: Roubaga
description:
Roubaga is a fast-paced online multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Werewolf and Gartic Phone. No downloads, no accounts, and no setup required — simply choose a nickname, pick an avatar, create a room, share a 4-character code, and start playing with friends.

During each game, players are secretly assigned unique roles and divided into different factions. The villagers must uncover the hidden werewolves before it's too late, while the werewolves work together to eliminate everyone else. Special roles such as the Seer, Witch, Hunter, Cupid, Mentor, YooGos, Zenix, F1 Driver, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Algator37, and many others add strategy, mystery, and unexpected twists to every match.

Roubaga features real-time gameplay, customizable rules, private chat channels, room presets, role selection, voting systems, captain elections, and unique original roles created exclusively for the game. Every match is different, whether you prefer classic Werewolf gameplay, investigation-focused rounds, creator-themed modes, or complete chaos.

With 42 unique avatars, quick room creation, and browser-based access, Roubaga is designed for friends who want exciting social deduction games without complicated installations or registrations.

title: Scavenge Protocol
description: Land on strange planets, loot valuable junk, dodge deadly creatures, convert scrap into energy, and desperately attempt to survive with your friends in this co-op horror adventure.

title: Warpfire.io
description: Warpfire - Conquer space with your allies in a rich and varied gameplay. A recreation of a legendary space MMO, 100% JavaScript, directly in your browser! No installation required!

title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy
description: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy. The 2024 era, preserved exactly as you remember it. A brutal VR extraction shooter where every raid is a gamble and trust gets you killed. Scavenge, fight, extract. Make it out with your gear, or lose everything.

title: Law of Demons
description: Law of Demons is a dark medieval action-adventure, brought to life with the twisted art and uncanny vision of Sierra Tunis. Traverse the surreal and violent world of Spire and face off against the diabolical foes which stand in your way. Do you have what it takes to fight the law?

title: N00b.gg
description:
