n00b.gg is a free browser-based daily puzzle game about identifying video games from screenshots. Each day at midnight, a new heavily pixelated screenshot from a video game is presented. Players have six attempts to name the game; each incorrect guess reduces the pixelation, making the image progressively clearer. Points are awarded based on how early the correct answer is given.

The game features daily streaks, experience points and levels, over 40 achievements, weekly community challenges, daily medals for the fastest correct answers, and a cosmetic shop with banners, frames, titles and name styles that are earned exclusively through play. Completed days can be replayed from an archive. The game can be played as a guest without registration; an optional passwordless account (one-time e-mail code) stores progress across devices. Real-time community statistics show how many players have solved the current puzzle.

title: Hiderman
description: Hiderman is a first--person psychological horror game about collecting mushrooms in a dark, ever-changing forest while a mysterious creature watches from the trees. Use your flashlight to expose the creature, follow the signs, and survive through multiple escalating horror phases. Features randomized vegetation and mushroom placement, two endings, and an average playtime of 25-45 minutes.

title: Reawait
description: After falling into a mysterious cave, your survival depends on your reflexes. REAWAIT is an intense underground puzzle-adventure where you must navigate a maze of shifting obstacles. Avoid deadly traps, unlock game-changing abilities, and discover what lies buried beneath the surface.

title: Fleet Conquest
description:
Fleet Conquest is a space-themed strategy game: build your fleet, grow your supply network, and fight back against the enemies of Super Earth who are trying to take over the galaxy!

This is a fan-made game based in the universe of Helldivers 2 and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Arrowhead Game Studios AB or Sony Interactive Entertainment. HELLDIVERS is a trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC. All game content and assets are property of their respective owners.

title: MegaManX6Recomp
description: MegaManX6Recomp is a native PC port.

title: CyberDeck: The Cyberpunk Roguelike Deckbuilder
description:
A Fast Cyberpunk Deckbuilder Where Every Run Plays Differently
CyberDeck is a roguelike deckbuilder about making sharp decisions under pressure. Choose your route, draft new cards, install powerful chrome, adapt to random enemies, and build a deck that can survive the city.

Every run starts a new puzzle. The map, rewards, enemies, and upgrade paths change each time you play.

title: Autumn's Leaves
description: Become an adventurer in Autumn's Leaves, a retro-inspired browser-based MMORPG. Collect equipment, discover spells, get married, become a mayor, or become a pirate.

title: Kara
description: Kara is a visual novel following an ordinary high schooler whose life slowly spirals into a nightmare. Sleep deprivation, a tragic chain of events, and dark secrets will force you to question reality itself.

title: Lordress
description: Rhiannon was born into honor — and cast into chains. Some are born to wear a crown. Others must take it.

title: Monster Ops 21
description: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

title: Ore & Odds
description:
Ore & Odds is an incremental game about extracting minerals and watching numbers spiral out of control. Every mineral you collect can be spent on upgrades or bet on the slot machine.

Your luck matters! Combine minerals and increase your chances of winning. Sometimes you win big. Sometimes… not so much.

title: Kurohi
description:
Explore interconnected areas, uncover hidden secrets, and unlock powerful abilities as you fight your way through deranged bosses and discover a mysterious world filled with danger, lore, and unexpected twists.

Kurohi combines tight platforming, overhead exploration, and arcade-style space shooter gameplay, creating a dynamic adventure that shifts between multiple styles of play. This represents an era of passion for retro gaming, pixel art, and authentic handheld development.

title: 100 Undersea Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

title: Résop Paz Yandere True
description: Cute horror choice game with a lot of varied gameplay, from bloody battles to platforms. Come break the fourth wall that separates us! Choices that have real impacts, charming characters, a blend of retro and realistic video games. Come meet Résop and Paz.

title: Frebbventure Alliance
description: That's right, the cat came back, and this time, with more. More what? More friends, more enemies, more action, more levels, more bosses, more story. More everything! Frebbventure Alliance takes the formula for a game that prided itself on being jam-packed no-frills action platforming madness, and does it even harder!

title: HackHub: Ultimate Hacker Simulator
description: Unravel cyber secrets and foil mass surveillance as a skilled hacker in Hackhub. Challenge authority, rewrite the rules, and emerge as the ultimate digital rebel.

title: Droned
description: Droned is a small, passion project that brings friends together for some good old fashion action. In that spirit, get your friends online and hop straight in some top-down combat.

title: Avoidvania
description: AvoidVania is a 2D game Top-down Runner / Metroidvania taking place in a medieval-fantastic universe.

title: Hamventure
description:
Hamventure is a platformer featuring creative puzzles and engaging challenges. Guide a small pig through 40 levels, overcoming traps such as spikes, saws, and arrows that react to your movements.
Each level introduces new situations that will make you think before taking your first jump.

title: On the Way Home: Strange Incidents
description: A novel adventure where two high school girls encounter the supernatural on their pixelated way home.

title: Electronic Woodfish
description: A casual companion that lives on your Windows desktop. Strike the woodfish to earn Merit, collect skins, open chests, complete collections and crafting, and play online with up to 3 Steam friends.

title: Puzzle Cottage
description: A cozy cottage of 16 hand-crafted logic puzzles, fresh every day — solved by pure deduction, never luck. Then pull up a second chair for six hot-seat games, or walk down to the shore and build a harbour town one floor at a time. Daily streaks, a world that grows as you play, 28 languages.

title: Qtz
description: A rhythm game where you hit the notes as they reach the sweetspot

title: Welcome to Victorville
description: You wake in a strange facility alongside your work partner Victor Adams with no memory of how you arrived. Using arrow keys to navigate a branching narrative, you decide whether to trust Victor or forge your own escape. Your choices shape the story across multiple paths, revealing dark secrets and twisted turns. Hunt for every ending, though only one truly matters.

title: Gospodar's Tales
description: Gospodar's Tales is a Romanian folk horror game set in 2009. Explore a rural village, uncover a dark story of greed, guilt, and betrayal, and face the consequences of a past that refuses to stay buried.

title: Retrobot: 2085
description: Retrobot: 2085 is a fast, frantic twin-stick arcade shooter with endless robot hordes, survivor rescues, high-score chasing, extra lives, and chaotic 4-player local multiplayer.

title: Termo99
description: A free online word-battle game in Portuguese for 2–99 players. Create a room, invite friends, discover your word, charge Ink, and build your strategy during every match. Play Classic for a pure word battle, or use Skills mode to choose a kit and assemble a different build each game.

title: Cat or Potat
description: Okay, big guy. So you saw a cat and thought you are a cat-pro? Let's see how you address a simple question - what is it that you see? Is it a cat, or is it a potato?

title: 3place
description: 3place is a collaborative, three-dimensional and real-time voxel canvas layered over a 3D global map, where anyone can paint and create artwork together.

title: Manga Club Advisor wants to support Saeki Sasara
description: One day, a student in your class blurts out, "I want to make manga!" As her homeroom teacher, you decide to create a club with her and carefully guide Saeki-san in achieving her dream.

title: Laundromat 8
description: Spot the anomaly. Choose STOP or RESUME. You are trapped in an endlessly repeating laundromat where even the smallest change matters. Study the room, make the right calls, finish your laundry, and find your way home.

title: Board Poker
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build a board, not just a hand. Drop cards onto the grid and score poker hands across every row, column, and diagonal at once. Stack rule-breaking augments, chain explosive combos, and rake in the gold.

title: Lighthouse
description: Lighthouse is an unofficial, community-made native PC port for Banjo-Kazooie developed by Harbour Masters.

title: You Must Remember
description: A dark past stops Patient 11 from retaining memories, leaving him hostile and lost in time. Dive deep into his mind through hypnosis to help him recover the truth. Every attempt is completely different. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Flip
description: A fast-paced memory game where every mistake costs time. Learn the board, build streaks, beat unique bosses, and clear 50 handcrafted levels before the clock runs out.

title: Papa
description: Years after escaping your childhood home, you return to visit your dying father one last time. As strange events unfold, memories of the past begin to blur with reality.

title: Mega Snake: 16-Bit Edition
description:
Relive the golden age of arcade gaming with Mega Snake: 16-Bit Edition, a retro-inspired arcade snake game featuring vibrant 16-bit visuals, responsive controls, and classic high-score gameplay.

Guide your snake through an endless grid, collect pellets to grow longer, avoid walls, obstacles, and your own tail, and survive as the speed steadily increases. Whether playing with a keyboard, gamepad, or touch controls, every run is a new challenge to beat your best score.

Designed for modern PCs and Xbox, the game supports offline play and delivers a pure arcade experience with no ads or microtransactions.

title: Project Glitch
description: The result of a 6-month student project. A dangerous oil called Glitch is corrupting humans into mindless robots. Fight your way to the mountain's peak and destroy the source of the corruption.

title: Keypad Simulator
description: Try to guess a randomly generated 4-digit code on a keypad. It resets each day or when someone guesses it correctly. You only have one try each day. If you guess right, you earn a point.

title: Task Bar of Ragnalis
description: Your taskbar turns into a battlefield! *Task Bar of Ragnalis* is an idle auto-RPG for PC. Heroes fight, collect treasure, and level up on their own. Combine equipment, form a trio, and find weapons with random abilities. Just let it run and get hooked!

title: Hell O’ Halo
description: "Lost your halo? Report to Hell!" Demoted from a cushy Heaven desk job to field duty in Hell, your fight for clock-out times and benefits begins! Build custom decks with opinionated office supplies, smash demon skulls, and loot your halo back. Welcome to Hell—no mercy, no overtime pay!

title: Unload
description: UNLOAD is an interception-focused top-down shooter where ammo is life. Intercept lethal projectiles to reload and survive by a thread. As a Visitor who lost everything in an explosion, hunt down those tied to the incident and uncover the truth behind that day.

title: Lockey
description: Seal your enemies with the power of a mystical key. Wield your key as a weapon to build Seal Power. Seal enemies, absorb their power, and unleash devastating Engraving abilities. Fight through the Lock Kingdom, defeat the mighty Lock King.

title: A.D.D. (Anomaly Detection Department)
description: A.D.D is a management simulation game where you run operations for a company investigating the Backrooms. Connect nodes, build workflows, dispatch employees, and deliver the results the company demands.

title: On & Off
description: On & Off is a turn-based strategy game where you manipulate pieces on a grid to trigger explosive chain reactions. Toggle pieces ON to attack, defend, and heal. Read the enemy's telegraphed intents, unleash powerful skills, and master the board to survive!

title: El Restaurante de Sam
description: You're a former employee of El Restaurante de Sam, you've returned to find out what happened to your colleagues, your goal is to find them...

title: Helen Keller Simulator
description: Explore a world without your eyes and ears to guide you. Uncover the secrets this world has to offer, hoard all the items you can find or get lost trying.

title: Angry Raccoon
description: One Masked Bandit!

title: Horror Cliche
description: The rules of horror are meant to be broken...

title: Tibby and the Lost and Found
description: Help Tibby and Truffle find lost stories and bring joy back to Cobblewick!

title: Dating Stories 2
description: Dating Stories 2 blends the addictive satisfaction of solving jigsaw puzzles with the spicy thrill of seducing the most alluring women you can imagine.

title: Primal Axis
description: Codex-driven creature collector in Aethel-Hearth — explore, fight, gather, craft, breed, and fill the ledger.

title: Golden Balloon
description: A native and browser source port of the Diddy Kong Racing.

title: Dear Magical Girls
description: Dear Magical Girls is a story-driven defense game about an overworked magical girl protecting the Mana Stone that keeps the city running. Move the vertices to reshape your magical field. Unlock modules and enchants, and build your own strategy to survive against waves of monsters.

title: Mootation
description: Mootation blends minigames, humor, and incremental systems where you need to optimize production to become the best Space Farmer in the galaxy!

title: CypherWars
description: CypherWars is a cyberpunk-themed, Drug Wars-inspired, buy-low, sell-high arbitrage simulator roguelite set in the Maxx Cypher universe. Travel from node to node, buying and selling digital contraband for maximum profit, pay off your debt to the Syndicate, and try to maintain the highest net worth possible before your runner session runs out of cycles. But, watch out! Warden Stryker is always on the hunt for runners who strike it big in the grid and is ruthless when he catches you!

title: The Unfamiliars
description: The Unfamiliars is a first person atmospheric horror experience presented through a VHS camcorder perspective. Players explore a small isolated mobile home while documenting strange and unsettling events unfolding outside during a rainy night.

title: FPV PVP
description: A competitive FPV drone shooter. Pilot an agile quadcopter with an RC transmitter, gamepad, or mouse and keyboard, and fight other players across 5v5 Bomb Defusal, Team Deathmatch, and 1v1 Ranked Duels. Two flight models, ranked ladders with global leaderboards, and a buy-menu economy.

title: Poker: Texas & Omaha Hold'em - Premium Edition
The Two Body Problem
description: The Two Body Problem is a physics-driven puzzle game where two robots must literally carry, throw, and reposition each other to survive. The catch: you, alone, control both robots. The world demands cooperation, but there's no one to cooperate with except yourself.

title: WordHive
description: Build words, score points, and master the hive.

title: Alarm112: Fire Unit
description: Command fire rescue operations under pressure. Receive emergency calls, dispatch units and make critical decisions in a realistic emergency response strategy simulation.

title: Batman: Caped Crusader - Chronicles
description: One hard-fought truth Batman has revealed over the years, Gotham City's darkest crimes won't solve themselves. In this cooperative party game for 1 to 4 players, you and your crew will step into the noir-drenched Gotham City of Batman: Caped Crusader the animated series, where every alley hides a secret and every case leads deeper into the shadowy depths of the city's criminal underworld.

title: Pot's On!
description: Got your soul completely crushed by a crazy witch and turned into a kitchen 'pot'! An inventory auto-battler where you beat up suspiciously pretty monster girls and boil them in your pot. Cram items into a tight space and experience the thrill of erasing cooldowns with a downpour of MSG!

title: Ocean Shark Survival: Float Home Builder Simulator
description: Build, craft, and fight to stay alive every day.

title: Bee With Gun
description: This construction bee will make never seen defenses.

title: Crooked
description: Crooked is a noir roguelite strategy game where rock-paper-scissors becomes a tense underground contest of bluffing, reading opponents and taking risks. Study your rivals, bend the rules when the moment is right, manage suspicion and climb through shady venues where every decision can turn the room against you.

title: Koi Frenzy
description: A fast-paced arcade game where every second counts. Catch koi fish, build combos, beat your high score, and compete against players worldwide in one-minute runs that are easy to learn but hard to master.

title: Into the End (Of the World)
description: Drive, maintain, and survive. Explore procedural biomes in a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge for parts, and fight infected zones with friends. Build your survival machine from the chassis up and keep it running - because without it, you wont get far.

title: Bound to Defend
description:
Bound to Defend is an endless wave defense game that combines roguelite progression with persistent loot. Level up, draft new skills each run, and experiment with different builds while surviving increasingly difficult waves. Earn gear that permanently carry across runs, allowing you to upgrade, merge, and strengthen your character over time.

Combat blends automatic attacks with manually activated abilities, runs can be saved and resumed at any time, and a live cross-platform monthly Top 100 leaderboard lets players compete for the highest score.

title: Metal Detector Island
description: A cozy first-person metal-detecting adventure where you explore an island, follow signals, dig up buried chests, sell or collect your finds, upgrade your gear and unlock new areas in search of rarer treasures.

title: Meatballs
description: A fast, juicy bullet-hell roguelike where you're lunch fighting back. Pick from 11 meatballs, blast through 10 levels of waves and 5 outrageous bosses, and build a god-tier meatball from 30 weapons & 55 items — without stacking so much you literally fall apart.

title: Don’t Pull Me!
description: Dont Pull Me is a physics-based co-op parkour game for 1 to 4 players. Tied together by a rope, you and your friends must climb, swing, carry objects, and survive chaotic ragdoll disasters without dragging the whole team down.

title: Xtreme Traffic Racing
description: Outrun the traffic. Outlast the chaos.

title: The Stone Ship
description: In The Stone Ship, paintings, maps, and photographs expand into living scenes, revealing hidden paths that lead back in time to the origins of an ancient megalithic monument. It is a single‑player, first‑person mystery‑exploration game featuring puzzle elements and navigation challenges.

title: Dungeons & Dummies
description: Descend alone or drag up to 7 friends into a deep, ever-changing dungeon that does not care about your feelings. Chase loot, quests, and power while insisting “one more floor” is a great idea. Greed is encouraged. Survival is optional.

title: Froggle
description:
Froggle is a weirdly empowering, delightfully breakable (F)roguelite dungeon crawler!

Live. Die. Ribbit. Inspired by Slay the Spire, Balatro, and Inscryption - if you like any of these, you'll probably like Froggle

Rich, unique, tactical turn-based combat. Basic initially; progressively awesomer.

title: Seeding The Wasteland
description:
Feeling like doing some gardening? Head to the planet Tau to relax with this narrative-driven plant management game!

You'll play as a small robot named Orchid, tasked with cultivating various plants to bring the planet back to life!

You'll have your ship, charging stations, and your trusty tools at your disposal. Aboard the Internode, your shuttle, you'll navigate across a desolate land to reach Demeter, a mysterious robotic entity.

title: Retro Puzzles: Eviva L'arte
description: A museum inspired jigsaw journey: 225 masterpieces, 45 artists, 9 regions, and three difficulty tiers up to 4160 pieces, plus fact based artist bios and artwork notes.

title: Rocket Man X
description: In this third-person platformer shooter, fight your way through enemies and platform your way through levels. Unlock new armor by finding the hidden boxes, and earn new weapons by beating the bosses.

title: Rising Moonshade
description: Rising Moonshade is a turn-based strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Lead your squad through ever-changing missions—gather resources, forge equipment, and build tactical playstyles. Under the dual pressure of survival and combat, you must ultimately withstand the Demon King's invasion.

title: Flocked and Loaded
description: Raise your herd. Arm them for war. Survive the wild! Guide your flock through dangerous environments, battling escalating waves of predators. Extract your surviving animals to your ranch to unlock powerful guardians, expand your roster, and prepare for even deadlier runs.

title: Shapemonger
description: Shapemonger is a colorful arcadey incremental game about destroying shapes - in outer space! - getting money and buying upgrades

title: Planetary Field Team
description: Play as the team's operator in this Roguelike Auto-Battler RPG. Build your team to effectively fight against hostiles on an alien planet.

title: Litterbox League
description: Welcome to the Litterbox League! Compete with cute animals in this chaotic multiplayer brawler. Shove them all out, be the last one standing, and claim all the fame and glory!

title: Defrag Incremental
description: A retro incremental where you optimize messy disks, choose the right algorithm, manage heat and wear, make a living from each job, and reboot for permanent BIOS upgrades.

title: Soulmine
description: Explore an abandoned mine, escape two entities working together and find a way out. Use your flashlight, search the tunnels and survive the dangers lurking in the depths.

title: Spacebolt
description: What am I? Where am I? Who am I? Spacebolt is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game where you control a spark of electricity. Traverse walls and ceilings, travel through circuits, and awaken dormant machines as each discovery brings you closer to the truth.

title: Knockout Battle
description:
Knockout Battle is a chaotic and fun multiplayer party game where up to 8 players clash in fully interactive sandbox arenas. The objective is simple yet endlessly entertaining: knock your friends out and hurl them into the void to secure victory!
Unleash absolute mayhem with an arsenal of wacky weapons and gadgets. Throw TNT across the map, blast fireworks and rockets into your rivals, or smash them with Thor’s hammer. Pull out blasters, revolvers, and all sorts of outrageous guns, or go full sci-fi and deflect attacks with a lightsaber.

Potions add another layer of madness, letting you grow huge, shrink tiny, run faster, or hit harder — flipping the fight in unexpected ways.

Every map is a sandbox of destruction, packed with hazards, traps, and interactive elements you can turn against your opponents. From launching rivals sky-high to chaining explosions together, no two matches ever play the same.

Whether you’re dodging rockets, spamming explosives, or laughing as your friends fall into the void, Knockout Battle guarantees non-stop action, hilarious moments, and pure chaos. And of course… expect a ridiculous amount of explosions and rockets.

title: Ryou-ude ga Oreta no de H na Osewa wo Sareru Hanashi
description:
To save his landlord daughter who was about to be run over by a truck, the protagonist makes a dangerous dash!
…As a result, he ends up getting both his arms run over and suffers a fracture that requires several months to heal.

His parents are away on a long-term business trip overseas. Going back to his family home won't help,so she has decided to take care of him for the time being...!

title: Medieval Market Simulator
description: A cozy first person medieval fantasy shop simulation where you stock shelves, set prices, and haggle with adventurers by day. Master a living economy with shifting market prices. At night, visit the tavern to gamble or seek tarot readings that shape the fate of tomorrow.

title: Appalachian Onslaught
description: Build, upgrade and defend against an endless onslaught of cryptids being sent to destroy your tribe by the great Appalachian nightmare himself... the Rketari.

title: Corsair Cove
description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

title: Paw Patrol: Dino World
description: Join the PAW Patrol and Rex on colossal missions across Dino Island. Create roar-some looks, play minigames with friends and more.

title: Elders K.O.
description:
Welcome to Elders K.O., the elderly fighting party game nobody asked for… but everyone secretly needed!

A first-person online multiplayer game where up to 8 elders (or rather, the players controlling them) exchange punches, laughs, magical items, and a worrying amount of digital osteoporosis.

Run, jump, push, dodge, steal, explode, and punch other old folks with boxing gloves.
Yes. Everything is allowed here.
Fast fun, instant chaos, guaranteed laughter.

title: Lurruna: The Island of Towering Automatons
description: It's the GRAVITY-BOUND BOMBER!!! LURRUNA is an homage to CLASSICVANIA gameplay. Pelt bombs, beat baddies and cross chasms in a mysterious island adventure.

title: Orbital Crash
description: Fight other players in this fast-paced arena! Grapple across dynamic maps with shifting gravitational forces, blasting foes into black holes or the cold void of space. Master a diverse arsenal and dominate the competition with skill and cunning.

title: Micro Rush
description: A Seconds-Long Speedrunning game about short levels and fast gameplay. The average level only takes a couple seconds to finish, so you can replay and hone your skills to earn higher medal ranks.

title: Phantom Smog
description: In a future suffocated by VX-Nebel, the megacorporation NOVA ATMOS controls every breath of the city. You are Kael, the only one immune to the gas — and therefore, the only real threat. Track and eliminate the leaders behind the conspiracy

title: Joker on the Spring
description: Joker On The Spring - “ Fall. Learn. Jump again ” . Joker on the Spring is a precision platformer where you control a joker with a spring for legs. Instead of walking, you bounce and ricochet, turning every move into a chaotic mix of humor and frustration.

title: The Rebellion
description: Fuel a people’s uprising through fast turn-based tactical battles and hard choices; lead your heroes, stretch scarce resources, heed the crowd’s needs, plan each move with care, break the tyrant’s grip, and let hope rise again!

title: HyperCycle League
description: Cut the line. Own the neon. Hypercycle League is a high-octane evolution of light-trail combat where milliseconds are the difference between glory and a data-crash. No RNG, no gimmicks—just pure, frame-perfect digital athleticism. Are you fast enough to leave a mark?"

title: Get Out!
description: Ever felt trapped in a nightmare? Get Out! is here to plunge you into the craziest VR horror experience on PSVR2! Inspired by 80s retro horror, this "popcorn" game is all about survival, thrills, and pure fun. As a wise adventurer once said, "Survive, Survive, Survive. And occasionally, Run!"

title: Drifted
description: DRIFTED is a 3d horror mystery game, as you explore a mansion looking for your missing friend, you will find many secrets within as you uncover the mystery behind their disappearance. Between locked rooms and fighting monsters, who knows what you will uncover!

title: Wonderland
description: Explore a world of swords and sorcery, and build your unique adventurer’s guild!

title: Bingo Betty
description: This ain't your average grandma's bingo! Put your bingo skills to the test in this strategic roguelite spin on the classic game as you collect items, customize cards, create combos, cash in scratch tickets, and take betty to the top! Betty isn't alone, though; Battle and Befriend both demons and angels, each with their own personalities!

title: Jezebel
description: Jezbel is a narrative-driven visual novel set in medieval Rosegate. Play as Duvessa Devereux, a ruthless noblewoman scheming her way to power. With RPG elements and branching paths, your choices shape her fate and the future of the kingdom.

title: Dig Baby Dig Company
description: An online co-op horror game with 1-4 players. Explore and dig through strange alien fields, face hostile creatures, and harvest energy matter... all to satisfy the cruel demands of your master.

title: Deadly Trick
description: Survive the death game unfolding at school under the name "Special Class." You are not given any special role at the beginning. Depending on the situation or your own choices, you could become the White or the Shadow! Cooperate… or betray.

title: Spellcast
description: SPELLCAST combines the strategy and deckbuilding of a card battler with the dynamic gameplay of word games.

title: Cloud Keeper: Shrine of Dal
description: Summon an army of clouds in this auto-battler survivors-like bullet heaven inspired by Korean folklore! Recruit cloud companions, collect relics, befriend shrine visitors, and survive against the monster hordes!

title: Night at the Lake: Silent Watcher
description: A night shift at a remote lake turns into something unsettling. Explore the area, log data, and uncover what lurks in the darkness.

title: System Critical III
description: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for PSVR2. With intense gunplay, gravity-defying jumps, and mind-bending virtual environments, you’ll navigate a futuristic cyber-realm where every battle is a test of skill and reflexes. Experience ruthless boss battles, traverse dynamic landscapes, and master an arsenal of powerful weapons—all in stunning virtual reality.

title: Zero Pixel Dawn
description: Scavenge, craft, and fight to survive in a post-pixel apocalypse. Explore dangerous biomes, wield guns and magic, and uncover a hidden truth buried in chaos. Every choice matters. Will you survive?

title: Waterpark Simulator
description: Build and run your own waterpark. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!

title: Tiny Bomber
description: Tiny Bomber is a 2D vertical scrolling action game blending roguelike elements with bullet-hell dodging. Players control a tiny bomber, navigating procedurally generated levels, avoiding bullets, and bombing enemies. With a countdown system and random upgrades, each run is a thrilling challenge.

title: Fisher Idle
description: Start from scratch in the middle of the ocean as a fisherman! Buy bigger boats, upgrade your ships, and build your fishing empire. Remember: more fish means more gold!

title: Hotel Tales
description: Hotel Tales is a mystery hotel manager set in the crossroads between worlds. Dive into the amazing, frightening and funny stories of guests and colleagues, discover the hotel's secrets and try to survive at least to the end of your probationary period!

title: Ocean Survivors
description: A pirate-themed, minimalistic, survivors-like where you dodge cannonballs, sink enemy ships, expand your arsenal, and loot their wrecks to climb the ranks. Upgrade your ship and become the ultimate pirate!

title: Mr. President
description: Can you face the challenges of the Oval Office? Find out in Mr. President, a sandbox simulation of the U.S. presidency. Pursue your legislative agenda. Compete with rivals Russia and China. Deal with crises from 9/11 to COVID-19; and direct the U.S. military against terror groups and rogue states.

title: Steel Judgment
description: Steel Judgment is an ultra-fast roguelike movement FPS full of wacky combos and weapons that combines the expressive combat of beat-em' ups with the unhinged chaos of a roguelike. Wipe out hordes of enemies with a diverse moveset and arsenal while collecting powerful items with unique effects.

title: Security Simulator: Nightshift
description: A spot-the-difference-horror game; you use a camera system to locate and report disturbances and thieves, but you can't stay in the cameras the whole night. Getting up from your office to patrol is necessary to keep thieves at bay.

title: Titan Force
description: When a failed experiment unleashes a plague of the undead, civilization collapses overnight. Cities fall. Nations burn. And the dead keep coming. Climb into the cockpit. Bring a Titan back online. Turn the end of the world into the beginning of a counterattack. Turn extinction into vengeance.

title: Xialuo: Kill All Flowers
description: Xialuo: Kill All Flowers is an innovative turn based adventure RPG that combines the commonly used "dice elements" and "big map exploration" in board games. In the game, you will gradually uncover various monsters in this dark and mysterious world, achieve your mission.

title: Sephiria
description: Sephiria is a top-down action rogue-lite game with pixel graphics. Go down the tower, meet various animals, and collect various talismans and artifacts to become stronger.

title: Parkside: Decayed Soul Manipulation
description: Parkside is an FPS-Immersive Sim that chronicles the future of biomechanical subterfuge and suffering. Shoot, hack, and either save or sour the future of humanity in the dismally attractive and dystopian city of Abbotsford, California in the awful year of 2038. Will you serve the Divine Rod?

title: AfterWar
description: AfterWar is a simple yet feature-rich strategy game for everyone.

title: Bad Pixels
description:
8-Bit first person shooter set in the old west! Have you ever wondered what a FPS game would look like in 8-bit? It's gotta look bad, right?

Bad Pixels is a gritty, hoodlum-shooting, gristle-chewing, law-avoiding retro style FPS. As Sheriff in this reckless retro environment, you must round up a team of deputies to help you flush out wrong doers, cash-in on wanted contracts and restore the peace.

title: Party Quiz
description: Play a local Quiz game with your friends. Create your own Quiz using the Party Quiz Constructor or use the Steam Workshop to download one of the Quizzes made by the community. Test your knowledge with fun!

title: Quasimorph
description: Take on a role of a hardened PMC fighter in a dark turn-based extraction RPG. Engage in unforgiving combat, manage your ship and pile up the bodies of your clones to unravel the dark mystery behind threat to all life.

title: Occulto
description: Occulto is a non-verbal, entirely hand-drawn point-and-click adventure inspired by Machinarium and its beautiful visual storytelling. Guide Eliot through an atmospheric fairy-tale world where mysteries are solved without a single word.

title: The Relic: First Guardian
description: "Guardian, gather the pieces of the great relic and seal the void of darkness." In this action RPG, you embark on a heroic adventure to save the world in the dark as the last guardian. Start your journey as a guardian, gather pieces of great relic and close the void.

title: A-Spec: First Assault
description: Engaging space combat simulator, using a realistic flight system with Newtonian physics, sophisticated and diverse gameplay featuring detailed ship systems, including ship weaponry and module customization.

title: Fairtravel Battle
description: Let your magic run wild in this fast-paced fantasy card game, with a unique resource system, back-and-forth battles, moddable cards and multiple unique game modes. Play alone or with up to four players online, all without a microtransaction in sight.

title: StoryForge
description: Create your own protagonist and live a serialized novel written around them. Steer your saga with your choices, talk to the characters you meet, and watch it unfold episode by episode in prose written to read like a real novel, in a world that remembers everything you do.

title: UnDo
description: UnDo is a box-pushing puzzle game where you place boxes on target tiles using mechanics tied to Undo. To clear a stage, you must consider not only walls and boxes, but also the order of actions and how the mechanics interact.

title: Ultidark
description: A story based puzzle-platformer, about a stickman, being in the place, he shouldnt ever be in. survive in this demonic dimension, where the thousand year old evil lies, by whatever it means nessesary. solve puzzles, run, avoid, hide. maybe the freedom was taken out of you, but the hope still remains

title: Swing Rush
description: Can you push your jumping, crawling and swinging skills? Challenge yourself in this physics-driven swinging game! Complete races, gather collectibles and master your momentum!

title: Forgotten Isle
description: Awaken upon a surreal fantasy isle far from time and explore its toxic shores for an audience with the Lord of Starlight. Brave the void of night in this first-person indie open world experience with retro 3D graphics.

title: Goodnight, Sun
description: The sun is dying. One billion minds sleep below. You are HALCYON, the caretaker AI — dismantle a solar system, planet by planet, to build them an Ark. An incremental that ENDS: 4-6 hours, two endings, no infinite grind. Every world you consume stays gone. Even the Earth. Especially the Earth.

title: Borderlands 4: Bounty Pack 4 - Murders & Acquisitions
description: A new repeatable mission that tasks you with mediating a conflict between two rival Ripper factions in the polluted Toxic Scowl canyon. Help Levaine navigate tensions between The Flock, a pacifist commune, and The Blasphemers, an aggressive group controlling a nearby Order facility. Your choices shape which mini-boss encounters you face as you fight through contaminated salt-addled bandits to secure powerful Order technology and unlock new cosmetics, vehicle skins, and Vault Hunter gear.

title: Penguin's Progress
description: A browser-based multiplayer game set in a medieval penguin kingdom. Players fill every rank of the feudal hierarchy, from peasant to monarch, in a constant power struggle for the crown. Or you can stay out of politics and live a chill farm life.

title: Frog Adventure
description: Frog Adventure is a cozy puzzle arcade game about a frog trying to get home. Jump between cells, avoid cars, cross rivers on logs, collect crowns for perfect completion, and compete against a friend in a local race.

title: Incredeck
description: Incredeck is a small incremental game where you collect cards, earn money, buy upgrades, and unlock new stages of the game.

title: Luck of the Draw
description: A wild west themed Roguelike Deck-builder where you claim bounties by getting into western standoffs and growing your arsenal. Order your bullets and buffs into the cylinder to create devastating combos and deal massive damage!

title: Tikal Online
description: Tikal Online is a mobile-first 2D MMORPG set in a Maya-inspired fantasy world. Explore ancient jungle temples and mysterious islands, battle creatures, master vocations and spells, complete quests, gather equipment, trade with other players, and join parties for challenging dungeons. Built for Android, iOS, and web, Tikal Online combines classic tile-based online role-playing with an original world inspired by Mesoamerican mythology.

title: Sorry About The Mess
description:
You went to your favorite bakery every day for years, made friends with the owners, Mara and Colin, and even got yourself a nickname, Crumb. (Seriously though, those crumble cookies are the best!)

But Colin has disappeared, leaving Mara all alone, stress-baking in a hot mess of a kitchen. You’re a good friend, so you make a house visit. Will you investigate Colin, comfort your friend, or something more?

title: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - With Open()
Nazi Zombies
description: Nazi Zombies is a cooperative survival game where players fend off escalating waves of Nazi zombies, earning points by killing zombies and repairing barriers to buy weapons, upgrades, perks, and unlock new map areas to maximize their survival.

title: Fantasy Journey
description: The core combat gameplay is similar to Sekiro, emphasizing precise parrying, counterattacks, and dodging—players can even trigger powerful counters with regular attacks. The game features richly detailed environments and a vast, expansive world map.

title: Zentris
description: Zentris is inspired by the classic 1988 falling blocks game, with modern controls and settings to make it more enjoyable today! Built with difficulty settings for a range of play from classic difficulty to full relaxation. 26 different tracks with built in music effect that immerse you in the game!

title: Shisya Zero
description: A new series launches on the paranormal channel [Tatarium]. Your mission is to examine photos submitted by listeners and speculate on the incidents hidden behind them. But with each examination, inexplicable disturbances creep into the studio.

title: Redtail Relic Rush
description:
Adventure never slows down in Redtail Relic Rush! Join Redtail, a fearless red panda explorer armed with a grappling hook, on an action-packed journey through ancient ruins filled with danger, mystery, and legendary treasures.

Run nonstop through thrilling platforming challenges packed with traps, enemies, and daring leaps. Swing through the air, build momentum at just the right moment, and master the perfect rhythm to overcome every obstacle as you race toward the legendary Golden Idol.

Explore 30 exciting levels across 3 unique biomes, from lush jungle ruins and mysterious cliffs to ancient pyramids full of secrets. Every environment introduces fresh challenges that put your reflexes, timing, and precision to the test while keeping the adventure fun and rewarding.

With charming pixel art, responsive controls, and smooth gameplay that always makes you want to play just one more level, Redtail Relic Rush is the perfect adventure for fans of fast-paced platformers, exploration, and exciting action.

Grab your grappling hook, keep your momentum, and prove that no treasure is out of your reach!

title: Blue Flag Down, Guard Up
description: A fast-paced Blue Flag, White Flag arcade game where a split-second choice determines your score. Follow changing commands to test your reflexes and focus. Enjoy classic rules with fresh features, perfect for casual family fun.

title: Hachishakusama
description: 『She Is Always Right Beside You』 The fate of one summer — a boy beloved by the eight-feet-tall Hachishakusama, the urban legend. A heartwarming yet terrifying Japanese horror game.

title: ChronoQuest VR
description: Narrative VR adventure inspired by classic graphic adventures. Explore historical eras, interact with characters, and solve story-driven puzzles through dialogue and immersive environments. Designed for experienced players who enjoy story-driven challenges.

title: Sunfall '80
description: Pilot a lone ship across a stark, vector-style battlefield as the world steadily collapses into the sun. Combat focuses on precision: aim carefully, fire deliberately, and dodge incoming shots from autonomous enemy constructs that track and engage on sight.

title: Asteranova
description: Fast-paced vertical scrolling space shooter featuring intense boss battles, challenging enemy waves, and score-driven arcade gameplay.

title: Bubsy 4D + Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection
description: Bubsy 4D The infamous, wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D in a new platforming adventure. Bubsy is back with new challenges, new moves, and even more purrsonality.

title: NieR Gestalt ver.1.22474487139...
description: NieR Gestalt ver.1.22474487139... is a fan-made overhaul for NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... that recreates the experience of the original Western release, NieR Gestalt. It replaces Brother Nier with the older Father Nier throughout the prologue and both parts of the story, including gameplay models, cutscenes, Dark Phantasm forms, the Shadowlord, and several alternate outfits. The mod also restores and adapts dialogue text, voice audio, music, pre-rendered movies, menus, and other presentation elements from the 2010 release, alongside various model improvements and optional add-ons designed to provide a more complete Gestalt-style playthrough.

title: La vieja contra el Dibu
description: The judge thought it was funny. He gave the kid a choice: two years behind bars, or get his mother to score a goal against the best goalkeeper in the world. The kid chose his old lady, he didn’t even think twice. So the judge signed off on the fine print: 30 penalty kicks, one per day. And if none of them go in, the kid will no longer get two years. He’ll be sentenced to death. No one asked the old lady, who’s sixty years old and has never even kicked a football. Nor did they tell Dibu that on the other side there was a woman. Or maybe they did, and that’s why he agreed. He waits for her every morning between the posts. He talks to her. He makes fun of her. He dances. She shows up every morning nonetheless.

title: Blackwood Lodge: The Siblings
description: Uncover the dark secrets of Blackwood Lodge in this atmospheric psychological horror game. As John Wilson, use your lighter to brave the dark, explore fractured spirit memories, and solve puzzles to piece together a tragic crime, all while evading a terrifying supernatural stalker.

title: Bringers of Darkness
description: Fight for the forces of darkness in a fast-paced bullet heaven survivors-like. Become a champion of darkness, master unique abilities, and bring ruin to the kingdoms of light that created their own nightmares.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 15
description:
He got his start rapping with friends while playing Fortnite, and now you and your friends can band up or go solo with his 4 new Jam Tracks "Ransom," "Dark Thoughts," “Love Me” and "500lbs".

The Neon Dreams Music Pass unlocks new Festival gear, like the music-reactive Tour Ready Lil Tecca Outfit, the Mic Mace Pickaxe, Tecca’s World Back Bling, and the Dopamine Tour-inspired Guitar.

title: Ben's Zombie Apocalypse
description: That unstoppable arcade addiction is back, once you start, you can't stop! Ben and Carmen, two agents, join the fight! Blast zombie heads and take down the towering bosses closing in!

title: Loot Before the Law
description: Sneak through guarded corridors, avoid police patrols, and steal valuable loot without being detected. Study their routes, stay out of sight, and escape before the law catches up with you.

title: Jump Protocol
description: Leap across towering rooftops, wall-run over obstacles, and master fast-paced parkour as you race through a dangerous city filled with enemies and challenging platforming.

title: Crayon Mandala
description: Enjoy healing time with your family through soothing mandala coloring!

title: Destroy The Universe: Solar Mayhem
description: Choose a planet. Unleash cosmic weapons. Decide how the world ends.

title: Chameleon Dummy Hunt
description:
Can you spot what does not belong?
Chameleon Dummy Hunt is a colorful first-person hidden-object action game where sneaky dummy.

title: Arcade Archives: TX-1
description:
"TX-1" is a racing game released by TATSUMI in 1983.
Enjoy a powerful race, unique to the triple-screen display.
The course splits along the way, where deserts, coastlines, and city nightscapes dynamically flash past. Goals all around the world?! Cross the finish line and claim your glorious checkered flag!

title: Arcade Archives 2: TX-1
description:
"TX-1" is a racing game released by TATSUMI in 1983.
Enjoy a powerful race, unique to the triple-screen display.
The course splits along the way, where deserts, coastlines, and city nightscapes dynamically flash past. Goals all around the world?! Cross the finish line and claim your glorious checkered flag!

title: Elementis TD
description: Elementis TD is an elemental tower defense game. Basic towers are intentionally weak, and the core mechanic consists of combining them into 21 discoverable fusions. A Corruption system can affect the player's own towers during a wave. The game features a 7-chapter campaign, an endless mode with progressive scaling, and 90 achievements.

title: Ludus: A Gladiator Story
description: A fully voiced branching narrative RPG of the Roman arena with a unique engraving and VO for every choice and outcome. Four origins, over 1,800 choices, and 19 endings. You will bleed on the sand. The only question is whether you bleed for them, or for yourself. Every choice leaves a scar.

title: Space Bar
description: Space Bar is a short psychological horror experience where simply pressing one key slowly reveals that something inside the game is trying to communicate with you.

title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Super Limit-Breaking NEO
description:
Super Limit Breaking NEO is a major expansion arriving in Summer 2026, designed to answer community expectations and elevate the experience to new heights.

With massive content additions across all key pillars, NEO represents the most ambitious evolution of the game to date.

title: Cyber City: Science Crime Mystery
description:
The evidence is hidden in the artwork.
Find the truth with a keen eye — a cyber sci-fi mystery!

title: Eden Coil
description:
upgrade your snake
manage more snakes at once
solve puzzles

title: Be Kind Rewind
description: The fate of movie night is in your hands.

title: Bicycle Quiz & Riding
description:
A game to learn about the Blue Ticket system
Two gameplay modes: Quiz and Action
Simultaneous Japanese and English display

title: One-Move Checkmate: Chess Brain Trainer
description:
Find the winning move
Solve checkmate puzzles
Train your chess thinking

title: Get Fit: Beach Workout
description: Train with hot beach trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer,

title: Cute Animals
description: Adorable animal puzzles where toddlers learn, explore & grow.

title: Room 0
description: A first-person horror game about a detective investigating an abandoned research facility, a missing girl named Carla, and the sealed room at the center of it all. Recover VHS tapes, follow the tracks left behind, and avoid what's left inside.

title: Escape game R00m15
description: Explore 3D space and escape

title: Solitaire Paradise: Anime Bikini Babes
description:
A classical Solitaire game with a modern twist.
Play classic Solitaire in a calm, anime-inspired world.

title: Something That Shouldn't Be There Is Visible.
description: Look closely at this image. One thing doesn't belong. Once you notice it, you can't look away.

title: Sudden Strike 5: France - Road to Liberation
description:
Under the cover of darkness, they came – silently across the waves… In Sudden Strike 5 – France: Road to Liberation, deploy to one of the most decisive chapters in the liberation of France! Following D-Day, you’ll be joining the fight in a new Allied landing operation in August 1944.

Storm the shores of Camel Beach alongside Allied forces, fight together with the French Resistance, and command operations across six new missions set in Southern France. From the chaos of the Allied beach landings to the Axis retreat through the Rhône Valley, every battlefield presents a new tactical challenge that will test your strategic skill!

title: The Person Living Next Door
description: Something about the neighbour is... off today. Can you spot the unease hidden in plain sight?

title: Spanking Exorcist
description: Explore a somewhat alluring apartment complex, avoiding evil spirits while exorcising the ghosts of housewives, in this slightly sexy comedy horror game!

title: Noun Town: Learn & Chill
description: Learn 500+ words across 12 languages (including Japanese + Spanish). Test your vocabulary to earn credits, unlock relaxing lofi tracks, and customize your study space. Put your progress on autopilot and watch your vocabulary grow while you chill.

title: Rose Guns Days: Season 2
description: In 1944, unprecedented disaster struck Japan, forcing it to accept an unconditional ceasefire from its enemy nations in World War 2. As a result, the Japanese have become a people without a nation, but they still come together and do whatever it takes to live without giving up...

title: Sponge Break
description: Sponge Break is a physics-based co-op survival game in which one to four players control sponges attempting to escape down a treacherous river aboard a fragile raft, steering through rapids, environmental hazards, and hostile wildlife. It supports drop-in co-op and solo play, and features proximity voice chat with sponges that lip-sync to player speech. Players use a plunger that doubles as a grappling hook, throw loose objects, and store loot in a shared raft stash, while a physics system governs raft handling and damage. Progression is level-based across multiple biomes such as sewers, rivers, and abandoned facilities, with safehouses between levels for repairing, reviving, and restocking, alongside over 100 unlockable cosmetic options, emotes, controller support, and a range of side activities.

title: Boli
description: Boli is a retro-style JRPG with hand-drawn ASCII art. Venture forth into the wilderness to find a cure for a rare disease that is decimating your village.

title: Truxton Extreme: Batsugun Ship + Music Pack
Truxton Extreme: Truxton Ship + Music Pack
Truxton Extreme: Truxton II Ship + Music Pack
Mikane's Hand
description: A girl's card battle world — where you witness the turmoil of youth. What is this place?

title: Laptop Architect
description: Design laptops from the PCB up and build a global tech empire! Balance complex heat and power mechanics, manage your corporate budget, and conquer international markets. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Laptop Architect?

title: Moon Corona
description: open your eyes from the ancient temple and embark on this adventure! Embark on an RPG adventure in a dark-themed sandbox world. Explore vast lands, collect all kinds of cards, craft diverse combinations, and make pivotal choices—seeking lost truths and redemption in the chaos and danger.

title: Buttons Up! 2
description: The Gnomes are back! Buttons Up! is a incremental button collecting game where you hoard Buttons and keep them safe from stealing intruders. Get those Buttons Up by buying and crafting buildings. Unlock new skills from the tech tree and automate your income!

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description: Command a group of Blades and lead them to countless strategic victories as you search for the fabled paradise Pyra calls home. This journey has been enhanced with 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second—and with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

title: Bloody Grids
description: A single move to carve a path through blood.Use the information on the grid to avoid, fight, and devour unseen enemies in this Minesweeper-style puzzle adventure.

title: Vision Quest: A New Ascent
description: Vision Quest: A New Ascent is a twin-stick souls-like shaped by nature. Survive 2-hit death combat with well-timed critical hits that restore your Health and rise above failure with a generous respawn system. The summit is waiting.

title: Hex Core
description: Hex Core is a short, incremental clicker-style defense game where you help PeteOS hold back waves of viruses until you can wipe them out for good. Spend resources to unlock a huge spread of upgrades, new mechanics, weapons, and research.

title: Card Homestead
description: Card Homestead is a roguelike deckbuilder where card placement decides everything. Each day, draft one of three delivered cards and stack them onto your plot, engineering powerful chain reactions. Produce gold with efficient synergies and layouts to survive the ever-rising taxes.

title: Click Build Repeat
description: Click Build Repeat is an incremental game about building and collecting model kits.

title: Boreal Tenebrae Act 0
description: A surreal narrative adventure set on the night Tamarack Narrows collapses into static, fire, and aurora. Follow Sarah, Bree, and the townsfolk as an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation. A lo-fi, analog-horror

title: Midnight Moments
description: A small, cyberpunk diorama-building game where you create cozy rain-soaked backstreets, glowing apartment blocks, or quiet neighbourhood corners. Decorate your designs with props and place citizens, crafting stories that bring your city to life. At your own pace. No goals. Just vibes.

title: The Organ Woman
description: A 1–4 player cooperative horror game set in an abandoned hospital in Japan. Work together with your friends, collect boxes containing organs, and escape from the hospital where something lurks!

title: Seventh Mansion: The First Escape
description: Escape an eerie mansion where death resets everything. Solve puzzles, evade the Wicked Nuns, or use a camera to survive in this psychological horror experience.

title: Exstetra
description: The only way to save the world is a kiss——. 《EXSTETRA》 is a fantasy RPG set in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and burdened with a doomed fate, where you rise as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the threat of the world’s destruction.

title: The Silver Crow
description: You play Conrad - executioner, outcast, and the last man anyone would trust to solve a murder. A handcrafted adventure steeped in Renaissance atmosphere, occult shadows and moral ambiguity. A point & click mystery in a city where truth is buried, power decides guilt, and someone is always watching.

title: Machine Party
description: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.

title: Blue Reflection: Second Light
description: A new release of Second Light included in the Blue Reflection quartet bundle. This release features eight additional characters from Ray and Sun who can join you in battle, as well as new quality of life features such as increased battle speed, faster movement speed while exploring, and event fast-forwarding.

title: Blue Reflection
description:
A remaster of the first Blue Reflection game included in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.
Textures and character models have been updated to high resolution versions, and new visual effects such as glistening water add to the world’s atmosphere. New quality of life features such as autosave and increased movement speed have been included, offering a more enjoyable experience than ever before.

title: Blue Reflection Sun
description:
An offline remake of the Blue Reflection Sun gacha game inclunded in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.
It has been remade as a console game using the systems of Blue Reflection: Second Light to recreate the memorable battles of the original game. 24 new character events have been added alongside the main story.

title: Blue Reflection Ray
description:
A condensed game adaptation of the Blue Reflection Ray's anime included in the Blue Reflection Quartet bundle.

Follow Hiori and Ruka as they explore the Common while re-experiencing their memories on their way to confront a girl trying to recreate the world. New short stories expand on the anime’s story, and a new prologue and epilogue connect this entry to the other works in the series.

title: Blue Reflection Quartet
description: Cosmos converge, into one light. The emotional stories of magical Reflectors and the bonds they form. The entire BLUE REFLECTION series combined into one!

title: Ghost Master: Resurrection - Solid Ice and Terror
description: Escape the bitter cold outside. Screams echo across the ice, celebrating victories and championships of years past

title: Dinosaurium
description: Crack. Hatch. Roar. Extinction was never the end. Hatch and raise hundreds of unique dinosaurs through real-time growth in this cozy idle game. Your prehistoric park thrives with ancient giants, even while you work or study.

title: The Prince of Tennis: Doki Doki Survival - Eternal Passion! Tie Break Game
description: Originally released on PlayStation 2 as two separate games and later combined into one on Nintendo DS, the Prince of Tennis game where you find yourself stranded on an island on the way to the National Middle School Tennis Championship is being remastered for modern platforms.

title: The Prince of Tennis: Sweet School Festival 0-40 and more…
description: Originally released on PlayStation 2, the Prince of Tennis game where you play as a high school student preparing for the school festival is being remastered in celebration of its 20th anniversary.

title: Kimi ni Madoi, Kimi ni Oboreru.
description: An omegaverse visual novel by Otomate.

title: Forgotten Playland: Party Edition
description: Step into Forgotten Playland: Party Edition, a 4-player social party game where the attic becomes your Playland and PlushKyn take center stage. Compete, socialize, and express yourself in a beautifully crafted world.

title: Edge of Destruction
description: A surreal First-Person Shooter where you destroy the haunting world you created to escape your guilt. Featuring almost full environment destruction.

title: Random Dragons
description: Chance-based roguelike deckbuilder with silly and goofy dragons. Spin the roulette wheel to get insane crit damage on enemies, manipulate the odds, and use multipliers like Balatro. Build your synergic deck and kill Random Dragons.

title: Warshift 2
description: Warshift 2 is a unique mix of Action, RTS and RPG gameplay elements that forms an innovative game genre. You can build base, manage troops, and then come down to keep your enemy at gunpoint in the dynamic battle and customize your main characters.

title: Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute
description:
The Culdcept series has captivated players worldwide. Now, the original masterpiece returns, enhanced with convenient new features.

Build your deck from over 300 types of cards and witness the dawn of a new battle among Cepter.

title: Console Archives: Doraemon
description:
Doraemon was released by Hudson (current Konami) in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
This is an action game in which Doraemon goes on adventure using various Secret Gadgets to search for Nobita, Shizuka, Gian, Suneo who have been sent to "Space," "The haunts of evil," and "Undersea" due to a problem with their Time machine.
Once you defeat the bosses in each world and rescue all of them, a wonderful ending awaits you!

title: Senatus
description: Strategic card battles in the heart of the Roman Senate. Debate, persuade, and rise through the ranks to become Consul of Rome. Influence is power — and power decides everything.

title: Bobble and the Tri-Crystal
description: Swim, shoot, and save the ocean! Play as a detective fish in this fast-paced 2D Game Boy-style shoot 'em up! Unlock multiple weapons, defeat enemy hordes, and defeat bosses before it's too late!

title: Waterpunk
description: A roguelite action game set in a post-apocalyptic water world. Shape your strategy by choosing which abilities shine by day and which awaken at night.

title: Senara: The Sacrament
description: "SENARA: The Sacrament" is a first-person survival horror aboard a ship. Uncover the truth while escaping fanatics and unspeakable horrors. In a place where blind faith and salvation intertwine, you’ll be forced to make choices that go far beyond survival.

title: Mimicry!
description: Blend into the environment and eat objects around you as a sneaky Mimic, or burn, zap, and explode everything as a crafty Exterminator to root out the Mimics in this Prop-Hunt inspired multiplayer game of chaos and frenetic fun!

title: Ungodly
description: UnGodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

title: Seifuku Kanojo 2: Free DLC Act.4 - Konomi Yui
description: The fourth and final free DLC for Seifuku Kanojo 2, focused on Yui.

title: How Many Dudes?
description: How many dudes does it take to beat up 1000 toddlers? A gorilla? Twelve bears and a horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out.

title: Sudden Attack Zero Point
description: Sudden Attack has been cherished for 20 years. Now, an endless journey begins. With its signature fast-paced combat and strategic gameplay rooted in classic bomb defusal, we've upgraded the graphics and introduced a gun customization system. Dive into action and discover a new level of excitement!

title: Beats of Un'sonia
description: Dive into a rhythmic combat game where every move counts! Adapt your playstyle, explore diverse biomes, face epic bosses, and push your score higher. Face the beat... and conquer it!

title: Leafy Corner
description: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

title: Village in the Shade
description: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

title: Typomagical
description: Type and cast your own spells! Typomagical is a spell-casting roguelike with a twist: create and cast spells by typing incantations! Spells and the elements are at your fingertips, literally -- creative synergies are the key to victory!

title: Mycubium
description: Mycubium is a first-person 3D puzzle platformer where you grow bridges using mushrooms in a minimalist cubic world. Explore and solve spatial puzzles across shifting landscapes filled with secrets, platforming challenges, and evolving mechanics. Build your path as the day fades to night.

title: CipherMind
description: Explore the eerie ruins, complete missions to obtain clues, deduce one's own and others' identities, and finally escape.

title: Astro Burn
description: A retro-inspired, side-scrolling bullet hell shoot-’em-up, where you play as a feline space pilot blasting through waves of strange machines to uncover Earth’s mysterious downfall.

title: Mechaconda
description: Survive hordes of monsters and bosses while collecting cards that add unique ability upgrades to the body of a small snake Mechaconda.

title: Sheva
description: Sheva is a card-based fighting game where both players act simultaneously in strategic 1v1 battles. Predict your opponent, adapt your deck, and master the chakras as you sharpen your skills with every run.

title: Welcome, Sharehouse!
description: Living in a share house with three pretty girls

title: Defense of Fort Burton
description:
Defense of Fort Burton is a top-down action RPG that fuses intense hero combat with strategic tower defense. Rebuild a besieged fortress, master legendary heroes, and face waves of corrupted creatures in heroic battles for survival.

This is a single player gameplay with blend of action and strategy. Defeat the series of various enemies, each enemies bring different character and ways to defeat them. Fight against unique bosses through at the climax situation.

title: Zoominoes
description: Build the ultimate Zoo in this number-go-up roguelike deckbuilder. Find powerful mythical animals, boost them with snacks, and even manipulate the board itself. Break the game by scoring millions (and more) with insane combos.

title: Rita
description: Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

title: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods
description: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods is a new kind of combo RPG where you and your pup piece together flashy combos to dismantle a plethora of enemies! Discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict amongst the gods.

title: Truxton Extreme
description: Truxton Extreme, which inherits the DNA from legendary arcade masterpiece Truxton, is a collaboration with manga artist and Toaplan alumni Junya Inoue.

title: Stoneguard
description: To protect the magical Lifestone, you must strategise, manage and build a fortified settlement. Lead your fellow survivors into battle against waves of nocturnal monsters who wish to take this precious Lifestone from your world.

title: Skyformer
description: A first-person survival and automation game where you build factories run by drones to power a machine that terraforms a planet. Build bases, prepare for different types of storms, and harness the weather along the way!

title: Dramatic Road: The Origin of Wind
description: A full-fledged simulation RPG set in modern Japan! A variety of characters unique to modern times, such as riders, magicians, and baseball players, have appeared. Command them, nurture them, and use their skills to protect the peace of the school!

title: Turnip Mountain
description: In this hands-on climbing platformer, chart your own path as you reach, swing and soar to the summit!

title: Kusan: City of Wolves
description:
Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter where players fight through a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption to save Haru — a girl fitted with a city-grade atomic weapon.

Welcome to Kusan: City of Wolves, a brutal top-down shooter set in a neon-drenched urban jungle consumed by violence and corruption.

Kusan delivers hardcore action where one mistake means death. Master gunplay, perfect your movement, survive the streets and combat arenas ruled by furious kingpins that demand speed, precision and flawless execution. Every moment of action is intensified by Korean hip-hop heavyweight Loptimist’s adrenaline-fuelled soundtrack drenched with head-bopping loops and deep 808s pushing you forward without mercy.

title: The Ranchers
description: The Ranchers is an open world country-life sim for 1-4 players. Raise animals, grow crops, craft machines, build your dream house and explore the gigantic open world where mines and dangerous monsters abound. Earn the villagers' respect and esteem. And who knows, maybe find love and start a family.

title: Hyperstacks
description:
Hyperstacks is a VR world of combat, parkour, logic-driven puzzles, memorable characters, and community-made levels.
Meet its residents through quests and discover a growing library of player creations.

title: Skillwarz
description:
SkillWarz is a fast-paced, cross-platform first-person shooter featuring competitive multiplayer battles across web, mobile, and desktop. Currently, the game includes five action-packed modes (Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Gun Game, Team Gun Game, and Skull Hunt) set across more than 20 diverse maps. Choose from six unique classes and ten different weapons to dominate the battlefield. Additional content (including maps, weapons, and game modes) is planned for future updates.

The browser version is already playable, with mobile and Steam releases planned soon.

title: New York Mysteries 3: The Lantern of Souls
description: A new chapter of the cold-blooded saga transports us to the New York of the late 1950s. The brutal murder of a rich lawyer's widow is not what it seems. Laura James, a reporter with the 'Daily News', was investigating an ordinary murder case when it all went to hell. The deeper she digs, the darker it gets. It seems that the roots of the case are buried somewhere in the history of WWII. Are you brave enough to venture into the chilling night, full of horror? Well, are you?

title: Hollowcross
description: Hollowcross is a gothic-horror collectible card game where every card you own plays in every mode — so the deity you forge in one becomes a weapon in all of them.

title: Let's Grow Together
description: Build your dream farm with friends in this cozy 1–4 player co-op farming adventure! Raise adorable animals, grow seasonal crops, fish, customize your farmer and loyal dog, and turn your small farm into a thriving countryside paradise.

title: Londoleon: Not a Single Penny
description: Many people dream of visiting London, but few ever stop to think about what would happen if they lost all their money in a foreign country. Unfortunately, Max's friend not only finds himself without any cash, but also discovers that it has been replaced with counterfeit banknotes.

title: Butts in Space: Porcelain Peril
description: Evil Butt has invaded the Porcelain Planet, central TP trading hub for the galaxy. Embark on a perilous journey as Butt Butt in an attempt to free the planet from Evil Butt's control in this fart filled platformer.

title: Orbital Hell
description: Orbital Hell is an arcade bullet hell shooter played from a first-person perspective inside a concave, spherical environment where the horizon curves upward. The player's rotary cannon fires automatically, requiring players to aim, manage secondary abilities, and navigate swarms of incoming enemies approaching from all directions. Core movement mechanics center on aerial traversal, allowing players to bounce directly off enemy units to reset double jumps, maintain airtime, charge defensive shields, and build scoring combos. Offensive and defensive tools include charged piercing shots, speed boosts, and an orbital shield that clears surrounding targets upon ground takeoff. The game features two primary modes: Normal Mode, focusing on surviving escalating enemy waves and bosses with time-slowing pickups, and Boss Rush, an endurance gauntlet of consecutive boss encounters with timed interludes.

title: Crescent Creek: Survival Horror
description: Crescent Creek: Survival Horror plunges you into a desolate farm, cut off from civilization and steeped in mystery. As you explore its winding corridors and ominous rooms, youll need to make critical choices, as each path could lead to salvation or peril.

title: RavenVeil
description: Explore abandoned homes, forgotten paths, and hidden places in RavenVeil. Find clues, solve puzzles, unlock sealed areas, and uncover the Bride's mystery. Every discovery reveals darker secrets. Will you escape with the truth, or become part of RavenVeil forgotten history?

title: Mischief Moves In
description: Welcome to the laid-back nighttime world of Mischief Moves In. You’re Mischief, a raccoon who has just moved into the neighborhood. Find furniture to decorate your new home. Lend a paw to other animals during your adventure, and don’t worry about causing a little mischief along the way!

title: Singulier
description: The party game where you must NEVER say the same thing as everyone else. Find the answer no one dares to give and survive — up to 100 players in Battle Royale! One friend buys it, the whole table plays FREE from their browser. Built for streaming.

title: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Ruler of the Skies
description: Look up, and you might catch a glimpse of a fearsome Pokémon twisting through the night sky. Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket’s next expansion, Ruler of the Skies, is now available, starring the Legendary Mega Rayquaza ex.

title: Dante's Rumba
description: A route-planning puzzle game set in an oddly cozy version of Dantes Inferno. Clean up Hell, one circle at a time, discover various traps, and help Faust deal with a malfunctioning Rumba, an overly dramatic dead poet, and a personal mission he wont quite talk about.

title: Osta
description: A militaria collecting simulator where you hunt for items through metal detecting, auctions, and markets to build your collection and customize your home. Travel to various locations to uncover the relics of different conflicts throughout history.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.1 - The Long Goodbye
description:
Marking the continuation of Zenless Zone Zero's Season 3, Version 3.1 includes:
• New Characters: Remielle and Sigrid
• New Main Story Quest: Season 3 Chapter 2: The Long Goodbye
• 2nd Anniversary Celebrations
• New gameplay mechanics, system updates, and events

title: Subsurface
description: Subsurface is a 1–4 player online co-op underwater horror game where players dive into abandoned underwater facilities to recover valuable scrap, meet demanding quotas, and survive terrifying creatures lurking in the depths. Explore, scavenge, and escape together—but beware, not everyone makes it back to the surface.

title: Blood Money
description: Blood Money is a 2D tactical shooter game.

title: Far Lands
description: Welcome to Far Lands, an open-world survival adventure. After a devastating plane crash, you find yourself stranded on a mysterious island with no way home. Surrounded by danger and uncertainty, your only priority is clear: survive.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Pixel Perfect
description: The 24th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings new content inspired by Disney's Wreck-It Ralph - including the titular character as a Villager. It also included new features to Villagers Friendship levels, Floating Islands inspired by the Storybook Vale, new rooms for Olaf's Grand Exhibition and started the Pop City Star Path.

title: Wake Up, Lia!
description: Help Lia overcome her nightmares in a side-scrolling adventure across emotionally themed stages!

title: Kassei: Road Cycling - Next Season
description: Kassei: Road Cycling - Next Season is a summer sports simulation game. Become one of more than 80 male and female road cycling managers at more than 10 tours and classics - and decide on training plans as well as race tactics! The next season starts here ...

title: Hotel The Memory
description: If you find an anomaly, remember it. Welcome to Hotel The Memory, an anomaly-hunting x memory-matching escape game. Match pairs of rooms with the exact same anomaly to escape from this strange hotel.

title: Florida Man Court
