description: Prosecute. Defend. Judge. Throw objections... or punches. Outwit opposing counsel, cross-examine bizarre NPC witnesses, and turn procedurally generated Florida Man cases into unforgettable multiplayer courtroom chaos.

title: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand
description: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand delivers a standalone roguelite wave-defense experience for solo and cooperative play. Command and survive against fast-paced escalating enemy waves, intimidating bosses, and dynamic battlefield events. Are you ready to make your final stand?

title: Debrisverse
description: The debt is a trap. DEBRISVERSE is a sci-fi incremental sim where you crush space debris for profit. Use roguelite upgrades to accelerate destruction and pay off your $100M debt. But this perfect workplace has a dark secret. Uncover the system's conspiracy across 7 unique endings.

title: Idle_Directive
description: Idly gather and manage resources to repair what's left of a decaying world. Scavenge forgotten ruins, meet scattered survivors, and push back against the inevitable collapse. Idle_Directive is a grid-based inventory and resource management idle game.

title: Cat Hits the Deck
description: Deckbuilder roguelike about a cat that fears being hurt but has only cards that hurt her before enemies! Min-max your resources, get OverPowered cards in your paw, and build an unlosable Deck that prolly gonna kill you 9 times^^

title: Idle Hacker
description: IdleHacker is an idler/incremental game where you hack the world.

title: Solitaire Deck
description: Solitaire that runs beautifully on PC gaming handhelds where every win builds your Museum of card history. Play Solitaire Deck on any device with controller, mouse, keyboard or touch. No tricks. Just solitaire done right.

title: You Had a Bad Dream
description: A minimalist horror game where you move through procedurally generated narrow corridors and avoid lurking monsters.

title: Market Chain 98
description: Build your Market Chain in this retro incremental game set inside a nostalgic 90s operating system. Start with a small shop, manage bank loans, expand your logistics hubs, and unlock global upgrades through your Portfolio. Fill your desktop with windows and dominate the market!

title: Vquarium
description: Vquarium is a relaxing incremental-idle game where you grow your own underwater world on your screen overlay with a virtual assistant. Collect rare fish, discover sparkling variants, and decorate your tank while taking care of an adorable assistant!

title: Project Manager Sim
description: Manage the most unpredictable resource - people - in this WASD tycoon! Plan projects, hire a dream team, assign tasks to specialists, and monitor the budget while upgrading your office. Balance between team burnout, complex contracts, and the wrath of upper management.

title: Retail Rivals
description: Build your retail empire inside a shopping mall. Open multiple stores, sabotage rivals, and play solo or with up to 8 players. Choose different match objectives or play endless mode and compete for retail domination.

title: BloodRayne: Definitive Collection
description:
Become Rayne, a half-human, half-vampire agent working for the Brimstone Society, as she hunts supernatural threats across a dark and violent world. From battling occult forces tied to the Third Reich to confronting her own vampiric bloodline, Rayne’s journey spans brutal conflicts, relentless enemies, and deeply personal vendettas.

This collection includes the original BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal – Fresh Bites, combining fast-paced third-person action with stylish 2D hack-and-slash gameplay. Face hordes of soldiers, grotesque creatures, and powerful bosses using Rayne’s acrobatic combat skills, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric abilities.

Enhanced for modern platforms, this definitive edition delivers the ultimate way to experience the full BloodRayne saga — a cult classic series known for its unique blend of action, horror, and gothic style.

title: Truck-Kun Is Supporting Me From Another World?!
description: Your truck is magic and you now owe a soul debt to the buff isekai elf girl living in your head. Run over pedestrians as Truck-kun, make deliveries, and defeat the Skeleton King across two worlds in this chaotic run-based anime driving game!

title: Joy Malignant
description: A surreal dice-based RPG in a cursed city of gut-wrenching suffering. Here, your choices shape your skills and your appearance. Survive the city's hellish trials, meet tortured characters, and develop your own unique identity. Every choice matters as your actions will literally shape you.

title: Bills Must Be Paid
description: A short active incremental game where you smash piggy banks to pay your bills. Collect coins, upgrade, and get out of debt!

title: Keyboard Warrior
description:
The keyboard is the level!

Every key your press sends you flying to that location on-screen, slashing your sword along the way! There's no limit to how quickly you can attack, so nothing will hold you back from fighting as quickly or as slowly as you want. But be careful- Every enemy is different, so you'll need to bring strategy along with speed.

A single run in this rogue-like adventure can last anywhere from 15 seconds to 15 minutes. Keyboard Warrior features multiple difficulty settings, multiple international keyboard layouts, and hours of fun for those who are willing to master their keyboard.

title: Ugoku Sushi Bar
description:
Become a sushi chef in a cozy Japanese conveyor belt sushi bar!
Prepare sushi on your crafting table, serve quirky customers, learn new recipes, unlock fresh ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, and build relationships with your regular customers.

title: Case Solved: The London Files
description: A cozy noir puzzle game where you must investigate the dark underbelly of London. Murders have taken place, witness statements conflict and alibis aren’t adding up. Everyone has a motive, only logic reveals the truth.

title: Express Rider Simulator
description: Paying rent is tough, but outrunning stray dogs is tougher! Go live in Express Rider Simulator, navigate complex addresses, and hype up your viewers. Manage fuel, handle your accountant, and upgrade your bike while battling dynamic weather. Can you deliver the goods without getting bitten?

title: Sea War Naval Supremacy
description: Sea War Naval Supremacy is a naval action RPG. Command your ship explore an endless ocean and battle pirates, mercenaries, and treasure hunters. Upgrade your fleet, unlock new ships and prove who rules the seas

title: Last Spaceship
description: Last Spaceship is an adventure puzzle game. Play as a maintenance robot, repair the ship by solving a series of fascinating puzzles, explore its various compartments, and collect relics of human legacy. Experience a story about war, extinction, salvation, and choice.

title: Hydra Heli 2
description: Hydra Heli 2 is a relaxing incremental game about sinking battleships with an overpowered helicopter. Control a swarm of unstoppable weapons, annihilate armadas, collect shards, and utilize the Depot to boost damage, increase firepower, and unlock new regions.

title: Cue Room
description: Cue Room is a rogue-like billiard game. Shop balls with special abilities, pot them, embrace their unleashed chaos and repeat.

title: Snekromancy
description: Slither through a maze-like dungeon, devouring enemies and gobbling up treasure to summon an unstoppable horde in this twist on a classic.

title: Dverghold
description: When the Dwarves of Dverghold awakened something ancient beneath the isle of Rekestt, King Sterren sent word across the Shattered Sea: brave the haunted depths, or let the darkness rise. Oldschool dungeon crawler with turn-based combat and atmospheric soundtrack by Dungeon Synth artist Splendorius.

title: Rleotha: Trial of Gods
description: Help the young one complete the trial, set by the council of gods, on the planet Rleotha.

title: Remembrance
description: Step into the fractured mind of a dying scientist in Remembrance, a mind-bending VR puzzle adventure. Piece together broken memories, uncover devastating truths, and decide the fate of a world teetering on the edge of collapse. Will you save humanity?

title: Devils Due
description: DEVIL'S DUE - A hellish slot machine RPG! Face demonic bosses in slot-based combat, collect Lucky Charms, and manage your debt to the Devil. Win big to deal damage, but demons turn your victories against you. Three phases of challenge await. Will you pay the Devil's Due?

title: Outclaw
description:
Ouclaw is a cosy minion-managing action adventure about herding cats. Play as Comet, a five eyed magic cat from space who commands mischievous shadow kittens called Shades.

Fight monsters, solve puzzles, collect treasure, and explore a galaxy of vibrant worlds.

Morph your underlings into various forms, creating shields, bridges, bombs and more to aid in your journey - Who knows what they’ll become next?

title: MandarinMastermind
description: This is an adventure game that uses voice to solve puzzles. You will play as an amnesiac girl trapped in the ether world. You need to learn Mandarin words to solve puzzles, and use these words to activate magic and defeat enemies. Can you complete the challenge of using Mandarin?

title: Archon Soul
description: Roll the dice but make your own luck in this 2D dicebuilding roguelike. Customize your dice using swappable faces, runes, and bodies with unique effects. ​Draft spells, create powerful synergies, defeat challenging enemies, and conquer the Archon's palace.

title: PhiloDeka
description: In a serene, immersive world, strategically craft your path to turn every multiple of 10 into a rewarding harvest. Unlock the powerful interplay of numbers and strategy, and savor the satisfaction of perfect alignment and numerical zen.

title: MineGeon: Renegades
description: Descend into Planet Paimo in MineGeon: Renegades, a chaotic multiplayer roguelite where you choose your renegade, delve into the minegeons, and battle unique enemies across diverse biomes. Fight, gather, improve, and die to uncover the secrets of Paimo and New Olympia.

title: Mistfall Hunter
description: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person action PvPvE extraction RPG. Gear up for different classes, master combos and strategic skills, and face intense battles against monsters or players, solo or with teammates. Only a successful escape will secure your treasures.

title: Powerplay
description: Powerplay is an RTS with a focus on resources and industry. Create supply chains, transport, and explore in this thrilling base builder. Grow into a powerful industrial nation, but don't spread too thin! Resources are finite and "the others" can reclaim what is theirs at any time.

title: Separated
description: Trapped and separated across two connected houses, you and your friend must use voice chat to solve puzzles from different perspectives. But beware, a blind presence is listening to your conversations. Your voice is your only way out.

title: Below, Rusted Gods
description: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

title: Echoes of Egypt
description: Master action challenges in an ancient Egyptian setting. Dodge, jump, and dance through rhythmic puzzles on animated temple carvings, enhanced by a unique 1980s Middle Eastern soundtrack. Experience dynamic gameplay where history & fantasy meet, pushing your reflexes and rhythm skills to the limits.

title: Lunarium
description: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.

title: Slimelon
description: Try to defeat the chaos generated by a multitude of slimes, each one cuter (almost) than the other. Discover all the fusions, collect them... And try to be the best (temporary) slime breeder!

title: Mattami Restaurant & Cafe Tycoon
description: ♪ Mattami is a restaurant tycoon game where you start with a tiny humble place and work your way up. Manage your staff, their schedule and inventory to efficiently grow your restaurant as fast and as elegant as possible.

title: Scuttle
description: Scuttle across the sands in an exhilarating musically charged adventure. Groove to the beat to jump and boost your way through treacherous dunes and risky seas in this mesmerizing 3D platformer with rhythm game elements.

title: Outfield
description: Outfield is a horror/puzzle game in which you are trapped in a mysterious field of tall grass. Solve the puzzles, discover the secrets of the tall grass and survive the danger around you to hope to survive.

title: Lily Fantasia
description: Welcome, to the fantastical and rhythmic world of Lily Fantasia! Join the mysterious vampire, Lily, in a race against time to save your sickened mother. Overcome fierce enemies, wield the magical piano, and become the Rhythm Master you were always destined to!

title: Scottside
description: "Scottside" is a non-linear visual novel in the thriller genre. A small provincial town may seem quite dull. However, everything changes when you find a strange object in the forest.

title: Achievement: Global Domination
description: Conquering the world has never been this addictive! Explore 100 countries, click and collect your achievements. Click one country or explore all, choose your strategy, and climb the leaderboard!

title: Color Capsules
description: Stack 'em, merge 'em, hit 'em, dodge 'em! Color Capsules is a versus physics puzzle game where your gachapon capsules go flying! With a frantic pace and over 100 cosmetics to unlock, you'll always have something new to mess with!

title: Devil's Arcade
description: Escape from the Devil's latest creation! In the 2D top-down shooter Devil's Arcade, hordes of demons, a bunch of different game modes, randomized events and endless fun await you!

title: Disciples of Canada
description: Play as Viviette, and her three lieutenants, and defeat the three rivalling criminal gangs in this cute RPG Maker game. Featuring a large cast of chibi girls in a unique Canadian city.

title: Puzzles: Water
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Parry Counter
description: PARRY COUNTER is a 2D side-scrolling Soulslike action game that puts your timing to the ultimate test. Master perfect parries to deflect enemy strikes and challenge a relentless boss rush. Every battle tests your skill, precision, and courage. Will you rise to counter every attack?

title: Runebook
description: Runebook is an AI story game where you become the protagonist of a living story. Tell the Storyteller what you do next—choose a suggestion, type anything, or say it aloud—and the world responds. Characters remember how you treated them, clues and relationships persist, and each story builds toward an ending shaped by your choices.

title: Duet Night Abyss: Paradise Prelude
description:
Paradise Prelude is the sixth major release (version 1.5) of Duet Night Abyss.

This update includes:
• New characters: Ada
• New weapons: The Best Day, Obsidian Heart-Reaper, Sovereign Ember
• New quests: What Do You Live For, Zen and the Art of Locomotive Maintenance, Behind the Curtains, A Portrait of Guilt, The Fall of Phaethon

As well as new demon wedges, events, other content updates, optimizations, and bug fixes.

title: Dust Bunny Simulator
description: You are a dust bunny under the couch. You don't move — the world moves you. Grow from a speck into a Dust Monster while dodging the one true predator: the Roomba. A cozy, gloriously helpless idle sim.

title: Cata-Bomb
description: Pinball game by where you use cat bombs to defeat bosses but the bombs explode in 30 seconds if they don't hit anything.

title: CookieRun: Crumble - Idle RPG
description: CookieRun: Crumble is a lighthearted idle strategy RPG from Devsisters that expands the beloved CookieRun universe into effortless, large-scale tactical battles.

title: Victor Space Program
description: A first-person voxel survival crafting game. Land on a strange new planet, dig up what you need, build better tools, watch out for the wildlife, and put together the rocket that takes you home.

title: Dog of Wisdom
description: Dog of Wisdom is a 2D action platformer where you play as Pepper the dachshund. Fly around barking at nothing and sample the galaxy's best foods, all while attaining the knowledge to be good. Get the foods and the wisdom and the hat and the galaxy.

title: Conquest: Global Domination
description:
Conquer the world through strategy, diplomacy, and military power.
Build your nation. Expand your empire. Dominate the globe.

title: Polygon Mayhem
description: Polygon Mayhem is an addictive puzzle game that challenges your spatial reasoning and reflexes. Navigate through complex geometric levels, solve intricate puzzles, and dominate the leaderboard.

title: Cristal Absoluto
description: A F2P Indie Roleplaying Game, Discover its story about crystals and old universal beings.

title: Heroes of Hammerwatch II: Celestial Ruins
description: Take up the holy duties of the new Priest class and brave a fallen sanctum in the Celestial Ruins Expansion for Heroes of Hammerwatch II.

title: Snayk 3+
description: Higher dimensional snake with gradients and many options, who can beat a megadimension?

title: Pastor
description:
Pastor is a short atmospheric horror experience combining elements of a walking simulator, psychological thriller, and visual demo.

Originally created for a game jam that never took place, the project was later completed and released as an ultra-indie title. It was developed almost entirely by one person, with additional voice acting and several 3D models contributed by members of the developer’s community, all credited in the game.

Expect a small, experimental experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and unsettling events rather than complex gameplay.

title: Drive Horizon Story
description: How far can you drive before the desert finally defeats you?

title: Whack-A-Monster
description: Whack-A-Monster. An incremental game about Whacking, Smashing, Splashing & BONKING monsters. Upgrade through the skill tree and unlock new weapons to vanquish all evil from this world.

title: Minimate
description: Solve puzzles with a chess board that sits in the corner of your screen. Challenge yourself to difficult puzzles, unlock streaks, and customize your board. Idle away and your chess buddy will always be there to help you practice.

title: Truck Parking Simulator 2026
description: Accuracy defines the driver

title: Aisle Survive
description:
Aisle Survive is a retail rogue-like, a deli-crawling dystopia and a supermarket survivor like no other. The customers will crush you. The banana skins are baying for your blood. Finish the job before the job finishes you.

Survive a week at the last human-run store in Mech City. Melee, multi-task and manage your stress to meet your boss' crushing standards - and stop the revolution.

title: Nibble Quest
description: A collectathon 3D platformer featuring a hungry capybara in search of legendary snacks.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Goryeo Pack
description: The Goryeo civilization is now available in Sid Meier's Civilization VII as part of the Brush and Blade Collection DLC!

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Joseon Pack
description: The Joseon civilization is now available in Sid Meier's Civilization VII as part of the Brush and Blade Collection DLC!

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Yi Sun-sin Pack
description: The leader Yi Sun-sin is now available in Sid Meier's Civilization VII as part of the Brush and Blade Collection DLC!

title: Monster Storm
description:
You are the bullet hell.

Fight back against an overwhelming storm of monsters in this 2D top-down multiplayer reverse bullet hell, where you unleash screen-filling chaos while struggling to survive ever-escalating enemy hordes.

Dive into procedurally generated levels, build absurdly powerful characters, and push your skills, talents, and weapons to their limits. Every run is different. Every mistake is deadly. Every victory feels earned.

Whether you’re flying solo or surviving together, the storm never stops coming.

title: Paironix
description: A fast-paced, rogue-lite tile-matching adventure! Connect identical pairs to unleash powerful magic spells, adapt to shifting grids, and draft game-changing upgrades. Can you survive the ever-evolving trials in this striking minimalist vector world?

title: Scream Note
description: Jumpscare your friends. If you write your friend's name on a page, the monster jumpscares them and they scream. Co-op comedy horror where you and your friends are trapped in a haunted neighborhood house. Can you reach the exit together, or will you scare each other out? 222 unique, crazy jumpscares!

title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2: Fresh Start Suit and Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Suit
description:
It's a Brand New Day for Marvel's Spider-Man 2! ️

Get TWO NEW SUITS for Peter Parker in today's update, including the Fresh Start and the Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls suits.

title: Hamster, Eat, Run
description: This is a casual strategy game about being a hamster on your first escape. To survive out there, you must learn to efficiently gather energy from food and upgrade hoarding level to gain new survival tricks. Fail, you'll have no choice but to be a house pet again!

title: The Kuon Island Nursery Rhyme Murders: Case Notes
description: A storm-lashed island, a nursery rhyme that foretells death, seven prodigies, serial murders, modern locked-room mysteries, classic locked-room mysteries, astrology, a jigsaw of flesh and blood, a survivor—and one lie told only so you would see this story.

title: We Were Here Before
description: The frontier does not want to be settled. A narrative highly replayable story game where your choices build a settlement, shape its story, and seal its fate. Every run ends. Every obituary tells a story only you lived.

title: Bloodwright
description: Descend through deadly procedural dungeons, claim powerful loot, and decide how deep you're willing to risk it all in this dark fantasy action RPG roguelite.

title: Incremental Retro Racing
description: Earn more and more stars by driving faster and faster in Incremental Retro Racing. Accumulate and unlock 70+ vehicles, upgrades, track generation options, and more. Includes unlimited tracks and customizable CRT filter for that old school retro feel.

title: Dissolution of the Silent Union
description: Dissolution of the Silent Union is a short, narrative-driven visual novel where you accompany Vera, who is trapped on the last day of school, toward her inevitable date.

title: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
description: Incremental style tower-defense game where you face tens of thousands of orcs.

title: EverQuest Legends
description: Step back into Norrath in EverQuest Legends, a reimagined take on the original 1999 EverQuest experience. Designed for solo and casual players, EQL features powerful multiclass characters, iconic races, classic zones, nostalgic visuals, and modern quality-of-life improvements. Legends begin here!

title: Zwamman
description: Zwamman is a zero pressure single screen puzzle game in which you have to use your light to help Zwamman find crystals in dark forests and swamps. Use the crystals to light a path to Zwamman's home and reveal the true nature of the scary monsters!

title: Space Imperia 4X
description: A faithful digital adaptation of the acclaimed board game Space Empires 4X by GMT Games, beloved by wargamers for almost two decades. Command the rise of your civilization and the fall of others, all in one to two hours.

title: E-Shop Tycoon
description: E-Shop Tycoon is an isometric online shopping company management game. Fill your warehouses, take orders, hire employees, expand and design your offices. Protect your site against hackers, improve your reputation on social media. Become the best online shopping company in the world!

title: Nulla Via
description: NULLA VIA is a WW2 psychological horror set in a preserved, abandoned war town. Explore silent ruins, bunkers, and mass graves where life was erased. Shadows cannot be killed by bullets alone. Use your camera, your weapons, and your sanity to survive. This town was never rebuilt for a reason.

title: Come Out Guys
description: Get ready for a chaotic chase for 2-8 players! Experience high tension FPS Parkour Hide and Seek with tiny characters in a giant environment. Climb, jump, hide, and shoot to surprise your friends. Escaping and chasing have never been this exciting!

title: Spellsy
description: A cozy-but-clever word puzzle game where every move counts. Plan your path, chain tile effects, and clear the board in as few turns as possible. No timers, no pressure, just pure puzzlin’.

title: Where We Used to Play
description: A first-person psychological horror game focused on observation, anomaly detection, and meaningful choices that lead to multiple endings inside a house filled with forgotten memories.

title: Skyward Bastion
description: Skyward Bastion is a tower defense roguelite set on floating islands. Build and upgrade your defenses, survive endless waves of enemies, and explore procedurally expanding maps under a living day-night cycle.

title: Suncraft
description: Another sun-filled day begins in this cozy pixel-art adventure. Gather resources, craft items, and upgrade tools to expand the land. Can you rebuild the grand Lighthouse and bring the village back to its golden days?

title: Saved by the Coupon
description: Your salary is gone, and payday is still a whole month away. Open your phone, pinch every penny, and make the most of every food delivery coupon. Can you survive until the next payday?

title: Augmented Fear
description:
Augmented Fear is a horror puzzle game set in a dark and oppressive cyberpunk universe.
Trapped in a mysterious district, you must find a way out and survive against aggressive creatures.
Use augmented reality to uncover the secrets hidden within.

title: Halo: Campaign Evolved
description: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign. Experience the original story rebuilt with high-definition visuals, updated cinematics, and refined controls, plus three brand-new prequel missions featuring the Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson. A broader arsenal of weapons, vehicles, enemies, and gameplay-modifying “Skulls” – optional modifiers that change combat in fun and challenging ways – add fresh tactics and endless replayability.

title: Proton & Electron
description: Play as Dr. Proton and Electron in a world of Electromagnetism, where two must collaborate to solve puzzles and restore their broken world.

title: Convent Chronicles: Revelation
description: A visual novel that combines religious themes from Catholicism with anime inspired drama and visuals.

title: Heartdust
description:
HEARTDUST is a horror online PvP/Co-op hero shooter with up to 4 players set inside a cursed retro videogame.

Your childhood friend texted you after realizing that the servers for HEARTDUST, a game you both used to play as children, have misteriously reopened 15 years after their closure. You decide to play together one more time, but something ghastly is awaiting inside.

title: Bonehold
description: Dungeon Crawler with elements of rogue-like and ARPG games. Kill hordes of enemies, duel mighty bosses, and acquire legendary loot!

title: My Infamous Dungeon
description:
It's time to be evil. Build and master your dungeon, hire despicable monsters, and rise to conquer the overworld. Gaze from below as your dark tendrils creep across the land, snatching treasures from the forces of good and funding an ever growing empire. But beware! Saint Million the Hero King and his table of royal knights are always watching. Leave your dungeon weak, and a single cleave from the hero's sword will end your reign.

My Infamous Dungeon is a roguelite dungeon builder. Take time to carefully plan your dungeon, then protect it against waves of greedy heroes.

title: Island Beekeeper
description: Build your apiary on islands above the clouds, travel on your medocycle, crossbreed bees with unique traits and create a cozy home in the sky. Grow plants, explore islands and send healing honey down to Earth, where people still hope for your help.

title: Shards of Order
description: A grim RPG with card-based combat where nothing stays dead. Lead a party of survivors through a world undone by shattered Laws. Restore them and reshape the rules of the game—but be ready to face the consequences.

title: Ispell
description: Ispell is a shoot'em up & bullet hell game where you take on the role of a nameless android who wanders through the dying worlds. Use various weapons and dodge enemy bullets, as well as challenge powerful creatures.

title: Chemical Combat
description: A chemistry-themed roguelike in which you fight your way through procedurally generated dungeons, splashing enemies with highly reactive potions.

title: My Lil Afterlife
description: Become the new ruler of the afterlife. Summon spooky friends to reside in your unearthly realm and decorate it however you like with items you can craft, buy and find. Unravel the mysteries of the afterlife by taking on the reapers tower using spine-tingling spells to smite your enemies.

title: Slot & Dungeons
description: "Slot & Dungeons” is a deck-building roguelite in which the placement of enemies and items on the floor changes depending on the slots. While developing your character, collect symbols along the way to enhance the contents of the slots and conquer the dungeon.

title: Conjurers
description:
Defeat the Conjurers. Take their constellations. Conquer the Zodiac.
A classic turn-based tactics game where deckbuilding lets players summon Zodiac creatures and hybrids, then steal new constellations by defeating rival Conjurers. Will you become powerful enough to face the Immortal Aquarius?

title: Go North
description: Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and immersive maze adventure!

title: Sinned Arena
description: Sinned Arena is a classic arena shooter inspired by timeless 90s games. You are trapped in Hell with other unfortunate souls, fighting among each other for demons twisted pleasures. Fight for your way out this dark place but beware, demons aren't there just to watch.

title: Roll The Bones
description: Select spell-dice for your loadout, roll them and wreak absolute havoc! This high-paced pixelart roguelite will let you build unique loadouts with extremely interactable spells. Let's roll some bones!

title: Realms and Ruins: Abencor
description: Realms & Ruins: Abencor is a first-person, grid-based, open world, retro, pixel art dungeon crawler harkening back to the days of yore. Realms & Ruins takes inspiration from games like Wizardry and Might & Magic and other cRPG's of the 90's.

title: The Fall of Zorata
description: Free Lovecraftian first-person puzzle game, 20~30 min linear story. Explore an underground palace, collect ritual items, and trigger a golden relic through chain puzzles—never touch it yourself. Includes 12 achievements, 3 save slots, 7 languages, and a full ending cinematic.

title: Kill-All Go!
description: Have you ever played Go (or Weiqi, or Baduk, or whatever you want to call it)? Cool! Have you ever played it with your life on the line? No better time to start than now! Collect upgrades, puzzle through rounds, and... wait, is this another indie dev team making a roguelike?

title: Block Wars: Falling Duel
description: A competitive falling-block puzzle game with online PvP, tactical line clearing, boosters, stone blocks, lightning symbols, and fast 1v1 matches.

title: Water Drop Brick Breaker
description: A fresh take on the classic brick breaker! Control a water drop ball through 1000 levels of exciting challenges. Packed with power-ups, cool skins, and constellation-themed stages — every round brings something new. Free to play, easy to relax.

title: Rockets.com
description:
Welcome to ROCKets.com, where we dream big and ROCK hard!

...that's what the ROCKets.com website used to say before their space rocket Flying V crashed onto the company headquarters, killing everyone inside.

You're the inspector tasked with investigating what chain of events led to that terrible tragedy. Dig through the emails, put names to the faces, and find out exactly what went wrong.

The report is due on Friday. Good luck!

title: Okaa-san
description: This is a Japanese horror, puzzle-solving, walking simulator.Your mother suddenly collapses right in front of you. Save her.You only have two actions to change her fate. Search for clues hidden throughout the house, piece together the truth, and try again and again to reach the happy ending.

title: The Faraway King
description: A narrative adventure with exploration and visual novel elements. Join J.D. on a journey through the nation of Yoom to find the mythical figure known as the Faraway King and rid himself of his supposed curse. But should J.D. trust his bizarre companion, Zxtabella?

title: Abyssal Soul
description: Abyssal Soul is a sequential card battle Roguelike game that blends strategic deck-building, multi-class progression, and Western fantasy art style, delivering a profound adventure centered on "sacrifice and choice." You will select characters, plan routes, collect cards and blessings through repeated "rituals," while confronting the anomalies lurking in the depths of dreams.

title: Ticket to Nowhere
description:
Enjoy your movie... if you can ever reach the theater.

You just wanted to catch a late-night screening, but you find yourself trapped in a strangely empty cinema corridor. The lights hum, the posters stare back at you, and the only way out is the elevator at the end of the hall. But memory is a fragile thing, and this place loves to play tricks on your mind.

Ticket to Nowhere is a psychological anomaly observation game where your eyes—and your ears—are your only lifeline.

title: Office Keeper
description: 5-to-10-minute score-attack cleaning with a spooky twist. Clean an abandoned office while evading a creepy "Entity." Vacuum and wipe away randomized dust, watching filth vanish right where it's traced. Secure the target score and report back to finish the shift!

title: Slime Jump
description: Master precise jumps, climb ever higher, and race against the clock in this challenging precision platformer. Every jump matters, can you reach the top and earn every speed achievement?

title: Office Ladies
description: Get Safe for Work with six inspirational HR managers in this interactive Human Resources Training Program

title: Alphabetto's
description: Roguelite letter-deckbuilder. The characters of the great classics sit at your table. Chain, sign and mutate letters from a deck shared by every player — every card you add arms your rival as much as you. Unlock the works line by line.

title: Ducks in Disguise
description: Ducks in Disguise is a cozy hand-drawn hidden object game where you find hundreds of hidden rubber ducks in intricate 2D illustrations and collect them in your personal scrapbook.

title: Rubber Duck Survival
description: Rubber Duck Survival is a 2D survival game where you control a rubber duck and face over 30 bosses plus 1 secret boss. Unlock skins, defeat challenging bosses, and face waves of enemies. Can you overcome the challenge?

title: Void Noir
description:
The internet never sleeps. Neither do its mysteries.

Welcome to Void Noir, a cozy detective investigation game where every case is generated from real live Twitch stream metadata.

You are not browsing Twitch.

You are not watching streams.

You are a detective.

Each investigation begins at your desk as rain falls outside your office window. A fresh case file slides onto your monitor containing only a handful of clues.

A category.

A language.

Maybe a viewer count.

Maybe part of a title.

Maybe how long they've been live.

Using those clues, you'll investigate the live internet to identify the correct broadcaster before closing another case.

Every investigation is different because every investigation comes from actual live Twitch streams happening right now.

No handcrafted mysteries.

No scripted solutions.

The internet creates the cases.

You solve them.

title: Capybara Pizza Cafe
description: Manage a cozy cafe run by Capybaras, for Capybaras. Bake pizzas, serve pizzas, clean tables and ring that cash register!

title: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator: Heavy South
description:
New challenges for the south - hauling heavy cargo through the mountains!

The “Heavy South” DLC offers you a particularly extensive expansion of the map into the southern part of the game world, effectively doubling the overall size of the map. It also introduces a wide range of challenging new handcrafted missions, exciting new cargo types, new delivery locations, and matching brand-new trailers. Towing vehicles that block your route is a new route mission added to the game. Master the many new missions, enjoy the breathtaking mountain atmosphere, and take on new challenges in heavy and super-heavy haulage.

title: Cosdarica's Journey at the End of the World
description: Human civilization had finally burned out its last spark. The survivors chose to gather together, shutting themselves within safe zones to await death. But Cosdarica did not. Neither did I.

title: No Socks RPG
description: Fight groovy enemies, and recruit a team of sexy, cute and quirky Monster Girls to get your fits back!

title: Tachyon Fire
description: Tachyon Fire is a hectic movement-focused arena shooter that pits you against an army of surreal mechanical creatures in a nightmarish dreamscape. Ski, slide, and launch yourself through the air while tearing apart the horde with unlimited firepower and a magic hammer.

title: Moon Miner
description: Drill into a dead moon, haul glowing ore, sell your load, and upgrade your mole-bot for the next risky descent. A compact mining adventure inspired by Motherload and I Dig It, with cozy progression, dangerous depths, and something alive below.

title: The Political Simulator
description: Create a candidate and run a Presidential campaign across the United States. Improve your approval rating with battleground voters and try to earn enough support to win on election night. The campaign mode allows you to take part in a turn-based strategic campaign where every decision matters.

title: Unsent
description: Trapped in a loop within old apartment, the only way out is to confront deliberately forgotten memories. Under the chilling atmosphere, you must confront the manifestations of your trauma, and decide the fate of a fractured bond. Every clue matters; every choice leads to a different redemption.

title: Alice's Night at the Mansion
description: Three eccentric ghosts have kidnapped Alice's dog, Dinah! Help Alice free her dog, solve the mysteries of Monster Mansion, and make the annual Monster Party a success in this hand-drawn, point-and-click-inspired comedy adventure!

title: Terra Invicta: Dark Skies
description: Face the alien invasion in two new scenarios for Terra Invicta. Drop into a world shattered by nuclear fire a century ago, or rewind to 2003 and trade the rush to the stars for a slower fight on Earth.

title: Unbeatable: The Jamie Paige Content Companion
description:
Introducing The Jamie Paige Content Companion DLC - a full on collaborative project with hit vocal synth producer Jamie Paige! Upgrade Arcade Mode with a dose of new originals, fan-favorite tracks, playable characters, and all new challenges.

Unbeatable - The Jamie Paige Content Companion DLC includes:
Four brand new originals exclusive to Unbeatable, made in collaboration between the D-Cell Sound Team and Jamie P.

Two additional remixes with Jamie-P's "I Wish That I Could Fall" and Unbeatable's "Sleeping In", plus an exclusive cover of エビチャーハン! sung by Quaver (Holly Earl).

Plus a multitude of additional tracks, leading to a total of 12(?) songs.

Two Playable New Characters: Jamie Paige (she's real!), and Chef Quaver (she's frying some rice)

Two New Stages: The Apple Orchard (based on Birdbrain), and Wrestling Arena (based on :women_wrestling:). Plus, enjoy music video backgrounds for Birdbrain, Rot for Clout, and Machine Love!

New DLC-Exclusive Challenge Folio included with the DLC, featuring unlocks for additional Arcade Mode titles, menu palettes, end game Star charts, and...

No secrets.

title: Imouto Paradise! 2
description: An all-ages version of Imouto Paradise! 2

title: BonkCity
description: BonkCity is a 90s hip-hop horde survivor roguelike. Playing as an MC defending your block, you survive waves of posers, record label security, and label muscle across a procedurally chaotic back-alley night. Move and auto-attack while drafting weapons and perks from level-up cards, evolve maxed weapons into powerful combos, and earn "drip" — cosmetic gear that stacks into real stats. Each run climbs toward a three-phase showdown with the Industry Plant, a manufactured fake MC built to replace the cypher. Features a shared Daily Block seed with leaderboards, four playable characters (more to come), and challenge modifiers called Beefs. Built solo in Godot, drawing DNA from Vampire Survivors and Brotato with the color and soul of Jet Set Radio and Streets of Rage.

title: Storytime Cats: A Day at the Park
description: Storytime Cats – A Day At The Park is a hidden object game where you’ll search for hundreds of hidden cats scattered throughout a cozy park. The only thing they're missing is their favorite hooman. Can you find and pet them all?

title: Tyrania Enforcers
description: Faced with evil... would you pull the trigger? Tyrania Enforcers is a story-driven visual novel exploring morality, duty, and the cost of enforcing order in a world on the brink of conflict.

title: Scrap Yard Idle
description: Build your own scrap empire in this incremental idle game. Collect, process, and automate your production chain while optimizing resources and scaling your industrial system.

title: Behind The Walls
description: A first-person puzzle adventure where you explore a secret place, solve mysteries, and uncover the dark truth hidden behind the walls.

title: Office Leveling
description: Office Leveling is a management game about secretly playing a minimalist clicker at work without getting caught. As you level up, you must complete office tasks, deal with coworkers dropping by with requests, and solve small puzzles to stay under the radar.

title: Bounce Forever
description: Bounce from the backyard to the clouds in this punishing vertical climber. The only thing faster than the climb is the fall. Bounce forever and you might just reach the top.

title: Nightmare Hospital
description: To cure a strange illness, you come to a bizarre hospital that seems abandoned. Someone tells you she can find a doctor, but you have to help her with some tasks first, such as taking some photos of the hospital's corpses. As things progress, you discover more abnormalities.

title: Forever Skies: The Final Echoes Update
Spell Knight
description: Descend into the dark abyss and wipe out endless hordes of monsters. Wield powerful weapons as a magic knight and enjoy the thrill of rapid growth.

title: Spheroll
description: Spheroll is a 3D rolling ball platformer. Balance the ball and feel every roll and jump between platforms.

title: Stop and Smell the Flowers
description: Relax in your shady garden and watch the flowers. Plant flowers, earn money, expand your garden, and trace the evolution chart to complete your collection.

title: Null Root
description: A roguelite incremental game about protecting a network by destroying the invading nodes, collecting the loot and customizing your build with new skills.

title: Infinite Ruins
description: An incremental mining game where you manage golems, destroy blocks, unlock upgrades, and descend infinitely in search of ever more valuable resources.

title: Tile Trials
description: Tile Trials is a tile-placing, number based puzzle game for the casual strategist. Place a variety of familiar shapes onto increasingly difficult layouts to maximize your score and surpass each level threshold. Iterative gameplay, mind bending challenges, and hand-crafted puzzles await!

title: Kinny and the Cosmic Cauldron
description: Cook or be cooked! In this cosmic deck-building roguelike, ingredients crash, merge, and react in chaotic ways. As the witch chef of Stewpendous Spoons, craft the perfect stew, master strategic combos, and satisfy bizarre patrons—before you end up in the cauldron yourself!

title: Skills & Raids
description: A party-based RPG with real-time, ability driven combat. Manage cooldowns and react to enemy mechanics. Loot and extract resources to complete quests and craft powerful gear. The world has fallen into the grasp of a corruption spreading creature. Combine skills to create unique builds.

title: Streetlight Syndicate
description: A casual, story-driven incremental game set in 1920s New York. Build your criminal empire from speakeasies to protection rackets, fight rival hitmen, meet colorful characters, and become the city's most powerful crime lord.

title: Bobanook!
description: A relaxing, idle boba-shop simulator that can accompany you as you work on other things. Sell boba tea, unlock new drinks, and customize and care for a boba pet that lives in the corner of your screen!

title: Utopia: Birth of The Heroes
description:
Utopia: Birth of the Heroes is a character‑driven fantasy visual novel about conviction, sacrifice, and the price of protecting those who matter most.

The story follows three distinct protagonists, each driven by a different vision of a perfect society. They’ll navigate hardship, political tension, and morally charged decisions. Every perspective reveals a different truth, and every “hero” believes that what they are doing is right and just.

title: Moon Crashers
description: Moon Crashers is a 4-player online co-op game. Crash-land on the lunar surface with your squad, drift across craters, scavenge junk & rare minerals, uncover ancient ruins, build your ride, and rocket back home. Think you can make it home?

title: Pigmen's Challenge
description: Two Piggies in one wild restaurant. Chaos, pressure, panic — served fresh!

title: Mothiary
description: Collect and raise hundreds of delicate moths in your cozy nighttime terrarium. Discover rare species, grow your collection, and unwind in a relaxing idle sanctuary.

title: Orbital
description:
Orbital is an outer space, endless survival, arcade game where players become planetary pilots to prolong the inevitable grasp of a super massive blackhole, witnessing the collapse of the solar system. Navigate the cosmic perils and chaos, deploying specialised planetary tech to endure the onslaught and ascend the galactic leaderboard.

Adapt your strategy with each mission and push your endurance further with every attempt.

title: Backfire Brigade
description: Backfire Brigade is a chaotic couch co-op firefighting game for two to four players. Coordinate with your fellow firefighters to rescue victims trapped in burning buildings while extinguishing the flames.

title: VectaGuard
description: Arcade-inspired shmup action where neon vector caverns explode with modern visuals, dynamic music, weapon upgrades and intense score chasing.

title: Plum Road Tea Dream
description: Plum Road Tea Dream tells the semi-autobiographical story of 'S', a young game designer who creates virtual sanctuaries that reflect their own introspective journey out of need for safe havens, new rituals and space for grief.

title: Graphite
description: Unleash your creativity as a kid’s drawings spring to life in this thrilling roguelike RPG. Build your party, navigate a dynamic timeline, and shape your fate through notebook scenarios that test your team in a world where the heroes don’t know they’re imaginary.

title: GunBang
description: GunBang is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you face off hordes of enemies and bosses. Choose from a variety of weapons, traits and items to create unique builds and survive until observers are satisfied!

title: Prelude Dark Pain
description: Prelude Dark Pain is a Tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ash Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.

title: The Left Behind
description: The Left Behind is a solo and co-op post-apocalyptic survival game. Explore an overgrown open world at day time and beware of enemies coming in at night. Salvage, hunt and build your way through this world to survive. How long will you survive?

title: Dwarf Delve
description: In this first-person extraction roguelite adventure, strap on your gloves, grab your Battlemallet, and explore randomly-generated mines as a new Delveling. Gather riches, avoid deadly hazards and try to make it out with your beard intact!

title: Ariokan
description: Ariokan is the online collectible card game where you can create new (and balanced) official cards to invent new combos and break the "Meta". No floodgates, no 10-minutes turns, no pay-to-win. Generated cards can be unlocked by other players, contributing to an ever-growing library of cards!

title: Broken Reality 2000
description: The sequel to everyone's favorite single-player adventure set on the internet about our digital lives.

title: Endacopia
description: Endacopia is a nontraditional point-and-click adventure game. Guide a lost child named Mellow through a world governed by unfamiliar rules. Relying on his strong gut instinct and your guidance as his guardian angel, Mellow must overcome obstacles in search of a place to call home.

title: Dystopicon
description:
In Dystopicon the players will live in a dystopian society in which they receive money in exchange to watch TV. With that money they pay services to cover their basic needs. Throughout the game they will discover the details of this dystopia in which the government monitors your movements but gives you freedom of choice.

The story will be told through gameplay, texts and comics. Take your time to explore the different objects and the mechanics in your first day.

title: Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call
description: Adventure awaits in this narrative driven fantasy action-RPG. The war-torn city of Vahrin stands before you on the brink of collapse and in desperate need of aid. As a mercenary in search of your next…opportunity, will you answer Vahrin’s Call?

title: Mahou Arms
description: Mahou Arms is an anime-inspired character-action hack and slash that tells the story of a magical girl paramilitary group fighting back against an alien invasion.

title: Amazing Trip to Europe 4: Search for Cats - Collector's Edition
Meikyu
description: Meikyu is a free daily deduction game played in the browser. Each day, the dungeon hides a five-resident lineup drawn from a cast of thirty-six. You have six sorties to identify the cast and place everyone in the right slot.

title: GodWright
description: Sculpt a tiny pixel world, seed it with life, and watch civilizations rise on their own. Kingdoms war, trade, and crown kings; dynasties fall to rebellion; whole ages turn. A cozy god-game sandbox where the story isn't scripted — it's discovered. No goals, no clock. Just a tiny world that lives.

title: What Happened to Squad 7
description: What happened to Squad 7 is a military visual novel where you will decide the outcome of the world, what members of the cast live and die, and Orion, the Frontman of Squad 7 which you play as. Will you follow orders? Or will you dig deeper beyond what you're given clearance?

title: I Was Seen as the Weakest Hero But I Can Secretly Edit the Metadata of the World?!?
description: I Was Seen as the Weakest Hero But I Can Secretly Edit the Metadata of the World?!? is a minimalist word-editing game where players trim sentences down to their essentials while keeping them grammatically correct. Each scene presents a short paragraph, and your goal is to remove words until the sentence fits a strict word count, though the real challenge lies in how those omissions reshape the story. With absurd twists like bribing a horse, the game rewards creative editing, letting you craft wildly different outcomes from the same starting text.

title: Escape from Vacov
description: A deceptive 2D platformer where the system wants you banned. Fake floors, vanishing platforms, and traps that wait for one wrong jump. Run. Jump. Trust nothing. Escape Vacov before it locks you out.

title: Broken Depths RPG
description:
You are Ari, a treasure hunter seeking riches in the depths.
What you didn't know is that this cave is cursed.
Can you make it to floor 30?

title: Mixolydia Fringes
description: Halt its ascension. Explore the lands through death to ascertain the way, they will hide their riches from those who take the trodden path. Be sure to find your way there before too long. Dethrone the Good King.

title: Mighty Moth and the Horrible, Terrible, Awful, No-Good Day!
description:
Save the day and save your date, one punch at a time!

You’re Mighty Moth, hero of the universe, defender of Cecropolis and helpless romantic! After saving your crush for the millionth time, you finally score a dinner date for 8:00PM. But your excitement is cut short, as the nefarious Shocked Cult has broken into your base and stolen all the galactic gifts you gathered for your date!

Help Mighty Moth beat up cultists, recover her gifts and get to her date before the risotto gets cold!

title: CarMarket
description:
Collect, trade and build the ultimate car empire in Car Market!

Start with a simple clicker, earn cash, buy mystery boxes and unlock over 1,000+ unique cars ranging from common city cars to ultra-rare prestige hypercars. Will you pull a common or a mythic car?

Simple to pick up, impossible to put down. How big will your garage get?

title: Frenfield
description: Descend Dracula's castle to go cheer him up!

title: Time Thief
description: Traverse through the magic dungeon and steal the sacred vial containing the embodiment of the tides of time to attain immortality... only then can you find the door to escape.

title: Tumble in the Deep Noon
description: Play as a tumbleweed in the final 8 seconds of a western film. Satisfy the order (critics) and chaos (audience). A short game about charisma.

title: Deathmate
description: DEATHMATE is a chess-themed roguelike deckbuilder. Build an army of pieces, stack a deck full of moves, and battle your way across the map towards the Grim Reaper.

title: Short Fuse
description: Short Fuse is a minimalist logic puzzle about timing detonations perfectly. Each bomb has a timer. Drag its fuse out, cover every tile on the grid with no overlaps, hit ignite, and watch the whole chain play out.

title: Boingus' Big Day
description: Keep ahead of the clock in this gauntlet of wacky mini-games.

title: Der Böse Mann
description:
An action packtion thriller with horror elements. Its a jump and run because you jump and run. You need to survive until your deadly laser is charged and then kill the evil man. But don't get hit by the hands or his little minios.

This game was made for the GMTK GameJam 2026

title: Bomb-Time Job
description: Defuse the bomb before it explodes! Compete for the highest score!

title: Catterplosion
description: Help Wiggle The Galaxy Swallower of Eternal Despair make his childrens become butterflys ! Place bombs and set their countdowns to explode Wiggle's childs into the magic ring of butterfly transformation.

title: Brief Offerings
description: Gather resources until a countdown ends and then battle your way through a bullet hell.

title: Bomberful!
description: Welcome, interns, to the Bomberful company! In this game, assemble bomb parts on a grid, manage space to increase your score, and calibrate your unstable product by mixing chemicals and connecting wires.

title: Kairos
description: Kairos is a basic Asteroids-like game, where your objective is to kill enemies to collect more ammo and stay alive. Getting hit decreases Kairo's time, shortening your run!

title: Yggdrasil
description:
9 worlds, 9 colors, 9 puzzles to solve.

YGGDRASIL is a small 2D puzzle game about walking, exploring and finding your ways.

You wake up in a place you do not recognise, with buttons you do not know what they are for (yet), and not even recalling exactally what you are.

Every piece of information matters. There are no "quests" and no direct leads. You are on your own in YGGDRASIL.

title: Goobers
description: A collection of micro-games featuring some goobs.

title: Fair And Balanced
description: A Roguelike Autobattler game about creating monster towers, balance them, exploit strategies, think out of the box by placing everything where it's not supposed to be, and win in this totally fair and balanced game!

title: Voleur!
description: With a minute left in the Volouvre, Rion must dash around the museum to steal the remaining treasures before they get him... A Voleur in the Volouvre!!

title: Questionable Countdowns
description: A game about counting down and following instructions.

title: Glade and Ritual
description: Glade and Ritual is a cute and short story game with some Breakout-meets-Peggle style minigames. You play as a gnome who is in charge of a small village with various bug inhabitants. In the centre of the village a magic flower grows. Every night the villagers come together to perform a ritual and in return the magic flower protects the village. However the flower starts loosing it's petals once a day, leading to chaos and tension between the villagers.

title: The Count is Down for Blood
description: A puzzle game where you control a vampire trying to get to its crypt by dawn, but on the way through he will need to suck up enough blood from the townsfolk.

title: PolterDates
description: It's a short narrative game where you play as Dolores Delalma, a medium and matchmaker who has to pair souls.

title: Captcha Overload
description: You are trying to play a very cool countdown game, so you use an installer. However, the installer seems kinda weird...

title: So Perfect I Could Eat You Up
description:
A mini restaurant simulator where envy eats you alive...

Enchanting Elixirs has been in Marion's family for years now, and it's up to her to make this cafe the best it can be!!! At all costs. Help Marion manage Enchanting Elixirs and make it great again!!! Or don't.

title: DeepCroak
description:
DeepCroak is a puzzle game in which a very hungry little frog discovers a cave full of flies, and its goal is to eat them all!
On DeepCroak, you move across a grid filled with obstacles; the number of moves allowed is extremely limited, so be careful how you navigate.

title: Desert Picaroon
description: Your goal is to descend into an endless, procedurally generated tomb, killing monsters and collecting their treasures. But be warned: the tomb is cursed, and every time you descend to a new floor, it will begin to crumble! Hurry to find the artifact and escape before it’s too late! Buy upgrades and make your way through the increasingly difficult levels!

title: Erdetspill
description: Grandpa wants 2 ice creams. You have to get them. It turns out to be more complicated than you thought. An absurd first-person adventure game where you navigate Norwegian bureaucracy, talk to strange people and solve pointless quests - in a small Norwegian village.

title: Countdown to Eclipse
description:
An incremental cult management sim.
Tired of your old life, you take out a $70,000 loan to purchase a tiny church and begin your new ministry.

title: ¡Tú decides!
description: Are we good? Are we bad? You decide what people think now!

title: Clairval
description: Join the pack, enter the pact and impose your law in a game of cunning and suspicion. Here, words are your sharpest weapon or your deadliest weakness. Manipulate, accuse, survive. The truth has never been so elusive.

title: Locostation
description: Locostation is an incremental game. Drive a train, deliver cargo, fight off thieves and upgrade.

title: Ascension Trail
description: Kill, Die, Repeat! Exterminate massive swarms of monsters in this action-packed, top-down rogue-lite. Dash, hit, and cast through endless mobs where every death is a step toward god-tier power. Hoard coins, buy permanent upgrades, and craft a legendary hero to challenge the Devil on your own terms.

title: Astral-Battlecraft
description: 3D Rogue Game Space Battleship Rogue Game light Tactical System, Inertia System, Drift System DIY Weapons: Flexible weapon customization with independent cooldowns. Weapons can be destroyed.

title: Tiny Birdtopia
description: This is not Bird Game 3! Build and manage a relaxing bird sanctuary. Collect and raise diverse bird species, and unlock hidden species by gathering feathers. Customize your Birdtopia with themes like forests and islands, and watch your birds thrive in this casual, idle game.

title: The Grade 5B Case Files
description: A narrative AVG focused on everyday mysteries from the lives of elementary school students. The two protagonists encounter ordinary yet unusual incidents at school, and through investigation and deduction, players uncover the truth together with them.

title: Clicker Ore
description: Dig deeper! Break rocks, hire miners, and uncover endless treasures beneath the earth.

title: Level Down
description: Crashed in space, surrounded by collapsing floors, reach for the top...

title: Idylls of the Lunar Maria
description: Idylls of the Lunar Maria is a charming "match-3 builder" roguelite adventure. Chat with rats, defeat demons.

title: Sneaky Fishy
description: Sneaky Fishy is a 2D puzzle platformer where the player is a fish with legs whose goal is to disable an oil rig that polluted its home.

title: Blue Vector
description:
Blue Vector is a 2D platform shooter.

It features level-based progression where each new level introduces new mechanics and weapons, increases the difficulty, and brings tougher enemy waves.

title: 100 Dragon Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️‍

title: Smash Remix +Extra
description: Smash Remix +Extra is an community-driven extension for Smash Remix, the popular SSB64 rom hack. This expansion serves as a modular framework that allows players to inject additional fan-made characters, custom stages, and unique music tracks into the game. It operates via open-source Python scripts that compile these community assets into an expanded ROM file designed to run smoothly on modern emulators.

title: Onaka Game
description: Merge a variety of fat furries together to achieve bigger furries and a high score.

title: Dracula: Restless Legs Syndrome
description: The Count needs to suck up the blood of the maiden, but after a countdown ends, your last few moves will be repeated backwards.

title: Blast Dash
description: Run Fast Blast Everything

title: Farming Homestead
description: Build, grow, craft, and live your dream farm life in Farming Homestead, a cozy farming simulation game where every day brings new opportunities.

title: T7's Basics in Educational
description: Just don't make anything wrong with this game, because T7 will get angry and try to catch you if you make wrong answers with the ThinkPad...

title: Pocket Dinos
description: An incremental dino collection game where prehistoric stickers come to life. Hatch eggs, discover unique variants, build thriving habitats, and uncover powerful combinations to grow your fortune.

title: The Legend of Fireball: Beasts Edition
No Final Night: Protect the Sponk Can
description: You are the night guard protecting the last Sponk Energy can in the world, and three energy drink junkies will break into your office to steal it. Watch the cameras, slam the doors and burn your power wisely to survive from 12 AM to 6 AM. Every night is harder than the last. There is no final night.

title: Driving School Sim
description: Can you master every road and every challenge?

title: Castaway
description: Survive day and night on a small island in the middle of the ocean.

title: Tiny Train Adventures
description: Set off on a tiny train adventure! Build your railway and drive through the mountains in this cozy exploration adventure.

title: Jack Bonecroft 4
description: An outsider. A different world. A warrior who isn't finished yet. Lunara Mistwalker is thrust into a realm of secrets and ancient powers. Four kingdoms. One mission. Jack Bonecroft 4 is a story-driven action RPG. Based on true events witnessed during my business trip to this sector.

title: Code-Black
description: A First-Person Single-Player Zombie Survival game where you, Rugir J.z, live through the initial events of a mass zombie outbreak, shoot, kill, upgrade, explore. Do you think you can survive, or possibly escape…

title: Steel Heaven
description: Hack, slash, and dismember the undead in this first-person melee action game. Fight through an ever-changing labyrinth where every wrong turn makes enemies stronger. Three brutal weapons, six upgrade paths, and a Doom-style kill-to-survive loop. Get lost, get punished.

title: The Box is Alive
description: A physics-based comedy platformer where you tumble, roll, and flap your way through chaotic warehouse challenges as a living cardboard box.

title: Curse of The Lineage
description: Curse of the Lineage is an isometric puzzle roguelike where you navigate shifting grounds filled with lost souls, powerful charms and endless secrets. Unravel your bloodline’s dark past as you solve evolving puzzles and fight to break the family curse.

title: Nothing To Declare
description: Live the thrill of working for airport security! In a wholesome setting, weigh and scan bags, ask passengers questions, and if you are not convinced, search their luggage for dangerous items. It could be a bomb or an oddly shaped electronic device. Earn money and upgrade your workstation.

title: Yolk & Yonder
description: Help the hen collect her chicks! Move blocks, press buttons, crawl through pipes, and avoid spikes. But remember: the more babies you rescue, the more massive the mother hen becomes, blocking the passages in the next stages.

title: Astro Raiders
description: A retro-inspired arcade action game where you shoot, split, and dodge bouncing orbs across vibrant alien worlds. Grab power-ups, unlock characters, and climb the leaderboards as you battle through hundreds of increasingly challenging levels.

title: Lust Solitaire: Horny Cards
description: Play the world's favorite card game and unlock stunning 18+ content. Complete levels, collect gorgeous girl cards, reveal intimate photo sets, and enjoy steamy animated scenes. It's the perfect mix of strategy and pleasure. Train your brain and indulge your desires !

title: Kalpa: Cosmic Symphony - Fourth Forte Pack
description:
Introducing KALPA's fourth Forte series, Fourth Forte!
Enjoy a total of 10 fantastic tracks, including 1 original song.

title: Hidden Legacy: Whispering Walls - Collector's Edition
description: Investigate a cursed mansion and a city built on lies. Solve hidden-object puzzles and uncover the truth behind a vanished architect.

title: Tiny Block: One Block Skyblock
description: Tiny Block is a 2D sandbox survival crafting game in which players start from a single block and expand a procedurally generated world. Players mine and place blocks, craft tools and items, grow plants, explore caves and biomes, and combine discoveries to create new materials and creatures. The game supports solo play and cooperative multiplayer with public worlds or invite codes.
Click digits to subtract them by one. Rule 1: All dots must be enclosed by walls. Rule 2: Walled-off zones cannot be empty. Rule 3: Each zone must contain an equal number of dots.

title: Dream Grove Gardens: First Shift
description: A top down RPG for Gameboy about a grub's first day as an employee at the greatest theme park in the world, Dream Grove Gardens!

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Okgyecheon
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Brush Hour
description: Race against the clock to copy a mini masterpiece, but you can only use primary colours; you must mix these to create any secondary colours.

title: Mad Taxi Simulator
description: Please rate your trip!

title: Minecraft Matcha Flavoured
description: Matcha Flavoured is a datapack designed to reward casual players who don't enjoy making mob farms, or engaging in the technical aspects of minecraft. The goal being for casual players, who like to play slowly, to be able to gather the same amount of resources technical players do in the same amount of time.

title: Conqueror's Blade: Three Kingdoms
description: Conqueror's Blade: Three Kingdoms is an open-world action war game blending hero combat and troop command. Lead legendary armies alongside allies to siege cities and claim vital resources. Forge alliances, crush rival factions, and seize the realm with steel and strategy!

title: Once Upon a Throne of Thorns
description: A dark fantasy boys' love / yaoi visual novel about an assassin who falls for the runaway prince he has been entasked with killing.

title: Zoo Protocol
description: Zoo Protocol is a co-op sci-fi horror game where you and your team are assigned to an abandoned alien industrial complex run by a malfunctioning corporate system. Care for dangerous anomalous creatures, prepare nutritional mixtures, process waste into energy, repair failing machinery, and meet ever-growing production quotas. Explore the facility, uncover the fate of the previous shift, and fight to escape before the system decides you're no longer needed.

title: Overtime
description:
it's an apocalyptic future where blood-hungry monsters run rampant, and in these dire situations you have to do whatever it takes in order to survive, even if it means going down one of the most physically and emotionally taxing paths out there: the fast food industry.

in "overtime.", you're put to work as a delivery boy for a multi-million dollar fast food chain and it's your job to fend off the horde, upgrade your arsenal, and power your way through 5 levels and 30 stages to hopefully earn enough money to escape back to normal civilization, or be kicked back into the streets to rot. and you don't want that, so GET TO WORK.

title: Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame
description: Discover sunken artefacts and battle the horrors of the deep in Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame. Our July expansion introduces a new challenge league, significant improvements to Abyss and Legion, the return of the Mercenaries of Trarthus, another new Ascendancy Class for the Scion, an all-new endgame system, and much more!

title: Kyuukyuu Enshi
description: A story-driven exploration horror adventure set in a fictional modern-day Japan. Experience a quiet tale of psychological horror as two schoolgirls confront folklore, curses, and choices that lead to multiple endings.

title: Homauton
description:
Trapped in a cramped landing pod with only a hibernation chamber and drone control computer, investigate the abandoned surface of a dead planet and build a rocket to escape before your family back home dies of old age.

Homauton is a tiny horror automation game where you are a new employee who was shipped to a job site on a dead planet but awoke from hibernation to find it completely abandoned.

title: Nebulis Entity
description: Nebulis Entity is a first person spaceship crew simulator, with support for online co-op. Maintain your vessel, track down and decode alien signals, and venture as far as you can - while doing your best to prevent your ship from falling apart around you.

title: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle - Silver Edition
FableBrawl
description: FableBrawl is a web-based high-fantasy auto-battler. Draft a hero, recruit characters and spells from a changing market, arrange a seven-slot warband, forge golden characters, discover powerful treasures, and outlast an eight-player realm in automatic tactical brawls. Play solo, gather friends in private rooms, or enter skill-based matchmaking.

title: The Dungeon of Lulu Farea: Rebirth
description: The Dungeon of Lulu Farea: Rebirth is an engaging blend of traditional turn-based RPG and puzzle game elements, boasting a complex world in which nothing is left to chance and every encounter matters. Genre classics such as fishing and side quests abound, and the game encourages thinking ahead to find the best way to obstacles in order to successfully clear the dungeon.

title: Gym Rat Simulator
description: Build a run-down local gym into a five-star fitness hotspot. Buy and arrange equipment, sell merchandise, hire staff, run fitness classes, train your character through workout minigames, and win competitions to grow your gym’s reputation.

title: Cave Looters
description: Chill co-op cowboy adventure. Up to 2 players!

title: Shunya
description:
Shunya is a survival horror game where you must escape a secret medical facility while uncovering the horrifying truth behind its human experiments. Trapped as Patient #17, you awaken with fragmented memories, pursued by the mysterious Janitor whose sole purpose is to erase every failed subject before they escape.

Search abandoned wards, laboratories, and restricted treatment rooms for key items needed to unlock your path forward while avoiding the Janitor's relentless patrols. Stay out of sight, listen carefully, and use the environment to survive as every patient file and hidden note reveals another piece of the facility's disturbing history.

Explore a claustrophobic research facility inspired by secret medical experiments, filled with abandoned equipment, unsettling patient records, and atmospheric environments designed to keep you constantly on edge. Every corridor hides a new danger, every room tells a forgotten story, and every discovery brings you closer to the truth.

Will you escape the facility... or become another terminated patient?

title: Sunny Side Up
description: Sunny Side Up is a cozy 3D parkour adventure game where you guide a brave little egg across a charming farm to reunite w/ your family. Master playful jumps, uncover hidden paths, & explore handcrafted levels on a heartfelt journey full of charm, one careful hop at a time. Can you find your way home?

title: Arctic Shift: Fuel Station
description: Operate a remote fuel station deep in the Arctic. Manage customers, supplies and vital systems while surviving brutal weather, wildlife and isolation.

title: Check-In Chaos
description: Run your own hotel — solo or in 1–4 player online co-op. Check guests in, cook and serve, run the spa and pool, hire staff, and upgrade your rooms from Standard to Luxury... before it all spirals into glorious chaos.

title: B-Prison Unchain
description: In this turn-based RPG, play as Misa, the supposedly strongest soldier in the Demon Realm, as she hunts down the legendary incubus Asmodeus. Battle through the succubi prison, recruit allies, and survive nasty traps, but beware! The enemies sent after you have plenty of tricks to slow you down!

title: Bob The Mad Rabbit
description: Cute. Furious. Unstoppable.

title: Meow Moments: Celebrating Frost & Flora
description: Join cute cats in a cozy getaway! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a snowy winter village and a peaceful Japanese cherry blossom park.

title: Kazuma Kaneko: Refined Arts Pack vol.2
Royal Pit
description: Spin for your life, pay with your soul.

title: Car Parking Simulator 2026
description: Challenge your parking skills.

title: Hotel 8
description: In Hotel 8, you find yourself caught in a loop. To break free, you must detect anomalies. Once you locate an anomaly, you have to decide which direction to take; making the wrong choice sends you right back to the beginning.

title: Ready or Not: The Deadline is Coming!
description: Join Shiiba Masashi on an unexpected journey from fan to creator when his sister's eroge company faces an "emergency"! With childhood friend Miku by his side, they dive into game development, unraveling secrets, love, and their true creative passions along the way!!

title: Cosmic Mart
description: Step into Cosmic Mart, the space supermarket where the deal of the day is certain death. Wipe out the relentless alien infestation devouring the facility in this frantic action roguelike. Choose your mercenary and survive long enough to reach the sixth floor.

title: Limitless Survivor
description: Incremental roguelite with infinite progression. Collect powerful artifacts, gather crystals, and scale your stats to absurd levels. Let auto-play handle the grind anytime—even while you're away.

title: Peerless Beauty Detective: Alice
description: A murder occurred at the Ai Qing Apartment. The female owner of Apartment 1802 died strangely. There was no struggle, no signs of a fight. Why did she die at night? Why wasn't the male owner at home? All the mysteries await the detective: Alice to solve. There is only one truth, let's find it!

title: Maze 95 Ultimate
description: The maze that hypnotized a generation is back. It was a screensaver. But now? You can finally walk those halls yourself. Or just relax and watch, like the old times.

title: RoboDeal Simulator
description: Design, craft, and trade robots on the frozen world of Xylaris-9. Serve factions, upgrade your facility, and shape your robotic legacy in Robodeal Simulator.

title: Norectus: Theatre of War
description:
Norectus: Rebellion is a digital collectible card game set in a gritty world of five nations locked in a decades-long war.

Collect from 400+ cards across five nations and a Neutral faction, each built around six elements (Flame, Frost, Nature, Spirit, Ki, Neutral) and more than 35 keyword mechanics. Build nation-aligned decks and take them into a deep roster of modes:

Ranked & Casual PvP: 1v1 ladder, 2v2, and free-for-all
Cooperative: team up to take down Raid Bosses and a persistent server-wide World Boss
The Gauntlet: a 100-floor roguelike climb with stacking boons and mini-bosses, solo or in a co-op party
Throne: defend your seat against an endless challenger queue
Story Campaign: 45 chapters of nation lore with NPC dialogue and branching paths
Grind your way up the level track, master your chosen nation, and climb the ELO rankings. Earn cosmetics, season-pass rewards, and nation essence along the way, then relive your best matches with full replay scrubbing.

Pick your nation and win the war.

title: Mammon’s Wager
