description: Mammon’s Wager is a narrative puzzle game blending psychological horror with resource management. Wager your remaining life at the demon's machine. When funds run low, choose to pawn memories, emotions, or organs. Every exchange weighs human value. For rebirth, how much of your "self" will you pay?

title: Dice Gun Commando
description: Guns roll dice. Dice trigger mods. Mods cause MAYHEM! Destroy waves of alien horrors in this bullet heaven roguelite by building an arsenal of dice-driven, synergistic weaponry.

title: Swish Ball Clicker
description: A cute, pixel-art, incremental basketball idler that every click is a swish. Automate your shots, upgrade your players, and go from being rookie to an all-star in this relaxing 2D indie baller. Perfect game to keep open in the background while you work.

title: Organize My Shop
description: Bring flawless order to the store! Switch between shelves and find the right items in the pile on the conveyor belt. Sort cheeses, meat delicacies, aromatic pastries, and sweets strictly according to the labels. Enjoy the moment of perfect order!

title: Traffic Survivor
description: Dodge traffic. Survive longer.

title: Mall Together
description: Run your mall. Open new stores, sign contracts with leading brands, hire teammates, and meet customer needs. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your mall.

title: Canvas of Thoughts
description: Canvas of Thoughts is an cozy point-and-click puzzle adventure which invites you into Evi's vibrant but loud inner world. Experience everyday situations through shifting colours, sounds and emotions. Solve reflective puzzles and navigate the world not through words, but through feelings.

title: Box Office Mayhem: Theatre Tycoon
description: Box Office Mayhem is a business management game where you simulate running your own movie theatre. Navigate through signing movie deals, managing day to day operations, and struggle as movie goers have unpredictable behavior. Play solo against AI competitors or take it online against friends!

title: Rail Route: Expect Delays
description: Add delays, failures, and maintenance to Rail Route. Build maintenance depots, dispatch service locomotives, and keep your network running when operations stop going to plan.

title: Huntin' Buddies
description: A 4-player online co-op hunting game set in a forbidden national park. Hunt wildlife to meet dangerous quotas, drag massive carcasses with your friends and evade the creatures that begin hunting you back.

title: Dino-Might
description: Dino-Might is a 2-4 player party fighting game where you control a tiny-armed t-rex in a fierce battle! Use arcade-inspired movement and power-ups to eliminate opponents, all while avoiding hazards. Easy to pick up, hard to put down, and built for all gamers. Only the best dino will survive!

title: Phantom Floor
description: You are trapped on the Phantom Floor. You must find a way to escape, but keep quiet, it's always listening.

title: LouveSystems' Realms
description: Realms is a strategy game where all actions are taken simultaneously then resolved all at once. With up to 8 players, there's no waiting for your turn here. Battle for land and for riches, upgrade your kingdom and follow your strategy to conquer other realms - become the one to rule them all.

title: World of Eggs: Idle Adventures
description: World of Eggs: Idle Adventures is a world where you can build your civilization, trade with players, fight in raids, and do it all in idle mode. The game automates all the routine!

title: Gigils
description: Gigils is an action packed multiplayer game where players will take on the role of cute alien creatures that bite, evolve, and brawl to capture control points. Choose your class, devour bugs or enemies to unlock powerful abilities, and grow stronger. Alien mayhem has never been this delicious.

title: Fate & Inflation
description: Fate & Inflation is a game that combines RPG roguelite elements with card building mechanics. Embark on a mysterious and unknown journey of fate, constantly strengthening yourself, and experience the thrilling charm of exponential combat power growth!

title: Discarded
description: Discarded is action rougelike, arena shooter where you face waves of relentless enemies. You’re alone and outgunned - move fast, shoot faster, dodge the bullets and upgrade on the fly. Keep up with the pressure or get shredded like the rest.

title: My Tasty Husband
description: Murders quietly upend May's life. A strange husband, a reckless courier, a dutiful officer—reality and hallucination blur together. In this narrative adventure of food, intimacy, and death, make choices as May and reach her ending. If she can still tell what she's eaten from what she's loved...

title: Gnome Glade
description: Gnome Glade - a cozy city builder puzzle with deckbuilding. Help gnomes build a village in a magic forest! Grow and merge mushrooms, build your deck of cards, and raise a golden statue. Create a gnome paradise!

title: Some of You May Die
description: Create an overpowered squad of heroes to fight for you. Each run is different. Heroes are granted random boosted abilities making each unique. Go head to head against other players online or overcome the challenging singleplayer campaign in this one-of-a-kind roguelike autobattler!

title: Aster Pebble and the Case of Bad Bureaucracy
description: A short and cozy point and click time loop mystery. Join Aster Pebble as she solves mysteries and helps those in need as she takes on her first adventure in a modern fantasy world. Overcome bureaucracy via direct action in this funny little adventure filled with intriguing oddball characters.

title: City States: Medieval
description: You are the leader of a city-state in high medieval Europe. Expand your city through deep city-building systems, build a trade empire across the known world, and lead men to war to defend trade routes in a high-stakes struggle of global strategy and brutal tower defense warfare.

title: The Alley
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore a maze-like Korean alley, photograph and identify supernatural 'Demon Traces' from realistic illusions, and escape while evading a relentless ghost.

title: Astray: Zero
description: A 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game. You constantly defeat monsters and advance to the next level. In the hand-drawn game world, you will fight alongside a girl named Zero, uncovering the truth of this game world during a fantastical journey!

title: An Eggstremely Hard Game
description: Two geese. One fragile egg. Infinite chaos. Work together to carry it through unpredictable challenges without breaking it, every crack makes it harder, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of honking.

title: Legacy of Shadows
description: "Legacy of Shadows" is a Wuxia roguelite. From avenging your fallen sect to unraveling the "Eternal Dragon" conspiracy, master fluid builds to cut through a world of intrigue and shatter the eternal scheme.

title: Backrooms Anomaly
description: Explore a looping corridor filled with anomalies. Walk through the fluorescent-lit backrooms environment, examine your surroundings, and spot subtle changes in reality.

title: Tulip Season
description: Tulip Season is an incremental farming sim built from small, satisfying routines. Beauty has a number, and you make it go up. Unlock new tulips and field upgrades, breed new colours, and help out when the neighbours come by.

title: Ashbound Expanse
description: This is a fast-paced first-person and third-person shooter that blends roguelike elements, offering easy-to-learn mechanics, satisfying controls, and intense gunplay. Combined with highly immersive visuals, it delivers a thrilling and exhilarating shooting experience.

title: No Fox Season
description: One rainy day you come home from the store and find a wounded fox on the road. In spite of your strict parents who forbid you to have pets, you decide to take her in.

title: Dawn Car
description: “Pixel art” is too soft a word! This is the story of the Pre-Pixel Age… A dazzling world built entirely from 8×8 character graphics— the vibrant construction set of a Digital Tangram World.

title: Oceanic Rails
description: Oceanic Rails is a game about building your island and creating combinations of crops, helpers, animals, modifiers, upgrades and more to pay your rent at the end of the week. Try out challenges and overcome the tricky weather or build you island worry free and create a beautiful pixel art world.

title: Catio Simulator
description: Catio Simulator is a casual incremental game with a satisfying gameplay loop: pet cats, adopt them out, collect adoption fees, and use the proceeds to upgrade your petting ability and fill your catio with new toys, plants, furniture, and expansions that attract even more cats.

title: The Afterlife Cafe
description: The Afterlife Cafe is a cozy visual novel centered around death and traveling to the afterlife. In the living world, meet and chat with your concierges at the cafes. Then take a temporary trip to the afterlife and learn the stories of those who have passed. Experience moving between the living and spirit realms in this narrative-driven game.

title: Robo Miner: Remastered
description: Dig deep, collect ores, and upgrade your robot in this remastered classic mining adventure with improved graphics and smarter gameplay.

title: Black Goat
description: The game is a BL Cthulhu-style narrative romance game. It tells the story of the protagonist struggling to survive on a cruise ship filled with strange events after losing their memory. The game's setting is modern with a Cthulhu-inspired narrative.

title: Boba Cafe Simulator
description: Reborn at my venture's start. Last life, poor management got my milk tea shop crushed by rivals. At the door, sweet milk scent hit me, fired me up. Now, "Frost Citadel" aims to haunt the milk tea world. With my friend, we’ll set up to rule this street.

title: Codename Cure II
description: Codename CURE II is an upcoming co-operative first person shooter set in the aftermath of a zombie apocalypse. Create an elite military squad with up to five players and fight your way through hordes of zombies in a variety of dynamic objective missions.

title: Papercraft Tactics
description: In Papercraft Tactics, your backpack is your lifeline. Navigate branching paths, battle fierce foes, and collect powerful items to craft the ultimate loadout. With a dark, hand-drawn style, every choice matters in this thrilling roguelite adventure. Will you survive?

title: Abyss Kitchen
description: Abyss Kitchen is a survival action game in which you play the role of Lop a cook who accompanies a party of adventurers, and guides them with the power of food. Feed yourself in the dungeon and eat whatever you can to keep from starving and falling down. Eat up anything that stands in your way!

title: Bookbinding
description: A quiet bookshop. A magical past. A murder and Tarot cards that can twist fate itself. Craft beautiful covers, read between the lines of your customers’ lives, and decide which secrets deserve to stay hidden… including your own.

title: Find Us Cats
description: Find Us Cats is a new hidden object game starring our favorite feline friends! Find dozens of cats in each level and aim for a high score in the Planetarium and San Francisco. Don't forget to try out the Painting mode! ️

title: Zavod: Conveyor Logic
description: ZAVOD is a minimalist puzzle game focused on setting up conveyor line operations.

title: Dreadweave
description: Immerse yourself in a horror extraction shooter where you must escape a Soviet ghost town with a monster from an upside-down world tracking your heartbeat. Arm yourself, gather resources, and fight to survive. Death is just the beginning—it's your gateway to an inside-out reality.

title: Second Dreamer
description: Rent games, pick out a movie for movie night, buy fireworks, explore the town and neighborhood, the world is yours but this particular night holds many secrets.

title: Infinitevania
description: Explore different worlds, defeat enemies and challenging bosses, in search of power to destroy the core of infinitevania.

title: Taolu
description: Becoming a kung fu master has never been that much fun! In Taolu you can train your martial arts skills respecting the essence of the real kung fu, expanded with the wonder of a VR game. Master curated sets of choreographed movements using a realistic wooden dummy.

title: Scrap Mechanic
description: Enter the creative paradise of Scrap Mechanic! Build fantastic machines, go on adventures with your friends and defend against waves of evil Farmbots in this imaginative multiplayer survival sandbox. With Scrap Mechanic’s powerful creation tools you can engineer your own adventures!

title: Echo Resonance
description: A classic science-fiction point-and-click adventure inspired by the genre’s greatest titles, where you’ll control two characters and solve ingenious puzzles using an innovative temporal superposition mechanic.

title: Ashbound: Endless Hunt
description: Ashbound: Endless Hunt is an active incremental action RPG where every click fuels the fight. Slay escalating waves and bosses, forge 100 weapon tiers, build a powerful party, complete relic sets, master combat upgrades, and prestige to return stronger and push deeper into the endless hunt.

title: Lost Vessel
description: Idle sci-fi RPG where combat actually matters. Crash-landed on an alien world, you rebuild through five skills, melee/ranged/void-magic combat, and a server-wide world boss. Progress keeps going while you're AFK. Solo, co-op, or faction raids. Free to play. No pay-to-win.

title: Cultist
description: Cultist is card game about begining of the religions and the way they grow, interact and even become immortal. Can you outgrow the world that contains yourself and become much bigger?

title: Zombuffoonery
description: Survive in a bloody hell! Build fortifications, deploy turrets, and fend off waves of zombies. Upgrade with coins, use weapons from a pistol to an axe, and unlock 10 hardcore achievements.

title: Cornhole Hero
description: Experience the absolute lowest-resolution backyard sports game possible in this quirky, ultra-minimalist cornhole simulator. Master intuitive swipe-to-toss physics, swish or slide your way through 3 frantic arcade modes, and fight for global leaderboard supremacy. No rules. Just bags.

title: Hentai Furry Wolfy 2
description: Hentai Furry Wolfy 2 is an erotic hentai puzzle game that takes you into a wild fantasy world where a charming wolf girl with fluffy ears, a beautiful tail, and an enchanting gaze awaits you. Solve puzzles, unlock stunning artwork, and immerse yourself in an atmosphere of adventure and romance!

title: Desire Empire
description: Desire Empire is an adult business management simulator where you build your own content empire. Hire models, upgrade studios, promote shows, and rake in millions from steamy performances. Do you have what it takes to dominate the industry and win over audiences worldwide?

title: For Honor: Arakure - Hero
description:
The Arakure Hero offer includes:

- 1 New Hero: Arakure
- 1 Ornament
- 1 Elite Outfit
- 7-Day Champion Status (extra XP, extra loot, and more)
- 3 Scavenger Crates with random gear

Live by your own rules and rely on your instincts. Take on multiple opponents and fight dirty to steal another victory. Wielding tonfas, Arakure packs a punch. Her brazen personality brings a unique perspective to the Samurai faction and with weapons never seen before, she is not afraid to do what it takes to win a fight. Explosive, scrappy, Arakure will hit you where it hurts.

title: Reefling
description: Reefling is a calm desktop aquarium that sits in the corner of your screen. Feed your fish with a click, earn shells over time, and collect over 150 pixel-art species. Decorate the tank and watch day turn to night. Your fish never starve and you can't lose, so just relax while you work.

title: Harvest Dice Profit
description: Harvest Dice Profit is an Incremental Idle Farming & Dice Game where you grow diceshrooms into dice, roll for profit, and automate your economy. Stay ahead of debt... or face the consequences.

title: Zyrcon
description: A mouse-only, endless sci-fi arcade shooter with dead-simple controls — just aim and auto-fire kicks in. Shatter asteroids into plasma cores, wield three upgradeable weapons, freeze time, and survive endless difficulty scaling.

title: Fading Light and Summer's Shadow
description: Uncover the hidden truth behind a summer festival in this Japanese-style story adventure.

title: Full Metal Nun
description: Sister Hel has seven seconds before her Grace runs out. Teleport and cross through gunfire, leaving explosive Martyrs in your wake. Draw sacred borders and invoke devastating Judgement bolts to purge waves of heretic machines.

title: Professional Chef
description: Transform simple ingredients into delicious dishes in Professional Chef. Buy, cook, sell, upgrade, and unlock new recipes. Optimize your processes, master every detail, and rise to culinary excellence in this engaging idle cooking experience!

title: Dino Jump Deluxe
description: Race against time in this frantic, side-scrolling endless runner. Master simple, high-speed controls to unlock a roster of mechanically distinct dinosaurs and a variety of biome colors. In Dino Jump, every collectable counts toward your ultimate prehistoric evolution.

title: Dancers
description: Reach for the stars!

title: Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni itsu no ma ni ka Dame Ningen ni Sareteita ken: Memorial Vacation
description:
Let's share a sweet and frustrating trip to Okinawa together.
The TV anime "The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten" is getting on its first console game adaptation. The bittersweet love story of the original work is fully captured in this original story.

title: Killing Floor III: Operation Shadow Hunter
description: A 4th season of Killing Floor III. It adds new perk, map, boss, campaign missions and more.

title: Coin Tavern
description: Coin Tavern is not your average tavern! In this roguelike game, you’ll wield a wild array of quirky coins to build your one-of-a-kind coin deck. Hoard coins, refine strategies, streamline your deck, unlock hidden treasures, and land outrageous combos in randomized runs!

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Rick Strowd
Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Season Pass 3
description:
Season Pass 3
- DLC Character 1 "Rick Strowd"
- DLC Character 2 "Duck King" (August 2026)
- DLC Character 3 "Kim Kaphwan" (September 2026)
- DLC Character 4 "Manjiro Sano & Ken Ryuguji" (October 2026)
- DLC Character 5 "Laocorn" (November 2026)
- DLC Character 6 "???" (December 2026)
- Additional stages

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Mr. Karate
description: Grants access to the following in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves. - DLC character "Mr. Karate" - Additional stage

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Blue Mary
description: Grants access to the following in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves. - DLC character "Blue Mary" - Additional stage

title: Green Thicket
description: Relaxing exploration game where you wander through a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, and interact with the world at your own pace.

title: Girls Wars 1939
description: An all-new squad of beautiful girl soldiers rewrites history in this one-of-a-kind World War II universe! A brand-new engine delivers an epic evolution unlike anything you've played before!

title: The Seven Crystal Petals: The Blossom Realm
description: Embark on a heartwarming narrative adventure with Princess Yumi and restore harmony to the Blossom Realm.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Armadillo Racing
description: Never Seen Before?! An Active Racing Game!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Mouser
description: Put those nasty mice to rest!

title: Arcade Archives: Armadillo Racing
description:
"Armadillo Racing" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1997.
Control an armadillo that rolls as it picks up speed, and head for the finish line through obstacle courses filled with unique events, or sprint courses designed for pure racing enjoyment. Finish in 1st place and you can enjoy a fun bonus game, too!

title: Console Archives: The Conveni
description:
The Conveni was released by Human in 1997 for a 32-bit home console.
This simulation game lets you experience the management of a convenience store, from assessing the actions of rival stores, local needs, and product demands, to managing the entire business and conducting sales activities such as in-store sales.
Let's take a good look at your "convenience store business sense"!!
Enjoy the experience of running your usual convenience store from a management perspective.

title: Pet World
description: Collect awesome pets, farm tons of gold, and discover Magical Kingdoms!

title: Zombie War
description: Zombie War plunges players into a relentless battle for survival against hordes of the undead.

title: Hunted
description: Run. Hide. Survive. A ruthless butcher stalks your every move in this tense first-person horror experience.

title: The Lonely Miner
description: A 2d pixel art incremental clicker/idle Mining game. You are dropped onto an Island, with a pickaxe and a dream. Collect rocks, sell rocks, hire workers and get rich!

title: ChatGladiators
description: ChatGladiators is an interactive Twitch battle game for streamers where viewers become fighters. Streamers connect their Twitch account, start a battle, and let their community compete for victory in an arena.

title: Sniper Game
description: Sniper Game is a first-person precision shooter built on a single idea: prove you are the best shot in the world. One handcrafted battleground, relentless escalating waves, and a global leaderboard scoring every shot. Two buildings, three rankings climb the World Championship.

title: A Love Letter in Snowfall
description: A Love Letter in Snowfall is a live-action, multi-ending interactive romance movie game. As a young B&B keeper in a small southern town, you meet, and fall for a visiting actress every choice rewrites your love story. Meet someone, and fall in love that trembles in bones.

title: Square Brain Puzzle
description: The more you think, the better it feels! Easy to play, deep enough to get hooked

title: Super Goldfish Scooping
description:
It's goldfish scooping like you've never seen it before!
Scoop up crazy goldfish one after another!

title: To the Basement: Before
description: Perform precise movements Defeat the bosses Complete the levels

title: Steam Girls
description: A puzzle game featuring many Steam Girls is here!

title: Seven Deadly Sins: Anime Girls Fantasy Love
Learn Through Riddles! Masterpieces of the World
description:
A masterpiece is wasted if you only glance at it.
Solve the riddles, and the world's great paintings come alive.

title: Flip-Flip Jigsaw Girls
description: Clear Both Sides♪ A Cute Girl Puzzle Game Featuring the Unique "Flip-Flip" Challenge!

title: Eggconsole Dragon Slayer Level 2.0 PC-8801
description: Nihon Falcom’s classic Action RPG returns in "2.0"! Slay the three-headed dragon to retrieve the four crowns.

title: The Chilling Moment You Realize It: Creepy Meaning Psychological Test
description: The answer you choose reveals a hidden truth about you. And the instant you finish reading it — a chill.

title: Zumba: Marble Jungle Adventure
description: Awaken the jungle spirits—match, blast, and conquer the marble wilds!

title: They Came for Blood
description:
They Came for Blood is a desk simulation game. Your goal is to make it through the month and make enough income to afford rent in your apartment. Greet donors at the blood bank, look at their ID to determine if they're good to donate blood, and either let them inside, or reject them for not meeting the requirements. Sometimes vampires try to slip in, which can spell disaster for the hospital staff. Let in too many vampires, and the staff will be picked off one by one until you're the only one left to suck dry.

There are multiple endings, and several decisions to make while sorting donors as quickly as possible. They Came for Blood has a branching save file system, in case you've realized you've made a horrible mistake and need to turn back the clock.

title: Seven Deadly Sins: Anime Boys Fantasy Love
description:
Seven sins. Seven boys. None of them willing to make it easy.
Are you ready to earn their trust?

title: Chilling Urban Legends
description:
Behind every scary rumour lies a hidden "truth."
Find the chilling clue inside a single picture.

title: Memory of Memorie: A Chill Story
description:
The more you focus, the more the story unfolds.
A chill work adventure with a girl from another world.
Focus time no longer spent alone, for you.

title: 7 Shifts in Subway
description:
Every night shift follows the same route. Every passenger follows their own rules. Break just one… and they stop being human.

Take the role of a night subway driver trapped in a nightmare where every passenger hides a deadly secret. Observe, remember, and follow an ever-growing list of mysterious rules to survive all seven shifts. Every mistake has consequences, and every new night introduces horrors you've never seen before.

title: Tolem
description: Explore. Transform. Fight. Switch between robotic forms with unique abilities. Each form changes how you play.

title: Coloring Pixels: Collection 7
description: A relaxing coloring-by-numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with different themes, levels of complexity, and sizes.

title: Project Corner
description: Project Corner is a fast-paced, tactical multiplayer Prop Hunt game where the classic childhood hide-and-seek hits a whole new level of tension and comedy.

title: Supermarket Simulator: Idle Tycoon Clicker
description: Start with a small market and build a huge supermarket empire! In Supermarket Simulator: Idle Tycoon Clicker, fill your shelves, satisfy your customers, make upgrades, increase your income, and grow your store. Click, manage, earn, and reach the top!

title: Car Sales Simulator
description: Car Sales Simulator is the ultimate dealership game where you become a true car dealer and build your own automotive empire. This is more than just a selling game - it's a full-on trade and business simulator experience!

title: Queen's Blade Re:Build
description: A roguelite deckbuilder featuring strong, beautiful female warriors. We fused real time card games and roguelite together to make the exciting single player deckbuilder. Discover new cards and item, Craft a strong deck. Break your rival of all their armor and defeat them with a finishing move!

title: Koko's Cafe
description: Serve coffee and befriend customers as you learn their story in this coming-of-age visual novel.

title: GalactiWar: Empire Simulator
description: Watch empires rise and fall, or intervene with godly powers, in GalactiWar, a space empire simulation sandbox game.

title: Lost in the Fogbound Deadwood
description: You are already lost. Most will never escape the Deadwood. Dense fog slowly destroys your sense of direction, your confidence, and eventually your mind as you search for keys, resources, and escape routes. Escape within 60 minutes… before the Deadwood consumes you completely.

title: Pixelwave Off
description: Pixelwave Off is a backrooms-mascot horror game set in the 2000s.You return to search for your friend, who disappeared a few years ago.Find him and uncover the dark secrets hidden within Pixelwave Entertainment.

title: The Others Will Join Shortly
description: A variation on classic memory game in horror setting. Cards can change, you have to stay focused, catching replaced card is a life or death situation. Play the cards. Track the changes. Survive the week. Collect your pay check.

title: Aether Crown
description: A fantasy visual novel with simulation and turn-based RPG elements. Manage Carl's schedule, complete guild requests, build relationships, develop his stats and equipment, and make choices that lead to multiple endings.

title: A Game About Getting Bigger
description: A Game About Getting Bigger is a loot-driven incremental game about feeding a growing black hole. Destroy celestial bodies to make the black hole at the center grow larger and larger.

title: Where Winds Meet: Hidden Mountain
description: Where Winds Meet: Hidden Mountain is the third major update for the adventure, adding a new mountainous region built with deep vertical terrain. Exploration is shaped by multi-layered elevations, leading to hidden surprises across the peaks. The expansion also introduces the secretive Mohist sect, bringing fresh mysteries, new martial-arts gameplay mechanics, and narrative twists to continue the journey.

title: The Deepest Castle
description: You are a mighty knight - how powerful your blows are! And in the very center of a vast forest lies a fortress filled with evil and black magic. There, they raise the dead and hide great artifacts. You decide to explore the fortress and see what the black magicians are hiding.

title: One More Delve
description: One More Delve is a physics based dungeon crawler hack and slash adventure. Fight, loot, and explore alone or in up to 3 player co-op as you delve in the dungeons and wield a diverse arsenal of one-handed and two-handed melee weapons, bows, shields, and powerful spells.

title: Hard Edge: War Zone
description: Hard Edge is back as a 4v4 real-time tactical card battler! Combine strategic deck-building with simultaneous team actions. Every turn, draw cards to shoot, throw, or defend. Sacrifice cards to move in a high-stakes tactical "WAR ZONE."

title: DragonSword: Awakening
description: Explore the anime-style open world of the Continent of Orbis, brought to life with Unreal Engine 5! Recruit unique companions, unleash spectacular Status Ailment tag-team action, and embark on an epic journey to save the world from the threat of a Dragon reawakened after 60 years.

title: Worlds Upon The Wind
description: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

title: Atomcraft
description: Adventure in a world where every pixel is physically and chemically simulated! In this ever-evolving sandbox, creativity meets chaos, and the only limit is your imagination!

title: Switch the Darkness
description: Memorize the room. Spot the anomaly. Flip the switch. If you miss a detail, the loop resets. A psychological horror where your attention is the only weapon against a shifting reality. Can you break the cycle?

title: Gamble: Hard Exit
description: Gamble for your family. Master the slot machine, pay off your debt, and save your family.

title: Dryad
description: Dryad is an island-building adventure where management and exploration intertwine. Grow your sanctuary. Brave the unknown. Push back the darkness.

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Wolfgang Krauser
description: Grants access to the following in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves. - DLC character "Wolfgang Krauser" - Additional stage

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Nightmare Geese
description: Grants access to the following in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves. - DLC character "Nightmare Geese"

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Kim Jae Hoon
description: Grants access to the following in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves. - DLC character "Kim Jae Hoon" - Additional stage

title: Echoes From Ciudadela
description:
Echoes from Ciudadela is a first-person adventure and puzzle-solving game focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and narrative discovery. You play as Katari, who follows the trail of his recently dead father after uncovering his journal, that leads him to a sealed mountain known as Ciudadela.

Throughout the journey, your main artifact is a Balearic sling, a tool tied to both the environment and the forgotten technologies hidden within the mountain. As you dive deeper and solve puzzles, you’ll unlock journal entries left behind by Katari’s father. Each revealing pieces of a lost civilization and their connection to time, invention, and legacy.

title: Bobble Shop Simulator
description: Take control of your very own bobble head shop. Sell, buy, trade, and repair a large variety of bobble heads and related merchandise. Stock shelves, hire employees, and grow your business. Pay attention though, as these bobble heads sometimes have a mind of their own.

title: Hololive Dreams
description:
The first official hololive mobile game is here, featuring a rhythm & RPG gameplay!
Centered around rhythm games, the game includes a variety of content such as theme park development and mini-games!
Over 50 hololive members make an appearance, and the initial tracklist will include 150+ songs!
A game that both hololive fans and newcomers can enjoy. The way you play is entirely up to you!

title: Ella's Nightmare
description: Linear single-player game with puzzles and alternate endings. Control Ella and explore the rooms of the house, solving puzzles to progress and escape before becoming a victim of the lurking creature.

title: Valkyrie Tune: Synthesis of Souls
description:
A visual novel that brings the "Valkyrie Tune" plastic model series by Good Smile Company to life.
Experience the resonant story of an amnesiac protagonist and six stunning heroines, whose intertwining serenade of love, sorrow, and fateful encounters calls forth a reboot for the future.

title: Under His Eyes
description: Under His Eyes is a gritty, story-driven strategy game where you play a crime boss. Make game-changing decisions, manage your crew and income, send operatives on missions, seize districts, and eliminate rivals. Will you rise through subtlety, rule with fear, or fall to a small-time gang?

title: Luminas: Parasite Reign
description: A single-player, party-based roguelite where you control up to 3 heroes at once. Face relentless enemies and unique bosses, unlock powerful treasures, and forge new builds through multiple skill paths. Each run offers fresh upgrades, combos, and strategic choices in your fight to survive.

title: Void Future: Hacking Protocol
description: In Void Future: Hacking Protocol, you play as a hacker in a cyberpunk world ruled by corporations. Hack, solve puzzles, and uncover a global conspiracy. Hunted by a system that never sleeps, you’ll need to stay hidden, outsmart surveillance, and fight to survive.

title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
description: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise. Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation true to the series’ roots, proprietary rollback netcode, and full cross-play for smooth, competitive gameplay.

title: TheVillage: Possession
description: A cursed village serves as the setting for this single-player psychological horror adventure. As you are drawn into a demonic scheme, solve spooky puzzles, evade deadly spirits, and discover sinister secrets. first in the series TheVillage Chronicles.

title: Club Soko
description: Navigate your way deep into an underground nightclub and discover secrets hidden in its depths.

title: Market Empire Simulator
description: Market Empire Simulator is a business management game where you build, run, and optimize your own supermarket. Manage inventory, hire employees, stock shelves, and expand your store to create the ultimate shopping experience.

title: Doomsday Diner
description: Chaos! Cooking! Combat! In a post-apocalyptic world where hot dogs are cheap and life is cheaper, you manage the last functioning hot dog diner. Cook hot dogs, brew coffee and serve bizarre orders. Upgrade your diner and shoot down raiders who want your hard-earned cash.

title: LinkShift
description: A abstract arcade-style puzzle game with roguelite elements in which you place Nodes on a grid to try and form big connection chains. Use Upgrades and Master Nodes to change the rules or break them.

title: Staffer Retro : A Supernatural Mystery Quest
description: Staffer Retro is a mystery adventure game where you uncover past incidents related to ‘Mana’, the source of supernatural powers. Gather information through dialogue and exploration, and piece together clues found in documents to guide the choices of Verita Retro, the protagonist.

title: Joe Adventure
description: Keep moving or explode! Control multiple Joes to solve puzzles in order to save your siblings and Joe Mama from the grasps of the food factory!

title: Splatoon Raiders
description:
Splat scores of enemies and hunt for treasure in this single-player focused action shooter.

Play as a mechanic working with Deep Cut – a trio of swashbuckling musicians – and venture out into the mysterious Spirhalite Islands! Customize your character, kit yourself out with mechanical gadgets and ink-splattering weapons, and take on waves of foes called Salmonids as you raid the islands for salvage.

This is mainly a single-player adventure, but you won’t be alone: one member of Deep Cut will raid alongside you in a powerful bot. You can also join with up to three other players online or via local wireless.

title: Viral Reload EX
description: Viral Reload EX is a sci-fi shoot-em-up with a unique dash mechanic where you shrink down to fight infections at a microscopic scale! Can you defeat the evil Kyle Kaboom before he destroys the moon?

title: Dodo Duckie
description: Aliens abducted your chicken friends! Play as Dodo, a brave but slightly clueless duck on a mission to bring them home. The twist? Swap between 2D and 3D perspectives INSTANTLY to solve platforming puzzles and explore a cozy, charming world full of surprises

title: Luna: Obscura
description: A first-person psychological horror game of hiding, solving, and surviving inside a haunted moon base

title: Dinoblade
description: Dinoblade is an action RPG game that takes place right after a major event that changed what we know about Dinosaurs. You shall set out on a journey as a young Spinosaurus that can use a Great Sword fighting against other Dinosaurs that uses weapons as well to stop an extinction.

title: Car Service Simulator
description: Car Service Simulator is a car service business simulation game where you start from scratch and work your way up. Take the chance to successfully run your own service center, offering a wide range of services from car repair to painting and modification.

title: Grim Dawn: Fangs of Asterkarn
description: In this latest massive installment of Grim Dawn, you will journey West into the rugged wilderness of Asterkarn and contend with the mighty Kurn. Discover the dark legacy that continues to haunt these nomadic people and again drives them East, towards renewed conflict.

title: Wonderia
description: Wonderia is a MANGA style open-world sandbox for 1-8 players. Unique blend of sci-fi life-sim and dungeon exploration. Transform into alien adorably quirky creatures, craft, farm, fight, recruit space travellers, and build your cosmic adventure!

title: Helix: Descent N Ascent
description: Helix is an adventure game taking place in a melancholic disembodied world. Combine your powers to solve puzzles and explore further and deeper.

title: Celestial Descends
description: "Tianlin Hunyuan" is a Chinese-style Xianxia SRPG with chess strategy and Roguelike elements, set in an open world. Players uncover lies and pursue freedom in a complex world of deep emotions and power struggles, embarking on an epic strategic and emotional adventure.

title: Battle Echoes
description: Take command of the mech and become the ultimate strategist. Construct impregnable defense facilities, handpick potent skills, lead your troops, and defy relentless enemy assaults. Will you emerge victorious in this thrilling battle for supremacy?
